title: Specialist, Technology Risk Management
description:
****Job Description****
**Specialist, Technology Risk Management**
**The Opportunity**

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  
****Role Overview****
The position acts as a trusted risk advisor, translating technical risk into business context and supporting the implementation of practical, risk-based controls that enable safe business operations and innovation.
  
  
The Business Information Risk Specialist supports the alignment of cybersecurity, information risk management, and compliance activities of the Information Technology Risk Management & Security (ITRMS) organization with the objectives of our company’s Research Laboratories Business Unit. The role partners with one of the IT, business stakeholders supporting research, development, clinical operations, regulatory, and ITRMS to identify, assess, document, and help mitigate information security and compliance risks across applications, data, cloud services, third parties, and digital initiatives.
  
  
****What Will You Do In This Role****

* Support risk advisory engagements for IT and business teams across research, development, clinical trials operations, regulatory activities, and related enabling functions.
* Help translate cybersecurity and compliance requirements into clear, practical actions for product teams, application owners, project teams, and business stakeholders.
* Participate in planning forums, product discussions, and program governance activities to help identify security, privacy, data integrity, and compliance considerations early in the lifecycle.
* Prepare concise risk summaries, decision options, and status updates for review by BIRO leadership and stakeholders.
* Support maintenance of related risk registers, including risk statements, ownership, treatment plans, target dates, residual risk, and evidence of closure.
* Assist business and technology owners in evaluating risk treatment options, including mitigation, compensating controls, exception requests, acknowledgement, transfer, or acceptance, in accordance with enterprise requirements.
* Track remediation commitments, follow up with accountable owners, validate supporting evidence, and escalate overdue or material items through the appropriate BIRO lead.
* Technology and Cybersecurity Risk

+ Support reviews of architecture, solution design, and operational controls for systems and digital capabilities, including identity and access, configuration, vulnerability management, data protection, integration security, backup, recovery, and business continuity.
+ Contribute to Crown Jewel application governance by coordinating control reviews, risk posture updates, remediation tracking, and readiness activities.
+ Assist with risk analysis for emerging technologies and innovation, including artificial intelligence, machine learning, advanced analytics, cloud platforms, laboratory technologies, and external data exchange.
+ Partner with cybersecurity and technology subject-matter experts to clarify control requirements and document practical remediation recommendations.

* Compliance, Assurance, and Incident Support

+ Support compliance and assurance activities relevant to including control testing, audits, inspections, assessments, and remediation follow-up in regulated environments.
+ Help evaluate technology risks affecting GxP-regulated processes, sensitive research and clinical information, privacy obligations, records retention, intellectual property, and data integrity.
+ Support security event and incident coordination by gathering facts, documenting business impact, monitoring corrective actions, and connecting stakeholders with the appropriate response teams.
+ Contribute to the development and operationalization of security guidance, standards, procedures, and reusable job aids for teams.

* Risk Visibility, Awareness, and Continuous Improvement

+ Prepare routine risk reporting and operational updates that highlight risk trends, remediation status, milestones, dependencies, and items requiring leadership awareness.
+ Analyze recurring issues and identify opportunities to improve risk processes, stakeholder guidance, controls, reporting, and customer experience.
+ Contribute to targeted cybersecurity awareness and training for audiences, tailored to scientific, clinical, regulatory, and technology work practices.
+ Stay informed about relevant cyber threats, regulatory expectations, industry practices, and emerging technologies, and raise potential impacts for review.

****What Should You Have****

* Bachelor's degree in information technology, cybersecurity, computer science, data science, engineering, life sciences, business administration, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 3 to 6 years of experience.

****Required Skills****

* Experience or demonstrated foundational knowledge in cybersecurity, technology risk management, IT compliance, IT audit, privacy, quality, or a related field.
* Experience supporting risk assessments, control reviews, remediation tracking, or compliance activities is preferred.
* Experience in a regulated industry, particularly pharmaceuticals, life sciences, healthcare, research, clinical operations, or manufacturing, is preferred but not required.
* Exposure to cloud, application, data, AI, laboratory, or operational technology security is beneficial.
* Skills and Competencies

+ Foundational understanding of security controls, technology risks, vulnerabilities, data protection, and risk treatment concepts.
+ Ability to analyze information, identify gaps, organize evidence, and produce clear, prioritized, and actionable recommendations.
+ Ability to explain technical and compliance topics in understandable business language.
+ Strong written and verbal communication, organization, follow-through, and attention to detail.
+ Ability to collaborate across scientific, clinical, regulatory, technology, privacy, quality, legal, procurement, and cybersecurity teams.
+ Comfort working independently on defined assignments while seeking guidance appropriately for complex or material risk decisions.
+ Adaptability, learning agility, sound judgment, and a practical, service-oriented approach.
+ High integrity and discretion when handling sensitive research, clinical, regulatory, security, and business information.

* Preferred Credentials

+ Entry-level or developing certifications in cybersecurity, risk, audit, privacy, cloud, project management, or data governance are beneficial.
+ Advanced certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, or CRISC may be valuable for career growth but are not required for this Specialist role.

****Primary Skills (Must Have)****

* Cybersecurity Fundamentals
* Technology Risk Management
* IT Compliance and Governance
* Risk Assessments and Control Reviews
* Vulnerability and Security Risk Analysis
* Data Protection and Information Security Controls
* Risk Remediation Tracking and Management
* IT Audit and Assurance Support
* Security Control Evaluation
* Risk Reporting and Documentation
* Stakeholder Management and Cross-functional Collaboration
* Strong Written and Verbal Communication Skills
* Regulatory and Compliance Awareness
* Incident and Risk Management
* Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills

****Secondary Skills (Nice To Have)****

* Pharmaceutical, Life Sciences, Healthcare, Clinical Operations, or Manufacturing Industry Experience
* Cloud Security
* Application Security
* Data Security and Data Governance
* Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning Risk Management
* Laboratory Technology Security
* Operational Technology (OT) Security
* Privacy and Data Protection Regulations
* Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery
* Crown Jewel Application Governance
* Cybersecurity Awareness and Training
* Audit and Inspection Support
* Third-Party Risk Management
* Project Management
* Certifications such as Security+, CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, or similar (preferred but not required).

****Who We Are****
We are known as Merck & Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
  
  
****What We Look For****
Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.
  
  
Additional location(s) Compensation Information

Ultimately, your mission is to empower practitioners through meaningful relationships and shared best practices that help our engineering community thrive with our tools while ensuring internal teams deeply understand their evolving needs.

* Actively engage and support the internal Roche engineering community through inner-sourcing initiatives, internal tech talks, and hackathons.
* Represent internal engineer needs by providing direct feedback on bugs, creating feature requests, and documenting workflow friction to help platform product squads improve the developer experience.
* Maintain a strong presence and high credibility within internal communication channels, developer forums, and technical communities relevant to Roche engineers and non-technical creators.
* Encourage, simplify, and drive the organic adoption of E3 capabilities across the company.
* Engage as a technical spokesperson and champion for the E3 organization across Roche business units.
* Communicate developer feedback trends, platform adoption milestones, and workflow bottlenecks clearly to E3 leadership and stakeholders.
* Act as a mentor and resource for internal engineers and platform squad members, sharing technical knowledge, best practices, and guidance on embedded AppSec and AI tools.
* Contribute directly to platform product vision discussions, advocating for critical improvements in documentation, API usability, and the end-to-end developer experience.

Who You Are:

title: Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – Technical Learning & Development
description:
About the Role

Hindustan Platinum Pvt. Ltd. is seeking a technically proficient Learning & Development professional to design, implement and continuously improve technical training and skill development initiatives across its manufacturing operations.

The role involves managing the complete technical training lifecycle, from identifying competency gaps and developing training programs to evaluating learning effectiveness and strengthening technical capabilities across the organisation.

We are looking for a proactive, self-motivated professional with strong technical understanding, execution capabilities and a collaborative approach to working with internal stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

**Training Needs Identification & Planning**

* Conduct Annual Training Needs Identification (TNI) in collaboration with functional heads and technical teams.
* Identify technical competency gaps, develop appropriate learning interventions and prepare annual training plans.
* Review training priorities periodically to align with business and operational requirements.

**Technical Training Design & Implementation**

* Design and develop technical training modules, presentations, practical exercises, case studies and competency-based learning programs.
* Collaborate with internal Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to ensure accuracy, relevance and practical applicability of training content.
* Plan, coordinate and facilitate technical training programs for employees across functions and levels.
* Develop and maintain a repository of technical training content and learning resources.

**Training Assessment & Effectiveness**

* Develop and implement structured pre-training and post-training assessment questionnaires to evaluate learning outcomes.
* Analyse assessment results, measure training effectiveness and identify areas requiring further development.
* Obtain feedback from participants, functional heads and internal stakeholders to continuously enhance training content and delivery.

**Trainer Development & Evaluation**

* Identify and develop internal technical trainers in collaboration with functional teams.
* Design, coordinate and facilitate Train-the-Trainer programs.
* Establish structured trainer evaluation mechanisms to assess training quality, delivery and effectiveness.

**Training MIS & Analytics**

* Prepare monthly Training MIS covering training calendar adherence, participation, training hours, assessment outcomes and effectiveness.
* Analyse training data, identify improvement opportunities and provide actionable recommendations.
* Ensure accurate maintenance of training records, assessment results and related documentation.

**Competency Development & L&D Compliance**

* Support technical competency mapping, skill development initiatives and structured learning programs for employees.
* Facilitate L&D-related internal, external, certification and customer audits, including applicable ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 requirements.
* Maintain audit-ready training records and coordinate timely closure of identified observations.

Qualifications & Experience

* B.E./B.Tech. in Chemical Engineering or B.Sc./M.Sc. in Chemistry/Chemical Sciences.
* MBA/PGDM in HR or Operations will be an added advantage.
* 8–15 years of relevant professional experience, preferably in chemical or process manufacturing with exposure to technical training and capability development.
* Experience in training needs identification, instructional design, competency assessment, technical training facilitation and training effectiveness measurement.
* Experience in Train-the-Trainer programs, learning analytics and stakeholder coordination.
* Strong proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and training management systems.

Functional & Behavioural Competencies

Strong technical understanding of chemical/process manufacturing, training design and facilitation, competency assessment, training analytics and L&D audit requirements.

Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management and analytical skills, with a proactive approach, learning agility, accountability and a focus on continuous improvement.

title: Clinical & Health Specialist
description:
**About Turing:**

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM, and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking experienced Clinical & Health Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to author, evaluate, and calibrate high-fidelity clinical tasks, long-chart scenarios, workplace simulations, and benchmark evaluation rubrics.

This unified opening covers contributors across multiple clinical, behavioral-health, revenue-cycle, quality, pharmacy, rehabilitation, and healthcare-operations disciplines. Candidates will be placed in either an Expert Contributor or Senior Specialist / Functional Lead track based on clinical depth, years of experience, active licensure or certification, leadership experience, and prior review or calibration expertise.

**Clinical & Health Disciplines Covered:**

* Acute-Care Physical, Occupational, and Speech-Language Therapy
* Pathology, Laboratory Cytotechnology, and Genetic Counseling
* Utilization Management, Prior Authorization, and Payer Claims
* Dietetics, Nutrition, Diabetes Education, and Chronic-Disease Education
* Hospital Social Work and Behavioral-Health Therapy
* Clinical Quality Improvement, Patient Safety, Infection Prevention, and EVS Policy
* Medical Coding, CDI, Billing, and Denials
* Hospital Pharmacy and Clinical Pharmacology
* Psychiatry, Addiction Medicine, and Behavioral Health
* Emergency Medicine, EMS Medical Direction, Paramedic, and EMT Handoffs

**Requirements:**

* Approximately 3 to 15+ years of demonstrable professional experience in one or more relevant Clinical & Health disciplines.
* Current or recent practice within the last three years in the applicable clinical, hospital, payer, laboratory, behavioral-health, revenue-cycle, or quality setting.
* Active professional licensure, board certification, or recognized credential appropriate to the discipline.
* Strong clinical reasoning, chart-review, documentation, and written communication skills.
* Ability to interpret fragmented medical records, reconcile conflicting information, identify missing or unsafe actions, and produce clinically defensible conclusions.
* High attention to detail, particularly regarding patient safety, clinical terminology, medical necessity, coding accuracy, payer requirements, regulatory standards, and documentation gaps.
* Ability to work within structured review cycles, standardized rubrics, and fast-paced calibration environments.
* Familiarity with US clinical guidelines, payer policies, regulatory requirements, and healthcare workflows is preferred. Relevant reference materials may be supplied in context for non-US contributors.

**Role-Specific Qualifications:**

Depending on the assigned discipline, relevant qualifications may include:

* Active PT, OT, SLP, RN, RD/RDN, LCSW, PharmD, MD, DO, or other applicable professional license.
* Board certification or specialist credentials such as BCPS, BCCCP, CIC, CPHQ, CPPS, CCS, CPC, CDIP, CCDS, CDCES, ABEM, ABPN, ABPM, or equivalent.
* Experience with acute-care rehabilitation, swallow evaluation, nutrition support, diabetes education, utilization management, prior authorization, payer appeals, medical coding, CDI, infection prevention, NHSN reporting, medication reconciliation, addiction medicine, emergency medicine, or EMS medical direction.
* Experience authoring or reviewing complex clinical documentation, longitudinal charts, discharge plans, medical-necessity determinations, coding assignments, safety assessments, or quality audits.

**Responsibilities:**

* Clinical Benchmark Authoring & Task Design: Develop high-difficulty clinical tasks, long-chart scenarios, realistic workplace cases, gold-standard answers, and evaluation criteria within the assigned discipline.
* Longitudinal Chart Synthesis: Evaluate fragmented, multi-encounter records and identify clinically meaningful trends, contradictions, omissions, risks, and required actions.
* Clinical Accuracy & Safety Review: Assess whether outputs are clinically accurate, practical, evidence-aligned, patient-safe, and appropriate for the relevant care setting.
* Rubric Application & Scoring: Apply evaluation criteria defined by the Functional SME Lead to assess outputs for clinical reasoning, terminology, documentation quality, regulatory alignment, payer accuracy, and patient-safety implications.
* Specialty Task Evaluation: Depending on the assigned area, review tasks involving mobility and discharge planning, swallow and diet-texture recommendations, medical necessity, prior authorization, claims and denials, nutrition support, diabetes management, psychosocial safety, infection prevention, coding and CDI, medication safety, addiction treatment, emergency decision-making, or EMS handoffs.
* Peer Review & Calibration — Senior Track: Review and calibrate pod members’ work, resolve edge-case ambiguities, identify rubric inconsistencies, and maintain day-to-day quality standards.
* Cross-Functional Review: Evaluate tasks that require coordination across physicians, nurses, therapists, pharmacists, social workers, dietitians, coders, case managers, payers, laboratory professionals, or emergency personnel.
* Iterative Refinement: Incorporate calibration feedback, revise task content and solutions, and participate in multiple critique cycles to align deliverables with project standards.
* Escalation & Quality Ownership — Senior Track: Escalate genuine clinical, regulatory, or rubric ambiguities to the Functional SME Lead and support consistent decision-making across the pod.

**Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree, graduate degree, professional degree, or equivalent practical experience in a relevant healthcare discipline.
* Active professional license, board certification, or recognized industry credential where applicable.
* Experience in clinical practice, healthcare operations, medical review, AI evaluation, data annotation, content review, quality assurance, clinical documentation, or a related analytical role is preferred.
* Prior experience reviewing expert work, creating clinical education content, developing assessment materials, or participating in quality-improvement programs is advantageous.
* Senior Specialist / Functional Lead Expectations

**Senior contributors may be responsible for:**

* Authoring high-difficulty tasks and gold-standard solutions.
* Reviewing and calibrating work produced by Expert Contributors.
* Maintaining quality across a designated Clinical & Health pod.
* Resolving complex clinical, safety, documentation, payer, or regulatory edge cases.
* Supporting rubric development and identifying gaps in evaluation criteria.
* Grading adjacent specialties where clinically appropriate, such as behavioral-health safety, nursing documentation, case management, paramedic handoffs, payer claims, or clinical quality tasks.

**Offer Details:**

* Commitment Required: At least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week.
* Overlap Requirement: 4 hours of overlap with PST.
* Engagement Type: Contractor.
* Engagement Length: 12 weeks.

**Evaluation Process:**

* Applicants must submit the Job Interest Form and complete the relevant assessment.
* Selected applicants may be invited to complete a discipline-specific review or calibration exercise.
* Final selected candidates will be contacted regarding next steps, contracting, and onboarding requirements.

IT Payment Services department, the worldwide reference for payments in the BNP Paribas Group. We are working on the many applications used worldwide.
  
  
**Position Purpose**

* Joining the Data Office IT Payment Services is a direct contribution to the Data strategy of Payment Services, working closely with the DCIO. You will evolve at the heart of a stimulating environment, at the intersection of regulatory, technological and business data-related challenges. You will take part in leading projects (data asset documentation, data flow reliability, Data architecture evolution, etc.), and will be recognized as an internal expert on the quality and governance of Payment Services data. If you recognize yourself in this profile and wish to shape the excellence and reliability of data for Payment Services and its clients, join us!
* Main mission of Data office is to ensure the quality, security, compliance, traceability, performance and continuity of data across the entire Payment Services Information System. The integrated Data Officer in this team directly contributes to this mission within the context of strengthening IT PS's Data Management governance.
* In this context, the Data Office IT PS operates according to 2 major axes:
* Compliance & protection: adherence to regulatory standards (GDPR, internal governance policies) and assurance of data protection (security, access management and traceability);
* Data quality: monitoring and continuous improvement of the quality and reliability of data, including through regular IT deliverable checks and contributing to the enhancement of business data quality.
* Missions of the Data Office IT Payment Services team:
* Governance & Compliance: Deployment of the data governance framework (charters, policies and processes) to ensure the compliance of the data ecosystem with internal regulations and standards. The team defines and monitors data management KPIs, ensures the application of protection policies (confidentiality, access) and contributes to the governance of data-related control plans. She notably chairs a Data Governance Committee to ensure alignment of data assets with IT PS's Data Management strategy. A data governance and compliance dashboard for Data Management maturity is regularly presented to the IT PS Management.
* Data Architecture & Projects: The team ensures alignment of data models with business needs and Group standards, and implements full traceability of data and data flows (data lineage). She supports projects in the Data areas (compliance, data model, data dictionaries, quality and strengthening of data security, etc.). The Data Office IT PS plays a cross-functional coordination role between business requirements, technical requirements and regulatory obligations in order to achieve quality and compliance objectives.
* Support and assistance: The team trains and raises awareness among staff on tools and best practices (e.g. Data Management tools, data dictionary, flow mapping, compliance with quality and security standards, Data Privacy principles She also ensures the daily monitoring of Data topics (KPI monitoring, on-site support, responses to requests) to embed the Data culture and governance rigor in daily operations.

**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Data Governance & Data Reference Frameworks: Manage data reference frameworks (application data dictionaries) using the internal data cataloging tool (WeData – based on Collibra). You ensure comprehensive documentation of key data (shared definitions, metadata, owners) and proper alignment of technical and business frameworks.
* Modeling & Data Lineage: Collaborate closely with project teams and the IT Data Manager to ensure the design of application data models, guaranteeing their consistency and completeness in line with business needs. You ensure documentation and maintenance of data traceability across all flows (data lineage), providing end-to-end visibility of every critical data point from its source to its consumption (a prerequisite for managing risks and ensuring compliance).
* Data Quality: Ensure the implementation and execution of data quality control plans defined by the business, by steering continuous improvement action plans dedicated to critical data. As an expert, you share your analyses and recommendations to improve data quality and strengthen trust in their use.
* Operational support & continuous improvement: Supporting and raising awareness among technical and business teams on a daily basis on Data topics: training in the use of governance tools (data dictionary, data flow mapping), advice on good data management practices, and responses to specific requests. You propose solutions to continuously improve data resilience and integrity, and contribute to the optimization of governance processes.
* KPI Data Management: Contributing to the production of the Data Management Dashboard.

Contributing Responsibilities
  
  

* Ability to drive and contribute to Data projects (quality, security, architecture, etc.) in a cross-functional manner, in a complex environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a sense of rigor to formalize and document results (reports, traceability matrices).

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Data Modeling & Management – Mastery of conceptual, logical, and physical data models; strong knowledge of databases and data integration technologies (ETL/ELT, data pipelines).
* Data Catalogue & Data Lineage – Practical experience with a cataloging/metadata tool (ideally weData/Collibra or equivalent) to manage data dictionaries. Solid understanding of data lineage principles and ability to document data flow traceability.
* Data Quality & Compliance – Knowledge of data quality standards and methods, as well as experience in implementing quality controls. Awareness of regulatory compliance issues (GDPR), data governance and security.
* Data Visualization: Hands-on experience with a Data Visualization tool (Power BI, Tableau...)
* Excellent communication skills, able to simplify Data issues and train/evangelize various stakeholders (IT teams, business units, management).
* Team spirit and ease in collaboration with multiple players (IT Data Manager, developers, business referents, Security teams…).
* Autonomy, proactivity and ability to propose improvements to continuously enhance data governance processes.
* Strong interest in data quality and enhancement, with a strong sense of ethics and confidentiality

**Specific Qualifications**

title: Sr. Exec / Ass. Manager R&D - Sewri Mumbai
description:
**Job Description**
We are seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented R&D Assistant to support our team in the development and innovation of high-performance paints and coatings. In this role, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to advance product development, ensure quality standards, and contribute to technical excellence. The ideal candidate will bring expertise in
**paint formulations**
,
**coatings testing**
,
**lab safety**
, and
**raw material analysis**
—ensuring compliance, innovation, and operational excellence in a dynamic R&D environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support R&D Projects: Assist in planning, executing, and documenting R&D experiments and projects related to paints and coatings, ensuring alignment with strategic goals.
* Material Testing: Conduct a variety of physical, chemical, and performance tests on paint materials and coatings—including adhesion, hardness, gloss, durability, and weatherability assessments—to assess quality, durability, and compliance with specifications (e.g., ASTM, ISO, NACE).
* Data Collection & Reporting: Maintain accurate, organized records of all R&D activities; prepare clear and concise technical reports and summaries for internal review, including failure analysis and root cause investigations.
* Product Formulation: Contribute to the development and optimization of paint formulations, balancing performance, cost-efficiency, and sustainability objectives using industry-standard resins, pigments, additives, and solvents.
* Raw Material Analysis: Perform chemical and physical characterization of incoming raw materials (e.g., resins, pigments, solvents, additives) to ensure consistency, purity, and suitability for use in formulations.
* Lab Safety & Compliance: Adhere strictly to lab safety protocols, including proper handling, storage, and disposal of hazardous chemicals; maintain MSDS/SDS compliance and participate in safety audits and training.
* Quality Assurance: Partner with the Quality Control team to perform inspections and validations on raw materials and finished goods, supporting continuous improvement initiatives and regulatory compliance.
* Industry Intelligence: Monitor industry trends, competitor activity, and emerging technologies to identify opportunities for innovation and differentiation—particularly in eco-friendly, low-VOC, and high-durability coating systems.
* Lab Management: Maintain a clean, safe, and well-organized laboratory environment; ensure proper handling, storage, and calibration of chemicals and equipment.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a methodical approach to experimentation and data interpretation—especially in coatings testing and raw material analysis.
* Fundamental knowledge of paint formulations, including resin chemistry, pigment dispersion, rheology control, and additive functionality, along with standard testing methodologies (e.g., ASTM, ISO, NACE).
* Hands-on experience with coatings performance testing (e.g., salt spray, UV exposure, humidity resistance, adhesion, gloss, hardness) and interpretation of results.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment, with strong time management and multitasking skills.
* Excellent organizational and documentation skills, with attention to detail and accuracy—particularly in maintaining lab safety logs and formulation records.
* Proficiency in using laboratory instruments (e.g., viscometers, gloss meters, weathering testers, particle size analyzers) and data analysis software (e.g., Excel, Minitab, OriginPro, or similar).
* Commitment to safety best practices and regulatory compliance in laboratory settings, including familiarity with OSHA, GHS, and local environmental health and safety (EHS) regulations.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Polymer Science, Paint Technology, or a closely related field (preferred), or a Diploma in Paint Technology with relevant industry experience.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in R&D, preferably within the industrial or architectural coatings industry—with demonstrable experience in paint formulation, coatings testing, and raw material analysis.
* Hands-on experience with lab safety management, including chemical handling, waste disposal, and emergency response procedures.
* Experience with quality systems (e.g., ISO 9001, ISO/IEC 17025) and regulatory frameworks (e.g., REACH, TSCA, Prop 65) is highly desirable.

title: Securities Services- Onboarding Product Development-Associate
description:
**Job Description**
Senior Associate, CIB Securities Services Onboarding Product Development (Mumbai, India)
  
  
About J.P. Morgan Corporate & Investment Bank: Join J.P. Morgan, a global leader in financial services, renowned for delivering innovative solutions and exceptional service to clients worldwide. With a strong presence in the marketplace and a commitment to excellence, we offer unparalleled career opportunities within one of the most respected financial institutions globally.
  
  
**Securities Services:**

We provide cutting-edge global custody, fund accounting, middle office services, and more to the world's largest institutional investors and asset managers.

* Strong project/program management capability, delivering complex, cross-functional initiatives end-to-end.
* Proven stakeholder management and influencing skills, aligning senior partners across Product, Technology, Operations, and Controls, including across regions and time zones.
* Hands-on knowledge of data architecture, including data modelling, data lineage, and data quality.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to produce clear documentation and translate complex concepts for non-technical audiences.
* Highly organized, with strong prioritization and delivery discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications, Skills And Capabilities**

* Experience with enterprise data platforms and data governance models will be a plus.
* Experience with AI/ML solutions to drive change and governance of data models is preferred.

Morgan and Chase brands. title: SME-Reg Affairs-Med Writing
description:
**Job Summary**
Serve as a subject matter expert in regulatory affairs and medical writing for life sciences projects applying deep regulatory domain knowledge to develop compliant documentation and optimize regulatory business processes. Collaborate in a hybrid work model with global stakeholders to support research and development activities ensuring precise communication and alignment with regulatory and standards requirements.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with cross functional regulatory and research teams to design and refine documentation strategies that align with global regulatory and standards compliance requirements and support timely product approvals and updates.
* Develop comprehensive regulatory submissions using regulatory Veeva and other approved platforms to ensure accurate tracking documentation integrity and alignment with life sciences regulatory expectations.
* Prepare medically accurate and evidence based documents including clinical overviews summaries and technical narratives that clearly support research and development outcomes and regulatory decisions.
* Analyze regulatory domain knowledge and regulatory affairs guidelines to interpret evolving regulations and transform them into practical documentation practices and process improvements for the organization.
* Coordinate regulatory business analyst activities by translating clinical and research insights into structured regulatory product specialist documentation that supports clear product positioning and risk communication.
* Review and refine regulatory business process services documentation to ensure consistency traceability and completeness across product lifecycles from early research stages through post approval commitments.
* Provide expert guidance on regulatory and standards compliance for life sciences regulatory projects ensuring that medical writing deliverables accurately reflect scientific data and regulatory expectations.
* Support hybrid work collaboration by maintaining clear written communication channels in English and organizing documentation workflows that enable efficient coordination across onsite and remote stakeholders.
* Utilize regulatory product specialist skills to map product features indications and risk profiles to relevant regulatory frameworks and to craft documentation that supports safe and effective use for patients and healthcare systems.
* Monitor regulatory affairs and research and development timelines to prioritize medical writing tasks and ensure that all deliverables are produced with high quality and submitted within agreed regulatory milestones.
* Evaluate existing regulatory business processes and recommend practical enhancements that improve data consistency document version management and audit readiness across life sciences regulatory operations.
* Coordinate with regulatory domain knowledge experts to validate scientific content and ensure that complex technical concepts are presented in clear concise and accessible language for regulatory agencies.
* Document hybrid day shift working practices and collaboration expectations to support stable operations and knowledge transfer while ensuring that no travel requirements impact project continuity.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate strong regulatory domain knowledge and hands on experience in life sciences regulatory documentation including work on regulatory affairs and research and development submissions.
* Apply regulatory Veeva expertise to manage document workflows metadata and version control ensuring that all regulatory and medical writing outputs remain accurate and inspection ready.
* Use experience as a regulatory product specialist to create structured product documentation that clearly describes indications benefits risks and compliance status for diverse health markets.
* Draw on regulatory business analyst capabilities to interpret business requirements and transform them into detailed regulatory documents and process descriptions that support organizational decision making.
* Exhibit deep understanding of regulatory and standards compliance and life sciences regulatory expectations to ensure that medical writing outputs consistently support safe and ethical product use.
* Leverage practical involvement in regulatory business process services and regulatory affairs to identify opportunities for process optimization and to support efficient management of submission portfolios.

**Certifications Required**
Preferred certification in Regulatory Affairs such as RAC or equivalent life sciences regulatory credential.

title: Content Producer - Business Skills
description:
JoVE is the world-leading video platform for scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students worldwide use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including leaders such as Harvard, MIT, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company
  
  
**The Role**

We are seeking a creative and detail-oriented Content Producer to develop engaging, short-form microlearning videos for professional and business skills training. The role owns the instructional content journey from research and scripting through storyboarding, production review, and final content quality checks.

The ideal candidate combines strong instructional thinking, scriptwriting, visual storytelling, research, and AI-assisted content creation skills and can translate complex business concepts into clear, practical, and engaging learning experiences.
  
  
**Responsibilities :**

* Research business and professional skills topics using credible sources and translate them into focused, learner-centered microlearning content.
* Write concise, engaging video scripts aligned with defined learning objectives and instructional outcomes.
* Develop relatable workplace scenarios, hooks, narratives, and examples that demonstrate skills through practical application.
* Translate approved scripts into production-ready storyboards and on-screen text.
* Use generative AI and content-production tools to support research, ideation, scripting, and production workflows while independently validating quality and accuracy.
* Collaborate with animation, voice-over, design, subject-matter experts, and quality teams to take content from script to final video.
* Review animatics, voice-over, animation, graphics, and video versions for instructional accuracy, visual clarity, continuity, and alignment with the approved script.
* Create supporting learning assets, including quizzes, visual summaries, landing-page content, and video metadata.
* Manage multiple lessons across production stages and maintain consistent quality, tone, terminology, and learner experience across a course.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Instructional Design & Business/Media, or a related field.
* 3-6 years of experience in instructional content, learning design, scriptwriting, educational media, corporate training, or video content production.
* Excellent writing, editing, research, and storytelling skills, with a strong command of American English.
* Demonstrated ability to simplify complex concepts into concise, practical, and engaging learning content.
* Strong understanding of learning objectives, microlearning principles, scenario-based learning, and assessment design.
* Ability to think visually and translate scripts into clear storyboards and production directions.
* Proficiency with generative AI tools for content development, ideation, research support, and visual/storyboard creation, combined with strong independent editorial judgment.
* Strong attention to detail, feedback management, cross-functional collaboration, and ability to own content through multiple stages of production.
* A portfolio demonstrating instructional scripts, microlearning, educational videos, storyboards, or comparable learning content is strongly preferred.

**Benefits**

* A competitive compensation package.
* We are fully remote!
* You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
* Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
* Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Tender & Proposal Coordinator
description:

We are looking for a structured and detail-focused Tender and Proposal Coordinator to join our Commercial Hub. In this role, you will help deliver high-quality, compliant tenders and proposals for customers across Asia and the Middle East, applying standard methods, tools, and controls at every stage of the bid.

title: Tender & Proposal Specialist

* Collaborate with developers, SMEs, and vendors to support defect resolution, retesting, and closure
* Ensure defects are properly linked to originating test cases and requirements

* Produce regular test execution reports, defect summaries, and quality metrics for project stakeholders
* Track and communicate test progress, risks, and system readiness
* Provide insights into defect trends, coverage status, and exit criteria readiness

title: Product Owner SharePoint Online
description:
What you will do
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Product Owner SharePoint Online to take end-to-end responsibility for SharePoint Online at tesa. In this role you own the platform in every sense: you develop, keep it running for our users day to day, you shape how it and you make sure it stays secure, governed and easy to work with. We are looking for a developper and not a simple SharePoint administrator. The position sits in our IT organisation and combines hands-on development and operational work with solution design and consulting for the business.
  
  
A large part of your time is spent close to our colleagues worldwide. You handle incidents and service requests, you lead the migration of legacy file servers into SharePoint Online, and you design the document management structures that our departments rely on. Alongside this operational ownership you work on demands and projects, and you build automation and low-code solutions with Power Apps and Power Automate where they create real value. You collaborate closely with our Modern Workplace team as well as with business stakeholders in Germany and at our international sites.

* Take ownership of SharePoint Online as a platform: Developement of complex Sharepoint applications and pages, configuration, governance, permissions, lifecycle and continuous improvement
* Process incidents and service requests in our ticket system, including analysis, resolution, documentation and communication with the requester
* Lead migrations from file servers and legacy platforms to SharePoint Online, from assessment and structure design through to cutover and adoption
* Design and implement document management solutions on SharePoint Online, including site and library structures, metadata, versioning, retention and access concepts
* Work on demands and projects together with business departments, from requirement clarification and solution design to implementation and handover
* Build and maintain low-code solutions with Power Apps, Power Automate flows and SharePoint Lists to digitise and automate business processes
* Support tickets and topics in the wider Microsoft 365 environment, for example Teams, OneDrive and related collaboration services
* Integrate SharePoint with other Microsoft 365 services and evaluate new capabilities such as Microsoft Copilot for our collaboration landscape
* Provide user training, documentation and expert guidance to drive adoption and effective use of SharePoint
* Monitor platform health, run regular audits and continuously improve stability, security and user experience

What you will need
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Several years of hands-on experience with SharePoint Online administration, configuration and solution design in a corporate environment
* Practical experience running file server to SharePoint Online migrations, including structure and permission concepts
* Solid knowledge of document management on SharePoint: libraries, metadata, content types, versioning and permission models
* Experience building solutions with Power Apps, Power Automate and SharePoint Lists
* Proven track record in IT service operations, working with incidents and service requests in a ticket system such as ServiceNow
* Good working knowledge of the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, in particular Teams, OneDrive and Entra ID based access management
* Ability to work directly with business users, translate their requirements into workable solutions and explain technical topics in plain language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* PowerShell scripting for SharePoint and Microsoft 365 administration
* Experience with information governance, compliance, retention and records management frameworks
* Experience with intranet and employee experience solutions based on SharePoint
* Experience with Microsoft Copilot or Copilot Studio and AI supported workplace scenarios
* Microsoft certifications, for example in Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Platform or Azure
* Project experience in agile environments, ideally in a product owner or comparable role

Soft Skills
  
  

* Strong sense of ownership and accountability for the platform and its users
* Service minded, with strong communication and organisational skills
* Able to manage multiple tickets, demands and projects in parallel and to set the right priorities
* Proactive, reliable and eager to learn new technologies
* Comfortable working independently and with colleagues across global time zones

What you can expect
  
  
tesa is one of the world's leading manufacturers of adhesive tape solutions, with a range of more than 7,000 products. With passion for technology, we drive innovation, reliability, and sustainability to shape a better future.
  
  
Our solutions make a difference in the work, products, and lives of our customers across a variety of industries, including Automotive, Electronics, and Home applications. With this, we address a broad segment of business customers, but also you as a private consumer.

title: AI Enablement & Governance Analyst
description:
At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!
  
  
Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.
  
  
**Job Description**
The AI Adoption & Governance Analyst operationalizes AI standards across the Patient Services engineering organization and proves the SDLC transformation in metrics. This role is the connective tissue of the AI Hub COE: rolling out AI development tooling to Dev, QA, and BA teams; owning the governance artifacts that keep AI use safe and compliant; and reporting the adoption and ROI story to leadership.
  
  
It is the right role for someone who blends analytical rigor with strong communication and change-management instincts — someone who can drive real adoption of new ways of working, not just publish a policy.
  
  
**Mission:**
Operationalize AI standards across BA, QA, and Dev — and prove the SDLC transformation in measurable adoption and ROI.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Adoption & Enablement**

* Roll out AI development tooling — Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor — as engineering standards across the Patient Services teams.
* Train and onboard Dev, QA, and BA staff into AI-augmented ways of working; run office hours, certification, and internal forums.
* Own the AI best-practice wiki, training materials, and the agent registry.

**Governance & Compliance**

* Own and maintain the prompt library governance process, including quality gates before templates are promoted.
* Conduct HIPAA/PHI compliance reviews of AI tool usage; coordinate with InfoSec on data-flow approval and risk sign-off.
* Maintain the approved-tools list and the AI risk register.
* Support model-selection and BAA-verification processes led by the AI Engineering & Enablement Lead.

**Metrics & Reporting**

* Define and track AI adoption KPIs: AI velocity, code-generation percentage, defect-rate delta, time-to-merge, and story points per sprint.
* Author monthly team adoption reports and quarterly executive ROI dashboards for the CTO and CFO.
* Surface adoption gaps and recommend interventions to the AI Engineering & Enablement Lead.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**

* 3+ years in a technical analyst, program enablement, developer-experience, or similar role.
* Strong data analysis and dashboarding skills.
* Excellent technical writing and documentation ability.
* Demonstrated change-management and training-delivery experience.
* Working fluency with AI tooling ecosystems (Claude, Gemini, AI coding assistants) — able to teach and support their use.
* Understanding of HIPAA, SOC 2, or comparable privacy/compliance fundamentals.
* Strong cross-team coordination and stakeholder-communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Background in healthcare or life-sciences technology.
* Experience supporting or governing an AI or developer-tooling rollout at scale.
* Familiarity with JIRA, Confluence, and BI tools (Looker, Tableau, or BigQuery).

**Tools & Stack**

* AI (evaluation & support): Claude, Gemini Enterprise, Einstein.
* Dev tools supported: Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor.
* Dashboards & data: Looker / Tableau, BigQuery.
* Documentation: Confluence, Notion, JIRA.

**First-Year Success Measures**

* AI development tooling adopted across Patient Services engineering, with measurable AI velocity gains tracked and reported.
* Governance framework operational: approved-tools list, prompt-library process, risk register, and compliance-review workflow all live.
* Monthly adoption reporting and quarterly executive ROI dashboards established and delivered.

title: Customer Quality Advisor
description:
Castrol is one of the world’s leading lubricant brands, serving customers and consumers in the automotive, marine, industrial and energy sectors. Castrol brands are recognised globally for their premium quality and high performance, shaped by the company’s commitment to innovation and cutting-edge technology. With products sold in more than 150 countries, Castrol has helped keep things moving on roads and racetracks, air, sea, and space for over 125 years.
  
  
Whether you're just starting out or ready for your next big move, you're in the right place to explore an exciting career with Castrol.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the team:**
The Customer Quality Advisor ensures that customer quality requirements, change communications, and compliance commitments are translated into robust, consistent, and customer‑trusted processes across the organization.
  
  
The role acts as the central authority and credible customer interface for Customer Specific Requirements (CSR), Change Management Communication (CMC), and related quality topics, balancing customer expectations with regulatory, legal, and operational feasibility.
  
  
By providing governance, expert guidance, and enablement, the role safeguards customer satisfaction, audit readiness, and license to operate, while enabling the business to manage change, complexity, and growth in a structured and sustainable way.
  
  
**Key tasks:**
**Process & Tool Governance**

* Own and govern Customer Quality tools and global CSR/CMC processes.
* Define standards, manage enhancements, monitor KPIs, and drive continuous improvement.
* Lead global deployment, stakeholder engagement, and training.

**Customer Specific Requirements (CSR)**

* Act as the CSR Subject Matter Expert.
* Interpret, assess, and implement customer requirements.
* Lead compliance assessments, maintain compliance matrices, and resolve gaps with business stakeholders.
* Drive organizational capability through coaching and training.

**Customer Change Management (CMC)**

* Own customer change communication standards and governance.
* Lead customer notifications, approvals, discrepancy management, and change-related decision making.
* Ensure consistent execution through training and performance monitoring.

**Special Customer Quality Requirements**

* Manage PPAP/PQA activities and associated customer negotiations.
* Serve as focal point for IMDS and customer disclosure requests.
* Coordinate cross-functional support to address customer requirements and data gaps.

**Customer Quality Consulting**

* Support complex customer quality issues, deviations, shortages, and requalification activities.
* Provide quality input for RFQs, tenders, contracts, and localization initiatives.
* Act as a trusted advisor in critical customer engagements.

**Customer Audits & Supplier Ratings**

* Lead preparation and support for customer audits.
* Coordinate audit readiness across Sales, Technology, Supply Chain, and Quality.
* Support management of non-OEM supplier performance ratings and associated risk assessments.
* Ownership of agreed Customer Specific Requirements across globe.
* Responsibility for planning and execution of customer audits and assessments.

**Experience required:**

* Bachelor's degree.
* Minimum 3+ years of experience in customer‑facing quality roles (e.g. Customer Quality, Quality Engineering, Quality Assurance, Process Management, Sales or GSC) within automotive, industrial, or other regulated industries, with direct exposure to OEM customers.
* Proven track record in working with Customer Specific Requirements (CSRs), including their interpretation, negotiation support, implementation, and ongoing governance across multiple customers. Strong hands‑on experience with IATF 16949 (formerly ISO/TS 16949) and customer‑specific standards such as VDA, QS‑9000, Ford Q1, and VW Formel‑Q.
* Demonstrated experience in process management and the practical application of core quality tools (including APQP, PPAP, FMEA, and 8D) across end‑to‑end value chains, with close collaboration across Sales, Global Supply Chain (GSC), and Operations.
* Hands‑on experience in process ownership or governance, particularly for customer requirements, quality processes, or change management (CMC or equivalent).
* Strong understanding of how customer requirements translate into internal processes, product changes, and plant or supply‑chain impact.
* Experience working with customer or quality management tools, databases, or workflow systems, and contributing to process or tool improvements.
* Awareness of legal and contractual implications related to customer requirements, quality agreements, and change notifications.
* CSR governance and compliance management.
* Automotive quality standards (IATF 16949, VDA, AIAG).
* Customer change management and communication.
* Customer audit management.
* Stakeholder influence and negotiation.
* Problem-solving and root cause analysis.
* Training, coaching, and knowledge transfer.
* Global process governance and continuous improvement.
* Customer Specific Requirements (CSR) management.
* Change Management Communication (CMC).
* Automotive quality systems knowledge.
* PPAP/APQP expertise.
* Customer audit management.
* Customer-facing communication and negotiation.
* Process governance and KPI management.
* Root cause analysis and 8D problem solving.
* Cross-functional stakeholder management.
* Global rollout, training, and capability building.

title: Technical Product Support Engineer
description:
Technical Product Support Engineer

Location: Pune, India, office-based (this is not a remote position)

Employment: Full time

This role is based in our Pune office, so you must live in or near Pune. You will be employed through our partner entity in India.

The opportunity

RoboShadow is a fast-growing UK-based global cybersecurity startup, and we are looking for an enthusiastic person to join our team in our Pune office.

Whether you are looking to start your career in technology or are already seasoned, we are not looking for the right experience, but the right person.

You will work with an enterprise-grade startup team and have access to a wealth of learning resources, think of it as your own Aladdin's cave of training materials, tools and mentors, to become a cybersecurity and app technical support guru. This is initially an app support role, but people usually move on to development, testing or engineering roles afterwards.

Our company is at an exciting crossroads: we are on the verge of being cash-flow positive and have already turned down multiple acquisition offers. You will have a chance to be part of something special and help us scale to the next level.

What you will own

• User support: help users resolve functional issues and make the most of our platform.

• Technical troubleshooting: identify and troubleshoot technical issues, get involved from a development perspective to remediate them, and escalate to the development team when required.

• User demos: demonstrate the platform and product features so users can use the product effectively.

• Working with Customer Experience: gather and act on feedback, and escalate bugs and feature requests to the right team.

• User account admin: add licences, update organisations and carry out other account administration.

How we will measure success

We will look at:

• How well and how quickly you help users resolve their issues.

• How clearly you communicate with users and with the wider team.

• The quality of the bugs, feedback and feature requests you escalate.

• How quickly you learn the product and grow your technical skills.

Who we are looking for

Above all, we need an excellent communicator. This role is for you if you:

• Love technology and want to build a career on it.

• Love helping users and get satisfaction from it.

• Have a background in coding and development (base skills) that you are keen to build on.

• Have your own tech projects you can demonstrate (a hobby is fine).

• Are a fast learner who can teach yourself new technology using Google, ChatGPT or YouTube, and enjoy doing so.

• Are keen to grow your skills in cloud architecture, development, AI tools and DevOps.

• Are excited by a startup where your contributions will be visible, impactful and meaningful.

• Are able to commute to our Pune office every day.

Why join RoboShadow?

This is the perfect opportunity for someone looking to make a mark in the tech world. You will be a key player in our success story, and in return we will give you the training, support and opportunities to thrive in cybersecurity.

Experience

You do not need years of experience. Base coding skills, a genuine passion for technology and strong communication matter more than your job history.

How to apply

Please apply by email to liz@roboshadow.com, not through LinkedIn. Send us:

• Your CV.

• A link to a short Loom video (around 1 to 3 minutes) telling us why you would be a great fit for this role.

The Loom video is your first stage interview, so applications without one will not be considered. It does not need to be formal.

Our purpose is advancing knowledge to improve lives. We succeed by being the premier provider of strategic learning and development, scientific advisory services, and medical communications solutions for the life sciences industry. Our global team is composed of nearly 800 full-time employees whose commitment to creativity, quality, and on-time delivery is unrivaled in our space.

Our culture is about meaningful work, a true sense of community, and fun. We love to celebrate our people and we are proud to have been Internationally recognized as a “Great Place to Work".
  
  
**Job Overview**
The Associate / Sr. Associate Consultant is a core member of the Epidemiology & Outcomes Research team, responsible for supporting health economics and outcomes research (HEOR), evidence generation, and evidence synthesis projects across a range of therapeutic areas.
  
  
This role requires strong analytical and epidemiological skills, along with the ability to independently manage multiple concurrent projects under the guidance of a senior team member. You will contribute to the design and execution of literature reviews and other secondary research, interpret complex clinical, epidemiological, economic, and health outcomes evidence, and supervise junior colleagues on select workstreams.
  
  
The role requires close collaboration with cross-functional project teams and direct engagement with clients during meetings, project discussions, and deliverable presentations.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
Research and Analysis
  
  

* Support the design and execution of systematic literature reviews (SLRs), targeted literature reviews (TLRs), and other evidence reviews, including development of search strategies, screening criteria, data extraction frameworks, and evidence synthesis approaches
* Conduct structured searches across bibliographic databases and other relevant evidence sources; screen literature against project-specific inclusion/exclusion criteria and supervise junior colleagues on the same
* Extract data in a structured manner, perform in-depth quality control, critically appraise studies, and interpret clinical, epidemiological, economic, and health outcomes evidence
* Resolve complex data issues, identify key evidence gaps and insights, and summarize scientific data clearly and accurately
* Support qualitative and narrative evidence synthesis across projects, including areas such as burden of disease, treatment patterns, unmet need, clinical outcomes, and other health outcomes evidence

Project Delivery and Quality
  
  

* Develop and implement strategies to ensure accurate and timely delivery of analysis results
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously with some guidance from senior team members
* Support development of high-quality scientific and client deliverables, including literature review reports, manuscripts, evidence/value dossiers, abstracts, posters, and presentations, as appropriate to the project
* Participate in client meetings and deliverable presentations, contributing analytical insight, interpretation of findings, and project updates
* Support senior team members in project scoping, methodology development, proposal preparation, and estimation of project requirements

Team Support
  
  

* Provide guidance and quality oversight to junior colleagues on literature screening and data extraction
* Collaborate proactively with senior consultants and cross-functional teams to ensure project objectives are met
* Contribute to internal knowledge sharing, training, methodology development, and continuous improvement of research processes and tools

Required Technical Expertise
  
  
Core Skills
  
  

* Sound HEOR, epidemiological, and analytical skills, with the ability to critically interpret complex scientific and health outcomes data
* Strong problem-solving mindset paired with excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Proactive, flexible, and resourceful, with the ability to work independently and manage ambiguity
* Excellent team player who is self-motivated and dependable
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office - PowerPoint, Word, and Excel - and familiarity with reference-management software such as EndNote or equivalent
* Working knowledge of AI tools and their application to research and analysis workflows

Education and Experience
  
  
Education
  
  

* MPH, MSc, MPharm, or equivalent postgraduate qualification in Epidemiology, Health Economics, Outcomes Research, Biostatistics, Pharmacy, Public Health, or a related life sciences discipline

**Required Experience**

* 4-6 years of relevant experience in HEOR, epidemiology, evidence synthesis, or related research within pharmaceutical companies or Life Science consulting firms
* Demonstrated experience conducting secondary research, literature reviews, evidence synthesis, and interpreting complex scientific data
* Experience managing multiple projects concurrently, with some guidance from senior team members

*Diversity, equity and inclusion are valued at Red Nucleus and we believe we have a shared responsibility to provide equal opportunity and foster an inclusive spirit. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, religion, caste, sexual orientation, gender, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Plant & NPI Support:

* Ability to build strong collaborative relationships with NPI buyers, supplier development engineers, quality teams, production, manufacturing, and suppliers.
