title: Product Design Technician - Level II - OFFC
description:
**Job Summary**
The Product Design Technician – Level II is responsible for creating, modifying, and maintaining engineering models, drawings, and product specifications for Cummins products in accordance with company, industry, national, and international standards.
  
  
The role primarily supports EBU component and assembly design activities using Creo, including 3D modeling, production drawing development, GD&T application, CAD quality checks, Windchill data management, and engineering change implementation. The position works closely with engineers and cross-functional teams to deliver accurate, manufacturable, and configuration-controlled product documentation while meeting defined quality and timing expectations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Design & CAD Modeling**

* Create and modify 3D component and assembly models using Creo based on engineering requirements, design inputs, packaging constraints, and applicable standards.
* Develop and maintain product specifications, including solid models, configured engineering bill of materials, and detailed engineering drawings.
* Support engineers in developing CAD concepts and basic design solutions for assigned EBU components and assemblies.
* Apply mechanical design principles and working knowledge of product systems to develop accurate and practical design solutions.
* Consider product requirements, operating environments, interfaces, clearances, manufacturability, and lifecycle requirements when developing models and drawings.
* Escalate complex design or technical decisions to the responsible engineer or technical lead.

**Engineering Drawings & GD&T**

* Create and revise production drawings using Creo, including dimensions, tolerances, GD&T, notes, materials, and other required engineering specifications.
* Ensure drawings accurately communicate design intent and manufacturing and inspection requirements.
* Apply Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) principles appropriately to product designs.
* Ensure models and drawings comply with applicable Cummins, industry, national, and international standards.
* Participate in Drawing Quality Reviews and incorporate review feedback into engineering documentation.

**CAD Quality & Self-Check**

* Perform detailed self-checks of Creo models and drawings before formal review.
* Verify geometry, dimensions, interfaces, clearances, drawing details, GD&T, and design requirements.
* Identify and correct discrepancies, errors, and quality issues before release.
* Maintain high standards of CAD and drawing quality through adherence to established design practices and procedures.

**Windchill & Product Data Management**

* Use Windchill and applicable CAD data management tools to manage models, drawings, associated product data, revisions, and lifecycle activities.
* Maintain configuration control, data integrity, security, and traceability of product artifacts.
* Establish and maintain product artifact baselines in accordance with configuration management processes.
* Support the release, tracking, control, and communication of product changes from concept through obsolescence.

**Engineering Change Management**

* Process and implement approved engineering changes, including CR/CN/CA activities, in Creo models, drawings, and associated product data.
* Complete required Windchill activities while maintaining accurate revision and configuration control.
* Process internal engineering work requests in accordance with established procedures and timelines.
* Ensure changes are accurately reflected across applicable product documentation and configurations.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Engage with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Product Development, and other functional teams as required.
* Obtain and incorporate engineering inputs to develop accurate product specifications and documentation.
* Communicate technical information, requirements, risks, and work status clearly to relevant stakeholders.
* Support effective communication of product design intent across engineering, manufacturing, and inspection functions.

**Delivery & Continuous Improvement**

* Complete assigned design and drafting activities within agreed quality, scope, and timing expectations.
* Communicate risks, technical concerns, and potential delays at an early stage.
* Progressively work with reduced supervision as technical capability and product knowledge develop.
* Learn from drawing reviews, checker feedback, quality issues, and completed assignments and apply lessons learned to future work.
* Participate in maintaining and improving design standards, practices, tools, and processes.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of product design quality, documentation, and engineering workflows.

**Competency**
**Technical Competencies**

* Mechanical Design Modeling and Analysis: Creates accurate CAD models in accordance with established standards and supports design analysis and evaluation activities.
* Mechanical Design of Mechanical Systems: Applies knowledge of mechanical systems and design principles to develop sound and practical design concepts.
* Mechanical Design Specification: Creates complete and accurate product specifications through solid models, configured engineering BOMs, and detailed drawings.
* Product Configuration and Change Management: Maintains product artifact baselines and ensures changes are properly released, tracked, controlled, and communicated throughout the product lifecycle.
* CAD and Drawing Quality: Applies established CAD standards, performs effective self-checks, and ensures drawings and models meet defined quality requirements.
* GD&T Application: Applies GD&T principles to accurately define product requirements and manufacturing/inspection characteristics.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Communicates Effectively: Clearly communicates technical information, requirements, work status, and concerns to different audiences.
* Decision Quality: Makes sound and timely decisions within the scope of assigned responsibilities and established processes.
* Drives Results: Delivers assigned work with focus on quality, accuracy, productivity, and timelines.
* Instills Trust: Demonstrates integrity, accountability, reliability, and transparency in interactions and work delivery.
* Manages Complexity: Analyses technical information and resolves issues using a structured approach.
* Self-Development: Actively develops technical knowledge and skills through training, feedback, and practical experience.
* Values Differences: Recognizes and respects different perspectives, experiences, and approaches while working with diverse teams.

**Qualifications**

* High school diploma, certificate of completion of secondary education, or equivalent experience in an appropriate STEM field.
* A relevant two-year Associate Degree, technical diploma, or regionally applicable certification may be required depending on the location and role.
* Formal education or technical training in mechanical design, drafting, CAD, or a related engineering discipline is preferred.
* The position may require licensing or eligibility in accordance with applicable export control or sanctions regulations.

**Required**
**Skills & Experience**

* Some relevant work experience with intermediate-level technical knowledge gained through education, training, internships, or on-the-job experience.
* Hands-on experience with Creo Parametric 3D modeling and drafting .
* Ability to create and modify mechanical component and assembly models.
* Experience creating and revising engineering drawings with dimensions, tolerances, notes, materials, and other engineering specifications.
* Working knowledge of GD&T and mechanical drawing practices.
* Understanding basic mechanical design principles and engineering documentation requirements.
* Working knowledge of Windchill or other PLM/CAD data management systems .
* Understanding of product configuration and engineering change management processes.
* Ability to perform CAD and drawing self-checks and identify geometry, dimension, interface, clearance, and documentation issues.
* Basic understanding of manufacturing processes and design-for-manufacturing considerations.
* Ability to interpret engineering requirements, design inputs, specifications, and technical documentation.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to drawing and CAD quality.
* Good communication, problem-solving, organizational, and time-management skills.
* Ability to work effectively with engineers, technical leads, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Ability to manage assigned work independently while escalating complex technical issues appropriately.

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting engine or EBU components and assemblies .
* Experience with Windchill product lifecycle and configuration management activities.
* Exposure to CR/CN/CA engineering change processes .
* Experience participating in formal Drawing Quality Reviews or design reviews.
* Knowledge of applicable Cummins, industry, national, and international engineering standards.
* Familiarity with manufacturing processes and inspection requirements.
* Experience working in a structured engineering design, drafting, or product development environment.

title: Documentation and Coordination Consultant
description:
**About the Project**

Room to Read India is leading a 12-month scoping and planning project (INV-109769) on reading fluency and comprehension in akshara scripts. The project is run by Room to Read India Trust from December 2026 to November 2027. It does not implement a program in schools. It builds the evidence base and a research agenda for the sector.

The work sits within Research and Insights, one of Room to Read's four core competencies, alongside Curriculum and Content, Educator Training and Coaching, and Delivery Structures. Its outputs are an evidence synthesis, a report and research agenda, two roundtables of about 40 participants each, and a dissemination event of about 100 participants. A four-member advisory board validates the findings, and the findings are published openly.

**Position Overview:**

The Documentation Consultant collates evidence, documents interviews and discussions, and turns research inputs into clear, well-structured materials for the India literacy innovations evidence scoping. The person in this role will support the synthesis of findings, coordinate with experts to set up the interviews and take part in them, prepare materials for the expert review, advisory-board validation, roundtables and dissemination event, and coordinate the project's written outputs so that they are complete, consistent and on time.

This is a full-time, in-office consultancy, reporting to the Research Lead, with oversight from the Senior Lead, IDTS, and working closely with the Research Consultant. It requires occasional travel to document the roundtables and the dissemination of events.

**The Role Involves:**

**Evidence Collation**

• Collect, organize and file the sources, data and reference material used in the desk review and evidence mapping.

• Maintain a shared evidence library with consistent naming, citations, and version control.

**Documentation of Interviews and Discussions:**

• Take clear notes and prepare structured records of stakeholder interviews and discussions (Months 1 to 3).

• Coordinate with experts to schedule the interviews and take part in them, so that the evidence is documented first-hand (Months 1 to 3).

• Document the expert review (Month 3), advisory-board sessions, and both roundtables (May and July 2027), including key points, decisions and follow-ups.

• Handle interview records with confidentiality, and with consent where needed.

**Synthesis Support:**

• Help the Research Lead and the Research Consultant bring evidence and interview findings together into themes and summaries.

• Check drafts for accuracy, consistency, and referencing against the sources.

**Preparation of Research Materials and Outputs:**

• Prepare briefing notes, presentations, and participant material for the roundtables and the dissemination event (about 100 participants, Months 11 to 12).

• Edit and format the evidence report and research agenda (Month 10) and the open publication and share-back materials.

• Shape how the findings are read: turn complex evidence into reports and syntheses that are clear, engaging, and the first thing a policymaker or practitioner opens, with formats, summaries and visuals for different readers.

• Prepare the report and research agenda for open, free publication and wide dissemination.

**Coordination of Project Outputs:**

• Track outputs, drafts and review comments against the Implementation Calendar and flag delays to the Research Lead.

• Keep final versions organized so that Room to Read India can report on them to the donor.

**Other Duties:**

Undertake any other work assigned from time to time to meet the needs of the project.

**Qualifications Required:**

• Bachelor’s/Master's degree in education, Social Sciences, Development Studies, Communications or related fields.

• Minimum 4 years of experience in documentation, research support, or report writing in the education or development sector.

• Excellent written English and strong Hindi; ability to take accurate notes in both languages.

• Strong editing, formatting and referencing skills, and ability to turn raw notes into clear structured documents.

• Experience organizing evidence, files, and version-controlled documents.

• Attention to detail, and ability to work deadlines with several reviewers.

• Willingness to travel to document roundtables and events.

**Desirable:**

• Postgraduate qualification in a relevant field.

• Experience documenting workshops, consultations or expert panels.

Understanding literacy or education research.

• Understanding how people read and consume research reports, and flair for making

them interesting.

• Familiarity with reference-management tools and basic design or presentation tools.

**Key Competencies:**

• Accuracy and attention to detail: records, cites and edits without errors.

Organization: keeps evidence, drafts, and versions in order to prevent deadlines.

• Synthesis: turns notes and findings into clear, structured summaries.

• Confidentiality: handles interview material with care and consent.

• Collaboration: works responsively with the Research Lead, the Research Consultant and reviewers.

• Coordination: Work with experts and the research team to set up interviews and keep them on track.

**Duration of Project:**

This is a full-time, in-office consultancy for the project period, December 2026 to November 2027. Fees will be set in the consultancy agreement.

* Run the content workflow from planning and production through review and publishing.
* Coordinate people, deadlines, and handoffs to keep content moving.
* Keep trackers up to date, with clear owners and due dates.
* Keep weekly updates and follow-ups on track, and raise blockers early.

3. Tech and Automation

* Set up tools and build small solutions for internal needs.
* Automate repetitive work and improve reusable workflows.
* Test, troubleshoot, and maintain tools and automations.
* Give teammates access and document how to use the tools.
* Experiment with AI coding tools to build solutions and simplify everyday work.

The role can also extend into strategy, product, or new initiatives, depending on company needs and your strengths.

Nothing is too small. Nothing is too big. If it needs doing, it’s on the table.

What Is the Growth Potential?

KraftedX alumni have gone on to:

* Join fast-growing startups like Lovable and ElevenLabs, at leadership positions.
* Secure admission to IIM A, B, C, K, L, and I.
* Build their own startups and grow their personal brands to 10,000+ followers.

What We Actually Mean by the Things Every JD Says

Every founder’s office JD uses the same words. Here’s what they mean to us:

Being a generalist

* Take on work across functions, even when the task is small or unfamiliar.
* Learn what you need and ask for help without ego.
* Connect ideas across domains to solve problems and use AI well.

High agency

* Bring up ideas, concerns, and better ways of working without waiting to be asked.
* Back your suggestions with context and clear thinking.

Ownership

* Take responsibility for the process, the outcome, and the follow-through.
* When something goes wrong, identify what broke, fix it, and learn from it.

Comfort with ambiguity

* Make progress even when you don’t have the full picture.
* Gather context, test quickly, and adjust as you learn.
* Stay organised when priorities shift or several things need attention.

The Kind of Person Who Thrives Here

* **Curious about AI.**
  You want to understand and use it better. Familiarity with AI coding tools or a willingness to learn them is a plus.

* **Thinks in systems.**
  You look for ways to make work repeatable through better workflows, documentation, and automation.

* **Comfortable with tech.**
  You don’t need to be a developer, but you should be willing to learn tools and troubleshoot problems.

* **Organised and reliable.**
  You keep trackers useful, follow up without being chased, and spot deadlines at risk.

* **Communicates clearly.**
  You write useful reports, explain how things work, and flag blockers early.

* **Always learning.**
  You learn from teammates, clients, mistakes, and unfamiliar subjects.

* **Willing to stretch.**
  You take on unfamiliar work and ask for help when needed.

* **Has no ego.**
  You do what’s needed, big or small.

How We Work

* **Work with intent.**
  Understand why you’re doing something and what success looks like before you begin.

* **Revision isn’t failure.**
  Good work takes rounds. Focus on the final outcome and an honest feedback process.

* **Trust, not surveillance.**
  No time tracking or activity monitoring. We measure outcomes. Stay in sync, communicate proactively, and flag problems early.

* **We work with people we believe in.**
  Values and ethics guide who we work with, both clients and teammates.

Why Join Us?

Small team. High trust. Real accountability.

* **Direct access.**
  Work with the founder on real problems and decisions.

* **Real breadth.**
  Learn how the business works through research, content operations, internal systems, and small builds.

* **Hands-on AI experience.**
  Help shape how the team uses AI and agents in everyday work.

* **Visible impact.**
  See how your work contributes to the team’s results.

If you’re early in your career, curious, and comfortable learning as the work evolves, come talk to us.

title: Clinical & Health Specialist
description:
**About Turing:**

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM, and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking experienced Clinical & Health Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to author, evaluate, and calibrate high-fidelity clinical tasks, long-chart scenarios, workplace simulations, and benchmark evaluation rubrics.

This unified opening covers contributors across multiple clinical, behavioral-health, revenue-cycle, quality, pharmacy, rehabilitation, and healthcare-operations disciplines. Candidates will be placed in either an Expert Contributor or Senior Specialist / Functional Lead track based on clinical depth, years of experience, active licensure or certification, leadership experience, and prior review or calibration expertise.

**Clinical & Health Disciplines Covered:**

* Acute-Care Physical, Occupational, and Speech-Language Therapy
* Pathology, Laboratory Cytotechnology, and Genetic Counseling
* Utilization Management, Prior Authorization, and Payer Claims
* Dietetics, Nutrition, Diabetes Education, and Chronic-Disease Education
* Hospital Social Work and Behavioral-Health Therapy
* Clinical Quality Improvement, Patient Safety, Infection Prevention, and EVS Policy
* Medical Coding, CDI, Billing, and Denials
* Hospital Pharmacy and Clinical Pharmacology
* Psychiatry, Addiction Medicine, and Behavioral Health
* Emergency Medicine, EMS Medical Direction, Paramedic, and EMT Handoffs

**Requirements:**

* Approximately 3 to 15+ years of demonstrable professional experience in one or more relevant Clinical & Health disciplines.
* Current or recent practice within the last three years in the applicable clinical, hospital, payer, laboratory, behavioral-health, revenue-cycle, or quality setting.
* Active professional licensure, board certification, or recognized credential appropriate to the discipline.
* Strong clinical reasoning, chart-review, documentation, and written communication skills.
* Ability to interpret fragmented medical records, reconcile conflicting information, identify missing or unsafe actions, and produce clinically defensible conclusions.
* High attention to detail, particularly regarding patient safety, clinical terminology, medical necessity, coding accuracy, payer requirements, regulatory standards, and documentation gaps.
* Ability to work within structured review cycles, standardized rubrics, and fast-paced calibration environments.
* Familiarity with US clinical guidelines, payer policies, regulatory requirements, and healthcare workflows is preferred. Relevant reference materials may be supplied in context for non-US contributors.

**Role-Specific Qualifications:**

Depending on the assigned discipline, relevant qualifications may include:

* Active PT, OT, SLP, RN, RD/RDN, LCSW, PharmD, MD, DO, or other applicable professional license.
* Board certification or specialist credentials such as BCPS, BCCCP, CIC, CPHQ, CPPS, CCS, CPC, CDIP, CCDS, CDCES, ABEM, ABPN, ABPM, or equivalent.
* Experience with acute-care rehabilitation, swallow evaluation, nutrition support, diabetes education, utilization management, prior authorization, payer appeals, medical coding, CDI, infection prevention, NHSN reporting, medication reconciliation, addiction medicine, emergency medicine, or EMS medical direction.
* Experience authoring or reviewing complex clinical documentation, longitudinal charts, discharge plans, medical-necessity determinations, coding assignments, safety assessments, or quality audits.

**Responsibilities:**

* Clinical Benchmark Authoring & Task Design: Develop high-difficulty clinical tasks, long-chart scenarios, realistic workplace cases, gold-standard answers, and evaluation criteria within the assigned discipline.
* Longitudinal Chart Synthesis: Evaluate fragmented, multi-encounter records and identify clinically meaningful trends, contradictions, omissions, risks, and required actions.
* Clinical Accuracy & Safety Review: Assess whether outputs are clinically accurate, practical, evidence-aligned, patient-safe, and appropriate for the relevant care setting.
* Rubric Application & Scoring: Apply evaluation criteria defined by the Functional SME Lead to assess outputs for clinical reasoning, terminology, documentation quality, regulatory alignment, payer accuracy, and patient-safety implications.
* Specialty Task Evaluation: Depending on the assigned area, review tasks involving mobility and discharge planning, swallow and diet-texture recommendations, medical necessity, prior authorization, claims and denials, nutrition support, diabetes management, psychosocial safety, infection prevention, coding and CDI, medication safety, addiction treatment, emergency decision-making, or EMS handoffs.
* Peer Review & Calibration — Senior Track: Review and calibrate pod members’ work, resolve edge-case ambiguities, identify rubric inconsistencies, and maintain day-to-day quality standards.
* Cross-Functional Review: Evaluate tasks that require coordination across physicians, nurses, therapists, pharmacists, social workers, dietitians, coders, case managers, payers, laboratory professionals, or emergency personnel.
* Iterative Refinement: Incorporate calibration feedback, revise task content and solutions, and participate in multiple critique cycles to align deliverables with project standards.
* Escalation & Quality Ownership — Senior Track: Escalate genuine clinical, regulatory, or rubric ambiguities to the Functional SME Lead and support consistent decision-making across the pod.

**Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree, graduate degree, professional degree, or equivalent practical experience in a relevant healthcare discipline.
* Active professional license, board certification, or recognized industry credential where applicable.
* Experience in clinical practice, healthcare operations, medical review, AI evaluation, data annotation, content review, quality assurance, clinical documentation, or a related analytical role is preferred.
* Prior experience reviewing expert work, creating clinical education content, developing assessment materials, or participating in quality-improvement programs is advantageous.
* Senior Specialist / Functional Lead Expectations

**Senior contributors may be responsible for:**

* Authoring high-difficulty tasks and gold-standard solutions.

description:

* Preparing and managing Interface Management Plans and associated documentation
* Coordinating interface activities with system-wide contractors, civil contractors, and consultants
* Ensuring timely communication and resolution of interface issues with stakeholders
* Overseeing the integration of signaling, telecom, and power supply systems with Rolling Stock

* Degree in Engineering (Mechanical/Electrical)
* Minimum 10 years of professional experience in interface coordination and management of Rolling Stock systems
* Experience in at least one driverless metro rail project (Grade of Automation 4)
* Knowledge of metro Rolling Stock system integration, testing, and commissioning
* Strong interpersonal skills for managing relationships with customers, contractors, and stakeholders
* Proven leadership, accountability, and teamwork abilities
* Understanding of interface functions and ability to manage milestone tracking

**Things you’ll enjoy**
Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:
  
  

* Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from boring daily routines

* Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
* Contribute to innovative projects
* Utilise our flexible and inclusive working environment

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

description:

**About Alvarez & Marsal**
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work - guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity - are why our people love working at A&M.
  
  
**The Team**
We are seeking an enthusiastic, self-motivated knowledge management professional to join our growing KM Services team. As part of A&M’s Global AI and Knowledge Organization, KM Services is at the center of an exciting firm-wide transformation in how A&M works and derives value from its intellectual property. The team is focused on building a mature knowledge management practice, including strengthening relationships with business stakeholders; breaking down siloes; and improving how consulting teams capture, organize, share, and find critical knowledge. In addition to supporting people-to-people and people-to-content use cases, the team has a critical role in building the data and information layer needed to power business-relevant AI agents and tools. The successful candidate will own the KM relationship for a portfolio of India business units, partnering closely with those businesses to improve their existing KM processes, understand their evolving needs, and connect them to the global KM strategy and toolkit. This is a high-visibility role for someone who wants to help business units get more value from their knowledge while also contributing directly to global KM and AI initiatives. The role will report to the EMEA & India KM Services Director
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**

* Partner with A&M Business Units on KM Initiatives
* Own the day-to-day KM relationship for India business units, with the opportunity to expand the portfolio over time
* Serve as the primary liaison between assigned business units and the central KM team, identifying opportunities to extend each business unit’s use of KM services and maximize KM adoption and value
* Lead projects to build and refine business-unit KM processes and tools, including coordinating timelines and partnering with KM services, KM technology, and other corporate groups on execution
* Monitor and provide routine support for business-unit KM processes and tools (e.g., knowledge libraries, taxonomies, capture processes, search, and communities)
* Provide advice and recommendations to business units based on internal and external KM best practices.
* Contribute to KM Knowledge and Expertise
* Partner with KM colleagues to design and build global capabilities and tools (e.g., expert profiles, conversational knowledge search, agentic knowledge capture) and help extend them to new areas of the business
* Support KM team members on initiatives both within and beyond the immediate region, contributing to a cohesive global KM capability
* Share knowledge of processes, approaches, methods, and tools/platforms with team colleagues so the team can leverage its collective experience across the globe
* Provide insight into business needs, initiatives, and end-user experience to help ensure global KM service offerings remain relevant and aligned to overall strategy
* Support the growth and evolution of the KM team by applying KM best practices in ways that strengthen the success of the overall KM support model
* AI Risk & Audit
* Identify internal and external KM trends and best practices; communicate and promote these to business-unit KM contacts
* Champion KM best practices and encourage knowledge sharing and adoption of new tools throughout the region and firm

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in a knowledge management role
* Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent work/technical experience in Business Studies, Business Administration, or Management
* Experience leading projects from inception to completion, including collaborating with stakeholders on timelines and expectations and handling change management
* Experience in a professional services or consultancy firm
* Proven experience working with professionals of all staff classes, up to C-level
* Experience with KM technology (e.g., SharePoint libraries, AI-enabled search and discovery tools)
* Fluent English required. Additional languages (Mandarin, Cantonese, Japanese, or Korean) are a plus but not required
* Consultative approach when partnering with the business
* Experience with KM and content management approaches (e.g., communities, skills and experience platforms, document libraries, taxonomy and metadata, search, curation, content analytics)
* Analytical reasoning and solution-focused problem solving, with the ability to connect the dots and scale KM efforts across a portfolio of business units
* Capable of synthesizing information and driving results in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to balance multiple projects and prioritize effectively
* Excellent communication and listening skills, with the ability to present complex ideas and solutions to technical and non-technical audiences
* Demonstrated history of operating with urgency, responsiveness, and a client-first focus
* Exceptionally close attention to detail
* Resilience and an ability to persevere in order to break down resistance and accomplish long-term goals

**Your journey at A&M**
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

**Position Summary**

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) - Course Instructor
description:
Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) - Course Instructor

About Tutedude

Tutedude is an upskilling platform founded by IIT Delhi alumni. It helps learners build job-ready skills through practical, industry-oriented courses. We combine self-paced learning with personalized mentorship, hands-on projects and real-world assignments to close the gap between learning and getting hired. Our mission is to make quality education accessible, outcome-driven and aligned with what the industry needs.

Location: Fully Remote

Engagement Type: Contract

Compensation: ₹90,000 – ₹1,00,000/month

Tutedude is looking for an expert to create and deliver a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) course. The course will turn students and early-career developers into engineers who can work directly with customers, scope messy real-world problems and ship AI-powered solutions into production.

This role is focused on content creation. Your main job will be to design the curriculum, record video lessons and build practical learning experiences for learners.

Responsibilities

\* Design a complete FDE curriculum, from foundations to advanced, covering both the engineering and the customer-facing parts of the role.

\* Record high-quality, hands-on video lessons showing how FDEs take a customer problem from discovery to a deployed solution.

\* Create assignments, projects and a final capstone based on real customer engagements: scoping, building, deploying and presenting.

\* Show how to build and ship solutions across API integrations and data pipelines, LLM-powered applications, RAG systems, AI agents with tool calling and MCP, evals and prompt iteration, cloud deployment and observability, and customer-specific customizations on top of a core product.

\* Teach the non-code skills of the role: requirement discovery, working through ambiguity, writing technical specs, running demos, managing stakeholders and turning field feedback into product input.

\* Keep the course current with industry practices and new AI capabilities.

Ideal Candidate

\* Has 3+ years of experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Implementation Engineer or Customer Engineer, or in a similar customer-facing engineering role at a product or AI company.

\* Writes production-grade code in Python and/or TypeScript and is comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, SQL, authentication (API keys, OAuth, SSO) and working with messy customer data.

\* Has built and deployed LLM applications in production using the OpenAI, Claude or Gemini APIs, including structured outputs, RAG and vector databases, tool-calling agents, and MCP (Model Context Protocol) to connect agents to real systems.

\* Knows how to evaluate and improve AI systems: building eval sets, measuring accuracy, debugging hallucinations, and trading off latency against cost.

\* Has deployed solutions on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP or Azure) using Docker and CI/CD, with logging, monitoring and error handling suitable for enterprise use.

\* Has integrated with enterprise systems such as CRMs, ERPs, data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Postgres) or internal tools, under real security and compliance constraints.

\* Has worked directly with customers to scope requirements, run discovery calls, deliver demos and own a deployment end-to-end.

\* Can show at least 3–4 real customer or company deployments with measurable impact. Tutorial projects and side projects don't count.

\* Is comfortable recording professional-quality video content on their own.

Preferred Qualifications

\* Experience teaching, running workshops, delivering training programs or creating educational content is a strong advantage.

\* Experience at an AI-first company, a high-growth startup or an enterprise SaaS company is a plus.

\* Experience with data engineering tools (dbt, Airflow) or frontend frameworks (React, Next.js) for building customer-facing internal tools is a plus.

Who Should Apply?

We want practitioners who have sat with customers, understood their problems and shipped engineering solutions those customers rely on, and who can teach others to do the same. If you've been the engineer who bridges product and customer, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Software Quality Engineer
description:
**About the Role:**

We are seeking a highly motivated and collaborative Quality Engineer to join our New Product Development (NPD) Quality team. In this role, you will partner with Design Engineering, Test Engineering, Advanced Operations, Manufacturing, Regulatory Affairs, and other cross-functional teams to ensure the successful development, transfer, and commercialization of high-quality medical devices products.

The Quality Engineer will provide leadership and technical expertise in Design Assurance, Risk Management, Design Controls, Process Validation, Usability Engineering, Supplier Quality, and Manufacturing Quality, ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and quality standards throughout the product lifecycle.

**Who We Are Looking For**

We are looking for individuals who are:

* Self-directed initiators who take ownership of their work, proactively identify opportunities for improvement, and consistently deliver high-quality results.
* Collaborative partners who build strong cross-functional relationships and effectively communicate with internal and external stakeholders.
* Analytical problem solvers who investigate root causes, evaluate data-driven solutions, and implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions.

**Key Responsibilities**

Design Assurance

* Support Design Assurance activities throughout the medical device product development lifecycle.
* Ensure compliance with Design Control requirements in accordance with FDA QSR/QMSR, ISO 13485, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Support preparation, review, and maintenance of Design History File (DHF) documentation.
* Review product requirements, design outputs, verification, validation, and traceability documentation.
* Support implementation and migration of quality systems and tools (e.g., Jama, Integrity, Matrix, or equivalent).

Risk Management

* Lead and support Risk Management activities in accordance with ISO 14971.
* Develop and maintain Risk Management Files throughout product development and manufacturing transfer.
* Facilitate and review Functional Analysis, Hazard Analysis, dFMEA, pFMEA, and uFMEA.
* Support Critical Quality Attribute (CQA) identification.
* Ensure appropriate risk controls are identified, implemented, verified, and documented.
* Evaluate manufacturing and process risks and ensure effective mitigation throughout the manufacturing lifecycle.

Validation & Usability Engineering

* Support development and maintenance of Usability Engineering Files in accordance with IEC 62366-1.
* Participate in usability studies, formative evaluations, and validation activities.
* Review and approve validation protocols, reports, and statistical analyses.
* Support Design Verification, Design Validation, Process Validation, Software Validation, Computer System Validation, and Sterilization Validation activities as applicable.

Manufacturing & Supplier Quality

* Partner with Advanced Operations and Manufacturing teams during design transfer.
* Ensure manufacturing processes are capable, controlled, and compliant before product launch.
* Support supplier qualification and supplier quality strategies.
* Review supplier validations, PPAP activities, and incoming quality requirements.
* Collaborate with suppliers to ensure components and manufacturing processes meet specified quality requirements.
* Participate in supplier performance monitoring and continuous improvement initiatives.

**What you need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in biomedical engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* Minimum 5-7 years of experience in Quality Engineering, Design Assurance, or Product Development within the medical device industry.
* Experience supporting New Product Development (NPD) in a medical device regulated environment.
* Strong understanding of medical device Design Controls and Risk Management principles.
* Experience preparing and reviewing quality and design documentation.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and organizational skills.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage priorities and deliver results in cross-functional environments.

Why Join Us?

This role provides the opportunity to contribute to the development of innovative medical device technologies while working with multidisciplinary teams in a highly collaborative environment. You will play a critical role in ensuring that our products are safe, effective, compliant, and successfully transferred into manufacturing, ultimately improving the quality of life for people across the globe.

description:

**Organization Profile:**
Centre for Chronic Disease Control (CCDC) is a not-for-profit research organization engaged in knowledge generation and knowledge translation for the prevention and control of non-communicable (chronic) diseases in varied settings of developing countries. CCDC has been recognized as a Scientific and Industrial Research Organization (SIRO) by Department of Scientific & Industrial Research (DSIR), Ministry of Science and Technology, Government of India. CCDC also holds recognition as a WHO Collaborating Centre for Surveillance, Capacity Building and Translational Research in Cardio-metabolic diseases and is an ICMR Collaborating Centre of Excellence.
  
  
**Project Brief:**
This project aims to evaluate the impact and feasibility of using a multicomponent digital health model for home-based care of post-discharge heart failure patients in India.
  
  
**Job Description**

* Organise various stakeholder meetings, workshops and review meetings.
* Work in close coordination with advisory board members, subject matter experts.
* Application and oversight of Ethics and HMSC submissions.
* Development and administration of research tools such as questionnaires for in-depth interviews, focus groups discussions, and surveys during the formative and evaluation phases.

* Report on a day-to-day basis to the Program Manager and Lead regarding program and seek timely advice wherever necessary.
* Coordinating with the stakeholders to ensure that critical issues are addressed in a timely manner.

title: Program Coordinator – Livelihoods - INDIA
description:
BRAC is an award-winning international non-governmental development organization, with the vision of a world free from all forms of exploitation and discrimination, where everyone has the opportunity to realise their potential. BRAC is a leader in developing and implementing cost-effective, evidence-based programmes to assist poor and disadvantaged communities in low-income countries, including in conflict-prone and post-disaster settings. It is an organisation of and for the people of the Global South, pioneering new development and social enterprise approaches to equip communities to achieve prosperity. As well as being the world's biggest NGO by the number of staff and people directly reached, BRAC has regularly been ranked the number one NGO in the world by the Geneva-based NGO Advisor, an independent organisation committed to highlighting innovation, impact, and governance in the non-profit sector. BRAC retained the top spot in 2020 among the top 500 NGOs for the fifth consecutive year.
  
  
BRAC was founded in Bangladesh in 1972 and over the last five decades has grown to become one of the world’s largest non-governmental organisations (NGOs), reaching over 100 million people. We started our first international operation by venturing into Afghanistan in 2002, building on lessons from our work in Bangladesh to support a nation devastated by war. Currently operating in 16 countries across Asia and Africa. Born, proven and led in the Global South, BRAC International brings a unique Southern perspective and commitment to continuous learning, providing a depth of insight, experience and evidence to meet the needs of diverse communities with humility and courage across Asia and Africa.
  
  
To learn more about BRAC International, please visit (www.bracinternational.org).
  
  
**About The Ultra-Poor Graduation Initiative**
The Ultra-Poor Graduation Initiative (UPGI) is a flagship programme of BRAC International at the global level that seeks to advance the use of proven Graduation approaches by governments at scale to address extreme poverty. UPGI primarily works with a range of global and national partners to pursue this mission. Focal countries include, but are not limited to, India, Indonesia, the Philippines, Ethiopia, Tanzania, Rwanda, and South Africa.
  
  
BRAC UPGI aims to position the evidence-backed Graduation approach as a key driver to eradicate extreme poverty worldwide. It does this by:
  
  

* Advocating for uptake of the Graduation approach by policymakers, national governments, multilateral institutions, and non-governmental organisations; and
* Effective adaptation and implementation of the Graduation approach in countries around the world, supported through technical assistance and capacity strengthening for external stakeholders.

In 2002, BRAC pioneered the Ultra-Poor Graduation (“Graduation”) approach in Bangladesh - a sequenced, two-year investment that enables people to create lasting pathways out of extreme poverty - after recognising that existing programmes were not reaching the poorest people. Through the provision of a productive asset, basic needs support, and ongoing coaching, the Graduation approach tackles multiple constraints at once and achieves lasting impact.
  
  
Graduation has been adapted and implemented across a wide variety of contexts and countries, with dozens of rigorous evaluations documenting its effectiveness at achieving broad and lasting impact, as well as returns that greatly outweigh the costs. So far, a total of 6.7 million households have been reached by Graduation programs, more than 2 million of which BRAC reached through its flagship Graduation programme in Bangladesh.
  
  
To help eradicate extreme poverty, BRAC UPGI is working with governments across Africa and Asia to scale Graduation by integrating it into existing government programmes. Alongside governments, BRAC aims to equip 21 million more people to lift themselves from extreme poverty by 2030.
  
  
BRAC UPGI is committed to creating effective solutions that leverage the available resources and existing programming to achieve the long-term benefits demonstrated by the Graduation approach. The organization is partnering with governments, as well as multilateral institutions, NGOs, and civil society, in countries where BRAC UPGI thinks it can have maximum impact and drive greater uptake for Graduation.
  
  
**About BRAC International’s Work In India**
The National Rural Livelihood Promotion Society under the Ministry of Rural Development has signed an MoU with BRAC International, formalising a shared commitment to promote holistic economic inclusion and social protection for people living in extreme poverty, particularly women. The MoU envisions a focused strategy to reach the poorest and most excluded households through a time-bound investment in the Graduation approach, enabling more inclusive and sustainable livelihoods across rural India.
  
  
The partnership positions BRAC International as a strategic orchestrator, demonstrating how targeted interventions can reach extremely vulnerable groups while generating evidence for scale across State Rural Livelihood Missions (SRLMs). In this role, BRAC is not only providing technical assistance for the implementation of the Samaveshi Aajeevika Yojana (SAY) but also convening stakeholders, aligning systems, and enabling coordinated action across levels. Through its partner agencies, BRAC International has established Project Management Units (PMUs) at national and state levels to support the government in co-designing approaches and ensuring strong strategic guidance alongside effective implementation support.
  
  
The Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana-National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM) has allocated the following states to BRAC International: Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Himachal Pradesh, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Nagaland, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, and Uttarakhand.
  
  
**About The Position**
The BRAC UPGI seeks to hire a Program Coordinator - Livelihoods for the BRAC UPGI India Office. Reporting to the Program Advisor - Livelihoods, the Program Coordinator - Livelihoods will work closely with the UPGI India team, state teams, government counterparts, implementation partners, and technical organisations to strengthen the design, implementation, and quality of livelihood interventions for extremely vulnerable households.
  
  
The position will provide technical and programme support to strengthen livelihood approaches within the Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India’s Samaveshi Aajeevika Yojana (SAY) or similar government-led Graduation programmes, with a particular focus on livelihoods training and capacity building, market assessments, value-chain analysis, livelihood diversification, and innovative livelihood opportunities for extremely vulnerable households. The role will also support the Program Advisor - Livelihoods in translating programme strategy and technical learning into practical tools, training, guidance, and implementation support for national, state, and field teams.
  
  
The role requires comfort working in ambiguous and evolving environments, where solutions need to be developed and refined iteratively. The Program Coordinator - Livelihoods will contribute to a culture of continuous learning, documentation, and knowledge sharing, ensuring that field insights and evidence inform ongoing programme improvements and broader replication. This position offers an excellent opportunity for a mid- to senior-level professional to gain hands-on experience in Graduation programme design, government engagement, programme implementation, and knowledge management.
  
  
This is a full-time position based in New Delhi, India, with regular travel across SAY programme states, including remote and field locations. Regular in-person office hours are expected.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Training and Capacity Building
* Support the Program Advisor - Livelihoods in strengthening the technical capacity of state and government teams on livelihoods within graduation programmes.
* Support the design and delivery of national and state-level Livelihoods training and capacity-building programmes, including ToTs and technical trainings.
* Develop and adapt training plans, session plans, facilitator guides, presentations, tools, and other technical learning resources.
* Identify technical and capacity gaps between state and field teams and support the development of targeted capacity-building responses.
* Facilitate cross-state learning and knowledge-sharing on livelihood approaches, implementation challenges, and innovations.
* Support post-training follow-up to assess application of learning and identify areas requiring further technical assistance.
* Livelihood Innovations and Diversification
* Partner with state teams in identifying, assessing, and testing innovative and emerging livelihood opportunities suitable for extremely vulnerable households.
* Scan for promising livelihood models and economic opportunities beyond conventional livestock and non-farm interventions.
* Assess potential livelihood models based on investment requirements, market demand, income potential, gestation period, risks, seasonality, household suitability, and scalability.
* Support the design, testing, and refinement of livelihood prototypes and diversification approaches.
* Document evidence and learning from innovative livelihood pilots and support decisions on adaptation and scale-up.
* Market Assessment and Value-Chain Development
* Develop frameworks, tools, and approaches to support state teams in market assessment and value-chain analysis to inform livelihood planning.
* Facilitate state teams to identify viable market opportunities and explore market linkages, aggregation, processing and value addition for extremely vulnerable households.
* Support the development of practical approaches for market linkages, aggregation, processing, value addition and improved access to buyers and service providers.
* Facilitate the design and testing of selected market-linkage and value-addition pilots in partnership with state teams, private-sector actors, buyers, aggregators and other relevant stakeholders.
* Document learning from pilots and translate successful approaches into replicable models, guidance and tools for wider adoption by state teams.
* Engaging with private sector partners to strengthen market linkages
* Mapping key actors across the identified livelihood value chain, including producers, processors, traders, and buyers, and identifying gaps in production, processing, market access, and logistics.
* Identifying opportunities to increase value addition and income for SAY programme participants.
* Supporting development of scalable models across identified livelihood value chains.
* Knowledge Management, Learning and Evidence
* Document learning, emerging practices and implementation insights from state programmes, pilots and field experience.
* Support development of practical livelihood knowledge products, including technical notes, advisories, case studies, learning briefs, tools and training resources.
* Capture and synthesise learning from market and value-chain pilots, livelihood innovations and state-level implementation to inform programme adaptation.
* Translate field learning and evidence into practical recommendations, frameworks and tools that can be adopted by state teams.
* Conceptualise and organise internal learning events, peer-learning sessions, workshops and technical discussions to facilitate cross-state learning on livelihood programs.
* Cross-cutting Responsibilities
* Build and maintain effective working relationships with government counterparts, state teams, implementation partners, technical agencies and other key stakeholders.
* Perform other duties assigned by the Country Lead or Program Advisor - Livelihoods and contribute to a positive and collaborative team environment.
* Safeguarding Responsibilities
* Ensure the safety of team members from any harm, abuse, neglect, harassment, and exploitation to achieve the program’s goals of safeguarding implementation
* Practice, promote, and endorse the issues of safeguarding policy among team members and ensure the implementation of safeguarding standards in every course of action
* Follow the safeguarding reporting procedure in case any reportable incident takes place, and encourage others to do so.

**Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in Development Studies, Rural Management, Agriculture, Forestry, Economics, Agribusiness, Social Sciences, Public Policy, Livelihoods, Entrepreneurship, or another relevant field.
* 7-10 years of relevant experience in livelihoods, rural development, poverty reduction, agriculture, market systems, enterprise development, skills or related development programmes.
* Demonstrated experience in designing or supporting livelihoods interventions and capacity-building programmes for rural and tribal communities.
* Experience in market assessment, value-chain analysis, livelihood diversification or enterprise development is highly desirable.
* Experience working with extremely poor or vulnerable households is an advantage.
* Experience working with government ministries and agencies, DAY-NRLM/SRLMs, or similar large-scale development programmes is desirable.
* Experience working with community institutions, producer organizations, or value chains is desirable.
* Experience working with implementation partners, technical consultants, or development organisations.
* Strong training design, facilitation, and capacity-building skills.

title: Specialist , Communications - INDIA
description:
BRAC is an award-winning international non-governmental development organization, with the vision of a world free from all forms of exploitation and discrimination, where everyone has the opportunity to realise their potential. BRAC is a leader in developing and implementing cost-effective, evidence-based programmes to assist poor and disadvantaged communities in low-income countries, including in conflict-prone and post-disaster settings. It is an organisation of and for the people of the Global South, pioneering new development and social enterprise approaches to equip communities to achieve prosperity. As well as being the world's biggest NGO by the number of staff and people directly reached, BRAC has regularly been ranked the number one NGO in the world by the Geneva-based NGO Advisor, an independent organisation committed to highlighting innovation, impact, and governance in the non-profit sector. BRAC retained the top spot in 2020 among the top 500 NGOs for the fifth consecutive year.
  
  
BRAC was founded in Bangladesh in 1972 and over the last five decades has grown to become one of the world’s largest non-governmental organisations (NGOs), reaching over 100 million people. We started our first international operation by venturing into Afghanistan in 2002, building on lessons from our work in Bangladesh to support a nation devastated by war. Currently operating in 16 countries across Asia and Africa. Born, proven and led in the Global South, BRAC International brings a unique Southern perspective and commitment to continuous learning, providing a depth of insight, experience and evidence to meet the needs of diverse communities with humility and courage across Asia and Africa.
  
  
To learn more about BRAC International, please visit (www.bracinternational.org).
  
  
**About The Ultra-Poor Graduation Initiative**
The Ultra-Poor Graduation Initiative (UPGI) is a flagship programme of BRAC International at the global level that seeks to advance the use of proven Graduation approaches by governments at scale to address extreme poverty. UPGI primarily works with a range of global and national partners to pursue this mission. Focal countries include, but are not limited to, India, Indonesia, the Philippines, Ethiopia, Tanzania, Rwanda, and South Africa.
  
  
BRAC UPGI aims to position the evidence-backed Graduation approach as a key driver to eradicate extreme poverty worldwide. It does this by:
  
  

* Advocating for uptake of the Graduation approach by policymakers, national governments, multilateral institutions, and non-governmental organisations; and
* Effective adaptation and implementation of the Graduation approach in countries around the world, supported through technical assistance and capacity strengthening for external stakeholders.

In 2002, BRAC pioneered the Ultra-Poor Graduation (“Graduation”) approach in Bangladesh - a sequenced, two-year investment that enables people to create lasting pathways out of extreme poverty - after recognising that existing programmes were not reaching the poorest people. Through the provision of a productive asset, basic needs support, and ongoing coaching, the Graduation approach tackles multiple constraints at once and achieves lasting impact.
  
  
Graduation has been adapted and implemented across a wide variety of contexts and countries, with dozens of rigorous evaluations documenting its effectiveness at achieving broad and lasting impact, as well as returns that greatly outweigh the costs. So far, a total of 6.7 million households have been reached by Graduation programs, more than 2 million of which BRAC reached through its flagship Graduation programme in Bangladesh.
  
  
To help eradicate extreme poverty, BRAC UPGI is working with governments across Africa and Asia to scale Graduation by integrating it into existing government programmes. Alongside governments, BRAC aims to equip 21 million more people to lift themselves from extreme poverty by 2030.
  
  
BRAC UPGI is committed to creating effective solutions that leverage the available resources and existing programming to achieve the long-term benefits demonstrated by the Graduation approach. The organization is partnering with governments, as well as multilateral institutions, NGOs, and civil society, in countries where BRAC UPGI thinks it can have maximum impact and drive greater uptake for Graduation.
  
  
**About BRAC International’s Work In India**
The National Rural Livelihood Promotion Society under the Ministry of Rural Development has signed an MoU with BRAC International, formalising a shared commitment to promote holistic economic inclusion and social protection for people living in extreme poverty, particularly women. The MoU envisions a focused strategy to reach the poorest and most excluded households through a time-bound investment in the Graduation approach, enabling more inclusive and sustainable livelihoods across rural India.
  
  
The partnership positions BRAC International as a strategic orchestrator, demonstrating how targeted interventions can reach extremely vulnerable groups while generating evidence for scale across State Rural Livelihood Missions (SRLMs). In this role, BRAC is not only providing technical assistance for the implementation of the Samaveshi Aajeevika Yojana (SAY) but also convening stakeholders, aligning systems, and enabling coordinated action across levels. Through its partner agencies, BRAC International has established Project Management Units (PMUs) at national and state levels to support the government in co-designing approaches and ensuring strong strategic guidance alongside effective implementation support.
  
  
**About The Position**
This is an exciting opportunity for a communications professional to contribute to BRAC’s work in India, supporting the development and dissemination of compelling communications and knowledge content that brings programme and field experiences, partnerships, evidence, and learning to diverse audiences.
  
  
Reporting to the Program Advisor - Partnerships and Strategic Communications, the Communications Specialist will work closely with the programme teams and partners to develop high-quality written and visual content, strengthen BRAC India’s digital and social media presence, document stories and experiences from the field, and translate programme learning into accessible and engaging communications products. The role will support BRAC’s efforts to share knowledge, increase visibility and contribute to wider sectoral discourse on poverty reduction and inclusive livelihoods.
  
  
This is a hands-on, execution focused position that offers opportunities for creativity, collaboration and professional growth. It is well suited for someone with strong writing and creative communication skills, an eye for detail, and keen interest and motivation to use communications effectively to support social change.
  
  
This is a full-time position based in New Delhi, India. Regular in-person office hours are expected.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Content Development, Documentation and Knowledge Products
* Edit and proofread reports, briefs, case studies, learning notes and other publications, ensuring consistency in language, tone, and organisational branding.
* Draft, edit and adapt programme content into clear and accessible communication products for different audiences, including government, development partners, donors and wider sector audiences.
* Develop presentations, factsheets, and visual communication materials for internal and external use, coordinating with designers where needed.
* Undertake field visits to identify and document programme experiences, participant and coach journeys, implementation learnings and stories through interviews, photographs, short-form video and written documentation.

* Digital Communication and Outreach

* Support internal knowledge-sharing and documentation processes within the country office.
* Safeguarding Responsibilities

**Qualifications**

What You'll Do
  
  
BCG’s internal functions are the foundation of how our firm operates— representing thousands of professionals and hundreds of millions in investment that enable BCG to deliver exceptional client impact at global scale. As the firm continues to grow and technology changes rapidly, our internal operations face an extraordinary opportunity: to continue to evolve to an even more scalable, technology-enabled, global organization.
  
  
Our Operational Innovations (OI) team is at the center of this transformation. We are trusted partners to our functions and firm leadership for driving this ambitious change agenda. We enable step-change improvement in the effectiveness and efficiency of the firm by accelerating high-priority initiatives sponsored by the Operations Leadership Team and/or our Operating Committee. From technology & AI deployments to end-to-end process redesign, we partner with functional and geographic leaders to re-architect how the firm operates — faster, smarter, and more connected than ever before.
  
  
We don’t just manage change — we partner with the business to make it happen. Our team helps shape and accelerate BCG’s most strategic initiatives, providing hands-on executional leadership and deep expertise in transformation, digital enablement, and change management. We enable functions to scale effectively, improve performance, and unlock new sources of value through data, automation, and forward-thinking design.

Project emphasis to include operational improvement projects, and often the digital delivery of operational improvements, digital collaboration, and/or digital employee services.

Deliverables could include business improvement plans, process design, effective communication & engagement plans, implementation plans or supporting analyses for any of these. * Experience working in a multi-national or large scale environment
* Data Analysis – strong data analysis skills, able to communicate key insights effectively
* Curiosity and focus on continuous development, learning
* Creativity and openness to new approaches, digital tools, Agile methodologies

The OI Leadership Team and OI team members, especially project managers and change managers Internal Clients / stakeholders to develop communications to deliver project and stakeholder change objectives External Associates – our network of BCG approved contingent resources, when appropriate.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
**You’re Good At**

* Organizing and managing project details with a bias for getting to great output quickly – You are flexible and organized in your work and can be effective across a range of activities and stakeholders
* Working in a complex environment at pace – You are analytical and comfortable managing multiple deliverables with multiple inputs often with high impact, time sensitive requirements
* Data Analysis – Qualitative and quantitative evaluation of information and data to draw out insights and help shape project plans, business cases, etc.

*At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.*
*For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.*

* Minimum 2-3 years of experience in drafting and prosecution services and especially working on patent drafting and SEP support.
* Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in Telecommunication domain.
* Ability to perform prepare patent application from minimal available invention disclosures.

* Good understanding of Electrical circuits, control systems and VLSI technologies
* Knowledge of Intellectual Property (IP) fundamentals and US Patent laws

**It would be great if you also had . . .**

* PhD in Electronics and communication or any related field

* IP and/or telecom related certifications
* Knowledge of US, IN, EP, KR and JP patent laws

**What will you be doing in this role?**

* Draft high-quality patent applications, including specifications, claims, abstracts, and drawings coordination, based on invention disclosures, prior art searches, and technical analyses.
* Perform end-to-end patent prosecution activities, including responding to Office Actions across jurisdictions (e.g., US, EP, IN, KR, CN), and collaborating with foreign associates.
* Conduct invention mining sessions and work closely with inventors to identify patentable subject matter and refine claim strategies.
* Ensure ownership of deliverables from initial drafting through filing and prosecution, maintaining consistency, accuracy, and strategic alignment with client objectives.
* Communicate effectively with internal stakeholders, clients, and attorneys to provide updates, clarify technical aspects, and drive projects to completion.
* Adhere to defined timelines, SLAs, and project schedules while managing multiple priorities efficiently.
* Continuously upgrade technical and legal knowledge in emerging domains such as AI/ML, 5G/6G, IoT, semiconductors, and software-based innovations.
* Ensure strict adherence to organizational policies, confidentiality standards, and compliance requirements.
* Perform rigorous quality assurance by complying with established drafting and prosecution standards, ensuring high-quality outputs that meet or exceed client expectations.

**About The Team**

title: Bid Specialist - SaaS US Facing
company: iPrime Services Pvt Ltd , NCR India
description:
**Job Description — Bid & Proposal Executive (RFP Team)**

**Role overview**

iPrime is hiring a Bid & Proposal Executive to prepare, assemble and submit compliant responses to US RFPs, RFQs and RFIs, mainly from state and local government, airports, transit agencies, universities and enterprises. The role sits in the RFP team and reports to a US-based RFP Manager. It owns assigned bids from solicitation download to final submission, working with sales, technical and finance teams in India and with Veoci in the US.

**Location:**
Noida (on-site), with a shift overlapping US Eastern business hours
**Reports to:**
RFP Manager (US-based), as a member of the RFP team
**Experience:**
3–6 years in bid management or proposal writing, with US RFP experience strongly preferred
**Type:**
Full-time

**About iPrime:**
iPrime Services Pvt. Ltd. is Veoci's authorized partner for India and South Asia. We deliver aviation safety management, business continuity management (BCM) and emergency management solutions to airports, airlines, PSUs and enterprises, alongside mobile app development and QA services.

**Key responsibilities**

**Opportunity Search**

* Increase and broaden search : Monitor US bid sources daily (SAM.gov, state procurement portals, BidNet Direct, DemandStar, Periscope/Bonfire, airport and transit authority sites) and log relevant opportunities.
* Increase geo of search to EU and South America

**Opportunity tracking and qualification**

* Prepare a short bid/no-bid summary for each solicitation: scope, minimum qualifications, references required, insurance, set-asides and deadlines (in the issuer's time zone).
* Maintain the RFP tracker with stages, deadlines and owners.

**Bid preparation**

* Break down each solicitation into a compliance matrix covering every mandatory requirement, evaluation criterion and required form.
* Draft proposal sections in US business English: cover letter, executive summary, understanding of need, technical approach, implementation plan, project team, references and case studies.
* Coordinate inputs from sales, solution/technical, finance and Veoci on time.
* Submit written questions before the Q&A deadline, attend pre-proposal conferences (virtual) and track every addendum.
* Work with finance on pricing forms, cost proposals and SaaS subscription pricing.

**Documentation and compliance**

* Complete required forms like W-9, certificates of insurance (COI), non-collusion affidavits, conflict-of-interest and debarment certifications, DBE/MBE/WBE and subcontracting forms, and vendor registrations.
* Prepare security and accessibility responses: certifications , security questionnaires, SOC 2 and hosting details, VPAT/Section 508 statements using Internal RFP database and often times , laison with CISO and Product Expertss
* Get forms signed (wet or e-signature) and notarized where the solicitation requires it.
* Keep a reusable library of company documents, past proposals, references and standard answers up to date.

**Submission**

* Upload and submit bids on US e-procurement portals well before the deadline, converting it correctly to IST.
* Manage hard-copy submissions shipped by courier (printing, binding, USB copies, sealed and labelled packages) where required.
* Run a final compliance check against the matrix before every submission.

**Post-submission**

* Respond to clarification requests, and support finalist demos and oral presentations.
* Track bid status, award notices and bid tabulations; file public records requests for winning proposals where useful.
* Request debriefs after each loss, run a short win/loss review and update the content library.

**Using AI across the bid process**

The role is expected to use AI tools at every stage of the bid, with a human check on every output before it goes out.

* Opportunity tracking : Scan portal alerts, summarize new solicitations and draft the bid/no-bid summary
* Requirement analysis: Extract requirements, mandatory forms, deadlines and evaluation criteria from long RFP PDFs into the compliance matrix
* Drafting: Produce first drafts from the content library, tailored to the issuer, and rewrite to US style and page limits
* Review: Check every answer against the compliance matrix; flag gaps, inconsistencies and tone issues
* Pricing and forms: Cross-check pricing sheets and pre-fill standard forms for human verification
* Post-submission: Summarize debriefs, bid tabulations and competitor proposals; update the content library

The hire must fact-check all AI output, never invent capabilities or references, and use only company-approved AI tools for confidential client and pricing data.

**Qualifications and skills**

**Must have**

•      Graduate from a reputed college or university; B.Tech, BBA or MBA preferred.

•      2-4 years of hands-on bid or proposal work, with bids submitted end to end.

•      Experience responding to US public-sector or enterprise RFPs, and familiarity with US procurement terms (RFP/RFQ/RFI, addenda, COI, W-9, set-asides).

•      Fluent spoken and written English, comfortable on calls with US colleagues and clients; able to write clear, persuasive proposal content in US style.

•      Hands-on, daily use of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot or similar) for document analysis, drafting and review, with strong prompting skills and the judgement to verify every output.

•      Advanced MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint; comfortable with PDF editing and e-signature tools.

•      Very high attention to detail and the discipline to meet hard deadlines.

•      Willing to work a shift that overlaps US Eastern business hours.

**Good to have**

•      Class 12 board score above 80%.

•      Bids in SaaS, software services, airports, emergency management or public safety.

•      Experience with SAM.gov and federal basics (FAR, UEI/CAGE) for federal opportunities.

•      Familiarity with AI-enabled RFP software (Loopio, Responsive) and building reusable prompt libraries or custom AI assistants.

•      APMP Foundation or similar bid management certification.

**Personal attributes**

•      Organised, persistent follower-up who chases inputs without waiting to be asked.

•      Calm under deadline pressure, including late-night and weekend pushes near submissions.

•      Comfortable working across sales, technical and finance teams.

**How success is measured**

Bids submitted on time: 100%

Bids rejected on technical or document grounds: Zero

Submission lead time: At least 24 hours before deadline

RFP tracker and content library : Updated weekly

Win/loss review: Within 2 weeks of each result

Quality of Submission: Each requirment matched to the appropriate response form the database and modified to the context and content required : 100% matrh to the RFP Requirement

Number of Submitted Bids in Quarter: a minimum of 12 and 36 as a team.

**What we offer**

•      Exposure to US public-sector bids in aviation, BCM and emergency management.

•      Daily work with a US-based RFP Manager and a US SaaS partner (Veoci).

•      Competitive salary, based on experience.

**Application Process:**

1. Look up our websites : www.veoci.com and ww.iprimeserv.com
2. Examine our verticals , solutions and products as well as the case studies
3. Use AI to generate a specific resume tailored to Veoci. Self Generate is a great way too.
4. Review to make the resume personal - we can smell if the draft is 100% AI !!
5. A form will be sent out to the initial shortlisted persons asking for more details and requesting a video upload of yourself giving us a brief about yourself and why this job is important to you
6. Personal Interview: These will be a minimum of 3 rounds including US Managers
7. If you are a confident person , you will not be using AI assist to answer the questions. We will stop the interview at the first sign of such use - shifting eyes, face gestures, etc and may even ask to take control of your screen.

**Happy Applying**

description:

Algoworks is an award-winning artificial intelligence, engineering services and experience

operators united by rigor, accountability and a commitment to delivering measurable
