At Algoworks, growth is continuous and closely tied to impact. Teams collaborate across

geographies and disciplines, strengthening outcomes through shared insight and

collective expertise. The culture values transparency, open dialogue and an environment

where every voice is heard and contribution is recognized.

Through collaboration, accountability and a focus on results, Algoworks operates at the

intersection of technology and people, building not only advanced systems but strong

global teams that elevate performance and create lasting impact.

**Role Overview-**

The Implementation Consultant (IC) turns client requirements into a working, tested and

documented Gotransverse configuration with speed and precision. The IC works alongside

the Executive Sponsor, Project Manager, Business Analyst, Solution Architect and QA to

translate business requirements into platform configuration, support testing and

reconciliation, and ensure successful implementation and handover.

The role combines billing domain knowledge, hands-on platform skills, analytical thinking

and client-facing communication to deliver accurate and reliable configurations.

**Key Responsibilities-**

1. Discovery & Requirements

• Run working sessions with clients and translate contract terms and business

scenarios into configurable requirements.

• Ask clarifying questions to understand the business need behind client requests.

• Challenge unclear requirements and recommend best practices.

• Ensure requirements are traceable to corresponding build elements.

• Understand design specifications to determine implementation next steps.

2. Platform Configuration & Build

• Configure the catalog, charges, lookup tables, custom fields, SRIDs, mediation

streams and integrations.

• Translate documented requirements into accurate Gotransverse configurations.

• Validate configuration changes and check work before handing it off.

• Ensure configuration and runbook documentation remain current as the build

changes.

3. Testing & Reconciliation

• Write and execute test cases.

• Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and regression testing after changes.

• Reconcile system output against source data and client expectations.

• Investigate and explain variances between system output and source data.

• Triage defects and distinguish data issues, configuration gaps, new requirements

and product bugs.

4. Demo Preparation & Execution

• Prepare and conduct client demonstrations.

• Tailor demo scripts to the audience.

• Stage clean demo data and dry-run end-to-end scenarios.

• Capture feedback, document follow-ups and communicate next steps.

5. Cutover, Go-Live & Handover

• Support cutover, go-live and hypercare activities.

• Contribute to migration, parallel-run and rollback planning.

• Maintain relevant configuration and runbook documentation.

• Ensure a clean transition to support and Customer Success teams.

6. Client & Internal Communication

• Provide clear and organized updates to clients and internal teams.

• Adjust communication for executive and technical audiences.

• Escalate risks and issues early.

• Work closely with the Executive Sponsor, Project Manager, Business Analyst, Solution Architect and QA.

**Required Technical Skills & Competencies**

**Core Technical Skills-**

• Strong SQL skills to query and validate data independently and reconcile counts and totals.

• Understanding of JSON and APIs, including building payloads, authentication, error handling and pagination.

• Data analysis skills, including Excel pivots, lookups, identifying outliers and explaining variances.

• Ability to work with configuration data and validate system outputs against source

data.

**Delivery & Implementation -**

• Understanding of requirements traceability and the ability to map requirements to

configuration elements.

• Ability to write test cases, execute UAT and regression testing, and reconcile outputs with source data.

• Understanding of defect triage and the ability to distinguish data issues, configuration gaps, new requirements and product bugs.

• Familiarity with cutover, go-live, migration, parallel runs, rollback planning and

hypercare.

**Consulting & Client Engagement -**

• Ability to conduct discovery sessions and clarify business requirements.

• Ability to recommend best practices rather than only implementing requested

changes.

• Strong demo preparation and execution skills.

• Ability to communicate clearly with both executive and technical stakeholders.

**Must-Have Skills -**

• SQL and data validation.

• Data analytics and reconciliation.

• Understanding of JSON and APIs.

• Requirements analysis and traceability.

• Testing, UAT and regression testing.

• Configuration validation and defect triage.

• Client communication and stakeholder management.

• Strong attention to detail and precise execution.

**Good to Have Skills -**

• Experience with billing platforms or subscription management systems.

• Familiarity with Gotransverse.

• Experience with mediation streams and integrations.

• Exposure to cutover, migration, parallel runs and hypercare.

**Desired Attributes -**

• Fast, detailed and precise in execution.

• Checks own work before handing it off.

• Organized and clear in client and internal communication.

• Able to adapt communication for executives and technical teams.

• Curious and comfortable challenging unclear requirements.

• Commercially and operationally practical.

• Focused on recommending best practices.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

title: Marketing Content Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Vertex Next focuses on connecting markets, creating opportunities, and accelerating growth for its clients. The organization brings businesses and audiences together through strategic marketing, content, and engagement initiatives. By aligning market needs with innovative solutions, Vertex Next helps clients expand their reach and achieve measurable results. Team members collaborate in a dynamic environment where data-driven insights and creative thinking drive impactful campaigns and long-term partnerships.

Job Profile: We are looking for a
**research-driven, creative and detail-oriented Marketing & Content Executive**
with exceptional English communication skills, strong marketing instincts and the ability to independently manage social media accounts.

The role combines approximately
**80% content research, writing, marketing communication and social media management, with 20% creative direction and visual oversight**
. We are not looking for someone who simply writes captions, schedules posts or relies on generic AI-generated content. We want someone who understands industries, identifies compelling stories, develops engaging marketing campaigns and takes ownership of their execution.

Key Responsibilities1. Industry Research & Editorial Content

* Research industry developments, technology trends, investments, policies and market announcements.
* Identify newsworthy developments relevant to our exhibitions and conferences.
* Write original industry articles, newsletters, thought leadership content and editorial features.
* Connect industry news with relevant companies, executives, speakers and event topics.
* Translate complex technical information into compelling and accessible business communication.
* Independently verify facts, statistics, company information and sources.

2. Marketing Content & Campaign Development

* Conceptualise and write B2B email marketing campaigns, newsletters and promotional communications.
* Develop impactful subject lines, headlines, campaign messaging and calls to action.
* Create content for websites, landing pages, brochures, event announcements and marketing collateral.
* Adapt messaging for different professional audiences and international markets.
* Build and maintain content calendars aligned with event timelines and marketing objectives.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely execution of campaigns.

3. Social Media Management & Growth

* Independently manage the company's and individual event brands' social media accounts, primarily LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram and other relevant platforms.
* Develop and execute social media content calendars for multiple exhibitions and conferences.
* Research and create engaging posts covering industry news, speaker announcements, exhibitors, sponsors, event updates and thought leadership.
* Write compelling captions, headlines and platform-specific content tailored to professional audiences.
* Identify trending industry conversations and opportunities for timely, relevant social media engagement.
* Coordinate with graphic designers and video editors to develop high-quality creatives, carousels, short videos and promotional content.
* Schedule, publish and monitor approved content across social media channels.
* Manage audience engagement, including relevant comments, messages and interactions, escalating sensitive enquiries when necessary.
* Monitor competitor activities, industry influencers and relevant social media trends.
* Track engagement, reach, follower growth, click-throughs and campaign performance.
* Prepare regular social media performance reports with recommendations for improvement.
* Ensure consistent brand voice, professional presentation and accuracy across all accounts.

**Event-Specific Social Media Responsibilities**

* Develop pre-event, live-event and post-event social media campaigns.
* Plan coverage of speaker announcements, exhibitor highlights, conference sessions, networking activities and industry developments.
* Coordinate live event updates, photographs, video clips, interviews and session highlights.
* Ensure timely publication of Day 1 and Day 2 recaps, event highlights, thank-you posts and post-event content.
* Maintain a structured content pipeline so that important event milestones and announcements are never missed.

4. Creative Direction & Visual Communication

* Develop creative concepts and detailed briefs for graphic designers and video editors.
* Guide the visual direction of social media campaigns, newsletters and marketing collateral.
* Review layouts, typography, imagery, branding and content hierarchy.
* Ensure visual materials communicate the intended message clearly and effectively.
* Identify and correct spelling mistakes, factual inaccuracies, inconsistent branding and poor visual presentation.
* Review content and creatives against established approval procedures before publication.
* Maintain high standards of accuracy, consistency and attention to detail.

*Professional graphic design expertise is not required, but a strong eye for design and the ability to guide creative teams are essential.*

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Exceptional written and spoken English.
* Strong research, analytical thinking, copywriting and storytelling skills.
* Experience managing professional social media accounts and content calendars.
* Understanding of B2B marketing, audience engagement and brand communication.
* Ability to produce original, insightful content rather than generic promotional copy.
* Strong visual judgment and meticulous attention to detail.
* Familiarity with social media scheduling, analytics and reporting tools.
* Ability to manage multiple brands, campaigns and deadlines simultaneously.
* Experience coordinating with graphic designers, video editors and marketing teams.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership and consistently deliver high-quality work.
* Willingness to work flexible hours aligned with Canadian business operations and marketing schedules.

Experience in technology, B2B events, exhibitions, business journalism, editorial marketing or professional services would be an advantage.

Who We're Looking For

Someone who:

* Is naturally curious and enjoys researching business and industry developments.
* Can transform industry news into a newsletter, social media campaign or compelling article.
* Understands the difference between posting content and building a meaningful professional audience.
* Has a strong sense of design and can recognise weak creatives immediately.
* Notices errors, inconsistencies and missed opportunities before others do.
* Is proactive, organised and comfortable taking ownership of multiple marketing channels.
* Wants to grow into a strategic marketing and brand leadership role.

What We Offer

* Flexible working arrangements aligned with Canadian business hours, with an emphasis on accountability, deliverables and performance.
* Exposure to international B2B exhibitions and conferences across multiple industries.
* Opportunities to develop expertise in content marketing, industry intelligence, social media strategy and creative direction.
* Direct collaboration with senior management and international teams.
* A growth-oriented environment with the potential to progress into a Marketing Manager role.

How to Apply

Please submit:

1. Your updated CV.
2. Two or three examples of your strongest written content.
3. Links to social media accounts or campaigns you have managed.
4. Examples of marketing creatives you have conceptualised or supervised.
5. A brief explanation of your contribution to those campaigns.

**Shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a practical research, writing, social media and creative assessment.**

*We value exceptional English, curiosity, originality, creativity and attention to detail more than job titles or years of experience.*

The Digital Marketing Team Leader will be responsible for planning, executing, monitoring, and optimising digital marketing activities across SEO, SEM/PPC, social media, content marketing, email marketing, website optimisation, analytics, and lead generation.

The candidate must be capable of managing the complete digital marketing function, assigning responsibilities, tracking team performance, ensuring timely execution, and achieving measurable business objectives.

Key Roles and Responsibilities1. Search Engine Optimisation (SEO)

Develop and implement comprehensive SEO strategies to improve organic traffic, keyword rankings, website visibility, and lead generation.

Demonstrate strong hands-on expertise in on-page SEO, including:

Keyword research, search intent analysis, and keyword mapping.

Title tags, meta descriptions, heading tags, and URL optimisation.

Internal linking, content optimisation, and image SEO.

Schema markup and structured data implementation.

Canonical tags, duplicate content management, and indexability checks.

Content quality, topical relevance, and E-E-A-T best practices.

Oversee technical SEO, including website crawling, indexing, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, Core Web Vitals, and site architecture.

Manage off-page SEO activities, backlink analysis, link-building strategies, and competitor backlink research.

Conduct comprehensive website audits and implement corrective actions.

Monitor SEO performance using Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, and professional SEO tools.

Track organic traffic, keyword performance, conversions, and SEO-driven leads.

2. Search Engine Marketing (SEM) and Paid Advertising

Plan, execute, and optimise paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads and other relevant platforms.

Manage campaign budgets, bidding strategies, audience targeting, conversion tracking, and return on ad spend.

Monitor cost per lead (CPL), cost per acquisition (CPA), conversion rates, and campaign profitability.

Conduct A/B testing of ad copies, landing pages, creatives, and audience segments.

Coordinate with the team to improve paid campaign performance and lead quality.

3. Social Media Marketing

Develop and execute social media strategies across relevant platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

Plan content calendars, campaign schedules, audience engagement initiatives, and brand communication.

Oversee social media creatives, captions, reels, videos, and promotional campaigns.

Monitor engagement, reach, impressions, follower growth, and social media-generated leads.

Ensure consistent brand positioning and messaging across all social channels.

4. Content Marketing and Website Management

Develop content strategies aligned with SEO goals, audience needs, and business objectives.

Supervise the creation and optimisation of blogs, landing pages, website content, articles, and promotional copy.

Ensure content quality, originality, readability, keyword relevance, and conversion-focused messaging.

Coordinate with content writers, designers, developers, and SEO specialists.

Monitor website performance and recommend improvements in user experience, content structure, and conversion rates.

5. Email Marketing and Lead Nurturing

Plan and manage email marketing campaigns, newsletters, promotional communications, and automated workflows.

Segment audiences and develop personalised campaigns to improve engagement and conversions.

Monitor open rates, click-through rates, unsubscribe rates, and email-driven conversions.

Implement lead nurturing strategies to improve prospect engagement and follow-up efficiency.

Ensure compliance with applicable email marketing and data protection requirements.

6. Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO) and Analytics

Analyse website traffic, user behaviour, campaign performance, and conversion funnels.

title: SEO Intern
description:
***Role Overview***

We are seeking a candidate to build and execute scalable organic growth strategies, with a strong focus on Programmatic SEO, Technical SEO, content optimization, and organic lead generation. The ideal candidate can identify commercial keyword opportunities, create useful landing-page frameworks, improve search visibility, and use automation and AI-assisted workflows to drive measurable results. Knowledge of Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) is an advantage.

***Key Responsibilities***

● Programmatic SEO: Plan scalable service, industry, location, and use-case landing pages; cluster keywords and map them to URLs; optimize templates for search intent; maintain unique, useful content; and monitor crawling, indexation, rankings, and conversions.

● Technical SEO: Conduct audits and resolve issues involving crawlability, indexation, canonicals, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, redirects, internal links, Core Web Vitals, page speed, mobile usability, site architecture, and structured data.

● Keyword Research & Content: Research high-intent commercial keywords; perform competitor and keyword-gap analysis; develop topical maps and content plans; optimize metadata, headings, page structure, and internal links; and collaborate with writers on content quality.

● AEO, GEO & AI Search: Structure authoritative, question-focused content for answer engines and AI-powered search; strengthen topical authority and brand-entity consistency; track mentions, citations, and referral traffic where measurable; and test AI-assisted SEO workflows.

● Organic Growth & Lead Generation: Improve qualified non-brand traffic and commercial keyword visibility; optimize pages for enquiries, demos, and conversions; analyze performance and underperforming pages; and work with marketing and business development teams to improve lead quality.

● SEO Automation & Reporting: Streamline repetitive tasks using Google Sheets, APIs, Python, n8n, or similar tools; build workflows for clustering, metadata, internal-link audits, and reporting; and deliver regular performance updates and prioritized action plans.

***Required Skills & Qualifications***

● 2–5 years of hands-on SEO experience, including practical Programmatic SEO and scalable landing-page optimization.

● Strong understanding of technical SEO audits, crawling, indexation, structured data, keyword research, search intent, competitor analysis, and internal linking.

● Working proficiency in Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, Google Keyword Planner, and at least one major SEO platform such as Ahrefs or Semrush.

● Experience improving organic visibility for commercial, service-based, or lead-generation websites.

● Familiarity with CMS platforms, HTML, and basic technical implementation; strong analytical, communication, problem-solving, and project-management skills. Preferred

***Qualifications***

● SEO experience in B2B, SaaS, IT services, or software development.

● Knowledge of AEO, GEO, AI search visibility measurement, and international SEO.

● Familiarity with n8n, Make, Python, APIs, or other SEO automation tools.

● Understanding of conversion-rate optimization and organic lead-generation strategies.

***Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)***

● Targets will be agreed based on existing website performance, available resources, and business objectives.

● Quality, indexation, and performance of programmatic landing pages.

● Growth in qualified non-brand organic traffic and commercial keyword visibility.

● Resolution of technical SEO issues and improvements to content and internal linking.

● Organic leads and landing-page conversion performance.

Pay: ₹2,000.00 - ₹5,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Leave encashment
* Work from home

**Company:** Coach Transformation Academy (CTA)  
**Job Title:** SEO Specialist / Senior SEO Specialist  
**Department:** Digital Marketing  
**Experience:** 4–5 Years  
**Job Location:** Remote – India  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**About Coach Transformation Academy**

Coach Transformation Academy (CTA) is an international coach training and certification organization offering professional coaching programs aligned with International Coaching Federation (ICF) standards. We are looking for an experienced, hands-on SEO Specialist to strengthen our organic search presence, improve search rankings, increase qualified organic leads, and enhance our visibility across AI-powered search platforms.

**Job Overview**

We are seeking a results-driven SEO professional with strong expertise in On-Page SEO, Technical SEO, and Off-Page SEO, along with practical knowledge of Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

The ideal candidate should be comfortable independently executing SEO activities from strategy and keyword research to implementation, performance analysis, and reporting. The candidate should also have some experience coordinating or managing an SEO team, particularly for off-page SEO, link building, and content optimization activities.

This is a hands-on role requiring both individual execution and the ability to guide team members to achieve measurable organic growth.

**Key Responsibilities1. On-Page SEO**

● Conduct comprehensive website audits and identify on-page optimization opportunities.

● Perform keyword research, search intent analysis, keyword mapping, and competitor analysis.

● Optimize title tags, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, internal linking, image alt text, and page content.

● Optimize landing pages, service pages, program pages, and location-specific pages for relevant search queries.

● Develop and implement content optimization strategies to improve rankings, click-through rates (CTR), and organic conversions.

● Identify keyword cannibalization, content gaps, duplicate content, and indexing issues.

● Optimize website content for user intent, topical relevance, E-E-A-T, and helpful content principles.

**2. Off-Page SEO & Link Building**

● Develop and execute effective off-page SEO and link-building strategies.

● Identify relevant, authoritative websites for quality backlinks and outreach opportunities.

● Manage backlink acquisition, competitor backlink analysis, and link profile audits.

● Plan and execute guest posting, digital PR, contextual link building, and relevant industry outreach.

● Monitor backlink quality, identify toxic or spammy links, and maintain a healthy backlink profile.

● Coordinate with off-page SEO executives or external agencies to ensure timely execution and quality deliverables.

● Track link-building performance and evaluate the impact on keyword rankings and organic traffic.

**3. Technical SEO**

● Identify and resolve technical SEO issues affecting crawling, indexing, and website performance.

● Work with developers to implement SEO recommendations.

● Understand XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonical tags, redirects, structured data, and indexability.

● Monitor Core Web Vitals, mobile usability, site architecture, and page experience.

● Use Google Search Console and other SEO tools to identify and resolve search performance issues.

**4. Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)**

● Optimize website content to improve visibility in answer-based search experiences.

● Understand how search engines select and present direct answers, FAQs, and featured snippets.

● Structure content around user questions, search intent, concise answers, and relevant supporting information.

● Implement appropriate FAQ and other relevant structured data where eligible and supported by search engine guidelines.

● Optimize content for conversational queries and question-based searches.

● Monitor opportunities to improve visibility in featured snippets, AI-generated answers, and other answer-focused search results.

**5. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) & AI Search Visibility**

● Develop strategies to improve brand and website visibility across AI-powered search experiences, including Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, and other relevant generative search platforms.

● Understand how content quality, topical authority, entity clarity, credible references, and brand mentions may influence AI search visibility.

● Optimize website content to improve its discoverability, clarity, factual consistency, and usefulness for AI-generated responses.

● Build topical authority through relevant, well-structured content and supporting topic clusters.

● Monitor brand mentions, citations, and visibility in AI-generated answers using appropriate tools and manual research.

● Track emerging AI search trends and recommend actionable improvements to organic and AI-driven discovery.

● Measure GEO performance using available evidence and appropriate reporting methods rather than relying on unsupported ranking claims.

**6. Keyword Research & Content Strategy**

● Conduct keyword research for informational, commercial, and transactional search intent.

● Develop keyword clusters, topic clusters, content briefs, and content calendars.

● Identify content gaps and opportunities based on competitor analysis and search demand.

● Collaborate with content writers to produce SEO-friendly blogs, landing pages, FAQs, and supporting content.

● Ensure content aligns with target audiences, relevant markets, and business objectives.

**7. SEO Analytics & Reporting**

● Monitor and analyze organic traffic, keyword rankings, impressions, clicks, CTR, indexed pages, and conversions.

● Use Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, and professional SEO tools to measure performance.

● Prepare weekly and monthly SEO performance reports with actionable insights.

● Identify underperforming pages and recommend improvements based on data.

● Track organic leads and landing-page performance wherever reliable conversion tracking is available.

● Translate SEO performance into measurable business outcomes, including qualified lead generation.

**8. Team Coordination & Execution**

● Coordinate and guide off-page SEO executives, link-building resources, and content team members.

● Assign tasks, monitor progress, review deliverables, and maintain quality standards.

● Create SEO task plans and prioritize activities based on business impact.

● Work independently on both On-Page and Off-Page SEO when required.

● Collaborate with marketing, content, and development teams to ensure successful implementation.

● Share best practices and help team members improve their SEO execution.

● 4–5 years of hands-on SEO experience.

● Strong practical knowledge of On-Page SEO and Off-Page SEO.

● Working knowledge of Technical SEO and website optimization.

● Practical understanding of AEO, GEO, and AI search visibility optimization.

● Experience with keyword research, competitor analysis, backlink analysis, and content optimization.

● Experience using SEO tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, or equivalent platforms.

● Ability to analyze SEO data and translate insights into actionable strategies.

● Basic team coordination or team-handling experience.

● Strong communication, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.

● Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and deliver measurable results.

**Preferred Qualifications**

● Experience working with international websites and multiple target markets.

● Experience in education, coaching, certification, professional training, or lead-generation businesses.

● Experience optimizing WordPress or similar CMS-based websites.

● Familiarity with conversion tracking, landing-page optimization, and organic lead generation.

● Exposure to AI visibility monitoring tools and emerging generative search platforms.

● Growth in non-branded organic clicks and qualified organic traffic.

● Improvement in target keyword rankings and organic CTR.

● Growth in qualified organic leads and organic conversion rates.

● Improvement in indexability, technical SEO health, and priority-page performance.

title: Green Building Certification Associate
description:
**Company Description**
Ekologiks Infinite Private Limited is a purpose-driven sustainability consulting firm focused on real estate and industrial decarbonisation. The company helps organizations embed sustainability into their core operations through practical, future-ready solutions that enable long-term growth and resilience. Inspired by the infinity symbol, Ekologiks Infinite views sustainability as a continuous journey that unlocks ongoing opportunities across sectors. Its clients include Fortune 500 companies, government and semi-government organizations, and leading real estate and manufacturing enterprises, all supported with customized strategies rooted in circular economy and low‑carbon development. Guided by the philosophy of “Sustaining Lives,” the firm integrates traditional wisdom with modern sustainability practices to help organizations move from growth to true thriving.

**Role Description**
The Green Building Certification Associate is a full-time, on-site role based in Kolkata. This role supports green building and sustainability projects from concept to certification, including documentation, data collection, and coordination with project teams, clients, and certifying bodies.

The associate will assist in applying rating systems (such as LEED, IGBC, GRIHA or similar), preparing technical submissions, tracking compliance, and ensuring timely completion of certification milestones.

Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting sustainability research, reviewing architectural and engineering drawings for alignment with green building criteria, preparing reports and presentations, and maintaining organized project records.

The role also involves working closely with internal consultants and external stakeholders to implement practical, low‑carbon and resource-efficient solutions in real estate and industrial projects.

**Qualifications**

* Foundational knowledge of green building rating systems and sustainability frameworks (e.g., LEED, IGBC, GRIHA, WELL, BREEAM) and an interest in certification processes.
* Ability to interpret architectural, mechanical, and electrical drawings, with understanding of building design, energy efficiency, water management, and materials selection.
* Strong research and analytical skills for collecting, validating, and organizing environmental and project performance data.
* Proficiency in documentation, report writing, and presentation preparation, with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Effective communication and stakeholder coordination skills to collaborate with project teams, clients, and external agencies.
* Basic competency in relevant software tools (e.g., MS Office, spreadsheets, presentation tools; exposure to energy modeling or building performance software is an advantage).
* Bachelor’s degree in architecture, civil engineering or environmental science ; professional certifications in green building or sustainability are a must
* Demonstrated interest in sustainability, circular economy, and low‑carbon development, with the ability to work on-site and manage multiple projects and deadlines.

title: Senior Principal Consultant – TSU Manager (Team Leader)
description:
SkyQuest is seeking a senior programme leader to manage a 24-month technical assistance programme supporting a national agricultural development finance institution in Nigeria. The programme aims to strengthen the Institution’s ability to mobilise and deploy capital to agricultural enterprises and organisations serving smallholder farmers, particularly women and underserved producers.

About the role

The TSU Manager will lead a multidisciplinary Technical Support Unit (TSU) and act as the central integration point between the Institution’s CEO and executive management, the funding partner and specialist teams. The role is accountable for programme governance, strategic coherence, executive and Board engagement, delivery oversight and the quality of programme deliverables.

Key responsibilities

* Lead programme governance, integrated planning, decision-making, escalation, risk and issue management, and formal phase-gate reviews.
* Manage a multidisciplinary team of specialist leads; set accountabilities, allocate work, monitor delivery and review all deliverables before submission.
* Serve as the principal counterpart to the Institution’s CEO and executive management and the primary point of contact for the funding partner.
* Lead executive validation sessions, strategic reviews and Board presentations, subject to CEO approval.
* Direct the institutional diagnostic, maturity assessment, prioritisation process and development of a resourced implementation plan.
* Integrate specialist work across agricultural finance and credit risk, technology and data, agribusiness investment readiness, blended-finance capital mobilisation and climate finance.
* Oversee design and testing of a multi-source financing facility, including capital structure, blended-capital architecture, financing documentation and mobilisation strategy.
* Ensure pilots are evidence-based, evaluated and refined, with clear benefits for organisations serving smallholder farmers.
* Lead programme performance management, monitoring, evaluation and learning (MEL), quarterly reviews and the formal mid-term review.
* Oversee institutionalisation, capability transfer and handover of validated policies, tools, models, SOPs and operating arrangements to named Institution owners.

Qualifications and experience

**Education:**
Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Agricultural Economics, Development Studies, Business Administration or a related field. CFA, ACCA, ICAN, PMP/PRINCE2 or equivalent is an advantage.

· 16+ years in development finance, agricultural finance, financial-institution advisory or large technical assistance programmes.

·       Substantial hands-on experience in agricultural lending and agri-finance, including credit appraisal, risk assessment and portfolio management.

· At least 8 years leading multidisciplinary teams on complex, multi-stakeholder programmes as Team Leader, Programme Director or equivalent.

· Experience advising CEOs, executive committees and Boards of banks, DFIs or public financial institutions.

· Track record leading assignments for development partners such as the World Bank Group, AfDB, FCDO, major philanthropic foundations or similar.

· Proven delivery of institutional transformation programmes that were successfully handed over to the client institution.

· Strong programme governance, integrated planning, dependency and risk management, and results-based management skills.

· Sound understanding of DFI operating models and blended-finance instruments.

**Desirable:**
Experience with Nigerian or Sub-Saharan African DFIs; facility or fund design; investor or lender engagement; MEL; gender-inclusive finance; and smallholder-focused impact measurement. Hausa, Yoruba or Igbo is an advantage.

title: Technical Sales Engineer
description:
About Elixir-India

For 15 years, Elixir-India has helped manufacturers solve bonding, sealing and assembly problems with the right adhesive and sealant solutions. We have grown steadily, year after year, and we have done it sustainably. Today we serve more than 400 active customers across India from our offices in Bangalore, Ahmedabad and Pune. Our key industries include engineering, EV, composites, railways, appliances and drones. The next five years will be the most exciting phase of our journey so far. We are building the team that will lead it, and this role is part of that plan.

The Role

As a Technical Sales Engineer, you will own the growth of your territory. You will meet manufacturers, understand how they build their products, and find where our solutions can make their process better or more reliable. You will then take that opportunity all the way through, from the first meeting to trials to regular business. This is a field role. Most of your time will be spent at customer plants, not at a desk.

What You Will Do

* Meet customers in your territory regularly, with a strong focus on opening new accounts
* Understand each customer's application and recommend the right solution, with support from our technical team
* Build a pipeline of projects and move each one from first discussion to trial to repeat orders
* Build relationships across design, production, quality and purchase teams at customer sites
* Look after existing customers so their business with us keeps growing
* Keep track of the market and competitors, and share what you learn with your manager
* Keep your pipeline and sales records up to date

Who We Are Looking For

* B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering
* 2–3 years of field sales to manufacturing companies
* Experience selling adhesives, sealants, paints, tapes, lubricants, welding consumables or similar industrial products is a strong plus
* Candidates from cutting tools, abrasives or power tools are also welcome to apply
* Comfortable with a technical discussion on the shop floor and a commercial one in the purchase office
* Self-driven, and able to deliver results without close supervision
* Honest and fair in dealing with customers and colleagues
* Looking to build a long-term career, not just change jobs

What You Can Expect from Us

* **Incentives:**
  a sales incentive scheme that is among the most rewarding and unique in the industry, paid monthly and linked directly to your results
* **Salary:**
  attractive increase over your current CTC
* **5-day working week:**
  so you have time to recharge
* **Fast growth:**
  quick learners and high performers grow fast here, moving up to larger territories and team leadership
* **Support in the field:**
  regular leads and technical backing, so you are never selling alone
* **Freedom:**
  room to plan and run your territory your own way
* **Learning:**
  hands-on exposure to adhesive and sealant applications across many industries
* Other benefits as per company policy

How to Apply

Send your CV to hr@elixir-india.net with "Technical Sales Engineer – Ahmedabad in the subject line.

In a few lines, also tell us about the best sale you have made so far and what made it work.

At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. **Job Description**
**Reuse Engineering**
**Location :-**
Bangalore/ Coimbatore/Pune

3-6 years
  
  
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a place where you’ll be empowered to shape your career, supported by a collaborative global community, and inspired to reimagine what’s possible. Join us in helping leading Consumer Products and Retail Services (CPRS) organizations unlock the value of technology and drive scalable, sustainable growth.
  
  
**Introduction**
The D&E Re-use team is responsible for the re-use of parts from Excess and Obsolete stocks to reduce costs, eliminate waste. Drive the transformation of D&E towards design for Re-use to unlock the potential of circular use of materials.
  
  
**Job Description - Grade Specific**
**Job Mission**
This competence is about the design and development of electrical cabinets and associated connectivity interfaces. The electrical cabinets contain diverse sets of electrical equipment like controllers, power supplies, computing modules etc. Activities comprise designing connectivity: cabling harnesses between active and passive electronic boards (PCBA's), electric transducers (sensors and actuators), racks, cabling and connections (plates and feedthroughs), and engineering the cabinet/enclosure.
  
  
As an Electrical Mechanical Engineer, you will be involved in electrical and mechanical 3D design, cabling and routing design, creating product documentation (TPD) and participation in product validation and test. You will be part of a team with Project managers and Lead engineers.
  
  
****Job Description****

* In this position, you will lead investigations on re-use potential on E&O (Excess & Obsolete)stock, identify re-use opportunity and represent D&E in X sector team.
* Discover and investigate the parts re-use opportunities from various influx channels
* Identify re-use opportunities and create an Reuse analysis report.
* Perform Technical part of reuse analysis, including AsNew autonomously using information from ASML system and expertise generated within reuse department, with minimum contact with FC’s
* Engineer is expected to do extended design activities related to Reuse, but no real design work.
* Support other departments to realize the reuse activity.
* Work with other ASML colleagues around the world(ASML sites) to implement reuse projects
* Share the experience and knowledge that you learn from reuse process

**Education**
Bachelor or Master in Electro-Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
  
  
****Experience****
You have 3 – 6 years of experience as engineer of electronic functions, including
  
  
experience with working in multidisciplinary module design teams to establish agreement on specifications.
  
  
****Personal Skills****

* Ability to initiate and drive/contribute to reuse projects, identify process gaps and work towards improvements
* Demonstrated responsibility for the results in his competence or process
* Be able to use mature skills and technical concepts to find the best solution to a specific problem in an innovative and creative way.
* Have good communication skills with cross departments to perform reuse activities
* Generate and maintain procedures.
* SAP, Teamcenter and NX experience
* Ability to read manufacturing drawings, BOM and Technical process documentations
* Hybrid working environment

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

description:
**Company Description**
Scholasys Technologies & Solutions Pvt Ltd is a leading provider of robotics education and solutions, focused on robotics, coding, and automation. The company offers a wide range of programs, kits, and curricula designed to engage learners of all ages and skill levels. Scholasys works in classrooms, after-school programs, and robotics competitions to create dynamic learning environments that spark creativity and curiosity. The organisation supports educators with training and resources to integrate robotics effectively into their teaching. As a trusted partner in robotics education, Scholasys aims to empower a new generation of innovators and problem solvers by making technology accessible and exciting.

**Role Description:**
The Technical Sales Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Thrissur. This role involves presenting and demonstrating robotics education solutions to schools, institutions, and other prospective customers, while clearly explaining technical features and benefits. The Technical Sales Engineer will manage the sales cycle from lead generation and qualification to proposal, negotiation, and closure, ensuring a positive customer experience. Day-to-day responsibilities include providing pre- and post-sales technical support, responding to client queries, configuring solutions to meet customer needs, and coordinating with product and training teams. The role also involves preparing technical documentation, conducting product training and workshops, gathering customer feedback, and contributing to sales strategies and market development activities.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Technical Sales and Sales skills for prospecting, opportunity management, and closing deals.
* Candidates should possess Sales Engineering and Technical Support skills for solution design, demonstrations, and customer issue resolution.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills for client interactions, presentations, and collaborative work with internal teams.
* Relevant experience in education technology, robotics, STEM products, or similar technical domains is highly beneficial.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience in technical sales.
* Ability to work on-site in Thrissur, manage multiple client accounts, and travel locally as required.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and relationship-building abilities, with a learner-focused and inclusive approach.

title: TechOps-SAP-VIM-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**S**
**ervice line - Position Title: TechOps\_SAP\_VIM\_Senior\_1,2**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for an SAP OPENTEXT VIM Senior Consultant to join the EY GDS Team. As part of our EY GDS – TechOps team, you will be responsible for providing functional support for SAP Vendor Invoice Management (OpenText VIM) across various regions for our global clients. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to address issues, implement enhancements, and optimize invoice management processes to meet business requirements.
  
  
This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth as you get to work with a high-quality team to support clients, ensuring seamless invoice processing, automation, and operational excellence through best-in-class solutions, innovation, and continuous improvement
**.**
**To qualify for the role, you must have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering/technology (B.E./B. Tech) or Commerce/Finance (B. Com, M. Com), MBA (Finance), CA, ICWA/CMA, or equivalent professional experience.
* 3-7 years of experience in SAP OPENTEXT VIM/OpenText VIM implementation or AMS support, preferably with global clients.

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Responsible for providing support for SAP OPENTEXT VIM incidents and service requests, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.
* Support incident resolution by analysing issues raised by users and providing effective solutions.
* Work closely with customers and support teams to ensure issues and requests are followed up and addressed in a timely manner.
* Handle change requests with a clear understanding of business requirements and invoice processing workflows.
* Understand business needs and deliver solutions that improve invoice automation, approval workflows, and operational efficiency.
* Cross-functional communication skills; experience in offshore/onsite delivery models.
* Defect analysis and resolution related to SAP OPENTEXT VIM and integrated SAP modules.
* Ability to work with minimal guidance or supervision in a time-critical environment.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills within a global support environment.
* Flexibility in managing work hours due to the nature of Application Management Services, including shift support and on-call availability for critical business requirements.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Ideally, you'll also have:**

* Strong knowledge of SAP OpenText VIM components including: Invoice Capture Center (ICC), Document Processing, Approval Workflows, Exception Handling, Duplicate Invoice Checks, Business Rules Framework, Reporting and Analytics.
* Experience with SAP FI and MM integration points, including: Accounts Payable, Purchase Orders, Goods Receipts, Vendor Master Data, Payment Processing.
* Knowledge of workflow troubleshooting, configuration, and enhancement activities.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA and VIM migration/support projects.
* SAP/OpenText VIM Certification is preferred.

**What You Will Do**

* Provide day-to-day Application Management support for SAP OPENTEXT VIM and related SAP applications across IT Service Management, including service requests, incident management, enhancement requests, change management, and problem management as a Level 2 or Level 3 Application Management Specialist.
* Lead and coordinate the resolution of complex VIM process issues, workflow failures, invoice processing exceptions, and system outages, including root cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to gather business requirements, assess operational challenges, and provide recommendations on SAP OPENTEXT VIM solutions and process improvements.
* Develop and maintain documentation, including configurations, process flows, knowledge articles, user guides, and test scripts.
* Support and execute enhancements related to invoice processing, approval workflows, validation rules, and integration with SAP FI/MM modules.
* Mentor and train junior SAP OPENTEXT VIM team members by sharing best practices, functional knowledge, and troubleshooting techniques.
* Keep abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, OpenText innovations, and SAP best practices to drive operational efficiency through automation and innovation.
* Participate in on-call rotations and provide off-hours support as needed to ensure the availability and reliability of critical SAP systems.
* Available to work in shift hours depending on client requirements across Australia, Asia, Europe, and the Americas.

**What We Look For**

* A team of professionals with strong functional expertise, analytical skills, and enthusiasm to learn and adapt in a fast-moving environment.
* Experience working with global delivery teams and supporting enterprise-scale invoice management processes.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with business users, technical teams, and third-party vendors.
* A proactive mindset focused on continuous improvement, automation, and operational excellence.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
**Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.**
**“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.**

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

title: Sales Executive
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Sales Expert – Pet Relocation

Company: Petaeron

Department: Sales

Reporting To: Inside Sales Executive

1. About Petaeron

Petaeron provides domestic and international pet relocation services, helping pet parents move their pets safely between cities and countries. Our services may include airline coordination, travel crates, veterinary procedures, documentation, import permits, customs clearance, and pet transportation.

2. Role Overview

The Sales Expert will manage pet relocation enquiries from the initial customer interaction through quotation, follow-up, and booking confirmation. The role requires strong communication, sales, negotiation, customer relationship management, daily Zoho CRM usage, and basic accounts and payment coordination.

3. Roles and Responsibilities

A. Lead Management and Qualification

* Handle incoming enquiries through calls, WhatsApp, email, website forms, advertisements, and referrals.
* Make a minimum of 15 meaningful inbound and outbound calls per working day.
* Contact new leads promptly and understand their relocation requirements.
* Collect essential details:
* Origin, destination, and travel date.
* Pet species, breed, age, weight, and number of pets.
* Vaccination, microchip, and documentation status.
* Airline preferences, budget, and urgency.
* Assess lead quality, customer intent, and likelihood of conversion.
* Maintain consistent follow-ups until the lead is converted, lost, or scheduled for future contact.

B. Sales, Quotations and Conversion

* Explain Petaeron's services, relocation procedures, timelines, and requirements.
* Coordinate with operations and vendors to obtain accurate pricing and service information.
* Prepare and send quotations with clear pricing, taxes, inclusions, exclusions, and payment terms.
* Follow up on quotations and guide customers towards booking confirmation.
* Handle objections related to pricing, documentation, timelines, and airline requirements.
* Negotiate within approved company guidelines and obtain necessary approvals.
* Identify relevant opportunities to upsell additional services.
* Achieve assigned monthly sales and conversion targets.

C. Customer Relationship Management

* Communicate with empathy, patience, and professionalism.
* Understand customer concerns and provide accurate, realistic information.
* Explain complex relocation requirements in simple language.
* Keep customers informed about important updates during the sales process.
* Avoid aggressive sales tactics and unverified promises.
* Build trust through transparent communication and reliable follow-up.

D. Zoho CRM and Follow-Up Management

Daily use of Zoho CRM is mandatory.

* Maintain accurate lead details, contact information, and customer requirements.
* Record meaningful calls, conversations, notes, and outcomes.
* Update lead stages, quotation status, and conversion status.
* Schedule follow-up dates, tasks, and reminders for active leads.
* Record reasons for lost or unqualified leads.
* Prioritize new enquiries, high-intent customers, urgent travel dates, and pending quotations.
* Ensure every active lead has a clear next action and an updated CRM record.

E. Internal Coordination

Coordinate with the following teams to ensure accurate information and smooth customer handling:

* Operations and relocation consultants: Service availability, relocation procedures, and destination requirements.
* Veterinary and documentation partners: Health procedures, certificates, permits, and approvals.
* Airline and cargo partners: Flight options, pet acceptance, travel conditions, and charges.
* Finance team: Quotations, billing, and payment confirmation.
* Management: Pricing approvals, escalations, and high-value opportunities.

Verify country-specific and airline requirements with the appropriate team before making commitments to customers.

F. Learning and Development

* Learn Petaeron's services, pricing structure, SOPs, and CRM processes.
* Develop knowledge of domestic and international pet relocation requirements.
* Improve sales, negotiation, objection-handling, and closing skills.
* Participate in training and performance reviews.
* Share customer feedback and reasons for lost sales with management.

4. Daily Performance Expectations

* Respond promptly to new enquiries.
* Complete at least 15 meaningful calls per working day.
* Qualify leads and collect the required information.
* Prepare or coordinate quotations and follow up on pending proposals.
* Maintain accurate Zoho CRM records and schedule next actions.
* Coordinate with relevant teams to resolve customer queries.
* Follow up on pending vendor payments and maintain organized invoice and accounting records.
* Review pending tasks and prioritize urgent or high-intent leads.

Performance will be assessed on call quality, follow-up discipline, CRM compliance, customer experience, and sales results—not just call volume.

5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

**KPI**

**Expectation**

Daily calls

Minimum 25-30 meaningful calls per working day

Lead response

Meet the company's defined response-time SLA

Lead qualification

Complete and accurate customer requirements

Quotation follow-up

Consistent follow-up on pending quotations

CRM compliance

All meaningful interactions and next actions recorded

Pipeline management

Accurate lead stages and scheduled follow-ups

Sales conversion

Achieve assigned monthly sales targets

Customer experience

Professional, empathetic, and accurate communication

Coordination

Timely resolution of customer queries

Accurate records and timely invoice maintenance

Vendor payment follow-up

Regular follow-up and updated payment tracking

* Monthly sales targets, conversion targets, and response-time expectations will be communicated by management.

title: Sr Executive - Inside Sales - Restaurant Partnerships
description:
About Dil Foods

Dil Foods is a house of regional food brands that partners with standalone restaurants, cloud kitchens, and cafés to help them generate additional revenue by utilising their existing kitchen infrastructure and operational capacity. Through our virtual food brands, we enable restaurant partners to expand their business without building a new brand from scratch.

About the Role

Dil Foods is looking for a target-driven and commercially aware Inside Sales Manager – Restaurant Partnerships to manage the complete sales cycle for prospective restaurant partners. The role involves engaging with qualified inbound leads received from the Business Development Control Tower, presenting the Dil Foods partnership model, explaining commercial terms and payout structures, evaluating partner suitability, conducting follow-ups, and converting prospects into active restaurant partners.

The Inside Sales Manager will own the sales process from the first conversation to final closure, ensuring every partner understands the business model, commercial expectations, operational requirements, and revenue opportunity before entering into a partnership.

Key Responsibilities1. Lead Management and Initial Engagement

·      Receive qualified inbound leads from the Business Development Control Tower team.

·      Contact prospective restaurant partners promptly, introduce yourself as an Inside Sales Manager from

Dil Foods, and review the details shared by the Control Tower.

·      Understand the partner’s business profile, current operations, kitchen infrastructure, location, and

objectives.

·      Assess the partner’s interest and initial suitability for the Dil Foods partnership model.

2. Dil Foods Model and Brand Presentation

·      Explain the Dil Foods business model and how partners can generate incremental revenue by utilising

existing kitchen infrastructure.

·      Maintain strong knowledge of Dil Foods brands, cuisines, menus, target customers, and positioning.

·      Recommend suitable brands based on the restaurant’s location, kitchen capabilities, existing menu,

and local demand.

·      Understand the areas being pitched, including market potential, brand suitability, and business

opportunities.

·      Present the partnership value proposition clearly and accurately.

3. Commercial Discussions and Revenue Understanding

·      Explain partnership commercials, payout models, pricing structures, applicable fees, and relevant terms

transparently.

·      Understand brand-level revenue potential, partner payouts, operating costs, and profitability

calculations.

·      Explain potential earnings and incremental revenue opportunities using realistic assumptions; do not

over promise returns.

·      Address questions about payouts, commissions, discounts, promotions, and other applicable terms.

·      Ensure commercial commitments align with approved company policies.

4. Partner Evaluation and Kitchen Assessment

·      Assess partner interest, operational readiness, kitchen infrastructure, equipment availability, and ability

to meet Dil Foods requirements.

·      Arrange follow-up discussions for interested partners who need additional clarification.

·      Schedule a virtual kitchen walkthrough or assessment to evaluate operational suitability.

·      Coordinate with internal teams for further technical or operational validation where required.

·      Identify gaps in equipment, hygiene, capacity, or readiness and communicate required corrective

actions.

5. Sales Follow-ups and Objection Handling

·      Maintain consistent follow-ups with interested partners throughout the sales cycle.

·      Address objections related to commercials, operational requirements, brand performance, and

siness viability.

·      Share relevant information to help partners make informed decisions.

·      Maintain clear next steps and timelines for every active opportunity.

·      Re-engage pending prospects and improve lead-to-closure conversion.

6. Negotiation and Partnership Closure

·      Drive negotiations within approved commercial and operational guidelines.

·      Explain agreement terms, payment requirements, documentation, and onboarding steps.

·      Obtain partner confirmations and required documentation to complete the closure process.

·      Document commitments made during sales discussions and communicate them to the onboarding

team.

·      Own each opportunity until formal closure and handover for onboarding.

·      Coordinate with onboarding and operations teams to support a smooth transition from closure to go-

live.

7. CRM Management and Sales Reporting

·      Maintain accurate, up-to-date CRM records for all assigned leads.

·      Record call outcomes, partner requirements, commercial discussions, objections, follow-up dates, and

closure status.

·      Maintain a clear sales pipeline and ensure no opportunity is left unattended.

·      Submit daily and periodic reports on leads handled, calls completed, follow-ups, kitchen assessments,

closures, and pipeline status.

·      Track performance against assigned targets and take corrective action where required.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

·      Restaurant partnerships closed against assigned monthly targets.

·      Lead-to-closure conversion rate.

·      Timeliness of lead engagement and follow-ups.

·      Qualified opportunities progressed to commercial discussions and kitchen assessments.

·      Accuracy of CRM updates and sales pipeline reporting.

·      Adherence to approved commercial terms and partner qualification standards.

·      Successful handover of closed partners to the onboarding team.

·      Contribution to partner onboarding and go-live targets.

Eligibility Criteria

·      1–4 years of experience in inside sales, B2B sales, business development, or partnership acquisition

preferred.

·      Experience in restaurants, food-tech, cloud kitchens, hospitality, or franchise sales is an advantage.

·      Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and objection-handling skills.

·      Ability to understand commercial models, revenue projections, payout structures, and profitability

calculations.

·      Comfortable conducting sales calls, virtual meetings, and kitchen walk-throughs.

·      Working knowledge of CRM platforms, MS Excel, and Google Sheets.

·      Strong ownership, follow-up discipline, and a target-oriented mindset.

·      Ability to work from the Bengaluru office.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a commercially astute sales professional who can independently manage a complete B2B sales cycle, build trust with restaurant owners, explain business opportunities clearly, and convert qualified prospects into long-term partners. The candidate should combine strong sales execution with an understanding of restaurant operations, local market dynamics, and partner profitability. Ownership, disciplined follow-up, and commitment to closure targets are essential.

title: Business Development and HNI relations
description:
ABOUT KHENSHU

Khenshu is an award-winning luxury furniture and interior design studio rooted in Indian craftsmanship and built for a global audience.

We design and manufacture bespoke furniture and interiors in India for the world, working closely with master artisans to revive, preserve, and elevate traditional Indian crafts through contemporary design.

Our clientele spans across India, the United States, and Europe and includes high-net-worth individuals, established entrepreneurs, celebrities, architects, designers, and discerning homeowners.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for a highly responsible, motivated, polished, and commercially driven individual to join our Business Development team.

THE ROLE

This is a high-ownership, target-driven sales and business development role focused on building and managing relationships with HNI and high-income clients.

You will be responsible for handling high-value enquiries, developing client relationships, generating new business, following up on opportunities, and ultimately converting them into sales.

Our products are high-ticket luxury pieces, and our clients expect a high level of professionalism, discretion, communication, and service. The ability to communicate confidently, conduct yourself with maturity, and build trust with established individuals is essential.

This role is ideal for someone who wants to build a career at the intersection of luxury, design, and commercial business development.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

\* Handle and follow up on qualified leads provided by the company on a daily basis

\* Maintain extremely disciplined, consistent, and timely follow-ups throughout the entire sales cycle

\* Build strong, long-term relationships with HNI clients and senior decision-makers

\* Understand client requirements and identify relevant Khenshu products and solutions

\* Conduct sales conversations and take opportunities from enquiry to closure

\* Research and identify prospective clients, architects, designers, and relevant networks

\* Proactively generate your own leads and business opportunities

\* Maintain a strong, organised, and constantly updated sales pipeline

\* Coordinate closely with the design, production, and operations teams to ensure a seamless client experience

\* Travel across India when required to meet clients, present products, develop relationships, and close high-value sales

\* Represent Khenshu professionally at client meetings, events, and industry opportunities

\* Work consistently towards monthly and annual revenue targets

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for someone who is:

\* Highly responsible, dependable, and accountable

\* Extremely motivated, ambitious, and driven to succeed

\* Confident, articulate, polished, and professional in communication

\* Comfortable speaking with senior, established, and high-net-worth individuals

\* Naturally persuasive and confident without being pushy

\* Extremely disciplined when it comes to follow-ups and client management

\* Comfortable working towards ambitious sales targets

\* Proactive and capable of creating opportunities rather than waiting for them

\* Curious and willing to learn about luxury, design, interiors, furniture, materials, and craftsmanship

\* Comfortable travelling and meeting clients across India

\* Commercially minded and interested in building a career in sales and business development

Prior experience in sales, luxury, real estate, hospitality, interiors, fashion, automobiles, or another premium client-facing industry will be an advantage. However, strong potential, communication skills, attitude, and ownership are equally important.

WHAT MAKES THIS OPPORTUNITY DIFFERENT

This is an opportunity to start or accelerate your career in the luxury and creative industries while developing strong commercial and sales expertise.

You will have the opportunity to:

\* Work directly with HNI and established clients across India

\* Build relationships with entrepreneurs, celebrities, architects, designers, and other influential professionals

\* Travel across India for client meetings and business development

\* Learn how high-value luxury products are presented, negotiated, and sold

\* Gain hands-on experience in negotiation, relationship management, business development, and closing

\* Work within a rapidly growing company with an established reputation in the design industry

\* Potentially travel internationally as the business expands, based on performance and business requirements

\* Work in an environment where your individual contribution directly impacts the company’s growth

PERFORMANCE & EARNING POTENTIAL

This is a target-based role with significant earning potential.

In addition to fixed compensation, the role offers performance-linked commissions on successful sales.

Because Khenshu works with high-ticket luxury products, strong performance can translate into meaningful commission earnings. The more business you develop and successfully close, the greater your earning potential.

MOST IMPORTANTLY

This is not a passive learning role.

We are looking for someone who will take complete ownership of their pipeline, follow up consistently and relentlessly, actively seek new opportunities, build relationships, and take responsibility for converting opportunities into revenue.

You will be given leads.

You will also be expected to create your own.

This is a role for someone who wants to be challenged, learn quickly, meet established individuals across the country, travel, build valuable relationships, and directly contribute to the growth of a recognised luxury design brand.

If you are ambitious, polished, commercially driven, and excited by the idea of building relationships with some of the country’s most established individuals while working within the world of luxury design, this could be an exceptional opportunity for you.

POSITION DETAILS

Role: Business Development Executive – Luxury Sales & Client Relations

Location: Khenshu Experience Center, Bangalore

Employment: Full-time

Function: Business Development & Luxury Sales

Compensation: Fixed Compensation + Performance-Linked Commission

Arista’s award-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. This position will focus on assisting with responses to public tenders, RFPs, public and private solicitations, routine drafting of high-volume agreements as well as supporting the contracts lifecycle management process, and administration of other commercial contract matters. * Data entry and analytics to provide visibility on overall commercial activity at Arista.

  
**Qualifications**  

* 1-3 years of proven and relevant experience working as Contracts administrator/manager with a top tier MNC or reputed corporate house.

* Hands-on experience with drafting, negotiating and managing basic commercial contracts.
* Proficiency with legal and business technologies, such as DocuSign, Microsoft Office, G-Suite, Zoom, Salesforce.com, Egnyte, and Adobe.
* Demonstrates, commitment, positive, integrity and transparency.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* A team player who is comfortable working closely with all Arista organizations and departments at any level upto executive management.

Arista stands out as an engineering-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right.

We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools.

Databricks is looking for a Senior Collections Analyst to own a high-volume accounts receivable (AR) portfolio in a fast-growing, usage-based SaaS business. The role drives timely collections, reduces delinquency, protects cash flow and leads recovery on complex, high-value accounts, while helping shape credit risk decisions. Working closely with Sales, Legal, Billing, Revenue Operations, Cash Application and Finance leadership to resolve disputes, billing gaps and customer escalations, the role has a measurable impact on DSO and bad debt exposure and requires regular overlap with EMEA and PST business hours.

**Job Description**
-------------------

* Own end-to-end portfolio collections and recovery strategies, partnering cross-functionally to resolve high-value escalations, influence credit risk decisions, and drive measurable performance across DSO, aging buckets, and bad debt exposure.
* Design and run recovery strategies for accounts that are structurally delinquent or high-risk.
* Lead cross-functional escalation forums for disputed high-value accounts.
* Present portfolio-level risk trends and actionable insights to Finance leadership.
* Recommend credit limit changes, payment term changes or account holds based on behavioral analytics.
* Work with Legal on pre-legal actions and structured recovery plans.
* Assess creditworthiness, establish risk controls, and lead complex recoveries to protect working capital and minimize bad debt exposure.
* Build scalable reporting models that give clear visibility into aging, dispute velocity and payment predictability.
* Flag worsening payment patterns, and provide quarterly bad debt reserve inputs with documented risk rationale for each account.
* Act as the subject matter expert on usage-based billing disputes and contract interpretation. Resolve complex disputes about usage, contract terms and invoicing discrepancies.
* Handle exceptions from automated dunning, and lead the clean-up of aged AR.
