* Work with Cash Application to keep unapplied cash low and resolve posting gaps.
* Find the systemic billing, consumption or process gaps that cause repeat delinquency. Work with Billing and Revenue Operations to put corrective frameworks in place.
* Perform detailed account reconciliations in NetSuite to keep AR accurate and audit-ready.
* Help standardize collections processes so they are faster and can scale, and support user acceptance testing (UAT) for new or improved systems.

* 10+ years of collections experience, ideally with both public/private technology companies.
* A track record of owning large, complex, high-value AR portfolios with measurable impact on DSO and cash.

title: Director - DWE Platform Architect
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Director, DWE Platform Architect owns the architecture of the Digital Workplace Experience domain, setting the target architecture, reference designs and standards across End User Computing and Mobile Device Management, Productivity & Collaboration and Global Site Experience. The role leads the architecture team, owns design assurance for the domain, and ensures the domain is coherent, secure, resilient and aligned to enterprise architecture.

The role leads architects rather than producing every design. Individual platform designs sit with the Platform Architects in the team, engineering delivery sits with the platform engineering teams, platform roadmaps sit with the Senior Product Owners, and enterprise-level standards and technology strategy sit with the Chief Architect. This role sets the domain direction and holds designs to it, including those produced by delivery partners.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the domain target architecture, standards and reference designs, aligned to DPTF strategy and to the enterprise architecture and technology strategy owned by the Chief Architect.
* Lead the architecture team across the domain, managing performance, capability development and the technical direction they work to.
* Own the design assurance process for the domain, setting what must be reviewed, by whom and against which standards, and holding that standard against delivery pressure.
* Embed AI patterns into the domain architecture, so that AI-assisted delivery and intelligent, self-healing operation of workplace services are designed in.
* Architect for reliability, resilience, observability and cost efficiency by design, supporting the service levels the domain commits to and designing out single points of failure.
* Ensure security, data protection and compliance, including GxP where relevant, are designed into the domain and not retrofitted.
* Guide technology selection and modernisation across the domain, maintaining the architectural view of the estate including technical debt and lifecycle position, and measuring outcomes against architecture objectives.
* Set the architecture standards that supplier and managed service solutions in the domain must meet, and assure partner-delivered designs against them.
* Align the domain to enterprise architecture and technology strategy, negotiating exceptions where the domain genuinely requires them.
* Advise the Head of Digital Workplace Experience on architectural risk, technical debt and the investment needed to address both.
* Maintain architecture decision records for the domain, increasing pattern reuse and reducing rework, and evidencing both with measures.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Architects on individual platform designs, the platform engineering teams on delivery, the Senior Product Owners on platform roadmaps, and the Chief Architect on enterprise standards.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems).
* Architecture certifications desirable (e.g., TOGAF, or a recognised cloud or workplace platform architecture certification relevant to the domain).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Domain architecture leadership, covering target architecture, standards, reference designs and design assurance governance.
* Digital workplace architecture across end user computing, mobility, productivity and collaboration, and site technology.

**Related Experience Required**

* Overall 18 Years and typically 10-12 years in technology architecture, including at least three years leading an architecture team with line responsibility.
* Experience owning a target architecture at domain or equivalent scale, not solely at solution level.
* Track record running design assurance governance, including holding a standard against delivery pressure.
* Deep experience of digital workplace technologies across end user computing, mobile device management, and productivity and collaboration platforms.
* Experience designing for reliability, resilience, observability and security in a regulated environment.
* Experience setting and assuring architecture standards for supplier and managed service delivered solutions.
* Familiarity with AI patterns applied to workplace services and to intelligent operations.

**Desirable:**

  

* Deep knowledge of Digital Workplace & Experience platforms, Microsoft 365, End User Computing, Device Management, Collaboration, AI-powered workplace services, Global Site Experience Modern Architecture

  

* Practical understanding of Digital Workplace & Experience AI architecture patterns AI-assisted delivery, intelligent operations, automation, and emerging AI platform capabilities.

* Digital Workplace & Experience supplier and managed service architecture governance, experience setting standards and evaluating vendor-provided solutions.

  

* Commercial and financial acumen, ability to articulate Digital Workplace & Experience technical debt, architectural risk, investment priorities, and business value to executive

**Skills/Background**

* Deep technical breadth across workplace technologies, with the judgement to know where standardisation matters and where it does not.
* Strong design assurance discipline, able to challenge a solution constructively without becoming a bottleneck.
* Excellent communication, able to explain architectural trade-offs to audiences without a technical background.
* Ability to lead and develop a team of architects.
* Ability to influence engineering teams and suppliers who do not report to the role.
* Commercial awareness, able to weigh architectural preference against cost and lifecycle risk.

**Skills**

AI Platforms, Architecture Governance, Cloud Computing, Container Orchestration, Data Center Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Identity Access Management (IAM), Information Technology (IT) Risk Management, Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS), Mobile Device Management (MDM), Network Design, Serverless Platforms, Service Oriented Architecture (SOA), Storage Area Network (SAN), Strategic Leadership, System Monitors, Technical Architecture, Technical Architecture Design, Virtualization, Workplace Architecture, Zero Trust Architecture

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

Be the definitive technical authority for how 50,000+ employees across [X] countries experience and interact with their devices. This role owns the architecture, reference designs, technical standards and engineering direction for the entire end user computing estate — laptops, desktops, mobiles, tablets, virtual desktops, meeting rooms, and specialised or regulated endpoints.

Where the Director owns delivery, budget and people, the Principal Architect owns what good looks like technically and holds the organisation to it. This is a hands-on-capable role: the expectation is to prototype, prove and pressure-test designs personally, not solely to review other people's slides.

The Principal Architect is accountable for ensuring the estate is secure by design, cloud-native, automatable, cost-efficient and — critically — genuinely pleasant to use. They are the person who says no to architecture that will not survive contact with 50,000 users, and who can explain why in terms both engineers and executives accept.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the target-state architecture for end user computing: platform selection, device management topology, identity integration, application delivery, security control placement and telemetry.
* Produce and maintain reference architectures, design patterns, technical standards and architecture decision records (ADRs) — with trade-offs made explicit rather than buried.
* Define the technical roadmap that underpins the EUC strategy: platform migrations, deprecations, convergence of fragmented tooling, and the sequencing that makes it deliverable.
* Continuously evaluate the market — modern management, AI PCs and on-device inference, cloud PC/DaaS economics, zero-trust endpoint models — and separate genuine capability from vendor narrative.
* Act as the design authority for all endpoint change: chair or sit on the EUC architecture review board, approve significant designs, and hold veto on standards deviation.
* Set and police the exception process — make the right path the easy path, and make deviations visible, time-bound and owned.
* Review and assure supplier and MSP technical designs; ensure partners build to the organisation's architecture rather than their own delivery convenience.
* Set engineering standards for configuration-as-code, packaging, testing, release management and rollback across the endpoint estate.
* Prototype and prove new capability in a lab before it reaches production; build the reference implementation the engineering teams then industrialise.
* Mentor and technically develop senior engineers and platform leads; raise the ceiling of the whole team, not just your own output.
* Partner with Cyber Security to embed zero-trust principles at the endpoint: device trust and attestation, conditional access, least privilege, application control, EDR and DLP placement.
* Architect for regulated and validated environments — GxP-qualified endpoints, computer system validation (CSV/CSA), data residency and privacy obligations, and audit/SOX ITGC evidence generation as a designed-in property rather than a manual scramble.
* Own the technical response to endpoint-relevant threat scenarios and drive architectural remediation of systemic vulnerabilities.
* Architect the digital employee experience (DEX) telemetry model: what is measured, how it is collected, where it lands, and how it drives automated remediation.
* Design for self-healing and self-service by default; treat every recurring ticket category as an architectural defect until proven otherwise.
* Translate architecture into business consequence for senior stakeholders — cost, risk, productivity, time-to-value.
* Represent EUC architecture in enterprise architecture forums, security governance, and vendor executive briefings.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent demonstrable professional expertise.
* Relevant certifications desirable (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Expert, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Cybersecurity Architect Expert, Jamf Certified Expert, TOGAF, CISSP or SABSA).

**Area of Specialisation**

* End user computing architecture at global enterprise scale — platform selection, device management topology, identity integration, application delivery and telemetry.
* Modern endpoint management (Intune/MECM) and macOS management (Jamf), including co-management, hybrid-to-cloud-native migration and staged ring-based rollout.
* Endpoint security architecture and zero-trust design — device trust, conditional access, application control, EDR/XDR, DLP and secure baselines.
* Regulated and validated endpoint environments — GxP-qualified endpoints, CSV/CSA, data residency and audit/SOX ITGC evidence generation designed in.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and 12+ years in IT infrastructure or end user computing, including 5+ years in a principal, lead or enterprise architect capacity with recognised design authority.
* Architecture ownership for an endpoint estate of 20,000+ devices across multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions.
* Expert-level, hands-on-derived command of modern endpoint management (Intune/MECM) and macOS management — sufficient to build the reference implementation personally, not only to specify it.
* Demonstrable advanced scripting and automation portfolio; evidence of configuration-as-code applied to a production endpoint estate.
* Working fluency in enterprise endpoint security and zero-trust architecture, with a track record of co-designing controls alongside a Cyber Security function.
* Led the architecture of at least one large-scale endpoint platform migration or transformation through to production, including the failures and what was learned from them.
* Able to produce architecture documentation of a standard that withstands external audit and supplier scrutiny.
* Proven credibility with both senior engineers and executive stakeholders, in English, in a global matrixed organisation.
* Willingness to travel internationally, approximately [5–15]% of the time.

Desirable:

* Experience in a regulated industry — pharmaceutical, life sciences, biotech, financial services or healthcare — with practical GxP/CSV/CSA and Annex 11 / 21 CFR Part 11 exposure.
* Architecture for specialised endpoints: laboratory instrument workstations, manufacturing and shop-floor devices, clinical and field devices, kiosks, shared and multi-user workstations.
Leading a major platform transformation: SCCM-to-Intune migration, Windows 10* 11 at scale, MSP transition, or M&A integration/divestment of an endpoint estate.
* Sustainability-aware design — device longevity, power management, refurbishment and Scope 3 implications of architectural choices.
* Accessibility and assistive technology designed into the standard build rather than bolted on.
* Network fundamentals relevant to endpoints — SASE/ZTNA, split tunnelling, Wi-Fi 6/7, certificate-based network access.
* Contribution to the wider community — open-source tooling, conference speaking, published technical writing, vendor customer advisory boards.

**Skills/Background**

* Deep technical breadth across Windows and macOS internals, modern endpoint management, identity, endpoint security, application delivery, virtual desktop / cloud PC, and mobile — with the judgement to know where tenant-wide standardisation matters and where a business exception is defensible.
* Advanced PowerShell and at least one general-purpose language (Python, C#, Go) applied to real automation, not toy scripts.
* Configuration-as-code and GitOps discipline — version-controlled endpoint configuration, CI/CD for policy and package deployment, automated testing and staged ring-based rollout as the default way endpoint change is delivered.
* API-first integration — Microsoft Graph, ServiceNow, MDM and security tool APIs; designing integrations that survive vendor change.
* Telemetry and data craft — designing measurement into the estate, with competence in the query languages and platforms the data lands in (KQL, Log Analytics, Power BI or equivalent).
* Architectural discipline — reference designs, ADRs, HLD/LLD, and the ability to write clearly enough that others can build from it and external auditors can accept it.
* Trade-off reasoning — cost, risk, experience, security and operability weighed explicitly; comfortable being the person who quantifies the uncomfortable option.
* Scale intuition — designing for 50,000 devices, unreliable networks, disconnected users, and the long tail of exceptions that always exists.
* Technical leadership without authority — landing decisions across engineering, security, service delivery and vendors by credibility and evidence.
* Executive communication — making architecture legible and decision-ready for non-technical leadership.
* Constructive challenge — able to disagree with a Director, a vendor or a security architect and keep the relationship intact.

**Skills**

Cloud Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Design Thinking, Endpoint Encryption, Endpoint Security, End User Services, Financial Operations, Jamf Pro, Network Protocols, Network Security, Zero Trust

title: Senior Business Consultant – Financial Modelling
description:
**About the Role**

  

We are seeking an experienced Senior Business Consultant to join the Financial Modelling & Conversion (FMC) team. This is a client-facing ,subject matter expert role responsible for leading complex financial modelling and competitive displacement engagements for some of the world's leading financial institutions. You will work with highly qualified colleagues and collaborate regularly with Account Managers, Sales Specialists, Product, Content and Technology teams across different locations. You will act as a trusted advisor to clients, helping them optimise workflows, migrate from competitor platforms and maximise the value of LSEG data, analytics and Excel-based solutions. The role combines financial markets expertise, consulting, project leadership, and stakeholder management.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead complex financial modelling, workflow transformation, and migration projects for global clients.
* Act as a trusted advisor to customers, understanding their business processes and designing tailored financial models.

* Identify opportunities to improve customer workflows and increase adoption of LSEG solutions.
* Identify revenue generating FMC consulting opportunities.
  

**Required Experience & Skills**

  

* 8+ years' experience in Financial Modelling, Investment Banking, Equity Research, Asset Management or Financial Consulting.
* Advanced financial modelling and Microsoft Excel skills, with the ability to analyze and rebuild complex models and workflows.

* Demonstrated experience leading complex, high-priority client engagements and large-scale competitive displacement or migration programmes.
* Proven end-to-end accountability for project delivery, including scope, workload, stakeholder, risk, quality and escalation management.

description:
Business Introduction

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

**Job Purpose**

The Portfolio Manager for Digital Workplace Experience manages the domain's demand and portfolio of work, sequencing delivery against strategy, capacity and dependencies, and giving domain leaders a clear view of what is being delivered and when. title: Outbound Calling Manager – BizHR, Bizpro & Bizvault
description:
**Job Title:** Outbound Calling Manager – BizHR, Bizpro & Bizvault

**Company:** Klipit.ai  
**Location:** Bengaluru  
**Department:** Sales & Business Development  
**Experience:** 4–8 years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Gross Monthly Salary:** ₹50,000–₹65,000 + incentives

**About Klipit.ai**

Klipit.ai is building technology solutions that help businesses streamline their HR, finance, accounting, and document management processes. Our enterprise product portfolio includes:

* **BizHR:** HRMS, employee management, attendance, payroll, and related HR operations.
* **Bizpro:** Invoice management, expense reimbursement, accounting automation, and integrations with accounting platforms such as Tally.
* **Bizvault:** Secure cloud storage and document management for businesses.

We are looking for a results-driven **Outbound Calling Manager** to lead our telecalling and lead qualification team, generate qualified sales meetings, and build a predictable pipeline of opportunities for our sales team.

**Role Overview**

The candidate will be responsible for managing a team of outbound callers who connect with prospective businesses, understand their requirements, qualify leads, and schedule high-quality product demonstrations and sales meetings.

This is a hands-on leadership role requiring strong team management, outbound sales process expertise, performance monitoring, and the ability to deliver measurable results through disciplined execution.

The primary objective is not just to generate calls, but to convert prospecting efforts into qualified meetings and revenue opportunities for the sales team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Team Management & Leadership**

* Recruit, train, manage, and motivate a team of outbound callers and lead qualification executives.
* Set daily, weekly, and monthly targets for calls, qualified leads, meetings booked, and meetings attended.
* Conduct daily team huddles, performance reviews, call coaching, and periodic training sessions.
* Monitor individual productivity and take corrective action to improve performance.
* Build a target-oriented culture focused on meeting quality rather than call volumes alone.

**2. Outbound Calling & Lead Qualification**

* Develop and execute outbound calling strategies targeting SMEs, startups, distributors, manufacturers, and other relevant businesses.
* Ensure callers effectively communicate the value propositions of BizHR, Bizpro, and Bizvault.
* Qualify prospects based on company size, employee strength, business requirements, existing software, decision-maker access, and purchase intent.
* Identify the appropriate decision-makers, including business owners, CFOs, finance heads, HR managers, and operations heads.
* Schedule qualified product demos and sales meetings for the enterprise sales team.
* Ensure accurate lead information, qualification notes, meeting confirmations, and follow-up records are maintained in the CRM.

**3. Sales Pipeline & Meeting Management**

* Work closely with the sales team to understand the ideal customer profile and improve meeting quality.
* Ensure scheduled meetings meet agreed qualification criteria and are relevant to the assigned salesperson.
* Track meetings booked, meetings attended, cancellations, no-shows, and conversions into opportunities.
* Coordinate with sales executives to collect feedback on lead quality and continuously improve qualification standards.
* Implement follow-up processes to minimise meeting drop-offs and maximise attendance.
* Maintain a consistent pipeline of qualified meetings to support monthly customer acquisition targets.

**4. Data Management & Performance Reporting**

* Monitor daily calling activity, connect rates, conversations, lead qualification rates, and meeting conversion rates.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports for management.
* Analyse campaign performance, lead sources, calling scripts, and team productivity.
* Work with the marketing team to improve lead quality and optimise campaign outcomes.
* Maintain clean, accurate, and updated CRM records and ensure disciplined follow-up.

**5. Process Improvement**

* Develop effective calling scripts, objection-handling frameworks, and qualification checklists.
* Design separate calling approaches for HR, finance, accounting automation, and document management prospects.
* Introduce structured training and quality monitoring processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve productivity through better data, segmentation, automation, and calling practices.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 4 years of experience in outbound telecalling, inside sales, lead generation, or sales development.
* At least 2 years of experience managing and achieving targets through a team of callers or lead qualification executives.
* Proven track record of generating qualified B2B meetings for field sales, inside sales, or enterprise sales teams.
* Experience in B2B SaaS, HRMS, accounting software, fintech, ERP, or other business technology solutions is preferred.
* Strong people management, coaching, communication, and objection-handling skills.
* Ability to analyse performance metrics and take data-driven decisions.
* Familiarity with CRM systems, Excel/Google Sheets, and telecalling tools.
* Strong organisational skills and a target-driven mindset.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be measured against business outcomes, including:

* Number of qualified meetings scheduled per month.
* Percentage of scheduled meetings successfully attended.
* Percentage of meetings accepted by the sales team as qualified.
* Lead-to-meeting conversion rate.
* Meeting-to-opportunity and meeting-to-customer conversion rates.
* Team productivity and achievement of monthly targets.
* Accuracy of CRM data and follow-up discipline.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹65,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do you have in outbound calling, telecalling, inside sales, or lead generation?
* How many years of experience do you have managing a team of outbound callers or lead qualification executives?
* Have you managed a team responsible for generating qualified B2B sales meetings or product demos?
* Do you have experience in B2B SaaS, HRMS, accounting software, ERP, fintech, or other business technology solutions?
* Which CRM systems and telecalling tools have you used to track team performance, leads, and sales meetings?

title: Founding Business Director
description:
**Founding Business Director – Finance & AI**

**Nebula Finance AI | Bangalore, India**

**Employment type:** Full-time, following a six-month probationary period  
**Location:** Kannur, Kerala, India  
**Expected office launch:** January 2027  
**Reporting to:** Founder  
**Travel:** Regular domestic travel, with potential international travel  
**Future mobility:** Willingness to relocate to other metros and international location as the business matures.

**About Nebula Finance AI**

Nebula Finance AI is an emerging financial technology company building an AI-powered finance workflow and intelligence platform for corporate clients in India.

Developed by AI engineers from Great Britain, our platform is designed to transform how corporate finance and treasury teams manage financial workflows, access insights, evaluate financial decisions, and automate repetitive processes.

Our solutions focus on practical applications across corporate treasury and finance, including cash and liquidity management, foreign exchange exposure and hedging, debt management, investments, receivables analysis, and AI-assisted financial decision-making.

By connecting financial data, business systems, banking workflows, and AI-powered intelligence, Nebula aims to help organisations improve efficiency, visibility, risk management, and the quality of financial decisions.

We have completed pilot testing with two major corporate organisations in India and are preparing to commence commercial operations. We are now establishing our first Indian office in Kannur, Kerala, with a planned launch in January 2027.

This is an opportunity to join Nebula at its earliest stage and help shape its commercial journey from the ground up.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly versatile, commercially minded and technology-oriented **Founding Business Director** to work directly with the Founder based in the UK.

The successful candidate will bring in **16-20 years of enterprise sales experience, closing large value enterprise solutions.** The person will have experience dealing with SAP, Oracle solutions and will be a well-known name in the market place.

The person will play a central role in developing client relationships, identifying business opportunities, demonstrating our technology, understanding customer requirements, and supporting the implementation and commercial growth of the Nebula platform.

As our first employee in India, you will have significant exposure to the Founder, senior corporate decision-makers, and the development of a growing AI-finance business.

The ideal candidate will combine a sound understanding of corporate finance and treasury with excellent communication skills, commercial awareness, technological curiosity, and the ability to work independently in a fast-moving startup environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Corporate Client Acquisition and Relationship Management**

* Identify and develop business opportunities with large Indian corporates, including organisations with complex finance and treasury operations.
* Establish and maintain professional relationships with Chief Financial Officers (CFOs), Chief Executive Officers (CEOs), Treasurers, Finance Directors, and other senior decision-makers.
* Research target organisations, understand their business models, and identify opportunities where Nebula's solutions can create measurable value.
* Arrange client meetings, introduce the platform, follow up on opportunities, and support the conversion of prospects into paying customers.
* Maintain a structured pipeline of prospects, meetings, demonstrations, proposals, and commercial opportunities.

**2. Platform Demonstrations and Solution Development**

* Develop a thorough understanding of the Nebula Finance AI platform, its modules, and its business applications.
* Conduct product demonstrations for prospective clients, including senior finance executives and corporate treasury teams.
* Understand customer requirements and translate business problems into practical technology use cases.
* Work with the Founder and technical team to communicate client feedback, refine demonstrations, and support the development of new features.
* Assist in preparing presentations, proposals, business cases, product documentation, and client-specific solution designs.

**3. Corporate Finance and Treasury**

* Develop a detailed understanding of corporate finance and treasury workflows, including cash management, liquidity forecasting, FX exposure, hedging, investments, debt management, and receivables.
* Understand how corporate finance teams interact with banks, ERP systems, financial data, and internal approval processes.
* Help identify opportunities to automate manual workflows and improve financial visibility through AI.
* Participate in discussions with client finance teams to understand existing processes and demonstrate how Nebula can improve them.

**4. Technology and AI Applications**

* Develop a working understanding of the technical architecture and capabilities of the Nebula platform.
* Demonstrate technological curiosity and an ability to understand how software applications, APIs, databases, AI models, and ERP integrations work.
* Work with the technical team to translate client requirements into clear functional specifications.
* Support platform testing, troubleshooting, user onboarding, and the preparation of user guides.
* Contribute to the development of practical AI-powered workflows for corporate finance.

**A strong interest in coding and software development is essential.** Candidates who can read or write basic code, understand APIs, work with data, or build simple technical demonstrations will have an advantage.

**5. Commercial Operations and Business Development**

* Support the Founder in preparing commercial proposals, pricing discussions, presentations, and client engagement strategies.
* Conduct market research to identify prospective customers, competitors, industry trends, and emerging opportunities in corporate finance technology.
* Maintain accurate records of client interactions, sales opportunities, and follow-up actions using a CRM or other business tools.
* Assist with client onboarding, implementation coordination, training, and ongoing relationship management.
* Help establish the processes, standards, and operating practices required to build Nebula's first Indian office.

**6. Founder’s Office and Strategic Projects**

* Work directly with the Founder on business development, strategic initiatives, operational planning, and market expansion.
* Take ownership of projects from initial research through execution and follow-up.
* Prepare concise reports, market assessments, meeting notes, and management updates.
* Represent Nebula professionally in client meetings, industry events, and business discussions.
* Be prepared to take on responsibilities beyond a conventional job description as the company evolves.

**Essential Qualifications and Experience**

* **16- 20 years of enterprise sales solution experience with a demonstrated history of the being a top-performer in the industry**.
* A well-known name in the market place and a thorough understanding of the gap in SAP and Oracle ERP Solutions with **a portfolio of client which could be moved**.
* Ability to onboard a few clients during the probationary period and proving his ability to catapult Nebula to greater heights in Indian and GCC markets.
* **Apart from a senior ERP sales consultant, senior banker, corporate advisor, retired CFO, ex-auditor etc will act as a strong candidate for the role.**
* A bachelor's degree in Finance, Commerce, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* An MBA in Finance, Business Management, or a related field is preferred.
* A strong understanding of corporate finance, treasury, financial markets, or business financial operations.
* Excellent spoken and written English. This is a non-negotiable requirement, given the role's direct interaction with senior corporate executives.
* Strong interpersonal, presentation, communication, and client-management skills.
* A good understanding of coding and software development concepts, with the ability to engage confidently with technical teams.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to understand complex business problems.
* A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to work independently.
* Willingness to travel regularly to major Indian cities based on client and business requirements.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

The following would be advantageous:

* Experience in corporate treasury, banking, financial services, fintech, enterprise software, or B2B technology sales.
* Exposure to FX markets, derivatives, hedging, liquidity management, investments, or debt financing.
* Experience engaging with CFOs, Treasurers, Finance Directors, or other senior corporate stakeholders.
* Familiarity with ERP systems such as SAP, financial software, APIs, databases, or business intelligence tools.
* Basic programming experience in Python, JavaScript, SQL, or similar languages.
* Familiarity with AI tools, large language models (LLMs), automation, or workflow software.
* Experience preparing business presentations, conducting product demonstrations, and developing commercial proposals.

Candidates with a strong combination of finance knowledge, technical aptitude, communication skills, and commercial potential will be considered even if they do not meet every preferred criterion.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who:

* Thinks like a business owner rather than someone who simply completes assigned tasks.
* Is comfortable speaking with senior executives and presenting complex concepts clearly.
* Can understand both the financial problem and the technological solution.
* Learns quickly, asks intelligent questions, and takes initiative.
* Is comfortable working in an early-stage startup where responsibilities evolve.
* Can manage multiple priorities while maintaining professionalism and attention to detail.
* Values confidentiality, integrity, accountability, and long-term client relationships.
* Is ambitious about building a career at the intersection of finance, AI, and enterprise technology.

**Employment Structure**

The role will begin with a **six-month probationary period**. Subject to satisfactory performance and the agreed employment terms, the position will continue as a full-time role.

The successful candidate will work closely with the Founder during the company's initial commercial expansion. As Nebula grows, there will be opportunities to assume greater responsibility across business development, client solutions, commercial operations, and regional expansion.

Compensation will be based on the candidate's qualifications, experience, and suitability for the role. Any performance-linked incentives or other benefits will be communicated during the recruitment process.

**Why Join Nebula Finance AI?**

* **Founding-team opportunity:** Become the first employee in our Indian operations and contribute directly to building the business.
* **Direct exposure to leadership:** Work closely with the Founder and participate in strategic and commercial decisions.
* **Enterprise technology exposure:** Gain practical experience in AI-powered financial workflows, enterprise software, and corporate treasury.
* **Senior client engagement:** Work with CFOs, CEOs, Treasurers, and other senior decision-makers.
* **Ownership and responsibility:** Take the lead on meaningful projects rather than being restricted to a narrow job function.
* **Career growth:** Develop towards leadership responsibilities as the business expands in India and internationally.
* **Geographic mobility:** Potential opportunities to work from other Indian cities or Dubai as the business develops.

**Application Process**

Interested candidates should submit the following:

* An updated CV/resume.
* A recent passport-size photograph.
* A brief cover note explaining their interest in Nebula Finance AI and why they are suited to a founding-team role.
* Details of relevant finance, technology, coding, client-facing, or business development experience.

Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a written English communication assessment, a finance or treasury case study, a basic technical aptitude assessment, and a product demonstration or business presentation exercise.

**To apply:** Submit your application through the recruitment channel specified in the job advertisement.

**Nebula Finance AI**  
*Building the future of corporate finance through artificial intelligence.*

Pay: ₹75,000.00 - ₹500,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

This role combines strategy acumen, AI fluency, structured consulting methods, and commercial orientation to help clients define AI value cases, operating models, roadmaps, and adoption approaches. * Personal sales contribution or qualified pipeline contribution, as applicable by career level.

* Contribution to downstream implementation opportunities and successful client mobilization.

* Master's degree, MBA, data science degree, AI/ML certification, or equivalent practical AI experience.
* Experience in one or more industries such as financial services, insurance, manufacturing, healthcare and life sciences, public sector, automotive, or commercial sectors.
* Familiarity with cloud and AI platforms such as Azure, AWS, GCP, OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Google/Gemini, Databricks, or Snowflake.
* Strong executive communication, structured problem solving, facilitation, stakeholder management, and collaborative teaming skills.

title: PPC Manager
description:
**Job Title / Designation:** PPC Manager
  
**Experience:** 15+ Years
  
**Qualification:** BE/Diploma/BTech in Electronics & Communication, Mechanical, Industrial, or Production Engineering.
  
**Job Location:** Bengaluru
  
  
**Role Description**  
  
We are seeking a highly driven Production Planning & Control (PPC) Manager specialist with 15+ years of core experience in EMS or Electronics Manufacturing or Defense or Aerospace, or High-Reliability Electronics Manufacturing. In this role, you will lead end-to-end operational planning, from Material Requirement Planning (MRP) and Master Production Scheduling (MPS) down to shop-floor execution. You will act as the operational center, managing cross-functional workflows across component sourcing, PCBA manufacturing, box-build integration, and Environmental Stress Screening (ESS). Furthermore, you will serve as a key liaison aligning top management strategies, sales targets, and customer delivery commitments with real-time manufacturing capacity.
  
  
**Desired Experience**   
  

* 15+ years of hands-on PPC manager experience in EMS or Electronics Manufacturing or Aerospace or Defense or Automotive, or EMS (Electronic Manufacturing Services) operating under AS9100D, IATF 16949, or ISO 9001 quality frameworks.
* Proven track record in managing high-mix, low-to-medium volume manufacturing, Mechanical assembly, wiring harness, System-level mechanical integration & Supply chain.
* Direct exposure to testing workflows, acceptances, and Environmental Stress Screening (ESS) environments (thermal cycling, ESS, vibration, and functional testing).
* Advanced proficiency in ERP systems, advanced Excel macros/data analytics, BOM management, clear-to-build (CTB) tracking, and capacity planning.

  
**Key Responsibilities**
  
  

* **Master Scheduling & Shop-Floor Planning**: Develop, maintain, and execute Master Production Schedules (MPS) and Material Requirement Plans (MRP) for SMT/PCBA assembly, mechanical integration, and final testing to ensure 100% On-Time Delivery (OTD).
* **Manufacturing & Assembly**: Coordinate with production team and engineering teams to optimize line balancing, eliminate shop-floor bottlenecks, and track daily output against target routings.
* **Supply Chain & Materials Management**: Partner with SCM, stores, and procurement to monitor component lead times, track critical active/passive electronic components, verify CTB readiness, and optimize store kitting processes.
* **Testing & ESS Integration**: Plan and route assemblies through functional testing, screening, and ESS labs to prevent testing backlogs and maintain steady WIP throughput.
* **Top Management Engagement**: Prepare daily/weekly progress dashboards, WIP reports, capacity utilization matrices, and delay analysis reports for executive reviews.
* **Sales & Customer Touchpoints**: Serve as the primary operational contact for the sales team and clients to provide accurate Lead Time estimates (ATP/CTP), order tracking, and delivery timelines.
* **Process & Inventory Control**: Control Work-in-Progress (WIP) levels, reduce inventory carrying costs, enforce strict engineering change order (ECO) controls, and drive continuous improvement through Lean and 5S initiatives on the shop floor.

title: Director, Global Supply Management
description:
Calling all originals: At Levi Strauss & Co., you can be yourself — and be part of something bigger. We're a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit — and your future.

**Position Summary**

The Director, Global Supply Management is a senior functional leader responsible for setting direction, establishing governance and delivering reliable in-season supply outcomes for assigned global portfolios. You will convert changing commercial requirements into possible supply commitments and lead enterprise-level trade-off decisions across demand, production capacity, materials, delivery, and responsiveness.

Beyond managing daily supply performance, the Director shapes the GSM operating model, builds decision mechanisms, sponsors planning and technology transformation, and develops organisational capability. You will operate in a global matrix, partnering with senior leaders across MPIM, Supply Planning, Merchandising, Sales, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Materials, Logistics, Finance and Technology.

Success requires deep supply-chain expertise, independent executive judgment, a proven record of transformation, the ability to influence without direct authority and a disciplined approach to leading a high-performing Bengaluru-based team.

**1. Global In-Season Supply Strategy and Demand-Supply Governance**
--------------------------------------------------------------------

  

* Set the in-season GSM strategy, operating priorities and performance agenda for the assigned global portfolios, aligned with our goals.

* Lead global demand-supply reconciliation and establish a disciplined governance process for possible vendor-level, time-phased supply commitments.
* Anticipate supply constraints and commercial changes; direct scenario planning and recommend explicit service, speed, capacity and cost trade-offs.
* Establish decision rights, escalation thresholds and executive review mechanisms for supply choices.
* Represent GSM in S&OP interfaces and senior business forums, providing concise decision recommendations and clear accountability.

**2. Supplier Capacity, Materials Readiness and Network Agility**
-----------------------------------------------------------------

  

* Provide senior oversight of supplier capacity agreement, RCCP, production feasibility, and material readiness in partnership with Product Development, Sourcing, Manufacturing, and Fabric teams.
* Shape cross-vendor capacity allocation and supply flexibility recommendations to respond to shifting our priorities.
* Sponsor plans to reduce lead times, improve material and production responsiveness, and strengthen the assigned supply network.
* Resolve material or capacity constraints requiring prioritisation or senior-leadership intervention.
* Ensure transparent assumptions, risks, milestones for critical supply commitments.

**3. In-Season Execution and Business Continuity**
--------------------------------------------------

  

* Lead the governance of in-season supply performance, supply confirmations, production readiness and delivery-risk resolution for assigned portfolios.
* Establish proactive risk identification, exception management and structured recovery processes across sourcing and execution partners.
* Lead resolution of the most consequential supply disruptions and direct escalation of issues affecting business-critical deliveries.
* Improve commitments, supply reliability, response speed and execution discipline.
* Ensure continuity through well-defined handoffs, process documentation and organisational resilience.

**4. Global GSM Operating Model, Transformation and Analytics**
---------------------------------------------------------------

  

* Define and guide a multiyear roadmap for GSM process, operating-model scalability and digital planning capability.
* Sponsor transformation plans to simplify planning cycles, standardise governance.
* Partner with Technology, Analytics and Planning on enterprise solutions, including o9, Boardwalk where applicable.
* Promote scenario-based management, data quality, exception-led workflows and decision-support dashboards.
* Establish benefit realisation, adoption measures and accountable owners for transformation plans; reduce reliance on individual expertise.

**5. Executive Partnership and Enterprise Influence**
-----------------------------------------------------

  

* Be the senior GSM counterpart to leaders across MPIM, Supply Planning, Merchandising, Sales, Product Development, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Materials, Logistics, Finance and Technology.
* Shape decisions where commercial urgency, supplier constraints, and execution feasibility create priorities.
* Present strategic options and clear recommendations to the Vice President and other senior leaders, including possible effects and required decisions.
* Represent the function in senior operational and transformation forums and strengthen trust in GSM as a partner.

**6. People Leadership, Succession and Organizational Capability**
------------------------------------------------------------------

  

* Develop the Bengaluru GSM organisation, setting direction, performance standards and accountability.
* Build a leadership bench and succession pipeline; delegate operational ownership while retaining governance of critical outcomes.
* Develop capabilities in global supply planning, capacity management, analytics.
* Establish repeatable knowledge-management, onboarding and continuity practices.
* Create a sustainable global working model with clear priorities, collaboration across time zones and disciplined escalation.

**Measures of Success**
-----------------------

  

* Demand-supply agreement and responsiveness to our requirements.
* Supply commitments, supply reliability and recovery performance.
* Supplier capacity readiness and resolution of material or production constraints.
* Lead-time reduction, flexibility and in-season responsiveness.
* Plan cycle efficiency, data quality and adoption of standardised decision processes.
* Decision speed, risk visibility and effectiveness of escalations.
* Delivery and adoption of the GSM transformation roadmap.
* Team capability, succession strength and partner confidence.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**
------------------------------------------

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Operations, Business or a related field.
* 25+ years of progressive experience in global supply-chain management, supply planning, sourcing operations, manufacturing planning or related disciplines.
* Substantial senior leadership experience across multi-region, multi-vendor or multi-category global supply environments.
* Lead Complex teams, develop successors and influence executive partners across a matrix organisation.
* Expertise in in-season demand-supply management, S&OP interfaces, RCCP, supplier capacity, materials readiness and supply execution.
* Experience shaping operating models and delivering process or technology transformation.

**Qualifications**
------------------

  

* Experience in apparel, footwear, consumer products, retail or other seasonal, outsourced global supply chains.
* Experience with multi-country sourcing networks and global capability-centre leadership.
* Exposure to o9, Boardwalk or comparable enterprise planning platforms.
* Master of Business Administration, relevant master's degree or professional supply-chain certification.

**Leadership Competencies**
---------------------------

**Enterprise perspective and commercial judgement; independent decision-making; operational accountability; transformation sponsorship; talent development and succession.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Expected First-Year Outcomes**
--------------------------------

  

* Maintain uninterrupted in-season supply management and establish credibility with important global partners.
* Confirm and strengthen global governance, decision rights and escalation routines for assigned portfolios.
* Improve visibility of capacity and materials constraints and accelerate resolution of critical supply exceptions.
* Agree a prioritised GSM transformation roadmap with measurable business and adoption outcomes
* Strengthen the Bengaluru team's leadership capacity, succession readiness and operational independence.

**Position Impact**
-------------------

You will influence global commercial execution through supply feasibility, supplier readiness, decisions and reliable in-season supply performance. Director-level impact is demonstrated by shaping how GSM operates, setting priorities and governance across functions leading major transformation and building enduring organizational capability rather than by managing exceptions alone.

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

Greenfield Site Launch & Industrialization

* Lead the end-to-end Supply Chain workstream for the new plant start-up and industrialization.
* Build Supply Chain processes, systems, governance and organization from a greenfield environment.
* Develop the Supply Chain launch roadmap aligned with plant commissioning and production ramp-up milestones.
* Define and implement planning policies, inventory strategies, warehouse processes and logistics flows.
* Support New Product Introduction (NPI), industrial transfers and production readiness reviews.
* Recruit, train and develop the Supply Chain team required for production launch and growth.
* Establish operational KPIs, reporting cadence and governance mechanisms prior to SOP (Start of Production).
* Drive launch readiness reviews and manage supply chain-related risks during ramp-up.

1. Demand Planning & S&OP

* Translate customer demand, sales forecasts and program requirements into an integrated Supply Chain and Production Plan.
* Lead the monthly S&OP process in coordination with Sales, Program Management, Operations, Finance and Engineering.
* Identify demand-supply gaps, capacity constraints, material risks and recovery actions.
* Maintain a rolling 12–18 month supply and capacity outlook.
* Establish clear priorities based on customer requirements, program milestones and business objectives
* Design and implement the site's S&OP / IBP process, governance and decision-making framework.
* Establish demand, supply, inventory and capacity review cycles and escalation processes.
* Lead executive S&OP reviews during plant launch and production ramp-up phases.

2. Production Planning & Control

* Own the Master Production Schedule (MPS) and ensure alignment with available capacity, manpower, materials and customer demand.
* Optimize production loading across manufacturing lines and work centers.
* Ensure timely release and closure of Manufacturing Orders / Work Orders.
* Monitor plan adherence and drive corrective actions for deviations.
* Establish appropriate production lead times, safety stocks and planning parameters.
* Work closely with Production and Engineering to resolve bottlenecks and improve throughput.
* Manage demand, capacity and inventory trade-off decisions during ramp-up phases.

3. Material Planning & MRP

Existing responsibilities plus:

* Own the MRP process and ensure availability of materials in line with the production plan.
* Monitor material shortages, long-lead items, critical components and supplier constraints.
* Establish and maintain accurate ERP planning parameters including:
  + Lead times
  + Lot sizes
  + Safety stocks
  + Reorder levels
  + MOQ
  + Supplier lead times
  + Planning horizons
* Develop material risk dashboards and provide early-warning alerts.
* Drive shortage recovery plans with Procurement, Suppliers and Operations Define and deploy MRP planning policies, parameters and system governance from plant start-up through serial production.
* Validate material planning assumptions, safety stock strategies and inventory buffers required for launch readiness.

4. Procurement & Supplier Management

* Lead procurement planning in alignment with production and material requirements.
* Ensure timely release and follow-up of Purchase Orders / Purchase Requisitions.
* Monitor supplier OTD, quality, lead time and responsiveness.
* Establish supplier recovery plans for critical shortages and delayed deliveries.
* Identify and mitigate single-source and long-lead supplier risks.
* Work with Strategic Sourcing and Quality to develop alternate sources wherever required.
* Support supplier capacity assessments and supplier development initiatives.
* Validate supplier capacity against projected production growth requirements.
* Develop business continuity strategies for critical commodities and components.
* Support supplier localization and supply base development initiatives where appropriate.

5. Inventory Management

* Own factory inventory performance covering raw material, WIP and finished goods.
* Establish inventory targets based on demand, lead time, criticality and customer requirements.
* Drive reduction of:
  + Excess inventory
  + Obsolete inventory
  + Slow-moving inventory
  + Uncontrolled WIP
* Ensure inventory accuracy through cycle counting and robust inventory-control processes.
* Balance inventory investment vs. customer service and production continuity.

6. Warehouse & Logistics

Existing responsibilities plus:

* Provide overall direction to stores, warehouse and material handling operations.
* Ensure timely material receipt, inspection, storage, kitting and issue to production.
* Establish FIFO/FEFO and appropriate storage controls where applicable.
* Ensure traceability and preservation of aerospace/defence materials.
* Optimize internal material movement and point-of-use availability.
* Coordinate finished-goods dispatches and logistics to achieve customer delivery commitments
* Design warehouse layout, storage concepts, inventory locations and material flow processes.
* Define inbound, internal and outbound logistics models for the site.
* Establish receiving, traceability, inventory-control and materials-management processes prior to launch.

Support implementation of traceability systems.

* + Manage customs and import/export activities for materials, components, equipment and finished goods, ensuring compliance with applicable customs regulations and trade requirements.
  + Coordinate with customs brokers, freight forwarders and relevant internal functions to ensure timely customs clearance and minimize supply-chain disruptions.
  + Establish customs documentation, classification, valuation and record-retention processes for import and export transactions.
  + Monitor customs-related risks, duties, taxes, permits and regulatory requirements and drive timely resolution of exceptions.

7. ERP / Digital Supply Chain

Existing responsibilities plus:

* Ensure high data integrity across ERP/MRP systems.
* Establish robust governance for:
  + BOM
  + Material master
  + Routings
  + Lead times
  + Planning parameters
  + Purchase orders
  + Production orders
  + Inventory records
* Drive digitalization of supply-chain dashboards and performance monitoring.
* Improve planning accuracy through data analytics and automation.
* Lead Supply Chain requirements definition for ERP/MRP implementation and deployment.
* Define planning master data structures, transaction governance and reporting requirements.
* Validate BOMs, routings, inventory policies and planning parameters prior to ERP go-live.
* Lead Supply Chain User Acceptance Testing (UAT), training and stabilization activities.
* Ensure ERP/MRP readiness and data integrity prior to production launch.

8. Risk Management & Business Continuity

* Establish a Supply Chain Risk Management framework covering critical materials, suppliers, logistics and capacity.
* Escalate risks early with clear impact, mitigation and recovery actions.
* Develop launch-specific risk mitigation plans covering suppliers, material availability, capacity constraints, systems readiness and logistics.
* Manage greenfield supply chain risk registers and drive closure of critical launch risks.

9. Continuous Improvement

* Lead Supply Chain improvement initiatives using Lean, Kaizen, PDCA, VSM and data-driven problem solving.
* Improve:
  + Planning accuracy
  + Inventory turns
  + Supplier OTD
  + Material availability
  + Production plan adherence
  + Lead time
  + OTIF
  + Supply Chain cost
* Establish standard work and governance across the Supply Chain organization.

10. Product Launch, NPI & Industrial Transfers

* Support New Product Introduction (NPI), engineering changes and industrial transfer programs.
* Ensure planning and procurement readiness for prototype, pilot, qualification and serial production phases.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Quality and Program Management to ensure launch readiness.
* Support customer audits, FAI/PPAP activities and production qualification requirements where applicable.

Candidate Profile

Education :

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Industrial Engineering or equivalent.
* Master's degree / MBA in Supply Chain Management, Operations or Business Administration preferred.

Experience

* 10–15 years of experience in Supply Chain / Operations / Production Planning in a manufacturing environment.
* Experience in aerospace & defence, electronics, electrical, precision engineering or other high-reliability manufacturing is preferred.
* Proven experience managing a factory-level supply chain organization.

Experience in a greenfield / ramp-up environment would be an advantage

* Proven experience leading Supply Chain activities in a greenfield manufacturing facility, plant start-up, industrial transfer, major ERP implementation or production ramp-up environment.
* Demonstrated experience establishing planning, procurement, warehouse and logistics processes from a greenfield or start-up environment.
* Demonstrated success in achieving production readiness, launch readiness and operational stabilization during plant ramp-up.

Technical Competencies

Existing competencies plus:

* S&OP / IBP
* MPS / MRP
* Production Planning & Control
* Material Planning
* Procurement
* Inventory Management
* Warehouse Management
* Supplier Management
* Capacity Planning
* ERP / MRP / PLM systems
* Advanced Excel / Power BI or equivalent analytics tools
* Lean Manufacturing / Six Sigma
* Greenfield Plant Launch & Start-Up
* Industrialization & Manufacturing Ramp-Up
* Project Management
* Program Management
* Change Management
* ERP Deployment & Go-Live
* Master Data Governance
* Launch Readiness & Operational Readiness Reviews
* New Product Introduction (NPI)

Leadership Competencies

Existing competencies plus:

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability
* Ability to manage cross-functional teams
* Strong stakeholder-management skills
* Ability to operate in a high growth / high-pressure manufacturing environment
* Strong execution discipline
* Data-driven decision making
* Excellent communication and escalation management
* Ability to build and develop Supply Chain teams
* Proven ability to build Supply Chain organizations, processes and governance from the ground up.
* Experience recruiting, developing and scaling Supply Chain teams during periods of rapid growth.
* Strong project leadership and cross-functional execution capabilities.
* Ability to lead through uncertainty, ambiguity and changing business priorities typical of greenfield environments.

Strong capability to balance launch objectives with operational performance requirements.

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Staff Security Engineer
description:
**About Refold AI**

Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants.

We've grown rapidly, reaching seven-figure ARR and 30+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM.

Refold AI has raised $6.5M from world-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital.

**About this role:**

You will set the security direction for the whole platform and build much of it with your own hands. This is a hands-on Staff+ role: you write code, review designs, and lead incidents, not only policy.

**Your mandate covers four things:**

* **Protect customer credentials and data** across a multi-tenant platform and every deployment model we ship.
* **Make AI agents safe to connect** to enterprise systems, from prompt injection to tool-permission scope.
* **Harden how we build and ship**, from the monorepo and CI to the images and Helm charts customers run in their own clusters.
* **Turn security into a sales advantage** by owning the technical side of enterprise security reviews and our compliance program.

You will work across every engineering team, partner with product and go-to-market, and help hire and grow the security function.

**What you'll do:**

**Cloud and infrastructure security**

* Harden our GCP and GKE footprint: IAM, workload identity, network policy, egress control and private control planes.
* Own secrets and key management end to end, including rotation, short-lived credentials and KMS-backed encryption.
* Build runtime security for containers and nodes, so a compromised workload is detected and contained fast.

**Product and application security**

* Threat-model the integration engine, credential vault, workflow runtime and webhook surface, and drive the fixes.
* Guarantee tenant isolation across shared data stores, queues and workflow engines.
* Design safe execution for customer-authored code and custom actions.
* Raise the bar on authentication and access: SSO, SCIM, RBAC, API keys and OAuth flows.

**AI and agent security**

* Define how AI agents get scoped, auditable access to enterprise systems through our MCP servers and AI gateway.
* Defend against prompt injection, tool misuse and data exfiltration through agents.

**Software supply chain**

* Secure the monorepo, CI pipelines and release process: branch protection, signed and provenance-attested images, SBOMs and dependency scanning.
* Make the images and Helm charts that customers install in their own clusters trustworthy and easy to verify.

**Detection and incident response**

* Build logging, detection and alerting that catch real attacks, with low noise.
* Lead security incidents end to end: triage, forensics, containment, customer communication and the post-incident fix.

**Customer trust and compliance**

* Be the senior technical voice in enterprise security reviews, questionnaires and customer calls.
* Run SOC 2 and ISO 27001 as engineering work: automate evidence, own pen-test scoping and drive remediation.
* Publish hardening guidance for customers who self-host or run Refold in their own cloud.

**Leadership**

* Build paved roads so the secure way is the easy way for every engineer.
* Mentor engineers, run a security-champions program, and help hire the security team.

**What we're looking for:**

* Typically 8+ years in security or software engineering, including several years as the senior security engineer for a multi-tenant SaaS platform.
* Deep cloud and Kubernetes security experience. GCP and GKE preferred; strong AWS or Azure depth is fine.
* Strong application security: threat modelling, secure design review, and code review in at least one of TypeScript/Node.js, Python or Go.
* Fluency with OAuth 2.0, OIDC and SAML, secrets management, key management and encryption design.
* You have led real production security incidents, including forensics and customer communication.
* Hands-on software supply chain work: CI/CD hardening, artefact signing, SBOMs and dependency risk.
* You write production-quality code and ship tooling, not only recommendations.
* You have represented a company's security in front of enterprise security teams, and won their trust.
* You can turn SOC 2 or ISO 27001 controls into engineering systems instead of spreadsheets.
* Clear, direct writing. You explain risk to engineers, executives and customers in their own terms.

**Bonus points:**

* Security work on LLM and agent systems: OWASP Top 10 for LLM applications, MCP, tool-use permissions.
* Sandboxing and isolation for untrusted code, such as gVisor, Firecracker or V8 isolates.
* Shipping software that customers run in their own environments: BYOC, on-prem, air-gapped.
* Securing workflow engines and data stores such as Temporal, MongoDB, Redis and PostgreSQL.
* Background in integration platforms, iPaaS, or enterprise systems like SAP, Workday or Salesforce.
* Offensive security experience, published research, CVEs or open-source security tooling.
* HIPAA or other regulated-data experience.
* You have built a security team from the first hire.

We are looking for an experienced C&I solar sales professional to win and grow business with factories, commercial buildings, institutions and agricultural enterprises. * Build long-term customer relationships to secure repeat business, referrals and O&M or upgrade opportunities.
* Track competitor pricing, new policies (MNRE, TNERC, DISCOM norms) and market trends, and share insights with management.

**Apply here - https://portal.tnsolarsolution.com/jobs/tn\_solar\_solution/senior-sales-executive**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Energy or similar) or a degree or MBA in Marketing or Business. Equivalent experience is considered.

* Proven record of closing C&I projects, ideally in the 50 kW to several MW range, with achieved sales targets.
* Working understanding of rooftop solar technology, system components (modules, inverters, structures), net metering and Tamil Nadu electricity tariff structures.

* Strong negotiation, presentation and communication skills in English and Tamil. Other languages are a plus.
* Proficiency in MS Office and CRM tools.
* Willingness to travel frequently within Tamil Nadu. Valid driving license and own two-wheeler or car preferred.

Preferred Skills

* Existing network among industrial clusters, such as textile, manufacturing, food processing, cold storage and educational institutions.
* Experience with RESCO/OPEX models or open access and group captive projects.
* Familiarity with government and bank financing schemes for solar.

Key Performance Indicators

* Monthly and annual sales target (kW or MW booked, and revenue)
* Gross margin on orders closed
* Lead-to-proposal and proposal-to-order conversion rates
* Pipeline value and forecast accuracy
* Collections against orders sold
* Customer satisfaction and repeat or referral business

•⁠ ⁠A second language relevant to our markets, such as Japanese, Mandarin, Vietnamese or German.

•⁠ ⁠Direct exposure to global enterprise clients across Europe and Asia.
