Job Description
  
  
Associate Director – Intelligent Personal Engagement
  
Customer Knowledge and Measurement | DHH India Hub Delivery
  
Role snapshot
  
Summary
  
Reports to
  
Director – Customer Knowledge and Measurement, DHH India Hub Delivery
  
  
Location
  
Hyderabad, India; international and domestic travel as required by business
  
  
Capability scope
  
Digital solutions for customer-facing teams and service channels: field engagement (face-to-face sales CRM), Veeva Sales Operations, sampling, event management, customer service, Field engagement and reporting, Field AI and associated AI capabilities, global and market deployment
  
  
Leadership scope
  
Lead product and delivery teams across Field, CRM, Veeva/Salesforce platforms, AI-enabled field workflows, operations, compliance reporting, and customer engagement execution
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
Lead the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of digital solutions supporting customer-facing teams and service channels across US and international markets, spanning field engagement, sales operations, sampling, event management, customer service, Patient CRM, transparency reporting, and associated AI capabilities, and evolve them into a connected, AI-enabled engagement ecosystem.
  
  
Job Description
  
  
This role sits within the Customer Knowledge and Measurement vertical of Digital Human Health (DHH), India Hub Delivery. The Associate Director, Intelligent Personal Engagement will lead the India Hub capability for the digital solutions that support our customer-facing teams and service channels across US and international markets. The role reports to the Director, Customer Knowledge and Measurement India Hub, and works as part of the US and International Intelligent Personal Engagement team.
  
The role is accountable for shaping and executing the strategy and roadmap for these solutions, and for delivering and continuously improving the platforms and workflows that power field engagement, sales operations, sampling, event management, customer service, Field CRM, transparency reporting, and associated AI capabilities, including Field AI.
  
The Associate Director will be a strategic delivery partner to the Intelligent Personal Engagement capability lead and to US and International market stakeholders, driving the evolution of these capabilities into a connected, AI-enabled ecosystem that enables more informed engagement, improves effectiveness across customer-facing teams, and delivers more consistent customer experiences, while remaining scalable, compliant, user-centered, and aligned to business outcomes across Human Health.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Shape and execute the strategy, roadmap, operating model, and delivery governance for Intelligent Personal Engagement capabilities across US and international markets, in partnership with the global capability lead and aligned with DHH priorities.
* Drive the evolution of field engagement, sales operations, customer service, event management, and transparency-reporting solutions from discrete platforms into a connected, AI-enabled ecosystem with integrated workflows, shared customer data, and reusable AI services across channels.
* Act as the accountable product owner for the Intelligent Personal Engagement product portfolio: define the product vision, own and prioritize the backlog, set release plans, and make value-based trade-offs across US and international market demand.
* Manage the end-to-end product lifecycle, from discovery and business case through MVP, scale-up, and retirement, with clear product OKRs, adoption targets, and value-realization tracking for each capability.
* Lead user-centered product discovery with field representatives, field managers, market operations, and customer service teams, using journey mapping, user research, and continuous feedback loops to ensure solutions address real engagement pain points.
* Govern demand intake and prioritization across markets, balancing global standardization with local market needs, and maintain transparent roadmaps and product communications with stakeholders.
* Own India Hub delivery for face-to-face sales and CRM capabilities, including field workflows, call planning, activity capture, customer interaction management, and field enablement.
* Lead Veeva-enabled Sales Operations capabilities, including business process support, release management, field operations enhancements, and user-adoption improvements.
* Drive delivery and continuous improvement of sampling, events management, customer service, Field CRM, Field AI, and transparency-reporting capabilities.
* Partner with Commercial, Market Operations, Sales, Medical/Legal/Regulatory, Privacy, Compliance, IT, Data/AI, and platform teams to translate market requirements into scalable products and implementation plans.
* Embed compliance-by-design across personal engagement workflows, including sampling controls, consent/privacy considerations, transparency reporting, CRM data quality, and appropriate use of AI-enabled recommendations.
* Establish clear capability KPIs, including field adoption, engagement quality, customer-facing team effectiveness, process efficiency, data quality, cycle-time improvement, consistency of customer experience across channels, and platform value realization.
* Lead cross-functional delivery pods and vendor partners to execute releases, resolve issues, manage risks, improve user experience, and scale best practices across markets.
* Champion Field AI and responsible GenAI use cases across customer-facing teams and service channels that enable more informed engagement, next-best engagement execution, coaching, summarization, and workflow productivity within compliance guardrails.
* Lead the end-to-end build of AI products for customer-facing teams, such as next-best-action suggestions, pre-call planning insights, call and interaction summarization, AI coaching assistants, customer service copilots, and agentic workflows, from use-case identification and feasibility through design, development, testing, and deployment.
* Partner with Data Science, Data Engineering, and platform teams to ensure AI-ready data, seamless integration of AI capabilities into Veeva/Salesforce CRM and service workflows, including monitoring for performance, accuracy, and drift.
* Apply responsible AI governance to every AI product, including human-in-the-loop design, guardrails, explainability, Medical/Legal/Regulatory and privacy review, and model risk controls appropriate for regulated customer engagement.
* Own AI activation and adoption across US and international markets, including launch planning, change management, field training, field champion networks, embedding AI into daily workflows, and capturing in-market feedback to drive sustained usage.
* Measure AI product value before and after launch, tracking adoption, usage, engagement quality, time saved, field productivity, and business impact (ROI and payback), and use these insights to iterate, scale, or retire AI capabilities.
* Develop talent and strengthen delivery excellence by coaching teams on product thinking, agile execution, stakeholder communication, operational rigor, and continuous learning.

Education Requirements
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related discipline. Advanced degree such as MBA, MS, PharmD, MPH, or equivalent preferred.

Required Experience and Skills
  
  

* 8 years of experience in pharmaceutical/biotech commercial operations, CRM, sales operations, digital engagement, product management, technology delivery, or customer experience functions.
* 4 years of people leadership experience in a global, matrixed environment, including leading direct reports and cross-functional delivery teams.
* Strong understanding of field sales workflows, CRM processes, Veeva and/or Salesforce capabilities, sales operations, sampling, events, customer service, and field effectiveness.
* Proven hands-on experience across Field Engagement, Analytics, and AI, including applying customer and field data, engagement analytics, and AI/ML-driven insights to improve field effectiveness, customer engagement, and commercial outcomes.
* Experience defining strategy and roadmaps and delivering enterprise products or platform enhancements across global and market teams, with strong knowledge of platform integration, agile delivery, release governance, user adoption, and lifecycle management.
* Working knowledge of compliance, privacy, transparency reporting, sampling governance, consent management, and regulated customer engagement requirements in pharma.
* Ability to translate commercial strategy and field execution needs into scalable business requirements, product roadmaps, data workflows, and measurable business outcomes.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex business problems, interpret data to generate actionable insights, and drive evidence-based decisions, combined with strong stakeholder engagement skills to build trusted relationships and influence across global, regional, and market teams.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder alignment skills, with ability to navigate competing priorities, manage trade-offs, and provide forward-looking visibility into risks and milestones.
* Digital and AI fluency, including ability to identify practical Field AI and GenAI opportunities and embed them into a connected engagement ecosystem that responsibly improves productivity, customer engagement, and operational excellence.

### **Role description**

At Grant Thornton INDUS, our people-centric culture is rooted in empowering individuals, bold leadership, and a commitment to providing distinctive client experiences. We foster a transparent, competitive, and performance-driven environment where professionals are given opportunities to contribute to meaningful and impactful initiatives. Our young and dynamic workforce not only excels in delivering business outcomes but also inspires and gives back to the community through generous and impactful service initiatives.

**Summary**

The Application Architect is responsible for the development and ownership of architectural solutions, leveraging standards, patterns, and framework, and maintaining an application’s data architecture that align to Enterprise Architecture’s Standards and Patterns as well as the business strategy and goals for the company. This role provides technical guidance on custom application and data solution implementations within the business technology team. The Application Architect collaborates with Project teams, Enterprise Architecture, Product Managers, and Business Stakeholders to determine solutions based on business requirements and consults on their implementation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Evaluate and analyze business needs and current technical assets/data to develop and implement solutions and strategy for applications.

* Perform application technology planning and drive technical product roadmaps with the product manager, suggesting improvements to increase efficiency, scalability, and maximize product value.

* Interact and communicate effectively with business sponsors, technology management, executives, end users, and subject matter experts.

* Utilize and evangelize enterprise architecture strategies, including reference architectures and standards, use of application patterns, and assisting development teams with best practices for application design.

* Create and maintain technical application architecture depicting the Business and IT landscape in its current, transitional, and future state for a portfolio of applications.

* Utilize enterprise application policies and standards for design, integration, scalability, navigation, maintainability, and reuse of capabilities in designs of solutions.

* Provide technical consultation for technology and software solutions based on business needs; oversee architectural aspects of business solution development and deployment.

* Work with the product team on a portfolio of applications and solutions to design, perform code reviews, roadmap solutions to keep with current technology and assist support on escalation of issues

**Education / Professional Experience/ Qualifications**

* Bachelor of Science (BS) in Computer Science or Information Systems (or equivalent work experience).

* 8+ years of experience in application technology—primarily within application architecture and development, including experience with TOGAF and Zachman frameworks, SOA, integration patterns, solution design, target architecture, cloud platforms, technology maturity models, Java, .NET, Python, microservices, and governance.

* Extensive experience working with application teams, vendors, or service providers; considerable experience with SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) methodologies and design/architecture aspects of project delivery.

* Experience with Microsoft technologies (Azure PaaS DBs, Event Grid, Kubernetes containers, Azure Insight, Azure Data Factory, Power Platform), Amazon technologies (Lambda, S3, EKS, EC2), BPMN (Business Process Model and Notation) tooling, and other relevant industry leaders.

* Ability to communicate clearly and concisely with others, including senior leadership, in and outside of the organization, in a credible, engaging, and confident manner. Adapt communication style and method as necessary.

* Ability to summarize and translate complex, technical information into straightforward language for various technical and non-technical audiences.

* Critical and creative thinking skills; ability to use a variety of tools and processes to conduct research and analyses, recognize solutions, and make timely decisions.

* Pursue professional and technical expertise; participate in developmental opportunities to ensure continual growth.

* Take initiative, proactively look for solutions, and help others to think ahead. Be innovative and share ideas with Enterprise Architecture for continuous improvement.

* Be flexible and work effectively across various situations to achieve goals. Prioritize different work streams and balance short-term versus long-term objectives.

* Value individual differences, treat everyone with respect, and appreciate diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

* Align actions with words, maintain a positive attitude, and respond productively to conflict.

* Hold yourself and others accountable for accomplishing high-quality results within timelines and appropriate resources.

**Desirable Characteristics**

* Experience with professional services firms.

* Experience working within an IT organization with a mix of managed IT services and internal services.

* Experience with IT software capabilities such as CRMs, e-signatures, rules engines, workflow engines, reporting, SSO, OCR, financial systems, software sales tooling, and document assembly.

**Reporting Relationship**

This position reports to Enterprise Architecture.

**Grant Thornton INDUS (Full-Time Employee) Benefits:**

* **Insurance:** Group Health, Accidental, and Term Life Insurance for employees (and dependents as applicable).
* **Wellness:** Employee Assistance Program, Corporate Health Plans, Gym (Bangalore), Wellness Webinars, Health months.
* **Work-Life Balance:** Hybrid work model, flexible work options for returning mothers.
* **Parental Support:** Maternity/Paternity leave, daycare facilities, flexible work arrangements.
* **Mobility:** Secondment opportunities, relocation benefits, internal job postings.
* **Retirement:** Provident Fund, Gratuity, Leave Encashment, National Pension Scheme.
* **Additional Benefits:** Women’s security (night transport), home office setup allowance, certification reimbursements, meal cards, appreciation holidays, service awards.
* **Learning:** Multi-channelIn-house learning platform, LinkedIn Learning, certification programs.

**Join us at Grant Thornton INDUS and be part of a firm that values your growth, encourages innovation, and makes a positive impact on the community.****We invite you to bring your own self — empowering you with the flexibility, support, and opportunities from day one.**

  

**About Grant Thornton INDUS**
------------------------------

Grant Thornton INDUS is the global capability center for Grant Thornton US, the U.S. member firm of Grant Thornton International Ltd., a leading global network of independent audit, tax, and advisory firms. Founded in Chicago in 1924, Grant Thornton US is one of the leading accounting and advisory firms in the U.S., bringing together $4B+ in revenue, 56 U.S. offices, and a multi-national platform spanning 20 countries with 25,000 people. -----------------

gTech Ads is responsible for all support and media and technical services for customers big and small across our entire Ad products stack. We help our customers get the most out of our Ad and Publisher products and guide them when they need help. We provide a range of services from enabling better self help and in-product support, to providing better support through interactions, setting up accounts and implementing ad campaigns, and providing media solutions for customers business and marketing needs and providing complex technical and measurement solutions along with consultative support for our large customers. These solutions range from bespoke and customized ones for our customers to scalable support for millions of customers worldwide. Based on the evolving needs of our ads customers, we partner with Sales, Product and Engineering teams within Google to develop better solutions, tools, and services to improve our products and enhance our client experience. As a cross-functional and global team, we ensure our customers get the best return on investment with Google and we remain a trusted partner.

  

In this role, you will lead a team of technical leaders who seek to understand our publishers’ business objectives and are committed to helping them achieve those goals through technical troubleshooting, innovation, and executional excellence.

The team acts as pre and post-sales specialists using technical expertise and operational experience to consult with and support publishers using Google Ad Manager ad serving and yield management products. Team members are product experts who serve as a liaison between the Partner Technology and Operations team, Google Product and Engineering, and Google Sales teams and partners.

Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.  
  
To learn more about gTech, check out our video.

title: Supv-Solutions Archt
description:
### **When you join Verizon**

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

### **What you’ll be doing...**

**Type of Work:** Strategic leadership, executive technical sponsorship, and cross-functional management. The daily focus is on leading a team of technical experts, overseeing overarching architectural strategies—spanning traditional underlay networks (MPLS, Dedicated Internet, Broadband), modern overlays (SD-WAN, SASE), Private 5G ecosystems, and advanced VoIP modernization efforts—and removing roadblocks to drive multi-million-dollar deals from discovery to closing.

**Expected Volumes:** Managing a high-performing team of Solution Architects who are concurrently handling multiple enterprise-level deal cycles and automation projects. You will navigate a highly matrixed environment, managing executive-level relationships with internal teams, external OEM partners, and C-level customer stakeholders.

**Risk & Criticality:** You are accountable for the foundational telecom, cloud, security, voice, and wireless enterprise infrastructure designed by your team. Failure to properly allocate resources, vet architectural designs, or align OEM vendors and implementation teams can stall major revenue opportunities. Poor oversight can lead to deployment failures, SLA breaches, or lost enterprise contracts.

### **What we’re looking for...**

* **Team Leadership & Mentorship:** Hire, coach, and manage a team of Pre-Sales Solution Architects. Foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and cross-functional collaboration.
* **Executive Deal Sponsorship:** Act as the executive technical sponsor and escalation point for high-stakes enterprise deals. Step in to navigate complex multi-vendor negotiations (including UCaaS/CPaaS and networking OEMs) and drive alignment between Sales, Product Management, and Implementation teams.
* **Architectural Oversight & Legacy Modernization:** Maintain accountability for the team's designs. Steer overarching strategies to transition legacy enterprise accounts from physical PRI/TDM and global MPLS networks to resilient, cloud-hosted SIP architectures and internet-first (DIA/Broadband) SD-WAN/SASE overlays.
* **Strategic Alignment & 5G GTM:** Partner with Sales Leadership to define technical Go-To-Market strategies for cutting-edge Private 5G and Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) solutions, ensuring the right mix of RAN, Core, and IP architects are allocated.
* **Deal & Technical Escalation:** Serve as the executive point of escalation for complex pre-sales roadblocks. Step in to unblock stalled architectural disagreements with internal Product teams, and smooth out critical handoff friction between Pre-Sales and Implementation teams.
* **Architectural & Regulatory Compliance:** Ensure the team’s solution designs strictly adhere to internal standards, delivery capabilities, and regional telecom regulatory requirements (e.g., data sovereignty, local VoIP routing laws) *prior* to contract signature.
* **Strategic Product Advocacy:** Aggregate field feedback—such as gaps in global broadband footprints, MPLS offloading challenges, or specific 5G network slicing requests—to act as the primary voice of the customer to VP-level Product Management.
* **AI/Automation Acumen:** Sponsor and integrate LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI) to drive internal team efficiencies and streamline complex sales engineering workflows.

### **You’ll need to have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Telecom/IT/Communications or a relevant engineering field.
* 9+ years of relevant work experience in the telecom or tech industry, with 3+ years of experience directly managing, mentoring, or leading technical pre-sales teams.
* **Comprehensive Core Networking:** Deep architectural understanding of traditional and modern WAN solutions, including global MPLS, Dedicated Internet Access (DIA), high-availability Broadband aggregation, and Software Defined Networking (SDN/SD-WAN).
* **Advanced Wireless & 5G:** Strong knowledge of cellular networks, LTE, Private 5G, and IoT ecosystems.
* **Voice/UC Expertise:** Strong understanding of overarching VoIP architectures, Session Border Controllers (SBCs), SIP trunking, and contact center modernization paths.
* **Cloud Computing Expertise:** Proven experience overseeing the design and integration of telecom solutions within public, private, or hybrid cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).

### **Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Proven ability to orchestrate complex technical workflows across a matrixed organization, driving executive alignment between sales, technical, and delivery teams.
* Ability to quickly learn, understand, and guide your team on emerging technologies and methodologies in the telecommunications and cloud space.
* Security, architecture, and industry certifications such as CCNP (Automation/Data Center/Wireless), ITIL Foundation, or equivalent.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

### **Where you’ll be working**

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

40

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
**BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT EXECUTIVE**

**ABOUT SHESHI**

Sheshi is a Financial Operating System - the governed infrastructure layer that converts raw financial data into results that organisations can completely trust. Governed, auditable, period-locked, and traceable to the source.

**Every organisation between seed stage and large enterprise has the same structural problem -financial data exists, but the process that converts it into trusted results is fragmented, manual, and dependent on individuals. Sheshi solves that problem with infrastructure-grade software built for the long term.**

We are headquartered in Bengaluru, India, building an enterprise-grade product for the global market.

As a Sales Executive, you own the full sales cycle for your accounts - from first outreach to signed deals across the segments and geographies. You will be coached and supported by the Sales Lead, and you will work with a strong sales stack that gives you the tools to prospect, engage, and close with intelligence and discipline.

**WHY SHESHI**

* **A product that solves a real problem.**
  Every organisation you prospect has this problem. The conversation starts from a place of genuine relevance.
* **Global scope.**
  You will work accounts across India and international markets from day one — building skills and relationships that most sales roles at this stage do not offer.
* **Full-cycle ownership.**
  You own your accounts end to end — no handoffs, no shared credit.
* **Strong coaching environment.**
  You will be developed by a Sales Lead who has carried significant numbers and closed complex deals personally.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Prospecting and Pipeline Building**

* Identify and target enterprise finance teams and funded startups across India and international markets through research, outreach, referrals, and signal-based prospecting.
* Build and maintain a healthy pipeline across all stages - volume and quality both matters.
* Use CRM, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, outreach tools, and signal data to prospect with intelligence and consistency.

**Discovery and Qualification**

* Run structured discovery conversations with CFOs, Finance Controllers, founders, and finance managers to understand their current workflows, pain points, and scale.
* Qualify accounts with rigour - the right fit at the right time, pursued with the right level of effort.

**Demo and Solution Presentation**

* Deliver product demonstrations tailored to the buyer's specific context - enterprise finance teams and startup founders have different priorities and different conversations.
* Connect Sheshi's capabilities directly to what the buyer is trying to solve or scale.

**Negotiation and Closure**

* Own the commercial conversation - pricing, terms, and objection handling through to a signed agreement.
* Manage enterprise deal complexity - multiple stakeholders, procurement processes, and longer timelines - with discipline and patience.
* Run startup deals with speed - founders move fast and expect the same in return.

**Relationship Management**

* Maintain relationships with prospects through the full sales cycle - enterprise buyers and startup founders both buy from people they trust.
* Keep CRM updated with accurate deal status, next steps, and communication history at all times.

**Digital and Tool-Led Outreach**

* Use the sales stack - CRM, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, outreach automation, and signal tools - as a core part of your daily workflow.
* Build and run outreach cadences that generate consistent pipeline across India and international markets.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

**Experience**

* 3–6 years in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology sales, with a full-cycle track record prospecting through closure.
* Experience selling to finance decision-makers - CFOs, Finance Controllers, or founders managing their financial function.
* Demonstrable history of meeting or exceeding sales targets consistently.
* Some exposure to international sales or cross-border accounts is a plus.
* Experience selling financial software, ERP, accounting tools, or enterprise governance products.
* Familiarity with how enterprise finance teams operate - close cycles, reporting, consolidation, audit.
* Exposure to the startup ecosystem - understanding how funded companies think about financial governance and investor reporting.
* International sales experience or comfort working across time zones and cultures

**Sales Capabilities**

* Comfortable owning the full sales cycle independently across different deal sizes and complexities.
* Strong discovery skills - you ask the right questions and listen before you pitch.
* Confident, credible demo presenter - you adapt the conversation to the buyer, not the other way around.
* Disciplined CRM user - your pipeline is always current, accurate, and actionable.
* Proficient with modern sales tools - LinkedIn Sales Navigator, outreach automation, and signal-based prospecting.

**Character and Approach**

* High persistence without being pushy - you follow up with professionalism and intent.
* Honest pipeline management - you call deals accurately, not optimistically.
* Comfortable selling to senior finance professionals and founders - the conversation requires credibility and preparation.
* You take ownership of your number - if it is not coming in, you know why and you have a plan.

title: Strategic Enterprise Account Executive - India
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
  
  
****About The Role****
As a Strategic Account Executive for India, you’ll be one of the foundational members of SpaceXAI’s enterprise sales team in the region. You’ll help large engineering organizations discover, adopt, and expand their use of Cursor, owning strategic accounts across APJ and working directly with engineering leaders, CTOs, developer platform teams, and procurement stakeholders.
  
  
This is a rare opportunity to bring a product engineers already love into some of India's most sophisticated technology, financial services, enterprise, and digital-native organizations and to help shape how software gets built in the AI era.
  
  
****What You’ll Do****

* Own a named book of strategic enterprise accounts across India, driving new logo acquisition and expansion revenue
* Run a disciplined, full-cycle sales process from prospecting and discovery through evaluation, negotiation, and close
* Build and execute account strategies that connect Cursor’s capabilities to the technical and business priorities of engineering leaders, CTOs, and developer platform teams
* Create pipeline through outbound prospecting, executive mapping, inbound follow-up, partner referrals, and your own network
* Partner closely with Sales Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to deliver high-quality evaluations and ensure customers realize value quickly
* Navigate complex enterprise buying processes, including security reviews, legal negotiations, procurement, and multi-stakeholder approval cycles
* Serve as the voice of India's enterprise customers internally, sharing market feedback and deal learnings with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and GTM leadership
* Help establish SpaceXAI’s enterprise presence in India by building repeatable motions, local market insights, and early customer references
* Consistently meet and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets

**You may be a fit if**

* You have 5+ years of enterprise B2B sales experience, ideally selling developer tools, infrastructure, cloud, security, AI, or other technical SaaS products to engineering-led organizations
* You have experience selling into strategic or large enterprise accounts in India
* You’re comfortable navigating complex buying committees across engineering, IT, security, legal, procurement, finance, and executive stakeholders

* You care deeply about AI and believe transforming how software is written is one of the most important problems to work on right now

title: Physiotherapist (Sales)
description:
We're #Hiring a Physiotherapy Sales Consultant

### About Us

At J.C. Fitkneesguy Pvt. Ltd., we specialize in helping individuals overcome chronic knee conditions such as osteoarthritis, ligament injuries, and post-surgical rehabilitation challenges, including ACL and meniscus surgeries.

Our team of experienced sports physiotherapists and strength and conditioning coaches provides personalized online knee rehabilitation programs designed to help clients reduce pain, restore mobility, improve strength, and regain confidence in their daily lives.

We are looking for a motivated and results-driven \*\*Sales Consultant\*\* who can understand clients' concerns, communicate effectively, and successfully sell our online knee rehabilitation programs.

### About the Role

As a Physiotherapy Sales Consultant, you will be responsible for interacting with prospective clients seeking solutions for knee pain, sports injuries, and rehabilitation needs.

You will conduct one-on-one sales consultations over Google Meet, understand clients' concerns, explain our knee rehabilitation programs, handle objections, and convert qualified prospects into paying clients.

The role requires strong communication, consultative selling, consistent follow-ups, objection handling, and sales closing skills.

### Key Responsibilities

- Conduct one-on-one sales consultations with prospective clients through Google Meet.

- Understand clients' knee-related concerns, rehabilitation goals, and expectations.

- Present and sell our personalized online knee rehabilitation programs.

- Clearly explain program benefits, structure, and pricing to prospective clients.

- Confidently handle objections related to pricing, trust, program effectiveness, and commitment.

- Convert qualified leads into paying clients through effective sales techniques.

- Be persistent and consistent with follow-ups, ensuring interested prospects are regularly contacted and no potential sales opportunities are missed.

- Follow up with prospects who have not made an immediate purchasing decision and work towards successfully closing them.

- Maintain accurate lead records, sales data, and follow-up details using Google Sheets.

- Manage consultation schedules, appointments, and follow-ups using Google Calendar.

- Learn and adapt to new CRM tools, sales systems, and internal processes.

- Coordinate with the rehabilitation and operations teams to ensure smooth client onboarding.

- Consistently work towards individual and team sales targets.

### Requirements & Skills

\*\*1. Strong Communication Skills\*\*

- Excellent verbal communication skills in \*\*English and Hindi\*\* are mandatory.

- Ability to communicate confidently, professionally, and empathetically with prospective clients.

- Strong active listening skills to understand client concerns and requirements.

\*\*2. Sales & Objection Handling\*\*

- Strong negotiation, persuasion, and objection-handling skills.

- Ability to manage challenging conversations and address client doubts effectively.

- Confidence in closing sales without being overly aggressive or pushy.

- Persistence in following up with leads, including those who are hesitant, undecided, or require multiple conversations before making a decision.

- Strong ability to build trust, maintain client relationships, and convert follow-ups into successful sales.

- A result-oriented mindset with a strong focus on achieving sales targets.

\*\*3. Technical & Organizational Skills\*\*

- Good working knowledge of \*\*Google Sheets and Google Calendar\*\*.

- Ability to maintain organized lead records, track follow-ups, and manage appointments.

- Comfortable using Google Meet and other digital communication platforms.

- Willingness to quickly learn and adapt to new software, CRM platforms, and company systems.

\*\*4. Professional Qualities\*\*

- Strong work ethic, discipline, accountability, and professionalism.

- Self-motivated, persistent, target-oriented, and committed to achieving results.

- Willingness to learn, accept feedback, and continuously improve.

- Strong team collaboration and time-management skills.

- Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

\*\*5. Industry Knowledge (Preferred)\*\*

- Basic understanding of physiotherapy, musculoskeletal conditions, sports injuries, or knee rehabilitation is an added advantage.

- Interest in fitness, rehabilitation, and helping individuals improve their quality of life.

- Candidates with experience in physiotherapy and rehabilitation

\*\*Note:\*\* Prior sales experience is an advantage but not mandatory. Candidates with excellent communication skills, a willingness to learn, and strong sales potential are encouraged to apply.

### Compensation & Benefits

- \*\*Fixed Salary:\*\* ₹20,000 per month.

- \*\*Sales Commission:\*\* 10% on every successful sale.

- \*\*Uncapped Incentives:\*\* No upper limit on commission earnings.

- \*\*Lead Support:\*\* Access to inbound inquiries and outbound leads.

- \*\*Remote Opportunity:\*\* Work from home.

- \*\*Career Growth:\*\* Opportunities for professional development in sales, client consultation, and team leadership.

- \*\*Training & Support:\*\* Opportunity to learn about knee rehabilitation programs, consultative selling, and objection-handling techniques.

### Who Should Apply?

We welcome applications from:

- Physiotherapists / S&C Coaches/ Rehab Specialists interested in Sales.

- Sports science, exercise science professionals.

- Motivated individuals who are comfortable with sales targets, persistent follow-ups, and client interactions.

### How to Apply

If you enjoy interacting with people, have strong sales and communication skills, and are confident in converting prospects into clients, we would love to hear from you.

**VRLA | Li-Ion | Ni-Cd**

Thane, India / Regional Scope

8-12 years

Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering

**FUNCTION**

Strategic Sourcing / Commodity Management

Position Summary

The Regional Commodity Manager for Packaging, Consumables is responsible for developing and executing regional sourcing strategies for Packaging, Consumables. The role will strengthen supplier competitiveness, optimize total cost, protect continuity of supply and support business growth across project-based and operational requirements.

The position serves as the primary commercial interface between suppliers and internal stakeholders, including Engineering, Quality, Operations, Logistics, Sales, Product Management and Global Procurement. The successful candidate will combine Mechanical product knowledge with strong strategic sourcing, negotiation and supplier-management capabilities.

Key Responsibilities 1. Commodity Strategy and Strategic Sourcing

* Develop and execute regional commodity strategies for Packaging, Consumables, etc.
* Align regional plans with global commodity direction, business objectives, technology roadmaps and customer requirements.
* RM supplier market scans, RFIs, RFQs, e-sourcing events, bid evaluations, negotiations and sourcing recommendations.
* Identify, qualify and onboard competitive suppliers, including localization and alternate-source opportunities.
* Build should-cost, total-cost-of-ownership and price-benchmarking models to support sourcing decisions.

2. Supplier Relationship and Performance Management

* Establish strategic relationships with manufacturers, system integrators and key sub-tier suppliers.
* Conduct regular supplier business reviews covering quality, cost, delivery, capacity, technology, service and sustainability.
* Develop corrective and improvement plans for underperforming suppliers and track actions to closure.
* Coordinate supplier development with Quality and Engineering to improve process capability, reliability and responsiveness.

3. Cost, Productivity and Commercial Management

* Deliver annual productivity and cost-reduction programs through negotiation, value engineering, localization, resourcing, specification optimization and supplier consolidation.
* Monitor key cost drivers.
* Negotiate commercial agreements, pricing mechanisms, warranties, payment terms, lead times, logistics models and service obligations.
* Maintain contract coverage and ensure sourcing decisions comply with delegated authority and procurement governance.

4. Supply Continuity and Risk Management

* Assess supplier capacity, financial health, geographic concentration, logistics exposure, sub-tier dependency and raw-material risks.
* Create and maintain mitigation plans, including dual sourcing, safety-stock arrangements, local warehousing, capacity reservation and business-continuity actions.
* Partner with planning, operations and suppliers to resolve shortages, expedite critical requirements and protect customer commitments.
* Monitor market developments and provide timely risk and opportunity updates to leadership.

5. Cross-Functional and Technical Collaboration

* Engage early in new product introduction, customer proposals and engineering change activities to ensure competitive and supply-ready solutions.
* Work with Engineering and Quality on specifications, supplier qualification, testing, approvals, reliability, warranty and failure-resolution activities.
* Support standardization and rationalization of makes, models and configurations across business units and sites.
* Coordinate with Sales and Product Management to understand pipeline, project timing, technology needs and regional customer expectations.

6. Sustainability, Compliance and Governance

* Ensure suppliers comply with applicable environmental, health and safety, trade, ethical sourcing and regulatory requirements.
* Promote responsible sourcing, recycling, end-of-life management, safe transportation and reduced environmental impact.
* Maintain accurate sourcing records, approvals, contracts, supplier data and audit documentation.

7. Analytics and Reporting

* Maintain commodity dashboards covering spend, savings, quality, delivery, lead time, inventory, contract coverage and supplier risk.
* Prepare periodic commodity reviews, executive updates and sourcing pipeline reports.
* Use data to identify supply-base, working-capital, cost and service improvement opportunities.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering.
* 8-12 years of experience in strategic sourcing, commodity management, procurement, supplier development or supply chain roles.
* Demonstrated experience sourcing Mechanical products.
* Experience working in a project-based, engineered-to-order or high-mix, low-volume business environment is preferred.
* Strong commercial negotiation, contract management, analytical and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to read and interpret drawings specifications, drawings, data sheets, test requirements and supplier technical proposals.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ERP/procurement systems; experience with Power BI or similar analytics tools is preferred.
* Fluent business English and willingness to travel regionally as required.

Key Performance Indicators

* Cost savings and productivity delivery
* Supplier on-time delivery and lead-time improvement
* Supplier quality and corrective-action closure
* Localization and alternate-source implementation
* Contract coverage and sourcing compliance
* Inventory and working-capital improvement
* Supplier risk reduction and continuity readiness
* Project sourcing milestones and stakeholder satisfaction
* ESG and supplier-compliance performance

Preferred Industry Exposure

Candidates with sourcing or engineering exposure in the following sectors will be preferred:

* UPS/ DC and critical power systems
* Data centers and telecom power
* Industrial energy storage
* Power generation and utilities

Role Success Profile

The ideal candidate is a technically credible and commercially strong sourcing professional who can translate business demand into a clear commodity strategy, create competitive supplier options and deliver measurable improvements in cost, quality, delivery and supply resilience. The person should be comfortable operating across regional and global teams, managing ambiguity and influencing decisions without direct authority.

description:
**Please do not apply if you are:**

**1. Out of Mumbai**

**2. Currently pursuing education**

**3. If you are currently freelancing**

**4. If you do not have experience in producing content**

**5. If currently not working**

**About Hurun**  
Hurun is a UK based leading research and rankings organisation focused on wealth, entrepreneurship, business, philanthropy, and high-growth companies in India.  
Hurun India is best known for its data-driven rankings and reports that track India’s wealthiest individuals, entrepreneurs, companies, emerging leaders, and high-value businesses.

**JOB ROLE - Delegate Acquisition**

Hurun India hosts some of the most considered gatherings in the country. List launches, forums, and closed-door conversations that bring together founders, investors, and industry leaders. Getting the right people into the room is what makes those rooms worth being in. This role does exactly that. You will be on the phone, on email, and in conversation

with senior business leaders every day, inviting them to participate, profiling their companies before outreach, and following through until they walk in.

What you will do:

→Identify entrepreneurs and industry leaders aligned with each event

→Profile companies carefully before reaching out

→Make outbound calls, send formal invitations, and follow up

→Liaise with delegates from first contact to attendance

→Build and maintain a clean database of industry contacts

→Coordinate with internal teams so delegate lists match event goals

→Keep accurate records of every outreach and confirmation

What we are looking for:

Someone who speaks well. Not in the practiced, scripted way. In the real way. Clear English, a steady voice, a tone that puts the person on the other end of the line at ease within the first few seconds. The kind of person you want to keep talking to. Someone who is unafraid of the phone. This role lives on outbound calls. You will dial people who have never heard of you, introduce yourself with confidence, and hold their attention long enough to make a clean, respectful invitation. You will hear no, often, and stay just as warm on the next call.

Someone who follows through. The difference between a good delegate acquisition executive and a great one is not the first call. It is the second, the third, the polite reminder a week later, the calendar invite that goes out at exactly the right time. The person we are looking for treats follow-up as the actual job, not an afterthought. Someone who is naturally hospitable. The best people in this role are former hotel front-desk staff, former cabin crew, former customer-experience leads, former call-centre executives. People who know what it feels like to receive a stranger and make them feel looked after. That instinct cannot be trained. We are looking for people who already have it. Someone who is organised. * Global mindset and cultural awareness, with the ability to work effectively across geographies, cultures and diverse teams in a fast-paced, highly matrixed environment.

title: Sr. Executive Accounts & Finance
description:
**Sr. Executive – Accounts (EDPMS and IDPMS)**

**Department:** Accounts & Finance

**Designation:** Senior Executive – Accounts

**Experience:** 4–6 Years (preferably)

**Qualification:** B.Com / M.Com / MBA in Finance

**Reporting To:** Accounts Manager / Finance Manager

**Location:** Mumbai

**1. Job Purpose / Description**

The Sr. Executive – Accounts will be responsible for managing day-to-day accounting activities, banking transactions, import and export documentation, reconciliations, statutory compliance support, and financial reporting. The role requires hands-on experience in EDPMS (Export Data Processing and Monitoring System) and IDPMS (Import Data Processing and Monitoring System), including coordination with banks and internal departments to ensure timely submission of documents and closure of outstanding export and import transactions in accordance with applicable RBI and FEMA requirements.

**2. Key Accountabilities**

**A. EDPMS – Export Documentation and Compliance**

* Prepare and submit export-related documents to banks for EDPMS processing.

* Track export invoices, shipping bills, e-BRC/realisation status, and outstanding export payments.

* Coordinate with banks for the closure of export transactions in EDPMS.

* Monitor export proceeds realisation within the applicable timelines.

* Follow up with banks and internal departments to resolve pending EDPMS entries and documentation discrepancies.

* Maintain export documentation, realisation records, and transaction-wise tracking reports.

**B. IDPMS – Import Documentation and Compliance**

* Handle import-related documentation and IDPMS transactions.

* Coordinate with banks for submission and verification of import documents, including Bills of Entry.

* Track import payments, advance remittances, and outstanding import transactions.

* Follow up with banks for matching Bills of Entry against remittances and closure of IDPMS entries.

* Maintain import transaction records and resolve discrepancies with banks, suppliers, and internal departments.

* Ensure timely follow-up on pending import documentation and applicable compliance requirements.

**C. Banking and Foreign Remittances**

* Coordinate with banks for inward and outward remittances, as applicable.

* Prepare and maintain documentation for foreign currency transactions and remittances.

* Assist with preparation and submission of Form 15CA/15CB documentation in coordination with the tax consultant, wherever applicable.

* Maintain records of foreign currency transactions, bank charges, and remittance advice.

* Coordinate with banks for transaction confirmations, supporting documents, and queries.

**D. Accounting and Financial Transactions**

* Record purchase, sales, expense, bank, receipt, and payment entries in Tally or other accounting software.

* Maintain accurate accounting records and supporting documentation.

* Prepare and verify payment entries, bank vouchers, and other accounting vouchers.

* Perform bank reconciliations and investigate outstanding or unreconciled items.

* Maintain records of advances, creditors, and other relevant ledger balances.

**E. Reconciliation and Reporting**

* Reconcile export and import transaction records with bank statements and accounting ledgers.

* Prepare monthly reports on outstanding export proceeds, pending Bills of Entry, and open EDPMS/IDPMS transactions.

* Maintain transaction-wise tracking sheets for inward and outward remittances.

* Prepare reports on pending documentation and follow up for timely resolution.

* Support management with periodic financial and banking reports.

**F. Audit and Compliance Support**

* Maintain organised records of export, import, banking, and accounting documents.

* Provide supporting documents for internal, statutory, and tax audits.

* Coordinate with auditors, consultants, banks, and internal departments to resolve queries.

* Ensure compliance with applicable company procedures and relevant regulatory requirements.

**3. Skills Required**

* Strong working knowledge of EDPMS and IDPMS documentation and processes.

* Practical experience in coordinating with banks for export and import transaction closure.

* Proficiency in Tally and MS Excel.

* Strong reconciliation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

* Good documentation, record-keeping, and follow-up skills.

* Effective written and verbal communication.

* Ability to manage multiple transactions and meet deadlines.

**4. Experience Required**

* 4–6 years of relevant experience in Accounts, Finance, Banking Operations, or Export-Import Documentation.

* Hands-on experience in EDPMS and IDPMS is mandatory.

* Experience in bank reconciliation, foreign remittances, and export-import documentation.

* Experience in Tally and financial reporting.

* Experience coordinating with authorised dealer banks for documentation and transaction closure.

**5. Knowledge Required**

* EDPMS and IDPMS procedures and documentation requirements.

* Basic understanding of FEMA and applicable RBI guidelines relating to export and import transactions.

* Export and import documentation, including shipping bills, Bills of Entry, and remittance records.

* Foreign exchange transactions and inward/outward remittance processes.

* Accounting principles, bank reconciliation, and ledger scrutiny.

* Basic knowledge of GST, TDS, and statutory audit requirements.

* Knowledge of e-BRC and export proceeds realisation tracking.

**6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely submission of EDPMS/IDPMS documents to banks.

* Timely follow-up and closure of outstanding export and import transactions.

* Accuracy of bank and ledger reconciliations.

* Timely resolution of bank queries and documentation discrepancies.

* Accuracy and completeness of accounting records.

* Timely submission of management reports and audit documents.

title: Manager - Finance
description:
### **We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Finance Manager professional to join our team. The role involves managing month-end closing, audits, taxation, and comprehensive accounting operations while ensuring accurate reporting and timely compliance. You will also collaborate closely with internal teams to drive financial discipline, oversee reconciliations, and support critical business reporting. If you excel in a dynamic environment and are committed to maintaining high standards of financial integrity, we'd love to connect.** **What You'll Do:**

#### **1. Financial Accounting & Period-End Closure:**

* **Month-End & Year-End Close:** Lead and streamline the monthly and annual book-close processes for the multiple business line in accordance with established timelines.
* **D2C & E-Commerce Accounting:** Spearheaded end-to-end accounting for the goods business vertical, including inventory valuation, revenue and procurement recognition, and SKU-level gross margin analysis across multiple e-commerce platforms.
* **P&L & Balance Sheet Review:** Conduct thorough P&L reviews and quarterly Balance Sheet reconciliations, providing clear variance analysis and business justifications for cost fluctuations.
* **Provisions & Accruals:** Track, record, and periodically review provisions, unbilled revenues, and accrual aging schedules for timely adjustments or releases.

#### **2. Audits, Governance & Statutory Compliance:**

* **Statutory & Entity Audits:** Spearhead internal and external audits for legal entities (UAE, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia), ensuring timely resolution of audit queries and sign-off well within management deadlines.
* **Direct Tax Audits & Assessments:** Coordinate and close Tax Audits, Transfer Pricing audits, and regulatory filings (including COI/statutory disclosures).
* **Tax Assessment Support:** Facilitate Income Tax and Transfer Pricing assessments by preparing schedules, documentation, and liaison with external tax consultants.

#### **3. Taxation (Direct & Indirect):**

* **TDS Compliance:** Ensure accurate deduction and accounting of Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) based on the applicable sections and nature of vendor contracts.
* **GST & ITC Reconciliation:** Manage GST compliance, maximise Input Tax Credit (ITC) utilisation strictly adhering to statutory rules, and maintain monthly GSTR-2B/3B reconciliations.

#### **4. Working Capital & Operational Finance:**

* **Accounts Payable (AP):** Oversee invoice verification, coding, and accurate, timely disbursement processing.
* **Accounts Receivable (AR) & Credit Control:** Monitor customer aging reports, ensure proactive follow-up for collections, and maintain strict adherence to agreed credit periods.
* **Reconciliations:** Perform regular vendor, client, and inter-company ledger reconciliations to minimise unadjusted balances.

#### **5. Management Reporting & Strategic Projects:**

* **MIS & Management Reporting:** Prepare and present routine management packs, including Sales & Cost analysis, AP/AR ageing summaries, and working capital overviews.
* **Cross-Functional Projects:** Partner with cross-functional teams on process improvement, ERP enhancements, and ad-hoc accounting projects.

**6. Executive Support:** Support the Head of Department (HOD) and senior leadership with ad-hoc analytical assignments and special initiatives.

  

### **Who You Are:**

  

**1.** **Education:** MBA , Semi-qualified CA or ACCA preferred.

**2. Experience:** Min 7 to 12 years of hands-on experience in financial reporting, corporate taxation (TDS/GST), and audit management.

**3. Technical Skills:** Strong proficiency in ERP platforms (SAP / Oracle / NetSuite / Tally) and advanced Microsoft Excel (financial modelling, pivot tables, lookup formulas).

**4. Core Competencies:** High attention to detail, strong analytical capability, proactive stakeholder communication, and strict adherence to statutory deadlines.

title: HR Executive
description:
1. Attendance & Timekeeping

* Maintain daily attendance records for all employees through the biometric/HRMS system and manual registers where required.
* Track late arrivals, early exits, absenteeism and unauthorised leave; follow up with employees and reporting managers.
* Close attendance by a fixed date each month and share verified inputs with accounts for payroll.
* Publish a monthly attendance and absenteeism report to management.

2. Leave & Holiday Management

* Publish the annual holiday calendar before the start of each year, covering national holidays (Republic Day, Independence Day, Gandhi Jayanti), Maharashtra Day and declared festival holidays.
* Approve and record leave applications, maintain leave balances, and collect medical certificates for extended sick leave as per policy.
* Plan leave cover with department heads so production, dispatch and service are not disrupted.

3. Employee Issues & Grievance Resolution

* Act as the first point of contact for employee concerns: workload, interpersonal conflicts, pay or leave queries, and working conditions.
* Run a documented grievance process with defined timelines for acknowledgement, investigation and closure.
* Mediate between employees and managers, and escalate to management where needed.
* Keep confidential, dated records of every issue raised and how it was resolved.

4. Workplace Ethics, Discipline & Rules

* Draft, communicate and enforce the Code of Conduct, HR policies and employee handbook (attendance, leave, dress code, confidentiality, use of company assets, conflict of interest).
* Ensure every employee acknowledges policies in writing at joining and on each revision.
* Handle disciplinary matters fairly: warnings, show-cause notices, inquiries and documentation as per the standing orders/disciplinary procedure.
* Constitute and run the Internal Committee under the POSH Act, 2013, conduct annual awareness sessions and file the annual report.
* Ensure compliance with labour laws, including the four Labour Codes and Maharashtra state rules as they are notified.

5. Internal Compliance & Deadlines

* Monitor that employees submit expense claims, travel reimbursements and supporting bills within the timelines set by company policy.
* Send reminders, escalate repeated delays to reporting managers, and coordinate with accounts so claims are settled on schedule.
* Track other internal submissions on time: timesheets, field visit reports, joining/exit documents, appraisal forms and training sign-offs.
* Maintain a simple tracker of pending submissions and report defaulters to management monthly.

6. Talent Acquisition

* Own end-to-end hiring for technical (production, QA/RA, service engineering), sales and support roles: requirement gathering, job descriptions, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offers and joining.
* Use job portals, LinkedIn, referrals and medical-device industry networks to build a pipeline for critical roles.
* Run onboarding and induction, including policy briefing, QMS awareness and role-specific SOP training coordinated with QA.
* Track time-to-hire and offer-acceptance rate.

7. Supporting Duties

* Maintain employee files, job descriptions and training records in audit-ready condition for ISO 13485 (clause 6.2) audits and CDSCO/notified-body inspections.
* Support EPF, ESIC and Professional Tax compliance and full-and-final settlements with accounts.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
**Business Development Executive**

**Coliving | Zolo**

**Own the cluster. Drive occupancy. Run the properties. Deliver the numbers.**

**Compensation:**
₹6.65 LPA (₹3.65 LPA Fixed + ₹3 LPA Performance-Linked Variable)

**Why this role exists**

Zolo's Coliving business operates through properties that need to perform every single day — commercially and operationally.

A property can be clean and well managed, but if beds remain vacant, the business does not perform.

It can achieve strong occupancy, but if resident experience and operations break down, customers leave.

As we scale, we need strong on-ground business owners who can bring
**Sales and Operations together**
and take responsibility for the complete performance of a cluster.

Each Cluster Business Manager will typically own
**approximately three Zolo properties**
.

This role exists to ensure that every property in the cluster:

* Maintains strong occupancy
* Converts available demand into bookings
* Creates local sales opportunities
* Delivers a strong resident experience
* Operates with discipline every day
* Resolves customer and operational issues quickly
* Has an accountable and high-performing property team

If the Cluster Business Manager is strong,
**beds get filled, residents stay, teams perform, and properties run well.**

If the Cluster Business Manager is weak,
**vacancies increase, sales opportunities get missed, complaints rise, and execution starts slipping.**

**Your mandate is clear**

* Own business performance across approximately 3 properties
* Drive Sales, bookings, and occupancy
* Convert walk-ins, leads, referrals, and local opportunities
* Identify and create new demand around your properties
* Own day-to-day property Operations
* Deliver strong resident experience and retention
* Lead and manage property-level teams
* Resolve customer and operational escalations
* Track performance numbers and take action when the cluster is behind target

This is not a property coordination role.

**You are the business owner for your cluster — responsible for both filling the properties and running them well.**

**About Zolo and Coliving**

Finding dependable accommodation has historically been fragmented and inconsistent.

People settled for compromises because the system offered few trustworthy options.

Zolo reimagined living and hospitality as a connected journey.

Zolo Coliving simplifies urban living by bringing together professionally managed homes, essential services, technology, and community into one seamless experience.

Z Hotels serves the modern traveller with consistency, warmth, and operational discipline.

Today, over 100,000 people trust Zolo across different phases of life.

Our ambition is to build the most trusted living and hospitality ecosystem for the new generation — delivering experiences customers can rely on while building properties that perform sustainably.

**What you will be responsible for**

**1. Own Cluster Business Performance**

* Take ownership of business performance across approximately 3 assigned properties
* Track occupancy, bookings, vacancies, move-ins, move-outs, and other key property metrics
* Understand which properties are performing and where intervention is required
* Build clear action plans for properties falling behind target
* Balance Sales performance with strong property Operations and resident experience
* Review numbers regularly and act quickly when performance moves off track

**2. Drive Sales, Conversion & Occupancy**

* Take direct ownership of occupancy across assigned properties
* Handle property walk-ins and convert prospects into bookings
* Follow up actively with interested prospects until closure
* Coordinate closely with Inside Sales teams on leads and conversions
* Understand customer requirements and recommend the right property / offering
* Track available inventory and actively work towards filling vacant beds
* Ensure leads do not get lost because of poor follow-up or property-level execution

**3. Build Local Demand**

* Understand the micro-market around each assigned property
* Identify colleges, offices, institutions, brokers, local businesses, and other potential demand sources
* Build relationships that can generate enquiries and referrals
* Drive resident referrals and other local lead-generation initiatives
* Identify opportunities to improve property visibility in the local market
* Continuously look for new ways to generate demand rather than depending only on centrally generated leads

**4. Own Property Operations**

* Ensure smooth day-to-day Operations across assigned properties
* Maintain property readiness, cleanliness, safety, and service standards
* Ensure rooms and beds are ready for prospective and incoming residents
* Identify operational gaps and drive quick resolution
* Coordinate Housekeeping, Maintenance, Security, and other property services
* Ensure operating issues do not negatively affect Sales, occupancy, or resident experience

**5. Own Resident Experience & Retention**

* Build strong relationships with residents across the cluster
* Handle complaints and escalations with ownership and urgency
* Ensure issues are resolved completely rather than simply forwarded to another team
* Identify recurring complaints and work towards permanent solutions
* Understand reasons for dissatisfaction and potential churn
* Build resident trust through visibility, responsiveness, and consistent follow-through

title: Business Development Manager, India
description:
Business Development Manager, India

Location: Pune, India, office-based

Team: Working alongside the DIPAX team in our Pune office

Employment: Full time

Pay: Competitive salary plus performance-related commission

This role is based in our Pune office, so you must live in or near Pune. You will be employed through our partner entity in India.

The opportunity

RoboShadow is a UK cybersecurity company with a simple mission: demystify cybersecurity by removing its cost and complexity. We help SMBs, MSPs and enterprise teams find security problems, fix them and prove they are protected.

We are now looking for someone to build RoboShadow's commercial presence in India. This is a hands-on business development role, and it could develop into our Head of Growth, India role.

You will speak with business owners, technology leaders, MSPs and security teams, learn how they manage cybersecurity today, find the gaps and help them build a sensible business case for improving it. You must enjoy picking up the phone, and you must be curious enough about technology to use RoboShadow, understand how it works and demonstrate it confidently.

What you will own

• Build your own pipeline through calls, email, LinkedIn, events, partnerships and referrals.

• Speak with SMBs, mid-market businesses, enterprise organisations, MSPs and MSSPs.

• Help customers understand their cybersecurity risks without fear or unnecessary jargon.

• Build clear business cases around reducing risk, automating work, consolidating tools and lowering security costs.

• Demonstrate the RoboShadow platform and explain its commercial value.

• Use company-provided AI tools to research markets, personalise outreach, produce campaigns and test new sales ideas.

• Run focused go-to-market experiments by industry, city, security problem or customer type.

• Manage opportunities properly in HubSpot and keep an honest, measurable pipeline.

• Develop relationships with Indian technology partners, MSPs and larger organisations.

• Help shape our pricing, positioning and growth plan for India.

How we will measure success

We will look at:

• The pipeline you build yourself, without relying on supplied leads.

• Customers won in India.

• The go-to-market experiments you run and what you learn from them.

• The accuracy and honesty of your pipeline in HubSpot.

• The partner and MSP relationships you develop.

Who we are looking for

We care more about ability, energy and judgement than job titles. Ideally, you will have:

• Experience selling technology, SaaS or cybersecurity products.

• Experience with mid-market or enterprise customers.

• Confidence making outbound calls and starting conversations.

• The ability to find and create opportunities without relying on supplied leads.

• Enough technical curiosity to learn the product properly.

• Strong written and spoken English.

• The ability to explain complicated cybersecurity problems in plain language.

• Experience using a CRM such as HubSpot.

• An interest in AI, automation and modern sales technology.

• The ambition to build a market, then lead the team that grows around it.

You are commercially sharp, but you do not use pressure or fear to sell. You listen, ask useful questions and help the customer reach a sensible decision. If an experiment fails, you learn from it and try the next one.

This role will not suit someone who only wants to manage existing accounts, avoids outbound calling, needs every lead supplied to them, or treats AI as a buzzword rather than a working tool.

Why join RoboShadow?

• Build a new market with support from an established international team.

• Work closely with the people who build the technology you are selling.

• Use AI and automation as part of your everyday job.

• Learn cybersecurity by working directly with the product and customers.

• Earn the chance to lead RoboShadow's growth in India.

• Help businesses protect themselves without making cybersecurity expensive, frightening or complicated.

Experience

Cybersecurity sales experience would be particularly valuable. We would also consider an exceptional technology salesperson who can prove they learn quickly and know how to sell business outcomes.

If you prove you can build a pipeline, win customers and understand the Indian market, we want you to grow into Head of Growth, India: owning the growth plan, recruiting a local team and developing partnerships. The opportunity is real, but the title will be earned through results.

How to apply

Please apply by email to liz@roboshadow.com, not through LinkedIn. Send us:

• Your CV.

• A link to a short Loom video (around 1 to 3 minutes) telling us why you would be a great fit for this role.

The Loom video is your first stage interview, so applications without one will not be considered. It does not need to be formal.

title: Institutional Sales Manager
description:
**Hiring: Institutional Sales Manager – Government Sales**

Industry: Paper, Paper Products, Notebooks & Stationery

Experience: 8–10 Years

Location: Pune | Travel: Extensive travel across India

About the Role

We are looking for a highly driven and result-oriented Business Development Manager to expand our Government Sales business.

We manufacture notebooks and supply paper, paper products and stationery to various Central and State Government departments and institutions. The role involves identifying new business opportunities, tracking government tenders across India, developing relationships with relevant stakeholders and, most importantly, converting opportunities into business.

Key Responsibilities

* Continuously identify and track relevant tenders across Central/State Government e-procurement portals, GeM and other procurement platforms.
* Explore new markets, government departments and institutions to develop additional business opportunities.
* Evaluate tenders, assess eligibility, competition and commercial viability, and drive the bidding process in coordination with internal teams.
* Develop and maintain strong professional relationships with government departments, procurement authorities and other relevant stakeholders.
* Take ownership of opportunities from identification and follow-ups through to order conversion and execution.
* Maintain a systematic database of tenders, market intelligence, competitor pricing, business pipeline and order status.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely and effective execution of secured orders.

The Person We Are Looking For

More than anything, we are looking for the right attitude and mindset. The ideal candidate should be someone who:

* Takes complete ownership of responsibilities and approaches work with dedication and accountability.
* Has a positive, solution-oriented and never-say-die attitude, particularly when faced with challenges.
* Is ambitious, target-driven and constantly strives to achieve more rather than settling for whatever has been achieved.
* Is proactive and resourceful, with the initiative to identify opportunities rather than waiting for instructions.
* Is well-spoken, confident and capable of building and nurturing strong professional relationships.
* Is organised and disciplined in maintaining information, tracking opportunities and following up on commitments.
* Has good analytical and commercial understanding, with the ability to assess opportunities, competition and pricing.
* Is persistent and focused on converting identified opportunities into actual business, not merely generating leads or tracking tenders.
* Is comfortable with frequent travel across India.

Experience & Qualifications

* Graduate in any discipline; MBA in Marketing/Sales will be an advantage.
* 8-10 years of experience in Government Sales, Institutional Sales, Business Development or Tender Management.
* Prior experience with GeM, Central/State Government tenders and e-procurement portals is preferred.
* Experience in paper, notebooks, stationery, printing or allied industries will be an added advantage.
* Good command over MS Excel, documentation and MIS reporting.

What Matters Most: We are looking for someone who has the hunger to grow, the initiative to create opportunities, the persistence to pursue them and, above all, the ability to convert those opportunities into measurable business results. We value ownership, commitment and achievement orientation as much as experience.

description:
.
**Outreach and Sales Intern**
**Role Overview**
Verispace is building the trust infrastructure for rentals in India. Rental companies lose money to fraud, defaults, and damages because there is no reliable way to verify the person taking their product. Verispace gives them that verification layer through one platform: KYC checks, face match and liveliness verification, incident tracking, and a shared scammer registry. It is built by the team behind The Rental Community, a network of 200+ rental companies across India.
  
  
**About the Founders**
Om Shah (Co-founder): Building in the rental sector since college and runs The Rental Community, India's network of 200+ rental company founders, including the co-founders of Cashify, Rentkar, and SharePal.
  
Bob Baga (Co-founder): Owns one of the largest camera rental companies in Pune with 30+ years in the industry.
  
Why Work With Us?
  
The rental industry in India runs on trust, but there is no infrastructure for it. Verispace is building that infrastructure. Every sale you close makes a real rental business safer and directly grows the company. You will learn cold outreach, discovery, and closing by doing it daily with live targets, not shadowing someone else. You work directly with the founders, and strong performers earn higher incentive slabs and a possible extension or full-time role.
  
  
**Role Summary**
You will own the top of the Verispace sales funnel. Follow the sales SOP: find rental businesses, do cold outreach and cold calls, present Verispace to decision-makers, and convert interested clients into paying customers. You work with the founders and the sales process they have built. Your results decide your incentives each month.
  
  
  
**Key Duties and Responsibilities**
Cold Outreach & Calling: Identify rental businesses and execute daily cold calls and outbound outreach without hesitation.
  
Product Presentation: Present Verispace clearly and persuasively to business owners and decision-makers, explaining product features and answering queries on the spot.
  
Process & SOP Adherence: Follow daily sales SOPs and maintain disciplined tracking of outreach numbers and follow-ups.
  
Pipeline Conversion: Move leads through the pipeline and convert interested rental businesses into paying customers to achieve monthly sales targets.
  
  
  
**Performance Objectives**
Execute Daily Outreach: Consistently follow the sales SOP to maintain target daily call volumes and follow-ups.
  
Meet Conversion Targets: Achieve monthly client acquisition targets by converting qualified rental businesses into active, paying customers.
  
Drive Revenue Growth: Outperform standard sales benchmarks to unlock higher incentive tiers.
  
  
  
**Qualifications & Requirements**
**Must Hav**
e
  
Cold Outreach and Cold Calling: Confident doing cold approaches. You pick up the phone and talk to strangers without hesitation. Comfortable talking to customers every single day. (Non-negotiable: If you do not enjoy cold calling, this role is not for you.)
