**Inside Sales Representative — Outreach**
Full-Time Remote Position
  
  
U.S. Eastern Time Business Hours
  
  
**Annual Target Earnings: C$40,000–C$50,000**
The Role
  
  
Royal York Property Management is hiring Inside Sales Representatives to introduce residential property owners to its rental-guarantee program.
  
  
The program costs C$100 per month. If a covered tenant defaults on rent, the program is designed to provide the owner with an amount equal to the property’s monthly rent, subject to the program’s terms, approval requirements, and claim conditions.
  
  
You will contact company-provided property-owner leads through an automatic dialer, identify whether they meet the campaign requirements, respond to objections, and connect qualified owners with a Royal York sales representative.
  
  
You will not complete the final sale or determine approval. Your success will depend on how effectively you turn outbound conversations into qualified live transfers.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Apply with your résumé. If your background aligns with the role, you will receive a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours.
  
  
The interview includes realistic property-owner calling scenarios designed to evaluate your communication, objection handling, judgment, and coachability.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Make continuous outbound calls using an automatic dialer.
* Introduce Royal York and the rental-guarantee program.
* Ask questions about the owner and their rental property.

title: ServiceNow Architect
description:
**Job Title:** ServiceNow Architect – Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) / IT Business Management (ITBM)

?

**Role/Job Summary:**
  
We are looking for a senior ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) Architect who will act as the senior-most technical authority for the organisation's SPM ecosystem, designing scalable, enterprise-grade solutions that connect business strategy to execution. The role owns the enterprise SPM and Enterprise Architecture (EA) blueprint, the multi-year platform roadmap, and the embedding of Artificial Intelligence (AI) capabilities such as Now Assist and Agentic AI into portfolio workflows. Equally important, this person must be an outstanding communicator and presenter who can evangelise the SPM product suite and influence Portfolio Management Office (PMO), Finance, Information Technology (IT) and business leadership on getting maximum value from the platform.

?

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Platform architecture and design:** Lead end-to-end architecture and implementation of the ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) suite across demand, project, portfolio, resource and financial management; define and maintain the enterprise SPM architecture and multi-year technology roadmap aligned to business strategy and investment priorities.
* **Enterprise Architecture (EA) alignment:** Position SPM within the wider enterprise architecture landscape, aligning business capabilities, application portfolio and technology services to the Common Service Data Model (CSDM) and Configuration Management Database (CMDB) so that strategy, spend and technology assets remain traceable end to end.
* **Governance and standards:** Minimise customisation, drive out-of-the-box (OOTB) adoption, enforce architectural governance and design standards across the implementation lifecycle, and ensure every solution is scalable, secure and upgrade-safe.
* **Portfolio and strategic planning:** Connect Objectives and Key Results (OKRs), investment funding and execution outcomes; configure Investment Funding, Strategic Planning Workspace, Alignment Planner and Business Planning Portal; architect Agile delivery capabilities including sprint planning, epic and story hierarchy, and backlog management integrated with the project and portfolio layers.
* **Artificial Intelligence (AI) enablement:** Design and embed Now Assist and Agentic AI use cases into SPM workflows, such as demand summarisation and conversational demand creation, project status and insight generation, story generation from epics, and autonomous monitoring of critical-path project tasks.
* **Integration and technical delivery:** Define integration strategies with financial and delivery systems including Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platforms such as Systems, Applications and Products (SAP) and Oracle, Project Portfolio Management (PPM) tools such as Planview, Clarity and Microsoft Project, Agile tools such as Jira and Azure DevOps, and IT Service Management (ITSM) modules; architect Representational State Transfer (REST), Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP), Management, Instrumentation and Discovery (MID) Server and IntegrationHub spokes for SPM data flows.
* **Evangelisation and stakeholder influence:** Act as the product evangelist for the SPM suite, running executive briefings, value-realisation sessions and roadmap presentations that influence senior stakeholders on the best use of the platform and improve Return on Investment (ROI) visibility and portfolio decision quality.
* **Workshops and advisory:** Lead SPM workshops, design sessions and architecture reviews with the Portfolio Management Office (PMO), Finance, IT and business stakeholders; act as trusted advisor on portfolio governance and digital transformation initiatives.
* **Mentoring and quality:** Mentor SPM developers and consultants, conduct code and design reviews, and set development standards across the delivery team.
* **Pre-sales support:** Support solution design, product demonstrations, effort estimation and responses to Requests for Proposal (RFP) and Requests for Information (RFI).

**?**

**Must-Have Skills:**

* **ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) / IT Business Management (ITBM) modules:** Demand Management (idea intake, scoring, approvals), Project Management (Work Breakdown Structure, milestones, baselines), Portfolio Management (investment prioritisation, scenario planning), Resource Management (capacity, allocation, utilisation), Financial Planning (budget versus actuals, cost tracking, Financial Operations or FinOps), Agile Development, Test Management, Innovation Management, Strategic Planning (Objectives and Key Results or OKRs, investment funding, Alignment Planner) and Time Management.
* **Architect-level solution ownership:** Proven accountability for solution design, design authority and delivery governance on enterprise-scale SPM programmes.
* **Platform and scripting:** Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, User Interface (UI) Policies, Flow Designer and IntegrationHub ; scoped applications, domain separation, Access Control List (ACL) design and security model configuration.

* **Data model:** Common Service Data Model (CSDM) and Configuration Management Database (CMDB) alignment, service mapping and control-to-asset accuracy.
* **Reporting and experience layer:** Performance Analytics, SPM dashboards, Workspaces and UI Builder.
* **Integrations:** Representational State Transfer (REST), Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP), Management, Instrumentation and Discovery (MID) Server and IntegrationHub spokes; Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Project Portfolio Management (PPM), Agile toolchains, Human Resource Information Systems (HRIS) and identity platforms such as Active Directory, Okta and SailPoint.
* **Certification (mandatory):** ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Strategic Portfolio Management (CIS-SPM).
* **Enterprise Architecture (EA) capability:** Ability to link business capabilities, application portfolio, technology services and investment decisions into a single architecture narrative.
* **Communication and presentation (A++ requirement):** Exceptional verbal, written and presentation skills, with the ability to evangelise the SPM product suite, facilitate executive workshops, and influence Chief Executive Officer (CEO), Chief Information Officer (CIO), Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and Portfolio Management Office (PMO) level stakeholders.

**?**

**Good-to-Have Skills:**

* **Now Assist and Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) for SPM (highly desired):** Hands-on exposure to Now Assist skills and AI agents for SPM use cases such as demand summarisation, conversational demand creation, project insights and status generation, story generation from epics, and autonomous project task monitoring.
* **Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) (highly beneficial):** Working knowledge of policies and controls, control attestation, risk registers, audit management and regulatory compliance, and how these connect to portfolio and investment governance.
* **Advanced Common Service Data Model (CSDM) and Configuration Management Database (CMDB) (highly beneficial):** Deep CSDM knowledge to support Enterprise Architecture (EA) use cases, including business capability mapping, application portfolio rationalisation and technology lifecycle management.
* **Additional certifications:** ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA), Certified Technical Architect (CTA), Certified Application Developer (CAD); Project Management Professional (PMP) from the Project Management Institute (PMI); Scaled Agile Framework ( SAFe ) Agilist or Scrum Master; Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) version 4 Foundation.
* **Enterprise Architecture frameworks:** The Open Group Architecture Framework (TOGAF), ArchiMate modelling or equivalent.
* **Domain exposure:** IT Financial Management (ITFM), FinOps, Application Portfolio Management (APM) and Enterprise Agile Planning.
* **Education:** Master's degree such as Master of Business Administration (MBA) or Master of Science (MSc), particularly for Portfolio Management Office (PMO) transformation or IT Financial Management scope.

**?**

**Experience Required:**
  
10–12+ years of total professional Information Technology (IT) experience, including a minimum of 7 years of hands-on ServiceNow experience, 3+ years of dedicated Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) / IT Business Management (ITBM) implementation experience, and 2–3 years in a lead or architect capacity with accountability for solution design and delivery governance. Must have led, as lead or architect, a minimum of 2 enterprise-scale SPM implementations. Bachelor's degree in Information Technology , Computer Science, Business Administration or Engineering is required.

**?**

**Any Other Important Notes:**

* **Communication screening:** This is a client-facing, board-visible role. Shortlisting must include a live presentation or whiteboard round to validate A++ communication, storytelling and executive presence, in addition to the technical evaluation.

* **Certification priority:** ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Strategic Portfolio Management (CIS-SPM) is mandatory; Enterprise Architecture (EA) credentials and Now Assist / Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) exposure are strong differentiators during shortlisting.
* **Industry preference:** Prior delivery in regulated industries is strongly preferred, including Banking, Financial Services and Insurance (BFSI), Healthcare and Life Sciences, Manufacturing and Retail, and Energy and Utilities.
* **Stakeholder engagement:** Expect regular interaction with Portfolio Management Office (PMO), Finance, IT leadership and business executives, including workshop facilitation, architecture review boards and value-realisation reviews.
* **Pre-sales contribution:** Participation in solution design, demonstrations, effort estimation and responses to Requests for Proposal (RFP) and Requests for Information (RFI) is an expected part of the role.
* **Location, shift and travel:** To be confirmed by the hiring manager, including base location, overlap hours with client or global stakeholders, and any onsite or travel expectation for workshops and go-live milestones.
* **Continuous learning:** The candidate is expected to track ServiceNow SPM product evolution, AI capabilities, agile delivery practices and portfolio governance trends, and to bring these into the platform roadmap.

title: Marketing & Events Executive
description:
Location: Pune Employment Type: full-time

### **Job Details**

Marketing and Events Executive

Why this role exists

Every event we attend, sponsor or host should lead to conversations, meetings and new business for

Systems Plus.

In the US, we want to show up at the industry conferences where our clients and prospects gather, as

attendees and sponsors. We arrive with target accounts identified, meetings booked and a clear story,

then follow through until conversations become real opportunities.

Across the US and India, the events we host should close the distance between people and technology.

Attendees should ask hard questions, get hands-on and leave eager to build something that once felt

out of reach.

As Marketing and Events Executive, you will lead this program and own our Employee Value Proposition

(EVP), and employer brand. You will work closely with leadership and be measured on business

outcomes and not attendance figures.

The role at a glance

Area Detail

Role Marketing and Events Executive

Regions United States and India

Focus areas Events and conferences, EVP and employer brand, employee

experience, content marketing

Leads Global events and production team

Works closely with Executive leadership, practice heads, sales, Talent Acquisition (TA)

and HR

Lead events and conferences across the US and India

You will own the Systems Plus events calendar end to end, from the events we host to the industry

conferences we sponsor and attend.

Build and run the events and conference playbook for both markets, adapting the format,

audience and message to each region

Define what a Systems Plus event should be: the format, the experience, the quality of content

and how attendees feel when they leave Set a clear framework for sponsored events: which ones we choose, what we negotiate for, and

how we show up to maximize return on investment (ROI)

Design hands-on formats such as live demos, workshops, labs, and open Q&A, so people can try

the technology rather than only hear about it

Lead the global events and production team, giving them clear direction and the room to do the

best work of their careers

Partner with the executive team on event strategy, speaking opportunities and leadership

presence

Own budgets, vendors, logistics and on-site delivery, with close attention to every detail

Turn every event into business

Each event should move the business forward, and you will be accountable for making that link.

Tie every event to clear business goals before budget is committed: target accounts, meetings,

pipeline and partnerships

Drive pre-event outreach to secure appointments and meetings with prospects, clients and

partners

Work with practice heads, sales and leadership to agree who we want to meet, what we want to

say and who owns the follow-up

Track follow-up through to new opportunities and report results in business terms

Use what you learn to decide where we invest next: which events to grow, change or stop

Lead our EVP and employer brand

You will shape how both talent and clients see Systems Plus as a place to work and turn that into new

opportunities.

Define the Systems Plus EVP: why strong people join, stay and grow here, grounded in what

employees actually experience

Build the employer brand across careers pages, LinkedIn, campus and industry forums, and our

own events

Use employer brand to open client conversations, since our people and culture are part of what

clients choose, especially in Global Capability Center (GCC) and long-term delivery partnerships

Bring employee stories, milestones and community work to the forefront in a way that feels

genuine through our social media handles

Shape the employee experience with TA and HR

Working alongside TA and HR, you will help make the Systems Plus employee experience something

people talk about.

Shape onboarding so new joiners feel welcome, informed and productive from their first week

Plan and run engagement programs, internal events and recognition moments across our

locations

Keep improving the employee experience using feedback, data and what you see on the ground Make sure the promise we make externally through the EVP matches what employees live day

to day

Drive event and employer brand specific content marketing

You will lead content that builds the Systems Plus brand with clients, prospects and future colleagues.

Own the content calendar across LinkedIn, our blog, newsletters, webinars and event channels

Turn every event into lasting content: session recordings, recaps, short videos, interviews and

case material

Work with practice heads and subject matter experts to publish thought leadership on AI, cloud,

cybersecurity, GCCs and digital transformation

Create employer brand content that shows real people doing real work

Measure which content drives engagement, leads and job applications, and refine the plan

accordingly

Build it as you go

Much of how this function runs has not been built yet, and that is the opportunity.

You will think alongside the team and leadership about where to focus, what to try next and what

matters most. We want someone who owns a broader business problem, not only the event marketing

and employer brand function.

Who you are

Curious about technology and the people who build it

Energized by bringing people together, and skilled at making a room feel open

Obsessive about detail, from the run-of-show to the follow-up email

Commercially minded, connecting your work to pipeline, revenue and growth

A leader who brings out the best in a talented team and shares credit freely

Comfortable with ambiguity, and inclined to build structure rather than wait for it

Open and honest with leadership, peers and partners

What you will bring

A track record of planning and delivering events and conferences, ideally in B2B technology or IT

services

Experience managing sponsorships and showing their business impact

Hands-on experience with employer branding, EVP work or internal communications

Strong content skills, from planning a calendar to writing and editing it yourself

Experience leading teams and managing agencies and vendors

Experience working across the US and India, including different time zones and business cultures

Comfort with marketing and CRM tools such as HubSpot, and with reporting on event ROIWhat success looks like

In your first 90 days

Review current events, sponsorships and content, and agree priorities with leadership

Publish the Systems Plus event playbook and the criteria for choosing sponsored events

Deliver your first events under the new playbook, each with clear meeting and pipeline targets

Draft the EVP with TA and HR

In your first year

An events calendar across the US and India, tied to business goals and reviewed every quarter

Measurable pipeline and new opportunities sourced from events

The EVP live across channels, with onboarding and engagement programmes running

A steady content rhythm that supports both sales and hiring

Why Systems Plus

At Systems Plus, we help organizations accelerate digital transformation through technology-led

innovation. With 38+ years of experience across 30+ countries, we work as an extension of our clients'

teams in IT consulting, cloud, cybersecurity, AI strategy, managed services and GCCs.

Our culture is built on openness, equality, integrity, honesty, and humility. We are an equal opportunity

employer, committed to a gender-neutral and inclusive workplace.

description:
**Location:** Pune  
**Industry:** Real Estate / Residential Property Development  
**Experience:** 3–4 Years  
**CTC:** Up to ₹4.50 LPA  
**Reporting To:** Marketing Manager  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Job Overview**

We are looking for a proactive and execution-oriented **Executive – Marketing (BTL)** to manage on-ground marketing activities for a residential real estate project. The candidate will be responsible for conducting market surveys, coordinating local activations, managing branding and promotional activities, maintaining activity records, and tracking campaign performance.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in BTL marketing, vendor coordination, field marketing, and MIS reporting, preferably within the real estate or residential property development industry.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

1. On-Ground Marketing & BTL Activities

* Execute on-ground marketing activities, including market surveys, local activations, BTL campaigns, canter/van activities, and promotional events.
* Conduct employee-group mapping and identify relevant organizations, residential communities, commercial hubs, and potential customer segments.
* Carry out hoarding surveys, identify suitable advertising locations, and coordinate site branding and collateral distribution.
* Support local marketing initiatives to improve project visibility, generate qualified leads, and drive site visits.

2. Market Survey & Demand Assessment

* Conduct market surveys to identify target audiences, local demand, competitor activities, and potential marketing locations.
* Participate in pre-RERA demand-assessment meetings and capture organization details, employee-group information, referral sources, and other relevant data as instructed.
* Maintain accurate records of survey findings, audience profiles, organization references, and local market insights.
* Submit survey reports and observations to the Marketing Manager for planning and decision-making.

3. Vendor & Activity Coordination

* Coordinate with printers, branding agencies, advertising vendors, and other service providers for timely delivery, installation, and execution of marketing materials.
* Ensure that hoardings, site branding, promotional displays, and other collateral are installed or distributed as per approved plans.
* Track vendor commitments, activity schedules, costs, display periods, and execution status.
* Verify the quality and completion of activities and promptly escalate delays or discrepancies.

4. Activity Tracking & MIS Reporting

* Maintain accurate activity-wise records covering exact location, target audience, vendor details, cost, display period, and response data.
* Maintain photographic proof of executed activities, daily activity reports, stock registers, and marketing collateral records.
* Prepare and update daily MIS reports covering completed activities, expenditure, leads generated, and campaign outcomes.
* Ensure all marketing activities are documented and reported accurately to the Marketing Manager.

5. Lead Tracking & Cross-Functional Coordination

* Coordinate with Digital Marketing and Sales teams to ensure every BTL activity has a defined source code for lead attribution.
* Track activity-wise lead generation, qualified enquiries, site visits, and other measurable outcomes.
* Ensure that leads generated through offline campaigns are properly recorded and shared with the relevant teams.
* Support performance reviews by providing accurate activity data and campaign response reports.

6. Budget & Compliance

* Track activity-wise expenses and ensure execution within approved budgets.
* Maintain records of vendor quotations, bills, invoices, and supporting documentation.
* Ensure marketing materials and project communications follow approved brand guidelines and applicable RERA and legal requirements.
* Obtain the necessary internal approvals before executing or releasing marketing activities.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Graduate in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field; a marketing qualification is preferred.
* 3–4 years of experience in BTL marketing, field marketing, activations, or on-ground campaign execution.
* Prior experience in real estate or residential project marketing will be preferred.
* Hands-on exposure to market surveys, hoarding surveys, branding, promotional activities, vendor coordination, and collateral distribution.
* Good knowledge of Excel, Google Sheets, MIS reporting, and activity tracking.
* Ability to maintain accurate records, photographs, expense details, and campaign response data.
* Strong coordination, communication, organizational, and follow-up skills.
* Willingness to travel locally and undertake regular field visits across Pune and surrounding markets.

**Application Process:**

Interested candidates can share their updated Resume with the subject line:

“[Job Title] – [Your Name]” on ambitious@smgroup.work (CC: team.hiringdesk@gmail.com ) You can also connect at +91-9321583057 / 8850220484

Current CTC, Expected CTC, Notice period, Location and total number of experience in years.

* Have you conducted market surveys and identified potential customer groups, residential societies, commercial areas, or employee groups for marketing activities?
* Are you proficient in MS Excel or Google Sheets for preparing daily MIS reports and tracking marketing activities?
* What is your current CTC, expected CTC and Notice Period ?

K. A. Tech. is a leading distributor of Pneumatics, Hydraulics, and Automation solutions, catering to diverse industries across India. As an authorized distributor for M2I Corporation (MXOn) HMIs, Hanyoung Nux controllers and sensors, and LS Electric switchgear, we empower businesses with reliable engineering solutions and dependable after-sales support.

We are seeking a dependable Accounts Executive to join our team in Pune. The candidate will manage day-to-day accounts and billing, handle our retail counter, and maintain accurate inventory records. * **Documentation:** Maintain dispatch logs, LR records, vendor price history and daily cash/bank summaries.

* **Collaboration:** Work closely with the sales and support teams to keep orders, stock and billing in step.

**Key Requirements:**

* **Experience:** 0–3 years in accounts, stores, counter sales or purchase support in a manufacturing or industrial trading set-up. Freshers with strong aptitude will also be considered.

* **Education:** B.Com/BBA or equivalent graduate; Tally Prime and GST knowledge preferred.

* **Technical Knowledge:** Working knowledge of Tally, MS Excel, GST invoicing, e-way bills and basic inventory practice.

* **Negotiation Skills:** Ability to negotiate rates and freight confidently and courteously.

* **Mobility:** Must know how to ride a two-wheeler and have a valid licence and own vehicle for PCMC-area visits.

* **Purchase Inclination:** Interest in or exposure to purchase will be an added advantage.

* **Personality:** Honest, organised, detail-oriented and customer-friendly.

* Compensation: ₹[15000] – ₹[25000] per month, based on experience and proficiency.

* Fuel/travel compensation at ₹2.5/- per km for outward visits.

* Opportunity to learn a wide range of industrial automation, pneumatics and hydraulics products.

title: Medical Business Associate -  Delhi
description:

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

You will engage with healthcare professionals across Delhi to build trust through clear, science-based information that supports better patient care. You will create and deliver a territory plan that reflects local needs and customer insights. Working closely with colleagues across teams, you will help solve challenges and improve patient access. We seek curious, honest, and practical thinkers who want to learn and grow. This role offers strong learning opportunities, meaningful career growth, and a chance to unite science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.

* Build and maintain respectful, professional relationships with doctors, pharmacists, and other healthcare partners across your territory.
* Develop and execute a territory business plan guided by customer insight and local patient needs.
* Share clear and accurate science-based information to support healthcare professionals’ decision-making.
* Record and report activities, outcomes, and customer insights accurately using company systems and tools.
* Collaborate with colleagues across functions to address customer needs and improve patient access.
* Continuously expand your knowledge of clinical evidence, market trends, and ways to enhance your performance.

Why You?
  
  
Work type
  
  
This is an on-site role based in Delhi, requiring regular travel within the assigned territory. You will be part of a supportive team that provides coaching and practical feedback. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and perspectives to apply. We value inclusion and strive to create a workplace where everyone can contribute and grow.
  
  
Basic Qualification
  
  
We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree from a recognised institution.
* Minimum 1 year of customer-facing experience in field sales, medical business, or territory management roles.
* Valid driver’s licence and willingness to travel regularly within the territory.
* Good verbal and written communication skills in English and Hindi; knowledge of local languages spoken in Delhi is a plus.
* Basic digital skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Right to work in India.

**Preferred Qualification**

* Prior experience in pharmaceutical, medical, or healthcare-related roles.
* Comfortable discussing clinical evidence and explaining scientific concepts to healthcare professionals.
* Strong planning, organisation, and time management skills.
* Ability to use customer insight and simple data to guide your activities and priorities.
* Fluency in local languages spoken in and around Delhi.
* High motivation to learn, adapt, and take on increasing responsibility.

Ready to apply?
  
  
If this role matches your skills and career goals, we would love to hear from you. Apply now and take the next step in your career while helping us unite science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.
  
  
**Job Location - Delhi**
**Skills**
Customer Centric Selling, Data to Insights, Digital Fluency, Omnichannel, Sales Territory Management, Scientific Literacy
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**About Us:**

Proofpoint is a global leader in human- and agent-centric cybersecurity. We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. **Bold** in how we dream and innovate

**Responsive** to feedback, challenges and opportunities

Proofpoint is a leading cybersecurity company protecting organizations’ greatest assets and biggest risks: vulnerabilities in people. Leading organizations of all sizes, including more than half of the Fortune 1000, rely on Proofpoint for people-centric security and compliance solutions mitigating their most critical risks across email, the cloud, social media, and the web. Strive to both penetrate net new accounts as well as to expand our presence with existing customers by introducing them to the rest of our security portfolio.

Last, but certainly not least, WIN!! Blow your quota out of the water!

Ideally we would like to see experience selling Enterprise Security or Information Technology products, but if you’re a “rockstar” from a different industry, we still want to talk to you!

Must have a proven and demonstrable track record of exceeding sales goals

Strong written and verbal communication skills and be able to clearly and effectively articulate Proofpoint’s value.

Great sales people are organized, detail and process oriented.

Must be a self-starter with the ability to work independently or in a team environment.

Ability to manage multiple tasks and use good judgment in resolving difficult issues.

Experience with SalesForce or similar CRM tools strongly preferred

BA/BS or equivalent preferred.

**Why Proofpoint**

Protecting people is at the heart of our award-winning lineup of cybersecurity solutions, and the people who work here are the key to our success. We’re a customer-focused and a driven-to-win organization with leading-edge products. We are an inclusive, diverse, multinational company that believes in culture fit, but more importantly ‘culture-add’, and we strongly encourage people from all walks of life to apply.

We believe in hiring the best and the brightest to help cultivate our culture of collaboration and appreciation. Apply today and explore your future at Proofpoint! #LifeAtPFPT #LI-KT2

**Gaurav Sharma Law Offices & Mednlaw**

**Location:** Delhi NCR  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** 3–7 years  
**Salary:** ₹50,000–₹80,000 per month, depending on experience and suitability

About Us

Gaurav Sharma Law Offices is a multi-practice law firm providing legal services to businesses, healthcare organisations and individuals.

Mednlaw is a specialised healthcare law and management consulting practice catering to hospitals, diagnostic centres, healthcare professionals and healthcare businesses.

We are looking for a dynamic, commercially oriented Business Development Manager to strengthen our institutional relationships, develop business opportunities and support the growth of both organisations.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Business Development & Client Acquisition**

* Identify and develop business opportunities among corporates, hospitals, diagnostic centres, healthcare companies and other institutions.
* Develop relationships with business owners, promoters, senior management and decision-makers.
* Identify potential clients requiring ongoing legal retainerships and healthcare management consulting services.
* Arrange and coordinate meetings with prospective institutional clients.
* Follow up on business proposals, quotations and prospective engagements.
* Develop strategies for acquiring corporate and institutional clients.

**2. Client Relationship Management**

* Maintain relationships with existing clients.
* Identify opportunities to expand existing client engagements.
* Coordinate periodic client meetings and relationship reviews.
* Ensure timely follow-up on client requirements and proposals.
* Maintain a structured database of existing and prospective clients.

**3. Business Development Strategy**

* Develop and implement business development plans for GSLO and Mednlaw.
* Identify new industry segments and potential institutional clients.
* Research competitors, market opportunities and potential client requirements.
* Develop professional networking and institutional relationship-building initiatives.
* Work closely with the Founder and senior legal and consulting teams.

**4. Marketing Coordination**

* Coordinate with the digital marketing team for business development initiatives.
* Identify opportunities for industry networking, seminars, conferences and professional engagement.
* Assist in preparing corporate presentations, service proposals and business profiles.
* Monitor business development activities and prepare periodic performance reports.

**5. Reporting & Performance Monitoring**

* Maintain an updated CRM/database of prospective and existing clients.
* Track meetings, proposals, follow-ups and business conversions.
* Submit weekly and monthly business development reports.
* Monitor the status of prospective retainerships and consulting engagements.

**Candidate Profile**

* Graduate in any discipline; MBA in Marketing, Business Development or Management will be preferred.
* 3–5 years of experience in business development, institutional sales, corporate relationship management or professional services.
* Experience dealing with corporate clients, hospitals, healthcare organisations, consulting firms or professional-services businesses will be an advantage.
* Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to interact confidently with business owners, senior executives and institutional decision-makers.
* Strong networking, negotiation and relationship-management abilities.
* Proficiency in MS Office, Excel, PowerPoint and CRM tools.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of business development activities.

description:
Job Description: Field Sales Executive (Partnership Acquisition)

Company: EBG Group (Nonstop Mobility & Nonstop PhysioCare)

Role: Field Sales Executive / Medical Representative (MR)

Location: Field-Based - Delhi, Mumbai, Ahmedabad

About the Role:

EBG Group is executing a massive, high-velocity retail and clinical expansion across India. Our goal is to rapidly onboard thousands of independent surgical stores and physiotherapy clinics into the Nonstop ecosystem. We are seeking aggressive, target-driven Field Sales Executives to drive partner acquisition. You will be responsible for pitching our zero-capital co-branding partnership, negotiating terms, and closing agreements. This role is highly field-oriented and requires a strong closer who can both hunt for new leads and execute on pre-qualified appointments.

Key Responsibilities:  
● Lead Generation & Closures: Conduct daily field visits to independent surgical stores and physiotherapy clinics. In addition to attending pre-qualified appointments set by our Inside Sales team, you are expected to actively generate your own leads through on-ground prospecting and cold canvassing.  
● Pitching the Value Proposition: Effectively present the Nonstop partnership model—highlighting our zero-upfront capital requirement, premium co-branding (signboards), supply of high-margin international inventory, clinic software (EMR), and centralized digital lead generation.  
● Negotiation: Successfully negotiate and sign commercial agreements based on our standardized, highly attractive revenue-share model.  
● Pipeline Management: Maintain an active, high-converting pipeline, ensuring a swift sales cycle from the first field meeting to the signed agreement.  
● Reporting: Provide daily field reports, update the CRM/pipeline trackers, and coordinate closely with the Sales Manager to strategize on complex closures.

Candidate Requirements:  
● Experience: 2–5 years of experience in B2B field sales, franchise acquisition, medical representation (MR), or retail channel expansion.  
● Skills: Exceptional face-to-face communication, objection handling, and closing skills. Must be comfortable dealing with store owners, clinicians, and retail entrepreneurs.  
● Drive: Highly motivated, target-oriented hunter capable of handling a high volume of daily field meetings to meet aggressive monthly closure quotas.  
● Mobility: Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory. Must own a two-wheeler with a valid driving license.

What We Offer:  
● Competitive base salary  
● Aggressive, uncapped performance incentives based on successful partner closures.  
● The opportunity to be a key driver in building India’s fastest-growing medical mobility and physiotherapy network.

Compensation: ₹20,000 – ₹25,000 per month + Performance-Based Incentives.

description:
Job Description – Payroll Executive (EdTech Industry)

**Experience:** 1–2 Years  
**Industry:** EdTech / Education Technology  
**Department:** Human Resources ( Payroll )  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented Payroll Executive to manage monthly payroll processing and employee compensation activities in our EdTech organization. The candidate will be responsible for salary processing, attendance and leave management, payroll data validation, statutory deductions, and coordination with HR and Finance teams to ensure timely and accurate salary disbursement.

Key Responsibilities

* Process monthly payroll for employees across departments, ensuring accuracy and timely salary disbursement.
* Maintain and validate employee attendance, leave records, working days, and loss of pay (LOP) data.
* Calculate salaries, incentives, variable pay, deductions, reimbursements, and other salary components.
* Handle payroll inputs for different employee categories, including sales, academic, counselling, operations, and corporate teams, as applicable.
* Manage payroll-related statutory deductions and compliance, including PF, ESI, Professional Tax, and TDS, as applicable.
* Prepare and verify full and final (F&F) settlements for employees who leave the organization.
* Coordinate with HR, Finance, and relevant department managers for payroll inputs, new joiners, exits, and salary revisions.
* Generate and distribute monthly payslips and maintain employee payroll records.
* Address employee queries related to salaries, payslips, deductions, incentives, and reimbursements.
* Maintain payroll trackers, monthly MIS reports, and employee compensation data.
* Ensure confidentiality of employee information and compliance with company policies.
* Support payroll audits and process improvements to enhance payroll accuracy and efficiency.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* Graduate in B.Com, BBA, HR, or a related field.
* 1–2 years of experience in payroll processing or HR operations.
* Basic knowledge of Indian payroll processes and statutory compliance.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, and basic formulas.
* Experience with HRMS or payroll software is preferred.
* Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage deadlines, maintain accuracy, and handle confidential information.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Experience in an EdTech, education, or fast-paced startup environment will be an advantage.
* Familiarity with incentive and variable-pay calculations for sales or counselling teams is desirable.
* Ability to manage payroll data for a diverse and growing workforce.

Key Competencies

* Payroll processing and reconciliation
* Attendance and leave management
* Statutory compliance
* Employee data management
* Excel and payroll reporting
* Attention to detail and confidentiality

#### **Entrepreneurial Executive Director**

The company is also looking for an Entrepreneurial Executive Director. This is an entrepreneurial position and is meant for a person who wants to manage and participate financially by investing in the shareholding of the company. He will be responsible for securing business for the projects to be implemented by the company and will also be responsible for the profitability of the business independently.

His prime responsibility will be to ensure positive monthly cash flows by generating suitable revenue and controlling expenses, and for timely payment of all the obligations which may arise for the conduct of the business, including timely payment to suppliers, contractors and employees involved in this activity. The selected candidate will be either an Electrical or Electronics Engineer with experience in the Electronic Security Systems Industry and will have a proven record of performance in the conduct of the above business, either as a Business Entrepreneur or Senior Manager in a large company. The position is open for any honest, energetic and enthusiastic individual.

##### **Earnings**

The Earnings will be primarily performance based and will comprise of earnings from:

* Fixed minimum monthly salary of Rs. 50,000.
* Rs. 50,000 per month from positive cash flow generation.
* 0.25% of the revenue received from sales, subject to a limit of Rs. 1 lac per month.
* Reimbursement of Conveyance Expenses at actuals for the use of a personal vehicle, as per Company norms.
* 5% of the Net Profit accrued at the end of the financial year, governed by applicable statutory rules and subject to any restrictions which may be imposed by the Company Law Board or any other statutory authorities.

##### **Career Progression**

The selected candidate will be elevated to the Board of the Company in case his performance is found to be good after completion of one year of service and on attaining successful business results, as will be mutually agreed upon at the time of induction. The position has the potential for extraordinary career advancement opportunities for a person who is an excellent performer and has unquestionable integrity. title: HR Admin
description:
**Position:** HR & Admin Executive  
**Department:** Human Resources & Administration  
**Reporting To:** HR Manager / Management  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience**: 2-3years

1. Job Summary

We are looking for a responsible and detail-oriented HR & Admin Executive to manage HR operations, payroll, attendance, recruitment, employee coordination, statutory compliance, and administrative activities across multiple branches.

2. Key Responsibilities

**A. Payroll & Salary Management**

1. Prepare and maintain monthly salary sheets, including new joiners and employees who have left.

2. Verify salary deductions, vendor payments and salary discrepancies.

3. Prepare salary sheets and coordinate salary distribution.

4. Maintain employee-wise advance, recovery, outstanding balance, and incentive records.

5. Coordinate salary approvals and submit salary reports to management.

**B. Attendance & Leave Management**

1. Monitor daily attendance, leaves, and duty rosters across all branches.

2. Verify and rectify attendance mis-punches.

3. Finalize attendance by the 1st of every month.

4. Update week-off changes in MiDAP software and share reports with the Internal Audit Team.

5. Share daily leave updates in the team WhatsApp group.

6. Submit attendance reports to the concerned authorities.

**C. Recruitment & Employee Management**

1. Handle recruitment, candidate screening, and interview coordination.

2. Prepare and share weekly recruitment reports with EA and PJ.

3. Manage employee joining, exit, transfer, and biometric registration.

4. Handle employee grievances, salary queries, and appraisal requests.

5. Coordinate Full & Final settlements with management.

**D. Branch & Administrative Management**

1. Visit and monitor all branches regularly.

2. Coordinate staff shifting between branches and floors.

3. Schedule branch visits for team leaders.

4. Monitor bill books, cashier audits, and administrative activities.

5. Communicate brand-wise and weekly sales targets to branch employees.

6. Maintain and update team groups and employee records.

**E. Statutory Compliance & Audit**

1. Prepare, submit, and coordinate ESI and PF challans.

2. Maintain statutory compliance records and documentation.

3. Prepare active/inactive designation and employee ID lists with second-in-charge details.

4. Submit attendance changes and required Excel reports to the Internal Audit Team.

5. Coordinate with the audit team regarding salary, attendance, and employee records.

3. Key Skills & Competencies

· HR Operations and Payroll Management.

· Attendance and Leave Management.

· Recruitment and Employee Coordination.

· Knowledge of ESI, PF, and statutory compliance.

· MS Excel, HRMS, and MiDAP Software.

· Salary and Advance Calculation.

· Branch Administration and Audit Coordination.

· Communication, Reporting, and Problem-Solving Skills.

4. Key Performance Areas (KRA)

· Accurate and timely salary processing.

· Attendance and leave management.

· Recruitment and employee record maintenance.

· Employee grievance and appraisal management.

· Timely ESI/PF compliance.

· Branch visits and administrative coordination.

· Accurate reporting and audit documentation.

Pay: ₹18,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

title: Account Executive - Consultant
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
  
  
By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.
  
  
Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
  
  
**Job Description**
**What You’ll Do**

* Identify, negotiate, and close major deals in a defined territory.
* Engage with CMOs and CTOs of top global brands to build impactful solutions.
* Use superior salesmanship to identify decision-makers and influencers.
* Build and nurture long-term relationships with multiple stakeholders.
* Actively pursue new leads and business opportunities through networking and referrals.
* Continuously learn about industry trends and competitors to maintain a strong sales edge.
* Seek regular feedback from leaders, peers, and clients to improve performance.

**What Makes You Qualified?**

* Top 10% sales performer in your current role or division.
* Smart, adaptable, and possesses a strong work ethic.
* 10+ years of relevant experience in enterprise software/SaaS sales.
* Exceptional relationship-building and influencing capabilities.
* Passion for customer experience and deep understanding of digital/social engagement trends.

**We focus on our mission**
: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
  
  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**
: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
  
  
**We invest in our people**
: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
  
  
To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
  
  
To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
  
  
**EEO - Our philosophy**
: Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
  
  
Sprinklr is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
  
  
Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
  
  
**Warning about Recruiting Scams:**
Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.
  
  
If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

Job Description – Field Sales Executive (Education Sales)
  
Department: Business Development & Sales
  
Employment Type: Full-Time
  
Work Location: Field-Based – Delhi NCR / Assigned Territory
  
Reporting To: Business Development Lead / Sales Manager
  
Compensation: Up to ₹40,000 per month, subject to the applicable compensation structure, experience and performance
  
Travel Requirement: Regular local travel for customer visits and home sessions
  
Mandatory Requirement: Personal two-wheeler or four-wheeler and a valid driving licence for the vehicle used
  
About EaseToLearn
  
EaseToLearn is an education-focused organisation offering technology-driven learning solutions designed to make learning more accessible, engaging and effective.
  
Role Overview
  
EaseToLearn is seeking a target-oriented and customer-focused Field Sales Executive to drive revenue through customer conversion and sales closures.
  
The role involves contacting assigned prospects and enquiries, conducting follow-up calls, understanding customer requirements, delivering in-person demonstrations and home sessions, addressing objections, and converting prospects into paying customers.
  
The primary responsibility is revenue generation through sales conversion and closures, not lead generation. The candidate must be comfortable with regular field travel, direct customer interaction and performance-based sales targets.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
1. Calling and Customer Conversion
  
Contact assigned prospects and customer enquiries through outbound calls and follow-ups.
  
Explain the company's products, services, pricing and value proposition accurately.
  
Understand customer requirements, address queries and resolve sales objections.
  
Follow up with interested prospects and guide them towards a purchase decision.
  
2. Field Sales and Home Sessions
  
Conduct customer visits, product demonstrations and home sessions within the assigned territory.
  
Explain relevant educational solutions based on customer requirements.
  
Build customer confidence, address concerns and negotiate within approved company guidelines.
  
Close sales through effective customer engagement and consultative selling.
  
Maintain professional conduct during customer visits and represent the company appropriately.
  
3. Revenue Generation and Sales Closures
  
Achieve assigned daily, weekly and monthly sales and revenue targets.
  
Convert assigned enquiries and prospects into paying customers.
  
Drive closures through calling, follow-ups, demonstrations and in-person meetings.
  
Maintain accurate records of sales opportunities, conversions, payments and closure status, wherever applicable.
  
Monitor sales performance and conversion rates to identify opportunities for improvement.
  
4. Customer Relationship Management
  
Maintain professional relationships with prospective and existing customers.
  
Provide accurate product information and support a smooth customer experience throughout the sales process.
  
Coordinate with internal teams regarding customer onboarding, payment confirmation and post-sale requirements.
  
Escalate customer concerns and share relevant feedback with the reporting manager.
  
5. Sales Reporting and Compliance
  
Update the CRM or designated reporting system with call outcomes, follow-up status, customer visits, home sessions, closures and revenue generated.
  
Submit daily sales and activity reports within prescribed timelines.
  
Plan customer visits and follow-ups efficiently to maximise productive selling time.
  
Follow approved pricing, sales processes, customer communication standards and company policies.
  
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
Performance will be assessed against defined, measurable targets, including:
  
Achievement of assigned sales and revenue targets.
  
Number of successful sales closures and paying customers.
  
Conversion rate from assigned prospects to paying customers.
  
Effectiveness of follow-up calls and customer visits.
  
Number and quality of completed home sessions.
  
Accuracy and timeliness of sales reporting.
  
Customer experience and compliance with company policies.
  
Eligibility Criteria
  
Graduation in any discipline.
  
Freshers with strong communication skills, sales aptitude and a willingness to learn may apply.
  
Prior experience in field sales, direct sales, education sales, consultative selling or customer conversion will be an advantage.
  
Good verbal communication, persuasion, negotiation and objection-handling skills.
  
Ability to manage follow-ups, interact confidently with customers and work towards sales targets.
  
Basic proficiency in smartphones and digital reporting tools; familiarity with CRM systems or spreadsheets is an advantage.
  
Mandatory Requirements
  
Must own and have regular access to a personal two-wheeler or four-wheeler suitable for field visits.
  
Must hold a valid driving licence for the vehicle used.
  
Must be comfortable with regular travel across Delhi NCR or the assigned territory.
  
Must be willing to conduct customer visits and home sessions.
  
Must be comfortable with outbound calling, follow-ups, direct selling and revenue-based performance targets.
  
Important Clarification About the Role
  
This is a field-based sales conversion and revenue-generation position, not a lead-generation role.
  
The company will assign prospects or customer enquiries for follow-up and conversion, as per its operational process. The executive will be responsible for engaging these prospects, conducting customer interactions and home sessions, following up consistently, and converting them into paying customers.
  
Independent lead sourcing is not the primary responsibility of this position.
  
Ideal Candidate Profile
  
The ideal candidate is proactive, persuasive, disciplined and comfortable with field mobility. They should be capable of managing the sales conversion process from the initial assigned customer contact through follow-up, home session and final closure. A strong focus on customer needs, sales discipline and measurable revenue outcomes is essential.
  
Compensation and Benefits
  
Compensation may be offered up to ₹50,000 per month, depending on the approved fixed-pay and incentive structure, relevant experience and performance.
  
The applicable fixed salary, performance incentives, travel reimbursement and other benefits, if any, will be communicated during the recruitment process.
  
Application Process
  
Interested candidates should complete the application form using the link below:
  
Application Form: https://tally.so/r/o99D7P
  
Shortlisted candidates will be assessed on communication skills, sales aptitude, customer handling, field readiness and ability to convert assigned prospects into paying customers.

* A business administration foundation and interest or study in B2B lead generation, inside sales, or business development.

Join Rassense Private Limited, a food services company focused on workplace experiences and the role of technology in food production and service. The company aims to serve clients across sectors and geographies, drawing on technological expertise in India and AI tools to enhance customer experience. Its vision also emphasizes relationships with production communities, including Farmer Producer Organizations, and its Indian heritage. title: AI Solution Architect
description:
AppSquadz is looking for a hands-on AI Solutions Architect who can own the technical customer journey—from first discovery and solution shaping through architecture, proof of concept, production deployment and managed-services recommendations. The role combines consultative technical presales with practical engineering judgment and accountability for secure, scalable, commercially viable AI solutions. The architect will collaborate with sales, alliances, delivery and customer stakeholders while remaining actively involved in implementation and handover.

Key responsibilities

· **Technical presales and solution shaping:** Partner with AI Services Business Development Manager in customer meetings; qualify AI opportunities, explain solution options, run technical demonstrations and contribute to proposals, effort estimates, bills of materials, statements of work and technical responses to RFPs.

· **Discovery workshops and use-case assessment:** Plan and facilitate business/IT workshops; map workflows, data sources, stakeholders, pain points, security constraints and success metrics. Assess AI readiness, prioritize use cases by value, feasibility and risk, and document requirements, assumptions and dependencies.

· **Architecture and solution design:** Design end-to-end generative AI, agentic AI, ML and data-enabled architectures covering models, prompts, RAG, vector search, orchestration, APIs, integrations, identity, guardrails, observability and cloud infrastructure. Produce diagrams, design decisions, cost estimates and deployment patterns.

· **PoCs, deployment and productionization:** Build or guide working PoCs and pilots; establish acceptance criteria; support integration, CI/CD, evaluation, performance testing, security reviews and production rollout. Troubleshoot issues and support operational readiness, documentation and knowledge transfer.

· **Managed-services advisory:** Assess post-go-live support needs and recommend appropriate managed-services packages: monitoring, incident response, model/prompt evaluation, cost optimization, data and knowledge-base refresh, security controls, SLA/SLO reporting and continuous improvement. Define scope, responsibilities, service levels and handover needs with delivery teams.

· **Collaboration and governance:** Work across OEM partners, engineering and customer teams; apply responsible-AI, privacy, data residency, governance and compliance considerations. Communicate trade-offs clearly to both business executives and technical teams.

Required experience and skills

· **Experience:** 5–10 years in solution architecture, cloud/data engineering, AI/ML engineering or technical consulting, including meaningful customer-facing presales and hands-on implementation experience.

· **AI engineering:** Practical experience delivering at least one production AI/GenAI solution; knowledge of LLM APIs, embeddings, RAG, agent workflows, evaluation, hallucination mitigation and prompt engineering.

· **Cloud and platforms:** Working experience with AWS and its AI/data services; familiarity with Amazon Bedrock and at least one major model ecosystem such as Anthropic Claude or OpenAI. Equivalent Azure/GCP experience is useful.

· **Engineering and integration:** Strong understanding of Python, REST APIs, application integration, databases, vector stores, containers, CI/CD, infrastructure as code and production monitoring.

· **Security and economics:** Ability to design IAM, encryption, secrets management, network controls, data protection and human oversight; estimate infrastructure/model usage costs and explain architectural trade-offs.

· **Communication:** Confidence facilitating workshops, whiteboarding solutions, writing technical proposals and presenting recommendations to CIO/CTO stakeholders and engineering teams.

Preferred qualifications

· **Additional experience:** AWS Solutions Architect or relevant cloud/AI certification; experience with agent orchestration frameworks, MLOps/LLMOps, regulated-industry architectures, enterprise knowledge assistants, coding assistants or intelligent process automation.

· **Commercial acumen:** Experience translating technical solutions into delivery plans, effort estimates, recurring support offerings and measurable customer outcomes.

Expected deliverables

· **Discovery:** Workshop agenda, current-state assessment, prioritized use-case backlog and measurable success criteria.

· **Solution design:** Reference/target architecture, integration and security design, sizing, cost estimate, risks and implementation roadmap.

· **Execution:** PoC/demo, deployment plan, test and evaluation results, production handover documents.

· **Operations:** Managed-services recommendation, operating model, monitoring plan, SLA/SLO inputs and improvement backlog.

description:

**Description**
**Why This Opportunity Is Different**
Most sales roles focus on selling products. This role focuses on transforming businesses.
  
  
As a Practice Development Manager (PDM), you will help doctors and practices adopt new technologies, embrace digital workflows, expand treatment capabilities, and unlock growth opportunities that improve both practice performance and patient outcomes.
  
  
You will operate at the intersection of: Healthcare | Medical Technology | Digital Transformation | Business Consulting | Practice Growth | Customer Success | Commercial Leadership
  
  
This is not simply a territory sales role. It is an opportunity to influence how healthcare innovation is adopted and delivered every day.
  
  
**Why Align?**
**Build a Career Beyond Traditional Sales -**
At Align, you are not just responsible for driving revenue. You are responsible for helping customers transform how they work. You will become a trusted advisor to doctors and practice teams, helping them improve clinical confidence, streamline workflows, elevate patient experiences, and grow sustainable businesses.
  
  
**Join a Company Shaping the Future of Healthcare -**
Align's digital ecosystem integrates advanced software, AI and machine learning, digital imaging, visualization, biomechanics, and material science to deliver industry-leading solutions worldwide.
  
  
**Be Part of India's Growth Story -**
India represents one of the most exciting opportunities within Align's global growth journey. As Align continues to expand its commercial presence, digital capability, and operational footprint in India, you will have the opportunity to contribute to a business that is shaping the future of healthcare technology in one of the world's most dynamic markets.
  
  
**Role expectations**
**What You Will Do**
**Drive Territory Growth**

* Develop and execute strategic territory plans using customer insight, commercial data, and opportunity analysis.
* Grow existing customer partnerships while acquiring and activating new customers.
* Convert new and existing practices into advocates of digital orthodontics and clear aligner treatment.
* Identify high-potential opportunities and prioritize activities that drive sustainable business growth.

**Become a Strategic Business Partner**

* Build trusted, long-term partnerships with doctors and practice teams.
* Understand each customer's clinical, commercial, and patient-focused objectives.
* Act as a strategic advisor rather than a transactional seller.
* Help practices identify opportunities to enhance efficiency, adoption, profitability, and patient experience.

**Lead Value-Based Commercial Conversations**

* Conduct structured, consultative conversations that uncover explicit and unspoken customer needs.
* Demonstrate the commercial and clinical value of Align solutions.
* Differentiate Align through insight-led selling rather than price-based selling.
* Confidently navigate competitive environments and complex objections.

**Drive Digital Transformation**

* Champion the Align Digital Workflow (ADW) and associated digital technologies.
* Help practices integrate digital workflows into daily operations.
* Demonstrate how technology can improve predictability, efficiency, patient engagement, and treatment outcomes.
* Become a trusted advocate for innovation and digital adoption.

**Deliver Meaningful Customer Impact**

* Support clinicians in developing confidence and capability in clear aligner treatment.
* Share evidence-based recommendations and best practices.
* Help practices improve patient outcomes and treatment experiences.
* Enable long-term practice transformation through technology and partnership.

**What Makes Someone Successful in This Role?**
**The Strongest PDMs Are**
**Growth Builders |**
They see opportunities where others see obstacles.
  
  
**Strategic Thinkers |**
They manage territories like businesses.
  
  
**Trusted Advisors |**
They earn credibility with customers through insight and partnership.
  
  
**Digital Advocates |**
They help customers embrace new technologies and ways of working.
  
  
**Category Creators |**
They help shape the future of digital dentistry by expanding adoption and influencing change.
  
  
**What We're Looking For**
**Who We're Looking For**
We would love to hear from professionals with experience in: Medical Devices | Healthcare Technology | Diagnostics | Capital Equipment | Dental Technologies | Orthodontics | Healthcare Solutions | Complex Consultative Sales
  
  
You will thrive in this role if you are: Commercially sharp and growth oriented | Highly customer focused | Curious and quick to learn | Resilient in competitive environments | Strong at relationship building | Passionate about technology and innovation | Motivated by business transformation rather than transactional selling
  
  
**A Message to Medical Device Professionals**
Many candidates initially view digital dentistry as a niche category. We see it differently.
  
  
While the category is specialized, the capabilities you build are broad and highly transferable. As a Practice Development Manager, you will develop expertise in strategic selling, customer transformation, digital adoption, territory leadership, commercial strategy, and market development.
  
  
**Digital dentistry is the category you enter. Healthcare transformation is the capability you build.**

Success in this role means:

* Expanding customer adoption of clear aligner treatment

* Turning customer insight into business growth

title: Regional Sales Manager (Pharma Testing)
description:
**Company Description**

* The QIMA and EFRAC Story

At QIMA, our Food Division is dedicated to helping every member of the global food supply chain ensure the safety and quality of food products, as well as safe working conditions and sustainable practices. With inspections, audits and certifications, we support food growers, producers and retailers, as well as businesses in food service and hospitality, securing their food products' journey from farm to shelf and fork.

Operating in over 100 countries, we serve the consumer products, food, and life sciences industries and help more than 30,000 brands, retailers, manufacturers, and growers achieve quality excellence.

EFRAC, part of QIMA group is a laboratory testing services company focusing on food safety, pharmaceutical quality control, and environmental monitoring.

What sets us apart is our unique culture. Our 6,000 Qimates live and make decisions every day by our QIMA Values. With client passion, integrity, and a commitment to making things simple, we disrupted the Testing, Inspection, and Certification industry. Are you ready to hop on this exciting ride with us and help us achieve our mission?

**Role in Brief**

We are looking for a motivated and experienced Regional Sales Manager to join our team and lead sales initiatives targeting Pharma Industries.

The Regional Business Development Manager will report directly to the Head of Sales and should have worked in
**TIC domain (Specifically for the Sale of Pharma Testing Services)**
for minimum 6 Years.

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of identifying opportunities, building strong relationships, and closing deals in
**the Pharma industry**
.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include:**

* Develop and implement strategic sales plans to drive revenue growth for the Pharma testing business. This includes identifying target markets, creating detailed marketing strategies, defining clear objectives to expand the customer base and increase market share.
* Partner and collaborate with industry stakeholders such as Pharma manufacturers, exporters, importers, regulatory bodies etc. Foster relationships with key decision-makers like quality assurance managers, procurement heads, and health and safety officials.
* Provide leadership and guidance to to the sales team, ensuring team members have the skills, knowledge, and motivation to achieve sales targets. This involves coaching, mentoring, conducting performance reviews, and facilitating continuous professional development opportunities to maximize team effectiveness.
* Evaluate and decide on new business opportunities and sales tactics by assessing market trends & competitor activities.

**Requirements**

To succeed in this role, you have:

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, Science or a related field.
* Minimum of 06 years of sales experience in ISO 17025:2017 accredited Lab/s for Sales of Pharma Testing Services to the Pharma industry.
* Proven track record of achieving sales targets and closing deals.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Hands-on experience
* Proficient in Computer Skills, CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience selling Pharma Testing Services to Pharma industry and strong existing network

If you possess the skills and experience required for this role and are passionate about driving business growth in the food industry, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity as our Regional Sales Manager.

**Qualifications**

**Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, Science or a related field.**

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
