title: Ecommerce Specialist
description:
Brand Head / E-commerce Growth Manager – Ecomhub24

**Company:**
FlixooLive – Ecomhub24

**Location:**
Kolkata

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

About Ecomhub24

**Ecomhub24 is the e-commerce enablement and brand-scaling division of FlixooLive.**

We partner with consumer brands to launch, manage and scale their businesses across
**Myntra, Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, Ajio and other digital marketplaces**
.

Our ecosystem combines marketplace management, cataloguing, pricing, advertising, inventory planning, warehousing, fulfilment, analytics and growth strategy.

Our vision is to build and manage a portfolio capable of generating
**10,000+ orders per day**
.

The Role

We are looking for a
**Brand Head / E-commerce Growth Manager**
who can take complete ownership of the growth and performance of brands managed by Ecomhub24.

This is not just an account-management role. We want someone who can
**think like a business owner**
, understand numbers, identify growth opportunities and build systems that can scale brands profitably.

Key Responsibilities

* Own the
  **monthly growth and overall performance**
  of assigned brands.
* Manage brands across multiple marketplaces and categories.
* Develop and maintain
  **brand-wise, marketplace-wise and SKU-wise P&L sheets**
  .
* Build effective
  **inventory planning, replenishment and stock management systems**
  .
* Develop
  **pricing, discounting, margin and promotional strategies**
  .
* Establish listing and cataloguing guidelines for different marketplaces.
* Monitor and improve product listings, content, keywords, images and marketplace compliance.
* Plan and optimise
  **marketplace advertising campaigns**
  .
* Track ROAS, ACOS, contribution margins and advertising profitability.
* Analyse sales, returns, cancellations, inventory ageing and SKU-level profitability.
* Identify
  **hero products, underperforming SKUs and new growth opportunities**
  .
* Coordinate with cataloguing, warehouse, operations, advertising and marketplace teams.
* Develop and maintain
  **SOPs, dashboards and reporting systems**
  .
* Conduct weekly and monthly brand performance reviews.
* Maintain proactive communication with partner brands.
* Ensure partner brands receive transparent reporting, actionable growth plans and strong operational support.
* Take ownership of
  **partner satisfaction, retention and monthly growth**
  .

What Success Looks Like

Over the first
**6 months**
, the objective will be to create the systems, strategies and execution capability required to scale selected existing brands towards approximately
**100–500 orders per day**
, depending on category, inventory and marketplace potential.

The larger Ecomhub24 mission is to build a diversified brand portfolio capable of generating
**10,000 orders per day**
.

Who Should Apply?

We are looking for candidates with hands-on experience in:

* E-commerce marketplace management
* Brand/account management
* Marketplace advertising
* Inventory planning
* Pricing and profitability
* P&L management
* Cataloguing and listings
* Sales analytics and reporting
* Marketplace operations

Experience in
**fashion, apparel, kidswear, lifestyle or consumer categories**
will be preferred.

You should be
**analytical, commercially minded, execution-driven and comfortable taking ownership of numbers and business outcomes**
.

Why Ecomhub24?

We are currently building Ecomhub24 into a large-scale e-commerce growth and fulfilment ecosystem.

This role offers an opportunity to work directly on multiple brands, build processes from the ground up and grow into a larger
**leadership position**
as Ecomhub24 expands.

We are particularly interested in people who have experience
**scaling brands rather than simply maintaining marketplace accounts**
.

Apply

Please apply through LinkedIn with your updated CV and mention:

**Current CTC | Expected CTC | Notice Period | Current Location | Marketplaces Managed | Largest Brand/Account Managed | Highest Monthly Orders/GMV Managed**

**Ecomhub24 — E-commerce Enablement & Brand Scaling Division of FlixooLive**

title: Salesperson
description:
**Company Description**
Oncquest Laboratories Ltd is a leading clinical diagnostics organization that has evolved from its origins as the Dabur Research Foundation’s research entity in 2001 into a recognized leader in cancer and molecular diagnostics. The company offers one of the most comprehensive pathology test menus in the region, ranging from routine tests to specialized, super-specialized, and advanced genomic testing. With a national footprint of over 50 labs, 500 collection centers, and 2,500 service associates, Oncquest conducts more than 4,000 different tests using over 200 technologies. Its highly skilled team of doctors with a combined experience of more than 600 years, strong logistics, and Pan Asia presence make it a preferred partner for clinicians, hospitals, and research organizations. Promoted by the Burman family, the promoters of Dabur, Oncquest is committed to supporting patients and partners, including during health crises and pandemic conditions.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Salesperson role based in Rajarhat. The Salesperson will be responsible for identifying and developing new business opportunities, building and maintaining relationships with clinicians, hospitals, and diagnostic partners, and promoting Oncquest’s range of diagnostic and genomic testing services. Daily activities include meeting prospective and existing clients, explaining test menus and service offerings, preparing and delivering sales presentations, and following up on leads to achieve sales targets. The role also involves coordinating with internal laboratory and logistics teams to ensure smooth service delivery, managing client feedback, and maintaining accurate records of sales activities and customer interactions. The Salesperson is expected to stay informed about industry trends, competitor offerings, and emerging diagnostic technologies to effectively position Oncquest’s solutions in the market.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Demonstrated skills in consultative selling, lead generation, and closing sales in healthcare, diagnostics, or related industries.
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships with clinicians, hospital administrators, and healthcare partners.
* Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills to explain technical diagnostic services in a clear and accessible manner.
* Basic understanding of clinical diagnostics, pathology testing, or medical services; prior experience in laboratory or pharmaceutical sales is an advantage.
* Proficiency in organizing territory visits, maintaining client databases, and using CRM or sales tracking tools.
* High level of self-motivation, integrity, and accountability, with the ability to work independently and meet performance targets.
* Comfort with field-based work in Rajarhat and nearby areas, including regular client visits and occasional travel.
* Bachelor’s degree in science, healthcare, business, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional experience will be considered.

***Navitus Controls & Equipment Private Limited (NCEPL)*** is a niche technology company providing end-to-end **Condition Monitoring Solutions** for Electrical Assets. We partner with globally recognized manufacturers of monitoring devices, communication infrastructure, and analytical software to deliver integrated solutions that enable industries and utilities to transition from **Time-Based Maintenance** to **Condition-Based Maintenance (CBM)**.

Our prestigious client base includes IOCL, NHPC, Tata Steel, Schneider Electric, BHEL, NRL, ABB, Andritz Hydro, Voith, Kahramaa (State Utility of Qatar), and over 50 leading industrial and utility organizations. description:
**Position: Senior Accountant**

**Department:** Finance & Accounts  
**Designation:** Senior Accountant  
**Reporting To:** Accounts Manager  
**Industry:** Jewellery Manufacturing  
**Experience:** 5–8 Years  
**Qualification:** B.Com / M.Com / MBA (Finance)  
**Work Location:** Singur, Hooghly

**1. POSITION SUMMARY**

The Senior Accountant will be responsible for managing and overseeing the company's accounting operations, financial reporting, taxation, statutory compliance, and internal financial controls. The role requires strong technical expertise in accounting principles, taxation, financial analysis, and inventory management, preferably within the jewellery manufacturing industry.

The incumbent will ensure the accuracy, integrity, and timely reporting of financial information while supporting management in strategic financial decision-making and operational cost control.

**2. KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Financial Accounting & Reporting**

* Oversee day-to-day accounting operations and ensure accurate maintenance of books of accounts.
* Review and validate journal entries, general ledgers, vouchers, and financial transactions.
* Manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, and vendor/customer reconciliations.
* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.
* Ensure timely closure of monthly accounts and maintenance of financial records.
* Monitor cash flow, fund utilization, and working capital requirements.

**B. Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure timely preparation and filing of GST returns, including GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B.
* Supervise TDS calculations, deductions, payments, and return filings.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Income Tax, GST, and other statutory regulations.
* Coordinate with external auditors, tax consultants, and statutory authorities.
* Manage GST reconciliations, input tax credit verification, and related documentation.
* Support statutory, internal, and tax audit processes.

**C. Financial Analysis & MIS**

* Prepare periodic MIS reports, financial statements, and management dashboards.
* Analyse revenue, operating expenses, profitability, and cost variances.
* Prepare budget versus actual expenditure reports.
* Monitor receivables, payables, and ageing analysis.
* Provide accurate financial information and analytical reports to management.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimization and improvement in financial efficiency.

**D. Internal Controls & Process Management**

* Establish and monitor effective accounting procedures and internal financial controls.
* Ensure proper authorization and documentation of financial transactions.
* Identify financial discrepancies, control weaknesses, and operational risks.
* Review accounting processes to improve accuracy, transparency, and efficiency.
* Maintain confidentiality and integrity of all financial information.

**E. Team Coordination & Supervision**

* Supervise, guide, and review the work of junior accountants and accounts executives.
* Allocate responsibilities and monitor the timely completion of accounting activities.
* Coordinate with Purchase, Sales, Production, Stores, HR, and other departments.
* Ensure smooth communication and coordination across departments.

**3. EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION & EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Commerce (B.Com / M.Com) or MBA in Finance.
* Minimum 5–8 years of relevant experience in accounting and finance.
* Prior experience in jewellery manufacturing, jewellery trading, or a manufacturing organization will be highly preferred.
* Strong practical knowledge of GST, TDS, Income Tax, and statutory compliance.
* Experience in inventory accounting, cost accounting, and financial reporting.

**4. TECHNICAL SKILLS & COMPETENCIES**

* Advanced working knowledge of Tally Prime / ERP accounting software.
* Strong proficiency in MS Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and financial reporting.
* Sound understanding of accounting standards and taxation regulations.
* Knowledge of manufacturing and inventory accounting procedures.
* Strong analytical, reconciliation, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Effective communication, coordination, and team management skills.
* High level of accuracy, integrity, accountability, and professional ethics.

**5. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)**

* Accuracy and timely closure of monthly financial accounts.
* Timely completion of GST, TDS, and other statutory compliances.
* Accuracy of bank, ledger, vendor, and customer reconciliations.
* Timely submission and accuracy of MIS reports.
* Effective monitoring of inventory and metal reconciliation.
* Control over manufacturing costs, wastage, and financial discrepancies.
* Adherence to internal financial controls and accounting policies.
* Timely completion of audit requirements.

**6. ROLE EXPECTATIONS**

The Senior Accountant is expected to demonstrate strong ownership of accounting and financial operations, maintain high standards of accuracy and compliance, proactively identify financial risks, and provide reliable financial insights to management. The position requires a result-oriented professional capable of independently managing responsibilities while ensuring effective coordination with internal and external stakeholders.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
**Company Description**
Micro Precision Calibration is a global leader in instrument calibration services, standards compliance testing, equipment repair and sales, and asset management solutions. The company helps customers ensure their equipment performs as designed, reducing quality and productivity risks across more than 3,000 customers annually in diverse industries. Its expertise covers calibration of mechanical, electronic, and dimensional instruments measuring pressure, flow, power, humidity, balance, and more. With calibration labs throughout North America, Europe, and Asia and headquarters in California, Micro Precision offers a global network of ISO 17025 accredited, NIST traceable labs and support offices. The organization focuses on simplifying calibration workflows through industry-leading services and solutions.
  
**Role Description**
This full-time Business Development Executive role is based in Ahmedabad and follows a hybrid work model, combining on-site responsibilities with some work-from-home flexibility. The role involves identifying and pursuing new business opportunities, generating and qualifying leads, and nurturing prospects through the sales pipeline. The Business Development Executive will conduct market research, prepare proposals and quotations, deliver presentations, and participate in negotiations to close deals. Day-to-day tasks include managing and growing key accounts, maintaining accurate records in CRM tools, and collaborating with internal teams such as operations and customer service to ensure smooth onboarding and high customer satisfaction. The role also requires regular reporting on sales activities, forecasting, and contributing ideas to improve business development processes and strategies.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong skills in New Business Development and Lead Generation, with the ability to identify opportunities and build a robust sales pipeline.
* Solid understanding of Business and Account Management to maintain relationships, drive revenue growth, and ensure customer retention.
* Effective Communication skills, including clear verbal and written communication and confident presentation abilities.
* Experience or familiarity with technical or industrial services, preferably in calibration, testing, or related engineering domains.
* Proficiency in using CRM software and basic office productivity tools (e.g., spreadsheets, presentations, email).
* Ability to work collaboratively in a hybrid environment, manage time well, and handle multiple opportunities and accounts simultaneously.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in sales or business development.
* Prior experience in B2B sales or business development, especially with industrial or manufacturing clients, is an advantage.

title: International Business Development Executive
description:
**Company Description**
SimSquare Engineering LLP delivers precision-driven mechanical engineering solutions that support global OEMs and EPC companies across the full product lifecycle, from concept to manufacturing-ready deliverables. The company focuses on simulation-led design to provide optimized, cost-effective, and high-performance engineering outputs that reduce risk and accelerate project timelines. Core capabilities include product design and development, application engineering, CAD design and drafting, advanced simulation and CAE, process and system engineering, and structural and heavy engineering. SimSquare prioritizes manufacturing-focused outcomes, compliance with global standards, and flexible engagement as an extended engineering team. The organization serves industries such as Oil & Gas, Manufacturing, Process Industries, Renewable Energy, Water Systems, and Material Handling, positioning itself as a trusted partner for validated and high-performance engineering solutions.
  
  
**Role Description**
The International Business Development Executive role is a full-time remote position focused on expanding SimSquare Engineering LLP’s global client base and strengthening relationships in key international markets. Day-to-day responsibilities include identifying and qualifying new business opportunities, conducting market research to assess industry trends and customer needs, and developing outreach strategies to generate leads across target regions. The role involves engaging with prospective clients via email, calls, and virtual meetings, preparing tailored proposals and presentations, and collaborating with technical and marketing teams to align service offerings with client requirements. The executive will maintain a pipeline of opportunities, track performance metrics, support contract negotiations, and contribute to long-term business development plans to drive sustainable growth in international markets.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess skills in International Business Development and International Business to identify global opportunities and manage cross-border client relationships.
* Candidates should possess skills in Market Research to analyze industry trends, competitor activity, and customer needs in international regions.
* Candidates should possess skills in Lead Generation to build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective clients across target markets.
* Candidates should possess strong Communication skills to present solutions, conduct negotiations, and collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
* Experience in B2B sales, account management, or business development in engineering, industrial, or technology sectors is highly beneficial.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage multiple opportunities, and meet defined targets and timelines.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field; advanced qualifications in international business or marketing are an advantage.
* Familiarity with global engineering markets and comfort working across cultures and time zones is preferred.

The Sales Executive will be responsible for generating new business opportunities, identifying potential customers, handling sales enquiries, developing customer relationships, and supporting the sales process for Armstrong's industrial machinery products.

The candidate will focus on domestic and international customer development for FIBC, Woven Sack, Lamination, Printing, Bag Conversion, and Mulch Film Machinery.

* Identify potential customers, manufacturers, dealers, and distributors.
* Maintain a database of prospective customers.

B. Sales & Customer Handling

* Contact potential customers and introduce company products.
* Understand customer requirements and generate relevant enquiries.
* Follow up on enquiries, quotations, and prospective orders.
* Coordinate customer meetings and product presentations.
* Build and maintain long-term customer relationships.
* Support senior sales team members in order closure.

C. Sales Coordination

* Follow up on order status and delivery schedules.
* Coordinate with customers regarding machine dispatch and installation updates.
* Support the resolution of customer queries and complaints.

D. Market Research

* Monitor competitor products and market activities.
* Collect market feedback and share business opportunities with management.
* Support participation in industrial exhibitions and customer visits.

E. Reporting & Documentation

* Update enquiry and quotation status.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales reports.
* Maintain customer databases and sales records using Excel/CRM.
* Track pending enquiries and follow-up activities.

3. Required Qualification

* Graduate in any discipline.
* Diploma / B.E. Mechanical or relevant technical qualification preferred.
* MBA in Marketing will be an added advantage.

4. Required Experience

**1–4 Years of experience** in B2B sales, industrial sales, or machinery sales.

Freshers with excellent communication and business development skills may also be considered.

5. Required Skills

**Sales & Business Development Skills**

* Lead Generation
* Cold Calling
* Customer Relationship Management
* Sales Follow-up
* Negotiation Skills
* Business Development

**Technical & Computer Skills**

* Basic understanding of industrial machinery.

* Email communication.

**Soft Skills**

* Good verbal and written communication.
* Confidence in customer interaction.
* Strong follow-up and coordination skills.
* Positive attitude and learning ability.

* FIBC Machinery
* Woven Sack Machinery
* Lamination Machinery
* Printing Machinery
* Packaging Machinery
* Plastic Machinery
* Textile Machinery

title: Associate Director - Master Scheduling
description:
Associate Director – Master Scheduling
  
Milacron India
  
ROLE SNAPSHOT
  
Function Master Scheduling – Material & Production Planning, Logistics & SIOP
  
Reports To Sr. Director of Operations / Manufacturing
  
Direct Reports SIOP │ Material Planning │ Production Planning & Control │ Logistics (Inbound/Outbound, Import/Export) │ Stores (RM/FG).
  
Location Ahmedabad
  
Role Type Full-time, Senior Leadership
  
  
ROLE PURPOSE
  
The Master Scheduling function leads the integrated planning and scheduling backbone of the Injection Molding Machine manufacturing business. This role ensures synchronization across Material Planning, Production Planning & Control, Inbound/Outbound Logistics, Stores, and SIOP, driving operational efficiency, cost optimization, and customer delivery performance.
  
The position institutionalizes demand-supply balancing, ERP/MRP discipline, and logistics governance, converting business forecasts into executable production schedules and supply chain flows across geographies. The function serves as a primary point of contact for and liaison with sales, engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain.
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
Strategic Leadership and Policy
  

* Design standard operating procedures, best practices, and frameworks for the entire scheduling department.
* Align long-term operational goals with business objectives and financial targets.
* Lead, mentors, and evaluate a team of schedulers, planners, and coordinators.

Master Production Schedule (MPS) Oversight
  

* Directs the creation and maintenance of the high-level Master Production Schedule (MPS) over medium-to-long-range horizons.
* Balance demand and capacity. Evaluate the sales forecasts against facility, labour, and machine capacity to ensure realistic output.
* Risk management: Identify supply chain bottlenecks or resource shortages and run what-if scenarios to resolve conflicts

Material Planning
  

* Own material requirement planning aligned with production schedules.
* Implement and operate lean practices like VMI, JIT, ROP and Kanban to maintain optimal stock.
* Ensure timely procurement and availability of raw materials, components, and consumables. Provide rolling forecast to suppliers.
* Collaborate with supply chain team for import/export compliance and lead-time optimization.
* Decide and update safety stocks, Long lead time parts and Inventory control.

Production Planning & Control
  

* Develop master production schedules balancing demand, capacity, and inventory.
* Collaborate with design engineering, & supply chain team for ensuring sales delivery timeline.
* Monitor shop floor execution, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure adherence to timelines.
* Implement lean practices to minimize WIP and optimize throughput.

SIOP (Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning)
  

* Lead monthly SIOP reviews aligning demand forecast, production capacity, and inventory targets.
* Partner with Sales, Manufacturing, Supply chain and Finance to balance customer commitments with operational realities.
* Provide executive dashboards and scenario planning for leadership decision-making.

Inbound & Outbound Logistics
  

* Manage inbound logistics for raw materials and components, including import coordination.
* Oversee outbound logistics for finished goods, ensuring timely dispatch and export documentation.
* Negotiate with logistics partners to optimize cost and service levels.

Stores Management
  

* Drive transformation projects of stores activities i.e. Receipts, Location management, Warehousing and Material movement etc.
* Oversee RM, FG, and consumables stores with robust inventory control.
* Implement digital systems for traceability, cycle counting, and stock accuracy.
* Drive safety and compliance in warehouse operations.

Team Leadership & Capability Building
  

* Lead and develop a team of professionals across planning, scheduling, logistics, and stores.
* Build capability through training, mentoring, and succession planning.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

PROPOSED TEAM STRUCTURE
  
The Master Scheduling Head oversees the following direct reports and supporting desks:
  
Direct Report Key Focus Team Under
  
Production Planning & Control Build and monitor master schedules; ensure shop floor adherence and optimize throughput. PPC Engineers
  
Material Planning Align material availability with production needs; ensure timely procurement and supplier coordination. Planners & Coordination team
  
SIOP Balance demand, supply, and inventory through monthly reviews; drive forecast accuracy and executive alignment. SIOP Analysts
  
Store - RM + Inbound Logistics
  
Manage receipt, inspection, and storage of raw materials; streamline inbound logistics, operate milk runs, and compliance.
  
  
Store Team & Import / Logistics Executives
  
  
Store - Outbound Logistics (for FG & TP) Ensure timely outbound logistics and export documentation. Export / Logistics Executives
  
  
SUCCESS METRICS / KPIs
  
Planning & Control SIOP & Governance Logistics & Stores
  
On-Time Delivery (OTD)
  
Production schedule adherence
  
WIP reduction
  
ERP Master Data accuracy
  
  
Forecast accuracy (%)
  
Inventory turns
  
SIOP milestone closure (%)
  
Executive dashboard timeliness
  
  
Logistics cost optimization
  
Inventory accuracy ( >95%)
  
Import/export compliance
  
Safety & compliance metrics
  
  
KEY SKILL REQUIREMENTS
  
Skill Dimension What We Are Looking For
  
Technical & Operational Master scheduling expertise │ ERP/MRP systems │ Import/export regulations │ Logistics optimization
  
Analytics & Planning Demand-supply balancing │ Capacity planning │ Inventory modelling │ KPI dashboards │ Advanced Excel / Power BI proficiency
  
Interpersonal & Leadership
  
Cross-functional leadership │ Stakeholder management │ Team development │ Collaboration across Sales, Design Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing & Finance
  
  
Behavioral Process-driven │ Execution-focused │ Strong ownership mindset │ Decisive │ Continuous improvement orientation
  
  
EXPERIENCE PROFILE
  

* 15+ years of total experience, with 10-12 years’ experience in developing and maintaining a Master Production Schedule within a manufacturing environment, preferably in capital equipment or machine industry.
* Hands-on expertise in production planning, logistics, and SIOP.
* ERP/MRP system proficiency (JD Edwards, SAP, Oracle, or equivalent).
* Proven track record of leading large teams and delivering operational excellence.

EDUCATION
  

* Graduate/Postgraduate in Engineering (Mechanical / Production / Plastics preferred)
* Master’s in Business Administration (MBA) strongly preferred

title: Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
description:
**Job Summary**

Seeking an accomplished and strategic Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to lead the company's overall business growth, profitability, operational excellence, and market expansion. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of managing a business in the interior design, fit-out, construction, architecture, or allied industries, with strong expertise in business strategy, financial management, sales growth, and organizational leadership. The CEO will be responsible for driving the company's long-term vision, strengthening its market position, building a high-performing leadership team, and ensuring sustainable business growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Business Strategy & Growth

* Develop and implement short-term and long-term business strategies aligned with organizational objectives.
* Identify new business opportunities, market segments, geographical expansion opportunities, and strategic partnerships.
* Establish annual business plans, revenue targets, profitability goals, and performance benchmarks.
* Drive business expansion and strengthen the company's competitive position.

2. Financial Management & Profitability

* Take overall responsibility for business revenue, profitability, cash flow, and financial performance.
* Monitor budgets, operating costs, project margins, and working capital.
* Review financial reports and implement measures to improve profitability and operational efficiency.
* Ensure appropriate financial controls and accountability across departments.

3. Sales & Business Development

* Lead the development of sales strategies for residential, commercial, hospitality, and other relevant interior projects.
* Build relationships with architects, builders, developers, corporate clients, consultants, and channel partners.
* Monitor sales pipelines, order bookings, conversion rates, and revenue realization.
* Drive strategic client acquisition and key account management.

4. Operational Excellence

* Oversee sales, design, procurement, production, project execution, installation, and customer service functions.
* Ensure projects are delivered within approved budgets, timelines, and quality standards.
* Improve coordination between design, production, project management, finance, and customer relations teams.
* Establish systems for operational reporting, risk management, and process improvement.

5. Leadership & Organizational Development

* Lead, mentor, and develop the senior management team.
* Establish clear KPIs, accountability structures, and performance review systems.
* Build a performance-oriented and customer-focused organizational culture.
* Ensure effective talent planning, succession planning, and leadership development.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Engineering, Architecture, or a rrelated field.
* MBA or equivalent management qualification preferred.
* Approximately 12–18+ years of relevant professional experience, including substantial senior leadership experience.
* Proven experience in business leadership within interior fit-out, modular interiors, construction, architecture, or related industries.

* Strong commercial acumen, negotiation skills, analytical ability, and strategic decision-making capability.

description:
Position: Reservation Executive

**Company:** Bestinn Leisure and Hospitality Pvt. Ltd.  
**Department:** Reservations  
**Industry:** Hotel, Leisure & Hospitality  
**Reporting To:** Reservations Manager  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

1. Job Purpose

The Reservation Executive is responsible for managing hotel and hospitality reservations, handling guest enquiries, processing booking requests, and ensuring a smooth and efficient reservation experience.

The role involves coordinating with hotel properties, front office teams, sales and operations departments to ensure accurate booking management, maximum room occupancy, revenue generation and high levels of guest satisfaction.

2. Key Roles and Responsibilities

**A. Reservation Management**

* Handle incoming reservation enquiries through telephone, email, WhatsApp, online platforms and other communication channels.
* Process individual, group, corporate and travel-agent bookings accurately.
* Check room availability, rates, packages, inclusions and applicable booking policies.
* Create, modify, confirm and cancel reservations in the Property Management System (PMS) or booking software.
* Ensure timely communication of booking confirmations, amendments and cancellation details to guests.
* Maintain accurate reservation records and guest information.

**B. Guest Relationship Management**

* Provide professional, courteous and prompt responses to guest enquiries.
* Explain room categories, hotel facilities, amenities, packages, tariffs and special offers.
* Understand guest requirements and recommend suitable accommodation options.
* Handle guest complaints, special requests and booking-related concerns professionally.
* Ensure a positive guest experience throughout the reservation process.

**C. Sales and Revenue Generation**

* Promote hotel rooms, accommodation packages, holiday packages and additional services.
* Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities to increase revenue.
* Convert enquiries into confirmed bookings through effective communication and follow-ups.
* Support occupancy targets and revenue objectives.
* Ensure adherence to approved room rates, discounts and promotional offers.

**D. Coordination and Operations**

* Coordinate with Front Office, Housekeeping, Sales, Accounts and Operations teams.
* Communicate confirmed bookings, VIP arrivals, special requests and group requirements to respective properties.
* Follow up with hotels and resorts to ensure room availability and booking confirmations.
* Monitor booking status, payment details, deposits and outstanding balances.
* Ensure smooth coordination for guest arrivals, departures and special arrangements.

**E. Documentation and Reporting**

* Maintain daily reservation reports, booking registers and enquiry records.
* Track confirmed, pending, cancelled and modified reservations.
* Maintain accurate guest profiles and booking documentation.
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly reservation performance reports.
* Ensure compliance with company reservation procedures and operational policies.

3. Required Skills and Competencies

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong customer service and guest relationship management skills.
* Good telephone etiquette and professional email communication.
* Knowledge of hotel reservation procedures and hospitality operations.
* Basic understanding of room inventory, room tariffs, occupancy and revenue management.
* Familiarity with PMS, CRS, OTA platforms and reservation systems.
* Good knowledge of MS Office, Excel and email applications.
* Strong coordination, negotiation and problem-solving abilities.
* Attention to detail and accuracy in booking management.
* Ability to multitask and work under pressure.
* Positive attitude, professional appearance and a customer-oriented approach.

4. Educational Qualification

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Hotel Management, Hospitality Management, Tourism or Travel Management.
* Candidates with relevant experience in hotel reservations, front office or customer service may also be considered.

5. Experience

* Preferred: 1–3 years of experience in hotel reservations or the hospitality industry.
* Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in hospitality may also apply.

6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The performance of the Reservation Executive will be evaluated based on:

* Reservation enquiry response time.
* Enquiry-to-booking conversion ratio.
* Accuracy of reservation entries and booking confirmations.
* Number of confirmed bookings generated.
* Revenue generated through reservations and upselling.
* Guest satisfaction and service quality.
* Follow-up efficiency and enquiry management.
* Compliance with reservation policies and procedures.
* Coordination efficiency with hotel properties and internal departments.
* Timely submission and accuracy of reservation reports.

7. Personal Attributes

* Guest-focused and service-oriented mindset.
* Professional and courteous behaviour.
* Strong sense of responsibility and accountability.
* Good interpersonal and team coordination skills.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to changing business requirements.
* Integrity and confidentiality in handling guest information.
* Flexibility to work in shifts, weekends and holidays as required.

8. Job Accountability

The Reservation Executive is accountable for ensuring efficient reservation handling, accurate booking records, timely guest communication, effective coordination with hotel properties and contributing to the company's overall booking conversion, revenue and guest satisfaction objectives.

title: Applied Value Engineer- CPGR/CMT-NAM
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. You will be working with our most strategic customers, understanding their objectives and key challenges, and building Celonis solutions using the world’s leading Process Intelligence (PI) platform in combination with the largest AI and ML technology partners, such as Microsoft, OpenAI and Databricks. With Celonis’ Process Intelligence (PI) platform we feed operational context to AI so it understands our customers’ business and enables them to industrialize AI unlocking real ROI on AI deployments and at scale. **Key Responsibilities:**

**Requirements:**

* 3+ years of experience leading technical pre-sales, including defining AI roadmaps, building compelling ROI/TCO business cases and prototyping of machine learning and generative AI solutions.

**Nice to have (big plus):**

* Hands-on experience building agentic systems using LLM orchestration, RAG, function calling, and prompt engineering, while ensuring safety through rigorous evaluations and guardrails.
* Working knowledge of tools in the LLM ecosystem such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or other OSS packages.
* Experience in deploying and monitoring models at scale across major cloud platforms (AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, GCP Vertex)

**What Celonis can offer you:**

* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
* Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
* Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
* Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
* Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
* Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.
* Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
* Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
* Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

**About Us:**
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
  
  
Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

title: Solutions Consultant — Enterprise AI & Presales
description:
**Solutions Consultant — Enterprise AI & Presales**

**Company: Assistents.ai**

Assistents.ai helps enterprises use AI agents to connect business systems, automate workflows, and support business decisions.

We are looking for a senior, client-facing professional who can lead discussions with business leaders, discover use cases, and deliver compelling product demonstrations.

You should be able to understand how a business works, identify where AI can help, and explain how Assistents.ai can address the need. We will provide product training. You will bring strong business judgment, clear communication, and the ability to earn trust with senior leaders.

**The role**

Our lead generation partner arranges prospective client meetings. You will lead these conversations and help turn initial interest into a clear solution opportunity.

A typical meeting may start with a broad question: “How can AI help our business?” Your role is to ask the right questions, understand the underlying problem, and connect it to a practical solution using Assistents.ai.

**What you will do**

* Lead discovery meetings and product demonstrations with CEOs, CXOs, business heads, and technology leaders.
* Research each prospect’s business, industry, and likely priorities before the meeting.
* Understand current processes, systems, manual work, bottlenecks, and business goals.
* Identify use cases across functions such as sales, customer service, finance, operations, HR, and supply chain.
* Develop initial solution approaches during live discussions. Explain the proposed workflow, system connections, expected benefits, and areas that need further validation.
* Tailor demonstrations to the client’s priorities and adapt when new requirements emerge.
* Explain technical concepts in clear business terms. Handle detailed questions with confidence and sound judgment.
* Qualify opportunities by clarifying business impact, urgency, decision-makers, budget, and readiness.
* Prepare concise meeting summaries, use-case briefs, solution outlines, and follow-up presentations.
* Work with the founder, product team, and engineering team to define proposals and proofs of concept.
* Agree on clear next steps with the client and maintain progress after each meeting.

**What you bring**

* Proven experience in enterprise presales, solutions consulting, business consulting, or technology consulting.
* A strong record of leading discovery sessions and demonstrations for senior decision-makers.
* A professional presence, excellent spoken and written English, and strong listening skills.
* The ability to connect business problems, process changes, technology capabilities, and measurable outcomes.
* The ability to think clearly during live discussions and respond to questions beyond a prepared presentation.
* Working knowledge of enterprise systems such as ERP, CRM, analytics platforms, and workflow tools.
* Enough technical understanding to discuss AI agents, integrations, APIs, and data requirements with technical teams.
* Sound judgment about what can be demonstrated, what can be proposed, and what needs technical validation.
* Strong preparation, documentation, and follow-through.

**Experience that would help**

* Selling or consulting on enterprise SaaS, AI, automation, analytics, or digital transformation.
* Working with clients across multiple industries.
* Designing business workflows or helping clients improve operational processes.
* Developing business cases, proposals, and proofs of concept.

**What success looks like**

Clients leave your meetings with a clear understanding of the problem, the proposed use case, and how Assistents.ai could help. Demonstrations address their actual needs. Follow-up documents give our delivery team enough detail to assess the solution. Qualified opportunities move towards an agreed workshop, proof of concept, or proposal.

**What we provide**

* Structured training on the Assistents.ai platform and its capabilities.
* Access to the founder, product specialists, and engineering team.
* The opportunity to shape enterprise AI solutions across industries.
* Ownership of discovery and demonstration conversations with senior business leaders.

**How to apply**

Send your CV or LinkedIn profile with a brief example of a client discussion you led. Explain the business problem, how you developed the solution approach, and the outcome.

* As part of the selection process, shortlisted candidates will lead a simulated executive discovery meeting and deliver a short demonstration after a product briefing.

title: Sr. Strategic Account Technology Strategist - Global Accounts
description:
**Overview**
The US Professional Services team has the opportunity to help customers reimagine what’s possible with Microsoft technology and AI. As part of the team supporting Accenture, you’ll collaborate across boundaries, bring together the best of Microsoft, and help create lasting impact for a global customer.
  
  
As an Account Technologist supporting Accenture in India, you will develop and execute technical strategies that align Microsoft technologies with Accenture’s business priorities and client ambitions. You will combine deep technical expertise with strong business acumen to shape transformation roadmaps, identify growth opportunities, and orchestrate teams across Microsoft and Accenture. This opportunity will allow you to strengthen your strategic advisory skills, deepen your understanding of complex global business needs, and collaborate with one of the world’s most advanced customers and partners.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* You generate innovative business insights, orchestrate teams to develop insights, and apply expertise in customer business in alignment with customer goals.
* You act as the "virtual Technical Officer," providing technical guidance to teams, building and maintaining strong industry and client knowledge, and acting as the voice of the customer (VOC).
* You create mid- to long-term digital transformation roadmaps while ensuring the execution of technological strategy, providing analysis of customer needs, and translating customer business objectives to develop technology architecture.
* You lead industry and digital transformation acceleration to identify, create demand, and deliver customer solutions. You drive new opportunities, lead internal teams to accelerate customer digital transformation, and drive conversations regarding the value of Microsoft solutions over competitors.
* You help customer technical specialists sell Microsoft solutions. You map technical customer requirements and business scenarios to Microsoft technology platforms.
* You orchestrate internal teams and local partners to ensure sufficient technical resources for demand generation. You drive account planning to inform quarterly and fiscal objectives. You influence customer technology engagement by engaging technical resources of a customer, partner, and Microsoft towards the customer's digital transformation. You use existing and new readiness resources to support enablement plans for customer technology adoption at the national and regional leve

* OR related technical/sales experience
* OR equivalent experience

title: Solution Engineer
description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
  
  
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

**The Senior Alliance Solutions Engineer Opportunity**

Okta believes in Partners and, together with our technology, will help take Identity mainstream and consolidate our position as a Leader in the market.  Partner Solutions Engineers are dedicated to growing Okta business through the Channel, working closely with Regional Alliance Managers, Sales Representatives, Marketing and Partner Enablement.  As a Partner Solutions Engineer at Okta, you will have an opportunity to be a well-respected technical expert, building strong, long standing relationships with key Partners and Global System Integrators, supporting both global and India markets.  You will become your partners’ trusted advisor for anything Identity and Access Management related and will help them understand how Okta can best fit in their Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy, integrate with their current offerings, help evangelize partner solutions within the Okta field teams and lead our partners in building Okta practices that deliver exceptional customer outcomes.

*\*This role requires in-person onboarding and travel to our San Francisco, CA HQ office during the first week of employment.*

**What you’ll be doing**

* Build and manage technical relationships with assigned Partners and team with the assigned Okta Partner Account Team
* Drive incremental revenue through increased Okta solution sales with the support of Strategic Partners and their GTM strategies.
* Develop domain expertise and thought leadership regarding the Partners’ current areas of focus as well as in new areas for expansion
* Gather, track, and translate partner feedback to help steer the Okta product roadmap
* Deliver technical training sessions for Partners (leading workshops, demoing Okta features, explaining best practices and competitive differentiators)
* Field technical questions, inquiries and Request for Information from the Partners through in-person, virtual and office hours and provide support for building Partner COEs
* Establish and maintain technical expertise on current and developing Okta products and technology
* Provide oversight, guidance, and assistance during the Partners sales process (including RFP responses) to ensure mutual success
* Up to 25% travel in support of Partner, Okta and industry events

**How you’ll be measured**

* Direct and influenced revenue growth
* Partner developed and driven GTM Solution Offering driven into the market / their customer base
* Partner enablement and resource certification growth

**What you’ll bring to the role**

* 5+ years pre-sales engineering experience.
* Experience with implementing Okta, Auth0 or both
* An understanding of IAM / IDaaS competitive landscape
* Experience supporting or enabling partner ecosystems or alliances in cloud security, identity, or cybersecurity
* Strong presentation and communication skills at a technical level
* A passion to serve the partner as our customer and ensure their success within their customer bases.
* Experience with at least one standard network security protocol. (OAuth, OAuth2, SAML, LDAP, OIDC)
* Knowledge in one or more of the following areas: web (Javascript, HTML, frontend frameworks) development, mobile (iOS, Android) development, backend (Java, C#, Node.js, Python, PHP, Ruby) development, IP-based real-time communications
* Hands-on experience in cloud computing environments (AWS, GCP, Azure)
* Confident dispensing knowledge to a highly skilled and experienced audience.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, MIS or a comparable field is preferred.

title: Senior Manager - FaaS Solutions, FinOps
description:
**Description**
The FaaS Solutions Senior Manager is responsible to assist Sales & Development team to bridge market demands with scalable products & solutions. This role engages cross-functional teams and external stakeholders, including vendors, sellers, and clients, to uncover systemic pain points and translate them into high-value service offerings and commercial models.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Opportunity Identification & Assessment
  
  

* Discovery: Conduct structured engagements with vendors, sellers, and internal operations teams to identify pain points, inefficiencies, and unmet needs within fulfillment workflows.
* Voice of the Customer (VoC) Synthesis: Consolidate feedback from external stakeholders and internal teams to surface recurring themes and prioritize high-impact opportunity areas.
* Service Opportunity Definition: Translate stakeholder insights into structured problem statements and service hypotheses that feed into the FaaS product roadmap.

Stakeholder Engagement & Relationship Management
  
  

* External Advisory: Serve as a trusted advisor to sellers and vendors, guiding them in articulating operational challenges and solution requirements.
* Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with Product, Operations, Delivery, and Sales to ensure proposed solutions align with organizational capabilities.
* Executive Communication: Present business cases, findings, and solution frameworks to C-suite and senior leadership with clarity and confidence.
* As-Is process walk-through: Lead and support prospect discovery calls, product and solution demonstrations to articulate value and advance deal progression.

Solution Design & Go-to-Market Development
  
  

* Solution Structuring: Transform qualitative feedback and identified pain points into repeatable service offerings, workflows, and value propositions.
* Solution Assessment: Evaluate third-party products for suitability alongside custom-build options, ensuring alignment with business processes, transaction flows, and functional requirements. Collaborate with Process SMEs and Technology teams to verify that HLD and LLD documents reflect business intent before development begins.
* Framework Development: Define scope of work (SoW), service level agreements (SLAs), staffing models, and technology requirements for new service offerings.
* Commercial Modeling: Partner with pricing teams to develop commercial structures that demonstrate measurable ROI for prospective clients.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 12+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
* 8+ years of creating process improvements with automation and analysis experience
* 10+ years of experience in Finance & Accounts (BPO) solution design.
* Demonstrated domain expertise in e-commerce, logistics, marketplace operations, or vendor management ecosystems.
* Strong consultative skills with the ability to identify root-cause problems through effective questioning and active listening.
* Analytical capability to synthesize qualitative stakeholder feedback with quantitative operational data to inform decision-making.
* Direct experience with seller/vendor ecosystems, marketplace platforms, or fulfillment and logistics services.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex operational concepts for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments and adapt to evolving market conditio
* Post Graduate in Finance/Accounts or professional qualification (CA, CS, CWA)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 8+ years of mentoring junior finance and/or business team members experience
* MBA, or CPA
* Experience with ML platforms such as Amazon SageMaker, Vertex AI, or equivalent.
* Familiarity with process mining tools and intelligent automation platforms (e.g., UiPath, Automation Anywhere).
* Understanding of responsible AI frameworks, risk assessment methodologies, and relevant regulatory requirements (e.g., EU AI Act).

title: Business Consultant – Financial Modelling
description:
**WE ARE LOOKING FOR A NEW COLLEAGUE:**
Business Consultant – Financial Modelling
  
  
**YOU AND YOUR TEAM:**
Business Consultant is a client-facing role in providing support on a wide range of LSEG Excel Add-in products. You will investigate and learn different segments of the financial industry depending on the clients' role and workflow. Our customers rely on our expertise to take their business decisions every day.
  
  
You will work with highly qualified colleagues and on a regular basis with Account Managers and Sales specialists in different locations. You will also have exposure to our customers, such experts as Research Analysts, Fund Managers, and Investment Advisors in large financial institutions around the world. Specialist will also be responsible for training the associates in the team on financial modelling
  
  
**WHY IS THIS JOB IMPORTANT?**
Specialist's daily tasks require creative approach using LSEG applications and financial knowledge. You will investigate and learn different parts of financial industry depending on client’s role and workflow. Our customers rely on your expertise to take their business decisions every day.
  
  
**SOME OF THE DAILY TASKS YOU WILL PERFORM:**

* Prepare custom, tailor-made analyses in Microsoft Excel / LSEG applications based on client’s requests
* Cooperate with sales teams in displacements of our competition (migrations from other products on the market, provide new revenue opportunities) and help in the retention of current clients
* Plan, prepare and perform migrations projects for huge, well known financial institutions (mainly work with customer’s financial models and charts, data conversion)
* Work on data presentations, analyses presentations, and functionality inquiries
* Provide creative solutions and a high level of service through telephone and e-mail

**WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BRING?**

* Fluency in English (both written and spoken)
* 2+ years of experience in Financial Modelling is a MUST
* Numeracy skills and analytic mind
* Advanced experience in using LSEG Workspace Excel Add-in (including Datastream for Office)
* Advanced knowledge about financial market
* Attention to details and ability to work with data
* Proved experience working with customers and internal stakeholders (SAM, Content, Product Management)
* Great communication and networking skills

**Career Stage:**
Senior Associate
  
  
**London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:**
Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.
  
  
Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of
**Integrity, Partnership**
,
**Excellence**
and
**Change**
underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.
  
  
Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.
  
  
We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.
  
  
You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.
  
  
LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.

description:

**JOB DESCRIPTION**
As a Senior Technical Account Manager, you will serve as a trusted customer advocate and technical advisor. You will understand customer business requirements, translate them into integrated technology and process solutions, and guide customers through cloud adoption and transformation.
  
  
You will provide leadership across the solution lifecycle, coordinate cross-functional teams, and help customers deploy and optimize Oracle Cloud workloads. This role combines technical depth, customer relationship management, and program delivery expertise to drive successful customer outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with customers to understand business goals, technical requirements, challenges, and desired outcomes, then translate them into practical solution designs.
* Conduct fit-gap assessments and develop roadmaps for transitioning, implementing, and optimizing customer solutions.
* Define and align the functional and technical vision for program solutions with customer and internal stakeholders.
* Lead end-to-end delivery across requirements intake, solution design, build, testing, deployment, and go-live activities.
* Guide deployment of customer workloads to Oracle Cloud, support cloud-adoption models, and recommend actions to overcome delivery blockers.
* Align customer solutions with Oracle product roadmaps, release cycles, business enhancements, and production break-fix requirements.
* Collaborate with portfolio management and cross-functional teams, including business analysts, integration specialists, quality assurance, development, support, services, and third-party partners.
* Communicate technical concepts, solution options, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Support strategic planning, program direction, customer satisfaction, and successful delivery of IT solutions within agreed timelines and budgets.

**Responsibilities**
**Qualifications & Skills**
**Mandatory**

* 8 years of experience in a customer-facing, consultative, or technology-related role; or an equivalent combination of education and experience:

+ Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Information Systems, or a related field plus 4 years of relevant experience.
+ Master’s degree in Business, Computer Information Systems, or a related field plus 2 years of relevant experience.
+ Doctorate in Business, Computer Information Systems, or a related field.

* 5–15 years of IT industry experience, including at least 3 years of demonstrated OCI experience.
* Strong understanding of Oracle products, including Fusion applications, OCI, and on-premises offerings.
* Ability to translate business requirements into system, application, process, and solution designs.
* Experience leading business analysis, business-process design, and software development lifecycle activities.
* Demonstrated ability to assess technology assumptions, identify systems, subsystems, and interfaces, and evaluate solution alternatives.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to consider broader cross-module impacts.
* Proven customer service and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, and organizational skills.
* Ability to build effective working relationships across business and IT teams in a collaborative, remote environment.
* Ability to travel to customer locations and internal sessions up to 25%.

**Good-to-Have**

* Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Relevant cloud certifications.
* One full cloud implementation lifecycle.
* Experience with IT service management.
* Experience with account management.
* Experience working with operating budgets or project financials.
* Familiarity with the CSS service portfolio across cloud and on-premises services.

**Self-Assessment Questions**

* Do I have experience working directly with customers to understand their business needs and translate them into technology solutions?
* Have I supported or led cloud adoption, implementation, or migration activities involving Oracle Cloud Infrastructure?
* Can I guide stakeholders through requirements, design, build, testing, deployment, and go-live activities?
* Am I comfortable collaborating with technical and non-technical teams to resolve blockers and keep a program on track?
* Can I clearly explain technical options, risks, and recommendations to customer stakeholders at different levels?

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. title: Applied AI Solutions Architect
description:
Join phData, a remote-first data and AI consultancy company with employees across the United States, Latin America, and India. We partner with industry leaders, including Snowflake, AWS, Anthropic, Glean, and dbt, to solve the complex data and AI challenges that slow large enterprises.
  
  
We're growing fast, and we give our people real ownership over their work. We hire top performers and trust them to deliver results.
  
  
**Why phData?**

* Snowflake Implementation Partner of the Year — 7 consecutive years, and 2026 Snowflake AI Partner of the Year
* AWS Premier Tier Services Partner — the highest tier of recognition in the AWS Partner Network
* 2025 Fivetran Partner of the Year (4th consecutive year)
* 2025 dbt Labs Partner of the Year (3x winner) with Visionary partner status
* 2026 KNIME Customer Excellence Partner of the Year
* Preferred Partner in the Anthropic Claude Partner Network
* #1 Partner in Snowflake Advanced Certifications
* 600+ Expert Cloud Certifications (Sigma, AWS, Azure, Dataiku, and more)
* Recognized as an award-winning workplace in the US, India and LATAM

We are looking for an Applied AI Solutions Architect to join our Applied AI team in our Agentic Delivery Center. In this role, you will lead the architecture and hands-on implementation of high-impact, production-ready agentic AI solutions that reason, retrieve, act, and integrate with enterprise systems to deliver measurable business outcomes. You will partner closely with clients, forward-deployed engineers, data engineers, and platform teams to design reusable accelerators, set technical standards, and deliver high-quality engagements that drive real business results.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Agentic Architecture & Client Delivery**

* Own and drive end-to-end architecture, solution design, and delivery of agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients across diverse industries.
* Design and build reusable agentic accelerators and reference architectures aligned with the Intelligence Platform that can be deployed across multiple clients in a fixed-price format.
* Translate ambiguous business problems into clear agentic solution designs that align with the phData Intelligence Platform, methodologies, standards, and best practices.
* Architect production-grade agents emphasizing reliability, scalability, security, observability, and evaluation and guardrail strategies for safe, accurate performance. before and after deployment.
* Ensure engagements are delivered on time, within scope, and with measurable business value for clients.

**Collaboration & Leadership**

* Collaborate with others to shape the architectural standards for how agentic capabilities and accelerators are built and deployed at clients.
* Design and build reusable agentic accelerators and reference architectures aligned with the Intelligence Platform that can be deployed across multiple clients.
* Establish the foundation of our India Agentic Delivery Center, by developing patterns, tooling, and ways of working that scale.
* Engage with cross-functional partners, including forward-deployed engineers, data scientists, data engineers, platform/DevOps engineers, and business stakeholders, to deliver successful client engagements.
* Ensure high quality in deliverables through code reviews, documentation, testing, governance, and adherence to security and compliance standards.
* Partner with practice and account leaders to identify opportunities to expand engagements, improve delivery, and standardize patterns for deploying and operating AI solutions.

**Practice & Firm Contribution**

* Contribute to internal initiatives such as IP development, accelerators, reference architectures, templates, playbooks, and training related to AI engineering.
* Represent phData with professionalism in all interactions, communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Additional Responsibilities
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, shaping roadmaps, influencing strategic decisions, and guiding long-term initiatives.
* Mentor and coach team members, fostering a culture of learning, feedback, and continuous improvement.
* Help define and refine practice standards, reusable assets, and delivery frameworks.

**About You**
You are a technical leader and client-focused consultant who enjoys turning complex, ambiguous problems into robust, production-ready agentic systems. You are opinionated and prescriptive about how good agents are built, comfortable working across data, infrastructure, and application layers, and energized by a zero-to-one environment where you are the technical bar. You thrive in an outcomes-driven environment, partnering with clients to engineers to design and build architectures that are performant, secure, scalable, and maintainable.
  
  
**Required Qualifications Experience**
6+ years of experience as an AI Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, Software Engineer, or Data Engineer building and deploying production AI/ML solutions, including recent hands-on experience building LLM-powered or agentic applications.
  
  
**Technical / Functional Skills**

* Hands-on understanding of Large Language Models, agentic architectures, and retrieval frameworks (RAG), including prompt design, context engineering, and tool/function calling
* Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (e.g. LangChain, LlamaIndex) and the broader agentic stack, such as multi-agent patterns, memory, planning, and protocols (e.g. MCP)
* Experience designing evaluation, guardrail, and observability strategics for LLM and agent systems (LLMOps/AgentOps)
* Hands-on experience in modern programming languages, such as Python, including developing APIs
* Deep expertise in cloud-native AI/ML platforms (e.g. AWS Bedrock and SageMaker, Azure AI/ML, Snowflake Cortex) with proven experience deploying solutions into production
* Complete software development lifecycle experience including design, documentation, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operations
* Demonstrated use of AI-assisted development tooling to accelerate delivery while maintaining quality
* Strong working knowledge of SQL and the ability to write, debug, and optimize complex and distributed queries.

**Consulting / Delivery Skills**

* Experience delivering projects for external or internal clients in a professional services or consulting environment, ideally in a fixed-bid capacity.
* Ability to break down ambiguous problems into structured, actionable steps and drive them through to completion.
* Excellent written and verbal communication English., with experience presenting technical solutions to clients and facilitating discussions with both technical and business stakeholders.

**Collaboration & Ownership**

* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with distributed and cross-functional teams across the US, LATAM, and India.
* Proven track record of taking ownership, managing multiple priorities, and delivering high-quality work with minimal supervision.
* Experience building reusable accelerators, modular codebases, or products deployed across multiple clients.
* Industry experience building AI/ML solutions in life sciences, retail, financial services, or manufacturing
* Prior experience working in global or remote teams and partnering across US, LATAM, and/or India.
* Contributions to open source technology stacks, technical communities, speaking, or writing related to AI and agents are a plus.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience preferred.
