title: EYP-Working Capital-Assistant Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- Parthenon – S&E - WCAS (Assistant Manager)**
**Working Capital Advisory Services (WCAS)**
WCAS is a cornerstone of EY's Transformation offerings to clients, working in tandem with other EY practices to drive top line and bottom-line growth with measurable cash benefits.
  
  
Our team is committed to improving the cash-impacting processes of EY clients globally. We aim to help clients enhance their liquidity, resulting in increased Free Cash Flow (FCF) from operations. Our approach includes in-depth analysis and benchmarking, data-driven diagnostics of Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, and Forecast-to-Fulfil processes using EY's market leading methodologies and tools, and interventions focused on liquidity, such as Cash Flow Forecasting support.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We seek Assistant Managers with expertise in Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), inventory optimization, and/ or supply chain management. Ideal candidates will have 4-7 years of experience in operational improvements with a strategic, transformation-oriented mindset, demonstrated by:
  
  

* Analyzing market/industry trends.
* Ideating from the client's perspective and strategizing with a 'big picture' approach.
* Aligning with client objectives for value, differentiation, ease of implementation, and long-term enablement.
* Experience in key sectors (e.g., Life Sciences and Healthcare, Advanced Manufacturing/ Industrials, Technology, Consumer Products or Retail).
* An end-to-end and transformational approach during pursuits, proposals, and engagements.

As a contributor to our performance improvement, and strategic growth initiatives, you will use your advanced skills in operational and financial data modelling to provide strategic insights to clients and internal stakeholders
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support in executing WCAS engagements either individually or as part of a team to support key conclusions in developing and executing Working Capital optimization opportunities, support strategy and process optimization programs and Cash positioning
* Analyze historical transactional and financial data and market trends to create accurate and reliable opportunity and benefits measures
* Working closely with client teams and GDS leads to tailor models to specific client needs.
* Present deliverables and solutions to clients, clearly communicating assumptions, methodologies, and implications for their business.
* Contribute to the development of proposals and participate in client presentations for new business opportunities.
* Engage in continuous learning and development to stay abreast of best practices in Working Capital and Cash management
* Maintain the highest standards of quality and compliance with EY's ethical guidelines and professional standards.
* Mentor and guide junior analysts in developing their analytical skills and understanding of methodologies
* Data analysis with extensive use Power BI / Alteryx / PowerPoint and advanced MS Excel
* Working knowledge of AI assistants such as copilot for developing automation agents for business development and other use cases

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Inventory Management Expertise: Experience in inventory turnover analysis, just-in-time inventory practices, and demand forecasting to reduce holding and shortage costs
* Credit and Receivables Management: Knowledge of credit policies, credit analysis, and accounts receivable management through Quote-to-Cash process analysis and designing strategies to minimize days sales outstanding (DSO).
* Payables and Disbursements Management: Expertise in managing accounts payable and optimising the Procure-to-Pay cycle. Experience in implementing efficient payment processes to maximise days payables outstanding (DPO).
* Supply chain management: Functional knowledge and experience within Plan, make, source, deliver pillars of supply chain management is a plus
* Data Analytics: Experience in working with large volumes of transactional data to develop segmentation and opportunity models (Must have- Power BI, Alteryx/SQL, MS Office applications; Good to have - Python/R, VBA, Snowflake/Databricks)
* Experience of working with stakeholders in global landscape
* Excellent problem solving and interpersonal skills
* Willingness to Travel: Openness to international travel for business purposes.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Post Graduate degree in business, accounting, finance, engineering, computer science or related field from a premier institute with 4-7 years of applicable industry / analytics and/or consulting experience
* Track record of delivering performance improvement projects related to supply chain/inventory optimization, sourcing/procurement or sales/accounts receivable that deliver tangible results (cost take out, revenue growth, increased cash flow, etc.).

**What You Can Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EYP practices globally with running businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  
EY is committed to being inclusive in all dimensions of diversity to ensure every employee is able to be and bring their authentic self to work, every day.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Sr. Sales Manager
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION Position**:

**Senior Sales Manager – Sales, Tender Management & Client Coordination**

**Company:** SUNONIX INDIA PVT LTD  
**Department:** Sales & Business Development  
**Experience:** 5–8 Years (Preferred)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Location:** Bangalore  
**Languages Required:** English, Kannada, Hindi and Telugu

1. Job Summary

We are looking for a highly experienced, proactive, and result-oriented Senior Sales Manager to lead and manage the overall sales operations, business development, tender management, and client coordination activities.

The candidate will be responsible for handling key clients, developing new business opportunities, managing government and private-sector tenders, preparing commercial proposals, negotiating with clients, and driving the complete sales process from enquiry generation to order closure.

The ideal candidate must have strong communication, negotiation, leadership, and client-management skills, along with the ability to independently handle the entire sales function.

2. Key Roles & Responsibilities

**A. Overall Sales Management**

* Manage and oversee the complete sales operations of the company.
* Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual targets.
* Identify new business opportunities and generate quality leads.
* Develop new clients and maintain strong relationships with existing customers.
* Handle corporate clients, industrial clients, government departments, consultants, and EPC contractors.
* Drive the complete sales cycle from enquiry generation, follow-ups, negotiation, order confirmation, and business closure.
* Monitor sales performance, revenue generation, and target achievements.
* Prepare sales forecasts, MIS reports, and business development plans.

**B. Client Coordination & Relationship Management**

* Independently handle client communications, meetings, and business discussions.
* Understand client requirements and coordinate with internal technical and operations teams.
* Conduct client visits, presentations, and commercial negotiations.
* Maintain long-term business relationships and ensure customer satisfaction.
* Handle client queries, complaints, escalations, and commercial discussions.
* Coordinate with clients for quotations, purchase orders, payments, and project-related requirements.
* Ensure timely follow-ups and professional communication with all clients.

**C. Tender Management & Business Development**

* Identify and monitor relevant government, PSU, corporate, and private-sector tenders.
* Independently handle the complete tendering process from identification to submission.
* Review tender documents, eligibility criteria, technical specifications, BOQ, and commercial terms.
* Coordinate for EMD, PBG, tender fees, and other required documentation.
* Prepare and coordinate technical and commercial tender submissions.
* Ensure compliance with tender conditions, submission deadlines, and documentation requirements.
* Coordinate with technical, finance, and management teams for tender preparation and approvals.
* Participate in pre-bid meetings, client discussions, and tender negotiations.
* Track tender status, results, and follow up for work orders.

**D. Quotation & Commercial Management**

* Review client requirements and coordinate for technical and commercial quotations.
* Ensure accurate pricing, costing, margins, and commercial terms.
* Handle price negotiations and close business deals.
* Follow up on submitted quotations and convert enquiries into confirmed orders.
* Coordinate for PO release, contract finalization, invoicing, and payment follow-ups.

**E. Team Management & Internal Coordination**

* Lead, guide, and monitor the sales and business development team.
* Allocate sales responsibilities and monitor individual performance.
* Coordinate with management, technical, project, service, purchase, and accounts departments.
* Ensure smooth communication between clients and internal teams.
* Conduct regular sales review meetings and provide management updates.
* Take ownership of sales targets and overall business growth.

3. Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong leadership and team management capabilities.
* Excellent communication and client-handling skills.
* Strong negotiation, presentation, and business closure skills.
* Thorough knowledge of tendering and bidding procedures.
* Ability to independently manage the complete sales cycle.
* Strong commercial understanding, costing, and pricing knowledge.
* Excellent follow-up, coordination, and decision-making abilities.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, email, and tender portals.
* Ability to work under pressure and achieve business targets.

4. Language Requirements

The candidate must have strong verbal communication skills in:

* English – Mandatory
* Kannada – Mandatory
* Hindi – Mandatory
* Telugu – Mandatory

Ability to communicate professionally with clients, vendors, government officials, and internal teams in the above languages is essential.

5. Educational Qualification

* Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, or a relevant discipline.
* MBA in Sales & Marketing will be an added advantage.

6. Preferred Industry Experience

Candidates with experience in the following industries will be preferred:

* Water Treatment – RO, STP, WTP and ETP.
* Solar Energy and Renewable Energy.
* HVAC, Heat Pump and Hot Water Systems.
* EPC Projects and Industrial Services.
* Government and Corporate Tendering.
* Technical Sales and Project-Based Business Development.

7. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Achievement of monthly and annual sales targets.
* New client acquisition and business generation.
* Tender identification and successful tender submissions.
* Tender conversion and order closure ratio.
* Revenue growth and profitability.
* Client retention and relationship management.
* Timely quotation submission and follow-ups.
* Outstanding payment follow-ups and collection coordination.
* Sales team performance and productivity.

8. Expected Candidate Profile

We are looking for a confident, mature, and commercially strong professional who can independently take ownership of the company's complete sales activities.

The candidate should be capable of handling clients, leading the sales team, managing tenders, negotiating commercial deals, developing new business, and coordinating with all internal departments.

**The selected candidate will be expected to take complete responsibility for sales growth, tender management, client relationships, and overall business development of the company.**

Pay: ₹45,000.00 - ₹52,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Food provided

title: SAP Architect
description:
**About Refold AI**

Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants.

We've grown rapidly, reaching seven-figure ARR and 30+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM.

Refold AI has raised $6.5M from world-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital.

**About this role**

The SAP Architect is Refold’s resident SAP expert who owns the architecture for our hardest enterprise SAP problems. You’ve spent years working with SAP ecosystems, understand SAP architecture and enterprise processes inside out, and have a deep, hands-on command of SAP systems, data models, APIs, and how SAP connects with the broader enterprise technology landscape. You set the technical approach where there’s no playbook and serve as the primary technical point of contact for enterprise accounts on SAP architecture and implementations.

* **Team:** Senior technical IC role within the delivery org, owning SAP architecture and enterprise implementations.
* **Building**: Mission-critical agentic AI integrations involving complex SAP environments at enterprise scale — the problems for which no playbook exists yet.
* **You’ll work with:** CTOs, CIOs, VPs of Engineering, SAP leaders, and enterprise architecture teams at Fortune 500 enterprises and $50M+ ARR software companies.

**What you'll do:**

* Own the architecture for the hardest SAP problems. Design complex, mission-critical solutions involving SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP BTP, and other enterprise systems, addressing complex business processes, data flows, and cross-system dependencies, especially where no playbook exists yet.
* Be the technical POC for enterprise accounts. Serve as the senior SAP technical voice enterprise customers trust and the technical owner of their most important SAP architecture and implementation initiatives.
* Make the decisive technical calls. Own the hard decisions on SAP system architecture, data modelling, integration patterns, extensibility, agentic orchestration, authentication, error handling, and performance under real enterprise load.
* Speak credibly to enterprise security. Be the trusted technical voice with customers’ security and compliance teams on SAP security models, role-based access controls, SSO, VPC, mTLS, and our SOC 2 Type II / ISO 27001 / ISO 42001 / HIPAA posture.
* Shape product direction. Be the most credible field voice in the room. Translate patterns observed across SAP implementations, customer accounts, and deals into identified gaps, reference architectures, and durable product bets, partnering directly with Product and Engineering on the roadmap.
* Codify what works. Turn hard-won learnings into SAP reference architectures, implementation patterns, solution blueprints, and runbooks that scale across the delivery team and feed the support knowledge base.
* Bring architecture expertise to high-stakes deals. Partner with pre-sales on the prospects where getting the SAP technical approach right is what wins, leading architecture reviews, solution design discussions, and technical deep dives.

**What we're looking for:**

* 6–10 years of experience in SAP architecture, SAP technical consulting, or enterprise solutions architecture, with a substantial, demonstrable background in designing and delivering complex SAP solutions.
* Mandatory hands-on SAP experience with enterprise SAP environments, including SAP S/4HANA and/or SAP ECC, and a strong understanding of SAP architecture, implementation approaches, and enterprise business processes.
* Excellent, deep understanding of SAP integration capabilities and technologies, including SAP BTP Integration Suite, SAP APIs, OData, IDocs, RFCs, BAPIs, and relevant integration patterns.
* A deep technical problem-solver who designs solutions from first principles for problems that have no established answer.
* Deep expertise in SAP solution architecture, SAP data models, enterprise application landscapes, and modern cloud infrastructure.
* Strong technical communication; credible as the senior technical voice with CIOs, CTOs, VPs of Engineering, SAP leaders, and enterprise architects.
* Startup-grade agency, high ownership, low ego, comfortable building the playbook as you go.

**Nice to have:**

* Hands-on experience with LLMs and agentic frameworks (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models, agent orchestration).
* Prior principal/staff SAP architect, lead SAP technical consultant, enterprise solutions architect, or founding solutions engineer role at a high-growth enterprise startup.
* Direct experience with SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP BTP, SAP Fiori, SAP ABAP, and SAP business processes across finance, procurement, supply chain, or other enterprise functions.
* Experience with SAP integration and middleware technologies, including SAP CPI / SAP Integration Suite, alongside platforms such as Workato, Boomi, or MuleSoft.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, and Azure), containerised environments (Docker and Kubernetes), and modern data infrastructure.

title: Senior Solutions Engineer
description:
**About Refold**

Enterprise integrations are still built by hand, one customer at a time, by a human supply chain of consultants. We think that's the last big software category that hasn't been automated — and we're automating it.

Refold is the AI integration delivery layer. Our agents build, test, deploy, and maintain integration workflows inside our customers' own products, white-labeled, up to 90% faster. Trained on millions of real-world contexts across SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, and Salesforce, we turn integration work that used to take quarters into days — and then keep it running, because the agents detect failures and repair mappings themselves.

Traction: 30+ paying enterprise customers, 1,500+ active users, 10M+ API calls processed daily, seven-figure ARR. Customers include Incorta, Kantata, Coupa, Naehas, OvationCXM, and Zycus. The results are the pitch: Kantata ships integrations 75% faster with 8x delivery capacity; Incorta cut time-to-go-live by 70% and recovered 8,000+ engineering hours; Naehas went from 3–5-month builds to 90% faster delivery.

Refold was founded by Jugal Anchalia and Abhishek Kumar, who have been featured in Forbes 30 Under 30. We've raised $6.5M led by Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber) and Tidal Ventures, with Better Capital, Ahead VC, Karman Ventures, Z21 Ventures, and Titan Ventures participating.

We're assembling a founding team of people who learn fast, raise the bar, and shape the company from day one. This is the second AE seat in the US and the first hired to build the motion, not inherit it.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Own the technical win:** Lead discovery, demos, and architecture conversations from first call to signature. When a deal is won or lost on technical confidence, that outcome is yours
* **Build the proof, don't slide it:** Stand up working prototypes against the customer's actual systems and messy data — SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce. Our product is the demo; a deck is a fallback, not a strategy
* **Run crisp POCs:** Design focused evaluations with explicit success criteria, timelines, and exit conditions. We're deliberately moving away from 4-week POCs — help us prove value in days
* **Speak both languages:** Translate schema mapping, auth flows, multi-tenancy, and in-tenant deployment into terms a CTO trusts and a VP of Professional Services can build a business case on
* **Clear security and procurement:** Own architecture reviews, security questionnaires, and RFP/RFI responses. Air-gapped, in-tenant deployment is one of our strongest cards — know how to play it
* **Hand off clean:** Partner with Delivery and our Forward Deployed Engineers so every go-live starts from a real technical plan, not a rediscovery exercise
* **Feed the platform:** You'll be one of our highest-signal sources of product truth. Surface the gaps and friction you hit in the field and push them into the roadmap
* **Build the SE motion:** Turn what works into a demo library, discovery framework, POC playbook, reference architectures, and competitive teardowns against iPaaS incumbents

**Role Information:**

* **Partners with:** The founding AE team and the founders directly; backed by Forward Deployed Engineers and Delivery
* **Average deal size:** $50–100K land / $200–300K expand
* **Average deal cycle:** 3–6 months
* **Technical buyers you'll face:** CTOs, CPOs, VPs of Product, VPs of Professional Services / Delivery, plus platform architects and security reviewers
* **Ideal customer:** Sales-led with an integrations page, an internal PS team or SI dependency, and enterprise deals that hinge on connectors
* **Competitive set:** iPaaS and middleware incumbents (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, SnapLogic) and in-house build
* **Current growth team:** 1 BDR, 1 AE, 2 Marketing, 4 Post-Sale, plus a 20-person engineering and delivery org

**Required Skills & Abilities**

* **Proven SE:** 5–8 years in solutions engineering, pre-sales, or technical consulting at a SaaS, data, or AI company. This is a hard requirement — we're not training someone into the seat
* **Builder, not just a presenter:** Hands-on with APIs and data integration, and fluent enough in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript to build a working prototype yourself over a weekend
* **Enterprise systems fluency:** Real experience with systems of record — SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce, Dynamics — and the messy parts: custom fields, schema mapping, OAuth, retries, idempotency, why an integration broke at 2 am
* **Sales instinct:** You've sold to or with product and professional services teams at software companies and understand what changes when your buyer's customer is the end user
* **Room-ready:** You can hold a CTO's attention, survive a security review, and be the calm one when the demo environment misbehaves
* **High ownership in ambiguity:** No playbook exists yet. You'll write it while running live deals, and you'll be comfortable doing both at once

**Nice to Have**

* Background in iPaaS, middleware, integration, or data infrastructure — or a track record of selling against MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, or SnapLogic
* Hands-on with LLMs and agentic frameworks, not just familiar with the concepts
* Experience with air-gapped, in-tenant, or customer-VPC deployments and the security conversations that come with them
* Cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerised environments (Docker, Kubernetes)
* First-SE or early-stage experience where you built the function, not joined one
* Worked day-to-day with an offshore engineering or delivery team

title: Solutions Architect
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Senior Technical Advisor / Senior Solution Architect to

serve as a senior individual contributor and technical subject matter expert across strategic

customer engagements.

This is a hands-on role that spans both the sales and delivery lifecycle. The successful

candidate will lead technical solutioning, build critical components, resolve complex

implementation challenges, and remain accountable for the technical quality and successful

delivery of assigned customer solutions.

The role requires strong experience in low-code platforms, enterprise architecture, integrations,

hands-on application development, customer-facing solutioning, and technical delivery

ownership. The individual will also mentor the broader technical team and help strengthen

delivery capability, standards, and execution quality.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Solution Architecture & Development**

* Lead the end-to-end technical solution for strategic and enterprise customer engagements
* Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, maintainable applications and workflows
* Design and build complex low-code applications, workflows, integrations, data models, reports, and automation components
* Develop prototypes, proof-of-concepts, and reusable components
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex functional, technical, integration, performance, and security issues
* Establish development standards, reusable patterns, and implementation best practices

**Technical Delivery Accountability**

* Own the technical solution from pre-sales handover through implementation and go-live
* Ensure delivered solutions align with agreed business requirements, architecture, scope, and platform capabilities
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and delivery constraints early in the engagement
* Work closely with project managers and delivery leads to track progress, risks, and milestones
* Take ownership of technical escalations, working directly with internal teams and customers to resolve them
* Ensure successful handover, documentation, and knowledge transfer

**Pre-Sales Solutioning**

* Partner with sales and account management during opportunity discovery and solution qualification
* Lead technical discovery workshops covering business processes, systems, integrations, and security requirements
* Build proof-of-concepts and prototypes to validate proposed solutions
* Contribute to proposals, statements of work, effort estimates, and implementation roadmaps
* Communicate platform capabilities, limitations, and delivery risks clearly to customers
* Identify potential expansion opportunities based on customer needs and platform capabilities

**Project & Engagement Support**

* Take ownership of selected customer projects or technical workstreams as needed
* Support project planning, milestone definition, risk tracking, and status reporting
* Manage a limited number of smaller projects alongside hands-on solution responsibilities

Team Growth & Mentoring

* Mentor solution architects, technical consultants, and developers through pairing and hands-on coaching
* Create reusable solution patterns, development standards, templates, and technical documentation
* Contribute to hiring, onboarding, and technical evaluation of team members

Required Experience

* Significant experience as a solution architect, technical architect, senior developer, or technical lead
* Strong hands-on experience building enterprise applications on low-code/no-code platforms such as Kissflow, Microsoft Power Platform, OutSystems, Mendix, Appian, ServiceNow, Salesforce Platform, or similar
* Proven experience leading technical solutioning across both pre-sales and delivery stages
* Strong application development experience — workflow design, data modeling, business rules, UI, integrations, reporting, and automation
* Strong knowledge of enterprise integrations, REST APIs, web services, identity and access management, databases, and cloud platforms
* Experience troubleshooting complex technical issues through testing, deployment, and production stabilization
* Experience contributing to proposals, statements of work, estimates, and implementation plans
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills — able to work with business stakeholders, IT teams, and senior customer leaders
* Experience mentoring technical team members while remaining an individual contributor

title: Senior Account Manager
description:
Swiggy Dineout is building India’s largest dining out platform that processes more than 100M diners for its partner restaurants across its network for 21,000 restaurants in 34 cities and growing. We are striving to augment our consumer promise of enabling unparalleled convenience by helping diners explore restaurants across all categories - from QSRs, cafes, casual dining, premium, fine dining and more and offer the widest range of offers on restaurant bills through easy payments on the app. We are on a mission to change the way India dines out. If you are a foodie and equally passionate to redefine the experience of dining out, join our team to be a part of the Swiggy ride!
  
  
Dineout is present in 34 cities across India and we have partnerships with more than 21,000 restaurant partners where users can save up to 40% on their dining bills when they pay their restaurant bills using the dine out feature on the Swiggy app.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Summary -**
The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given
  
  
territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 40-60 lacs Gross Merchandise
  
  
Value (GMV) per month.
  
  
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
  
  
specific geographies assigned.
  
  
**Responsibilities -**
**Account & Partner Relationship Management**

* Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and co-ordinating with

internal stakeholders
  
  

* Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Rest Display Page(RDP) content is correct

and image coverage is high
  
  

* Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for

month on month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
  
  

* Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments etc.

to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
  
  

* Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and

partners at the restaurants
  
  

* Prepare the growth plans for each of the accounts being managed and gather competitor action

insights.
  
  
**Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:**

* Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance

metrics to the partner
  
  

* Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable

conversions and grow the business.
  
  

* Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition.
* Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts,

commission and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from dashboard.
  
  
Interaction with Stakeholders:
  
  

* Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page etc.), sales operations

(competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data etc.) and finance team ( reconciliation
  
  
of payouts, queries on GST etc, amount not credited to partner accounts etc.).
  
  
**Functional Competencies:**

* Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
* Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads

RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value
  
  
(AOV)Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
  
  

* Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise

transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Desired Skill:**

* Graduate with 3-5 years of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working

knowledge of English
  
  

* Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing

channels
  
  

* Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
* Effective communication skills
* Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
* Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
* Analytical, good Excel skills.
* The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
* Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions. Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
* Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal

drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.
  
  
**Additional Information**
**Visit our tech blogs to learn more about some the challenges we deal with: https://medium.com/swiggy-bytes**
**We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by the law.**

title: Manager - Pricing - Freight Forwarding
description:
**Job Description**
Ocean Export Pricing & Booking Management
  
  

* Develop and execute booking strategies aligned with volume, capacity, customer and profitability objectives.
* Ensure clear visibility of bookings, carrier allocation, capacity utilization and pricing commitments.
* Optimize carrier mix with focus on core carriers including Hapag-Lloyd, CMA CGM, MSC, COSCO and Maersk.
* Maintain spot business within defined thresholds and drive greater utilization of core carrier contracts.
* Monitor booking performance and proactively address capacity, rate and allocation gaps.
* Ensure timely and accurate updation of pricing, booking and performance trackers.

Carrier & Rate Management
  
  

* Manage commercial relationships with shipping lines and support negotiation of competitive ocean freight rates.
* Track market movements, carrier rate changes, GRIs/PSS and other relevant pricing developments.
* Provide regular market intelligence and pricing updates to Sales and network offices.
* Identify opportunities to optimize carrier selection and improve overall buying efficiency.
* Ensure pricing decisions balance competitiveness, volume growth and profitability.

Sales & Commercial Support
  
  

* Partner with Sales, network offices and sector teams to support new business acquisition and existing account growth.
* Develop pricing strategies for own accounts, new opportunities and special products.
* Support sales promotions across network offices, sectors and target customer segments.
* Provide timely and competitive quotations to improve business conversion.
* Maintain accurate quote logs and track business wins, losses and conversion trends.

Trade Lane Development
  
  

* Identify opportunities to develop and expand priority ocean export trade lanes.
* Analyse market trends, customer demand, carrier capacity and competitive pricing to identify growth opportunities.
* Develop strategies for new and special products and support their commercial penetration.
* Drive year-on-year growth across identified target trade lanes.

Volume & Profitability Management
  
  

* Drive FCL volume growth through effective pricing, carrier strategy and commercial support.
* Monitor contribution and EBITA performance across trade lanes, customers and carrier portfolios.
* Identify opportunities to improve yields, reduce cost leakage and enhance profitability.
* Work with Sales and Operations to improve conversion and profitable volume acquisition.

Performance & MIS Management
  
  

* Maintain accurate and timely monthly pricing and performance sheets.
* Ensure regular updates of quote logs, booking trackers, carrier allocation and market intelligence.
* Monitor business win percentage, FCL volumes, carrier mix and profitability against targets.
* Prepare periodic performance analysis and highlight key trends, gaps and corrective actions to management.

Branch & Product Maturity
  
  

* Work with target branches to improve ocean export pricing capability and product maturity.
* Provide guidance to branches on market rates, carrier strategies, trade lanes and pricing practices.
* Drive adoption of standard pricing processes and commercial best practices across eligible branches.
* Support branches in improving pricing discipline, customer conversion and profitable volume growth.

title: OEM Account Manager Hyderabad
description:
Are you…
  
  
Interested in working for an international and diverse company?
  
  
Interested in developing your career in a leading Printing, Coding and Marking industry?
  
  
Interested in working for a company that is dedicated to sustainability?
  
  
If so, read on!
  
  
It’s likely you have purchased or used a product touched by Videojet Technologies this week. From freshness dating to track and trace coding, our technologies help ensure products sold across the globe, in the food, beverage, pharmaceutical, and industrial marketplaces are authentic and safe for consumers to use.
  
  
We recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent. Diversity of experience and skills combined with passion is a key to innovation and excellence. Therefore, we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions.
  
  
You
*as an*
***OEM Account Manager***
are responsible for
  
  

* Overseeing the OEM accounts ; this includes; Sales Revenue, Order Booking, Daily Management, Collection, Coordination, Execution, and Customer Complaints. This role ensures alignment with organizational goals and objectives, facilitating efficient project management processes to drive timely and high-quality outcomes. You will join the OEM team. This team is responsible for driving OEM business through TOP, Existing and Prospect accounts .Managing sales growth through required Profitability and Margin Drive for the OEM vertical.
* Reporting to the Zonal Manager in the team, you'll work and collaborate closely with associates across departments to ensure seamless delivery.

You will be located at
***Hyderabad***
and will work in
*Remote/hybrid mode.*
**In this role, a typical day will look like:**

* Total 80% travel. Covering States Telangana and Andhra Pradesh. Majority of travel at base location in Hyderabad.
* Total 3 to 4 Nights per month (may be additional sometimes on need basis) away from base location/ home (Vijaywada, Vizag, Guntur, Etc.).
* Weekly 4 days in the field for customer visits.
* 1 day (mostly Monday) for Planning, office work, and Internal Calls (Forecast, Daily Management, Growth Room)
* OEM Account Manager owning revenue and account management responsibility of OEM customers in Hyderabad (Andra Pradesh and Telangana). Visit OEMs with planned agenda ensuring engagement with multiple contacts at multiple levels in OEM customer organisation.
* Developing a territory plan, sales call strategy, and growing and securing business in assigned territory or account set of packaging machines manufacturer’s
* Empower sales and technical team of OEMs

+ By providing them Sales tools like Samples, Return on Investment Sheet, Fight Sheet, Consumption calculation, etc.
+ By Technical presentations, Product demonstrations, Road Shows, Exhibition Placements

* Analyse territorial sales potential and develop strategies, utilizing regional commercial operation resources necessary to achieve customer service levels
* Actively seek and build relationships with new OEMS, while maintaining existing OEM relationships
* Monitor customer satisfaction and propose / deliver corrective actions
* Submit accurate and timely reporting of pertinent sales activities
* Keep management aware of commercial developments and trends, both product and market that could affect future business

**Key Responsibilities and Performance Indicators:**

* Driving Sales Revenue and Order Booking for assigned region
* Action plan execution to Protect and Expand Existing and Top OEM Accounts in assigned region
* Action Plan execution to Win and develop New OEM Accounts in assigned region
* Drive and meet Gross Margin Objective for the assigned region
* Relationship development with TOP, Existing and New OEM.
* Exhibition Placements on OEM machines
* Forecast Accuracy for Revenue and Order Booking
* Daily and Weekly Management Indicators (Opportunity Creation, Visits, Etc)

**KEY Skills/ Competences**

* Ownership Driven and Motivated: Own the responsibilities, business and performance with a strong desire to succeed and have determination to overcome challenges. Your proactive approach and resilience will be key drivers of your success in this role.
* Relationship Building Capability (Account Relationship Management): Effective planner and executor of agenda to ensure engagement with multiple contacts at multiple levels in OEM Accounts. Effective in connecting Right People at Right Time for Right purpose.
* Responsive: Effective in Timely response to OEMs with a balance of setting right expectations
* Team Player: Collaborate effectively with colleagues across departments, leveraging collective expertise and resources to deliver exceptional results. Your ability to build strong relationships and work collaboratively will be essential for success in a dynamic team environment.
* Interpersonal and Communication Skills: The ability to establish strong relationships with customers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams is crucial. Excellent communication and interviewing skills to accurately grasp customer needs, foster collaboration, and effectively convey product vision and strategic insights to senior leadership.
* Effective Project Management (Structured and Organized at work, Technically sound and Problem solving capability): Proficient in project management methodologies and techniques, with the ability to plan, execute, and monitor projects within the assigned program portfolio. Demonstrated experience in navigating complex project environments and overcoming obstacles to ensure successful project delivery.
* Attention to Detail: Possess a keen eye for detail and a meticulous approach to project execution, ensuring that all aspects of the project are thoroughly reviewed and addressed. Ability to identify potential risks and issues early on and implement proactive measures to mitigate them, thereby ensuring high-quality project outcomes.

*WE ARE LOOKING FOR A PROFESSIONAL WHO HAS:*

* Leadership Skills: Demonstrated ability to provide direction and to the cross-functional teams, driving alignment with organizational goals and objectives. The candidate should have the capability to translate business strategies into actionable project plans, ensuring the successful execution and delivery of projects.
* Effective Stakeholder Engagement: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, enabling the candidate to engage effectively with stakeholders at all levels, including senior management, cross-functional teams, partners, suppliers, and alliances. The candidate should have the ability to influence and negotiate to ensure project success and foster collaborative relationships.
* Integrity and Professionalism: Uphold the highest standards of honesty, integrity, and professionalism in all interactions, demonstrating a commitment to ethical conduct and sound business practices.

**The essential requirements of the job include:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Science (MBA preferred):

*This educational background equips the candidate with a solid foundation in both technical and business disciplines, essential for effective project management and decision-making in product development initiatives.*

* 5-8 years of experience in Sales:

*Candidates preferably should have an experience in Key Account management roles, particularly in the context of industrial products/ engineering products/ capital equipment/ machines.*

* Proven Track Record in driving techno commercial business:

*The candidate should demonstrate a successful track record of driving OEM accounts, including, Sales revenue and Customer centric approach . Experience in managing cross-functional teams and navigating project environments is essential.*

The NAND Component Applications Engineer team is looking for outgoing technical candidates to join our team. * Customer and Factory support for Application Qualification through communication of technical needs, issues identification and problem resolution
* Customer training of advanced error correction features and other advanced features
* Provide feature and specification guidance to internal SSD development teams

Creation of datasheet specifications related to our next generation NAND interface
  
  

* Creation of datasheet specifications related to our next generation NAND features
* Engagement with internal development teams to define and enable usage of our next generation NAND interface features and buffer chip solutions
* Engagement with external controller partners and customers to enable usage of our next generation NAND products and buffer chip solutions

Performance modeling and performance benchmark definition and measurement
  
  
Technical Failure Analysis Support at Factory and in the Field including but not limited to:
  
  

* Field Application Engineering technical support for customer problem resolution
* Direct Customer technical support for product use and enablement as well as problem resolution and follow up with factory or customer corrective action
* Guide application-oriented problem resolution with factory received RMA (assist QA)

* New Product and Feature Definition
* Training of the Worldwide Field Applications Engineers on the latest design features and their utilization
* Customer product feature use training to enable design wins and product acceptance of Micron NAND
* New Product and Feature Definition to differentiate Micron’s NAND products from the competition

**Qualifications And Skills Include, But Not Limited To**

* Bachelor or Masters Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer engineering or equivalent
* 5-10 years experience working with NAND Flash/semiconductor memories
* A solid background in high-speed I/O interface design or characterization (e.g., DDR3, DDR4, DDR5, LPDDR4, LPDDR5 or ONFI) strongly preferred
* Excellent problem solving and analytical skills
* Effective communication skills in written and spoken English
* Good multitasking and organizational skills
* Strong presentation skills, self-motivation and enthusiastic
* Experience using AI technologies to improve engineering productivity, workflow efficiency, and decision-making.
* Demonstrated ability in applying AI solutions to solve complex technical and business challenges.
* Proven track record of leveraging AI and automation tools to accelerate analysis, content generation, and process optimization.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead OT cybersecurity engagements end-to-end, from scoping through delivery, ensuring quality, timeline, and budget adherence.
* Own client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor on OT/ICS security strategy and risk management.
* Oversee design and deployment of OT security solutions, including asset management, network monitoring, segmentation, and secure remote access.
* Lead OT gap assessments, cyber risk assessments, and maturity assessments; guide teams in prioritizing and remediating findings.
* Drive proposal development, scoping, and pricing; identify and pursue follow-on opportunities with existing clients.
* Manage, mentor, and develop consulting teams, including performance feedback and career development.
* Engage senior client stakeholders (e.g., CISO, plant and operations leadership) and coordinate with engineering, network, cloud, and cybersecurity teams.
* Contribute to practice development, including methodology, tools, and thought leadership.

**Required Skills:**

* 10-15 years of experience in OT, ICS, industrial cybersecurity, or a related field, including experience leading teams and engagements.
* Proven experience managing multi-workstream projects and client relationships in a consulting environment.
* Deep knowledge of OT devices, network architectures, and industrial protocols.
* Experience with at least three of the following:
* OT asset management
* OT network segmentation
* Secure remote access
* OT monitoring or IDS
* OT Automation solutions
* OT incident response
* IoT security
* SCADA/ICS security
* Hands-on and oversight experience with OT cybersecurity platforms such as Claroty, Nozomi, Dragos, or equivalent.
* Strong command of ISA/IEC 62443, NIST 800-82, NISTIR 8183, NIST CSF, ISO 27001, and OT cyber risk management frameworks.
* Experience developing proposals, statements of work, and pricing for cybersecurity engagements.
* Track record of managing, mentoring, and developing junior and mid-level consulting staff.
* Experience presenting to executive and plant-level stakeholders, and building trusted advisor relationships.
* Ability to leverage GenAI and agentic AI tools to improve assessment, documentation, and delivery efficiency across teams, with appropriate governance and oversight.
* Understanding of AI governance and responsible AI controls in cybersecurity contexts.
* Strong business acumen, including budget and financial management of engagements.
* Excellent communication, executive presence, and problem-solving skills.

**Additional Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, Cybersecurity, or related field; Master's degree (MBA, M.Tech, or MS in Cybersecurity) is a plus.
* Experience leading proposals and business development in a consulting environment.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent engagements and teams.
* Willingness to travel based on client requirements.

**Preferred:**

* Certifications such as ISA/IEC 62443, CISSP, CISM, CISA, GICSP.
* PMP, Scrum, or similar project-management certification.
* Experience in Power and Utilities, Oil and Gas, Manufacturing, or Industrial Products.
* Experience with CyberPHA or OT maturity assessments.
* P&L or account management experience.

**Location:**

THE ROLE
  
  
The Technical Marketing Engineer for AMD-AECG is an adaptable, self-motivated individual who drives the Vivado and next-generation tool product roadmap to best serve customer needs. This role is responsible for feature specification, planning, validation, documentation, early training materials, and key customer support. THE PERSON
  
  
The successful Technical Marketing Engineer plays a critical role in defining, planning, and supporting
**Run-Time Reconfiguration (RTR)**
flows in the Vivado Design Suite for AMD FPGA and Adaptive SoC products. This includes maintaining Run-Time Reconfiguration Intellectual Property (IP), enabling advanced use cases that reduce compile time, ensuring compliance with PCI Express standards, and driving the next generation of the Vivado tool roadmap.
  
  
This individual understands customer requirements and pain points across Run-Time Reconfiguration, design partitioning, module reuse, and preservation-based incremental compilation flows, and translates those insights into innovative product capabilities. * Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to internal stakeholders and customers, including architecture, implementation tradeoffs, and design recommendations.

* Strong knowledge of the complete FPGA design flow and Vivado tool suite.
* Hands-on experience with Run-Time Reconfiguration or similar modular and reconfigurable design methodologies.
* Understanding of design partitioning, module reuse, incremental compilation, and preservation-based implementation flows.
* Expertise in System-on-Chip (SoC) development.
* Experience applying AI/ML technologies, including AI-assisted design, automation, debug, or agentic engineering workflows.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze and solve complex system-level technical challenges, both independently and in collaboration with strategic customers.

title: EYP-Working Capital-Assistant Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- Parthenon – S&E - WCAS (Assistant Manager)**
**Working Capital Advisory Services (WCAS)**
WCAS is a cornerstone of EY's Transformation offerings to clients, working in tandem with other EY practices to drive top line and bottom-line growth with measurable cash benefits.
  
  
Our team is committed to improving the cash-impacting processes of EY clients globally. We aim to help clients enhance their liquidity, resulting in increased Free Cash Flow (FCF) from operations. Our approach includes in-depth analysis and benchmarking, data-driven diagnostics of Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, and Forecast-to-Fulfil processes using EY's market leading methodologies and tools, and interventions focused on liquidity, such as Cash Flow Forecasting support.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We seek Assistant Managers with expertise in Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), inventory optimization, and/ or supply chain management. Ideal candidates will have 4-7 years of experience in operational improvements with a strategic, transformation-oriented mindset, demonstrated by:
  
  

* Analyzing market/industry trends.
* Ideating from the client's perspective and strategizing with a 'big picture' approach.
* Aligning with client objectives for value, differentiation, ease of implementation, and long-term enablement.
* Experience in key sectors (e.g., Life Sciences and Healthcare, Advanced Manufacturing/ Industrials, Technology, Consumer Products or Retail).
* An end-to-end and transformational approach during pursuits, proposals, and engagements.

As a contributor to our performance improvement, and strategic growth initiatives, you will use your advanced skills in operational and financial data modelling to provide strategic insights to clients and internal stakeholders
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support in executing WCAS engagements either individually or as part of a team to support key conclusions in developing and executing Working Capital optimization opportunities, support strategy and process optimization programs and Cash positioning
* Analyze historical transactional and financial data and market trends to create accurate and reliable opportunity and benefits measures
* Working closely with client teams and GDS leads to tailor models to specific client needs.
* Present deliverables and solutions to clients, clearly communicating assumptions, methodologies, and implications for their business.
* Contribute to the development of proposals and participate in client presentations for new business opportunities.
* Engage in continuous learning and development to stay abreast of best practices in Working Capital and Cash management
* Maintain the highest standards of quality and compliance with EY's ethical guidelines and professional standards.
* Mentor and guide junior analysts in developing their analytical skills and understanding of methodologies
* Data analysis with extensive use Power BI / Alteryx / PowerPoint and advanced MS Excel
* Working knowledge of AI assistants such as copilot for developing automation agents for business development and other use cases

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Inventory Management Expertise: Experience in inventory turnover analysis, just-in-time inventory practices, and demand forecasting to reduce holding and shortage costs
* Credit and Receivables Management: Knowledge of credit policies, credit analysis, and accounts receivable management through Quote-to-Cash process analysis and designing strategies to minimize days sales outstanding (DSO).
* Payables and Disbursements Management: Expertise in managing accounts payable and optimising the Procure-to-Pay cycle. Experience in implementing efficient payment processes to maximise days payables outstanding (DPO).
* Supply chain management: Functional knowledge and experience within Plan, make, source, deliver pillars of supply chain management is a plus
* Data Analytics: Experience in working with large volumes of transactional data to develop segmentation and opportunity models (Must have- Power BI, Alteryx/SQL, MS Office applications; Good to have - Python/R, VBA, Snowflake/Databricks)
* Experience of working with stakeholders in global landscape
* Excellent problem solving and interpersonal skills
* Willingness to Travel: Openness to international travel for business purposes.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Post Graduate degree in business, accounting, finance, engineering, computer science or related field from a premier institute with 4-7 years of applicable industry / analytics and/or consulting experience
* Track record of delivering performance improvement projects related to supply chain/inventory optimization, sourcing/procurement or sales/accounts receivable that deliver tangible results (cost take out, revenue growth, increased cash flow, etc.).

**What You Can Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EYP practices globally with running businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  
EY is committed to being inclusive in all dimensions of diversity to ensure every employee is able to be and bring their authentic self to work, every day.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

title: Key Accounts Manager – Cross-Border Payments (B2B)
description:
About GlocalPe™

GlocalPe™ is a B2B cross-border payments and financial infrastructure platform being developed by Dhaniti™ Fintech Solutions Private Limited. Its business proposition covers international
**pay-ins (collections) and pay-outs (payments)**
for businesses and ecosystem partners.

Dhaniti's broader portfolio includes DhanitiPay™, a platform combining UPI-led digital payments with responsible credit enablement. We focus on building technology-enabled financial solutions with an emphasis on trust, transparency, compliance, and reliable service.

About the Role

**Can you win new customers, activate their business, and grow the relationship?**

We are looking for a commercially driven B2B sales professional to acquire and grow customers for GlocalPe™.

This is an
**acquisition-led sales role**
, not simply an account-servicing position. You will identify businesses with international collection and payment requirements, engage decision-makers, win new customers, support onboarding and initial transactions, and grow the business routed through GlocalPe.

The role covers the complete customer journey:

**Prospecting → Customer Acquisition → Solution Selling → Onboarding → Activation → Account Growth → Retention → Cross-sell → Referrals**

What You Will Do1. Find and acquire new customers

* Identify and approach SMEs, enterprises, exporters, importers, and other businesses with cross-border payment requirements.
* Build your own sales pipeline through market mapping, direct outreach, referrals, industry networks, events, and professional relationships.
* Engage business owners, founders, CFOs, finance heads, and treasury teams.
* Understand customers' payment flows, transaction volumes, business requirements, existing arrangements, and pain points.
* Present suitable GlocalPe solutions, handle objections, negotiate, and close new business.

2. Onboard and activate customers

* Coordinate with Operations and Compliance teams to facilitate customer onboarding and documentation.
* Guide customers through onboarding requirements, payment processes, and transaction workflows.
* Help new customers complete their initial transactions and address barriers to activation.
* Follow up until acquired customers become active sources of business.

3. Grow accounts and increase transaction volumes

* Understand customers' eligible cross-border payment business and identify opportunities to increase the share routed through GlocalPe.
* Develop customer relationships to expand transaction volumes, frequency, and recurring business.
* Identify opportunities across both pay-ins and pay-outs, subject to product availability and customer eligibility.
* Monitor declining or inactive accounts and take corrective action to improve engagement and business activity.
* Develop repeat business, cross-sell opportunities, and referrals.

4. Deliver business results

* Own assigned targets for new customer acquisition, customer activation, transaction volumes, and revenue.
* Maintain a healthy sales pipeline and provide regular updates on prospects, conversions, forecasts, and business performance.
* Work with Product, Operations, Compliance, Treasury, and Technology teams to address customer requirements and resolve issues.
* Share market intelligence, customer feedback, and competitor insights to support business development.
* Follow applicable KYC, RBI/FEMA, and other relevant compliance requirements. Sales targets must never override compliance obligations.

Must-Have Qualifications

* **5+ years of experience**
  in B2B business development, enterprise sales, key account management, or relationship-led sales in fintech, payments, forex, remittance, trade finance, or related financial services.
* Proven experience in
  **new customer acquisition**
  , not just servicing an existing customer portfolio.
* A demonstrated track record of achieving sales, revenue, transaction-volume, or acquisition targets.
* Good understanding of B2B payment flows and the business requirements associated with international collections and payments.
* Experience managing customer relationships from prospecting and acquisition through onboarding, activation, and account growth.
* Ability to engage business owners, founders, CFOs, finance heads, and other senior decision-makers.
* Strong prospecting, presentation, negotiation, communication, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to independently build a pipeline, follow through on opportunities, and take ownership of business targets.
* Willingness to travel for customer meetings and business development as required.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with cross-border payments, international payments, forex, remittance, or payment platforms.
* Existing relationships with SMEs, exporters, importers, enterprises, or businesses engaged in international trade and services.
* Experience in trade finance, treasury, foreign exchange, or international transaction services.
* A professional network among founders, CFOs, finance heads, and treasury professionals.
* Familiarity with payment processing, APIs, integrations, reconciliation, settlement, or technology-enabled financial services.
* Experience growing transaction volumes, increasing customer share of business, and generating referrals.
* Exposure to CRM tools, sales automation, data-driven account management, or AI-enabled sales tools.
* Working knowledge of applicable RBI/FEMA requirements for cross-border payment activities.
* Availability to join immediately

You do not need to be a technology specialist, but you should be comfortable explaining payment solutions in business terms and coordinating with technical teams when required.

What Success Looks Like

* A consistent pipeline of qualified prospects and newly acquired B2B customers.
* Successful onboarding and activation of new customers.
* Growth in recurring transactions, transaction volumes, and revenue.
* Increased share of eligible customer business routed through GlocalPe.
* Strong retention, account expansion, cross-sell, and referral business.
* Achievement of assigned commercial targets while maintaining compliant business practices.

Why Join GlocalPe™?

* **Build new business:**
  Acquire customers and develop your own portfolio rather than relying solely on inherited accounts.
* **Own the customer relationship:**
  Stay involved from the first conversation through onboarding, activation, and account growth.
* **Work across payment use cases:**
  Develop experience across international collections, payments, and B2B financial infrastructure.
* **Grow with the business:**
  Strong performers may take on larger customer portfolios, broader commercial responsibilities, and leadership opportunities as the business expands.

What to Expect if Shortlisted

1. **Initial screening:**
   Discussion of your experience, sales track record, location, and availability.
2. **Business discussion:**
   Assessment of your acquisition approach, cross-border payments knowledge, customer network, and commercial achievements.
3. **Leadership discussion:**
   Conversation about customer acquisition, account growth, business ownership, and your approach to targets.
4. **Offer and onboarding:**
   For selected candidates.

How to Apply

Please submit an updated resume highlighting:

* Your B2B sales, business development, and account management experience.
* Previous acquisition, transaction-volume, or revenue targets and actual achievements, wherever available.
* Customer segments, industries, and cross-border payment use cases you have handled.
* Your current location, notice period, and earliest possible joining date.

**We are looking for hands-on B2B sales professionals who can win new customers, convert opportunities into active business, and grow customer relationships into sustainable revenue.**

Dhaniti™ does not charge candidates any fee at any stage of the recruitment process.

Key Focus Areas

**B2B Sales | Business Development | Cross-Border Payments | International Pay-ins & Pay-outs | Customer Acquisition | Enterprise Sales | Key Account Management | Account Growth | Forex | Trade Finance | Import-Export | Payment Solutions | Fintech**

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. In this role you will be part of a team that drives AWS's data center contract negotiations, with a focus on colocation projects. The position encompasses comprehensive ownership of both new and existing colocation agreements, including pricing structures, terms, and service level agreements, while developing and implementing market expansion strategies across existing and new markets.

title: Supv-Solutions Archt
description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**
**Type of Work:**
Strategic leadership, executive technical sponsorship, and cross-functional management. The daily focus is on leading a team of technical experts, overseeing overarching architectural strategies—spanning traditional underlay networks (MPLS, Dedicated Internet, Broadband), modern overlays (SD-WAN, SASE), Private 5G ecosystems, and advanced VoIP modernization efforts—and removing roadblocks to drive multi-million-dollar deals from discovery to closing.
  
  
**Expected Volumes:**
Managing a high-performing team of Solution Architects who are concurrently handling multiple enterprise-level deal cycles and automation projects. You will navigate a highly matrixed environment, managing executive-level relationships with internal teams, external OEM partners, and C-level customer stakeholders.
  
  
**Risk & Criticality:**
You are accountable for the foundational telecom, cloud, security, voice, and wireless enterprise infrastructure designed by your team. Failure to properly allocate resources, vet architectural designs, or align OEM vendors and implementation teams can stall major revenue opportunities. Poor oversight can lead to deployment failures, SLA breaches, or lost enterprise contracts.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For...**

* Team Leadership & Mentorship: Hire, coach, and manage a team of Pre-Sales Solution Architects. Foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Executive Deal Sponsorship: Act as the executive technical sponsor and escalation point for high-stakes enterprise deals. Step in to navigate complex multi-vendor negotiations (including UCaaS/CPaaS and networking OEMs) and drive alignment between Sales, Product Management, and Implementation teams.
* Architectural Oversight & Legacy Modernization: Maintain accountability for the team's designs. Steer overarching strategies to transition legacy enterprise accounts from physical PRI/TDM and global MPLS networks to resilient, cloud-hosted SIP architectures and internet-first (DIA/Broadband) SD-WAN/SASE overlays.
* Strategic Alignment & 5G GTM: Partner with Sales Leadership to define technical Go-To-Market strategies for cutting-edge Private 5G and Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) solutions, ensuring the right mix of RAN, Core, and IP architects are allocated.
* Deal & Technical Escalation: Serve as the executive point of escalation for complex pre-sales roadblocks. Step in to unblock stalled architectural disagreements with internal Product teams, and smooth out critical handoff friction between Pre-Sales and Implementation teams.
* Architectural & Regulatory Compliance: Ensure the team’s solution designs strictly adhere to internal standards, delivery capabilities, and regional telecom regulatory requirements (e.g., data sovereignty, local VoIP routing laws) prior to contract signature.
* Strategic Product Advocacy: Aggregate field feedback—such as gaps in global broadband footprints, MPLS offloading challenges, or specific 5G network slicing requests—to act as the primary voice of the customer to VP-level Product Management.
* AI/Automation Acumen: Sponsor and integrate LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI) to drive internal team efficiencies and streamline complex sales engineering workflows.

**You’ll Need To Have**

* Bachelor’s degree in Telecom/IT/Communications or a relevant engineering field.
* 9+ years of relevant work experience in the telecom or tech industry, with 3+ years of experience directly managing, mentoring, or leading technical pre-sales teams.
* Comprehensive Core Networking: Deep architectural understanding of traditional and modern WAN solutions, including global MPLS, Dedicated Internet Access (DIA), high-availability Broadband aggregation, and Software Defined Networking (SDN/SD-WAN).
* Advanced Wireless & 5G: Strong knowledge of cellular networks, LTE, Private 5G, and IoT ecosystems.
* Voice/UC Expertise: Strong understanding of overarching VoIP architectures, Session Border Controllers (SBCs), SIP trunking, and contact center modernization paths.
* Cloud Computing Expertise: Proven experience overseeing the design and integration of telecom solutions within public, private, or hybrid cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Proven ability to orchestrate complex technical workflows across a matrixed organization, driving executive alignment between sales, technical, and delivery teams.
* Ability to quickly learn, understand, and guide your team on emerging technologies and methodologies in the telecommunications and cloud space.
* Security, architecture, and industry certifications such as CCNP (Automation/Data Center/Wireless), ITIL Foundation, or equivalent.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.
  
  
Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
  
  
Scheduled Weekly Hours
  
  
40

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.
