title: Healthcare Data Partnerships lead
description:
Location: Mumbai

Experience: 3–6 years

Seniority: Manager | Individual Contributor

Reporting to: VP – Healthcare

About the Role

BioStack is building partnerships across the healthcare ecosystem to develop high-quality clinical

datasets for healthcare AI, life sciences and research.

We are looking for a Manager – Healthcare Data Partnerships to identify, evaluate and drive

partnerships with hospitals, senior clinicians, diagnostic laboratories, EHR/HIS companies,

digital-health platforms, specialty healthcare networks and other healthcare organizations.

This is a hands-on, externally facing role with significant ownership of the partnership lifecycle. The

Manager will work closely with the VP – Healthcare, taking opportunities from initial engagement

through data discovery, due diligence, stakeholder coordination, closure and partnership activation.

Senior leadership will remain involved in strategic relationships, commercial structuring and key deal

negotiations.

The role combines healthcare partnerships, business development and data-driven opportunity

assessment. Prior experience specifically in healthcare data partnerships is not required, but

candidates should be comfortable learning how clinical data is generated, stored and used.

Key Responsibilities

● Proactively identify and develop new partnership opportunities across the healthcare ecosystem.

● Take ownership of opportunities following initial engagement and actively drive them toward signed

LOIs and partnerships.

● Conduct first-level data discovery and due diligence, assessing patient volumes, historical depth,

longitudinality, completeness, digitization, linkage and accessibility.

● Understand available data modalities—including EHR/EMR, laboratory, imaging, pathology,

prescriptions, clinical notes and other clinical data—and assess their quality and extraction

feasibility.

● Assess the potential clinical, research, AI and commercial value of datasets, along with partner

readiness and feasibility of execution, and recommend which opportunities merit deeper evaluation.

● Engage confidently with healthcare leadership, senior clinicians, medical administrators, IT/HIS

teams, founders and other relevant stakeholders.

● Support commercial discussions while working with senior leadership on partnership structure,

commercials and deal terms.

● Act as the coordination point between partners and BioStack's commercial, technical, legal and

data teams.

● Coordinate data assessments, meetings, proposals, documentation and follow-ups through

partnership closure, and support the transition from signed agreement to data access and

partnership activation.

● Maintain a structured partnership pipeline with clear next steps, risks, priorities and ownership.

Ideal Profile

● 3–6 years of experience in healthcare business development, partnerships, enterprise sales, key

accounts, healthcare technology, consulting or other client-facing commercial roles within the

healthcare ecosystem.

● Bachelor’s degree required; healthcare, life sciences, technology or business background preferred.

An MBA is an added advantage.

● Relevant healthcare industry experience and demonstrated understanding of the healthcare

ecosystem will be valued more highly than a specific educational qualification.

● Strong familiarity with the Indian healthcare ecosystem; a clinical qualification is not required.

● Familiarity with HIS/EMR, digital-health systems or clinical workflows is preferred. Candidates

should demonstrate the ability to quickly develop an understanding of clinical datasets, including

longitudinal and multimodal data.

● Ability to make or learn to make a first-level assessment of a dataset's quality, usability, accessibility

and potential value.

● Demonstrated ability to independently engage and manage senior stakeholders across hospitals,

clinical practices and other healthcare organizations.

● Strong ownership, persistence, commercial acumen, communication and relationship-management

skills.

● Familiarity with healthcare data privacy, consent, data-sharing, regulatory or contractual

considerations is preferred; deeper legal or regulatory expertise is not required.

● Comfortable travelling across India for partner meetings.

What Success Looks Like

Success will be measured by the ability to:

● Build and maintain a high-quality healthcare partnership pipeline.

● Identify and qualify valuable clinical data opportunities.

● Conduct effective first-level data and partner due diligence.

● Maintain momentum across multiple stakeholders and opportunities.

● Progress qualified opportunities through LOI/agreement, data assessment and partnership

activation.

The emphasis is on building high-quality partnerships that can translate into usable clinical datasets—not simply generating leads or meetings.

title: Sr Tender & Proposal Specialist

At Wilson Composites India LLP, we are manufacturers of custom Architectural Fiberglass (FRP) and (GFRC) products for the commercial construction industry. We specialize in design, engineering, and fabrication.

hours to overlap with our U.S. team

title: Manager, Sales
description:
**Job Description**
The role involves identifying new business opportunities, managing the end-to-end sales cycle, developing account strategies and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver tailored telecom solutions. The candidate should possess deep knowledge of telecom networks, strong negotiation and presentation skills, and experience handling complex enterprise sales engagements.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Monitor market trends and competitor activity to identify potential areas for growth.
* Achieve and exceed assigned sales targets and KPIs.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business, or a related field. MBA preferred.
* 10–15 years of experience in sales and business development of telecom equipment, with a focus on Tier-1 operator accounts.
* Deep understanding of telecom networks, products, and solutions.
* Strong negotiation, communication, and presentation skills.
* Proven ability to manage complex sales cycles and large customer accounts.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams.
* Willingness to travel as required.

**About Us**
Tejas Networks is a global broadband, optical and wireless networking company, with a focus on technology, innovation and R&D. We design and manufacture high-performance wireline and wireless networking products for telecommunications service providers, internet service providers, utilities, defence and government entities in over 75 countries. Tejas has an extensive portfolio of leading-edge telecom products for building end-to-end telecom networks based on the latest technologies and global standards with IPR ownership. We are a part of the Tata Group, with Panatone Finvest Ltd. (a subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.) being the majority shareholder. Tejas has a rich portfolio of patents and has shipped more than 900,000 systems across the globe with an uptime of 99.999%. Our product portfolio encompasses wireless technologies (4G/5G based on 3GPP and O-RAN standards), fiber broadband (GPON/XGS-PON), carrier-grade optical transmission (DWDM/OTN), packet switching and routing (Ethernet, PTN, IP/MPLS) and Direct-to-Mobile and Satellite-IoT communication platforms. Our unified network management suite simplifies network deployments and service implementation across all our products with advanced capabilities for predictive fault detection and resolution. As an R&D-driven company, we recognize that human intelligence is a core asset that drives the organization’s long-term success. Over 60% of our employees are in R&D, we are reshaping telecom networks, one innovation at a time.
  
  
**Diversity And Inclusion Statement**

* Tejas Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating all inclusive environment for all employees.
* We welcome applicants of all backgrounds regardless of race color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age or veteran status.
* Our goal is to build a workforce that reflects the diverse communities we serve and to ensure every employee feels valued and respected.

**About The Team**
At Tejas Networks, product development is driven by a comprehensive lifecycle approach that begins with understanding customer and network requirements, followed by competitive analysis, architectural design, and implementation. This process emphasizes performance, scalability, cost-efficiency, and environmental considerations, culminating in deployment and operational support. The technology portfolio spans diverse networking domains, including optical transport (DWDM, OTN), broadband access (GPON, XGSPON, CPON), service provider routing (IP/MPLS, Segment Routing, MPLS-TP), and enterprise switching (L2/L3). Products range from compact systems to complex, multi-terabit, chassis-based platforms designed for high availability, modularity, and scalability. Development involves specialized skills across hardware, firmware, FPGA, software, and synchronization, enabling teams to address multidisciplinary challenges effectively. Supporting these engineering efforts there is a centralized operational framework that provides strategic direction, governance, and essential services across the organization. This includes financial management, talent development, compliance, branding, innovation, risk management, and CSR. Together, these functions ensure seamless execution, alignment with business goals, and a culture of continuous improvement and excellence.

title: Veterinary Territory Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Palvi Agrico Pvt Ltd is an agribusiness organization focused on providing quality products and solutions to the livestock and veterinary sector. The company works closely with distributors, veterinary professionals, and farmers to support animal health, productivity, and welfare. By combining field knowledge with customer-focused service, Palvi Agrico aims to strengthen its presence in key markets and build long-term partnerships. The organization values integrity, performance, and continuous learning, offering team members opportunities to develop their careers within the agricultural and veterinary industry.
  
**Role Description**
The Veterinary Territory Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Pune City, responsible for managing sales and relationships within an assigned territory. In this role, the individual will visit veterinary clinics, farms, distributors, and retailers to promote the company’s veterinary products and solutions. Day-to-day tasks include identifying new business opportunities, conducting product presentations and demonstrations, and providing technical and commercial support to customers. The role involves planning and executing territory sales strategies, monitoring market trends and competitor activities, and preparing regular sales reports and forecasts. The Veterinary Territory Manager will collaborate with internal teams for supply coordination, marketing initiatives, and customer feedback, while ensuring high standards of professional conduct and adherence to company policies.
  
**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated ability in territory sales management, customer relationship development, and field marketing activities.
* Knowledge of veterinary or animal health products, livestock management practices, and basic animal nutrition concepts.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage veterinary professionals and farm owners effectively.
* Proficiency in planning, organizing, and reporting, including maintaining visit schedules, sales data, and market intelligence.
* Comfort with using digital tools (email, spreadsheets, CRM or sales tracking software) for documentation and communication.
* Bachelor’s degree in Veterinary Science, Animal Husbandry, Agriculture, Life Sciences, or a related field is preferred.
* Prior experience in veterinary sales, pharmaceutical sales, or agribusiness field operations is an advantage.
* Ability to travel regularly within the assigned territory and work on-site with customers in Pune City and surrounding areas.

Value (GMV) per month.

transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

knowledge of English
  
  
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing
  
  
channels
  
  
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
  
  
Effective communication skills

description:

In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation.

Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:

* *SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards.*
* *Environmental Impact Award (2025) – E+E Leaders Awards.*
* *IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners*
* *Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category*
* *Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change*
* *Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards.*

**How We Work**

Energy Exemplar is growing fast around 30% year on year and, that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.

We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

**About the Role**

Energy Exemplar is the leader in energy market/system simulation software, with its two platforms: PLEXOS and AURORA. These software platforms have a significant presence in global markets. We are seeking a confident, self-motivated and professional person for the role of Energy Market Analyst in our Support Division. The company has consistently grown its global client base and the successful candidate will have many opportunities to interface with a diverse mix of clients with the goal of enhancing their software user experience.

**Responsibilities:**
•    Learn our software to an advanced level
  
•    Provide technical support to customers and track support cases from start to finish
  
•    Work with clients to resolve issues related to our SaaS/Cloud offerings and our Desktop version
  
•    Collaborate with Cloud Developers and Engine/GUI Developers to ensure issues are resolved and development requests are properly documented
  
•    Provide onsite and web-based trainings to existing and potential clients
  
•    Maintain and update training materials
  
•    Compose articles and produce videos to educate clients and to market our software.
  
•    Construct tools and examples that clients can utilize to more effectively utilize our software
  
•    Assist in maintaining software user documentation and help platforms
  
•    Maintain a high level of power market knowledge, news, trends and developments
  
•    Communicate market trends and customer requirements with the development team as needed
  
•    Assist Account Management with Retention calls and visits with clients
  
•    Assist in preparation and presentations for energy related tradeshows and conferences
  
•    Travel to client sites as required

**Qualifications, Skills & Experiences:**
•    Bachelor’s degree: Electrical Engineering, Another Engineering Degree, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Economics, Applied Math, Physics, or related field.
  
•    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to research and learn new techniques
  
•    Ability to articulate the business problem to be analyzed, quickly identify the critical elements of the problem, achieve a high-quality answer in a timely fashion, and synthesize answers to resonate with decision makers
  
•    Excellent communication skills, including strong verbal, presentation, and technical writing abilities
  
•    Team player, with the ability to be a self-starter and work independently as needed.

**Education:**
•    2 to 4 years of demonstrated working knowledge of power plant operations, electricity and gas markets.
  
•    Knowledge of fundamental energy market analysis, capacity markets, environmental markets, demand side management/energy efficiency, electric utility resource planning approaches
  
•    Demonstrated working knowledge of SaaS products and experience troubleshooting issues with Cloud offerings
  
•    Demonstrated capability of effectively communicating complex ideas and analysis verbally, in document format (Word), and in presentation format (Power Point).
  
•    Experience with computer and database management languages such as VBA, Python and SQL
  
•    Working knowledge of the Microsoft Office suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, etc.)
  
•    Experience with power market production cost and expansion planning models.
  
•    Degree or certificate specializing in Power Markets.

**Key Stakeholder Relationships**
This role works collaboratively with all Energy Exemplar staff, particularly:

•    Indian Development Centre colleagues
  
•    Senior IDC Management
  
•    Chief Product Officer
  
•    Global Product Delivery Team
  
•    Global Product Development Team
  
•    Global Support Team

**Title And Summary**

**About The Team**
Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by providing unparalleled data-driven insights and advanced analytics. By leveraging proprietary data and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, more informed decisions that drive profitability and success. We turn complex data into actionable strategies that lead to better outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.
  
  
We are currently looking for a Lead Forward Deployed Engineer (AI) for the Operational Intelligence Program within the B&MI group. This role exists at the boundary between customer and product - /ou embed with clients before a single line of production code is written, validate whether an AI solution actually solves the business problem, and hand a scoped, evidence-backed brief to the product and engineering teams that build it. You are a builder first, but your deliverable is clarity, not code.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Embed directly with issuer and acquirer clients to understand their operational workflows, surface pain points, and identify where AI-driven automation or intelligence creates measurable business value.
* Design and build rapid proof-of-concept prototypes - agentic pipelines, conversational interfaces, analytical tools - scoped deliberately to test a specific business hypothesis, not to be production-ready.
* Translate ambiguous client requirements into concrete, testable problem statements; push back on requirements that are too broad to validate or too narrow to generalize.
* Run structured validation sessions with customers using working prototypes, gather qualitative and quantitative signal on whether the PoC addresses the stated need, and document what it does not.
* Synthesize field observations into product briefs: scoped requirements, edge cases discovered in the wild, constraints the platform team would not have known from a desk, and a clear go/no-go recommendation.
* Partner with product managers to ensure PoC findings directly inform roadmap decisions - requirements that survive validation become backlog items; those that do not get killed before investment is made.
* Maintain a working knowledge of the AI capability landscape (LLMs, agentic frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation, structured data reasoning) broad enough to know what is feasible in a six-week PoC versus

what requires a platform build.
  
  

* Identify patterns across client engagements that suggest platform-level investment - repeatable needs that should become product features rather than one-off prototypes.
* Represent technical feasibility in pre-sales and discovery conversations; give customers and internal stakeholders an honest read on what AI can and cannot do for their specific workflow today.
* Mentor engineers and analysts on the team on customer discovery craft - how to ask questions that reveal unstated requirements, how to scope a PoC to answer one question well, and how to present findings without overselling.

**All About You**

* Master's or bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with significant experience delivering AI or data solutions to enterprise clients.
* Proven track record building working AI prototypes that directly influenced product or investment decisions - you can point to cases where your PoC changed what got built.
* Strong engineering foundation: you can write clean, working code quickly without over-engineering for production concerns that are irrelevant at the PoC stage.
* Fluent in Python and comfortable with SQL; experience with large-scale structured data and cloud data platforms is a strong plus.
* Hands-on experience with LLM APIs and agentic patterns - you understand the tradeoffs between what you can prompt, what you need to engineer, and what requires fine-tuning.
* Exceptional customer-facing communication: you can run a discovery session with a non-technical reconciliation analyst in the morning and write a technical scoping document in the afternoon.
* Strong product instinct: you can distinguish a business requirement from a solution assumption, and you know when a client is describing a symptom rather than a root cause.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity - you thrive when the problem statement is unclear and see scoping it as part of the job, not a blocker.
* Experience working in regulated industries (financial services, payments, healthcare) where data sensitivity, compliance constraints, and customer trust shape what can and cannot be prototyped.
* Track record of handing off well-scoped, evidence-backed briefs to product and engineering teams; you measure success by what gets built from your findings, not by the prototype itself.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Network Practice Leader - Architecture and Transformation
description:
Own the end-to-end architecture and solution design for enterprise network programs spanning campus/LAN, WAN, data center, cloud, and security-edge (SASE) domains.
  
  

* Produce High-Level Designs (HLD), Low-Level Designs (LLD), reference architectures, and design standards, including topology diagrams, IP/routing schemes, migration plans, and bill of materials.
* Lead technology evaluations, PoCs, and OEM/vendor selection, comparing solutions against functional, commercial, operational, and security criteria.
* Support pre-sales and solutioning activities — respond to RFPs/RFIs, size and cost solutions, present designs to customers and executives, and defend design decisions in technical reviews.
* Define transformation and migration strategies for legacy-to-software-defined transitions (e.g., traditional WAN → SD-WAN/SASE, classic DC → spine-leaf fabric, campus → SD-Access/fabric).
* Embed security-by-design — micro-segmentation, Zero Trust, secure edge, and integration with the broader security architecture.
* Drive network automation and Infrastructure-as-Code adoption across designs (templating, ZTP, CI/CD for network config).
* Establish design governance — architecture review boards, design patterns, guardrails, and documentation standards.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to network engineers and junior architects; act as design escalation point during delivery.
* Partner with cloud, security, applications, and infrastructure teams to ensure the network architecture aligns with the wider enterprise architecture and roadmaps.

title: Client Manager - IATF
description:
We exist to create positive change for people and the planet. Join us and make a difference too!
  
  
**Purpose of the position**

* To conduct on-site assessments against the requirements of relevant standards or specifications
* To provide expertise, produce surveillance and initial assessment reports and make recommendations for certification decisions.
* To promote the BSI product offering and solutions to our clients with the view of improving their business performance, managing risk and “Making excellence a habit”

**Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities**

* Undertake management system assessments in accordance with BSI requirements.
* Prepare assessment reports and deliver findings to clients to ensure client understanding of the assessment decision and clear direction to particular items of corrective action where appropriate.
* Recommend the issue, re-issue or withdrawal of certificates, and report recommendations in accordance with BSI policy, procedures and prescribed time frame.
* Lead assessment teams as required ensuring that team members are adequately briefed so that quality of service is maintained and that effective working relationships are sustained both with Clients and within the team
* Establish and develop an effective partnership with clients by delivering effective audits increasing client satisfaction with clients in your portfolio.
* Provide accurate and prompt information to support services, working closely with them to ensure that client records are up to date and complete and that all other internal information requirements are met.
* Plan/schedule workloads to make best use of own time and maximize revenue-earning activity. Coach colleagues as appropriate especially where those members are inexperienced assessors or unfamiliar with clients' business/technology and assist in the induction and coaching of new colleagues as requested.
* Maintain and develop assessment skills and technical and management system standards knowledge.
* Provide technical support to sales and customer service staff.
* Participate in witness audits and calibration sessions.
* Adhere strictly to IATF rules, accreditation requirements, and BSI internal procedures.
* Ensure audit impartiality, confidentiality, and professional conduct.
* Support complaint handling, appeals, and technical reviews when required.
* Support planning teams with audit scheduling inputs and availability
* Act as a brand Ambassador for BSI. This means acting ethically, following company rules and promoting BSI services to clients so they are able to optimize business performance and “Make Excellence a Habit”.

**Candidate specifications**

* Bachelor’s degree/Diploma or above in Engineering field.
* Qualified IATF 16949 Auditor with ADP.
* Demonstrate sector-specific knowledge (e.g., manufacturing processes, core tools like APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, MSA)
* Exposure to multiple automotive manufacturing processes (e.g., machining, assembly, injection molding, etc.)
* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of IATF rules and Customer Specific requirements.
* Minimum 4–6 years of experience in conducting IATF audits.
* Knowledge of business processes and application of quality management standards
* Good verbal and written communication skills and an eye for detail
* Be self-motivated, flexible, and have excellent time management/planning skills
* Can work under pressure
* Willing to travel on business intensively
* An enthusiastic and committed team player
* Good public speaking and business development skill will be considered advantageous

**Key performance indicators**

* Delivery of man-days as booked in time and good quality work together with positive feedback from clients
* Feedback efficiently to both clients and internal queries Timely submission of reports
* Actively solve problems when needed with “can do” attitude
* Add value to clients by identifying their needs and introducing multiple BSI services to improve clients business performance and help them “Make excellence a habit”
* Help to avoid customer attrition by providing quality value added service and technical support

**Travel Requirements**

* Regular travel required for on-site assessments.

**Language Requirements**

* Proficiency in Business English (written and spoken).

**About Us**
BSI is a business improvement and standards company and for over a century BSI has been recognized for having a positive impact on organizations and society, building trust and enhancing lives.
  
  
Today BSI partners with more than 77,500 clients in 195 countries and engages with a 15,000 strong global community of experts, industry and consumer groups, organizations and governments.
  
  
Utilizing its extensive expertise in key industry sectors - including automotive, aerospace, built environment, food and retail, and healthcare - BSI delivers on its purpose by helping its clients fulfil theirs.
  
  
Living by our core values of Client-Centricity, Agility, and Collaboration, BSI provides organizations with the confidence to grow by partnering with them to tackle society’s critical issues – from climate change to building trust in digital transformation and everything in between - to accelerate progress towards a better society and a sustainable world.
  
  
BSI is an Equal Opportunity Employer dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
Product Marketing Manager (B2B SaaS / Physical AI & Enterprise Drone Autonomy)
  
  
Location: Pune, India (On-site)
  
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
  
**About The Opportunity**
We are partnering with a global category leader in Physical AI and enterprise drone autonomy. Our client’s software platform powers mission-critical autonomous operations across 400+ large industrial sites in 70+ countries. Their customer roster includes Fortune 500 leaders across energy, utilities, security, and infrastructure (such as Shell, CSX, Airbus, Anglo American, Dole, and Statnett). With core engineering and business teams based in Pune, they are building the "nervous system" for large industrial sites worldwide.
  
  
The team operates at AI speed—where intelligence and autonomy are at the core of everything. They thrive in a high-agency, high-velocity environment where AI is not a side project, but the operating system for thinking, building, and growing.
  
  
The Role
  
  
As the Product Marketing Manager, you will be the bridge between what is built and how the market understands it. You will own positioning and messaging across verticals—translating deep technical capabilities into language that resonates with enterprise buyers in energy, utilities, security, and infrastructure. You will arm sales with materials that actually get used, turn customer wins into compelling proof points, and ensure every product launch lands with clarity and impact.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of product, sales, and the market. You will spend as much time talking to customers and prospects as you do with internal teams, distilling technical specifications into buyer-centric narratives.
  
  
What You’ll Own
  
  
Positioning & Messaging: Sharpen how the brand speaks across verticals, personas, and use cases. You will define the narrative, not just document it.
  
  
Sales Enablement: Build battlecards, pitch decks, one-pagers, objection-handling guides, and competitive comparisons that reps actively use to close deals.
  
  
Product Launches: Drive cross-functional launches with product, engineering, and marketing to ensure new features land with the right story and market awareness.
  
  
Competitive Intelligence: Track the landscape, understand alternatives, and keep sales and leadership informed on win-loss dynamics.
  
  
Customer Evidence: Build a robust library of case studies, testimonials, and reference customers that make value tangible.
  
  
Buyer & Market Research: Understand enterprise evaluation criteria, buyer pain points, and deal blockers.
  
  
Partner Marketing: Coordinate with 50+ integration partners to ensure co-marketing efforts are accurate, consistent, and compelling.
  
  
What We’re Looking For
  
  
Experience: 2–4 years in product marketing, preferably within B2B SaaS, enterprise tech, or technical products.
  
  
Domain Background: Drone, robotics, hardware, autonomous systems, or industrial tech background strongly preferred.
  
  
Technical Agility: A technical foundation that allows you to read a product spec, understand an integration, and translate it for a non-technical buyer.
  
  
Sales Collaboration: Deep understanding of enterprise sales cycles, rep workflows, and common deal objections.
  
  
Messaging Instincts: Ability to take a complex technical differentiator and turn it into a memorable, high-impact sentence.
  
  
Customer Comfort: A preference for external customer and prospect conversations over internal meetings.
  
  
AI Fluency: Practical experience using AI tools for research, drafting, and presentation creation to move fast without relying on them as a crutch.
  
  
Why Join?
  
  
Category-Defining Impact: Shape a brand leading the future of autonomous drone operations across 400+ enterprise sites worldwide.
  
  
The H3 Philosophy: Experience a culture built on being Happy, Healthy, AND High-Performing—moving fast without burnout.
  
  
In-Person Pune Energy: Work closely with a sharp, ambitious team in Pune where proximity accelerates ideas, feedback, and trust.
  
  
The Perks: Unlimited leave policy, flexible working hours, global travel exposure, and a no-cap budget for AI tools, courses, and experiments.

title: Strategic Alliances Manager - MSSP
description:

AlgoSec helps leading organizations secure application connectivity across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. Trusted by more than 2,300 organizations globally, our platform simplifies security policy management, improves visibility, reduces risk, and automates compliance across complex networks.
  
  
As we expand our enterprise and cloud security business, we are looking for a Strategic Alliances Manager - MSSP to build and grow strategic MSSP partnerships in India, develop joint go-to-market opportunities, accelerate partner-driven revenue and build a repeatable MSSP revenue engine
  
  
This is an opportunity to join a profitable, growing cybersecurity company with strong market traction, a collaborative culture, and significant growth potential.
  
  
Reporting to: Regional Sales Director
  
  
Location: Mumbai/ Bangalore/Delhi , India (Home office)
  
  
Direct employment
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Identify and qualify high-potential MSSP partners and joint business opportunities across the assigned market. Invest in a service practice, technical capability, enterprise customer base, recurring managed-services motion, and executive sponsorship
* Build strategic relationships with MSSPs and relevant GSIs, developing joint value propositions and go-to-market plans
* Partner with Sales, Systems Engineers, and cross-functional teams to position AlgoSec solutions and enable partners
* Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities from strategy through execution
* Build trusted relationships with partner leaders and decision-makers, aligning business plans to mutual growth objectives
* Stay current on AlgoSec capabilities, including cloud security and automation, and translate them into compelling MSSP offerings
* Monitor partner performance, market trends, competitive dynamics, and pipeline; provide actionable business updates to leadership
* Drive new business and expansion revenue through MSSP partnerships, including recurring software and services opportunities
* Drive and deliver measurable MSSP business targets, including partner-sourced recurring ARR/bookings, qualified pipeline, activated MSSPs, new customer logos, and expansion revenue.
* Build joint 12-month business plans with priority MSSPs, including target accounts, use cases, seller/SE alignment, enablement milestones, campaigns, pipeline targets, and executive governance.
* Work with priority MSSPs to productize AlgoSec into repeatable managed-service offerings - defining the customer proposition, scope, operating model, commercial/consumption model, onboarding motion, and lifecycle expansion opportunities.
* Prioritize high-impact partner activities and manage time effectively
* Own the partner business development cycle, from recruitment and enablement to joint pipeline development and deal execution
* Maintain accurate partner pipeline, opportunity updates, and forecasts in Salesforce
* Collaborate across teams with accountability, agility, and a customer-first mindset
* Take ownership of partner growth and business results across the assigned region

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, or related field
* 10+ years of experience in enterprise software or cybersecurity sales, alliances, or business development, with a strong record of delivering growth
* Demonstrated success building partner-driven pipeline and achieving commercial targets
* Ability to engage senior executives and influence stakeholders across partner and customer organizations
* Strong understanding of network security, hybrid cloud environments, and the MSSP business model
* Experience developing MSSP service offerings and joint go-to-market motions around software platforms
* Proven, quantified track record of creating recurring revenue through MSSPs - able to demonstrate pipeline and bookings/ARR personally influenced or sourced

title: Strategic Channel Manager | India | Remote | Expressions Of Interest

Grafana Labs is looking for a Channel Manager to develop, execute and evolve our partner go-to-market strategy in India. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.
  
  

* Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

**Why You’ll Thrive At Grafana Labs**

* In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
* Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. \*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

**Equal Opportunity Employer:**
*Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. title: Business Development Intern
description:
Pay: ₹8,000.00 - ₹10,000.00 per month
  
  
Job description:
  
  
About us
  
  
We are a Gurugram-based group building products across EdTech, B2B SaaS and deep technology. Our team is small, fast and close to the founders, so interns work on real targets and see the impact of their work every day.
  
  
Each selected intern is assigned to one of the products below. The final assignment is decided during selection, based on your strengths, interests and our business needs.
  
  
About the role and daily KRAs
  
  
Your core job is to start conversations with new prospects every day and keep every conversation moving until it becomes a meeting, a sign-up or a clear no. You will own the top of the sales pipeline for your assigned product.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
Lead research: Find and qualify new prospects that match the target customer profile of your assigned product, using LinkedIn, company websites, directories and other sources.
  
Daily outreach: Reach out to at least 100 fresh leads every day through email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, phone calls or other approved channels.
  
Follow-ups: Follow up with every lead you have contacted, on a regular cadence, until they respond or are closed out.
  
Personalized messaging: Adapt approved message templates to each prospect's role, company and needs, so outreach feels relevant and not generic.
  
Qualifying interest: Understand each prospect's need, answer first-level questions about the product and move interested leads to a meeting, demo, trial, sign-up or enrollment as per the product's sales process.
  
Pipeline management: Keep the CRM or lead tracker accurate and up to date with every touchpoint, response and next step.
  
Reporting: Share a daily activity report and join weekly reviews on outreach numbers, reply rates and conversions.
  
Feedback loop: Share objections, common questions and market feedback with the team to improve messaging, targeting and the product.
  
Coordination: Work with the marketing, product and leadership teams on campaigns, events and partner opportunities for your product.
  
Compliance: Follow the company's outreach guidelines, respect opt-out requests and never misrepresent the product or the company.
  
Who we are looking for
  
  
We want people who enjoy talking to strangers, can handle rejection without losing energy, and take daily numbers seriously.
  
  
Must-haves
  
  
Pursuing or recently completed a graduate or postgraduate degree (BBA, MBA, B.Com, BA, B.Tech or any related field).
  
Excellent written and spoken English; clear, confident and professional communication.
  
Comfort with high-volume outreach and a daily target of 100 fresh leads plus follow-ups.
  
Strong discipline, organization and attention to detail in tracking leads.
  
Basic skills in MS Excel or Google Sheets, email and LinkedIn.
  
A laptop and a stable internet connection for working from home.
  
Willingness to report to the Gurugram office whenever the company asks.
  
Good-to-haves
  
  
Prior internship or experience in sales, business development, lead generation or customer outreach.
  
Familiarity with CRM tools (HubSpot, Zoho or similar) and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
  
Interest in HR technology, EdTech, emerging technologies or defence technology, depending on the product.
  
Knowledge of Hindi or another regional language, for products with Indian audiences.
  
Work mode and what we offer
  
  
This is a hybrid internship. You will work from home most of the time, and you must report to our Gurugram office whenever the company asks you to be present in person, for example for training, team reviews, events or client meetings.
  
  
Working days and hours: Monday to Friday, 9:30 am to 6:30 pm IST]
  
Office : Gurugram
  
What we offer
  
  
A monthly stipend of INR 8,000-10,000.
  
Hands-on training in lead generation, outreach, follow-up cadences and pipeline management.
  
Direct exposure to live products and their go-to-market strategy, working closely with the founding team.
  
An internship certificate on successful completion.
  
A chance of a pre-placement offer (PPO) for top performers, based on business needs.
  
Selection process and how to apply
  
  
Application screening: We review your resume and a short note on why business development interests you.
  
Online assessment: A short test of English communication, reasoning and attention to detail.
  
Outreach task: Write a cold outreach message and two follow-ups for a sample prospect.
  
Interview: A conversation with the hiring manager on your communication, drive and comfort with daily targets.
  
Offer and product assignment: Selected candidates receive an offer and are assigned to one of our products.
  
You can also send your resumes to - kanishka@hirevalid.com
  
  
Benefits:
  
  
  
Work from home
  
Work Location: Hybrid remote in Gurugram, Haryana

title: Solutions Consultant
description:

* Legacy & Innovation: We were created more than 260 years ago as the world’s first marine classification society to improve and set standards for the safety of ships.

* Product Offering: Covering five proven product areas - learning, fleet operations, compliance, voyage planning and performance management - supporting its customers from ship to shore, from training and people operations, to voyage compliance and optimisation.

* Conduct workshops and advanced proof-of-value demos to highlight capabilities.
* Organise and manage software trials by defining success criteria and metrics, and monitoring progress during the trial process.

* Win rate improvement through strong pre-sales support.
* Customer satisfaction with demos and workshops.
* Reduced sales cycle times by addressing concerns upfront.
* Seamless handover to post-sales and onboarding teams.

Born from the integration of LR OneOcean and Ocean Technologies Group, we unite decades of maritime expertise with cutting-edge digital innovation under one powerful brand. Our comprehensive portfolio spansLearning, Fleet Operations, Compliance, Voyage Planning, and Performance Management— trusted by thousands of maritime professionals worldwide. By connecting ship and shore, people and data, we help organisations operate more safely, efficiently, and sustainably through real-time intelligence and predictive insights.

We are part of Lloyd’s Register (LR) a global leader in marine and offshore engineering, technology, and digital solutions. With over260 years of trust, integrity, and leadership at sea, LR supports more than30,000 vessels worldwide. Together, OneOcean and LR combine the agility of innovation with the strength of a world-renowned institution, driving digital transformation and shaping a more connected, sustainable maritime industry.

title: Principal Solutions Engineer
description:
**Principal Solution Engineer (Presales)**

Sales and Revenue, Solutions Engineering | Gurgaon (Onsite) | US business hours (Eastern/Central overlap) | Periodic US travel

**About Spyne**

Spyne is building the AI operating system for automotive retail. We started with visual merchandising, expanded into conversational AI, and are now putting AI agents across the dealership so dealers move inventory faster, respond to buyers instantly and run more of their operation with AI. Founded by operators from Amazon, Cox and OYO, Spyne has grown 30x in under 3 years and powers 1,500+ dealerships across the US. We’re backed by Accel, Vertex Ventures and Storm Ventures.

What we’re building:

* **Studio AI (Visual Agents):**
  turns a smartphone capture into a complete, publish-ready listing, so cars reach the website faster.
* **Vini AI (Conversational Agents):**
  answers every call, chat and text across sales and service, and writes outcomes back into the dealer’s DMS and CRM. We’re building a family of agents for recall, receptionist, reputation, acquisition, sales and service, built for dealers to try and turn on themselves.
* **AI Contact Service:**
  Vini at the core with a human BDC team around it, delivering the outcomes dealers expect from an in-house BDC.
* **DealerOS:**
  the layer that brings it all together. It sits above the dealer’s existing software (DMS, CRM, inventory, website, service) and runs agents across the vehicle journey, from sourcing to sale to service.

See DealerOS in action: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gjehUZhJi3k

**Role Overview**

The Principal Solution Engineer owns the technical win on Spyne’s largest US dealer-group and enterprise opportunities, from initial discovery through to a structured handover into Onboarding. The role reports to the Head of Sales and partners closely with Account Executives, Product, Engineering and Customer Success.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Discovery:**
  Lead structured discovery with dealer principals, GMs, BDC and internet managers, and dealer-group IT. Map the vehicle lifecycle from acquisition to service, and quantify pain in dealer terms such as time-to-line, lead response time, missed after-hours leads and aged inventory.
* **Demonstration:**
  Deliver tailored demos using the prospect’s own VINs and lead scenarios. Present Studio AI and Vini AI as a single inventory-to-sale solution for executive, operator and IT audiences.
* **Scoping:**
  Define rooftops, modules, integrations and volumes. Design pilots with written success criteria, owners and fixed end dates. Validate any non-standard request with Product and Engineering before it is committed.
* **Solution Documentation:**
  Author the solution design for each enterprise deal and own the technical sections of RFPs and security questionnaires. Secure customer sign-off before contract.
* **Handover:**
  Run a formal internal handover to Onboarding, join customer kickoff, and remain the point of contact for technical escalations through go-live.
* **Team Enablement:**
  Coach AEs and junior SEs, maintain demo environments, discovery frameworks and the pilot playbook, and support the growth of the SE function.

**Measures of Success**

Performance is assessed on technical win rate, pilot-to-paid conversion, enterprise sales cycle length and handover quality. Targets are agreed with the CRO within the first 30 days, and the role is expected to run the full deal cycle independently by day 90.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8-10+ years in B2B SaaS, including 6+ years in presales or solution engineering on enterprise, multi-stakeholder deals
* Track record as technical lead on six-figure ARR deals with US customers
* Strong understanding of integrations, including APIs, webhooks, data feeds and SSO
* Executive presence and excellent written English
* Ability to work US hours and travel to the US

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience selling AI products, startup experience, familiarity with TCPA, CAN-SPAM and SOC 2, or a background in automotive retail.

**What We Offer**

* A principal-level role shaping how Spyne sells to the largest US dealer groups and OEMs
* Direct access to the Head of Sales
* The opportunity to build and lead the Solutions Engineering function as it scales
* Competitive fixed pay plus a variable component tied to technical-win and ARR targets

title: Founder's Office
description:
About AdsFlo

AdsFlo (adsflo.ai) is a Meta Ads analytics and launcher platform built by performance marketers, for performance marketers. It started as the internal tool behind Outwrk Media, a Gurugram-based D2C growth agency that manages about ₹40 crore of monthly ad spend across 50+ brands.

Today AdsFlo helps brands and agencies launch ads in bulk, tag and analyse every creative with AI, and see what is actually driving ROAS. Google Ads launching and Shopify data are next. We have paying customers, a product that works, and now need someone to take it to market.

**Role:**
Founder's Office, Growth (Sales, Marketing and Customer Success)

**Location:**
Gurugram, in office

**Experience:**
1 to 3 years

**Reports to:**
Founders

The role

You will be the first growth hire at AdsFlo and own the full customer journey: getting brands to hear about us, closing them, and keeping them happy enough to stay and refer others.

This is not a coordinator role. You will work directly with the founders, sit in on product decisions, and be the voice of the customer inside the team. If you have run Meta campaigns yourself, you already understand our buyer better than most salespeople ever will. That is the edge we are hiring for.

What you'll ownSales

* Build and run the pipeline: D2C brands, agencies and in-house growth teams spending on Meta
* Run discovery calls and product demos, handle objections, and close deals end to end
* Own outbound on LinkedIn, email and WhatsApp, plus warm intros from the Outwrk network
* Track every lead in a CRM and report weekly on pipeline, conversion and revenue
* Shape pricing, plans and the agency (B2B) offering based on what you hear from buyers

Marketing

* Plan and run AdsFlo's own paid campaigns on Meta and Google, and own the CAC and trial-to-paid numbers
* Run the founder and brand LinkedIn presence: posts, carousels, product walkthroughs, customer stories
* Create content that performance marketers actually want: teardowns, benchmarks, creative insights from the platform
* Own the website funnel (landing pages, signup flow, onboarding emails) with the product team
* Set up webinars, community sessions and partnerships with agencies and D2C founder circles

Customer support and success

* Onboard new customers: ad account connection, first launch, first insight within the first week
* Be the first line of support on chat, email and WhatsApp, and resolve or route issues fast
* Turn support tickets and feedback into clear, prioritised inputs for the tech team
* Track activation, usage and churn; run renewals and upgrades
* Build the help docs, FAQs and video guides so customers can self-serve

Who we're looking forMust have

* At least 1 year of hands-on performance marketing, ideally Meta Ads for D2C brands, at an agency or in-house
* You know ROAS, CPM, CTR, CPC, CVR and AOV cold, and can explain why a campaign is working or not
* Strong spoken and written English and Hindi; you can hold a room on a demo call and write a sharp cold email
* Analytical by default: comfortable in Excel or Google Sheets, pulling numbers and turning them into a story
* High ownership: you finish what you start without being chased

Good to have

* Any B2B or SaaS sales exposure, even informal (freelance clients, agency pitches)
* Experience with Google Ads, Shopify, or quick commerce ads
* A LinkedIn presence or content you have created and grown
* Familiarity with tools like HubSpot, Zoho, Notion, Canva or basic automation

You'll love this if

* You want to see how a SaaS company is built from the inside, not just one function of it
* You would rather own a number than a task list
* You see the founder's office as a fast track to leading growth, and you want that responsibility early

This is not for you if

* You need a fixed playbook and a large team before you can start
* You dislike talking to customers or picking up the phone

Your first 90 days

By

What success looks like

Day 30

Know the product inside out, speak to every active customer, set up the CRM and support process

Day 60

Run demos and close your first deals independently; AdsFlo's own Meta campaigns and LinkedIn calendar are live

Day 90

Own a monthly revenue and activation target, with a repeatable sales and onboarding playbook in place

What we offer

* Direct access to the founders and every growth decision
* Exposure to 50+ D2C brands through the Outwrk portfolio
* Fast-track path to leading AdsFlo's growth team as it scales
* CTC: ₹8 to 10 lakh per annum

title: Growth Manager (Pre-Sales - AI SaaS)
description:
**Client - Fast growing AI Solutions setup focused on SAP; helping CFO save millions**

**The role**

You run the funnel from first meeting to signed contract: you lead customer calls alongside our sellers, shape the solution with our technical pre-sales lead, and build the deck, proposal or RFP (Request for Proposal) response that wins the deal. You also own how the market sees us, through our capability story, case studies, events and social media. You will work directly with our Chief Business Officer and founders as we scale from our first customers in India, the US and Europe, and you will build the pre-sales and growth function as it grows. The pace is fast, and the ownership is real.

**What you will do**

* **Own the funnel:**
  track every opportunity from first meeting to signed contract, keep the CRM (customer relationship management system) and forecast honest, and find and fix where deals stall.
* **Run customer calls:**
  lead discovery and follow-up calls with CIOs (Chief Information Officers) and SAP leaders alongside our sellers, and drive the next steps to closure.
* **Win RFPs:**
  own our responses end to end, from the bid or no-bid call, plan and compliance matrix to the commercial sections and final submission, with our technical pre-sales lead on the technical answers.
* **Shape every proposal:**
  tailored customer decks within 24 hours of a call; proposals, statements of work and pricing within 48 hours.
* **Own our story:**
  the capability deck, case studies and follow-up packs, kept sharp and backed by evidence.
* **Run events:**
  plan and deliver presence at SAP user-group meetings, webinars, CIO roundtables and partner events, from invitations and content to the follow-up that turns attendees into meetings.
* **Build the engine:**
  reusable content, templates and AI-assisted workflows that make every next deal faster; bring what you learn from customers back into product and pricing.

**What you bring**

* 4–7 years in pre-sales, bid and proposal work, or consulting, at an IT (Information Technology) services firm, SAP partner, consulting firm or software company.
* Confidence leading client calls with senior IT leaders, and a track record of moving deals forward, not just documenting them.
* Strong business writing and storytelling: answer first, then evidence. You build clean, well-structured and impactful slides quickly.
* Working knowledge of SAP: what ECC and S/4HANA are, why custom code and testing matter in a migration, and how SAP programmes are bought.
* Comfort with Excel for pricing and effort tables.
* Daily use of AI writing tools (such as Claude or Microsoft Copilot) to work faster, while checking every fact.
* The ability to juggle several deadlines at once and still deliver on time.

**Nice to have:**
proposals for US or European clients; an SAP functional background (Finance, Sales and Distribution, or Materials Management); an MBA (Master of Business Administration); experience of new-age design tools.

**Why join**

* Shape how a new kind of SAP company tells its story to CIOs (Chief Information Officers) in India, the US and Europe.
* Work directly with the founders, and room to build and lead the pre-sales function.

**How we hire**

A portfolio conversation about decks or proposals you have built, a 24-hour customer-deck exercise, a short live working session, and an SAP conversation with our technical pre-sales lead. We aim to decide within a week and prefer candidates who can join within 30–60 days.

title: Senior Engineer – Estimation & Costing (RFQ)
description:
**Job title:**
Senior Engineer – Estimation & Costing (RFQ)

**Company:**
Dynatech Controls Private Limited

**Workplace type:**
On-site

**Job location:**
Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India

**Job type:**
Full-time

**Experience level:**
Mid-Senior level

**Industry / Function:**
Machinery Manufacturing / Engineering, Business Development

**Description:**

About Dynatech Controls
  
Dynatech Controls manufactures precision CNC-machined, stamped and assembled parts for global OEMs. Our parts go into aerospace, semiconductor equipment, instrumentation, oil & gas, defence, consumer durables and automotive products, and we export to the USA, Europe, Japan and the Middle East. We are ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100D certified.
  
  
About the Role
  
You will own every customer RFQ from receipt to submitted quotation. You'll turn drawings and specifications into an accurate, well-reasoned cost and a competitive price, on time. The quotes should win business at healthy margins, and the costing behind them should hold up on the shop floor. This role reports directly to the CEO.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
RFQ Management
  
• Log and track every RFQ in the RFQ register through to closure: won, lost or on hold
  
• Plan workload so every quote is submitted on or before the customer due date
  
• Record win/loss reasons and customer price feedback for future quotes
  
  
Drawing Review & Feasibility
  
• Review drawings, 3D models and specifications: GD&T, tolerances, material specs (AMS, ASTM, MS, IS), surface finish, coatings and special processes
  
• Identify quality requirements such as FAI (AS9102), PPAP, CMM reports, material certificates and RoHS/REACH
  
• Check manufacturing feasibility with Production and Quality: machines, tooling, fixtures, gauges, in-house vs. outsourced operations
  
• Raise technical queries and deviation requests, and suggest DFM changes that reduce cost
  
  
Cost Estimation
  
• Build process routings and estimate setup and cycle times for CNC turning, VMC/HMC milling, multi-axis machining, sheet-metal stamping and assembly
  
• Calculate raw material cost: blank size, gross/net weight, scrap and metal price basis (LME, NALCO, copper/brass indices)
  
• Apply machine hour rates, labour, setup amortisation, outsourced processes (plating, anodising, heat treatment, passivation), packing, freight and Incoterms
  
• Add overheads and margin; prepare quantity price slabs, MOQs and separate tooling costs
  
• Source vendor quotes for bought-out items, raw material and outsourced processes
  
  
Quotation & Customer Interaction
  
• Prepare quotations and complete customer bid sheets and supplier portals accurately
  
• Obtain CEO approval on price and terms; maintain a clear costing file for every quote
  
• Join customer calls to explain costing and support price negotiations
  
• Handle price revisions, metal-price adjustments, annual cost-down requests and open-book costing
  
  
Cost Control & Costing Database
  
• Maintain the costing master: machine hour rates, standard cycle times, material and vendor rates
  
• Compare quoted vs. actual cost and cycle time on won jobs, and update the costing master
  
• Hand over won RFQs to Production/NPI with costing assumptions clearly documented
  
  
Must Have
  
• B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering
  
• 4–7 years in precision machining, with at least 3 years in estimation, costing or RFQ handling
  
• Experience costing parts for OEM customers from drawings
  
• Strong drawing reading and GD&T (ASME Y14.5)
  
• Hands-on knowledge of CNC turning and milling, tooling and cycle-time estimation
  
• Working knowledge of sheet-metal stamping and assembly costing
  
• Knowledge of engineering materials: aluminium, stainless steel, brass, bronze, plastics
  
• Ability to use CAD (SolidWorks / NX / AutoCAD viewer) for volume, weight and dimensions
  
• Knowledge of Incoterms, GST, export basics and currency conversion
  
• Advanced Excel; ERP experience; comfortable using AI tools
  
• Good written and spoken English for US/EU customers
  
  
Good to Have
  
• Experience with export customers in the USA, Europe or Japan
  
• Aerospace, semiconductor or instrumentation background (AS9100)
  
• 2+ years on the shop floor or in process engineering before moving into costing
  
  
  
  
Location: Surajpur Industrial Area, Greater Noida (on-site)
  
Employment Type: Full-time, permanent
  
Reference: DCPL/HR/JD/2026/EC-01

title: Design & sales Consultant
description:
Design & Sales Consultant (Luxury Metal Decor)
  
  
Company Overview:
  
Curio Crafts produces custom, sculptural metal furniture and architectural decor for premium spaces. We need a hybrid professional who understands spatial design and can successfully sell our metal manufacturing capabilities to B2B and B2C clients.
  
  
Job Overview:
  
This role sits at the intersection of creative design and revenue generation. You will meet with interior designers, architects, and direct clients, understand their vision for a space, propose custom metal decor solutions, and close the sale. You are not just selling a product; you are selling a bespoke metal design concept.
  
  
Key Responsibilities (Day-to-Day Tasks):
  
  
Client Consultation & Pitching: Meet with clients (architects, hoteliers, luxury homeowners) to understand their specific needs for custom metal furniture, brass wall art, or decorative aluminum installations.
  
  
Design Translation: Create visual presentations, mood boards, or basic 3D renders to show the client how our metal products will look in their space.
  
  
Sales & Commercials: Prepare detailed price quotations based on metal weights, casting complexity, and finishing requirements. Negotiate terms and close sales contracts for custom manufacturing projects.
  
  
Project Liaison: Once a sale is closed, hand over the technical specifications to the metal factory floor and track the project to ensure the final piece matches the client’s approved design.
  
  
Lead Generation: Actively reach out to new architectural firms and interior design studios to showcase Curio Crafts’ metalwork portfolio and secure new orders.
  
  
Requirements & Qualifications:
  
  
Strict Industry Requirement: Background must be in metal decor, bespoke furniture, hardgoods, or architectural metalwork. (Note: Candidates with experience exclusively in soft furnishings, garments, or apparel design/sales will not be considered).
  
  
Experience: 2–4+ years of experience in luxury retail sales, bespoke furniture sales, or architectural business development.
  
  
Design Skills: Strong aesthetic sense with the ability to read interior floor plans. Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, or similar 3D modeling software is a massive advantage.
  
  
Attributes: Excellent spoken and written English, confident presentation skills, and a target-driven mindset.

Bihari Steel Solutions Private Limited (DORPRIME) is a technology-driven steel fabrication and engineering company specializing in precision laser cutting, CNC manufacturing, and customized metal fabrication solutions. Headquartered in Bihar, India, the company serves industrial, commercial, and infrastructure clients with engineered steel products designed for precision, durability, and performance. Its manufacturing capabilities include CNC fiber laser cutting, CNC press brake bending, fire-rated and non-fire metal doors, cable trays, steel almirahs, truck body fabrication, work trolleys, and custom sheet-metal components. With advanced technology, skilled engineering professionals, and strong process control, Bihari Steel Solutions delivers consistent quality and meets demanding project timelines. The company is committed to quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction, enabling clients to build stronger, safer, and more efficient projects under the DORPRIME brand.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Business Development Specialist role based in Noida. The Business Development Specialist will identify and qualify new business opportunities, generate leads across target sectors, and build a strong sales pipeline for steel fabrication and engineering services. Daily responsibilities include conducting market research, analyzing industry trends, engaging with prospective and existing clients, and presenting solutions aligned with customer requirements. The role involves preparing proposals and quotations, coordinating with internal engineering and operations teams, and following up to close opportunities and support contract negotiations. The Specialist will also maintain accurate records in CRM tools, provide post-sales support in collaboration with customer service teams, and contribute to strategic business growth initiatives.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills for evaluating markets, opportunities, and sales performance.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills for client outreach, presentations, and internal coordination.
* Candidates should possess Lead Generation skills to identify prospects, build pipelines, and nurture potential clients.
* Candidates should possess Market Research skills to assess competitors, industry trends, and customer needs.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service skills to manage relationships, respond to inquiries, and support ongoing accounts.
* Prior experience in business development or sales in manufacturing, engineering, or construction-related sectors is beneficial.
* Ability to work on-site in Noida, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Marketing, or a related field is preferred.
* Proficiency with CRM tools, MS Office, and basic data analysis is an advantage.

You will become a trusted advisor to doctors and practice teams, helping them improve clinical confidence, streamline workflows, elevate patient experiences, and grow sustainable businesses.

Align's digital ecosystem integrates advanced software, AI and machine learning, digital imaging, visualization, biomechanics, and material science to deliver industry-leading solutions worldwide.

* Build trusted, long-term partnerships with doctors and practice teams.

* Help practices identify opportunities to enhance efficiency, adoption, profitability, and patient experience.

**Lead Value-Based Commercial Conversations**

* Conduct structured, consultative conversations that uncover explicit and unspoken customer needs.
* Demonstrate the commercial and clinical value of Align solutions.
* Differentiate Align through insight-led selling rather than price-based selling.
* Confidently navigate competitive environments and complex objections.

**Drive Digital Transformation**

* Champion the Align Digital Workflow (ADW) and associated digital technologies.
* Help practices integrate digital workflows into daily operations.
* Demonstrate how technology can improve predictability, efficiency, patient engagement, and treatment outcomes.
* Become a trusted advocate for innovation and digital adoption.

**Deliver Meaningful Customer Impact**

* Support clinicians in developing confidence and capability in clear aligner treatment.
* Share evidence-based recommendations and best practices.
* Help practices improve patient outcomes and treatment experiences.
* Enable long-term practice transformation through technology and partnership.

**What Makes Someone Successful in This Role?**
**The Strongest PDMs Are**
**Growth Builders |**
They see opportunities where others see obstacles.
  
  
**Strategic Thinkers |**
They manage territories like businesses.
  
  
**Trusted Advisors |**
They earn credibility with customers through insight and partnership.
  
  
**Digital Advocates |**
They help customers embrace new technologies and ways of working.
  
  
**Category Creators |**
They help shape the future of digital dentistry by expanding adoption and influencing change.
  
  
**What We're Looking For**
**Who We're Looking For**
We would love to hear from professionals with experience in: Medical Devices | Healthcare Technology | Diagnostics | Capital Equipment | Dental Technologies | Orthodontics | Healthcare Solutions | Complex Consultative Sales
  
  
You will thrive in this role if you are: Commercially sharp and growth oriented | Highly customer focused | Curious and quick to learn | Resilient in competitive environments | Strong at relationship building | Passionate about technology and innovation | Motivated by business transformation rather than transactional selling
  
  
**A Message to Medical Device Professionals**
Many candidates initially view digital dentistry as a niche category. We see it differently.
  
  
While the category is specialized, the capabilities you build are broad and highly transferable. As a Practice Development Manager, you will develop expertise in strategic selling, customer transformation, digital adoption, territory leadership, commercial strategy, and market development.
  
  
**Digital dentistry is the category you enter. Healthcare transformation is the capability you build.**
**What Success Looks Like**
Success in this role means:

* Turning customer insight into business growth

**Summary:**
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Manager – Solution Architecture to lead the design and governance of end-to-end enterprise solutions supporting data products and corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines solution strategy, architecture leadership, and people management, translating complex business requirements into secure, scalable, and cost-effective solutions. **Solution Strategy & Architecture Leadership**

* Own end-to-end solution architecture across complex transformation initiatives, aligning business capabilities, functional requirements, and technology choices with enterprise strategy.
* Lead discovery and architecture workshops to define solution scope, assess current-state landscapes, and develop target-state designs and phased transition roadmaps.
* Define architecture across application, data, integration, infrastructure, and security domains, with clear component responsibilities, interfaces, deployment models, and dependencies.
* Evaluate build-versus-buy options, cloud services, enterprise products, and emerging technologies through structured trade-off analysis and targeted proofs of concept.
* Establish reference architectures, design patterns, architecture decision records, and review standards; ensure alignment with enterprise principles and govern justified exceptions.
* Lead architecture reviews and resolve cross-domain design challenges, balancing business fit, scalability, resilience, security, maintainability, and total cost of ownership.

**Architecture Governance & Delivery Excellence**

* Provide architecture oversight across concurrent engagements, maintaining traceability from requirements to design decisions, implementation, and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with engineering and delivery teams to translate designs into actionable work, validate feasibility, and manage technical dependencies, design changes, and architecture risks.
* Define measurable non-functional requirements for availability, performance, scalability, recovery, and supportability; guide validation through testing and operational readiness reviews.
* Develop migration and modernization approaches, including data migration, coexistence, cutover, and rollback; align sequencing, estimates, and cost assumptions with delivery teams.
* Embed security, privacy, data governance, and applicable compliance requirements in solution designs, working with control owners to assess risks and close design gaps.

**Team Leadership & Talent Management**

* Lead and scale a solution architecture team, coordinating application, data, integration, cloud, and security specialists across engagements.
* Build an inclusive, high-performance architecture practice focused on sound judgment, collaboration, reusable knowledge, and measurable business outcomes.
* Own hiring, resource allocation, performance management, succession planning, and capability development aligned with business demand and technology priorities.
* Mentor architects and technical leads on design quality, business understanding, stakeholder influence, and career growth; strengthen communities of practice and peer reviews.

* Lead architecture inputs for proposals, RFP responses, and client presentations, including solution narratives, estimates, assumptions, dependencies, and implementation approaches.
* Communicate architecture decisions, delivery implications, technical risks, and business value clearly to executive and technical audiences.

**Reusable Solutions & Innovation**

* Develop reusable solution blueprints, accelerators, and integration patterns that improve consistency, reduce delivery effort, and support repeatable client outcomes.
* Assess opportunities to simplify application portfolios and modernize legacy solutions, balancing reuse and standardization with business-specific requirements.
* Evaluate analytics, automation, and AI-enabled solutions through business cases and proofs of value, addressing data readiness, security, responsible use, and operational feasibility.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 12+ years of experience across solution architecture, software engineering, enterprise integration, or data platforms, including ownership of complex enterprise solution designs.
* 5+ years of architecture or engineering people-management experience, with a proven track record of leading architects or technical leads across multiple programs or engagements.

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep experience designing solutions on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including hybrid integration, deployment models, resilience, and cost considerations.
* Strong expertise in application architecture, APIs, microservices, event-driven systems, enterprise integration patterns, and the trade-offs between distributed and simpler architectures.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, including transactional systems, data warehouses or lakehouses, data pipelines, master data, and analytics integration.
* Experience producing architecture models, interface specifications, decision records, and non-functional requirements; familiarity with frameworks or methods such as TOGAF, C4, or ArchiMate.
* Expertise in secure solution design, identity and access management, data protection, and enterprise governance, with working knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD, observability, and operational support.

**Architecture & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to guide enterprise solutions from discovery and option assessment through design governance, implementation oversight, and transition to operations.
* Experience leading architecture reviews, proofs of concept, vendor evaluations, and risk assessments while managing cross-team dependencies and stakeholder expectations.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Understanding of enterprise business processes and data models; exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A) is preferred.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**
