title: Salesperson
description:
**Company Description**
Oncquest Laboratories Ltd is a leading clinical diagnostics organization that has evolved from its origins as the Dabur Research Foundation’s research entity in 2001 into a recognized leader in cancer and molecular diagnostics. The company offers one of the most comprehensive pathology test menus in the region, ranging from routine tests to specialized, super-specialized, and advanced genomic testing. With a national footprint of over 50 labs, 500 collection centers, and 2,500 service associates, Oncquest conducts more than 4,000 different tests using over 200 technologies. Its highly skilled team of doctors with a combined experience of more than 600 years, strong logistics, and Pan Asia presence make it a preferred partner for clinicians, hospitals, and research organizations. Promoted by the Burman family, the promoters of Dabur, Oncquest is committed to supporting patients and partners, including during health crises and pandemic conditions.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Salesperson role based in Rajarhat. The Salesperson will be responsible for identifying and developing new business opportunities, building and maintaining relationships with clinicians, hospitals, and diagnostic partners, and promoting Oncquest’s range of diagnostic and genomic testing services. Daily activities include meeting prospective and existing clients, explaining test menus and service offerings, preparing and delivering sales presentations, and following up on leads to achieve sales targets. The role also involves coordinating with internal laboratory and logistics teams to ensure smooth service delivery, managing client feedback, and maintaining accurate records of sales activities and customer interactions. The Salesperson is expected to stay informed about industry trends, competitor offerings, and emerging diagnostic technologies to effectively position Oncquest’s solutions in the market.

channels

title: Oracle - SCM and Procurement - SCM-Functional Consultant - Senior
description:
**Job Summary:**
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Cloud Supply Chain Management (SCM) and Procurement (PROC) Functional Consultant at Senior level with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience. The successful candidate will independently support and deliver Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation, transformation, rollout and support engagements across Procurement and related SCM areas, including Self Service Procurement, Purchasing, Sourcing, Supplier Qualification and Management, Procurement Contracts, Inventory Management, Order Management, Product Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain Planning, Cost Management, Maintenance and Logistics. The role requires strong hands-on functional capability, client-facing delivery experience and relevant industry/domain expertise to translate real-world source-to-pay and supply-chain requirements into scalable Oracle Fusion solutions. Knowledge of Oracle Redwood user experience and Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio is also expected.
  
**Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**
•Deliver Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM and Procurement implementation, transformation, rollout and support activities from requirements gathering through design, configuration, testing, deployment and stabilization.
  
•Manage assigned workstream tasks, plans, risks, issues, dependencies, quality and stakeholder updates under the guidance of the project lead or manager.
  
•Facilitate business workshops, assess current-state industry processes and translate requirements into scalable future-state Oracle Fusion SCM and Procurement solutions aligned with leading practices.
  
•Perform functional fit-gap analysis, configuration, prototyping, conference room pilots, testing, training, cutover and go-live support.
  
•Design integrated source-to-pay, procure-to-pay and supply-chain solutions across Procurement, Inventory Management, Order Management, Cost Management and related SCM modules, coordinating dependencies with Payables, Finance, Projects, reporting, integration, security and data teams.
  
•Prepare high-quality functional designs, configuration workbooks, process flows, test artefacts, user guides and training materials in line with Oracle implementation methodologies.
  
•Assess Oracle Redwood readiness, support business-process redesign for Redwood pages and guided experiences, and execute adoption, testing and change-impact activities.
  
•Identify suitable SCM use cases for Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio and support the definition of agent topics, instructions, tools, data access, human-approval checkpoints and expected outcomes.
  
•Collaborate with technical, security and integration teams to configure, test, publish and monitor AI agents and agentic workflows within Oracle Fusion.
  
•Follow responsible AI controls covering role-based access, data privacy, traceability, testing, monitoring and business-owner approval.
  
•Support SIT, UAT, regression testing, cutover and production support, and drive timely resolution of defects and functional queries.
  
•Contribute to client presentations, solution demonstrations, estimates, proposals, knowledge assets and practice-development initiatives.
  
•Guide junior consultants, review assigned deliverables and maintain delivery quality and internal KPIs.
  
  
  
Requirements
  
  
**Experience:**
•Minimum 5 years of relevant Oracle SCM and Procurement experience, including strong hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud.
  
•At least two end-to-end ERP implementation or transformation engagements, including at least one Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM implementation.
  
•Strong functional expertise in Oracle Fusion Procurement—including Self Service Procurement, Purchasing, Sourcing, Supplier Qualification and Management, Supplier Portal and Procurement Contracts—together with hands-on knowledge of at least one core SCM area such as Inventory Management, Order Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain Planning, Product Management, Cost Management, Maintenance or Logistics.
  
•Hands-on experience with source-to-pay and procure-to-pay process design, enterprise structures, procurement business units, requisitioning, purchasing, approvals, catalogs, supplier onboarding, sourcing, contracts, receiving, integrations, data migration, reporting and operational controls.
  
•Practical knowledge of Oracle Redwood UX, including Redwood page adoption, process redesign, extension considerations, testing and end-user change management.
  
•Working knowledge of Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio, including agent configuration concepts, topics, instructions, tools, workflow orchestration, deployment, security and monitoring.
  
•Ability to support high-value agentic SCM use cases, such as supplier onboarding assistance, procurement policy guidance, order exception management, inventory insights or planning support.
  
•Client-facing delivery experience with sound planning, estimation, risk management, testing and quality assurance capabilities.
  
•Demonstrable industry/domain experience in at least one sector—such as retail, government, energy, real estate, oil and gas, manufacturing, utilities, logistics or consumer products—with practical understanding of sector-specific procurement, supplier, inventory, fulfilment, planning and operational-control requirements.
  
**Competencies / Skills:**
•Strong stakeholder management, consulting, collaboration and junior-team mentoring skills.
  
•Ability to independently manage assigned functional workstreams, priorities and deliverables within agreed timelines.
  
•Excellent verbal, written and presentation skills, with the ability to explain business and functional concepts clearly.
  
•Strong analytical, industry-process design, problem-solving and decision-making capabilities, with the ability to apply domain knowledge to Oracle Fusion SCM and Procurement solutions.
  
•Sound understanding of responsible AI, data privacy, access controls, human oversight and governance for enterprise agentic solutions.
  
•Awareness of Oracle quarterly updates and the ability to assess new SCM, Redwood and embedded-AI capabilities for business adoption.
  
•Proficiency in delivery and collaboration tools such as Microsoft Project, Jira, Azure DevOps or equivalent.
  
•Valid passport and willingness to travel to client sites and work MENA business schedules, including Sunday to Thursday, where required.
  
**Education:**
•Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business Administration, Information Systems or a related discipline; an MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred.
  
•Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM and/or Procurement certification in relevant modules is preferred; credentials or demonstrated training in Oracle Redwood and Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio are an added advantage.

title: Senior Manager - Performance & Growth Marketing
description:
**About the job**

About the CompanySamaaro is an AI-powered event marketing platform that enables marketing teams to turn events into a measurable growth channel by planning, promoting, executing, and measuring their business impact. We are building for marketing teams as they scale their event GTM, and we solve two hard problems for them: getting the right people in the room, and proving the ROI of events. Recognized by YourStory as one of the Top 30 Most Innovative Startups in India, Samaaro works with phenomenal brands including PepsiCo, FIFA, Dr. Reddy's, The Times of India, TVS Motor, and Sodexo across geographies and industries.

**About the Role**

Own Samaaro's paid growth engine, from first impression to closed revenue. You will run paid acquisition, the marketing funnel, the MarTech stack and our agencies, and turn marketing spend into qualified pipeline. Marketing and Sales work as one revenue team toward a shared pipeline number, and you are measured on pipeline and CAC, not lead volume.

**What You Will Own**

**Performance Marketing (about 65% of the role)**

* **Paid channels:**
  Run Google, LinkedIn, Meta and new paid channels end to end across India and the US, including campaign structure, audience targeting, budgets, creatives, offers and landing pages.
* **Pipeline target:**
  Own the monthly and quarterly pipeline target from marketing. Build the plan to reach it, spot gaps early and adjust spend, channels or conversion to close them.
* **Budget and efficiency:**
  Own the ad and marketing tool budget. Track each channel from spend to MQLs, SQLs, pipeline and revenue, know the CAC and pipeline generated per rupee, and move budget to what produces pipeline.
* **Experimentation and conversion:**
  Keep testing audiences, offers, messaging, creatives and landing pages. Find where the funnel leaks, run experiments and scale what works.
* **Lead nurturing and retargeting:**
  Build nurture journeys for accounts that engage, nurture leads that stall in the pipeline and retarget leads that drop out, so they are warm when Sales picks them up.
* **ABM and outbound support:**
  Run awareness campaigns on LinkedIn and Meta to warm up target accounts before Sales reaches out.
* **Competitive intelligence:**
  Track competitor ads, keywords, offers and positioning, and turn the gaps you find into campaign tests.

**Marketing Management (about 35% of the role)**

* **MarTech stack:**
  Run HubSpot and its connected tools for enrichment, intent, outbound and calling. Keep integrations healthy and cut tools that do not pay off.
* **Reporting:**
  Share a weekly update on what changed, why and what comes next, and a monthly view of spend, pipeline and revenue by channel. Build dashboards that leadership can read without help.
* **Lead management:**
  Own the lead lifecycle, routing, account scoring by fit, intent and engagement, and CRM hygiene. Agree lead stages, handoff rules and response times with Sales.
* **Agencies and vendors:**
  Brief and manage partners for the website, SEO, backlinks, campaigns and outbound, and hold them to results. You own their outcomes.
* **Cross-team collaboration:**
  Work hands-on with content and design to get campaign assets built and shipped. Give sales the data, assets and systems they need. Work with product and leadership when needed.

**You Have**

* **B2B experience:**
  6 to 9 years in B2B marketing, including at least 4 years running Google and LinkedIn Ads hands-on.
* **Long sales cycles:**
  Experience at a B2B tech company where buying cycles run over several months.
* **Commercial ownership:**
  You can work back from a pipeline target to the spend, traffic, conversion rates, MQLs, SQLs and opportunities needed to reach it, and you know how to find and fix a leaking funnel.
* **Cross-team leadership:**
  You have managed agencies to deadlines and led work across teams without formal authority.
* **Marketing stack:**

title: Performance Marketing Lead
description:
Emergent builds autonomous coding agents that replace traditional software development by generating, testing, and deploying production applications directly from plain-language intent. Our systems run in production at global scale and are used to build millions of real applications.

Since our public launch, we’ve crossed
**$130M in Annualised Revenue**
and grown to
**over 10M users across 190+ countries**
, who have built
**12M+ applications**
on Emergent. We’re backed by
**Creaegis, Khosla Ventures, SoftBank, Lightspeed, Together, Y Combinator, Google, Claypond and Sentinel Global.**

We’re solving the hard part of AI-driven software creation: correctness, reliability, security, and scale in real production systems. The team is built by
**repeat founders, Olympiad medalists, IIT & IIM alumni,**
and leaders from
**Google, Amazon, and Dropbox.**

We’re hiring builders who want ownership, speed, and impact at global scale.

**The Role:**

You’ll own paid acquisition across every channel and market, on a budget of several million dollars a month. Your goal is to grow first-month and lifetime revenue at a target return on ad spend (ROAS), not to grow clicks or signups. You’ll decide where each next dollar goes, by country, channel, campaign, and partner, and you’ll be the first to notice when a channel looks good on the dashboard but brings in users who never build anything or pay twice.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Own the plan: split monthly budget across Google (non-brand and brand), Meta, Bing, TikTok, programmatic, affiliates, and influencers, and across 30+ countries, based on where marginal ROAS is highest. Each month, defend the plan against what actually happened
* Run channels hands-on and through agencies: Search, Performance Max and AI Max, Meta Advantage+ and value-based campaigns, app campaigns, and programmatic partners. Know when to scale, cap, or cut
* Hold affiliates and partners accountable: find low-quality and incentivised traffic at the sub-publisher level, for example a source whose users pay for a trial within minutes but never create a project. Reverse bad payouts, and design commission structures that pay for real usage and renewals, not trial sign-ups
* Measure on revenue, not on platform reports: judge every channel on day-0, day-7, and day-30 revenue per signup, payback period, and repeat purchasing, from our own data. Know where ad platforms over-count, and why
* Keep the tracking healthy: own server-side conversion setup (Meta CAPI, Google enhanced and offline conversions), the conversion values sent for value-based bidding, and UTM and attribution standards. Notice quickly when an event breaks
* Work with product and pricing: paywall, trial, pricing, and top-up offer changes move ROAS as much as bids do. Partner with Growth Product to read those changes by country and channel, and to tell traffic-quality problems apart from product problems
* Run a creative and landing-page testing programme by market and language, including localised and creator-led ads
* Build and lead the team: channel managers, analysts, and agencies

**What We’re Looking For:**

* 7+ years in performance marketing, including 3+ years owning a budget of $1M+ a month across several channels and countries
* Hands-on depth in Google Ads and Meta Ads: account structure, bidding strategies (tCPA, tROAS, value-based), budget pacing, and recognising when automated campaigns are buying cheap, low-intent traffic
* Comfortable judging growth on LTV and ROAS in a subscription or usage-based business, including how free trials, discounts, and repeat purchases change what a “conversion” is worth
* Strong SQL: you can query a warehouse such as BigQuery yourself to build cohorts, break down a change by country and channel, and check what the platforms report
* Has managed affiliates or performance networks at scale (Impact, PartnerStack, or similar), including detecting fraud and incentivised traffic and enforcing payout terms
* Solid grasp of attribution and measurement: server-side conversions, UTM hygiene, gaps between ad-platform and internal numbers, and designing holdout or geo tests
* Can explain a drop: when a metric moves, you separate traffic mix from product change from tracking error before acting, and you write it up clearly for leadership
* Has led people and agencies and is comfortable setting their targets and holding them to them

**Good to Have:**

* Has worked on a product-led AI, developer-tool, or SaaS product whose users discover it through search
* Has run localised acquisition in Europe (Italy, France, Germany, Spain) and/or high-volume, low-price markets (India, Brazil, Indonesia), including local payment and pricing differences
* Python or notebook skills for budget-allocation models, response curves, or marketing mix modelling (MMM)
* Has used newer channels: ChatGPT and AI-search ads, Reddit, YouTube, programmatic (StackAdapt, The Trade Desk), connected TV
* Has run influencer and creator programmes measured on revenue, not reach
* Has worked closely with product and pricing teams on paywall, trial, and offer experiments
* Has built a performance marketing function from scratch at a fast-growing startup

**Why Join Us:**

* Work at the frontier of agentic AI, helping real users experience the next generation of computing
* Collaborate with a small, fast, and deeply technical team obsessed with product and growth
* Shape a new paradigm where software builds itself from human intent
* Competitive compensation, equity, and real ownership of the growth function

**Benefits and Perks:**

1. Daily Meals: Lunch and Dinner provided
2. Family Insurance: 5 Lakhs worth of coverage for you and your family
3. Unlimited Paid Time Off: Take the time you need to recharge and come back refreshed
4. Flexible Working Hours: Work arrangements that fit your life and commitments

Let’s build the future of software together.

description:
**Job Description**

Associate Manager, SMM (Social Media Marketing)

Industry: EdTech (Education Technology)

Location: Bangalore

Reporting To: Associate Director, Global Brand & Comms

**Position Overview**

TutorCloud is hiring an Associate Manager for Social Media Marketing to build our social presence from the ground up. For most schools, teachers, and parents, social media is the first place they'll come across TutorCloud, long before anyone books a demo. You'll be setting the cadence, the content, and the creator relationships from scratch, across India, the US, and UAE, and each of those markets has a different audience with different reasons to care.

Part of this job is also building out our influencer and creator work. We don't want this treated as a side project tacked onto regular posting; it should function as its own channel. Teacher influencers, parenting and education creators, and smaller community voices tend to carry more trust than anything we could post ourselves. You'll be the one finding these people, working out partnerships with them, and making sure it addsup to something ongoing rather than a handful of one-time posts.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Social Strategy & Execution**

Plan and run the social calendar across LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube/Shorts, and Facebook, keeping it in step with campaigns and events

Manage day to day community interactions, replying to comments and messages in a tone that actually sounds like us

Keep tabs on relevant conversations and trends across our markets so content ideas aren't coming from a vacuum

Build out strategy separately for India (teachers and school decision makers), the US (district leaders and parents), and UAE (schools), since these audiences don't respond to the same messaging.

Brief the copy, design, and video team clearly enough that they're not guessing what you need

Take events, webinars, and thought leadership pieces (like exec interviews or op-eds) and turn them into ongoing content rather than a single post

Shoot and edit quick, lightweight content on your own when needed, phone reels, quick clips from an event floor, that kind of thing, so you're not always waiting on the video editor

Track and report on performance: reach, engagement, and how social is actually contributing to leads and event ROI

**Influencer & Creator Partnerships**

Build a working list of relevant creators and influencers across India, the US, and UAE, from teacher

influencers to parenting and education content creators

Handle the full loop with creators: reaching out, briefing them, negotiating terms, and tracking how each partnership performs

Guide the tone and script direction for creator content, Hinglish and English for India, English for the US and UAE

**What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days**

There's a real content calendar running across the main platforms, with a posting rhythm that's holding up

First phase of influencer or creator partnerships are already briefed and moving

A first performance baseline exists, so from month two onward, growth gets measured against actual numbers rather than a guess.

**Who You Are**

3 to 5 years in social media, with real experience managing influencer or creator relationships, not just organic posting

You're equally comfortable planning the strategy and doing the daily execution yourself

Some basic shooting and editing ability, phone or camera, plus something like CapCut or Premiere Rush.

No need to be a trained editor, just quick on your feet

Used to working closely with design, video, and copy people, and know how to brief them well

You look at the numbers regularly and actually change what you're doing based on them

EdTech, SaaS, or consumer education background helps, but it's not a dealbreaker.

**What We Offer**

A social and creator function you're building from the ground up, nothing inherited, nothing to undo

Direct ownership from day one, working alongside the Brand & Comms leadership team

Three genuinely different markets to work across (India, US, UAE) instead of one audience wearing

different hats

A small but growing Brand & Comms team around you, not a one-person department

✚ Equal Opportunity Employer

We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. Applications are welcome from candidates of all backgrounds

and experiences.

title: SEO & AI Growth Executive
description:
**About Learnbay**

At
**Learnbay**

, we believe career conversations should be about more than just selling a course.

For over 10 years, we have helped
**2L+ learners**

build skills and transition towards better technology careers.

We are building a culture where
**performance and people go hand in hand**

-  where you are expected to own your numbers, but you are also supported in learning, growing and becoming better at what you do.

If you enjoy talking to people, understanding what they actually need, handling objections intelligently, and closing a conversation with confidence - you might fit right in.

**🎯 What you'll be doing?**

Are you an SEO professional who loves experimenting, analysing data, building quality backlinks, and finding smarter ways to grow organic traffic using AI?

At
**Learnbay**

, we’re looking for an execution-driven
**SEO & AI Growth Executive**

who understands the fundamentals of SEO, can take ownership of off-page SEO initiatives, and knows how to combine human expertise with AI-powered workflows to drive sustainable organic growth.

**Your day-to-day will include:**

**1. SEO Strategy & Performance**

* Execute On-Page, Off-Page, and Technical SEO initiatives to improve organic visibility and rankings.
* Conduct keyword research and identify opportunities based on search intent, competition, and business relevance.
* Monitor organic performance using Google Search Console (GSC), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and other SEO tools.
* Analyse competitor strategies, ranking gaps, backlink profiles, and content opportunities.
* Track performance, identify bottlenecks, and recommend actionable improvements.

**2. Off-Page SEO & Link Building**

* Identify, evaluate, and pursue relevant backlink opportunities across high-quality websites and publishers.
* Build and maintain a consistent pipeline of approximately
  **15–20 relevant link-building prospects or outreach opportunities per day**

  , prioritising relevance and quality over volume.
* Coordinate guest posts, digital PR placements, and external publishing opportunities with agencies and publishers.
* Research competitor backlinks and uncover new opportunities to strengthen domain authority and organic visibility.
* Maintain accurate outreach, follow-up, and backlink tracking records.

**3. Content & AI-Powered SEO**

* Plan, write, and optimise approximately
  **10 high-quality articles per month**

  for guest posts, PR publications, and external platforms.
* Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini to accelerate research, content briefs, optimisation, and content refreshes.
* Ensure all published content is original, fact-checked, useful, naturally written, and aligned with the target audience and search intent.
* Identify content gaps, declining pages, and opportunities to improve existing content.
* Experiment with emerging search trends, including
  **Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO)**

  and
  **Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO)**

  .

**🧠
The kind of person we're looking for:**

* **1–5 years of hands-on SEO experience**

  , particularly in Off-Page SEO and link building.
* Strong understanding of keyword research, search intent, On-Page SEO, Technical SEO, and organic performance metrics.
* Practical experience with Google Search Console and GA4.
* Experience identifying backlink prospects, evaluating publisher quality, and coordinating outreach or guest posts.
* Ability to write or develop high-quality content that sounds human, not machine-generated.
* Familiarity with AI tools and the ability to integrate them meaningfully into everyday SEO workflows.
* An analytical mindset, strong attention to detail, and a bias for action.
* Someone who takes ownership, tests new approaches, learns from results, and consistently follows through.

**⭐**
**Good to have:**

* Hands-on experience with Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, or similar SEO tools.
* Exposure to AEO/GEO and AI-driven search experiences.
* Experience in EdTech, SaaS, technology, or other competitive digital-first industries.
* Understanding of white-hat link-building practices and digital PR.

**Learnbay - Let's build the future of tech careers together. 🚀**

**About Studyties**

Studyties is building India's first unified platform for schools, bringing school-related services, resources, and opportunities together in one place. Our vision is to simplify and transform the school ecosystem through technology, creating a connected platform for schools, students, parents, educators, and other stakeholders.

We are looking for a results-driven Performance Marketing Executive who can plan, execute, and optimize digital marketing campaigns to drive user acquisition, generate qualified leads, and accelerate business growth.

**Role Overview**

As a Performance Marketing Executive at Studyties, you will take ownership of paid advertising campaigns, audience targeting, conversion optimization, and performance analysis across digital platforms. You will work closely with the marketing, content, and design teams to develop data-driven strategies that deliver measurable results.

The ideal candidate has 1–2 years of hands-on experience in performance marketing, understands paid advertising platforms, and can translate campaign data into actionable growth strategies.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan, launch, manage, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Meta Ads, Google Ads, and other relevant platforms.
* Develop performance marketing strategies focused on lead generation, user acquisition, website traffic, and conversions.
* Conduct audience research, competitor analysis, keyword research, and customer segmentation.
* Manage campaign budgets effectively to achieve acquisition targets and maximize return on advertising spend.
* Monitor key performance metrics, including CTR, CPC, CPM, CPL, CPA, conversion rate, and ROAS.
* Conduct A/B testing of ad creatives, copy, headlines, audience segments, landing pages, and campaign structures.
* Develop and execute retargeting strategies to improve conversion rates and reduce acquisition costs.
* Collaborate with content creators and designers to develop high-performing ad creatives and marketing assets.
* Set up, monitor, and troubleshoot conversion tracking using Meta Pixel, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and related tools.
* Analyze campaign performance and prepare regular reports with insights, recommendations, and optimization plans.
* Identify growth opportunities across acquisition channels and continuously experiment with new campaign strategies.
* Ensure campaigns comply with advertising platform policies and maintain accurate performance tracking.
* Work toward defined marketing KPIs and contribute to Studyties' overall growth objectives.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* 1–2 years of relevant professional experience in performance marketing or paid digital advertising.
* Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.
* Strong understanding of campaign setup, audience targeting, bidding strategies, budget allocation, and optimization.
* Practical knowledge of conversion tracking, marketing funnels, and attribution fundamentals.
* Ability to interpret campaign data and make data-backed decisions.
* Proficiency in Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel for performance tracking and reporting.
* Understanding of ad copy, creative testing, landing page optimization, and conversion rate optimization.
* Strong analytical thinking, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns independently and meet performance targets.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a startup, technology company, education technology business, or lead-generation-focused organization.
* Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, and conversion APIs.
* Experience managing advertising budgets and improving customer acquisition efficiency.
* Understanding of SEO, organic marketing, CRM tools, and marketing automation.
* A portfolio of campaigns, performance reports, or measurable results from previous work.

**What We Offer**

* An opportunity to take ownership of real performance marketing campaigns.
* The chance to work closely with the founding and marketing teams.
* A fast-paced environment with opportunities to experiment, learn, and implement new strategies.
* Exposure to growth marketing, customer acquisition, and brand-building initiatives.
* An opportunity to contribute directly to the growth of an emerging education technology platform.
* Professional growth based on performance, ownership, and results.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates should submit their updated resume along with a brief overview of their previous performance marketing experience. Applicants are encouraged to highlight the campaigns they have managed, advertising platforms they have worked with, budgets handled, and measurable results achieved.

If you are passionate about performance marketing, data-driven growth, and building scalable acquisition strategies, we would love to hear from you.

* \*Join Studyties and help shape the future of India's school ecosystem through performance-driven growth.\*

.

  **WordPress and Webflow**

  **GEO / Generative Engine Optimization / AI Search Optimization**
  .

  **WordPress and Webflow**
  .

  **Ahrefs/Semrush, Google Search Console, GA4, Screaming Frog**

title: Growth Marketer
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a data-driven and results-oriented Growth Marketer to drive customer acquisition, lead generation, conversion optimization, and overall business growth. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with digital marketing channels, performance campaigns, analytics, and growth strategies to improve marketing effectiveness and generate measurable business results.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute growth marketing strategies to drive business growth, customer acquisition, and lead generation.
* Plan, launch, and optimize digital marketing campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other relevant platforms.
* Collaborate with content, SEO, design, and sales teams to improve marketing performance and lead quality.
* Analyze website traffic, campaign performance, conversion rates, and customer behavior to identify growth opportunities.
* Conduct A/B testing on landing pages, ad creatives, email campaigns, and calls to action to improve conversions.
* Optimize marketing funnels to increase lead conversion rates and reduce customer acquisition costs.
* Develop and execute email marketing, remarketing, and customer engagement campaigns.
* Track and report key performance indicators (KPIs), including cost per lead (CPL), customer acquisition cost (CAC), return on ad spend (ROAS), conversion rates, and ROI.
* Use analytics and CRM tools to monitor campaign performance and improve lead nurturing processes.
* Conduct competitor analysis, audience research, and market research to identify new growth opportunities.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams to align marketing initiatives with business objectives.
* Experiment with new marketing channels, strategies, and tools to achieve sustainable growth.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
* 2–5 years of hands-on experience in growth marketing, digital marketing, or performance marketing.
* Experience managing paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, or LinkedIn Ads.
* Working knowledge of Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and conversion tracking.
* Understanding of SEO, landing-page optimization, marketing funnels, and lead-generation strategies.
* Experience with CRM platforms and marketing automation tools such as HubSpot, Zoho, or similar platforms.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data and make data-driven decisions.
* Knowledge of A/B testing, audience segmentation, remarketing, and conversion rate optimization.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and project management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns and prioritize activities based on business impact.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, technology, or lead-generation businesses.
* Familiarity with email marketing platforms and marketing automation workflows.
* Understanding of SEO content strategy and organic growth channels.
* Experience using AI-powered marketing tools to improve productivity and campaign performance.
* Basic knowledge of SQL, dashboards, or business intelligence tools is an added advantage.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Qualified leads generated and lead-to-customer conversion rate.
* Cost per lead (CPL) and customer acquisition cost (CAC).
* Return on ad spend (ROAS) and marketing ROI.
* Website traffic and landing-page conversion rate.
* Marketing-qualified leads (MQLs) and sales-qualified leads (SQLs).
* Campaign performance and budget utilization.
* Customer retention and revenue contribution, where applicable.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for a proactive, analytical, and growth-oriented professional who can combine marketing creativity with data-driven decision-making. The ideal candidate should be comfortable experimenting with new strategies, measuring results, and continuously optimizing campaigns to achieve business goals.

title: Organic Growth Manager
description:
Sprinto is an
**Autonomous Trust Platform**
that centralizes trust requirements across
**security frameworks, vendors, and customers.**
Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.
  
  
Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve
**raised**
**$31.8M**
in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over
**4,000 organizations across 75 countries**
, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With
**300+ native integrations**
and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports
**200+ global security standards natively**
, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.
  
  
**Founded in 2020**
by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.
  
  
**Life as a Sprinter -**
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.
  
  
We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.
  
  
Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.
  
  
We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.
  
  
And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.
  
  
**The mission -**
We're hiring an Organic Growth Manager to own how Sprinto gets discovered, chosen, and bought without paying for every click. You own the number: qualified pipeline and revenue from organic, AI discovery, and our website.
  
  
This is not an SEO role with a bigger title. It's a business owner's role. You'll set the strategy, build the team, run the analytics, and still get your hands dirty when a problem needs cracking.
  
  
**Your mandate**
Two goals, one number behind both: revenue.
  
  
  

* Grow revenue from organic and AI discovery. Double organic-sourced qualified pipeline in next 12 months, measured in SQLs, pipeline value, and closed revenue. Not traffic.
* Make Sprinto the answer wherever our buyers research. Google, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, analyst and review sites, publications, communities. When a Head of GRC at a 1,000-person SaaS company asks "what should I use?", Sprinto shows up, and shows up positioned right.

**Where you'll leave your mark?**
**Strategy and the number**

* Own the organic growth strategy end to end: from discovery to qualified demand, pipeline, and revenue.
* Decide where the team spends its time and money, and what it stops doing.

**Diagnosis and problem solving**

* Build a clear, evidence-backed view of where Sprinto is winning and losing in discovery, and take the bets that changes the trajectory.
* Investigate why certain pages, brands, and sources get picked by search engines and AI answers. Turn what you learn into experiments.
* Treat every stalled metric as a problem to solve, not a status to report.

**Analytics and measurement**

* Solve attribution for AI discovery, where clicks are rare and influence is real. Define how we count it.
* Run a portfolio of experiments, at least 15-20 a quarter across the team, with clear hypotheses, success criteria, and kill rules.
* Make decisions from data and enable the team to do the same.

**Visibility and category position**

* Win & Own the categories that matter: Compliance, GRC, TPRM, ERM etc
* Fix how AI models describe Sprinto, starting with the "not enterprise-first" narrative.
* Build discoverability with mid-market and enterprise buyers in the US and other priority markets.

**Website and conversion**

* Own how organic and AI-referred visitors convert: landing pages, comparison pages, CTAs, and conversion paths.
* Work with BDRs & Sales on lead quality so we grow SQLs that close, not just form fills.

**Team and systems**

* Build systems that compound: automation, programmatic approaches, and repeatable playbooks, so output doesn't depend on heroics.
* Partner with Content Marketing to define what gets created, how it's distributed, and how it converts.

**The kind of builder we're looking for -**
**You own outcomes.**
You've owned a revenue or pipeline number before, not just a traffic number. When you commit to a target, you find a way to hit it. When something breaks, you don't wait to be told.
  
  
**You're an exceptional problem solver.**
You break messy problems into parts, form hypotheses, and test them fast. You challenge easy explanations, including your own.
  
  
**You're deeply analytical.**
You're comfortable in GA4, GSC, HubSpot or Salesforce, and spreadsheets or SQL. You can build a funnel model, spot the leak, and size the opportunity. You know the difference between correlation and cause, and you design tests that tell them apart.
  
  
**You've built or turned something around.**
A growth channel, a product, a business. Ideally you've revived something that was declining, and you can show which decisions made the difference.
  
  
**You understand where discovery is going.**
You know how search, AI answers, review sites, and communities shape B2B buying today. You've tested your way to results there, not just read about it.
  
  
**You lead and still do.**
You can hire, coach, and set direction for a small team. You can also run the analysis or rebuild the page yourself when it matters.
  
  
**Experience:**
typically 5-8 years in demand gen/inbound marketing or growth. You've cracked at least one non-paid channel yourself, such as organic, content, community, partnerships, or product-led, and can show how. You've solved complex, ambiguous problems and can walk us through your thinking. Experience leading people is a plus. Founders and founding marketers welcome.
  
  
US market experience is a strong plus. What you've built matters more than your last title.
  
  
**How we care for our Sprinters?**

* Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach
* Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
* We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills
* We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
* Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
* Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you

**Inclusion & Diversity -**
At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.
  
  
We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Associate Lifecycle CRM
description:
**Join Skillz and Level Up Your Career!**
Are you ready to take your career to the next level? Join Skillz, the first publicly-traded mobile esports platform that hosts billions of casual mobile gaming tournaments for millions of players worldwide. Skillz is revolutionizing the gaming industry, providing the ultimate platform for competitive mobile games. By fostering social competition within games, Skillz empowers developers to create multi-million dollar franchises while connecting players through fair, enjoyable, and meaningful competition.
  
  
At Skillz, we firmly believe that everyone is born with unique skills and deserves to experience an epic win. We understand the thrill of achievement and the satisfaction of overcoming challenges. That's why we passionately champion game developers and players alike, empowering them to unleash their full potential through the power of competition.
  
  
**Life @ Skillz**

* Culture of Impact: Join a united team of builders, creators, innovators, and entrepreneurs driven by the desire to win. At Skillz, we create value and make a difference in the world.
* Comprehensive Benefits: Enjoy peace of mind with our comprehensive benefits package, which includes 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision expenses for both you and your entire family.
* Wellness Support: Enhance your well-being with our array of wellness initiatives, including meditation and mental health resources, physical fitness coaching and classes, family planning assistance, health and parenting guidance, virtual therapy sessions, and more.
* Perks: We believe in enhancing your work experience. Enjoy daily breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks, Friday Happy Hours, insurance, and many more. We also offer competitive paid time off (PTO) & company holidays to help you recharge and pursue your passions.

**Why Skillz?**

* Pioneers of Skill-Based Competition: Skillz is not just any company in the gaming industry; we are the pioneers of skill-based competition, partnered with industry titans like UFC, NFL, T-Mobile, Buzztime, while also hosting renowned events like the Game Developer Conference (GDC). Join us in transforming the way people play games and building the home of competition for all.
* Impact Beyond Gaming: Skillz harnesses the power of its platform to support nonprofit organizations such as Susan G. Komen, American Cancer Society, the NAACP, and more. By participating in Skillz tournaments, you can make a difference and contribute to causes you care about.
* Recognized Success: Skillz has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, CNBC's Disruptor 50, San Francisco Business Times' Best Places to Work, Forbes' Next Billion-Dollar Startups, and the #1 fastest-growing company in America on the Inc. 5000 list, and many more.
* Talent Magnet: Join a team of talented professionals who are passionate about what they do. Our team includes experts from Meta, Apple, Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Tesla, Twitter (X), Roblox, Zynga, Samsung, Lyft, EA, Riot, Nexon, Gameskraft, PlayStation, Unity, Scopely, Tinder, Intel, Deloitte, EY, Twitch, DraftKings, and more.

**The Future of Gaming Awaits!**
The gaming industry is larger than movies, music, and books combined, with over 3 billion active gamers playing monthly and over 25 million active developers worldwide. Mobile gaming, in particular, is the fastest-growing segment, projected to reach $300 billion by 2025. At Skillz, you have the opportunity to be at the forefront of this exciting industry and shape its future.
  
  
**About The Role**
Push notifications, email, and reactivation are Skillz's fastest available revenue levers. This role owns building the instrumentation, holdout-based measurement, and journey ownership needed to turn owned channels into an accountable, optimized growth engine.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own email, push notification and in-app messaging as a single lifecycle function for Skillz Platform — strategy, calendar, execution and measurement.
* Own reactivation marketing end to end: cohort definition, offer design, ROI gating against held-out controls, step-downs and exclusion rules for perpetual reactivators.
* Own CleverTap journey design and execution once ownership transfers from Product, and drive onboarding of remaining titles as SDK 26 coverage expands.
* Make every campaign measurable: holdout-audited incremental NGR per campaign, CTR by channel and game, deliverability, and unsub/opt-out guardrails.
* Enforce messaging hygiene — one notification per campaign per player, mutually exclusive segments, contextual interstitial triggers, and segment→campaign attribution so no segment is orphaned.
* Design reactivation and win-back offers within the incentive rules: above-30% bonuses reserved for genuine reactivation, framed as rare and limited.
* Manage the Email Marketing Manager and build the lifecycle bench.
* Partner with Analytics for holdout design and reads, Game LiveOps for surface slates, Launch GTM for feature adoption campaigns, and Product (Rishabh) for messaging machinery and PN observability.
* Report weekly: what was sent, what it earned, what is being retired, and what needs unblocking.

**Key Competencies**

* Incrementality-first thinking — instinctively asks what the control group did; treats sends, opens and pMAU as inputs rather than results.
* Lifecycle craft — journey design, triggers, frequency capping, suppression logic and deliverability, across push, email and in-app together rather than channel by channel.
* Offer economics — understands that a reactivated user arriving on bonus cash can be NGR-negative, and can defend a step-down against a stakeholder whose reactivation number it depresses.
* Hands-on tooling — configures journeys and segments themselves; can pull their own data in SQL or a BI tool.
* Player respect — treats notification volume as a finite asset and argues for fewer, better sends.
* Builds from zero — the function, the DL, the runbook and the measurement all need creating; comfortable with that rather than expecting an established machine.

**Experience**

* 2-4 years in lifecycle / CRM / retention marketing for a consumer mobile product, including direct ownership of a reactivation or win-back programme.
* Deep hands-on experience with a lifecycle platform — CleverTap strongly preferred; Braze, MoEngage, Iterable or WebEngage acceptable — including journey building, segmentation and frequency management.
* Ran holdout-based incrementality measurement on messaging campaigns and can evidence a campaign they killed on the number.
* Real-money gaming industry experience required.
* Owned push notification deliverability and opt-in economics, including double-dialogue opt-in patterns and the constraints of iOS re-enablement.
* Comfortable partnering with Product on instrumentation gaps and with Analytics on independent scoring; experience taking over tooling ownership from another function is a plus.

**Location:**
Hybrid in Bangalore, India.
  
  
**Travel Requirement:**
Less than 10%

description:

Sri Madhusudan Sai Global Humanitarian Mission

Muddenahalli, Karnataka

Under the visionary leadership of the globally acclaimed humanitarian, Sadguru Sri Madhusudan Sai, the Organisation is dedicated to uplifting the most marginalised communities. As the Marketing Manager, you will be responsible for developing and executing strategic marketing initiatives to promote the organisation's mission, programs, and fundraising efforts. Your role will involve leading marketing campaigns, engaging with diverse stakeholders, and leveraging various channels to increase brand awareness, attract supporters, and drive engagement. By aligning marketing strategies with our organisational objectives, you will play a vital role in advancing our impact and outreach within the community.

* Develop and implement comprehensive marketing plans and strategies to support the organisation's mission, goals, and initiatives.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify target audiences, key messages, and value propositions for marketing campaigns and initiatives.
* Oversee the creation of marketing materials, including print collateral, digital content, social media assets, and promotional merchandise, ensuring consistency and adherence to brand guidelines.
* **Create and Implement strategies acros**
  s digital marketing channels, including website, social media platforms, email campaigns, and online advertising, to increase visibility and engagement.
* Conduct market research, audience analysis, and competitor benchmarking to identify trends, opportunities, and best practices for marketing outreach.
* Plan and execute marketing events, workshops, webinars, and community outreach activities to raise awareness and promote participation in our programs and events.
* Collaborate with fundraising team to develop and implement donor acquisition and retention strategies, leveraging marketing tactics to engage donors and supporters.
* Track and analyse marketing metrics, such as website traffic, social media engagement, email open rates, and campaign performance, to evaluate effectiveness and optimize strategies.
* Cultivate relationships with media partners, influencers, and external stakeholders to enhance visibility and amplify messaging through earned media opportunities.
* Stay informed about emerging trends, technologies, and innovations in marketing, sharing insights and recommendations with the team to enhance marketing efforts.

**Requirements:**

* Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate organisational goals into actionable marketing strategies and tactics.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders, including internal teams, donors, volunteers, and community partners.
* Proficiency in digital marketing tools and platforms, including content management systems (CMS), email marketing software, social media management tools, and analytics platforms.
* Creative mindset and ability to think outside the box to develop innovative marketing ideas and campaigns that resonate with target audiences.

* Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business administration, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.

This is a full-time, work from office role.

Joining SMSGHM offers a chance to impact marginalised communities globally. With a focus on free Nutrition, Education, and Healthcare across 100 countries, your efforts directly contribute to positive change. Being part of our mission means experiencing the joy of helping others and knowing your contributions bring happiness to those in need.

title: Marketing Manager - Diagnostics Imaging
description:
**Job Requirements**  

**Job Description - Marketing Manager – Diagnostic Imaging**

**Role Purpose**

The Marketing Manager – Diagnostic Imaging is responsible for driving market leadership, demand generation, portfolio positioning, outbound marketing activities across the Diagnostic Imaging portfolio which includes Computed Tomography (CT), Magnetic Resonance (MR), Molecular Imaging (MI), X-Ray Products (XP), and Digital & Automation solutions. The role serves as the strategic link between customers, sales teams, business lines, service organizations, and headquarters to develop and execute market growth strategies, strengthen customer engagement, build thought leadership, and accelerate adoption of innovative imaging technologies and digital healthcare solutions.

As a Marketing Manager – DI Zone India, you will plan and execute field marketing activities that drive demand generation, brand awareness, and pipeline growth in the market, in alignment with regional marketing priorities.

You will work closely with sales teams to support lead generation and follow up, localize regional campaigns, and develop creative marketing programs that resonate with customers. This role is execution focused, hands on, and ideal for a marketer who enjoys turning ideas into measurable results.

In addition, you will actively contribute to Zone India wide initiatives, collaborating with cross-country teams and working on regional projects beyond the India market. This includes sharing best practices, co-developing scalable campaign concepts, and supporting joint programs, ensuring strong alignment and impact across the region.

**Scope of the Role**

* Own and execute marketing strategy for the Diagnostic Imaging portfolio across India and selected neighboring countries, aligned with business priorities.
* Translate market insights, customer needs, and portfolio strengths into clear value propositions and commercial programs.
* Create measurable business impact through pipeline generation, market-share growth, customer advocacy, and sales enablement.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and execute annual marketing plans aligned with business objectives and market opportunities.
* Identify market trends, customer needs, clinical adoption gaps, and growth opportunities.
* Support portfolio lifecycle management, including launch strategies, Install Base retention campaigns.
* Conduct structured competitive analysis on marketing activities.
* Design and execute integrated marketing campaigns that create qualified pipeline and support funnel conversion.
* Manage digital marketing, social media engagement, lead nurturing, and customer outreach programs.
* Drive account-based marketing programs for strategic healthcare providers and priority growth accounts.
* Build structured KOL engagement plans, clinical advisory forums, and customer advocacy programs.
* Establish customer reference-site programs and success-story pipelines.
* Support scientific collaborations, workshops, webinars, advisory boards, and customer forums.
* Lead go-to-market planning for new product introductions and major portfolio upgrades.
* Develop launch toolkits, clinical evidence packages, promotional materials, and sales support content.
* Position Siemens Healthineers as a leader in AI-enabled imaging, workflow optimization, and precision diagnostics.
* Drive educational initiatives and scientific communication programs.
* Support participation in national conferences, congresses, and professional society meetings.
* Promote digital transformation and enterprise imaging solutions across priority customer segments.
* Lead planning and execution of customer events, user meetings, workshops, roadshows, symposiums, and congress participation.
* Manage event messaging, booth themes, speaker engagement, invitee strategy, and follow-up conversion plans.
* Drive customer engagement initiatives that improve brand perception, loyalty, and solution adoption.

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Healthcare Management, or related field.
* MBA from a reputed institution preferred.

**What we need:**

* 8–10 years of experience in B2B marketing, field marketing, digital marketing, or a related role with experience in healthcare, medical devices, diagnostic imaging, healthcare technology, or MedTech.
* Experience in strategic marketing, product marketing or portfolio management.
* Strong understanding of CT, MR, Molecular Imaging, X-Ray, and healthcare digitalization trends.
* Experience working with radiologists, hospital leadership, and healthcare networks.
* Demonstrated success in launching products and driving market growth.
* Adept at planning and executing integrated marketing campaigns across multiple channels
* Understanding of demand generation, lead management, and marketing performance measurement
* Experience using CRM, marketing automation, and digital marketing tools
* Strong project management, communication, and stakeholder management skills

**What Makes You a Standout:**

* Hands-on experience with LinkedIn, email marketing, content marketing, or social media campaigns
* Ability to analyze campaign performance and translate data into actionable insights
* Experience working in a regional or global matrix organization
* Knowledge of demand generation principles and marketing-to-sales alignment
* Interest in AI-enabled and data-driven marketing
* Proactive mindset with strong curiosity and willingness to learn

**What Success Looks Like:**

Success in this role means establishing Siemens Healthineers as the preferred Diagnostic Imaging partner through differentiated market positioning, stronger customer engagement, accelerated adoption of AI-enabled imaging solutions, and measurable contribution to revenue growth. The individual will create visible business impact by connecting customer needs, portfolio strengths, and commercial execution to deliver sustainable growth across the Zone India Diagnostic Imaging business.

with a strong background in digital marketing and brand storytelling to join our team. title: Digital Marketing & Content Specialist
description:
Content Creation, Content Marketing, Creative Content Production, Design, Digital Marketing, Social Media, Social Media Marketing
  
  
**Remote | Full-Time | Eastern Time Availability | C$12,000 Annually**
Royal York Property Management is looking for a creative and highly organized professional to produce marketing content for residential rental properties.
  
  
You will take property details, photographs, and video clips and turn them into polished listings, improved images, virtually furnished rooms, and short videos that help available properties stand out.
  
  
This is a hands-on production position. It is not a senior marketing-strategy, social-media-management, or paid-advertising role.
  
  
Your Work
  
  
Property Positioning and Listings
  
  
You will identify each property’s strongest selling points, write engaging titles and descriptions, and publish accurate listings across approved rental websites and online platforms.
  
  
You will adjust content to meet different platform requirements and keep prices, availability, photographs, and property details current.
  
  
Photography and AI Editing
  
  
You will select the strongest property photographs and complete light editing such as cropping, resizing, lighting improvements, and appropriate cleanup.
  
  
When needed, you will use AI tools to remove temporary clutter or virtually furnish empty rooms.
  
  
AI may improve the presentation, but it must never change permanent property features, room dimensions, layouts, or amenities.
  
  
Short-Form Video Content
  
  
You will create short property videos using photographs and video clips.
  
  
You may also create AI-assisted content using presenters, avatars, or voiceovers.
  
  
**Tools May Include**

* Canva
* CapCut
* HeyGen
* AI virtual-staging platforms
* AI object-removal tools
* Comparable image and video applications

You will be responsible for reviewing AI-generated content and correcting visual, factual, pronunciation, or branding errors before publication.
  
  
Organization and Quality Control
  
  
You may manage content for several properties at the same time.
  
  
**You Will Need To**

* Track every active listing and its current status
* Complete urgent price and availability corrections
* Remove or update properties that are no longer available
* Manage competing deadlines
* Identify missing information or materials
* Coordinate with Royal York’s leasing and property-management teams
* Respond professionally to feedback and complete revisions promptly

What You Should Bring
  
  
**We Are Looking For Someone With**

* Two to three years of experience in digital marketing, content creation, online listings, real-estate marketing, marketplace content, or a comparable field
* Experience producing online listings, graphics, edited photographs, or short videos
* Strong writing skills and the ability to identify a property’s strongest selling points
* Experience with Canva, CapCut, or comparable editing tools
* Experience using AI for photo editing, object removal, virtual furnishing, or virtual staging
* Experience with HeyGen or another AI presenter, avatar, voice, or video-generation tool
* Strong creative and visual judgment
* Excellent organization and attention to detail
* The ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines
* The ability to receive feedback and revise work without becoming defensive
* Strong written and spoken English
* The ability to work independently
* Reliable internet, a suitable computer, and a professional remote-work environment
* Full-time availability with regular overlap during Eastern Time business hours

Candidates with less experience may be considered when their portfolio demonstrates strong ability.
  
  
Experience in residential leasing, property management, PropTech, real estate, or property-listing platforms is preferred but not required.
  
  
A Bachelor’s degree is not required. Your demonstrated ability, relevant experience, and portfolio quality are more important.
  
  
**You’ll Do Well Here If You Are**

* Creative without sacrificing accuracy
* Organized enough to manage repetitive, high-volume work
* Comfortable improving imperfect source material
* Curious about new AI and editing tools
* Careful not to create misleading property content
* Responsive to deadlines and feedback
* Able to work without constant supervision

How to Apply
  
  
Submit your résumé and an accessible portfolio or work-sample link.
  
  
Your portfolio must include examples from at least two of these areas:
  
  

* Graphics or edited photographs
* AI-edited or virtually furnished rooms
* Short-form videos
* AI-generated presenter or voice content

The link must work without a password or access request.
  
  
Candidates whose experience and portfolio align with the position will receive an email invitation to complete a short pre-recorded video interview.

title: Social Media Content Executive
description:
**A LITTLE ABOUT THE QUAD**

The Quad is a fitness coaching company with strength training at its core, because strength is essential for all. Period.

You need strength to go about your day without aches and niggles. That compounds into living your life without worrying about how your body might react. One of our students summited Mt. Kilimanjaro simply because she wanted to! Your life really expands when you're stronger.

And no, it's not an all-boys club. Strength is especially important for women, and nearly 50% of the people training with us are women. If you've been to any gym, you'll know why that number is mind-blowing.

We've been around for 15 years. Today we're a team of 60+ incredibly smart and talented people, and we train folks aged 35 to 80, all with one aim: getting stronger.

**THE ROLE: SOCIAL MEDIA CONTENT EXECUTIVE**

Social media is one of our most important marketing tools. It's where a lot of people discover us, learn about us, and decide to join. It's where we show who we are, who we're not, and the impact we're driving. You'll be part of the team that brings all of that to life.

Check out our Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/thequad.in/

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

1. Ideas, scripts, and storyboards: You'll work with the Social Media Manager and bring your own ideas and research to the table.
2. Information gathering: We can't create content in a silo. We need input from the wider team, and you'll be the one driving that.
3. Shoot coordination: You'll line up people, locations, and timings so shoots run on schedule.
4. Shoots: You'll support the Social Media Manager on set: setting up, filming, and making sure we get the footage the edit needs.
5. Edit and design: I saved the best for last. You'll own the edit and design of every piece of content that goes out.

* Editing: which clips to pick, how to cut for hook rate and retention, which edit style fits, and which audio to use (what's trending and what suits the post). Basically, everything that turns the work into a finished piece.
* Design: carousels, static posts, stories, and more. You should know how to lay out a post so people stop on it, read it, and interact with it.

Steps 1 to 4 give you the context for what you're editing and why, so that when you sit down at the edit table, you already know what you're going to do. Editing and design WILL be a big part of this role.

As you grow, the role will expand to include more of what drives our social media.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

What we care about least: years of experience. What matters is that you can show skill and the drive to create impact through content. That, and a few more things :)

* Strong communication skills
* Solid writing skills
* A portfolio of short-form videos you've edited and designs you've made, whether for a brand, a client, a college project, or your own page
* Strong working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro and Canva
* Comfort with quicker tools like Edits or InShot when you need a fast turnaround
* A good sense of pacing, hooks, sound, and on-screen text, and an eye for what makes someone stop scrolling
* Comfort framing and shooting content on a phone
* Reliability with deadlines and follow-ups, because other people's work depends on yours

**WHY THIS MATTERS**

If you've looked at our Instagram, you'll have noticed we don't post just for the sake of posting. We make content that resonates: content that educates, makes people laugh, or makes them feel empowered or simply seen. Content that ultimately pushes people to make a change in their lives. A healthy one!

If you'd like to be part of the team that makes this happen, I'd love to hear from you. Send us your CV and portfolio link, and we'll talk :)

title: Community Growth Associate
description:
**Company Description**
Kynhood (KYN) is a discovery and community platform that connects people through experiences and interest-based communities. The platform helps individuals find events, live shows, sports activities, workshops, nightlife, and community-led experiences in their city. By enabling people to explore local happenings and meet like-minded individuals, Kynhood focuses on fostering genuine, meaningful connections. The company’s mission is to help community members explore, connect, and belong in vibrant urban environments. Applicants joining Kynhood will contribute to building inclusive, engaging communities both online and offline.

**About the role**

We help hosts build communities through events, content and engagement, and we are building this into a 
**community SaaS**
: hosts pay us for the tools to run their communities and earn from their members through subscriptions and paid content.

You will own two kinds of communities:

·      
**Content communities:**
 paywalled content, subscriptions and premium access

·      
**Engagement communities:**
 gamification, streaks, levels, rewards and member activity

**What you'll do**

·      
**Find and onboard hosts:**
 identify the right hosts from our existing base (with the ticketing team) and new ones and get them set up on community features.

·      
**Drive activation:**
 help each host launch their community, set up content or engagement mechanics, and get members using it every week.

·      
**Drive monetization:**
 help hosts price plans, packages and paid content, get their first paying members, and grow from there.

·      
**Retain hosts:**
 run regular check-ins, spot hosts at risk of dropping off and fix the cause.

·      
**Build playbooks:**
 document what works for content hosts and engagement hosts, so onboarding becomes repeatable.

·      
**Use data:**
 track the funnel (onboarded, live, active, monetizing, paying, retained) and report weekly and monthly.

·      
**Feed product:**
 collect host feedback and requests, write them up clearly, and help prioritize what we build next. You write requirements and test them. You don't code.

·      
**Work with the events team:**
 agree on referrals and handoffs, so hosts have one clear point of contact.

**What we're looking for**

·      1 to 2 years of experience working with creators, hosts, communities. Strong freshers are welcome

·      Comfort with numbers: you can read a simple dashboard, work in a spreadsheet, and explain what it means.

·      Clear communication, in writing and on calls, with hosts and internal teams.

·      Help hosts grow their communities by helping them with content plan, engagement ideas etc.

·      Curiosity about subscriptions, community platforms, and gamified apps.

·      Structured and organized: you can manage many hosts at once without dropping follow-ups.

**Nice to have**

·      Experience with subscription products, memberships or paid communities.

·      Understanding of gamification or engagement design.

**Not required**

Coding or technical skills.

title: Videographer
description:
About the job

About the jobWe are looking for a creative and energetic Videographer cum Video Editor to support our in-house marketing and brand communication requirements. The candidate will be responsible for shooting and editing engaging video content for social media, project sites, customer testimonials, corporate communications, events, exhibitions, and digital campaigns.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Shoot and edit videos for Instagram Reels, LinkedIn, YouTube, WhatsApp, website, and paid digital campaigns.
* Capture high-quality footage at offices, solar project sites, customer locations, events, exhibitions, and employee activities.
* Create short-form videos, project progress videos, customer testimonials, brand films, leadership messages, and event highlights.
* Handle end-to-end production including camera setup, lighting, audio, framing, editing, colour correction, subtitles, music, transitions, and final exports.
* Create simple motion graphics, animated text, logo stings, lower-thirds, and branded video elements.
* Shoot professional photographs for projects, events, products, and social-media requirements when needed.
* Maintain organised folders for raw footage, edited videos, photographs, and final marketing assets.
* Collaborate closely with the marketing team to understand briefs, plan shoots, and deliver content within timelines.

**Required Skills**

* 1–2 years of experience in videography and video editing.
* Hands-on experience with DSLR/mirrorless cameras, lighting, microphones, tripods, and gimbals.
* Proven experience in drone shooting; knowledge of safe drone operation and applicable permissions/compliance is required.
* Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, or similar editing tools.

* Experience in solar, renewable energy, construction, real estate, manufacturing, or B2B industries will be an added advantage.

title: Senior AEM Engineer
