title: Account Manager
description:
Swiggy Dineout is building India’s largest dining out platform that processes more than 100M diners for its
  
  
partner restaurants across its network for 21000 restaurants in 34 cities and growing. We are striving to
  
  
augment our consumer promise of enabling unparalleled convenience by helping diners explore
  
  
restaurants across all categories - from QSRs, cafes, casual dining, premium, fine dining and more and
  
  
offer the widest range of offers on restaurant bills through easy payments on the app. We are on a
  
  
mission to change the way India dines out. If you are a foodie and equally passionate to redefine the
  
  
experience of dining out, join our team to be a part of the Swiggy ride!
  
  
Dineout is present in 34 cities across India and we have partnerships with more than 21,000 restaurant
  
  
partners where users can save up to 40% on their dining bills when they pay their restaurant bills using
  
  
the dine out feature on the Swiggy app.
  
  
**Job Description**
Role Summary -
  
  
The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given
  
  
territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise
  
  
Value (GMV) per month.
  
  
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
  
  
specific geographies assigned
  
  
Responsibilities -
  
  
Account & Partner Relationship Management
  
  
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with
  
  
internal stakeholders
  
  
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is
  
  
correct and image coverage is high
  
  
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for
  
  
month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
  
  
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc.
  
  
to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
  
  
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers
  
  
and partners at the restaurants
  
  
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.
  
  
Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
  
  
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance
  
  
metrics to the partner
  
  
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable
  
  
conversions and grow the business.
  
  
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale,
  
  
conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
  
  
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts,
  
  
commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and
  
  
explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.
  
  
Interaction with Stakeholders:
  
  
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations
  
  
(competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
  
  
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
  
  
Functional Competencies
  
  
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
  
  
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads
  
  
RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
  
  
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
  
  
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise
  
  
transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition
  
  
**Qualifications**
Desired Skills -
  
  
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
  
  
knowledge of English
  
  
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing
  
  
channels
  
  
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
  
  
Effective communication skills
  
  
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
  
  
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
  
  
Analytical, good Excel skills.
  
  
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
  
  
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people
  
  
at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
  
  
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
  
  
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness
  
  
and success of campaigns.
  
  
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal
  
  
drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.
  
  
**Additional Information**
**Visit our tech blogs to learn more about some the challenges we deal with: https://medium.com/swiggy-bytes**

title: CMT - Domain Consultant
description:
**About The Role**
As a Domain Consultant – Communications, Media & Technology, you will make an impact by supporting the pre-sales team in crafting compelling, market insight-led proposals and bid responses across CMT sub-sectors such as OTT, AdTech and telco BSS. You will be a valued member of the Business Development team and work collaboratively with presales leads, solution architects, account teams, and clients.
  
  
**In this role, you will**

* Act as a trusted advisor to Sales and Solutioning teams, translating complex CMT industry trends (5G, OTT convergence, AdTech shifts) into actionable client-facing insights and opportunity maps aligned to Cognizant Moment solutions.
* Proactively identify, qualify and prioritise new business opportunities within CMT accounts by mapping industry trends, regulatory shifts and competitive dynamics to solution capabilities.
* Partner with account teams to uncover cross-sell and upsell opportunities within existing engagements, expanding Cognizant’s footprint.
* Develop deep expertise in Cognizant Moment’s CX-CRM and Digital Engagement platform solutions and articulate how they address CMT priorities such as subscriber growth, churn reduction, digital monetization and personalised omnichannel experiences.
* Incubate emerging CMT offerings and proofs of concept, leading cross-functional sprints and building business cases to secure internal investment for practice growth.

**Work model**
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Chennai, Bangalore or Hyderabad. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
  
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
  
**What You Must Have To Be Considered**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, preferably computer science or IT; MBA or relevant master’s preferred.
* 10–15+ years of experience in business development, pre-sales or consulting, with at least 5+ years focused on business growth in the Communications, Media and Technology industry related to enterprise-level Customer Data Platform solutions.
* Working knowledge of monolithic as well as microservices application architecture (RESTful API, API integration, etc.).
* Proven experience supporting RFx responses, client presentations and solution demonstrations.
* Strong executive presence with excellent communication, storytelling and presentation skills.

**These will help you succeed**

* Deep CMT industry fluency across 5G/telecom ecosystems, OTT and streaming, digital publishing, AdTech/MarTech, gaming and SaaS business models, with sub-sector depth in Telecom, Media & Entertainment or High-Tech.
* Ability to track and distil regulatory, technology and consumer-behaviour shifts into actionable business insights and opportunity maps for clients.
* Working knowledge of key CMT players, platform vendors, system integrators and emerging disruptors shaping the digital engagement space.
* Technology awareness of SaaS mobile and web applications on AWS, GCP and Azure for CX-CRM and Digital Engagement platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Mixpanel, Moengage, Webengage, Google Analytics, Adobe Experience Cloud or other Product Analytics tools).
* Working knowledge of global and regional CMT regulations such as GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, ePrivacy Directive, CAN-SPAM, TCPA and evolving AI governance frameworks.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

**About Jxtapose**

Jxtapose is a multidisciplinary design studio based in Hyderabad, India, working across Branding, Marketing, Packaging, and Spatial Branding. We combine strategic thinking, storytelling, and creative execution to build meaningful brand experiences and deliver result-driven marketing solutions.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Digital Marketer with mandatory hands-on experience in Performance Marketing and SEO. The candidate should be comfortable managing digital campaigns, optimizing website performance, analysing marketing data, and implementing strategies that drive visibility, traffic, and conversions.

The role involves working across Jxtapose's internal marketing initiatives as well as multiple client projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Performance Marketing**

* Plan, execute, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and YouTube Ads.
* Manage audience targeting, campaign budgets, conversion tracking, and lead generation.
* Conduct A/B testing and optimize campaigns for conversions, cost efficiency, and ROAS.
* Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

**2. Search Engine Optimization (SEO)**

* Develop and execute on-page, off-page, and technical SEO strategies.
* Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and content gap analysis.

* Plan ethical backlink acquisition strategies and monitor organic search performance.

* Understand emerging practices in Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
* Explore strategies to improve brand visibility across AI-powered search platforms.
* Leverage AI tools for research, content planning, reporting, and marketing efficiency.

**5. Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with designers, developers, content writers, and account managers.
* Coordinate the execution of marketing strategies across internal and client projects.

**Skills & Requirements**

* Mandatory 1–2 years of hands-on experience in Performance Marketing and SEO.
* Practical experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and YouTube Ads.
* Working knowledge of GA4, Google Tag Manager, and Google Search Console.
* Understanding of technical, on-page, and off-page SEO.
* Knowledge of SEO tools and keyword research methodologies.
* Familiarity with AEO, GEO, and AI-powered marketing tools.
* Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Agency experience or experience handling multiple client accounts will be an added advantage.

Interested?

If you enjoy working at the intersection of data, strategy, and digital marketing, we'd love to hear from you.

* Apply now and be part of the Jxtapose team!

**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Specialist Manager, Go-To-Market**
We are seeking a Specialist Manager to work closely with U.S.-based Strategic Marketers—including portfolio marketing leaders, national marketing leaders, and Business Chief Marketing Officers (BCMOs)—to manage strategic marketing initiatives and service offering activations. This role defines campaign goals, guides execution across channels, and fosters collaboration across teams. Managers are responsible for performance reporting, annual planning, and operational standardization. They also coach team members and ensure marketing efforts align with business priorities and a client-first mindset.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
As a Specialist Manager, you will collaborate with business stakeholders and portfolio marketers to drive annual marketing planning, competitive analysis, and strategic alignment. You will collaborate with Client Account Teams, Research & Insights, and Market Intelligence to inform portfolio-level initiatives, integrate insights into campaign planning, and standardize operations for efficiency and impact.
  
  
In execution, you will help manage the planning and delivery of integrated campaigns across channels such as thought leadership, events, podcasts, and digital platforms. You will define campaign goals, oversee content development, ensure brand consistency, and guide demand generation strategies. Leveraging marketing platforms and tools, you will optimize execution, automate reporting, and mentor team members through feedback, performance management, and career development.
  
  
To measure impact, you will prepare and present performance reports to leadership, establish benchmarks and reporting cadences, and provide strategic recommendations. You will also direct media strategy for PR campaigns, analyze coverage and sentiment, and recommend improvements to enhance visibility and engagement.

**Marketing strategy & planning**

* Strategic planning & integrated campaigns — Help provide long-term marketing strategies, connecting campaigns to lead generation and retention, and aligning initiatives with business objectives.
* Content & brand strategy — Help shaping content vision, managing streams for brand integrity, and defining brand strategy for consistent communications and reputation management.

**Project and stakeholder management**

* Financial & project management — Overseeing strategic marketing projects, standardizing operations, and managing large-scale budgets aligned with strategic goals.
* Stakeholder engagement & collaboration — Help develop engagement strategies and manage senior leader relationships to support organizational priorities.
* Problem solving & continuous improvement — Addressing complex challenges, managing crises, and driving process improvements.

* Leadership & team development — Setting leadership tone, coaching team members, and supporting career growth.
* Quality & standards management — Assist in establishing review processes and maintaining quality standards across deliverables.

**Data analytics and storytelling:**

* Technology and data analytics — Aligning technology investments with business goals, optimizing data platforms, and helping in managing adoption of analytical tools for campaign insights.

**Experience Required in Integrated Marketing Leadership & Channel Optimization Including:**
**Digital strategy and media performance**

* Experience managing SEO/SEM implementation and working with web and content teams to optimize search visibility.
* Hands-on experience managing paid advertising campaigns, coordinating with media teams, and optimizing performance based on analytics.
* Experience leading web development projects and UX/UI enhancements to improve digital experience and accessibility.

**Content, brand, and experiential marketing**

* Experience managing content calendars and production workflows, maintaining brand voice and quality standards across channels.
* Experience leading digital marketing activations such as video, podcast, webcasts, or webinars, including managing schedules, budgets, and vendor relationships.
* Experience planning and coordinating social media campaigns, including posting schedules and engagement strategies.
* Experience planning and executing events, managing logistics, budgets, and stakeholder communications.

**Demand generation and growth marketing**

* Experience in executing nurture campaigns, monitoring funnel metrics, and collaborating with sales teams to improve lead conversion.
* Proven ability to lead account-based and opportunity-based marketing campaigns, coordinate with sales, and track performance outcomes.
* Demonstrated success in managing email marketing calendars, workflows, and segmentation strategies to determine campaign effectiveness.
* Demonstrated ability to qualify leads, track engagement, and support audience segmentation for demand generation efforts.

**Public relations and corporate communications**

* Experienced in driving PR campaigns and managing media relationships to ensure consistent messaging and coverage.

The Go-To-Market team brings Deloitte’s priorities to life through marketing that connects with clients, builds relationships, and supports the firm’s growth. We partner with strategists, business leaders, and cross-functional teams to turn ideas into integrated campaigns, develop clear and compelling messaging, and create experiences that resonate across channels—email, social, events, PR, web, paid media, SEO/SEM, podcasts, webinars, and account-based marketing (ABM), among others.
  
  
We blend creativity, strategy, collaboration, and data-driven thinking. In addition to executing campaigns, we coordinate stakeholders, manage budgets and workflows, improve digital experiences, and measure performance so each effort can learn, adapt, and have a greater impact over time. Across every level, our work is grounded in teamwork, curiosity, and a shared focus on helping Deloitte show up in the market with clarity, consistency, and purpose.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* 10–13 years of relevant experience in B2B / Professional Services marketing, with a strong understanding of integrated marketing and communication strategies, with demonstrated ability to coach and mentor team members and manage performance.

**Work Environment and Shift Timings**
Deloitte offers a hybrid working environment designed to support flexibility and business requirements. The following schedule applies to this role:

description:
**Social Media  - Job Description**

**The role**

We are hiring a hands-on Social Media to lead organic social strategy, content planning, copywriting, creative briefing, publishing and audience growth for both V-Rich and Yogurt Alley. You will own the editorial direction of each brand, work closely with the in-house creative team, and identify and coordinate influencer agencies and creators to execute relevant collaborations. This is a strategy-to-execution role, not just a content scheduling position.

**Key responsibilities**

* Own differentiated social media strategies, content pillars, tone of voice and platform priorities for V-Rich and Yogurt Alley, aligned to awareness, engagement, product discovery and business goals.
* Build monthly content calendars and weekly production plans for Instagram, YouTube (Shorts and relevant long-form), Facebook and other priority channels like reddit, Pinterest, LinkedIn etc; maintain publishing cadence and platform-specific adaptations.
* Lead content ideation, trend spotting, storytelling, hooks, scripts, captions, on-screen copy, CTAs and community-first formats; ensure claims and product information are accurate and on-brand.
* Turn concepts into actionable briefs for designers, videographers and editors, including objective, audience, references, visual direction, storyboards/shot lists, deliverables and deadlines; review outputs and manage revisions.
* Own YouTube content programming, metadata, titles, thumbnails, Shorts strategy, discoverability, audience retention and channel growth in collaboration with the production team.
* Manage community engagement, comments, DMs, social listening and proactive interactions; identify recurring audience questions, UGC opportunities and emerging consumer insights.
* Identify, shortlist, evaluate and onboard relevant influencer/creator agencies; request proposals, compare rosters and commercials, coordinate negotiations and recommend partners for approval.
* Brief and coordinate influencer agencies and individual creators end-to-end: creator fit, deliverables, content guidelines, timelines, approvals, usage rights, disclosures, tracking, reporting and payment coordination with internal stakeholders.
* Work with marketing, performance, design and sales teams to amplify launches, seasonal campaigns, sampling activations and city-specific initiatives.
* Monitor content and channel performance; produce weekly dashboards and monthly reviews covering reach, engagement, retention, follower quality, profile actions, traffic and campaign outcomes; translate insights into experiments.

**What we are looking for**

* 2+ years of relevant experience in social media/content marketing, with demonstrable ownership of brand accounts or channels and measurable outcomes.

company: Digital Mojo - Branding and Digital Marketing Agency in Hyderabad
description:
**Company Description**

Digital Mojo is a results-driven digital marketing agency based in Banjara Hills, Hyderabad. Since 2016, we have been helping brands scale through performance-focused digital strategies, storytelling, lead generation, branding, and high-impact marketing campaigns.

**Role Description**

**We are looking for a highly ownership-driven Pod Manager with 5-7 years of agency experience to lead a pod of clients end-to-end.**

This Manager role is not a delivery coordinator. They are the business head of their pod. They own the P&L of their accounts, drive client growth strategy, lead the pod team, and are the last point of escalation before it reaches the CEO. Every commercial decision, every retention risk, every growth opportunity within the pod runs through them.

If something goes wrong in the pod, the Pod Manager owns it. If something goes right, the Pod Manager drove it.

**What This Role Is Not**

* Not a senior Account Manager with a fancier title
* Not someone who only reviews reports and attends calls
* Not someone who escalates client problems to the CEO without first attempting resolution
* Not a task manager or execution coordinator
* Not someone who waits for strategy to come from above

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Pod P&L Ownership**

* Own the revenue, profitability, and commercial health of all accounts within the pod
* Track pod-level billing, scope utilization, and team bandwidth against revenue
* Identify accounts where the agency is over-servicing and course-correct scope or pricing
* Protect agency margins by managing team allocation and delivery efficiency
* Flag accounts at commercial risk to the Founder with a clear plan, not just a problem
* Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities and close them in coordination with the Founder
* Own monthly pod revenue targets and report against them with clarity

**2. Client Growth Strategy**

* Go beyond delivery. Actively think about what is next for each client's business
* Develop quarterly growth plans for key accounts covering new campaigns, channels, and opportunities
* Proactively bring ideas to clients before they ask. Be the strategic voice in every client relationship
* Identify gaps in a client's current marketing mix and recommend solutions backed by data
* Lead strategic review meetings with clients, not just performance catch-up calls
* Connect client business goals to marketing strategy and keep both aligned as the business evolves
* Be the person a client calls when they want a fresh perspective, not just a status update

**3. Escalation Leadership**

* Serve as the final internal escalation point before the CEO for all pod-level issues
* Handle client escalations, conflicts, and difficult conversations directly and with confidence
* Resolve delivery failures, team gaps, and quality issues at the pod level without pushing them upward
* Make judgment calls on scope disputes, pricing conversations, and client dissatisfaction independently
* Know when to involve the Founder and walk in with context, options, and a recommendation
* Protect the Founder's bandwidth by resolving 90% of pod issues at the pod level

**4. Team Leadership and Pod Management**

* Lead and manage Account Managers, Social Media Managers, Performance Marketers, and SEO Specialists within the pod
* Set clear expectations, review output quality, and hold team members accountable
* Run pod reviews, identify underperformance early, and address it directly
* Build a culture of ownership, speed, and quality within the pod
* Identify training or skill gaps in the team and flag them to the Founder
* Ensure Account Managers are handling day-to-day client communication so the Pod Manager can focus on strategy and commercial outcomes

**5. Delivery and Quality Oversight**

* Own the quality of everything that leaves the pod, from reports to creatives to campaign performance
* Ensure all client deliverables across social media, SEO, and performance marketing are on time and to standard
* Review monthly performance reports before they reach the client
* Maintain SLA adherence across the pod and flag risks before they impact delivery
* Coordinate with centralized teams including design, SEO, website, and automation for seamless execution

**6. Performance and Campaign Strategy**

* Understand performance marketing fundamentals including CPL, ROAS, CTR, lead quality, and funnel structure
* Review campaign performance across accounts and push for optimization when results are not meeting targets
* Work with Performance Marketers on budget planning, channel strategy, and campaign direction
* Ensure SEO, social, and paid strategies are aligned and working toward the same client business outcome
* The character in sitcom is Ross

**7. Commercial Responsibility and Client Retention**

* Own client retention across all pod accounts
* Conduct regular health checks on every account and know the status of each relationship at all times
* Identify at-risk clients early and create a recovery plan before it becomes a churn situation
* Manage contract renewals, scope expansions, and pricing conversations
* Track client satisfaction and act on early signals before they escalate

**Key KPIs**

* Pod Revenue vs Target
* Pod Gross Margin and Profitability
* Client Retention Rate
* Upsell and Cross-sell Revenue Generated
* Client Satisfaction Score
* Escalations Reaching CEO (target: minimal)
* On-Time Delivery Percentage
* Team Utilization and Bandwidth Efficiency
* Strategic Growth Plans Delivered per Quarter

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* 4-7 years of experience in a digital marketing agency
* Proven experience managing multiple client accounts and cross-functional teams
* Strong understanding of agency P&L, billing, scope management, and margin control
* Deep knowledge of performance marketing, social media, SEO, and content marketing
* Experience handling client escalations and difficult commercial conversations independently
* Strong strategic thinking with the ability to build and present growth plans for clients
* Excellent English communication skills, written and verbal
* Confident in senior client-facing discussions and presentations
* Experience with project management and reporting tools
* Ability to lead, motivate, and hold a team accountable in a fast-paced environment

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* **Agency experience is mandatory.**
* Has managed a revenue-bearing portfolio of clients, not just a team of people
* Has had commercial conversations with clients around scope, pricing, and renewals
* Thinks in terms of client business growth, not just campaign delivery
* Is a problem-solver who finds solutions before escalating
* Can lead a room whether it is a team standup or a senior client strategy session

**Reporting Structure**

* **Reports To: Founder / CEO**
* Manages: Account Managers, Social Media Managers, Performance Marketers, SEO Specialists
* Coordinates With: Creative Team, SEO Team, Website Team, Automation Team
* Escalation Authority: Final internal point before the CEO

title: Digital Marketing & Content Specialist
description:
Content Creation, Content Marketing, Creative Content Production, Design, Digital Marketing, Social Media, Social Media Marketing
  
  
**Remote | Full-Time | Eastern Time Availability | C$12,000 Annually**
Royal York Property Management is looking for a creative and highly organized professional to produce marketing content for residential rental properties.
  
  
You will take property details, photographs, and video clips and turn them into polished listings, improved images, virtually furnished rooms, and short videos that help available properties stand out.
  
  
This is a hands-on production position. It is not a senior marketing-strategy, social-media-management, or paid-advertising role.
  
  
Your Work
  
  
Property Positioning and Listings
  
  
You will identify each property’s strongest selling points, write engaging titles and descriptions, and publish accurate listings across approved rental websites and online platforms.
  
  
You will adjust content to meet different platform requirements and keep prices, availability, photographs, and property details current.
  
  
Photography and AI Editing
  
  
You will select the strongest property photographs and complete light editing such as cropping, resizing, lighting improvements, and appropriate cleanup.
  
  
When needed, you will use AI tools to remove temporary clutter or virtually furnish empty rooms.
  
  
AI may improve the presentation, but it must never change permanent property features, room dimensions, layouts, or amenities.
  
  
Short-Form Video Content
  
  
You will create short property videos using photographs and video clips.
  
  
You may also create AI-assisted content using presenters, avatars, or voiceovers.
  
  
**Tools May Include**

* Canva
* CapCut
* HeyGen
* AI virtual-staging platforms
* AI object-removal tools
* Comparable image and video applications

You will be responsible for reviewing AI-generated content and correcting visual, factual, pronunciation, or branding errors before publication.
  
  
Organization and Quality Control
  
  
You may manage content for several properties at the same time.
  
  
**You Will Need To**

* Track every active listing and its current status
* Complete urgent price and availability corrections
* Remove or update properties that are no longer available
* Manage competing deadlines
* Identify missing information or materials
* Coordinate with Royal York’s leasing and property-management teams
* Respond professionally to feedback and complete revisions promptly

What You Should Bring
  
  
**We Are Looking For Someone With**

* Two to three years of experience in digital marketing, content creation, online listings, real-estate marketing, marketplace content, or a comparable field
* Experience producing online listings, graphics, edited photographs, or short videos
* Strong writing skills and the ability to identify a property’s strongest selling points
* Experience with Canva, CapCut, or comparable editing tools
* Experience using AI for photo editing, object removal, virtual furnishing, or virtual staging
* Experience with HeyGen or another AI presenter, avatar, voice, or video-generation tool
* Strong creative and visual judgment
* Excellent organization and attention to detail
* The ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines
* The ability to receive feedback and revise work without becoming defensive
* Strong written and spoken English
* The ability to work independently
* Reliable internet, a suitable computer, and a professional remote-work environment
* Full-time availability with regular overlap during Eastern Time business hours

Candidates with less experience may be considered when their portfolio demonstrates strong ability.
  
  
Experience in residential leasing, property management, PropTech, real estate, or property-listing platforms is preferred but not required.
  
  
A Bachelor’s degree is not required. Your demonstrated ability, relevant experience, and portfolio quality are more important.
  
  
**You’ll Do Well Here If You Are**

* Creative without sacrificing accuracy
* Organized enough to manage repetitive, high-volume work
* Comfortable improving imperfect source material
* Curious about new AI and editing tools
* Careful not to create misleading property content
* Responsive to deadlines and feedback
* Able to work without constant supervision

How to Apply
  
  
Submit your résumé and an accessible portfolio or work-sample link.
  
  
Your portfolio must include examples from at least two of these areas:
  
  

* Graphics or edited photographs
* AI-edited or virtually furnished rooms
* Short-form videos
* AI-generated presenter or voice content

The link must work without a password or access request.
  
  
Candidates whose experience and portfolio align with the position will receive an email invitation to complete a short pre-recorded video interview.

**About Keus**

Keus is at the forefront of integrating elegant design with state-of-the-art technology in smart home automation and architectural lighting. Our mission is to transcend ordinary living, offering a luxurious smart home experience that is seamless and beyond compare.

Our philosophy is centered around a design-first approach, where impeccable aesthetics meet unparalleled functionality. At Keus, a cadre of leading Industrial Designers, Electronics and Electrical Engineers, and Software Architects merge their expertise to redefine industry standards and craft bespoke smart home products and solutions that lead the way in

innovation.

We pride ourselves on being the benchmark of sophistication and holistic smart home experiences in India, relentlessly innovating not only to meet but redefine global standards.

Keus is on an ambitious path of expansion, with 2024 marking our entry into the thriving markets of Mumbai, Bangalore, Pune, and Delhi. Our strategy involves directly engaging with Architects, Interior Designers, and leveraging Digital Marketing to enhance our customer reach.

**Position Overview:**

We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented
**SEO Content Writer**

.

**1. SEO Content Strategy & Research**

•

in SEO content writing or digital content marketing.

title: Expert, AI Content - Omnichannel
description:
**Job title**
: Expert, AI Content - Omnichannel
  
  

* Location: Hyderabad, India
* % of travel expected: Travel required as per business need
* Job type: Permanent and Full time

**About The Job**
**Strategic context:**
Sanofi currently has the best and most robust pipeline of R&D and consequent new launches of our history. As the new phase of the Play-To-Win strategy, funding this pipeline and new launches is key to materialize the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. Thus, as we enter the next phase, modernization of Sanofi is required as per the recent announcements on DRIVE, and in this respect, we are in the beginning stages of organizing the Go-to-Market Capabilities (GTMC) team at global level.
  
  
The GTMC organization will help us to drive best-in-class capabilities across the board and bring value and excellence in our commercial operations. This move is a key part of the aimed modernization of Sanofi and will allow us to focus on our priorities across our products, market and pipeline through the reallocation of resources and realizing the efficiencies of removing silos that exist between our business units, avoiding the duplication and overlapping of resources, standardizing our processes and tools, operating with a One Sanofi approach to accelerate our key capabilities development, and fostering the entrepreneurial spirit by speeding up decision making.
  
  
As part of GTMC, the vision of the Customer Experience Capabilities (CXC) pillar is the definition of Sanofi-wide best-in-class Omnichannel engagement strategy, including development of standards & best practices across markets and brand teams, as well as executional planning and support of local omnichannel approaches (including change management). GTMC will also collaborate closely with Digital to provide consistent tools.
  
  
Our Hubs are a crucial part of how we innovate, improving performance across every Sanofi department and providing a springboard for the amazing work we do. Build a career and you can be part of transforming our business while helping to change millions of lives. Ready? As a Senior Specialist in the Content Operations Team, within our Hyderabad Hub, you'll plan and execute market-driven campaigns, make data-driven business recommendations, and create insightful presentations. You'll optimize omnichannel strategies in SFMC, leveraging your knowledge of campaign automation and data segmentation to provide valuable recommendations.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities**
The overall purpose and main responsibilities are listed below:
  
  
To create/review complex and specialized content (branded/unbranded) without supervision; manage end-to-end omnichannel content creation/repurposing/localization process including supporting designing & enhancement, validation, tagging & upload, deployment, publishing, and dissemination via relevant tools & platforms. Develop and maintain therapeutic area(s), process(es), and compliance expertise for CXC pillar/GTMC. Perform/review/guide team for background research/literature analysis/due diligence and application of available content insights generated via AI-enabled digital platforms, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Search Engine Marketing (SEM), campaign analytics, CX surveys, etc. as relevant for enhancing content generation framework and delivering high-quality content. Manage multiple projects across multiple franchises or therapeutic areas.
  
  
Review scientific accuracy checks/validation performed by junior/senior content specialists to ensure the scientific and medical accuracy of marketing content with a strong emphasis on compliance with medical, legal and regulatory (MLR) standards. Guide GenAI/Content Operations initiatives (as relevant in the role) for ideation sessions for content generation; review AI-generated content to meet high-quality standards and brand guidelines; and to ensure delivery of content with improved GEO/SEO rankings, user engagement, and accuracy.
  
  
Support/guide team for claims and component review, localization, building GloCal MLR memory. Leverage GenAI capabilities and implement innovation and agile methodology aligned with CXC/GTMC to scale our production of marketing content.
  
  
Coach senior and junior content specialists for developing engaging, impactful, GEO-/SEO-friendly content for websites (Healthcare Professionals & patients), campus portals, social media channels, and omnichannel campaigns (including but not limited to banners, emails, newsletters, social media content/posts, interactive visual aids, gifs, scrolls, carousels, KOL interview videos/videos/video articles, podcasts, articles/summaries, infographics, slide decks). Partner with Head/Lead for strategic support for Content Operations Hub. Collaborate effectively with stakeholders, peers/team to develop, and promote best-in-class customer experience through best-in-class content.
  
  

* People: (1) Maintain effective relationship with the stakeholders within the allocated GTMC pillar with an end objective to develop content as per requirement; (2) Constantly assist content specialists (senior or junior) in developing knowledge and sharing expertise (3) Partner with Leads to strengthen capabilities and support individual development plans (4) Collaborate with cross-functional teams in GTMC to build digital transformation/to bring innovative digital solutions (5) Provide proactive recommendations on improving scientific content of deliverables and play an active role to follow the best practices in relation to processes, communications, project management, documentation and technical requirements
* Performance: (1) Provide content as per agreed timelines and quality (2) Be a subject matter expert, coach, mentor, and assist fellow specialists. Recommend, lead, and implement tactical process improvements within the department and division
* Process: (1) Develop complex scientific content (branded/unbranded); (2) Act as an omnichannel content expert for the assigned therapeutic area(s); (3) Assist the Content Operations Hub Team in conducting comprehensive content-need analysis; (4) Implement the content plan and associated activities for the year identified for the pillar; (5) Work with selected vendors within the region to deliver the required deliverables as per defined process; (6) Leverage advanced training delivery tools and techniques thereby enhancing the effectiveness of training delivery; (7) Design an overall plan of action based on end-user feedback and improve course content and delivery
* Stakeholder: (1) Work closely with GTMC/CXC pillars (Global, Local, and Hub) to identify content need and assist in developing assigned deliverables and (2) Liaise with CXC, global brand teams (GTBs), and/or agency of record (AoR) to prepare relevant and customized deliverables

**About You**

* Experience: 8-10 years of experience in content creation in medico-marketing/medical/commercial/omnichannel domain for the pharmaceutical/healthcare industry/digital platforms.
* Soft skills: Stakeholder management; fluent communication skills (written and verbal); and ability to work independently and within a team environment
* Technical skills:

+ Expert-level ability to independently create medico-marketing content, creative storytelling, persona-based content derivatization/repurposing/localization, omnichannel campaign/content derivatization, brand knowledge/understanding of brand messaging and guidelines

+ Content tagging/digital asset management expertise

+ Advanced understanding of GenAI prompting/fluency with GenAI content framework and GEO/SEO optimization experience is required

+ Expertise in cross-channel content delivery (web, mobile, social), drives customer journey analysis, knowledge of channel best practices to guide team members is preferred



* Advanced proficiency in MS PPT/Excel/Word & Adobe
* Education: Advanced degree in life sciences/pharmacy/similar discipline
* Languages: Excellent knowledge of English language (spoken and written)

Why choose us?
  
  

* Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team
* Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally
* Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact
* Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave
* Play a key role in shaping and optimizing our content strategy, driving business growth and achieving impactful results

Pursue Progress, discover Extraordinary
  
  
Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.
  
  
At Sanofi, we provide equal opportunities to all regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.
  
  
Watch our ALL IN video and check out our Diversity Equity and Inclusion actions at sanofi.com!

title: Audience Analyst
description:
**About Us**
DataBeat Consulting is seeking to hire for the role of an Audience/Traffic Analyst. We are looking to recruit enthusiastic talent and quick learners who could take up challenges. In this role, you will own responsibilities and master various skills – handling data, business decision making, project management, client communication and management.
  
  
DataBeat, a specialist in Media and Analytics space, provides managed services for Publishers (typically news websites that make revenue from advertising) and Ad Tech to increase their revenue and audience. Digital advertising is data-intensive and we believe in data-based decision making and problem-solving to excel in various functions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Work with the client business managers to study the data, identify the patterns, present the insights and make recommendations to support the client on business decisions
* Acquire subject matter expertise in media and adtech space over a period of time to own the day to day handling of the analysis and revenue management on behalf of the client
* Develop knowledge of the tools and systems to be able to extract relevant data for a business problem at hand or analysis required
* Manage and/or take up execution of the recommendations
* Traffic, optimize and manage campaigns in the ad server of Publishers
* Own the reporting needs (periodic or ad-hoc) of the client

**Skills**

* Ability to conceptualize and build templates (typically excel) to represent data
* Extremely detail-oriented and well-organized
* Strong Communication skills (verbal and written)
* Ability to positively engage with the clients and build strong long-term relationships
* Ability to work efficiently and effectively in a high-paced environment and under deadlines
* Having good conceptual understanding of SEO and SEM is a plus
* In depth knowledge of user experience and how it impacts the performance of websites is a plus

**Tools To Be Good At**

* Excel
* Visualization tools like looker or lookerstudio is a plus
* In depth knowledge of Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics (implementation and usage)
* Knowledge of tools like chartbeat, parsley is a plus

**Location: Hyderabad**
**Note:**
This is not a coding/programming role. The default working hours are 5pm – 2am.
  
  
**Why DataBeat**

* DataBeat was founded in 2017 by ex IIM, IIIT grads who held leadership roles in top media and consulting firms
* Currently a ~100 people organization and with clients in US and UK, DataBeat has been growing at 50%+ YOY
* You would be working on a client facing role with reputed global media and adtech firms developing client management skills
* Provides an opportunity to not only be part of a dynamic environment, but also gain expertise in business/data analytics which is the next big thing
* Be part of the fast-growing digital media and advertising space which is the core business of the likes of Google, Facebook, LinkedIn and Amazon
* In a matter of year or two, you could expect to do one more or of the following
* Lead a client engagement
* Lead a set of people
* Own development of ideas and concepts to grow the organization.

**Information Security & ISO 27001 Compliance**
Security is at the heart of everything we do. In this role, you will be strictly required to uphold our Information Security Management System (ISMS) policies in alignment with
**ISO/IEC 27001**
standards. Responsibilities include safeguarding sensitive asset data, completing mandatory security awareness training, reporting potential security incidents or vulnerabilities immediately, and ensuring that daily operations comply with our rigorous data protection protocols.

title: Assistant Manager – Performance Marketing
description:
We are looking for a results-driven Assistant Manager – Performance Marketing to own and lead our paid media, social media and brand building across multiple business verticals. You should be equally comfortable building a campaign strategy, optimising live ads, and presenting performance numbers to leadership. You will be accountable for lead generation — not just campaign delivery — and for how our brands look and feel, from visual identity to campaign creative direction.

**Key Responsibilities:**

***Paid Media & Lead Generation***

* Plan, execute and optimise paid campaigns across Meta, Google and LinkedIn to generate qualified leads across all business verticals
* Own the full campaign lifecycle — strategy, audience targeting, creative briefing, budget management and performance optimisation
* Drive lead generation for B2C verticals (retail, education, bookings) and B2B verticals (corporate services, broking, real estate concepts)
* Monitor and improve key metrics: cost per lead (CPL), return on ad spend (ROAS), click-through rates and conversion rates
* Coordinate with the creative and content teams so campaign assets are delivered on time and aligned to brief

***Social Media Management***

* Develop and implement social media strategy across all brand handles — content cadence, platform priorities and audience growth targets
* Oversee content scheduling and publishing across Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook and YouTube
* Drive consistent follower growth and engagement across all active brand handles
* Set up and manage automated DM and lead qualification flows on social platforms
* Stay ahead of platform trends, algorithm changes and content formats

***Brand Building & Visual Direction***

* Define and maintain brand guidelines, visual identity, tone of voice and design language across all verticals
* Build distinct brand positioning for each vertical while keeping it cohesive under the group identity
* Set the visual direction for every major campaign and brief the design and video team before launch
* Review creative output from the design team to keep quality high and every asset on-brand
* Create or direct premium brand collateral: social creatives, pitch decks, brochures and one-pagers
* Test multiple creative variants on key campaigns and iterate visuals based on performance data
* Run regular brand audits to catch inconsistencies and drive alignment across teams

***AI & Automation***

* Use AI-powered ad tools for automated targeting, bidding and campaign optimisation
* Implement automation workflows for lead capture, CRM entry and follow-up sequences
* Use AI tools for ad copy, creative briefs and audience research to multiply output
* Continuously evaluate and adopt new tools that improve campaign performance or team productivity

**Requirements:**

***Experience & Skills***

* 3–5 years of hands-on performance marketing experience, independently managing Meta Ads and Google Ads
* Proven track record managing multi-brand or multi-vertical paid campaigns simultaneously
* Strong social media management experience — strategy, content calendars, platform growth, scheduling
* Proficiency with Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, Google Analytics and LinkedIn Campaign Manager
* Experience with CRM platforms for lead tracking and pipeline management
* Ability to build and present weekly performance reports clearly and confidently
* Familiarity with campaign automation tools and performance dashboards

***Brand & Design Skills***

* Strong visual sense with a portfolio showing brand identity, campaign creatives and social media work
* Experience briefing, directing and reviewing a design or creative team
* Familiarity with AI design tools such as Adobe Firefly, Canva AI or Midjourney



***What Makes You the Right Fit***

* You think in leads, CPL and ROAS — not just impressions and reach
* You are proactive: campaigns are always-on, not waiting for someone to brief you
* You are uncomfortable leaving manual work that can be automated
* You own your numbers — if a target is missed, you know why and have a fix ready
* You actively use AI tools to do more with less
* You communicate clearly to senior leadership — reporting is a strength, not a chore

***What We Offer***

* Ownership of a multi-vertical lead generation function with direct visibility to senior leadership
* A full tools and technology budget — every resource you need to perform at your best
* A dynamic, growing group company across music, capital markets and lifestyle sectors
* Performance-linked career growth — strong results translate into expanded scope and compensation
* An AI-first team culture where automation is encouraged and manual work is actively reduced

Revenue growth — your contribution to month-over-month sales from the affiliate channel.

Be part of a growing team where your ideas actually shape outcomes.

Work with a supportive manager who values growth and initiative.

Prime Vashi location with easy connectivity and a collaborative office culture.

**Rusk Media | Mumbai, Maharashtra | On-site**

**About Rusk Media**

Rusk Media is building the future of entertainment for the next generation. We create and distribute youth-first entertainment across the AVOD, SVOD and OTT ecosystem, combining original IPs, branded entertainment and digital-first storytelling. We are focused on building engaging entertainment experiences while continuously growing our audience and subscriber base.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a data-driven
**Remarketing Manager**
to own audience re-engagement, retention and monetisation initiatives across our digital entertainment ecosystem.

The role will focus on developing audience segmentation strategies, designing personalised and behaviour-driven campaigns, and driving repeat content consumption and subscriber conversions. The candidate will be responsible for engaging existing, inactive and at-risk users through targeted campaigns across the user lifecycle, ultimately improving retention, reactivation and revenue.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in lifecycle marketing, CRM, remarketing, marketing automation and performance optimisation, preferably within OTT, media, entertainment or consumer internet businesses.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Remarketing & Lifecycle Strategy**

* Develop and execute remarketing strategies across different stages of the user lifecycle.
* Build audience segmentation frameworks based on user behaviour, engagement patterns, viewing history and subscription status.
* Identify inactive, dormant and at-risk users and develop targeted reactivation strategies.
* Create campaigns to improve repeat engagement and long-term user retention.

**2. Personalisation & Campaign Management**

* Design personalised, show-specific, genre-based and behaviour-driven campaigns to drive content discovery and consumption.
* Develop targeted campaigns based on viewing preferences, user activity, content interests and engagement history.
* Plan and execute campaigns across relevant channels such as Push Notifications, Email, SMS, WhatsApp and other CRM channels.
* Ensure relevant content recommendations and messaging are delivered to the right audience at the right time.

**3. Retention & Monetisation**

* Drive repeat viewership, active users (DAU/MAU), subscriber conversions and subscription renewals.
* Develop strategies to improve user retention and reduce churn.
* Identify opportunities to monetise existing users through targeted campaigns, personalised content recommendations and subscription-led initiatives.
* Improve the overall user lifecycle journey from engagement and repeat consumption to subscription and renewal.

**4. Performance Tracking & Optimisation**

* Track and analyse campaign performance across reactivation, repeat views, conversions, retention and incremental revenue.
* Monitor campaign ROI and identify opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness.
* Analyse user cohorts, engagement patterns and drop-off points to identify retention opportunities.
* Use data-driven insights to continuously improve campaign targeting and performance.

**5. Experimentation & Continuous Improvement**

* Conduct A/B testing across messaging, creatives, audience cohorts, campaign frequency, timing and offers.
* Experiment with different engagement strategies to improve campaign response and conversion rates.
* Identify successful campaign approaches and scale them across relevant audience segments.
* Work closely with Product, Data Analytics and Content teams to improve user engagement and lifecycle performance.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* 4–7 years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, remarketing, retention or growth marketing.
* Prior experience in OTT, media, entertainment, gaming, e-commerce or consumer internet businesses is preferred.
* Hands-on experience in audience segmentation, campaign automation, personalised marketing and user reactivation.
* Strong understanding of Push Notifications, Email Marketing, SMS, WhatsApp and other CRM communication channels.
* Experience working with CRM, marketing automation and customer engagement platforms.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data, user cohorts and engagement metrics.
* Understanding of user acquisition, retention, churn, subscriber conversion and monetisation metrics.
* Ability to independently plan, execute and optimise multiple campaigns.

**Key Success Metrics**

* User reactivation and repeat engagement
* DAU / MAU growth
* Repeat viewership and content consumption
* Subscriber conversion and renewals
* User retention and churn reduction
* Campaign ROI and incremental revenue

title: Digital Marketing & Content Specialist
description:
Content Creation, Content Marketing, Creative Content Production, Design, Digital Marketing, Social Media, Social Media Marketing
  
  
**Remote | Full-Time | Eastern Time Availability | C$12,000 Annually**
Royal York Property Management is looking for a creative and highly organized professional to produce marketing content for residential rental properties.
  
  
You will take property details, photographs, and video clips and turn them into polished listings, improved images, virtually furnished rooms, and short videos that help available properties stand out.
  
  
This is a hands-on production position. It is not a senior marketing-strategy, social-media-management, or paid-advertising role.
  
  
Your Work
  
  
Property Positioning and Listings
  
  
You will identify each property’s strongest selling points, write engaging titles and descriptions, and publish accurate listings across approved rental websites and online platforms.
  
  
You will adjust content to meet different platform requirements and keep prices, availability, photographs, and property details current.
  
  
Photography and AI Editing
  
  
You will select the strongest property photographs and complete light editing such as cropping, resizing, lighting improvements, and appropriate cleanup.
  
  
When needed, you will use AI tools to remove temporary clutter or virtually furnish empty rooms.
  
  
AI may improve the presentation, but it must never change permanent property features, room dimensions, layouts, or amenities.
  
  
Short-Form Video Content
  
  
You will create short property videos using photographs and video clips.
  
  
You may also create AI-assisted content using presenters, avatars, or voiceovers.
  
  
**Tools May Include**

* Canva
* CapCut
* HeyGen
* AI virtual-staging platforms
* AI object-removal tools
* Comparable image and video applications

You will be responsible for reviewing AI-generated content and correcting visual, factual, pronunciation, or branding errors before publication.
  
  
Organization and Quality Control
  
  
You may manage content for several properties at the same time.
  
  
**You Will Need To**

* Track every active listing and its current status
* Complete urgent price and availability corrections
* Remove or update properties that are no longer available
* Manage competing deadlines
* Identify missing information or materials
* Coordinate with Royal York’s leasing and property-management teams
* Respond professionally to feedback and complete revisions promptly

What You Should Bring
  
  
**We Are Looking For Someone With**

* Two to three years of experience in digital marketing, content creation, online listings, real-estate marketing, marketplace content, or a comparable field
* Experience producing online listings, graphics, edited photographs, or short videos
* Strong writing skills and the ability to identify a property’s strongest selling points
* Experience with Canva, CapCut, or comparable editing tools
* Experience using AI for photo editing, object removal, virtual furnishing, or virtual staging
* Experience with HeyGen or another AI presenter, avatar, voice, or video-generation tool
* Strong creative and visual judgment
* Excellent organization and attention to detail
* The ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines
* The ability to receive feedback and revise work without becoming defensive
* Strong written and spoken English
* The ability to work independently
* Reliable internet, a suitable computer, and a professional remote-work environment
* Full-time availability with regular overlap during Eastern Time business hours

Candidates with less experience may be considered when their portfolio demonstrates strong ability.
  
  
Experience in residential leasing, property management, PropTech, real estate, or property-listing platforms is preferred but not required.
  
  
A Bachelor’s degree is not required. Your demonstrated ability, relevant experience, and portfolio quality are more important.
  
  
**You’ll Do Well Here If You Are**

* Creative without sacrificing accuracy
* Organized enough to manage repetitive, high-volume work
* Comfortable improving imperfect source material
* Curious about new AI and editing tools
* Careful not to create misleading property content
* Responsive to deadlines and feedback
* Able to work without constant supervision

How to Apply
  
  
Submit your résumé and an accessible portfolio or work-sample link.
  
  
Your portfolio must include examples from at least two of these areas:
  
  

* Graphics or edited photographs
* AI-edited or virtually furnished rooms
* Short-form videos
* AI-generated presenter or voice content

The link must work without a password or access request.
  
  
Candidates whose experience and portfolio align with the position will receive an email invitation to complete a short pre-recorded video interview.

title: Junior Social Media Copywriter
description:
About All In Motion

All In Motion is a global B2B creative agency, working with enterprise brands since 2010. We help some of the world's biggest technology, consulting and industrial companies, including Capgemini, Schneider Electric, Genpact, TCS, Infosys and Google Cloud, turn complex stories into creative that moves buyers.

Our work covers brand narrative, integrated campaigns, digital experiences and large-scale creative production. Every project runs through our CORE™ framework, which keeps delivery on track and leaves room for big ideas. We think good B2B work should still make a person feel something.

What you'll do

•        Come up with campaign concepts, platforms and taglines for enterprise brands, and present them with conviction.

•        Create social-first ideas, series and formats for LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube. Hooks, carousels, short-form video, the occasional meme when the brand can carry it, and stunts people share.

•        Write short form: headlines, taglines, social posts, ad copy, scripts and voiceovers.

•        Write long form: blogs, articles, whitepapers, e-books, reports and thought-leadership pieces.

•        Keep everything in a campaign sounding like one idea, across formats, markets and months.

•        Work with art directors, designers and animators from the first sketch, so ideas are built visually from the start.

•        Dig through research, reports and expert interviews to find the insight a campaign can stand on. The technical detail is there to support the story.

•        Use modern creative and productivity tools to explore more routes and move quickly. The ideas and the final words are yours.

Who you are

•        You're an ideas person first. Your portfolio has campaigns you helped come up with, as well as copy you wrote.

•        You get social. You've made social campaigns that people actually engaged with, and you can tell which trends are worth joining.

•        You have your own voice and a good ear, and you can adapt to any brand, from playful to boardroom.

•        You're as comfortable with a six-word headline as with a 3,000-word whitepaper.

•        You'll pitch the idea that makes the room a little nervous, and you can tell a good idea from a loud one.

The suit

•        You communicate clearly with senior marketing teams and can present and defend your work.

•        You meet deadlines. Enterprise clients rely on it, and so do we.

•        You have 3–6 years in an agency or brand team, including some B2B work. You don't need to be a tech expert, but you pick up a new industry or product quickly.

•        You follow brand guidelines, check your facts and only ship work you can stand behind.

•        You use modern creative tools to work faster, and you know when to put them down and think for yourself.

•        You like working with designers, take feedback well and give it honestly.

•        Your written and spoken English is excellent.

Nice to have

•        Campaign work that won awards, made a shortlist or got results you can point to.

•        Concepting and scripting for brand films, animated explainers or events.

•        Experience with IT services, consulting, SaaS, sustainability or financial services clients.

•        Some understanding of how B2B buyers make decisions.

•        Something you make outside work: a newsletter, a podcast, short films, poetry, a meme page.

title: Search Engine Optimization Manager (SEO Manager)
description:
About Fenzo Digital

Fenzo Digital is an established, full-service digital marketing agency headquartered in Singapore and expanding globally to Canada, US and Australia. We work with SMEs, MNCs, established brands and government/public-sector organisations across a wide range of industries.

As we expand our international operations and client portfolio, we are strengthening our SEO team and looking for an experienced SEO Manager with a solid agency background.

The Role

Reporting directly to the Senior Manager and CEO, you will work closely with our content, development, advertising, creative and account management teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and deliver SEO strategies for multiple company and client accounts.
* Build strategies that improve client visibility across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms through Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Large Language Model Optimization (LLMO). Optimise content, website structure, entities, authority signals and citations to strengthen brand discoverability and mentions across Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and other AI-driven search experiences.
* Perform technical, on-page, off-page and content SEO audits.

* Work with Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog and comparable tools.
* Prepare professional monthly reports that explain performance, highlight insights and provide actionable recommendations.
* Coordinate with developers, content creators and other digital specialists to implement improvements.
* Participate in client meetings and clearly present SEO strategies, progress and results.
* Proactively uncover SEO opportunities and take responsibility for client performance.

Requirements

* 5+ years of hands-on SEO experience in a digital marketing agency.
* A proven track record of managing several SEO client accounts simultaneously.
* Strong knowledge of Technical SEO, On-Page SEO, Content SEO and Off-Page SEO.
* Practical experience using GA4, Google Search Console and professional SEO tools.
* Strong analytical, reporting and problem-solving skills.
* Strong written and spoken English.
* A proactive and accountable approach, with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced agency environment.

We are looking for someone who can assess challenges, develop strategies, implement solutions and take ownership of results.

As we continue to grow and expand our horizons, CBIZ remains committed to delivering exceptional service and value to our clients. We invite you to join us on this exciting journey and explore the possibilities that we offer.

**Role Overview**

The Web Manager is responsible for the performance, health, and growth of the company website as a core marketing channel. The role leads search visibility across traditional search (SEO) and AI-driven discovery (AEO/GEO), ensuring the brand is found on Google and cited in AI-generated answers.

The position combines technical ownership with marketing impact, covering site maintenance, optimization, page development, analytics, governance, agency partnerships, and digital investments while connecting web performance to leads, pipeline, and business growth.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Build, edit, and publish pages, landing pages, and templates in the CMS using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
* Own the SEO, AEO, and GEO roadmap across technical, on-page, and content
* Run technical SEO audits covering crawlability, indexation, sitemaps, canonicals, and internal linking
* Implement structured data (JSON-LD) and entity-led content so the brand is cited in AI-generated answers
* Track rankings, organic traffic, and AI visibility, and report on competitor benchmarks
* Manage day-to-day site health: uptime, security, backups, plugins, and updates
* Improve site speed and Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS)
* Run CRO programs including A/B tests, UX fixes, and form and CTA optimization
* Set up and manage GA4, GTM, Search Console, and heatmap tools with accurate event and conversion tracking
* Build dashboards and deliver regular reports that link web performance to leads and pipeline
* Manage external web, SEO, analytics, and digital agency partners to deliver projects on time, within budget, and aligned to business and website performance goals
* Manage website budgets, agency retainers, software subscriptions, and project investments to maximize efficiency and business impact
* Establish and maintain website governance, including content standards, accessibility requirements, SEO best practices, and publishing workflows

**Skills & Qualifications:**

* 8-10 years in website management, SEO, or digital marketing
* Bachelor's/Master’s degree in Marketing, Computer Science, Communications, or a related field
* Hands-on expertise with a WordPress
* Strong technical SEO skills with Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, and Search Console
* Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, schema markup, and page speed tools
* Proficiency in GA4 and GTM, with the ability to present data clearly to non-technical stakeholders

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* B2B, SaaS, or professional services experience
* Familiarity with Power BI for data analysis
* Experience with website migrations, multilingual SEO, or headless CMS setups

Deloitte is seeking an experienced Creative Strategist (Individual Contributor) to lead the creative vision and hands-on execution of high-impact pursuit collaterals across print and digital platforms. This role is ideal for a senior design professional who thrives as a maker, thinker, and visual storyteller, someone who can independently translate complex business ideas into compelling, brand-aligned creative solutions.
  
  
In this role, you will serve as the creative strategist for new business pursuits supporting Deloitte’s businesses. You will work closely with senior leaders, pursuit strategists, writers, and cross-functional teams to shape the visual narrative of pursuit materials, elevate design quality, and bring clarity to complex information through strong conceptual thinking and refined execution.
  
  
This is not a people-management role. Instead, it is a senior individual contributor role for a creative professional who sets direction through expertise, influence, innovation, and exceptional design craft. You will also help advance the team’s capabilities by exploring emerging tools, technologies, and GenAI-enabled design approaches.
  
  
**Work Responsibilities**

* Lead the creative direction and hands-on design development for high-priority new business pursuits, ensuring work is visually compelling, strategically grounded, and aligned to Deloitte’s brand.
* Conceptualize and produce sophisticated design collaterals across print and digital formats, including presentations, infographics, proposals, videos, and other pursuit-related sales assets.
* Translate complex business concepts, data, and messaging into clear, engaging visual communication that strengthens storytelling and client impact.
* Partner closely with senior leaders, pursuit teams, strategists, and cross-functional stakeholders to develop visual solutions that support business goals and elevate the quality of pursuit materials.

* In collaboration with creative leadership, explore and apply emerging design technologies, platforms, and methodologies to keep work current, differentiated, and effective.
* Leverage advanced Generative AI tools to improve creative exploration, speed, quality, and innovation across complex design assignments.
* Maintain high standards of craft, consistency, and attention to detail while managing multiple deadlines in a fast-paced, pursuit-driven environment.
* Present and articulate creative concepts, rationale, and design recommendations to senior stakeholders with confidence and clarity.
* Contribute to a culture of creativity, experimentation, and continuous improvement through thought leadership, collaboration, and strong individual execution.

**Qualifications Required**

* Bachelor of Fine Arts (BFA), BSc in Visual Communication, or related field.

* Demonstrated experience operating as a senior individual contributor in a high-performance creative or marketing environment.

* Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working within established brand systems and implementing brand strategy across multiple formats.

* 2:00 PM–11:00 PM (IST)
