title: Social Media Manager, D2CX
description:
Inc42 Media is looking for a
**Social Media Manager**
to own and scale
**D2CX by Inc42**
— our fastest-growing IP and India's most credible voice on building consumer brands.

The mandate is simple to state and hard to execute:
**make D2CX the single best source of content on D2C and consumer brand building in India**
, and get every meaningful stakeholder in the D2C and ecommerce ecosystem — founders, operators, investors, agency and enabler teams, category managers, and aspiring brand builders — following us.

You will own
**Instagram**
as the primary growth engine,
**build and scale our YouTube channel**
from strategy to publishing cadence, and set up the social playbook for
**new IPs Inc42 launches**
in this space. This is a builder's role, not a scheduler's role — you'll decide what gets made, why it will travel, and how it compounds into audience.

Our ideal candidate is a creative, obsessive, insight-led social professional from a modern media brand, a content-first startup, or a creator-led business — someone who watches a reel and instinctively knows why it worked.

**About Inc42 Media**

Inc42 is India’s #1 startup media & intelligence platform that informs, educates and empowers startup & business leaders through its incisive reporting, insightful reports, curated events & communities, and industry-leading executive courses & programs.

Since launching in January 2015, and having risen to become the authoritative voice on India’s startup economy, we've moved markets, gotten the early scoop on billions of dollars of transactions and told you what's happening deep inside some of the fastest growing startups & industries alike. Our stories have been followed by the Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg, Reuters, TechCrunch and other major outlets hundreds of times.

We also track over 50,000+ startups and provide market research and intelligence through our in-depth research reports, and we organise some of the most sought-after conferences and events for startup & business leaders across India.

**The Inc42 Impact**

* Inc42 stories reach over 50 Mn+ people monthly
* Published more than 55,000 stories
* Successfully conducted 150+ events
* Launched 100+ research reports
* Receives 500+ startup applications monthly
* Worked with 350+ brands

**What winning looks like**

* **D2CXbyInc42 becomes the default follow**
  for anyone building or backing a consumer brand in India — measured on follower growth, reach, saves, shares, and share of voice in the category.
* **A real YouTube channel, not a dumping ground**
  — with defined formats, a publishing rhythm, and watch-time and subscriber growth that compounds month on month.
* **A repeatable content engine**
  where every D2CX session, cohort, event, report, and founder conversation converts into multi-format social output without extra lift.
* **Social becomes a demand channel**
  — driving qualified applications and enrolments into D2CX programs, not just vanity reach.
* **Every new Inc42 IP launches with a social playbook ready on day one.**

**Primary Responsibilities**

**Instagram — Own & Scale D2CX**

* Own the end-to-end strategy, calendar, and growth of the @d2cxbyinc42 handle across Reels, carousels, Stories, collabs, and broadcast channels.
* Define the content pillars that make D2CX the authority on D2C — brand decodes, category breakdowns, founder playbooks, operator insights, data drops, and myth-busting.
* Set the format mix and publishing cadence, and hold the line on it.
* Build a hook-and-retention discipline: study drop-offs, iterate on openers, kill formats that don't travel, double down on the ones that do.
* Drive collaborative posts and cross-posting with founders, brands, creators, and partner handles to expand reach beyond our own audience.
* Own comments, DMs, and community engagement as a growth lever, not an afterthought.

**YouTube — Build The Channel**

* Build the YouTube content strategy from the ground up: channel positioning, format architecture, long-form vs Shorts mix, and publishing cadence.
* Design repeatable formats — founder interviews, brand teardowns, category deep-dives, session cuts, and explainers — and run them as series, not one-offs.
* Own packaging: titles, thumbnails, hooks, chapters, descriptions, and end screens; A/B test relentlessly.
* Own YouTube SEO and discovery — keyword research, tagging, playlists, and Shorts-to-long-form funnel design.
* Track watch time, retention curves, CTR, and subscriber conversion, and use them to shape the next slate.

**Content Strategy & Production**

* Convert D2CX's raw material — cohort sessions, Basecamp and Runway conversations, events, DataLabs reports, founder interviews — into a high-volume, high-quality social pipeline.
* Write and direct scripts, hooks, captions, thumbnail copy, and carousel narratives in the D2CX voice: founder-to-founder, tactical, no fluff.
* Work with design, video, and editorial to run production sprints that keep the calendar full without dropping quality.
* Maintain and evolve the D2CX content and design system so output stays instantly recognisable across formats.
* Build a repurposing engine — one session should yield reels, shorts, carousels, quote cards, newsletter blocks, and a long-form cut.

**New IP Launches**

* Build the go-to-market social playbook for every new IP Inc42 launches in this space — positioning, handle setup, content pillars, launch calendar, and first-90-days growth plan.
* Set up measurement, reporting, and iteration loops for each new handle from day one.
* Codify what works on D2CX into templates other IPs can run with.

**Creators, Founders & Partnerships**

* Build and manage a network of D2C founders, operators, and creators who contribute to and amplify D2CX content.
* Plan and execute influencer and creator collaborations, takeovers, and co-created series.
* Deliver on brand and sponsor social commitments across D2CX programs and events without diluting audience trust.

**Analytics & Reporting**

* Own weekly and monthly reporting across Instagram and YouTube — reach, engagement, saves, shares, follower growth, watch time, retention, and traffic/conversion contribution.
* Run structured post-mortems on top and bottom performers, and turn findings into the next content bet.
* Benchmark against category and competitor handles in India and globally, and bring the best ideas back.
* Share clear, decision-ready performance reads with founders and key stakeholders.

**Professional Traits**

**A. Mandatory Skills:**

* 3+ years of experience in social media, content marketing, or creator-led content, with hands-on ownership of a brand or IP handle.
* **Demonstrated growth on social platforms**
  — you can point to handles you scaled and explain exactly what drove it.
* Strong Instagram craft: short-form video instincts, hook writing, format design, and an actual read on why things go viral.
* Working knowledge of YouTube growth — packaging, retention, SEO, Shorts strategy, and channel building.
* Sharp writing skills in English, with a natural feel for Hinglish where the audience calls for it.
* Comfortable with numbers — able to read analytics and change the plan because of them, not despite them.
* Experience with social and scheduling tools (Meta Business Suite, YouTube Studio, Later, Buffer/Hootsuite, or equivalent) and analytics platforms.
* Genuine interest in D2C, consumer brands, retail, and ecommerce — and in the Indian startup ecosystem broadly.
* Creative mindset with an eye for detail; heavy consumer of content across social, OTT, newsletters, and creator media.

**B. Preferable Skills:**

* Experience at a modern digital media brand, content-first startup, D2C brand, or creator-led business.
* Hands-on with editing and design tools (CapCut, Premiere, Canva, Figma) enough to prototype without waiting on a queue.
* Exposure to performance marketing, email/WhatsApp lifecycle, and community-led growth.
* Experience launching a new social handle or content IP from zero.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with multiple IPs running in parallel.

\*\*Salary:\* 0 to 10,000per month, based on lead-generation/ performance

\*Duration\* - 3 month

Timing - 12PM to 5PM

## About Vedricx Global

Vedricx offers a \*\*7-month diploma program\*\* designed to prepare students for careers in the service and customer-facing industries.

Our program includes:

\* Customer Service

\* Hospitality

\* Aviation

\* Tourism

\* English Language

\* Personality Development

\* Placement Support

## Role Overview

We are looking for a \*\*Marketing Intern\*\* who can generate \*\*qualified student leads organically\*\* and help us increase enquiries and admissions for our 7-month diploma program.

The focus of this role is not just posting content, but \*\*actively finding and generating genuine prospective-student leads through organic channels\*\*.

## Key Responsibilities

\* Generate qualified leads organically for Vedricx's diploma program.

\* Identify and reach out to prospective students through platforms such as \*\*Reddit, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp communities, and other relevant online platforms\*\*.

\* Use \*\*Apollo\*\* and other prospecting/research tools to identify relevant audiences and potential leads.

\* Participate in relevant online communities and discussions to create awareness about the program.

\* Develop creative organic strategies to generate student enquiries without relying entirely on paid advertising.

\* Communicate with prospective students and understand their requirements.

\* Maintain and share accurate lead data with the admissions team.

\* Track the number and quality of leads generated.

\* Experiment with new platforms, communities, outreach methods, and content strategies to improve lead generation.

\* Coordinate with the admissions team to understand lead quality and conversion.

## What We Are Looking For

\* Strong communication and convincing skills.

\* Good understanding of social media and online communities.

\* Ability to find and connect with the right target audience.

\* Creative approach to organic lead generation.

\* Comfortable using platforms such as Reddit, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, etc.

\* Familiarity with \*\*Apollo or similar prospecting tools\*\* is an advantage.

\* Self-driven and target-oriented.

\* Freshers with strong communication skills and a genuine interest in marketing are welcome.

#Basic Training will be provided.

BotLab Dynamics is a pioneering drone technology company transforming the world of
**live entertainment, events and experiential experiences**
through cutting-edge drone technology.

From spectacular drone light shows to large-scale technology-led experiences, BotLab has delivered some of the most ambitious drone shows in India and globally.

, with a strong focus on India and international markets.

**Marketing Head**
to build the BotLab brand, strengthen our market positioning and create demand across the corporate, live events, entertainment and experiential ecosystem.

**overall brand, marketing, communications and demand-generation strategy**

We are looking for a marketing leader who understands
**brands, entertainment, experiences and storytelling**
—someone who can turn spectacular drone shows into powerful stories, create market excitement around BotLab, strengthen our positioning and generate meaningful business opportunities.

The ideal candidate will have experience in
**Live Events, Media & Entertainment, Experiential Marketing, Advertising, Brand Marketing, PR, Sports & Entertainment or technology-led consumer experiences**

  **drone entertainment, aerial experiences and technology-led live entertainment**

* Corporate events
* Live entertainment
* Experiential marketing

This will be a critical part of the role.

  **live events and experiential marketing ecosystem**
  .

* Develop creative marketing campaigns around BotLab's drone shows and landmark projects.
* Create partnerships with event organizers, experiential agencies, production houses and entertainment companies.
* Develop BotLab-led experiences, showcases and demonstrations that create market visibility.
* Position BotLab not merely as a service provider but as an
  **innovator in live entertainment and experiential technology**
  .

**4. Content & Storytelling**

Drone shows are inherently visual. The Marketing Head will be responsible for turning that visual advantage into a powerful brand story.

* Build a strong
  **content and storytelling strategy**
  around BotLab's projects, technology, people and achievements.
* Develop compelling video, photography, reels, case studies and campaign content.
* Create high-quality content from major shows for use across digital, media, sales and brand channels.
* Develop customer success stories and case studies.
* Work closely with animation, creative and show design teams to create visually compelling marketing assets.
* Build a library of BotLab's best work for corporate and agency presentations.
* Identify opportunities to turn major projects into
  **high-impact content moments**
  .

**5. Digital & Social Media**

* Own BotLab's digital brand presence across relevant platforms.
* Develop and execute social media strategy across LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube and other relevant platforms.
* Build a consistent content calendar across:
* Show highlights
* Behind-the-scenes stories
* Technology
* Innovation
* Client stories
* Team stories
* Company milestones
* Industry insights
* Grow BotLab's digital reach, engagement and community.
* Build BotLab's leadership and employee voices as part of the overall brand strategy.
* Use digital platforms to strengthen both
  **brand awareness and business generation**
  .

**6. PR, Media & Corporate Communications**

* Develop and own BotLab's
  **PR and media strategy**
  .
* Build strong relationships with:
* Business media
* Technology media
* Entertainment media
* Advertising & marketing media
* Event industry publications
* Regional media
* International media
* Generate meaningful media coverage around major projects, innovations, milestones and company announcements.
* Develop press releases, media stories, thought leadership and executive communications.
* Identify opportunities for founder and leadership visibility.
* Position BotLab executives as
  **thought leaders in drone technology, entertainment and experiential innovation**
  .
* Manage media interactions around major shows and company announcements.

**7. Campaigns & Brand Activations**

* Develop integrated marketing campaigns for key BotLab initiatives.
* Conceptualize campaigns that combine
  **technology + entertainment + storytelling**
  .
* Develop campaigns around major festivals, sporting events, national occasions and industry moments.
* Collaborate with agencies and creative partners where required.
* Manage campaign execution from concept to delivery.
* Measure campaign performance and brand impact.

**8. Industry Events & Thought Leadership**

* Identify and manage BotLab's participation in relevant industry events, conferences, exhibitions and forums.
* Build opportunities for BotLab to showcase its technology to decision-makers and industry influencers.
* Develop speaking opportunities for founders and leadership.
* Identify awards, recognitions and industry platforms relevant to BotLab.
* Build BotLab's presence within the
  **events, entertainment, experiential, technology and business ecosystem**
  .
* Develop proprietary events, showcases or industry experiences where relevant.

**9. Marketing for Business Development**

Work closely with the Business Head and Business Development team to create marketing that directly supports revenue growth.

* Develop sales enablement material including presentations, case studies, credentials and capability decks.
* Create industry-specific marketing collateral for corporates, brands, agencies and institutions.
* Develop campaigns to generate qualified business leads.
* Support account-based marketing for strategic clients.
* Build marketing programs targeting key corporate and agency accounts.
* Create content that helps the sales team communicate BotLab's value proposition effectively.
* Measure marketing contribution to pipeline and business opportunities.

**10. Partnerships & Brand Collaborations**

* Brands

* Event agencies
* Entertainment companies
* Sports organizations
* Tourism bodies
* Technology companies

**11. Employer & Corporate Brand**

* Develop employer-branding initiatives in collaboration with HR.
* Showcase BotLab's people, culture, technology and innovation.
* Build compelling internal and external storytelling around the company's journey.
* Support leadership communication and company-wide brand initiatives.

**12. Marketing Team & Agency Management**

* Build and lead a high-performing marketing team.
* Define roles, responsibilities, KPIs and performance expectations.

* Build an effective ecosystem of external partners and specialists.
* Ensure high standards of creativity, execution and brand consistency.

title: Senior Brand Manager
description:
Senior Brand Marketing Manager | Cüraa

Backed by 3one4 Capital, Kae Capital, Lumikai and Better Capital (₹40 crore Series A, led by 3one4 Capital)

Location: Delhi NCR

Experience: 4–8 years in brand marketing at D2C / consumer startups

Type: Full-time

Focus: Brand building, launches, content and creators, D2C growth

Category: Kitchen and home appliances

THE ROLE IN SHORT

Own the Cüraa brand. You will shape how India sees Cüraa, launch every new product with a clear story, and make every rupee of performance spend work harder. This is a hands-on role in a lean D2C team: you set the direction and you also get it done, working closely with the founders, product and design, performance marketing, marketplaces and customer experience.

We are looking for someone who has built a brand from scratch, not someone who has only managed a big one.

Half a million homes. Now make 40 million remember the name.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

1. The brand: positioning, value proposition, tone of voice and visual identity for Cüraa and any new brands we launch. Build the brand book and the distinctive assets that make people recognise us before they see the logo.

2. The consumer: talk to customers, read every review, run quick surveys and home visits in real Indian kitchens, and track competitors on Amazon, Flipkart and quick commerce. Turn what you learn into messaging, claims and input for our product roadmap.

3. The launches: go-to-market for every new product: naming, claims, packaging story, listing content and A+ pages, launch creatives and plans across our website, marketplaces, quick commerce and offline. Every launch gets one clear reason to buy.

4. The content and campaigns: creator and influencer programs, social, video, PR and community, plus festive and sale-season campaigns (Big Billion Days, Prime Day, Diwali). Test fast, keep what works, kill what does not.

5. The numbers: brand and growth metrics that matter for D2C: share of search, organic traffic, ratings and reviews, repeat purchase, content engagement, and how brand work lowers CAC and lifts conversion. Work hand in hand with the performance team on creative and budget.

6. The team and the standard: lead a small team (content, social, design) and freelancers or agencies with sharp briefs. Keep the brand consistent across the website, marketplace stores, packaging, social and customer service.

WHAT YOU BRING

• 4–8 years in brand marketing, mostly at D2C or consumer startups

• You have built a brand, sub-brand or category from scratch, and can show what you did and what it achieved

• Hands-on launches: products taken from zero to market on D2C, marketplaces and quick commerce

• Strong content instincts: creators, social, video, packaging and listing pages that sell

• You understand how brand and performance marketing work together, and speak the language of CAC, ROAS and conversion

• Comfortable with lean budgets: you get big results from small spends

• Data-driven: you use reviews, social listening, search trends and simple dashboards to decide what to do next

• Strong taste in creative, copy and design, and the ability to brief and guide a small team or freelancers

• Ownership: you work like a founder and do whatever it takes to ship

BONUS POINTS

• Home, kitchen or consumer durables experience

• Took a D2C brand from early stage to scale

• Built a community or creator-led brand

• Amazon and Flipkart brand store and A+ content expertise

• Offline retail or quick commerce launches

SELF-CHECK: ANSWER HONESTLY

• I have built a brand or product line from scratch, and can show the before and after.

• I have launched products on D2C and marketplaces, and know how they performed.

• I have run creator or content programs that moved sales, not just likes.

• I have done a lot with a small budget.

• I have worked closely with performance marketing and made each other better.

• I am happy to write the brief, review the creative and fix the listing myself.

Mostly yes? Apply. Not really? This is not the role, and that is fine.

HOW TO APPLY

Apply here: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeAH5eftzB9Ak1TdfEjuUda3-bmq40euLEWTU0rfXn-1E4TOA/viewform

Share your resume and a short portfolio or case-study deck: the brands, launches and campaigns you worked on, your exact role, the idea behind the work, how you executed it, and the results. Include at least one brand or product you built from scratch.

ABOUT CÜRAA

Cüraa started from scratch: a small team, a blank sheet, and one habit we never dropped. Pick a real kitchen problem, solve it properly, and ship it at a price India will pay. A few of the problems we have solved so far:

• The bullet mixer grinder with a steel jar: bullet-style speed and size, with a jar made for everyday Indian grinding.

• The most durable frother: the product everyone underestimates, built to last.

• Manual and electric choppers that set a new bar for the whole category.

• The knob-based induction: India's inductions came covered in buttons. Ours is simple: turn it, cook.

One kitchen problem at a time, Cüraa has reached half a million households. We have raised a ₹40 crore Series A led by 3one4 Capital, with Kae Capital, Lumikai and Better Capital. Our goal is 30–40 million households in the next five years, roughly 10% of India's homes. Most of those homes have never heard of Cüraa, and they already have a brand in mind for every mixer, chopper and induction. We need a brand that is remembered, chosen and recommended. That is your job.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

• A sharper, more recognisable Cüraa brand that stands apart from the big players

• Share of search, organic traffic and ratings rising month on month

• Every launch lands with a clear story and hits its launch targets

• Brand and content that lower CAC and lift conversion for the performance team

• Consistent messaging across the website, marketplaces, packaging and social

• Customer insight that shapes what we launch next

**Inc42**
**is India's #1 startup media & intelligence platform**
that informs, educates and empowers startup & business leaders through its incisive reporting, insightful reports, curated Events, Conferences & communities, and industry-leading executive courses & programs.

Since launching in January 2015 and having risen to become the authoritative voice on India's startup economy, we've moved markets, gotten the early scoop on billions of dollars of transactions, and told you what's happening deep inside some of the fastest-growing startups & industries alike. Our stories have been followed by the Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg, Reuters, TechCrunch, and other major outlets hundreds of times. **Program**

**Format**

**Built For**

12-week hands-on hybrid accelerator

**D2CX Foundations**

First-time founders launching a D2C brand profitably

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Build and run the cohort calendar: session scheduling, speaker confirmations, content readiness, platform setup, and communication timelines.

**3. Cross-Functional Efficiency & Systems**

* Act as the single point of alignment across content, design, marketing, growth, product/tech, partnerships, and operations for everything Courses.
* Map current workflows, identify duplicated effort and bottlenecks, and rebuild them into leaner, documented processes with clear owners and turnaround times.
* Run a weekly operating rhythm — review calls, blockers, dependencies, and next actions — with complete visibility for the Founder's Office.
* Drive automation and tooling decisions across LMS, CRM, payments, community platforms, and internal trackers to reduce manual load per cohort.

**4. Funnel, Revenue & Performance Reporting**

title: Partnerships Associate
description:
**About Us:**

Good Business Lab (GBL) is a research-to-action nonprofit that advances access to high-quality jobs for low-income workers. We believe a truly good job is more than wages — it creates conditions for workers to thrive. Yet too few workers have access to sustained wage growth, supportive workplaces, and real opportunities for advancement. GBL works to change this by expanding pathways into better-fit, higher-opportunity work and improving job quality within large employers. We study worker needs, partner with workers and employers to co-design interventions that serve both individual and business goals, and evaluate impact through causal methods. Across manufacturing, retail, and food service, our work shows that improving job quality also improves firm performance. Globally, we have directly improved outcomes for over 500,000 workers, with indirect reach across an ecosystem impacting nearly 2 million more.

The founders of the GBL are Ach Adhvaryu – Professor of Economics, Director of 21st Century India Center, School of Global Policy and Strategy at UC San Diego, Anant Ahuja – Director of ESG and Sustainability at Shahi Exports Pvt. Ltd. (India’s largest Ready Made Garment firm), and Anant Nyshadham – Associate Professor of Business Economics and Public Policy at the University of Michigan.

**About the role**

Projects at GBL are centred on building the business case for worker wellbeing. Examples include studying the migration experience and mental health of workers and how these are affected by pairing them with experienced workers from their region (through a novel ‘buddy system’), unlocking women’s economic participation, and understanding how an effective grievance redressal system affects workers’ job outcomes. We are also building a portfolio of projects at the intersection of climate action and worker wellbeing, including the clean energy transition through a human lens and extreme heat stress.

To further our mission of advancing good jobs at the intersection of worker wellbeing and business resilience, the Partnerships Associate will service existing project needs, identify new project opportunities across industries and geographies, build key stakeholder relationships with private-sector firms and ecosystem partners, and support GBL’s external engagement strategy, including through delivering events.

*We strongly encourage applications from individuals belonging to historically underrepresented and marginalized communities. If comfortable, please share your social location in your application. This information will be limited to the hiring team and will not have any detrimental impact on your candidature.*

***Location: Delhi/Bangalore***

***Compensation: 6.5-8 LPA***

***Type of Engagement: Full Time***

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

**Partnership pipeline and outreach**

* Run a process-driven outreach pipeline: identify prospects (private sector, CSR, and industry bodies), sequence outreach, and maintain CRM hygiene (records, logs, and status).
* Support GBL’s partnerships strategy by following a systematic approach to partner outreach and relationship management.
* Conduct background research on organisations GBL could partner with, for projects, new opportunities, and otherwise, across industries and geographies.
* Ensure regular documentation of partnerships and opportunities in the form of records and logs.

**Relationship management**

* Service ongoing partnerships with private-sector firms, manufacturers, implementation agencies, NGOs, consultants, and other partners.
* Develop strong relationships with new and existing partners.
* Support other GBL teams in servicing project-specific partnerships.

**Events and external engagement**

* Support relevant teams in curating events for GBL, including participant and attendee outreach, event flow, roundtable or panel curation, vendor coordination, and other event-related logistics.
* Support relevant teams in vetting ecosystem events suited to GBL’s participation.
* Represent GBL at forums, conferences, and gatherings, and use them to share GBL’s work and identify new partnership opportunities.

**Research, insights, and communication materials**

* Coordinate and prepare policy memos, concept notes, proposals, presentations, and other targeted communication materials for meetings and internal or external stakeholder engagements.
* Proactively monitor policy and business developments that concern GBL’s focus areas, especially in the sustainability space, and share regular updates with the team.
* Build domain depth in evaluation, sustainability/ESG, and social ventures, and translate learning into practical recommendations for the pipeline.

**Who are you?**

**Required skills and experience**

* A bachelor’s degree in economics, environmental science, political science, international relations, sociology, history, English, communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 1–2 years of work experience in the social sector, preferably within sustainability, gender, or livelihoods.
* Advanced writing, communication, and presentation skills.
* Demonstrated administrative and coordination skills.
* Ability to network and build meaningful connections.
* An interest in GBL’s mission and thematic areas of work.

**Good to have**

* Familiarity with, or openness towards, CRM platforms such as Salesforce.
* An understanding of how economic research works, or experience doing economic research.

*We understand that candidates may not meet every listed requirement exactly. So please avoid the confidence gap, if this role excites you, and go ahead and apply. You don’t have to match all the listed requirements exactly to be considered for this role.*

**Additional Requirements: (If Any)**

* Strong problem-solving and organisational skills, with close attention to detail.
* Ability to prioritise and work under pressure to tight deadlines.
* Ability to work independently and proactively.
* Comfort with a dynamic environment with competing priorities, where teamwork and resourcefulness are highly valued.
* An entrepreneurial spirit and a ‘can-do’ attitude.
* Openness to giving and receiving constructive feedback.
* Empathy and sensitivity towards the wellbeing and growth of fellow coworkers.
* Strong perseverance in high-pressure situations.

**Recent projects and blog posts:**

To acclimatize yourself with some of our work, you can explore our website where you’ll find project insights, podcasts and reports. You can also read our blog posts on Medium, and follow us on LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter (X), and Instagram to learn more about our work.

**Deadline to Apply:**
*On rolling basis*

**The process:**

We are glad you’re interested in applying for this role! We deeply value your time and effort.

Our interview process for this role includes the following steps:

1. Introductory Conversation
2. Assignment
3. First Round of Interview
4. Second Round of Interview

*Depending on the candidate pool, we may add any additional interviews to make a well thought through decision.*

*The hiring team will review your application after each round and share a timely update on your application status and keep you updated on your progression through the following stages.*

**Our commitment to diversity:**

GBL is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, age, physical disability, or length of time spent unemployed. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We are a young and growing company making us the ideal ground for team members to experiment, take on dynamic roles, and grow with us. We focus on happiness, output, and quality of work.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

**Background Verification:**

Employment with GBL is contingent upon satisfactory background verification. GBL reserves the right to withdraw the offer in the event of any adverse or unsatisfactory findings.

title: Senior Copywriter – Culture & Brand
description:
**About Atlys**
Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
  
  
Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
  
  
Atlys is changing that.
  
  
We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
**1M+ travellers across 127 countries**
. But we’re still early.
  
  
**The Role**
We're looking for a culture-obsessed, AI-savvy creative who lives on the internet, writes exceptionally well, and thinks in ideas.
  
  
Someone who doesn't just write copy for campaigns but comes up with the campaigns themselves. Who can spot a cultural moment, turn it into a disruptive idea, use AI to bring it to life, and create content people actually want to watch and share.
  
  
At Atlys, you'll help build a distinctive travel brand through sharp writing, original ideas, social content, creators and collaborations. You'll have the freedom to experiment, ownership to make things happen, and plenty of startup chaos to navigate.
  
  
**The Job**

* Think big ideas: Develop disruptive campaigns, social concepts, content IPs and culturally relevant brand moments.
* Write brilliantly: Create sharp, distinctive copy for social, films, ads, websites and campaigns.
* Live on the internet: Spot trends, understand online culture and find unexpected ways for Atlys to participate in conversations.
* Make things with AI: Use AI tools, prompting, image and video generation to explore ideas, prototype concepts and create content.
* Direct social content: Independently conceptualise, script and direct reels and short-form videos.
* Build cultural relevance: Develop creative ideas with influencers, creators, brand partnerships and collaborations.
* Collaborate on craft: Work closely with art and design teams to turn ideas into exceptional creative output.
* Get things done: Own projects end-to-end, manage stakeholders and thrive in a fast-moving, constantly evolving environment.

**The Ideal Candidate**
**You’ll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**

* 3–5 years of experience in copywriting, creative strategy, advertising or social content.
* Excellent writing skills, a distinct point of view and the ability to think on your feet.
* An internet-native understanding of culture, creators, trends and what makes content shareable.
* Hands-on experience with AI tools and strong prompting skills.
* The ability to take an idea from a rough thought to a finished piece of content independently.
* Strong collaboration, communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Startup DNA: resourceful, proactive, comfortable with ambiguity and obsessed with making great work.

*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*
**What You Can Expect**
Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
  
  
**Here’s What You Can Expect**

* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
  
  
*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

description:
**About Loop:**

Loop is a subscription management platform built for e-commerce brands on Shopify. Our primary market is the US, with growing presence in Europe and ANZ.

We are scaling rapidly, driven by a strong product and exceptional merchant experience. We achieved ~3x growth in 2024, followed by nearly 3x growth again in 2025. Looking ahead, we are building the team and foundation to drive another 2x growth in 2026 as we accelerate toward our $50M goal.

**Our DNA:**

* High Agency — action over instruction
* High Ethics — trust is the foundation
* Positive Attitude — solutions over excuses
* Impact-Driven — if it doesn't move the needle, it doesn't matter

**About the role**

Our buyers research on LinkedIn, X, YouTube and peer communities long before they talk to sales. You'll make sure Loop shows up there with content worth following, not product announcements on repeat.

This is a hands-on role. You'll set the social and content strategy and prove impact in pipeline terms. You'll work closely with product marketing, sales, customer success, and our leadership team, whose personal profiles are part of the channel.

**What you'll do**

You'll own social end to end, from strategy to the post to the pipeline report.

* Build and own the social strategy across LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and relevant communities, tied to monthly & quarterly marketing goals.
* Run a monthly content calendar aligned with launches, campaigns, events and sales priorities.
* Write, produce and publish posts, carousels, short-form video, polls, LinkedIn newsletters and LinkedIn Events.
* Turn existing assets (webinars, case studies, reports, customer calls, sales decks) into social-native content.
* Brief and manage designers, video editors and freelancers, and keep everything on brand.
* Spot industry conversations early and decide quickly whether we join them.
* Run the executive social program: ghostwrite or co-write posts for the CEO and 2–3 leaders.
* Build an employee advocacy program that makes it easy for sales and other teams to share and post.
* Monitor and respond to comments, mentions and DMs; route sales signals and support issues to the right team.
* Take part in groups, communities and creator conversations where our buyers spend time.
* Build relationships with industry creators and partners for collaborations and co-marketing.
* Track performance weekly and report monthly on leads & influenced pipeline and on reach, engagement, follower growth, traffic from our ICP
* Use social listening and competitor benchmarks to sharpen the strategy.
* Feed audience questions and objections back to product marketing and sales.

**What you bring**

* 4–8 years in social media marketing, with at least 2 in B2B (SaaS, tech or professional services preferred).
* A portfolio of B2B social content you created or led; with the results it drove.
* Deep LinkedIn and X knowledge: how the feed rewards content, company pages, newsletters, Events and Campaign Manager.
* Sharp writing. You can explain a complex product in plain, punchy language and switch between brand and executive voices.
* Hands-on paid social experience with budgets of [$X+/month], reporting on cost per lead and pipeline.
* Comfort with data: you set up UTMs, read dashboards and connect social activity to CRM outcomes.
* Experience helping executives build their personal brand.
* Strong project management across many stakeholders, without dropping deadlines.

**Nice to have**

* Experience in e-commerce or shopify app ecosystem.
* Short-form video skills: scripting and shooting (editing can be outsourced)
* You've built an employee advocacy or creator program from scratch.
* Familiarity with ABM platforms and intent data.
* An active personal presence on LinkedIn with an engaged following.

**About Effora**

Effora is a new-age beauty and wellness brand built around the ritual, not the product. Our devices, topicals and supplements work together to stimulate, absorb and recover. You will own and run Effora's entire creator ecosystem, from nano creators doing honest product demos to macro lifestyle creators who bring the brand into aspirational spaces. You will build the influencer engine, decide which creators and formats work best for Effora, and be accountable for the revenue they drive.

• Define Effora's influencer marketing across Instagram, YouTube and other platforms, for each product category (devices, topicals, supplements)

• Design and launch a brand ambassador programme with loyal customers and micro-creators

**Execution, End to End**

• Scout, shortlist and onboard the right creators for each campaign, and run outreach yourself

• Negotiate deals and manage creator budgets

• Own the full flow: scripting and references, product dispatch, briefing, drafts, changes, scheduling and going live

• Run high-volume campaigns, including festive sale pushes, new launches and marketplace-specific content

• Build long-term relationships with creators so the best ones work with us repeatedly

**Performance and Reporting**

• Track every campaign on CAC, ROAS, CTR, views and sales using discount codes, affiliate links and UTMs

• Maintain the influencer database and a daily performance report

• Work with the growth team to turn top creator content into ads, and with the brand team on messaging

**Market Intelligence**

• Track competitor influencer activity and current content and creator trends

• Spot emerging creators early

**Collaboration**

• Work closely with the brand, design, growth, ops and sales teams, so stock, creative and offers are ready before a campaign goes live

What We Are Looking For

**Must-Have**

• 5–6 years of experience in influencer marketing at D2C beauty and wellness brands

• Experience running influencer campaigns end to end, at volume, with measurable sales results

• Experience negotiating performance-based and barter deals, and managing budgets

• Strong understanding of creator-led content, social media trends and campaign metrics

• Strong negotiation, communication and relationship skills

• Based in or able to commute to Noida

**Good to Have**

• An existing network of beauty and wellness creators

• Experience with affiliate tools, UTM tracking and creator-to-ads workflows

• Experience with marketplace and quick-commerce content (Amazon, Flipkart, Nykaa)

• Comfort using AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT for research, briefs and scripts

**Who You Are**

• Executor: you get things done and ship campaigns on time

• Creative: you come up with fresh ideas and formats creators want to make

• Insightful: you understand audience behaviour and creator-brand fit

• Ownership-driven: you take accountability for campaign outcomes, not just activity

Email your CV to talent@effora.in

title: Founder's Office
description:
About AdsFlo

AdsFlo (adsflo.ai) is a Meta Ads analytics and launcher platform built by performance marketers, for performance marketers. It started as the internal tool behind Outwrk Media, a Gurugram-based D2C growth agency that manages about ₹40 crore of monthly ad spend across 50+ brands.

Today AdsFlo helps brands and agencies launch ads in bulk, tag and analyse every creative with AI, and see what is actually driving ROAS. Google Ads launching and Shopify data are next. We have paying customers, a product that works, and now need someone to take it to market.

**Role:**
Founder's Office, Growth (Sales, Marketing and Customer Success)

**Location:**
Gurugram, in office

**Experience:**
1 to 3 years

**Reports to:**
Founders

The role

You will be the first growth hire at AdsFlo and own the full customer journey: getting brands to hear about us, closing them, and keeping them happy enough to stay and refer others.

This is not a coordinator role. You will work directly with the founders, sit in on product decisions, and be the voice of the customer inside the team. If you have run Meta campaigns yourself, you already understand our buyer better than most salespeople ever will. That is the edge we are hiring for.

What you'll ownSales

* Build and run the pipeline: D2C brands, agencies and in-house growth teams spending on Meta
* Run discovery calls and product demos, handle objections, and close deals end to end
* Own outbound on LinkedIn, email and WhatsApp, plus warm intros from the Outwrk network
* Track every lead in a CRM and report weekly on pipeline, conversion and revenue
* Shape pricing, plans and the agency (B2B) offering based on what you hear from buyers

Marketing

* Plan and run AdsFlo's own paid campaigns on Meta and Google, and own the CAC and trial-to-paid numbers
* Run the founder and brand LinkedIn presence: posts, carousels, product walkthroughs, customer stories
* Create content that performance marketers actually want: teardowns, benchmarks, creative insights from the platform
* Own the website funnel (landing pages, signup flow, onboarding emails) with the product team
* Set up webinars, community sessions and partnerships with agencies and D2C founder circles

Customer support and success

* Onboard new customers: ad account connection, first launch, first insight within the first week
* Be the first line of support on chat, email and WhatsApp, and resolve or route issues fast
* Turn support tickets and feedback into clear, prioritised inputs for the tech team
* Track activation, usage and churn; run renewals and upgrades
* Build the help docs, FAQs and video guides so customers can self-serve

Who we're looking forMust have

* At least 1 year of hands-on performance marketing, ideally Meta Ads for D2C brands, at an agency or in-house
* You know ROAS, CPM, CTR, CPC, CVR and AOV cold, and can explain why a campaign is working or not
* Strong spoken and written English and Hindi; you can hold a room on a demo call and write a sharp cold email
* Analytical by default: comfortable in Excel or Google Sheets, pulling numbers and turning them into a story
* High ownership: you finish what you start without being chased

Good to have

* Any B2B or SaaS sales exposure, even informal (freelance clients, agency pitches)
* Experience with Google Ads, Shopify, or quick commerce ads
* A LinkedIn presence or content you have created and grown
* Familiarity with tools like HubSpot, Zoho, Notion, Canva or basic automation

You'll love this if

* You want to see how a SaaS company is built from the inside, not just one function of it
* You would rather own a number than a task list
* You see the founder's office as a fast track to leading growth, and you want that responsibility early

This is not for you if

* You need a fixed playbook and a large team before you can start
* You dislike talking to customers or picking up the phone

Your first 90 days

By

What success looks like

Day 30

Know the product inside out, speak to every active customer, set up the CRM and support process

Day 60

Run demos and close your first deals independently; AdsFlo's own Meta campaigns and LinkedIn calendar are live

Day 90

Own a monthly revenue and activation target, with a repeatable sales and onboarding playbook in place

What we offer

* Direct access to the founders and every growth decision
* Exposure to 50+ D2C brands through the Outwrk portfolio
* Fast-track path to leading AdsFlo's growth team as it scales
* CTC: ₹8 to 10 lakh per annum

territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise
  
  
Value (GMV) per month.

specific geographies assigned

internal stakeholders

correct and image coverage is high

to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.

and partners at the restaurants

Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance
  
  
metrics to the partner
  
  
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable
  
  
conversions and grow the business.

commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and

Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads
  
  
RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
  
  
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
  
  
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise
  
  
transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
  
  
knowledge of English
  
  
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing
  
  
channels
  
  
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
  
  
Effective communication skills
  
  
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
  
  
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
  
  
Analytical, good Excel skills.
  
  
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
  
  
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people
  
  
at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
  
  
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
  
  
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness
  
  
and success of campaigns.
  
  
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal
  
  
drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

title: Program Manager
description:
**Job Description – Program Manager**

K12 Technoservices Pvt. Ltd. | Orchids The International School

Location : Pune, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Coimbatore, Mumbai

**About K12 Technoservices Pvt. Ltd.**

K12 Technoservices Pvt. Ltd. is associated with Orchids The International School, an education organisation focused on delivering quality schooling and creating meaningful learning experiences for students.

Website:
www.orchidsinternationalschool.com

**Job Title: Program Manager – School Operations & Business Development**

**Role overview**

The Program Manager will be responsible for managing the overall operations, business development, admissions, and revenue growth of the assigned school branch. The role requires an individual who can effectively manage cross-functional teams, drive admission and revenue targets, execute field marketing initiatives, build strategic partnerships, and ensure smooth day-to-day school operations.

The position will act as a key link between the school branch, parents, employees, management, and central corporate teams to ensure operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and business growth.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Business development, admissions & revenue growth**

* Drive overall admission targets and revenue generation for the assigned school branch.
* Develop and execute strategies to increase student enrolment s and achieve business objectives.
* Monitor admission pipelines, conversion ratios, revenue performance, and collection targets.
* Identify new business opportunities and potential catchment areas for student admissions.
* Build and maintain relationships with parents, preschool partners, tutors, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Establish and manage preschool tie-ups and strategic partnerships to generate admission leads.
* Ensure timely collection of tuition fees, transport fees, fines, and other applicable charges.
* Monitor outstanding fee dues and ensure timely follow-up and collection.

**2. Field sales & team management**

* Lead, manage, and monitor a team of approximately 5-10 members responsible for field sales, counselling, and business development.
* Set individual and team targets, monitor performance, and ensure achievement of assigned goals.
* Guide, motivate, and develop team members to improve productivity and business outcomes.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and provide necessary coaching and support.
* Ensure effective coordination between field sales, counselling, admissions, and marketing teams.
* Participate in recruitment and selection of administrative and business development team members.

**3. Marketing, field activities & brand promotion**

* Analyse local marketing needs, market trends, and business opportunities.
* Develop and implement field marketing and business development plans.
* Plan and execute Below-the-Line (BTL) activities, promotional campaigns, events, and community engagement initiatives.
* Identify opportunities for school promotions and increase brand visibility within the assigned catchment area.
* Coordinate with internal marketing and corporate teams for campaign execution.
* Plan, organise, and host admission-related events and promotional activities.
* Evaluate campaign performance and submit reports on lead generation, conversions, and outcomes.

**4. School & branch operations**

* Ensure smooth day-to-day operations of the assigned school branch.
* Oversee administrative functions, campus maintenance, housekeeping, inventory, and vendor management.
* Ensure the school campus, playgrounds, courts, and other facilities are maintained appropriately.
* Monitor inward and outward movement of materials and maintain relevant records.
* Coordinate with Procurement, Logistics, Projects, Academics, Marketing, HR, and other corporate departments.
* Identify operational gaps and implement standardised processes to improve efficiency.
* Monitor branch-related operational reports and present updates to management.

**5. Parent relationship management & grievance resolution**

* Act as the primary point of contact for parents regarding non-academic matters.
* Ensure timely resolution of parent complaints and grievances.
* Monitor the complaint register and coordinate with the Front Office, Accounts, and Campus teams for closure.
* Build strong parent relationships and maintain a high level of service satisfaction.
* Handle escalations professionally and ensure effective communication with stakeholders.

**6. Staff administration & employee coordination**

* Monitor staff strength, attendance, and workforce requirements at the branch.
* Coordinate with HR for recruitment, attendance regularisation, salary processing, and employee-related matters.
* Ensure employee grievances are addressed and escalated to the appropriate departments.
* Maintain proper recruitment and employee-related records.
* Support training and development initiatives for branch operations and administrative teams.

**7. Transport & infrastructure management**

* Monitor daily school transport operations and ensure smooth functioning of the bus fleet.
* Ensure timely vehicle maintenance and proper functioning of GPS/GPRS tracking systems.
* Coordinate with transport vendors and ensure compliance with prescribed safety procedures.
* Ensure regular driver breathalyser testing as specified by company procedures.
* Monitor campus maintenance registers and ensure timely closure of maintenance issues.

**8. Finance, collections & vendor management**

* Monitor branch-level fee collections, outstanding dues, and revenue reports.
* Manage branch petty cash and ensure supporting documentation is maintained.
* Coordinate vendor payments and ensure timely submission of invoices and supporting documents.
* Monitor vendor performance and ensure adherence to agreed service standards.
* Coordinate with Finance and Accounts teams for financial and operational requirements.

**9. Management reporting & stakeholder coordination**

* Prepare and present regular reports on admissions, revenue, collections, marketing activities, and branch operations.
* Conduct periodic performance reviews and provide updates on business targets.
* Coordinate with management, trustees, parents, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
* Support quarterly reviews and ensure timely closure of assigned action points.
* Ensure effective communication and coordination across all business verticals.

**Desired candidate profile**

* Educational qualification
* Graduate in any discipline is required.
* Postgraduate qualification or MBA in Business Administration, Marketing, or Operations will be an added advantage.

**Experience**

* Experience in business development, field sales, school operations, admissions, or education-sector management.
* Hands-on experience in managing and driving field sales teams.
* Experience in handling revenue targets, admissions, marketing activities, and stakeholder relationships.
* Exposure to branch operations, vendor management, and administrative functions will be preferred.

**Skills and competencies**

* Strong leadership and team management capabilities.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong business acumen and revenue-driven mindset.
* Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and stakeholders.
* Excellent planning, execution, and problem-solving abilities.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret business and operational reports.
* Customer-centric approach with a focus on parent satisfaction.
* Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable working in a target-driven environment.
* Willingness to travel locally between branches and assigned locations.

**Key performance indicators (KPIs)**

* The performance of the Program Manager will be evaluated on:
* Achievement of admission and revenue targets.
* Fee collection efficiency and reduction in outstanding dues.
* Lead generation and admission conversion rates.
* Productivity and performance of the field sales team.
* Number and effectiveness of preschool and other strategic tie-ups.
* Execution and effectiveness of BTL marketing activities.
* Parent satisfaction and timely grievance resolution.
* Efficiency of school operations and campus maintenance.
* Vendor management and operational cost control.
* Timely reporting and coordination with corporate teams.

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager - Bangalore
description:
Who Are We?
  
  
RZR is an AI-native advertising platform built for the next era of performance marketing. We operate at the intersection of machine learning, programmatic media, and full-funnel mobile growth, powering campaigns for some of the world's most ambitious advertisers. Our platform is purpose-built to deliver outcomes at scale, not just impressions.
  
  
We are a team of builders, operators, and technologists who believe the advertising industry is overdue for a fundamental rethink. We move fast, operate with a high degree of ownership, and hold ourselves to an exceptionally high standard of craft.
  
  
RZR is scaling aggressively with an active M&A pipeline and a platform vision that puts us on a path to becoming an industry leader. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at an inflection point and help shape what it becomes.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
As RZR's first Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will build the product marketing function from the ground up. You will own positioning, messaging, sales enablement, and content marketing across RZR's platform — bringing a consistent, differentiated story to buyers across mobile gaming, performance advertising, and connected TV.
  
  
You will report directly to the Senior Director of Go-to-Market and Product Marketing and work closely with Product, Sales, and Brand. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role with direct accountability for commercial outcomes: sourced and influenced pipeline, sales readiness, and RZR's market positioning.
  
  
Your first major milestone is January SKO — you will own the agenda, revenue-enablement sessions, complete sales library, and certification kickoff. From there, you will operate on a quarterly cadence: aligning on three management-approved storylines, then executing the content strategy, campaign plan, and editorial calendar that bring them to market.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Positioning & Messaging
  
  

* Complete the positioning overhaul and roll it out across the website, sales decks, one-pagers, and case studies — adapted by priority ICP and region, with validated product claims.
* Own launch plans and product playbooks across RZR's offerings; adapt messaging for direct growth teams and agency buyers.

Sales Enablement
  
  

* Stand up and maintain a sales enablement library covering customer-facing proof, internal playbooks, competitive battlecards, and objection-handling guidance — with owners, version control, and review cycles.
* Build the sales certification program, SKO agenda, and enablement sessions; assess Sales during and after SKO and drive targeted coaching on identified gaps.

Content Marketing
  
  

* Co-develop three management-aligned quarterly storylines and translate them into a content strategy, campaign plan, and editorial calendar.
* Produce recurring webinars, blog articles, quarterly data reports, practical guides, case studies, and expert interviews.
* Coordinate email and social distribution with the Brand team through a shared content, PMM, and events calendar.

Measurement & Reporting
  
  

* Establish reporting on sourced and influenced opportunities and named-account engagement; agree definitions, attribution rules, and targets with revenue operations within your first 30 days.
* Report monthly on pipeline value, distinct influenced opportunities, and the share of named accounts engaging with content — keeping sourced and influenced cohorts separate.

title: NPD - Manager (Appliances)
description:
**Position Overview**

We are looking for an experienced
**Manager – New Product Development (Appliances)**
to lead the end-to-end development and launch of new home and kitchen appliance products. The ideal candidate must have strong hands-on experience in the appliances category, including product development, vendor/OEM management, product specifications, sampling, testing, costing, compliance, commercialization, and new product launches. The role will work closely with vendors and internal cross-functional teams to bring innovative, reliable, safe, and commercially viable appliance products to market.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Appliances Category Development:**
  Drive new product development specifically for home and kitchen appliances, with a strong understanding of product functionality, consumer use cases, category trends, and technical requirements.
* **Market Research & Consumer Insights:**
  Conduct market research, analyze customer feedback, ratings, reviews, complaints, and category trends to identify new product opportunities and improvements to existing products.
* **New Product Launch Management:**
  Own and coordinate end-to-end new product launches from concept identification and product specification through sampling, validation, commercialization, and market launch.
* **Product Specification Development:**
  Define detailed product specifications including wattage, voltage, capacity, material, motor or heating performance, safety features, accessories, functionality, and user requirements.
* **Competitive Benchmarking:**
  Benchmark competitor appliances across features, specifications, technology, performance, design, price points, customer ratings, reviews, and pain points to develop differentiated products.
* **Vendor / OEM / ODM Development:**
  Identify, evaluate, onboard, and manage domestic and international appliance manufacturers, OEMs, and ODM partners based on capability, quality, cost, capacity, compliance, and delivery performance.
* **Vendor Management & Coordination:**
  Maintain strong vendor relationships, follow up on development timelines, resolve technical and commercial issues, and ensure timely completion of samples, tooling, pilot production, and bulk production.
* **Sample Development & Validation:**
  Manage multiple sample iterations, coordinate testing, capture feedback, drive design and engineering corrections, and ensure final golden-sample approval before commercialization.
* **Technical Evaluation & Product Testing:**
  Work closely with QA and vendors to evaluate product performance, durability, electrical safety, usability, reliability, and functional consistency prior to launch.
* **Compliance & Certification:**
  Coordinate applicable regulatory and compliance requirements for electrical appliances, including BIS/ISI, product safety, testing, labeling, packaging, and other statutory requirements as relevant.
* **Costing & Commercial Negotiation:**
  Work with vendors on BOM understanding, target costing, tooling and mould costs, MOQ, lead time, payment terms, and commercial negotiations to achieve desired cost and margin targets.
* **Pilot & Mass Production Readiness:**
  Coordinate pilot batches, pre-production validation, manufacturing readiness, quality checkpoints, and smooth transition from development to mass production.
* **Quality & Reliability Improvement:**
  Analyze product failures, customer complaints, returns, warranty concerns, ratings, and reviews to identify root causes and implement corrective and preventive actions with vendors.
* **Return Reduction:**
  Develop product-level actions to reduce customer-initiated returns by addressing quality, functionality, usability, packaging, and expectation-related issues.
* **Packaging & Branding Coordination:**
  Collaborate with packaging, brand, and design teams to ensure appliance packaging protects the product, communicates specifications clearly, complies with labeling requirements, and optimizes cost and volumetric weight.
* **Innovation & Product Roadmap:**
  Identify emerging appliance technologies, features, consumer needs, and category opportunities to build a strong new product pipeline and long-term category roadmap.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:**
  Work closely with QA, Procurement, Packaging, Ecommerce, Marketing, Supply Chain, Customer Care, Finance, and other stakeholders to ensure successful product commercialization.
* **Project Management:**
  Manage multiple appliance development projects simultaneously with clear milestones, timelines, risk tracking, dependencies, stakeholder updates, and launch ownership.
* **Post-launch Performance Monitoring:**
  Track early-stage product performance, customer feedback, defects, reviews, service issues, and returns after launch and drive timely improvements wherever required.

**Mandatory Experience & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Electrical / Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Business Administration, Product Management, or a related field.
* Minimum 5–8 years of experience in New Product Development / Product Management, with mandatory hands-on experience in the Home / Kitchen Appliances category.
* Candidates must have worked on appliance products such as mixer grinders, blenders, choppers, induction cooktops, electric kettles, air fryers, rice cookers, OTGs, or similar electrical home appliances.
* Proven experience in handling end-to-end new product launch initiatives from concept / sourcing stage through commercialization and market launch.
* Strong experience in vendor, OEM, or ODM management, including vendor evaluation, development follow-up, negotiation, quality coordination, and production readiness.
* Good understanding of appliance specifications, product testing, electrical safety, regulatory requirements, quality parameters, and manufacturing processes.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, negotiation, and project-management skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment while maintaining strong attention to detail.

**Preferred Exposure**

* Experience working with consumer durable, D2C, ecommerce, kitchen appliance, or home appliance brands.
* Exposure to domestic and/or international supplier sourcing and product development.
* Experience in cost optimization, value engineering, tooling, mould development, and product improvement projects.
* Understanding of customer reviews, return data, and post-launch product performance as inputs for NPD decisions.

**About The Indus Valley**

The Indus Valley is a Chennai-based direct-to-consumer cookware and kitchen brand focused on health, safety, quality, and innovation. We are committed to developing products that improve everyday cooking experiences while maintaining strong standards of reliability, functionality, customer satisfaction, and responsible product development.
