description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are looking for an Applied Science Manager to build and lead Minerva's first Risk Science team in Bengaluru. This is a hands-on role: you will collaborate with scientists in the US to set the scientific bar and advance how we detect and respond to risk across KDP and Kindle Unlimited.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Hire, develop, and retain a high-performing team of applied scientists across levels, and set its practices for experimentation, evaluation, reviews, publishing, and patents.

  

* Push the quality of production risk models higher: set the standard for how model performance is measured, and lead the deep-dive science that turns model behavior into better detection.

  

* Develop new and improved detection models for fraud, abuse, copyright infringement, and harmful content, using NLP, computer vision, LLMs, and behavioral and graph-based modeling.

  

* Partner with engineering, product, policy, and investigation teams in the US and India to turn findings into fixes, and present options, risks, and tradeoffs to senior leaders.

  

* Work with the US science team to divide ownership clearly and share methods across Minerva.

  
About the team  
Kindle Direct Publishing (KDP) has empowered a new wave of self-motivated creators, tearing down barriers that once blocked writers from reaching readers. Minerva is the science and analytics organization for Amazon's Books business. We build systems for content understanding, author marketing and discovery, fraud and abuse prevention, and content risk, and we optimize manufacturing, fulfillment, and quality for Print On Demand (POD). We have mature areas and green-field opportunities, with engineering, business intelligence, and data engineering support across our areas. We are now building science teams in Bengaluru that work closely with our scientists in the US. Risk Science, a team within Minerva, keeps fraud, abuse, copyright infringement, and harmful content out of the Books catalog and programs such as Kindle Unlimited, using text, image, and behavioral data.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of scientists or machine learning engineers management experience
* PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application experience
* Excellent communication skills, capable of discussing technical details with a variety of audiences and influencing decision-making processes.
* Experience writing, reviewing, and testing production code in Python or a related language
* Experience shipping machine learning, NLP, or computer vision models to production and maintaining their quality after launch

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience leading teams in the areas of fraud detection, abuse prevention, and content risk management within a digital or e-commerce environment.
* Experience with model monitoring, data drift detection, calibration, or causal analysis of model behavior
* Experience with graph-based ML, behavioral modeling, or real-time detection
* Experience with LLMs, fine-tuning, embeddings, or multimodal models
* Experience building a new team, including hiring across several levels
* PhD in computer science, machine learning, statistics, or a related quantitative field, or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed venues (for example KDD, NeurIPS, ICML, ACL, CVPR) or patents
* Experience leading teams that build with AI coding agents, with guardrails such as tests, automated review, and verifiable done criteria

- Strong understanding of marketplace dashboards, catalogue management, promotions, and operational processes.

- Proficiency in MS Excel, data analysis, and business reporting.

- Strong communication, negotiation, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

- Ability to manage multiple marketplaces, prioritise tasks, and drive timely issue resolution.

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform supports millions of buyers and sellers across over 190 markets worldwide. We are looking for a **Data Scientist (Analytics)** to join our **Focus Category Analytics** team. Our team uses data to understand marketplace trends, improve customer experiences, and support growth across key eBay categories, including Collectibles, Luxury, Sneakers, Apparel, Parts and Accessories and Vehicles.

In this role, you will help teams make informed decisions by analyzing customer behavior, measuring business performance, and evaluating new ideas through experimentation. You will work with partners across Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Category Management to identify opportunities and recommend improvements.

You will also explore and implement **Agentic AI solutions** that make analytics more efficient and help teams access insights faster.

This role offers opportunities to take ownership of meaningful analytical projects, work with a variety of business partners, and see how your recommendations influence customer experiences and business outcomes.

* **Support category growth:** Analyze buyer and seller behavior, marketplace trends, and category performance to identify opportunities to improve engagement, conversion, retention, and GMV.

* **Collaborate across teams:** Partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Category Management to align analytical work with business priorities.
* **Share recommendations:** Present findings in a clear, practical way so teams can understand results, evaluate options, and take action.

------------------

* **7–10 years of experience** in data science, product analytics, business analytics, or a related field.
* Experience using **SQL and Python** to analyze large datasets, identify trends, and answer business questions.
* Experience managing **end-to-end experimentation**, including hypothesis development, experiment design, A/B testing, statistical analysis, result interpretation, and recommendations.
* Knowledge of **statistics, hypothesis testing, experimental design, and causal inference**, with the ability to select appropriate methods for different business questions.
* Hands-on experience **implementing Agentic AI solutions**, including AI agents or LLM-based workflows, to support analytics, automation, or business decision-making.
* Experience using analytical methods such as funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation, and performance measurement.
* Ability to translate complex data into clear findings and practical recommendations.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to understand business needs, solve problems, and support decisions.
* Communication skills that help technical and non-technical audiences understand analytical findings and their implications.

* Understanding of marketplace dynamics, including customer engagement, seller performance, pricing, and product selection.
* Familiarity with advanced experimentation methods and measuring the impact of business initiatives.
* Experience with Generative AI, LLM applications, AI agent frameworks, or workflow automation tools.
* Exposure to machine learning, personalization, recommendation systems, or predictive analytics.
* Interest in learning new analytical approaches and using technology to improve how teams work.

Blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager. **Business Unit**

BXTI – Finance & Operations Technology

**Business Description**

Blackstone Technology & Innovations (BXTi) is the technology team at the core of each of Blackstone’s businesses and new growth initiatives. Serving both internal and external clients, we work to build the next generation of systems that manage risk, create efficiency and improve transparency within the firm and across our broad community of investors and portfolio companies.

BXTi is nimble and entrepreneurial – our open, iterative design processes and rapid pace of development mean that everyone on the team has the opportunity to make an impact from day one. We are problem solvers who can take projects from idea to implementation. We believe in active mentoring and developing excellence. We collaborate to find the best answers for our customers and for Blackstone. We are critical to the firm maintaining its competitive edge.

**Job Title**

Senior Vice President – Program Manager

**Job Description**

Blackstone is seeking a best-in-class Senior Vice President, Program Manager to shape and lead technology-enabled initiatives across its Finance and Operations Technology portfolio. Based in Bangalore, this leader will define the long-term direction and own the delivery of complex, multi-year programs spanning corporate finance, procurement, treasury, and fund accounting platforms, partnering closely with Finance, Treasury, Fund Operations, and Technology leadership across global offices.

The ideal candidate pairs deep corporate finance technology expertise (for example Oracle, Coupa, treasury management, and fund calculation platforms) with strategic foresight, exceptional problem-solving skills, strong program leadership, and a hands-on technical mindset. This person will anticipate future business and technology needs, use AI and data thoughtfully to improve decisions and delivery, and set the standard for program leadership in Bangalore. The role requires equal comfort shaping a compelling long-term vision, presenting recommendations to executive steering committees, and driving disciplined sprint-level execution in a fast-paced, high-performance environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Lead end-to-end delivery of a portfolio of finance and operations technology programs, including general ledger, financial close, procure-to-pay, treasury and cash management, and fund calculation and allocation platforms.
* Own program strategy, target-state roadmaps, and multi-year delivery plans, anticipating future business capabilities and technology needs while translating objectives from the CFO organization, Controllers, Treasury, Tax, Procurement, and Fund Operations into clear priorities, requirements, and execution milestones.
* Drive large-scale implementations, upgrades, and integrations of enterprise platforms such as Oracle (Fusion/EBS), Coupa, treasury management systems (e.g. Kyriba, FIS Quantum, or ION), and fund accounting and waterfall engines.
* Establish and run program governance, including steering committees, executive status reporting, RAID management, budget and resource tracking, and benefits realization.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams across engineering, data, architecture, information security, finance operations, and third-party vendors and system integrators, across Bangalore, New York, and other global locations, leveraging tools such as JIRA, Sigma, and Excel for planning, tracking, and analysis.
* Serve as a trusted strategic partner to senior finance and technology leaders, structuring ambiguous problems, identifying root causes, developing practical options, and prioritizing investments based on long-term value, risk, scalability, and business impact.
* Manage vendor and system integrator relationships, including statements of work, delivery oversight, commercial tracking, and escalation.
* Define and track program success metrics (for example close-cycle time, straight-through processing rates, reconciliation breaks, and user adoption), using data and AI-enabled analysis where appropriate to surface insights, improve forecasting, strengthen decisions, and drive continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**

Blackstone seeks to hire individuals who work well in a team-driven working group, are highly motivated, intelligent, have sound judgment and have demonstrated excellence in prior endeavors.

  

* 15+ years of experience in financial services technology, with at least 8 years leading large, complex programs as a program manager, delivery lead, or senior technical project manager.
* Deep, hands-on experience delivering corporate finance technology, such as Oracle ERP (Fusion or EBS), Coupa, treasury management systems, and fund accounting, fund calculation, or waterfall and allocation platforms.
* Strong understanding of corporate finance and fund operations concepts, including general ledger, consolidation, financial close, accounts payable, cash management, fees, carried interest, capital calls and distributions, and investor allocations, and how they translate into data, systems, and processes.
* Proven track record delivering multi-workstream, cross-regional programs in a high-expectation environment, ideally at a top-tier asset manager, private equity firm, investment bank, or leading technology or consulting organization.
* Experience leading distributed teams and working across time zones, including partnering with US- and Europe-based stakeholders from an India delivery center.

* Demonstrated critical thinking beyond immediate delivery, define a credible long-term vision and roadmap, and connect near-term priorities to broader business, operating model, data, and technology outcomes while remaining close to execution.
* Exceptional problem solver who thrives in ambiguity, brings structure to complex and incomplete information, challenges assumptions constructively, and drives decisions and outcomes without heavy supervision.
* Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, to build clear, visually compelling executive materials; synthesize complex information into a concise narrative; facilitate decision-oriented discussions; and tailor messages for technical, business, and senior leadership audiences.

* High level of critical and systems thinking, intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and professionalism, to evaluate second-order impacts and make balanced recommendations aligned with Blackstone’s culture of and performance.
* Proficiency with JIRA (or similar tools) for backlog management, sprint planning, portfolio and program tracking, and status reporting.
* Solid understanding of finance system integration patterns, including ERP interfaces, bank connectivity (SWIFT, host-to-host, payment file formats), subledger and journal feeds, and master data management.
* Strong understanding of modern system architectures, including cloud-native and SaaS platforms, APIs, microservices, data pipelines, event-driven integrations, and enterprise application ecosystems.
* Experience partnering with technology teams on data model reviews, technical requirements, solution architecture, and end-to-end delivery across upstream and downstream platforms.
* Command of both Agile and waterfall delivery, including SDLC governance, DevOps concepts, release planning, testing coordination, environment management, and production implementation readiness.
* Hands-on, resourceful, and detail-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership over delivering outcomes rather than just managing processes.
* Forward-looking, curious, analytical, and intellectually rigorous, to connect market, business, data, and technology trends to a practical long-term strategy.
* Confident and credible with senior leaders, to present a clear point of view, communicate complex trade-offs simply, influence decisions, and navigate competing priorities with maturity and discretion.
* A leader who builds trust across geographies and develops talent within the Bangalore team.
* Strong alignment with Blackstone’s values, including ethical judgment teamwork, innovation, and long-term partnership with colleagues and investors.

title: Associate - Compliance and Ops Risk Test Senior Specialist
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

This role is instrumental in identifying and mitigating risk by assessing the control environment, identifying gaps, and supporting remediation. You will execute testing with precision and accountability, producing clear documentation that supports conclusions. You will collaborate with process and control owners and cross-functional teams to complete walkthroughs, gather evidence, and report results in a timely manner.

**Job summary:**

As an **Associate - Compliance and Operations Risk Test Senior Specialist** within the **Testing Center of Excellence** team, you will assess the control environment to identify gaps and support remediation to mitigate risk. You will execute testing with precision and accountability to deliver high-quality outcomes aligned to the firm's highest risks. You will apply analytical thinking and problem-solving skills to break down complex objectives into manageable tasks and activities. You will contribute to a cohesive and efficient testing framework through strong documentation, collaboration, and continuous improvement of testing methods.

**Job responsibilities:**

* **Understand** and evaluate the assigned function's control environment, with proven experience assessing the adequacy, effectiveness, and design of controls to ensure alignment with SOX, other regulatory frameworks, and the firm's risk priorities.
* **Execute** testing processes with precision and accountability to assess the control environment, identify gaps, and prepare robust documentation including process documents, process flows, and overview documents that support testing conclusions.
* **Collaborate** with process and control owners and cross-functional teams on the testing schedule; obtain walkthroughs of processes; document process changes; gather evidence; analyze potential issues; and facilitate timely reporting.
* **Partner** with control owners to support issue validation, action plan quality, and closure discipline, ensuring remediation aligns with risk acceptance and compliance expectations.
* **Lead** walkthroughs and other meetings with business owners, fostering collaboration across engagements with minimal oversight.
* **Read** and interpret policies, standards, and procedures to support accurate implementation of compliance requirements, and continuously improve control evaluation methodologies, including interpretation of control ratings and metrics.
* **Propose** and implement improvements to current testing methods, contributing to the efficiency and effectiveness of risk management.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:**

* Bachelor's degree in business, finance, or a related field, or equivalent work experience; **minimum of 4 years** of experience in controls testing, audit, or operational risk management within a risk and control environment.
* Domain knowledge of banking products and the ability to interpret financial statements; experience across one or more of the following: product control, balance sheet substantiation, month-end close processes (journal entries, accruals, financial close procedures), treasury (liquidity management, capital management, Basel capital, securities operations, front and middle office operations, asset liability management), reconciliation processes (account reconciliation, position matching, break resolution), valuation controls (independent price verification, fair value adjustments), regulatory reporting, financial reporting (daily financial reporting, external disclosures, off-balance-sheet review), and control testing (SOX testing, risk assessments, key control reviews, issue identification, remediation tracking).
* Demonstrated proficiency in advanced analytical thinking and problem-solving, including analyzing large data sets to identify exceptions or patterns and evaluating key information.
* Proven ability to build strong partnerships with key stakeholders and collaborate with business and functional experts to recognize risks and gaps.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to remain flexible and productive through shifting priorities and deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence business leaders in a meaningful and actionable manner.
* Demonstrated expertise in **Microsoft Office** applications, with advanced skills in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:**

* Professional qualifications such as **Chartered Accountant (CA), Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Master of Business Administration (MBA) in Finance, or Certified Internal Auditor (CIA)**.
* Audit and control testing background and experience.
* Comfortable using intelligent solutions such as Alteryx and Tableau to support testing activities or metrics reporting.
* Ability to innovate, challenge the status quo, and identify automation opportunities.

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**  
  
  

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

  

Control Management maintains a strong and consistent control environment through a joint accountability model that aligns managers with each function and region to mitigate operational risk. The team focuses on four areas: Control Design & Expertise, Risks & Controls Identification/Assessment, Issues & Control Deficiencies and Control Governance & Reporting.

title: Customer Experience Associate EN - Ecommerce
description:

From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, o**ur tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition.** We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection.

As a **certified B Corp**, we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance.

Today, more than **500,000 businesses** across **180 countries**—from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our **reliable technology** and **75+ integrations** help them create **unparalleled customer experiences,** without the usual tech headaches.

In 2024, we reached **€179M ARR** with nearly **1,000 team members** worldwide. And we’re just getting started!

Brevo is one of the world’s leading CRM and marketing platforms, helping businesses build strong customer relationships through connected, omnichannel experiences.

Within Brevo, our **Ecommerce Business Unit** powers targeted marketing, customer engagement, and revenue growth for over 50,000 merchants globally, primarily across the US and Europe. Our technology is trusted by leading international brands, including **Levi’s, Louis Vuitton, Tissot, Chanel, and L’Occitane**, to drive seamless merchant and shopper interactions across the entire customer journey.

**The Role:**

  

You’ll be the front line of Brevo’s customer experience for our Live chat or email ticket support. Customers will rely on you to resolve their questions quickly, accurately, and with care, so every conversation leaves them feeling heard and supported.  
  
Alongside real-time troubleshooting, you will play a pivotal role in customer success by helping new merchants through a seamless onboarding and migration process from other ESPs. Your day-to-day will be a balance between fast-paced reactive support and proactive enablement: leading customer trainings, developing clear SOPs, and mastering the platform inside and out to spot growth opportunities and generate qualified leads.  
  
You will act as a critical bridge between our merchants and internal teams, translating daily user feedback into actionable insights for Product and Development. This is a role for an autonomous, problem-solving self-starter who thrives in a remote startup environment, takes pride in driving customer satisfaction, and wants to grow alongside a fast-moving e-commerce platform.

### **Your impact at Brevo:**

* **Live Chat Support:** Deliver real-time, exceptional support via live chat, swiftly resolving issues so merchants feel heard and supported.
* **Customer Onboarding & Training:** Guide new merchants through setup and migration, leading engaging sessions and onboarding sessions so they know exactly what to do next.
* **Product Mastery:** Become a Brevo guru, developing deep functional & industry expertise to solve both straightforward inquiries and complex edge cases.
* **Process & SOP Documentation:** Create, update, and refine internal standard operating procedures and self-serve documentation to share knowledge across the team.
* **Product Feedback Loop:** Champion the customer voice by capturing user insights and partnering with Product and Engineering to improve the platform.
* **Night Shift Coverage:** Open to working the night shift to provide reliable, responsive coverage for our global merchant base.

### **Who you are:**

* **Relevant Experience:** 3+ years of proven track record in a customer support, onboarding, or implementation role, ideally within SaaS, e-commerce, or the Shopify ecosystem.
* **Clear Communication:** Excellent written English with the ability to explain complex technical concepts simply, warmly, and concisely.
* **Ownership & Attitude:** A proactive, user-first mindset focused on making merchants successful rather than just closing tickets.
* **Technical Aptitude & Curiosity:** Eagerness to learn the technical nuances of Brevo, Shopify, and e-commerce mechanics, backed by strong problem-solving skills.
* **Autonomy & Organisation:** Self-motivated and comfortable working remotely, managing time effectively, and documenting solutions as you learn.
* **Bonus Points:** Prior experience with platforms like Intercom or Zendesk, working remotely in a fast-paced startup, or managing difficult customer interactions with poise

If you don’t meet all the requirements below but believe this opportunity matches your expectations and experience, we still encourage you to apply!

### **Why people love working at Brevo:**

* **A place to grow, together:** Join a diverse, international team in a modern office buzzing with energy and ideas.
* **Practical perks for everyday balance:** Cab Facility and per-day meal vouchers; Employee-friendly salary structure; 1.4x pay on holidays/weekends for critical work; excellent referral program with high-value gift options (e.g., bike, flight tickets)
* **Learning, every step of the way:** Over 1,55,000 courses on Udemy, along with facilitator-led sessions and personalised training programs tailored to individual and team needs
* **Flexible for life:** A hybrid setup (2 days WFH), budget for your home workspace, and a generous leave policy to help you balance life and work effortlessly
* **Wellbeing that works:** INR 10 Lakh medical insurance, maternity support, childcare facilities, and wellness bonuses to keep you and your family covered
* **A culture that cares:** Annual company off-sites, inter-office trips, team outings, active social, green, and LGBTQIA+ communities, along with festive celebrations - all making Brevo a vibrant and inclusive workplace.

### **Your candidate journey:**

* HR Screening: 30 mins
* Take-Home Case Study: 48 hours
* Team Interview: In-office- 60 Mins
* Hiring Manager Interview: Virtual 60 mins
* Cultural Fitment with HOD: Virtual 30 mins

Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, if this role speaks to you, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Director, Product Management - Platforms
description:
**Description**
At Gigamon, our purpose is to protect the hybrid networks and data of the largest, most complex organizations on the planet. Certified as a Great Place to Work, we offer a deep observability pipeline that efficiently delivers network-derived intelligence to cloud, security, and observability tools. This helps our customers to eliminate security blind spots, optimize network traffic, and dramatically reduce tool cost and complexity, enabling them to better secure and manage their hybrid cloud infrastructure. Gigamon has served more than 4,000 customers worldwide, including over 80 percent of Fortune 100 enterprises, 9 of the 10 largest mobile network providers, and hundreds of governments and educational organizations.
  
  
Gigamon is seeking a Director, Product Management for it's core platforms, to play a vital role in our product line management team focused on the software that runs on all of the hardware platforms. The person in this role will be working as part of a team in this domain, with the responsibility to drive, manage and enable product success from ‘vision’ to ‘bookings’. The right candidate will be a strategic team player with demonstrated excellence in understanding market and customer needs, collaborating with other stakeholders to develop product strategy and translate that strategy into world-class products.
  
  
The ideal candidate would have an excellent understanding of networking, competitive analysis and is obsessed with starting from the customer problems and working backward.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Product strategy: Define the vision and roadmap for the hardware and system software product, considering market trends, customer needs, and competitor analysis to identify potential features and functionalities.
* Product development and team work: Collaborate with engineering to develop, and implement new features, enhance existing ones, prioritize key fixes, and ensure the product meets performance and scalability requirements.

* Voice of the customer: Meet regularly with customers and partners to evangelize the vision, strategy, and roadmap, and collect feedback both on existing products and features but also building an understanding of where customers are going next, with a focus on the "why".
* Technical expertise: Visibility platforms require a strong understanding of both hardware architectures and network protocols. Bringing a strong understanding of networking will be key to working well with both customers and engineering.

**What You'll Bring**

* At least 7+ years of Product Management experience.
* 20+ years overall experience.
* Previous experience working with operating systems, platforms, system architecture, or related technologies.
* Well rounded Product Management skills, from working with customers to understand pain points, translating these into well written requirements, articulating the needs both at a technical and business level.
* Prior experience driving requirements, from initial writing, to discussions with engineering, to delivery in a release.

The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $115 billion in investment capital as of September 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are seeking an enthusiastic, analytical, and resourceful product manager to join our Investment Services Technology team, partnering closely with the Compliance team, based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram. This position offers the opportunity for broad exposure to the firm’s trading, operations, and software development groups, as well as the chance to manage real-time issues related to the firm’s expanding suite of global investment products in a dynamic, constantly evolving regulatory environment. The role offers an inclusive and dynamic environment, with a focus on improving technology for efficiency, control, and scalability. The ideal candidate will bring exceptional product management fundamentals, experience in process optimization and workflow automation, and the judgment to operate effectively in a highly regulated and confidential environment with diverse stakeholders.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
You will drive technological solutions that support critical compliance functions across the firm, collaborating with cross-functional teams — engineering, design, business, and other front- and back-office partners — to develop and launch new products and features. You will develop and maintain a strategic product roadmap that aligns with the firm's overall goals and evolves continuously based on user feedback, prioritization, and other factors while working with senior leadership in Compliance. You will also partner closely with the business to understand their needs, define product requirements, scope open-ended projects, and conceptualize effective solutions across a broad range of functional areas, including pre-trade compliance and trade-restriction management, position-limit monitoring, trade surveillance, and regulatory and transaction reporting. Additionally, you will conduct technical design and architecture reviews to ensure alignment with the roadmap and end-user needs and partner with engineering to address technical challenges and deliver on time and to specification. You will evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, replace legacy and vendor systems with scalable in-house platforms, and develop AI- and data-enabled tools for monitoring, detection, and reporting — balancing near-term regulatory and operational needs against long-term strategic and architectural objectives, often building scalable infrastructure in areas with limited existing technology while serving as a senior point of coordination for compliance technology transformation. Furthermore, you will monitor product usage and feedback to identify areas for improvement and address technical debt in a timely manner, maintain product documentation (requirements documents, user guides, and more), conduct training and enablement as a subject-matter expert for the product suite, and manage product launches and backlogs — prioritizing features and enhancements based on end-user feedback and business needs.
  
  
**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, a related field, or an MBA, with 8+ years of product management experience, preferably within the financial services or investment management industry
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical and operational concepts clearly, influence decision-making through both meetings and written artifacts, and engage effectively with diverse stakeholder groups
* Excellent analytical and data-driven decision-making capabilities, with proficiency in data analysis tools and techniques to generate product insights, prioritize initiatives, measure outcomes, and guide product strategy
* Proven adaptability in managing changing priorities, with robust project and delivery management skills in dynamic environments
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, operations, and business teams, translating nontechnical needs into clear requirements while balancing competing stakeholder priorities, building consensus, and delivering customer-focused outcomes
* A high degree of attention to detail and structured problem-solving abilities, with a consistent focus on quality, risk awareness, and operational excellence
* Hands-on experience owning and delivering technology products end-to-end in Agile environments, from product vision and discovery through backlog management, iterative delivery, launch, scaling, and ongoing maturation
* Demonstrated expertise in workflow automation and process optimization, applying structured approaches and tools to improve efficiency, transparency, and control
* A solid understanding of operational workflows within hedge funds and investment management firms, including how controls, data integrity, and regulatory considerations shape technology and product design

Preferred qualifications:
  
  

* Exposure to the investment management or hedge fund domain, with familiarity with pre-trade compliance, trade restrictions, position limits, trade surveillance, or regulatory and transaction reporting
* Experience partnering closely with Compliance, Legal, Risk, or other control functions to define requirements and deliver workflow-driven, compliant technology solutions

The role reports to the Director, Customer Knowledge and Measurement India Hub, and works as part of the US and International Intelligent Personal Engagement team.

title: Associate Director, Measurement Activation Planning and Strategy
description:
****Job Description****
**Associate Director – Integrated Measurement (MAPS)**
**Measurement, Activation, Planning & Strategy (MAPS) Product Line | DHH India Hub Delivery**
**Reports to**
Director – Customer Knowledge and Measurement, DHH India Hub Delivery
  
  
**Location**
Hyderabad, India;
  
  
international and domestic travel as required by business
  
  
**Capability scope**
Integrated measurement, measurement and planning, product build, activation enablement, and AI-enabled planning and measurement across brands and markets KPI and measurement frameworks, marketing mix modeling, multi-touch attribution, incrementality and test-and-learn, campaign and content performance, investment and ROI optimization, insight-to-planning feedback loops, and AI-enabled measurement across the One marketing framework journey
  
  
**Leadership scope**
Lead measurement science, analytics, insights, and product build teams (product owners, data scientists, AI and data engineers); partner with MAPS Customer Insight, Planning, and Activation capabilities; orchestrate pods across Brand, Commercial, Finance, Data Science/AI, Technology, Content, and Market partners
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
Lead the Integrated Measurement capability within the Measurement, Activation, Planning & Strategy (MAPS) , turning performance evidence into decisions that improve brand planning, customer activation and effectiveness, investment allocation, performance measurement and future growth across brands and markets.
  
  
**Job Description**
This role sits within the Customer Knowledge and Measurement capabilities vertical of Digital Human Health (DHH), India Hub Delivery. MAPS connects customer insight, planning, activation, and measurement to improve decision-making and business performance across brands and markets. The Associate Director, Integrated Measurement-MAPS will own the measurement backbone of MAPS, ensuring every plan has clear success metrics, every activation is measured consistently, and every insight feeds back into optimization and investment decisions.
  
  
The role brings together KPI and measurement frameworks across customer identification, marketing mix and attribution modeling, incrementality testing, campaign and content performance analytics, and investment and ROI optimization into a single, integrated view of performance. Beyond analytics, the role owns the build of scalable measurement and planning products, such as ROI simulators, budget optimizers, and performance intelligence tools, and embeds measurement into activation so that insights drive strategy and planning, targeting, omnichannel orchestration and optimization. A key mandate is to accelerate AI-enabled planning and measurement, including GenAI and agentic solutions for automated insight generation, scenario planning, and optimization, and to scale proven solutions across brands and markets.
  
  
The Associate Director will work closely with the MAPS Lead and the Customer Insight, Planning, and Activation capability leads, and partner with Brand Strategy, Customer Engagement, Finance, Data Science/AI, Commercial Technology, and market teams to close the loop between strategy and execution.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Define and lead the Integrated Measurement roadmap and India Hub delivery model within Customer Knowledge and measurement, aligned to MAPS product line priorities and to US and international brand and market needs.
* Establish a common measurement framework, including KPI hierarchy, definitions, data standards, and success criteria, that links brand strategy and planning objectives to activation and business outcomes.
* Lead advanced measurement solutions, planning and strategy, customer mapping, including marketing mix modeling, multi-touch attribution, incrementality and holdout testing, and closed-loop campaign and content measurement, with clear guidance on when to use each approach.
* Connect strategy and execution by ensuring performance insights directly inform brand planning, channel and content optimization, in-flight campaign adjustments, and resource allocation decisions.
* Activate capability to embed measurement into activation, including audience and segment targeting, next-best-action and trigger performance, omnichannel orchestration across CRM, email, web, media, and field channels, and closed-loop optimization of HCP and patient campaigns.
* Partner with Brand, Commercial, and Finance leaders to drive evidence-based investment decisions through ROI analysis, scenario planning, budget optimization, and identification of future growth opportunities.
* Run a structured test-and-learn agenda across brands and markets, capturing learnings in a reusable knowledge base that accelerates planning and activation for future campaigns.
* Accelerate AI-enabled planning and measurement by defining the AI roadmap for MAPS measurement, prioritizing use cases by business value, and applying AI/ML, GenAI, and agentic capabilities to automated performance monitoring, anomaly detection, forecasting, scenario planning, and optimization recommendations.
* Build and deploy AI solutions with Data Science/AI and Technology partners, such as conversational insight assistants, automated campaign performance readouts, AI-driven budget reallocation, and agentic planning and measurement workflows, with responsible-use guardrails, human-in-the-loop review, and value tracking.
* Scale measurement capabilities across brands and markets through reusable models, standardized dashboards, self-service tools, and playbooks that reduce cycle time and cost to serve.
* Own the product build of measurement and planning products, such as MMM and ROI simulators, budget and channel-mix optimizers, performance intelligence dashboards, and measurement data products, from discovery and MVP through release, adoption, and continuous improvement, using product management practices (vision, roadmap, backlog, user stories, and success metrics).
* Partner with Data Engineering, Commercial Technology, and AI platform teams on solution architecture, data pipelines, model operationalization (MLOps), and integration with planning and activation platforms, so that products are production-grade, reusable, and scalable across brands and markets.
* Ensure measurement rigor and trust through strong data quality, model validation, privacy and compliance controls, transparent assumptions, and consistent performance reporting across stakeholders.
* Establish governance and operating rhythms for prioritization, roadmap and backlog management, adoption, and value tracking, and report measurable business impact to MAPS and DHH leadership.
* Build and develop a high-performing team that combines measurement science, commercial understanding, consulting skills, product thinking, and stakeholder influence to deliver measurable impact.

Education Requirements
  
  
Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Statistics, Econometrics, Economics, Data Science, Decision Science, Marketing Science, Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Life Sciences, or a related discipline. Advanced degree such as MBA, MS, MPH, PharmD, or PhD preferred.
  
  
**Required Experience And Skills**

* 8+ years of experience in pharma/biotech commercial analytics, marketing science, measurement and ROI analytics, omnichannel analytics, data science, or related functions, with a strong track record in marketing and promotional measurement.
* 4+ years of people leadership experience, including coaching measurement/analytics teams and leading cross-functional pods in a global, matrixed environment.
* Deep expertise in measurement methodologies, including MMM, multi-touch attribution, incrementality/holdout testing, experimental design, causal inference, and forecasting.
* Proven experience translating measurement insights into planning, budget allocation, and optimization decisions, and influencing brand and investment choices with senior stakeholders.
* Demonstrated experience building and scaling analytics or AI products end to end, including product ownership, agile delivery, working with engineering teams, and driving user adoption and measurable value.
* Strong understanding of brand planning, customer engagement strategy, segmentation and targeting, omnichannel activation, and how measurement connects across the insight-to-plan-to-activate cycle.
* Hands-on exposure to activation, including omnichannel campaign execution, next-best-action and triggers, audience targeting, and in-flight optimization of HCP and patient engagement.
* Experience with customer and promotional data sources such as CRM activity, Rx, claims, media and spend data, web analytics, email engagement, content interaction, sales, market research, and syndicated data.
* Familiarity with modern data, analytics, and MarTech platforms such as Veeva, Salesforce, Adobe Experience Cloud, Power BI/Tableau, Databricks, AWS/GCP, Python/R, or similar platforms.
* Strong AI/ML and GenAI fluency, including practical experience with machine learning, LLMs, and agentic AI use cases, and a responsible-use mindset, with the ability to identify, build, and scale AI-enabled planning and measurement solutions that improve speed, accuracy, productivity, and decision quality.
* Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured solutions and communicate the so what/now what clearly through compelling data storytelling.

title: CoFounder - Content, Growth & Sales
description:
**About Entrext**

Entrext is a venture-building company focused on identifying real-world problems and building businesses through technology, experimentation, and business development.

**About Stage**

Stage is an early-stage SaaS venture being developed within Entrext, with the vision of growing into an independent company.

We’re building Stage as a
**communication layer between clients and the developers, designers, and product teams bringing their ideas to life.**

During a project, feedback often gets scattered across WhatsApp, emails, screenshots, and calls. As conversations grow, the original context gets lost. A simple change can lead to repeated follow-ups, misunderstandings, and unnecessary revision rounds.

Stage brings feedback closer to the actual work. Clients can point to the specific part of a webpage, design, app, or digital product they want changed and leave feedback in context. The person working on it can respond and keep the discussion connected to that specific change.

The goal is simple:
**less time clarifying feedback, less effort chasing conversations, and fewer unnecessary revisions caused by misunderstandings.**

Stage isn't another messaging tool. It's a way to keep communication connected to the work, from the first feedback to its resolution.

Website:
https://stage.entrext.com

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a
**Co-Founder to own Content, Growth & Sales from zero.**

You’ll help take Stage to market, find the right customers, build relationships, and turn an early-stage product into a business with real customers and repeatable growth.

There is no established playbook. You’ll help create it.

**What You’ll Own**

* **ICP & Go-to-Market:**

  Identify our ideal customers and figure out how to reach them.
* **Customer Acquisition:**

  Build our initial customer base among web development agencies, freelancers, designers, and product teams.
* **Content & Distribution:**

  Create content that connects with real customer problems and attracts the right audience.
* **Outbound & Partnerships:**

  Reach out to potential customers, build relationships, and explore relevant partnerships.
* **Sales & Conversion:**

  Talk to customers, demonstrate Stage, understand objections, and turn conversations into active users and paying customers.
* **Market Validation:**

  Test assumptions, gather feedback, and identify what customers actually need.
* **Growth Experiments:**

  Experiment with acquisition channels, messaging, and positioning until we find what works consistently.
* **Business Building:**

  Help shape Stage's direction and eventually build its growth and sales function.

**Who We’re Looking For**

Someone who enjoys building from zero and is comfortable figuring things out without waiting for instructions.

You should be willing to:

* Talk to customers and understand their problems.
* Build relationships and explore opportunities.
* Create content and handle outbound outreach.
* Sell, negotiate, and handle rejection.
* Test ideas, learn from failures, and adapt quickly.
* Take ownership of outcomes rather than just completing assigned tasks.

Experience in SaaS, B2B sales, startup growth, or agency business development is valuable. A perfect founder résumé isn't necessary. We care more about your ability to execute, learn, and build.

**What You Get**

**25% Equity | Co-Founder Role**

* Real ownership and responsibility in building Stage.
* The opportunity to shape its growth, sales, and business strategy from the beginning.
* Direct collaboration with Entrext's product, technology, and venture-building ecosystem.
* The opportunity to help develop Stage into an independent company.

Stage is currently being developed within Entrext, with the intention of establishing it as a separate venture as it grows. The proposed equity will relate to the future independent Stage company, subject to the agreed legal structure and formal documentation.

This is an
**equity-only opportunity**

, with no guaranteed salary. Equity terms, vesting, founder responsibilities, and the future company structure will be discussed transparently with the selected candidate.

This isn't a conventional growth job. It's an opportunity to help build a company.

**Interested?**

If you enjoy solving real problems, talking to customers, finding opportunities, and building something from the ground up, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Senior Business Development Manager
description:
ProArch is seeking an experienced, revenue-driven Inside Sales & Business Development leader to drive global pipeline generation, enterprise prospecting, GTM execution, and business growth across North America markets.
  
  
The ideal candidate will combine strategic sales planning with hands-on execution, leading inside sales resources, developing targeted go-to-market programs, engaging enterprise stakeholders, and supporting opportunities through qualification, solution positioning, commercial negotiations, and deal closure.
  
  
The role will work closely with Marketing, Account Executives, Solution Architects, Delivery teams, and technology partners such as Microsoft to accelerate pipeline growth and improve sales conversion across ProArch's Cloud, Data & AI, Cybersecurity, and Digital Transformation offerings.
  
  
**Requirements**

* Global Inside Sales & Business Development
* Drive inside sales and business development initiatives across North America, markets
* Develop territory plans, account penetration strategies, target account lists, and enterprise prospecting programs
* Identify new business opportunities across Microsoft Cloud, Azure, Fabric , Data & AI, Cybersecurity, and Digital Transformation services
* Build relationships with business leaders, technology executives, and C-level stakeholders to identify business challenges and transformation opportunities
* Drive qualified pipeline creation, opportunity progression, account acquisition, and revenue contribution
* Go-to-Market Strategy & Demand Generation
* Develop and execute quarterly GTM strategies aligned with company offerings, revenue objectives, industry verticals, and market opportunities
* Partner with Marketing to plan and execute outbound campaigns, Account-Based Marketing (ABM), Contact-Based Marketing (CBM), and targeted demand-generation initiatives
* Develop compelling value propositions, industry-specific messaging, email sequences, call scripts, and multichannel prospecting plays
* Translate ProArch's technical capabilities into business-focused messaging that resonates with enterprise buyers
* Identify new market segments, buying triggers, technology trends, and cross-selling opportunities to improve campaign effectiveness
* SDR Leadership & Sales Enablement
* Lead, mentor, and coach SDRs, BDMs, and inside sales professionals to achieve pipeline and business development targets
* Establish sales development processes, operating cadences, productivity benchmarks, and performance management frameworks
* Build repeatable prospecting methodologies, qualification frameworks, objection-handling guides, and sales playbooks
* Train teams to engage enterprise buyers and position complex technology services through consultative selling
* Monitor individual and team performance, identify execution gaps, and implement corrective action plans to improve productivity and conversion
* Microsoft Ecosystem & Partner-Led GTM
* Develop co-sell strategies and campaigns around Azure, Microsoft 365, Data & AI, Security, and other relevant Microsoft technologies
* Identify opportunities to leverage partner relationships, customer transformation initiatives, and eligible funding programs to accelerate sales conversations
* Align outbound campaigns with Microsoft priorities, customer needs, and ProArch's service capabilities
* Pipeline Governance, Forecasting & Performance Management
* Own pipeline reviews, opportunity inspections, forecasting, CRM hygiene, and sales performance reporting
* Establish KPIs for prospecting activity, qualified opportunities, pipeline value, stage progression, conversion rates, and revenue contribution
* Review campaign performance and lead-to-opportunity conversion to improve targeting and sales effectiveness
* Provide leadership with regular visibility into pipeline health, forecast accuracy, deal risks, and growth opportunities
* Drive accountability through structured weekly reviews, monthly performance assessments, and quarterly business reviews
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Work closely with Marketing, Account Executives, Solution Architects, Delivery, and Customer Success teams to ensure alignment across the sales lifecycle
* Provide market feedback, buyer insights, competitive intelligence, and campaign performance inputs to refine GTM strategies
* Ensure effective handoffs between demand generation, sales qualification, opportunity management, and account teams
* Contribute to the development of scalable sales processes, enablement assets, and technology-driven sales operations

**Required Qualifications & Experience:**

* 8-15 years of experience in inside sales, business development, demand generation, enterprise sales, or technology services sales
* Proven experience leading inside sales or business development teams serving international markets, preferably North America
* Strong understanding of IT services and enterprise technology solutions, particularly Cloud, Azure, Data & AI, Cybersecurity, Microsoft technologies, or Digital Transformation
* Demonstrated success in building qualified sales pipelines, developing GTM strategies, and improving opportunity conversion
* Experience in ABM, outbound prospecting, enterprise account targeting, and consultative selling
* Experience working with CRM platforms and sales engagement tools, with strong forecasting and pipeline management capabilities
* Excellent communication, executive engagement, stakeholder management, and team leadership skills
* Experience with platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, or equivalent tools
* Exposure to AI-led sales enablement, sales automation, and data-driven demand generation
* Experience working with Microsoft or other major technology partner ecosystems

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)"**
Performance will be measured against agreed business objectives, including:
  
  

* Qualified pipeline generated and pipeline coverage against targets
* Number and value of sales-qualified opportunities created
* Lead-to-opportunity and opportunity-to-win conversion rates
* Pipeline progression, sales cycle effectiveness, and forecast accuracy
* New logo acquisition and strategic account penetration
* Revenue contribution and closed-won business, where applicable
* SDR/BDM productivity, target attainment, and team performance
* GTM campaign effectiveness and enterprise stakeholder engagement

description:

At Goldman Sachs, we connect people, capital and ideas to help solve problems for our clients. We are a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments and individuals.

**Who are we**

Goldman Sachs Engineers are innovators and problem-solvers, building solutions in risk management, big data, mobile and more. We look for creative collaborators who evolve, adapt to change and thrive in a fast-paced global environment. The Digital Client Experience teams in Asset Management provide clients with innovative and customer-centered financial products to drive transformative changes. We bring the best qualities of a technology player and combine that with the best attributes of a large bank. Our Digital teams comprise of three main businesses, underpinned by engineering, product operations, security and risk management:

* **Mosaic**, an end-to-end open architecture technology platform and a digital product that provides trading, settlement, analytics, and reporting solutions to global liquidity clients.

* **GSAM.com**: GSAM is the asset management arm of Goldman Sachs, which supervises more than $1.8 trillion in assets. Goldman Sachs Asset Management has been providing discretionary investment advisory services since 1988 and has investment professionals in all major financial centers around the world.

Our team of engineers builds solutions to the most complex problems. We develop cutting-edge digital platform and processes that form the core of our key business and enable several marketing and sales. We develop global web and mobile platform for Third Party Distribution and Institutional businesses. **Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**

  
  

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

With our focus on four therapeutic areas – Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lie within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

**What you will do**

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. This role sits at the intersection of data analytics, commercial operations, and field strategy, with a focus on enabling actionable insights and operational excellence.

This position reports to the Sr Manager, Field Effectiveness and will be responsible for the following

**Responsibilities -**

**Field Data Analysis & Insights**

* Extract, clean, and analyze large datasets from Veeva CRM, distribution partners (e.g., specialty pharmacies/wholesalers), claims data (e.g., Symphony, IQVIA), and internal patient services platforms.

* Conduct analysis of execution for Field Sales teams to assess reach, frequency, HCP engagement trends, and account targeting effectiveness.

**Operational Execution & Field Enablement**

* Execute and manage regular territory alignments, roster updates, and call-plan deployments across therapeutic areas, ensuring accuracy and alignment.

* Ensure operational delivery of tools used by the field—e.g., Veeva CRM, Next Best Action dashboards, digital companion tools, Alerts, and call plan refreshes.

**Sales Force Size/Structure & Deployment**

* Lead end-to-end size & structure, including new product launches, reorganizations, annual realignments and alignment cycles.
* Manage deployment planning to ensure optimal coverage of healthcare providers (HCPs), accounts, and geographies.
* Leverage internal resources in marketing, media, finance to design optimal and performance-driven territories.
* Partner with sales leadership to adjust alignments based on market dynamics and business priorities.
* Develop communication strategies for field force notifications, placement deliverables.

**Field Force Effectiveness**

* Develop and implement strategies to enhance field productivity, including call planning, coverage optimization, and targeting.
* Build KPI dashboards and performance reporting to track territory efficiency, sales team impact, and customer reach.
* Conduct periodic targeting audit, by providing insights into workload balance, call frequency, and engagement quality.

**Compliance, Quality, and Process Optimization**

* Ensure all analytics and reports adhere to promotional and non-promotional field engagement compliance requirements (e.g., Sunshine Act, sampling rules, HCP engagement limits).
* Document processes and assumptions used in analytics pipelines and reports to support internal audit readiness and training.
* Identify opportunities for automation and process refinement using SQL, Python, or ETL tools to reduce manual data handling and improve cycle times.

**Project Management, Issue Tracking and Status Reporting**

* Track, manage, and drive resolution of issues and action items using systems such as JIRA and ServiceNow; ensure timely closure with clear ownership and supporting documentation.
* Apply structured project management approaches to plan, monitor, and deliver cross-functional initiatives, ensuring alignment across stakeholders and timely risk mitigation.
* Maintain comprehensive project documentation including timelines, decision logs, issue trackers, and closure reports to support governance and knowledge transfer.

**What we expect of you**

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The Field Analytics & Operations professional we seek has these qualifications.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree & 10+ years of experience in sales analytics, sales operations, and/or field effectiveness
* Master’s degree & 8+ years of experience in sales analytics, sales operations, and/or field effectiveness

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Relevant Bio/Pharmaceutical industry experience
* Ability to write SQL queries and ability to do data analysis, data visualization and creating presentations.
* **Execution-Focused Delivery:** Own and execute day-to-day analytics tasks, reporting development, and field data operations with speed, accuracy, and minimal oversight.
* **Insight Generation:** Translate complex datasets into clear, actionable insights that inform territory strategy, account planning, and field engagement performance.
* **Technical Proficiency**: Knowledge of relevant software and technologies, such as sales planning and operations platforms (targeting, alignment and roster management, incentive compensation), sales CRM, and other field-specific tools, is important.
* **Critical Thinking:** Strong analytical skills to diagnose business issues and incorporate into development or adjustment of strategies, plans and tactics to achieve business objectives
* **Communication:** Effective communication is key, both in writing and verbally. This includes the ability to present data and findings clearly to stakeholders and team members. Ability to create training documents and communication deliverables based on projects/ needs.
* **Collaboration**: Collaborate with cross team and cross functional team partners to lead projects and operational activities.
* Oral, written and presentation skills to explain complex concepts and controversial findings clearly to a variety of audiences, including senior management
* Ability to identify areas for process and systems innovation and implement change that will enhance the overall effectiveness of the team
* Understanding of technology platforms and ability to partner with IS/IT and business leaders
* Good to have: Ability to create US based territories and maps using tools such as Javelin or similar tools

**What you can expect of us**

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers competitive and comprehensive Total Rewards Plans that are aligned with local industry standards.

Digital solutions for customer-facing teams and service channels: field engagement (face-to-face sales CRM), Veeva Sales Operations, sampling, event management, customer service, Field engagement and reporting, Field AI and associated AI capabilities, global and market deployment
  
  
Leadership scope
  
Lead product and delivery teams across Field, CRM, Veeva/Salesforce platforms, AI-enabled field workflows, operations, compliance reporting, and customer engagement execution
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
Lead the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of digital solutions supporting customer-facing teams and service channels across US and international markets, spanning field engagement, sales operations, sampling, event management, customer service, Patient CRM, transparency reporting, and associated AI capabilities, and evolve them into a connected, AI-enabled engagement ecosystem.
  
  
Job Description
  
  
This role sits within the Customer Knowledge and Measurement vertical of Digital Human Health (DHH), India Hub Delivery. The Associate Director, Intelligent Personal Engagement will lead the India Hub capability for the digital solutions that support our customer-facing teams and service channels across US and international markets. The role reports to the Director, Customer Knowledge and Measurement India Hub, and works as part of the US and International Intelligent Personal Engagement team.
  
The role is accountable for shaping and executing the strategy and roadmap for these solutions, and for delivering and continuously improving the platforms and workflows that power field engagement, sales operations, sampling, event management, customer service, Field CRM, transparency reporting, and associated AI capabilities, including Field AI.
  
The Associate Director will be a strategic delivery partner to the Intelligent Personal Engagement capability lead and to US and International market stakeholders, driving the evolution of these capabilities into a connected, AI-enabled ecosystem that enables more informed engagement, improves effectiveness across customer-facing teams, and delivers more consistent customer experiences, while remaining scalable, compliant, user-centered, and aligned to business outcomes across Human Health.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Shape and execute the strategy, roadmap, operating model, and delivery governance for Intelligent Personal Engagement capabilities across US and international markets, in partnership with the global capability lead and aligned with DHH priorities.
* Drive the evolution of field engagement, sales operations, customer service, event management, and transparency-reporting solutions from discrete platforms into a connected, AI-enabled ecosystem with integrated workflows, shared customer data, and reusable AI services across channels.
* Act as the accountable product owner for the Intelligent Personal Engagement product portfolio: define the product vision, own and prioritize the backlog, set release plans, and make value-based trade-offs across US and international market demand.
* Manage the end-to-end product lifecycle, from discovery and business case through MVP, scale-up, and retirement, with clear product OKRs, adoption targets, and value-realization tracking for each capability.
* Lead user-centered product discovery with field representatives, field managers, market operations, and customer service teams, using journey mapping, user research, and continuous feedback loops to ensure solutions address real engagement pain points.
* Govern demand intake and prioritization across markets, balancing global standardization with local market needs, and maintain transparent roadmaps and product communications with stakeholders.
* Own India Hub delivery for face-to-face sales and CRM capabilities, including field workflows, call planning, activity capture, customer interaction management, and field enablement.
* Lead Veeva-enabled Sales Operations capabilities, including business process support, release management, field operations enhancements, and user-adoption improvements.
* Drive delivery and continuous improvement of sampling, events management, customer service, Field CRM, Field AI, and transparency-reporting capabilities.
* Partner with Commercial, Market Operations, Sales, Medical/Legal/Regulatory, Privacy, Compliance, IT, Data/AI, and platform teams to translate market requirements into scalable products and implementation plans.
* Embed compliance-by-design across personal engagement workflows, including sampling controls, consent/privacy considerations, transparency reporting, CRM data quality, and appropriate use of AI-enabled recommendations.
* Establish clear capability KPIs, including field adoption, engagement quality, customer-facing team effectiveness, process efficiency, data quality, cycle-time improvement, consistency of customer experience across channels, and platform value realization.
* Lead cross-functional delivery pods and vendor partners to execute releases, resolve issues, manage risks, improve user experience, and scale best practices across markets.
* Champion Field AI and responsible GenAI use cases across customer-facing teams and service channels that enable more informed engagement, next-best engagement execution, coaching, summarization, and workflow productivity within compliance guardrails.
* Lead the end-to-end build of AI products for customer-facing teams, such as next-best-action suggestions, pre-call planning insights, call and interaction summarization, AI coaching assistants, customer service copilots, and agentic workflows, from use-case identification and feasibility through design, development, testing, and deployment.
* Partner with Data Science, Data Engineering, and platform teams to ensure AI-ready data, seamless integration of AI capabilities into Veeva/Salesforce CRM and service workflows, including monitoring for performance, accuracy, and drift.
* Apply responsible AI governance to every AI product, including human-in-the-loop design, guardrails, explainability, Medical/Legal/Regulatory and privacy review, and model risk controls appropriate for regulated customer engagement.
* Own AI activation and adoption across US and international markets, including launch planning, change management, field training, field champion networks, embedding AI into daily workflows, and capturing in-market feedback to drive sustained usage.
* Measure AI product value before and after launch, tracking adoption, usage, engagement quality, time saved, field productivity, and business impact (ROI and payback), and use these insights to iterate, scale, or retire AI capabilities.
* Develop talent and strengthen delivery excellence by coaching teams on product thinking, agile execution, stakeholder communication, operational rigor, and continuous learning.

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related discipline. Advanced degree such as MBA, MS, PharmD, MPH, or equivalent preferred.

title: Senior Manager - Business Development (South Zone)
description:
**Job Description – Business Development Manager (South Zone)**

**Luxury Furniture Manufacturing & Interior Solutions**

**Department**: Sales & Business Development  
**Designation**: Manager – Business Development (South Zone)  
**Location**: Hyderabad (Travel across assigned territories)  
**Reporting To**: Head – Sales & Business Development / Business Head  
**Experience**: 8–12 years  
**Industry Preference**: Luxury Furniture, Premium Interiors, Modular Furniture, Architecture & Interior Design

**Job Purpose:**

To lead and drive business development activities across the South Zone by building strong relationships with architects, interior designers, design consultants, developers, HNIs, corporate clients and project management companies.

The role will be responsible for expanding the company's market presence, generating high-value business opportunities, achieving regional sales targets, strengthening brand positioning and developing strategic partnerships within the luxury furniture and interior industry.

**2. Key Roles & Responsibilities (KRAs)**

**A. Regional Business Development & Revenue Growth**

* Develop and execute business development strategies for the South Zone.
* Drive regional revenue growth and achieve assigned monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.
* Identify new business opportunities across residential, commercial, hospitality and premium real estate segments.
* Develop and maintain a strong sales pipeline and ensure consistent lead conversion.
* Explore new markets, territories and business segments to expand the company's footprint.
* Prepare regional business forecasts, sales plans and revenue projections.

**B. Architect & Interior Designer Relationship Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with leading architects, interior designers, design consultants and architecture firms.
* Develop a structured architect management programme to strengthen professional relationships and generate business referrals.
* Conduct regular meetings, presentations and product demonstrations with architects and design firms.
* Organise networking events, product showcases, design presentations and studio visits.
* Ensure regular follow-ups on ongoing projects, specifications and upcoming business opportunities.
* Build long-term strategic associations with key influencers in the luxury design ecosystem.

**C. Project Acquisition & Key Account Management**

* Identify and secure high-value residential, commercial, hospitality and institutional projects.
* Develop relationships with builders, developers, PMC consultants, contractors and project stakeholders.
* Track upcoming projects from the initial design and specification stage through to order closure.
* Ensure the company's furniture collections and products are specified in relevant projects.
* Manage key accounts and ensure repeat business through strong relationship management.
* Drive upselling and cross-selling of premium furniture collections and customised solutions.

**D. Brand Promotion & Market Positioning**

* Strengthen the company's brand visibility and positioning in the South Indian luxury furniture market.
* Represent the organisation at architecture exhibitions, design events, industry forums and networking platforms.
* Coordinate with the marketing team for regional brand promotions, product launches and campaigns.
* Conduct product presentations highlighting design, craftsmanship, quality, materials and customisation capabilities.
* Gather competitor intelligence, market trends and customer preferences to support business strategy.

**E. Studio & Team Coordination**

* Work closely with studio designers, sales teams, product teams and project execution teams to ensure seamless business development.
* Coordinate with studio teams for client presentations, product selections, quotations and customised furniture requirements.
* Ensure timely submission of proposals, quotations and commercial offers.
* Facilitate smooth coordination between clients, architects, internal teams and project stakeholders.
* Monitor project progress and ensure timely resolution of customer concerns.

**F. Customer Experience & Relationship Management**

* Ensure a premium customer experience throughout the business development and sales cycle.
* Collect customer feedback, testimonials and architect feedback to improve service quality.
* Conduct periodic client meetings to understand requirements and identify additional business opportunities.
* Resolve escalations in coordination with internal departments.
* Build long-term customer relationships to generate referrals and repeat business.

**G. Team Leadership & Performance Management**

* Lead, guide and monitor the regional business development team.
* Set individual and regional sales targets and monitor performance.
* Conduct regular pipeline reviews, performance meetings and business review discussions.
* Coach team members on relationship management, negotiation, presentations and business closure.
* Ensure accountability, productivity and achievement of regional business objectives.

**H. MIS & Business Reporting**

* Maintain an updated regional business development MIS.
* Submit weekly and monthly reports covering:
* New leads generated.
* Architect and designer meetings.
* Project pipeline and potential business value.
* Quotations submitted and follow-ups.
* Order conversion and revenue achievement.
* Lost business and competitor analysis.
* Customer feedback and key account status.
* Provide monthly business forecasts and strategic market insights to management.

100% achievement

8–10 per month

**5. Required Skills & Competencies**
