title: Operations Manager (Restaurant)
description:
1. Role Overview

We are looking for a result-oriented and hands-on Operations Manager to oversee the day-to-day operations of our F&B outlet. The role involves ensuring seamless service delivery, maintaining operational standards, managing teams, controlling costs, enhancing guest experiences, and driving overall outlet performance.

The ideal candidate should possess strong leadership skills, a thorough understanding of restaurant operations, and the ability to balance service excellence with business profitability.

2. Key Responsibilities

**A. Outlet Operations & Service Management**

* Oversee the daily functioning of the outlet, ensuring smooth coordination between the kitchen, bar, service, and support teams.
* Ensure operational readiness before opening and proper closure procedures at the end of each shift.
* Monitor service standards, table turnover, order processing, food delivery timelines, and overall service efficiency.
* Ensure adherence to standard operating procedures (SOPs) across all operational areas.
* Conduct regular operational inspections to identify gaps and implement corrective actions.
* Manage peak-hour operations, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure adequate deployment of manpower.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure uninterrupted operations and timely resolution of operational issues.

**B. Team Management & Leadership**

* Lead, supervise, and motivate outlet teams across service, bar, kitchen coordination, and housekeeping.
* Prepare staff rosters and ensure optimal manpower deployment based on business requirements.
* Monitor employee attendance, punctuality, grooming, discipline, and productivity.
* Conduct daily briefings, communicate operational priorities, and ensure team alignment.
* Identify training needs and ensure employees are trained on service standards, product knowledge, upselling, and SOPs.
* Work closely with the HR team on recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and employee retention.
* Address employee grievances and maintain a productive and professional working environment.

**C. Revenue Generation & Business Performance**

* Monitor daily sales, revenue trends, average order value, average spend per guest, and other relevant business metrics.
* Drive revenue through effective upselling, cross-selling, menu knowledge, and service initiatives.
* Track outlet performance against budgets and business targets.
* Analyse sales trends, customer preferences, and peak business periods to improve operational planning.
* Coordinate with the marketing team to execute promotions, events, and customer engagement initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to improve profitability, increase customer retention, and maximise outlet utilisation.

**D. Cost Control & Inventory Management**

* Monitor food costs, beverage costs, staff costs, consumables, and other controllable operating expenses.
* Ensure effective inventory management across food, beverages, bar supplies, and operational consumables.
* Oversee stock receiving, storage, issuing, transfers, and periodic stock counts.
* Investigate inventory variances, wastage, pilferage, and unusual consumption patterns.
* Ensure adherence to portion control, recipe standards, and inventory handling procedures.
* Monitor purchase requirements and coordinate with procurement to ensure timely availability of stock.
* Maintain appropriate stock levels while minimising overstocking, expiry, and unnecessary purchases.
* Review operational expenses and implement cost-saving measures without compromising service quality.

**E. Guest Experience & Complaint Resolution**

* Ensure a consistent, high-quality guest experience throughout the customer journey.
* Monitor guest feedback, online reviews, service complaints, and recurring operational issues.
* Personally handle escalated guest complaints and ensure timely, appropriate resolution.
* Identify service improvement opportunities through guest feedback and operational observations.
* Ensure the outlet maintains appropriate ambience, cleanliness, music levels, lighting, and overall presentation.
* Build a service-oriented culture focused on customer satisfaction and repeat business.

**F. Compliance, Hygiene & Safety**

* Ensure compliance with applicable food safety, hygiene, sanitation, fire safety, and workplace safety requirements.
* Ensure adherence to applicable FSSAI requirements and other relevant statutory regulations.
* Maintain proper documentation, operational checklists, inspection records, and incident reports.
* Ensure regular cleaning, pest control, equipment maintenance, and preventive maintenance schedules.
* Monitor the safe handling and storage of food, beverages, and cleaning materials.
* Ensure responsible service of alcohol wherever applicable and compliance with relevant state excise regulations.
* Coordinate with relevant teams to address audit observations and close compliance gaps within defined timelines.

**G. Reporting & Operational Excellence**

* Prepare and review daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports.
* Track key performance indicators (KPIs), including sales, costs, productivity, guest satisfaction, and operational compliance.
* Conduct regular operational reviews to identify performance gaps and establish corrective action plans.
* Maintain accurate records relating to sales, inventory, wastage, attendance, incidents, and operational expenses.
* Develop, implement, and continuously improve SOPs, checklists, and reporting mechanisms.
* Coordinate with finance, HR, procurement, marketing, and maintenance teams to ensure effective outlet functioning.
* Provide regular business performance updates and recommendations to senior management.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Operations Manager will be evaluated against the following performance indicators:

* **Revenue Performance:** Achievement of outlet sales targets and budgeted revenue.
* **Cost Management:** Control of food cost, beverage cost, manpower cost, and other operating expenses.
* **Guest Satisfaction:** Customer feedback, complaint resolution, repeat visits, and online ratings.
* **Operational Efficiency:** Service timelines, table turnover, operational readiness, and adherence to SOPs.
* **Inventory Accuracy:** Stock variance, wastage, pilferage, and inventory reconciliation.
* **Team Productivity:** Staff attendance, manpower utilisation, training completion, and employee retention.
* **Compliance & Hygiene:** Audit scores, food safety compliance, and closure of operational observations.
* **Reporting Accuracy:** Timely submission of operational reports and completion of assigned action plans.

4. Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Hotel Management, Hospitality Management, or a related field preferred.
* 4–7 years of experience in F&B operations, restaurant management, pub operations, or hospitality.
* At least 2 years of experience in a supervisory or managerial role preferred.
* Experience managing high-volume restaurants, pubs, breweries, taprooms, or casual dining outlets will be an advantage.
* Strong understanding of restaurant operations, service management, inventory control, and cost management.
* Experience handling teams across multiple operational functions.
* Working knowledge of POS systems, inventory management systems, and MS Excel or Google Sheets.

5. Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong operational ownership and execution capabilities.
* Excellent team leadership and people management skills.
* Commercial awareness and understanding of outlet profitability.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage high-pressure situations and peak-hour operations.
* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Data-driven approach to operational reviews and performance improvement.
* Customer-centric mindset with a focus on service excellence.
* Ability to develop and implement structured processes and operational frameworks.

6. Key Expectations

The Operations Manager is expected to take complete ownership of the outlet's day-to-day functioning, ensure consistent service standards, build a capable and accountable team, maintain operational discipline, and contribute directly to business profitability.

The role requires a hands-on leader who can identify operational gaps, establish effective systems, monitor performance through measurable indicators, and consistently translate business objectives into execution on the floor.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Sr Strategy & Execution Leader BioTech (Lifesciences)
description:
**About Paramverse Bio**

Paramverse Bio Pvt. Ltd. is building India’s next great bio company, with a focus on biological agriculture. Founded in 2024 and part of Paramverse Group, it develops and sells indigenous microbial formulations under the DHARITRI SUTRA™ brand. The portfolio spans 21 registered products across three lines: RAKSHAK (bio-protection), POSHAK (bio-nutrition), and AMRITAM (export-grade compliance).

Every product is delivered through the “Doctor of Soil” model: a certified agronomist, a personalised prescription, and data to show whether it worked. Paramverse Bio is live across nine Indian states in Phase 1 (FY27), with 48 territories, institutional-grade manufacturing, and field-to-export traceability.

**What You Will Own**

Platform Strategy & Cross-Industry Planning

* Drive end-to-end execution of key strategic programs across Paramverse Bio’s seven target industries — not just agriculture.
* Support the CEO’s Office in scoping new B2B verticals (pharma CDMO, food-grade enzymes, bio-surfactants, cosmetic actives) — market sizing, competitor mapping, PE-framework evaluation, and go/no-go recommendations.
* Build and maintain the cross-industry opportunity pipeline: track where capital is flowing, which sectors are maturing, and where Paramverse’s shared platform creates a structural cost or speed advantage.
* Coordinate the translation of platform-level capabilities (fermentation, AI, manufacturing) into industry-specific revenue plans across B2B2C (Agri), B2B (Pharma + Industrial), and B2C (Consumer Brands) channels.

Go-to-Market & Commercial Execution

* Partner with sales leadership, state heads, and commercial teams to track performance, identify gaps, and drive corrective actions across the agricultural biologicals business (Dharitri Sutra).
* Support market expansion and distribution growth across existing and new geographies — building structured GTM playbooks, retailer onboarding frameworks, and territory-level P&L dashboards.
* Coordinate with regulatory, agronomy, and external partners to support product registrations, compliance, field trials, and market-readiness activities across both agri and non-agri portfolios.
* Track competitive intelligence across all target sectors — funded startups, policy shifts, regulatory changes, and M&A activity that affects Paramverse’s positioning.

Manufacturing, Technology & Data

* Work with the manufacturing and R&D teams to track greenfield plant milestones, capacity utilisation, and the seasonal production-swing strategy (agri in Kharif, industrial in off-season).
* Support the AI and computational biology initiatives — tracking research partnerships, model development milestones, and the data flywheel that connects fermentation batches to field outcomes.
* Help build the business case for each manufacturing phase expansion — marginal capex analysis, capacity-revenue mapping, and utilisation economics.

Operations, Reporting & Governance

* Build structured project plans, milestones, dashboards, and review mechanisms to track progress and drive accountability across all active programs.
* Prepare CEO-facing reviews, MIS dashboards, investor updates, and board-level business recommendations.
* Manage cross-functional collaboration with Finance, HR, Legal, IT, and external advisors to ensure smooth operations.
* Analyse business and program performance data to generate insights and support decision-making — from per-acre unit economics in agri to EBITDA modelling for B2B pilot batches.
* Identify operational bottlenecks, solve ambiguous business problems, and implement scalable processes as the organisation grows from a single-market operation to a multi-industry platform.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Engineering degree with strong academic credentials; MBA from a leading business school preferred.
* 4–10 years of experience in Program Management, Strategy, Business Operations, Management Consulting, or General Management roles — ideally in environments that span multiple industries or business lines.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities with a structured, first-principles approach to execution.
* Experience managing cross-functional stakeholders and driving outcomes without formal authority — across technical, commercial, and operational teams.
* High ownership mindset with the ability to thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous, and evolving environments where the playbook doesn’t exist yet.
* Ability to shift fluently between strategic thinking (market sizing, competitive positioning, capital planning) and hands-on execution (dashboards, vendor coordination, field visits).
* Strong written and verbal communication — you will prepare materials that go directly to the Founder, Governing Council, and investors.
* Intellectual curiosity about biology, fermentation, AI, and the broader bio-economy transition — you don’t need a science background, but you need to understand the platform at a technical level.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in Biotechnology, AgriTech, Pharmaceuticals, CDMO, Specialty Chemicals, Food Ingredients, or FMCG — any sector where biology meets manufacturing at scale.
* Exposure sales operations, commercial excellence, GTM strategy, or multi-geography market expansion.
* Experience working directly with founders, C-suite leadership, or in a CEO’s Office / Founder’s Office capacity at a high-growth company.
* Familiarity with regulatory processes (CIB, FCO, FSSAI, CDSCO), product validation programs, or field trial management.
* Comfort with financial modelling — unit economics, capacity utilisation, PE-framework evaluation, and investor-grade business plans.
* Exposure AI/ML workflows, data platforms, or computational biology — even at a non-technical level.

title: General Manager - Celviq Daily Skincare
description:
**About Celviq and the role**

Celviq Daily Skincare is an Indian D2C skincare startup selling primarily through its own website and online marketplaces. The company is scaling from a pilot team to a full organisation across 14 departments.

The GM / Business Head is the single point of accountability for the business. The role converts the founders' vision into an annual operating plan, then delivers revenue, margin and brand growth through the functional heads, agencies and supply partners.

**Role purpose**

•        Own the full business lifecycle: product concept, formulation, sourcing, manufacturing, launch, sale, delivery and repeat purchase.

•        Deliver the annual P&L: revenue, gross margin, contribution margin, EBITDA and cash.

•        Build Celviq into a trusted, compliant and digitally native skincare brand.

•        Build the leadership team, culture and governance needed to scale.

1. Key responsibilities

**1. Strategy, P&L and business planning**

•        Build the 3-year business plan and annual operating plan (AOP) with the founders and Board.

•        Own the P&L: revenue, COGS, gross margin, marketing spend, contribution margin, EBITDA and working capital.

•        Set quarterly targets for each function and run monthly business reviews against them.

•        Prepare Board decks and investor updates, and support fundraising with the Finance Head.

•        Decide channel mix, pricing, discounting and SKU portfolio based on unit economics.

**2. E-commerce and D2C growth**

•        Grow sales across the brand website, Amazon, Flipkart, Nykaa, Myntra, Purplle and quick-commerce (Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart).

•        Own marketplace performance: listings, content, ratings, Buy Box, ads (sponsored products, DSP) and account health.

•        Drive website conversion, average order value, repeat rate and customer lifetime value.

•        Manage performance marketing ROAS, customer acquisition cost (CAC) and payback period.

•        Oversee fulfilment, returns, COD/RTO control and customer service standards.

**3. Product, quality and R&D**

•        Approve the new product development roadmap with the QA/R&D Head.

•        Ensure formulations, testing (stability, safety, dermatological) and claims meet brand and regulatory standards.

•        Ensure compliance with the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, Cosmetics Rules 2020, BIS standards and Legal Metrology labelling.

•        Drive product quality metrics: complaint rate, batch rejection and recalls.

**4. Supply chain, procurement and manufacturing partners**

•        Oversee contract manufacturers, packaging and raw-material suppliers through the Procurement Head.

•        Negotiate key commercial terms, MOQs and payment terms for strategic vendors.

•        Own demand planning, inventory days, stock-outs and dead-stock levels.

•        Manage warehousing and 3PL logistics partners against cost and delivery SLAs.

**5. Brand and marketing**

•        Approve brand positioning, identity and communication with the Branding and Marketing Head.

•        Approve the annual marketing budget and its split across performance, influencer, content and offline.

•        Track brand health: share of search, social engagement, reviews and NPS.

**6. Functional leadership: Finance, Legal, IT, HR and Admin**

•        Finance and Accounts: monthly closing, MIS, budgets, cash flow, GST and statutory compliance, audits.

•        Legal: contracts, trademarks, IP, regulatory licences and dispute management.

•        IT: e-commerce stack (website, OMS, WMS, ERP, CRM), data and analytics, cybersecurity.

•        HR and Admin: manpower plan, hiring of key roles, performance management, culture, Labour Code compliance and facilities.

**7. Agencies, vendors and partners**

•        Appoint, brief and review creative, digital, PR, influencer and marketplace agencies.

•        Set agency KPIs and retainers, and run quarterly performance reviews.

•        Maintain a vendor governance process: onboarding, contracts, SLAs and periodic audits.

**8. Governance, risk and culture**

•        Set and enforce the delegation of authority, approval matrix and internal controls.

•        Identify and mitigate business, regulatory, financial and reputational risks.

•        Build a performance-driven, ethical and customer-first culture.

•        Act as the company's senior representative with investors, partners and regulators.

**Team and span of control**

The role leads 8 functional heads directly and manages external agencies, vendors and suppliers through them.

Direct report -What the GM holds them accountable for

QA / R&D Head -NPD pipeline, formulation quality, testing, regulatory approvals

Procurement Head -Vendor base, cost of materials, contract manufacturing, inventory

Branding and Marketing Head -Brand equity, performance marketing ROAS, CAC, agency output

E-commerce / Marketplace lead -Channel revenue, conversion, marketplace health, quick-commerce

IT Head E-commerce tech stack, systems uptime, data and analytics

HR and Admin Head -Manpower plan, hiring, performance, culture, compliance, facilities

Legal Head -Contracts, IP, licences, regulatory and dispute risk

Finance and Accounts Head -MIS, budgets, cash, taxation, audits, statutory compliance

**External partners managed:**
contract manufacturers, packaging and raw-material suppliers, 3PL and warehousing partners, marketplaces, creative and digital agencies, PR and influencer agencies, and technology vendors.

Open question: confirm whether E-commerce is a separate head or sits under Marketing.

**Qualifications, experience and competencies**

**Education**

•        Graduate in any discipline; MBA or PGDM from a reputed institute preferred.

•        A science, pharmacy or cosmetic technology background is an added advantage.

**Experience**

•        15+ years in consumer businesses, with 5+ years as GM, Business Head, BU Head or CEO with full P&L ownership.

•        Proven record scaling a D2C or e-commerce-led brand in beauty, personal care, skincare, FMCG or wellness.

•        Hands-on experience with marketplaces (Amazon, Flipkart, Nykaa) and quick-commerce.

•        Experience managing contract manufacturers and a multi-vendor supply chain.

•        Startup or high-growth experience; exposure to investor reporting or fundraising preferred.

**Knowledge**

•        E-commerce unit economics: CAC, LTV, ROAS, contribution margin, payback.

•        Indian cosmetics regulation, labelling and claims compliance.

•        Financial statements, budgeting and working-capital management.

•        E-commerce technology: Shopify or similar, OMS, WMS, ERP, analytics tools.

**Competencies**

•        Strategic thinking with strong execution discipline.

•        Data-driven decision making.

•        Leading and developing senior leaders across diverse functions.

•        Commercial negotiation with vendors, agencies and partners.

•        Consumer and brand sense in beauty and personal care.

•        Integrity, ownership and comfort with ambiguity.

•        Clear communication with the Board, investors and teams.

**Authority and first-year success**

**Decision rights**
(limits as per the Board-approved delegation of authority)

•        Approves functional budgets and spends within the AOP.

•        Hires, appraises and exits roles below the functional-head level; recommends functional-head appointments to the Board.

•        Appoints and terminates agencies and vendors within approved limits.

•        Approves pricing, promotions and SKU launches within margin guardrails.

•        Escalates to the Board: AOP changes, capex, fundraising, new entities and high-value contracts.

**What success looks like**

1.      
**First 90 days:**
assess every function, channel and vendor; fix the MIS and review cadence; present a 12-month business plan to the Board.

2.      
**By 6 months:**
leadership team complete; channel unit economics positive at contribution level; product launch calendar running on schedule.

3.      
**By 12 months:**
AOP revenue and margin delivered; scalable systems, processes and governance in place; a strong brand and team ready for the next growth stage.

KRA / KPI will be discussed accordingly post joining

title: Head of Business & Operation - D2C Fashion
description:
Head of Business & Operations

**Organisation:**
SheRox

**Industry:**
Women's Athleisure, Activewear & D2C Fashion

**Location:**
Mumbai preferred

**Experience:**
10–15 years

**Business Stage:**
Pre-launch

**Compensation:**
Commensurate with experience

**Career Growth:**
Potential progression into broader executive leadership, based on performance

About SheRox

SheRox is an emerging women's athleisure brand focused on creating comfortable, stylish and functional activewear for Indian women.

Our mission is to build a brand that combines global activewear aesthetics with Indian consumer preferences, offering quality products at accessible prices.

The brand is being developed for a growing market of women seeking fitness and lifestyle apparel that balances performance, comfort and everyday wearability.

As we prepare for launch, we are looking for an entrepreneurial business leader who can build the commercial and operational foundations of SheRox and lead its growth.

About the Role

We are looking for a
**Head of Business & Operations**
to take ownership of the commercial development, operational execution and business performance of SheRox.

The selected candidate will be responsible for building and scaling the business across product development coordination, sourcing, manufacturing, merchandising, distribution, e-commerce, financial management and team leadership.

This is a hands-on leadership position suited to someone who has previously built or scaled an apparel, activewear or D2C consumer business.

The ideal candidate should understand the complete product-to-market process, from fabric selection and manufacturing economics to customer acquisition, pricing, inventory management and profitability.

The role involves working closely with the founder, creative leadership and executive management to translate the business vision into an operationally efficient and commercially sustainable brand.

The position offers potential progression toward a CEO role over approximately 2–3 years, subject to demonstrated performance, business growth and leadership requirements. Such progression is not guaranteed.

Key Responsibilities1. Business Strategy and Leadership

* Develop and execute the overall business strategy for SheRox.
* Establish operational priorities, commercial targets and business growth plans.
* Translate the brand vision into measurable business objectives and execution plans.
* Lead business planning, budgeting and performance reviews.
* Identify market opportunities and build strategies for sustainable expansion.
* Work closely with the founder and executive leadership on key business decisions.

2. P&L and Financial Management

* Take ownership of business profitability and commercial performance.
* Prepare and manage operating budgets, revenue forecasts and financial plans.
* Monitor gross margins, contribution margins, operating expenses and working capital.
* Develop product pricing strategies based on costs, competition, target consumers and profitability.
* Track commercial performance across products, categories and sales channels.
* Identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency and overall business economics.

3. Product Strategy and Merchandising

* Develop product assortment and SKU strategies aligned with the brand's target customers.
* Work with the Creative & Product Design Head to build commercially viable activewear collections.
* Support decisions relating to product categories, pricing, fit, functionality and consumer demand.
* Oversee merchandising, product launches and seasonal collection planning.
* Analyse product performance, customer feedback and category profitability.
* Balance consumer demand, product availability, margins and inventory investment.

4. Sourcing, Manufacturing and Supply Chain

* Identify and manage manufacturing partners, sourcing vendors and suppliers.
* Oversee product development coordination, sampling, production planning and quality requirements.
* Understand and evaluate technical fabrics, garment construction, fitting challenges and product performance.
* Negotiate commercial terms, manufacturing costs, lead times and minimum order quantities (MOQs).
* Establish processes for quality assurance, production tracking and vendor performance.
* Manage supply chain risks and ensure timely product availability.

5. D2C, E-commerce and Sales Growth

* Develop and execute the brand's direct-to-consumer and e-commerce strategy.
* Oversee online sales performance, customer conversion and revenue growth.
* Collaborate with marketing teams on customer acquisition, retention and brand growth.
* Monitor customer acquisition costs, conversion rates, repeat purchases, return rates and channel profitability.
* Improve customer experience across ordering, delivery, returns and after-sales support.
* Evaluate opportunities across digital marketplaces, retail channels and other distribution models.

6. Inventory, Fulfilment and Operations

* Establish systems for demand planning, inventory management and replenishment.
* Monitor inventory turnover, stock availability, slow-moving products and working capital utilisation.
* Coordinate logistics, warehousing, fulfilment and returns management.
* Implement operational processes that support scalable business growth.
* Develop standard operating procedures and performance reporting systems.
* Ensure efficient coordination between sourcing, product development, sales and fulfilment.

7. Team Building and Cross-functional Leadership

* Build and lead a lean, high-performing business operations team.
* Identify staffing requirements and manage external specialists and service providers.
* Establish accountability, operating processes and performance measures.
* Coordinate closely with creative, product, manufacturing, finance and marketing teams.
* Manage vendors, commercial partners and service providers.
* Lead execution across functions while maintaining strong communication with the founder and executive leadership.

8. Brand Growth and Market Expansion

* Evaluate market opportunities across Indian consumer segments and geographic regions.
* Develop strategies for reaching customers in metropolitan and Tier 2/3 markets.
* Identify suitable partnerships and distribution opportunities.
* Use customer insights, market data and business performance to guide expansion.
* Support the development of a long-term commercial roadmap for the brand.

Mandatory Requirements

* **10–15 years of relevant professional experience**
  in apparel, activewear, sportswear, fashion retail or D2C consumer businesses.
* Demonstrated experience building, launching or scaling an apparel or athleisure business.
* Proven responsibility for business or category P&L, budgets, pricing, margins and commercial performance.
* Strong understanding of apparel sourcing, manufacturing, merchandising and supply chain operations.
* Practical knowledge of technical fabrics, garment fit, sampling and product development.
* Experience managing D2C or e-commerce operations and understanding customer acquisition economics.
* Ability to manage inventory, working capital, operating expenses and business profitability.
* Experience leading teams and coordinating multiple business functions.
* Strong commercial judgment and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to operate independently and take ownership in an early-stage, founder-led environment.

Preferred Qualifications and Skills

* MBA, postgraduate qualification in Fashion Management, Retail Management, Business Administration or a related discipline.
* Experience working with women's activewear, athleisure or sportswear brands.
* Previous experience launching a D2C brand or scaling a consumer business.
* Exposure to both online and offline retail distribution.
* Strong understanding of the Indian apparel market and consumer preferences.
* Experience managing manufacturing partners and product development teams.
* Strong financial modelling, analytical and reporting skills.
* Excellent negotiation, stakeholder management and communication abilities.
* Experience establishing operating systems and building teams from an early stage.

**Proven business execution, measurable outcomes and P&L ownership will be prioritised over educational pedigree alone.**

What We Expect

The successful candidate should be able to:

* Build the commercial and operational foundations of SheRox.
* Develop a realistic product launch and business growth roadmap.
* Establish a reliable sourcing and manufacturing network.
* Manage business profitability, inventory and working capital.
* Develop commercially viable product and channel strategies.
* Build and lead a team capable of supporting business expansion.
* Demonstrate the leadership potential required to scale the brand over time.

title: Concept Research & Insights Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Fifth Studio is a dynamic production house that works across television, OTT platforms, microdramas, and films. The studio focuses on developing compelling, audience-focused concepts and stories that can successfully move from idea to screen. By combining creative vision with solid commercial thinking, Fifth Studio aims to make creative meet capital in a sustainable way. Team members collaborate with writers, directors, producers, and partners to build content that is both artistically strong and market-ready.

**Role Description**
The Concept Research & Insights Manager is a part-time, hybrid role based in Mumbai, with flexibility for some work from home. This role is responsible for researching audience trends, market data, and cultural insights to inform the development of concepts across TV, OTT, microdrama, and film. Day-to-day work includes scanning content landscapes, analyzing performance data, synthesizing viewer feedback, and preparing clear insight reports and decks for creative and production teams. The manager collaborates closely with writers, showrunners, and producers to test concept viability, refine pitches, and identify new opportunities for formats and narratives. The role also involves maintaining insight repositories, supporting brainstorming sessions with evidence-backed inputs, and recommending measurable ways to validate creative ideas before greenlighting.

**Qualifications**

* Strong research and analytical skills, including the ability to gather, interpret, and synthesize qualitative and quantitative data into actionable insights.
* Experience in content or media strategy, such as evaluating concepts, understanding audience segments, and tracking trends across TV, OTT, and digital formats.
* Background in storytelling or creative development, with the ability to translate insights into narrative directions and support pitch documentation.
* Proficiency with presentation and collaboration tools (e.g., PowerPoint/Keynote, Google Workspace, spreadsheets) and comfort working in a hybrid environment.
* Relevant experience in entertainment, media, or market research; a degree in Media Studies, Communications, Marketing, Psychology, or a related field is preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work with multidisciplinary teams in a fast-paced, project-based setting.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, prioritize multiple projects, and maintain confidentiality around concepts and strategic information.

title: Senior Manager - Automotive & Mobility
description:
**About us:**

1Lattice™ is a 360-degree business decision support partner with a tech-enabled services stack of data, people network, and custom research. Powered by advanced tech tools and unique data-gathering approaches, 1Lattice is an integrated product suite to make decisions smartly, right from Inputs to Validation to Execution to Measurement. 1Lattice works with clients and partners globally, helping clients solving a wide variety of organizational and business challenges through actionable research-led insights.

**Location:** Gurugram/Mumbai

**About the role:**

As a Senior Manager (SM) you will have four key responsibilities: (1) Driving account growth and supporting business development activities, (2) Client management, (3) Ensuring project delivery, and (4) Team management.

1. The foremost responsibility of this role is to drive account growth, client retention, and project profitability. You will be expected to seamlessly own and nurture existing client accounts for repeat and continued business, identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities within existing accounts, and ensure sustained client engagement. In addition, you will support the Director in business development activities, including proposal development, solutioning, and other pre-sales initiatives. Apart from ensuring account continuity and growth, you will also be responsible for the profitability of your projects by effectively managing direct and indirect costs. You will further contribute towards the development and enhancement of product offerings and capabilities within 1Lattice.

2. This role will be expected to develop close connections and relationships with senior leaders across the **Automotive & Mobility sector, including automotive OEMs, auto components, electric vehicles (EVs), aftermarket, commercial vehicles, passenger vehicles, two-wheelers, and related automotive segments.**This will require playing a significant role in influencing client thinking, identifying opportunities for account expansion, supporting proposal development, and assisting the Director in driving opportunities to closure. This will also involve ensuring high-quality project delivery through your teams to maintain high client satisfaction and drive repeat business.

3. This position will lead and drive delivery teams of 10+ members, including mid-management members who will be responsible for project delivery, and junior team members for execution. This will involve supervising and guiding the research process, managing complex engagements, and generating actionable insights that help clients make strategic and operational business decisions.

4. You will also play a very meaningful leadership role internally and assume the leadership responsibility for your team. You will support the 1Lattice culture by motivating your colleagues and helping team members under you train and develop their skills, showcase their talents, make them feel part of the 1Lattice family, and overall help them grow professionally. As such, you will be responsible for both their growth and overall engagement, while fostering a high-performance and collaborative team environment.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Ensuring sustained growth and profitability of existing accounts through effective account farming, client retention, and identification of expansion opportunities within key accounts.
* Driving business continuity with existing clients, ensuring repeat business and long-term engagement from key accounts.
* Supporting the Director in business development activities, including proposal development, solutioning, client discussions, and other pre-sales initiatives.
* Driving sectoral marketing, industry visibility, representing the 1Lattice brand, and supporting lead generation and conversion initiatives.
* End-to-end ownership of project scoping and delivery by leading high-impact teams and ensuring overall client satisfaction and engagement.
* Driving thought leadership in projects and developing compelling approaches, frameworks, and solutions to complex client challenges.
* Managing team growth and satisfaction – being responsible for their success while building a strong team culture.
* Playing an active role in recruitment and building project delivery teams within the vertical.

**Competencies and Skills:**

* Deep understanding of the **Automotive & Mobility domain**, including OEMs, auto components, electric vehicles, batteries, charging, aftermarket, and related automotive industries. Experience within an automotive or auto components company is an added advantage.
* Proven experience in business research, consulting, market intelligence, or data services, with a minimum of **8+ years of experience leading and managing teams in the Automotive & Auto Components industry**.
* Strong and credible industry relationships, with the ability to manage senior stakeholder conversations, drive account growth within existing clients, understand client needs, and develop trusted relationships across the automotive and auto components ecosystem.
* Ability to create impactful proposals for specific projects with a tailored approach and support business development initiatives to maximise conversions.
* Demonstrated ability to execute and manage large-scale projects from beginning to completion, with a strong orientation towards planning work, defining scope and approach for assignments, and driving work through teams with high efficiency.
* Strong team management skills, including building a high-performance culture, driving impact and efficiency, and ensuring team growth and engagement.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to derive insights from data, industry trends, market developments, and stakeholder discussions.
* Excellent communication skills, both written (reports, presentations, proposals) and verbal (client interactions and executive presentations).

**Educational qualification and Certifications:**

* Consistent track record of academic excellence - at least an MBA degree.
* Demonstration of leadership in educational and professional career. Experience in secondary and primary research of 5 yrs+ is a must.
* Very high drive and energy.
* Clear, confident and articulate presentation skills.

title: Senior Manager - Quality & Regulatory
description:
### **Job Title**

Senior Manager - Quality & Regulatory

### **Job Description**

**Role Overview**

The SQR Lead will serve as the Quality and Regulatory leader for Oral Healthcare sustaining, lifecycle-management and product-development activities supported from Pune. The role will partner with global OHC R&D, Procurement, Operations and Quality & Regulatory teams to strengthen product quality, regulatory compliance, supplier quality performance and effective portfolio execution, ensuring the delivery of safe, effective, and compliant OHC products throughout the product lifecycle. The leader will support quality strategy, regulatory deployment, risk management, governance and continuous improvement while building a capable, high-performing SQR team.

The Product Safety Quality Manager 70 is responsible for conducting seamless, in-depth safety assessments and compliance evaluations of product designs, overseeing the analysis of test data and root cause analysis to effectively resolve complex safety issues. The role acts as a principal advisor and subject matter expert on product safety and compliance matters, provides authoritative guidance to internal teams and external stakeholders. The role reviews and enhances product safety processes and procedures, optimizes operational efficiency and resource allocation to achieve departmental objectives effectively.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the OHC Quality and Regulatory function in Pune as a site leadership-team member, fostering a culture of quality, compliance, accountability and continuous improvement across the site.
* Provide oversight of the Quality Management System and ensure alignment with applicable global requirements, including FDA QMSR, ISO 13485, EU MDR and other relevant regulatory and quality standards.
* Serve as the primary site Quality representative for leading and supporting the regulatory inspections, notified-body assessments and external audits, while maintaining organizational audit readiness and ensuring timely, effective responses.
* Establish, maintain and continuously improve quality processes, systems, procedures and controls that support safe, effective, reliable and compliant products throughout their lifecycle.
* Lead design assurance and design control activities, including design inputs, quality planning, verification, validation, usability, reliability, manufacturability, safety, design transfer and process validation across hardware, software and system development.
* Ensure quality engineering documentation, including product and system quality plans, is accurate, current, risk-based and compliant with internal and external requirements.
* Guide product and process risk-management activities across development, manufacturing and post-market phases, ensuring risks are identified, assessed, controlled and monitored throughout the lifecycle.
* Lead & support investigations, root-cause analysis, CAPA, nonconformance management and corrective actions, ensuring sustainable resolution of product, process and quality-system issues.
* Integrate customer feedback, reliability information, complaint trends and post-market surveillance data into product-development and lifecycle decisions, providing actionable feedback to design and manufacturing teams.
* Monitor quality-system, product and process performance metrics, using data-based insights to identify trends, manage emerging risks and drive strategic improvement priorities.
* Partner with R&D, Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Procurement and other functions to resolve quality issues, support business objectives and ensure effective execution of quality strategies and project milestones.
* Lead supplier-quality governance, including supplier qualification and development, audits, quality agreements, supplier changes, performance monitoring and corrective actions.
* Drive quality and operational-excellence initiatives using quality engineering, Lean, Six Sigma and other appropriate continuous-improvement methodologies.
* Lead and develop a high-performing quality organization through talent acquisition, objective setting, performance management, coaching, succession planning and employee development.
* Establish and manage departmental objectives, budgets, resource plans and performance goals, and communicate quality risks, priorities and recommendations effectively to senior leadership and key stakeholders.
* Oversee the deployment of applicable global regulatory requirements and internal regulatory policies across OHC development and lifecycle-management activities, covering medical, non-medical.
* Provide governance for global product certification and conformity-assessment strategies, including coordination with certification bodies and test houses such as UL and DEKRA when required.
* Ensure regulatory requirements are translated into development plans and product requirements, and that verification and validation evidence is adequate to demonstrate product safety and compliance.
* Oversee regulatory submission planning, product licensing, maintenance of existing registrations and licenses, and regulatory change-control activities in partnership with Regulatory Affairs and market teams.
* Provide oversight for product labeling plans and the review and approval of product labeling and product-related marketing communications for regulatory and safety compliance.

**You're the right fit if:**

* You have a minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree (Required), in Quality, Engineering or similar disciplines.
* You have a minimum of 15+ years’ overall experience in Product development lifecycle and 10+ years’ experience in FDA regulated Class 2 or Class 3 medical device environments, with a focus on Quality Management System (QMS) Compliance, and Design Assurance functions.
* You have proven experience in functional management of quality teams, including budgeting, workforce planning, Performance Management, Employee Engagement/ Retention, Succession Planning, coaching, training, etc.
* You have strong understanding of Medical Device regulations/standards including ISO 13485/14971, 21CFR (803, 806, 820, etc.), MDD/ EU MDR, GMP, and GDP.
* You have extensive experience managing design assurance activities throughout the product lifecycle, including design controls, Risk Management (ISO 14971, DFMEA/PFMEA) V&V, design transfer, and process validation.
* You have extensive experience in leading audit readiness, serving as the primary quality representative for regulatory inspections, external audits, and interactions with regulatory authorities and notified bodies and ensuring timely, effective responses to internal audits, regulatory inspections, and external assessments.
* You have proven experience utilizing Quality KPI’s/Data Analysis to assess project/team performance and identify process and continuous improvement opportunities.
* You have extensive experience leading CAPA/Nonconformance activities, including problem identification, root cause analysis, implementation of solutions to prevent recurrence and drive continuous improvement.
* You have a minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree (Required), in Quality, Engineering or similar disciplines.
* You have working knowledge of product safety and compliance standards relevant to OHC products, including IEC 60335, IEC 60601, electromagnetic compatibility and radio requirements.
* You have working knowledge of RoHS, REACH, global environmental requirements and biocompatibility principles under ISO 10993.
You have experience working with certification bodies and supporting global product certifications, regulatory submissions and product-license maintenance.  

**How we work together**  
We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.

**About Philips**  
Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? Learn more about our business , discover our rich and exciting history and learn more about our purpose .
  
If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care .

As a Public Relations Intern at PopPop Labs, you will work closely with the leadership, marketing, and business teams to develop and execute communication initiatives. You will help identify media opportunities, draft press materials, research journalists and publications, support announcements, and maintain consistent brand messaging across communication channels.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys storytelling, understands the power of public perception, follows media trends, and wants hands-on experience in corporate communications, media relations, and brand reputation management.

Key Responsibilities

1. Media Relations & Outreach

- Research and build databases of relevant journalists, editors, media houses, publications, digital news platforms, and industry-specific outlets.

- Assist in establishing and maintaining professional relationships with media representatives.

- Identify suitable opportunities for interviews, press coverage, features, and company announcements.

- Develop clear, compelling narratives around the company's products, initiatives, milestones, and achievements.

- Proofread communication materials to ensure accuracy, consistency, and professional presentation.

- Adapt messaging for different audiences, including journalists, business leaders, investors, partners, and the public.

3. Brand Image & Reputation Management

- Help maintain a consistent and professional public image for PopPop Labs.

- Research public relations trends, competitor communications, and emerging media opportunities.

- Assist in preparing communication responses and escalation notes for review by the relevant team.

4. Campaigns & Public Announcements

- Assist in developing communication plans for announcements and launches.

- Interns are expected to remain reachable during agreed working hours, meet deadlines, and participate in scheduled team meetings.

The focus is on consistent communication, professional conduct, measurable contributions, and timely delivery of assigned work.

- Exposure to media outreach, press release writing, and brand storytelling.

- An understanding of how companies manage public perception and brand reputation.

- Experience supporting product announcements, campaigns, events, and partnership communications.

- Opportunities to collaborate with marketing, business development, product, and leadership teams.

- Development of professional writing, research, networking, and stakeholder management skills.

Performance Expectations

Interns are expected to maintain professional communication, respect confidentiality, represent the company responsibly, and ensure that no media statement or public announcement is issued on behalf of the company without appropriate authorisation.

Join Us

title: Technical Sales Engineer
description:
Thinking Nodes GbR is a Cologne-based engineering software company building simulation and digital twin tools. Our newest product is a browser-based CAE pre-processor for sheet-metal parts. It imports STEP and IGES assemblies, cleans the geometry, mid-surfaces sheet parts, imports spot welds, meshes in batch against defined quality criteria and exports solver-ready LS-DYNA and Nastran decks.

Every automated step is logged and explained, so an engineer can see why each element passes or fails. Today the product runs as a hosted service with built-in quality profiles for crash (5 mm) and NVH (8 mm) meshes. Customer-specific quality profiles and on-premise installation are in development.

We are launching in India and are hiring our first Technical Sales Engineer there. You will work directly with the founder, who leads pricing and closing. Your job is to build the pipeline, run first demos and make the product known among CAE engineers. This is an entry-level role with a clear path into account management as the Indian business grows.

**What you will do**

**Sales**

* Research and build a list of target accounts: CAE service firms, automotive OEMs, Tier-1 suppliers and EV start-ups in Pune, Chennai, Bengaluru and Hyderabad.
* Reach CAE heads, founders and engineering managers by LinkedIn, email and phone, and book discovery calls.
* Run first calls and product demos on sample or non-confidential customer parts.
* Support paid 30-day pilots with the founder and our application engineer: collect test parts, track results and summarise them for the customer.
* Prepare quotations from our approved price list for the founder's approval.
* Keep the CRM up to date and send a short weekly report on meetings, pipeline and lost deals.

**Marketing**

* Post on LinkedIn and help produce short demo recordings, case studies and benchmark results.
* Organise webinars and email campaigns.
* Attend industry events such as NAFEMS India and SAEINDIA conferences, and set up demos and meetings around them.
* Build contacts with engineering colleges, training institutes and student teams (BAJA SAEINDIA, Formula Bharat) for our academic programme.

**Market feedback**

* Pass customer feedback to the product team: missing features, solver and workflow needs, objections and reactions to price.
* Track competitors and their pricing in India.

**What you bring**

**Must have**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Automobile or Production Engineering (B.E./B.Tech).
* 0 to 2 years of experience in CAE, FEA, CAD or technical sales. Freshers with strong CAE training are welcome.
* Basic understanding of the CAE workflow: geometry clean-up, meshing, model build, solving and post-processing.
* Hands-on exposure to at least one of ANSA, HyperMesh, LS-DYNA, Nastran or Ansys, through work, coursework or a certification course.
* Good spoken and written English; confident on calls and video demos with engineers.
* Willingness to travel within India, mainly between Pune, Chennai, Bengaluru and Hyderabad.

**Nice to have**

* An internship or first job at a CAE service firm, OEM or Tier-1 supplier.
* Experience in a BAJA SAEINDIA, Formula Bharat or similar student team.
* Hindi and a regional language such as Marathi, Tamil, Telugu or Kannada.
* Experience with a CRM (HubSpot, Zoho or Salesforce) and LinkedIn outreach.

**How you work**

* You are a self-starter who is comfortable building something new with a small team.
* You can explain a technical product simply and listen carefully to what engineers need.
* You are honest with customers about what the product can do today and what it cannot do yet.
* You are organised and follow up on every lead.

**What we offer**

* Fixed salary of ₹2.4-3.6 LPA (₹20,000 - 30,000 per month based on experience) + Commission.
* A performance incentive on top, tied to qualified meetings booked, pilots started and contracts won.
* Travel expenses for customer visits and events reimbursed.
* Training on the product, on CAE pre-processing and on technical sales.
* Direct work with the founder, and a growth path into account management.
* Flexible, hybrid working.

**Location, employment and how to apply**

* **Location:** Pune or Bengaluru preferred; Chennai or Hyderabad, with regular customer travel.
* **Type:** Full-time, employed through our Indian employment partner.
* **Reports to:** Partners, Thinking Nodes GbR.
* **Authority:** This role does not negotiate prices or sign contracts. All quotations and contracts are approved and signed by Thinking Nodes GbR in Germany.
* **Start:** As soon as possible.

To apply, send your CV and a short note on the CAE tools you have used to yash@thinkingnodes.tech

title: Senior Brand Manager
description:
Senior Brand Marketing Manager | Cüraa

Backed by 3one4 Capital, Kae Capital, Lumikai and Better Capital (₹40 crore Series A, led by 3one4 Capital)

Location: Delhi NCR

Experience: 4–8 years in brand marketing at D2C / consumer startups

Type: Full-time

Focus: Brand building, launches, content and creators, D2C growth

Category: Kitchen and home appliances

THE ROLE IN SHORT

Own the Cüraa brand. You will shape how India sees Cüraa, launch every new product with a clear story, and make every rupee of performance spend work harder. This is a hands-on role in a lean D2C team: you set the direction and you also get it done, working closely with the founders, product and design, performance marketing, marketplaces and customer experience.

We are looking for someone who has built a brand from scratch, not someone who has only managed a big one.

Half a million homes. Now make 40 million remember the name.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

1. The brand: positioning, value proposition, tone of voice and visual identity for Cüraa and any new brands we launch. Build the brand book and the distinctive assets that make people recognise us before they see the logo.

2. The consumer: talk to customers, read every review, run quick surveys and home visits in real Indian kitchens, and track competitors on Amazon, Flipkart and quick commerce. Turn what you learn into messaging, claims and input for our product roadmap.

3. The launches: go-to-market for every new product: naming, claims, packaging story, listing content and A+ pages, launch creatives and plans across our website, marketplaces, quick commerce and offline. Every launch gets one clear reason to buy.

4. The content and campaigns: creator and influencer programs, social, video, PR and community, plus festive and sale-season campaigns (Big Billion Days, Prime Day, Diwali). Test fast, keep what works, kill what does not.

5. The numbers: brand and growth metrics that matter for D2C: share of search, organic traffic, ratings and reviews, repeat purchase, content engagement, and how brand work lowers CAC and lifts conversion. Work hand in hand with the performance team on creative and budget.

6. The team and the standard: lead a small team (content, social, design) and freelancers or agencies with sharp briefs. Keep the brand consistent across the website, marketplace stores, packaging, social and customer service.

WHAT YOU BRING

• 4–8 years in brand marketing, mostly at D2C or consumer startups

• You have built a brand, sub-brand or category from scratch, and can show what you did and what it achieved

• Hands-on launches: products taken from zero to market on D2C, marketplaces and quick commerce

• Strong content instincts: creators, social, video, packaging and listing pages that sell

• You understand how brand and performance marketing work together, and speak the language of CAC, ROAS and conversion

• Comfortable with lean budgets: you get big results from small spends

• Data-driven: you use reviews, social listening, search trends and simple dashboards to decide what to do next

• Strong taste in creative, copy and design, and the ability to brief and guide a small team or freelancers

• Ownership: you work like a founder and do whatever it takes to ship

BONUS POINTS

• Home, kitchen or consumer durables experience

• Took a D2C brand from early stage to scale

• Built a community or creator-led brand

• Amazon and Flipkart brand store and A+ content expertise

• Offline retail or quick commerce launches

SELF-CHECK: ANSWER HONESTLY

• I have built a brand or product line from scratch, and can show the before and after.

• I have launched products on D2C and marketplaces, and know how they performed.

• I have run creator or content programs that moved sales, not just likes.

• I have done a lot with a small budget.

• I have worked closely with performance marketing and made each other better.

• I am happy to write the brief, review the creative and fix the listing myself.

Mostly yes? Apply. Not really? This is not the role, and that is fine.

HOW TO APPLY

Apply here: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeAH5eftzB9Ak1TdfEjuUda3-bmq40euLEWTU0rfXn-1E4TOA/viewform

Share your resume and a short portfolio or case-study deck: the brands, launches and campaigns you worked on, your exact role, the idea behind the work, how you executed it, and the results. Include at least one brand or product you built from scratch.

ABOUT CÜRAA

Cüraa started from scratch: a small team, a blank sheet, and one habit we never dropped. Pick a real kitchen problem, solve it properly, and ship it at a price India will pay. A few of the problems we have solved so far:

• The bullet mixer grinder with a steel jar: bullet-style speed and size, with a jar made for everyday Indian grinding.

• The most durable frother: the product everyone underestimates, built to last.

• Manual and electric choppers that set a new bar for the whole category.

• The knob-based induction: India's inductions came covered in buttons. Ours is simple: turn it, cook.

One kitchen problem at a time, Cüraa has reached half a million households. We have raised a ₹40 crore Series A led by 3one4 Capital, with Kae Capital, Lumikai and Better Capital. Our goal is 30–40 million households in the next five years, roughly 10% of India's homes. Most of those homes have never heard of Cüraa, and they already have a brand in mind for every mixer, chopper and induction. We need a brand that is remembered, chosen and recommended. That is your job.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

• A sharper, more recognisable Cüraa brand that stands apart from the big players

• Share of search, organic traffic and ratings rising month on month

• Every launch lands with a clear story and hits its launch targets

• Brand and content that lower CAC and lift conversion for the performance team

• Consistent messaging across the website, marketplaces, packaging and social

• Customer insight that shapes what we launch next

title: Strategic Channel Manager | India | Remote | Expressions Of Interest
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
  
  
You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Grafana Labs is looking for a Channel Manager to develop, execute and evolve our partner go-to-market strategy in India. You will work closely with Sales, Solution Engineering, Marketing, Operations and the leadership team to align sales and go-to-market efforts with our product, technical and sales development efforts. Your key task is to deliver immediate and future partner-sourced revenue growth, working primarily with Grafana's regional Systems Integrators and Value-Added Resellers.
  
  
As our first dedicated channel hire in India, you will build an emerging partner community and shape the role, the strategy and the playbook inside a rapidly growing company where partners are a core part of go-to-market.
  
  
This is NOT a programmatic channel and distribution role. This IS a sales-focused channel role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, is comfortable owning a partner-sourced revenue number, and can build on a fast-growing channel business.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Develop executive-level relationships with focus partners in India
* Own partner opportunity identification and deal acceleration to drive revenue targets
* Lead the identification, activation and development of regional partners
* Develop partner capabilities, co-sell motions and brand awareness initiatives
* Establish strong executive relationships to create partnership business plans
* Work with leadership to manage pipeline and revenue commitments
* Work across Grafana Labs on message alignment, operational coordination and evangelism of the partner strategy and program

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

* 7+ years of experience in channel sales or sales (selling with partners)
* Experience selling SaaS (open source technology is a plus), and familiarity with BEPIC and MEDDPICC selling methodologies
* A demonstrated history of consistent goal achievement at high-growth startups
* A consultative sales approach, with the goal of keeping customer, partner and community satisfaction exceptionally high
* Proven experience developing a high-performing channel strategy for SaaS vendors new to the India market

**Bonus Points For**

* Running low-touch deal cycles with partners independently of the direct sales team
* A demonstrated ability to increase partner-sourced revenue (NACV) contribution to India's overall revenue.

**Compensation & Rewards**
In India, the OTE (On-Target Earnings) compensation range will apply for this role. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. title: D2CX, Founder's Office
description:
The
**Founder’s Office- Inc42 Courses**
owns the growth engine behind Inc42's executive education vertical —
**D2CX, D2CX Foundations, RetailX and D2CX.AI.**

This role sits inside the Founder's Office and works across two mandates. First,
**new initiatives**
: identifying what Inc42 Courses should build next — new programs, formats, cohorts, pricing constructs, and revenue lines — and taking them from idea to live product. Second,
**operating efficiency**
: acting as the connective tissue between content, editorial, design, marketing, growth, product, and operations so that every cohort runs tighter, faster, and more profitably than the last.

Inc42 Courses has already worked with 400+ D2C founders across eight cohorts. The next phase is about scale — more programs, more learners, better unit economics, and a repeatable operating system that doesn't depend on heroics.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who can think like a product owner, execute like a program manager, and read a funnel like a growth marketer.

**Your Impact in This Role:**

* **Build What's Next:**
  You'll research, design, and launch new programs, formats, and revenue lines across the Inc42 Courses portfolio — from curriculum architecture to pricing to go-to-market.
* **Own The Operating System:**
  You'll design the end-to-end operating model for course delivery — admissions, onboarding, session flow, mentor management, community, and completion — and make it repeatable across programs.
* **Drive Cross-Functional Efficiency:**
  You'll align content, design, marketing, growth, product, and operations around a single cohort calendar, removing dependencies and duplicated effort.
* **Make The Numbers Visible:**
  You'll build the dashboards and reporting cadence that give founders real-time visibility into enrolments, funnel health, revenue, engagement, and learner outcomes.
* **Raise The Bar On Experience:**
  You'll own learner experience end-to-end, ensuring every cohort reflects the standard associated with the Inc42 brand.

**About Inc42 Media**

**Inc42**
**is India's #1 startup media & intelligence platform**
that informs, educates and empowers startup & business leaders through its incisive reporting, insightful reports, curated Events, Conferences & communities, and industry-leading executive courses & programs.

Since launching in January 2015 and having risen to become the authoritative voice on India's startup economy, we've moved markets, gotten the early scoop on billions of dollars of transactions, and told you what's happening deep inside some of the fastest-growing startups & industries alike. Our stories have been followed by the Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg, Reuters, TechCrunch, and other major outlets hundreds of times. We also track over 10,000+ startups and provide market research and intelligence through our in-depth research reports, and we organise some of the most sought-after conferences and Events for startup & business leaders across India.

**The Inc42 Impact**

* Inc42 stories reach over
  **50 Mn+**
  people monthly
* Published more than
  **55,000**
  stories
* Successfully conducted
  **150+**
  events
* Launched
  **100+**
  research reports
* Receives
  **500+**
  startup applications monthly
* Worked with
  **350+**
  brands

**The Inc42 Courses Portfolio**

**Program**

**Format**

**Built For**

**D2CX**

12-week hands-on hybrid accelerator

Early-stage D2C founders scaling from INR 1 Cr to 10 Cr

**D2CX Foundations**

6-week self-paced + live program

First-time founders launching a D2C brand profitably

**D2CX.AI**

Focused paid program on AI-led brand & content building

D2C operators building an AI-native marketing stack

**Primary Responsibilities**

**1. New Initiatives & Program Development**

* Identify, evaluate, and build new initiatives across the Inc42 Courses vertical — new programs, cohort formats, certifications, workshops, sprints, and community layers.
* Run market, competitor, and demand research to validate what founders will pay for, and translate findings into concept notes, business cases, and launch plans.
* Own curriculum architecture in partnership with editorial and faculty — module structure, session outcomes, assignments, tooling, and assessment.
* Define pricing, cohort sizing, seat economics, and revenue targets for each program; test and iterate on offers.
* Take new programs from concept to live — landing page, curriculum, faculty, funnel, launch campaign, and first cohort — with clear ownership at every step.

**2. Program Operations & Cohort Delivery**

* Own the end-to-end cohort lifecycle across D2CX, D2CX Foundations, and D2CX.AI — from admissions and onboarding to sessions, assignments, community, and convocation.
* Build and run the cohort calendar: session scheduling, speaker confirmations, content readiness, platform setup, and communication timelines.
* Manage the live + self-paced delivery mix — ensuring recordings, resources, playbooks, and templates reach fellows on time and in the right format.
* Track attendance, engagement, drop-offs, and completion; intervene early on at-risk fellows.
* Troubleshoot in real time during live sessions and cohort weeks, keeping delivery quality uncompromised.

**3. Cross-Functional Efficiency & Systems**

* Act as the single point of alignment across content, design, marketing, growth, product/tech, partnerships, and operations for everything Courses.
* Map current workflows, identify duplicated effort and bottlenecks, and rebuild them into leaner, documented processes with clear owners and turnaround times.
* Run a weekly operating rhythm — review calls, blockers, dependencies, and next actions — with complete visibility for the Founder's Office.
* Drive automation and tooling decisions across LMS, CRM, payments, community platforms, and internal trackers to reduce manual load per cohort.
* Ensure every recurring activity has an SOP, a template, and a named owner — so cohort N+1 costs less effort than cohort N.

**4. Funnel, Revenue & Performance Reporting**

* Own the admissions funnel end-to-end — applications, screening, conversion, payments, and onboarding — in partnership with marketing and growth.
* Work with marketing on acquisition campaigns, landing pages, content, referral loops, and alumni-led demand for each program.
* Track and report on enrolment, revenue, CAC, conversion rates, refunds, completion, NPS, and alumni outcomes.
* Build weekly and monthly dashboards and MIS for founders, with clear reads on what's working, what's at risk, and what needs a decision.
* Manage program P&L inputs — faculty costs, platform costs, production, marketing spend — and drive cost efficiency without diluting experience.

**5. Mentor & Alumni Ecosystem**

* Identify, onboard, and manage faculty, mentors, and session speakers from India's top operator and investor pool.
* Own speaker briefs, session outlines, moderation documents, and pre-session prep to ensure every session delivers a sharp, tactical takeaway.
* Build and activate the alumni network across cohorts — community programming, referrals, testimonials, and case studies.
* Manage partner and sponsor integrations within programs, ensuring deliverables are met without compromising learner experience.

**6. Documentation, Playbooks & Quality Control**

* Document program playbooks, SOPs, checklists, and templates for every recurring workflow across the vertical.
* Run structured post-cohort reviews — capturing feedback, learnings, content gaps, and operational misses — and convert them into changes for the next cohort.
* Act as the quality check on outward-facing course material: curriculum decks, landing pages, emailers, session collateral, and fellow communication.
* Maintain a single source of truth for cohort data, content libraries, and program documentation.

**Growth Path**

* Take ownership of the full Inc42 Courses P&L across programs.
* Expand the vertical into new categories, audiences, and formats beyond D2C.
* Evolve into a broader business ownership role across Inc42's education and community verticals.

**Professional Traits/Skills Required**

* 3–5 years of experience in program management, edtech operations, community-led programs, business operations, consulting, or a founder's office role — preferably in startups, media, or education-led organisations.
* Demonstrated ability to take a new initiative from idea to launch, including research, structuring, and go-to-market.
* Strong comfort with numbers — funnels, unit economics, cohort metrics, and budget management — and the ability to turn data into decisions.
* Proven track record of running multiple programs or projects in parallel with tight timelines and high visibility.
* Excellent written communication, with the ability to produce concept notes, curriculum outlines, speaker briefs, and founder-facing reports.
* Strong stakeholder management skills — comfortable working with founders, CXOs, operators, investors, faculty, and internal teams.
* A systems mindset: bias for documentation, SOPs, automation, and process improvement over repeated firefighting.
* Genuine interest in the D2C and consumer brand ecosystem; prior exposure to cohort-based learning, accelerators, or founder communities is a strong plus.
* Proficient in Google Workspace, Excel/Sheets, Notion, Asana, and modern productivity and analytics tools; familiarity with LMS, CRM, and marketing automation platforms is preferred.
* P.S: Past D2C, Founder office experience preferred

Graduate in any discipline.

title: Area Sales Director
description:
**Company Description**
It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.
  
  
We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.
  
  
The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.
  
  
If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you’ll find your purpose here.

**:**

They will also be responsible for hiring, training, and development of a dynamic Intuitive India Capital Sales Team.

* Lead, assist and coach the team in the following areas:

+ Negotiating key accounts and further developing KOLs
+ Corporate, and capital sales presentations
+ Organize and manage territory growth
+ Building country specific clinical and economical validation of da Vinci Surgery
+ Closing deals, sales presentations, and developing end user business plans

* Educate Sales teams on new product information or new information on existing products
* Forecast Sales and manage quarterly and annual quota targets
* Manage expenses within the budget
* Lead and support SFDC utilization across the team.

**Qualifications**
**Required Knowledge, Skills, and Experience**
**:**

Manage WhatsApp, email and SMS marketing campaigns.

Build customer databases and segmentation strategies.

Monitor customer feedback, reviews and complaints.

Improve customer satisfaction and brand loyalty.

Track website traffic, sales and conversion rates.

Monitor customer acquisition cost (CAC) and return on ad spend (ROAS).

Analyse product-wise sales and profitability.

Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports.

Recommend strategies based on business data.

Coordinate with warehouse and logistics teams.

Ensure timely order processing and delivery.

Monitor returns, refunds and cancellations.

Maintain adequate inventory availability.

Graduate in Marketing, Business Administration or related field.

2–5 years of experience in D2C or e-commerce.

Experience with Shopify or other D2C website platforms.

Hands-on experience with Meta Ads and Google Ads.

Knowledge of Google Analytics 4 and performance marketing.

Understanding of SEO, CRM and marketing automation.

Strong analytical and communication skills.

Good command of Excel and reporting tools.
