title: Brand Manager - D2C (Founders Office)
description:
**About Effora**

Effora is a new-age beauty and wellness brand built around the ritual, not the product. Our devices, topicals and supplements work together to stimulate, absorb and recover. After crossing ₹4.5 crore in net sales in our first year, we're scaling across marketplaces and offline retail. If you want to build a brand people remember, join a small Noida team that gives you real ownership.

**About the Role**

We are hiring a Brand Manager who will be accountable for the brand's growth and how it shows up in the market. You will own Effora from strategy to shelf: what it stands for, how it looks, what goes out every month, and the numbers it delivers. This is a role for someone who builds brands that sell.

**What You Will Own**

1.
**Brand vision and positioning**

• Set the long-term direction for Effora and keep its routine-led, premium positioning sharp and different across devices, topicals and supplements

• Success: brand awareness, consideration and brand health scores, tracked quarterly

2.
**Look, feel and visual identity**

• Own the visual language across packaging, digital, social and retail, so every touchpoint is instantly Effora

• Success: brand recall, creative consistency and on-time delivery of brand assets

3.
**Marketing calendar and execution**

• Build and run the annual and monthly calendar: launches, campaigns, festive sales and marketplace events

• Success: campaigns and launches delivered on time and within budget

4.
**Social, content and PR**

• Drive the social, content and PR agenda with agencies, creators and the in-house team

• Success: follower growth, engagement rate, share of voice and earned media

5.
**Performance intelligence**

• Partner with the performance team to turn data into decisions on creative, messaging and spends

• Success: better ROAS, CAC, CTR and conversion, plus creative win rate in testing

6.
**Competition benchmarking**

• Track competitors on positioning, pricing, launches and communication, and turn it into action

• Success: a monthly competition report and brand decisions backed by insight

7.
**Growth and P&L**

• Own the brand's P&L outcomes

• Success: revenue growth, market share, repeat rate and contribution margin against annual targets

**What We Are Looking For**

**Must-Have**

• 5–7 years in brand management, ideally in D2C, beauty, personal care or FMCG

• A track record of growing a brand, with numbers to show for it

• Strong creative judgement and an eye for design

• Comfort with performance data and with owning targets

• Experience leading agencies and working across growth, ops, design and sales teams

• Based in or able to commute to Noida

**Good to Have**

• Experience with marketplaces (Amazon, Flipkart, Nykaa) and Shopify

• Experience with creator and influencer marketing

• Experience launching new products or categories

• Comfort using AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT for research, briefs and content

**Who You Are**

• Someone who sets an ambitious vision and is equally hands-on with execution

• Accountable for outcomes, not just activity

• Comfortable building from zero in a small, fast team

**Why Effora**

• Own an entire brand, not one channel

• Work directly with the Founder and see your decisions reach the market fast

• Build a premium brand across beauty and wellness

**How to Apply**

Email your CV to talent@effora.in

**Job Description – Product Head, Financial Services**

**Designation:**
Product Head

Deputy Vice President (DVP)

Airtel Payments Bank

**About Airtel Payments Bank**

Airtel Payments Bank is making banking accessible, simple and inclusive for every Indian – serving the unbanked and underserved through digital banking and one of the country's largest distribution networks. We are looking for a Product Head to lead our Financial Services business, with lending as the primary mandate.

**Role Summary**

The Product Head – Financial Services owns product strategy and outcomes across Lending, Insurance, Wealth, Plans and emerging financial services, with lending as the core focus. Working closely with Business, Technology, Partnerships, Risk, Compliance, Analytics, Operations and Distribution, the role drives acquisition, engagement, monetisation and long-term customer value through compliant, commercially viable products.

The ideal candidate combines deep lending expertise with strong product leadership, a sharp understanding of the Indian financial services ecosystem and partner-led models, and a track record of execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Lending Strategy & Portfolio Growth**

* Define the multi-year lending strategy – target segments, product sequence, partnership and capital models – and own the portfolio across personal loans, consumer credit, merchant and retailer financing, credit lines, secured products (gold, two-wheeler), credit cards and new credit constructs.
* Identify credit white spaces across the Airtel ecosystem (Airtel Thanks, retailer and distributor network, merchants) and design embedded credit propositions, balancing growth with portfolio prudence.

**2. Insurance, Wealth & Adjacent Products**

* Set the product vision and roadmaps for Insurance and Wealth with clear outcomes and metrics, prioritising synergies with lending.
* Build cross-sell and bundling strategies that lift borrower lifetime value and retention.

**3. Business Growth & P&L**

* Own lending metrics – disbursement, revenue (referral fees, cross-sell), attachment rate and contribution margin.
* Drive acquisition and activation across digital (Airtel Thanks, bank app, web, partner surfaces) and assisted channels (banking points, retailers, field force); optimise the funnel end to end.

**4. Partnerships & Ecosystem**

* Build and manage relationships with lending partners, insurers, fintechs, technology providers and regulators; develop partnership-led growth opportunities.
* Own the integration roadmap with each lending partner – APIs, offer exchange, underwriting hand-offs, disbursement and repayment reconciliation, servicing SLAs.

**5. Market, Technology & Data**

* Track the Indian digital lending landscape – fintech lenders, bank and NBFC propositions, UPI-linked credit, regulation – and turn insights into strategy.
* Partner with Technology to align product vision and architecture; use analytics and customer insight to drive prioritisation and track outcomes.

**6. Team & Stakeholder Leadership**

* Build and mentor a high-performing product team, and act as the single point of accountability for lending across Business, Risk, Compliance, Technology, Operations, Collections and Distribution.
* Communicate vision, performance and recommendations crisply to executive and partner leadership.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Loan disbursement volume; approval rate and application-to-disbursement conversion
* Portfolio growth of Insurance and Wealth products
* Revenue and contribution margin across products
* Regulatory and audit compliance; customer grievance and NPS

**Candidate Profile**

**Experience & Expertise**

* 10+ years of experience, with significant product leadership in lending at a bank, NBFC, fintech or digital lending platform in India; Insurance domain exposure is an added advantage.
* Proven record of launching and scaling digital products, with hands-on experience of co-lending, LSP/DSA and FLDG partnership structures.
* Strong grasp of RBI digital lending and Insurance regulations; builds compliant-by-design products.

**Capabilities**

* Commercial ownership – comfortable owning a P&L and making volume–risk–margin calls with data; fluent in funnel, portfolio and cohort analytics.
* Strong partnership, negotiation and stakeholder skills across senior internal and external leadership.
* Strategic clarity with execution discipline.

**Education**

* MBA / postgraduate degree from a premier institute preferred; engineering or quantitative background an advantage.

description:

**Location:** Gurugram, Haryana  
**Work Mode:** Full-time, Work from Office  
**Experience:** 3–6 Years

**About the Role**

We are looking for a creative, strategic and detail-orientated brand experience manager who can take ownership of how our brand is perceived, experienced and remembered.

This role goes beyond managing social media or executing marketing campaigns. We are looking for someone who understands the fundamentals of building a strong brand, developing a distinct identity, creating meaningful brand experiences and maintaining consistency across every customer touchpoint.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of branding, consumer perception, visual communication, storytelling and brand positioning, along with the ability to translate ideas into effective execution.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and strengthen the brand's identity, positioning and overall market perception.
* Establish and maintain a consistent brand voice, visual language and communication strategy.
* Conceptualise and execute brand-building initiatives, campaigns and creative projects.
* Oversee brand storytelling, messaging and creative direction across platforms.
* Ensure consistency across website, product presentation, packaging, social media and other customer touchpoints.
* Understand the target audience, consumer behaviour and market trends to identify opportunities for brand development.
* Work closely with design, content, creative and business teams to bring brand concepts to life.
* Identify opportunities to improve the overall customer and brand experience.
* Maintain brand guidelines and ensure that all communication reflects the desired brand identity.
* Take ownership of projects from initial conceptualisation through execution and evaluation.

What We Are Looking For

* 3–6 years of relevant experience in branding, brand management or brand development.
* Strong understanding of brand positioning, identity, storytelling and consumer perception.
* Excellent communication, conceptualisation and creative thinking skills.
* A strong aesthetic sense and understanding of visual branding.
* Ability to develop ideas independently and translate them into actionable projects.
* Experience working with creative, design and content teams.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain brand consistency.
* A combination of strategic thinking and hands-on execution.

***Experience with premium, luxury, lifestyle, fashion, beauty or D2C brands will be an advantage.***

**Important Role Clarification**

This is a brand-building and brand experience position, not a performance marketing role.

We are specifically looking for professionals with expertise in organic brand development, brand strategy, identity, communication and creative direction.

This position does not primarily involve paid advertising, media buying, performance campaigns or lead-generation targets.

If you understand how brands are built, differentiated and remembered, we would like to hear from you.

description:
About the Team
  
  
Join our high-performing Hunting Team within the Growth Sales Segment that drives aggressive business expansion through new customer acquisition and strategic account development. Our team operates at the cutting edge of fintech sales, working directly with SMB merchants to onboard them onto our comprehensive financial solutions platform. Based in Chennai, we collaborate across marketing, product, and operations teams to identify untapped market segments and convert prospects into long-term customers. The team culture emphasizes aggressive growth mindset, target-driven performance, and customer-first approach to drive rapid business expansion.
  
  
About the Role
  
  
You will be the driving force behind our new business acquisition and customer portfolio expansion. This role combines strategic prospecting with intensive account management, requiring you to own ambitious sales targets including new customer acquisitions, gross monthly volumes, revenue targets, and product penetration metrics. You'll be responsible for the complete sales cycle - from initial lead generation and prospecting to deal closure and ongoing account growth optimization. This position offers the opportunity to directly impact business growth while building a strong customer base in the competitive fintech landscape.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  

* Identify and pursue new business opportunities through strategic prospecting and lead generation
* Manage and develop relationships with new and existing SMB merchant accounts
* Drive sales targets including customer acquisition, revenue growth, and volume metrics
* Collaborate with Marketing, Product, and Operations teams to execute go-to-market strategies
* Engage in senior-level sales conversations with business owners and decision-makers
* Analyse sales performance metrics and optimize conversion strategies
* Monitor market trends and identify emerging business opportunities within fintech and payments
* Conduct product demonstrations and presentations to prospective clients
* Negotiate contracts and pricing terms to close new business deals

**Requirements:**  

* Minimum 4+ years' experience in fintech sales, business development, or B2B sales
* Deep understanding of the payments ecosystem and SMB merchant needs
* Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets in competitive markets
* Experience with consultative selling and complex sales cycle management
* Comfortable engaging with business owners and senior decision-makers
* Strong analytical skills and familiarity with sales metrics and CRM systems
* Excellent communicator and relationship builder, adept at cross-functional collaboration
* Hunter mentality with demonstrated ability to generate new business from scratch

What we offer?
  
  

* A positive, get-things-done workplace
* A dynamic, constantly evolving space (change is par for the course – important you are comfortable with this).
* An inclusive environment that ensures we listen to a diverse range of voices when making decisions.
* Ability to learn cutting edge concepts and innovation in an agile start-up environment with a global scale.
* Access to 5000+ training courses accessible anytime/anywhere to support your growth and development (Corporate with top learning partners like Harvard, Coursera, Udacity).

**About us:**  
At PayU, we are a global fintech investor and our vision is to build a world without financial borders where everyone can prosper. We give people in high growth markets the financial services and products they need to thrive. Our expertise in 18+ high-growth markets enables us to extend the reach of financial services. This drives everything we do, from investing in technology entrepreneurs to offering credit to underserved individuals, to helping merchants buy, sell, and operate online. Being part of Prosus, one of the largest technology investors in the world, gives us the presence and expertise to make a real impact. Find out more at www.payu.com
  
  
Our Commitment to Building A Diverse and Inclusive Workforce
  
  
As a global and multi-cultural organization with varied ethnicities thriving across locations, we realize that our responsibility towards fulfilling the D&I commitment is huge. Therefore, we continuously strive to create a diverse, inclusive, and safe environment, for all our people, communities, and customers. Our leaders are committed to create an inclusive work culture which enables transparency, flexibility, and unbiased attention to every PayUneer so they can succeed, irrespective of gender, color, or personal faith. An environment where every person feels they belong, that they are listened to, and where they are empowered to speak up. At PayU we have zero tolerance towards any form of prejudice whether a specific race, ethnicity, or of persons with disabilities, or the LGBTQ communities

We are looking for a strategic, hands-on academic leader to partner with the Chief Academic Officer in building the next generation of online higher education.

The General Manager – Academic Excellence & Innovation will be responsible for driving academic innovation, curriculum modernization, academic product development, learning experience design, academic quality frameworks, AI-enabled learning initiatives, and strategic academic transformation across our university partnerships.

This is
**not**
a traditional Academic Operations role. Operational delivery, learner progression, and student success functions are managed through dedicated teams. This role is focused on
**building**
,
**innovating**
, and
**transforming**
the academic ecosystem.

The ideal candidate combines strong academic foundations with product thinking, learner-centric design, technology orientation, and a deep understanding of the Indian Online Higher Education ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

Academic Product & Portfolio Development

* Lead the design and development of innovative academic products, online degree programmes, certificate programmes, industry pathways, and stackable learning offerings.
* Identify emerging learner and industry needs to build future-ready academic portfolios.
* Support enterprise learning and university partnership opportunities through academic solution design.
* Conduct market and competitive analysis to identify new programme opportunities.

Curriculum Innovation

* Drive curriculum modernization across degree and certificate programmes.
* Develop competency-based, industry-integrated and AI-enabled curriculum frameworks.
* Design learner-centric academic pathways aligned with employability and lifelong learning.
* Collaborate with universities, faculty and industry experts to continuously enhance programme relevance.

Learning Experience & Innovation

* Design differentiated digital learning experiences that improve learner engagement and academic outcomes.
* Partner with Learning Technology teams to shape future learner journeys.
* Recommend innovative pedagogical models, assessment approaches and learner engagement strategies.
* Support the adoption of AI-enabled learning experiences and digital innovation.

Academic Excellence & Governance

* Develop academic quality frameworks and continuous improvement models.
* Establish academic policies, governance frameworks and quality standards across programmes.
* Support academic reviews, programme audits and institutional quality initiatives.
* Ensure academic innovations remain aligned with applicable regulatory frameworks.

Strategic Academic Transformation

* Lead institution-wide academic transformation initiatives.
* Drive cross-functional projects involving Academic Operations, Student Success, Learning Technology, Career Services and partner universities.
* Support new university onboarding and strategic academic initiatives.
* Act as a strategic advisor to the Chief Academic Officer on future academic models.

AI & Future Learning

* Evaluate emerging trends in higher education, AI and digital learning.
* Drive experimentation around AI-enabled teaching, learning and learner support.
* Support the evolution of intelligent learning ecosystems and future-ready academic models.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 12–18 months, you will:

* Launch innovative academic products and learner pathways.
* Modernize curriculum frameworks across key programmes.
* Improve learner experience through innovative academic design.
* Institutionalize academic quality and governance frameworks.
* Drive AI-enabled learning initiatives.
* Support strategic university partnerships and new programme launches.
* Become a trusted strategic partner to the Chief Academic Officer.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are specifically looking for professionals who have built or transformed academic ecosystems within
**Online Higher Education**
or
**Higher Education-focused EdTech organizations**
.

The ideal candidate is:

* A builder rather than a maintainer.
* Hands-on and execution-oriented.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and creating new solutions.
* Passionate about learner experience and academic innovation.
* Equally comfortable working with curriculum, technology, universities, and business stakeholders.
* Able to move seamlessly between strategy and execution.

Mandatory Experience

* 12–18 years of experience in Online Higher Education, OPMs, Higher Education-focused EdTech or Digital Learning organizations.
* Demonstrated experience in academic product development, curriculum innovation, learning experience design, or academic transformation.
* Experience working with universities, academic leadership and cross-functional business teams.
* Strong understanding of the
  **Indian Online Higher Education ecosystem**
  .

Essential Knowledge

Candidates should have practical experience and understanding of:

* UGC Online & ODL Regulations
* UGC-DEB regulatory framework
* National Education Policy (NEP 2020)
* Academic Bank of Credits (ABC)
* National Credit Framework (NCrF)
* Online Degree programme design and delivery
* Academic governance within Indian Higher Education
* Industry-integrated curriculum design
* Higher Education quality frameworks

description:
**Job Title: Brand Services Director**

**Experience: 5 yrs +**

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking a visionary who can create and implement a robust digital roadmap for our clients, particularly those with traditionally offline brands. This individual will bring a fresh perspective, demonstrating the power of digital marketing beyond just social media and collaborations. The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker who can drive content strategies and collaborative approaches, ultimately enhancing customer journeys and converting engagement into tangible results.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Build comprehensive digital roadmaps tailored to each client's brand, focusing on transforming traditional marketing approaches to digital-first strategies.

* Foster collaborative efforts between brands and digital influencers, media, and other stakeholders to enhance brand visibility and reach.
* Analyse and map out customer journeys, identifying key touchpoints and opportunities for digital engagement.
* Develop strategies to enhance customer experiences and drive conversions through personalized and targeted digital interactions.

* Regularly analyse and report on the performance of digital strategies, providing insights and recommendations for continuous improvement.

* Proven experience in digital marketing and account management, with a strong understanding of both traditional and digital marketing landscapes.

* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and clients.
* A deep understanding of customer journeys, digital content strategies, and brand building.

* Visionary thinker with a digital-first mindset.

title: Principal Manager, Product Management (Comply Tech)
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $115 billion in investment capital as of September 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are seeking an enthusiastic, analytical, and resourceful product manager to join our Investment Services Technology team, partnering closely with the Compliance team, based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram. This position offers the opportunity for broad exposure to the firm’s trading, operations, and software development groups, as well as the chance to manage real-time issues related to the firm’s expanding suite of global investment products in a dynamic, constantly evolving regulatory environment. The role offers an inclusive and dynamic environment, with a focus on improving technology for efficiency, control, and scalability. The ideal candidate will bring exceptional product management fundamentals, experience in process optimization and workflow automation, and the judgment to operate effectively in a highly regulated and confidential environment with diverse stakeholders.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
You will drive technological solutions that support critical compliance functions across the firm, collaborating with cross-functional teams — engineering, design, business, and other front- and back-office partners — to develop and launch new products and features. You will develop and maintain a strategic product roadmap that aligns with the firm's overall goals and evolves continuously based on user feedback, prioritization, and other factors while working with senior leadership in Compliance. You will also partner closely with the business to understand their needs, define product requirements, scope open-ended projects, and conceptualize effective solutions across a broad range of functional areas, including pre-trade compliance and trade-restriction management, position-limit monitoring, trade surveillance, and regulatory and transaction reporting. Additionally, you will conduct technical design and architecture reviews to ensure alignment with the roadmap and end-user needs and partner with engineering to address technical challenges and deliver on time and to specification. You will evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, replace legacy and vendor systems with scalable in-house platforms, and develop AI- and data-enabled tools for monitoring, detection, and reporting — balancing near-term regulatory and operational needs against long-term strategic and architectural objectives, often building scalable infrastructure in areas with limited existing technology while serving as a senior point of coordination for compliance technology transformation. Furthermore, you will monitor product usage and feedback to identify areas for improvement and address technical debt in a timely manner, maintain product documentation (requirements documents, user guides, and more), conduct training and enablement as a subject-matter expert for the product suite, and manage product launches and backlogs — prioritizing features and enhancements based on end-user feedback and business needs.
  
  
**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, a related field, or an MBA, with 8+ years of product management experience, preferably within the financial services or investment management industry
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical and operational concepts clearly, influence decision-making through both meetings and written artifacts, and engage effectively with diverse stakeholder groups
* Excellent analytical and data-driven decision-making capabilities, with proficiency in data analysis tools and techniques to generate product insights, prioritize initiatives, measure outcomes, and guide product strategy
* Proven adaptability in managing changing priorities, with robust project and delivery management skills in dynamic environments
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, operations, and business teams, translating nontechnical needs into clear requirements while balancing competing stakeholder priorities, building consensus, and delivering customer-focused outcomes
* A high degree of attention to detail and structured problem-solving abilities, with a consistent focus on quality, risk awareness, and operational excellence
* Hands-on experience owning and delivering technology products end-to-end in Agile environments, from product vision and discovery through backlog management, iterative delivery, launch, scaling, and ongoing maturation
* Demonstrated expertise in workflow automation and process optimization, applying structured approaches and tools to improve efficiency, transparency, and control
* A solid understanding of operational workflows within hedge funds and investment management firms, including how controls, data integrity, and regulatory considerations shape technology and product design

Preferred qualifications:
  
  

* Exposure to the investment management or hedge fund domain, with familiarity with pre-trade compliance, trade restrictions, position limits, trade surveillance, or regulatory and transaction reporting
* Experience partnering closely with Compliance, Legal, Risk, or other control functions to define requirements and deliver workflow-driven, compliant technology solutions

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/PMComplyTechOct26
  
  
We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.
  
  
The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers

* Karnataka – Bengaluru, Mysuru and other key markets

Make Divine Hindu products widely available across South India's leading retail chains, supermarkets, spiritual stores, gifting outlets and online shopping platforms, before scaling nationwide.

* Secure product listings with DMart, Reliance Smart Bazaar, Lulu Hypermarket, SPAR and other leading national and South Indian regional retail chains.

* Negotiate listing fees, margins, promotional plans and commercial agreements.
* Drive product placement, in-store visibility, replenishment and sell-through.

**2. General Trade & Distribution**

* Build a strong distributor, super-stockist and retailer network across all five South Indian states.
* Expand into supermarkets, spiritual stores, jewellery and gifting outlets, and relevant retail formats.
* Identify high-potential cities, appoint distribution partners and execute market-entry plans.
* Build scalable distribution processes for future nationwide expansion.

**3. E-commerce & Quick Commerce**

* Strengthen presence across Amazon, Flipkart, Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart and other relevant platforms.
* Identify opportunities for regional marketplace and quick-commerce expansion.
* Coordinate onboarding, assortment, pricing, promotions and inventory planning.
* Develop an integrated online and offline distribution strategy.

**4. Revenue & Business Growth**

* Own sales targets, revenue growth and channel profitability.
* Develop trade schemes, pricing structures and retail-specific product assortments.
* Track primary sales, secondary sales, inventory movement and channel performance.
* Build and manage regional sales teams as the business scales.

Requirements

* 7–12+ years of relevant experience in Modern Trade, General Trade, FMCG Sales, Retail Distribution or Key Account Management.
* **Strong existing relationships with modern-trade buyers, distributors and retail partners across South India.**
* Proven experience personally securing listings in major retail chains.
* Demonstrated ability to appoint distributors and build retail networks from scratch.
* Experience launching or expanding consumer brands into new regional markets.
* Strong negotiation, commercial planning, sales leadership and P&L management skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively across South India and subsequently across India.
* Familiarity with South Indian regional markets and languages is an added advantage.

What We're Looking For

We are not looking for someone who has only managed existing retail accounts.

**We want a market expansion leader who has personally:**

* Opened new modern-trade retail accounts.
* Negotiated directly with category buyers.
* Appointed distributors and super-stockists across South India.
* Built profitable offline sales channels from the ground up.
* Successfully scaled brands across multiple cities and states.

**Candidates with proven South India retail distribution networks will be given priority.**

* High-ownership leadership role with direct access to the founding team.
* Opportunity to build new retail channels and distribution partnerships from scratch.
* Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives.
* Play a pivotal role in scaling an emerging Indian spiritual and wellness brand.

How to Apply

Apply through LinkedIn or share your CV along with:

1. South Indian retail chains you have personally helped brands enter.

description:
**Department:**
Sales

**Description**
**Why This Opportunity Is Different**
Most sales roles focus on selling products. This role focuses on transforming businesses.
  
  
As a Practice Development Manager (PDM), you will help doctors and practices adopt new technologies, embrace digital workflows, expand treatment capabilities, and unlock growth opportunities that improve both practice performance and patient outcomes.
  
  
You will operate at the intersection of: Healthcare | Medical Technology | Digital Transformation | Business Consulting | Practice Growth | Customer Success | Commercial Leadership
  
  
This is not simply a territory sales role. It is an opportunity to influence how healthcare innovation is adopted and delivered every day.
  
  
**Why Align?**
**Build a Career Beyond Traditional Sales -**
At Align, you are not just responsible for driving revenue. You are responsible for helping customers transform how they work. You will become a trusted advisor to doctors and practice teams, helping them improve clinical confidence, streamline workflows, elevate patient experiences, and grow sustainable businesses.
  
  
**Join a Company Shaping the Future of Healthcare -**
Align's digital ecosystem integrates advanced software, AI and machine learning, digital imaging, visualization, biomechanics, and material science to deliver industry-leading solutions worldwide.
  
  
**Be Part of India's Growth Story -**
India represents one of the most exciting opportunities within Align's global growth journey. As Align continues to expand its commercial presence, digital capability, and operational footprint in India, you will have the opportunity to contribute to a business that is shaping the future of healthcare technology in one of the world's most dynamic markets.
  
  
**Role expectations**
**What You Will Do**
**Drive Territory Growth**

* Develop and execute strategic territory plans using customer insight, commercial data, and opportunity analysis.
* Grow existing customer partnerships while acquiring and activating new customers.
* Convert new and existing practices into advocates of digital orthodontics and clear aligner treatment.
* Identify high-potential opportunities and prioritize activities that drive sustainable business growth.

**Become a Strategic Business Partner**

* Build trusted, long-term partnerships with doctors and practice teams.
* Understand each customer's clinical, commercial, and patient-focused objectives.
* Act as a strategic advisor rather than a transactional seller.
* Help practices identify opportunities to enhance efficiency, adoption, profitability, and patient experience.

**Lead Value-Based Commercial Conversations**

* Conduct structured, consultative conversations that uncover explicit and unspoken customer needs.
* Demonstrate the commercial and clinical value of Align solutions.
* Differentiate Align through insight-led selling rather than price-based selling.
* Confidently navigate competitive environments and complex objections.

**Drive Digital Transformation**

* Champion the Align Digital Workflow (ADW) and associated digital technologies.
* Help practices integrate digital workflows into daily operations.
* Demonstrate how technology can improve predictability, efficiency, patient engagement, and treatment outcomes.
* Become a trusted advocate for innovation and digital adoption.

**Deliver Meaningful Customer Impact**

* Support clinicians in developing confidence and capability in clear aligner treatment.
* Share evidence-based recommendations and best practices.
* Help practices improve patient outcomes and treatment experiences.
* Enable long-term practice transformation through technology and partnership.

**What Makes Someone Successful in This Role?**
**The Strongest PDMs Are**
**Growth Builders |**
They see opportunities where others see obstacles.
  
  
**Strategic Thinkers |**
They manage territories like businesses.
  
  
**Trusted Advisors |**
They earn credibility with customers through insight and partnership.
  
  
**Digital Advocates |**
They help customers embrace new technologies and ways of working.
  
  
**Category Creators |**
They help shape the future of digital dentistry by expanding adoption and influencing change.
  
  
**What We're Looking For**
**Who We're Looking For**
We would love to hear from professionals with experience in: Medical Devices | Healthcare Technology | Diagnostics | Capital Equipment | Dental Technologies | Orthodontics | Healthcare Solutions | Complex Consultative Sales
  
  
You will thrive in this role if you are: Commercially sharp and growth oriented | Highly customer focused | Curious and quick to learn | Resilient in competitive environments | Strong at relationship building | Passionate about technology and innovation | Motivated by business transformation rather than transactional selling
  
  
**A Message to Medical Device Professionals**
Many candidates initially view digital dentistry as a niche category. We see it differently.
  
  
While the category is specialized, the capabilities you build are broad and highly transferable. As a Practice Development Manager, you will develop expertise in strategic selling, customer transformation, digital adoption, territory leadership, commercial strategy, and market development.
  
  
**Digital dentistry is the category you enter. Healthcare transformation is the capability you build.**
**What Success Looks Like**
Success in this role means:
  
  

* Building a healthy, high-performing territory
* Expanding customer adoption of clear aligner treatment
* Accelerating digital workflow adoption
* Strengthening doctor and practice partnerships
* Turning customer insight into business growth
* Helping practices improve outcomes for patients and teams alike

description:
**Senior Executive – Material Planning**

Group Bayport | Supply Chain Management | Gandhinagar, Gujarat

**About Group Bayport**Group Bayport is a rapidly growing global e-Commerce B2B2C, B2B and B2C organisation that has re-defined the business of delivering high-quality custom products through a unique blend of innovative digital technologies, robust manufacturing capabilities, and a global supply chain. An industry leader in print technology, Group Bayport operates in the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, the UK, and India through its family of brands — Banner Buzz, Covers & All, Vivyx Printing, Circle One, Giant Media and Neon Earth.From full suites of trade show and small business marketing solutions to sophisticated outdoor living covers, signages and shades, to eclectic personal accents and home decor, we help our customers, clients and partners make a personalised statement through customisation.While our advanced technology and customer focus are certainly our salient attributes, our true strength comes from our team of 1,450+ people. We are seeking exceptional talent across the board to join us in our exciting growth journey.

Learn more: LinkedIn:

**About the Role**

We are looking for a meticulous and initiative-taking Senior Executive – Material Planning to plan all general inventory items and domestically sourced materials across our Gandhinagar manufacturing operations.The role keeps production supplied — planning requirements against the production schedule, raising purchase requisitions, following them through with the Domestic Procurement team, and holding inventory at the right level. It suits someone who is methodical, follows things to closure, and would rather prevent a shortage than report one.

**Position details**Designation: Senior Executive – Material PlanningFunction: Supply Chain Management – Centralised Material PlanningReporting to: Deputy General Manager – Supply Chain PlanningLocation: Gandhinagar, GujaratExperience: 2 – 5 years

**Key Responsibilities Planning and requirement generation**

* Plan and monitor material requirements for all general inventory items across manufacturing operations.
* Generate material requirement plans from production schedules, forecasts, and consumption patterns.
* Raise purchase requisitions on time and with accurate quantities and dates.
* Maintain planning data in the ERP — reorder levels, safety stock, lead times, and material master records.

**Follow-through and availability**

* Coordinate with the Domestic Procurement team to ensure requirements convert into timely purchase orders.
* Track open purchase orders and supplier lead times and follow up proactively to avoid production delays.
* Review daily material availability against the production plan and highlight potential risks early.
* Support new product launches by planning and securing required materials in time.

**Inventory control**

* Monitor inventory levels and maintain optimum stock to prevent both shortages and excess.
* Analyse material consumption trends and recommend inventory optimisation actions.
* Monitor slow-moving, non-moving, and obsolete inventory and recommend corrective action.
* Support cycle counts and inventory accuracy improvement with Stores.

**Coordination and reporting**

* Work closely with Production Planning, Procurement, Warehouse, Quality and Stores for seamless material flow.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports on inventory status, shortages, purchase follow-ups, and planning performance.
* Ensure adherence to company inventory policies and planning processes.

**Scope boundary** This role plans requirements and follows them through to delivery. Supplier selection, negotiation, and purchase order placement sit with the Domestic Procurement team. The planner is accountable for raising the right requirement at the right time and for escalating delays early.

**What success looks like in the first 90 days?**

* All general inventory items under an active, maintained plan.
* Open purchase requisitions and orders tracked daily, with delays escalated before they affect production.
* ERP planning parameters cleaned up and accurate for the assigned material groups.
* A working daily shortage report that production and procurement both rely on.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Material availability for production (%)
* Stock-out incidents.
* Inventory turns and inventory record accuracy.
* Purchase requisitions raised on or before the planned date
* Open purchase order follow-up adherence
* Reduction in excess and obsolete inventory
* Planning accuracy — requirement plan against actual consumption
* Production schedule adherence attributable to material availability

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Commerce, or a related field.
* A diploma or certification in Supply Chain or Inventory Management will be an advantage.

**Experience**

* 2 to 5 years in material planning, inventory management, or production planning.
* Experience coordinating with domestic suppliers and an internal procurement team.
* Manufacturing background preferred — signage, printing, textiles, packaging or similar.
* Exposure to a high-SKU or made-to-order environment is an advantage.

**Technical Skills**

* Good working understanding of Material Requirement Planning (MRP).
* Experience with an ERP system — SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics or equivalent.
* Strong Microsoft Excel — pivot tables, lookup functions, and reporting.
* Ability to analyse material consumption and demand trends.

**Competencies**

* Methodical, organised, and strong on follow-through.
* Analytical, with genuine diligence.
* Effective communication and coordination skills across departments.
* Able to prioritise multiple tasks in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* Takes ownership and closes items rather than passing them on.

description:

Over the years, our UAE - based group has evolved into a comprehensive retail and hospitality entity, with over 2200 retail stores, leisure, and hospitality outlets, panning the GCC, Middle East, India, Southeast Asia, and Africa. Today, Landmark Group is one of GCC's largest omnichannel retailers and India's top home and fashion retailer.

We take immense pride in the organic growth of our retail brands, which have blossomed into household names. From Max, Splash, Babyshop, Centrepoint, Shoemart, Home Centre, Emax, Fitness First, to Fun City, to name a few, our brands span across a multitude of categories, enriching the lives of countless families over the past decade.

Headquartered in Dubai, UAE, we oversee the digital operations of eight leading brands across diverse geographies, with ambitious plans for expansion into new territories and functions. Joining us means becoming a vital part of the Middle East's most significant bricks-to-clicks success story, boasting an impressive year-on-year growth rate exceeding 100%.

Working at Landmark Digital means engaging with cutting-edge technologies, including Enterprise and E-commerce tech, headless commerce, Java Spring Boot, React Native, React frontend, and Azure Cloud solutions, providing an enriching environment for professional growth and development.

In addition to competitive remuneration and benefits, we prioritize continuous learning and growth through dedicated training and upskilling initiatives. Furthermore, our vibrant workplace culture fosters camaraderie through various team events, celebrations, and recreational amenities, ensuring a fulfilling experience both personally and professionally.

Come be a part of Landmark Digital, where innovation, collaboration, and growth converge to redefine the digital retail landscape

description:

Join a globally recognized, product-led technology company focused on building innovative software solutions and delivering meaningful value to customers worldwide.

We’re looking for a
**Technical Talent
*Partner***
who understands the software engineering talent market and is passionate about helping product and engineering teams grow. In this role, you’ll
*partner*
closely with engineering leaders, technical leads, and hiring managers to shape recruitment strategies and attract exceptional mid- to senior-level talent, particularly across software development and engineering.

  with software product and engineering teams to understand product roadmaps, technical priorities, team growth plans, and hiring requirements.

* Deliver a high-quality candidate experience through clear communication, timely feedback, and a thoughtful, engaging recruitment process.

* Support the long-term growth of software product teams by anticipating talent needs and building relationships with qualified technical professionals before vacancies arise.

* 3–5 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, Technical Recruitment, or Talent Partnering.
* Proven experience managing
  *end-to-end*
  recruitment for mid- to senior-level technology roles, particularly software development or software engineering positions.
* Strong understanding of software engineering talent profiles and the ability to identify relevant technical skills and experience.
* Experience partnering directly with engineering managers, technical leads, product teams, or other technology stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to develop sourcing strategies and attract talent in competitive technical markets.
* Proficiency in Boolean search, LinkedIn sourcing, talent mapping, and other candidate research techniques.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the confidence to provide market insights and influence hiring decisions.
* A data-driven, proactive, and consultative mindset, with a focus on hiring quality and long-term team growth.
* Experience supporting global or distributed technology teams is an advantage.

**Why Consider This Opportunity?**

* Join a Tier 1 global technology organization with a strong focus on software product innovation.
* Work closely with software product teams and engineering leaders, directly contributing to their growth and success.
* Manage meaningful mid- to senior-level technical searches rather than focusing solely on high-volume or transactional recruitment.
* Gain exposure to global talent markets, complex technical hiring challenges, and strategic stakeholder partnerships.
* Build your career as a consultative Talent
  *Partner*
  who influences hiring decisions and helps shape high-performing engineering teams.

**Ready to Make an Impact?**

If you are a technically minded recruitment professional who enjoys partnering with engineering leaders, identifying exceptional software development talent, and helping product teams scale, this opportunity offers the chance to make a meaningful contribution to a global technology organization.

title: HR Recruiter
description:
Baghiraa, founded in 2017 is a purpose-driven company committed to sustainability, innovation, and community. Headquartered in Atlanta with operations in Bangalore and skeletal offices in Broomfield and The Hague. We are in the process of opening an office in Tallinn, Estonia. We operate across three dynamic subsidiaries: Sanrachna Steel, Baghiraa Café & CoWork, and Baghiraa Earth Labs.

Sanrachna Steel is a value-driven design firm specializing in high-quality steel detailing for commercial and industrial projects, with over 450 successful builds in the U.S. and a focus on sustainable practices in engineering and design.

Baghiraa Café & CoWork is a minimal waste café and co-working facility in Bangalore, India that is over 90% plastic free. Our café offers vegan/vegetarian, farm-to-table meals that align with our commitment to earth-conscious living.

Baghiraa Earth Labs is our vehicle for change. Creating and sharing knowledge is at the core of our mission. We are currently developing sites in Atlanta and Colorado that follow Earthship principles, using recycled materials to build spaces that include a co-working space and café for the community, an outdoor multi-use kitchen, residential quarters for employees, and a garden that also serves as a habitat for various farm animals. These locations will also function as educational resource centers focused on the use of recycled materials and will provide access to those materials for the broader community.

At Baghiraa, we believe that business can be "Ek Chingari" (spark) for positive change. We are committed to reducing waste, rethinking how spaces are built and used, and creating models of living and working that are healthy, inclusive, and regenerative.

title: Recruitment Coordinator
description:
**Our Team**
As part of Koch Recruiting, you will join a dynamic team operating within a fast-paced, matrixed environment. Our team is distributed across various Koch subsidiaries, but we work in a collaborative environment where being agile and curious about working across businesses and functional areas is encouraged. We are part of the HR Capability Group and seek to attract and identify candidates to enable our businesses to select and hire individuals motivated to create superior value. * Coordinate on-campus and off-campus hiring activities, including sourcing, screening, assessments, interviews, selection, and offer-process support.
* Manage candidate communication from initial engagement through joining, conversion, non-conversion, or program closure.
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with university placement teams, training partners, assessment providers, and vendors.

* Monitor offered candidates, identify joining or withdrawal risks early, and coordinate timely support or escalation.
* Support internal and external Early Careers engagement activities and contribute to process improvements, templates, and standard work.

* Experience in recruitment coordination, talent acquisition, HR operations, campus hiring, or a related field.
* Experience coordinating multiple activities, stakeholders, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Working knowledge of candidate sourcing, screening, interview coordination, and offering or onboarding support for campus hires.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Teams, with the ability to maintain accurate data and reports.
* Demonstrated attention to detail, ownership, sound judgement, and disciplined follow-through.
* Ability to handle sensitive candidate and employee information with discretion.
* Ability to work independently, learn new processes quickly, and escalate risks or gaps early.
* Contribution motivation and alignment with Koch values, including integrity, respect, humility, and mutual benefit.

* Experience in Early Careers, campus recruitment, talent acquisition, or HR operations, university relations.
* Experience supporting internship, apprenticeship, trainee, graduate, or volume-hiring programs.
* Experience working with Avature, MyHR, an applicant tracking system, or an HR information system.
* Exposure to apprentice administration, government portals, compliance documentation, or lifecycle coordination.
* Experience managing university relationships, assessment partners, vendors, procurement, or hiring-event logistics.
* Ability to use data and reporting to identify risks, support decisions.
* Potential to grow from operational coordination into independent Early Careers program ownership.

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

The current portfolio combines significant scale with a strong internal mobility agenda. Approximately 50% of hiring is internal and 50% external, with the majority of activity taking place at Associate or Senior Associate level.
  
  
The portfolio is concentrated in major global delivery locations with c55% of volume in India, c25% in the Philippines, and c10% in Poland.
  
  
Partnering closely with Operations, People and business leaders, the Director, Talent Acquisition, Operations will deliver outcomes across three strategic priorities: Quality, Speed and Insight. Beyond recruitment delivery, the role acts as a strategic advisor, using talent intelligence, workforce insight and labour-market expertise to influence hiring, skills, location and resourcing decisions.
  
  
The portfolio will continue to evolve as technology, automation and AI reshape work and skills requirements. The successful candidate will help Operations anticipate this shift, balancing current delivery at scale with increasing demand for more specialised, analytical, transformation-oriented and senior talent. The role will also maximise opportunities for internal talent movement and career progression.
  
  
The successful candidate will be a key member of the Global Talent Acquisition Leadership Team, contributing to enterprise-wide Talent Acquisition strategy, transformation priorities and the continued evolution of LSEG’s hiring capabilities.
  
  
**Scope**

* Global responsibility for Operations Talent Acquisition.
* Leadership of c20 Talent Acquisition professionals across multiple locations.
* Delivery of approximately 2,000 hires annually.
* Accountability for hiring across operational, change, transformation, controls, specialist and leadership disciplines up to Director level.
* Member of the Global Talent Acquisition Leadership Team, helping shape enterprise Talent Acquisition strategy and priorities.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Strategic Talent Partner
* Develop and implement Talent Acquisition strategies aligned to Operations workforce requirements, location strategy and business priorities.
* Partner with Operations and People leaders to shape workforce plans, anticipate how skills and role requirements will evolve, and address emerging capability gaps.
* Act as a trusted advisor, providing market insight, talent intelligence and data-driven recommendations that improve workforce, location and hiring decisions.
* Help leaders balance external recruitment, internal mobility, capability building and workforce redeployment as the composition of demand changes.
* Hiring Delivery and Performance
* Own end-to-end hiring outcomes for the Operations portfolio, balancing quality, speed, candidate experience and cost.
* Create clear portfolio priorities, service expectations and performance rhythms that translate demand into executable hiring plans.
* Use data to identify demand, capacity, conversion, ageing and location risks, intervening early to improve outcomes.
* Differentiate hiring approaches by segment, combining scalable delivery for recurring demand with specialist-led and advisory models for more complex and senior roles.
* Accelerate internal mobility by improving visibility of opportunities and enabling effective movement of talent across the organisation.

**Leadership and Capability**

* Lead, develop and hold accountable a globally distributed Talent Acquisition team, creating clarity of purpose, priorities and performance expectations.
* Evolve the team’s capability as the portfolio shifts from predominantly high-volume hiring towards more complex, specialist and senior requirements.
* Build an impactful, inclusive team with strong business knowledge, market expertise, commercial judgement and advisory capability.
* Ensure the team deploys capacity flexibly against business priorities and operates effectively across locations and time zones.

**Transformation and Enterprise Contribution**

* Champion consistent, technology-enabled and insight-led hiring practices across the portfolio.
* Use automation and AI-assisted workflows to improve scalability, quality and speed, with appropriate human oversight and governance.
* Help reshape the Talent Acquisition service as workforce demand evolves, ensuring recruiter capacity is increasingly focused on higher-value, complex and advisory work.
* Contribute to enterprise Talent Acquisition priorities and partner across Talent Acquisition, People Services and People Engineering to establish clear accountabilities and effective end-to-end delivery.

**Essential**
**Experience and Qualifications**

* Significant Talent Acquisition leadership experience supporting operations, service delivery, business services or similarly complex distributed organisations.
* Proven track record of leading hiring at scale across a broad range of operational and leadership talent, with the judgement to differentiate volume, specialist and senior hiring approaches.
* Strong business partnering and influencing skills, with the ability to challenge, advise and build credibility with senior leaders.
* Demonstrated ability to translate workforce and hiring strategies into measurable business outcomes.
* Experience evolving Talent Acquisition capability and capacity as business demand, skills requirements and service models change.
* Proven experience improving hiring performance through demand management, process discipline, data, technology and clear accountability.
* Experience using talent intelligence and analytics to improve hiring, workforce planning, internal mobility and location decisions.
* Ability to lead through ambiguity and change while maintaining delivery focus and team engagement.

**Preferred**

* Experience within financial services, financial markets infrastructure, technology-enabled services, shared services or another highly regulated global environment.
* Experience leading, developing and being accountable for the performance and outcomes of geographically distributed Talent Acquisition teams.
* Experience leading Talent Acquisition across multiple geographies and major operational hubs, particularly India, the Philippines and Poland.
* Responsibility for a talent portfolio of significant scale and complexity, spanning volume, specialist, change and leadership hiring.
* Experience supporting Operations organisations through transformation, organisational redesign, location strategy or operating model change.
* Experience implementing AI-enabled, technology-driven or automation-led Talent Acquisition solutions with appropriate governance and human oversight.
* Experience building internal mobility and talent redeployment into the hiring model.
* Experience working as part of a senior Talent Acquisition or People leadership team, contributing to broader enterprise priorities.

**Why Join LSEG?**
This is an opportunity to lead a significant global Talent Acquisition portfolio at the centre of how LSEG serves customers, manages risk and delivers operational performance.
  
  
The immediate challenge is substantial: a team of approximately 20 supporting around 2,000 hires annually across a globally distributed portfolio, with internal mobility accounting for approximately half of hiring. The broader opportunity is to help shape how the portfolio evolves as technology changes work, skills requirements become more complex and a greater share of Talent Acquisition capacity moves towards specialist and advisory activity.
  
  
The role offers exposure to senior Operations, People and enterprise leaders globally, and the opportunity to influence workforce composition, location, capability and career mobility across one of LSEG’s largest employee populations.
  
  
As a member of the Global Talent Acquisition Leadership Team, the successful candidate will help shape the future direction of Talent Acquisition across LSEG while partnering directly with Operations leaders on important workforce and transformation priorities.
  
  
We are interested in established Talent Acquisition leaders as well as high-potential individuals ready to step into a broader global leadership role. The critical requirement is a track record of leading complex hiring portfolios, developing high-performing teams and influencing business outcomes through talent expertise, insight and execution.
  
  
**ABOUT US:**
LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.

We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 65 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers.

title: Senior Manager Talent Acquisition
description:
As Senior Manager – Talent Acquisition, you will lead senior and leadership hiring across Refyne Group: CXO, business heads and specialist leaders across finance, legal, compliance, governance and capital markets. You will partner directly with founders and the CXO team, run confidential searches end to end, and act as the trusted advisor in every hiring decision at the top of the house.

This is a player-coach role. You will close the hardest searches yourself, and you will build and mentor the TA team so it can run at your standard without you in every loop.

**How You'll Make an Impact:**

**Leadership & CXO Hiring**

* Own end-to-end search for CXO, business head and senior specialist roles across Refyne Group entities, from role calibration to offer close.
* Lead hiring for finance and governance leadership, finance control, treasury and capital raising, legal, compliance and company secretarial, where regulatory depth and judgment matter as much as pedigree.
* Run confidential and replacement searches with discretion, managing sensitive stakeholder and candidate communication.
* Map talent across fintech, NBFCs, banks, insurance and Big 4 to build warm leadership pipelines before roles open.

**Founder & CXO Partnership**

* Work directly with founders and CXOs to turn a business problem into a sharp role brief: mandate, success in 12 months, must-haves vs. trainables.
* Bring a point of view on market availability, compensation benchmarks and trade-offs; push back when the brief or the bar is wrong.
* Pitch Refyne to senior candidates with credibility, and handle complex negotiations across CTC, ESOPs, joining bonuses and notice buyouts.

**Strategy & Process**

* Build the leadership hiring playbook: structured interview loops, assessment design, case or presentation rounds, and reference and background checks for senior roles.
* Own search partner strategy: select, brief and manage executive search firms on cost, quality and speed.
* Track and report leadership hiring metrics (time to close, offer acceptance, quality of hire, 12-month retention) to the Chief of Staff and founders.
* Raise the employer brand with senior talent through targeted outreach, leadership networks and industry forums.

**Strategy & Process**

* Mentor and coach the TA team on sourcing depth, stakeholder management and closing; review their pipelines and unblock them.
* Set the example as an IC: take the toughest searches, show how they are run, and turn those lessons into team practice.
* Diagnose what is breaking in hiring, funnel, process or brief and solve it with the team, not around it.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

* 10–14 years in talent acquisition, with at least 5 years focused on senior and leadership hiring (VP, CXO and board-adjacent roles).
* A track record of closing leadership roles in finance, legal, compliance or governance
* Comfortable in the room with founders and CXOs: you advise, challenge and close, not just coordinate.
* Deep networks and sourcing craft for passive senior talent, plus experience managing executive search partners.
* Strong command of senior compensation: benchmarking, ESOPs, variable pay and negotiation.
* Experience leading or mentoring a recruiting team, while still carrying an IC hiring load.

**Good to have**

* Experience in fintech, NBFCs, banking, insurance or financial services, or hiring for them from a search firm.
* Familiarity with regulated environments (RBI, IRDAI, SEBI) and the fit-and-proper expectations they place on senior hires.
* Multi-entity or group-level hiring experience.

title: AVP- Radiologist Experience and Engagement
description:
About Teleradiology Solutions

Teleradiology Solutions (TRS) is a pioneer in teleradiology, delivering round-the-clock diagnostic radiology reporting and support to hospitals and healthcare providers across India, the US, and other global markets. Founded in 2002 by two Yale-trained physicians and headquartered in Ardmore, PA, TRS today serves over 150 hospitals across 21 countries.

The company pairs a network of board-certified radiologists — including ABR-certified specialists — with technology-driven workflows and its AI-enabled arm, dAIgnostiX, to deliver fast, accurate, and reliable imaging interpretation. dAIgnostiX is based out of Bengaluru (Whitefield). TRS/dAIX also maintains an active academic focus (www.radguru.net) and ongoing research interests, including AI in radiology.

TRS is set for rapid growth, at a CAGR above 25%. That growth depends on American Board Radiologists (ABRs): the size, deployment and satisfaction (NPS) of the ABR panel is the binding constraint. The panel has about 100 ABRs today, with a substantial increase planned in the coming months.

The ABR journey is split across several teams, including Onboarding, Scheduling and Assigning, and no one owns the ABR's experience end to end. The result is a paradox: the company reports a capacity shortage, while ABRs say they are underused. Part of the capacity gap is really a deployment gap, and closing it is faster than recruiting alone.

This role is the single owner of that journey. You will lead everything that decides whether an ABR is credentialed, scheduled, supported and productive. You will own ABR capacity and productivity, and ABR satisfaction.

Key responsibilities

* Own ABR (
  American Board Radiologists )
  capacity and productivity . Be the named owner of ABR utilisation (actual vs. contracted hours), productivity, and the capacity gap against planned revenue. Make these live, per-ABR numbers, not a one-off analysis. Calculate the capacity gap net of utilisation recovery, so recruiting decisions rest on real utilisation rather than an inflated shortage.
* Deploy before you recruit. Run an ABR-by-ABR diagnostic across the full roster, starting with the highest-hours group. Tag a root cause and a named owner for each, and work through the fixes with Operations Delivery, who own case assignment.
* Own the pipeline from offer to first live shift. Recruitment and HR source candidates; you own everything after: offer, licensing and credentialing, orientation and the first live shift. Set a time-to-first-read target and keep bringing it down.
* Credential to match demand. Credential against forecast demand, not whoever is next in the queue. Introduce a rule that each ABR agrees their hospital list before applications start. Set up a live credentialing feed into Scheduling, so a hospital approved on Monday can be scheduled on Tuesday.
* Run ABR experience and engagement. Give every ABR one point of contact and a set rhythm: a weekly pulse, a monthly review and a quarterly plan. Track every concern from intake to closure: acknowledge within 24 hours, and resolve operational and IT issues within 48–72 hours. Set up a real ABR satisfaction measure (an open item in the KPI framework today). Manage no-show rate and annualized attrition as leading indicators, not just reported numbers.
* Shape the ABR proposition: technology, terms and training. Be the ABR's voice wherever their working day is shaped.
* Technology first. Image load, dictation workflow, RADSpa friction and pre-read or AI support are the most common complaints. Sponsor a ranked fix list with the technology team, and a pre-read pilot with volunteer ABRs, measured in RVUs per hour.
* Training. Shape training and onboarding of new and existing ABRs
* Chair the shared ABR-capacity forum. Run forum that brings together scheduling decisions, credentialing status, assignment practice and utilisation data. Keep one shared tracker so every team sees gaps at the same time, and agree a clear escalation path.
* Build the leadership bench. Build a real management layer with succession depth as the roster and volume triple, and give new leaders the structure, tools and coaching to grow.

Candidate profile

* You have led a multi-team clinical or physician-workforce operation and have managed managers. Teleradiology, locum or physician staffing, hospital medical-staff services and similar clinician-supply settings all count.
* What matters is that you have been accountable for a panel of expert, independent clinicians: recruiting, credentialing and scheduling them, and keeping them productive and engaged.

You should be able to show

* A track record of growing and deploying a clinician or specialist panel, with real numbers on utilisation, time to onboard and attrition.
* Hands-on command of scheduling and capacity planning, including forecasting, no-show design, and choosing or implementing a scheduling platform.
* Comfort with credentialing and licensing in a regulated environment.
* Data fluency: you read utilisation, RVUs per hour and no-show data yourself and run the function by the numbers.
* Credibility with radiologists and other physicians. They trust you enough to be honest about why they are not showing up, and you can hold a hard conversation without it feeling punitive.
* The ability to lead through influence across functions you do not own (Operations Delivery, Technology, Finance), and to build a management layer beneath you.

We are looking for an engineering manager to join our Human Capital Development (HC Dev) team based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram. HC Dev builds and operates the core platforms and data systems that support how the firm hires, assesses, develops, and retains its people. We are in the midst of a broader evolution of these platforms, spanning their data foundations and use of AI, creating significant opportunities to shape their architecture, technical direction, and future.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
In this role, you will lead an engineering team with ownership of its technical direction and delivery. You will work closely with other engineering managers and senior engineers across HC Dev, shape the roadmap in partnership with the business, drive architecture and engineering quality, and develop the engineers on your team. You will lead the design and delivery of web applications, data platforms, and supporting infrastructure, working closely with business stakeholders and product managers. You will set the technical direction for the systems your team owns, working with senior engineers and leads to drive architecture, key design decisions, and engineering quality. The team’s technology stack includes Java/Spring, React/TypeScript, SQL Server, and Python. You will manage a team of engineers, including senior engineers and leads, with responsibility for performance, career growth, and team effectiveness. You will shape the roadmap for your area with business leadership and product managers, and own planning, estimation, capacity planning, and scope management while navigating delivery risks, trade-offs, and escalations independently. You will remain close to design and development, guiding the team on engineering best practices and providing technical leadership on complex, high-impact problems. You will mentor engineers on both technology and domain aspects to support their growth and development.
  
  
**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic Qualifications:
  
  

* A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related field, with 8 to 11 years of relevant experience
* Robust software design and architecture experience, with sound judgment on trade-offs involving scalability, availability, security, and maintainability
* Experience managing and developing engineers, including providing feedback, coaching, and supporting career growth
* Proven ability to work with senior stakeholders, shape requirements and technical direction, build alignment, and handle escalations independently
* Solid software engineering background across web applications, backend services, or data-intensive systems, with experience building and operating production systems at scale
* Proven experience delivering complex projects end to end, including planning, estimation, execution, and course correction
* Robust problem-solving and analytical skills, with a focus on engineering quality and sound technical judgment
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and business stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Experience engineering production AI systems, including retrieval, agentic workflows, tool use, model orchestration, and integration with enterprise data and services
* Experience taking AI capabilities from prototype to production, including evaluation, observability, reliability, and operating these systems as models and underlying dependencies evolve
