title: Talent Acquisition Operations Specialist
description:
**Location:** Pune, India (Hybrid)

**Position Summary**
--------------------

Bentley Systems is seeking a **Talent Acquisition Operations Specialist** to support the day-to-day operations behind our global hiring process. In this role, you will help ensure interview scheduling runs smoothly across L1–L3 hiring stages, proactively monitor recruitment activity for potential time-to-fill (TTF) risks, and support the development of a more streamlined, data-driven Talent Acquisition operation.

You will work closely with the Sr. Talent Acquisition Partner, Operations Lead to bring greater visibility and consistency to recruitment processes, turning manual and reactive activities into more structured and proactive workflows. You will also help identify opportunities to improve processes through automation and workflow solutions that reduce administrative effort across the Talent Acquisition team.

This role is well suited for someone who is highly organized, comfortable managing processes from end to end, and motivated by finding practical ways to make recruiting operations more efficient and effective.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

### **Interview Scheduling & Coordination**

* Own interview scheduling across L1–L3 hiring stages, coordinating availability among candidates, interviewers, and hiring managers.
* Manage interview logistics, including calendars, meeting rooms, video links, and rescheduling, while creating a smooth experience for all parties.
* Serve as a point of contact for interview scheduling questions, issues, and conflicts.

### **Time-to-Fill (TTF) Monitoring**

* Monitor requisitions and candidates moving through the recruitment pipeline and flag activity that has remained idle in the system for more than 72 hours.
* Proactively follow up on stalled recruitment activities, including pending interview feedback, unscheduled next-round interviews, and outstanding approvals.
* Work with relevant stakeholders to resolve outstanding actions and keep hiring processes moving forward.
* Escalate persistent bottlenecks to the Sr. Talent Acquisition Partner, Operations Lead.

### **Dashboards & Reporting**

* Maintain and update recruitment dashboards tracking time-to-fill, pipeline health, and stage-by-stage aging.
* Support data accuracy across the applicant tracking system (ATS) and reporting tools and flag discrepancies for resolution.
* Support ad hoc reporting requests for Talent Acquisition leadership.

### **Process Improvement & Automation**

* Track recruitment process updates and changes and maintain accurate, current process documentation.
* Identify repetitive or manual activities that could be streamlined or automated.
* Support the development of workflow automations and solutions that reduce administrative effort across the Talent Acquisition team.
* Partner with the Sr. Talent Acquisition Partner, Operations Lead to pilot and implement process improvements across Talent Acquisition.

### **General Operations Support**

* Provide operational support to the Sr. Talent Acquisition Partner, Operations Lead.
* Support the broader Talent Acquisition team with operational activities as priorities and business needs evolve.

**Qualifications**
------------------

  

* Minimum 3–5 years of relevant experience in recruitment coordination, Talent Acquisition operations, HR operations, or a related role, ideally within a Talent Acquisition environment.
* Strong organisational and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage multiple activities, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Experience working with an Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
* Experience developing or maintaining reports and dashboards using Excel, Power BI, or similar tools.
* A proactive approach to problem-solving and follow-through, with the ability to identify and pursue outstanding actions through resolution.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with candidates, interviewers, hiring managers, and Talent Acquisition colleagues.
* Ability to work flexibly across 2nd or 3rd shifts to support collaboration with global teams and stakeholders across different time zones.
* Interest in recruitment process improvement, operational efficiency, and automation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with recruitment metrics, including time-to-fill (TTF), pipeline conversion, and offer acceptance rates.
* Experience supporting global or multi-location recruitment teams.
* Previous exposure to workflow automation tools or experience developing simple process automations.

This is a Hybrid role.  

**What We Offer:**

* Step into a collaborative work environment where ideas flourish, and teamwork propels us forward towards shared success.
* An attractive salary and benefits package.
* Bentley Impact Day: take a day off from work to volunteer with an organization of your choice.
* Celebrate milestone achievements and moments that matter through our colleague recognition award programs and our Bentley Achievers platform.
* A commitment to inclusion, belonging and colleague wellbeing through global initiatives and resource groups.
* Be part of a company committed to making a real difference by advancing the world’s infrastructure for better quality of life, where your contributions help build a more sustainable, connected, and resilient world. Discover our latest user success stories for an insight into our global impact.

**Who We Are:**

Bentley Systems (Nasdaq: BSY) is the infrastructure engineering software company. We provide innovative software to advance the world’s infrastructure – sustaining both the global economy and environment. Our industry-leading software solutions are used by professionals, and organizations of every size, for the design, construction, and operations of roads and bridges, rail and transit, water and wastewater, public works and utilities, buildings and campuses, mining, and industrial facilities. Our offerings, powered by the iTwin Platform for infrastructure digital twins, include MicroStation and Bentley Open applications for modeling and simulation, Seequent’s software for geoprofessionals, and Bentley Infrastructure Cloud encompassing ProjectWise for project delivery, SYNCHRO for construction management, and AssetWise for asset operations. Bentley Systems’ 5,200 colleagues generate annual revenues of more than $1 billion in 194 countries.

Bentley is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and considers for employment all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, gender/gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, marital status, religion/belief, national origin, caste, age, or any other characteristic protected by local law or unrelated to job qualifications.

title: Senior Human Resources Manager
description:
**Role:**
Senior Manager – Human Resources

**Function:**
Human Resources

**Location:**
Delhi

**Type:**
Full-time

**Industry:**
Media Production, Broadcast Media, Online Media

**About Company**

One of India's largest private FM radio networks, reaching 40 million+ listeners weekly. The company broadcasts across 49 cities, 1,000+ towns, and 50,000 villages.

It is the only private FM station broadcasting from Jammu & Kashmir, with an international presence in Singapore and Bhutan. Its digital platform extends the brand into curated lifestyle, music, and entertainment content.

The company operates at the intersection of legacy broadcasting and digital innovation, with a team of 740.

**Position Overview**

This is a senior, standalone HR role embedded within the company's digital entertainment vertical. The person in this role will own the full people function: building hiring pipelines across creative, content, and tech talent; designing compensation structures; and driving performance and culture initiatives as the business scales. This is a core team position with direct influence on how the vertical attracts, retains, and develops its workforce.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end talent acquisition for the digital entertainment vertical — sourcing, assessing, and onboarding profiles across digital content, creative, product, and technology functions
* Design and execute structured onboarding programs that accelerate time-to-productivity for new hires across creative and tech tracks
* Lead compensation benchmarking exercises and build salary bands aligned to digital entertainment and tech market standards
* Drive the full performance management cycle — goal-setting, mid-year reviews, calibration, and feedback frameworks
* Build and sustain employee engagement programs, culture rituals, and internal communication initiatives specific to a digital-first team
* Partner with business leaders to identify org design needs and translate them into hiring and people plans
* Track and report HR metrics (attrition, offer-to-join ratio, engagement scores) to leadership and iterate on people strategy accordingly

**Must Have Criteria**

* 8–12 years of HR generalist or HRBP experience, with demonstrated ownership of the full people function
* End-to-end talent acquisition experience spanning both creative/content roles (writers, producers, RJs) and tech roles (engineers, product managers) within a digital entertainment or media business
* Hands-on experience designing or restructuring compensation bands and conducting market benchmarking
* Prior ownership of performance management cycles — including framework design, calibration, and manager enablement
* Experience running employee engagement and culture-building programs in a team of 100+ employees
* Comfortable operating as a standalone or lean-team HR function with high ownership expectations

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience in a startup or new business unit setup — building HR processes from scratch
* Exposure to OTT, digital content, or media-tech companies
* Familiarity with HRMS and ATS platforms used in mid-size media or tech organizations
* MBA or Post Graduate Diploma in HR from a recognized institution

**What We Offer**

* Core team membership in the digital entertainment vertical — a high-visibility, high-ownership role within a legacy media brand entering digital entertainment
* Onsite presence at Aerocity, Delhi — a modern, well-connected work hub
* Opportunity to shape people strategy and culture for a greenfield digital business backed by one of India's largest FM networks
* Exposure to cross-functional leadership across content, tech, and business teams

title: Human Resources Executive
description:
**About Supertalks**

Supertalks by The Moving Ship is a podcast and digital media brand producing in-depth conversations with thinkers, researchers, spiritual teachers and founders.

**About the role**

As HR Manager, you will own the complete employee lifecycle at Supertalks, from hiring to exit. You’ll build and run the systems for recruitment, onboarding, records, payroll inputs and performance, and be the first point of contact for the team.

**What you’ll do**

***Hiring and onboarding***

* Run recruitment end to end: post openings, screen candidates, schedule interview rounds and present final shortlists for decision

* Maintain employment records: contracts, NOCs, offer letters and salary revision letters
* Track attendance and leaves, and prepare monthly payout sheets for approval
* Handle exits: resignations, full and final settlements, experience and relieving letters

***Performance and culture***

* Build and run a KPI tracking system with monthly reviews and documented feedback
* Be the first point of contact for team concerns, and resolve them early
* Communicate company policies clearly: working hours, studio discipline, system access and NDAs

* Minimum 2 years of HR experience covering recruitment and HR operations
* Hands-on experience with end-to-end hiring, onboarding and exits
* Working knowledge of offer letters, contracts and payroll inputs such as attendance, leave and payouts
* Strong communication skills and comfort handling sensitive conversations
* Good command of Excel or Google Sheets
* Experience in a media, creative or startup environment is a plus

About Bloom Café

Bloom Café is a hospitality and lifestyle brand focused on delivering an excellent customer experience through quality service, hospitality, and a welcoming environment. We are looking for a proactive and responsible HR Executive to manage day-to-day HR operations and support our growing team.

Job Overview

We are looking for an HR Executive who can independently manage recruitment, employee relations, attendance, payroll coordination, HR documentation, and staff management. The ideal candidate should have good communication skills, a strong understanding of HR processes, and the ability to coordinate effectively with café management and operational teams.

Key Responsibilities
  

**1. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition**

* Manage end-to-end recruitment for café and corporate positions.
* Source candidates through job portals, social media, and recruitment platforms.
* Conduct initial screening and schedule interviews.
* Coordinate with department heads for hiring requirements.
* Manage joining formalities and onboarding.

**2. HR Operations & Administration**

* Maintain employee records, personal files, and HR databases.
* Manage attendance, leaves, shifts, and employee working hours.
* Coordinate monthly payroll processing and salary-related queries.

* Coordinate staff training and development activities.
* Support management in resolving operational and employee-related issues.

**5. HR Policies & Compliance**

* Implement and communicate HR policies and procedures.
* Maintain leave, attendance, and employee disciplinary records.
* Support statutory compliance and maintain relevant documentation.
* Ensure smooth execution of HR processes across the organisation.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in HR operations and recruitment.
* Experience in hospitality, cafés, restaurants, or retail will be preferred.
* Good verbal and written communication skills in English and Hindi.

* Strong coordination, problem-solving, and interpersonal skills.

* Good understanding of employee management and workplace discipline.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced hospitality environment.
* Flexible and comfortable coordinating with employees across different shifts.

As per industry standards and candidate experience.

title: Manager - Operations
description:
**About Udhyam**
Udhyam Learning Foundation is on a mission towards Making Bharat Entrepreneurial. We believe that
  
  
entrepreneurship is a powerful way to channelize an individual’s potential. Entrepreneurship enables agency and allows an individual to work on their strengths while creating value for the world.
  
  
Our Programs
  
  

* Udhyam Shiksha works on developing entrepreneurial mindsets among the youth and enabling them to achieve their potential, having impacted :47,00,000 learners across 12 Indian states.
* Udhyam Vyapaar focuses on nano businesses in India, and solving large problems faced by them, at scale; having already enabled 10000+ entrepreneurs.

**About Maadhyam**
Maadhyam is Udhyam’s initiative to bridge the gap between government school students and opportunities beyond the classroom.
  
  
Working with students in Grades 9–12, Maadhyam helps young people discover and access opportunities that can shape their future — from scholarships and internships to exposure visits, mentorships, courses and employment pathways.
  
  
The program is currently embedded within government school systems across Haryana, Punjab and Uttarakhand. In its first three months, Maadhyam reached over 4,500 students and generated 14 offers.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Manager to lead Maadhyam’s operations team and help shape the next phase of the program.
  
  
The person will manage a team across Maadhyam operations, student engagement and content creation. They will guide and mentor the team, enable independent ownership, and ensure strong execution across functions.
  
  
The role will work closely with the Director – Maadhyam to shape strategy, identify opportunities for growth and translate these into execution.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Strategy & Program Development
  
  

* Work with the Director and define Maadhyam’s strategy, priorities and approach.You will own the operations outcomes across all states.
* Understand the opportunity ecosystem for young people and identify gaps and potential areas for Maadhyam to build.
* Translate strategy into clear plans across operations, student engagement and content.
* Use insights from students, partners and the team to continuously improve the program.

Team Leadership
  
  

* Lead, manage and develop the central and state teams for Maadhyam.
* Set clear priorities and outcomes while enabling team members to independently own their areas.
* Coach team members on problem-solving, stakeholder management and quality of execution and build a culture of ownership, collaboration and accountability.

Opportunities & Student Engagement
  
  

* Plan daily school & student engagement with field teams, and hold the teams to execution accountability
* Guide the team in taking partners to school, design the interventions, build buzz, follow up with students, and supporting students in understanding about and applying to opportunities & beyond
* Own teacher and student led models in target schools, be outcome focussed and devise execution plans accordingly
* Build a team that is empathetic towards students, and can work with students, teachers, parents and the partners you identify to collectively ensure students can access more opportunities with greater confidence
* Build content & digital media engagement strategies to find ways to engage students, unearth their aspirations, expose them to new learning and career pathways

Partnerships & Ecosystem
  
  

* Support the team in converting partnerships into meaningful, high-quality opportunities for students.
* Help navigate complex stakeholders and build long-term relationships.

Execution & Learning
  
  

* Build and maintain strong relationships with government officials, partner organisations, resource persons, district officials, school principals and teachers.
* Establish systems for monitoring program implementation and outcomes. Build the team's capacity to collect, analyse and use data for decision-making, identify gaps and drive corrective actions.
* Foster a culture of experimentation and learning, identifying what is working and what needs to change.
* Drive improvements in how Maadhyam operates and delivers outcomes for students.
* Take overall accountability for performance, proactively identify opportunities and challenges, make informed decisions, and ensure timely achievement of program goals.
* Work closely with State teams, Curriculum, M&E, Product & Tech, HR, Communications and other teams to ensure effective planning, coordination and delivery.

What We're Looking For
  
  

* 7–10 years of experience, with meaningful experience in the development, education, social sector, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of one or more areas relevant to Maadhyam — youth/student engagement, content creation, ecosystem building or program implementation.
* Strong strategic thinking with the ability to get into the details and drive execution.
* Excellent communication in English and Hindi, networking and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong ownership, grit and bias for action and experimentation, with the ability to take initiative, lead teams and drive tasks to completion.
* Comfort working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment.
* Excited by Maadhyam’s mission of expanding access to opportunities for young people who have limited guidance, exposure and confidence in accessing them.
* Strong experience in team management and large-scale operations, with the ability to experiment, pilot new approaches and deliver results with limited resources.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams, government stakeholders, partners and other external stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving skills, adaptability, and a continuous willingness to learn, improve, and respond effectively to changing program needs.

**Job Description – Assistant to Group Administration Head**

**Organisation:**
Delhi Public School Ghaziabad Society (DPSGS)

**Reporting to:**
Group Administration Head

**Experience:**
10–15 years of relevant experience

**Location:**
Central Office, with travel to school campuses

**Role Purpose**

Support the Group Administration Head in coordinating administration across DPSGS schools, preparing accurate MIS, analysing operational performance and ensuring timely completion of assigned actions. The role requires a proactive professional with strong cross-functional communication, sound judgement and a practical approach to solving problems.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **Cross-functional coordination**

* Coordinate with Principals, Campus Admin Managers, Transport, Projects, Procurement, Finance, HR and IT teams.
* Communicate management directions clearly and follow up on commitments, dependencies and pending decisions.

1. **MIS and management reporting**

* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly MIS covering administration, transport, maintenance, security, housekeeping, manpower, expenditure and ongoing projects.
* Validate information received from schools and highlight exceptions, trends and overdue actions.
* Prepare concise dashboards, presentations and management review reports.

* Analyse operational issues, recurring complaints, cost variations and performance gaps.
* Identify root causes and recommend practical solutions with clear responsibilities, timelines and resource requirements.
* Track corrective actions and verify their effectiveness.

1. **Planning and follow-through**

* Maintain a consolidated action tracker for all campuses and central administration functions.
* Prioritise tasks according to safety, urgency and operational impact.
* Escalate unresolved issues with supporting facts and recommended action.

1. **Meetings and communication**

* Prepare meeting agendas, review presentations, minutes and action points.
* Draft professional emails, reports, circulars and correspondence on behalf of the Group Administration Head.
* Coordinate meetings, campus visits and operational reviews.

1. **Operational and compliance monitoring**

* Track preventive maintenance, safety inspections, statutory renewals, vendor commitments and audit observations with the responsible teams.
* Maintain organised records and supporting evidence for reviews and audits.
* Immediately escalate safety concerns and critical compliance gaps.

1. **Process improvement and digital systems**

* Support standardisation of reporting formats, SOPs and administrative processes.
* Coordinate implementation and adoption of ERP/COSMOS modules and other digital tools.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, optimise manpower and control costs.

* Visit campuses to verify reported progress, understand operational concerns and coordinate corrective action.
* Support school events, new initiatives and special assignments entrusted by the Group Administration Head.

**Qualifications and Competencies**

* Graduate; MBA or postgraduate qualification in management is preferred.
* 10–15 years of experience in administration, operations, management coordination or a similar role; experience across multiple locations is preferred.
* Strong command of Excel, including PivotTables, lookup formulas, data analysis and dashboards.
* Proficiency in PowerPoint, Word and professional email drafting; Power BI knowledge is an advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, with confidence in interacting with senior management, Principals and external stakeholders.
* Strong analytical ability, attention to detail and a solution-oriented approach.
* Professional presence, effective presentation skills and the ability to work calmly under pressure.
* High standards of confidentiality, integrity, ownership and follow-through.

**Key Performance Measures**

* Accurate MIS and management reports submitted within agreed timelines.
* Assigned actions completed on time, with delays escalated promptly.
* Clear meeting records and consistent follow-up until closure.
* Timely visibility of operational risks, compliance deadlines and performance gaps.
* Demonstrable improvements in reporting quality, process efficiency and issue resolution.

title: Lead - Talent Acquistion, Retail
description:
New Delhi

**About this role**
-------------------

Role Purpose :

Lead Lenskart's national store hiring engine across Store Directors/Managers, Optometrists and store sales and operations staff. You will own demand-to-offer delivery end to end: precision hiring in the right clusters at the right cost, and a recruiter team that is skilled, measured and recognized. You will build processes that remove friction for recruiters and business teams rather than add to it.

  
  

Key Responsibilities :

1. Demand planning and hiring delivery

* Deliver hiring volumes, quality and speed for CAT-A/CAT-B stores and new store openings across all circles.
* Drive precision hiring: focus effort on based on business priorities; Allocate recruiters in line with business needs.

2. Process, governance and cost

* Own and evolve hiring governance to ensure Right Hiring at Right Cost, Right Place & with Right Quality.
* Ensure candidate level TATs against defined standards.
* Reduce cost of hiring while improving quality of hire and early retention.

3. Team leadership

* Lead, coach and develop 3–4 direct reports and, through them, the wider recruiter team.
* Run input-led performance management: daily tracking of interview lineups, shows and no-shows, evaluations, selections and offers during bulk hiring.
* Build a high-performance culture with clear goals, regular reviews, succession planning and recognition of the team's work.
* Develop a team through fact based problem solving and using constructive feedback mechanisms.

4. Stakeholder management and reporting

* Partner with Circle Heads, Store Operations, HRBPs, Finance and Compensation teams; act as the single point of accountability for retail hiring.
* Present clear MIS and dashboards to senior leadership on pipeline, conversion, cost, quality and recruiter productivity.
  

  

Success Metrics :

* Hiring plan achievement versus demand, by circle and cluster.
* Ensuring New Store hiring & deployment before the store opening date
* Offers per recruiter per working day, and funnel conversion (lineups to shows to selections to offers).
* Compensation grid compliance and cost per hire.
* Quality of hire: assessment pass rates and early attrition.
* Demand data accuracy and tracking discipline (CRM and daily trackers).
* Team capability, engagement and retention.
  

  

Who You Are :

Experience and Education :

* 6 - 10 years in Talent Acquisition, with at least 3 years leading high-volume retail, frontline or multi-location hiring.
* 2-3 years of experience in bulk hiring but from top pedigree colleges
* Proven experience managing a multi-level TA team, ideally including managers as direct reports.
* MBA / PGDM in HR or equivalent preferred.
  

  

Skills :

* Strong command of workforce planning, funnel metrics and data-led decision making; comfortable with Power BI, Excel/Google Sheets and CRM or ATS tools.
* Sound understanding of compensation structures and offer governance.
* Ability to build and scale processes while keeping recruiters and business teams on side.
* Excellent stakeholder influence, communication and coaching skills.
* Familiarity with regional hiring markets is a plus.

Join us and shape your story with Mott MacDonald, where everyone has the opportunity to be
**brilliant**
.
  
  
**Role**
The role is responsible for independently managing end‑to‑end Talent Development processes across India. This includes training coordination, stakeholder engagement, content support, performance management cycles (Connected Conversations), talent review processes, learning systems administration, reporting and communication management.
  
  
This position ensures seamless delivery of all talent development initiatives across the business, working closely with stakeholders, SMEs, global teams and external partners.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Learning Needs & Stakeholder Engagement**
  

+ Engage with business stakeholders to understand functional needs and recommend Unit/Function‑specific training and development plans.
+ Support the identification of skill gaps, learning needs and interventions required at an operational level.

**Learning Program Management**

+ Work with internal SMEs and external partners to scope, design, create and adapt training content.
+ Manage end‑to-end logistics, communication, attendance, and completion follow‑ups for all training initiatives.

**Learning Systems & Content Administration**

+ Upload, maintain and monitor training content, learner assignments, completions, and reporting accuracy.
+ Maintain and periodically update induction material, learning pathways, and guidance resources.

**Learning Communication & Knowledge Management**
  

+ Independently manage all L&D communication channels including SharePoint pages, Compass pages, newsletters and learning campaign messaging.
+ Ensure content is updated, user‑friendly, and promotes high employee engagement.

**Performance Management (Connected Conversations)**
  

+ Manage the entire Connected Conversations cycle including communication rollout, training and awareness sessions, query resolution, monitoring completion and facilitating escalations.
+ Track progress and ensure timely closure of the performance management process across India.

**Talent Review & Calibration Support**
  

+ Drive the annual Talent Review and Calibration process by coordinating schedules, collecting data, maintaining templates, and supporting facilitation.
+ Partner with the Talent Development Business Partner to ensure smooth execution and documentation.

**Global & Group Development Programmes**
  

+ Facilitate the nomination and selection process for Group/Global development programmes for India.
+ Support implementation and communication of Group programmes and contribute inputs as required.

**Data, Reporting & Insights**
  

+ Prepare periodic and on‑demand reports on training effectiveness, feedback, training hours, nominations, and completion metrics.
+ Analyse L&D budget utilisation vs spend and highlight variances.
+ Provide insights to continuously improve the learning experience.

**Continuous Improvement**
  

+ Contribute to the development and updating of L&D processes, policies, frameworks, and resources.
+ Recommend innovative tools, methodologies, and technologies to enhance learning delivery and impact.

* Strong coordination and project management
* Excellent communication (written and verbal)

* Learning system/LMS administration (SAP Success Factors and Articulate Rise is preferred)

* Data analysis and reporting
* High attention to detail and ownership
* Ability to manage multiple tasks independently
* Digital mindset and tech savviness

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in HR; certification in L&D or OD is an advantage.

description:

Powered by curiosity, courage, and innovation, our teams implement data, technology, and AI to create tomorrow, today.*

**Inviting Candidates for Senior Manager – Talent Sourcing and Recruitment**

**Responsibilities :-**

***Strategic Talent Acquisition Leadership***

* Develop and execute recruitment strategy, with a special focus on sourcing and screening, to meet hiring goals across multiple departments and geographies in the ANZ region.
* Lead large-scale, complex hiring – senior leadership and niche roles – with talent-pipeline management, market intelligence, and strong candidate assessment.
* Drive employer-branding initiatives and track their success in attracting top talent in a competitive market.
* Oversee requisition posting, candidate scheduling, pipeline tracking, and offer documentation through ATS tools (Avature, SuccessFactors), with hands-on proficiency in recruitment tools and an understanding of AI and agentic AI.
* Supervise pre-joining activities – documentation, compliance validation, third-party background checks, and onboarding-portal readiness.
* Hold delivery to SLAs, turn-around-times, and internal quality metrics; run random quality checks on candidate records, scheduling logs, and offer documentation; and handle exceptions and escalations.
* Champion the candidate and hiring-leader experience across brands – coach and influence hiring leaders, match talent pools to requisitions, and ensure timely, constructive candidate feedback.

***Always-On Pipeline Management***

* Build and maintain robust, visible leadership/Support talent pipelines through effective candidate tagging, talent pooling, and CRM utilization.
* Proactively source candidates for critical, niche, and leadership roles to ensure a continuous flow of qualified talent from existing and external pipelines.
* Drive recruitment efficiency by reducing hiring cycle times and ensuring timely movement of candidates through the recruitment process.
* Monitor open requisitions closely, proactively identify ageing positions, and escalate potential delays to support timely hiring outcomes.

***Elevating the Candidate & Hiring Manager Experience***

* Deliver a consistent, inclusive, and positive recruitment experience for all candidates throughout the hiring lifecycle.
* Ensure candidates receive timely, meaningful, and constructive feedback at every stage of the recruitment process.
* Partner closely with candidates and hiring managers through the offer stage, conducting regular engagement and expectation-setting discussions to support successful hiring outcomes.
* Build strong relationships with stakeholders to enhance engagement, transparency, and confidence in the recruitment process.

***Data-Led Talent Advisory***

* Provide market insights, talent availability information, and sourcing recommendations to support informed hiring decisions.
* Act as a trusted talent advisor to hiring managers by offering consultative guidance on recruitment strategies, talent trends, and market dynamics.
* Develop and position compelling Talent Value Propositions (TVPs) for roles to attract and engage both active and passive talent.
* Use recruitment data and market intelligence to influence hiring strategies and improve talent acquisition outcomes.

**Key Expectations**

* Demonstrate ownership and accountability for end-to-end leadership and support recruitment delivery.
* Maintain proactive communication with candidates, hiring managers, and stakeholders.
* Leverage talent market insights and data to drive hiring decisions and workforce planning.
* Champion an exceptional candidate and stakeholder experience.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve recruitment processes, efficiency, and outcomes.
* Foster collaboration, compliance, and operational discipline across all recruiting activities.

***Recruitment Delivery & Talent Acquisition***

* Lead end-to-end recruitment delivery for corporate, specialist, and high-volume frontline roles across the ANZ retail market – high-volume sourcing and screening, fast candidate engagement, and funnel management.
* Bring strong recruitment best practice, talent-pipeline management, market intelligence, and sourcing technique, and support employer branding for leadership roles.
* Give candidates and hiring leaders a positive, inclusive, and efficient experience; use talent pools to match candidate preferences to requisitions across brands; and provide timely, constructive feedback to unsuccessful candidates.
* Coach and influence hiring leaders on recruitment best practice and their own hiring process.

***Onboarding & Employee Experience***

* Run pre-joining activities cleanly – document collection, background and pre-employment check initiation and tracking, onboarding system readiness, and Day 1 planning.
* Maintain compliance with documentation checklists, background-verification protocols, and data-privacy standards such as GDPR and EEO.
* Work with global onboarding owners to tailor the support model to regional needs while keeping global consistency, and supervise exception handling (delayed checks, rehires, leadership onboarding) with clear stakeholder visibility and resolution.

***Workforce Data Administration***

* Ensure end-to-end accuracy of employee master-data transactions – hires, exits, transfers, promotions – across the HRIS (preferably SuccessFactors), and drive consistency and compliance across all master-data activity.
* Maintain documentation and quality controls for data compliance, audit readiness, and operational efficiency, and act as the liaison between business teams, HR, and IT on data-administration matters.

***Team Leadership & Capability***

* Lead and coach a team of recruiters – assign work effectively, balance workload, and build a culture of precision, accountability, learning, and collaboration across service delivery and the wider business.
* Manage staffing plans, shift rosters, and training to ensure full coverage across multiple time zones, and own the onboarding and integration of new team members to client-specific standards.
* Partner with leaders to secure strong frontline talent, support the team on complex cases and query management during peaks, and manage collaboration with retained teams.
* Drive engagement through a high-trust, inclusive, performance-oriented environment, and lead business-continuity planning for seasonal spikes and expansion into new hiring geographies or functions
* Support workforce planning – including BCP, capability development, and retention – resolve performance or process issues across your area, and model the purpose, values, and ways of working.

***Stakeholder & Vendor Management***

* Build strong relationships with HR, operations, and business leadership to align recruitment priorities, and manage vendor partnerships as needed.
* Act as the escalation point between the Genpact team and the client-retained recruitment leads, hiring managers, HRBPs, and wider HR.
* Run strategic reviews, governance calls, and quarterly business reviews (QBRs) to drive alignment and performance.
* Partner with client-side process owners to co-create continuous-improvement and employee-experience strategy, and anticipate needs during volume surges, org changes, or calendar-based recruitment cycles – adjusting operating plans proactively.

***Reporting, Process Excellence & Governance***

* Own weekly and monthly reporting on sourcing, screening, onboarding, and workforce-data metrics (volume, accuracy, experience), with periodic insight for internal leadership and the client.
* Run root-cause analysis for SLA misses or process errors, lead quality-assurance reviews and mitigation planning, and implement corrective actions.
* Drive lean process improvement and digitization – automation of trackers, templates, and dashboards – standardize SOPs and knowledge retention, and take part in UAT and change assessments during system changes or upgrades.
* Ensure strict adherence to data privacy and local labour law across workforce data and recruitment, put internal controls in place to detect and resolve data risks, and lead audits, internal reviews, and remediation.

***Risk, Compliance & Audit Readiness***

* Ensure strict adherence to labour law, corporate policy, and audit requirements across all in-scope processes.
* Lead periodic internal reviews, documentation audits, and risk assessments, and close audit gaps with preventive controls in high-risk areas – delayed background checks, data access, offer issuance, and HRIS data quality.

***Qualifications:-***

* MBA in HR or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of global recruitment, onboarding, end-to-end employee-lifecycle workflows, payroll operations, and service delivery.
* Experience in Talent Sourcing/Recruitment for international geographies like ANZ/US/UK/EMEA

**Why join Genpact?**

* Make an impact Drive change for global enterprises and solve business challenges that matter

**The Compensation Analyst supports the design, administration, and evaluation of compensation programs that attract, retain and engage employees across the enterprise. * Excellent attention to detail & ownership

Projects

description:
**3 months Contract**

**Role summary**- We are hiring an Application Support Executive to be the first point of contact for users of our business applications, keeping recruiters productive and issues moving to the right fix. You will troubleshoot, test releases, write the documentation and training material, and work with the development team to resolve application issues.

**Key responsibilities:**

**L1 application support:**  
**Be the first point of contact for application issues raised by email, chat or ticket; log, categorise and prioritise each one. Resolve L1 issues (access and permissions, login problems, data corrections, configuration queries, how-to questions) within agreed turnaround times. Escalate L2/L3 issues to the development team or the vendor with clear steps to reproduce, screenshots and business impact. Update the requester until closure and confirm the fix works.**

**Basic IT troubleshooting:**  
**Diagnose common user-side problems: browser, cache, network issues, etc. on application.**

**User access management:**

**Create, change and remove application access for joiners, movers and leavers, as per approved requests, and keep an audit trail. Review user lists and permissions periodically and flag excess or dormant access.**

**Data confidentiality and security :**  
**Handle candidate and client data in line with information-security and data-protection policies. Report suspected security incidents or data exposure immediately.**

**Testing**

**Prepare test cases and test new releases, fixes and configuration changes before they reach users (functional, regression and user acceptance testing). Log defects with clear reproduction steps and retest after the fix.**

**Documentation**

**Maintain a knowledge base of known issues, fixes and FAQs, and keep it current. Write and update SOPs, user guides, release notes and issue logs**.

**Training material**

**Create user guides, quick-reference sheets, short videos and slide decks for new features and new joiners. Run walkthroughs and refresher sessions for recruiters and business users when asked. Communicate releases and changes to users in plain language: what changed, what to expect and who to contact.**

**Working with the development team**

**Act as the link between users and developers: relay issues, clarify requirements and track fixes to closure. Join triage and release discussions, and flag recurring issues so the root cause gets fixed. Report weekly on ticket volumes, open issues, repeat problems and turnaround times. Page 2 of 4Job Description – Application Support Executive Log and follow up issues with external vendors and implementation partners, and keep users informed on their progress.**

**Reporting, data hygiene and continuous improvement**

**Prepare weekly ticket and issue reports for the Technology Leader. Spot and fix duplicate or incomplete records in the applications, within the access you have. Identify repeat issues and suggest automation, self-service fixes or knowledge-base articles to reduce tickets. Use AI tools to speed up triage, documentation and training content, with human review.**

**Skills and qualifications**

Must have Graduate in IT, Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent experience). 2–4 years in application support, helpdesk or IT support. Solid basic IT troubleshooting: Windows, browsers, networking basics, Microsoft 365. Experience with a ticketing or helpdesk tool and with writing clear defect reports. Hands-on experience writing test cases and running manual testing. Strong written English; able to write documentation and training material that nontechnical users can follow. Patient, service-minded communication with business users.

**Good to have**

Experience with business applications like an ATS/ CRM (Salesforce)/ HRMS/ SaaS tools in general. Familiarity with Jira or a similar tool for tracking bugs. Experience creating screen recordings or e-learning content. Prior experience in recruitment, HR tech or professional services.

title: Delivery & Release Coordinator (UAT and Quality) - IFS Logistics
description:
**Company Description**

IFS is a billion-dollar revenue company with 7000+ employees on all continents. Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of Service™. Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting-edge.

At IFS, we’re flexible, we’re innovative, and we’re focused not only on how we can engage with our customers but on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. We help solve some of society’s greatest challenges, fostering a better future through our agility, collaboration, and trust.

We celebrate diversity and understand our responsibility to reflect the diverse world we work in. We are committed to promoting an inclusive workforce that fully represents the many different cultures, backgrounds, and viewpoints of our customers, our partners, and our communities. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view.

By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a **global, diverse environment;** you will be joining a **winning team** with a **commitment to sustainability;** and a company where we get things done so that you can **make a positive impact** on the world.

We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can **#MakeYourMoment** so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference.

If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.

 **Job Description**

**About IFS Logistics**

IFS Logistics is an AI enterprise logistics platform that helps shippers and logistics businesses connect transport data, manage carrier spend and automate execution. Originally launched as 7bridges, the product is now part of IFS and is developed by a small, dedicated team.

**The role**

We are looking for a Delivery & Release Coordinator to manage user acceptance testing, release activity and day-to-day delivery coordination across the product team.

The team is preparing for its first IFS Cloud customer go-live, bringing a new API into production and recruiting a significant number of new colleagues. As the pace of delivery increases, we need clear ownership of test cycles, defects, release readiness and communication.

You will coordinate UAT with customers and internal stakeholders, maintain release plans and checklists, track defects through to resolution and support go/no-go decisions. You will work closely with Lorraine Hassall, our Quality Manager, allowing her to focus on quality standards and strategy while you manage the practical coordination required to apply them consistently.

Most of the role is focused on UAT, releases and delivery. It also includes a smaller amount of team coordination, particularly onboarding, in-person sessions, travel planning, and financial coordination.

**What you'll work on**

**UAT and release management**

* Plan and coordinate UAT cycles with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Confirm scope, participants, test windows, evidence and sign-off for each cycle.
* Track defects from identification through triage, ownership, resolution and closure.
* Support on the release calendar, release notes, readiness checklist and go/no-go process.
* Coordinate with other teams in IFS as the product is integrated with IFS Cloud.
* Support the UAT and release plan for Project Oliver and the first IFS Cloud customer go-live.

**Supporting the quality function**

* Work with the Quality Manager on test processes, evidence and audit trails.
* Help apply standards such as clear acceptance criteria, merge-request review and controlled production releases.
* Support the move from periodic manual QA towards per-ticket quality assurance and more frequent releases.

**Delivery coordination**

* Keep Jira accurate, with current statuses, acceptance criteria and links to relevant merge requests.
* Maintain useful documentation and decision records in Notion.
* Prepare concise delivery and release updates for product and engineering leads.
* Identify risks early, clarify ownership and follow actions through to completion.

**Team coordination**

* Organise onboarding logistics for new starters and monthly in-person sessions in Staines.
* Coordinate team travel, expenses and purchase orders.

 **Qualifications**

**What we're looking for**

* Strong organisation and follow-through, with a habit of identifying and addressing issues early.
* Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* The ability to work constructively with engineers and maintain agreed standards when priorities are competing.
* A practical, accountable approach to moving work forward without waiting for detailed direction.
* Experience coordinating UAT, software releases or delivery within a product or engineering team.
* Familiarity with release notes, test cycles, defect tracking, go/no-go decisions, acceptance criteria and regression scope.
* Experience managing a defect list through triage and resolution rather than only reporting its status.
* Confidence using Jira and a documentation platform such as Notion or Confluence.

Relevant backgrounds may include delivery coordination, release coordination, junior delivery management, QA coordination, scrum mastery or project coordination. We are more interested in what you have managed than in your previous job title.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with enterprise software involving customer UAT and formal sign-off.
* Exposure to regulated or audited environments, ERP products or supply-chain software.
* ISTQB, Agile or delivery certification.
* Experience working within a large organisation with established procurement and HR processes.
* Experience using AI tools to draft release notes, summarise defect lists or prepare status updates.

**Tools**

The team uses Jira, Notion, GitLab, Slack, Microsoft 365 and Outlook, along with IFS systems for travel, expenses and purchasing. You do not need to write code, but you should be comfortable working with engineers and understanding their delivery processes.

**What success looks like in the first six months**

* Releases follow a predictable cadence and include clear, accurate release notes.
* Each UAT cycle has an agreed owner, schedule, defect list, evidence and sign-off.
* Customer and support defects receive clear ownership and a visible route to resolution.
* The Project Oliver go-live is supported by a well-managed UAT and release plan.
* Acceptance criteria, review and release controls are applied consistently.
* Product and engineering leads spend less time on routine coordination and administration.

**Why we're hiring now**

The product team is growing and preparing for several important releases. The Quality Manager currently carries much of the practical coordination associated with testing and releases. This role will provide dedicated support of that work, helping the team increase delivery frequency while maintaining clear quality and release controls.

 **Additional Information**

*We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.*

title: Head of Human Resources
description:
**1. Job Overview**

**Lead the complete human resources function across Regal Jewellers’ corporate offices, regional offices and showrooms. Build a structured, accountable and technology-enabled HR department that supports business growth, workforce productivity, employee engagement and statutory compliance. Partner with the CEO, General Managers, Regional Managers, Department Heads and Showroom Managers.**

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**HR Strategy & Organisational Development**

**• Develop HR strategy aligned with business objectives and expansion plans.**

**• Define HR organisation structure, reporting relationships, approval matrices and accountability.**

**• Prepare manpower plans, annual HR budgets and succession plans.**

**• Standardise HR practices across offices, regions and showrooms.**

**Recruitment & Manpower Planning**

**• Own recruitment strategy for corporate, regional and showroom positions.**

**• Maintain approved headcount, vacancy tracking and hiring turnaround times.**

**• Govern sourcing, screening, interviews, selection, offers and onboarding.**

**• Monitor recruitment budgets, cost per hire, talent pipelines and probation confirmation.**

**HR Operations & Administration**

**• Oversee employee lifecycle from onboarding through separation.**

**• Maintain accurate employee master records and employment documentation.**

**• Govern transfers, promotions, designation and department changes.**

**• Monitor attendance, shifts, weekly offs, leave, overtime and field attendance.**

**• Implement standard workflows, approvals and regional HR audits.**

**Payroll, Compensation & Benefits**

**• Oversee accurate, on-time payroll, incentives, overtime, reimbursements and deductions.**

**• Coordinate payroll reconciliation and approvals with Finance and Accounts.**

**• Manage compensation structures, salary reviews, benefits and payroll budgets.**

**• Ensure timely full-and-final settlements and compensation confidentiality.**

**Employee Performance Management**

**• Define KRAs and KPIs for departments and employee categories.**

**• Implement appraisals, probation assessments and performance improvement plans.**

**• Review productivity, absenteeism, performance gaps and workforce utilisation.**

**• Support evidence-based promotions, increments and recognition.**

**HR Policies & Governance**

**• Develop employee handbook, HR policies and standard operating procedures.**

**• Govern attendance, leave, shifts, overtime, conduct, discipline and approvals.**

**• Communicate policy changes and ensure consistent implementation.**

**• Review policy compliance, exceptions and management escalations.**

**Statutory Compliance & Labour Laws**

**• Ensure compliance with applicable laws in Kerala, Karnataka and Tamil Nadu.**

**• Oversee PF, ESI, gratuity, professional tax and applicable wage/working-hour requirements.**

**• Maintain statutory filings, registrations, renewals and inspection records.**

**• Coordinate audits, corrective actions, legal advisors and workplace harassment prevention obligations.**

**HRMS & Digital Transformation**

**• Lead adoption and continuous improvement of RegalSoft HRMS.**

**• Maintain employee master data and workflows for attendance, leave, payroll, incentives and performance.**

**• Coordinate IT integrations, role-based access, audit trails and data security.**

**• Introduce automated dashboards and train HR teams and employees.**

**Employee Relations & Engagement**

**• Manage grievances, disciplinary matters and conflict resolution fairly and consistently.**

**• Develop employee engagement, recognition, retention and welfare initiatives.**

**• Review attrition, exit interviews and employee feedback.**

**• Advise managers on employee relations and workplace culture.**

**Training & Development**

**• Assess training needs across corporate and showroom operations.**

**• Plan induction, sales, service, leadership and operational training.**

**• Measure training completion and effectiveness.**

**• Develop internal talent and succession pipelines.**

**Regional & Showroom HR Management**

**• Oversee regional HR implementation and showroom staffing.**

**• Coordinate with Regional and Showroom Managers on attendance, discipline and performance.**

**• Conduct regional audits and resolve escalated HR issues.**

**• Support manpower mobilisation for new showroom openings.**

**HR Budgeting, Analytics & Reporting**

**• Prepare and track HR budgets, employee costs and recruitment expenditure.**

**• Publish monthly HR dashboards for hiring, attendance, attrition, payroll and performance.**

**• Review regional manpower utilisation and cost optimisation opportunities.**

**• Present risks, corrective actions and HR performance to CEO / Management.**

**3. Key Result Areas & Performance Indicators**

**KRA**

**KPI**

**Recruitment**

**Vacancy closure time; hiring plan achievement; cost per hire**

**Manpower**

**Approved vs actual headcount; vacancy percentage**

**HR Operations**

**Transaction turnaround time; employee data accuracy**

**Attendance**

**Compliance; absenteeism; unresolved exceptions**

**Payroll**

**Payroll accuracy; on-time processing**

**Retention**

**Attrition rate; critical employee retention**

**Performance**

**On-time performance review completion**

**HRMS**

**Adoption; data accuracy; workflow compliance**

**Compliance**

**Timely filings; audit issue closure**

**Employee Relations**

**Grievance resolution turnaround time**

**Training**

**Completion and effectiveness**

**Budget**

**Actual expenditure vs approved budget**

**Targets are to be agreed and approved by management based on operational requirements.**

**4. Qualifications & Experience**

**• MBA / Master’s degree in HR, Personnel Management or related discipline.**

**• 12–15 years of progressive HR experience, including 5 years in leadership.**

**• Experience managing multi-location HR operations; retail/jewellery experience preferred.**

**• Strong command of HRMS, payroll, employee performance and applicable employment regulations.**

**5. Core Competencies**

**Strategic HR leadership; organisational planning; talent acquisition; policy design; statutory compliance; payroll governance; employee relations; HRMS transformation; analytics; budget control; communication; confidentiality and integrity.**

**6. Reporting & Accountability**

**Reports to the CEO / Management. Collaborates with General Managers, Department Heads, Regional Managers, Showroom Managers, Finance, IT, Administration and HR teams. Accountable for the effectiveness, compliance and measurable performance of the HR function.**

**7. Expected Outcomes**

**1. A clearly structured HR department with defined ownership and reporting.**

**2. Standardised policies and efficient employee lifecycle processes across regions.**

**3. Improved recruitment turnaround, retention and workforce productivity.**

**4. Reliable payroll, attendance and statutory compliance.**

**5. Successful RegalSoft HRMS adoption and accurate management dashboards.**

**6. Measurable HR KPIs, governance and accountability.**

title: Manager, Implementation
description:
**About Rippling**
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365 - all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.85B+ from the world’s top investors - including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, Bedrock, GIC, Elad Gil and Goldman Sachs—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

**About The Role**
We are looking for a seasoned customer success leader to join our Implementation team. As a first line manager, you will coach and develop a team of 6-8 Implementation Managers, engage on high priority customers and drive improvement on key metrics. **What You Will Do**

* Collaborate cross-functionally with Rippling Sales, Technical Account Management and Support teams to create a seamless customer journey

**What You Will Need**

* EST/PST work hour schedule
* 5+ years of SaaS experience in professional services, implementation, or customer success

* Ruthless prioritization and time management
* Boundless energy to help your team and your customers...all with a “can-do” attitude!

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. title: Enterprise CSM
description:
**About Testsigma**
Testsigma is building the world's first Quality Intelligence Platform — the infrastructure layer that sits between every code change and every confident release. We help QA teams run test automation at speed and scale, without coding expertise, using plain English. Our customers include Cisco, Samsung, Bosch, Honeywell, and hundreds of leading QA teams globally. AI is rewriting software faster than at any point in history. Code that used to take a quarter now ships in a week. The gap between how fast software is built and how confidently it can be released that's the problem Testsigma exists to close. We are backed by Accel, MassMutual, and Strive, and headquartered in San Francisco with engineering teams in Bangalore.
  
  
**WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS**
We have a growing portfolio of enterprise accounts across the US and EMEA that have made real commitments to Testsigma. This is a founding-seat CSM role — you will own relationships end-to-end, build the CS playbook from scratch, and set the standard for post-sale excellence at this company. You report directly to the CEO. The Quality Intelligence category is consolidating now. The customers who land with Testsigma in the next 12 months will be the lighthouse accounts that define the category. The CSM who owns this period owns the reference stories and the expansion base that the next phase of growth is built on.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Own a named portfolio of enterprise accounts — know the health score, stakeholder map, contract terms, and renewal date for every account without looking it up
* Run structured onboarding for every new account and hold the plan accountable through go-live
* Track product usage signals and intervene before customers disengage — proactively address health concerns before they become churn risks
* Conduct executive business reviews (QBRs/EBRs) with C-level and senior stakeholders to track evolving objectives and demonstrate value
* Own the renewal conversation and identify expansion opportunities — work with Sales to close upsells and cross-sells
* Manage escalations end-to-end — don't forward them, own them through to resolution
* Identify product usage gaps and consult customers on actionable solutions; contribute structured feedback to the product roadmap
* Drive customer advocacy — case studies, references, reviews, testimonials, customer meetups, and webinars
* Build and refine CS processes and playbooks that don't yet exist — leave the function more structured than you found it
* Collaborate with Account Managers and AEs on upselling, cross-selling, and customer success plans based on desired outcomes

**Must-have Requirements**

* 5–8 years of B2B SaaS Customer Success experience, with a focus on US and EMEA customers
* Startup experience — at a company below 300 people where CS processes were being built, not inherited
* Enterprise CSM experience — managing accounts above $50K ARR with multi-stakeholder buying groups
* Demonstrated C-level and senior executive engagement — you have personally led and maintained executive relationships as the account owner
* Proven renewal ownership — you have personally led renewal conversations with multi-stakeholder enterprise accounts
* CS platform fluency — Gainsight, Totango, ChurnZero, or equivalent — with hands-on configuration experience
* Exceptional written and verbal communication in English — to work effectively with global customers
* Experience with technical buyers or developer-facing products — comfortable navigating conversations with engineering leaders and CTOs
* Structured QBR and executive communication skills — you have run QBRs that change what the customer does next
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills — ability to derive actionable insights from data and translate customer needs into internal requirements

**Good-to-have Skills**

* Experience with testing, QA, DevOps, or developer tooling products
* Familiarity with AI-native products or selling into engineering teams
* Ability to translate customer needs into clear technical requirements for product and engineering
* Exposure to product-led growth motions — usage-based onboarding, activation metrics, PLG expansion
* Experience managing customers across multiple segments — SMB, mid-market, and enterprise
* Comfort with data — pulling usage reports, building churn risk models, reading product analytics dashboards
* Experience running VOC programs or formalised customer advisory boards
* Graduation in Science, Engineering, or Commerce from an accredited college or university (postgraduate is a plus)

**What This Role Is Not**

* It is not a support role — you own outcomes, not tickets.
* It is not a role for someone who needs to be told what to do next — the playbook doesn't exist yet, you're building it.
* It is not post-sale maintenance mode — you own expansion as much as retention.
* It is not a stepping stone inside three years — we're looking for someone who wants to own and build this function.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary + performance bonus
* 100% company-paid medical insurance
* Daily catered lunch and free snacks
* Flat hierarchy — direct access to founders and leadership
* Flexible working hours

title: Lead, Client Partner
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced and client-focused Client Partner – Business Consulting to join our team in Bangalore. The ideal candidate will have 8+ years of experience, preferably with a strong background in Global Capability Centers (GCCs), business consulting, or professional services organizations.

This role will be responsible for building and managing strategic client relationships, understanding client business needs, driving consulting engagements, and partnering with internal teams to deliver high-quality solutions. The candidate should have a strong understanding of GCC setup and transformation, business operations, stakeholder management, and the ability to translate client requirements into actionable business outcomes.

The role requires a combination of consulting expertise, commercial acumen, relationship management, and execution capability. The successful candidate will work closely with senior client stakeholders, internal leadership, and cross-functional teams to support client growth and long-term partnerships.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Client Relationship & Account Management**

* Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, including CXOs, business leaders, HR leaders, and functional heads.
* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, ensuring effective communication, engagement, and ongoing relationship management.
* Understand client business objectives, challenges, and growth priorities to identify opportunities for consulting and business support.
* Drive regular business reviews, client governance meetings, and strategic discussions.
* Proactively identify potential risks, address client concerns, and ensure a high level of client satisfaction.

**2. GCC Consulting & Advisory**

* Support clients in establishing, scaling, and transforming Global Capability Centers in India.
* Understand GCC operating models, including talent strategy, organization design, HR operations, governance, compliance, and business enablement.
* Partner with clients to assess business requirements and recommend appropriate solutions aligned with their strategic objectives.
* Provide insights into India talent markets, operating costs, location strategy, organizational structures, and scaling considerations.
* Support clients through different stages of their GCC journey, from initial setup and transition to operational maturity and expansion.

**3. Business Development & Growth**

* Identify opportunities to expand existing client relationships through additional consulting and business services.
* Collaborate with internal business development and leadership teams to develop account growth strategies.
* Participate in client presentations, solution discussions, proposals, and commercial negotiations.
* Understand client needs and work with relevant teams to create tailored solutions and engagement proposals.
* Contribute to revenue growth, account expansion, and long-term client retention.

**4. Consulting Engagement Delivery**

* Work with internal delivery teams to ensure consulting engagements are executed in line with agreed scope, timelines, and quality standards.
* Translate client requirements into clear project objectives, deliverables, and success measures.
* Monitor engagement progress, identify dependencies and risks, and ensure timely escalation and resolution.
* Facilitate collaboration across TA, HR, finance, compliance, operations, and other relevant business functions.
* Ensure clients receive consistent communication and visibility into project progress.

**5. Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with internal leadership and delivery teams to align client expectations with operational capabilities.
* Build effective working relationships across business consulting, talent acquisition, HR, finance, and operations.
* Lead discussions with senior stakeholders and facilitate alignment on key business decisions.
* Support continuous improvement in client delivery processes, governance, and engagement models.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* 8+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably in business consulting, GCC advisory, professional services, or client relationship management.
* Strong experience working with GCC clients, supporting GCC setup, expansion, transformation, or operational maturity.
* Experience in a consulting firm, professional services organization, GCC advisory business, or a similar client-facing environment.
* Proven experience managing senior client stakeholders and building long-term business relationships.
* Strong understanding of business consulting, operating models, and organizational transformation.
* Experience in managing multiple client engagements, projects, or strategic accounts.
* Strong commercial awareness and ability to identify business development opportunities.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Engineering, or a relevant discipline. An MBA or equivalent qualification would be an advantage.

title: Customer Relationship Management Manager
description:
**Department -**
Customer Relationship Management (CRM)

**Location -**
Bengaluru, Karnataka

**Reports To -**
CEO

**Experience -**
Minimum 5 years, with at least 3 years in a CRM, customer experience, or dealer-relations leadership role

**Qualification -**
Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business Administration, Information Technology, or

**Preferred:**
MBA in a related field

**About KisanKraft**

KisanKraft Limited is a Bengaluru-headquartered agricultural equipment and power tools company, serving farmers across India through a dealer network of 5,000+ and exporting to 16+ countries worldwide. Our 46-acre manufacturing facility in Nellore anchors a business built on reliability, innovation, and farmer-first thinking. As we scale our reach and deepen our farmer and dealer relationships, we are looking for a CRM Manager to lead the systems, processes, and people that keep our customers and channel partners at the center of everything we do.

**Role Summary**

The CRM Manager owns the development, execution, and continuous refinement of KisanKraft's multi-channel Customer and Dealer Relationship Management function — from lead management and complaint resolution to loyalty, retention, and dealer-engagement programs.

This is a hands-on, cross-functional role that requires strong project management, process discipline, data fluency, and the ability to work closely with Sales, IT, Branding, and Product teams to ensure every farmer and dealer interaction reflects KisanKraft's standards of trust and service.

You will need to set an example to other members of the CRM team.

**Key Responsibilities**

***1. Customer & Dealer Relationship Management***

•       Own the end-to-end enquiry pipeline generated from website, calls, emails, social media, print, IndiaMART, exhibitions, and other sources — connecting with leads accurately and promptly. Afterwards routing the potential leads to the relevant sales team across India or to e-commerce purchase.

•       Manage resolution of customer and dealer complaints by coordinating with the relevant service and sales personnel and tracking cases through to closure.

•       Maintain and continuously update dealer master data and sales-team employee data, ensuring accuracy across all CRM and reporting systems.

•       Continuous customer engagement through seasonal greetings, dealer offers/discount communications, social media leads follow-up, and other company announcements to dealers and employees through appropriate channels.

***2. Sales Enablement & Lead Conversion***

•       Perform the first-level screening of incoming enquiries/leads to assess genuineness and purchase potential before routing them to the relevant sales team.

•       Support the sales team in converting enquiries to closed sales through structured daily follow-ups, reminders, and lead-nurturing cadences.

•       Track lead-to-conversion funnel performance and flag drop-off points to Sales leadership for corrective action.

•       Drive initiatives to increase e-commerce purchase conversion and repeat online orders from dealers and customers.

•       Manage paid communication and campaigns to dealers and customers for promotions, product updates, and service alerts.

***3. CRM Systems, Data & Analytics***

•       Analyze CRM team performance and productivity — enquiry volumes, response times, resolution rates, conversion rates — and maintain an up-to-date performance tracker/dashboard.

•       Work with the Branding and IT teams to keep e-commerce lead and customer data clean and accurate.

•       Own implementation and ongoing maintenance of CRM-related IT projects, including periodic upgrades and issue resolution.

•       Coordinate with IT teams to update and design inhouse CRM system.

***4. Training & Content Development***

•       Create and maintain user manuals for KisanKraft products, keeping content current as the product portfolio evolves.

•       Develop training content on agricultural products and power tools.

•       Localize training and customer-facing content into regional and other country languages to serve KisanKraft's pan-India and global dealer and farmer base.

***5. Branding & Marketing Support***

•       Provide coordinated support to the Branding, Marketing and Sales team on farmer events, exhibitions, and campaigns to improve customer engagement.

**What We're Looking For**

•       Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to juggle multiple CRM workstreams simultaneously.

•       Comfort with CRM tools, dealer/customer databases, and basic data analysis; exposure to web/app analytics is a plus.

•       Excellent written and verbal communication skills; multilingual ability (including regional Indian languages, Hindi, and English) is a strong advantage.

•       A process-oriented, farmer- and dealer-first mindset, with the ability to work cross-functionally with Sales, IT, Branding, and zonal teams.

•       Prior experience in agri-equipment, industrial products, FMCG, or a dealer/distributor-led business is preferred.

**Travel**

Occasional travel is required to visit exhibitions, dealers, customers, farmer events, and branches across India.

**How to Apply**

Please email your resume to
**jobs@kisankraft.com**
with the subject line "CRM Manager – Application".

title: Manager, Renewals -APAC
description:

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.
  
  
To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy.

title: Implementation Manager
description:

This role sits at Level 3 (“Implementation Manager — Independent Ownership”) on Lumber's Implementation Team career ladder. It's built for someone who can manage a full book of SMB and MM implementations end-to-end with limited oversight — leading clients confidently, resolving issues independently, and raising the bar for the teammates around them.

**Job Title:**
Implementation Manager

**Location:**
Whitefield, Bengaluru

**Shift Timings :**
6:30 pm - 3:30 am

**Key Responsibilities**

**Client Ownership & Communication**

* Lead client-facing sessions independently, including kickoffs, discovery calls, and implementation reviews.
* Experience managing US clients
* Proactively manage client expectations rather than waiting for clients to raise concerns.
* Navigate difficult conversations — timeline slippage, scope issues — with professionalism.
* Build trust with day-to-day contacts and senior client stakeholders alike.
* Communicate confidently and accurately across all client touchpoints.

**Payroll & Implementation Execution**

* Understanding of payroll cycles, statutory deductions, tax calculations and reconciliation
