* Shape client expectations from the earliest stages of the engagement.
* Act as the client’s primary internal advocate; know when to escalate internally.

**Escalation & Problem Solving**

* Resolve most implementation issues without manager involvement.
* Escalate with a clear recommendation — not just the problem.
* Track risk across multiple active projects and maintain situational awareness.
* Serve as a reliable escalation resource for Analyst- and Sr. Analyst-level teammates.
* Never sit on a blocker — proactive escalation is a strength, not a weakness.

**Team Contribution & Growth**

* Onboard and coach junior team members on product knowledge and implementation standards.
* Proactively identify team process gaps and drive improvements with follow-through.
* Contribute process improvement ideas that support team operational efficiency.
* Demonstrate strong ownership and accountability across all assigned clients.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 5+ years of experience in project management, implementation management, or client-facing delivery roles.
* Prior professional experience in fintech, payroll, or HR technology (or a closely related financial services domain).
* Demonstrated technical capability — comfortable working with system configuration, data imports/exports, APIs, or software/ERP integrations (e.g., Acumatica, Sage, NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, or similar).
* Proven track record independently managing 5+ concurrent client implementations or projects.
* Experience reconciling payroll, financial, or transactional data and resolving variances independently.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills; comfortable leading client calls solo.
* Ability to work hours that meaningfully overlap with U.S. (Pacific/Eastern) business hours.

**Preferred**

* Direct experience implementing or supporting payroll, HRIS, or workforce management software.
* Familiarity with construction-industry payroll complexity — certified payroll, prevailing wage, or union payroll.
* PM certification (PMP, PMI-ACP, CAPM) or equivalent.
* Experience with Asana or comparable project-management tooling.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field.

**What Success Looks Like**

A Level 3 Implementation Manager owns 6–7 concurrent SMB implementations without quality degradation, resolves the majority of issues without manager involvement, and is trusted by both clients and teammates. Success is driving strong outcomes independently — and elevating the team around you by mentoring junior teammates and closing process gaps you spot along the way.

**Reporting & Team Structure**

Reports to Lumber's onshore Implementation leadership. Works as part of Lumber's offshore implementation pod, with onshore supervision available for escalations and high-stakes decisions — not required for day-to-day delivery.

title: Territory Manager - Diabetes
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
  
  
**A Day in the Life**
This position is an exciting opportunity to work with the Diabetes business. Medtronic announced its intention to separate the Diabetes division to promote future growth and innovation within the business and to reallocate investments and resources across Medtronic. The Diabetes division, now known as MiniMed, completed its IPO in March 2026. This separation provides our team with a bold opportunity to unleash our potential, enabling us to operate with greater speed and agility. As a separate entity, we anticipate leveraging increased investment to drive meaningful innovation and enhance our impact on patient care. While you will start your employment with Medtronic, upon completion of required local legal and employment processes, we expect your employment to transfer to MiniMed, subject to business needs and any applicable information and consultation requirements in your jurisdiction.
  
  
The Diabetes Operating Unit partners with healthcare professionals and institutions to improve outcomes for people living with diabetes through advanced insulin delivery and diabetes management solutions. This role supports the promotion, adoption, and ongoing utilization of the Diabetes portfolio across assigned customer accounts and healthcare facilities, while working closely with cross-functional commercial and clinical support teams to deliver a high-quality customer experience.
  
  
The Territory Manager is responsible for driving adoption and utilization of the Diabetes portfolio within the assigned territory of Bangalore, Mysore, and Mangalore. The role focuses on territory growth, customer relationship management, stakeholder engagement, and achievement of an annual sales target of USD 300K through effective account planning and execution.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Achieve or exceed an annual sales target of USD 300K within the assigned territory.
* Drive sales performance to increase revenue, market share, and portfolio adoption across assigned accounts.
* Build and maintain relationships with endocrinologists, diabetologists, healthcare professionals, hospital stakeholders, and key decision-makers.
* Educate customers on the clinical and operational benefits of Diabetes products and solutions.
* Provide product, procedural, and technical support during customer interactions and clinical activities.
* Develop and execute territory business plans aligned with regional business objectives.
* Identify and convert new business opportunities to expand customer reach and product utilization.
* Maintain accurate sales forecasts, customer activity records, account plans, and commercial documentation using approved business systems

**Required Qualifications**

* High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 6+ years experience OR Associate’s Degree AND 4+ years experience OR Bachelor’s Degree AND 2+ years experience.
* Kannada language proficiency with the ability to conduct business discussions, customer engagement, and presentations in Kannada.
* Experience managing customer accounts and achieving territory sales objectives.
* Valid ability to travel extensively across Bangalore, Mysore, and Mangalore.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 2+ years of medical device or pharmaceutical sales experience within the diabetes therapy area.
* Experience supporting public hospitals, healthcare institutions, or government healthcare accounts.
* Knowledge of insulin pump therapy, continuous glucose monitoring, or diabetes management solutions.
* Experience participating in tender management, pricing submissions, and commercial documentation activities.
* Ability to analyze territory performance data and translate insights into business growth plans.

**Physical Job Requirements**

‌
  
  
‌

title: Senior Product Specialist Lead
description:
We are looking for an experienced
**Senior Product Specialist Lead**
to lead our Product Support function at Trupeer.

This role will own day-to-day support operations, manage a team of Product Specialists, and ensure exceptional customer experiences across our global customer base, including enterprise clients.

You will be responsible for building and managing a high-performing support team, establishing performance benchmarks, driving SLA adherence, and ensuring timely resolution of complex customer issues.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to translate customer challenges into actionable product improvements.

This is a hands-on leadership role that requires strong technical troubleshooting skills, proven people management capabilities, and experience delivering high-quality product support to enterprise customers in a fast-paced technology startup environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Team Leadership & Performance Management**

* Lead and manage a team of at least 5 Product Specialists operating across rotating shifts.
* Define team goals, performance metrics, and individual KPIs to drive productivity and service quality.
* Establish performance management frameworks covering SLA adherence, first-contact resolution, ticket resolution time, customer satisfaction, and overall support quality.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching sessions, and feedback discussions to improve individual and team performance.
* Manage shift schedules, workload distribution, weekend rotations, and team coverage across global time zones.
* Build a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement within the team.

**2. Enterprise Customer Support**

* Oversee high-touch product support for enterprise customers, ensuring timely and effective resolution of their queries and technical issues.
* Handle complex and escalated customer issues, acting as the primary point of contact when required.
* Ensure enterprise clients receive a consistently high standard of support, with clear communication and proactive follow-ups.
* Work closely with Customer Success and Account Management teams to address customer roadblocks and maintain customer satisfaction.
* Understand enterprise customer expectations around response times, issue resolution, product reliability, and service quality.

**3. Support Operations & SLA Management**

* Own daily support operations across email, live chat, and ticketing platforms.
* Ensure strict adherence to response and resolution SLAs across all operational shifts.
* Monitor support queues, ticket backlogs, escalations, and resolution trends.
* Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs) to improve support efficiency and consistency.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and implement processes to improve first-contact resolution and turnaround times.
* Ensure adequate support coverage across global time zones, including night shifts and scheduled weekends.

**4. Product & Technical Collaboration**

* Oversee the reproduction, documentation, and escalation of customer-reported bugs to Product and Engineering teams.
* Work with internal teams to prioritise critical customer issues and track them through resolution.
* Identify recurring customer pain points and share actionable insights with the product team.
* Ensure the team maintains updated troubleshooting guides, internal knowledge bases, FAQs, and customer-facing help documentation.
* Develop a strong understanding of Trupeer's product, features, workflows, and technical capabilities.

**Requirements**

* **Experience:**
  Minimum 3 years of experience in a Product Specialist Lead, Product Support Lead, or equivalent team leadership role.
* **Startup Experience:**
  Must have worked with a product-led technology startup, preferably a B2B SaaS company that builds and delivers software products to enterprise clients.
* **Team Management:**
  Proven experience managing a team of at least 5 Product Specialists or Technical Support Specialists.
* **Performance Management:**
  Experience defining KPIs, setting performance benchmarks, tracking individual performance, conducting reviews, and driving team productivity.
* **Enterprise Support:**
  Hands-on experience managing product support for enterprise customers, including complex queries, technical issues, and escalations.
* **Shift Management:**
  Experience managing teams across rotational morning, evening, and night shifts, including scheduled weekend rotations.
* **Technical Aptitude:**
  Strong troubleshooting skills across web applications, browser tools, APIs, integrations, and SaaS platform workflows.
* **Communication:**
  Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to handle enterprise stakeholders and explain technical solutions clearly.
* **Tools:**
  Experience with support platforms such as Zendesk, Intercom, or Freshdesk, and bug-tracking tools such as Jira or Linear.

**What Makes You a Good Fit?**

* You have worked in a fast-paced, product-led tech startup serving enterprise customers.
* You have built, managed, or scaled a team of Product Specialists.
* You know how to establish measurable performance standards and drive accountability.
* You understand the service expectations of enterprise customers and can manage critical escalations.
* You can balance people leadership with hands-on involvement in complex technical issues.
* You are comfortable collaborating with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to improve the overall customer experience.
* You enjoy building scalable processes and high-performing teams in a rapidly evolving environment.

TWC is expanding its marketplace beyond venues into a la carte services: decor, catering, photography and bridal makeup. The Vendor Onboarding Manager builds and converts the vendor pipeline for this expansion. You will own each vendor's journey from first conversation to a signed, KYC-cleared and live partner, in close coordination with Category Managers, Legal and Finance

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in business, hospitality, marketing or a related field. An MBA is a plus.

title: Associate Manager, Banking Alliances
description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
  
  
Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
  
  
From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
  
  
Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
  
  
Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
  
  
Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
  
  
We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
  
  
But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
  
  
**Key Roles And Responsibilities**

* Understand subvention and other applicable models and drive Razorpay’s GTM strategy via bank-led route.
* Identify and pitch newer use cases such as Omnichannel (offline+online), Cross border payments, PPI, other solutions - via Bank partnership channel.
* Develop implementation plan across alliance life cycle for the assigned portfolio of banks/PSPs
* Define and own metrics for monitoring the performance & the effectiveness of existing alliances
* Facilitate seamless onboarding of Razorpay as a Vendor / Customer in the bank’s ecosystem as well as ensure set-up on system and its complete alignment across departments
* Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders including leadership, strategy, marketing, and design teams to ensure seamless execution of business launch and scale-up
* Ecosystem collaboration: Self-starter to identify and collaborate with ecosystem players to discover and co-build products for the market (Fintechs, Banks, Partners, etc)

title: AVP- Radiologist Experience and Engagement
description:
About Teleradiology Solutions

Teleradiology Solutions (TRS) is a pioneer in teleradiology, delivering round-the-clock diagnostic radiology reporting and support to hospitals and healthcare providers across India, the US, and other global markets. Founded in 2002 by two Yale-trained physicians and headquartered in Ardmore, PA, TRS today serves over 150 hospitals across 21 countries.

The company pairs a network of board-certified radiologists — including ABR-certified specialists — with technology-driven workflows and its AI-enabled arm, dAIgnostiX, to deliver fast, accurate, and reliable imaging interpretation. dAIgnostiX is based out of Bengaluru (Whitefield). TRS/dAIX also maintains an active academic focus (www.radguru.net) and ongoing research interests, including AI in radiology.

TRS is set for rapid growth, at a CAGR above 25%. That growth depends on American Board Radiologists (ABRs): the size, deployment and satisfaction (NPS) of the ABR panel is the binding constraint. The panel has about 100 ABRs today, with a substantial increase planned in the coming months.

The ABR journey is split across several teams, including Onboarding, Scheduling and Assigning, and no one owns the ABR's experience end to end. The result is a paradox: the company reports a capacity shortage, while ABRs say they are underused. Part of the capacity gap is really a deployment gap, and closing it is faster than recruiting alone.

This role is the single owner of that journey. You will lead everything that decides whether an ABR is credentialed, scheduled, supported and productive. You will own ABR capacity and productivity, and ABR satisfaction.

Key responsibilities

* Own ABR (
  American Board Radiologists )
  capacity and productivity . Be the named owner of ABR utilisation (actual vs. contracted hours), productivity, and the capacity gap against planned revenue. Make these live, per-ABR numbers, not a one-off analysis. Calculate the capacity gap net of utilisation recovery, so recruiting decisions rest on real utilisation rather than an inflated shortage.
* Deploy before you recruit. Run an ABR-by-ABR diagnostic across the full roster, starting with the highest-hours group. Tag a root cause and a named owner for each, and work through the fixes with Operations Delivery, who own case assignment.
* Own the pipeline from offer to first live shift. Recruitment and HR source candidates; you own everything after: offer, licensing and credentialing, orientation and the first live shift. Set a time-to-first-read target and keep bringing it down.
* Credential to match demand. Credential against forecast demand, not whoever is next in the queue. Introduce a rule that each ABR agrees their hospital list before applications start. Set up a live credentialing feed into Scheduling, so a hospital approved on Monday can be scheduled on Tuesday.
* Run ABR experience and engagement. Give every ABR one point of contact and a set rhythm: a weekly pulse, a monthly review and a quarterly plan. Track every concern from intake to closure: acknowledge within 24 hours, and resolve operational and IT issues within 48–72 hours. Set up a real ABR satisfaction measure (an open item in the KPI framework today). Manage no-show rate and annualized attrition as leading indicators, not just reported numbers.
* Shape the ABR proposition: technology, terms and training. Be the ABR's voice wherever their working day is shaped.
* Technology first. Image load, dictation workflow, RADSpa friction and pre-read or AI support are the most common complaints. Sponsor a ranked fix list with the technology team, and a pre-read pilot with volunteer ABRs, measured in RVUs per hour.
* Training. Shape training and onboarding of new and existing ABRs
* Chair the shared ABR-capacity forum. Run forum that brings together scheduling decisions, credentialing status, assignment practice and utilisation data. Keep one shared tracker so every team sees gaps at the same time, and agree a clear escalation path.
* Build the leadership bench. Build a real management layer with succession depth as the roster and volume triple, and give new leaders the structure, tools and coaching to grow.

Candidate profile

* You have led a multi-team clinical or physician-workforce operation and have managed managers. Teleradiology, locum or physician staffing, hospital medical-staff services and similar clinician-supply settings all count.
* What matters is that you have been accountable for a panel of expert, independent clinicians: recruiting, credentialing and scheduling them, and keeping them productive and engaged.

You should be able to show

* A track record of growing and deploying a clinician or specialist panel, with real numbers on utilisation, time to onboard and attrition.
* Hands-on command of scheduling and capacity planning, including forecasting, no-show design, and choosing or implementing a scheduling platform.
* Comfort with credentialing and licensing in a regulated environment.
* Data fluency: you read utilisation, RVUs per hour and no-show data yourself and run the function by the numbers.
* Credibility with radiologists and other physicians. They trust you enough to be honest about why they are not showing up, and you can hold a hard conversation without it feeling punitive.
* The ability to lead through influence across functions you do not own (Operations Delivery, Technology, Finance), and to build a management layer beneath you.

Industry Solution Leaders combine deep industry and engineering expertise with end-to-end ownership of customer solutions. title: Incident & Escalation Lead- Enterprise Customers
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
  
  
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
  
  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

**An Overview Of This Role**
Support Engineering at GitLab believes that healthy teams deliver a healthy customer experience, and that command during a crisis shouldn't fall to whoever happens to be senior and available. GitLab's global Incident & Escalation Management (IM/EM) function coordinates critical incidents, complex multi-team engagements, and executive-level escalations for enterprise customers. As Escalation Manager, you'll own complex, executive, and commercial escalations where customer trust and the relationship are at stake, alongside or independently of a technical issue.
  
  
In this functional role, you'll advocate for customers inside GitLab, coordinate teams toward resolution, and lead relationship repair after the event.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own complex, executive, and commercial escalations end-to-end, as defined in GitLab's IM/EM engagement model.
* Advocate for customers internally and coordinate Engineering, Support, Product, Customer Success, and Sales toward resolution, tracking commitments and holding owning teams accountable to agreed dates and deliverables.
* Maintain a written, customer-facing resolution plan from engagement through confirmed resolution, updating it at each communication milestone.
* Coordinate with Incident Managers during concurrent technical incidents to maintain a single, coherent narrative for the customer.
* Own external escalation communications using GitLab's approved templates and cadence, and represent GitLab in high-stakes customer conversations where clarity and ownership influence retention.
* Engage Sales, Customer Success, and executive stakeholders as needed, including executive-to-executive communication for Severity 1 and 2 events. Brief GitLab leadership with concise summaries that distinguish what's known, what's unknown, and next steps.
* Lead post-escalation reviews and relationship repair plans, contribute corrective actions with named owners and due dates to postmortems, and hand the relationship back to the account's Customer Success Manager at resolution.
* Partner with the Head of IM/EM to develop playbooks, communication templates, and process improvements based on patterns from escalations.

**What You'll Bring**

* Experience in enterprise technical support, customer success, or incident and escalation management at a business-to-business software-as-a-service or enterprise software company.
* A track record of owning complex, multi-stakeholder escalations end-to-end, including executive customer engagements and structured resolution or account plans.
* Executive-level written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical detail into plain-language updates for customers and GitLab leadership.
* The ability to coordinate Engineering, Support, Product, Customer Success, and Sales under pressure without formal authority over those teams.
* Calm, structured decision-making with incomplete information and the ability to provide a steadying presence in high-stress customer situations.
* Proficiency with support and coordination tools such as Zendesk, Salesforce, Slack, and PagerDuty, or equivalent platforms.
* Availability for on-call coverage supporting executive escalations as part of a globally distributed team.
* Nice to have: Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Foundation or equivalent certification; customer-facing experience with GitLab, development, security, and operations (DevSecOps), continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), or cloud-native products; experience with formal escalation or incident command frameworks; or AI-assisted support tools for triage, sentiment analysis, or resolution drafting.

**About The Team**
The Incident & Escalation Management function sits within Support Engineering in GitLab's Enterprise Technology & AI (ETA) division. We operate a follow-the-sun model anchored in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, and Asia-Pacific, providing year-round, 24-hour coverage for enterprise customers. Our Escalation Managers work globally rather than within a single region, partnering with Incident Managers, Communications Leads, and regional Support Engineering leadership. You'll help shape our playbooks, templates, and standards as we scale.
  
  
**How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees**

* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
  
  
**Country Hiring Guidelines:**
GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
  
  
**Privacy Policy:**
Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
  
  
GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

title: Senior Technical Account Manager
description:

You will provide leadership across the solution lifecycle, coordinate cross-functional teams, and help customers deploy and optimize Oracle Cloud workloads. title: Sr. Manager, Customer Experience
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
  
  
Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
  
  
**Introduction to team**
This role sits on the Traveler Operations team within the Traveler & Partner Services Platform (TPSP) organization. You will oversee Expedia Group's external contact center vendors so they operate efficiently, follow company policy, and follow defined customer processes. The team owns how our vendor partners perform for travelers across voice, chat, and back office channels, and works with product, policy, and knowledge teams to fix what drives travelers to contact us again. Your work improves the customer experience and supports top operational performance.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Oversee a multi-site network of external contact center vendors to promote operational efficiency, policy compliance, and adherence to defined customer processes
* Own vendor performance against key metrics such as resolution, handle time, customer satisfaction, quality, and service levels, find what drives changes in results, and agree remediation plans with vendor leadership
* Build working relationships with stakeholders, vendors, leaders, and business partners, and act as a trusted advisor who recommends solutions to meet business needs, reaches agreements that create value for all parties, and holds vendors accountable for agreed service levels and commitments
* Review data and customer interactions (calls, chats, and cases) to find the root cause of problems, measure customer and employee satisfaction and program effectiveness, and propose key performance indicators and recommendations that drive action, using analytics, automation, and AI tools to scale the work
* Act as the escalation point for customer and vendor issues, lead the vendor response to service disruptions, and work with product, policy, and knowledge teams to prioritize fixes to tools, processes, and policies
* Identify, size, and deliver efficiency and cost-saving opportunities, and partner with workforce planning and finance on forecasts, capacity, and targets
* Lead or take part in cross-functional projects by aligning timelines and milestones, spotting resourcing gaps, and adjusting plans to keep work on track, including getting vendor teams trained and ready when new processes, policies, or tools launch
* Prepare and present regular business reviews to senior leaders and vendor leadership, turning performance data into clear actions
* Apply knowledge of standard contract terms and conditions to answer vendor questions, validate compliance and invoice reconciliation so bills are processed on time, and advise on quarterly and yearly budgets
* Lead, coach, and develop team members and vendor leaders to improve performance, and implement improvements to the quality of products, services, and processes

**Experience And Qualifications**

* You have a bachelor's or master's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management or related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience
* You have at least 8 years of relevant experience in vendor management or contact center operations with a bachelor's degree, or at least 6 years with a master's degree, including at least 3 years leading people or teams
* You have an in-depth understanding of vendor management processes, policies, and tools, including managing outsourced (BPO) partners across multiple sites or regions
* You have knowledge of contact center technologies and keep current with changes in the contact center industry
* You think analytically, solve problems effectively, and use key performance indicators to draw conclusions about trends, and you are comfortable working with large data sets in tools such as Excel, SQL, or BI dashboards
* You are proficient in written and spoken communication, pay close attention to detail, and stay well organized, and you can present clearly to senior leaders and influence partners where you have no direct authority.
* It's a plus if you have experience in travel or e-commerce customer service, or with automation and AI tools in an operations setting.

**Accommodation requests**
Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation.
  
  
**About Expedia Group**
Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.
  
  
**Important notice**
Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity**
Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

AI Consultant

The AI Consultant is a client-facing advisor within the AI Go-to-Market organization responsible for identifying, shaping, and mobilizing AI transformation opportunities. This role combines strategy acumen, AI fluency, structured consulting methods, and commercial orientation to help clients define AI value cases, operating models, roadmaps, and adoption approaches. The AI Consultant partners with AI Architects, Forward-Deployed Engineering, Delivery, Sellers, ecosystem partners, and Geo and Industry leaders to convert client priorities into qualified opportunities and successful engagements.
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
  

* Act as a trusted client advisor to identify AI transformation opportunities, business pain points, and value cases.
* Shape AI strategy, target operating model, governance, adoption, responsible AI, and transformation roadmaps for clients.
* Translate client needs into practical AI solutions in partnership with architects, FDE, delivery, and partner teams.
* Develop proposals, business cases, ROI models, proof-of-concept plans, and executive-ready client materials.
* Support opportunity qualification, deal shaping, solutioning, mobilization, and transition into delivery.
* Lead and support structured consulting activities, including workshops, stakeholder interviews, assessments, prioritization exercises, and roadmap development.
* Bring a strategic lens to client conversations, connecting AI use cases to operating model change, business outcomes, adoption, and measurable enterprise value.
* Reuse and improve global GTM assets, offering content, credentials, delivery patterns, and client-facing narratives.
* Stay current on AI, agentic AI, enterprise adoption trends, responsible AI, and partner capabilities to strengthen client advisory quality.

Success Measures:
  
  

* Personal sales contribution or qualified pipeline contribution, as applicable by career level.
* Utilization or billability against target.
* Quality of client deliverables, proposal contribution, stakeholder feedback, and reuse of global GTM assets.
* Contribution to downstream implementation opportunities and successful client mobilization.

Basic Qualifications:
  
  

* 8+ years of professional experience in consulting, professional services, strategy, transformation, AI, data, analytics, or related client-facing roles.
* 3+ years of experience shaping or delivering AI, data science, machine learning, GenAI, agentic AI, analytics, or digital transformation initiatives. Experience may be demonstrated through client delivery, on-the-job AI work, a data science background, or an advanced degree.
* Demonstrated strategy acumen, including business model analysis, operating model design, value case development, transformation planning, and executive narrative development.
* Experience supporting presales activities such as opportunity identification, solution shaping, proposal development, business case creation, or executive-level deal reviews.
* Working knowledge of enterprise AI concepts, including LLMs, AI agents, RAG, ML lifecycle, data readiness, responsible AI, governance, and adoption considerations.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.

Preferred Skills:
  
  

* Master's degree, MBA, data science degree, AI/ML certification, or equivalent practical AI experience.
* Experience in one or more industries such as financial services, insurance, manufacturing, healthcare and life sciences, public sector, automotive, or commercial sectors.
* Familiarity with cloud and AI platforms such as Azure, AWS, GCP, OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Google/Gemini, Databricks, or Snowflake.
* Strong executive communication, structured problem solving, facilitation, stakeholder management, and collaborative teaming skills.
* Ability to travel as required for client and internal engagements.

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. Responsibilities include coaching and developing individuals within the team in their roles as product experts and participating in improvement efforts across Support. * Manage & lead a team of globally distributed technical support professionals to provide enterprise-level, post-sales technical support to Smartsheet customers. Teams will be comprised of members with varying levels of technical expertise and tenure

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. title: Product Support Operations, Team Lead
description:
Who we are
  
  
**About Stripe**
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
  
  
**About The Team**
As Stripe’s user base and global footprint grows dramatically, we have distinctly unique support problems resulting from both our type of scale and the type of businesses we partner with. The Stripe Delivery Center (SDC) strategy will provide operational leverage and expand Stripe’s portfolio of operational capabilities to support the scaled needs for external users and internal Stripe teams. We strive to deliver frictionless experiences for all of our users, whether they are an Independent Business, Startup, SMB, or Enterprise and our mission is to provide all Stripe Users with the best support experience possible.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
In this role, you will act in a player-coach capacity and will be accountable for supporting a team of Operations Associates. This team is responsible for resolving our users’ most challenging and impactful issues, providing exceptional user experience, and contributing to the overall user satisfaction.
  
  
To be a fit, you will have a coaching mindset, proven ability to communicate at different levels, a track record of driving operational performance, possess a deep expertise in customer service, and a passion for inspiring a team to deliver an incredible user experience.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Guide your team in troubleshooting and solving external user issues
* Manage the operational performance of your team to deliver KPIs
* Help scale our operations and improve user experience by identifying process improvements
* Manage capacity and scheduling, dividing and assigning work between team members
* Ensure your team has all the skills and resources needed to be successful in their role
* Set clear goals and expectations for individual and team performance
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement to refine team processes and procedures
* Support recruitment and hiring initiatives
* Coach and mentor individuals to meet career goals via structured career development conversations
* Provide continuous performance feedback and facilitate periodic formal performance reviews
* Drive and own initiatives that make the team a warm and welcoming place to work
* Keep the team engaged and motivated towards their work

Who you are
  
  
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements**

* 5+ years of experience coaching/leading Customer Service teams and managing performance
* Experience mentoring and providing constructive feedback to others
* Experience in delivering weekly and monthly business metrics and reporting
* Proven ability to be a subject matter expert in Customer Service
* Ability to work cross functionally to deliver best results and promote partnership
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Exemplary planning and time management skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience launching new processes and driving continuous improvement.
* AI Fluency: with practical experience using AI tools to support day-to-day work and critically evaluate their outputs.

In-office expectations
  
  
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
  
  
Pay and benefits
  
  
Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
  
  
We look forward to hearing from you.
  
  
At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
  
  
Apply now

description:

Location : Pune, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Coimbatore, Mumbai

**About K12 Technoservices Pvt. Ltd.**

K12 Technoservices Pvt. Ltd. is associated with Orchids The International School, an education organisation focused on delivering quality schooling and creating meaningful learning experiences for students.

Website:
www.orchidsinternationalschool.com

**Job Title: Program Manager – School Operations & Business Development**

**Role overview**

The Program Manager will be responsible for managing the overall operations, business development, admissions, and revenue growth of the assigned school branch. The role requires an individual who can effectively manage cross-functional teams, drive admission and revenue targets, execute field marketing initiatives, build strategic partnerships, and ensure smooth day-to-day school operations.

The position will act as a key link between the school branch, parents, employees, management, and central corporate teams to ensure operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and business growth.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Business development, admissions & revenue growth**

* Drive overall admission targets and revenue generation for the assigned school branch.
* Develop and execute strategies to increase student enrolment s and achieve business objectives.
* Monitor admission pipelines, conversion ratios, revenue performance, and collection targets.
* Identify new business opportunities and potential catchment areas for student admissions.
* Build and maintain relationships with parents, preschool partners, tutors, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Establish and manage preschool tie-ups and strategic partnerships to generate admission leads.
* Ensure timely collection of tuition fees, transport fees, fines, and other applicable charges.
* Monitor outstanding fee dues and ensure timely follow-up and collection.

**2. Field sales & team management**

* Lead, manage, and monitor a team of approximately 5-10 members responsible for field sales, counselling, and business development.
* Set individual and team targets, monitor performance, and ensure achievement of assigned goals.
* Guide, motivate, and develop team members to improve productivity and business outcomes.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and provide necessary coaching and support.
* Ensure effective coordination between field sales, counselling, admissions, and marketing teams.
* Participate in recruitment and selection of administrative and business development team members.

**3. Marketing, field activities & brand promotion**

* Analyse local marketing needs, market trends, and business opportunities.
* Develop and implement field marketing and business development plans.
* Plan and execute Below-the-Line (BTL) activities, promotional campaigns, events, and community engagement initiatives.
* Identify opportunities for school promotions and increase brand visibility within the assigned catchment area.
* Coordinate with internal marketing and corporate teams for campaign execution.
* Plan, organise, and host admission-related events and promotional activities.
* Evaluate campaign performance and submit reports on lead generation, conversions, and outcomes.

**4. School & branch operations**

* Ensure smooth day-to-day operations of the assigned school branch.
* Oversee administrative functions, campus maintenance, housekeeping, inventory, and vendor management.
* Ensure the school campus, playgrounds, courts, and other facilities are maintained appropriately.
* Monitor inward and outward movement of materials and maintain relevant records.
* Coordinate with Procurement, Logistics, Projects, Academics, Marketing, HR, and other corporate departments.
* Identify operational gaps and implement standardised processes to improve efficiency.
* Monitor branch-related operational reports and present updates to management.

**5. Parent relationship management & grievance resolution**

* Act as the primary point of contact for parents regarding non-academic matters.
* Ensure timely resolution of parent complaints and grievances.
* Monitor the complaint register and coordinate with the Front Office, Accounts, and Campus teams for closure.
* Build strong parent relationships and maintain a high level of service satisfaction.
* Handle escalations professionally and ensure effective communication with stakeholders.

**6. Staff administration & employee coordination**

* Monitor staff strength, attendance, and workforce requirements at the branch.
* Coordinate with HR for recruitment, attendance regularisation, salary processing, and employee-related matters.
* Ensure employee grievances are addressed and escalated to the appropriate departments.
* Maintain proper recruitment and employee-related records.
* Support training and development initiatives for branch operations and administrative teams.

**7. Transport & infrastructure management**

* Monitor daily school transport operations and ensure smooth functioning of the bus fleet.
* Ensure timely vehicle maintenance and proper functioning of GPS/GPRS tracking systems.
* Coordinate with transport vendors and ensure compliance with prescribed safety procedures.
* Ensure regular driver breathalyser testing as specified by company procedures.
* Monitor campus maintenance registers and ensure timely closure of maintenance issues.

**8. Finance, collections & vendor management**

* Monitor branch-level fee collections, outstanding dues, and revenue reports.
* Manage branch petty cash and ensure supporting documentation is maintained.
* Coordinate vendor payments and ensure timely submission of invoices and supporting documents.
* Monitor vendor performance and ensure adherence to agreed service standards.
* Coordinate with Finance and Accounts teams for financial and operational requirements.

**9. Management reporting & stakeholder coordination**

* Prepare and present regular reports on admissions, revenue, collections, marketing activities, and branch operations.
* Conduct periodic performance reviews and provide updates on business targets.
* Coordinate with management, trustees, parents, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
* Support quarterly reviews and ensure timely closure of assigned action points.
* Ensure effective communication and coordination across all business verticals.

**Desired candidate profile**

* Educational qualification
* Graduate in any discipline is required.
* Postgraduate qualification or MBA in Business Administration, Marketing, or Operations will be an added advantage.

**Experience**

* Experience in business development, field sales, school operations, admissions, or education-sector management.
* Hands-on experience in managing and driving field sales teams.
* Experience in handling revenue targets, admissions, marketing activities, and stakeholder relationships.
* Exposure to branch operations, vendor management, and administrative functions will be preferred.

**Skills and competencies**

* Strong leadership and team management capabilities.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong business acumen and revenue-driven mindset.
* Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and stakeholders.
* Excellent planning, execution, and problem-solving abilities.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret business and operational reports.
* Customer-centric approach with a focus on parent satisfaction.
* Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable working in a target-driven environment.
* Willingness to travel locally between branches and assigned locations.

**Key performance indicators (KPIs)**

* The performance of the Program Manager will be evaluated on:
* Achievement of admission and revenue targets.
* Fee collection efficiency and reduction in outstanding dues.
* Lead generation and admission conversion rates.
* Productivity and performance of the field sales team.
* Number and effectiveness of preschool and other strategic tie-ups.
* Execution and effectiveness of BTL marketing activities.
* Parent satisfaction and timely grievance resolution.
* Efficiency of school operations and campus maintenance.
* Vendor management and operational cost control.
* Timely reporting and coordination with corporate teams.

title: Manager, Network and Infrastructure Reliability
description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.

Five9 is rebuilding the operational leadership for its Network & Infrastructure team and needs a hands-on, senior technical manager to take direct ownership of the environment and the team executing the work.

The right candidate will have directly managed production networks at scale, led teams of engineers who build and maintain those systems, and successfully transitioned frontline operations from manual "click-ops" into automated, code-driven execution. If you have not personally managed engineering teams through this specific transition, this is not the right role.

Modernization is already underway, but the current engineering team is short-handed and lacks several critical skills. The person stepping into this role must stabilize daily operations quickly, assess the existing talent, and immediately begin rebuilding both the team and the operating workflows against clear, sprint-level, and measurable milestones.

This is a true player-coach role. You must stay close enough to the technical work to keep your engineering judgment sharp, maintain credibility with senior engineers, and be willing to set the standard by example on the keyboard when needed. At the same time, you must focus on building automated validation gates and upskilling your team so that you can step out of the daily critical path. Carrying a portion of the senior technical load to stabilize the team at the outset is expected; still operating as the primary technical bottle-neck six months in is a failure.

**What success looks like in your first 120 days**

* A working map of the network and infrastructure estate across our DCs and our cloud footprint, plus a clear assessment of your team's capabilities and operational bottlenecks.

* A team skills assessment and a tactical execution plan that details how your team will transition from manual operations to infrastructure/network-as-code, automation, and drift control, balanced against current project deliverables.

* Key engineering hires onboarded successfully, with existing team members actively engaged in cross-training and upskilling programs.

* Early modernization wins visible in production, the on-call and incident load distributed fairly across the team, and you have successfully transitioned from tactical firefighting to guiding team execution.

**What You Bring to Five9**

* A track record of building and leading cohesive teams, raising engineering standards, and shifting daily operations from reactive to proactive, engineering-led execution.

* Experience stabilizing operations and guiding engineering teams through periods of technical change and modernization.

* Strong communication skills backed by operational data, clear risk articulation, and the ability to report measurable outcomes to department leadership.

* Proven ability to build trust, accountability, and a high-performance culture within your engineering team.

* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience partnering closely with software engineering, security, SRE, and product teams.

* Ability to mentor and develop senior engineers and technical leads, driving accountability while establishing clear ownership, operational discipline, and career growth pathways.

* Strong decision-making and prioritization skills in high-pressure production environments with competing operational demands.

* Demonstrated ability to lead teams through ambiguity, align team goals with broader department objectives, and execute complex technical migrations.

* Effective conflict resolution and stakeholder management skills to align technical delivery with business needs.

* Strong operational judgment in network and infrastructure security, with the ability to partner effectively with Security Operations teams.

**What We Require**

* 7+ years of experience in network/infrastructure engineering, with 3+ years directly managing engineering teams in mission-critical, multi-DC production environments.

* Deep technical background in modern DC networking, including OSPF, EVPN, VXLAN, Cisco Nexus, and NX-OS.

* Experience managing infrastructure in a hybrid cloud environment, with a strong focus on supporting GCP workloads.

* Proven success guiding teams to build and adopt network automation and IaC using tools such as Ansible, Terraform, Python, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.

* Hands-on experience modernizing legacy environments by introducing configuration management, drift detection, and policy-based operations where they didn't exist before.

* Strong understanding of network and infrastructure observability using tools such as ThousandEyes, Grafana, Loki, NetFlow, and Netscout to achieve a "single pane of glass" for system health.

* Experience supporting the underlying infrastructure needs of Kubernetes, AI, and GPU workloads.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

Workplace location: This role is fully remote for candidates who reside further than a 30 kilometer driving distance from either our Bangalore or Chennai offices. Candidates who reside within a 30 kilometer driving distance of one of our office locations would be required to work in-office 3 days a week.

Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better we are. Five9 is an equal opportunity employer.

Five9 is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@five9.com to request an accommodation. Requests will be handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable law.

View our privacy policy, including our privacy notice to California residents here: https://www.five9.com/pt-pt/legal.

Note: Five9 will never request that an applicant send money as a prerequisite for commencing employment with Five9.

title: Network Implementation Engineer, Google Enterprise Network
description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Network Engineering or Telecom Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3 years of experience in core networking protocols and technologies, including TCP/IP, routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, ISIS), and LAN switching.
* Experience with MPLS VPN, firewalls, data center networking, and virtual extensible LAN (VXLAN).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Certifications in CCNP, CCIE, JNCIE, or Google's Professional Cloud Network Engineer certification.
* Understanding of Linux/Unix fundamentals, including system resource monitoring and shell scripting.
* Excellent coding skills to develop automation solutions for network monitoring and management.

**About the job**
-----------------

As a Network Implementation Engineer, you will be the initial point of our efforts to execute deployment, maintenance, and operations of private data networks worldwide. You will work with Technical Program Managers, Network Engineers, Design and Infrastructure Engineers, Field Engineers within Google, as well as construction and telecommunications vendors and contractors, all to position your team and organization for success.

You will facilitate faster, better, and more efficient, positive outcomes for the business and our customers. Your objective will be to build the world’s most reliable, cost-effective and scalable network to support all of our current and future customers and users globally.

Google's network provides services to millions of Internet users around the world. Our metros are on the edge of our network where Google connects to its users. The Network Team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. Our team owns the full life cycle of all space, power, and network assets in all of Google’s data centers and metro points of presence globally. From the foundation, we are involved from site acquisition to construction and are accountable for what space and power is delivered. We're involved in every facet of network delivery from architecture and design to installation, configuration, activation, and commissioning.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Build and operate Google's network reliably and at scale.
* Execute deployment, maintenance, and operations of private data networks worldwide.
* Develop creative approaches and collaborate with cross-functional teams to keep operational costs low.

title: Senior PMT, Cart Building and Consolidation
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

What if you could shape how millions of customers across emerging markets receive their orders — and do it as part of an AI-native product organization built from the ground up? Amazon International Emerging Stores Customer Fulfillment Experience (CFX) owns basket building and delivery consolidation, one of the most critical levers for reducing cost-to-serve across 12+ international markets including Mexico, Brazil, Australia, India and the Middle East. This is not about layering AI onto existing systems; you will define what AI-native product development looks like at Amazon, designing the team, the roadmap, and the operating model from scratch. As a Senior Product Manager - Technical, you will use first principles thinking and strong judgment to drive major improvements in delivery efficiency and customer convenience at a scale that few roles can offer. This role requires international travel to markets such as Mexico, Brazil, Australia and the Middle East to work directly with local teams and customers.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for basket building and delivery consolidation across 12+ international markets, making clear trade-offs between customer convenience, cost-to-serve, and speed.
* Design AI-native product capabilities from the ground up, identifying where AI can reshape delivery consolidation rather than incrementally improve existing workflows.
* Partner with engineering, science, design, and country teams to translate local customer needs into scalable, cross-market solutions.
* Define success criteria and metrics that track both adoption and real-world outcomes such as cost savings and customer satisfaction, using data to inform roadmap priorities.
* Collaborate with senior leadership to align priorities across the international portfolio, influencing roadmap decisions and building agreement among stakeholders with different market contexts.

  
A day in the life  
Your morning might start with a working session alongside engineers and scientists reviewing how an AI model performs on delivery consolidation recommendations, followed by a call with a country team to understand local cart-building patterns. After lunch you could be writing a product requirements document or building a prototype for a new consolidation feature, then joining an architecture review to talk through scalability trade-offs. You will travel to key markets- Mexico, Brazil, Australia and the Middle East, to work directly with customers and local teams, making sure the products you build reflect real-world needs across the international footprint.  
  
About the team  
We sit within Amazon International Emerging Stores Customer Fulfillment Experience (CFX), where our mission is to help customers across emerging markets build smarter carts and receive their orders more conveniently and efficiently. Basket building and delivery consolidation is one of three strategic pillars for International Emerging Stores, and our charter carries high visibility and direct senior leadership sponsorship. We are building an AI-native organization from day one, and the work we do here will set the standard for how Amazon approaches AI-driven product development internationally. If you are excited about tackling large-scale, ambiguous problems that touch millions of customers and growing by shaping customer-facing delivery experiences across some of the world's fastest-growing markets, this is the team for you.

title: Network Implementation Engineer, Wireless
description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Network Engineering or Telecom Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in fundamental networking technologies and protocols (BGP, OSPF, ISIS, DHCP, IPSec, GRE, Wi-Fi standards, DNS, Radius)
* 2 years of experience with wireless technologies.
* Experience with 802.11 Wi-Fi standards, 802.1X access control and DHCP/IPv6 SLAAC.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in one or more of the following disciplines: Layer 1 optical transmissions systems, layer 3 routing TCP/IP, wireless networking, network design, or operations.
* Experience with the triage of network issues, identification of root causes, and generation of Methods of Procedure (MOP) for network repair.
* Foundational skill set in network automation, scripting (e.g., Python, Go), and standard network operational tools.

**About the job**
-----------------

As a Network Implementation Engineer, you will be the initial point of our efforts to execute deployment, maintenance, and operations of private data networks worldwide. You will work with Technical Program Managers, Network Engineers, Design and Infrastructure Engineers, Field Engineers within Google, as well as construction and telecommunications vendors and contractors, all to position your team and organization for success.
  
  
You will facilitate faster, better, and more efficient, positive outcomes for the business and our customers. Your objective will be to build the world’s most reliable, cost-effective and scalable network to support all of our current and future customers and users globally. Google's network provides services to millions of Internet users around the world. Our metros are on the edge of our network where Google connects to its users. The Network Team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. Our team owns the full life cycle of all space, power, and network assets in all of Google’s data centers and metro points of presence globally. From the foundation, we are involved from site acquisition to construction and are accountable for what space and power is delivered. We're involved in every facet of network delivery from architecture and design to installation, configuration, activation, and commissioning.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Build and operate Google's network reliably and at scale.
* Execute deployment, maintenance, and operations of private data networks worldwide.
* Develop creative approaches and collaborate with cross-functional teams to keep operational costs low.
* Monitor the network and repair issues while anticipating needs and escalating issues.
* Own network documentation, update and maintain network designs and plans.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Job Title:** Engineering Manager

**Location:** Hybrid

**Job Type:** Full-time

ServiceChannel Managers are the drivers of technology and team excellence, turning ideas into impactful solutions. As Engineering Manager, you will lead the design and delivery of our SaaS platform, ensuring proven software architecture and engineering best practices. Prospective candidates must have extensive experience building software as a service (SaaS) with .NET and React, and experience leading teams in these technologies. They must understand information systems and secure development lifecycles, and be able to define and enforce engineering standards across projects.

Collaborating with global teams, you will provide technical direction, mentor engineers, and work on international projects, enhancing your skills and expertise. Join us to be part of a diverse and inclusive work environment, where innovation, leadership, and collaboration drive success.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own commitments and delivery outcomes for the team(s), ensuring predictable and high-quality execution.
* Define and drive the technical strategy and roadmap for the .NET back end and React front end, including architecture, modernization and technical-debt management.
* Translate product and business goals into clear technical deliverables and execution plans.
* Mentor and coach team members, supporting their professional growth and fostering a collaborative, productive environment.
* Monitor delivery and service-health metrics (velocity, quality, reliability, performance, cost) and take corrective action when needed.
* Act as the primary technical and delivery point of contact for product, business and leadership stakeholders; partner closely with Product Management to shape roadmaps, scope initiatives and manage expectations.
* Lead collaboration across software engineers, product owners, project managers, DevOps, QA, security and mobile teams; own API contracts, versioning and backward compatibility for consumers such as web and mobile clients.
* Own release management and CI/CD practices, including safe deployments, feature flags and rollback strategies.
* Drive observability and operational excellence: logging, monitoring, alerting, SLOs, incident management, postmortems and root-cause analysis.
* Continuously improve engineering processes to increase efficiency, predictability and quality; drive adoption of code review, testing and accessibility/performance standards.
* Ensure compliance with security, privacy and regulatory requirements throughout the development lifecycle.
* Conduct regular 1-on-1s, own performance management (goal setting, mid-cycle check-ins, annual reviews), and plan team capacity to meet roadmap commitments while avoiding burnout.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum of 9 years of hands-on experience in full stack development using .NET and React.js.
* 3+ years of experience leading or managing engineering teams (people management, technical leadership and delivery ownership).
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail.
* Excellent communication, collaboration and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional and global teams.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Proven experience developing robust APIs using Microsoft .NET C#, ASP.NET MVC and .NET Core / modern .NET.
* Strong expertise in Entity Framework and LINQ for efficient data access and manipulation.
* Proficiency in front-end development with React.js and TypeScript, with a solid understanding of modern JavaScript frameworks and state management.
* Hands-on experience with SQL Server, including performance tuning and query optimization.
* Solid understanding of the SDLC and familiarity with JIRA, GitHub and CI/CD pipelines.
* Strong grasp of modern software design principles, coding best practices and scalable architecture patterns (REST API design, microservices, event-driven systems).
* Proficient in unit testing and a sound understanding of test automation frameworks and principles.
* Knowledge of application security best practices (authentication/authorization, OAuth/SSO, OWASP).

**Preferred Skills & Experience**

* Practical experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure and/or AWS, including deployment and monitoring.
* Experience with Azure services such as Functions, Service Bus, Storage Accounts and App Services.
* Experience with MongoDB.
* Familiarity with the Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana, Logstash) for logging and analytics.
* Exposure to microservices architecture, including design, development and deployment; containers and Kubernetes.
* Experience with continuous integration tools such as TeamCity, Jenkins or GitHub Actions.
* Experience with feature-flag platforms such as LaunchDarkly, and with APM/observability tools.
* Experience supporting mobile clients (iOS, Android, React Native) through APIs and SDKs.

Science, or related field

* Advanced .NET programming skills for the implementation of new features

* Software Development/Configuration Knowledge
* Understand software technologies and application hosting environments
* knowledge in Business Intelligences and Analytics tools
* Advanced experience in ITIL processes (ITIL) and SLAs
* Advanced English language skills

* Openness for business travel
* Well-developed communication skills
* Ability to work under time pressure
