Core Application Systems: Knowledge of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations.  
**Level Working Knowledge:**  

* Helps create contingency plans to mitigate impact of disruption on core applications.
* Identifies key players, criticalities, roles, and responsibilities.
* Investigates application-related issues with both business and IT professionals.
* Recommends enhancements for a major application system or related subsystems.
* Works with core application systems for a major business unit or function.

  
**Problem Solving:**

Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.  
Level Working Knowledge:
  

* Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
* Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
* Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
* Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.
* Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

  
Application Design, Architecture: Knowledge of application design and architecture principles and practices; ability to utilize application design methodologies, tools, and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into a technical application design.  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**  

* Analyzes system requirements and translates them into detailed design specifications.
* Designs complex application architectures that meet performance, scalability, and reliability requirements.
* Evaluates and selects appropriate pattern, components, technologies, and tools for application development; integrates them with technical design.
* Leads application design reviews and walkthroughs to ensure alignment between business requirements and technical solution.
* Troubleshoots complex design issues and provides innovative solutions.
* Prepares technical design documents and blueprints for applications.

Implementation: Knowledge of how to run applications for organizations; ability to implement application software within an organization and help end-users perform specific tasks (ex: accounting or graphic design).  
**Level Working Knowledge:**  

* Tracks problems associated with the quality and effectiveness of application software.
* Researches the benefits and drawbacks of an organization's application software.
* Drafts application software usage for the department's needs.
* Provides instant support for end users of application software.
* Implements a specific application software under the supervision of management.

  
**Requirements Analysis**: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.  
**Level Working Knowledge:**
  

* Follows policies, practices and standards for determining functional and informational requirements.
* Confirms deliverables associated with requirements analysis.
* Communicates with customers and users to elicit and gather client requirements.
* Participates in the preparation of detailed documentation and requirements.
* Utilizes specific organizational methods, tools and techniques for requirements analysis.

  
System and Technology Integration: Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms.  
**Level Working Knowledge:**
  

* Assists with current and planned integration initiatives.
* Explores major issues and considerations for successful system integration.
* Works with applications, data, technology bridges and a variety of platforms.
* Works with existing interfaces as well as integration and migration plans within own area.
* Plays an active role in local integration efforts.

  
**System Testing**:

Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle.  
Level Working Knowledge:
  

* Supports the project leader in developing and executing system test plans.
* Evaluates system documentation and user manuals for usability, accuracy and completeness.

**The Opportunity**

Nutanix AHV builds on top of the open-source x86-KVM stack, with an emphasis on performance, scale, and reliability. The hyperconverged nature of our stack provides the phenomenal potential for optimizations cutting across various parts of our stack - right from the kernel and ranging up to, but not limited by, the management layer.

We are looking for original thinkers who won't hesitate to demand conventional thought in arriving at out-of-the-box solutions.

We aim to work as closely aligned with the open-source community as possible. Our engineers are highly encouraged to participate in open-source community development. Any work you do will be preserved as open-source commit(s) for posterity!

A day in the life of an AHV hypervisor engineer:

* **Problems you’ll solve:**
  We’ve always believed in demanding the status quo and disrupting ourselves to provide the best in-class customer experience. A case in point: Nutanix is well known for providing a zero-touch upgrade experience for our customers. Within the hypervisor team, we are focussing on various ways to make this faster and more reliable
  + - by pushing the limits of VM live migrations towards speed and predictability, or rethinking why a hypervisor upgrade should need a reboot at all.

**About the Team**

At Nutanix, you will have the opportunity to be part of the Hypervisor team, a dynamic group that is spread out geographically. Despite being in different locations, the team collaborates effectively and maintains a strong sense of camaraderie. Working with the Hypervisor team means being surrounded by talented people who are supportive, making it a great team to work with. This setup also provides exciting exposure to diverse perspectives and opportunities for personal and professional growth.

You will report to a Senior Manager who is committed to supporting your development and ensuring your success within the organization.This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager. As for travel requirements, there are none, allowing you to focus on your projects without the need for frequent travel.

**Your Role**

You’ll be managing a team of extremely talented engineers across a spectrum of geographies and experience. The most successful candidate for this role will be someone who can:

* Constantly look for ways to improve the product, learning from customer questions and not limited to existing technologies.
* Devise solutions and back them up with solid research and numbers to prove their efficacy.
* Have the ability to convey ideas to a geographically diverse audience using excellent communication/writing skills.
Participate in design discussions, often outside one’s known comfort zone* - learning on the go.
* Proactively mentor junior members of the team, finding ways to fuel their intelligent curiosity and leverage their unique strengths.
* Not hesitate to help out with occasional customer escalations: Nutanix believes in putting customers first. While we have a huge, dedicated team to assist customers with any issues, there might be situations where engineering help might be sought to bail out a rare, unfortunate outage.
* Take pride in working with open-source communities to fold product improvements back into community projects.

**What You Will Bring**

* The must-haves:
  + Rock-solid OS/systems fundamentals drive design and implementation.
  + Low-level coding and debugging experience with at least one hardware architecture, preferably x86.
  + The ability to write and maintain enterprise-quality code.
  + Deep reasoning and detailed skills, which provide top-down thinking to break down abstract concepts into actionable pieces.
  + Proven feature delivery experience: should have 8+ years of hands-on experience of what it means to ship enterprise-quality code to customers.
* The good-to-haves:
  + Knowledge of x86 virtualization and the KVM stack.
  + Code contributions to the Linux kernel/virtualization stack is an added plus.

**Desired qualification & experience:**

* Bachelor's/Master's degree in computer science or equivalent.
* 12+ years of experience building enterprise-grade software, preferably some with guide experience.

title: Territory Manager - Diabetes
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

  
  

This position is an exciting opportunity to work with the Diabetes business. Medtronic announced its intention to separate the Diabetes division to promote future growth and innovation within the business and to reallocate investments and resources across Medtronic. The Diabetes division, now known as MiniMed, completed its IPO in March 2026. This separation provides our team with a bold opportunity to unleash our potential, enabling us to operate with greater speed and agility. As a separate entity, we anticipate leveraging increased investment to drive meaningful innovation and enhance our impact on patient care. While you will start your employment with Medtronic, upon completion of required local legal and employment processes, we expect your employment to transfer to MiniMed, subject to business needs and any applicable information and consultation requirements in your jurisdiction.

  

The Diabetes Operating Unit partners with healthcare professionals and institutions to improve outcomes for people living with diabetes through advanced insulin delivery and diabetes management solutions. This role supports the promotion, adoption, and ongoing utilization of the Diabetes portfolio across assigned customer accounts and healthcare facilities, while working closely with cross-functional commercial and clinical support teams to deliver a high-quality customer experience.
  
  
The Territory Manager is responsible for driving adoption and utilization of the Diabetes portfolio within the assigned territory of Bangalore, Mysore, and Mangalore. The role focuses on territory growth, customer relationship management, stakeholder engagement, and achievement of an annual sales target of USD 300K through effective account planning and execution.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Achieve or exceed an annual sales target of USD 300K within the assigned territory.
* Drive sales performance to increase revenue, market share, and portfolio adoption across assigned accounts.
* Build and maintain relationships with endocrinologists, diabetologists, healthcare professionals, hospital stakeholders, and key decision-makers.
* Educate customers on the clinical and operational benefits of Diabetes products and solutions.
* Provide product, procedural, and technical support during customer interactions and clinical activities.
* Develop and execute territory business plans aligned with regional business objectives.
* Identify and convert new business opportunities to expand customer reach and product utilization.
Maintain accurate sales forecasts, customer activity records, account plans, and commercial documentation using approved business systems  

  

**Required Qualifications**

* High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 6+ years experience OR Associate’s Degree AND 4+ years experience OR Bachelor’s Degree AND 2+ years experience.
* Kannada language proficiency with the ability to conduct business discussions, customer engagement, and presentations in Kannada.
* Experience managing customer accounts and achieving territory sales objectives.
* Valid ability to travel extensively across Bangalore, Mysore, and Mangalore.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 2+ years of medical device or pharmaceutical sales experience within the diabetes therapy area.
* Experience supporting public hospitals, healthcare institutions, or government healthcare accounts.
* Knowledge of insulin pump therapy, continuous glucose monitoring, or diabetes management solutions.
* Experience participating in tender management, pricing submissions, and commercial documentation activities.
Ability to analyze territory performance data and translate insights into business growth plans.  

**Physical Job Requirements**  
  
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.
‌
‌

**Recruitment Fraud Alert**

We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind:

  

Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses.

  

Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate.

  

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments.

  

If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic.com .

A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.

title: Manager, Site Reliability Engineer (Production Engineering)
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world's largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world's hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

**Role**

We are looking for a Manager, Site Reliability Engineering to join our team. This is a Hybrid (Bangalore) role, reporting to the VP, Site Reliability Engineering in the Engineering department.

In this role, you will lead a team of Production Engineers responsible for the reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of our global platform. You will provide the technical leadership and execution rigor to drive an automation-first and reliability-focused engineering culture. By maturing observability, operational readiness, and architectural standards, you will help reduce Mean Time to Mitigate (MTTM) and improve the resilience of a globally distributed, multi-cloud infrastructure protecting millions of users.

**What you'll do (Role Expectations)**

* Lead and grow a team of Production Engineers responsible for the reliability, availability, and scalability of large-scale production services
* Drive an automation-first culture by guiding the team to eliminate manual toil, improve workflows, and build resilient, self-healing tools and systems
* Implement and mature observability practices, including monitoring, alerting, SLIs/SLOs, and error budgets to improve service health and operational decision-making
* Lead high-severity incident response, strengthen response playbooks, and drive deep post-incident reviews that result in durable engineering improvements
* Partner with Engineering and cross-functional teams to conduct operability reviews and influence architecture and service design for scale, resilience, and maintainability

**Who You Are (Success Profile)**

* Acts as an owner with an authentic passion for operational excellence and a strong bias for action, navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and tactical execution.
* Fosters a high-trust, collaborative environment that values transparent feedback, healthy debate, and shared team success above individual accolades.
* Champions the customer experience by anchoring engineering decisions in solving critical, real-world problems for both internal stakeholders and external users.
* Brings deep technical curiosity and an innovative mindset to solve complex architectural challenges, continuously seeking more resilient, automated, and scalable solutions.
* Leads with unwavering integrity and high accountability, cultivating trust across organizations through transparent communication and consistent follow-through.

**What We're Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)**

* Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
* 8+ years of experience managing reliability, scalability, and availability for large-scale production services
* 4+ years of people management experience leading engineering, SRE, or Production Engineering teams
* Strong technical background in production engineering, infrastructure, or site reliability, with proficiency in programming using Python, Go, or similar
* Strong foundation in networking protocols, Linux systems, and distributed architecture
* Experience leading high-stakes incident management in a 24/7 on-call environment and using structured operational practices to drive service maturity

**What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
* Experience driving reliability programs involving capacity engineering, disaster recovery, chaos engineering, and resilience testing
* Deep technical understanding of networking protocols, global routing, traffic tunneling, DNS at scale, and proxy architectures, with demonstrated success scaling high-performing engineering teams

description:

As a **certified B Corp**, we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance.

Today, more than **500,000 businesses** across **180 countries**—from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our **reliable technology** and **75+ integrations** help them create **unparalleled customer experiences,** without the usual tech headaches.

In 2024, we reached **€179M ARR** with nearly **1,000 team members** worldwide. And we’re just getting started!

Brevo is one of the world’s leading CRM and marketing platforms, helping businesses build strong customer relationships through connected, omnichannel experiences.

Within Brevo, our **Ecommerce Business Unit** powers targeted marketing, customer engagement, and revenue growth for over 50,000 merchants globally, primarily across the US and Europe. Our technology is trusted by leading international brands, including **Levi’s, Louis Vuitton, Tissot, Chanel, and L’Occitane**, to drive seamless merchant and shopper interactions across the entire customer journey.

**The Role:**

  

You’ll be the front line of Brevo’s customer experience for our Live chat or email ticket support. Customers will rely on you to resolve their questions quickly, accurately, and with care, so every conversation leaves them feeling heard and supported.  
  
Alongside real-time troubleshooting, you will play a pivotal role in customer success by helping new merchants through a seamless onboarding and migration process from other ESPs. Your day-to-day will be a balance between fast-paced reactive support and proactive enablement: leading customer trainings, developing clear SOPs, and mastering the platform inside and out to spot growth opportunities and generate qualified leads.  
  
You will act as a critical bridge between our merchants and internal teams, translating daily user feedback into actionable insights for Product and Development. This is a role for an autonomous, problem-solving self-starter who thrives in a remote startup environment, takes pride in driving customer satisfaction, and wants to grow alongside a fast-moving e-commerce platform.

### **Your impact at Brevo:**

* **Live Chat Support:** Deliver real-time, exceptional support via live chat, swiftly resolving issues so merchants feel heard and supported.
* **Customer Onboarding & Training:** Guide new merchants through setup and migration, leading engaging sessions and onboarding sessions so they know exactly what to do next.
* **Product Mastery:** Become a Brevo guru, developing deep functional & industry expertise to solve both straightforward inquiries and complex edge cases.
* **Process & SOP Documentation:** Create, update, and refine internal standard operating procedures and self-serve documentation to share knowledge across the team.
* **Product Feedback Loop:** Champion the customer voice by capturing user insights and partnering with Product and Engineering to improve the platform.
* **Night Shift Coverage:** Open to working the night shift to provide reliable, responsive coverage for our global merchant base.

### **Who you are:**

* **Relevant Experience:** 3+ years of proven track record in a customer support, onboarding, or implementation role, ideally within SaaS, e-commerce, or the Shopify ecosystem.
* **Clear Communication:** Excellent written English with the ability to explain complex technical concepts simply, warmly, and concisely.
* **Ownership & Attitude:** A proactive, user-first mindset focused on making merchants successful rather than just closing tickets.
* **Technical Aptitude & Curiosity:** Eagerness to learn the technical nuances of Brevo, Shopify, and e-commerce mechanics, backed by strong problem-solving skills.
* **Autonomy & Organisation:** Self-motivated and comfortable working remotely, managing time effectively, and documenting solutions as you learn.
* **Bonus Points:** Prior experience with platforms like Intercom or Zendesk, working remotely in a fast-paced startup, or managing difficult customer interactions with poise

If you don’t meet all the requirements below but believe this opportunity matches your expectations and experience, we still encourage you to apply!

### **Why people love working at Brevo:**

* **A place to grow, together:** Join a diverse, international team in a modern office buzzing with energy and ideas.
* **Practical perks for everyday balance:** Cab Facility and per-day meal vouchers; Employee-friendly salary structure; 1.4x pay on holidays/weekends for critical work; excellent referral program with high-value gift options (e.g., bike, flight tickets)
* **Learning, every step of the way:** Over 1,55,000 courses on Udemy, along with facilitator-led sessions and personalised training programs tailored to individual and team needs
* **Flexible for life:** A hybrid setup (2 days WFH), budget for your home workspace, and a generous leave policy to help you balance life and work effortlessly
* **Wellbeing that works:** INR 10 Lakh medical insurance, maternity support, childcare facilities, and wellness bonuses to keep you and your family covered
* **A culture that cares:** Annual company off-sites, inter-office trips, team outings, active social, green, and LGBTQIA+ communities, along with festive celebrations - all making Brevo a vibrant and inclusive workplace.

### **Your candidate journey:**

* HR Screening: 30 mins
* Take-Home Case Study: 48 hours
* Team Interview: In-office- 60 Mins
* Hiring Manager Interview: Virtual 60 mins
* Cultural Fitment with HOD: Virtual 30 mins

Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, if this role speaks to you, we’d love to hear from you.

At Brevo, we’re proud to be an AI-first company. Still, every application is carefully reviewed by a member of our team.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: NPD - Service Manager (Kitchen Appliances)
description:
**Position Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Service Manager - Appliances to manage after-sales service, product defect verification, warranty claims, replacements, and vendor coordination for our appliance category. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in home or kitchen appliances and be capable of identifying product defects, validating customer complaints, coordinating with vendors for repair or replacement, and ensuring timely closure of service issues. The role will work closely with Customer Care, Quality, New Product Development, Warehouse, Supply Chain, and appliance vendors to improve service quality and reduce recurring product issues.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Defect Identification & Verification:**
  Review and validate appliance-related customer complaints to identify whether the issue is a product defect, usage-related concern, transit damage, or service requirement.
* **Warranty Management:**
  Verify warranty eligibility based on purchase details, product condition, warranty terms, and complaint nature before approving repair, replacement, or further action.
* **Vendor Coordination:**
  Coordinate with appliance manufacturers, OEMs, and service vendors for warranty claims, repair support, spare parts, replacement approvals, and defective product resolution.
* **Defective Product Replacement:**
  Ensure defective appliances are repaired or replaced within agreed timelines in coordination with vendors, Customer Care, Warehouse, and Supply Chain teams.
* **Product Inspection:**
  Conduct or coordinate inspection of returned or defective appliances to validate the issue before processing vendor claims or replacements.
* **Root Cause Analysis:**
  Analyze recurring defects, service complaints, warranty claims, and return patterns to identify root causes and drive corrective actions with vendors and internal teams.
* **Service Escalation Management:**
  Handle critical and escalated appliance service cases and ensure timely resolution with proper communication to relevant stakeholders.
* **Vendor Claim Tracking:**
  Maintain records of defective units, warranty claims, replacements, credit notes, pending cases, and vendor closures.
* **Spare Parts Coordination:**
  Work with vendors to ensure availability of critical spare parts required for appliance repairs and service support.
* **Service TAT Monitoring:**
  Track turnaround time for inspection, repair, replacement, and claim closure and ensure service cases are resolved within defined timelines.
* **Customer Complaint Analysis:**
  Review complaint trends, customer feedback, ratings, and service-related concerns to identify opportunities for product and service improvement.
* **Quality Feedback:**
  Share structured defect and service feedback with Quality and NPD teams to improve future product quality, design, specifications, and vendor performance.
* **Return & Replacement Control:**
  Work with Customer Care and Operations teams to ensure only validated defective cases are processed for replacement or warranty claims.
* **Vendor Performance Monitoring:**
  Track vendor performance based on defect rates, service responsiveness, warranty closure time, spare availability, and replacement support.
* **Documentation & MIS:**
  Maintain accurate records and periodic reports on service complaints, defect categories, warranty claims, replacements, vendor recoveries, and pending cases.
* **Process Improvement:**
  Develop and improve SOPs for appliance service, warranty verification, defect handling, replacement approval, and vendor claim management.
* **Cross-functional Coordination:**
  Collaborate with Customer Care, QA, NPD, Warehouse, Ecommerce, Supply Chain, Finance, and vendors for effective service case closure.

**Mandatory Experience & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Electrical / Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 5-8 years of experience in after-sales service, service operations, warranty management, or appliance service management.
* Mandatory hands-on experience in Home / Kitchen Appliances.
* Experience handling products such as mixer grinders, blenders, choppers, induction cooktops, electric kettles, air fryers, rice cookers, OTGs, or similar appliances.
* Strong experience in defect identification, warranty verification, vendor coordination, repair, and replacement handling.
* Good understanding of electrical and functional appliance issues, common failure modes, and service requirements.
* Experience working with OEMs, manufacturers, service centres, or appliance vendors.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, coordination, and escalation-management skills.
* Good communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to maintain service records, MIS, claim trackers, and vendor follow-ups.

**Preferred Exposure**

* Experience with consumer durable, D2C, ecommerce, or home appliance brands.
* Exposure to service centre operations and technician coordination.
* Experience in warranty cost control and vendor claim recovery.
* Knowledge of spare parts planning and defective stock handling.
* Experience using customer complaint data and service trends to drive product quality improvements.

**About The Indus Valley**

The Indus Valley is a Chennai-based direct-to-consumer cookware and kitchen brand focused on health, safety, quality, and innovation. We are committed to developing products that improve everyday cooking experiences while maintaining strong standards of reliability, functionality, customer satisfaction, and responsible product development.

title: AVP - BA Client Journey Execution
description:

title: AVP Premier Relationship Manager
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
**Business Descriptor**
International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
To build and grow HSBC Premier Banking relationships with high-net-worth individual (HNI) customers, acting as a single point of contact and providing comprehensive banking support and financial advisory aligned to customer needs. The role focuses on delivering against business targets while meeting Global Premier Service Standards and ensuring strong conduct and regulatory outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibility**

* Grow profit and portfolio value across Premier client relationships through new and existing business
* Deliver agreed financial targets through effective relationship management and consistent service delivery
* Conduct regular client reviews to understand needs and recommend suitable products and services
* Identify wealth review opportunities and provide tailored wealth solutions aligned to customer goals
* Build long-term client relationships that improve retention satisfaction and wallet share
* Maintain accurate client information using client relationship management tools and disciplined record keeping
* Manage a prospect pipeline and apply structured plans to deepen and expand relationships
* Embed HSBC policies and controls including KYC AML and sanctions alongside sales quality requirements

**Eligibility & Educational Qualifications**

* Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline with 4-7 years of relevant experience
* Substantial experience as a Relationship Manager within the Retail or Premier Banking segment
* Proven outcomes in wealth products with a record of meeting portfolio and revenue goals
* Strong wealth management technical knowledge to provide suitable recommendations and advice
* Experience building trusted relationships with high-net-worth individual (HNI) clients as a consistent point of contact
* Capability using client relationship management systems to maintain accurate timely client data
* Experience partnering with Compliance Credit and Risk and Internal Control teams to deliver balanced risk outcomes
* Required local regulatory licences and accreditations for wealth management or equivalent demonstrable experience
* AMFI IRDA NISM XXI A (PMS Certification) and NISM XIII (SIF Certification) or equivalent certification or equivalent demonstrable experience where required by the market

**Additional Notes**

* Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
  
  
Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India

title: Territory Manager, South India
description:
**About Aerogen:**

Headquartered in the vibrant city of Galway, Ireland, with offices around the world, Aerogen is proud to be the world leader in acute care aerosol drug delivery. Recognised through multiple MedTech awards, including being named Galway Chamber Company of the Year 2025, and twelve-time winner of the Zenith Award for Respiratory Care Excellence in North America, our employees make a difference to patients’ lives every day, having reached over 30 million patients in more than 80 countries.

Today, Aerogen is powered by a global team representing 54 nationalities, working together with a shared commitment to improving patient care. Our talented and skilled team collaborate to innovate, challenge and test not only in relation to our products but every facet of how we work.

We lead the way by finding innovative solutions to even the most complex problems, all in the name of delivering better patient outcomes.

Our business continues to grow rapidly across the globe and, as we grow, our core culture of “We Care” universally connects us. We believe that your ambition and integrity fuels ours, and we are committed to supporting our employees to reach their full potential through tangible investment in their careers.

**What is the role?**

The person in this role is responsible for enabling the commercial performance of our distribution partners by providing clinical support and training on Aerogen products to the products’ end users. The Territory Manager leverages their own deep knowledge of Aerogen products, services and processes to nurture the relationship with existing customers and follow up and develop new opportunities. The Territory Manager supports the distributor to deliver the pipeline of sales by communicating the value of Aerogen products to the customers to overcome the clinical and commercial barriers to achieve the changes required of the customer to adopt Aerogen, whilst forging strong working relationships with cross functional teams especially Sales, Marketing and Medical Affairs.

**What are the key responsibilities?**

• Develop and implement a territory plan driving Aerogen revenues through customer engagement (at all levels), territory management and effective collaboration with Aerogen OEM and distributor partners.

• Delivery of high quality territory action plan following Aerogen commercial excellence framework including:

• Key account performance based on account potential and ensure execution against these accounts

• Reporting of weekly activities using the CRM tool

• Leverage of omnichannel customer tools to drive / reinforce access

• Leverage of global marketing campaigns

• Sales support including training, support for distributor and OEM partners

• Work with distributors partners within the region to align on strategic direction

• Collaborate with distributors partners to align on focus for growth

• Drive utilization of Aerogen’s sales excellence and learning management tools with distributors partners

• Ensure strong customer engagement including systematic KOL engagement and close liaison with Medical Affairs in key accounts as required

• Partner with Aerogen’s Marketing team on the launch of new products

• Conduct, in partnership with the distributor, peer to peer and promotion events in their assigned territory.

• Ensure strong engagement within the territory governmental sectors main KOLs responsible for major tender procurements such as Ministry of health.

• Build an access to main reimbursement authority within the assigned territory including main insurance company to enhance products being approved and covered under insurance umbrella.

• May participate in partners QBR meetings

**What education and experience are required?**

• BA or BS degree or equivalent work experience.

• Previous experience in similar commercial roles within the medical device industry

**What key skills will make you great at the role?**

• A challenger who understands well the customer’s business and uses that understanding to push the customer’s thinking and teach them something new about how they can compete more effectively

• A results-oriented individual who can assess the medium- and long-term impact of the solutions they propose

• An innovator who is not afraid to try new approaches

• A team player who constructively partners with others to achieve goals

• Good understanding of financial drivers and ability to influence the financial customers

• Strong clinical acumen

• Strong learning application

• A learning partner who understands the company and knows the product and can effectively share their knowledge and enthusiasm with a new colleague

• A relationship builder who can effectively work cross functionally

• High energy and self-driven to achieve targets

• Strong territory management skills and proven ability to drive multiple opportunities Excellent organizational and communication skills

• Ability to manage a complex sales process that has clinical and financial customers

• Proficiency in use of desktop software applications, such as MS office, LMS and CRM

• Ability to travel extensively domestically (approximately 80% of time) and internationally as require

**What is it like to work at Aerogen?**

Our purpose is to transform patient lives, and innovation is embedded in our culture. This also translates to how we look after our people. We want talented, passionate and engaged people to join Aerogen and build your career with us. We understand that your life evolves through different stages, and we are here to support our global team with a range of financial and non-financial rewards and benefits. There’s something for everyone! Here is an idea of what we offer:

• Competitive bonus plan.

• Above market life insurance.

• Opportunities for development and professional growth.

• "Aerogen Connect" – our employee-led program that helps our global teams unite and have fun.

• We donate 1% of profits and time to charities and organizations.

Visit our careers website for more information about life at Aerogen.

Aerogen is committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equality in the workplace. If you have difficulty using our application process, please contact us via email at careers@aerogen.com. Please provide your name and preferred contact method.

description:

* Ability to balance technical delivery with business priorities and growth objectives.
* Experience in Agile/DevOps methodologies and modern delivery practices.
* Strong analytical mindset with focus on quality, scalability, and performance.

* Data Migration using SSIS (KingswaySoft) and Azure Data Factory

* Proven track record of delivering Dynamics 365 CRM programs at scale.

title: Associate Manager – Customer Services & Logistics
description:
**Overview**
Location : Gummidipundi
  
  
**Position Objective**

* To own the complete domestic customer order process – from order receipt until delivery as per agreed terms – from all distribution warehouses (Factory warehouse, 3PL warehouse and C&F locations).
* To act as the contact point for the domestic Sales team to fulfil customer order requirements.
* To manage customer returns, deliveries and secondary freight cost for the domestic business.
* C&F order processing, Factory warehouse and 3PL warehouse customer order processing report to this role.
* Working in factory environment.
* Interacts with internal and external customers.

**Responsibilities**




+ Own the processing of all domestic Sales orders in M3 – accurate and on time – for Factory warehouse, 3PL warehouse and all C&F locations.
+ Ensure every customer order is delivered as per agreed terms (quantity, date and delivery terms) from the right distribution warehouse.
+ Act as the contact point for the domestic Sales team; handle spot and urgent requirements and prioritise based on stock and customer commitment.
+ Keep the Sales team informed in real time on order status, stock position, QC release and expected delivery; inform delays in advance, not after the event.
+ Coordinate with Planning, Production and QC on stock availability and QC release for open orders.
+ Review open and overdue orders daily and drive them to closure; know the status of every open order at fingertip level.
+ Lead and monitor order processing at C&F, Factory warehouse and 3PL warehouse; ensure billed goods are dispatched the same day.
+ Track deliveries and proof of delivery; resolve transit and delivery issues with transporters and C&F.
+ Manage customer returns end to end – approval, physical receipt, QC check, stock posting and credit note – in coordination with Sales, QC and Finance.
+ Handle customer complaints on short, damaged, wrong or delayed deliveries; find the root cause, close within timeline and track complaint trends.
+ Own secondary freight cost; review freight rates, vehicle utilisation and load/route planning to optimise cost.
+ Verify transporter and C&F freight bills before submission to Finance; track freight cost against budget.

+ Ensure zero difference between book stock and physical stock at all distribution warehouses.

+ Lead, guide and monitor the Executive and order processing teams; ensure proper backup so that operations do not stop in anyone’s absence.

+ Collaborate with the Sales team to gather and review customer order details.
+ Ensure accurate and timely processing of customer orders in the system.

+ Coordinate with relevant departments to confirm product availability and delivery timelines.
+ Work closely with logistics partners and internal teams to organize and optimize domestic transportation of goods.
+ Monitor shipment schedules, track deliveries, and address any logistical challenges that may arise.
+ Manage 3rd party depot operations for order management and ensure timely delivery.
+ Collaborate with the Planning and C&F team to ensure efficient stock management and timely dispatch of products.
+ Act as a liaison between the Sales team and internal departments to facilitate clear communication and understanding of customer requirements.
+ Provide real-time updates to the Sales team regarding order status, stock availability, and potential delays.
+ Proactively communicate any issues or challenges that may impact the order fulfillment process.
+ Address and resolve any issues related to order fulfillment or logistics, working proactively to find solutions.
+ Escalate complex issues to higher management when necessary and provide recommendations for improvement.
+ Maintain accurate records of customer orders, shipments, and logistics activities.
+ Ensure compliance with all documentation requirements for domestic shipments.
+ Document and track customer complaints and transit insurance claims for reporting and analysis.
+ Continuously evaluate and identify opportunities to improve the efficiency of customer service and logistics processes.
+ Implement best practices and contribute to the development of standard operating procedures

title: Director, Salesforce Program Leader
description:
**Description**
**The Experience**
As an Engagement Delivery Director, you are a senior individual contributor and a foremost expert in delivering intended business value from the Salesforce platform. This is a fully-billable, high-impact role deployed as a Delivery Leader to our strategic and complex customer engagements.
  
  
You will be responsible for the end-to-end success of programs, with a primary focus on maximizing platform adoption, demonstrating ROI, and mitigating revenue or license attrition risk. You will ensure that emerging capabilities, including agentic and generative AI programs, are delivered on time, within budget, and with a strict focus on quantifiable business outcomes.
  
  
You will act as the key strategic advisor and point of accountability, building trust with executive stakeholders and ensuring the customer's long-term success on the platform.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Program Accountability: Assume ultimate accountability for establishing, executing and overseeing program governance to deliver strategic value-realization and recovery plans for strategic customer accounts, ensuring clear governance frameworks for complex multi-cloud and enterprise AI implementation roadmaps.
* Executive Stakeholder Management: Engage directly with C-level stakeholders to build trust, define success metrics, and demonstrate measurable platform ROI. You will lead all executive stakeholder forums, like Steering Committees, focusing heavily on Performance Evaluation & ROI to help customers quantify the financial and operational business value of their AI investments.
* Strategic Advisory: Serve as the primary, billable expert providing strategic oversight to ensure program delivery aligns with the customer's core business objectives.
* Risk & Scope Management: Proactively identify, assess, and manage program risks, dependencies, and scope changes. You will own the executive-level escalation process and translate complex technical issues—such as AI compliance, data readiness, and security boundaries—into clear business implications.
* Commercial Acumen: Lead and support pre-sales teams in initial scoping, change management, and identifying opportunities for expansion of the running program, accurately sizing the organizational change management and delivery effort required for generative AI and digital agent rollouts.
* Delivery Governance: Define, structure, and oversee complex engagement models (e.g., T&M, Fixed Price), ensuring all delivery commitments, milestones, and scope are meticulously managed. You will champion an AI-First Delivery & Engineering methodology from a management perspective, tracking program health, team velocity, and delivery efficiency.
* Cross-Functional Influence: Provide expert guidance and strategic direction to customer, partner (SI), and internal teams (e.g., MuleSoft, UI/UX, technical PODs) to ensure cohesive and successful program outcomes.
* Subject Matter Expertise: Act as a deep subject matter expert on the Salesforce platform, including new products, industry trends, and best-practice implementation strategies involving custom development, integration, and data migration.
* Contract Management: Prior experience in understanding and working with MSA/SOW and ensuring delivery is compliant to the terms laid out there.

**You're Our Person If...**

* Experience: 15+ years of experience, predominantly in consulting or strategic advisory roles, managing large-scale, complex SaaS/CRM program implementations.
* Platform Expertise: Deep expertise in the Salesforce platform and ecosystem, including common implementation patterns, integration challenges, custom development, and data migration strategies, and foundational understanding of Agentforce use cases and data cloud dependencies.
* Executive Presence: Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with a proven ability to build C-level relationships, navigate difficult conversations, and negotiate high-stakes outcomes.
* Account Recovery: Proven experience in strategic account recovery, risk mitigation, and driving platform adoption in complex, at-risk customer environments.
* Cross-cultural experience: Must have prior experience working in a multi-cultural environment with teams and stakeholders geographically spread.
* Team management: Prior experience leading the program pre-sales & delivery team by fostering continuous learning and ensuring members are well-trained, while supporting and driving career growth, personal and team development, well-being, diversity, and inclusion.
* Methodology: Demonstrated mastery of program management methodologies (Agile, Hybrid) and the ability to apply them to complex enterprise environments, including adapting agile frameworks to support the iterative testing and validation loops unique to generative AI solutions.
* Mindset: A self-starting, individual contributor mindset with the ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy and influence across matrixed organizations.
* Leadership: Ability to lead a team of consultants in a matrix environment towards a common goal while navigating customer & internal organizational landscape.
* Education: Degree or equivalent relevant experience.
* Certifications: Must have at least either of these Project management certification (PMI-ACP / PMP / PgMP / Prince 2) and having Salesforce Certification is an asset. An AI Associate or related AI/ML delivery credential is highly valued.

The Customer Support Team Lead is a strong leader with a mindset that allows them to build strong teams and processes that put our customers first, while providing continuous feedback from customers to various product teams.

The Customer Support Team Lead will provide leadership to the Customer Support Team. Establish and maintain Quality Compliance and other processes required for an exceptional level of customer support. Customer Support Team is the primary point of contact for the Wise customers and forms a large part of the company’s profile. As such, all enquiries to Customer Support need to be acted upon with efficiency and professionalism.

It is the Customer Support Team Lead’s primary responsibility to ensure that expectations are clearly set and that members of the Customer Support team are highly engaged, motivated, armed with all necessary equipment and software, have opportunities to contribute to tactics and strategy, and opportunities to learn and grow.

**The Customer Support Team Lead will ensure that customer service is maintained by:**

* Liaising with the relevant departments to ensure that customer objectives are being met
* Ensuring a high level of product knowledge within Customer Support team members as evidenced through turnaround time of issues and ability of Customer Support to resolve issues independently
* Ensuring a high level of customer focus (internally and externally) with due care and attention to customer priority issues and appropriate levels of customer communications
* Ensuring that regular audits of communications are performed and that appropriate training is provided to personnel in this area
* Assigning and monitoring the customer support tickets and implementing action plans and escalation procedures to address problematic areas
* Developing and maintaining customer satisfaction measurement metrics
* Defining and implementing the procedures and policies to ensure that high-quality service is delivered to customers (both internal and external) and adherence to strict SLA’s
* Seeking feedback and following up information from customers

**Also, communicating the customers’ perception of value and quality to the business and identifying:**

* Any bugs in the product that result in issues for the customer
* Any improvements that could be made to the product itself – its features or functionality – to bring it more in line with what the customer defines as quality or value
* Any improvements to the product’s inbuilt support functionality that could reduce customer frustration / the need to make a support call
* Participate directly in the product design process, to identify gaps between customer expectations and product design as early as possible
* The Customer Support Team Lead is primarily responsible for the implementation and maintenance of a Customer Support Team within the Wise.
* The Customer Support Team Lead will be the customer advocate, ensuring that all customer support requests (be they internal or external) are followed up in a timely fashion, while performing Quality Assurance and Quality Control on customer service requests ongoing.
* We are looking for a human-centric leader who is not just managing metrics, but is a proactive champion for their people and customers, navigating complex issues with emotional intelligence and data-driven insight.

title: Customer Support Manager
description:
**A MULTI-BRAND D2C CONSUMER PRODUCTS COMPANY**

**Job Description**

**Customer Experience | Full-Time | India (on-site) | US Customers**

**Customer Scope:**
You will own customer support across our full portfolio of consumer brands. Our customers are based in the United States, and most of our support volume arrives outside India business hours.

**Location**
: Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad

**Employment Type**
: Full-Time

**Work Hours**
: 6 Days WFO

**Shift Timings**
: 10:00AM - 7:00PM

**Notice Period: 15- 30 Days (Maximum)**

We are hiring a Customer Support Manager to own the entire customer experience after the sale. You will lead our day and night support team, set the standard for how we talk to customers, and make sure every email, direct message, chat, and review gets a fast, accurate, and human response. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will coach your team, step into escalations yourself, and use what customers tell us to help the rest of the business get better. For a subscription-heavy

business like ours, great support protects revenue directly, through saved subscriptions, fewer chargebacks, and happy repeat customers.

**Key Responsibilities:**

• Lead and develop the support team across day and night shifts, including scheduling, coverage, performance reviews, and coaching.

• Own support across every channel, including email, social media direct messages, live chat, marketplace messages, and product reviews.

• Set and track service standards, including first response time, resolution time, backlog, customer satisfaction, and quality scores, and report on them regularly.

• Manage subscription support end to end, including cancellations, updates, pauses, and save offers, with the aim of retaining customers wherever it is the right outcome for them.

• Own refunds, replacements, and returns, and make sure they follow our policies consistently while still treating customers fairly.

• Manage chargebacks and payment disputes, including responding with strong evidence and spotting patterns that cause them.

• Own reputation management, including responding to reviews on platforms such as Trustpilot and TikTok, and resolving negative or hidden reviews quickly.

• Handle escalations personally when needed, and drive upset customers and difficult cases through to a resolution.

• Run quality assurance by auditing a sample of tickets, giving structured feedback, and holding the team to a clear quality bar.

• Build and maintain the support playbook, including macros, knowledge base articles, and standard operating procedures, and keep them current as products and policies change.

• Recruit, onboard, and train new team members, and plan ahead for attrition and peak periods.

• Turn customer feedback into insight for the growth, product, and operations teams, so recurring issues get fixed at the source.

• Work with our technology team to automate repetitive tasks and improve our helpdesk, storefront, and subscription tools.

• Produce clear daily and weekly reporting on volumes, performance, and open issues.

**Required Qualifications and Experience:**

• At least five years of experience in customer support, including at least two years leading a support team.

• Experience in a direct-to-consumer, e-commerce, or subscription business, supporting customers in the United States.

• Hands-on experience with a helpdesk platform such as Freshdesk, Zendesk, or Gorgias, including reporting, automations, and macros.

• A track record of running support to clear service level targets, using metrics such as response time, resolution time, and customer satisfaction.

• Experience managing refunds, replacements, and chargebacks, and working within defined policies.

• Excellent written and verbal English, and the judgment to coach others on tone and communication.

• A calm, solution-focused approach to difficult customers and high-pressure escalations.

• Comfort managing a team across day and night shifts.

• A bachelor's degree is preferred but not required.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

• Experience with subscription businesses, including cancellation handling and retention or save flows.

• Experience with Shopify and subscription management tools.

• Experience in health, wellness, pet, or other consumer categories where product questions are common.

• Experience managing support for marketplaces such as Amazon, Walmart, or TikTok Shop.

As a Principal Technical Account Manager, you will serve as a trusted customer advocate and senior technical advisor. You will provide technical leadership across the full solution lifecycle—from discovery and design through build, testing, deployment, and go-live—while coordinating cross-functional teams to remove blockers and drive successful customer outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with customers to understand business goals, requirements, challenges, and desired outcomes, translating them into practical technical and process solutions.
* Lead fit-gap assessments of customer cloud environments and develop roadmaps for cloud transition, implementation, and optimization.
* Define and align the functional and technical vision for program solutions with customer and internal stakeholders.
* Lead and oversee end-to-end delivery across requirements intake, design, build, testing, deployment, and go-live.
* Design secure, scalable OCI architectures, including networking, security, identity and access management, and infrastructure frameworks.

* Align customer solutions with Oracle product roadmaps, release cycles, business enhancements, and production break-fix requirements.
* Collaborate with portfolio management and cross-functional teams, including business analysts, integration specialists, quality assurance, development, support, services, and third-party partners.
* Communicate solution options, risks, progress, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical customer stakeholders.
* Contribute to strategic planning, program governance, customer satisfaction, service delivery, and cross-functional team leadership.

**Responsibilities**
**Qualifications & Skills**
**Mandatory**

* 11 years of experience in a customer-facing, consultative, or technology-related role; or an equivalent combination of education and experience:

+ Bachelor’s degree in business, computer information systems, computer science, or a related field plus 7 years of relevant experience.
+ Master’s degree in a related field plus 5 years of relevant experience.
+ Doctorate in a related field plus 3 years of relevant experience.

title: Supervisor, Customer Service
description:
**Description**
The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
  
  
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
  
  
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
  
  
**Brief Job Overview**
The Supervisor, Customer Success provides operational leadership for the India-based Customer Success team within a global, matrixed Customer Success & Operations organization, with primary responsibility for day-to-day execution and resolution of customer requests related to quotes, orders, order changes, order status, fulfillment, pricing, and other transactional activities across the customer journey. Working closely with the US-based Senior Manager, Customer Success, the Supervisor translates global strategy and Success standards into effective local execution, while leading team performance, workforce management, escalations, process adherence, and continuous improvement to drive timely, accurate, and consistent customer outcomes.
  
  
**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
  
  
Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.
  
  
**Leadership And Operational Direction**
The Supervisor, Customer Success has the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Provide visible, inclusive leadership and set clear direction, Success standards, priorities, and accountability for the Customer Success function in India within the global operating model.
* Align routinely with the Senior Manager, Customer Success on functional priorities, performance expectations, customer and business risks, and execution plans for the India Customer Success team.
* Translate Customer Success Operations strategy into executable team plans, goals, measures, and routines aligned with customer, revenue, quality, and operational objectives.
* Lead through change by communicating business context, preparing the team for new processes and technologies, and reinforcing adoption and sustained execution.
* Promote a culture of customer focus, quality, integrity, collaboration, continuous improvement, and equitable employee engagement.
* Exercise sound financial stewardship, manage resources responsibly, and support business priorities within approved budgets.

**Team Management And Capability Building**

* Direct daily team operations and equitably allocate omni-channel work, including orders, quotes, cases, calls, and correspondence, based on volume, skills, priorities, and Success commitments.
* Recruit, onboard, train, coach, and develop Customer Success Representatives, Specialists, and Supervisors to build capability, engagement, and succession readiness.
* Establish clear job expectations and manage performance through regular feedback, recognition, mentoring, development planning, counseling, and corrective action when required.
* Monitor workload, productivity, quality, data accuracy, and Success results; identify gaps and implement targeted coaching, training, and process improvements.
* Ensure employees have the tools, knowledge, procedures, and cross-training needed to deliver consistent, high-quality Success and maintain business continuity.

**Customer Escalation And Resolution Management**

* Own and coordinate the timely investigation, documentation, communication, and resolution of complex, sensitive, or high-impact customer complaints and escalations.
* Assess business and customer impact, establish the appropriate urgency, engage accountable partners, and maintain clear ownership through resolution and follow-up.
* Identify recurring complaint and escalation themes, determine root causes with relevant partners, and convert customer feedback into corrective and preventive actions.
* Provide hands-on support across the full order cycle when needed, including quotations, registration, ordering, payment, fulfillment, access, shipment, and post-order concerns.
* Ensure escalation handling follows applicable SOPs, operating manuals, complaint requirements, and customer communication standards.
* Support the Customer Service Manager in reviewing, maintaining, and updating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure Customer Service processes remain accurate, current, and aligned with operational requirements. Conduct periodic reviews of SOPs and identify opportunities for process clarification and improvement.

**Operational Governance, Compliance, And Continuous Improvement**

* Develop, maintain, and improve Customer Success policies, SOPs, operating procedures, knowledge resources, and controls to support consistent and compliant execution.
* Ensure adherence to applicable requirements for controlled substances, permits, customs, foreign licensing, shipments, and order documentation.
* Monitor reporting and database accuracy; analyze service, quality, volume, productivity, and complaint data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
* Lead or support improvements that strengthen customer experience, service quality, efficiency, productivity, cost effectiveness, and organizational readiness.
* Maintain current knowledge of USP products, service, systems, and Customer Success practices, and perform other related duties or special projects as assigned.
* The Supervisor supports for ISO audits within the India Customer Success department, coordinating audit activities, maintaining compliance documentation, driving corrective actions, and ensuring adherence to established quality management standards.

**Who is USP Looking For?**
**Education & Experience**
The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree required in a business, sales or related field.
* Minimum of seven (7) years of experience in Customer Success, Sales, or related field in a multi-cultural environment, preferably for a global organization.
* Experience with artificial intelligence (AI), automation, or other emerging technologies in a customer service or business environment is highly desirable. Relevant AI-related training or certifications are considered a strong plus.
* Previous experience in an Order to Cash environment required.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Fluency in English required, and a second language strongly preferred.
* Willingness to work in rotational shifts.
* Customer Success focused and ability to provide a high degree of customer Success.
* Must possess ability to handle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment with a high level for stress tolerance while maintaining composure and enthusiasm.
* Excellent organization, problem analysis, problem solving and decision-making skills, and attention to details required.
* Excellent communication skills (written and oral) and presentation skills are a must.
* Individuals must possess the ability to influence without direct authority.
* Results driven with demonstrated successful outcomes.
* Excellent supervisory skills with a history of building high performing and motivated teams.
* Strong team builder and people leader with the ability and desire to work well with diverse employees and customers in a cooperative and friendly manner.
* Must be able to work independently and in a team environment.
* Must be highly proficient in the use of Microsoft software (word processing, email, spreadsheet, database, and Internet).
* Proficiency in Oracle and CRM systems desired.
* Familiarity with automated order entry systems, Ariba or other EDI processes a plus.
* Good understanding of complaint handling and resolution management.
* Familiarity with imports, exports, customs, and business with other countries strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with the culture(s) in the applicable geography(s) is strongly preferred.
* Candidates must be able to work flexible hours, when needed.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
Yes
  
  
**Benefits**
USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.
  
  
**Job Category**
Customer Service
  
  
**Job Type**
Full-Time

The team acts as pre and post-sales specialists using technical expertise and operational experience to consult with and support publishers using Google Ad Manager ad serving and yield management products. Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. title: Lead, Client Service Operations

Working within our team, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. We offer excellent career development, diverse opportunities and fantastic work life balance including hybrid working. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
