You will manage multiple engagement teams and stakeholders, both internally and externally, taking full ownership of projects and relationships. Your focus will be on delivering impactful results, on time, within budget and in line with EY’s quality and risk management practices. Key responsibilities include:
  
  

* Client Delivery and Project Management: Lead and manage multiple client engagements. Oversee planning, fieldwork and reporting of findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders. Ensuring high-quality deliverables, on time within budget.
* Technical Expertise: Act as a key trusted advisor in discussing complex regulations with clients, including UK Corporate Reform, US Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance, Global Internal Audit Standards and other industry-specific regulatory compliance requirements.
* Quality and Risk Management: Ensure compliance with EY’s quality and risk management processes across client acceptance, contracting and engagement delivery. Proactively identify and manage risks across engagements, escalating issues where appropriate.
* Stakeholder Management: Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and proactively manage client expectations to ensure alignment on project goals, timelines and deliverables. Collaborate cross-functionally with other EY service lines and subject matter experts to deliver high quality insights. Collaborate with internal leader/s, provide regular updates on engagement progress and support internal decision-making through clear communication and proactive escalation and the ability to flex communication styles.
* Team Leadership and Development: Mentor and coach junior team members through effective supervision to develop their technical and professional skills. Support career development through performance reviews and providing timely, regular and actionable feedback. You will contribute to a positive team environment by demonstrating consistent commitment and optimism toward work challenges.
* Business Development: Build the EY brand through high quality delivery. Support in the identification of new opportunities and development of proposals. Build EY’s market presence through contribution to thought leadership and client events.
* Promoting EY’s values: Champion EY’s commitments to integrity, respect and teaming in all client and internal interactions. Foster an inclusive and diverse working environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.
* Practice development: contribute to practice development and internal initiatives such as learning and development programmes and solution development.

**Skills And Experience**

* You will be a trusted manager with proven technical expertise in risk, control and compliance that will complement our teams in delivering high-quality solutions to our clients. Your skills and experience will include:
* Control & Compliance experience: Proven and relevant professional experience across core process and controls solutions (e.g. internal audit, SOX and internal controls) in consulting, government or industry. Extensive experience in process mapping, walkthroughs, risk analysis (strategic, financial, operational and compliance) and control identification and design assessment. The ability to act as a trusted advisor to clients on risk and control issues, such as controls remediation or Enterprise Risk Management.
* Technical skills and knowledge: In depth understanding of core business processes, associated risks, and leading practice controls. Strong leadership and communication skills, technical knowledge, and the ability to write at a publication quality level in order to communicate findings and recommendations to clients. Strong business acumen, including the ability to compile information quickly and accurately, and to test data and assumptions for informed decision-making.
* Engagement management: Track record demonstrating success in leading high-performing teams, mentor junior staff and foster a culture of continuous learning. Experienced in managing complex project and multiple stakeholder groups including senior clients and internal leadership. Demonstrated ability to balance project management and delivery skills across a range of clients, including financial management, quality, and risk management requirements.
* Communication and interpersonal skills: Strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and build trust at all levels. Being an active listener, having self-awareness when dealing with others, and adapting your own approach to differences in individual style and backgrounds, recognising the risk of unconscious biases.
* Client delivery: Demonstrated success in delivering high-quality, client-focused solutions on time and within budget with a commitment to going above and beyond for clients.
* Commercial acumen: Commercially aware, with a track record of developing relevant propositions and sales collateral and supporting business development efforts.
* Technology and innovation: Proficient in leveraging technology such as data analytics, automation, and AI in project delivery. Experience with data visualisation tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and core business systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle). Proficient across the Microsoft Office suite (e.g. PowerPoint, Excel and Word). Ability to develop dashboards across key data visualization tools and produce visual reports to track key risks and control metrics, noted as desirable but not essential.
* Professional attributes: Self-stater with a proactive mindset, natural curiosity and commitment to delivering excellence for our clients. Ability to work in areas of uncertainty and navigate ambiguous situations, adaptable and inclusive, with strong self-awareness and the ability to work effectively across diverse teams. Up to date with industry trends, emerging risks, and the UK regulatory landscape. Adaptability and the ability to work effectively across diverse teams.
* Other desirable skills and experience: Professional experience, skills and knowledge in the following areas is desirable but not essential; finance transformation, controls automation, programme assurance, IT control including analysing core systems (e.g., SAP and Oracle) to identify control weaknesses

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Significant managerial and professional experience in risk, process and controls services in a consulting, industry or public sector setting.
* Chartered Accountant (CA), CPA (US), ACCA (UK) or MBA with 5-10 years of experience with a large global corporate Process, Risk and Control and/or similar experience
* Experience on the following Process and Control / SOX areas:

+ Governance, controls and regulation
+ Governance, Risk & Compliance
+ Process and Control
+ Process reviews
+ Standard Operating Procedures
+ Enterprise Risk Management
+ Revenue Assurance
+ SOX
+ Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR)
+ Design and Implementation testing
+ Process walkthroughs and testing effectiveness of controls

* Strong problem solving and analytical skills
* Strong sales, presentation and client management skills
* Strong training and mentoring skills
* Ability to manage a team and to establish credibility as a trusted advisor with clients
* Effective written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to present complex information in a concise and clear manner
* Strong executive presence and ability to interface with all levels of management (EY and clients)
* Strong project management and organizational experience
* Willingness and ability to travel approximately 50% to 80% of the time

**What we look for:**

* We are interested to hear from entrepreneurial people who feed on the energy of a thriving global team. We seek a high level of drive, commitment to achieving solutions, and ability to work under pressure. We need people worthy of trust, who demonstrate enthusiasm, passion to grow fast and are highly motivated to support this purpose.
* We invite applications from all cultures, backgrounds and experiences and are proud of our culture where people from all walks of life can grow and thrive. If you want to know more about our people and our culture, search #EyCulture on LinkedIn.

**What we offer:**
EY is committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance.
  
  
We offer a competitive remuneration package. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next, including having the opportunity to gain an EY Tech MBA which is an accredited MBA program offered to all EY professionals globally
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Associate Director – Intelligent Personal Engagement
description:
****Job Description****
**Associate Director – Intelligent Personal Engagement**
**Customer Knowledge and Measurement | DHH India Hub Delivery**
**Role snapshot**
****Summary****
**Reports to**
Director – Customer Knowledge and Measurement, DHH India Hub Delivery
  
  
**Location**
Hyderabad, India; international and domestic travel as required by business
  
  
**Capability scope**
Digital solutions for customer-facing teams and service channels field engagement (face-to-face sales CRM), Veeva Sales Operations, sampling, event management, customer service, Field engagement and reporting, Field AI and associated AI capabilities, global and market deployment
  
  
**Leadership scope**
Lead product and delivery teams across Field, CRM, Veeva/Salesforce platforms, AI-enabled field workflows, operations, compliance reporting, and customer engagement execution
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
Lead the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of digital solutions supporting customer-facing teams and service channels across US and international markets, spanning field engagement, sales operations, sampling, event management, customer service, Patient CRM, transparency reporting, and associated AI capabilities, and evolve them into a connected, AI-enabled engagement ecosystem.
  
  
**Job Description**
This role sits within the Customer Knowledge and Measurement vertical of Digital Human Health (DHH), India Hub Delivery. The Associate Director, Intelligent Personal Engagement will lead the India Hub capability for the digital solutions that support our customer-facing teams and service channels across US and international markets. The role reports to the Director, Customer Knowledge and Measurement India Hub, and works as part of the US and International Intelligent Personal Engagement team.
  
  
The role is accountable for shaping and executing the strategy and roadmap for these solutions, and for delivering and continuously improving the platforms and workflows that power field engagement, sales operations, sampling, event management, customer service, Field CRM, transparency reporting, and associated AI capabilities, including Field AI.
  
  
The Associate Director will be a strategic delivery partner to the Intelligent Personal Engagement capability lead and to US and International market stakeholders, driving the evolution of these capabilities into a connected, AI-enabled ecosystem that enables more informed engagement, improves effectiveness across customer-facing teams, and delivers more consistent customer experiences, while remaining scalable, compliant, user-centered, and aligned to business outcomes across Human Health.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Shape and execute the strategy, roadmap, operating model, and delivery governance for Intelligent Personal Engagement capabilities across US and international markets, in partnership with the global capability lead and aligned with DHH priorities.
* Drive the evolution of field engagement, sales operations, customer service, event management, and transparency-reporting solutions from discrete platforms into a connected, AI-enabled ecosystem with integrated workflows, shared customer data, and reusable AI services across channels.
* Act as the accountable product owner for the Intelligent Personal Engagement product portfolio define the product vision, own and prioritize the backlog, set release plans, and make value-based trade-offs across US and international market demand.
* Manage the end-to-end product lifecycle, from discovery and business case through MVP, scale-up, and retirement, with clear product OKRs, adoption targets, and value-realization tracking for each capability.
* Lead user-centered product discovery with field representatives, field managers, market operations, and customer service teams, using journey mapping, user research, and continuous feedback loops to ensure solutions address real engagement pain points.
* Govern demand intake and prioritization across markets, balancing global standardization with local market needs, and maintain transparent roadmaps and product communications with stakeholders.
* Own India Hub delivery for face-to-face sales and CRM capabilities, including field workflows, call planning, activity capture, customer interaction management, and field enablement.
* Lead Veeva-enabled Sales Operations capabilities, including business process support, release management, field operations enhancements, and user-adoption improvements.
* Drive delivery and continuous improvement of sampling, events management, customer service, Field CRM, Field AI, and transparency-reporting capabilities.
* Partner with Commercial, Market Operations, Sales, Medical/Legal/Regulatory, Privacy, Compliance, IT, Data/AI, and platform teams to translate market requirements into scalable products and implementation plans.
* Embed compliance-by-design across personal engagement workflows, including sampling controls, consent/privacy considerations, transparency reporting, CRM data quality, and appropriate use of AI-enabled recommendations.
* Establish clear capability KPIs, including field adoption, engagement quality, customer-facing team effectiveness, process efficiency, data quality, cycle-time improvement, consistency of customer experience across channels, and platform value realization.
* Lead cross-functional delivery pods and vendor partners to execute releases, resolve issues, manage risks, improve user experience, and scale best practices across markets.
* Champion Field AI and responsible GenAI use cases across customer-facing teams and service channels that enable more informed engagement, next-best engagement execution, coaching, summarization, and workflow productivity within compliance guardrails.
* Lead the end-to-end build of AI products for customer-facing teams, such as next-best-action suggestions, pre-call planning insights, call and interaction summarization, AI coaching assistants, customer service copilots, and agentic workflows, from use-case identification and feasibility through design, development, testing, and deployment.
* Partner with Data Science, Data Engineering, and platform teams to ensure AI-ready data, seamless integration of AI capabilities into Veeva/Salesforce CRM and service workflows, including monitoring for performance, accuracy, and drift.
* Apply responsible AI governance to every AI product, including human-in-the-loop design, guardrails, explainability, Medical/Legal/Regulatory and privacy review, and model risk controls appropriate for regulated customer engagement.
* Own AI activation and adoption across US and international markets, including launch planning, change management, field training, field champion networks, embedding AI into daily workflows, and capturing in-market feedback to drive sustained usage.
* Measure AI product value before and after launch, tracking adoption, usage, engagement quality, time saved, field productivity, and business impact (ROI and payback), and use these insights to iterate, scale, or retire AI capabilities.
* Develop talent and strengthen delivery excellence by coaching teams on product thinking, agile execution, stakeholder communication, operational rigor, and continuous learning.

Education Requirements
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related discipline. Advanced degree such as MBA, MS, PharmD, MPH, or equivalent preferred.

**Required Experience And Skills**

* 8+ years of experience in pharmaceutical/biotech commercial operations, CRM, sales operations, digital engagement, product management, technology delivery, or customer experience functions.
* 4+ years of people leadership experience in a global, matrixed environment, including leading direct reports and cross-functional delivery teams.
* Strong understanding of field sales workflows, CRM processes, Veeva and/or Salesforce capabilities, sales operations, sampling, events, customer service, and field effectiveness.
* Proven hands-on experience across Field Engagement, Analytics, and AI, including applying customer and field data, engagement analytics, and AI/ML-driven insights to improve field effectiveness, customer engagement, and commercial outcomes.
* Experience defining strategy and roadmaps and delivering enterprise products or platform enhancements across global and market teams, with strong knowledge of platform integration, agile delivery, release governance, user adoption, and lifecycle management.
* Working knowledge of compliance, privacy, transparency reporting, sampling governance, consent management, and regulated customer engagement requirements in pharma.
* Ability to translate commercial strategy and field execution needs into scalable business requirements, product roadmaps, data workflows, and measurable business outcomes.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex business problems, interpret data to generate actionable insights, and drive evidence-based decisions, combined with strong stakeholder engagement skills to build trusted relationships and influence across global, regional, and market teams.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder alignment skills, with ability to navigate competing priorities, manage trade-offs, and provide forward-looking visibility into risks and milestones.
* Digital and AI fluency, including ability to identify practical Field AI and GenAI opportunities and embed them into a connected engagement ecosystem that responsibly improves productivity, customer engagement, and operational excellence.

title: Operations Manager, Customer Service
description:
**Overview**
**170+ Years Strong. Industry Leader. Global Impact.**
At Pinkerton, the mission is to protect our clients. To do this, we provide enterprise risk management services and programs specifically designed for each client. Pinkerton employees are one of our most important assets and critical to the delivery of world-class solutions. Bonded together, we share a commitment to integrity, vigilance, and excellence.
  
  
Pinkerton is an inclusive employer who seeks candidates with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to join our network of industry subject matter experts.
  
  
The Operations Manager (OM) leads day-to-day operations for the CS India email team within the Business Assurance Centre (BAC). This role manages a team of 6+ supervisors and 24+ associates who process approximately 4,000 emails weekly across three shifts (24/7 coverage). The OM drives operational excellence through active coaching, consistent communication of expectations, and direct accountability for team performance against service level agreements and quality standards.
  
  
This is a contact centre operations leadership role — managing email volume, response quality, staffing compliance, and supervisor development with the same discipline and metrics rigor applied to voice-based contact centers.
  
  
This role requires an active leader — someone who takes control of operational outcomes, drives accountability, and leads from the front. Passive management and reactive decision-making do not fit this environment. The CS India team operates within Corporate Security, handling sensitive security and safety inquiries including medical emergencies, threats of harm, employee well-being concerns, and facility incidents. While deep security expertise is not required, familiarity with security operations and the judgment required to triage sensitive situations is a strong advantage.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Represent Pinkerton’s core values of integrity, vigilance, and excellence.
* Actively coach supervisors on leadership expectations, email quality standards, escalation judgment, and team communication.
* Conduct regular 1:1s with each supervisor to review performance, address gaps, and develop capability.
* Ensure supervisors can independently coach their frontline associates — building capability at the supervisor level that cascades to the team.
* Deliver consistent feedback aligned with the other Operations Manager(s) so that expectations remain uniform across all shifts and supervisors.
* Identify supervisor skill gaps and create targeted development plans.
* Lead, not manage passively — be present, visible, and decisive in setting direction for the supervisory team.
* Own team performance against email response time SLAs (Priority: 30 minutes, Urgent: 1 hour, Standard: 4 hours).
* Monitor daily queue health — email volume, aging, staffing levels, and coverage gaps.
* Drive case quality scores above organizational goals through coaching, not just monitoring.
* Review and act on Process Improvement (PI) scorecard results — translate quality data into specific coaching actions for supervisors.
* Conduct root cause analysis when SLA targets are missed and implement corrective measures.
* Understand the sensitivity and urgency of security-related communications — prioritize life safety, medical, and threat-related emails accordingly.
* Partner with the Workforce Management (WFM) resource on schedule adherence and leave planning.
* Actively monitor daily staffing compliance (minimum staffing thresholds met per shift).
* Communicate proactively with CS leadership when coverage gaps emerge — provide queue status, staffing levels, specific needs, and shift coverage details without being prompted.
* Set and reinforce expectations for email response quality: accurate classification, appropriate tone, correct routing, and stakeholder notification
* Coach supervisors and associates on the distinction between template compliance and thoughtful, situation-appropriate responses.
* Review escalations and sensitive cases to ensure responses meet the standard before sending
* Own corrective actions and after-action reviews (AARs) for handling failures — drive accountability, not deflection.
* Recognize that security communications require judgment beyond process compliance — a theft report and a lost item require different responses.
* Communicate with CS leadership proactively — surface issues, share context, and provide solutions (not just questions).
* Respond to partner team inquiries with ownership and accountability.
* Ensure consistent messaging between both Operations Managers so the team hears one standard, not two.
* Ensure the team does not operate below minimum staffing levels without documented awareness and escalation.
* All other duties, as assigned.

**Qualifications**
Have a minimum 5-years of experience in leading and managing all aspects of an operations center or equivalent experience in a team management role out of which 3+ years managing operations in a contact center, BPO, or high-volume email/case management environment. Bachelor's degree (required) with the background of security operations, corporate security, physical security, or protective services (understanding the sensitivity and urgency of security-related communications). Experience managing teams of 30+ across multiple shifts Familiarity with Salesforce or similar case management platforms Six Sigma, Lean, or continuous improvement methodology experience. Experience managing vendor-contracted teams. Experience in environments where judgment and escalation decisions carry safety or compliance implications
  
  
Experience managing supervisors (not just frontline associates) — demonstrated ability to develop middle management. Proven track record of coaching and developing team leads/supervisors into independent decision-makers. Experience managing SLA-driven operations with defined response time targets. Strong written and verbal communication in English (active voice, clear, concise, professional). Experience with workforce scheduling in a 24/7 environment (understanding of shift coverage, leave management, and staffing compliance). Comfort with data — ability to read dashboards, interpret quality scores, and translate metrics into coaching actions. Demonstrated leadership presence — takes initiative, drives decisions, and holds teams accountable without requiring constant direction from above.
  
  

* Takes control of operational Does not wait for direction, does not default to asking permission, and does not allow the team to drift. Active leadership means being present, visible, and decisive.
* The OM actively develops supervisors — not just tracks their performance metrics. Coaching happens daily, not quarterly.
* Does not wait to be asked for Surfaces issues, provides context, and offers solutions before CS leadership identifies the gap.
* Expectations communicated to one supervisor are communicated to all. Feedback aligns with the other OM so the team hears one standard.

**Working Conditions**
With or without reasonable accommodation, requires the physical and mental capacity to effectively perform all essential functions;
  
  

* Regular computer usage.
* Occasional reaching and lifting of small objects and operating office equipment.
* Frequent sitting, standing, and/or walking.
* Travel, as required.

Pinkerton is an equal opportunity employer to all applicants and positions without regard to race/ethnicity, color, national origin, ancestry, sex/gender, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, marital/prenatal status, pregnancy/childbirth or related conditions, religion, creed, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any protected status by local, state, federal or country-specific law.

title: Regional Sales Manager- Cardiac Surgery
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

As the global leader in medical technology, Medtronic partners with the industry to make healthcare more affordable and accessible. Be a part of a community of experts committed to ensuring quality, affordable care around the globe.
  
  
Medtronic Cardiac Surgery is global technology leader in this therapeutic space with a strong commitment to improving lives with continuous innovation. Cardiac surgery represents end stage treatment in the care continuum for many cardiovascular diseases and this operating unit provides an intimate relationship with the Cardiac Surgeon and Cardiac OR by offering an unparalleled depth and breadth of portfolio.
  
We have an exciting career opportunity for a driven sales Professionals to join our Cardiac Surgery team. The primarily responsibility would be selling our range of cardiac surgery solutions to cardiac surgeons and perfusion teams in hospitals across the targeted territory.  
  

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.

* Drive sales growth and market development for Cardiac Surgery across assigned territories through daily engagement with healthcare professionals, hospitals, and key stakeholders
* Build strong clinical and commercial relationships with cardiac surgeons, vascular surgeons, interventional specialists, and procurement teams to support product adoption and business expansion
* Provide product education, case support, and technical guidance on Medtronic technologies, including advanced cardiac surgery solutions designed to improve surgical outcomes and patient care.
* Provide surgical case coverage, follow-up support and troubleshooting in the assigned Territory
* Conduct customer in-services & required training for new and existing accounts on all therapies.
* Develop relationships with physicians and hospital administration staff to ensure both clinical and non-clinical needs are identified and met
* Work with existing key implant centers to develop and implement strategies to move accounts towards technical self-sufficiency.
* Provide adequate training and troubleshooting help at the time of live cases.
* Gather and communicate input from field to management regarding market trends, customer satisfaction, competition, and product issues
* Develop ethical, positive long-term customer relationships
* Conduct Consignment counts as required by Product and Inventory Management
* Provide Sales Forecast data to Sales Manager upon request and in a timely manner
* Develop Sales strategies and execute same within the Sales Force Effectiveness model
Maintain data relating to Customer information and Sales activity in prescribed manner within Data Management Systems  

  

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

  
High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 9+ years experience OR Associate’s Degree AND 10+ years experience OR Bachelor’s Degree AND 5+ years experience preferably in Cardiac Surgery or similar therapies.  

  

**Preferred Qualification**

  

* Candidate with Perfusion Technology background will be preferred.

* Strong learning agility and problem solving skills.
* Demonstrates integrity and recognized as a role model by their peers and manager along with strong Clinical selling aptitude.
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills & Highly optimistic and indomitable spirit.
* Excellent communicator with a good command of written and spoken English.
Willingness to travel, well organized, able to set and reset priorities, willing to work extended hours (sometime even beyond call of duty hours) to support emergency cases.

title: Manager V&A Transformation Initiatives
description:
India - Hyderabad

JOB ID: R-258313 LOCATION: India - Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Oct. 30, 2026 CATEGORY: Value and Access

**Job Description Summary: Manager, V&A Transformation Initiatives**

**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

As Manager – V&A Transformation Initiatives, you will be at the forefront of solving the US Value & Access team’s biggest challenges using cutting edge technology. The AIN Transformation team will be viewed as an “innovation engine”, constantly testing and refining analytics solutions to address customer needs and opportunities alongside business partners.

In your role as a manager, you’ll be expected to combine a deep understanding of access data and analytics with experience in developing and deploying advanced machine learning, operational research, semantic analysis, and statistical methods to uncover structure in large data sets. Together with 2-4 associates you lead, you will be responsible for building and testing solutions for targeted business challenges. This will include application of advanced machine learning, operational research, semantic analysis, and statistical methods to uncover structure in large data sets.

The ideal candidate for this position will understand the business challenges that US Value & Access teams face and will have with a track record of success in applying that knowledge to build, deploy, and refine high impact advanced analytics tools.

This role will report to the Senior Manager, V&A Transformation Initiatives and will work in close collaboration with leaders of the Strategy & Innovation Team in the United States Access Analytics & Insights organization in India.

Roles & Responsibilities:

* Accountable to drive full lifecycle of data science projects delivery and ability to guide data scientists in shaping the developing the solution and act as a subject matter expert in solving development and commercial questions
* Assume the role of business owner and manage the Proprietary AI engine built to optimize Copay
* Ensure models are trained with the latest data and meet the SLA expectations
* Manage AI tool’s road map, working with a global cross functional team
* Work in technical teams in development, deployment, and application of applied analytics, predictive analytics, and prescriptive analytics.
* Utilize technical skills such as hypothesis testing, machine learning and retrieval processes to apply statistical and data mining techniques to identify trends, create figures, and analyze other relevant information.
* Perform exploratory and targeted data analyses using descriptive statistics and other methods.
* Model/analytics experiment and development pipeline leveraging MLOps.
* Oversee efforts of 2-4 associates, including setting performance standards, managing their staffing, and monitoring performance
* Collaborate with technical teams to translate the business needs into technical specifications, particularly focusing on AI-driven automation and insights.
* Develop and integrate custom applications, intelligent dashboards, and automated workflows that incorporate AI capabilities to enhance decision-making and efficiency.

**What We Expect of You**
-------------------------

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients.

**Basic Qualifications****:**
-----------------------------

* Master’s degree in computer science, statistics or STEM majors with a minimum of 6 years of Information Systems experience OR
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, statistics or STEM majors with a minimum of 8 years of Information Systems experience.
* Foundational understanding of US pharmaceutical ecosystem and Patient support services offerings and other standard data sets including claims, prescription, EMR
* Experience with one or more analytic software tools or languages like R and Python
* Strong foundation in machine learning algorithms and techniques
* Experience in statistical techniques and hypothesis testing, experience with regression analysis, clustering and classification

**Preferred Qualifications****:**
---------------------------------

* Experience in MLOps practices and tools (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow); Experience in DevOps tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD)
* Proficiency in Python and relevant ML libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn)
* Outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills; Ability to learn quickly; Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Experience with data engineering and pipeline development
* Knowledge of NLP techniques for text analysis and sentiment analysis
* Experience in analyzing time-series data for forecasting and trend analysis
* Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
* Experience with Databricks platform for data analytics and MLOps

**Professional Certifications**
-------------------------------

* Any AWS Developer certification (preferred)
* Any Python and ML certification (preferred)

**Soft Skills:**
----------------

* Initiative to explore alternate technology and approaches to solving problems.
* Skilled in breaking down problems, documenting problem statements, and estimating efforts.
* Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to work effectively with global, virtual teams
* High degree of initiative and self-motivation.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities successfully.
* Team-oriented, with a focus on achieving team goals

**What you can expect of us**
-----------------------------

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers competitive and comprehensive Total Rewards Plans that are aligned with local industry standards.

title: Sr. Manager, Engineering
description:
**Join Us as a Sr. Manager, Engineering!**

Are you ready to make a significant impact in an innovative environment? At ORBCOMM, we're looking for an experienced and technically strong Sr. Manager, Engineering to lead high-performing software engineering teams responsible for building and operating our cloud-based IoT and asset intelligence solutions.

If you're passionate about developing engineering talent, building scalable cloud platforms, and translating complex business requirements into reliable technology solutions that create meaningful customer value, we'd love to hear from you.

**Why You'll Love Working Here**

As a Sr. Manager, Engineering, you'll lead software engineering teams responsible for the design, development, delivery, and operation of ORBCOMM's cloud-based products and platforms.

You'll partner closely with Product Management, Program Management, Architecture, Quality Assurance, DevOps, and Customer Success to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable solutions that support ORBCOMM's global customers.

This role combines **technical leadership, people leadership, and delivery execution.** You'll help establish engineering standards, guide technical decision-making, develop engineering talent, and ensure teams have the structure, priorities, and resources needed to deliver high-quality products. You'll also collaborate with globally distributed engineering teams, helping create consistent engineering practices and a culture of accountability, innovation, continuous improvement, and customer focus.

This role is based out of our Hyderabad office. We operate in an onsite work environment.

**What You'll Do**

**Engineering Leadership & Delivery**

* Lead software engineering teams responsible for the development and operation of ORBCOMM's cloud-based IoT, asset intelligence solutions and AI First offerings.
* Drive execution of cloud platform initiatives, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality, scalable, and reliable software.
* Manage engineering capacity, prioritization, and resource allocation across multiple projects and initiatives.
* Partner with Product Management to translate business requirements into technical solutions and executable delivery plans.

* Drive Agile development practices, including sprint planning, release management, and continuous delivery.
* Monitor engineering productivity, software quality, system reliability, and customer satisfaction to identify opportunities for improvement.

**Technical & Operational Excellence**

* Establish and champion engineering best practices across software development, architecture, code quality, testing, security, and operational excellence.
* Guide teams in the development and operation of cloud-native applications, microservices, APIs, and distributed systems.
* Promote effective CI/CD, DevOps, automation, monitoring, and production support practices.
* Drive improvements in application scalability, performance, reliability, and security.
* Support customer escalations and critical production issues when required, ensuring appropriate technical resources and stakeholders are engaged.

**People & Organizational Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and mentor engineering teams while fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Develop engineering talent through ongoing coaching, feedback, career development, and succession planning.
* Build and scale high-performing engineering teams capable of supporting evolving product and business priorities.
* Create an environment that encourages technical excellence, ownership, problem-solving, and knowledge sharing.

**Cross-Functional & Global Collaboration**

* Partner closely with Product Management, Program Management, Architecture, QA, DevOps, Customer Success, and other business stakeholders.
* Collaborate effectively with engineering teams across multiple locations and time zones.
* Communicate engineering priorities, risks, dependencies, and progress clearly to technical and business stakeholders.
* Apply data-driven decision-making to engineering priorities, resource planning, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Who You Are**

You're an experienced engineering leader who combines strong technical knowledge with exceptional people leadership and execution capabilities. You understand how to build high-performing teams while maintaining a strong focus on software quality, operational reliability, and customer outcomes.

If you have:

* 15+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including 5+ years of engineering management experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading globally distributed software engineering teams.
* Strong experience building and operating cloud-native applications and enterprise software platforms.
* Hands-on knowledge of public cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Hands on experience with microservices architecture and distributed systems.
* Knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and modern software delivery methodologies.
* Strong understanding of SaaS platforms, API development, and system integrations.
* Experience with cloud security, scalability, performance optimization, monitoring, and system reliability.
* Familiarity with databases, messaging systems, and event-driven architectures.
* Experience managing cloud-based enterprise software products and platforms.
* Experience within IoT, transportation, logistics, telematics, supply chain, industrial automation, connected products, or a related technology environment.
* Knowledge of IoT platforms, connected devices, telemetry, and asset tracking solutions is highly desirable.
* Strong people leadership, coaching, and talent development capabilities.
* Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making capabilities.

* Excellent communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate with technical teams, business stakeholders, and executive leadership.
* A customer-focused mindset with a passion for delivering measurable business outcomes.
* Leverage AI-enabled tools and automation to support daily tasks and productivity.
* Commitment to continuous learning in digital and AI literacy.

Then we want to meet you!

**The Benefits of Working Here**  
A career with ORBCOMM offers a unique opportunity to grow your skills and expand your expertise in a collaborative, innovative environment. Beyond being part of an exceptional team, we provide a competitive, locally relevant benefits package designed to support our employees around the world. Benefits vary by location and include health and wellness coverage, paid time off, retirement or savings programs, flexible work arrangements, insurance coverage, lifestyle perks, and access to employee discounts—helping you thrive both professionally and personally.

**How We Hire**

ORBCOMM uses technology-enabled tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by people, as part of our human-led, tech-enabled culture.

**About Us**

At ORBCOMM, we’re pioneers in IoT technology that drives innovation and empowers our clients to make data-driven decisions. Our industry-leading solutions enable customers to boost productivity, streamline operations, and increase their bottom line. With over 30 years of experience and the most comprehensive solution portfolio in the industry, we enable the management of millions of assets worldwide across diverse sectors, including transportation, heavy industries, satellite, and maritime. Discover how ORBCOMM is transforming industries and unlocking the potential of data to drive meaningful change at www.orbcomm.com!

**Ready to Join Us?**

We believe that our people are our greatest asset. Your skills and passion can help us achieve remarkable things! If you’re seeking a thrilling career opportunity in a vibrant, growth-oriented environment, ORBCOMM is the perfect fit for you.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and appreciate all applicants for their interest in joining our team. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

At ORBCOMM, we are also dedicated to ensuring accessibility and are pleased to offer accommodations for individuals with disabilities upon request throughout all aspects of the selection process.

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. * Business Analytics. Six or more years of experience as a **Data Analyst / Data science** or related role.

Verizon is committed to maintaining a Total Rewards package which is competitive, valued by our employees, and differentiates us as an Employer of Choice.

title: Supervisor, Customer Service
description:
**Description**

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

**Brief Job Overview**

The Supervisor, Customer Success provides operational leadership for the India-based Customer Success team within a global, matrixed Customer Success & Operations organization, with primary responsibility for day-to-day execution and resolution of customer requests related to quotes, orders, order changes, order status, fulfillment, pricing, and other transactional activities across the customer journey. Working closely with the US-based Senior Manager, Customer Success, the Supervisor translates global strategy and Success standards into effective local execution, while leading team performance, workforce management, escalations, process adherence, and continuous improvement to drive timely, accurate, and consistent customer outcomes.

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**

As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.

Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.

The Supervisor, Customer Success has the following responsibilities:

**Leadership and Operational Direction:**

* Provide visible, inclusive leadership and set clear direction, Success standards, priorities, and accountability for the Customer Success function in India within the global operating model.
* Align routinely with the Senior Manager, Customer Success on functional priorities, performance expectations, customer and business risks, and execution plans for the India Customer Success team.
* Translate Customer Success Operations strategy into executable team plans, goals, measures, and routines aligned with customer, revenue, quality, and operational objectives.
* Lead through change by communicating business context, preparing the team for new processes and technologies, and reinforcing adoption and sustained execution.
* Promote a culture of customer focus, quality, integrity, collaboration, continuous improvement, and equitable employee engagement.
* Exercise sound financial stewardship, manage resources responsibly, and support business priorities within approved budgets.

**Team Management and Capability Building:**

* Direct daily team operations and equitably allocate omni-channel work, including orders, quotes, cases, calls, and correspondence, based on volume, skills, priorities, and Success commitments.
* Recruit, onboard, train, coach, and develop Customer Success Representatives, Specialists, and Supervisors to build capability, engagement, and succession readiness.
* Establish clear job expectations and manage performance through regular feedback, recognition, mentoring, development planning, counseling, and corrective action when required.
* Monitor workload, productivity, quality, data accuracy, and Success results; identify gaps and implement targeted coaching, training, and process improvements.
* Ensure employees have the tools, knowledge, procedures, and cross-training needed to deliver consistent, high-quality Success and maintain business continuity.

**Customer Escalation and Resolution Management:**

* Own and coordinate the timely investigation, documentation, communication, and resolution of complex, sensitive, or high-impact customer complaints and escalations.
* Assess business and customer impact, establish the appropriate urgency, engage accountable partners, and maintain clear ownership through resolution and follow-up.
* Identify recurring complaint and escalation themes, determine root causes with relevant partners, and convert customer feedback into corrective and preventive actions.
* Provide hands-on support across the full order cycle when needed, including quotations, registration, ordering, payment, fulfillment, access, shipment, and post-order concerns.
* Ensure escalation handling follows applicable SOPs, operating manuals, complaint requirements, and customer communication standards.
* Support the Customer Service Manager in reviewing, maintaining, and updating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure Customer Service processes remain accurate, current, and aligned with operational requirements. Conduct periodic reviews of SOPs and identify opportunities for process clarification and improvement.

**Operational Governance, Compliance, and Continuous Improvement:**

* Develop, maintain, and improve Customer Success policies, SOPs, operating procedures, knowledge resources, and controls to support consistent and compliant execution.
* Ensure adherence to applicable requirements for controlled substances, permits, customs, foreign licensing, shipments, and order documentation.
* Monitor reporting and database accuracy; analyze service, quality, volume, productivity, and complaint data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
* Lead or support improvements that strengthen customer experience, service quality, efficiency, productivity, cost effectiveness, and organizational readiness.
* Maintain current knowledge of USP products, service, systems, and Customer Success practices, and perform other related duties or special projects as assigned.
* The Supervisor supports for ISO audits within the India Customer Success department, coordinating audit activities, maintaining compliance documentation, driving corrective actions, and ensuring adherence to established quality management standards.

**Who is USP Looking For?**

The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:

**Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree required in a business, sales or related field.
* Minimum of seven (7) years of experience in Customer Success, Sales, or related field in a multi-cultural environment, preferably for a global organization.
* Experience with artificial intelligence (AI), automation, or other emerging technologies in a customer service or business environment is highly desirable. Relevant AI-related training or certifications are considered a strong plus.
* Previous experience in an Order to Cash environment required.

**Skills & Competencies:**

* Fluency in English required, and a second language strongly preferred.
* Willingness to work in rotational shifts.
* Customer Success focused and ability to provide a high degree of customer Success.
* Must possess ability to handle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment with a high level for stress tolerance while maintaining composure and enthusiasm.
* Excellent organization, problem analysis, problem solving and decision-making skills, and attention to details required.
* Excellent communication skills (written and oral) and presentation skills are a must.
* Individuals must possess the ability to influence without direct authority.
* Results driven with demonstrated successful outcomes.
* Excellent supervisory skills with a history of building high performing and motivated teams.
* Strong team builder and people leader with the ability and desire to work well with diverse employees and customers in a cooperative and friendly manner.
* Must be able to work independently and in a team environment.
* Must be highly proficient in the use of Microsoft software (word processing, email, spreadsheet, database, and Internet).
* Proficiency in Oracle and CRM systems desired.
* Familiarity with automated order entry systems, Ariba or other EDI processes a plus.
* Good understanding of complaint handling and resolution management.
* Familiarity with imports, exports, customs, and business with other countries strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with the culture(s) in the applicable geography(s) is strongly preferred.

USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer - Middleware Operations - Kafka
description:
**Senior Infrastructure Engineer (Middleware Operations & Kafka)**

**About this role:**

* Wells Fargo is seeking a **Senior Infrastructure Engineer** to join the Middleware Operations team, with a primary focus on supporting and engineering enterprise Apache Kafka and Confluent Platform environments.
* The role is responsible for designing, deploying, operating, securing, and optimizing large-scale messaging infrastructure. The successful candidate will combine strong hands-on Kafka expertise with production support, automation, observability, risk management, and stakeholder collaboration skills.

**In this Role:**

* Design, deploy, upgrade, and operate enterprise-scale Apache Kafka and Confluent Platform environments.
* Configure and manage KRaft controllers, brokers, Schema Registry, REST Proxy, Kafka Connect, ksqlDB, and Cluster Linking.
* Deploy and operate Confluent Platform on OpenShift Container Platform using the Confluent Operator.
* Provision and administer Kafka topics, ACLs, producers, consumers, partitions, retention policies, quotas, and replication settings.
* Configure Kafka security using TLS, certificates, authentication, authorization, secrets management, and key rotation practices.
* Monitor and optimize platform performance, including JVM garbage collection, heap utilization, partition distribution, ISR health, disk capacity, throughput, and consumer lag.
* Troubleshoot production issues such as message loss or duplication, offset errors, broker failures, disk saturation, latency, throughput degradation, and consumer lag.
* Design and maintain platform health dashboards and alerts using Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Splunk, or comparable enterprise monitoring tools.
* Automate provisioning, monitoring, recovery, regression testing, and operational activities using Python, Bash, Ansible, or similar technologies.
* Conduct capacity planning, performance benchmarking, and throughput optimization using tools such as KafkaPerf and kcat.
* Support incident, problem, change, and recovery management for business-critical middleware services, including root-cause analysis and preventive remediation.
* Develop infrastructure specifications, test solutions, support complex system upgrades, and contribute to application and infrastructure requirement validation.
* Establish long-term solutions for recurring production issues and identify opportunities to improve availability, resilience, and recovery time.
* Support risk and control initiatives by following technology policies, operating procedures, compliance requirements, and established work standards.
* Collaborate with application teams, engineering teams, cybersecurity partners, product managers, and infrastructure stakeholders to resolve issues and deliver platform objectives.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, recovery procedures, architecture diagrams, and operational runbooks.
* Participate in an on-call support rotation and provide implementation support for production releases and critical risk initiatives.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 4+ years of Technology Infrastructure Engineering, Middleware Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or equivalent experience demonstrated through work, education, training, or military experience.
* Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience supporting large-scale middleware environments, including Apache Kafka and Confluent Platform.
* Strong production experience with Kafka brokers, KRaft, Schema Registry, REST Proxy, Kafka Connect, ksqlDB, and Cluster Linking.
* Hands-on experience deploying and operating Kafka on OpenShift using the Confluent Operator.
* Experience managing topics, ACLs, partitions, replication, retention, quotas, idempotent producers, and consumer groups.
* Strong troubleshooting experience covering consumer lag, broker crashes, offset issues, message loss or duplication, disk saturation, latency, and throughput problems.
* Experience implementing Kafka security using TLS, certificates, authentication, authorization, and enterprise key-management practices.
* Experience configuring Prometheus and Grafana dashboards for platform monitoring and health reporting.
* Proficiency in automation and scripting using Python, Bash, Ansible, or comparable technologies.
* Experience supporting highly available, enterprise production environments.
* Understanding of technology risk, control, compliance, and change-management practices within the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance sector.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Experience with KRaft migrations and upgrades from ZooKeeper-based Kafka environments.
* Knowledge of performance testing and benchmarking using KafkaPerf, kafkacat, or kcat.
* Experience with Confluent Cloud, Amazon MSK, or Azure Event Hubs for Apache Kafka.
* Knowledge of schema evolution, compatibility modes, and Avro, JSON, or Protobuf serialization.
* Experience with additional messaging technologies such as Solace, IBM MQ, or RabbitMQ.
* Understanding of enterprise networking concepts, including routing, BGP, multicast, load balancing, DNS, and certificate management.
* Experience with capacity management, workload forecasting, and throughput optimization.
* Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Splunk, or similar monitoring and observability platforms.
* Confluent Certified Developer for Apache Kafka or Confluent Certified Administrator certification.
* ITIL 4 Foundation or higher certification.
* Job Expectations
* Ability to provide production implementation and operational support outside standard business hours when required.
* Ability to participate in an on-call rotation for critical incidents and service restoration.
* Ability to work in a controlled enterprise environment with strong risk, security, audit, and documentation requirements.
* Ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly to engineering teams, business partners, management, and control functions.

**Posting End Date:**

4 Nov 2026

* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

Someone who goes beyond simply managing client relationships — a professional who can build trust, anticipate client needs, identify business opportunities and grow accounts while representing BOMBAYDC with confidence and finesse.

title: Remarketing Manager
description:
Remarketing Manager – OTT, Lifecycle & Growth Marketing

**Rusk Media | Mumbai, Maharashtra | On-site**

**About Rusk Media**

Rusk Media is building the future of entertainment for the next generation. We create and distribute youth-first entertainment across the AVOD, SVOD and OTT ecosystem, combining original IPs, branded entertainment and digital-first storytelling. We are focused on building engaging entertainment experiences while continuously growing our audience and subscriber base.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a data-driven
**Remarketing Manager**
to own audience re-engagement, retention and monetisation initiatives across our digital entertainment ecosystem.

The role will focus on developing audience segmentation strategies, designing personalised and behaviour-driven campaigns, and driving repeat content consumption and subscriber conversions. The candidate will be responsible for engaging existing, inactive and at-risk users through targeted campaigns across the user lifecycle, ultimately improving retention, reactivation and revenue.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in lifecycle marketing, CRM, remarketing, marketing automation and performance optimisation, preferably within OTT, media, entertainment or consumer internet businesses.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Remarketing & Lifecycle Strategy**

* Develop and execute remarketing strategies across different stages of the user lifecycle.
* Build audience segmentation frameworks based on user behaviour, engagement patterns, viewing history and subscription status.
* Identify inactive, dormant and at-risk users and develop targeted reactivation strategies.
* Create campaigns to improve repeat engagement and long-term user retention.

**2. Personalisation & Campaign Management**

* Design personalised, show-specific, genre-based and behaviour-driven campaigns to drive content discovery and consumption.
* Develop targeted campaigns based on viewing preferences, user activity, content interests and engagement history.
* Plan and execute campaigns across relevant channels such as Push Notifications, Email, SMS, WhatsApp and other CRM channels.
* Ensure relevant content recommendations and messaging are delivered to the right audience at the right time.

**3. Retention & Monetisation**

* Drive repeat viewership, active users (DAU/MAU), subscriber conversions and subscription renewals.
* Develop strategies to improve user retention and reduce churn.
* Identify opportunities to monetise existing users through targeted campaigns, personalised content recommendations and subscription-led initiatives.
* Improve the overall user lifecycle journey from engagement and repeat consumption to subscription and renewal.

**4. Performance Tracking & Optimisation**

* Track and analyse campaign performance across reactivation, repeat views, conversions, retention and incremental revenue.
* Monitor campaign ROI and identify opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness.
* Analyse user cohorts, engagement patterns and drop-off points to identify retention opportunities.
* Use data-driven insights to continuously improve campaign targeting and performance.

**5. Experimentation & Continuous Improvement**

* Conduct A/B testing across messaging, creatives, audience cohorts, campaign frequency, timing and offers.
* Experiment with different engagement strategies to improve campaign response and conversion rates.
* Identify successful campaign approaches and scale them across relevant audience segments.
* Work closely with Product, Data Analytics and Content teams to improve user engagement and lifecycle performance.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* 4–7 years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, remarketing, retention or growth marketing.
* Prior experience in OTT, media, entertainment, gaming, e-commerce or consumer internet businesses is preferred.
* Hands-on experience in audience segmentation, campaign automation, personalised marketing and user reactivation.
* Strong understanding of Push Notifications, Email Marketing, SMS, WhatsApp and other CRM communication channels.
* Experience working with CRM, marketing automation and customer engagement platforms.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data, user cohorts and engagement metrics.
* Understanding of user acquisition, retention, churn, subscriber conversion and monetisation metrics.
* Ability to independently plan, execute and optimise multiple campaigns.

**Key Success Metrics**

* User reactivation and repeat engagement
* DAU / MAU growth
* Repeat viewership and content consumption
* Subscriber conversion and renewals
* User retention and churn reduction
* Campaign ROI and incremental revenue

title: Program Manager
description:
**Job Description – Program Manager**

K12 Technoservices Pvt. Ltd. | Orchids The International School

Location : Pune, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Coimbatore, Mumbai

**About K12 Technoservices Pvt. Ltd.**

K12 Technoservices Pvt. Ltd. is associated with Orchids The International School, an education organisation focused on delivering quality schooling and creating meaningful learning experiences for students.

Website:
www.orchidsinternationalschool.com

**Job Title: Program Manager – School Operations & Business Development**

**Role overview**

The Program Manager will be responsible for managing the overall operations, business development, admissions, and revenue growth of the assigned school branch. The role requires an individual who can effectively manage cross-functional teams, drive admission and revenue targets, execute field marketing initiatives, build strategic partnerships, and ensure smooth day-to-day school operations.

The position will act as a key link between the school branch, parents, employees, management, and central corporate teams to ensure operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and business growth.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Business development, admissions & revenue growth**

* Drive overall admission targets and revenue generation for the assigned school branch.
* Develop and execute strategies to increase student enrolment s and achieve business objectives.
* Monitor admission pipelines, conversion ratios, revenue performance, and collection targets.
* Identify new business opportunities and potential catchment areas for student admissions.
* Build and maintain relationships with parents, preschool partners, tutors, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Establish and manage preschool tie-ups and strategic partnerships to generate admission leads.
* Ensure timely collection of tuition fees, transport fees, fines, and other applicable charges.
* Monitor outstanding fee dues and ensure timely follow-up and collection.

**2. Field sales & team management**

* Lead, manage, and monitor a team of approximately 5-10 members responsible for field sales, counselling, and business development.
* Set individual and team targets, monitor performance, and ensure achievement of assigned goals.
* Guide, motivate, and develop team members to improve productivity and business outcomes.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and provide necessary coaching and support.
* Ensure effective coordination between field sales, counselling, admissions, and marketing teams.
* Participate in recruitment and selection of administrative and business development team members.

**3. Marketing, field activities & brand promotion**

* Analyse local marketing needs, market trends, and business opportunities.
* Develop and implement field marketing and business development plans.
* Plan and execute Below-the-Line (BTL) activities, promotional campaigns, events, and community engagement initiatives.
* Identify opportunities for school promotions and increase brand visibility within the assigned catchment area.
* Coordinate with internal marketing and corporate teams for campaign execution.
* Plan, organise, and host admission-related events and promotional activities.
* Evaluate campaign performance and submit reports on lead generation, conversions, and outcomes.

**4. School & branch operations**

* Ensure smooth day-to-day operations of the assigned school branch.
* Oversee administrative functions, campus maintenance, housekeeping, inventory, and vendor management.
* Ensure the school campus, playgrounds, courts, and other facilities are maintained appropriately.
* Monitor inward and outward movement of materials and maintain relevant records.
* Coordinate with Procurement, Logistics, Projects, Academics, Marketing, HR, and other corporate departments.
* Identify operational gaps and implement standardised processes to improve efficiency.
* Monitor branch-related operational reports and present updates to management.

**5. Parent relationship management & grievance resolution**

* Act as the primary point of contact for parents regarding non-academic matters.
* Ensure timely resolution of parent complaints and grievances.
* Monitor the complaint register and coordinate with the Front Office, Accounts, and Campus teams for closure.
* Build strong parent relationships and maintain a high level of service satisfaction.
* Handle escalations professionally and ensure effective communication with stakeholders.

**6. Staff administration & employee coordination**

* Monitor staff strength, attendance, and workforce requirements at the branch.
* Coordinate with HR for recruitment, attendance regularisation, salary processing, and employee-related matters.
* Ensure employee grievances are addressed and escalated to the appropriate departments.
* Maintain proper recruitment and employee-related records.
* Support training and development initiatives for branch operations and administrative teams.

**7. Transport & infrastructure management**

* Monitor daily school transport operations and ensure smooth functioning of the bus fleet.
* Ensure timely vehicle maintenance and proper functioning of GPS/GPRS tracking systems.
* Coordinate with transport vendors and ensure compliance with prescribed safety procedures.
* Ensure regular driver breathalyser testing as specified by company procedures.
* Monitor campus maintenance registers and ensure timely closure of maintenance issues.

**8. Finance, collections & vendor management**

* Monitor branch-level fee collections, outstanding dues, and revenue reports.
* Manage branch petty cash and ensure supporting documentation is maintained.
* Coordinate vendor payments and ensure timely submission of invoices and supporting documents.
* Monitor vendor performance and ensure adherence to agreed service standards.
* Coordinate with Finance and Accounts teams for financial and operational requirements.

**9. Management reporting & stakeholder coordination**

* Prepare and present regular reports on admissions, revenue, collections, marketing activities, and branch operations.
* Conduct periodic performance reviews and provide updates on business targets.
* Coordinate with management, trustees, parents, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
* Support quarterly reviews and ensure timely closure of assigned action points.
* Ensure effective communication and coordination across all business verticals.

**Desired candidate profile**

* Educational qualification
* Graduate in any discipline is required.
* Postgraduate qualification or MBA in Business Administration, Marketing, or Operations will be an added advantage.

**Experience**

* Experience in business development, field sales, school operations, admissions, or education-sector management.
* Hands-on experience in managing and driving field sales teams.
* Experience in handling revenue targets, admissions, marketing activities, and stakeholder relationships.
* Exposure to branch operations, vendor management, and administrative functions will be preferred.

**Skills and competencies**

* Strong leadership and team management capabilities.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong business acumen and revenue-driven mindset.
* Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and stakeholders.
* Excellent planning, execution, and problem-solving abilities.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret business and operational reports.
* Customer-centric approach with a focus on parent satisfaction.
* Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable working in a target-driven environment.
* Willingness to travel locally between branches and assigned locations.

**Key performance indicators (KPIs)**

* The performance of the Program Manager will be evaluated on:
* Achievement of admission and revenue targets.
* Fee collection efficiency and reduction in outstanding dues.
* Lead generation and admission conversion rates.
* Productivity and performance of the field sales team.
* Number and effectiveness of preschool and other strategic tie-ups.
* Execution and effectiveness of BTL marketing activities.
* Parent satisfaction and timely grievance resolution.
* Efficiency of school operations and campus maintenance.
* Vendor management and operational cost control.
* Timely reporting and coordination with corporate teams.
