title: Senior Sales Manager
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Company Name:**
Thriwe Consulting Pvt. Ltd.

**Experience:**
3-5 Yrs

**Work Location:**
Mumbai

**Position:**
Senior Manager-Sales

**About the role**

Thriwe builds and runs benefits and loyalty programmes for banks, card issuers and large enterprises, covering golf, airport services, lifestyle privileges and rewards, along with the platforms underneath them. Our clients are some of the largest banks in India, the card networks, banks in the Middle East and Southeast Asia, and corporates across industries. This role sells to all of them. Banks are the biggest part of the book, so you need to understand how that sector works, but the job is not limited to it. You will find the right teams inside a client, get in the room, build the case, close, and stay involved until the programme is live. It is an on-ground sales job with targets.

**Roles and responsibilities**

* Build and run a pipeline of new clients across banking, financial services and enterprise accounts.
* Own the full sales cycle: prospecting, first meetings, proposals, commercial negotiation, contracting and handover to delivery.
* Grow revenue from existing clients by finding and selling additional programmes and services.
* Meet clear and ambitious quarterly and annual targets on revenue and gross margin. You will be measured on both.
* Build proposals, decks and commercial structures, present them to senior stakeholders, and rework them in the room when the conversation changes direction.
* Face senior banking and enterprise leadership in meetings and hold the room.
* Manage client stakeholders across levels, from working teams to decision makers, and keep them all moving.
* Work with product and engineering to scope what a client has asked for against what we can deliver.
* Handle difficult client conversations: pricing pressure, escalations, delays, scope changes.
* Track usage and margin data on your accounts and bring it into client discussions.

**Requirements**

* 3 to 5 years of experience in B2B sales or business development.
* A bachelor’s degree in any discipline. A master’s degree is a plus. We care more about how you communicate and think than what you studied.
* A strong sales instinct. Someone who likes selling, is comfortable asking for the deal, and does not need to be pushed to make the next call.
* A working understanding of the BFSI sector: how banks run cards, loyalty and customer engagement, and who decides what.
* Excellent communication, spoken and written. You should be able to explain a commercial structure to a senior stakeholder in two minutes and present a deck without reading from it.
* Good at building commercials and proposal decks. Clear numbers, clean slides, tight story.
* Comfortable using AI tools in daily work and a working understanding of what AI can and cannot do. We use it heavily and expect you to as well.
* Quick on your feet. Client meetings rarely go to script, and you need to think, respond and adjust in the moment rather than take it back to the office.
* Comfortable working without a brief. Many client asks arrive half-formed and you will shape them yourself.
* Analytical. You know the numbers on your accounts before the client asks.

title: Expert Business Development Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Role: Expert Business Development Manager**
**Location: Gurugram or Mumbai, India**
**Work Model: Hybrid – 4 days in the office**
**Work Timings: Monday – Friday, 10.00 AM to 7:00 PM IST**
**Reports to: Managing Director, Head of Markets, Asia Pacific**
**Introduction**
Are you a seasoned commercial leader with deep expertise in corporate services, fund administration, and entity management and a strong track record of shaping complex client solutions? Join CSC’s Markets team within the Global Financial Solutions (GFS) team in India as a Market Director where you will lead high-impact pursuits, influence strategic client engagements, and drive growth across our multinational client base.
  
  
In this senior role, you’ll collaborate with sales executives, service delivery leaders, and fellow subject matter experts to design innovative solutions, strengthen client relationships, and position CSC as a trusted advisor in the corporate and fund administration services space, and be a key driver of revenue growth, client satisfaction, and market expansion.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Define and drive the India commercial strategy.
* Identify, develop, and win new business mandates targeting new and existing client accounts across corporate, fund administration, and entity management services in India and the broader APAC region, both individually and as part of the wider APAC Markets team, driving new sales and revenue.
* Develop and maintain strong, client-centric relationships with corporate clients, banks, asset managers, law firms, intermediaries, and referral partners in India and key cross-border markets.
* Leverage a strong local and regional network to build a high-value pipeline of opportunities, with a focus on cross-border business and strategic accounts.
* Lead complex sales opportunities across India, from qualification through close, ensuring alignment with client needs and CSC’s service capabilities.
* Shape and deliver strategic proposals that address multinational corporate and governance requirements, collaborating with senior stakeholders across the business.
* Act as a trusted advisor in client engagements, presenting CSC’s GFS solutions at a senior level and advising on best practices, delivery approaches, and value-added services.
* Oversee commercial structuring, including pricing strategy, negotiation support, and contractual considerations, ensuring both client value and commercial sustainability.
* Partner with Sales Leadership to drive pipeline strategy, conduct win/loss reviews, and identify opportunities to expand client relationships.
* Engage with cross-functional stakeholders — Business Operations and Commercial teams — to ensure seamless implementation and delivery readiness.
* Contribute to market positioning, leveraging industry insights and competitor analysis to influence strategic business development initiatives.
* Represent CSC in local and regional client forums, industry events, and senior-level planning sessions.
* Keep applicable marketing technology (e.g., Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce) updated on leads, pipeline and through to closure, as well as relevant market intelligence.

**What We’re Looking For:**
Required Qualifications:
  
  

* 12–15 years of experience in sales, business development, or client solutions in corporate services with a demonstrated ability to generate and grow revenue.
* Proven track record leading complex, multi-jurisdictional client engagements and securing significant commercial wins.
* Strong background in corporate governance, fund administration, entity management, or legal compliance services.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage and influence senior client stakeholders.
* Experience developing tailored proposals, leading RFP responses, and structuring complex commercial arrangements.
* Skilled at working within complex global, matrixed organizations and managing cross-border teams.
* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to balance client needs and operational delivery requirements.
* Fluent in English.
* Advanced proficiency with CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred) and commercial analytics tools (Power BI).

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* University degree in Law, Business, Finance, or a related discipline.
* Established network within the corporate, funds, and banking services industry.

**About Us**
CSC is a global business, legal, and financial services company based in Wilmington, Delaware, USA, providing knowledge-based solutions to clients worldwide. title: Business Development Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Hudle is India’s largest sports community platform, enabling more than 2 million players across 110+ cities to play regularly, join communities, and make sport part of everyday life. The platform has grown from simplifying sports venue discovery and booking into a full ecosystem that powers how India plays, connects, and experiences sport. Hudle connects 4,000+ venues and 40+ sports with community-led play, events and tournaments, coaching, and curated player experiences. The company also focuses on content, highlights, and stories that extend beyond the game, reflecting sport as a social ritual and lifestyle. Hudle is a Series A-funded startup backed by leading investors including Sky Impact Capital, Physis Capital, Inflection Point Ventures, and Survam Partners.

**Experience: 3 -6 Years**

**About Hudle:**

At Hudle, work is literally Play! We are a sports tech company on a mission to enable 100 million Indians to play active sports as a way of life through a combination of cutting-edge technology and on-ground expertise.

We are a fast-growing platform with Indian cricket legend Ajinkya Rahane as a brand ambassador.

**About the Role:**

You will own Hudle's business development outcomes for Mumbai. That means hitting the city's partner acquisition and revenue targets, making sure every new venue is onboarded well and starts generating bookings, and building long-term relationships with the city's most important partners. You'll run the full sales cycle yourself on key deals while coaching a small team to do the same.

**What You'll Own:-**

**Mumbai targets and pipeline**

- Deliver monthly and quarterly targets for partner acquisition and venue activation for the region

- Build and maintain a healthy pipeline through market mapping, outbound outreach, referrals and on-ground prospecting

- Personally lead high-value and strategic deals, including multi-venue operators, premium clubs, institutions and real estate developers

**Onboarding and activation**

- Drive end-to-end onboarding of new partners: commercials, agreements, listing setup, pricing and inventory, and handover to Partner Growth

- Make sure onboarded venues go live quickly and start receiving bookings, and fix whatever stands in the way

- Coordinate with internal teams (Partner Growth, Product, Ops, Hudle Vision) for smooth launches

**Key relationships**

- Own relationships with Mumbai's top partners and decision-makers, serving as their senior point of contact

- Find opportunities to deepen partnerships: additional courts or sports, exclusive listings, premium products such as Hudle Vision, and co-marketing

- Stay close to the local market: new venues, competitor activity, pricing trends and emerging sports

**Team leadership**

- Coach and manage 1–2 BD Executives, including setting targets, doing joint field visits and running regular pipeline reviews

- Build repeatable playbooks for prospecting, pitching and closing in the Mumbai market

**Process and reporting**

- Keep Zoho CRM accurate and current for yourself and your team

- Share weekly and monthly progress reports with leadership, covering pipeline health, closures, activation and forecasts

- Suggest improvements to sales processes, pitch materials and commercial structures

**How Success Is Measured**

- New venues and courts onboarded against target

- Time from signing to first booking, and early booking volume of new partners

- Team productivity and target achievement

- CRM hygiene and forecast accuracy

**What We're Looking For**

- 4–7 years in B2B sales or business development, with at least 1 year leading or mentoring others.

- ⁠Experience in marketplaces, SaaS, sports, fitness, hospitality or real estate is a plus.

- A strong network in Mumbai, or the ability to build one quickly

- A track record of owning and hitting targets in a field-sales role

- Comfort selling to very different people, from tech-savvy founders and club committees to traditional, first-time business owners

- Excellent communication in English and Hindi. Marathi is a strong plus.

- Confident at running app demos, building presentations and negotiating commercials

- Organised and data-driven, comfortable with CRMs, Google Sheets and Excel

- Resilient, self-driven and at ease in a fast-moving startup

- A genuine interest in sports is a bonus

**Benefits:**

* Start-up environment with plenty of learning and growth opportunities
* Great exposure as the candidate will be working closely with the senior management
* Employee-first culture
* Market Salary
* Potential ESOPs in future

title: QNB3737 - Senior Manager, Global Transaction Banking Sales (Cash and Trade)
description:
**About QNB**
Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
  
  
QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
  
  
QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard & Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3) and Fitch (A+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
  
  
Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
  
  
QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The roles and its primary focus will be business development and marketing of the banks existing product base. The incumbent is responsible for identifying Cash Management opportunities and Trade Finance opportunities through understanding the client’s business model, including operational and financial processes and working capital and treasury management needs. Cash Management includes all payments, collections, liquidity management solutions. Trade Service businesses include traditional and Open Account trade products. The incumbent will provide customer centric banking solutions and services to meet customer needs and improve the client experience. The role has annual revenue targets and other quantitative and qualitative KPIs, contributes to the GTB department objectives in terms of growing the customer base, increase revenue and transaction volumes in compliance with established QNB Group policies, regulatory requirements, and best market practice. The role reports to corporate banking management domestically and to the global GTB business.
  
  
Main Responsibilities
  
  
**Shareholder & Financial**

* Responsible for QNB in-country timely and quality planning of sales plan of transaction solutions to contribute to department’s revenue, profitability for Cash Management and Trade Finance. Works towards delivering set targets in line with Global Corporate and Institutional Banking strategic directions and applicable policy guidelines.
* Works with country corporate management team in achieving unit’s budget and implementing of group approved business plans for the unit and overall objectives of the QNB group with direct P/L ownership, including growth of transaction fees, as well as growth of Trade assets and CASA balances.

**Customer (Internal & External)**

* Is responsible for collection of market information on competitor actions, customer preferences as well as market/business development.
* Formulates and proactively implements the sales and marketing strategy that enables QNB to achieve its plans in relation to Cash Management and Trade Finance business.
* Is responsible for client and market data analysis as well as preparation of meaningful and actionable results aimed for enhancement of GTB offerings as well as preserving and increasing the market share.
* Works closely with in-country RMs in identifying cash management and trade finance opportunities from corporate clients and regular follow-ups to close the product sales.
* Regularly interacts with customers and other relevant market participants to gather feedback on the GTB products and services as well as provides this information to the parties concerned.
* Demonstrate thought leadership in developing new solutions, in relation to GTB to complement Global Corporate and Institutional banking business growth
* Increase adoption of digital channels and increase straight through processing and improve the efficiency in order to maximize the shareholder benefits

**Internal (Processes, Products, Regulatory)**

* Based on market research data as well as customer feedback provides valuable inputs to Group cash management and trade services product development team based in H.O for product development requirements.
* Is responsible for preparation of country sales/marketing plan, road shows/customer workshops to promote awareness of cash management and trade finance products and services.
* Responds to Request for Proposals (RFPs), assessing customer needs and recommending effective approach as well as pricing structure. Ensure RFPs as and when received from customers in country are well coordinated with GTB Sales, Product and Services and Implementation team to ensure best offers made to win deals.
* Supports Relationship Managers in their selling efforts by providing expertise and structuring know-how.
* Performs verification of information on assigned customers' activities to ensure correctness of data.
* Is responsible for preparation and delivery of periodic as well as ad hoc MIS reports on personal and unit performance. Reports on a regular basis with group reporting.

**Legal, Regulatory, And Risk Framework Responsibilities**

* Comply with all applicable legal, regulatory and internal compliance requirements including, but not limited to, Group Compliance Policies and Procedures (AML & CTF, Sanctions Policy, Data Protection Policy, Fraud Control Policy, Whistle Blowing Policy, Conflict of Interest and Insider Dealing Policy).
* Understand and effectively perform your role under the Three Lines of Defence principle to identify measure, monitor, manage and report risks.
* Ensure systematic good outcomes for clients in accordance with Conduct Risk policy.
* Support the framework of RCSA, KRI, Incident reporting and remediation, as appropriate, in accordance with the Operational Risk Management requirements.

**Education/Experience Requirements**
Education and Experience Requirements
  
  

* University graduate with a Major in Banking, Finance, Accounting or related field of study. Masters Preferred
* At least 8 years of relevant banking experience, preferably with at least 2 years at banking within a highly rated international bank.
* Sound Cash Management experience, typically acquired through 2-3 years of experience in Cash Management and /or related filed.
* Fluency in English.
* Solid technical knowledge of the bank’s operations, transaction cycles, payments/ collection processing, bank account information, SWIFT transmissions related to corporate and retail bank accounts.
* Understanding of relevant laws, regulations and practices pertaining to corporate banking products and services in particular and Banking Industry, geography in general
* Good understanding of in-country GTB customer base, it's needs and expectations
* Strong analytical skills with ability to communicate both verbally and in writing
* Problem solving abilities as part of relationship and technical knowledge of outstanding issues.

Note: you will be required to attach the following:
  
  

* Resume/CV
* Copy of ID
* Copy of Education Certificate

title: Lead Technical Program Manager, Data Center Network Delivery Engineering
description:
[For Singapore]

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in technical program management, software engineering, or network engineering, including 5 years managing teams of technical program managers or engineers within a networking environment.
* 8 years of experience in infrastructure planning, capacity strategy, supply chain management, or technical program management within the data center, cloud computing, or related high-tech industries.
Experience in data centers or network operations.  

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or MBA.
* 8 years of experience managing cross-functional/team projects.
* Strong analytical, communication, and presentation skills with the ability to operate with intensity and flexibility in a fast-moving, constantly evolving and collaborative environment.

**About the job**
-----------------

Google's projects, like our users, span the globe and require managers to keep the big picture in focus while being able to dive into the unique engineering challenges we face daily. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you lead complex, multi-disciplinary engineering projects using your engineering expertise. You plan requirements with internal customers and usher projects through the entire project lifecycle. This includes managing project schedules, identifying risks and clearly communicating them to project stakeholders. You're equally at home explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical trade-offs in product development with engineers.  
  
Using your extensive technical and leadership expertise, you manage various Engineering-specific programs and teams.

As a DCNet Delivery Manager, you'll be at the helm of critical network deployment programs, directly managing a team that drives the tactical work. You'll guide them in organizing complex cross-functional projects, ensuring clear ownership, streamlined workflows, and meticulously managed master schedules. Success in this role demands a strong technical background in infrastructure, capacity planning, servers, networks, and data center operations, along with excellent communication and presentation skills to influence leaders and foster collaboration across all business.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Manage a team of Project Managers/Engineers responsible for cross-functional coordination, design and oversight of data center network and capacity growth projects in a given region to deliver on on-time delivery and cycle time goals.
* Hire, coach and develop a team of Network Engineers to meet objectives.
* Define and develop cross-team roles, expectations, and responsibilities.
* Work with direct reports and partner teams to set and implement short term and long term infrastructure delivery strategy for the region.
* Deliver effective execution at scale within large, multi-project programs.

title: AVP - Journey Excellence and Optimisation
description:
Embark on a transformative journey as
**“**
AVP - Journey Excellence and Optimisation
**”**
at Barclays, where you’ll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You’ll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unparalleled customer experiences.
  
  
You will join the Business Banking transformation team, which shapes future-state operating models and redesigns end-to-end customer and colleague journeys. Working across Operations, Product, Technology, Risk, Compliance and Customer Experience, the team turns strategic designs into practical transformation roadmaps that simplify processes, strengthen controls and enable sustainable digital change.
  
  
**Skills**
To be successful in this role as a “AVP - Journey Excellence and Optimisation”, you should possess the following skillsets:
  
  
**Target Operating Model Design**

* Lead the development and evolution of Target Operating Models across Business Banking customer and operational journeys.
* Conduct current-state assessments to understand existing processes, customer and colleague pain points, operating structures, technology dependencies, controls and performance.
* Define future-state operating-model components across people, process, technology, data, controls, governance and performance management.
* Develop clear design principles to guide future-state structures, service models and ways of working.
* Define roles, responsibilities, capabilities, interaction models, governance arrangements and decision rights required to support the target state.
* Ensure proposed operating models are practical, scalable and aligned with Business Banking priorities, customer needs and applicable regulatory expectations.
* Maintain traceability between identified business problems, design decisions, proposed changes and intended outcomes.

**Customer and Colleague Journey Transformation**

* Lead the assessment and redesign of end-to-end customer and colleague journeys across areas such as onboarding, servicing, lending, Customer Due Diligence and case management.
* Apply customer-centred design principles to simplify journeys, reduce avoidable friction and improve customer and colleague outcomes.
* Facilitate journey-mapping and design workshops with operational teams, subject-matter experts and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Identify process gaps, failure points, unnecessary hand-offs, duplication, delays and control weaknesses.
* Translate complex operational challenges into simplified, scalable and digitally enabled future-state journeys.
* Ensure journey designs appropriately consider different customer needs, servicing requirements and risk profiles.
* Establish appropriate measures to assess the impact of journey changes on customer experience, service quality, turnaround time and operational performance.

**Process Optimisation and Continuous Improvement**

* Apply appropriate process-improvement methodologies to assess and redesign end-to-end processes.
* Develop current-state and future-state process maps, service blueprints and supporting design documentation.
* Identify opportunities to remove process debt, reduce manual activity, simplify hand-offs and improve first-time-right outcomes.
* Use operational data, customer insight and colleague feedback to identify root causes and prioritise improvement opportunities.
* Assess opportunities to improve productivity, create capacity and strengthen process resilience.
* Embed continuous-improvement principles within future-state processes and operating models.
* Support the identification, validation, measurement and tracking of transformation benefits.

**Digital, Automation and AI Enablement**

* Identify and assess opportunities to use digital workflow, automation, process mining, analytics, artificial intelligence and generative AI within Business Banking journeys.
* Work with Product and Technology partners to translate business requirements into appropriate digital and technology capabilities.
* Support the assessment of technology feasibility, business value, operational impact and control implications.
* Ensure that proposed technology solutions are integrated into the wider operating model rather than implemented as isolated process changes.
* Contribute to the design and implementation of workflow, case-management and AI-enabled servicing solutions.
* Promote responsible adoption of technology, with appropriate consideration of governance, data, customer outcomes, operational resilience and controls.

**Transformation Planning and Delivery**

* Translate agreed target-state designs into structured and executable delivery roadmaps.
* Define delivery phases, dependencies, business readiness requirements, risks, assumptions and intended outcomes.
* Support the development of business cases, investment proposals and governance submissions.
* Partner with change and delivery teams to transition designs from concept through mobilisation, implementation and embedding.
* Provide design oversight during delivery to ensure that implemented changes remain aligned with agreed target-state principles.
* Identify and manage design risks, dependencies and issues, escalating where appropriate.
* Support pilot, test-and-learn and phased implementation approaches where these are appropriate.
* Monitor delivery progress, benefit realisation and adoption against agreed measures.
* Produce clear updates, recommendations and decision papers for senior stakeholders and governance forums.

**Risk and Control**

* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work performed.
* Ensure target operating models and journey designs appropriately consider regulatory requirements, operational risk, customer outcomes, data, privacy and control effectiveness.
* Identify potential risks and control impacts arising from process, technology, organisational or operating-model changes.
* Engage Risk, Compliance, Legal and Control stakeholders at the appropriate stages of design and delivery.
* Ensure key controls, accountabilities, governance arrangements and escalation routes are clearly reflected in the future-state design.
* Support completion of relevant risk assessments, governance reviews and approvals.
* Escalate material design, delivery or control concerns through the appropriate governance channels.
* Ensure all activities and duties are carried out in full compliance with regulatory requirements, the Enterprise Risk Management Framework and applicable internal Barclays policies and standards.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills Include**

* Experience identifying and evaluating opportunities across digital workflow, automation, process mining, analytics, artificial intelligence and generative AI, including consideration of business value, operational impact, governance and controls.
* Experience developing business cases, benefits assessments, executive papers and senior-management updates, and providing design oversight through mobilisation, implementation and embedding.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based in our Pune office.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To collaborate with stakeholders and use data and MI to identify process optimisation opportunities for capacity creation in relevant business areas.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development and implementation of strategies to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of banking operations, using data led insights.

title: Account Manager
description:
Swiggy Dineout is building India’s largest dining out platform that processes more than 100M diners for its
  
  
partner restaurants across its network for 21000 restaurants in 34 cities and growing. We are striving to
  
  
augment our consumer promise of enabling unparalleled convenience by helping diners explore
  
  
restaurants across all categories - from QSRs, cafes, casual dining, premium, fine dining and more and
  
  
offer the widest range of offers on restaurant bills through easy payments on the app. We are on a
  
  
mission to change the way India dines out. If you are a foodie and equally passionate to redefine the
  
  
experience of dining out, join our team to be a part of the Swiggy ride!
  
  
Dineout is present in 34 cities across India and we have partnerships with more than 21,000 restaurant
  
  
partners where users can save up to 40% on their dining bills when they pay their restaurant bills using
  
  
the dine out feature on the Swiggy app.
  
  
**Job Description**
Role Summary -
  
  
The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given
  
  
territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise
  
  
Value (GMV) per month.
  
  
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
  
  
specific geographies assigned
  
  
Responsibilities -
  
  
Account & Partner Relationship Management
  
  
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with
  
  
internal stakeholders
  
  
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is
  
  
correct and image coverage is high
  
  
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for
  
  
month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
  
  
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc.
  
  
to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
  
  
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers
  
  
and partners at the restaurants
  
  
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.
  
  
Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
  
  
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance
  
  
metrics to the partner
  
  
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable
  
  
conversions and grow the business.
  
  
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale,
  
  
conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
  
  
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts,
  
  
commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and
  
  
explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.
  
  
Interaction with Stakeholders:
  
  
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations
  
  
(competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
  
  
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
  
  
Functional Competencies
  
  
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
  
  
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads
  
  
RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
  
  
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
  
  
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise
  
  
transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition
  
  
**Qualifications**
Desired Skills -
  
  
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
  
  
knowledge of English
  
  
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing
  
  
channels
  
  
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
  
  
Effective communication skills
  
  
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
  
  
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
  
  
Analytical, good Excel skills.
  
  
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
  
  
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people
  
  
at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
  
  
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
  
  
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness
  
  
and success of campaigns.
  
  
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal
  
  
drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.
  
  
**Additional Information**
**Visit our tech blogs to learn more about some the challenges we deal with: https://medium.com/swiggy-bytes**

title: Tech support manager
description:
**Description**

1. People Leadership & Team Management

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Technical Support Engineers.
* Establish clear goals, expectations, KPIs, and performance standards.
* Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, coaching sessions, and career-development discussions.
* Build technical and leadership capabilities within the team through structured training and mentoring.
* Identify skill gaps and create training and cross-training plans.
* Manage shift coverage and ensure adequate support capacity across global time zones.
* Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Identify high-potential team members and create opportunities for career progression.

2. Customer & Enterprise Support

* Own the overall technical support experience for assigned customers and customer segments.
* Provide leadership oversight for critical and complex customer issues.
* Partner with Customer Success and Account Management teams on strategic and enterprise accounts.
* Participate in customer calls for critical escalations and technically complex issues.
* Ensure customer issues are communicated clearly, proactively, and professionally.
* Build strong relationships with technical stakeholders at strategic customers.
* Identify recurring customer pain points and drive them toward permanent solutions.

3. Technical Escalation Management

* Act as an escalation point for complex technical issues that cannot be resolved by frontline support.
* Drive investigation of issues involving APIs, SDKs, integrations, web technologies, authentication, data, infrastructure, and third-party systems.
* Work closely with Engineering and Product teams to troubleshoot product defects and technical issues.
* Ensure escalated Jira issues contain accurate technical information, reproduction steps, logs, impact, and customer context.
* Maintain ownership until the issue is resolved and appropriately communicated to the customer.
* Ensure SLA commitments are consistently met.

4. Incident & Problem Management

* Lead or support P0/P1 critical incidents and customer-impacting outages.
* Coordinate incident response across Support, Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, and Customer Success.
* Ensure timely internal and external communication during major incidents.
* Maintain incident timelines, action items, and stakeholder communication.
* Drive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and post-incident reviews.
* Track corrective and preventive actions to completion.
* Identify recurring incidents and initiate Problem Management activities.
* Continuously improve incident response and escalation processes.

5. Support Operations & SLA Management

* Own support operational metrics including:
* CSAT
* Time to First Response (TTFR)
* Time to Resolution (TTR)
* SLA adherence
* Backlog
* Escalation volume
* Resolution efficiency
* Customer-impacting incidents
* Monitor team performance and identify operational trends.
* Build dashboards and reports for leadership.
* Conduct regular operational reviews and establish improvement plans.
* Optimize workflows, queues, staffing, and escalation processes.
* Ensure support processes are documented, followed, and continuously improved.

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with:

* Engineering — product defects, technical escalations, incident resolution.
* Product Management — customer feedback, feature gaps, product improvements.
* Customer Success / Account Management — enterprise customers and strategic escalations.
* QA — reproductions, validation, and regression testing.
* Infrastructure / DevOps — platform incidents, monitoring, performance, and reliability.
* Professional Services / Solutions Engineering — complex implementations and integrations.

Represent the voice of the customer internally and ensure customer-impacting issues receive appropriate visibility.

7. Knowledge Management & Automation

* Drive creation and maintenance of technical documentation and Knowledge Base content.
* Establish documentation standards for troubleshooting and known issues.
* Identify repetitive support activities suitable for automation.
* Encourage the use of scripts, APIs, dashboards, AI, and automation to improve support efficiency.
* Develop troubleshooting guides, runbooks, escalation templates, and internal playbooks.
* Promote self-service capabilities to reduce repetitive support volume.

8. Capacity Planning & Support Strategy

* Forecast support demand based on customer growth, product adoption, historical ticket volumes, and upcoming releases.
* Develop staffing and capacity plans aligned with business growth.
* Identify opportunities to improve support scalability without compromising customer experience.
* Participate in hiring and workforce planning.
* Establish support coverage models for global customers and critical accounts.
* Partner with leadership on long-term support strategy and organizational planning.

9. Product & Release Readiness

* Partner with Product and Engineering teams during major product releases.
* Ensure Support is adequately prepared for new features and product changes.
* Drive release-readiness activities including:
* Product training
* Documentation
* Troubleshooting guides
* Known issues
* Support communication
* Escalation paths
* Provide customer-impact feedback before and after major releases.

title: Director, Quality Engineering and Automation
description:
**Company Description**

QAD is a leading provider of ERP solutions purpose-built for manufacturing industries — automotive, life sciences, food & beverage, high tech, and industrial. Serving thousands of global manufacturers, QAD's Adaptive Manufacturing Cloud helps companies operate with greater precision, agility, and intelligence.

Enterprise software is entering a third era. The first gave manufacturers a System of Record — ERP that answered 'what do we have and what did we commit to?' The second gave them Data Infrastructure — the ability to move, analyse, and query that data at scale. The third era is domain-specific intelligence: AI agents that can act autonomously on manufacturing data, but only if that data has been given the context, relationships, and governed rules that allow an agent to reason correctly.

 **Job Description**

This director changes how QAD builds and proves quality in Adaptive ERP. The goal is continuous, automated evidence that every release, patch, and update works in environments that look like customers' own, not a QA stage at the end. This leader owns quality standards, regression automation, and release gates, and has the authority to stop a release that does not meet them. We are not looking for a QA manager. We need a leader who will reshape how the organization thinks about quality.

**Responsibilities**

* Build and lead the central Quality Engineering organization: strategy, staffing, capability, and results.
* Define quality standards and evidence-based release gates covering installation, configuration, upgrades, patches, integrations, and end-to-end business flows.
* Hold the authority to block a release that fails those gates.
* Lead regression automation: one framework, a suite covering the defined test surface, and a measurable coverage ramp, integrated into development and deployment pipelines.

title: Assistant Manager, Key Accounts
description:
Inc42 Media is looking for a sharp, relationship-driven Assistant Manager / Manager – Key Accounts to own a book of BrandLabs accounts end-to-end – the single point of contact between our clients and our internal teams across content & marketing campaigns. This is a role for a persuasive communicator who can build deep, trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, and use those relationships to retain and expand revenue from assigned accounts.

This role runs on a defined Key Account Management operating system — a scorecard that measures your accounts across Inputs (20%), Outputs (30%), and Outcomes (50%), a review cadence, renewal runways, and a governance layer. You won't have to invent the system; you'll operate it with discipline, make it hum, and — as you grow — help own and evolve it.

You'll own the full arc of an account — curating sharp concepts & proposals, orchestrating flawless delivery across BrandLabs properties (events, articles, videos, reports, custom programmes and more), and turning every campaign into a reason for clients to come back and spend more. Just as importantly, we want someone who is AI-native: you instinctively reach for AI tools to research faster, write tighter, build better decks, and free up time for the relationship-building that actually moves the needle.

Think of this as the role our best key-account leaders held earlier in their journey. You step in to run the OS on a live book of accounts today; the trajectory is to own it, sharpen it, and lead a pod as the vertical scales.

**About Inc42 Media**

Inc42 is India's #1 startup media & intelligence platform that informs, educates, and empowers startup & business leaders through its incisive reporting, insightful reports, curated events & communities, and industry-leading executive courses & programs.

Since launching in January 2015 and rising to become the authoritative voice on India's startup economy, we've moved markets, gotten the early scoop on billions of dollars of transactions, and told the inside story of some of the fastest-growing startups & industries alike. Our stories have been followed by the Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg, Reuters, TechCrunch, and other major outlets hundreds of times. Through Inc42 BrandLabs, we partner with enterprises & brands to create branded content & experiences that reach our audience of decision makers.

**The Inc42 Impact**

* Inc42 stories reach over 50 Mn+ people monthly
* Published more than 55,000 stories
* Successfully conducted 125+ events
* Launched 100+ research reports
* Receives 500+ startup applications monthly
* Worked with 350+ brands

**Why This Role Is Unique**

* Driving new revenue opportunities: You'll be the lynchpin on major revenue bets for Inc42 BrandLabs — retaining, growing, and cross-selling into your book of accounts.
* Anchoring relationships: You'll own client satisfaction and the metrics that matter — Net Promoter Score, repeat business, and account churn.
* Market experimentation: You'll help stand up new revenue channels and enable go-to-market motions for new formats and segments.
* Building for scale: This role is central to growing revenue from existing clients and is expected to develop into a team-leading position as the vertical scales.

**What You'll Own**

Your performance mirrors how every account is scored. The three layers below are exactly how success is measured — the weightings tell you where to spend your energy.

**1. Relationship & Activity Discipline — Inputs (20%)**

* Be the trusted point of contact for your accounts and build depth beyond a single stakeholder — widen coverage so no account depends on one relationship.
* Run a consistent meeting and interaction cadence (weekly / monthly / quarterly), logging planned-vs-actual so nothing slips.
* Keep the account record — the single source of truth — accurate and current: contacts, contract values, renewal dates, activity.

**2. Concepts, Proposals, Delivery & Reporting — Outputs (30%)**

* Curate customized content & branding concepts and translate them into compelling proposals, RFP responses, and pitch decks across BrandLabs properties.
* Own delivery quality end-to-end — plan execution, coordinate with internal production & content teams, marketing, event ops, Founders' Office, finance, and other stakeholders.
* Report campaign performance to clients and the sales team at a defined cadence, turning data into insight the client values.

**3. Retention & Expansion — Outcomes (50%)**

* Own the commercial outcomes for your book: gross revenue retention (keep what we have) and net revenue retention (grow it through upsell and cross-sell).
* Manage every renewal on its 90/60/30-day runway — no renewal should ever come as a surprise.
* Own client NPS, repeat business, and churn; anticipate needs before the client raises them.

**4. Governance & No-Surprises**

* Surface risks and escalations early through a structured, no-surprises review — flag a wobbling account before it becomes a lost one.
* Drive coordination with internal teams and improve the processes that make delivery smoother.

**5. AI-Native Ways of Working**

* Use AI tools smartly across the whole workflow — research and market mapping, proposal and deck drafting, meeting notes and follow-ups, reporting, and client communication.
* Continuously find ways to compress turnaround and raise output quality with AI, and share what works with the team.

**How Success Is Measured**

Concretely, you'll be measured on:

* Outcomes (50%): Repeat business, renewal timeliness, & NPS.
* Outputs (30%): Proposal quality and win rate, delivery quality, and reporting consistency.
* Inputs (20%): Cadence adherence, relationship coverage, and data hygiene on the account record.

**Who We Are Looking For**

**Must-have**

* Executive communication & relationship-building: builds trust fast with senior client stakeholders, holds their ground, and multi-threads an account. This is the single most important trait for the role.
* Revenue retention & expansion instinct: comfortable owning retention and driving upsell/cross-sell, and working a renewal to a timely close.
* Concept & proposal curation: turns a brief into a sharp concept and a genuinely persuasive proposal, deck, or RFP response.
* AI-native execution: already uses AI tools daily to research, draft, and speed up delivery — and eager to push further.
* Account & project management with P&L discipline: runs projects end-to-end and protects delivery quality and margin.
* Data & scorecard fluency: comfortable operating inside a metrics-driven system — reading a dashboard and making decisions from the numbers (sharp Excel/Google Sheets).
* Cadence & governance discipline: runs a review rhythm and a no-surprises escalation habit reliably, without being chased.
* 3–6 years of relevant experience (media solutions, consulting, SaaS, or brand/agency account management) with front-end client ownership. Bachelor's or Master's in Engineering/Tech, Sales, Marketing, Business, or equivalent.

**Good-to-have**

* Startup-ecosystem / media & branded-content domain knowledge — understands Inc42's world and audience.
* Negotiation skills, specifically on renewals and expansion pricing.
* Analytical storytelling — turning campaign performance into insight a client will pay to keep hearing.
* Comfort with CRM & project tools (e.g., Asana) and light BI/dashboarding.
* Early signs of team leadership / mentoring — this role is expected to grow into leading a pod.

**Why This Role Is Special**

* A system, not a scramble: you inherit a proven operating system and scorecard — clarity on exactly what good looks like from day one.
* Clear growth trajectory: operate the system now; own it, sharpen it, and lead a team as the vertical scales.
* Founder proximity & autonomy: direct exposure to leadership on high-stakes accounts, with the independence to drive outcomes your way.
* Massive visibility: be the face of Inc42 BrandLabs to some of India's most exciting brands and decision makers.

title: Product Support Lead
description:
**Location:** India (Remote / Hybrid)

**Experience:** 5-6 Years

Role Overview

We are looking for a Support Lead to build, manage, and be the ultimate escalation point for a 24x7 operations support team covering the Visiogen platform — HiApp (Human Intelligence App), our primary and most business-critical application, serving as the core platform Optometrists (ODs) use to monitor and respond to patient conversations across multiple clinics; Customer Portal; Operations Portal; and clinic chatbot integrations — all running on Zeiss's Azure infrastructure. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will manage a team of engineers across shifts, but you are also expected to personally step in and solve the issue when the team is stuck. You are the technical backstop as much as the people manager.

**WHAT MATTERS MOST**

This role is not certification-driven. We need someone with a proven history of personally solving hard, customer-specific production problems — the kind that don't have a documented fix — and who can lead a team to do the same. Certifications (Azure, Kubernetes, etc.) are welcomed as a bonus but are secondary to a demonstrable track record of hands-on resolution and forward-deployed engineering experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Team Leadership & Shift Management**

* Build, staff, and manage a 24x7 rotational schedule across a team in active rotation

* Ensure backup engineers remain current on the platform and cycle into the active rotation periodically, so coverage never depends on a single point of failure

* Mentor and upskill the team on HiApp, Customer Portal, Operations Portal, Azure infrastructure, and CI/CD processes

* Act as the final escalation point when the on-shift team cannot resolve an issue — personally driving it to resolution

* Own hiring, onboarding, and performance management for the support team

**Incident & Escalation Ownership**

* Own the incident management process end-to-end: severity classification (P1/P2/P3), coordination with engineering, and SLA adherence

* Lead major incident / outage bridges, making real-time judgment calls under pressure

* Drive post-incident root cause analysis and ensure corrective actions are actually implemented, not just documented

* Communicate incident status and business impact clearly to engineering and business stakeholders

**Technical Oversight**

* Maintain deep working knowledge across the full Azure stack: AKS, App Gateway (WAF\_v2), PostgreSQL, Redis, Function App (EP1), ACR Premium, Log Analytics/App Insights, Key Vault, Private Endpoints, Storage, and Traffic Manager

* Oversee troubleshooting of React, .NET, and Python (Gen AI) service issues across HiApp and the Customer Portal

* Oversee the Function App-based data ingestion pipeline into the vector database, and troubleshoot failures in that pipeline

* Review and validate production releases and deployments to prevent avoidable incidents

**Process & Continuous Improvement**

* Establish and refine monitoring, alerting, and on-call processes to reduce time-to-detect and time-to-resolve

* Build and maintain runbooks and knowledge base content from real incidents — while still expecting the team to solve novel problems beyond the runbook

* Partner with Operations and Customer Success teams on clinic onboarding, and remove recurring friction in onboarding or chatbot integration

* Report on support metrics (SLA adherence, incident volume, MTTR, recurring issues) to leadership

**Required Skills & Experience**

**Area**

**What We're Looking For**

**Experience**

Prior experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer, Technical Lead, or Support/SRE Lead, with direct, hands-on ownership of production issues — not purely a management role

**Cloud & Infrastructure**

Strong hands-on expertise across AKS, App Gateway (WAF\_v2), Private Endpoints, Traffic Manager, and Azure resource management at an architectural level

**Data Layer**

Solid troubleshooting depth in PostgreSQL and Redis, including performance and scaling issues

**Serverless / AI Pipeline**

Experience with Azure Function Apps (EP1) and data ingestion into vector databases

**DevOps & Release**

Strong background in Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, ACR (Premium), and production release governance

**Application Stack**

Working fluency across React, .NET, and Python (Gen AI) services to lead root cause investigations, not just delegate them

**Leadership**

Demonstrated experience managing or leading a 24x7 / shift-based support team, including scheduling and escalation ownership

**Problem-Solving**

A proven, specific track record of personally resolving hard, customer-specific or one-off issues — this matters more than any certification

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading support or forward-deployed teams for a SaaS or platform product with multiple customer-facing applications

* Experience in healthcare, clinic, or patient-facing platforms is a plus, not a requirement

* Azure or Kubernetes certifications are welcomed but are not a substitute for hands-on incident-resolution experience

* Experience setting up or maturing an on-call / 24x7 support function from the ground up

**What Success Looks Like**

* The 24x7 rotation runs smoothly with consistent SLA adherence and low unplanned escalation to engineering leadership

* Major incidents are resolved quickly, with clear communication and solid root cause analysis

* The team is capable of independently solving customer-specific issues, with the Lead only pulled in for the genuinely hard cases

* Clinic onboarding and chatbot integration friction decreases over time due to process and technical improvements

Work Location: In person

title: SOC Manager - IN
description:
**About Rackspace Cyber Defence**

Rackspace Cyber Defence is our next generation cyber defence and security operations capability that builds on 20+ years of securing customer environments to deliver proactive, risk-based, threat-informed and intelligence driven security services.

**Our purpose** is to enable our customers to defend against the evolving threat landscape across on-premises, private cloud, public cloud and multi-cloud workloads.

**Our goal** is to go beyond traditional security controls to deliver cloud-native, DevOps-centric and fully integrated 24x7x365 cyber defence capabilities that deliver a **proactive** , **threat-informed** , **risk-based** , **intelligence-driven** approach to detecting and responding to threats.

**Our mission** is to help our customers:

* Proactively detect and respond to cyber-attacks – 24x7x365.
* Defend against new and emerging risks that impact their business.
* Reduce their attack surface across private cloud, hybrid cloud, public cloud, and multi-cloud environments.
* Reduce their exposure to risks that impact their identity and brand.
* Develop operational resilience.
Maintain compliance with legal, regulatory and compliance obligations.  

**What we’re looking for**

To support our continued success and deliver a Fanatical Experience™ to our customers, Rackspace Technology is seeking an experienced, technically proficient and customer-focused **Security Operations Manager** to lead the delivery of its 24×7 Managed Security Services.

The successful candidate will lead a multidisciplinary team of security analysts and engineers responsible for threat detection, incident investigation, incident response, vulnerability management and security operations across customer environments.

This is a **hands-on technical leadership role** , requiring strong incident investigation capabilities, excellent customer engagement skills and proven experience managing security operations in an MSSP or enterprise SOC environment.

The Security Manager will be responsible for maintaining operational excellence, developing technical capabilities, mentoring engineers and driving continuous improvements across Rackspace's Cyber Defense portfolio.

  

**Key Accountabilities**

**1. SOC Leadership & Team Management**

* Lead, manage and mentor a team of SOC analysts, security engineers and technical specialists across L1/L2/L3 functions.
* Oversee 24×7 security operations, shift coverage, workload distribution, incident escalation and operational readiness.
* Provide technical direction and guidance during complex investigations and security incidents.
* Conduct technical reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, coaching and skills development.
* Drive analyst productivity, operational quality and team performance.
* Maintain effective collaboration across security service towers.

**2. Security Incident Investigation & Response**

* Lead technical investigations into critical and high-severity security incidents, including malware, ransomware, compromised identities, unauthorized access, suspicious network activity and cloud security threats.
* Act as the security incident lead for P1/P2 incidents, coordinating investigation, containment, remediation guidance and security recovery validation.
* Perform or oversee advanced analysis of endpoint telemetry, security logs, network events, indicators of compromise and attacker techniques.
* Guide analysts in threat hunting, incident correlation, root cause analysis and forensic evidence preservation.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, network, cloud, IAM, application and customer security teams to facilitate incident resolution.
* Ensure timely customer communication, incident updates, escalations and post-incident reporting.
* Maintain and improve incident response playbooks and investigation procedures.

**3. Managed Security Services & Technology Ownership**

Oversee security operations across Rackspace's RCDC portfolio, including:

* XDR / SIEM: Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic Security and associated detection, investigation, correlation and response workflows.
* EDR: CrowdStrike Falcon and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, including threat investigation, containment, policy tuning and agent health.
* VMDR: Qualys vulnerability management, assessment coverage, vulnerability prioritization, reporting and remediation coordination.
* Edge Security: Cloudflare WAF, DDoS protection and associated security monitoring and response.
* Managed Network Security: Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet and native cloud security controls, including security incident coordination and policy management.
* MDRM / External Threat Monitoring: CloudSEK and related external exposure and threat intelligence capabilities.
* Cloud Security: CSPM/CNAPP technologies such as Prowler and Upwind, as applicable to the evolving service portfolio.

The role requires strong working knowledge of core SOC technologies and the ability to lead specialists across the broader portfolio. Deep hands-on expertise in every individual product is not expected.

**4. Customer Engagement & Service Delivery**

* Serve as a senior technical point of contact for customer CISOs, security leaders and technical stakeholders.
* Lead technical incident discussions, operational reviews, security workshops and customer escalations.
* Explain security incidents, risks, investigation findings and remediation recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ensure delivery against agreed SLAs, KPIs, customer commitments and security service objectives.
* Oversee customer onboarding, monitoring coverage, policy configuration and operational handover.
* Identify recurring customer issues and recommend improvements to security controls, detections and operational processes.
* Build trusted customer relationships through proactive communication and technical credibility.

**5. Detection Engineering, Threat Intelligence & Automation**

* Oversee detection rule development, tuning, alert correlation and false-positive reduction.
* Promote proactive threat hunting using MITRE ATT&CK, threat intelligence and adversary TTPs.
* Develop and improve security investigation and response runbooks.
* Identify opportunities for SOAR automation, AI-assisted investigation and pre-approved response actions.
* Improve SOC effectiveness through measurable reductions in alert noise, investigation effort and response delays.
* Ensure security automation follows appropriate authorization, testing, logging and change-control procedures.

**6. Vulnerability & Exposure Management**

* Oversee vulnerability assessment operations, scanning coverage and agent health monitoring.
* Ensure critical vulnerabilities are appropriately prioritized, communicated and tracked.
* Coordinate remediation activities with infrastructure, cloud, application and customer teams.
* Monitor vulnerability aging, overdue findings, risk exceptions and remediation validation.
* Support customers in understanding and reducing security exposure.

**7. Governance, Reporting & Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain SOC operational standards, investigation quality, documentation and service delivery controls.
* Track operational KPIs such as incident response compliance, investigation quality, monitoring coverage, customer escalations and service improvement.
* Lead security incident reviews, root cause analysis and corrective action planning.
* Maintain operational runbooks, escalation procedures and knowledge documentation.
Support service enhancements, technology integrations and operational readiness for new security offerings.  

**Skills & Experience**

* **10–15 years of cybersecurity experience** , including approximately 4–6 years in SOC leadership, incident response or security operations management.
* Proven experience managing a 24×7 SOC or MSSP security operations environment.
* Strong hands-on experience in security incident investigation, threat detection, incident response and log analysis.
* Practical expertise in at least one major SIEM platform, preferably Microsoft Sentinel or Elastic Security.
* Strong experience with enterprise EDR technologies such as CrowdStrike Falcon or Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
* Working knowledge of vulnerability management platforms, preferably Qualys.
* Understanding of cloud security across Azure, AWS and GCP.
* Knowledge of network security, firewalls, WAF, identity security and endpoint protection.
* Experience with MITRE ATT&CK, NIST incident response guidance and security operations best practices.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent customer communication, stakeholder management and presentation skills.
* Experience handling major security incidents and coordinating multidisciplinary technical teams.
Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and develop high-performing technical teams.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in an MSSP or managed security services organization supporting multiple enterprise customers.
* Exposure to Cloudflare, Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet, CloudSEK, CSPM or CNAPP technologies.
* Experience with SOAR platforms, security automation, scripting and AI-assisted SOC operations.
* Experience supporting customer technical workshops, solution evaluations and new service onboarding.
* Familiarity with ITIL incident, problem and change management processes.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GCIH, GCIA, GSOC, SC-200, or equivalent practical expertise.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.  

**Soft skills**

* Strong technical leadership with a willingness to engage directly in complex security investigations.
* Customer-focused, accountable and decisive during high-pressure situations.
* Capable of balancing operational management with hands-on technical oversight.
* Effective communicator with senior customer stakeholders and internal technical teams.
* Collaborative leader who develops talent and encourages continuous learning. Proactive, adaptable and committed to improving security operations.

  

**About Rackspace Technology**

Rackspace Technology is the trusted operator of the full enterprise AI stack, from governed private cloud to AI inference and agents in production. From edge to core to cloud, we operate the infrastructure, data layer, and software integration to deliver business outcomes with the predictable cost, reliability, security, and compliance that regulated and mission-critical environments demand. We support customers in more than 120 countries with AI capabilities spanning private cloud, public cloud, applications, data and cyber resilience.

  

**More on Rackspace Technology**

Though we’re all different, Rackers thrive through our connection to a central goal: to be a valued member of a winning team on an inspiring mission. We bring our whole selves to work every day. And we embrace the notion that unique perspectives fuel innovation and enable us to best serve our customers and communities around the globe. We welcome you to apply today and want you to know that we are committed to offering equal employment opportunity without regard to age, color, disability, gender reassignment or identity or expression, genetic information, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity status, military or veteran status, nationality, ethnic or national origin, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any legally protected characteristic. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Portfolio Manager
description:
Account Management, Client Relations, Client Retention, Customer Experience, Customer Success, Real Estate
  
  
Portfolio Manager
  
  
**C$30,000–C$36,000 Annually | Full-Time | Remote | Eastern Time Hours**
The Opportunity
  
  
Royal York Property Management is hiring a Portfolio Manager to manage a portfolio of existing clients, properties, and active service files.
  
  
You will keep clients informed, monitor rent and account activity, coordinate property services, resolve problems, renew agreements, and protect client relationships.
  
  
This role requires strong service ownership and sales ability. You must be comfortable handling objections, explaining value, discussing pricing, preventing cancellations, and identifying opportunities to expand client relationships.
  
  
Direct property-management experience is preferred but not required. Candidates with strong experience in account management, portfolio management, client success, relationship management, sales, or service operations are encouraged to apply.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**

* Act as the primary contact for an assigned portfolio of property owners and tenants.
* Manage multiple client accounts, properties, and active service files.
* Complete client onboarding and collect required property, owner, and tenant documents.
* Provide proactive updates about completed work, outstanding issues, and next steps.
* Monitor rent collection and follow up on overdue balances.
* Review monthly property activity before owner payouts, including rent received, fees, expenses, invoices, reserves, and holdbacks.
* Investigate account discrepancies and coordinate corrections with the accounting team.
* Coordinate maintenance requests with internal teams and external service providers.
* Handle owner and tenant complaints, urgent issues, and service escalations.
* Identify dissatisfied or at-risk clients and take action to prevent avoidable cancellations.
* Manage agreement renewals and discuss pricing or service concerns within company guidelines.
* Handle objections, reinforce the value of the company’s services, and identify appropriate opportunities to expand client relationships.
* Monitor tenant notices, vacancies, turnovers, and re-leasing activity.
* Maintain accurate CRM notes, documents, tasks, deadlines, and follow-ups.
* Identify stalled files and escalate financial, legal, or service risks when necessary.
* Use technology and AI tools to improve documentation, communication, reporting, and efficiency.

**What You’ll Need**

* Three or more years of experience in account management, portfolio management, property management, client success, relationship management, sales, or service operations.
* Experience managing multiple clients, accounts, properties, claims, cases, or active files simultaneously.
* Experience with client retention, renewals, objection handling, negotiation, account growth, or consultative sales.
* Experience monitoring rent, invoices, recurring payments, accounts receivable, or overdue balances.
* Confidence reviewing account activity, statements, expenses, and supporting documents.
* Strong client communication and experience handling complaints or escalations.
* Excellent organization, documentation, and follow-through.
* Experience using a CRM, ticketing system, property-management platform, or workflow-management system.
* Ability to coordinate work across internal departments and external providers.
* Strong judgment when managing deadlines, financial concerns, sensitive information, and client expectations.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Availability to work full-time during Eastern Time business hours.
* Reliable internet, backup connectivity or power, a suitable computer, and a professional environment for calls.

Experience in property management, leasing, real estate operations, housing, facilities, insurance, financial services, SaaS, telecommunications, managed services, or another recurring-service industry will be considered.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  
Success means maintaining an organized portfolio, communicating proactively, collecting rent promptly, reviewing property accounts accurately, resolving service issues, securing renewals, protecting client relationships, and supporting portfolio growth.
  
  
Who Will Succeed
  
  
The right person takes ownership instead of waiting to be reminded. You are comfortable handling difficult conversations, challenging unclear explanations, negotiating professionally, and coordinating several parties until a problem is fully resolved.
  
  
You are client-focused and commercially aware. You know how to protect a relationship without making promises, offering discounts, or bypassing procedures simply to satisfy a client.
  
  
**Compensation**
The annual compensation range is
**C$30,000–C$36,000**
, based on relevant experience, qualifications, and demonstrated ability.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Apply with your resume. If your background aligns with the position, you will receive an email with a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours of applying.
