The team is preparing for its first IFS Cloud customer go-live, bringing a new API into production and recruiting a significant number of new colleagues. As the pace of delivery increases, we need clear ownership of test cycles, defects, release readiness and communication.

You will coordinate UAT with customers and internal stakeholders, maintain release plans and checklists, track defects through to resolution and support go/no-go decisions. You will work closely with Lorraine Hassall, our Quality Manager, allowing her to focus on quality standards and strategy while you manage the practical coordination required to apply them consistently.

Most of the role is focused on UAT, releases and delivery. It also includes a smaller amount of team coordination, particularly onboarding, in-person sessions, travel planning, and financial coordination.

**What you'll work on**

**UAT and release management**

* Plan and coordinate UAT cycles with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Confirm scope, participants, test windows, evidence and sign-off for each cycle.
* Track defects from identification through triage, ownership, resolution and closure.
* Support on the release calendar, release notes, readiness checklist and go/no-go process.
* Coordinate with other teams in IFS as the product is integrated with IFS Cloud.
* Support the UAT and release plan for Project Oliver and the first IFS Cloud customer go-live.

**Supporting the quality function**

* Work with the Quality Manager on test processes, evidence and audit trails.
* Help apply standards such as clear acceptance criteria, merge-request review and controlled production releases.
* Support the move from periodic manual QA towards per-ticket quality assurance and more frequent releases.

**Delivery coordination**

* Keep Jira accurate, with current statuses, acceptance criteria and links to relevant merge requests.
* Maintain useful documentation and decision records in Notion.
* Prepare concise delivery and release updates for product and engineering leads.
* Identify risks early, clarify ownership and follow actions through to completion.

**Team coordination**

* Organise onboarding logistics for new starters and monthly in-person sessions in Staines.
* Coordinate team travel, expenses and purchase orders.

 **Qualifications**

**What we're looking for**

* Strong organisation and follow-through, with a habit of identifying and addressing issues early.
* Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* The ability to work constructively with engineers and maintain agreed standards when priorities are competing.
* A practical, accountable approach to moving work forward without waiting for detailed direction.
* Experience coordinating UAT, software releases or delivery within a product or engineering team.
* Familiarity with release notes, test cycles, defect tracking, go/no-go decisions, acceptance criteria and regression scope.
* Experience managing a defect list through triage and resolution rather than only reporting its status.
* Confidence using Jira and a documentation platform such as Notion or Confluence.

Relevant backgrounds may include delivery coordination, release coordination, junior delivery management, QA coordination, scrum mastery or project coordination. We are more interested in what you have managed than in your previous job title.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with enterprise software involving customer UAT and formal sign-off.
* Exposure to regulated or audited environments, ERP products or supply-chain software.
* ISTQB, Agile or delivery certification.
* Experience working within a large organisation with established procurement and HR processes.
* Experience using AI tools to draft release notes, summarise defect lists or prepare status updates.

**Tools**

The team uses Jira, Notion, GitLab, Slack, Microsoft 365 and Outlook, along with IFS systems for travel, expenses and purchasing. You do not need to write code, but you should be comfortable working with engineers and understanding their delivery processes.

**What success looks like in the first six months**

* Releases follow a predictable cadence and include clear, accurate release notes.
* Each UAT cycle has an agreed owner, schedule, defect list, evidence and sign-off.
* Customer and support defects receive clear ownership and a visible route to resolution.
* The Project Oliver go-live is supported by a well-managed UAT and release plan.
* Acceptance criteria, review and release controls are applied consistently.
* Product and engineering leads spend less time on routine coordination and administration.

**Why we're hiring now**

The product team is growing and preparing for several important releases. The Quality Manager currently carries much of the practical coordination associated with testing and releases. This role will provide dedicated support of that work, helping the team increase delivery frequency while maintaining clear quality and release controls.

 **Additional Information**

*We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.*

Value (GMV) per month.

internal stakeholders

metrics to the partner

conversions and grow the business.

(competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
  
  
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
  
  
Functional Competencies
  
  
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
  
  
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads
  
  
RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
  
  
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
  
  
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise
  
  
transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills -
  
  
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
  
  
knowledge of English
  
  
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing
  
  
channels
  
  
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
  
  
Effective communication skills
  
  
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
  
  
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
  
  
Analytical, good Excel skills.
  
  
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
  
  
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people
  
  
at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
  
  
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
  
  
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness
  
  
and success of campaigns.

drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

* Own end-to-end complaint management for international and domestic customers (acknowledgement, resolution timelines, investigation, closure) through a structured tracking system covering quality, breakage, defects, shortages, packaging, labelling, documentation and shipment delays.

* Oversee EXIM operations: accurate export and import documentation (invoices, packing lists, shipping bills, BL/AWB, certificates), document control and audit readiness, and coordination with customs brokers, freight forwarders and shipping lines for timely shipment and clearance.
* Ensure compliance with customs laws, Foreign Trade Policy, DGFT and GST, including licences, duty benefits, export-linked schemes and renewals, and coordinate with Finance on export proceeds realisation and e-BRC.
* Monitor shipping costs (freight, demurrage, detention) and optimise shipment planning and container utilisation.

* Present periodic MIS and dashboards to management (order status and backlog, on-time shipments, complaints with RCA/CAPA status, shipment status, documentation accuracy, freight and avoidable costs, export proceeds, team productivity), analyse trends and close process gaps.

* Graduate in Commerce, Business Administration, International Business, Supply Chain Management or a related discipline.
* MBA / PGDM in International Business, Operations or Supply Chain (added advantage).
* Certification in Export-Import Management, International Trade or Logistics (preferred).

**Experience**

* 10-15 years in international sales coordination, export commercial operations, customer services or EXIM management, including international customer handling, export documentation, shipment coordination and complaint resolution.
* 3-5 years leading teams or managing multiple functions.
* Experience coordinating with international buyers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, shipping lines and financial institutions.

* Strong team leadership and people management.
* Excellent written and verbal business English.

* Analytical thinking, structured problem-solving and decision-making.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities, tight deadlines and customer escalations.
* Ownership, accountability, integrity and continuous improvement.

We are looking for a proactive and responsible Branch Admin Executive to handle the daily operations of a Betaspace branch.

You will ensure the branch is ready for clients, supervise housekeeping and support staff, attend to client requirements, coordinate maintenance, and follow up on operational tasks. This is an active, on-site role requiring regular walkthroughs, direct staff coordination, and ownership of issues until they are resolved.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

**1. Branch Readiness and Daily Operations**

* Conduct a morning walkthrough to ensure the branch is clean, organised, and ready for clients.
* Check reception, workstations, cabins, meeting rooms, pantry, washrooms, and common areas.
* Conduct regular checks throughout the day and address operational gaps promptly.
* Follow branch opening and closing procedures and maintain relevant checklists.

**2. Housekeeping and Support Staff Supervision**

* Monitor housekeeping and other assigned support staff attendance.
* Assign daily duties and verify that work is completed properly.
* Ensure washrooms, pantry, desks, floors, and waste bins are cleaned regularly.
* Arrange corrective cleaning whenever required.
* Report staff shortages, attendance concerns, and repeated service gaps to the manager.

**3. Client Service and Relationship Management**

* Act as the branch contact for day-to-day client requirements.
* Respond professionally to requests, complaints, and feedback.
* Coordinate solutions with the appropriate staff, vendors, or manager.
* Track issues until completion and confirm resolution with clients.
* Maintain courteous communication and a welcoming branch environment.

**4. Facility Checks**

* Check internet connectivity, Wi-Fi, AC, lighting, drinking water, and washroom facilities.
* Monitor UPS and generator readiness through approved checks and coordination with authorised personnel.
* Identify faults, record issues, and arrange timely follow-up.
* Escalate interruptions that affect client operations immediately.

**5. Maintenance and Vendor Coordination**

* Identify repairs and maintenance requirements during branch walkthroughs.
* Coordinate technician visits, vendor access, and service schedules.
* Obtain quotations and management approval where required.
* Follow up on pending repairs and verify completion.
* Maintain maintenance records and highlight recurring problems.

**6. Enquiries, Branch Tours, and Follow-ups**

* Handle incoming calls, walk-in enquiries, and workspace enquiries professionally.
* Understand prospective clients’ requirements and explain available workspace options.
* Conduct branch tours and share approved pricing and service information.
* Record enquiry details and coordinate follow-ups with the manager or sales team.

**7. Occupancy and Booking Coordination**

* Maintain accurate information on occupied and available seats and cabins.
* Coordinate meeting room bookings, day passes, and workspace allocations.
* Ensure booked spaces are ready before client arrival.
* Track expected move-ins, move-outs, and changes in client requirements.

**8. Client Onboarding and Exit**

* Coordinate workspace preparation before new clients move in.
* Follow up on required documents and internal onboarding formalities.
* Coordinate access cards, keys, and workspace handovers.
* Assist with exit inspections, access card returns, and handover records.

**9. Payment, Renewal, and Documentation Follow-up**

* Coordinate with the accounts team on assigned payment follow-ups.
* Record client payment commitments and share updates with the relevant team.
* Follow up on renewals and pending documents.
* Escalate overdue commitments and unresolved documentation requirements.

**10. Supplies and Branch Records**

* Monitor housekeeping materials, pantry supplies, stationery, and other essential consumables.
* Raise replenishment requests before supplies run out.
* Maintain visitor, courier, key, access card, inventory, and other assigned branch records.
* Maintain clear supporting records for approved purchases and expenses.

**11. Security and Closing Checks**

* Monitor visitor entry and coordinate with security personnel where available.
* Report unauthorised access, security concerns, or unusual incidents promptly.
* Ensure equipment, lights, AC, doors, and keys are checked according to branch closing procedures.

**12. Reporting and Continuous Improvement**

* Submit a daily branch operations report before leaving for the day.
* Report checks completed, work handled, client issues, maintenance updates, and pending tasks.
* Mention the action taken, current status, next step, and support required.
* Report urgent issues immediately.
* Suggest practical improvements to cleanliness, client experience, facility upkeep, and branch operations.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Any graduate; candidates with a diploma and relevant practical experience may also apply.
* 1–3 years of experience in office administration, facility coordination, coworking operations, front office, hospitality, or customer service.
* Experience supervising housekeeping or support staff is preferred.
* Experience handling clients, vendors, and maintenance follow-ups is an advantage.

**Required Skills**

* Good spoken Tamil and working proficiency in English.
* Professional communication and client-handling skills.
* Basic knowledge of email, Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, and daily reporting.
* Good organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to prioritise tasks and follow up consistently.
* Willingness to conduct regular branch walkthroughs and supervise work directly.
* Ability to handle routine issues independently and seek support when required.

**What Success Looks Like**

* A clean, organised, and client-ready branch.
* Housekeeping and support duties completed consistently.
* Client requests acknowledged and followed through to resolution.
* Maintenance issues identified early and tracked to completion.
* Accurate branch records and timely daily reports.
* Reliable follow-up on enquiries, payments, and pending tasks.

title: Support Engineer (Teleradiology)
description:
**What We’re About**
At Harrison.ai, we’re redefining what’s possible in healthcare. Through our diagnostic AI solutions, we’re building tools that support clinicians to deliver earlier, more accurate diagnoses and raise the standard of care for millions of patients worldwide.
  
  
Our mission is bold but simple: to scale global healthcare capacity and create a fairer, healthier world. By using AI as a co-pilot for clinicians, we’re tackling one of healthcare’s biggest challenges, the shortage of human expertise, and giving every patient the chance to access timely, high-quality care, no matter where they live.
  
  
Because while we’re building cutting-edge AI, what we’re really building is hope—that everyone can access the healthcare they deserve.
  
  
***And we’re just getting started.***
**About Your Role**
This Support Engineer (Teleradiology) role is a technical position within Harrison.ai's Service Excellence Squad. The role mainly supports Harrison.ai Services, which provides non-clinical services, including IT support, to Frontier Radiology, an affiliated US teleradiology practice.
  
  
**This role is based in person in Bangalore, India, and works on a rotating shift roster that includes nights and weekends to provide 24/7 support across US hours.**
You will provide non-clinical IT support to Frontier's radiologists, who deliver 24/7 teleradiology reads of critical diagnostic imaging studies across the United States. The focus is on Level 2 end user support with emphasis on rapid resolution of issues that directly impact patient care. This spans hardware (diagnostic workstations), business-as-usual SaaS applications, and specialised clinical systems including PACS, RIS, and Harrison.ai's AI applications and reporting software.
  
  
You will build relationships with radiologists and clinical teams, drive continuous improvement, and advocate for change. Technical downtime in teleradiology directly affects patient diagnosis and care, so you'll need to prioritise urgent clinical support requests and respond rapidly to workstation or application issues. The role also encompasses systems implementation, migration, and consolidation work, with a focus on agile project delivery. You will be solutions-focused, supporting teams across multiple divisions as we scale globally.
  
  
**What You Do**

* Provide Level 2 support to all users regarding workstation setups - including issues with Windows OS, user accounts, and business-as-usual SaaS applications
* Provide 24/7 support to Frontier's US-based radiologists with priority response for reading workstation and clinical application issues that impact clinical workflows
* Perform case management with a focus on SLA adherence for all requests
* Provide support for PACS and RIS systems used in the clinical workflow of teleradiology
* Troubleshoot DICOM and HL7 connectivity, image routing, and PACS/RIS integration issues
* Support and troubleshoot VPN and secure remote access for distributed radiologists
* Support and troubleshoot site-to-site VPN connections for clinical data sharing
* Administer and support SaaS applications such as Atlassian, Office 365, SharePoint, Mimecast, 1Password, Zoom Phone and other applications within the business
* Take remediation actions in response to errors, problems, service requests and incidents, with ability to triage and escalate urgent technical issues affecting clinical workflows
* Perform root cause analysis on recurring issues and implement preventative measures
* Work closely with engineering teams to ensure feedback and faults are fully understood and logged, with resolutions or workarounds being implemented with minimal downtime
* Work closely with counterparts across the global Support Services team on continuous improvement projects, including supporting ongoing education and training
* Maintain HIPAA compliance across all systems and support activities, ensuring strict adherence to healthcare data security standards
* Educate internal customers and radiologists on applications, systems, and best practices

**What You Bring**

* 2+ years of experience with PACS and RIS systems in a healthcare or radiology environment
* 3+ years of previous experience in an IT Support role supporting the Microsoft ecosystem
* Familiarity with both Windows and MacOS operating systems
* Experience supporting healthcare professionals in time-sensitive clinical environments where downtime directly impacts patient care
* Previous experience working in a cloud-first technology environment
* Strong understanding of Microsoft 365 ecosystem, including Entra ID, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Exchange Online
* Strong understanding of HIPAA requirements and healthcare data security principles
* Experience with DICOM and HL7 protocols and medical imaging workflows
* Demonstrated ability to triage and prioritise urgent clinical support requests effectively
* Excellent problem and conflict resolution skills with ability to liaise effectively with radiologists and all levels of stakeholders

**Nice To Have Skills And Characteristics**

* Experience with healthcare integration engines (e.g. Mirth Connect, Cloverleaf)
* Experience working concurrently with multiple PACS and RIS vendors
* Ability to handle multiple concurrent tasks/activities and meet high customer expectations
* Tertiary qualified in a relevant IT related field and/or relevant work experience
* Experience with teleradiology operations or distributed healthcare service delivery
* Familiarity with radiology workstation hardware specifications and diagnostic monitor calibration
* Knowledge of cyber security principles and healthcare-specific security frameworks

**Why join us?**
🌍
**Innovate for Global Good.**
Join us to pioneer world-first AI technology that transforms patient outcomes and helps build a healthier, fairer world.
  
  
🤝
**Collaboration Across Continents.**
Work with brilliant minds from every corner of the globe in a culture built on trust, autonomy, and genuine teamwork.
  
  
🚀
**Well-Funded & Global.**
Backed by world-class investors including Aware Super, Blackbird Ventures, Skip Capital, and Horizons Ventures, we’ve raised over US$240M to accelerate our global impact.
  
  
**🌱**
**Scale Your Potential.**
Tap into yearly L&D budgets, mentoring, hackathons, and secondments—all supported by a transparent growth framework to grow your career.
  
  
💻
**Flex for Life.**
Work when and where you do your best—with WFH options, flexible hours, and the autonomy to make an impact your way.
  
  
**🙌 Support for Every Family Journey.**
From fertility to parenthood, loss, and even grandparenthood—we provide inclusive, thoughtful policies to support families in every stage.
  
  
**What's next?**
If you’re inspired by what we're up to, please apply now and we'll be in touch soon.
  
  
*We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Diversity’s not a buzzword here, it’s in our DNA. Diverse perspectives shape our culture and make our work better. We’re committed to building inclusive teams that represent a variety of backgrounds and skills. We look forward to hearing from you.*

title: Senior IT & Administration Coordinator (2-3 years experience)
description:
**Company Description**

Inkers Technology is based in Bengaluru with offices in the USA and UAE. We specialise in designing and developing deep, large-scale AI and ML solutions for the construction industry. With a focus on AI, computer vision and deep neural networks, we have built "Kaël", an AI project manager that predicts delays, flags risks, automates reporting and prevents cost overruns with real-time construction intelligence. Our hardware platform, "Observance", uses LiDAR scanning, thermal imaging and AI-powered analysis to deliver BIM models, deviation detection and as-built intelligence.

**Role Description**

We are looking for a proactive Senior IT Administrator to own day-to-day IT operations while building out a more mature infrastructure, identity, endpoint and security backbone as Inkers scales. You will administer Microsoft 365 and endpoint/MDM environments end to end, strengthen identity and access management, support cloud administration across AWS/Azure, and act as the go-to escalation point for complex issues. You will anticipate needs and follow vendors and renewals through to closure, while keeping the workplace infrastructure and services our teams rely on every day running smoothly.

You should be willing to travel to project sites when required, including supporting 3D scanning equipment and on-site IT needs. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Bengaluru.

**Responsibilities**

* Administer Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive): licensing, mail flow, retention policies and PowerShell-driven automation.
* Manage identity and access across Active Directory, Group Policy and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD): user provisioning and deprovisioning, security groups, MFA and Conditional Access.
* Administer endpoint and MDM environments (Microsoft Intune, Jamf Pro or equivalent) across Windows, macOS and iOS: enrolment, compliance policies, configuration profiles and app deployment.
* Provide IT support for hardware, software, network, email and systems; set up and configure laptops, desktops, monitors, printers and other equipment.
* Install, configure and troubleshoot Windows and Linux systems.
* Troubleshoot LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, switches, routers and other network issues; support enterprise networking (e.g. Cisco Meraki) where applicable.
* Assist with AWS/Azure cloud monitoring, administration and cost/performance optimisation.
* Maintain IT asset records, software licences and equipment inventories; maintain IT documentation, SOPs and troubleshooting records.
* Perform system updates, antivirus/EDR checks, backups and other security activities; support ISO 27001-aligned security and audit practices.
* Support CCTV, NVR, access-control and other office and site IT infrastructure.
* Own employee onboarding and offboarding from the IT side: system setup, access management, ID card and asset handover.
* Track IT issues end-to-end and ensure timely resolution; act as the Level 2/3 escalation point for IT.
* Travel to project sites when required for 3D scanning, scanning equipment setup and on-site IT support.
* Coordinate with vendors for internet, hardware, software and other IT services; compare quotes and keep contracts, renewals and invoices in order.
* Own workplace infrastructure upkeep: schedule preventive maintenance and servicing of air-conditioning, water purification, pantry and beverage equipment, and biometric/attendance devices with the respective vendors.
* Negotiate, obtain and renew Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs) for IT and workplace equipment; maintain an AMC and warranty tracker with renewal dates.
* Plan and procure office equipment, consumables and everyday workplace essentials so that supplies never run short; review and shortlist service vendors (such as pantry and catering) periodically.
* Arrange employee ID cards and business cards as part of onboarding and role changes.
* Be proactive: keep a preventive-maintenance calendar, raise renewals and replacements ahead of time, and flag issues before they affect the team.

**Qualifications**

* 2-3 years of experience in IT Administration, IT Support or System Administration.
* Degree/Diploma in Computer Science, IT or a related field.
* Strong knowledge of Windows and Linux systems, computer hardware, networking and troubleshooting.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace administration.
* Working knowledge of AWS/Azure or other cloud platforms.
* Experience with MDM/endpoint management (Intune, Jamf or similar) is a strong plus.
* Exposure to information security practices and frameworks (e.g. ISO 27001) is a plus.
* Experience in vendor coordination, procurement and handling AMCs and renewals for IT and workplace equipment.
* Good communication, coordination and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and manage multiple requirements.
* Willingness to travel and work at project sites when required.

**Language Requirements**

* **Mandatory:**
  fluency in English, Hindi and Kannada (spoken).
* **Added advantage:**
  any additional language (e.g. Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Marathi).

**Key Qualities**

Ownership, proactiveness, strong follow-up, vendor coordination, discretion with confidential information, and a service mindset.

title: Senior IT System Administrator
description:
**About Assetze**

Assetze helps companies manage their IT equipment, from procurement and device setup to technical support, asset tracking, recovery, and recycling.

We work with 300+ companies, including 50+ YC-backed startups, across 35+ countries.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Senior IT Systems Administrator to manage employee IT support, endpoint devices, identity and access management, and day-to-day IT operations.

This is a hands-on role for someone with experience managing macOS devices, administering identity platforms, troubleshooting technical issues, and automating routine IT tasks.

You'll be responsible for keeping employee devices and systems running smoothly, managing access throughout the employee lifecycle, and finding practical ways to make IT operations more efficient.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **IT Support and System Administration**

* Troubleshoot hardware, software, operating system, application, and network connectivity issues.
* Provide Tier 1 and Tier 2 support for employee devices and business applications.
* Resolve incidents and service requests, escalating complex issues when necessary.
* Maintain troubleshooting guides, knowledge-base articles, and standard operating procedures.

**2. Identity & Access Management**

* Administer Okta or a similar identity platform, managing users, groups, application access, SSO, and MFA.
* Handle user provisioning and deprovisioning during employee onboarding, role changes, and offboarding.
* Troubleshoot authentication issues and integrations involving SAML and OAuth.
* Ensure access permissions follow established security policies.

**3. Endpoint & Device Management**

* Configure, deploy, and troubleshoot employee laptops, with a focus on macOS.
* Use Jamf Pro or a comparable MDM platform to manage device enrollment, configuration profiles, software deployment, and updates.
* Monitor device compliance and support endpoint security requirements.
* Coordinate device repairs, replacements, and warranty claims.
* Maintain device inventories and employee assignment records.

**4. IT Automation**

* Automate routine IT tasks, particularly employee onboarding, offboarding, access provisioning, and device setup.
* Use scripting, APIs, and integration tools to simplify IT administration.
* Troubleshoot failed workflows and maintain documentation for automated processes.

**5. Asset & Vendor Management**

* Coordinate device procurement, deployment, tracking, recovery, and decommissioning.
* Work with vendors on device deliveries, repairs, replacements, and warranties.
* Ensure devices are securely wiped and prepared for reuse or disposal.
* Maintain accurate asset records and support IT projects as needed.

**6. Security, Compliance & Improvement**

* Support software updates, endpoint compliance, and access reviews.
* Maintain records required for IT audits and compliance checks.
* Follow established security procedures and assist with SOC 2 and ISO 27001 requirements, where applicable.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Hands-on experience managing macOS devices using Jamf Pro or another MDM solution.
* Practical experience administering Okta or a comparable enterprise identity and access management platform.
* Strong understanding of endpoint management, SSO, MFA, user provisioning, deprovisioning, and access controls.
* 5+ years of experience in IT support, systems administration, or corporate IT operations.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across operating systems, hardware, applications, and network connectivity.
* Experience managing employee onboarding, offboarding, and IT assets.
* Familiarity with Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, or similar business applications.
* Experience working with IT ticketing systems and incident management.
* Good communication skills and the ability to manage technical issues independently.

**Preferred Qualification**

* Experience integrating identity platforms with endpoint management tools.
* Familiarity with scripting languages, APIs, and IT automation.
* Experience with Jira Service Management, Freshservice, ServiceNow, or similar tools.
* Knowledge of endpoint security, access reviews, and IT compliance.
* Experience coordinating IT vendors and technical projects.
* Relevant certifications in Jamf, Okta, Apple, CompTIA, or ITIL.

**What Matters in This Role**

* You can troubleshoot problems independently and follow them through to resolution.
* You understand how to manage employee access and devices securely.
* You look for practical ways to automate repetitive tasks.
* You keep asset records and technical documentation accurate.
* You communicate clearly with employees, vendors, and other IT teams.

**Work location: Bengaluru.**

title: Professional Services Consultant
description:
Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,200 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 15 million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide.

**Job Description**

The Professional Services Consultant plays a key role in our Services organisation, acting as a customer-facing representative of Nexthink. You will deliver advisory and technical services for Nexthink products, ensuring customer expectations are met or exceeded in terms of technical execution and business impact.

This role extends beyond implementation. You will engage regularly with customer stakeholders to define business challenges, design outcome-driven use cases, and guide solution adoption to improve digital employee experience and overall business operations. By combining consultative engagement with hands-on configuration, you will help customers embed Nexthink into their operational workflows and realise measurable value.

This position requires a dedicated and enthusiastic professional with strong technical, analytical, and consulting skills, capable of establishing and maintaining trusted advisor status.

Key Responsibilities:

Consultative Engagement & Business Outcome Ownership

· Lead recurring customer sessions to identify, prioritise, and design outcome-driven use cases aligned to business and operational objectives.

· Drive consultative conversations to define business issues and remediation possibilities achievable with Nexthink products and services.

· Translate business requirements into structured solution designs that consider process alignment, stakeholder engagement, and operational impact.

· Guide customers in embedding Nexthink into service management and cross-functional operational workflows.

· Empower customers to fully adopt Nexthink solutions while maintaining trusted advisor status.

· Support customers in progressing towards defined milestones and measurable outcomes.

Technical Implementation & Solution Execution:

· Implement, configure, and operate Nexthink products ensuring alignment with best practices and approved solution designs.

· Develop dashboards, investigations, alerts, campaigns, automation workflows, and other Nexthink content

· Support integrations with customer systems using scripting and API-based approaches where required.

· Analyze endpoint and operational data to generate actionable insights and optimize use case effectiveness.

· Troubleshoot technical challenges using structured problem-solving techniques.

· Maintain accurate documentation of configurations, solution designs, and engagement activities.

Leadership, Collaboration & Professional Excellence

· Lead technical engagements and collaborate effectively with colleagues, taking direction as needed.

· Continuously enhance skills and resolve issues using structured problem-solving tools and techniques.

· Effectively acquire, present, and clarify information using strong communication skills across various platforms.

· Commit to customer satisfaction, act with integrity, and treat colleagues with respect, promptly addressing service delivery issues.

· Ensure timely and accurate compliance with service processes, including schedule management, reports, expenses, and timesheets.

**Qualifications**

5+ years of consulting or advisory experience, preferably in a customer-facing services role in the technology industry, B2B, SaaS, or similar.

· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or related technical discipline, or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

· Strong ability to gather and translate business issues into structured technical solutions.

· Ability to drive consultative conversations defining business challenges and remediation possibilities.

· Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to interpret and visualise data to generate actionable insights.

· Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Windows clients and applications.

· Ability to quickly learn new technologies in an unsupervised environment.

· Excellent communication, teamwork, and time management skills.

· Working knowledge of Nexthink and its products.

· Enterprise Operations experience (Digital Workplace, IT infrastructure, Capacity planning, end-user software/hardware engineering).

· ITIL v4 knowledge.

· Experience in scripting and integration concepts (PowerShell, Python, JSON, REST API, LDAP, SSO, BASH).

· Experience in data analytics and visualisation tools (SQL, Power BI, Tableau, etc.).

· MacOS familiarity.

This position requires 10% travel to the headquarters for training purposes.

**Additional Information**

We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers’ IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace.

With over 1000 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees ‘Nexthinkers’ and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages.

Total Rewards @ Nexthink
  
  
  
  
At Nexthink, we offer one of the most comprehensive and generous benefits plans.  Your total rewards compensation package includes base salary and may also include a commission or performance bonus plan, as well as equity.  We provide our US employees with 100% covered company benefits that consist of health, dental, vision as well as access to life insurance, long-term disability, and accidental death/personal loss coverage.

If you are looking for a change and like a nice atmosphere, lots of challenges, and having fun while working, this is a great opportunity for you! Check what we offer:-

* 💼 Permanent Contract and a competitive compensation package.

* 🩺 Health insurance through our partnership with ACKO, including OPD coverage for dental, vision, health check-ups, consultations, and pharmacy expenses.

* 🏡 Hybrid work model balancing office and remote work, with a structured approach for new hires to foster connections and onboarding.

* 🏖️ Flexible Hours and unlimited vacation (employees have unlimited paid time off on top of the 22 days of holidays we offer). Plus, company-paid bank holidays (12), sick days (10-30), bereavement leave (5), and 3 days per year for volunteering.

* 📚 Free access to professional training platforms to explore your interests and enhance your skills.

* 🛡️ Stay covered against accidents, bodily injuries, and disabilities with our personal accident insurance policy, providing assurance with coverage up to three times your annual CTC.

* 🍼 New mothers are entitled to up to 26 weeks of maternity leave, with the flexibility to use up to 8 weeks before the expected delivery and the remaining 18 weeks after. Birth fathers can take 6 weeks of paternity leave, while adoptive parents are eligible for 26 weeks of leave for mothers and 6 weeks for fathers.

* 💰 Under the Payment of Gratuity Act, receive gratuity at the rate of 15 days of basic pay for every completed year of service, provided you've been employed by the company for a minimum of 5 years. Gratuity is payable at retirement or resignation based on your last drawn basic pay.

title: Technical Support Specialist III - Oracle Integration Cloud
description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.
  
  
We are more than 36,000 people, in over 70 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.
  
  
**Role Description:**
Oracle Integration Cloud Developer with 2–5 years of experience developing, testing and supporting integrations between Oracle Fusion and external applications. Hands-on experience with OIC, REST/SOAP APIs, SFTP, scheduled and application-driven integrations, XML/JSON transformations and SQL. Experienced in integration monitoring, incident troubleshooting, UAT support and deployment activities. Familiar with Oracle Fusion ERP/HCM integration patterns and enterprise integration lifecycle practices.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities – Oracle Integration Cloud Developer**

* Develop, test and support integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) between Oracle Fusion applications and external systems.
* Comprehend application-driven, scheduled and file-based integrations based on functional and technical requirements.
* Configure and maintain Connections, Integrations, Lookups, Packages and Schedules.
* Build and maintain integrations involving Oracle Fusion ERP and/or HCM applications.
* Understand integration validations, conditional processing and appropriate fault/error-handling mechanisms.
* Work with Oracle Fusion REST/SOAP APIs, BI Publisher reports and file-based integration patterns where applicable.
* Use SQL for data validation, reconciliation, troubleshooting and integration support activities.
* Test REST/SOAP services using tools such as Postman and analyze request/response payloads.
* Monitor OIC integration instances, schedules and message flows and proactively identify failed or delayed transactions.
* Troubleshoot production incidents involving connectivity, authentication, API errors, SFTP failures, transformation issues and source/target data problems.
* Analyze Activity Streams, error messages, payloads and application logs to identify the root cause of integration failures.
* Perform incident investigation, defect resolution and root-cause analysis (RCA) for recurring integration issues.
* Support failed transaction recovery, reprocessing and reconciliation following defined operational procedures.
* Provide L2 technical support for OIC integrations and coordinate with functional, application, infrastructure and external-system teams when required.
* Support SIT, UAT and regression testing, including defect analysis and resolution.
* Prepare SOP's, technical validation evidence and deployment-related documentation.
* Support the migration and deployment of integrations across Development, Test/UAT and Production environments.
* Perform post-deployment validation and monitor integrations following production releases.
* Maintain technical documentation, support runbooks, troubleshooting guides and knowledge-based articles.

**Required Qualifications and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related technical discipline.
* 2–5 years of relevant experience in enterprise application integration, Oracle Cloud integration development/support or a comparable technical role.
* Hands-on experience developing, testing and supporting integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC).
* Practical experience with application-driven, scheduled and file-based OIC integration patterns.
* Experience configuring and working with OIC components such as Connections, Integrations, Lookups, Packages and Schedules.
* Working knowledge and practical experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and/or HCM integrations.
* Strong practical experience with REST APIs, SOAP web services and SFTP/file-based integration mechanisms.
* Good working knowledge of XML and JSON, including data mapping, transformation and validation.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data validation, reconciliation, troubleshooting and integration-support activities.
* Practical experience using tools such as Postman for REST/SOAP API testing and request/response analysis.
* Experience troubleshooting OIC integrations using Activity Streams, error messages, payloads and application logs.
* Good understanding of integration fault handling, exception management, transaction recovery, reprocessing and reconciliation.
* Experience supporting production incidents and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for integration-related issues.
* Practical exposure to SIT, UAT, regression testing, deployment and post-production validation activities.
* Familiarity with Oracle Fusion REST/SOAP APIs and BI Publisher (BIP) integration/reporting patterns.
* Exposure to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and enterprise authentication/connectivity concepts would be advantageous.
* Good written and verbal communication skills with the ability to prepare clear technical documentation, SOPs, support runbooks and troubleshooting guidance.
* Ability to manage assigned priorities independently, take ownership of technical issues and work effectively within established change, release and operational processes.

It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.

title: Business Systems Lead
description:

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. What You Can Expect
  
  
The Business Systems Lead is an IT role that is responsible for administering applications that enable the automation of Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable processes. **Roles & Responsibilities**

Associates in India have the opportunity to solve complex problems, contribute to global initiatives, and support products and services that are part of the U.S. healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Support Supervisor II leads the Service Desk and Production Data Support teams, ensuring smooth day-to-day operations, effective incident response, and reliable support for business-critical products and data processes. This is a leadership-focused position responsible for team development, service delivery, shift coverage, stakeholder communication, and continuous improvement. * Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
* Demonstrated experience in technical support, service desk, or production support, including leadership or supervisory responsibilities.
* Strong understanding of IT service management, incident management, troubleshooting, and escalation processes.
* Ability to understand end-to-end application and data flows and work effectively with technical teams during production issues.
* Strong people leadership, coaching, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and support effective operations in a fast-paced production environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading Service Desk, Application Support, or Production Support teams.
* Exposure to production data support, including understanding of data flows, integrations, and operational dependencies.
* Familiarity with ITIL / IT Service Management (ITSM) practices and structured incident and problem management.
* Experience working collaboratively with Product, Development, Data Engineering, Database, and Infrastructure teams.
* Strong coaching, mentoring, stakeholder communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Experience improving support processes, documentation, knowledge management, and operational efficiency.

**Why Join Availity India?**

* Meaningful impact: Work on solutions that help simplify healthcare administration and support better provider and patient experiences.
* Global exposure: Partner with U.S. teams and leaders while contributing from India to global business priorities.
* Learning and growth: Be part of a culture that values continuous learning, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and career development.
* Flexible work experience: Work in a way that supports productivity, collaboration, and team needs across remote, hybrid, and office-based models.
* Holistic rewards: Benefit from competitive compensation, health and insurance benefits, paid time off, company holidays, leave benefits, Employee Assistance Program support, and learning programs.
* Inclusive workplace: Join a casual, collaborative, and inclusive environment where associates are encouraged to bring ideas forward.
* Office experience: For office-based associates, Availity India provides amenities such as coffee and tea, subsidized meals, recreation areas, and eligible night-shift transportation support.

**What To Expect From The Hiring Process**
Our hiring process is designed to be transparent and engaging. Depending on the role, it may include application review, recruiter discussion, technical or functional assessment, hiring manager interviews, team or leadership conversations, offer discussion, background verification, and onboarding support.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Statement**
Availity is committed to building an inclusive workplace where all associates feel valued, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds and encourage individuals who are excited by collaboration, innovation, and meaningful impact to apply.
  
  
**Eligibility**
**Video Camera Usage**
*Availity fosters a collaborative and open culture where communication and engagement are central to our success. As a remote first company, we are also camera-first and provide all associates with camera/video capability to simulate the office environment. If you are not able to use your camera for all virtual meetings, you should not apply for this role.*
*Having cameras on helps create a more connected, interactive, and productive environment, allowing teams to communicate more effectively and build stronger working relationships. The usage of cameras also enhances security and protects sensitive company information. Video participation is required to ensure that only authorized personnel are present in meetings and to prevent unauthorized access, data breaches, preventing social engineering, or the sharing of confidential information with non-participants.*

**Education And Qualifications**

Why UKG:

At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.

We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.
  
  
About the Role
  
Operations is evolving from application support into an enterprise capability that engineers reliable, observable, secure, and increasingly intelligent services. The Enterprise Operations Architect will shape this evolution across enterprise applications and services, including Salesforce, Dynamics 365, integration platforms, and ServiceNow.
  
The role defines operational architecture, standards, and roadmaps that make services easier to monitor, support, recover, secure, and improve. It establishes end-to-end observability across technology and business transactions and leads the evaluation, design, and implementation of AI and automation solutions. Working across domain teams, engineering, security, business stakeholders, vendors, and managed service partners, the architect translates strategy into production-ready capabilities and measurable outcomes.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Operational architecture and service design
  

* Define target operational architecture, including service boundaries, dependencies, ownership, resiliency, supportability, and lifecycle requirements.
* Create and maintain reference architectures, patterns, standards, and decision records for readiness, monitoring, alerting, integrations, recovery, knowledge, and automation.
* Engage early with application and solution architects so new capabilities are observable, secure, supportable, and ready for transition to operations.
* Establish onboarding and operational acceptance criteria covering service maps, runbooks, access, support models, alert routing, recovery procedures, and measures.
* Identify architectural risks, single points of failure, technical debt, and recurring operational demand; drive prioritized remediation with accountable owners.

Resilience, observability, and operational excellence
  

* Define resilience and operational-excellence standards based on service criticality, dependencies, recovery readiness, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with continuity, security, engineering, and service owners to assess business impact and establish recovery strategies, including RTO and RPO where applicable.
* Ensure continuity and disaster-recovery requirements are embedded in service maps, runbooks, escalation paths, communications, support models, and exercises; track gaps to closure.
* Define service-level indicators, objectives, health models, instrumentation, actionable alert thresholds, and escalation paths that minimize avoidable noise.
* Establish event-management patterns for enrichment, deduplication, correlation, dependency context, assignment, and ServiceNow incident creation or updates.
* Lead service mapping and dependency discovery; improve CMDB and operational data quality, dashboards, analytics, incident learning, knowledge, and improvement backlogs.

AI, automation, and knowledge enablement
  

* Build a use-case-led AI and automation roadmap, prioritizing opportunities by value, volume, risk, feasibility, and measurable service or capacity impact.
* Assess AI capabilities, vendors, and platforms; lead architecture reviews, proofs of concept, technical due diligence, and adoption recommendations.
* Design capabilities for incident triage and routing, knowledge retrieval, diagnostics, major incident support, problem detection, change-risk insight, and runbook automation.
* Connect approved incidents, problems, changes, service maps, knowledge, runbooks, and observability signals while defining production requirements for integration, data, security, privacy, auditability, human approval, confidence, fallback, and monitoring.

Governance, delivery, and influence
  

* Set governance for observability, AI, automation, and operational architecture while balancing enterprise consistency with platform needs.
* Align ServiceNow workflows, CMDB, ITSM processes, knowledge, event management, and automation with the target operating model.
* Partner with internal teams, managed service providers, and vendors to embed standards, validate solutions, improve outcomes, and reduce avoidable effort.
* Coach operations teams and subject-matter experts in architecture thinking, reliability, observability, AI solution design, and continuous improvement.
* Measure and report adoption, coverage, alert quality, detection and diagnosis time, recurrence, automation, user experience, and realized capacity or cost benefits.

Qualifications
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Substantial experience in enterprise architecture, application or platform operations, site reliability engineering, observability, IT service management, or technology transformation in a complex enterprise.
* Demonstrated ability to design end-to-end monitoring and observability across SaaS applications, integrations, data flows, and business services, including metrics, logs, traces, health indicators, event correlation, dashboards, and alert management.
* Strong knowledge of integration patterns, APIs, identity and access, data flows, cloud or SaaS architecture, resilience, security, and operational controls.
* Ability to create architecture artifacts and roadmaps, facilitate decisions, and communicate trade-offs to technical and executive audiences.
* Strong stakeholder leadership across engineering, operations, security, business teams, vendors, and managed service partners.
* Experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics 365, ServiceNow, and integration platforms such as Informatica IICS or equivalent; Grafana experience is advantageous.
* Experience with AIOps, event management, agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, operational knowledge models, knowledge graphs, SLOs, service mapping, operational readiness, or reliability engineering across multiple domains.
* Relevant architecture, cloud, ServiceNow, observability, security, or AI certifications are advantageous.

Company Overview:

UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform with unified HR, payroll, and workforce management, built to solve the unique challenges of frontline work. Powered by people-first AI and decades of labor data, UKG turns workforce intelligence into real-time decisions around staffing, pay, compliance, and productivity, enabling every worker to confidently take action as work happens. That’s why more than 80,000 organizations worldwide trust UKG to run their workforce — not just manage it. Learn more at ukg.com.

title: Technical Services & Support Analyst
description:
We’re looking for a curious, analytical, and solution-oriented Technical Services & Support Analyst to join goFLUENT’s Technical Services & Support team.
  
  
As part of the team, you will investigate technical and functional issues reported internally, identify root causes and patterns, assess impact, and coordinate with teams such as Tech, Analytics, Product, Content, and Operations to drive issues through to resolution.
  
  
You’ll be expected to go beyond simply handling tickets: test and reproduce issues, investigate data and system behavior, challenge assumptions, communicate findings clearly, and help us continuously improve products, processes, monitoring, and documentation.
  
  
**What You'll Do:**
As a Technical Services & Support Analyst, you will act as a key point of contact for incoming internal support requests. You will own investigations end-to-end, from initial analysis and reproduction through escalation, follow-up, and resolution communication.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Technical Investigation & Troubleshooting
  
  

* Investigate technical and functional support requests across goFLUENT products and services.
* Test and reproduce reported issues to validate behavior, understand the conditions in which they occur, and gather the information needed for further investigation.
* Use tools and techniques such as SQL, APIs, browser Developer Tools, HAR files, logs, and application data to investigate issues and validate findings.
* Analyze issues beyond individual cases to identify patterns, determine potential scope and impact, and distinguish isolated cases from broader incidents.
* Identify and apply available workarounds when appropriate, while ensuring permanent issues are properly escalated and followed through.
* Perform initial root cause analysis and work with the appropriate teams when deeper technical investigation or a permanent fix is required.
* Participate in monitoring activities and help identify potential issues before they result in widespread reports.

Request Ownership & Cross-Functional Coordination
  
  

* Act as the main point of contact for assigned support requests and take ownership of investigations from initial report through resolution.
* Coordinate with Tech, Analytics, Product, Content, Operations, and other teams as needed to move investigations forward.
* Provide clear, structured, and actionable information when escalating issues, including reproduction steps, evidence, impact, findings, and investigation already performed.
* Follow up proactively on open investigations and ensure requesters receive clear and timely updates.
* Communicate resolutions in a way that explains what happened, the impact, the root cause when available, what was done to resolve the issue, and any required next steps.

Documentation & Knowledge Sharing
  
  

* Create and maintain clear documentation covering troubleshooting procedures, business rules, known issues, workarounds, and operational processes.
* Translate technical findings into documentation that can be understood by both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Share knowledge with other teams and help them become autonomous in handling known issues and established workarounds.
* Develop deeper expertise over time in specific goFLUENT products or services while remaining capable of investigating requests across the broader platform.

Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Identify recurring issues, inefficiencies, and patterns through day-to-day support activities.
* Proactively suggest improvements to our products, services, monitoring, documentation, and internal processes.
* Work with relevant teams to turn support insights into actionable improvements.
* Contribute to improving investigation practices, support workflows, escalation processes, and overall service quality.

**What You'll Need:**
**Experience**

* At least 1 year of experience in a technical support, application support, production support, technical analyst, or similar troubleshooting role.
* Experience working in a support environment or collaborating with Engineering/Technology teams is a plus.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Working knowledge of SQL, with the ability to query and investigate data.
* Experience working with APIs and API testing/troubleshooting tools such as Postman or similar.
* Comfortable using browser Developer Tools to investigate web application behavior.
* Ability to capture, read, and analyze HAR files and other technical troubleshooting information.
* General understanding of web applications, HTTP requests/responses, status codes, authentication, and common browser/network issues.

Skills & Competencies
  
  

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset, with the ability to investigate beyond the initial symptoms of an issue.
* Curious and persistent: comfortable asking questions, testing assumptions, and digging deeper until an issue is understood.
* Strong sense of ownership and ability to follow investigations through to resolution.
* Ability to connect individual cases to the bigger picture and recognize patterns or potentially widespread issues.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to document findings clearly and accurately.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills, with the ability to explain technical topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Comfortable working cross-functionally and coordinating with multiple teams to resolve complex issues.
* Organized and able to manage multiple investigations and priorities simultaneously.
* Proactive mindset with an interest in improving processes rather than simply resolving individual tickets.

**Preferred / Nice To Have**

* Experience working in a SaaS, EdTech, LMS, or other web-based product environment.
* Familiarity with monitoring, logging, or visualization tools.
* Experience creating technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, or internal processes.
* Exposure to enterprise integrations, SSO, APIs, or data integrations is a plus.

**What we offer:**

* Hybrid Work Setup: Enjoy the flexibility of working both remotely and onsite, designed to support work-life balance and productivity.
* Flexible Work Hours: We value outcomes over hours—manage your time effectively while meeting project goals.
* Opportunities for Career Growth: Be part of a company that invests in your professional development through continuous learning and clear growth paths.
* Collaborative Global Environment: Work with diverse teams across 20+ countries, fostering innovation and cross-cultural learning.
* Employee Engagement and Culture: Join a supportive, inclusive workplace where teamwork, respect, and engagement are at the core of everything we do.

Be a part of a workplace that encourages growth, celebrates your uniqueness, and empowers everyone with an equal voice, but its not just a click away! We need your resume to start with!!
  
  
If you want to know more, watch our video to discover goFLUENT in the words of our own global family: https://careers.gofluent.com/

Senior Software Engineer – Java Application Support
  
  
Application Support & Managed Services | Java Technology Stack
  
  
Role Title: Senior Software Engineer – Application Support (Java / Spring Boot)
  
  
Grade / Band: Senior Software Engineer
  
  
Experience: 4–8 years, with at least 2 years supporting production Java applications
  
  
Location: [Location] – hybrid; shift coverage, weekend releases and on-call required
  
  
Reports To: Lead – Java Application Support
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to provide L2/L3 support. You will investigate production incidents down to the code level, write and test defect fixes, tune performance, and take ownership of the root cause analysis for issues in your area. Because the team owns the codebase, this role blends production support discipline with real development capability — expect to spend your time across log analysis, thread and heap dumps, SQL investigation, and the IDE.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
L2 / L3 Incident Resolution
  
  
Investigate and resolve incidents and service requests for assigned Java applications within agreed SLAs.
  
  
Perform detailed log analysis across application, integration, middleware and database layers to isolate root cause.
  
  
Analyse thread dumps, heap dumps and GC behaviour to diagnose hangs, memory leaks, slowness and crashes.
  
  
Reproduce production defects in lower environments and confirm the failure path in the source code.
  
  
Participate in major incident bridges, providing clear technical analysis and timely updates.
  
  
Escalate to the Lead or development team with complete diagnostic evidence when the fix is outside support scope.
  
  
Code-Level Fixes & Application Maintenance
  
  
Develop, unit test and raise pull requests for production defect fixes and hotfixes in Java/Spring Boot.
  
  
Implement approved configuration changes, property updates, data corrections and remediation scripts.
  
  
Deliver small enhancements and change requests routed to the support team.
  
  
Write and validate SQL data fix scripts, with rollback statements prepared before execution.
  
  
Follow the change process for every production modification — no undocumented changes.
  
  
Problem Management & Performance
  
  
Own root cause analysis for recurring and high-impact issues in your area and contribute to formal RCA documents.
  
  
Profile and tune application performance — slow endpoints, inefficient queries, connection pool sizing, caching, JVM parameters.
  
  
Maintain the known-error database and workaround library.
  
  
Identify supportability weaknesses (poor logging, missing error handling, absent retries) and raise them for remediation.
  
  
Monitoring, Automation & Release Support
  
  
Monitor application health, batch schedules, queues and integration flows; act on alerts before user impact.
  
  
Build and maintain health-check scripts, alerts and dashboards; close monitoring gaps proactively.
  
  
Automate repetitive operational tasks through scripting to reduce manual effort and human error.
  
  
Support deployments and release windows — execute steps, validate post-implementation health, and be ready to roll back.
  
  
Support UAT and regression cycles by triaging defects and coordinating fixes.
  
  
Documentation & Mentoring
  
  
Create and maintain runbooks, SOPs, troubleshooting guides and knowledge base articles.
  
  
Enable L1/SE colleagues to handle repeatable issues independently through shift-left documentation and coaching.
  
  
Mentor junior engineers on debugging technique, not just on individual fixes.
  
  
Complete structured shift handovers so no issue is lost between shifts.
  
  
Technical Skills
  
  
Java Troubleshooting & Development
  
  
Strong hands-on Java (8/11/17) — you must be able to read, debug, modify and unit test production code.
  
  
Spring Boot and Spring Framework — configuration, dependency injection, transactions, Actuator, profiles.
  
  
Hibernate/JPA and its production failure modes; ability to drop to native SQL when needed.
  
  
JVM diagnostics: jstack, jmap, jstat, jcmd, VisualVM, Eclipse MAT; reading GC logs and diagnosing OutOfMemoryError.

title: CloudOps Engineer (L3)

Frontline Infrastructure Support Engineer (L3) serves as the Senior technical support for enterprise infrastructure, providing expert-level administration, troubleshooting, architecture guidance, and technical leadership across complex IT environments. * Manage cluster architecture, capacity planning, workload optimization, upgrades, and platform lifecycle management.

* Design and administer enterprise storage and backup solutions.
* Lead disaster recovery planning, backup architecture, replication, capacity planning, and business continuity initiatives.

* Support Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud infrastructure, hybrid networking, and cloud platform administration.

* Design, administer, and optimize GPU infrastructure supporting AI, Machine Learning, and High-Performance Computing (HPC) workloads.

* Develop infrastructure automation using PowerShell, Bash, Python, Ansible, Terraform, or similar technologies.

* Mentor L1 and L2 engineers through technical guidance and knowledge sharing.

* Collaborate with architects, engineering teams, OEMs, and vendors on strategic initiatives.

BE/B-Tech or equivalent with Computer Science or Electronics & Communication
  
  
**Relevant Experience**

* 6 to 10+ years in Enterprise Infrastructure Engineering, Managed Services, Data Center Operations, Cloud Infrastructure, or Platform Engineering.
* Proven experience supporting business-critical production environments with 24×7 operations.
* Hands-on experience with enterprise monitoring tools (SolarWinds, SCOM, Zabbix, Nagios, PRTG, Prometheus, Grafana) and ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow, ManageEngine, BMC Remedy, or Jira Service Management. Expertise in virtualization (VMware, Hyper-V, Kubernetes, OpenShift), enterprise storage, backup solutions, and hybrid cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP). Strong exposure to GPU infrastructure for AI/ML and HPC workloads, Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Ansible), container platforms, CI/CD pipelines, and enterprise security technologies.

description:
Specialist, IT Infrastructure
  
  
Req ID: 138375

Band: 08
