**Summary**
We are seeking an experienced, compliance-driven RDL Jump Host Administrator to take ownership of the system administration, security, and access control of our global local jump hosts. Reporting directly to the Lead Network Architect, and working in close alignment with the RDL Network Administrator, you will manage secure access pathways into completely isolated, air-gapped lab networks across multiple HPS Design Centers (including San Jose, Richardson, Thailand, Shanghai, SongShan Lake, Penang, Chennai, and future sites).
  
  
The primary objective of this role is to ensure that remote connections terminating from corporate Zscaler ZTNA or customer CyberArk vPAM environments are securely processed, authenticated, and audited. Since our environments strictly prohibit Active Directory or domain joins, you will manage decentralized, local authentication configurations, shell environments, and session boundaries.
  
  
Crucially, you will implement and maintain the strict compliance frameworks required for Export Controlled VLANs—including interactive terms-of-use banners, mandatory user acceptance gates for shell access, and tamper-proof user-acceptance audit logging.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  

* Jump Host System Administration & Hardening
* Server Provisioning & Lifecycle: Deploy, configure, and maintain Linux-based (Rocky Linux, Ubuntu, CentOS) local jump host virtual machines operating on VMware vSphere or Microsoft Hyper-V clusters.
* Operating System Hardening: Apply strict CIS (Center for Internet Security) hardening benchmarks on all jump host operating systems. Ensure that no unauthorized software or corporate agents (e.g., CrowdStrike, ServiceNow, ClearPass, Windows Domain utilities) are installed or active on endpoints installed on the VLAN behind the Jump Host.
* Service Availability: Ensure the high availability, performance, patch status, and storage capacity of jump servers acting as gateways to the core RDL networks.
* Export Control Compliance & Interactive Gates
* Export Control Shell Banners: Configure and manage interactive, mandatory user agreement screens (e.g., using custom shell login scripts, Pluggable Authentication Modules (PAM), or SSH ForceCommand) specifically for systems accessing Export Controlled VLANs.
* User Acceptance Verification: Ensure that users cannot acquire an interactive shell, run commands, or bypass the landing screen without explicitly reading and accepting the export control and NDA terms.
* Tamper-Proof Acceptance Logging: Implement and maintain robust, structured logging systems (using Rsyslog, Journald, or custom secure local logging scripts) that capture:

+ The authenticated user's local/remote identifier.
+ Source IP and connection timestamp.
+ Explicit timestamped confirmation of the user's compliance acceptance.

* Log Archival & Integrity: Set up secure, write-only log forwarding or local hashing protocols to ensure audit logs of export-control acceptances cannot be modified or deleted by general users.
* Identity, Access, & Session Management
* Decentralized Local Authentication: Programmatically or manually provision local Unix user accounts, localized Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), and SSH keys on all jump hosts.
* Remote Integration Support: Partner with corporate IT to ensure seamless hand-offs from Zscaler ZTNA (via local Zscaler App Connectors) and CyberArk vPAM sessions terminating on the jump hosts.
* Session Controls: Configure strict SSH timeouts, idle session terminations, and multi-factor authentication loops to prevent abandoned active connections.
* Operations, Ticket Resolution & Collaboration
* Workplace Collaboration: Align daily with the RDL Network Administrator to coordinate VLAN mappings, firewall rule adjustments, and routing protocols necessary for jump host access.
* Engineering Support: Serve as a technical point of contact for HPS design engineers having credentialing, shell, or connection issues when entering secure environments.
* Incident & Audit Readiness: Assist the Lead Network Architect in pulling audit trails and access reports during compliance reviews, system security audits, or customer security evaluations.

Knowledge/Skills/Competencies
  
  
**Required Technical Skills**

* Linux Expertise (Expert Level): Mastery of Linux OS administration (Rocky Linux, RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu) including shell scripting (Bash, Python), security policies, and package management.
* Secure Access & Authentication: Comprehensive knowledge of SSH daemon configuration (sshd\_config), PAM (Pluggable Authentication Modules) stack configuration, and secure local authentication patterns.
* Audit & Log Engineering: Proven experience configuring structured logging systems, syslog routing, Rsyslog, or Journald to create secure, immutable compliance audit trails.
* Access Technologies: Familiarity with Zscaler ZTNA (App Connectors), CyberArk vPAM, and Virtual Private Network (VPN) architectures.
* Virtualization Basics: Practical experience administering virtual machines, virtual switches, and storage within VMware ESXi / vCenter or Microsoft Hyper-V.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) or Engineer (RHCE)
* CompTIA Linux+ or Linux Foundation Certified SysAdmin (LFCS)
* CompTIA Security+ or GISF (GIAC Information Security Fundamentals)
* CyberArk Certified Sentry or Trustee

Soft Skills & Working Style
  
  

* Extreme Attention to Detail: Precise, systematic approach to system configuration, security rules, and audit trail maintenance.
* High Integrity: Uncompromising commitment to maintaining security barriers, compliance standards, and ethical handling of export-controlled hardware and software.
* Excellent Communicator: Strong written and verbal communication skills, necessary for writing technical LLD/SOP documentation, explaining access gates to end-users, and coordinating with the RDL Network Architect.

Physical Demands
  
  

* Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.
* Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.

Education & Experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Network/System Administration, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or equivalent technical experience.
* 4+ years of dedicated experience in Linux System Administration, with a strong focus on secure system hardening, user management, and compliance auditing.
* Overall 14+years of work experience is required.

Notes
  
  
This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for any function are subject to change at any time.
  
  
Celestica is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on any protected status (including race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran or disability status or other characteristics protected by law).
  
  
At Celestica we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. title: Technical Support Specialist I
description:
Overview:

The L1 Technical Support Specialist provides front-line remote and telephonic technical assistance for critical security screening equipment, including baggage X-ray systems and trace detection products (e.g., ETD/BPI/RTT systems). This role focuses on basic L1 troubleshooting, customer/Field Engineer guidance, accurate part number identification using technical documentation, and efficient issue escalation to ensure maximum security checkpoint uptime.

Responsibilities:

* **Level 1 Technical Support & Basic Troubleshooting**

* Provide initial diagnostic and troubleshooting assistance over the phone and via remote access tools for baggage X-ray systems and Trace detection equipment.
* Diagnose basic hardware, software, power, and mechanical issues, Password issues including:
* + **X-Ray Systems:** Conveyor belt jams, basic software crashes, power supply issues, image display artifacts, and operator interface errors.
  + **Trace Detection Products:** Basic sample inlet/calibrator errors, clearing standard system alarms, flow rate/gas line issues, and basic sensor/detector warnings.
* Guide operators and Field Service Engineers (FSEs) through basic resolution steps, such as performing power cycles, running system self-tests, verifying cable connections, adjusting basic image settings, and clearing basic system jams.
* **Part Identification & Schematic Lookup**

* Analyze technical manuals, exploded-view diagrams, schematics, and Bill of Materials (BOM) to accurately identify correct replacement part numbers for X-ray and Trace product lines.
* Assist field personnel and customers with part identification to prevent order errors and minimize equipment downtime.
* **Escalation & Documentation**

* Log and track all incoming incidents in the ticketing system (CRM), maintaining clear records of symptoms, basic steps taken, and diagnostic results.
* Recognize when an issue exceeds L1 scope (e.g., complex generator failure, trace spectrometer calibration issues, deep network integration) and escalate promptly as per escalation matrix with complete case details.
* **Customer Service & Compliance**

* Deliver clear, concise instructions to both technical (FSEs) and non-technical (checkpoint operators, airport security) personnel under high-pressure security environments.
* Stay current on technical product updates, service bulletins, and basic regulatory requirements for checkpoint screening.

**Technical Skills:**

* **Product Familiarity:** Basic understanding of X-ray imaging components (conveyors, generators, detectors) and Trace Detection technologies (ETD).
* **Part Lookup:** Demonstrated ability to read technical diagrams, assembly drawings, and schematics to isolate correct part numbers.
* **Systems & Networking:** Solid grasp of basic computer hardware, OS navigation, remote access tools, and fundamental networking concepts (IP addressing, connectivity).

**Soft Skills:**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a strong customer-first orientation.
* Strong active listening skills to de-escalate urgent situations in critical operational environments.
* High organizational skills and ability to manage multiple open support tickets effectively.

**Working Conditions**

* This is a 5-day working role with 2 rotational offs.
* Must be comfortable working in rotational shifts to support global operations.
* Preference will be given to candidates who can align their schedules to cover key business hours in time zones like GMT and PST.

Qualifications:

* **Education:** Associate degree or vocational certification in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent technical experience.
* **Experience:** 3-4+ years of experience in technical support, helpdesk, or field service—preferably supporting security screening, medical imaging, or trace detection systems.

title: System Administrator
description:
**Job Title:**
Technical Systems Administrator (Zoho / Asterisk Telephony / Employee Monitoring)

**Location:**
On-site – Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, India

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**About the Role**

We are seeking a hands-on Technical Systems Administrator to own the day-to-day administration, configuration, and reliability of three core platforms that power our contact center, recruiting, and back-office operations: the
**Zoho ecosystem (including Zoho Learn LMS)**
, our
**Asterisk-based telephony and dialer environment**
, and our
**employee monitoring and productivity software**
.

You will be the go-to technical owner for these systems on-site in Navi Mumbai — keeping users productive, agents dialing, training on track, and data flowing accurately between platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1) Zoho Ecosystem & Zoho Learn LMS Administration**

* Administer Zoho One apps including Zoho CRM, Zoho Recruit, Zoho Creator, Zoho Desk, Zoho People, and Zoho Analytics: users, roles, profiles, permissions, and data-sharing rules.
* Configure and maintain Zoho Learn LMS: courses, learning paths, manuals, quizzes/assessments, certifications, enrollments, and completion tracking for agent onboarding and ongoing training.
* Build and maintain workflow rules, blueprints, layouts, custom fields, approval processes, and Zoho Flow automations; write and troubleshoot Deluge scripts and custom functions.
* Manage integrations between Zoho apps and third-party systems using Zoho REST APIs and webhooks; monitor sync health and resolve data issues.
* Produce training-compliance and user-adoption reports and dashboards; run data imports, cleanups, and deduplication.

**2) Telephony Dialer Administration – Asterisk**

* Install, configure, and maintain Asterisk PBX and Asterisk-based dialer platforms (e.g., VICIdial, FreePBX, GoAutoDial) on Linux servers.
* Manage SIP trunks, carriers, extensions, IVRs, inbound groups, queues, campaigns, lists, dispositions, and call routing/dial plans.
* Configure predictive, progressive, and preview dialing modes; tune dial levels, drop rates, and AMD settings to balance productivity and compliance.
* Monitor call quality (latency, jitter, packet loss); troubleshoot one-way audio, registration, NAT, and codec issues; analyze CDRs and SIP traces.
* Maintain call recording storage, DNC list management, time-zone calling windows, and caller ID configuration; perform backups, patching, and security hardening (fail2ban, firewall rules).

**3) Employee Monitoring & Productivity Software Administration**

* Deploy, configure, and administer employee monitoring and productivity platforms (e.g., Teramind, ActivTrak, Hubstaff, Time Doctor, Insightful, or similar).
* Roll out and maintain endpoint agents across Windows/macOS workstations; manage groups, policies, productive/unproductive app and website classifications, and alert rules.
* Build and distribute daily/weekly productivity, attendance, idle-time, and utilization reports for team leads and management.
* Investigate policy alerts and data anomalies; partner with HR and operations on usage policies, data-privacy settings, and audit requests.
* Integrate monitoring data with Zoho People/Analytics and payroll/attendance workflows where applicable.

**Cross-Functional**

* Serve as on-site Tier 2/Tier 3 support for these platforms; manage tickets, escalations, and vendor support cases.
* Write and maintain SOPs, runbooks, and system documentation; train end users and team leads.
* Support user onboarding/offboarding, access reviews, and data-security best practices.

**Required Qualifications**

* **Experience:**
  3–5+ years of hands-on systems administration experience in a contact center, BPO, or multi-platform business environment.
* **Zoho:**
  Proven administration experience across Zoho One applications; working knowledge of Deluge scripting, workflows, and Zoho APIs. Zoho Learn experience strongly preferred.
* **Telephony:**
  Practical experience administering Asterisk and/or Asterisk-based dialers (VICIdial, FreePBX, GoAutoDial), SIP, and VoIP troubleshooting.
* **Linux:**
  Comfort with Linux server administration (CentOS/Rocky/Ubuntu), command line, MySQL/MariaDB basics, and shell scripting.
* **Monitoring Software:**
  Experience deploying and managing at least one employee monitoring or workforce productivity platform.
* **Networking:**
  Solid understanding of TCP/IP, NAT, firewalls, VLANs, and QoS for voice traffic.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills; ability to work on-site in Navi Mumbai.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Zoho Certified Administrator/Developer, Asterisk (dCAP) or VICIdial certification, or Linux certifications (RHCSA, LPIC).
* Experience with LMS content design, SCORM, or training program administration.
* Familiarity with outbound calling compliance (TCPA, DNC, calling-hour rules) and data-privacy frameworks.
* Scripting or development experience in PHP, Python, or JavaScript for integrations and automation.
* Background supporting US-based clients or operating in a 24/7 contact center environment.

**Why Join Us**

* Own critical systems end-to-end with real impact on daily operations.
* Work across a modern stack spanning CRM, LMS, telephony, and workforce analytics.
* Growth path into senior systems, telephony engineering, or platform architecture roles.

description:
ACI Noc L2 Engineer | BFSI
  
  
Location: Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra
  
  
Shift: 24×7 rotational shifts
  
  
Priority - BFSI Domain
  
  
Role: Data Center – Cisco ACI L2 Engineer
  
  
Certification- CCNP
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a skilled DC-ACI L2 Engineer with hands-on experience in Cisco Application Centric Infrastructure (ACI), data center networking, Cisco Nexus switches, VXLAN, and IP/MPLS technologies. The candidate will be responsible for supporting, implementing, troubleshooting, and optimizing data center network infrastructure while ensuring high availability and performance.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of Cisco data center products, ACI architecture, routing and switching protocols, and ACI migration activities. The candidate must be comfortable working in customer environments and collaborating with cross-functional technical teams.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Plan, design, implement, operate, troubleshoot, and optimize Cisco networking and data center infrastructure.
* Provide L2 technical support for Cisco ACI networks, data center operations, and related networking technologies.
* Configure and troubleshoot Cisco ACI components, including Tenants, VRFs, Bridge Domains (BDs), Endpoint Groups (EPGs), Contracts, Subnets, and L2Out/L3Out.
* Support VXLAN-based data center fabrics, ACI migrations, and network modernization projects.
* Troubleshoot complex network issues involving routing, switching, virtualization, security, firewalls, load balancers, and related infrastructure.
* Support hardware and software upgrades, Proofs of Concept (POCs), and network change activities.
* Work with Cisco TAC, third-party vendors, and internal technical teams to resolve critical incidents.
* Perform root cause analysis, incident management, configuration changes, and network optimization.
* Maintain technical documentation, network diagrams, change records, and operational procedures.
* Ensure network availability, performance, and compliance with customer requirements.
* Work in a 24×7 rotational shift environment and participate in customer-facing technical coordination.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Cisco ACI & Data Center Networking – Mandatory
* Strong hands-on experience with Cisco ACI and VXLAN technologies.
* Knowledge of ACI architecture and components: Tenant, VRF, BD, EPG, Subnet, Contracts, L2Out, and L3Out.
* Experience in ACI migration, implementation, troubleshooting, and data center operations.
* Knowledge of Cisco Nexus product families, including Nexus 9000, 7000, 5000, 3000, 2000, and 1000 series.
* Understanding of vPC, VDC, MEC, orphan port management, and redundancy mechanisms.
* Routing & Switching
* Strong understanding of BGP, OSPF, Static Routing, BFD, PIM, and multicast routing.
* Knowledge of VLANs, STP, VTP, ACLs, HSRP, VRRP, and IP SLA.
* Understanding of TCP/IP, IPSec, PPP, SNMP, IGMP, and Spanning Tree Protocol.
* Strong knowledge of IP/MPLS and data center migration concepts.
* Cisco Networking Platforms
* Cisco ASR 9000 series – IOS XR.
* Cisco ASR 1000 series – IOS/IOS XE.
* Hands-on experience with Cisco Nexus platforms and data center switching technologies.
* Multi-Vendor Networking
* Working knowledge of Cisco, Huawei, and Arista networking devices.
* Exposure to Aruba wireless solutions is an added advantage.
* Additional Advantageous Skills
* Experience with L4–L7 load balancing solutions.
* Knowledge of firewalls and network security technologies.
* Experience with virtualization and cross-functional data center infrastructure troubleshooting.
* Exposure to Proof of Concepts (POCs), software/hardware upgrades, and network migration projects.

**Required Qualifications**

* Relevant degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Telecommunications, or a related field.
* Relevant Cisco networking certifications such as CCNA or CCNP are preferred.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and customer coordination skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with technical teams in a customer-facing environment.

Key Mandatory Skills
  
  
Cisco ACI | VXLAN | Cisco Nexus | IP/MPLS | ACI Migration | Data Center Operations | Routing & Switching
  
  
Candidates must have hands-on experience with Cisco ACI and VXLAN and be comfortable working in 24×7 rotational shifts.

title: System Administrator
description:
Job Description

### **About the company**

Noventiq is a global digital transformation and cybersecurity solutions and services provider headquartered in London. We help organisations modernise their IT environments and achieve business goals through cloud, cybersecurity, data, AI and software engineering, combining leading technology partners’ solutions with our own services and proprietary technologies.

We are looking for a **System Administrator** to keep our treasury management platform **GTreasury** secure, reliable and connected to business systems. Working with Treasury, Finance, IT and external partners, you will manage system configuration, user access, bank connectivity and integrations. You will also support users across regions and help deliver platform improvements and further rollouts.

Key responsibilities

* Administer **GTreasury** across cash positioning, cash forecasting, payments and bank account management, maintaining configuration, workflows, approval rules and reports.
* Manage user access, roles, permissions and single sign-on, ensuring appropriate access controls, segregation of duties and audit readiness.
* Coordinate bank and account onboarding, configure and troubleshoot connectivity through SWIFT, SFTP and APIs, and resolve statement and payment file issues.
* Maintain master data and mappings between **GTreasury**, banks and **Oracle NetSuite;** monitor integrations and resolve data exceptions.
* Monitor daily statement and payment feeds, investigate incidents and coordinate resolution with banks, GTreasury support and internal IT.
* Provide user support and training to Treasury and Finance teams across time zones.
* Test platform updates, manage configuration changes and maintain clear technical and user documentation.
* Support the rollout of GTreasury to additional entities and regions.

### **What you bring**

* **2+ years of experience** administering, supporting or implementing a treasury management system; hands-on **GTreasury experience is strongly preferred**.
* Understanding of cash management, forecasting, payments, bank account management and reconciliation.
* Working knowledge of bank connectivity and file formats, such as SWIFT, SFTP, APIs, MT940/MT942, ISO 20022 and BAI2.
* Experience managing application access, roles and SSO, ideally using SAML and Microsoft Entra ID.
* Strong data troubleshooting skills, including advanced Excel and the ability to interpret bank files and error logs.
* Fluent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly with technical teams, banks and finance users.
* A structured approach to documentation, controls and issue resolution.
* A degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

### **Additional experience that would be valuable**

* GTreasury implementation, upgrades or bank onboarding.
* ERP integrations, particularly Oracle NetSuite.
* IT controls and audit evidence preparation.
* Basic SQL, XML/XSLT or scripting for troubleshooting.
* Ticketing tools such as Jira or ServiceNow.
* Treasury qualifications such as CTP or ACT, or ITIL Foundation.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
**Technical Support Engineer**

SailPoint is the leading AI-driven security platform providing autonomous governance that best solves the needs of the modern enterprise. By harnessing the power of AI and machine learning, SailPoint automates and streamlines the complexity of delivering the right access to the right identities and technology resources at the right time. Delivered at the scale our enterprise customers demand.

We are proud of our team and the culture we have built, which has led to our employees voting us “best places to work” – 15 years in a row.

We are seeking a Technical Support Engineer to work directly with SailPoint field personnel and customers to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve complex technical problems. As a critical member of our Customer Support Team, you will deliver exceptional technical assistance and collaborate internally to improve product quality and service.

**To excel, the position requires a person:**

* Who is... an outstanding communicator who can explain complex technical concepts in a clear, concise manner to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Who can... utilize aggressive troubleshooting techniques, testing, and creative problem-solving to resolve challenging issues without letting roadblocks stop progress.
* Who will... collaborate effectively across Sales, Marketing, and  Product Engineering, Product Management, and Customer Success Management, and actively support on-call rotations to ensure customer success 24x7.
* Who demonstrates... deep empathy, responsiveness, and a meticulous attention to detail to guide and reassure customers during high-pressure technical situations.

**Responsibilities:**

* Resolve complex technical problems reported by SailPoint customers and field personnel via multiple channels (telephone, email, Microsoft Teams) to maintain high customer satisfaction.
* Escalate highly complex issues to the Engineering team in a timely, structured manner, ensuring that comprehensive details and diagnostic data are captured.
* Document problem solutions and case details meticulously throughout the support lifecycle, publishing solutions in the internal and customer-facing knowledge bases to drive self-service and team efficiency.
* Collaborate with Product Engineering, Product Management, and Customer Success Management to provide actionable feedback that improves overall product service, design, and software quality.
* Participate in recurring support review meetings and share knowledge, presenting challenging cases and innovative troubleshooting ideas to continuously upskill the support team.
* Manage and provide 24x7 on-call support via a rotational schedule to ensure continuous coverage for critical incidents.

**The Path to Success (Milestones):**

**1-Month Milestones (The "Learning" Phase):**

* Absorb critical training on SailPoint's core products, architectures (including AWS cloud-native and event-driven microservices), and internal support systems.
* Begin handling P3/P4 cases with supervised mentoring and a set limit.
* Shadow senior support engineers on customer calls, case documentation, and initial troubleshooting sessions.

**2-Month Milestones (The "Connecting" Phase):**

* Gradually raise the number of cases and queues, and enable handling for high-priority cases.
* Independently perform routine troubleshooting activities and manage standard customer support cases.
* Prepare initial drafts of knowledge base articles for recently resolved common technical issues.

**3-Month Milestones (The "Contribution" Phase):**

* No capping on cases and queue dispatch.
* Become fully ramped on core troubleshooting tools and support ticket management processes.
* P1 ( Production down scenarios) enablement. Shadowing and assisting colleagues in their P1 cases.
* Successfully present a challenging case or a new troubleshooting methodology in the weekly support review meeting.

**4-6 Month Milestones (The "Performance" Phase):**

* Achieve or exceed support key performance indicators (KPIs), such as target case resolution time and customer satisfaction score (CSAT).
* Refine existing troubleshooting documentation and create Knowledge base articles.
* Participate independently in the 24x7 on-call rotation schedule, managing critical escalations with minimal supervision.
* Achieve internal SailPoint support certifications or relevant initial product badges.

**Education & Qualifications:**

**Must Haves:**

* 5+ years of professional software support experience, preferably in enterprise security software product companies.
* Proven track record of advanced, aggressive troubleshooting techniques and using various investigative resources.
* Experiance in SAP GRC
* Experience in Supporting Cloud-Based / microservice architecture-based products.
* REST API, Browser-based troubleshooting, OpenSearch/ Splunk, JSON awareness.
* Experience with Database Administration (Oracle, Sybase, MSSQL, DB2, MySQL).
* Strong familiarity operating across both Windows, Unix (Linux, Sun, HP, AIX) , Flatcar O.S and Dockerized container platforms.
* Experience writing or troubleshooting XML and JavaScript.
* Hands-on experience with J2EE / Java EE 5 Application Servers (such as Tomcat, JBoss, WebSphere, or WebLogic).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proven empathy and interpersonal skills for handling stressful customer situations.

**Nice to Haves / Preferred:**

* Preferred: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Science, or equivalent experience.
* Some software development experience with an object-oriented language.
* Experience troubleshooting Java applications in an enterprise environment.
* Experience with Log4j or other logging system configurations.

**Browser compatibility testing experience**
.

* Version control systems experience (such as Subversion/SVN).
* Generating and reading HAR files.
* Knowledge of Java, Ant, XHTML, JSF, SPML/SOAP, and software build technologies.
* Familiarity with identity management provisioning systems (e.g., Sun, Oracle, IBM, Novell).
* Understanding of networking and application server clusters.

title: Technical Product Support Engineer
description:
Technical Product Support Engineer

Location: Pune, India, office-based (this is not a remote position)

Employment: Full time

This role is based in our Pune office, so you must live in or near Pune. You will be employed through our partner entity in India.

The opportunity

RoboShadow is a fast-growing UK-based global cybersecurity startup, and we are looking for an enthusiastic person to join our team in our Pune office.

Whether you are looking to start your career in technology or are already seasoned, we are not looking for the right experience, but the right person.

You will work with an enterprise-grade startup team and have access to a wealth of learning resources, think of it as your own Aladdin's cave of training materials, tools and mentors, to become a cybersecurity and app technical support guru. This is initially an app support role, but people usually move on to development, testing or engineering roles afterwards.

Our company is at an exciting crossroads: we are on the verge of being cash-flow positive and have already turned down multiple acquisition offers. You will have a chance to be part of something special and help us scale to the next level.

What you will own

• User support: help users resolve functional issues and make the most of our platform.

• Technical troubleshooting: identify and troubleshoot technical issues, get involved from a development perspective to remediate them, and escalate to the development team when required.

• User demos: demonstrate the platform and product features so users can use the product effectively.

• Working with Customer Experience: gather and act on feedback, and escalate bugs and feature requests to the right team.

• User account admin: add licences, update organisations and carry out other account administration.

How we will measure success

We will look at:

• How well and how quickly you help users resolve their issues.

• How clearly you communicate with users and with the wider team.

• The quality of the bugs, feedback and feature requests you escalate.

• How quickly you learn the product and grow your technical skills.

Who we are looking for

Above all, we need an excellent communicator. This role is for you if you:

• Love technology and want to build a career on it.

• Love helping users and get satisfaction from it.

• Have a background in coding and development (base skills) that you are keen to build on.

• Have your own tech projects you can demonstrate (a hobby is fine).

• Are a fast learner who can teach yourself new technology using Google, ChatGPT or YouTube, and enjoy doing so.

• Are keen to grow your skills in cloud architecture, development, AI tools and DevOps.

• Are excited by a startup where your contributions will be visible, impactful and meaningful.

• Are able to commute to our Pune office every day.

Why join RoboShadow?

This is the perfect opportunity for someone looking to make a mark in the tech world. You will be a key player in our success story, and in return we will give you the training, support and opportunities to thrive in cybersecurity.

Experience

You do not need years of experience. Base coding skills, a genuine passion for technology and strong communication matter more than your job history.

How to apply

Please apply by email to liz@roboshadow.com, not through LinkedIn. Send us:

• Your CV.

• A link to a short Loom video (around 1 to 3 minutes) telling us why you would be a great fit for this role.

The Loom video is your first stage interview, so applications without one will not be considered. It does not need to be formal.

description:
IT and Operations Lead
  
  

* This role is ideal for someone who enjoys being deeply hands-on, solving problems directly, and building scalable IT practices from the ground up without heavy layers of management.
* Sahaj is a growing global software engineering consultancy — and this role sits right at the heart of that growth. You will be joining at a point where IT infrastructure, security, and operations need to scale alongside the business.
* That means building processes and systems that work today and hold up as the organisation expands — across headcount, offices, and complexity. If you have done this before in a similar environment, you will know exactly what this role demands.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own IT strategy and operations across global offices, while remaining hands-on in execution to ensure scalable, secure, and reliable systems.
* Actively manage and support infrastructure across Mac environments, SaaS platforms, and cloud services (AWS, GCP).
* Own and directly manage cloud governance practices, including billing oversight, cost management, resource tagging standards, and execution of platform upgrades.
* Hands-on ownership of endpoint and device security, including implementation and day-to-day management of tools such as Jamf, Sophos Endpoint, and similar platforms.
* Drive and execute processes around licensing, asset management, hardware provisioning, onboarding, and exit management — building for scale, not just the current headcount.
* Establish and implement standards for networking, hardware setup, and workplace IT practices across all locations.
* Provide practical, tool-driven security oversight for systems, data, and global collaboration.
* Partner with leadership to support business growth while actively resolving IT issues and maintaining operational reliability.
* Travel domestically as needed to align and implement IT practices across locations.
* Manage vendors and partners for asset purchase, leasing, sourcing, and decommissioning.

Good to Have
  
  

* Experience contributing to IT and security programmes in growing organisations.

Ideal Candidate
  
  

* ~8 years of experience in IT infrastructure, cloud platforms, and security, with exposure to distributed teams.
* Demonstrable experience working within a scaling organisation — you have built or significantly evolved IT infrastructure, processes, and security practices as a business has grown, and you understand the difference between what works at 50 people and what needs to change at 200.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Mac-based environments, SaaS tools, and enterprise cloud platforms (AWS/GCP).
* Proven hands-on experience with endpoint management and security tools such as Jamf, Sophos Endpoint, or equivalent.
* Demonstrated ability to build and execute IT processes, policies, and governance structures that scale — not just document them, but own them end to end.
* Strong working knowledge of cloud governance, including billing management, cost control, resource tagging, and upgrade execution.
* Comfortable operating as a hands-on individual contributor in a flat structure, with full ownership of IT operations and no existing team to inherit.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to work closely with leadership and teams across geographies.
* Based in Bangalore or Pune; fully on-site.

Sahaj Culture
  
  

* A culture defined by trust, radical transparency, and profound respect.
* The exhilarating opportunity to collaborate and learn from some of the finest minds in the technology industry.
* The freedom to work across multiple domains and redefine what's possible.

Benefits at Sahaj
  
  

* Unlimited leaves, trusting you to manage your balance.
* Life Insurance & Private Health insurance fully covered by Sahaj.
* RSUs, stake in our shared success.
* An authentically flat organizational structure (No hierarchy).
* Complete Open Salaries transparency.

title: LMS Administrator
description:
**LMS Administrator – Multiple Positions**

**About SureSkills**

SureSkills is a global edtech services company and market leader in technical education. We design and deliver engaging, high-impact learning experiences for some of the world’s most innovative technology companies — including Google, AWS, Microsoft, VMware, Meta, and Coursera. Our programmes combine expert-led instruction with hands-on labs, helping learners move from foundational knowledge to real-world mastery.

**The Role**

We’re looking for a number of experienced
**LMS Administrators**
to join our growing team in Pune, supporting the delivery and ongoing management of enterprise learning platforms and programmes.

These are hands-on operational roles where you'll be responsible for the day-to-day administration, maintenance and support of Learning Management Systems (LMS), ensuring courses, user accounts, permissions, reporting and learning activities run smoothly.

You'll work closely with learning teams, programme managers, technical colleagues and other stakeholders to troubleshoot issues, maintain accurate learning records and support a positive experience for learners and administrators.

**Experience with Intellum LMS is highly desirable**
, although we also welcome candidates with strong administration experience across other enterprise learning platforms.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Manage day-to-day LMS administration, maintenance and operational support.
* Create, configure and maintain courses, learning paths, catalogues and enrolments.
* Manage user accounts, roles, permissions and access requests.
* Investigate and resolve LMS issues relating to user access, course functionality, enrolments and learning completions.
* Handle support tickets and administrative requests, escalating more complex technical issues when required.
* Generate and maintain reports covering learner activity, course completions, training progress and compliance requirements.
* Support bulk user uploads, data imports, exports and regular data maintenance.
* Monitor data accuracy and help maintain the overall integrity of the LMS.
* Assist with testing platform updates, new functionality, configuration changes and system releases.
* Work with internal technical teams and external vendors to investigate and resolve platform issues.
* Support mandatory learning and compliance-related training requirements.
* Maintain clear documentation of LMS processes, configurations and troubleshooting procedures.
* Identify opportunities to improve administrative workflows, reporting and the learner experience.
* Collaborate with global teams to support learning programmes and operational requirements.

**What We’re Looking For**

* **3+ years of hands-on LMS administration experience**
  , ideally within a large organisation or enterprise environment.
* **Experience with Intellum LMS is highly desirable.**
* Strong practical experience managing courses, catalogues, enrolments, user accounts, roles and permissions.
* Good understanding of LMS reporting, learner records, completion tracking and data management.
* Experience investigating and troubleshooting common LMS issues.
* Comfortable managing support tickets, administrative requests and operational escalations.
* Experience working with Google Sheets, CSV files, bulk uploads and reporting tools.
* Understanding of compliance training, mandatory learning requirements and data accuracy.
* Experience supporting LMS configuration changes, testing or platform updates.
* Strong attention to detail, organisational skills and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple requests and priorities in a busy operational environment.
* Good communication skills and confidence working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Comfortable working independently while collaborating with colleagues across different teams and locations.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with other enterprise LMS platforms such as Cornerstone OnDemand, SAP SuccessFactors Learning, Docebo or similar.
* Familiarity with SCORM, eLearning content standards and course packaging.
* Basic understanding of SSO, APIs, integrations or automated data feeds.
* Experience creating LMS reports or dashboards for learning and compliance teams.
* Exposure to learning technology within a global technology company or large enterprise.
* Experience supporting large-scale learning programmes with significant learner volumes.

**Why Join Us?**

You'll have the opportunity to work with a global learning and technology services organisation, supporting enterprise learning programmes and collaborating with colleagues across different regions.

We're hiring for multiple positions, offering an opportunity to develop your LMS expertise, gain exposure to large-scale learning operations and build your experience working with enterprise learning technologies.

title: Safety System Administrator (Required Argus Safety Systems, system configuration and safety data migration experience)
description:
**Company Description**
Medicine moves forward here. So will you.
  
  
At PrimeVigilance, patient safety is not one part of the job. It is why we exist.
  
  
We are a global pharmacovigilance specialist. Our teams help clients navigate complex regulations while keeping patient safety at the center of every decision, from early development through to post-marketing surveillance. Increasingly, the value we create is not only in processing safety data but in interpreting it: spotting the signal that matters early and turning it into insight our clients can act on.
  
  
That work takes curious minds, problem-solvers and experts who care about getting it right. It also takes a culture worth staying for. Across Europe, North America, South America, Asia and Australia, we work in an environment built on kindness, flexibility, growth and belonging, where colleagues support one another and good ideas are heard wherever they come from.
  
  
If you want a role with real purpose, global reach and the chance to keep growing while you help protect patients, you will feel at home here. We would love to hear from you.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Position Summary**
This role requires working as part of the Safety & MI System Administrator Team performing database administration activities; supporting creation and upgrade of database instances; change control and data migration activities; first line user support and troubleshooting; and training users on databases.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities**
The Safety System Administrator is primarily responsible for:
  
  

* Maintenance of database libraries
* Involvement in system validation activities
* Interrogating the database and generating outputs for internal and client use
* Training and providing database access to internal and client users

**Principle Functions For the Client (may include but is not limited to the following)**

* Set up and maintenance of project specific database libraries including:
* Products
* Licenses
* Studies
* Reporting destinations
* Documenting and validating any change to the project specific database
* Support during legacy data transfer e.g., validation
* Supporting/providing guidance to the Project Manager / Client / Project Start Up Team during the development of project specific data handling guidelines (to ensure project specific guidelines are necessary and will not impact line listings and report generation)
* Prepare line listings and tabulations and other database outputs for use in aggregate reports, signal detection, reconciliation and other activities as required
* Provide case processing metrics required for invoicing (e.g., number of submissions, number of spontaneous vs initial cases processed)
* Provide database training to clients
* Providing and documenting client / internal team access upon receipt of an approved access request.

**For the Company (may include but is not limited to the following)**

* Coordinate user access (including maintenance and revoking access)
* Maintain database procedures including core data handling conventions
* Provide database training and certification to PrimeVigilance users
* Provide user support
* Involvement in root cause investigation of database related deviations and ensure timely and complete documentation of resulting actions in line with Quality procedures
* Provide case processing quality and compliance metrics to the Quality Team
* Identify areas for improvement and address via training, clarifying changes to data handling guidelines, user guides etc.
* Execute business continuity periodic testing for database failure
* Ensure that existing software bugs, user requests, changes to regulatory requirements etc., are considered and appropriate changes are made and validated as required
* Support IT, database vendor and technical colleagues in troubleshooting and implementing software fixes and enhancements as required

**Other Supportive Responsibilities**
Assist PrimeVigilance senior management on an as needed basis. Potentially provide chargeable consulting / training activities to clients regarding Argus, and if required LSSMV.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Educated to degree standard
  
  
Demonstrated work experience within Argus Safety Systems.
  
  
**Additional Information**
When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.
  
  
We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.
  
  

* Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
* Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.
* Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.
* Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.
* Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.
* Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

title: System Support Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Position Overview
  
  
We are looking for a motivated and technically enthusiastic System Support Engineer to support internal IT operations and assist with ANSYS software installation and customer support activities. This role is ideal for fresh graduates or early-career professionals with strong Linux fundamentals, troubleshooting ability, and an interest in enterprise IT and engineering simulation environments.
  
  
The candidate will work closely with internal IT, technical, and customer support teams to maintain systems, resolve technical issues, and support software deployment activities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Internal IT Support
  
  

* Provide day-to-day IT support for desktops, laptops, servers, and internal users
* Install, configure, and troubleshoot Windows and Linux systems
* Support networking, VPN, remote access, printers, and storage systems
* Monitor system health, backups, antivirus, and patch updates
* Assist in managing IT assets, user accounts, and access permissions
* Maintain technical documentation and support records

ANSYS Installation & Technical Support
  
  

* Assist in installation and configuration of ANSYS software and license servers
* Support customer deployments remotely or onsite under senior guidance
* Troubleshoot installation, licensing, environment, and performance issues
* Perform system readiness and compatibility checks before deployment
* Support Linux-based simulation and HPC environments
* Coordinate with technical teams during software upgrades and customer support activities

**Requirements**

* Required Skills & Qualifications
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Mechanical, or related field
* 0–2 years of experience (Freshers can apply)
* Strong understanding of Linux operating systems and command-line tools
* Good debugging and troubleshooting skills
* Basic knowledge of:
* Networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN)
* Windows administration
* Hardware and system configuration
* Remote desktop and support tools
* Ability to analyze technical issues logically and provide resolutions
* Good communication and learning attitude

**Preferred Skills**

* Exposure to Linux shell scripting or Python
* Understanding of HPC, clusters, or engineering simulation environments
* Knowledge of virtualization platforms or GPU systems
* Familiarity with ANSYS software is an added advantage

title: Systems Support Engineer
description:
We are seeking an enthusiastic Associate System Engineer from within our team to join our operations and client services function. This is a great opportunity to grow your technical foundation, work closely with clients, and contribute to a high-performing 24×7 support team.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Support a 24×7 operational environment across rotational shifts, ensuring consistent service delivery.
* Handle Level 1 analysis, troubleshooting, and resolution of application and infrastructure incidents.
* Conduct recording reviews to assess user experience and gauge service impact.
* Collect application logs and escalate cases to the Development team with clear context.
* Deliver a premium client experience — tracking open issues, coordinating responses, and helping clients resolve problems efficiently.
* Contribute to weekly/monthly client read-outs and progress presentations.
* Identify and help drive issue/bug remediation to resolution across the client base.
* Maintain an up-to-date log of known issues and fixes, supporting consistent resolution outcomes.
* Author and maintain technical and operational procedure documentation.
* Participate in daily/weekly technical and leadership calls, keeping stakeholders informed on progress.
* Build positive, professional relationships with customers and teammates.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 3-4 years of experience in proactive support and infrastructure/application monitoring.
* Familiarity with Global Command Center, Service Desk, or Frontline Monitoring operations.
* Commitment to following team, account, and client policies and procedures.
* Exposure to Application/Infrastructure Monitoring tools and solutions.
* Experience with Windows Server environments, .NET-based application support, IIS, worker processes, Web.config, and Event Logs.
* Basic understanding of networking and Azure Monitoring.
* Intermediate SQL skills — including SQL Jobs, queries, blocking scenarios, and Always On configuration.
* Experience with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow or equivalent Service Desk tools.
* Basic knowledge of ITIL framework (V3.0 Foundation certification is an advantage).
* Ability to present data clearly using Power BI, Excel pivot tables, and charts.
* Good command of written and verbal English; international support experience (US or Europe preferred).

**Nice to Have**

* Exposure to healthcare-related applications or patient care environments.
* Familiarity with Azure cloud environments.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Relevant IT certification(s) are a plus.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills — written and verbal — with a customer-first approach.

title: ADM Support Analyst
description:
**Who We Are**
Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
  
  
**The Role**
The ADM Support team handles all client inquiries related to Addepar's Alternatives Data Management (ADM) solution post-implementation. ADM Support Analysts play a critical role in supporting some of the world's most sophisticated investors, answering questions and resolving issues related to their alternative investment data on the Addepar platform. They ensure clients get the most value out of each interaction by providing accurate, timely guidance across the full scope of ADM functionality.
  
  
Our ideal candidate is tenacious about tackling problems, can skillfully coordinate with internal teams, and enjoys working directly with clients in the alternative investments space.
  
  
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Identify, respond to, and resolve issues and questions raised by ADM clients, providing timely and accurate support.
* Work in complex alternative investment data sets to identify and resolve data and calculation discrepancies.
* Evaluate the criticality of client issues and collaborate with other internal ADM teams (Collections, Operations) to drive resolution.
* Conduct root-cause analysis in partnership with Engineering and Data teams to resolve issues.
* Help clients leverage the ADM platform to the greatest extent possible through both functional and conceptual instruction.
* Prioritise and context-switch effectively to execute on simultaneous cases, seeing each through to the finish line.
* Contribute to improving team processes and documentation as we scale and deliver on ADM.
* Develop deep expertise in Addepar's ADM solution and the broader alternative investments landscape.

**Who You Are**

* Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, or equivalent experience.
* 1+ years of relevant experience in a client-facing role, ideally within financial services or investment management.
* Strong communication, organisational, and time-management skills.
* Proficiency in maths and comfort working in complex data sets.
* Passion for problem-solving and continuous learning.
* Passion for technology and finance.
* [Plus] Previous experience in investment management, particularly alternative investments.
* [Plus] Familiarity with alternative investment data and its operational nuances.
* [Plus] Experience using or supporting the Addepar platform.

**Our Values**

* Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

title: SAP Print and output administrator
description:
Dematic/KION is looking for an experienced SAP Output Management Administrator as part of the Global Service SAP Authorization, Job Control & Output Management Team to support and maintain the enterprise-wide print and output infrastructure in KION Group IT.
  
  
**We Offer**
Dematic/KION is looking for an experienced SAP Output Management Administrator as part of the Global Service SAP Authorization, Job Control & Output Management Team to support and maintain the enterprise-wide print and output infrastructure in KION Group IT. The role will focus on managing output systems integrated with SAP, including LRS VPSX, CUPS (Common UNIX Printing System), and Plossys. You will ensure reliable and efficient document and print delivery across the business, supporting both operational and project-based requirements.
  
  
**Tasks And Qualifications**
To be successful in this demanding role, your proven track record will enable you to deliver against the following key performance areas:
  
  

* Administration and Support of SAP Output Management tools such as LRS VPSX, Plossys, and CUPS.
* Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot output devices (SAP devices) across SAP landscapes (ECC, S/4HANA, BW, etc.).
* Monitor and resolve print failures, spool issues, and document output errors.
* Collaborate with SAP Basis, Infrastructure, and Functional teams to ensure seamless document delivery (invoices, delivery notes, reports, etc.).
* Implement and maintain output rules and distribution logic in SAP SPAD.
* Manage and upgrade print servers and middleware components (LRS VPSX, Plossys) and SAPSPrint.

title: Senior Integration Health Engineer
description:
**Our Mission**
You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.
  
  
We’re here to give power to the patient.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.
  
  
Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from
*seeking*
to
*getting*
. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.
  
  
Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a detail-oriented Senior Integration Health Engineer to ensure the stability, performance, and reliability of our system integrations. This role focuses on monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimizing integrations between various applications, platforms, and third-party services. The ideal candidate will proactively identify potential issues, resolve system errors, and work closely with development and operations teams to maintain seamless data flow and system connectivity. They will build and maintain secure Claude Code and Glean tooling that improves integration triage, troubleshooting, documentation, and QA while applying evidence-based verification, human review, and measurable quality controls. In addition to technical responsibilities, this role also includes leadership in process improvement, training, and communication across teams and stakeholders.
  
  
A Day in Your Life
  
  

* Monitor Integration Performance – Continuously oversee system integrations to detect anomalies, latency, or failures.
* Develop AI-Assisted Tooling – Build, maintain, and continuously improve secure internal tooling and AI-assisted workflows using approved tools such as Claude Code and Glean.
* Troubleshoot & Resolve Issues – Diagnose and resolve integration errors, API failures, and data flow disruptions in real-time.
* Maintain System Health – Ensure integrations remain functional, efficient, and up to date with minimal downtime.
* Log Analysis & Reporting – Review logs and alerts to identify root causes of failures and document resolutions.
* Optimize Existing Integrations – Identify inefficiencies in data processing and recommend improvements to enhance performance.
* Coordinate with Engineering Teams – Work closely with developers, DevOps, and IT teams to implement fixes and improvements.
* Ensure Compliance & Security – Adhere to industry standards and best practices, including data protection policies and system security.
* Document Processes & Solutions – Maintain thorough documentation of troubleshooting procedures, integration updates, and system workflows.
* Team Leadership & Communication:

+ Owns Training Initiatives – Develops and leads training sessions to elevate team knowledge and performance.
+ Acts as a Point of Escalation – Handles complex technical issues, providing expert guidance and resolution support.
+ Performs QA Activities – Reviews ticket management, client and cross-department interactions, and technical troubleshooting, providing both real-time and written feedback.
+ Leads Daily Standups – Facilitates team check-ins to align on progress, blockers, and priorities.
+ Contributes to Weekly Project Planning – Participates in roadmap discussions, ensuring integration priorities are accounted for.
+ Drives Cross-Team Communication – Ensures effective communication with internal and external stakeholders, and proactively “closes the loop” on outstanding issues or updates.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
* 4-7 years of experience with API monitoring, system health checks, integration, and network troubleshooting.
* Proficiency in SQL, Python, PowerShell, or Bash for log analysis and automation.
* Experience with monitoring tools such as Splunk, Datadog, or Prometheus.
* Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to issue resolution.
* Excellent communication and teamwork skills to collaborate with developers and stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize issues effectively.
* Ability to combine technical depth with judgment, confidence, and EQ.
* Strategic thinking, understanding priorities and dependencies, ability to contribute to broader team planning.
* Experience working in integration support or system operations. (Preferred)
* Experience with QA and mentorship. (Preferred)
* Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) (Preferred)
* Knowledge of incident management best practices. (Preferred)

**Benefits**
An incredible team of smart and supportive people
  
  
A competitive compensation package, including attractive medical insurance
  
  
Amazing perks – think catered lunch every day, Ping Pong, etc.
  
  
Daycare/creche facility for kids
  
  
The chance to create a better healthcare experience for millions of patients!
  
  
Corporate wellness programs with Headspace

Competitive parental leave

title: Fulfillment Analyst
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
  
  
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
  
  
**Skills And Competencies**

* 2-4 years of experience in fulfillment operations, technical support, data operations, customer support, or similar analytical and problem-solving roles
* Working knowledge of CRM platforms, preferably Salesforce, and experience navigating entitlement, provisioning, or internal operational systems
* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to analyze data relationships, troubleshoot access issues, and identify root causes across multiple platforms
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data validation, reconciliation, reporting, and management of structured templates
* Ability to exercise sound judgment, manage competing priorities, and resolve complex issues independently with minimal supervision
* Excellent communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills, with strong attention to detail and accountability

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Technology, Operations Management, or a related field
* Relevant Salesforce, CRM, data management, or process improvement certifications are advantageous but not required

**Responsibilities**

* Independently manage user access and entitlement requests across Salesforce and internal fulfillment platforms, ensuring timely, accurate, and secure provisioning
* Configure trial and production access by interpreting contract terms, entitlement rules, and internal policies while applying sound judgment in non-standard scenarios
* Serve as a key point of contact for access-related inquiries, collaborating with Sales, Customer Success, Client Services, and other stakeholders to drive effective resolutions
* Investigate and troubleshoot access, entitlement, and provisioning issues by analyzing system logs, validating data flows, identifying root causes, and coordinating escalations when necessary
* Execute data quality, reconciliation, and audit-readiness activities to maintain accurate records and ensure reliable downstream fulfillment processes
* Create, maintain, and continuously improve process documentation, operational guidelines, and training resources to enhance efficiency and consistency
* Identify workflow inefficiencies, process gaps, and control risks, partnering with business and technology teams to implement scalable improvements, including AI-enabled solutions where appropriate
* Apply a risk-based approach to access management, ensuring provisioning decisions align with contractual obligations, compliance requirements, and audit standards
* Support system enhancements and releases by performing testing, validating entitlement logic, documenting defects, and contributing to successful production deploymentsContribute to a culture of operational excellence by recommending improvements that enhance client experience, data integrity, and fulfillment effectiveness

**About The Team**
The Fulfillment team plays a critical role in delivering a seamless client experience by ensuring accurate, secure, and consistent access to Moody's products and platforms. Working closely with Sales, Customer Success, Client Services, and Technology teams, the group manages user entitlements, resolves access-related issues, maintains data integrity, and supports both trial and production requests.
  
  
Team members leverage Salesforce and proprietary fulfillment platforms to deliver high-quality service while ensuring compliance, audit readiness, and operational consistency. The team is committed to continuous improvement and actively explores innovative technologies, including AI-driven solutions, to enhance workflows, strengthen controls, and improve the overall client experience.
  
  
Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

title: Senior Hotel Partner Solutions Specialist

Position reports to-Associate Director – Sales Operations / Global Sales Operations
  
  
**Job Purpose**
To provide hands-on ownership of Acuity’s enterprise Salesforce ecosystem across user support, platform administration, data management, integration, enhancements and user enablement. The role will translate business needs into secure, scalable CRM solutions; strengthen data quality; support responsible AI adoption; and turn Salesforce data into actionable commercial insight.
  
  
Another important angle will be to improve forecasting accuracy by developing repeatable, data-led approaches that use opening pipeline position, conversion, win rates, sales cycle dynamics and deal level signals to better anticipate quarterly and year-end sales outcomes.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  

* Business-facing support and ownership: Act as the primary contact for Salesforce incidents, service requests, enhancements and user queries; manage intake, prioritization, communication, resolution and escalation; provide training, release updates and clear documentation.
* Salesforce administration : Manage users, licenses, profiles, permission sets, roles, sharing settings and access reviews; configure Flows, approvals, validation and assignment rules, record types, page layouts, Dynamic Forms and Lightning pages; maintain reports, dashboards, queues and notifications.
* Platform development and continuous improvement : Apply configuration-first thinking while using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL and APIs where appropriate; troubleshoot defects, address root causes, reduce technical debt and coordinate environments, deployments and post-release validation.
* Integrations and data management : Support Salesforce integrations with ERP, billing, CPQ, e-signature, marketing and other enterprise platforms; oversee APIs, authentication, middleware, monitoring and error handling; lead migration, cleansing, deduplication, reconciliation, backup and validation activities.
* AI, analytics and forecasting : Build operational and executive dashboards covering pipeline, conversion, sales, forecasting, revenue, customers, adoption and service performance; establish repeatable predictive methods to forecast quarterly and year-end landing positions using opening pipeline, stage conversion, win rates, sales-cycle velocity, slippage and deal-level risk; identify and deliver high-value use cases using Agent force, Einstein and related capabilities.
* Governance, risk and documentation : Maintain effective release, change, backup, testing and deployment controls; support audits and ITGC requirements; maintain solution designs, SOPs, configuration inventories, deployment records and user guidance; coordinate vendors while retaining clear internal accountability.
* Stakeholder partnership : Work closely with Sales, Finance, Marketing, Billing, Delivery, IT and external partners to support connected Lead-to-Order and Order-to-Cash processes, including merger and acquisition initiatives.

Key competencies
  
  

* Customer and support orientation : Approachable and accountable front line for Salesforce users.
* Technical depth: Strong knowledge of Sales Cloud, Flow, Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, APIs, testing and deployment, balancing configuration-first thinking with development and integration capability.
* Commercial forecasting and analytical judgement : Converts CRM data into reliable forecasts, early-warning indicators and practical actions for Sales Leadership; challenges assumptions and explains variance clearly.
* AI and automation mindset : Identifies AI and automation opportunities that simplify day to day business processes
* Ownership and delivery : Takes responsibility from problem definition through design, delivery, validation, adoption and support.
* Communication and stakeholder management : Make complex principles easy to understand and explain technical and analytical topics clearly to users, technical teams and senior leadership.
* Continuous improvement : Identifies opportunities for automation, simplification, innovation and improved user experience.
* Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in computer science preferred but Information Systems, Engineering, Analytics or a related discipline considered too, Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification required, with Sales Cloud Consultant, Platform Developer, Omni studio, CPQ, platform data architect or Agent force certification advantageous.
