title: On-Premises Deployment Engineer
description:
**About the role**

We are looking for an On-Premises Implementation Engineer with hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience. You will install, configure, upgrade and hand over our product on customer-owned servers, including restricted and air-gapped environments, within agreed timelines. This is a customer-facing engineering role. You will assess client infrastructure readiness, deploy the product using Docker and Docker Compose, integrate it with the client’s network, security and identity controls, and support the environment after go-live until it is stable and formally handed over.

**What you will do**

* Review customer infrastructure against product prerequisites: server sizing, OS version, storage, ports, DNS, certificates and firewall rules
* Prepare checklists, deployment plans and implementation schedules for customer IT teams
* Validate server readiness before deployment, including patch level, disk layout, time sync and proxy connectivity
* Install, configure and harden Linux servers (RHEL, Rocky Linux, Ubuntu, Oracle Linux)
* Manage users, sudo access, SSH keys, permissions, systemd services, cron jobs and log rotation
* Configure LVM, filesystems, NFS shares and storage for application data and backups
* Configure networking, firewalld/iptables and SELinux/AppArmor in line with customer security standards
* Install Docker Engine and Docker Compose on customer servers, including offline installation
* Deploy, configure and upgrade the product stack using Compose files, environment files and scripts
* Set up local image registries and move images into air-gapped environments using docker save/load or registry mirroring
* Configure Docker networking, volumes, restart policies, resource limits and log drivers
* Troubleshoot container start-up failures, image pull issues, port conflicts, storage and permission errors and inter-service connectivity
* Configure reverse proxies and load balancers (Nginx, HAProxy, Apache) and install SSL/TLS certificates from customer CAs
* Integrate the product with customer databases, SMTP, LDAP/Active Directory and SSO providers such as Keycloak
* Set up and verify PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB and Redis when hosted alongside the product
* Plan and run upgrades and patch releases with documented rollback steps and minimal downtime
* Configure backup and restore for application data, databases and Docker volumes, and test restores periodically
* Provide L2 support for deployed environments, including root cause analysis and resolution within SLAs
* Escalate and close product defects with internal development and product teams
* Write installation guides, as-built documents, runbooks and handover notes for each customer
* Run handover and knowledge-transfer sessions for customer IT and operations teams
* Keep an accurate record of each customer’s deployed version, configuration and change history

**What you bring**

* 2 to 3 years of hands-on experience in Linux administration and Docker-based deployment, ideally in product implementation or customer-facing roles
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT or equivalent practical experience
* Linux (must have): strong command line skills on RHEL, Rocky or Ubuntu, including dnf/yum, apt, systemd, permissions, LVM, networking, firewalld/iptables, SELinux and log analysis
* Docker (must have): Docker Engine and Compose in production, image management, volumes, networks, private registries, offline image transfer and container troubleshooting
* Web and proxy services: Nginx, HAProxy or Apache, plus SSL/TLS installation and troubleshooting
* Scripting: Bash for installation and operational automation. Python is an advantage
* Networking: TCP/IP, DNS, ports, firewalls, proxies and basic troubleshooting (curl, telnet/nc, tcpdump, ss/netstat)
* Databases: working knowledge of PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB or Redis, including install, connectivity, backup and restore
* Support: ticket-based support, root cause analysis and SLA-driven resolution

**Good to have**

* RHCSA, RHCE or LFCS; Docker Certified Associate
* Experience deploying into air-gapped or highly restricted customer networks
* Ansible for repeatable server preparation and deployment
* Monitoring exposure: Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix or Loki
* Keycloak, LDAP/Active Directory or SSO configuration
* Familiarity with CIS Benchmarks for Linux and Docker

**How you work**

* Clear, professional communication with customer IT teams, including non-technical stakeholders
* Structured troubleshooting under time pressure during go-live windows
* Ownership of each implementation from readiness through handover
* Willingness to travel to customer sites and support deployments outside business hours when required

title: Application Support Specialist
description:
**Contract Type:**
 Full Time; Permanent
  
**Location:**
 Noida, India
  
  
**JOB OVERVIEW**
The Application Support Specialist is responsible for providing support for Study Group applications and addressing end-user requests under the guidance of the Application Support Manager. The position involves responding to support tickets raised through the Service Desk, diagnosing and troubleshooting application-related issues, and delivering timely resolutions. The role also supports the creation and maintenance of user guides, support materials, and process documentation to ensure effective service delivery and continuous improvement.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

**Application Support**

* Provide end-user support for all Study Group applications, and act as a point of contact and response for end-user issues
* The tasks contained within this responsibility revolve around the use of a service desk system to prioritise and respond to issues, perform troubleshooting, provide support, and escalate issues when required
* The described functions of the responsibility should be undertaken constantly and with a high priority. Response and resolution times are defined as SLAs and should be adhered to

**Learning Systems Administration**

* To ensure end-users have consistent access and functionality across all learning systems, constant administration and monitoring is required. The monitoring of learning systems and infrastructure upon which they reside forms a core part of this responsibility
* The administration component requires careful management of permissions and configuration changes while adhering to change control policies. Monitoring is undertaken using a variety of automatic and manual procedures via both hardware and software

**Incident and Change Management**

* Assistance with IT critical incident communication
* Communicate fully and effectively with colleagues throughout the incident lifecycle, ensuring that staff are updated at all stages of the incident
* Assist with managing business communication regarding software change, downtime and upgrades

**Development and Knowledge**

* Build specialist knowledge of Study Group’s applications
* Document and share knowledge and best practise with other IT staff
* Identify trends in application supports and recommend remedial action to address the trending topics and areas, continually improving the user experience and increasing the efficiency of the app support function
* Knowledge sharing within the team and collaborate with other teams to build skills and understanding across new projects and solutions developed

**Audit Compliance**

* Working with the Application Support Manager (or similar), coordinate and assist with regularly scheduled audit activities, including privileged user access review, and access appropriateness review

**Governance**

* Compliance to all relevant data protection, financial, taxation and legal requirements
* Compliance to all relevant education sector requirements
* Compliance to all Study Group policies and procedures
* Champion Study Group’s Corporate Social Responsibility and in particular Building Futures
* Comply with all IT policies and procedures

**ABOUT YOU**

* A Bachelor's degree in Information Technology or a related field is essential; additional diploma-level qualifications and relevant experience are desirable
* Experience in application support
* Experience using service desk tools and processes
* At least 2 years’ experience in the IT industry in a similar/equivalent role
* Experience gathering and presenting detailed information
* Excellent communication, customer service and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to work under pressure and tight deadlines
* Experiencing in dealing with customers/end users
* Moodle or equivalent LMS experience would be advantageous
* Salesforce or equivalent CRM experience would be advantageous

**ABOUT US**
Study Group is a leading international education provider that is dedicated and passionate about helping students around the world, creating a brighter future and reaching their full potential. With university partnerships and a variety of face-to-face, online, and hybrid study programmes, we can provide students with the resources and guidance they need to succeed. Our global network of offices and university partnerships ensure that students receive the best educational services available. Additionally, our Insendi platform enables us to deliver innovative, accessible, and intuitive digital learning experiences with the most advanced digital tools available.
  
  

**ORGANISATIONAL COMPLIANCE**
Study Group is proud of its high standards in safeguarding and recognises its importance in enabling the best possible student experience and outcomes. For successful applicants the following checks will be conducted- Criminal Background Check (country specific), x2 References, ID and Right to Work checks as well as Education Verification.
  
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and we strive to create a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of race, gender, religion, nationality, or any other factor. We believe that the best person for the job should be selected based on skills and experience alone. Your information will be kept confidential and stored securely. Please see our Privacy Policy.
  
  
We adopt a rolling recruitment process meaning that we review applications as they are submitted. To avoid disappointment, please ensure that you apply ASAP.

title: Technical Support Specialist III - Oracle Integration Cloud
description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.
  
  
We are more than 36,000 people, in over 70 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.
  
  
**Role Description:**
Oracle Integration Cloud Developer with 2–5 years of experience developing, testing and supporting integrations between Oracle Fusion and external applications. Hands-on experience with OIC, REST/SOAP APIs, SFTP, scheduled and application-driven integrations, XML/JSON transformations and SQL. Experienced in integration monitoring, incident troubleshooting, UAT support and deployment activities. Familiar with Oracle Fusion ERP/HCM integration patterns and enterprise integration lifecycle practices.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities – Oracle Integration Cloud Developer**

* Develop, test and support integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) between Oracle Fusion applications and external systems.
* Comprehend application-driven, scheduled and file-based integrations based on functional and technical requirements.
* Configure and maintain Connections, Integrations, Lookups, Packages and Schedules.
* Build and maintain integrations involving Oracle Fusion ERP and/or HCM applications.
* Understand integration validations, conditional processing and appropriate fault/error-handling mechanisms.
* Work with Oracle Fusion REST/SOAP APIs, BI Publisher reports and file-based integration patterns where applicable.
* Use SQL for data validation, reconciliation, troubleshooting and integration support activities.
* Test REST/SOAP services using tools such as Postman and analyze request/response payloads.
* Monitor OIC integration instances, schedules and message flows and proactively identify failed or delayed transactions.
* Troubleshoot production incidents involving connectivity, authentication, API errors, SFTP failures, transformation issues and source/target data problems.
* Analyze Activity Streams, error messages, payloads and application logs to identify the root cause of integration failures.
* Perform incident investigation, defect resolution and root-cause analysis (RCA) for recurring integration issues.
* Support failed transaction recovery, reprocessing and reconciliation following defined operational procedures.
* Provide L2 technical support for OIC integrations and coordinate with functional, application, infrastructure and external-system teams when required.
* Support SIT, UAT and regression testing, including defect analysis and resolution.
* Prepare SOP's, technical validation evidence and deployment-related documentation.
* Support the migration and deployment of integrations across Development, Test/UAT and Production environments.
* Perform post-deployment validation and monitor integrations following production releases.
* Maintain technical documentation, support runbooks, troubleshooting guides and knowledge-based articles.

**Required Qualifications and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related technical discipline.
* 2–5 years of relevant experience in enterprise application integration, Oracle Cloud integration development/support or a comparable technical role.
* Hands-on experience developing, testing and supporting integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC).
* Practical experience with application-driven, scheduled and file-based OIC integration patterns.
* Experience configuring and working with OIC components such as Connections, Integrations, Lookups, Packages and Schedules.
* Working knowledge and practical experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and/or HCM integrations.
* Strong practical experience with REST APIs, SOAP web services and SFTP/file-based integration mechanisms.
* Good working knowledge of XML and JSON, including data mapping, transformation and validation.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data validation, reconciliation, troubleshooting and integration-support activities.
* Practical experience using tools such as Postman for REST/SOAP API testing and request/response analysis.
* Experience troubleshooting OIC integrations using Activity Streams, error messages, payloads and application logs.
* Good understanding of integration fault handling, exception management, transaction recovery, reprocessing and reconciliation.
* Experience supporting production incidents and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for integration-related issues.
* Practical exposure to SIT, UAT, regression testing, deployment and post-production validation activities.
* Familiarity with Oracle Fusion REST/SOAP APIs and BI Publisher (BIP) integration/reporting patterns.
* Exposure to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and enterprise authentication/connectivity concepts would be advantageous.
* Good written and verbal communication skills with the ability to prepare clear technical documentation, SOPs, support runbooks and troubleshooting guidance.
* Ability to manage assigned priorities independently, take ownership of technical issues and work effectively within established change, release and operational processes.

title: Implementation Consultant
description:
**About the Company -**

Algoworks is an award-winning artificial intelligence, engineering services and experience

transformation firm with offices across the United States, Europe, South America and

India. We bring together a global team of engineers, architects, designers, researchers and

operators united by rigor, accountability and a commitment to delivering measurable

results.

For over 20 years, Algoworks has partnered with Fortune 500 organizations across the

Americas, Europe and Asia to define, build and run technology that drives meaningful

business outcomes. Our work combines human-centered design, engineering excellence

and AI-powered capabilities to solve complex challenges with clarity and precision.

Innovation, particularly in the responsible application of AI, is embedded in how teams

approach problem-solving and continuous improvement.

At Algoworks, growth is continuous and closely tied to impact. Teams collaborate across

geographies and disciplines, strengthening outcomes through shared insight and

collective expertise. The culture values transparency, open dialogue and an environment

where every voice is heard and contribution is recognized.

Through collaboration, accountability and a focus on results, Algoworks operates at the

intersection of technology and people, building not only advanced systems but strong

global teams that elevate performance and create lasting impact.

**Role Overview-**

The Implementation Consultant (IC) turns client requirements into a working, tested and

documented Gotransverse configuration with speed and precision. The IC works alongside

the Executive Sponsor, Project Manager, Business Analyst, Solution Architect and QA to

translate business requirements into platform configuration, support testing and

reconciliation, and ensure successful implementation and handover.

The role combines billing domain knowledge, hands-on platform skills, analytical thinking

and client-facing communication to deliver accurate and reliable configurations.

**Key Responsibilities-**

1. Discovery & Requirements

• Run working sessions with clients and translate contract terms and business

scenarios into configurable requirements.

• Ask clarifying questions to understand the business need behind client requests.

• Challenge unclear requirements and recommend best practices.

• Ensure requirements are traceable to corresponding build elements.

• Understand design specifications to determine implementation next steps.

2. Platform Configuration & Build

• Configure the catalog, charges, lookup tables, custom fields, SRIDs, mediation

streams and integrations.

• Translate documented requirements into accurate Gotransverse configurations.

• Validate configuration changes and check work before handing it off.

• Ensure configuration and runbook documentation remain current as the build

changes.

3. Testing & Reconciliation

• Write and execute test cases.

• Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and regression testing after changes.

• Reconcile system output against source data and client expectations.

• Investigate and explain variances between system output and source data.

• Triage defects and distinguish data issues, configuration gaps, new requirements

and product bugs.

4. Demo Preparation & Execution

• Prepare and conduct client demonstrations.

• Tailor demo scripts to the audience.

• Stage clean demo data and dry-run end-to-end scenarios.

• Capture feedback, document follow-ups and communicate next steps.

5. Cutover, Go-Live & Handover

• Support cutover, go-live and hypercare activities.

• Contribute to migration, parallel-run and rollback planning.

• Maintain relevant configuration and runbook documentation.

• Ensure a clean transition to support and Customer Success teams.

6. Client & Internal Communication

• Provide clear and organized updates to clients and internal teams.

• Adjust communication for executive and technical audiences.

• Escalate risks and issues early.

• Work closely with the Executive Sponsor, Project Manager, Business Analyst, Solution Architect and QA.

**Required Technical Skills & Competencies**

**Core Technical Skills-**

• Strong SQL skills to query and validate data independently and reconcile counts and totals.

• Understanding of JSON and APIs, including building payloads, authentication, error handling and pagination.

• Data analysis skills, including Excel pivots, lookups, identifying outliers and explaining variances.

• Ability to work with configuration data and validate system outputs against source

data.

**Delivery & Implementation -**

• Understanding of requirements traceability and the ability to map requirements to

configuration elements.

• Ability to write test cases, execute UAT and regression testing, and reconcile outputs with source data.

• Understanding of defect triage and the ability to distinguish data issues, configuration gaps, new requirements and product bugs.

• Familiarity with cutover, go-live, migration, parallel runs, rollback planning and

hypercare.

**Consulting & Client Engagement -**

• Ability to conduct discovery sessions and clarify business requirements.

• Ability to recommend best practices rather than only implementing requested

changes.

• Strong demo preparation and execution skills.

• Ability to communicate clearly with both executive and technical stakeholders.

**Must-Have Skills -**

• SQL and data validation.

• Data analytics and reconciliation.

• Understanding of JSON and APIs.

• Requirements analysis and traceability.

• Testing, UAT and regression testing.

• Configuration validation and defect triage.

• Client communication and stakeholder management.

• Strong attention to detail and precise execution.

**Good to Have Skills -**

• Experience with billing platforms or subscription management systems.

• Familiarity with Gotransverse.

• Experience with mediation streams and integrations.

• Exposure to cutover, migration, parallel runs and hypercare.

**Desired Attributes -**

• Fast, detailed and precise in execution.

• Checks own work before handing it off.

• Organized and clear in client and internal communication.

• Able to adapt communication for executives and technical teams.

• Curious and comfortable challenging unclear requirements.

• Commercially and operationally practical.

• Focused on recommending best practices.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

India is in the middle of an extraordinary AI revolution, powered by a young, tech-savvy generation and visionary leaders who see the future in code and creativity. Co-founded by industry pioneers Sharad Sanghi and Anindya Das, Neysa combines deep expertise in cloud, AI infrastructure, and cybersecurity to empower the builders of the future. * Strengthen operational maturity through process adherence and documentation
* Drive automation and efficiency across infrastructure management
* Act as a technical mentor and escalation point for L1 and L2 teams

* Be available for 24×7 operational support in rotational shifts
* Handle escalations, severity incidents, and critical projects

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive faster resolutions and improvements

**Required Qualifications**

* 4 to 8 years of experience in Linux System Administration & Storage
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field (preferred)
* Strong experience working in enterprise or data center environments
* Proven ability to handle critical incidents and escalations

**Primary Skills (Must Have)**

* Strong expertise in Linux OS and infrastructure management
* In-depth knowledge of networking concepts: DNS, DHCP, SSH, TCP/IP, SMTP, IP, Iptables/Firewalld
* Experience with web servers and load balancers: Apache, Nginx, HAProxy
* Advanced troubleshooting and analytical skills (logs analysis, event correlation)
* Strong knowledge of storage technologies: LVM, RAID, SAN, NAS, iSCSI
* Proficiency in scripting and automation: Python, Shell scripting, Ansible, Terraform
* Experience with containerization and orchestration: Docker, Containers, Kubernetes

* Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools: Prometheus, Grafana
* Exposure to provisioning tools like Foreman and MAAS
* Understanding of virtualization platforms: KVM, Proxmox
* Basic knowledge of AI model deployment and fine-tuning
* Experience in driving automation and infrastructure optimization initiatives

**Why This Role is a Unique Opportunity at Neysa**

This role offers the opportunity to work on complex, large-scale infrastructure systems that power AI-driven platforms. You will play a critical role in maintaining system reliability, handling high-impact incidents, and shaping operational excellence in a fast-growing AI ecosystem. You’ll gain deep exposure to enterprise infrastructure, automation practices, and next-generation AI workloads while contributing to a high-performance environment.

title: IBM MQ ADMIN
description:
IBM MQ Lead / MQ Administrator
  
Salary -4- 8 lpa(depending on experience)
  
Employment Type-Full-Time
  
Exp- 2-5
  
  
  
About the Company
  
We are a leading aviation IT solutions provider specializing in mission-critical airport systems integration, enterprise middleware, operational technology platforms, and digital transformation solutions for airports and aviation stakeholders. Our projects involve complex, high-availability environments requiring secure, scalable, and resilient system integrations across multiple airport operational systems.
  
We are seeking a highly skilled MQ Administrator to manage, optimize, and support enterprise messaging and middleware infrastructure in demanding, 24x7 operational environments.
  
  
Role Overview
  
We are looking for an experienced IBM MQ Lead / Administrator with strong technical and leadership capabilities to manage enterprise messaging environments and production support operations.
  
The candidate will be responsible for providing technical leadership, managing day-to-day MQ operations, handling critical incidents, coordinating with L2/L3 teams, and ensuring timely resolution and closure of issues. The role requires strong client-facing skills, ownership of production activities, and the ability to lead support teams in a 24x7 environment.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Lead and manage IBM MQ administration and production support activities across multiple environments.
  
Provide technical leadership to the MQ support team and guide team members in troubleshooting and issue resolution.
  
Take ownership of critical and complex incidents and drive them through to resolution and closure.
  
Analyze production issues, identify the impacted areas, and coordinate with relevant technical teams for resolution.
  
Coordinate with L2, L3, application, infrastructure, network, security, and vendor teams to resolve complex issues within agreed SLAs.
  
Act as the primary technical point of contact for MQ-related issues and operational activities.
  
Lead incident calls and ensure clear communication between technical teams, stakeholders, and clients.
  
Provide regular and accurate status updates to clients and management during critical incidents.
  
Coordinate with L2/L3 teams for detailed troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and implementation of corrective actions.
  
Ensure issues are properly tracked, resolved, validated, and formally closed.
  
Review recurring incidents and coordinate with relevant teams to identify permanent solutions and preventive measures.
  
Manage and coordinate shift operations, including shift handovers, pending activities, critical incidents, and operational priorities.
  
Ensure adequate coverage and smooth execution of 24x7 production support and shift activities.
  
Coordinate planned activities, changes, deployments, maintenance, and testing with respective teams.
  
Review and approve operational activities, implementation plans, rollback plans, and troubleshooting approaches where applicable.
  
Participate in client meetings, governance calls, service reviews, and technical discussions.
  
Translate technical issues into clear business-impact updates for clients and stakeholders.
  
Ensure adherence to operational procedures, SLA requirements, change management processes, and support standards.
  
Prepare and review RCA, incident reports, operational reports, and other support documentation.
  
Identify operational gaps and drive improvements in support processes, monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident management.
  
Mentor and guide junior team members and help build technical capability within the support team.
  
Coordinate knowledge transfer and ensure proper documentation of critical systems and operational procedures.
  
Work closely with management to identify resource requirements, operational risks, and support priorities.
  
Leadership & Client Management
  
Demonstrate strong ownership and accountability for MQ operations and production support.
  
Lead technical discussions with clients and internal stakeholders.
  
Effectively manage communication during high-priority and critical incidents.
  
Coordinate multiple teams simultaneously to drive issues toward closure.
  
Ensure clear assignment of actions, ownership, and timelines during incident and technical calls.
  
Escalate issues appropriately and ensure timely involvement of L2/L3 teams when required.
  
Follow up with respective teams until the issue is completely resolved and validated.
  
Ensure proper closure of incidents with appropriate RCA and preventive actions.
  
Build strong working relationships with clients, vendors, and internal technical teams.
  
Act as a bridge between the support team, L2/L3 technical teams, and the client.
  
Technical Responsibilities
  
Strong understanding of IBM MQ administration and enterprise messaging concepts.
  
Manage and troubleshoot MQ-related connectivity, messaging, queue, channel, security, and performance issues.
  
Perform MQ health checks and monitor the overall health of messaging environments.
  
Support MQ configuration, maintenance, deployments, and production changes.
  
Troubleshoot message flow issues and coordinate with application/integration teams.
  
Support high-availability, disaster-recovery, and infrastructure-related MQ activities.
  
Analyze logs and technical information to identify the root cause of issues.
  
Work with infrastructure, network, security, and application teams when issues span multiple technology areas.
  
Shift & Operations Management
  
Lead assigned shifts and ensure smooth execution of production support activities.
  
Review open incidents, pending activities, planned changes, and operational priorities at the start of each shift.
  
Ensure proper handover between shifts.
  
Coordinate resources during major incidents and production outages.
  
Ensure all critical issues are followed up until resolution and closure.
  
Maintain operational discipline and ensure SLA commitments are met.
  
Support on-call and 24x7 operations as required.
  
Required Skills
  
6+ years of experience in IBM MQ administration/support.
  
Strong production support and incident management experience.
  
Strong leadership and coordination skills.
  
Experience working with L2/L3 technical teams.
  
Strong client-facing and communication skills.
  
Experience handling critical incidents and driving them to closure.
  
Experience working in 24x7 shift environments.
  
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  
Good understanding of enterprise integration and messaging environments.
  
Ability to coordinate across multiple technical teams.
  
Experience with ITIL/service management processes is preferred.
  
Experience with incident, problem, change, and release management is preferred.
  
Ideal Candidate Profile
  
The ideal candidate should be a technically strong MQ professional with proven leadership experience, capable of independently managing production support, leading shifts, handling critical incidents, coordinating with L2/L3 teams, and managing client communication.
  
The candidate should demonstrate strong ownership, decision-making, coordination, communication, and issue-closure capabilities, rather than being limited to individual technical troubleshooting.

title: Advisory Customer Solutions Consultant
description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you'll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact.Success in Global Sales is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. You'll connect technical understanding with strong people skills, building trusted relationships and shaping solutions that improve business and society. With world-class onboarding, continuous learning, and a supportive culture, IBM offers the tools and opportunities to grow your career. Join us and be part of a global team that's passionate about driving innovation and making a difference.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As an Acquisition Technical Transition Incentive Generalist, you will be part of a unique incentive plan associated with an acquisition or integration agreement. This role is designed to support eligible employees during a transitional period of up to 24 months.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Maintain Incentive Eligibility: Ensure compliance with the terms of the incentive plan and meet the requirements to remain eligible for the duration of the agreement.
* Support Integration Efforts: Collaborate with teams to facilitate a smooth transition and integration of acquired entities, assets, or systems.
* Monitor Progress: Track and report on progress against agreed-upon milestones and performance metrics.
* Address Transitional Issues: Identify and resolve technical issues that arise during the transition period, ensuring minimal disruption to operations.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Exposure to Incentive Plan Management: Familiarity with the terms and conditions of incentive plans, including compliance requirements and eligibility criteria.
* Experience with Integration Support: Knowledge of integration processes and procedures, including collaboration with cross-functional teams to facilitate smooth transitions.
* Understanding of Performance Metrics: Exposure to tracking and reporting progress against milestones and performance metrics, ensuring accurate and timely updates.
* Technical Issue Resolution: Experience working with technical issues that arise during transitional periods, with the ability to identify and resolve problems efficiently.
* Familiarity with Transitional Operations: Understanding of the importance of minimizing disruptions to operations during transitional periods, with a focus on maintaining continuity and stability.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Incentive Plan Administration: Exposure to managing and administering incentive plans, including compliance requirements and eligibility criteria, would be beneficial in this role.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Experience working with various teams to facilitate integration efforts and ensure smooth transitions would be an asset.
* Performance Metric Analysis: Familiarity with tracking and analyzing performance metrics to inform progress and decision-making would be valuable in this position.

title: Sales And Service Associate
description:
**Company Description**
VNS Scientific Instruments is a growing provider of scientific and laboratory equipment, serving clients across research, education, healthcare, and industrial sectors. The organization focuses on delivering reliable instruments, responsive technical support, and efficient after-sales service to help customers maintain high-quality operations. VNS Scientific Instruments values collaboration, integrity, and customer satisfaction, and encourages team members to contribute ideas that improve service quality. The company offers opportunities to learn about new technologies, engage with a variety of clients, and develop practical skills in sales and technical support. Team members are supported with training and a structured environment that promotes professional growth.
  
**Role Description**
The Sales and Service Associate is a full-time, on-site role based in Ghaziabad. This role involves engaging with existing and prospective customers, explaining product features and benefits, and providing guidance on suitable scientific instruments for their needs. The associate will prepare quotations, follow up on inquiries, process orders, and coordinate deliveries in collaboration with internal teams. Day-to-day tasks include basic installation support, routine maintenance visits, and assisting with troubleshooting under the guidance of senior technical staff. The role also entails maintaining customer records, documenting service activities, and contributing to sales targets through proactive communication and relationship building.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Ability to understand and explain technical product information, with an interest in scientific instruments or laboratory equipment.
* Customer-focused mindset, with strong interpersonal skills for building and maintaining client relationships.
* Clear verbal and written communication skills to present product details, prepare quotations, and document service activities.
* Basic problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities to support installations and routine service tasks.
* Organizational and time-management skills to handle multiple inquiries, follow-ups, and service visits efficiently.
* Comfort using office productivity tools (e.g., email, spreadsheets, CRM or customer databases).
* Relevant education in science, engineering, or a related field is an advantage; prior experience in sales or technical service is preferred but not mandatory.
* Willingness to travel locally for client visits and the ability to work on-site in Ghaziabad.

Grade

India (Noida, Bangalore)

Full-time, Permanent

Reports To
  
  
Delivery Manager – EPM Practice

* Atleast 3 to 5yr of hands on experience in MDM L2 team supporting on tools mainly Microsoft Intune, AirWatch / Workspace ONE, XenMobile, MobileIron, MaaS360 etc.
* Provide mobility MDM end user support in Adding or Deleting users from the EMM console, Performing remote device management actions like Device Wipe, Enterprise Wipe, and Password Reset also device enrolment, password, Configuration, Application, Email issues, DEP Enrollment etc.

* support mobile Application Management like remove and adding users to MAM policies, report on applications installed on devices.
* Supporting customer environments on 24x7x365 basis.
* Interact with a large variety of clients to provide Mobility MDM L2 level technical support for Mobility/Exchange related incidents and requests.
* Understand requirements, analyze networking issue and provide first level updates and recommendations.
* Should be experienced on Intune/SCCM/MECM for customer and actively support Deployment, Patching on Windows desktop/laptop using Intune. Should be strong in new technologies as AI, AutoPilot etc. and be prepared to handle any new support in other NTT customers, training on Azure, Microsoft 365 Fundamentals: Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate as a part of regular technical upgradation.
* Meet and manage MDM mobility agreements with customers through troubleshooting the MDM issues and resolving.
* Participation in daily operations meeting, ensuring compliance and meet the customer desired resolutions for your respective sites and service area.
* Interact with a large variety of clients to provide Mobility and MDM related L2 Level technical support for Mobility/Exchange related incidents and requests.

Microsoft SCCM / MECM – Platform Lead Engineering
  

* Lead SCCM/MECM architecture and administration for enterprise client environments — site hierarchy, boundary groups, DP management, and content distribution governance.
* Own Software Update Management in SCCM — SUP/WSUS architecture, ADR design, phased deployment rings, maintenance windows, and patch compliance reporting.
* Lead application deployment design and governance — MSI/MSIX/EXE deployments, detection rules, supersedence chains, phased rollouts, and software lifecycle management.
* Govern OS Deployment (OSD) and task sequence engineering — Windows 11 deployment, in-place upgrade (IPU), and golden image integration within SCCM.
* Lead SCCM co-management configuration — workload transition planning, policy authority management, and Cloud Attach/CMG enablement for internet-based device management.
* Manage SCCM client health — client installation, push deployment, health monitoring, and remediation across large device populations.
* Govern SCCM reporting infrastructure — SSRS compliance dashboards, custom WQL collection queries, and Power BI integration for operational reporting.
* Lead SCCM CB upgrade planning and execution — site server upgrades, console updates, and post-upgrade validation.
* Act as L3 escalation authority for Priority-1/Priority-2 SCCM incidents, driving root cause analysis and permanent resolution.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced
**Manager – ERP (Ginesys)**
to lead the administration, configuration, maintenance, and optimization of the Ginesys ERP system across our retail, warehouse, and corporate operations.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with Ginesys ERP in the retail, apparel, or fashion industry, along with the ability to manage master data, user access, inventory workflows, POS operations, system integrations, and cross-functional requirements. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring system reliability, data accuracy, process efficiency, and effective coordination with internal stakeholders and the Ginesys support team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **ERP Administration & Management:**
  Manage the end-to-end administration, maintenance, and smooth functioning of Ginesys ERP across retail, warehouse, finance, and other business functions.
* **Master Data Management:**
  Oversee the creation, validation, upload, and maintenance of item, style, SKU, pricing, vendor, customer, store, and other business masters, ensuring accuracy and consistency.
* **User Access & Security:**
  Manage user creation, deactivation, roles, permissions, and access controls in line with organizational policies and data security requirements.
* **Retail & Inventory Operations:**
  Ensure effective system support for retail operations, POS, inventory management, stock transfers, warehouse transactions, and related workflows.
* **System Troubleshooting:**
  Identify, analyze, and resolve ERP-related issues, minimize operational disruptions, and coordinate with Ginesys support for complex technical issues and system enhancements.
* **Process Improvement:**
  Identify opportunities to optimize ERP workflows, automate repetitive activities, improve system utilization, and enhance operational efficiency.
* **Cross-Functional Coordination:**
  Work closely with IT, Retail, Warehouse, Merchandising, Finance, and other business teams to understand requirements and implement appropriate ERP solutions.
* **Data Integrity & Reporting:**
  Monitor master data and transaction accuracy, investigate discrepancies, and support business reporting through data extraction and analysis.
* **System Enhancements & Upgrades:**
  Coordinate ERP updates, configuration changes, testing, issue resolution, and implementation of new features or functionalities.
* **Audit & Compliance:**
  Ensure proper documentation, access controls, audit trails, and adherence to internal processes. Support month-end and year-end closing activities and audits.
* **SOPs & Documentation:**
  Develop, maintain, and update SOPs, process documents, and guidelines for ERP administration, master uploads, and user management.
* **Training & User Support:**
  Train and guide users across departments on Ginesys workflows, system best practices, and process changes.
* **Team & Vendor Management:**
  Coordinate with internal IT resources and external vendors to ensure timely resolution of issues, effective service delivery, and continuous system improvement.

**Requirements**

* Minimum
  **5+ years of overall experience**
  , with substantial hands-on experience in Ginesys ERP administration and management.
* Mandatory practical experience in
  **Ginesys ERP within the retail, apparel, fashion, or omnichannel business environment**
  .
* Strong understanding of Ginesys modules and workflows related to retail operations, POS, inventory, warehouse management, and master data.
* Proven expertise in master creation, validation, bulk uploads, data migration, and maintenance, including item/SKU, pricing, vendor, customer, and store masters.
* Experience in user administration, role management, access controls, system configuration, and troubleshooting.
* Strong knowledge of retail business processes, inventory movement, stock reconciliation, and interdepartmental workflows.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, data validation, and large-data handling.
* Experience in ERP implementation, upgrades, testing, process automation, or system integration will be an added advantage.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to independently manage ERP operations, prioritize issues, and drive timely resolution.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* A self-driven professional capable of independently managing Ginesys ERP operations and driving continuous improvement.
* Strong understanding of the end-to-end retail and inventory lifecycle in a fashion or apparel business.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, growth-oriented organization with multiple business functions and locations.

title: Manager, Payment Operations
description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Part Of**
Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.
  
  
**What You'll Be Responsible For**
You’ll own the day-to-day Payment Operations function supporting Circle Payments Network, with accountability for operational coverage, queue performance, escalations, investigation quality, team capability, and process execution across a 24x7 environment. You’ll develop analysts from onboarding through independent case ownership, maintain a high bar for operational quality, and ensure the team has the processes, training, documentation, and performance management needed to operate effectively. You’ll also be the domain expert on the network and the senior operational escalation point for issues that cannot be resolved within the team.
  
  
**What You'll Work On**

* Own shift design, rostering, coverage planning, and handoffs across a 24x7 model, including leave, surge and holiday planning, and the coverage math that sits behind it.
* Own live queue management, ensuring incoming partner queries and detected exceptions are picked up, triaged, worked, and closed within SLA.
* Own the escalation path. Senior Analysts are the first escalation point and work the hardest cases; you take what they cannot resolve and decide when an issue needs to leave the team and move to Engineering, Product, or partner-facing leadership.
* Build and run analyst onboarding, continuous training, certification, and competency development, using actual case output to identify individual gaps, build targeted improvement plans, and develop analysts from day one through independent handling of the full query mix.
* Establish and operate the QC program, including case sampling, review, calibration, error taxonomy, investigation standards, and feedback loops into training and SOPs.
* Own the operational metrics the function reports on, including Time to Acknowledge (TTA), Time to Resolve (TTR), SLA compliance, and volume and failure trends by shift, partner, and rail; produce the weekly operations readout and be able to explain any number in it.
* Develop and maintain current, usable SOPs and runbooks that reflect how the team actually works; close gaps between practice and documentation, and run process changes through communication, training, adoption verification, and measurement.

**What You'll Bring To Circle**
Core requirements
  
  

* 8+ years in payment operations, payment investigations, settlement operations, or a comparable operations function at a payments company, fintech, or bank.
* 2+ years directly managing a team of operations analysts as a Team Lead, Assistant Manager, or Manager, with real accountability for their output and not just work allocation; you are still hands-on and want to stay that way.
* Hands-on ownership of at least one full shift roster in a 24x7 or extended-coverage operation; you have built the roster, run the coverage math, and handled the exceptions.
* Demonstrated ownership of training and ramp; you can name analysts you took from new to independent and describe how you developed them.
* Demonstrated ownership of process and documentation; you have written SOPs and runbooks that other people used, not just followed someone else’s.
* Cross-border payments depth, including correspondent banking, SWIFT/MT103, local rails, reconciliation, exception handling, and settlement investigations.
* Comfortable working from data; you set targets, track them, and can defend the numbers.

What will make you stand out
  
  

* You have done this in a team that was being built, not one that was already running; you set the process rather than inheriting it.
* You have run an operation where the SLA mattered to a customer or partner, and you can describe what you changed to hit it.
* You have exposure to stablecoins, crypto rails, or digital assets, or clear evidence that you pick up new domains quickly.
* You actively use AI tooling in your own work and have a point of view on where it can—and cannot—improve operations.

*Circle is on a mission to create an inclusive financial future, with transparency at our core. We consider a wide variety of elements when crafting our compensation ranges and total compensation packages.*
*Starting pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to: relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and other business and organizational needs. Please note that compensation ranges may differ for candidates in other locations.*
We are an
**equal opportunity employer**
. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, or any other protected status required by the laws in the locations where we hire. Additionally, Circle participates in the E-Verify Program in certain locations, as required by law.
  
  
*Should you require accommodations or assistance in our interview process because of a disability, please reach out to*
*accommodations@circle.com*
*for support. We respect your privacy and will connect with you separately from our interview process to accommodate your needs.*

title: Payroll Operations Manager
description:
**About the role**

We’re looking for a hands-on people leader to own and scale India Payroll Operations — someone who can develop a high-performing team, strengthen execution, and drive excellent customer outcomes across a complex and growing market.

You will manage an established team of specialists and own the operating rhythm for the function: day-to-day execution, escalation management, quality, vendor performance, team development, hiring, onboarding, and process improvement. The right person brings strong people leadership, operational rigor, polished senior-stakeholder communication, and practical India payroll experience. You should be comfortable working closely with clients, external vendors, and internal teams like R&D, Support, Compliance, Product, and Customer Success to resolve issues, deliver strong customer experiences, and strengthen India payroll operations.

**Note: This role is based in our Bangalore office and follows a hybrid schedule, with team members expected to work from the office at least three days per week. The expected working hours are 2:00 PM–10:00 PM IST.**

**What you will do**

**Lead, coach, and grow the team**

- Manage, coach, and develop a team of India Payroll Operations specialists, setting clear expectations around quality, ownership, responsiveness, and customer experience.

- Create meaningful growth opportunities for team members through regular feedback, mentorship, training, knowledge sharing, and clear development plans.

- Own hiring, onboarding, training, and capacity planning as the team continues to scale.

- Build a high-performing team culture grounded in accuracy, accountability, strong communication, operational discipline, and continuous improvement.

**Own execution and quality**

- Oversee day-to-day India payroll workflows, ensuring timely and accurate execution across the team.

- Manage complex escalations and customer-impacting issues with strong judgment, clear communication, and effective follow-through.

- Maintain strong customer outcomes across time to first response, backlog management, case resolution, escalation handling, and CSAT.

- Strengthen existing QA standards, audit routines, case review processes, SOPs, playbooks, and escalation frameworks as the team scales.

- Support operational quality across India payroll compliance activities, including TDS, professional tax, EPF, quarterly filing support, annual POI, Form 16 coordination, and related payroll activities.

**Scale processes, systems, and partnerships**

- Identify opportunities to make existing workflows, controls, documentation, tooling, and operating rhythms more scalable and efficient.

- Manage external vendors and partners, holding them accountable to timelines, quality expectations, issue resolution, and escalation standards.

- Use operational data, QA findings, customer feedback, and team insights to identify root causes and drive durable improvements.

- Define and track key operating metrics, including SLA adherence, accuracy, rework, escalation trends, case volume, vendor performance, team capacity, backlog, and customer satisfaction.

**Partner cross-functionally**

- Collaborate closely with R&D, Support, Product, Engineering, Compliance, Customer Success, and other Operations teams to resolve issues and improve how India payroll is delivered.

- Translate operational pain points into clear product requirements, tooling needs, and process recommendations.

- Represent India Payroll Operations in cross-functional discussions with strong judgment, concise written communication, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders.

- Partner on product launches, audits, tooling improvements, and process changes that improve reliability, customer experience, and team efficiency.

**What you will need**

* 4+ years in payroll operations, payroll compliance, or payroll service delivery, with practical India payroll experience.
* 3+ years managing, leading, or supervising teams in operations or service delivery.
* Working knowledge of TDS, professional tax, EPF, POI, quarterly filings, Form 16, and vendor-supported payroll operations.
* Experience with hiring, onboarding, coaching, capacity planning, and performance management.
* Strong customer orientation across escalations, high case volume, SLAs, backlog management, QA, and CSAT.
* Track record of improving processes, controls, SOPs, playbooks, and operating outcomes.
* Strong collaboration with technical, product, support, compliance, vendor, and client-facing teams.
* Exceptional written and verbal English communication for customers, executives, vendors, and internal partners.
* Strong judgment, prioritization, root-cause analysis, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace and/or Microsoft Office; Salesforce, JIRA, or Confluence experience is a plus.
* Ability to work a schedule aligned with approximately 2:00 PM–10:00 PM IST, with flexibility for cross-time-zone partnership as needed.

**Highly desirable**

* Experience in a SaaS, HRIS, payroll technology, or global payroll environment.
* Experience partnering with R&D, Product, Engineering, or Support teams to improve tooling, automation, case workflows, or product reliability.
* Experience using AI or automation to improve operations, quality, case management, knowledge management, or team productivity.
* Experience building operational metrics, QA programs, dashboards, audit frameworks, or customer experience programs.
* Prior experience leading a payroll operations team through scale, process maturity, or operating model change.

title: Incident Manager, AI-Ops
description:
**Why should you choose us?**

Rakuten Symphony is reimagining telecom, changing supply chain norms and disrupting outmoded thinking that threatens the industry’s pursuit of rapid innovation and growth. Based on proven modern infrastructure practices, its open interface platforms make it possible to launch and operate advanced mobile services in a fraction of the time and cost of conventional approaches, with no compromise to network quality or security.

Rakuten Symphony has operations in Japan, the United States, Singapore, India, South Korea, Europe, and the Middle East Africa region. For more information, visit: https://symphony.rakuten.com.

Building on the technology Rakuten used to launch Japan’s newest mobile network, we are taking our mobile offering global.

To support our ambitions to provide an innovative cloud-native telco platform for our customers, Rakuten Symphony is looking to recruit and develop top talent from around the globe. We are looking for individuals to join our team across all functional areas of our business – from sales to engineering, support functions to product development.

Let’s build the future of mobile telecommunications together!

About Rakuten Group, Inc. (TSE: 4755) is a global leader in internet services that empower individuals, communities, businesses and society. Founded in Tokyo in 1997 as an online marketplace, Rakuten has expanded to offer services in e-commerce, fintech, digital content and communications to 2 billion members around the world. The Rakuten Group has over 30,000 employees, and operations in 30 countries and regions. For more information visit https://global.rakuten.com/corp/.

**About Department:**

The Network Operations (SXC) Division at Rakuten Mobile is pioneering the future of telecommunications through a fully virtualized, cloud-native architecture. We are transitioning from traditional manual operations to an Autonomous Network Operations model. We are looking for an AI-Ops Manager to lead this transformation, running our incident management function through the deployment, supervision, and continuous refinement of Agentic AI models.

**Role Purpose:**

You will not just manage incidents; you will manage the AI agents that resolve them. Your mission is to minimize MTTR (Mean Time To Recovery) by overseeing an AI-first operational environment, ensuring our cloud-native network (Open RAN/Core) remains resilient through autonomous and semi-autonomous AI intervention.

**Job Duties:**

* **Agentic AI Supervision & Incident Command:**
  Serve as the lead incident commander, monitoring and steering Agentic AI models as they perform real-time diagnostics and remediation. You are responsible for the "Human-in-the-loop" (HITL) oversight of these agents, ensuring they operate within safety guardrails.
* **AI-Orchestrated Operations:**
  Manage the end-to-end incident lifecycle by orchestrating AI-driven workflows across CLOUD/CORE/IPTX/RAN/OSS/BSS. You will validate AI-generated root cause analysis (RCA) and approve autonomous remediation actions.
* **AI Knowledge Hub Management:**
  Own the evolution of our AI-based Knowledge Hub. You will ensure that AI models continuously ingest network telemetry and incident data to generate, update, and refine autonomous resolution articles, turning past incidents into future AI-driven preventative logic.
* **Predictive Network Resilience:**
  Leverage AI capabilities to shift from reactive to predictive operations. Use AI-driven observability to detect anomalies before they impact the end customer, proactively triggering agentic workflows to mitigate service degradation.
* **Model Performance Tuning:**
  Act as the primary owner of the AIOps roadmap. Regularly audit the decision-making logic of AI agents, refine their training data, and optimize their performance to ensure maximum accuracy in complex, cloud-native network environments.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Present AI-derived incident insights to senior management, utilizing data-backed trends to drive infrastructure improvements and architectural changes.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* **Work Experience:**
  Minimum 7 years in Telecom/IT operations, with at least 2 years specifically focused on AIOps, machine learning operations (MLOps), or AI-driven network automation.

**Core Technical Skills:**

* **Agentic AI Mastery:**
  Deep expertise in managing autonomous agents. Ability to interpret agent decision-making paths, troubleshoot automation failures, and perform real-time steering during critical outages.
* **Cloud-Native & Telecom Expertise:**
  Expert-level knowledge of Open RAN, Kubernetes, containerized network functions (CNFs), and cloud-native architecture.
* **AIOps Tooling:**
  Proficiency in operating enterprise-grade monitoring systems and ticketing systems that integrate with AI-driven observability platforms.
* **Knowledge Management:**
  Experience managing AI-based knowledge ecosystems where documentation is dynamically generated and maintained by machine learning models.
* **Process Mastery:**
  Strong alignment with ITIL frameworks, adapted for a high-velocity, automated, AI-first environment
* **Analytical Mindset:**
  Exceptional ability to synthesize high-dimensional technical data into actionable strategic intelligence

**Preferred Qualification:**

* Advanced degree or certification in Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or Machine Learning.
* Experience in Python or other scripting languages for the purpose of creating custom AI-agent integrations or automation hooks.
* Proven track record of leading a successful digital transformation from manual operations to an AI-automated or "Self-Healing" network model.
* Relevant certifications in Cloud (e.g., CKA/CKAD) and ITIL 4 (Managing Professional).

**RAKUTEN SHUGI PRINCIPLES:**

Our worldwide practices describe specific behaviours that make Rakuten unique and united across the world. We expect Rakuten employees to model these 5 Shugi Principles of Success.

* **Always improve, always advance.**
  Only be satisfied with complete success - Kaizen.
* **Be passionately professional.**
  Take an uncompromising approach to your work and be determined to be the best.
* **Hypothesize - Practice - Validate - Shikumika.**
  Use the Rakuten Cycle to success in unknown territory.
* **Maximize Customer Satisfaction.**
  The greatest satisfaction for workers in a service industry is to see their customers smile.
* **Speed!! Speed!! Speed!!**
  Always be conscious of time. Take charge, set clear goals, and engage your team.

**Blue Dart Express Limited**
, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, timebound, and secure delivery services across 55,000+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast-paced logistics environment and ever-evolving supply-chains. It wholly-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004.
  
  
Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.
  
  
We are proud to be consistently ranked among
**India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**

**Employer of Choice**
is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
  
  
If you are looking to join a purpose-led, people-first, company that shapes India’s supply-chains with integrity and safety,
**Blue Dart is where you belong**
. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
  
  
**Position Overview:**
The Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – Hub Operations is responsible for managing end-to-end mid-mile operations at an assigned Air Hub or Surface Hub, ensuring seamless movement of shipments across the Blue Dart network. The role oversees inbound, outbound and transit operations, enabling timely network connectivity, operational accuracy and service reliability while maintaining the highest standards of safety, compliance and productivity.
  
  
Reporting to the Head – Hub Operations, the incumbent leads shift operations across the hub by coordinating shipment processing, fleet movements, manpower deployment and operational resources. The role works closely with Network Operations, Aviation, Surface Linehaul, Customer Service and Regional Operations teams to ensure network schedules are met, operational exceptions are proactively managed, and hub performance supports Blue Dart's service commitments.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
To manage mid-mile hub operations by ensuring timely movement of shipments across the network, maximising hub productivity, maintaining network connectivity, driving operational excellence and ensuring compliance with organisational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.
  
  
**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**
Hub Operations Management
  
  
  

* Lead day-to-day operations across the assigned Air Hub or Surface Hub, ensuring efficient inbound, outbound and transit shipment movement.
* Ensure adherence to network schedules, operational workflows and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Plan daily hub activities based on shipment volumes, network priorities and operational requirements.
* Ensure optimum utilisation of hub infrastructure, operational resources and manpower.
* Support the Head – Hub Operations in achieving operational, service quality and productivity objectives.

Mid Mile Network Operations
  
  
  

* Ensure timely receipt, processing, consolidation and dispatch of shipments across the Blue Dart network.
* Coordinate movement of shipments through scheduled air, surface and feeder networks to maintain network connectivity.
* Monitor loading, unloading, scanning, tallying and dispatch activities to ensure shipment accuracy.
* Coordinate vehicle placement and dock activities to minimise turnaround times.
* Ensure timely movement of priority, premium and time-definite shipments across the network.

Network Coordination & Exception Management
  
  
  

* Monitor adherence to network schedules and proactively manage delays, misconnections, misroutes and operational exceptions.
* Coordinate with Aviation, Surface Linehaul, Network Operations and Regional Operations teams to resolve operational issues.
* Ensure timely communication of network disruptions and recovery actions to impacted stakeholders.
* Monitor stock lying at hub (SLAH) and drive timely clearance of pending shipments.
* Ensure accurate status updates and operational visibility across all network systems.

Workforce & Shift Leadership
  
  
  

* Lead operational employees, supervisors and outsourced workforce during assigned shifts.
* Plan manpower deployment based on shipment volumes and operational priorities.
* Conduct daily shift briefings and communicate operational updates and safety requirements.
* Monitor workforce productivity, attendance and adherence to operational standards.
* Support capability building through coaching, training and performance feedback.

Fleet, Capacity & Resource Management
  
  
  

* Ensure availability and optimum utilisation of vehicles, trailers and operational equipment to support scheduled network movements.
* Coordinate with fleet partners and transport vendors to minimise delays and maximise vehicle utilisation.
* Monitor dock utilisation, bay allocation and turnaround times to improve hub efficiency.
* Support capacity planning during peak volumes, network changes and seasonal demand fluctuations.
* Ensure operational readiness of manpower, equipment and infrastructure to meet business requirements.

**Service Quality & Operational Excellence**

* Drive adherence to network timelines and ensure timely connectivity of shipments across the air or surface network.
* Monitor shipment accuracy, scanning compliance, loading quality and dispatch integrity to minimise operational errors.
* Ensure timely closure of operational exceptions, stock lying at hub (SLAH), misroutes and misconnections.
* Review operational performance trends and implement corrective actions to improve service reliability.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance hub productivity, service quality and operational efficiency.

Safety, Security & Compliance
  
  
  

* Ensure compliance with organisational policies, operational SOPs, aviation or transportation regulations and statutory requirements.
* Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring safe handling of shipments, vehicles and operational equipment.
* Support periodic operational, security and quality audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory documentation, shipment security requirements and operational controls applicable to the hub.
* Identify operational risks and implement preventive measures to ensure uninterrupted hub operations.

Stakeholder Management & Operational Communication
  
  
  

* Coordinate closely with Network Operations, Aviation, Surface Operations, Customer Service, Security and Regional Operations teams to ensure seamless execution.
* Maintain effective communication with upstream and downstream network locations regarding shipment movements, operational disruptions and recovery plans.
* Ensure timely escalation of operational risks, capacity constraints and service issues to the Head – Hub Operations.
* Build collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders and transport partners to improve network performance.
* Support implementation of organisational initiatives, process changes and operational improvement programmes across the hub.

People Leadership & Capability Development
  
  
  

* Lead, coach and develop supervisors, operational employees and outsourced workforce to achieve operational objectives.
* Conduct regular shift briefings and ensure effective communication of operational priorities, safety requirements and service expectations.
* Monitor employee productivity, attendance, discipline and overall team performance.
* Support implementation of learning initiatives and on-the-job capability development programmes.
* Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, continuous improvement and customer focus across the hub.

**Experience**

* Assistant Manager – Hub Operations (Grade M): 4 - 7 years of relevant experience with demonstrated experience in leading medium to large hub operations.
* Experience in managing inbound, outbound and transit operations within an air or surface logistics network.

title: Building Operations, Soft Services
description:
**Resident Safety and Community Security**
The primary focus is protecting residents, their guests, and their property within a residential community. This includes managing access control systems such as gate entry, fob or key card systems, and visitor check-in procedures for common areas, pools, fitness centers, and parking garages. The manager typically oversees CCTV coverage for entrances, parking lots, mailrooms, and amenity spaces, reviewing footage when incidents occur such as package theft, vehicle break-ins, or trespassing.
  
  
Patrol operations are often more community-oriented, involving regular walkthroughs of hallways, stairwells, parking structures, and outdoor common areas, particularly during evening and overnight hours when residents report feeling less secure. Many complexes contract courtesy officers or off-duty police officers who live on-site in exchange for reduced rent, and the Security & Safety Manager typically coordinates their schedules and responsibilities.
  
  
**Emergency and Life Safety Systems**
Fire and life safety compliance is critical in multifamily housing due to the density of residents and shared building systems. This involves ensuring fire alarm systems, sprinkler systems, and fire extinguishers meet local code requirements, coordinating fire drills for staff, and maintaining clear egress routes. The manager usually develops emergency plans for scenarios specific to apartment living, including gas leaks, building-wide power outages, elevator entrapments, severe weather (particularly relevant for coastal or tornado-prone regions), and unit fires that could spread to neighboring units.
  
  
**Tenant Communication and Incident Management**
A significant part of the role involves direct resident interaction, including communicating safety advisories, coordinating with leasing and property management teams on lease violations related to safety (such as unauthorized subletting or hazardous behavior), and managing the aftermath of incidents like domestic disturbances, noise complaints escalating to safety concerns, or suspicious activity reports. The manager typically maintains incident logs and may need to testify or provide documentation in legal matters, particularly premises liability claims if a resident is injured or a crime occurs on property.
  
  
**Vendor and Contractor Coordination**
Apartment complexes often rely on third-party security guard companies, and the manager oversees these contracts, ensuring guards are properly licensed, trained, and performing adequately. This also extends to coordinating with vendors for security system maintenance, lighting repairs (critical for perceived and actual safety in parking areas and walkways), and landscaping that affects sightlines and lighting coverage.
  
  
**Regulatory and Insurance Considerations**
Multifamily properties face specific premises liability exposure, so the manager typically works closely with property insurance carriers and legal teams to ensure security measures meet a "reasonable standard of care" to mitigate negligent security claims. This often includes maintaining lighting standards, adequate locks and access control, and documented security patrols, since courts in many jurisdictions evaluate whether a property took reasonable steps to prevent foreseeable criminal activity.
