title: AVP- Radiologist Experience and Engagement
description:
About Teleradiology Solutions

Teleradiology Solutions (TRS) is a pioneer in teleradiology, delivering round-the-clock diagnostic radiology reporting and support to hospitals and healthcare providers across India, the US, and other global markets. Founded in 2002 by two Yale-trained physicians and headquartered in Ardmore, PA, TRS today serves over 150 hospitals across 21 countries.

The company pairs a network of board-certified radiologists — including ABR-certified specialists — with technology-driven workflows and its AI-enabled arm, dAIgnostiX, to deliver fast, accurate, and reliable imaging interpretation. dAIgnostiX is based out of Bengaluru (Whitefield). TRS/dAIX also maintains an active academic focus (www.radguru.net) and ongoing research interests, including AI in radiology.

TRS is set for rapid growth, at a CAGR above 25%. That growth depends on American Board Radiologists (ABRs): the size, deployment and satisfaction (NPS) of the ABR panel is the binding constraint. The panel has about 100 ABRs today, with a substantial increase planned in the coming months.

The ABR journey is split across several teams, including Onboarding, Scheduling and Assigning, and no one owns the ABR's experience end to end. The result is a paradox: the company reports a capacity shortage, while ABRs say they are underused. Part of the capacity gap is really a deployment gap, and closing it is faster than recruiting alone.

This role is the single owner of that journey. You will lead everything that decides whether an ABR is credentialed, scheduled, supported and productive. You will own ABR capacity and productivity, and ABR satisfaction.

Key responsibilities

* Own ABR (
  American Board Radiologists )
  capacity and productivity . Be the named owner of ABR utilisation (actual vs. contracted hours), productivity, and the capacity gap against planned revenue. Make these live, per-ABR numbers, not a one-off analysis. Calculate the capacity gap net of utilisation recovery, so recruiting decisions rest on real utilisation rather than an inflated shortage.
* Deploy before you recruit. Run an ABR-by-ABR diagnostic across the full roster, starting with the highest-hours group. Tag a root cause and a named owner for each, and work through the fixes with Operations Delivery, who own case assignment.
* Own the pipeline from offer to first live shift. Recruitment and HR source candidates; you own everything after: offer, licensing and credentialing, orientation and the first live shift. Set a time-to-first-read target and keep bringing it down.
* Credential to match demand. Credential against forecast demand, not whoever is next in the queue. Introduce a rule that each ABR agrees their hospital list before applications start. Set up a live credentialing feed into Scheduling, so a hospital approved on Monday can be scheduled on Tuesday.
* Run ABR experience and engagement. Give every ABR one point of contact and a set rhythm: a weekly pulse, a monthly review and a quarterly plan. Track every concern from intake to closure: acknowledge within 24 hours, and resolve operational and IT issues within 48–72 hours. Set up a real ABR satisfaction measure (an open item in the KPI framework today). Manage no-show rate and annualized attrition as leading indicators, not just reported numbers.
* Shape the ABR proposition: technology, terms and training. Be the ABR's voice wherever their working day is shaped.
* Technology first. Image load, dictation workflow, RADSpa friction and pre-read or AI support are the most common complaints. Sponsor a ranked fix list with the technology team, and a pre-read pilot with volunteer ABRs, measured in RVUs per hour.
* Training. Shape training and onboarding of new and existing ABRs
* Chair the shared ABR-capacity forum. Run forum that brings together scheduling decisions, credentialing status, assignment practice and utilisation data. Keep one shared tracker so every team sees gaps at the same time, and agree a clear escalation path.
* Build the leadership bench. Build a real management layer with succession depth as the roster and volume triple, and give new leaders the structure, tools and coaching to grow.

Candidate profile

* You have led a multi-team clinical or physician-workforce operation and have managed managers. Teleradiology, locum or physician staffing, hospital medical-staff services and similar clinician-supply settings all count.
* What matters is that you have been accountable for a panel of expert, independent clinicians: recruiting, credentialing and scheduling them, and keeping them productive and engaged.

You should be able to show

* A track record of growing and deploying a clinician or specialist panel, with real numbers on utilisation, time to onboard and attrition.
* Hands-on command of scheduling and capacity planning, including forecasting, no-show design, and choosing or implementing a scheduling platform.
* Comfort with credentialing and licensing in a regulated environment.
* Data fluency: you read utilisation, RVUs per hour and no-show data yourself and run the function by the numbers.
* Credibility with radiologists and other physicians. They trust you enough to be honest about why they are not showing up, and you can hold a hard conversation without it feeling punitive.
* The ability to lead through influence across functions you do not own (Operations Delivery, Technology, Finance), and to build a management layer beneath you.

Role Purpose
  
  
The Site Lead holds single-point accountability for the overall performance of the lab facility in Bangalore, spanning safety, technical integrity, operational delivery, financial performance and multi-party stakeholder governance. This is a senior leadership role requiring a genuine technical background sufficient to engage credibly with process, mechanical, electrical and instrumentation matters, while leading a cross-functional site team and managing complex interfaces across BP, JLL (as facilities/managing agent), the landlord/lessor, and specialist engineering partners.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Site Leadership & Governance**

* Act as the single point of accountability for HSSE, technical and operational performance of the Bangalore lab facility.
* Own and maintain the site's operational accountability model across Upstream, Downstream, clarifying ownership and reporting lines.
* Chair and lead cross-functional site governance forums, including risk, incident review and operational performance reviews.
* Represent the site to senior BP and JLL stakeholders, and act as primary escalation point for site-level issues.

**Technical Oversight**

* Maintain sufficient technical understanding of process, mechanical, electrical and I&C systems, and lab-specific infrastructure (compressed air, fume hoods, gas systems, oil sinks, gas detection) to challenge specialist partners and approve technical decisions.
* Own the boundary definitions between JLL/facilities-delivered scope, lab-operations scope, and specialist third-party scope, ensuring these remain current as the site matures.
* Sponsor engineering design review and sign-off processes for significant process, mechanical, electrical and I&C changes.

**Stakeholder & Contract Management**

* Manage the JLL managing-agent relationship, including oversight of facilities service delivery against agreed service levels.
* Oversee the landlord/lessor CAM (Common Area Maintenance) interface, including validation of service delivery and invoice review.
* Oversee contracts and performance of specialist engineering and technical partners engaged for scope outside core FM competency.
* Own escalation and resolution of service-level shortfalls across all delivery partners.

**Risk, Safety & Compliance Leadership**

* Hold executive-level ownership of the site risk register, ensuring appropriate mitigation plans are in place and reviewed.
* Chair incident review for significant events and ensure root-cause corrective actions are tracked to closure.
* Ensure Management of Change (MOC) and Control of Work governance is followed consistently across lab and workplace teams.
* Ensure statutory and regulatory compliance obligations for the site are met, engaging local regulatory expertise as required.

**Financial & Commercial Management**

* Own the site operating budget, including CAM charge validation and specialist/vendor contract spend approval.
* Review and approve major capital and operational expenditure proposals for the site.
* Ensure cost-effective delivery of services across all outsourced and managing-agent arrangements.

**People Leadership**

* Lead the site leadership team, including the Technical Manager, HSSE Manager and sub-regional/function leads.
* Manage team performance, capability development and succession planning.
* Foster a strong safety and performance culture across all site personnel and delivery partners.

Qualification & Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical, or related technical discipline) — essential.
* Master's degree or MBA in Engineering Management, Operations Management or Business Administration — preferred.

Certification & Licenses
  
  

* NEBOSH International General Certificate or Diploma (or equivalent HSE qualification) — desirable.
* PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent project/programme management certification — desirable.
* Relevant process safety management (PSM) training.
* Working familiarity with India statutory compliance frameworks (Factories Act, PESO) — desirable.

**Experience Required**

* 15+ years' experience in facilities, operations or site management within chemical, oil & gas, pharmaceutical or industrial laboratory environments.
* 5+ years in a senior site leadership role with full P&L or budget accountability.
* Demonstrated experience managing multi-stakeholder outsourced service delivery models, including managing-agent and landlord/CAM interfaces.
* Experience with facility or process-site commissioning, transition or start-up programmes.
* Track record of leading cross-functional teams through organisational or operational change

Technical Competencies
  
  

* Working knowledge of process safety management and high-hazard operations.
* Understanding of engineering design review and technical sign-off processes across multiple disciplines.
* Familiarity with CMMS platforms, Management of Change (MOC) systems and Control of Work / permit-to-work systems.
* Understanding of statutory and regulatory compliance frameworks relevant to industrial/laboratory facilities in India.

Leadership & Behavioural Competencies
  
  

* Strategic thinking with the ability to translate site-level objectives into operational execution.
* Executive-level stakeholder management and influencing skills across BP, JLL, landlord and specialist-partner boundaries.
* Strong decision-making under ambiguity, particularly during transition and go-live phases.
* Ability to hold technical and safety accountability while appropriately delegating execution to specialist leads.
* Skilled negotiator and conflict resolver across complex, multi-party commercial relationships.
* Change leadership capability to guide the site through transition into steady-state operations.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen

title: Senior Product Specialist Lead
description:
We are looking for an experienced
**Senior Product Specialist Lead**
to lead our Product Support function at Trupeer.

This role will own day-to-day support operations, manage a team of Product Specialists, and ensure exceptional customer experiences across our global customer base, including enterprise clients.

You will be responsible for building and managing a high-performing support team, establishing performance benchmarks, driving SLA adherence, and ensuring timely resolution of complex customer issues.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to translate customer challenges into actionable product improvements.

This is a hands-on leadership role that requires strong technical troubleshooting skills, proven people management capabilities, and experience delivering high-quality product support to enterprise customers in a fast-paced technology startup environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Team Leadership & Performance Management**

* Lead and manage a team of at least 5 Product Specialists operating across rotating shifts.
* Define team goals, performance metrics, and individual KPIs to drive productivity and service quality.
* Establish performance management frameworks covering SLA adherence, first-contact resolution, ticket resolution time, customer satisfaction, and overall support quality.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching sessions, and feedback discussions to improve individual and team performance.
* Manage shift schedules, workload distribution, weekend rotations, and team coverage across global time zones.
* Build a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement within the team.

**2. Enterprise Customer Support**

* Oversee high-touch product support for enterprise customers, ensuring timely and effective resolution of their queries and technical issues.
* Handle complex and escalated customer issues, acting as the primary point of contact when required.
* Ensure enterprise clients receive a consistently high standard of support, with clear communication and proactive follow-ups.
* Work closely with Customer Success and Account Management teams to address customer roadblocks and maintain customer satisfaction.
* Understand enterprise customer expectations around response times, issue resolution, product reliability, and service quality.

**3. Support Operations & SLA Management**

* Own daily support operations across email, live chat, and ticketing platforms.
* Ensure strict adherence to response and resolution SLAs across all operational shifts.
* Monitor support queues, ticket backlogs, escalations, and resolution trends.
* Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs) to improve support efficiency and consistency.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and implement processes to improve first-contact resolution and turnaround times.
* Ensure adequate support coverage across global time zones, including night shifts and scheduled weekends.

**4. Product & Technical Collaboration**

* Oversee the reproduction, documentation, and escalation of customer-reported bugs to Product and Engineering teams.
* Work with internal teams to prioritise critical customer issues and track them through resolution.
* Identify recurring customer pain points and share actionable insights with the product team.
* Ensure the team maintains updated troubleshooting guides, internal knowledge bases, FAQs, and customer-facing help documentation.
* Develop a strong understanding of Trupeer's product, features, workflows, and technical capabilities.

**Requirements**

* **Experience:**
  Minimum 3 years of experience in a Product Specialist Lead, Product Support Lead, or equivalent team leadership role.
* **Startup Experience:**
  Must have worked with a product-led technology startup, preferably a B2B SaaS company that builds and delivers software products to enterprise clients.
* **Team Management:**
  Proven experience managing a team of at least 5 Product Specialists or Technical Support Specialists.
* **Performance Management:**
  Experience defining KPIs, setting performance benchmarks, tracking individual performance, conducting reviews, and driving team productivity.
* **Enterprise Support:**
  Hands-on experience managing product support for enterprise customers, including complex queries, technical issues, and escalations.
* **Shift Management:**
  Experience managing teams across rotational morning, evening, and night shifts, including scheduled weekend rotations.
* **Technical Aptitude:**
  Strong troubleshooting skills across web applications, browser tools, APIs, integrations, and SaaS platform workflows.
* **Communication:**
  Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to handle enterprise stakeholders and explain technical solutions clearly.
* **Tools:**
  Experience with support platforms such as Zendesk, Intercom, or Freshdesk, and bug-tracking tools such as Jira or Linear.

**What Makes You a Good Fit?**

* You have worked in a fast-paced, product-led tech startup serving enterprise customers.
* You have built, managed, or scaled a team of Product Specialists.
* You know how to establish measurable performance standards and drive accountability.
* You understand the service expectations of enterprise customers and can manage critical escalations.
* You can balance people leadership with hands-on involvement in complex technical issues.
* You are comfortable collaborating with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to improve the overall customer experience.
* You enjoy building scalable processes and high-performing teams in a rapidly evolving environment.

title: Senior Lead Supply Chain Planning & Optimization
description:
Sandisk understands how people and businesses consume data and we relentlessly innovate to deliver solutions that enable today’s needs and tomorrow’s next big ideas. With a rich history of groundbreaking innovations in Flash and advanced memory technologies, our solutions have become the beating heart of the digital world we’re living in and that we have the power to shape.
  
  
Sandisk meets people and businesses at the intersection of their aspirations and the moment, enabling them to keep moving and pushing possibility forward. We do this through the balance of our powerhouse manufacturing capabilities and our industry-leading portfolio of products that are recognized globally for innovation, performance and quality.
  
  
Sandisk has two facilities recognized by the World Economic Forum as part of the Global Lighthouse Network for advanced 4IR innovations. These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthouses for breakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world moving forward.
  
  
**Description**
We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Senior Lead, Supply Chain Digital Transformation to lead the design, implementation, and continuous evolution of our next-generation supply chain planning capabilities. In this role, you will drive large-scale digital transformation initiatives across the end-to-end supply chain, leveraging advanced planning technologies including Blue Yonder Enterprise Supply Planning (ESP) and related analytics platforms. You will partner with business leaders, operations teams, IT, and executive stakeholders to modernize planning processes, improve decision-making, and deliver measurable business outcomes. The ideal candidate brings a strong combination of supply chain domain expertise, planning system leadership, solution architecture experience, and program management capabilities. This individual will play a key role in transforming how the organization plans demand, supply, inventory, capacity, and factory operations in an increasingly dynamic business environment.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Drive end-to-end supply chain transformation initiatives from concept through deployment, including: Business discovery, Process assessment, Requirements definition, Solution design, testing, User adoption
* Serve as the functional owner and subject matter expert for Blue Yonder ESP planning solutions.
* Design and implement scalable planning capabilities supporting: Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Capacity Planning, Inventory Optimization, Factory Planning and Execution
* Drive continuous enhancement of planning processes, models, and system capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to improve planning performance through process automation, advanced analytics, and digital technologies.
* Lead evaluation and implementation of innovative planning capabilities and best practices.
* Drive standardization and simplification of processes across global operations.
* Manage multiple concurrent projects and transformation workstreams across global teams.
* Manage relationships with key stakeholders and management teams across operations, business units, finance, engineering etc.
* Data analysis and development of supply chain policies to meet overall business objectives - and not have any local sub optimization
* Work closely with IT on designing and developing planning systems.

**Qualifications**

* Master / Bachelor degree in Industrial engineering / Supply Chain with 10+ years of experience implementing and supporting Supply Chain Planning solutions with a focus on Blue Yonder (JDA) ESP product.
* Extensive experience leading large-scale enterprise transformation programs.
* Experience with MEIO is an added advantage.
* In-depth knowledge of supply chain management processes and best practices.
* Proficiency in configuring and customizing Blue Yonder ESP module.
* Experience with databases, PL/SQL, system integrations, and software development lifecycle methodologies.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Blue Yonder ESP certification(s) preferred

This role sits at the intersection of supply chain strategy, digital transformation, and advanced planning technology. You will help shape the future of supply chain planning by enabling smarter decisions, improving operational agility, and building the digital foundation required to support growth and business resilience
  
  
Additional Information
  
  
Sandisk thrives on the power and potential of diversity. As a global company, we believe the most effective way to embrace the diversity of our customers and communities is to mirror it from within. We believe the fusion of various perspectives results in the best outcomes for our employees, our company, our customers, and the world around us. We are committed to an inclusive environment where every individual can thrive through a sense of belonging, respect and contribution.

In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

title: Travel & Mobility Manager (Global)
description:
Founded in 2014, Circles is a global technology company reimagining the telco industry with its innovative SaaS platform, empowering telco operators worldwide to effortlessly launch innovative digital brands or refresh existing ones, accelerating their transformation into techcos.
  
  
Today, Circles partners with leading telco operators across multiple countries and continents, including KDDI Corporation, Etisalat Group (e&), AT&T, and Telkomsel, creating blueprints for future telco and digital experiences enjoyed by millions of consumers globally.
  
  
Besides its SaaS business, Circles operates three other distinct businesses:
  
  

* Circles.Life: A wholly-owned digital lifestyle telco brand based in Singapore, Circles.Life is powered by Circles’ SaaS platform and pioneering go-to-market strategies. It is the digital market leader in Singapore and has won numerous awards for marketing, customer service, and innovative product offerings beyond connectivity.
* Circles Aspire: A global provider of Communications Platform-as-a-Service (CPaaS) solutions. Its cloud-based Experience Cloud platform enables enterprises, service providers and developers to deliver and scale mobile, messaging, IoT, and connectivity services worldwide.
* Jetpac: Specializing in travel tech solutions, Jetpac provides seamless eSIM roaming for over 200 destinations and innovative travel lifestyle products, redefining connectivity for digital travelers. Jetpac was awarded Travel eSIM of the Year.

Circles is backed by renowned global investors, including Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia), Warburg Pincus, Founders Fund, and EDBI (the investment arm of the Singapore Economic Development Board), with a track record of backing industry challengers.
  
  
**About The Role**
That travel needs an owner. As Travel & Mobility Manager you run travel and mobility for the whole of Circles: every country we operate in, and every country our travellers go to. You sit in Bangalore. Your remit is global.
  
  
One day you are negotiating an airline deal or a hotel programme. The next you are getting a visa over the line, walking Finance through where the travel budget is going, or rerouting a traveller stranded mid-trip.
  
  
Outside Circles, you work through a network of partners: our travel management company (TMC), airlines, hotels, visa agencies and insurers. You choose them, manage them and hold them to their service levels.
  
  
Inside Circles, you do not work alone. Finance is your partner on budgets, spend and savings. People Operations, the People Business Partners and the wider People team are your partners on policy, visas and relocations. Travellers and their managers turn to you as the expert.
  
  
This is not a booking desk. It is a global programme to shape and own, at a company that keeps adding countries.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Run the travel programme**

* Own the TMC partnership: the commercial relationship, service levels, performance reviews and a voice in their roadmap.
* Run the TMC's booking platform so it works for travellers in every country: policy set-up, approval flows, users, integrations and adoption.
* Shape the global travel policy with Finance and People leadership, enforce it, and change it when the business changes.
* Make the programme easy to use, with clear guidance and training for travellers, bookers and approvers.
* Get the travel programme ready for each new location before the first person lands.

**Get us better deals**

* Build preferred hotel programmes in the cities we visit most: tenders, rate negotiation and audits.
* Negotiate airline agreements on our key routes, then hold carriers to what they promised.
* Manage ground transport and every other travel supplier against clear service levels.
* Review suppliers regularly and renegotiate when the value slips.

**Show Us What The Numbers Say**

* Produce monthly reporting that People and Finance leaders actually read: spend, booking behaviour, policy compliance and supplier performance.
* Track travel spend against budget and flag problems early.
* Turn travel data into insight and clear recommendations.
* Find the savings, lead the cost-efficiency initiatives and prove what they delivered.

**Work hand in hand with Finance and People**

* Partner with Finance on travel budgets and forecasts, expense rules, supplier payments and reconciliation, so travel spend is planned and never a surprise.
* Agree savings targets with Finance, then report progress against them.
* Work with People Operations and the People Business Partners on visas, work permits, relocations and policy exceptions.
* Keep Finance and People leaders ahead of the news: what is changing in travel, what it will cost and what you recommend.

**Get travellers across borders**

* Own visas for our travellers end to end. Manage the visa agencies and immigration counsel so applications are filed on time and fully compliant. You direct the work rather than process the paperwork yourself.
* Know the visa and work permit routes for our key corridors: Singapore (Employment Pass, S Pass), the UAE (work, Golden and mission visas), Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Morocco, India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Japan and the US (H-1B, L-1, B-1/B-2, ESTA).
* Advise travellers and managers on documents, eligibility and realistic lead times before a trip is booked, not after.
* Keep one central tracker of visas and work permits across every Circles entity, so renewals never slip and nobody gets stuck at a border.

**Keep travellers safe**

* Own traveller safety: assess the risk, know where our travellers are, and lead the response when things go wrong.
* Brief travellers before they head to higher-risk destinations.
* Manage travel insurance, from renewals and the insurer relationship to supporting claims.

**Be the person travellers trust**

* Take on the complex bookings: multi-country itineraries, group travel and executive trips.
* Be the escalation point when a trip goes sideways: a cancelled flight, an emergency reroute, a supplier that has let someone down. Fix it fast, then fix the cause.
* Ask travellers how their trips went, and act on what they tell you.

**Support relocations**

* Support relocation cases in partnership with People Operations, including work permits.
* Coordinate our relocation vendors (movers, temporary housing, destination services) and work with the People Business Partners on packages and allowances.

**What You Bring**

* You have run corporate travel as a travel manager in a multinational, across multiple countries.
* You have worked with TMCs and managed booking platforms such as TravelPerk, Navan or Egencia, alongside travel expense tools. The platform experience is non-negotiable.
* You have built hotel programmes and negotiated with airlines.
* You have a track record of managing travel and visa vendors against clear service levels.
* You have partnered closely with Finance on travel budgets, reporting and savings.
* You can turn travel data into insight and management information that leaders use.
* You have driven cost-efficiency initiatives and can show the results.
* You know visa and work authorisation frameworks first hand across the UAE and wider Middle East, India, the US and Asia.
* You have supported relocation cases alongside a People or HR team.
* Ideally, you have worked in a fast-moving, multi-entity company spanning APAC, the Middle East, Europe and North America.

**How You Work**

* You build strong working relationships across functions, especially with Finance and People colleagues.
* You communicate clearly and with empathy in written and spoken English, and can explain a complex visa process to anyone, from a new hire to an executive.
* You are service focused and you care about the traveller experience, especially when a trip goes wrong.
* You are comfortable working across cultures and time zones, because your travellers can be anywhere.
* You negotiate commercially and balance cost against what travellers need.
* You stay calm and decisive under pressure.
* You are organised and precise, particularly on immigration compliance and deadlines.
* You treat passports, visa documents and personal data with strict confidentiality.

Circles is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, disability or age.
  
  
**Data Protection and Privacy Statement**
By submitting an application for this position, you, as the applicant, or your authorised representative(s), consent to
**Circles’ Candidate Data Protection and Privacy Policy.**
You also agree to the collection, use, and/or disclosure of your personal data by us solely for recruitment purposes as specified in the Policy. You acknowledge that you have read and understood the Policy, are aware of your rights regarding your personal data, and accept the terms relating to international data transfers, where applicable. You further understand that you may withdraw consent at any time, which may affect our ability to consider your application. In instances where your personal data or application is submitted by a third party, it is understood that such third party has been duly authorised by you to disclose the relevant personal data and provide consent on your behalf, and that you have been made aware of this Policy.
  
  
To all recruitment agencies: Circles will only acknowledge resumes shared by recruitment agencies if selected in our preferred supplier partnership program.
  
  
Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Circles, employees or any other company location. Circles will not be held accountable for any fees related to unsolicited resumes not uploaded via our ATS.

title: Control Manager - Vice President
description:
**Job Description**
JPMorgan Chase & Co. (NYSE: JPM) is a leading global financial services firm with assets of $2 trillion and operations in more than 60 countries. The firm is a leader in investment banking, financial services for consumers, small business and commercial banking, financial transaction processing, asset management, and private equity.
  
  
The Client Onboarding and Documentation (CO&D) program is a cross-business program focused on building a global platform to streamline the Client On-boarding and Documentation process. This transformation program's goal is to implement a standardized and consistent Client on-boarding approach across J.P. Morgan Chase Corporate & Investment Bank (CIB) in order to deliver a best in class client experience. It comprises of 2 specific groups viz. WKO (Wholesale KYC Operations), DDS (Digital Document Services Operations).
  
  
CO&D is supported by Operations Control Management (OCM) team whose role is to develop and manage a Control Program in each region that identifies and monitors significant risks and ensures compliance with operational policies, control procedures and legal/regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Job Description**
Client Onboarding & Documentation (CO&D) Exam Management is responsible for managing several engagements (e.g. Regulatory Exams, Regulatory Reporting, Internal/External Audits and Compliance Monitoring and Testing activities) and special projects globally for Wholesale KYC Operations (WKO), Digital Document Services Operations (DDS), and the firm wide KYC Quality Assurance (QA) Program. This position manages a caseload of KYC, DDS Engagements as well as regulatory reporting activities in adherence to protocols established for pre-exam preparation, on-site facilitation, post exam processes and regulatory requests. Key responsibilities include Engagement coordination, requesting and reviewing materials/data procurement, management reporting, request intake and issue identification. This position will also utilize subject matter expertise to develop written responses to Engagement requests.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Effectively manage a caseload of Engagements (primarily WKO with opportunities in DD, and KYC QA) including regulatory examinations, internal audits, external audits and Compliance tests and monitoring activities.
* Develop a cohesive and effective partnership with Senior Business leaders, LOB Compliance teams, local and regional onboarding and banking teams, Oversight and Controls, Legal, Internal Audit and Operations.
* Review requests for information from examiners, auditors and testers, and in a timely and effective manner, prepare written responses, or coordinate with subject matter experts to collect, review and submit responses. This includes adequately explaining why there is no issue and communicating to applicable stakeholders of any potential issues.
* Manage the entire lifecycle of Engagements (planning, fieldwork and reporting).
* Understand and become familiar with the various data sources, platforms and tools including the flow of data from source systems.
* Provide strategic, clear, and regular updates and key messages to management regarding significant matters, including potential issues requiring timely escalation and resolution.
* Ensure all issues and concerns highlighted during the Engagement, including those not included on the final report, are reviewed and addressed. Also partner with applicable Action Plan owners and Control Managers to develop and complete test steps to address root cause of the issue.
* Influence and drive change in functional areas outside of the individual's direct control.
* Perform ad-hoc project work as identified such as SMARTE (CO&D Exam Management Application) development/enhancement and other MIS data requests.
* Synthesize large amount of information efficiently and effectively into clear and concise messages to be relayed to key stakeholders
* Work to tight deadlines and deliver in a very aggressive schedule.
* Ability to perform process deep dives / control reviews. Summarise findings and present to senior management and operations for further action
* Program manage implementation of action plans arising from issues. Engage with various stakeholders across operations to come up with right solutions that are sustainable and addresses the risk and ensure implementation within the timelines

**Knowledge/Skills**

* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with fluid regulatory and business requirements.
* Strong presentation, communication and investigative skills.
* Excellent time management, organizational, and planning skills along with ability to handle multiple assignments at the same time. Solid judgment along with the ability to evaluate complex KYC, DDS and/or data issues.
* Knowledge of Operational management concepts; ability to understand and interpret the impact of policy and procedural changes, as well as identify and convey potential problem areas. Eye for details.
* Action-oriented and effective listening skills.
* Experienced and comfortable working with databases, familiarity with database concepts and language. Ability to work with large data sets.
* Ability to review documentation and provide executive summary overviews and trend analysis.

title: Program Head
description:
**Dimension of Job**
**:**
Program Management at Tenneco Powertrain (PT) shall embody the part of the organization that drives Customer Programs towards successful production implementation. The Program Manager (PM) is responsible as a “mini–General Manager” for each program, responsible for the overall success, financial health and strategic relevance of the program within the plant and business portfolio. The PM assumes ownership for the project and leads through influence. PMs shall act and communicate transparently about all project matters and facilitate Teamwork across disciplines and functions. This Job Description shall apply for Program Managers in Tenneco Powertrain on a global basis in all regions to help harmonize the global project management approach.
  
  
**Major Role of the Position**
**:**
**Project Management**

* Project Leadership within the guidelines of the Customer Application Program PT (CAP-PT)’s phased gate review
* process as well as customer and industry standards (IATF 16949, VDA RGA, APQP, ANPQP, etc.).
* Ensure Customer (Specific) Requirements are fully understood, business relevant implications vs. Tenneco

specifications and capabilities are considered, and exceptions/deviations are documented and communicated / escalated as needed.
  
  

* Align team and stakeholders at the start of the project via the Kick-off meeting.
* Drive timely cross-functional data gathering to support the quote process.
* Drive completion of project feasibility assessments throughout the project, including stakeholder alignment.
* Monitor and drive Project financial health throughout the project life cycle, to ensure project profitability.
* Clear, consistent, and timely communication with all members of the team, and stakeholders on project status and progress.
* Lead weekly project meetings including oversight of open issues and all action plans.
* Timely and / or proactive escalation to Plant Management and/or Sr. Leadership in case of project critical status.
* Conduct gate reviews, and close out project at Gate 5 after successful Safe Launch period.
* Accountable for the completeness of project related documents.
* Creation and monitoring of project timing plans (incl. who, what and when, as well as customer milestones), and timely communication of progress to customer and internal stakeholders.
* Conduct proactive Project risk assessment and management, and implementation of risk mitigation measures.
* Clearly evaluate and document lessons learned throughout the project lifecycle.
* Work closely with all functional team members to drive accountability for related project work packages.
* Ensure reception of materials, tools etc. for sample and pre-production builds in accordance with specifications and agreed timing.
* Trigger and follow-up on project related tool ordering, tool making, sample and PPAP production (including raw
* material and equipment) through submission to the customer.
* Coordinate manufacturing and supply requirements between plant functions and customer receiving facilities with respect to specific program needs.
* Manage project prioritization within the scope of given tasks and communicate to the relevant stakeholders.
* Leadership of change management in the scope of the projects. Activate the change management process and
* consider the effect of changes on cost, quality and timing with approval of the project team and appropriate stakeholders.
* Ensure the completion of project objectives such as profitability, costs, technical targets, adherence to technical specifications from the statement of requirements, timing and milestones (Prototypes, off tool parts, PPAP-parts, SOP).
* Support of the organization for audits (IATF 16949, customer specific audits, etc.).

**Business Support Process**

* Be the go-to person in the plant for any project management related matters.
* Support the project team members in the application of project management tools and software.
* Provide first line of support for users of the project management system in the plant.
* Coordinate programs across other Tenneco manufacturing sites, in the case that the project is a lead project of a wider program (other products, sub-assemblies or dual validation programs) within the organization.

**Skills Profile**
**:**

* Qualification & Experience:
* A successfully completed academic education degree in Engineering or similar.
* 15 years of experience, ideally within the automotive industry.
* Knowledge and experience in Project Management methodologies, tools and techniques.

**Specialized Skills /Knowledge:**

* Leadership through influence - ability to inspire and motivate team to contribute, creating vision to achieve goals.
* Good business understanding (Profit and Loss, Investment, financial performance indicators, etc.)
* Attention to detail.
* Goal oriented and result based thinking.
* Excellent command of English and the local language in oral and written.
* Exceptional knowledge of product development processes (such as IATF 16949, APQP, VDA).
* Awareness of Engineering and Quality tools such as FMEA, validation plans (DVP&R), 8D, Fishbone, FTA etc.
* Excellent communication skills, written and oral, to all levels of the organization (internal as well as with customers and suppliers).
* Ability to train others in business processes and systems.
* Thorough knowledge of Project Management systems and tools and good understanding of Product Lifecycle
* Management (PLM).

**Additional Requirements:**

* Mobility / Willingness to travel regularly and on short notice.
* High personal identification with the company, the product and the customer landscape.
* Exceptional capability to lead conversations, hold presentations and facilitate discussions.
* Support the company’s core values.

title: Product Support Operations, Team Lead
description:
Who we are
  
  
**About Stripe**
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
  
  
**About The Team**
As Stripe’s user base and global footprint grows dramatically, we have distinctly unique support problems resulting from both our type of scale and the type of businesses we partner with. The Stripe Delivery Center (SDC) strategy will provide operational leverage and expand Stripe’s portfolio of operational capabilities to support the scaled needs for external users and internal Stripe teams. We strive to deliver frictionless experiences for all of our users, whether they are an Independent Business, Startup, SMB, or Enterprise and our mission is to provide all Stripe Users with the best support experience possible.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
In this role, you will act in a player-coach capacity and will be accountable for supporting a team of Operations Associates. This team is responsible for resolving our users’ most challenging and impactful issues, providing exceptional user experience, and contributing to the overall user satisfaction.
  
  
To be a fit, you will have a coaching mindset, proven ability to communicate at different levels, a track record of driving operational performance, possess a deep expertise in customer service, and a passion for inspiring a team to deliver an incredible user experience.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Guide your team in troubleshooting and solving external user issues
* Manage the operational performance of your team to deliver KPIs
* Help scale our operations and improve user experience by identifying process improvements
* Manage capacity and scheduling, dividing and assigning work between team members
* Ensure your team has all the skills and resources needed to be successful in their role
* Set clear goals and expectations for individual and team performance
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement to refine team processes and procedures
* Support recruitment and hiring initiatives
* Coach and mentor individuals to meet career goals via structured career development conversations
* Provide continuous performance feedback and facilitate periodic formal performance reviews
* Drive and own initiatives that make the team a warm and welcoming place to work
* Keep the team engaged and motivated towards their work

Who you are
  
  
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements**

* 5+ years of experience coaching/leading Customer Service teams and managing performance
* Experience mentoring and providing constructive feedback to others
* Experience in delivering weekly and monthly business metrics and reporting
* Proven ability to be a subject matter expert in Customer Service
* Ability to work cross functionally to deliver best results and promote partnership
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Exemplary planning and time management skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience launching new processes and driving continuous improvement.
* AI Fluency: with practical experience using AI tools to support day-to-day work and critically evaluate their outputs.

In-office expectations
  
  
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
  
  
Pay and benefits
  
  
Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
  
  
We look forward to hearing from you.
  
  
At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
  
  
Apply now

title: Sr. Manager, Customer Experience
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
  
  
Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
  
  
**Introduction to team**
This role sits on the Traveler Operations team within the Traveler & Partner Services Platform (TPSP) organization. You will oversee Expedia Group's external contact center vendors so they operate efficiently, follow company policy, and follow defined customer processes. The team owns how our vendor partners perform for travelers across voice, chat, and back office channels, and works with product, policy, and knowledge teams to fix what drives travelers to contact us again. Your work improves the customer experience and supports top operational performance.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Oversee a multi-site network of external contact center vendors to promote operational efficiency, policy compliance, and adherence to defined customer processes
* Own vendor performance against key metrics such as resolution, handle time, customer satisfaction, quality, and service levels, find what drives changes in results, and agree remediation plans with vendor leadership
* Build working relationships with stakeholders, vendors, leaders, and business partners, and act as a trusted advisor who recommends solutions to meet business needs, reaches agreements that create value for all parties, and holds vendors accountable for agreed service levels and commitments
* Review data and customer interactions (calls, chats, and cases) to find the root cause of problems, measure customer and employee satisfaction and program effectiveness, and propose key performance indicators and recommendations that drive action, using analytics, automation, and AI tools to scale the work
* Act as the escalation point for customer and vendor issues, lead the vendor response to service disruptions, and work with product, policy, and knowledge teams to prioritize fixes to tools, processes, and policies
* Identify, size, and deliver efficiency and cost-saving opportunities, and partner with workforce planning and finance on forecasts, capacity, and targets
* Lead or take part in cross-functional projects by aligning timelines and milestones, spotting resourcing gaps, and adjusting plans to keep work on track, including getting vendor teams trained and ready when new processes, policies, or tools launch
* Prepare and present regular business reviews to senior leaders and vendor leadership, turning performance data into clear actions
* Apply knowledge of standard contract terms and conditions to answer vendor questions, validate compliance and invoice reconciliation so bills are processed on time, and advise on quarterly and yearly budgets
* Lead, coach, and develop team members and vendor leaders to improve performance, and implement improvements to the quality of products, services, and processes

**Experience And Qualifications**

* You have a bachelor's or master's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management or related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience
* You have at least 8 years of relevant experience in vendor management or contact center operations with a bachelor's degree, or at least 6 years with a master's degree, including at least 3 years leading people or teams
* You have an in-depth understanding of vendor management processes, policies, and tools, including managing outsourced (BPO) partners across multiple sites or regions
* You have knowledge of contact center technologies and keep current with changes in the contact center industry
* You think analytically, solve problems effectively, and use key performance indicators to draw conclusions about trends, and you are comfortable working with large data sets in tools such as Excel, SQL, or BI dashboards
* You are proficient in written and spoken communication, pay close attention to detail, and stay well organized, and you can present clearly to senior leaders and influence partners where you have no direct authority.
* It's a plus if you have experience in travel or e-commerce customer service, or with automation and AI tools in an operations setting.

**Accommodation requests**
Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation.
  
  
**About Expedia Group**
Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.
  
  
**Important notice**
Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity**
Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

title: Team Manager, Technical Support (Hybrid)
description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.
  
  
As a Team Manager, Technical Support you will be directly responsible for managing and mentoring a team of globally distributed professionals in providing exceptional customer support experiences. This position manages the day-to-day operations of the team and works closely with other Support leaders to ensure the team is hitting its targets. Responsibilities include coaching and developing individuals within the team in their roles as product experts and participating in improvement efforts across Support. The successful candidate will be experienced (3+ years) in leading and developing a Support team within a Software as a Service environment.
  
  
At Smartsheet Support we empathize and empower others with expert engagements and are the first line of response for our customers to fix issues, share best practices, and advocate for users. Our teams of experts are aligned to various domains of knowledge, promoting the most effective and expedient customer resolution.
  
  
You will report to a Sr Support Manager within the Global Support team.
  
  
Estimated Breakdown: Core responsibility distribution may change depending on business and customer need but in general fall around:
  
  

* 70% People management, career development & coaching
* 30% Operations: Provide oversight, case/queue management & insights of the day-to-day operations of your team, owning and driving towards meeting KPIs/SLAs

**You Will**

* Manage & lead a team of globally distributed technical support professionals to provide enterprise-level, post-sales technical support to Smartsheet customers. Teams will be comprised of members with varying levels of technical expertise and tenure
* Set clear objectives, coach & provide feedback, evaluate progress, and instill a high performance culture with focus on teamwork, customer excellence, and ownership for resolving customer issues
* Own and drive performance and customer outcomes through the delivery of SLAs and KPIs
* Leverage the strengths of your team to maintain case volume, reduce backlog, and deliver improvements to Support experiences
* Analyze and interpret KPI metrics, customer feedback, to identify trends and make recommendations for improving efficiencies
* Execute to meet targets of strategic goals set by Support Leadership
* Perform regular case reviews and quality assessments of your team
* Actively engage in the release readiness process and assist with evaluating new features and changes
* Create a culture of inclusivity, recognizing the strengths that individuals bring to the team to promote engagement and development opportunities
* Recruit to business needs, alongside recruitment partners, shaping and iterating to ensure the quality of talent attracted
* Partner with the Training team, as applicable, aligning on onboarding and assessment objectives and programs, through feedback and effective communication whilst sharing any skill gaps
* Promote continuous improvements through recognition and feedback within the team
* Effectively partner across the global Support organization and other stakeholders to drive initiatives, share ideas, and model team collaboration
* Other duties as assigned

**You Have**

* 3+ years of prior people management or equivalent experience in mentoring, managing, or providing feedback to individual contributors

title: Associate Director, Threat Exposure Management & CD Business Operations
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
The Associate Director, Threat Exposure Management will lead a defined area of the Threat Exposure Management capability and the team or programme that delivers it. This is a leadership role accountable for a defined area of the capability.
  
  
**About the team**
:
  
  
Threat Exposure Management maintains a continuous, prioritised view of where GSK is exposed, spanning vulnerabilities, attack surface, configuration drift and control coverage. The team also runs the business operations of the Cyber Defense function, keeping its planning, reporting and delivery rhythm on track.
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**
This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:
  
  

* Lead a defined area of the capability, including its people, delivery and outcomes.
* Manage delivery against the capability roadmap and escalate blockers early.
* Develop team capability through coaching, review and structured feedback.
* Represent the area in CSO governance and cross-functional forums.
* Maintain a continuous view of GSK's threat exposure across vulnerabilities, external attack surface, configuration drift and control coverage.
* Prioritise exposure using exploitability, asset criticality and business impact rather than raw severity scores.
* Operate exposure and vulnerability tooling, including coverage assurance and data quality.
* Track remediation against agreed service levels and escalate where it slips.
* Manage the exception and risk acceptance process with documented residual risk.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Degree in a relevant discipline, or related experience.
* Demonstrated experience in vulnerability or exposure management.
* Working knowledge of risk-based prioritisation of technical findings.
* Practical experience with operational reporting and process improvement.
* Significant experience in cyber security within the relevant domain.
* Proven experience leading a team or a substantial programme of work.
* Experience managing delivery to plan, quality and timelines.
* Excellent relationship management, influencing and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with continuous threat exposure management practice.
* Experience with enterprise vulnerability and attack surface tooling.
* Familiarity with EPSS and the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalogue.
* Data visualization skill in Power BI.
* Relevant certification such as CISSP, CompTIA Security+, GIAC, CRISC.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences or another highly regulated industry.
* Typical tools and technologies: Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, external attack surface management tooling, CSPM, ServiceNow, Power BI.

#AGTech
  
  
**Skills**
AI for Cybersecurity, AI Observability, Cloud Security, CrowdStrike Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM), Cyber Threat Intelligence, Electronic Performance Support Systems (EPSS), Enterprise Modeling, Enterprise Technologies, Forensic Data Analysis, Incident Management, Infrastructure Security, Intrusion Detection, Intrusion Prevention, ML Security, Offensive Cyber Operations, Security Monitoring, Security Operations, Security Planning, Security Protocols, Security Risk, Security Technologies
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

title: Lean Section Manager
description:
****Career Area:****
Manufacturing
  
  
****Job Description:****
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
****Role Definition:****
Oversees and coordinates the activities of the production line, prepares schedules, resolves issues, and ensures adherence to safety and quality standards.
  
  
****Responsibilities:****

* Creating reports and records of production processes, tools issues performance, and inventory; sharing them with managers and providing suggestions to improve safety, productivity and quality.
* Preparing, maintaining, and updating documentation related to operating procedures and safety and quality standards; ensuring all processes and products meet desired safety and quality standards.
* Supervising and directing the daily activities of production lines workers, assigning tasks, ensuring coordination between different teams, ensuring their safety and monitoring their performance.
* Hands-on experience in Lean Manufacturing techniques and advanced manufacturing platforms supporting genset assembly and testing operations
* Training new hires, managing scheduling and work conflicts, monitoring safety, and promoting internal communication to create a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.

**Degree Requirement:**
Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent experience desired
  
  
****Skill Descriptors:****
Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
* Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
* Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
* Helps to analyse risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.
* Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

Data Gathering & Analysis: Knowledge of data gathering and analysis tools, techniques, and processes; ability to collect and synthesize data from a variety of stakeholders and sources in an objective manner to reach a conclusion, goal, or judgment.
  
  
**Level Basic Understanding:**

* Describes alternative data-gathering techniques and tools.
* Documents basic data-gathering methodologies.
* Identifies the purposes of data gathering and analysis.
* Identifies key objectives in gathering and analyzing data.

Performance Management: Knowledge of successful performance management techniques; ability to apply organization's performance management system, practices, and tools to developing and improving individual, team, and organizational performance.
  
  
**Level Basic Understanding:**

* Demonstrates an understanding of performance management concepts.
* Describes organization's performance management process.
* Explains organization's core performance factors and ratings.
* Participates in own performance review or performance checkpoint session.

Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Approaches a situation or problem by defining the problem or issue and determining its significance.
* Makes a systematic comparison of two or more alternative solutions.
* Uses flow charts, Pareto charts, fish diagrams, etc. to disclose meaningful data patterns.
* Identifies the major forces, events, and people impacting and impacted by the situation at hand.
* Uses logic and intuition to make inferences about the meaning of the data and arrive at conclusions.

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.
  
  
**Level Basic Understanding:**

* Explains characteristics and steps in an effective decision-making process.
* Identifies issues and communicates with others when a decision needs to be made.
* Names decision makers in own environment and cites examples of past decisions.
* Describes types of decisions incumbent may and may not make in own job or function.

Planning and Organizing: Knowledge of the process of planning and arranging tasks and resources; ability to plan and organize both time and resources to get things completed while structuring and maintaining work in a systematic and highly methodical way.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Raises awareness of potential bottlenecks and disruptions to the schedule.
* Breaks tasks into manageable steps that can be incorporated into a personal work plan.
* Escalates concerns over competing or conflicting priorities.
* Monitors progress continuously and adjusts tactics for handling situations on a case by case basis.
* Creates action plans that ensure the accomplishment of responsibilities.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
  
  
**Level Basic Understanding:**

* Describes non-verbal behaviors that influence the interpretation of the message.
* Cites examples of effective and ineffective communications.
* Explains the importance of effective business communication.
* Speaks/writes using correct language, mechanics, and gestures.

Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision.
  
  
**Level Basic Understanding:**

* Explains the importance of accuracy in own function or unit.
* Identifies tasks or outputs that require accuracy and detail-level attention.
* Identifies the procedures for making sure that results are mistake-free.
* Describes consequences of errors within own unit or function.

**Additional information:**
This job required 5working days from office

It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as an exhaustive summary of all responsibilities, duties and effort required of employees assigned to this job. At the discretion of management, this description may be changed at any time to address the evolving needs of the organization. It is expressly not intended to be a comprehensive list of “essential job functions” as that term is defined by the Americans with Disabilities Act."
  
  
This position requires working onsite five days a week.
  
  
Relocation is available for this position.

title: Director, Talent Acquisition, Operations
description:
**Director, Talent Acquisition, Operations**

**Location:** Bengaluru, India  
**Reporting to:** Global Head of Talent Acquisition

  

**About the Role**

LSEG is seeking a Talent Acquisition leader to lead global hiring for our Operations organisation.

Leading a global team of approximately 20 Talent Acquisition professionals and supporting around 2,000 hires annually, this role oversees one of LSEG’s largest and most operationally complex talent portfolios.

The current portfolio combines significant scale with a strong internal mobility agenda. Approximately 50% of hiring is internal and 50% external, with the majority of activity taking place at Associate or Senior Associate level.

The portfolio is concentrated in major global delivery locations with c55% of volume in India, c25% in the Philippines, and c10% in Poland.

Partnering closely with Operations, People and business leaders, the Director, Talent Acquisition, Operations will deliver outcomes across three strategic priorities: Quality, Speed and Insight. Beyond recruitment delivery, the role acts as a strategic advisor, using talent intelligence, workforce insight and labour-market expertise to influence hiring, skills, location and resourcing decisions.

The portfolio will continue to evolve as technology, automation and AI reshape work and skills requirements. The successful candidate will help Operations anticipate this shift, balancing current delivery at scale with increasing demand for more specialised, analytical, transformation-oriented and senior talent. The role will also maximise opportunities for internal talent movement and career progression.

The successful candidate will be a key member of the Global Talent Acquisition Leadership Team, contributing to enterprise-wide Talent Acquisition strategy, transformation priorities and the continued evolution of LSEG’s hiring capabilities.

**Scope**

* Global responsibility for Operations Talent Acquisition.
* Leadership of c20 Talent Acquisition professionals across multiple locations.
* Delivery of approximately 2,000 hires annually.
* Accountability for hiring across operational, change, transformation, controls, specialist and leadership disciplines up to Director level.
* Member of the Global Talent Acquisition Leadership Team, helping shape enterprise Talent Acquisition strategy and priorities.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Strategic Talent Partner
* Develop and implement Talent Acquisition strategies aligned to Operations workforce requirements, location strategy and business priorities.
* Partner with Operations and People leaders to shape workforce plans, anticipate how skills and role requirements will evolve, and address emerging capability gaps.
* Act as a trusted advisor, providing market insight, talent intelligence and data-driven recommendations that improve workforce, location and hiring decisions.
* Help leaders balance external recruitment, internal mobility, capability building and workforce redeployment as the composition of demand changes.
* Hiring Delivery and Performance
* Own end-to-end hiring outcomes for the Operations portfolio, balancing quality, speed, candidate experience and cost.
* Create clear portfolio priorities, service expectations and performance rhythms that translate demand into executable hiring plans.
* Use data to identify demand, capacity, conversion, ageing and location risks, intervening early to improve outcomes.
* Differentiate hiring approaches by segment, combining scalable delivery for recurring demand with specialist-led and advisory models for more complex and senior roles.
* Accelerate internal mobility by improving visibility of opportunities and enabling effective movement of talent across the organisation.

**Leadership and Capability**

* Lead, develop and hold accountable a globally distributed Talent Acquisition team, creating clarity of purpose, priorities and performance expectations.
* Evolve the team’s capability as the portfolio shifts from predominantly high-volume hiring towards more complex, specialist and senior requirements.
* Build an impactful, inclusive team with strong business knowledge, market expertise, commercial judgement and advisory capability.
* Ensure the team deploys capacity flexibly against business priorities and operates effectively across locations and time zones.

**Transformation and Enterprise Contribution**

* Champion consistent, technology-enabled and insight-led hiring practices across the portfolio.
* Use automation and AI-assisted workflows to improve scalability, quality and speed, with appropriate human oversight and governance.
* Help reshape the Talent Acquisition service as workforce demand evolves, ensuring recruiter capacity is increasingly focused on higher-value, complex and advisory work.
* Contribute to enterprise Talent Acquisition priorities and partner across Talent Acquisition, People Services and People Engineering to establish clear accountabilities and effective end-to-end delivery.

**Experience and Qualifications**

**Essential**

* Significant Talent Acquisition leadership experience supporting operations, service delivery, business services or similarly complex distributed organisations.
* Proven track record of leading hiring at scale across a broad range of operational and leadership talent, with the judgement to differentiate volume, specialist and senior hiring approaches.
* Strong business partnering and influencing skills, with the ability to challenge, advise and build credibility with senior leaders.
* Demonstrated ability to translate workforce and hiring strategies into measurable business outcomes.
* Experience evolving Talent Acquisition capability and capacity as business demand, skills requirements and service models change.
* Proven experience improving hiring performance through demand management, process discipline, data, technology and clear accountability.
* Experience using talent intelligence and analytics to improve hiring, workforce planning, internal mobility and location decisions.
* Ability to lead through ambiguity and change while maintaining delivery focus and team engagement.

**Preferred**

* Experience within financial services, financial markets infrastructure, technology-enabled services, shared services or another highly regulated global environment.

The broader opportunity is to help shape how the portfolio evolves as technology changes work, skills requirements become more complex and a greater share of Talent Acquisition capacity moves towards specialist and advisory activity.

The role offers exposure to senior Operations, People and enterprise leaders globally, and the opportunity to influence workforce composition, location, capability and career mobility across one of LSEG’s largest employee populations.

We are interested in established Talent Acquisition leaders as well as high-potential individuals ready to step into a broader global leadership role.
