title: Operations Manager
description:
Job Purpose

To oversee and manage the company's day-to-day business operations, ensure smooth coordination between departments, improve operational efficiency, monitor team performance, and establish effective processes and systems.

The Operations Manager will be responsible for ensuring that all operational activities, including Sales Coordination, Order Processing, Purchase, Warehouse, Dispatch, and other support functions, are carried out efficiently and in alignment with company objectives.

2. Key Responsibilities (KRAs)A. Overall Operations Management

* Oversee the day-to-day functioning of various departments and ensure smooth business operations.
* Ensure all departments follow company policies, procedures, and operational guidelines.
* Monitor daily activities and ensure timely completion of assigned responsibilities.
* Identify operational gaps, delays, and inefficiencies and implement corrective measures.
* Ensure effective utilization of manpower, resources, and infrastructure.
* Establish accountability and discipline across operational teams.

B. Team Management and Supervision

* Supervise and monitor the performance of department heads, team leaders, and operational staff.
* Define roles, responsibilities, and performance expectations for team members.
* Monitor employee productivity, attendance, task completion, and work quality.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and departmental meetings.
* Identify training requirements and support employee development.
* Coordinate with HR regarding manpower planning, recruitment requirements, and employee performance issues.
* Ensure proper delegation of work and accountability at every level.

C. Sales Operations and Coordination

* Monitor sales operations and ensure effective coordination between Sales, CRM, Customer Development, and Order Processing teams.
* Track sales orders, pending enquiries, quotations, and order execution.
* Ensure smooth communication between the sales team and supporting departments.
* Monitor customer-related operational issues and ensure timely resolution.
* Review sales MIS and operational reports to identify improvement opportunities.
* Support management in achieving business growth and operational targets.

D. Purchase and Inventory Management

* Monitor purchase activities and ensure timely procurement of required materials.
* Coordinate with the Purchase team to maintain appropriate stock levels.
* Monitor inventory movement, stock availability, and replenishment requirements.
* Ensure proper coordination between Purchase, Warehouse, and Sales teams.
* Monitor slow-moving, non-moving, and excess inventory.
* Ensure proper stock reconciliation and inventory records.
* Identify opportunities to reduce procurement costs and inventory holding costs.

E. Warehouse and Dispatch Management

* Supervise warehouse and dispatch operations.
* Ensure proper storage, handling, and movement of materials.
* Monitor order picking, packing, and dispatch activities.
* Ensure timely dispatch of customer orders as per commitments.
* Monitor stock discrepancies, damages, shortages, and dispatch errors.
* Ensure proper documentation and records of inward and outward materials.
* Maintain warehouse discipline, safety, and operational efficiency.

F. Process Development and SOP Implementation

* Develop, implement, and monitor Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for different departments.
* Establish proper reporting systems and operational workflows.
* Identify repetitive tasks and opportunities for process improvement.
* Implement systems to reduce operational errors, delays, and unnecessary costs.
* Ensure adherence to company policies and approval procedures.
* Regularly review existing processes and recommend improvements.

G. MIS and Performance Monitoring

* Prepare and review daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports.
* Monitor department-wise performance against assigned targets.
* Analyse operational costs, productivity, inventory, order processing, and dispatch performance.
* Identify performance gaps and prepare corrective action plans.
* Present operational performance updates and recommendations to management.
* Maintain accurate records and ensure timely reporting from all departments.

H. Cost Control and Operational Efficiency

* Monitor operational expenses and identify cost-saving opportunities.
* Ensure optimum utilization of manpower, materials, and other resources.
* Reduce wastage, damages, processing errors, and unnecessary expenses.
* Improve turnaround time across operational activities.
* Ensure that operational decisions support company profitability and business growth.

I. Interdepartmental Coordination

* Ensure effective coordination between Sales, Purchase, Accounts, HR, Warehouse, Dispatch, and Administration.
* Resolve operational issues affecting departmental performance.
* Conduct coordination meetings to review pending tasks and important issues.
* Ensure timely communication of decisions and action points.
* Escalate critical operational matters to management with appropriate recommendations.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Engineer - Threat Exposure Management & CD Business Operations
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

**Job Purpose**:

The Senior Engineer, Threat Exposure Management will deliver the team's work and act as a senior hands-on contributor within Threat Exposure Management. This is a hands-on engineering role within the team.

**About the team:**

Threat Exposure Management maintains a continuous, prioritised view of where GSK is exposed, spanning vulnerabilities, attack surface, configuration drift and control coverage. The team also runs the business operations of the Cyber Defense function, keeping its planning, reporting and delivery rhythm on track.

**Key responsibilities:**

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

  

* Deliver assigned work to agreed quality and timelines.
* Support colleagues with peer review and knowledge sharing.
* Maintain a continuous view of GSK's threat exposure across vulnerabilities, external attack surface, configuration drift and control coverage.
* Prioritise exposure using exploitability, asset criticality and business impact rather than raw severity scores.
* Operate exposure and vulnerability tooling, including coverage assurance and data quality.
* Track remediation against agreed service levels and escalate where it slips.
* Manage the exception and risk acceptance process with documented residual risk.
* Build and maintain the Cyber Defense reporting pack and its underlying data.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Degree in a relevant discipline, or related experience.
* Demonstrated experience in vulnerability or exposure management.
* Working knowledge of risk-based prioritisation of technical findings.
* Practical hands-on experience in the relevant cyber security domain.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver work independently to a high standard.
* Strong attention to detail in analysis and documentation.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with continuous threat exposure management practice.
* Experience with enterprise vulnerability and attack surface tooling.
* Familiarity with EPSS and the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalogue.
* Data visualization skill in Power BI.
* Relevant certification such as CISSP, CompTIA Security+, GIAC, CRISC.

* Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences or another highly regulated industry.
* Typical tools and technologies: Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, external attack surface management tooling, CSPM, ServiceNow, Power BI.

**Skills**

AI for Cybersecurity, Cloud Security, CrowdStrike Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM), Cyber Threat Intelligence, Electronic Performance Support Systems (EPSS), Forensic Data Analysis, Incident Management, Infrastructure Security, Intrusion Detection, Intrusion Prevention, LLM Architecture, LLM Evaluation, ML Security, Offensive Cyber Operations, Security Monitoring, Security Operations, Security Planning, Security Protocols, Security Risk, Security Technologies, Workflow Process

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. title: Operations Lead
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Operations Lead
  
Account Management – Work Dynamics (region/country)
  
  
**What this job involves:**  
Leading daily property operations
  
Are you a seasoned facilities expert with solid leadership skills? Working with a team, you’ll manage the daily client activities for the assigned property or facility. Likewise, you will implement building procedures and performance measures—and ease the path for compliance with these. You’ll also boost on-site operations by promoting best practices and developing better processes. On top of these, you’ll be at the helm of property safety by encouraging adherence to health and safety standards.
  
  
Getting the clients’ thumbs up
  
You’ll be working frequently with clients—that’s why you’ll need to build strong relationships with them. You’ll be expected to proactively make sure that the clients’ expectations are always met. You’ll also serve as the main point of contact for any facilities-related concerns.
  
  
Keeping an eye on contracts and the budget
  
Do you have a proven track record in finance management? In this role, you will take charge of the site’s budget, accounting and financial operations. You’ll also coordinate with vendors and suppliers to ensure that they comply with the procurement processes and deliver quality work practices according to the contract and budget.
  
  
Fostering teamwork and excellence
  
Teamwork has always been our secret recipe for success, and the ideal candidate should stand up for this core value. As the person in charge, you will support our people’s growth and development through training and coaching sessions. You’ll also uphold a culture that thrives on collaboration, cooperation and performance excellence. Furthermore, you’ll ensure that the team is constantly motivated, and that trust and work ethics prevail among members.
  
  
**Sound like you? To apply you need to be:**  
Adept at facilities management
  
You’ll need to have six to eight years’ experience in facilities management or other related fields to land this job. A SCEM certification, a working knowledge of occupational safety, and exposure to life sciences environment may also give you leverage in getting the job. You must also have a solid background in contract management, budget supervision, customer service and stakeholder engagement.
  
  
Highly analytical and engaging
  
The ideal candidate can effectively resolve complex issues through quantitative methods and holistic approaches. You’ll also need to be a goal-oriented manager who is an expert in health and safety requirements, vendor management and property technical systems management. You’ll spend a lot of time working with different kinds of people—that’s why strong verbal and written communication skills are essential. Think you can ace this job? Apply now and let’s discuss!
  
  
**What we can do for you:**  
At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realise your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.
  
  
Apply today!
  
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Facilities Manager
description:
**About the Role:**

As a CBRE Facilities Manager, you will manage a team responsible for providing overseeing building operations and maintenance for a facility, campus, or portfolio of small to medium sized buildings.

This job is a part of the Facilities Management functional area which focuses on all aspects of the operations of a set of assets, providing support to the Property Managers regarding all repairs and investment plans.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Provide formal supervision to employees. Monitor the training and development of staff. Conduct performance evaluations and coaching. Oversee the recruiting and hiring of new employees.
* Schedule and manage the team's daily activities. Establish work schedules, assign tasks, and cross-train staff. Set and track staff and department deadlines. Mentor and coach as needed.
* Coordinate and manage facility repairs and maintenance by working with technicians, vendors, and contractors.
* Maintain positive client relationships and conduct meetings on unresolved facility issues.
* Prepare and manage capital projects, operating budgets, and variance reports.
* Perform facility inspections quality assurance following local, state, and federal regulations. Suggest operational efficiencies, repairs, and upgrade opportunities.
* Manage environmental health and safety procedures for facilities.
* Oversee vendor relationships and invoicing procedures. Review price quotes for the procurement of parts, services, and labor for projects.
* Conduct process and procedure training on maintenance, repairs, and safety best practices.
* Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with CBRE RISE values. Influence parties of shared interests to reach an agreement.
* Apply knowledge of own discipline and how own discipline integrates with others to achieve team and departmental objectives.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve day-to-day and moderately complex issues which may or may not be evident in existing systems and processes.

**What You’ll Need:**

* Bachelor's Degree preferred with 3-5 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered. Valid driver's license required. Facility Management certification preferred.
* Experience in the areas of staffing, selection, training, development, coaching, mentoring, measuring, appraising, and rewarding performance and retention preferred.
* Ability to guide the exchange of sensitive, complicated, and difficult information, convey performance expectations and handle problems.
* Leadership skills to motivate team impact on quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of the job discipline and department.
* Extensive organizational skills with a strong inquisitive mindset.
* Advanced math skills. Ability to calculate difficult figures such as percentages, fractions, and other financial-related calculations.

title: Regional Facilities Manager
description:
**Designation:** Facility Regional Incharge  
**Location:** Bangalore, Karnataka  
**Department:** Operations / Facility Management  
**Reporting To:** Regional Operations Head / National Operations Head  
**Experience:** 8–12 years  
**Qualification:** Graduate in any discipline; Diploma / Degree in Engineering or Facility Management preferred.

1. Job Purpose

To oversee and manage end-to-end facility management operations across multiple client locations in the Bangalore region, ensuring operational excellence, service quality, statutory compliance, customer satisfaction and cost optimisation.

The role involves managing facility teams, vendor partners, infrastructure, housekeeping, security, technical maintenance and other integrated facility management services across assigned locations.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Regional Operations Management

* Manage day-to-day facility management operations across multiple locations in Bangalore.
* Ensure smooth delivery of housekeeping, technical maintenance, security, pantry, front office and other facility services.
* Conduct regular site inspections and operational audits.
* Ensure compliance with client SLAs, SOPs and contractual commitments.
* Drive standardisation of facility operations across all assigned locations.

B. Team Management

* Lead and supervise Facility Managers, Site Incharges, Supervisors and frontline staff.
* Ensure adequate manpower deployment and effective workforce utilisation.
* Conduct performance reviews, training and development programmes.
* Monitor attendance, productivity, discipline and employee engagement.
* Develop second-line leadership at individual sites.

C. Client Relationship Management

* Act as the primary regional point of contact for key clients.
* Conduct regular client review meetings.
* Address escalations, service complaints and operational challenges.
* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and service delivery.
* Identify opportunities for service improvement and additional business.

D. Technical & Infrastructure Management

* Oversee preventive and breakdown maintenance of electrical, HVAC, plumbing, DG sets, lifts, fire safety systems and other building infrastructure.
* Ensure timely completion of maintenance schedules.
* Monitor equipment uptime and maintenance costs.
* Coordinate with technical teams and external service providers.
* Ensure proper maintenance documentation and asset management.

E. Housekeeping & Soft Services

* Monitor housekeeping standards, hygiene and cleanliness across facilities.
* Ensure proper deployment of housekeeping manpower and equipment.
* Implement cleaning schedules, checklists and quality audits.
* Monitor pest control, waste management, landscaping and pantry services, wherever applicable.

F. Statutory Compliance, Safety & Risk Management

* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
* Monitor PF, ESI, minimum wages, labour licences and other applicable statutory obligations.
* Ensure implementation of EHS policies and workplace safety standards.
* Conduct safety inspections, fire drills and emergency preparedness programmes.
* Investigate incidents and implement corrective and preventive actions.

G. Financial & Commercial Management

* Prepare and monitor regional operating budgets.
* Control manpower, consumables, maintenance and vendor costs.
* Monitor site-wise profitability and operational expenses.
* Validate vendor bills, attendance and service delivery records.
* Identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising service quality.

H. Vendor & Procurement Management

* Manage regional vendors and service partners.
* Monitor vendor performance against agreed SLAs.
* Ensure timely procurement of materials, consumables and equipment.
* Negotiate with vendors and drive cost efficiencies.
* Conduct periodic vendor performance assessments.

I. MIS & Reporting

* Prepare and submit regional operational MIS reports.
* Monitor KPIs, SLA performance, manpower productivity and customer complaints.
* Present monthly operational performance reports to senior management.
* Implement corrective action plans for underperforming sites.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Client satisfaction and retention.
* SLA compliance across assigned facilities.
* Preventive maintenance compliance.
* Equipment uptime and breakdown reduction.
* Manpower productivity and absenteeism control.
* Statutory compliance and audit scores.
* Cost optimisation and budget adherence.
* Complaint resolution turnaround time.
* Safety performance and incident reduction.
* Vendor performance and service quality.

4. Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Excellent client relationship and communication skills.
* Strong knowledge of integrated facility management.
* Good understanding of technical and soft services.
* Knowledge of labour laws and statutory compliance.
* Budgeting, cost control and commercial management.
* Vendor negotiation and contract management.
* MIS reporting and analytical skills.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
* Willingness to travel across Bangalore and assigned locations.

5. Experience & Qualification

* 8–12 years of overall experience in Facility Management / Integrated Facility Management.
* Minimum 3–5 years in a regional or multi-site management role preferred.
* Experience handling multiple client locations and large manpower teams.
* Experience in corporate offices, IT parks, commercial buildings, industrial facilities or institutional facilities preferred.
* Graduate qualification mandatory; technical or professional certifications in Facility Management will be an advantage.

6. Compensation

**Indicative Annual CTC:** ₹7.2–12 LPA, depending on experience, operational scale and the number of facilities managed.

**Employment Type:** Full-time, Permanent.

**Job Location:** Bangalore, Karnataka, with regional travel as required.

Pay: From ₹60,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement
* Leave encashment
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Manager – AFR Import Operations

**About Air Freight Operations**
The Air Freight Operations team plays a pivotal role in managing the import and export of goods by air. Their primary objective is to create and maintain efficient processes, guaranteeing the seamless movement of goods by collaborating with Airline partners, Procurement and Capacity management, network offices, vendors, and customs brokers, ultimately contributing to profitability.
  
  
**Job Summary**
As the Manager of Air Freight Export/Import Operations, your role involves overseeing and improving operational activities related to Air Freight Export/Import. Your primary focus will be aligning with the business strategy, which includes developing and implementing strategic plans to optimize export/import operations. Additionally, you will be tasked with fostering a culture of operational excellence, optimizing resources, delivering an exceptional customer experience, and maximizing profitability—all while ensuring strict compliance with industry regulations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Operational Excellence**

* Ensure cost-effective, high-quality air export/import operations processes and drive volume growth.
* Plan and deploy human resources and capital in an optimized manner to manage business cycle peaks and lows.
* Implement CW1 Best Practices, utilizing tools such as search grid, edocs, task, Auto Rating, Auto Costing, and E-Booking.
* Procure and utilize optimal airline capacity through network offices.
* Encourage consolidations to focus on specific sectors.
* Taking charge of supervising the team members for all relevant operations, efficiency optimization, and upholding the standards outlined in the 'one file, one operator' methodology.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Manage customer relationships and address grievances.
* Take responsibility for overall billing quality and timeliness, driving Operational Hygiene to achieve maximum results in KPIs.
* Manage relationships with multiple carriers, vendors, customs brokers, Terminal Custodians, and network partners.
* Mentor and manage the Air Export Team to deliver service excellence and profitable growth.
* Efficiently manage claims, customer complaints, Inter-Company Issues, and customer disputes for a healthy P & L.
* Demonstrate a problem-solving approach and proactively design solutions for customers by engaging with stakeholders.

**Team Management**

* Develop IKOs/KPIs with team members and monitor individual performance.
* Check your Teams Station Metrics Widget, and ensure every file has an owner (1F1O).
* Manage the allocation of appropriate resources and the commitment of staff.
* Run Daily Performance Dialogs to drive a performance focus of managing shipments and managing customers.
* Foster a culture of quality, service excellence (for internal customers), flexibility, and cost consciousness.

**Product Management**

* Ensure high standards of quality across operations.
* Interface with the Customs Brokerage & Clearance team.
* Drive and implement new product launches.

**COMPETENCIES**
**Functional Competencies**

* Product Knowledge: Thorough knowledge on the entire operational flow, from booking to documentation and customs clearance, ensuring efficient and timely movements.
* Customer Service: Strong customer service skills to address inquiries, provide updates, and resolve issues related to shipments.
* Technology Proficiency: Implementing CW1 and other tools for optimizing operations.
* Customs Regulations Acumen: Understanding of customs procedures, tariff and international trade laws for industry regulations and standards.

**Behavioural Competencies**

* Agility: Ability to adapt quickly to changing operational needs and environments.
* Continuous Learning: Willingness to learn and improve skills to enhance performance.
* Attention to Detail: Consistently maintaining accuracy and precision in tasks.
* Leadership and Team Management: Directing teams towards goals and optimizing productivity by promoting accountability.
* Quality Orientation: Commitment to delivering high-quality results and services.
* Initiative: Taking proactive steps to improve processes or address issues.
* Strategic Planning: Developing and implementing strategic plans to achieve organizational objectives.

**WHO CAN APPLY?**
**Must Have:**

* 8-10 years of experience in logistics or airline.
* Experience managing a team of at least 5 people.
* Bachelor’s degree is required.
* Lead teams for operational excellence and a high-performance culture.
* Effective written and verbal communication with teams, vendors, and stakeholders.
* Promptly address operational challenges and make data-driven decisions.

**Preferred:**

* Courses and certifications in business administration, operations management.
* EXIM/IATA certification.
* Familiarity with Trade Laws & Regulations.
* Knowledge of the Indian Export & Import Trade, Trade Lanes/Routes, Commodities, and Major Players.

\* Ensure offices are well-maintained, organised, functional and equipped to meet business requirements.

\* Manage office seating, space allocation, meeting rooms, visitor management, access arrangements and general workplace infrastructure.

\* Oversee office expenses, petty cash, administrative purchases, maintenance requirements and service requests.

\* Ensure timely resolution of employee and business-related administrative requirements.

\* Maintain proper documentation of administrative activities, expenses, contracts, assets and service records.

**2. Multi-Location Administration & Hub Management**

\* Manage and monitor administrative and facilities operations across multiple locations.

\* Work closely with Hub Managers and location representatives to understand and fulfil administrative and infrastructure requirements.

\* Establish uniform administrative standards and operating procedures across all offices and hubs.

\* Conduct periodic reviews of each location to assess infrastructure, maintenance, housekeeping, security, assets and operational readiness.

\* Monitor location-wise expenses, vendor performance, asset utilisation and pending administrative requirements.

\* Ensure each hub operates within approved budgets and follows company policies.

\* Take ownership of resolving location-specific infrastructure and administrative challenges.

\* Develop centralised reporting mechanisms to track all locations and provide visibility to management.

\* Coordinate inter-location asset movement, transfers, replacements and procurement requirements.

**3. New Office Setup & Business Hub Expansion**

\* Take complete ownership of setting up new offices, business hubs, warehouses and operational facilities.

\* Understand business requirements and prepare infrastructure plans, resource requirements and setup budgets.

\* Identify suitable locations and coordinate with brokers, landlords, building management and relevant stakeholders.

\* Manage lease documentation, rental agreements, deposits, negotiations and handover coordination with Finance and management.

\* Plan office layouts, seating capacity, workstations, meeting rooms, storage areas, electrical requirements, internet connectivity and other infrastructure.

\* Coordinate civil work, interiors, electrical installations, networking, furniture, air conditioning, security systems and other setup activities.

\* Ensure all required equipment, furniture, internet, utilities and facilities are ready before business operations begin.

\* Coordinate procurement, installation, testing and commissioning of required infrastructure.

\* Manage office shifting, relocation, expansion and renovation projects.

\* Prepare project timelines, track execution and ensure setup is completed within approved budgets and timelines.

\* Conduct final readiness checks before handing over the facility to the respective business or Hub Manager.

**4. Facilities & Infrastructure Management**

\* Manage the complete upkeep and maintenance of office infrastructure across all locations.

\* Oversee electrical systems, air conditioning, UPS, DG backup, plumbing, internet connectivity, fire safety systems and other utilities.

\* Ensure preventive maintenance schedules are followed and breakdowns are addressed without affecting business operations.

\* Manage housekeeping, hygiene, pest control, drinking water, pantry services and workplace cleanliness.

\* Coordinate Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs), repairs, servicing and equipment replacement.

\* Monitor infrastructure utilisation and identify requirements for upgrades or expansion.

\* Coordinate with landlords, building management and external service providers for infrastructure-related issues.

\* Ensure uninterrupted availability of essential workplace facilities.

\* Identify potential infrastructure risks and resolve them proactively.

**5. IT Asset & Infrastructure Management**

\* Take ownership of the complete lifecycle of company IT assets including laptops, desktops, monitors, printers, networking equipment and accessories.

\* Plan IT asset requirements based on hiring, replacement, expansion and business needs.

\* Coordinate with the Technology team for laptop configurations, technical specifications, procurement and deployment.

\* Ensure assets are tagged, recorded and allocated to employees and respective locations.

\* Maintain a centralised IT asset register with purchase details, serial numbers, warranty, assigned employee, location and asset status.

\* Manage asset allocation, handover, recovery, repair, replacement, transfer and disposal.

\* Ensure laptops and other IT equipment are available before employee onboarding.

\* Coordinate asset recovery during employee exits and ensure proper handover documentation.

\* Track warranty periods, AMC renewals, repairs and replacements.

\* Coordinate with internal IT teams and external service providers for hardware, network, Wi-Fi, printers, CCTV, biometric systems and conferencing equipment.

\* Maintain records of software subscriptions, licences and renewals in coordination with the Technology team.

\* Conduct periodic physical asset audits and resolve discrepancies.

\* Ensure proper utilisation and accountability of company-owned IT assets.

**6. Procurement & Purchase Management**

\* Manage end-to-end procurement for office administration, facilities, IT assets and business infrastructure requirements.

\* Consolidate purchase requirements from functional heads, Hub Managers and business teams.

\* Understand actual business requirements before initiating purchases and ensure procurement aligns with approved budgets.

\* Identify suitable vendors, obtain quotations, compare pricing, evaluate quality and negotiate commercial terms.

\* Prepare purchase recommendations and coordinate management approvals.

\* Manage procurement of laptops, desktops, office furniture, appliances, electrical equipment, networking equipment, stationery, office supplies and other business requirements.

\* Coordinate business-related purchases for new hubs, office expansions and operational requirements.

\* Ensure timely delivery, installation and commissioning of purchased equipment.

\* Verify quality and quantity of materials received against approved purchase orders.

\* Maintain proper purchase records, quotations, approvals, invoices, delivery challans and warranty documents.

\* Coordinate with Finance for invoice verification, payment processing and vendor reconciliation.

\* Identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality or business requirements.

\* Avoid unnecessary purchases, duplicate procurement and underutilisation of company assets.

**7. Vendor Management & Commercial Negotiations**

\* Identify, evaluate, onboard and manage vendors across all locations.

\* Manage vendors for housekeeping, security, maintenance, IT hardware, internet, transport, pantry, office supplies, furniture, civil work and other business requirements.

\* Negotiate pricing, service scope, payment terms, delivery timelines and commercial conditions.

\* Ensure proper agreements, Statements of Work (SOWs), quotations and supporting documents are maintained.

\* Monitor vendor performance, service quality, delivery commitments and response timelines.

\* Conduct periodic vendor reviews and address service-related gaps.

\* Maintain a centralised vendor database with contact details, commercial terms, agreements and renewal dates.

\* Track AMC renewals, rental agreements, service contracts and other recurring commitments.

\* Verify vendor invoices against approved quotations, purchase orders and actual services delivered.

\* Build reliable vendor relationships across different cities to support business expansion.

\* Identify opportunities for vendor consolidation and improved commercial terms.

**8. Budgeting, Cost Control & Financial Discipline**

\* Prepare annual budgets for administration, facilities, IT assets, infrastructure, maintenance and procurement.

\* Prepare location-wise budgets for existing and upcoming business hubs.

\* Track monthly expenses against approved budgets and report significant variances.

\* Evaluate purchase requirements based on business necessity, cost, quality and long-term utilisation.

\* Negotiate with vendors to achieve competitive pricing and better service terms.

\* Monitor recurring expenses such as rentals, electricity, internet, housekeeping, security, maintenance and AMCs.

\* Identify opportunities to reduce operational costs through better planning, asset reuse and vendor management.

\* Ensure purchases and administrative expenses follow the company’s approval process.

\* Prepare monthly MIS reports covering expenses, procurement, assets, vendor performance and infrastructure requirements.

**9. Workplace Safety, Security & Compliance**

\* Ensure all company offices and facilities maintain appropriate safety, hygiene and security standards.

\* Coordinate fire safety systems, emergency preparedness, evacuation drills and safety inspections.

\* Maintain relevant facility licences, certificates, inspection records and renewal documentation.

\* Coordinate with building management, landlords and external agencies for safety and infrastructure requirements.

\* Ensure security personnel follow established visitor management, access control and incident-reporting procedures.

\* Monitor housekeeping and workplace hygiene standards across locations.

\* Maintain records of incidents, inspections and corrective actions.

\* Escalate safety, security and compliance concerns to management without delay.

**10. Employee Workplace Experience & Business Support**

\* Ensure employees have a clean, safe, comfortable and functional working environment.

\* Address employee concerns related to facilities, seating, equipment, housekeeping and workplace services.

\* Coordinate infrastructure and administrative requirements for new joiners and employee movements.

\* Support HR and functional teams with office arrangements for leadership visits, manager meetings, training programmes and employee events.

\* Ensure meeting rooms, workstations and common areas are ready for use.

\* Gather feedback from employees and Hub Managers and take corrective action.

\* Ensure administrative support is responsive and business teams are not held up due to avoidable infrastructure or facility-related issues.

**11. Team Management, Process & MIS**

\* Manage and guide administrative staff, housekeeping teams, security personnel and location-level administrative representatives.

\* Define responsibilities, service expectations and performance standards for administrative teams and outsourced service providers.

\* Train Hub Managers and administrative representatives on company SOPs, asset management, vendor coordination and expense controls.

\* Develop centralised trackers for assets, procurement, vendors, expenses, facility issues and contract renewals.

\* Prepare periodic MIS reports for management.

\* Track pending requests, issue-resolution timelines, recurring problems and corrective actions.

\* Ensure proper documentation and accountability across all locations.

\* Provide management with timely updates on infrastructure risks, expansion requirements, cost optimisation and operational readiness.

**What We Expect From You:**

\*
**10+ years of experience in Administration, Facilities Management, IT Asset Management and multi-location operations.**

\* Experience managing multiple offices, hubs, warehouses or business locations.

\* Strong hands-on experience in setting up new offices, operational hubs and business facilities from scratch.

\* Experience in procurement, vendor identification, commercial negotiations and contract management.

\* Good understanding of IT assets, hardware procurement, inventory management and asset lifecycle.

\* Experience managing administrative and infrastructure budgets across multiple locations.

\* Ability to coordinate with Founders, Functional Heads, Finance, HR, Technology and Hub Managers.

\* Strong understanding of office infrastructure, facilities maintenance, safety and workplace management.

\* Experience in start-ups, healthcare, e-commerce, logistics or other fast-growing organisations will be preferred.

\* Good knowledge of Excel, MIS reporting, ERP, procurement and asset management systems.

\* Strong communication, negotiation, planning and problem-solving skills.

\* Willingness to travel to different company locations as required.

**What Success Looks Like in This Role:**

\* All company offices and hubs are operationally ready and well-maintained.

\* New office and hub setups are completed within approved budgets and timelines.

\* Employees receive timely administrative and infrastructure support.

\* IT and non-IT assets are properly tracked, utilised and accounted for.

\* Vendor services meet agreed quality and cost expectations.

\* Procurement is planned, transparent and cost-effective.

\* Administrative processes are standardised across all locations.

\* Infrastructure issues are resolved proactively without disrupting business operations.

\* Management has clear visibility of administrative costs, assets, vendors and infrastructure requirements.

title: NPD - Service Manager (Kitchen Appliances)
description:
**Position Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Service Manager - Appliances to manage after-sales service, product defect verification, warranty claims, replacements, and vendor coordination for our appliance category. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in home or kitchen appliances and be capable of identifying product defects, validating customer complaints, coordinating with vendors for repair or replacement, and ensuring timely closure of service issues. The role will work closely with Customer Care, Quality, New Product Development, Warehouse, Supply Chain, and appliance vendors to improve service quality and reduce recurring product issues.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Defect Identification & Verification:**
  Review and validate appliance-related customer complaints to identify whether the issue is a product defect, usage-related concern, transit damage, or service requirement.
* **Warranty Management:**
  Verify warranty eligibility based on purchase details, product condition, warranty terms, and complaint nature before approving repair, replacement, or further action.
* **Vendor Coordination:**
  Coordinate with appliance manufacturers, OEMs, and service vendors for warranty claims, repair support, spare parts, replacement approvals, and defective product resolution.
* **Defective Product Replacement:**
  Ensure defective appliances are repaired or replaced within agreed timelines in coordination with vendors, Customer Care, Warehouse, and Supply Chain teams.
* **Product Inspection:**
  Conduct or coordinate inspection of returned or defective appliances to validate the issue before processing vendor claims or replacements.
* **Root Cause Analysis:**
  Analyze recurring defects, service complaints, warranty claims, and return patterns to identify root causes and drive corrective actions with vendors and internal teams.
* **Service Escalation Management:**
  Handle critical and escalated appliance service cases and ensure timely resolution with proper communication to relevant stakeholders.
* **Vendor Claim Tracking:**
  Maintain records of defective units, warranty claims, replacements, credit notes, pending cases, and vendor closures.
* **Spare Parts Coordination:**
  Work with vendors to ensure availability of critical spare parts required for appliance repairs and service support.
* **Service TAT Monitoring:**
  Track turnaround time for inspection, repair, replacement, and claim closure and ensure service cases are resolved within defined timelines.
* **Customer Complaint Analysis:**
  Review complaint trends, customer feedback, ratings, and service-related concerns to identify opportunities for product and service improvement.
* **Quality Feedback:**
  Share structured defect and service feedback with Quality and NPD teams to improve future product quality, design, specifications, and vendor performance.
* **Return & Replacement Control:**
  Work with Customer Care and Operations teams to ensure only validated defective cases are processed for replacement or warranty claims.
* **Vendor Performance Monitoring:**
  Track vendor performance based on defect rates, service responsiveness, warranty closure time, spare availability, and replacement support.
* **Documentation & MIS:**
  Maintain accurate records and periodic reports on service complaints, defect categories, warranty claims, replacements, vendor recoveries, and pending cases.
* **Process Improvement:**
  Develop and improve SOPs for appliance service, warranty verification, defect handling, replacement approval, and vendor claim management.
* **Cross-functional Coordination:**
  Collaborate with Customer Care, QA, NPD, Warehouse, Ecommerce, Supply Chain, Finance, and vendors for effective service case closure.

**Mandatory Experience & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Electrical / Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 5-8 years of experience in after-sales service, service operations, warranty management, or appliance service management.
* Mandatory hands-on experience in Home / Kitchen Appliances.
* Experience handling products such as mixer grinders, blenders, choppers, induction cooktops, electric kettles, air fryers, rice cookers, OTGs, or similar appliances.
* Strong experience in defect identification, warranty verification, vendor coordination, repair, and replacement handling.
* Good understanding of electrical and functional appliance issues, common failure modes, and service requirements.
* Experience working with OEMs, manufacturers, service centres, or appliance vendors.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, coordination, and escalation-management skills.
* Good communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to maintain service records, MIS, claim trackers, and vendor follow-ups.

**Preferred Exposure**

* Experience with consumer durable, D2C, ecommerce, or home appliance brands.
* Exposure to service centre operations and technician coordination.
* Experience in warranty cost control and vendor claim recovery.
* Knowledge of spare parts planning and defective stock handling.
* Experience using customer complaint data and service trends to drive product quality improvements.

**About The Indus Valley**

The Indus Valley is a Chennai-based direct-to-consumer cookware and kitchen brand focused on health, safety, quality, and innovation. We are committed to developing products that improve everyday cooking experiences while maintaining strong standards of reliability, functionality, customer satisfaction, and responsible product development.

title: Global Billing Operations - Senior Manager
description:
Role: Invoice Review Lead, Global Billing Function
  
  
**Location: Chennai**
**Background**
State Street has established a Global Billing Function under Controllership, which is responsible for client billing set up and invoicing across all business lines and geographies globally at State Street. Organizationally, it combines all groups performing these activities globally, and also includes centers residing in State Street Shared Service locations in Poland, India and China. Billing Organization owns aspects of business-as-usual activities within billing areas and also drives process improvements and automation.

The Invoice Review Lead will be responsible for all aspects of the invoice billing process including invoice raising, OOPS (Out of Pocket Expenses) invoicing, and invoice review across State Street global businesses spread across countries & regions.
  
  
The Invoice Review Lead will manage a large team with a complex engagement model on a day-to-day basis. The individual will be directly responsible for daily management of accurate, consistent, and timely invoice deliverables. This individual will provide subject matter expertise in invoice preparation and review including receivables analytics. The Invoice Review Lead will also be responsible for managing State Street Global Advisors’ invoice production and review.

* Independent decision-making capabilities, demonstrated thought leadership
* Pride of ownership with the ability to deliver high quality results timely

* Strong attention to details
* Problem solving skill

title: Associate Manager – Customer Services & Logistics
description:
**Overview**
Location : Gummidipundi
  
  
**Position Objective**

* To own the complete domestic customer order process – from order receipt until delivery as per agreed terms – from all distribution warehouses (Factory warehouse, 3PL warehouse and C&F locations).
* To act as the contact point for the domestic Sales team to fulfil customer order requirements.
* To manage customer returns, deliveries and secondary freight cost for the domestic business.
* C&F order processing, Factory warehouse and 3PL warehouse customer order processing report to this role.
* Working in factory environment.
* Interacts with internal and external customers.

**Responsibilities**




+ Own the processing of all domestic Sales orders in M3 – accurate and on time – for Factory warehouse, 3PL warehouse and all C&F locations.
+ Ensure every customer order is delivered as per agreed terms (quantity, date and delivery terms) from the right distribution warehouse.
+ Act as the contact point for the domestic Sales team; handle spot and urgent requirements and prioritise based on stock and customer commitment.
+ Keep the Sales team informed in real time on order status, stock position, QC release and expected delivery; inform delays in advance, not after the event.
+ Coordinate with Planning, Production and QC on stock availability and QC release for open orders.
+ Review open and overdue orders daily and drive them to closure; know the status of every open order at fingertip level.
+ Lead and monitor order processing at C&F, Factory warehouse and 3PL warehouse; ensure billed goods are dispatched the same day.
+ Track deliveries and proof of delivery; resolve transit and delivery issues with transporters and C&F.
+ Manage customer returns end to end – approval, physical receipt, QC check, stock posting and credit note – in coordination with Sales, QC and Finance.
+ Handle customer complaints on short, damaged, wrong or delayed deliveries; find the root cause, close within timeline and track complaint trends.
+ Own secondary freight cost; review freight rates, vehicle utilisation and load/route planning to optimise cost.
+ Verify transporter and C&F freight bills before submission to Finance; track freight cost against budget.
+ Ensure full compliance in invoicing, returns and credit notes – e-invoice, e-way bill, LR copy, POD, gate entry and credit notes as per GST rules and company policy.
+ Ensure domestic pricing in M3 is correct and as per the approved price list; no invoice to be raised at a wrong price.
+ Keep records audit-ready and support ISO, Customer, Worldwide Internal and GST audits; close audit observations on time.
+ Ensure zero difference between book stock and physical stock at all distribution warehouses.
+ Act as key user of M3 for domestic order management; own KAI ERP testing and follow up system issues with IT.
+ Share regular reports on OTIF, secondary freight cost, complaints, returns and open orders.
+ Lead, guide and monitor the Executive and order processing teams; ensure proper backup so that operations do not stop in anyone’s absence.
+ Escalate critical issues to the Sr. Manager with facts and proposed solutions.
+ Identify process gaps, implement best practices and contribute to SOPs for customer service and domestic logistics.
+ Collaborate with the Sales team to gather and review customer order details.
+ Ensure accurate and timely processing of customer orders in the system.
+ Proactively inform the Sales team about the stock position and potential delays to avoid stock-out situations.
+ Coordinate with relevant departments to confirm product availability and delivery timelines.
+ Work closely with logistics partners and internal teams to organize and optimize domestic transportation of goods.
+ Monitor shipment schedules, track deliveries, and address any logistical challenges that may arise.
+ Manage 3rd party depot operations for order management and ensure timely delivery.

title: Manager – AFR Import Operations
description:
**ABOUT AIR FREIGHT OPERATIONS**

The Air Freight Operations team plays a pivotal role in managing the import and export of goods by air. Their primary objective is to create and maintain efficient processes, guaranteeing the seamless movement of goods by collaborating with Airline partners, Procurement and Capacity management, network offices, vendors, and customs brokers, ultimately contributing to profitability.

  

**JOB SUMMARY**

As the Manager of Air Freight Export/Import Operations, your role involves overseeing and improving operational activities related to Air Freight Export/Import. Your primary focus will be aligning with the business strategy, which includes developing and implementing strategic plans to optimize export/import operations. Additionally, you will be tasked with fostering a culture of operational excellence, optimizing resources, delivering an exceptional customer experience, and maximizing profitability—all while ensuring strict compliance with industry regulations.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Operational Excellence**

* Ensure cost-effective, high-quality air export/import operations processes and drive volume growth.
* Plan and deploy human resources and capital in an optimized manner to manage business cycle peaks and lows.
* Implement CW1 Best Practices, utilizing tools such as search grid, edocs, task, Auto Rating, Auto Costing, and E-Booking.
* Procure and utilize optimal airline capacity through network offices.
* Encourage consolidations to focus on specific sectors.
* Taking charge of supervising the team members for all relevant operations, efficiency optimization, and upholding the standards outlined in the 'one file, one operator' methodology.

  

**Stakeholder Management**

* Manage customer relationships and address grievances.
* Take responsibility for overall billing quality and timeliness, driving Operational Hygiene to achieve maximum results in KPIs.
* Manage relationships with multiple carriers, vendors, customs brokers, Terminal Custodians, and network partners.
* Mentor and manage the Air Export Team to deliver service excellence and profitable growth.
* Efficiently manage claims, customer complaints, Inter-Company Issues, and customer disputes for a healthy P & L.
* Demonstrate a problem-solving approach and proactively design solutions for customers by engaging with stakeholders.

  

**Team Management**

* Develop IKOs/KPIs with team members and monitor individual performance.
* Check your Teams Station Metrics Widget, and ensure every file has an owner (1F1O).
* Manage the allocation of appropriate resources and the commitment of staff.
* Run Daily Performance Dialogs to drive a performance focus of managing shipments and managing customers.
* Foster a culture of quality, service excellence (for internal customers), flexibility, and cost consciousness.

  

**Product Management**

* Ensure high standards of quality across operations.
* Interface with the Customs Brokerage & Clearance team.
* Drive and implement new product launches.

  

**COMPETENCIES**

**Functional Competencies**

* Product Knowledge: Thorough knowledge on the entire operational flow, from booking to documentation and customs clearance, ensuring efficient and timely movements.
* Customer Service: Strong customer service skills to address inquiries, provide updates, and resolve issues related to shipments.
* Technology Proficiency: Implementing CW1 and other tools for optimizing operations.
* Customs Regulations Acumen: Understanding of customs procedures, tariff and international trade laws for industry regulations and standards.

**Behavioural Competencies**

* Agility: Ability to adapt quickly to changing operational needs and environments.
* Continuous Learning: Willingness to learn and improve skills to enhance performance.
* Attention to Detail: Consistently maintaining accuracy and precision in tasks.
* Leadership and Team Management: Directing teams towards goals and optimizing productivity by promoting accountability.
* Quality Orientation: Commitment to delivering high-quality results and services.
* Initiative: Taking proactive steps to improve processes or address issues.
* Strategic Planning: Developing and implementing strategic plans to achieve organizational objectives.

**WHO CAN APPLY?**

**Must Have:**

* 8-10 years of experience in logistics or airline.
* Experience managing a team of at least 5 people.
* Bachelor’s degree is required.
* Lead teams for operational excellence and a high-performance culture.
* Effective written and verbal communication with teams, vendors, and stakeholders.
* Promptly address operational challenges and make data-driven decisions.

**Preferred:**

* Courses and certifications in business administration, operations management.
* EXIM/IATA certification.
* Familiarity with Trade Laws & Regulations.
* Knowledge of the Indian Export & Import Trade, Trade Lanes/Routes, Commodities, and Major Players.

Role: Invoice Review Lead, Global Billing Function

**Location: Chennai**

  

**Background:**

State Street has established a Global Billing Function under Controllership, which is responsible for client billing set up and invoicing across all business lines and geographies globally at State Street. Organizationally, it combines all groups performing these activities globally, and also includes centers residing in State Street Shared Service locations in Poland, India and China. **Basic Purpose of Job:**

The Invoice Review Lead will be responsible for all aspects of the invoice billing process including invoice raising, OOPS (Out of Pocket Expenses) invoicing, and invoice review across State Street global businesses spread across countries & regions.

The Invoice Review Lead will manage a large team with a complex engagement model on a day-to-day basis. The individual will be directly responsible for daily management of accurate, consistent, and timely invoice deliverables. This individual will provide subject matter expertise in invoice preparation and review including receivables analytics. The Invoice Review Lead will also be responsible for managing State Street Global Advisors’ invoice production and review.

**Expectations:**

* Experience of building and maintaining strong control environment (risk excellence, experience with SOX, RCSA controls, etc.), establishing policies, procedures and strong internal controls.
* Demonstrated leadership in improving/building-out the invoice function for multiple geographies and business areas

**Skills required:**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite (Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Word, Visio), advance levels of Excel (pivot tables, formulas, excel workbook maintenance best practices)
* Knowledge of billing systems
* Conceptual understanding of company-wide financial architecture (GL, sub-GL technology, specialized tools) applicable to the above process groups of processes
* First level management expertise required
* Independent decision-making capabilities, demonstrated thought leadership
* Pride of ownership with the ability to deliver high quality results timely
* Self-motivated, self-assured, and self-managed
* Strong analytical and ability to analyze and summarize complex financial transactions
* Strong attention to details
* Problem solving skill
* Highly organized with ability to multi-task and work under high pressure deadlines
* Must be able to work in a fast paced environment

title: Regional Facilities Manager
description:
**Department:** Facilities Management / Administration  
**Designation:** Regional Facility Manager  
**Location:** Tamil Nadu Region  
**Reporting To:** Head – Facilities / National Facility Manager  
**Experience:** 8–12 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

1. Job Purpose

To oversee and manage end-to-end facility management operations across multiple locations in the Tamil Nadu region, ensuring operational efficiency, statutory compliance, cost optimization, service quality, infrastructure upkeep, and customer satisfaction.

The Regional Facility Manager will be responsible for leading facility teams, managing service partners, implementing operational standards, and ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient facility operations across all assigned locations.

2. Key Roles and Responsibilities

**A. Regional Facility Operations**

* Manage day-to-day facility management operations across all assigned locations in Tamil Nadu.
* Ensure effective management of housekeeping, security, technical maintenance, landscaping, pest control, and other facility services.
* Conduct regular site inspections and operational audits.
* Ensure facilities are maintained in accordance with organizational standards and SLAs.
* Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs).

**B. Engineering and Maintenance**

* Oversee preventive and corrective maintenance of electrical, HVAC, plumbing, DG sets, lifts, fire safety systems, and other infrastructure.
* Ensure uninterrupted operation of critical equipment and utilities.
* Monitor equipment performance and maintenance schedules.
* Coordinate breakdown maintenance and ensure timely resolution of technical issues.
* Maintain asset registers and equipment maintenance records.

**C. Vendor and Contract Management**

* Manage facility management vendors and service providers across the region.
* Monitor vendor performance against agreed SLAs and KPIs.
* Conduct periodic vendor reviews and performance assessments.
* Ensure proper deployment of manpower and adherence to contractual obligations.
* Identify opportunities for vendor consolidation and cost optimization.

**D. Budgeting and Cost Control**

* Prepare and manage regional facility management budgets.
* Monitor monthly operating expenses and utility consumption.
* Implement cost-saving initiatives without compromising service quality.
* Review vendor invoices and validate service delivery.
* Track budget versus actual expenditure.

**E. Statutory Compliance and Safety**

* Ensure compliance with applicable statutory requirements, including:
* Fire and life safety regulations.
* Electrical safety requirements.
* Lift and DG-related statutory requirements.
* Building and local authority approvals.
* Applicable labour laws and contractor compliance.
* Environmental and waste management regulations.
* Coordinate statutory inspections, renewals, and audits.
* Ensure implementation of EHS policies and emergency response procedures.
* Conduct fire drills and safety awareness programmes.

**F. Team Management**

* Lead and supervise facility managers, engineers, supervisors, and outsourced manpower.
* Define responsibilities and performance expectations.
* Conduct periodic performance reviews and training programmes.
* Build a service-oriented and accountable regional facility team.
* Ensure adequate manpower deployment across all locations.

**G. MIS and Reporting**

* Prepare and submit monthly regional facility performance reports.
* Track KPIs, including:
* Facility operational uptime.
* Maintenance closure and response time.
* Housekeeping and security performance.
* Utility consumption and cost.
* Vendor SLA compliance.
* Statutory compliance status.
* Customer satisfaction.
* Present operational updates and improvement plans to senior management.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Achievement of regional facility operational targets.
* Compliance with approved budgets and cost-saving targets.
* Preventive maintenance schedule compliance.
* Reduction in equipment breakdowns and downtime.
* Vendor SLA and KPI performance.
* Statutory and safety compliance.
* Customer and internal stakeholder satisfaction.
* Timely closure of facility-related complaints.
* Successful completion of facility audits.
* Manpower productivity and operational efficiency.

4. Educational Qualification

* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical / Electrical / Civil Engineering.
* Diploma in Engineering with relevant extensive experience may also be considered.
* Additional certification in Facility Management, Project Management, or Safety Management will be an advantage.

5. Experience and Skills

* 8–12 years of experience in Facility Management / Administration / Engineering Operations.
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in managing multiple facilities or regional operations.
* Experience in managing large-scale commercial, corporate, industrial, or institutional facilities.
* Strong knowledge of MEP systems, HVAC, electrical infrastructure, fire safety, and building maintenance.
* Experience in vendor management, budgeting, contract management, and statutory compliance.
* Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, MIS reporting, and CAFM / CMMS systems.

6. Regional Coverage

Responsible for managing facilities across assigned locations in Tamil Nadu, including:

* Chennai
* Coimbatore
* Madurai
* Trichy
* Salem
* Tirunelveli
* Erode
* Vellore
* Hosur
* Other assigned locations in Tamil Nadu.

7. Key Competencies

* Strategic and operational leadership.
* Multi-location facility management.
* Cost control and financial management.
* Vendor and stakeholder management.
* Technical and engineering expertise.
* Statutory compliance and risk management.
* Team building and people management.
* Customer service orientation.
* Decision-making and crisis management.

**Overall Accountability:** Ensure seamless facility operations across the Tamil Nadu region through effective people management, vendor governance, infrastructure maintenance, statutory compliance, and continuous improvement while achieving organizational service quality and financial objectives.

Pay: From ₹50,000.00 per month

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement

title: Team Lead, Product Operations, ICE Climate
description:
**Job Purpose**
ICE Climate Operations supports ICE's Climate Risk Data business, covering physical climate risk, transition risk, nature-related risk, and avoided emissions across public and private companies, sovereigns, and structured finance assets such as mortgage-backed and municipal securities. The Physical Risk team runs the geospatial research and quality assurance function behind this coverage, identifying and validating corporate and sovereign asset locations against wildfire, flood, hurricane, and extreme-temperature exposure for ICE's global geospatial risk platform.
  
  
Lead the operational delivery and continuous improvement of Physical Risk data projects within ICE Climate Operations. The role manages and develops a team of analysts responsible for asset-location research, geospatial validation, structured quality assurance, and project delivery. It combines people leadership with hands-on oversight of complex research and QA, ensuring data is accurate, complete, traceable, and delivered in line with product and client priorities.
  
  
The team leader is the primary operational contact for Physical Risk workstreams and coordinates closely with Product, R&D, Engineering, Analytics, and Data Quality teams. The role is expected to translate evolving requirements into clear work plans, maintain visibility of progress and risks, and build the team's ability to support product improvements and respond to data-related queries with increasing independence.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Team leadership and delivery management

+ Lead, coach, and develop a team of associates and senior associates, setting clear expectations for delivery, quality, accountability, and professional growth.
+ Convert business and project priorities into practical work plans, allocate resources across concurrent workstreams, and adjust assignments as priorities change.
+ Monitor milestones, productivity, quality, and turnaround times; identify delivery risks early and implement recovery actions.
+ Conduct regular one-to-one discussions, goal setting, performance reviews, and development planning; support recruitment, onboarding, and succession readiness.
+ Act as the first point of escalation for operational blockers, quality concerns, scope ambiguity, and resourcing conflicts.

* Physical risk project and product support

+ Lead operational support for Physical Risk initiatives, including industrial and mine location QA, high-materiality asset review, corporate mapping, location weighting, and damage-function research across corporate, sovereign, and private-company asset classes.
+ Coordinate delivery with Product and R&D stakeholders, clarify objectives and acceptance criteria, maintain project status and dependencies, and ensure outputs are usable for downstream product or model development.
+ Keep the team focused on work that improves the quality and coverage of Physical Risk products, including continuous QA of critical asset data and on-demand QA or updates for client-driven requirements spanning wildfire, flood, hurricane, and extreme-temperature exposure.
+ Build sufficient product and methodology knowledge within the team to support data samples, stakeholder queries, and issue investigation with reduced dependency on Product teams.

* Research, geospatial data, and quality assurance

+ Oversee research to identify, classify, map, and validate corporate asset locations, ownership relationships, operational status, facility type, coordinates, and materiality indicators.
+ Ensure consistent use of authoritative internal data, third-party datasets, company disclosures, mapping platforms, satellite imagery, and documented public sources.
+ Review complex or high-risk discrepancies, confirm source traceability, approve final outputs, and direct root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
+ Oversee QA controls for completeness, coordinate accuracy, classification, duplication, status, source evidence, and conformity with approved methodologies and due-diligence standards.
+ Ensure project outputs are documented, reproducible, and ready for ingestion, analytics, model research, or client delivery as applicable.

* Data, reporting, and operational governance

+ Use SQL and BigQuery to retrieve, join, analyze, and validate entity and location datasets; use advanced Excel and reporting tools to manage and communicate delivery performance.
+ Maintain concise dashboards and status reporting covering scope, milestones, quality, throughput, risks, dependencies, and decisions required.
+ Establish clear operating procedures, research playbooks, source hierarchies, QA checklists, and hand-off criteria; keep documentation current as requirements evolve.
+ Support audits, internal reviews, release validation, production issue analysis, and governance activities relevant to Physical Risk data operations.

* Process improvement, automation, and capability building

+ Identify recurring data and workflow issues and implement scalable improvements that reduce manual effort, rework, and turnaround time without weakening control quality.
+ Promote responsible use of AI-assisted research, automated validation, and smart workflows, with human verification and clear evidence retained for material decisions.
+ Develop team capability in Physical Risk methodology, corporate structures and identifiers, GIS and mapping, asset materiality, SQL/BigQuery, QA, and relevant internal platforms.
+ Create a collaborative learning environment through structured training, calibration sessions, knowledge sharing, and review of complex cases.

**Knowledge And Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Geography, Geospatial Science, Environmental Science or Planning, Data Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 6+ years of relevant experience in data operations related to geospatial or location data, GIS research, including experience leading people or project delivery.
* Demonstrated ability to manage priorities, resources, quality, and stakeholder expectations in a data-intensive operational environment.
* Working knowledge of corporate entity structures, asset-location data, geospatial concepts, mapping tools, and research-based verification.
* Proficiency in SQL, Python, and advanced Excel; practical experience querying and analyzing large datasets. Experience with BigQuery is strongly preferred.
* Strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, documentation discipline, and ability to resolve ambiguous or conflicting evidence.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to present status, risks, recommendations, and decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Knowledge And Experience**

* Experience supporting Physical Risk, climate risk, catastrophe modelling, asset-level analytics, or commercial geospatial data products.
* Exposure to facility materiality, industrial assets, mines, utilities, damage-function or historical-loss research, and third-party location datasets.
* Experience with Power BI or similar reporting tools, workflow automation, and AI-assisted research or validation processes.
* Familiarity with data governance, audit controls, client data samples, and cross-functional product delivery.
