title: Senior Manager, Real Estate
description:
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
******Vanguard’s India Office******
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
This role manages all aspects of operation and maintenance of multiple or large physical facilities. Recommends, plans, and directs the design, maintenance, construction, renovation, and repair of organization facilities. Leads and negotiates multi-year vendor contracts. This role also ensures efficient utilization of real estate assets while aligning facility strategies with organizational growth and operational goals.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Hires, evaluates, and supervises crew. Provides guidance and training as necessary to develop crew. Sets performance standards, reviews performance, and makes informed compensation decisions in accordance with all applicable Human Resources policies and procedures.
* Develops plans and programs that meet present and anticipated space and facility requirements. Evaluates present and future needs for real estate, owned or leased, for the organization.
* Oversees and plans annual facility spending for office services, building and grounds maintenance, and facility expansion or improvement projects.
* Prepares cost estimates for building renovations or space allocations.
* Manages the maintenance, repair, and improvement of physical systems and equipment, related vendor relations, and cost control.
* Monitors and inspects all buildings and equipment to ensure that utility systems are fully operational and that preventive maintenance schedules are being followed. Leads facility staff working on various facility systems, such as water, utilities, generators, lighting, etc.
* Evaluates completed work and checks for conformance to specifications.
* Tracks industry and application trends to contribute to planning current and future real estate solutions. Proposes real estate solutions based on deep understanding of industry forces, emerging trends, and regional best practices.
* Manages KPI targets/performance objectives for the site(s) and drives performance, cost savings, and operational improvement initiatives.
* Ensures compliance with local regulatory requirements, safety standards, and environmental guidelines across all facilities.
* Drives sustainability and energy-efficiency initiatives within real estate and facility operations.
* Collaborates with cross-functional stakeholders to align facility management with business continuity and expansion plans.
* Implements and leverages facility management systems and tools for improved operational efficiency and reporting.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.

**Qualification & Skills**

* Minimum 10 years of related work experience, with at least Three years of real estate or facilities management experience. Supervisory experience preferred.
* Undergraduate degree (such as B.E./B.Tech, B.Arch, or equivalent) or equivalent combination of training and experience. Graduate degree (such as MBA, M.Tech, or equivalent) preferred.

******Location******
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard’s India office. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
******Our mission******
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
******Our commitment to you******
**Benefits**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
******Financial wellness******
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
******Physical wellness******
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
******Personal wellness******
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
******How we work******
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

title: Senior Analyst/Manager – DESIMOperations and Client Services – Financial Operations
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world’s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are looking for a highly resourceful, proactive, and detail-oriented individual to join our Operations and Client Services team supporting D. E. Shaw Investment Management (DESIM), our institutional asset management group, based out of Hyderabad and Gurugram, India. DESIM was established in 2005 and currently has over $19.1 billion in assets under management. DESIM builds on the experience and infrastructure of the broader firm to develop and manage active investment strategies that complement the firm’s alternative investment strategies. The group currently operates a platform of systematic, active equity strategies and a platform of discretionary, multi-asset class strategies. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to an inclusive team at ground level and to work with senior leaders at the firm while assuming considerable responsibility.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
You will be a part of a team that is responsible for designing and implementing processes and controls to support a growing business, executing strategic projects and initiatives, and optimizing internal and external client service. You will provide operational support for fund and managed account launches and liquidations, complex investor transactions, and investment mandate changes. Additionally, you will engage with internal stakeholders on operational matters, working closely with the team on initiatives aimed at improving client service while interacting directly with investors and counterparties. You will contribute to the reporting function within the team, supporting the production of investor reports, managing day-to-day reporting workflows, and coordinating production. Furthermore, you will participate in changing management processes, working closely with the DESIM COO and other internal stakeholders on projects and initiatives aimed at creating automated and efficient processes, along with supporting technology projects to build tools for reporting and analysis, streamlining workflows, and improving the user experience. You will have the opportunity to gain a macro view of the firm’s financial activities and learn about complex legal entity structures and transactions while enjoying substantial interaction with other internal departments, including technical investing groups, corporate development, investor relations, legal and compliance, and software development groups.
  
  
**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* A Chartered Accountancy qualification or a master’s degree in finance, along with 2–6 years of experience in fund operations and/or client service roles within the financial services sector
* Proficient project management and critical thinking skills with good commercial judgment
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build rapport and collaborate effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization
* Exceptional problem-solving abilities, a process-oriented mindset, the ability to execute short-term tasks while contributing to long-term projects, and the desire to work as part of a team. Additionally, excellent attention to detail and a proactive approach to work are essential
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel

Preferred qualifications:
  
  

* Knowledge of investor transactions, brokerage/counterparty relationships, and hedge fund accounting functions
* Prior experience in mentoring or coordinating small teams and a track record of contributing to process improvements
* Demonstrated ability to identify and implement scalable automation, AI solutions, and agentic workflows that streamline reporting and improve operational efficiency

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/SrAnaMgrDESIMOCSAug26
  
  
We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.
  
  
The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
  
  
**Job Description:**
We are seeking an experienced and relationship-oriented
**Information Technology Manager**
to lead day-to-day IT operations for our India Delivery Center in Hyderabad. This role is responsible for ensuring reliable, secure, and effective technology services while maintaining strong operational alignment between our U.S. and India IT organizations.
  
  
The IT Manager will serve as the primary technology leader for the Hyderabad and Noida offices and a key liaison between India business leadership and the broader IT organization. Success in this position requires a combination of strong IT operations leadership, technical knowledge, service orientation, and the ability to build trusted partnerships with business and technology leaders across geographies.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role requiring a consistent on-site presence. The successful candidate will be expected to report to and work from the Hyderabad office daily and travel approximately 10–20% to other India locations, including Noida.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**IT Operations & Service Delivery**

* Lead day-to-day IT operations for the Hyderabad Delivery Center, ensuring technology services are reliable, secure, responsive, and aligned with business needs.
* Oversee local IT infrastructure, end-user technology, workplace technology, network connectivity, conferencing and collaboration capabilities, and related technology services.
* Ensure incidents, service requests, and operational issues are addressed in accordance with established service levels and escalation procedures.
* Coordinate response to significant technology incidents affecting India operations and ensure appropriate communication with business stakeholders and U.S.-based IT leadership.
* Identify recurring operational issues, perform or coordinate root-cause analysis, and drive sustainable corrective actions.
* Maintain operational readiness, including appropriate documentation, procedures, support coverage, asset management, and technology lifecycle planning.
* Support business continuity, disaster recovery, and technology resilience activities for India locations.
* Partner with information security, infrastructure, network, application, and other technology teams to ensure compliance with enterprise technology and security standards.

**U.S. & India IT Alignment**

* Serve as a key liaison between U.S. and India IT teams, ensuring consistent implementation of enterprise technology standards, processes, controls, and priorities.
* Maintain regular communication with the Director of IT and other global technology leaders regarding operational performance, risks, business requirements, and emerging needs.
* Coordinate across time zones and geographic locations to ensure issues affecting India operations receive appropriate visibility, ownership, and resolution.
* Help translate enterprise IT strategies and standards into effective local execution while communicating India-specific requirements and considerations to global technology leadership.
* Identify opportunities to improve consistency, collaboration, and knowledge sharing between U.S. and India technology teams.
* Participate in global IT initiatives and represent the operational requirements and perspectives of India offices.

**Business Partnership**

* Develop trusted relationships with India business leaders and serve as a primary point of contact for technology-related needs, concerns, and opportunities.
* Develop a strong understanding of business operations, priorities, growth plans, and technology dependencies across the India Delivery Center.
* Proactively engage business leaders to understand upcoming requirements and ensure IT is prepared to support organizational growth and change.
* Communicate technology issues, risks, priorities, and solutions in clear business terms to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Balance local business requirements with enterprise technology standards, security requirements, and global IT priorities.
* Promote a customer-focused culture within the local IT organization with an emphasis on responsiveness, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Leadership & Team Management**

* Provide leadership, direction, coaching, and development for local IT personnel and/or technology service providers.
* Establish clear expectations and accountability for service quality, responsiveness, technical standards, and professional conduct.
* Develop team capabilities and ensure appropriate technical knowledge, documentation, and cross-training exist to support reliable operations.
* Collaborate effectively within a matrixed global IT organization in which responsibility for services may span local, regional, and global teams.
* Support workforce planning and resource allocation as India operations grow and technology requirements evolve.
* Manage relationships with technology vendors and service providers as appropriate.

**Governance, Security & Continuous Improvement**

* Ensure local IT operations adhere to enterprise policies, cybersecurity requirements, technology standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Support internal and external audit activities and ensure identified technology issues or control deficiencies are addressed appropriately.
* Maintain accurate technology asset inventories and support hardware and software lifecycle management.
* Monitor operational performance and service metrics and identify opportunities to improve reliability, efficiency, employee experience, and service quality.
* Participate in technology budgeting, forecasting, procurement, capacity planning, and investment prioritization as required.
* Identify and manage operational technology risks, escalating significant risks to appropriate leadership.
* Champion standardized processes and continuous improvement across India IT operations.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* Typically 8+ years of progressive information technology experience, including significant experience supporting enterprise IT operations.
* Typically 3+ years of IT leadership, supervisory, or team-management experience.
* Demonstrated experience managing IT operations in a corporate or professional-services environment.
* Strong understanding of enterprise IT operations, including end-user computing, network and infrastructure services, identity and access management, collaboration technologies, IT service management, cybersecurity, and technology asset management.
* Experience working within a geographically distributed or global IT organization.
* Demonstrated ability to build effective relationships with senior business leaders and translate business requirements into technology priorities.
* Strong incident management, problem-solving, prioritization, and escalation-management capabilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams and business executives.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple operational priorities simultaneously.
* Ability and willingness to collaborate regularly with U.S.-based colleagues across time zones.
* Ability to work on-site in the Hyderabad office five days per week.
* Ability and willingness to travel approximately 10–20% within India, including travel to the Noida office and other company locations.

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting a large India delivery center, global capability center (GCC), professional-services organization, or similarly complex enterprise environment.
* Experience coordinating IT operations across India and North America.
* Experience with ITIL or other established IT service-management frameworks.
* Experience supporting Microsoft enterprise technologies, cloud services, collaboration platforms, and modern workplace environments.
* Familiarity with enterprise cybersecurity, risk management, compliance, and audit requirements.
* Experience with technology budgeting, vendor management, procurement, and lifecycle planning.
* ITIL, PMP, Microsoft, cloud, cybersecurity, or other relevant professional certifications.

**Leadership Competencies**
The successful candidate will demonstrate:
  
  

* Business Partnership: Builds credibility and trusted relationships with business leaders and understands how technology enables business objectives.
* Operational Excellence: Maintains high standards for reliability, responsiveness, accountability, and service delivery.
* Global Collaboration: Works effectively across cultures, geographies, organizational boundaries, and time zones.
* Leadership: Creates clarity, develops people, establishes accountability, and leads effectively through change.
* Communication: Communicates complex technology topics clearly and appropriately for the intended audience.
* Judgment: Makes thoughtful decisions while appropriately balancing business requirements, technology standards, risk, and urgency.
* Customer Focus: Approaches technology operations as a service to the business and continuously seeks to improve the employee experience.
* Continuous Improvement: Identifies opportunities to simplify processes, improve service quality, reduce operational risk, and increase efficiency.

**Work Environment & Travel**
This position is based in
**Hyderabad, India and requires daily on-site presence in the Hyderabad office**
. The role is not intended to be a remote or hybrid position.
  
  
Because the position works closely with U.S.-based technology teams and leadership, periodic meetings outside standard India business hours may be required to support effective global collaboration.
  
  
Approximately
**10–20% domestic travel within India**
is expected, including regular travel to the company's Noida office and occasional travel to other India locations as business needs require.

title: Shift Incharge
description:
**Position:**
Shift In-Charge,
  
  
**Business:**
Property and Asset Management, Hyderabad
  
  
**What This Job Involves**
You will be ensuring that all technical services are maintained operational during your shift duty. Taking charge of entire technical assets in building, managing engineering team and supporting the Property Manager / Assistant Property Manager your team leader for coordinating for technical issues with client and occupants. Your key deliverables will be to:
  
  

* Manage and maintain electromechanical / utilities services at the site with the help of technician team.
* Prepare and implement planned preventive maintenance (PPM).
* Conduct inspections at site regularly to check for risk / defects areas.
* Review work of subordinate staff and provide guidance when needed.
* Ensuring the documentation, checking and follow up of the assets under defect liability period and AMC/CAMC in a tracker.
* Be responsible for hiring, training and development of shift engineers and maintenance staff.
* Formulating suitable budgeting controls and Monitoring SLA’s & KPI’s for JLL and outsourced agencies towards effective service deliverance.
* Maintaining service level agreements and keeping performance indicator scores above excellence.
* Ensuring timely renewal of the agreement, submission of invoices and follow-ups for the payments.
* Overseeing all vendor quotations and invoices.
* Ensure proper signoffs for attendance and all the required details for cost sheet submission.
* Ensuring timely submission of client approved cost sheet to JLL office and following up for the invoice.
* Schedule monthly vendor meeting to discuss on daily matters & ensure corrective actions are taken for the same.
* Planning and implementing for energy conservation.
* Prepare monthly readings sheet with occupants and ensure all check-sheets and logbooks are being filled properly as per the schedule

title: Manager, Operations Supply Planner
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The
***Manager, Operations Supply Planner***
supports the supply planning process for both external manufacturing and internal sites. This role ensures alignment with customer and market demand while maintaining operational efficiency. The execution planner will interact with internal and external supply sites, logistics, and other supply chain teams. Responsibilities include assisting in the development of supply strategies, helping to create and execute supply plans, and identifying and reporting any risks or constraints that may affect product availability.
  
  

* Supply Planning and Execution

+ Develop and manage supply plans for materials related to product portfolios
+ Support coordination with internal and external manufacturing sites to help balance customer service with operational efficiency.
+ Maintain accurate inventory levels, ensuring purchase orders are up to date for Drug Substance, Drug Product and Finished goods to meet demand

* Customer and Stakeholder Engagement

+ Build and maintain relationships with global and local supply chain teams and market stakeholders, collaborating to ensure continuity of supply and identify potential risks
+ Attend supply chain meetings to ensure alignment on customer requirements and consumption plans

* Demand & Supply Alignment

+ Use ERP systems (e.g., SAP) to manage demand propagation and supply requirements, ensuring the MRP planning process runs effectively
+ Monitor changes in demand, communicate with stakeholders to adjust production plans, and incorporate these changes into site production schedules

* Risk Management & Problem Solving

+ Monitor and assess inventory risks, including shortages, excess stock, and obsolescence
+ Assist to identify and resolve supply constraints, working closely with necessary stakeholders
+ Support inventory risks related to regulatory or artwork changes

* Metrics and Reporting

+ Track and report on key supply chain performance metrics such as backorders, inventory compliance, and PO accuracy
+ Provide input into inventory projections, budget processes, and root cause analysis for any supply issues
+ Contribute to monthly and quarterly stock overviews, identifying any inventory risks or supply disruptions

* Projects & Continuous Improvement

+ Participate in supply chain improvement projects and other initiatives to optimize supply chain processes
+ Support new product introductions, government tender supply programs, and clinical supply requests when required
+ Ensure that master data is accurately maintained and continuously updated in collaboration with relevant teams

* Digital Acumen, Analytics, and Learning

+ Leverages visualization and data contextualization tools including Excel and BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI), integrated APS capabilities, and BMS platforms to monitor KPIs, perform root cause analysis, review best action analysis and provide data-driven decision support.
+ Contributes to process improvements through digitization and automation of planning workflows, supporting improved speed and accuracy.
+ Executes task-level work using available tools (e.g. WMS, SAP, Tableau, Riverlogic, Kinaxis), follows SOPs, fulfills orders, and maintains high level of performance across data and planning accuracy.
+ Demonstrates curiosity and adaptability in learning new digital tools and platforms (e.g., SAP, Kinaxis, forecasting systems), quickly integrating them into daily operations.
+ Strong Planning and financial acumen with understanding of ERP transaction codes, planning/operational software, physical and transactional flows, etc.
+ Familiarity with AI and ML systems features including performance & expectation management, optimization, etc.

**Required Competencies**

* Min. 2 years of experience in supply chain management, preferably within global manufacturing or pharmaceutical environments.
* Knowledge of supply chain operations
* Expertise in ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Rapid Response) and related data analysis tools is preferred
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and negotiation skills.
* Base understanding of regulatory requirements, particularly in the pharmaceutical industry (cGMP, FDA, EMA).
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively under tight deadlines.

**Required Qualifications And Desired Experience**

title: Shift Lead (Linux)
description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**
We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
  
  
We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience.
**Want to be part of it?**
**Role Summary**
We are looking for a Shift Lead to run our 24/7 Operations team on a rotational basis. You will be the first point of command during your shift, owning monitoring, incident response, escalations, and handovers for Linux-based production systems. You will guide a team of operations engineers, keep services stable, and ensure incidents are resolved within SLA with clear communication to stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Shift Leadership**

* Lead and coordinate the shift team, assigning work and prioritising tickets, alerts, and incidents
* Run structured shift handovers, ensuring open incidents, risks, and pending changes are clearly documented
* Act as the escalation point for L1/L2 engineers and make timely decisions during live incidents
* Mentor and coach team members; support onboarding, training, and skills development

**Incident and Problem Management**

* Monitor dashboards and alerts, triage events, and drive incidents through detection, resolution, and closure
* Manage major incidents: coordinate bridge calls, assign roles, provide regular updates to stakeholders, and escalate to engineering or management as needed
* Contribute to post-incident reviews and root cause analysis, and track follow-up actions to completion

**Linux Operations**

* Perform first- and second-line troubleshooting on Linux servers (RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu, Amazon Linux), covering CPU, memory, disk, network, and service issues
* Manage users, permissions, services (systemd), cron jobs, log analysis, and package updates
* Support patching, reboots, and routine maintenance using approved change procedures
* Write and maintain Bash scripts and runbooks to automate repetitive operational tasks

**Monitoring and Service Management**

* Work with monitoring tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Nagios, Zabbix, Prometheus/Grafana, Datadog) to tune alerts and reduce noise
* Follow ITIL practices for incident, change, and problem management using a ticketing tool (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira Service Management)
* Track SLA/KPI performance and report on shift activity, trends, and improvement opportunities

**Process and Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain and improve runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base articles
* Identify automation opportunities and work with engineering teams to reduce manual toil
* Ensure compliance with security, access, and change control policies

**Required Skills And Experience**

* 7+ years in IT operations, NOC, or infrastructure support, including experience in a 24/7 environment
* Prior experience as a shift lead, team lead, or senior operations engineer
* Strong hands-on Linux administration skills: command line, file systems, LVM, networking (DNS, TCP/IP, firewalls), SSH, systemd, and log analysis
* Solid troubleshooting skills with the ability to stay calm and decisive under pressure
* Experience handling major incidents and running bridge calls
* Working knowledge of ITIL processes (incident, problem, change management)
* Experience with monitoring and alerting tools and ticketing systems
* Scripting skills in Bash and/or Python
* Excellent verbal and written communication, including clear stakeholder updates and handover documentation
* Willingness to work rotational shifts, nights, weekends, and holidays

**Why join us?**
We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space - and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.
  
  
**An inclusive environment to thrive**
We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles - not just on key days, but every day.
  
  
**Be rewarded for your efforts**
We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.

title: Talent & Learning Enablement Team Leader
description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**
**Principal Accountabilities:**
**Team leadership, performance, execution & service excellence (~70%)**

* Lead, coach and develop a team of learning specialists setting clear priorities, goals and performance expectations.
* Own, design, manage, document and take initiative to continually improve processes and operational practices across the team focused on simplification, quality and operational reliability, utilising technology and automation wherever possible.
* Own processes including, but not restricted to procurement, full end-to-end learning programme co-ordination and communications in tools such as Workday Learning, managing learning queries and tickets from employees, regular reporting on learning completion and evaluation, taking full ownership for end to end operations outcomes.
* Drive consistent execution of programme co-ordination and learning operations processes across the team, ensuring high standards and a strong global learner experience. Monitor operational compliance to standards (e.g. quality audits, ticket themes, catalogue accuracy, course set-up, training brochures, sharepoint/intranet pages, accurate reporting).
* Design and own a set of KPIs for the Enablement Team, providing regular stakeholder reports on team performance and operational excellence and drive corrective action as needed. Also provide regular data sets for the wider talent & learning team senior managers to manage key KPIs.
* Ensure ServiceNow tickets and learner queries are triaged appropriately and resolved consistently within defined service levels by the global shared service centre and by the learning enablement team, monitor trends and address recurring issues through process improvements and knowledge articles.
* Lead stakeholder alignment with the Talent & Learning Senior Managers to understand the business, learning needs and priorities and take decisions to align these expectations to the team priorities and performance.
* Own resource planning and workload management across the team, balancing BAU delivery and project work, making prioritisation trade-offs explicit and escalating risks early.
* Partner closely with the Talent & Learning Process & Technology Senior Manager and senior specialist to operationalise governance and technology changes, ensuring the Enablement team is trained, ready and compliant with agreed standards.
* Oversee development and maintenance of learning content created in the team, learning communications and enablement content ensuring meeting brand, inclusivity and accessibility expectations. Ensure the team have licences and are trained in quality content creation.
* Oversee and manage talent & learning information and resources for learners ensuring intranet pages, communication/marketing community channels and brochures are up to date, on brand and inclusive. Ensure the team are trained to use the respective platforms and channels.
* Encourage use of approved AI tools and other technologies to explore more efficient ways of working and improve learner experience.
* Personally manage the operations for selected talent & learning programmes and/or experiences end-to-end alongside the Talent & Learning Senior Manager/s including vendor co-ordination (logistics, planning, issue resolution), programme co-ordination (scheduling, enrolment, communications, delivery co-ordination) and programme follow-up (evaluation, reporting, communications).

**Learning projects (~30%)**

* Lead learning projects that improve global learning outcomes and operational scalability, such as compliance training campaigns and design of core learning programmes.
* Bring a fresh and modern approach to designing and delivering learning experiences for employees, being familiar with adult learning styles, human centred learning design and different tools to create self-paced learning.
* Partner with Talent & Learning stakeholders to translate learner and business needs into project plans, clear requirements, stakeholder alignment and measurable outcomes.
* Create and manage project workstreams including timelines, risks, dependencies, communications and delivery governance.
* Ensure projects are operationalised with new processes documented, support model in place to reflect the experience, communications and training completed in a timely manner.
* Track and evaluate project effectiveness, measure outcomes and drive iterative improvements.

**Important Working Relationships**
It is important that the Talent & Learning Enablement Team Manager is comfortable interacting with employees of all levels and positions throughout the company. As a global company, the incumbent requires sensitivity to other perspectives and cultures. The role supports global stakeholders and will require some flexibility to connect across time zones, including the US.
  
  
Close working relationships with the Talent & Learning Senior Managers and the Talent & Learning Process & Technology Senior Manager, is essential to provide a consistent and joined up experience to learning and that learning strategy, technology and governance is embedded into delivery.
  
  
**Key success measures (first 3 months):**

* Enablement playbook for all processes and governance (SOPs, templates, SLAs) establishing a weekly operations and monthly metrics review and quarterly process audit and stakeholder service reviews, all powered by consistent and accurate data
* Key stakeholder cadence established with a clear intake/prioritisation/feedback mechanism
* Team capability and resourcing analysis for the coming 12 months with clear responsibilities that meets stakeholder priorities
* Team upskilling plan for end to end operations delivery, removing single points of failure, setting clear performance expectations, leveraging the full potential of team members and onboarding new team members.

**Essential Knowledge, Skills And Experience**

* Strong learning operations, process and programme management expertise in a global/matrixed environment. Likely to have minimum 6-10 years experience in this area.
* Demonstrated people leadership experience, including driving high performance, coaching, capability building, and hiring/onboarding. Likely to have 3+ years people management experience.
* Good knowledge of Workday Learning (or equivalent LMS) operational administration, system testing and learner experience—able to enforce consistent ways of working.
* Proven ability to design and embed scalable processes, governance adherence, and support models (including ticketing/ServiceNow operations).
* Experience of vendor management and procurement processes.
* Strong analytical skills: confident using data to manage operational performance, identify root causes, and prioritise improvements.
* Excellent communication skills (written and verbal): clear, pragmatic, able to create straightforward guidance and drive adoption.
* Strong stakeholder management capability: able to translate needs into clear requirements, drive alignment, and deliver outcomes at pace.
* Strong experience in project management – end to end management of project activities from stakeholder engagement, project scoping & project planning, through to managing timely deliverables and project retrospectives.
* Experience in learning design and delivery, including design of impactful virtual learning experiences
* Experience in virtual facilitation
* Strong knowledge and skills in human centred learning design.
* Experience of using different learning content creation tools.

**Behaviours**

* Service excellence mindset with a strong focus on learner experience and operational reliability.
* Calm, structured problem solver; manages ambiguity and competing demands effectively.
* Continuous improvement orientation—simplifies and standardises while protecting quality.
* Collaborative and transparent; escalates early and communicates trade-offs and risks clearly.
* High integrity and discretion; handles sensitive data appropriately.
* Proactive leader who creates clarity, builds capability, and drives accountability.
* Proactive and shows initiative to bring about change and improvement
* Responsive and detail orientated
* Strong interest in learning and development and the impact on performance of the business

**People at AVEVA**
We’re focused on the single most important part of AVEVA’s business: our employees. From recruitment and reward to experience and engagement, our partnerships across the business create and enable the conditions for every individual to thrive.
  
  
Doing the best we can for our great people requires quick thinking – and big thinking. Our team is as involved in the day-to-day activities affecting the employee experience as we are in the global transformation projects shaping AVEVA’s future. title: Head of Operations – D2C (Supply Chain, Fulfilment & Customer Experience)
description:
Location: Hyderabad (in-office)

Function: Operations

Reports to: Founders

Earthful is a clean-label, plant-based nutrition brand for women's health, backed by Fireside Ventures and V3 Ventures. We sell through our own website, Amazon and Flipkart, quick commerce, and B2B customers, and every order depends on an operation that works. This role owns that operation end to end: planning, contract manufacturing, warehouses and 3PLs, logistics, and customer support. It is a build job. Our SOPs are only partly written and our systems are still taking shape, so we need someone who has done this before at a D2C brand and wants to do it again here.

**Role Overview**

You will run Earthful's operations as one connected system, from the raw material that goes into a product to the reply a customer gets when she writes to us. You will lead the people and partners involved (procurement and contract manufacturing, 3PL warehouses, courier partners, and the customer support floor), put clear owners and written SOPs behind every critical process, and give the founders one reliable view of how operations is performing. You will report to the founders, work daily with Finance, Marketing, the E-commerce and D2C growth teams, and Regulatory & Compliance, and hire and develop the team under you.

**What You'll Own**

**Supply Chain Planning & Procurement**

• Run the weekly demand plan with Marketing and turn it into a rolling plan for raw and packing material, with lead times, MOQs, and risks built in

• Plan production against a 60-day inventory norm, and balance stock-outs against over-buying across all channels

• Shorten the PO-to-GRN cycle, and reduce the cash tied up in raw material, including moving raw material buying to manufacturers where it makes sense

**Contract Manufacturing & Vendors**

• Oversee production at our contract manufacturers: scheduling, batch readiness, finished-goods QC, and timely dispatch

• Identify, evaluate, and onboard new contract manufacturers and vendors, and negotiate cost reductions on the highest-COGS items

• Work with R&D, Quality, and Regulatory so every launch is production-ready on the date it is promised

**Warehousing & Inventory**

• Run our 3PL warehouses against written SLAs and a monthly scorecard: inbound receipt, pick-and-pack accuracy, dispatch time, inventory accuracy, and claims

• Keep inventory accurate through cycle counts, follow FEFO on every dispatch, and keep near-expiry stock visible and moving

• Own stock transfers between locations and the rules for allocating stock to each channel

**Logistics & Last Mile**

• Govern our courier partners on delivery time, RTO, failed-delivery handling, damage and loss, and cost per shipment, using ClickPost and partner dashboards

• Make sure D2C, marketplace, quick-commerce, and B2B orders each meet their own delivery promise: PO fill rate, on-time-in-full, and dispatch windows

• Raise repeating courier problems with evidence, and hold partners to the penalties in their contracts

**Customer Support Operations**

• Own the support operation: the floor, the shifts, the metrics (response time, resolution time, first-time resolution, CSAT, QA), and the quality of our AI chat agent

• Set the escalation protocol for sensitive cases such as product reactions, so Operations and R&D act the same shift

• Use support data to find and fix the operational causes of complaints: delays, wrong items, and damage

**SOPs, Systems & Control**

• Map every critical process, rank them by risk, and write, launch, and audit the SOPs, starting with the most important ten

• Run the operating rhythm: a daily huddle, a weekly ops review on a scorecard, and a monthly report to the founders

• Build one view of orders, inventory, service levels, and support, and choose and tighten the systems behind it (WMS or OMS, ClickPost, helpdesk)

**Cost to Serve & Working Capital**

• Know the true cost to serve each channel (warehouse, freight, packing, returns) and bring it down without hurting service

• Manage inventory value and days of cover, and report cost to serve to the founders every month

Team, Partners & Working With Other Functions

• Build and lead the operations team: hire managers where needed, give every direct report written KRAs, and name one owner for every area

• Hold quarterly reviews with each 3PL, courier, and contract manufacturer

• Agree clear service levels with Finance (dispatch documents and reconciliations), the E-commerce and D2C growth teams, Marketing, and Regulatory & Compliance

**What We're Looking For**

Required: all of these

• 8 to 14 years in operations or supply chain, including at least 3 years leading operations as head of function or senior manager at a D2C or e-commerce brand

• Brand-side background at a D2C, e-commerce, or high-growth consumer brand. Experience only at a 3PL, courier, consulting firm, or supply-chain software company is not a fit for this role

• Has led a team of 15 or more across more than one function, including managers, such as warehousing and fulfilment, logistics, procurement and planning, or customer support

• Has managed 3PL warehouses and courier partners with SLAs, scorecards, penalties, and cost-to-serve targets

• Has built SOPs and an operating rhythm in a business where processes were not yet documented, and audited adherence

• Has owned fulfilment and logistics cost against targets, such as cost per order, freight, RTO, or inventory days

• Has run multi-channel fulfilment: D2C plus at least one of marketplaces, quick commerce, or B2B

• Strong with numbers: has owned an operations dashboard and can tell a story from the data

• Based in Hyderabad, or willing to relocate and work in-office from Hyderabad

Strong plus

• Nutraceuticals, FMCG wellness, food, or personal care, with batch, expiry, FEFO, and FSSAI awareness

• Procurement and contract manufacturing experience

• Customer support operations experience, including an AI chat agent

• Hands-on with ClickPost, a WMS or OMS (such as Unicommerce or Vinculum), and a helpdesk

• Quick-commerce fulfilment (PO fill rate, on-shelf availability) and Amazon FBA or FBF operations

• An MBA or equivalent. This is a plus, not a requirement

This is not a role for someone whose experience is only at very large enterprises, or only at logistics providers. We are looking for a builder.

**Job Description: Packing Supervisor**

Packing Supervisor

Production – Packing

3 Years

Pharmaceutical Formulations

**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Job Summary**

**We are looking for a responsible and experienced Packing Supervisor to oversee day-to-day pharmaceutical packing operations. The candidate will be responsible for supervising packing line activities, manpower management, ensuring production targets, maintaining quality standards, and ensuring compliance with GMP and safety requirements during primary and secondary packaging operations.**

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Supervise and monitor daily packing activities in accordance with approved production plans and schedules.
* Handle primary and secondary packing operations for pharmaceutical formulations such as tablets, capsules, syrups, and other dosage forms.
* Ensure proper execution of packing activities as per approved Batch Packing Records (BPR).
* Coordinate and supervise packing line operations, including blister packing, strip packing, bottle filling, labelling, cartoning, and shipper packing, as applicable.
* Ensure line clearance before starting packing operations and after completion of each batch.
* Monitor packing machinery and equipment to ensure smooth and uninterrupted operations.
* Allocate manpower and manage shift-wise activities to achieve daily production targets.
* Ensure proper reconciliation of printed packaging materials, labels, cartons, foils, and other packing components.
* Verify product details, batch numbers, manufacturing dates, expiry dates, and other printed particulars during packing operations.
* Ensure compliance with GMP, SOPs, GDP, and safety procedures throughout packing activities.
* Coordinate with Quality Assurance (QA) for line clearance, in-process checks, and quality-related approvals.
* Monitor in-process packing parameters and ensure rejection and wastage are maintained within permissible limits.
* Maintain proper documentation of packing activities, equipment usage, production output, and manpower records.
* Identify and report packing-related issues, machine breakdowns, and deviations to the concerned departments.
* Coordinate with Engineering and Maintenance teams for timely resolution of equipment-related problems.
* Ensure proper housekeeping, cleanliness, hygiene, and safety practices in the packing area.
* Ensure proper handling, storage, and segregation of finished products and packaging materials.
* Train and guide packing operators and helpers on operational procedures, GMP, and safety requirements.
* Prepare shift-wise production reports and report daily packing performance to the Production Manager.
* Ensure timely completion of batch packing activities without compromising product quality.

**Required Qualifications**

* Diploma / B.Sc. / B.Pharm or any relevant qualification.
* 3–4 years of experience in packing operations in a pharmaceutical formulation manufacturing company.
* Hands-on experience in primary and secondary packing operations.
* Practical knowledge of blister packing, strip packing, bottle packing, labelling, and cartoning operations.
* Knowledge of GMP, SOPs, BPR documentation, and packaging material reconciliation.
* Experience in manpower handling, shift management, and production target achievement.

**Key Skills Required**

* Packing line supervision and production planning.
* Manpower management and team coordination.
* Knowledge of pharmaceutical packaging machinery.
* Documentation and reporting skills.
* Problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
* Good communication and coordination with QA, QC, Production, and Engineering departments.
* Strong focus on quality, productivity, and safety compliance.

**Candidates with hands-on experience in pharmaceutical formulation packing operations are encouraged to apply.**

title: Enterprise Apps People Technology Lead

This leader will own the operational excellence of SAP SuccessFactors and adjacent HR platforms, building a high-performing team that provides L2/L3 support, release/change management, and continuous improvement across our employee lifecycle solutions. **Service Management, Risk & Compliance**

- Ensure audit readiness (privacy, access governance, evidence repositories) and support internal/external audits with traceable configuration and test artifacts.

- Responsible for overall delivery of the Enterprise Applications portfolio consisting of Success Factors , HR Platforms and Atlassian tools.

**Required**

- 7+ years in HR technology and team leadership, with demonstrated experience running support operations for SAP SuccessFactors (implementation, configuration, deployment, and production support).

- Hands-on experience supporting and integrating HR platforms such as Greenhouse, Beeline, and SmartRecruiters.

- Strong understanding of HR data models and employee lifecycle (joiner/mover/leaver), including integration patterns and error handling across payroll, time, identity, and finance systems.

- Proven track record driving ITIL processes (incident, problem, change), SLAs/KPIs, and continuous improvement in a global support model.

- Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and vendor coordination skills; ability to lead cross-functional triage and CABs.

**Preferred**

- Experience establishing operations in a GCC environment (team setup, documentation standards, knowledge transfer, and governance playbooks).

- Exposure to security & compliance frameworks (SoD, access certification), audit support, and evidence management in HRIS landscapes.

- Familiarity with enterprise integration tooling and delivery methods referenced in our stack (e.g., Workato, Cloud Foundry/SFTP).

**Core Competencies**

- Operational Excellence: Data accuracy, reliability, and disciplined change control.

- Systems Thinking: End-to-end process view spanning HR, IAM, Payroll, Finance.

- People Leadership: Coaching, performance management, and building high-trust teams.

- Customer Orientation: Empathy for HR partners and employees; bias toward frictionless experiences.

- Problem Solving: Root-cause analysis, preventative controls, and measurable improvements.

The Customer Support Team Lead is a strong leader with a mindset that allows them to build strong teams and processes that put our customers first, while providing continuous feedback from customers to various product teams.

The Customer Support Team Lead will provide leadership to the Customer Support Team. Establish and maintain Quality Compliance and other processes required for an exceptional level of customer support. **The Customer Support Team Lead will ensure that customer service is maintained by:**

* Liaising with the relevant departments to ensure that customer objectives are being met
* Ensuring a high level of product knowledge within Customer Support team members as evidenced through turnaround time of issues and ability of Customer Support to resolve issues independently
* Ensuring a high level of customer focus (internally and externally) with due care and attention to customer priority issues and appropriate levels of customer communications
* Ensuring that regular audits of communications are performed and that appropriate training is provided to personnel in this area

* Developing and maintaining customer satisfaction measurement metrics
* Defining and implementing the procedures and policies to ensure that high-quality service is delivered to customers (both internal and external) and adherence to strict SLA’s

title: Digital Technology Delivery and Performance Lead
description:
About the Job

At Opella, we have one shared mission – we work passionately, every day, to ‘serve healthier, fuller lives’ now and for the generations to come.

In order to do so, we strive to act as a force for good by integrating sustainability along our business and employees’ mission and operate responsibly from both a social and environmental point of view.

Everything we do is centered around people’s interests – our consumers, our customers, healthcare professionals, and our employees – across the world.

We are building loved brands that serve 1bn consumers worldwide, through our key platforms: Allergy, Physical & Mental Wellness, Pain, Digestive Wellness and Cough, Cold & Flu.

We aspire to become the best Fast Moving Consumer Health (FMCH) company in & for the world and we aim to build a work environment where people can thrive, grow, enjoy and be at their best.

**Our team**
designs, delivers, and governs Digital Technology services and capabilities for Opella worldwide.

We deliver our solutions in a highly competitive market answering FMCH needs and sometimes supporting regulated environments (GxP, SoX and other regional or local regulations).

Our team operates in an international context, serving all markets in most of the countries around the world.

Digital Technology & Architecture organization encompasses following capabilities: Integration, Enterprise Architecture, Cloud engineering, Platform Engineering (e.g. DevOps & related framework), FinOps, Platforms (ServiceNow, Observability, Chatbots, SAP, Salesforce, RPA, …), Digital Workplace and Cloud Infrastructure.

**Delivery & Performance**
provides the management system that connects strategy, portfolio execution, financial performance, governance, and operational improvement across Technology & Architecture. The team works across domains to create transparency, strengthen accountability, and enable faster, better-informed decisions.

Are you passionate about turning strategy into brilliant execution, improving financial visibility, and simplifying how technology is governed and delivered? Join us as Delivery & Performance Lead within the Technology & Architecture organization and help strengthen portfolio execution, operational performance, and leadership decision-making across Opella.

Delivery & Performance Lead

Job Summary

The Delivery & Performance Lead drives disciplined execution, financial performance, governance, and operational excellence across Opella’s Technology & Architecture organization. The role provides an integrated view of delivery progress, portfolio health, budgets, risks, dependencies, and outcomes, enabling leaders to make timely, evidence-based decisions.

Working across technology domains and in close partnership with Finance, Procurement, project managers, and business stakeholders, the role strengthens ways of working, improves transparency and accountability, and supports simplification of the technology portfolio and landscape.

Key Responsibilities

Technology Delivery & Performance

* Drive execution discipline and delivery performance across the Technology & Architecture portfolio.
* Maintain clear visibility of progress, milestones, outcomes, risks, issues, dependencies, and delivery commitments.
* Challenge delivery plans constructively, facilitate issue resolution, and support recovery actions where performance is off track.
* Promote outcome-based planning and consistent portfolio delivery practices.

Financial & Budget Management

* Oversee budget tracking, forecasting, purchase order management, and financial performance across Business as Usual and Separation Costs.
* Reconcile actuals, commitments, forecasts, and variances in partnership with Finance, Procurement, and budget owners.
* Improve financial transparency, cost control, and decision-making through reliable data and timely insight.
* Identify financial risks and opportunities and coordinate corrective actions with accountable owners.

Governance & Ways of Working

* Strengthen delivery governance, standards, reporting rhythms, decision forums, and operating models.
* Clarify accountabilities, decision rights, escalation paths, and performance expectations.
* Standardize practical ways of working that improve consistency, speed, and execution efficiency without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
* Drive continuous improvement based on delivery data, stakeholder feedback, and lessons learned.

Portfolio & Digital Landscape Simplification

* Create an integrated view of initiatives, demand, capacity, investment, and strategic alignment.
* Support portfolio prioritization and sequencing, balancing business value, cost, risk, dependencies, and delivery capacity.
* Contribute to technology landscape simplification by identifying overlaps, rationalization opportunities, and complexity reduction actions.
* Ensure initiatives remain aligned with Technology & Architecture priorities and Opella’s strategic objectives.

Performance Reporting & Executive Insights

* Define and maintain meaningful KPIs covering delivery, financial health, risk, capacity, quality, and outcomes.
* Develop dashboards and management reporting that provide a trusted, concise view of portfolio performance.
* Translate delivery and financial data into actionable insights, options, and recommendations for leadership.
* Improve data quality and reporting automation to reduce manual effort and accelerate decision-making.

Cross-functional Collaboration & Digital Enablement

* Partner with Technology & Architecture leaders, project and portfolio managers, Finance, Procurement, and business stakeholders.
* Facilitate alignment across functions, surface trade-offs, and ensure actions and decisions are followed through.
* Act as a trusted partner to leadership, combining constructive challenge with pragmatic execution support.
* Where relevant, use AI-powered tools and digital solutions to improve productivity, streamline reporting, and simplify ways of working.
* Facilitate animation of team routines and coach our Teams to work in Agile ways of working and according to the Project Management methodology defined by our Digital group.

Core Skills & Expertise

* Technology delivery and performance management.
* Project and portfolio management.
* Budget management, forecasting, purchase order management, and cost control.
* Technology governance, operating models, and decision frameworks.
* KPI development, analytics, and executive reporting.
* Stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership.
* Process optimization and continuous improvement.
* Digital transformation and AI enablement.

Required Qualifications

* Significant experience in technology delivery, portfolio performance, PMO, finance, operations, or a comparable role in a complex international organization.
* Proven ability to manage budgets and forecasts, interpret financial data, and drive cost accountability.
* Strong understanding of project and portfolio governance, delivery methodologies, and technology operating models.
* Excellent analytical, communication, facilitation, and executive presentation skills.
* Ability to influence without direct authority, manage competing priorities, and operate effectively in ambiguity.
* Pragmatic, structured, detail-oriented, and able to connect strategic priorities with operational execution.
* Fluent English required; additional languages are an advantage.

Tools & Digital Capabilities

* **Project & Portfolio Management**
  : Jira.
* **Collaboration & Knowledge Management:**
  Confluence, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint.
* **Reporting & Analytics:**
  Power BI, Microsoft Excel.
* **AI & Productivity:**
  Microsoft Copilot and generative AI tools like Vibe Coding.
* **Financial & Procurement Processes:**
  budget tracking, forecasting, and SAP.

Success Indicators

* Leadership has a reliable, timely, and actionable view of delivery and financial performance.
* Portfolio milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions, and accountabilities are transparent and actively managed.
* Budget forecasts are accurate, variances are understood, and financial actions are completed on time.
* Governance and reporting are simpler, more consistent, and focused on decisions and outcomes.
* Prioritization and landscape simplification decisions are supported by clear data and strategic alignment.

Stakeholders recognize the function as a trusted partner that improves execution, accountability, and operational efficiency.

title: Senior Manager, Network Supply Planner
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
  
  
**Position Summary**
Lead the development & agreement of a feasible Supply Plan for Finished goods (FG), Drug Product (DP) and Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API) in the tactical planning horizon (typically 3 years), in close alignment with execution planning and the internal/external manufacturing network.
  
  

* Tactical implementation of Brand Supply Chain strategies and planning assumptions within the supply planning process, ensuring seamless supply for patients.
* Responsible for developing what-if supply scenarios and develop recommendations in response to actual or anticipated changes in demand or supply.
* Ownership of the product structure process to ensure demand propagation through the E2E network in BMS planning and execution systems Rapid Response / SAP.
* Global scope with key interface to Pod Leads, execution planners, External Manufacturing, and other SC partners across GPS (Global Product Supply).

* Drive the monthly FG/ DP / API network planning process for assigned brands, aligned with agreed metrics including

+ Inventory Months of Cover, plan Vs budget & previous plan. Manage and communicate deviations.

* Review global analytics of assigned portfolio, including product trends, demand evolution, inventory projections (Heatmaps), supply performance and risks.
* Understand site capacities, capabilities, and supply risks. Issue and bottleneck coordination as appropriate.
* Work closely with BMS sites and External Manufacturing group, to ensure alignment of site manufacturing plans and CMO forecasts according to contract.
* Strong accountability to lead cross functional sub teams to align plans, scenarios, and drive solutions for specified business deliverables / events / situations. Proactively identify risks and opportunities.
* Provide input to the Global Supply Review process to incorporate major supply risks. Drive escalation of risks and manage active communication and action focus.
* Develop and maintain consistent planning information via the product structure template, aligned with Brand and sourcing strategy. Drive the change process and flavor management as required.
* Supply planning MasterData governance and systems management to ensure an accurate demand propagation and supply plan.
* Collaborate with other global partners including

+ Long Range Planning, Business Continuity Management, Product Strategy, Quality Management, Network Strategy & Business Operations.

* Actively participate and support New Product introduction to ensure that supply network plans are optimally aligned and that supply plans are executed in support of the established timelines.
* Identify continuous improvement approach for supply planning tools and planning process; Support systems planning enhancements and capability projects (SAP / Kinaxis Rapid Response).
* Digital Acumen, Analytics, and Learning

+ Leverages visualization and data contextualization tools including BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI), integrated APS capabilities, and BMS platforms to monitor KPIs, perform root cause analysis, review best action analysis and provide data-driven decision support.
+ Contributes to process improvements through digitization and automation of planning workflows, supporting improved speed and accuracy.
+ Executes task-level work using available tools (e.g. WMS, SAP, Tableau, Riverlogic, Kinaxis), follows SOPs, fulfills orders, and maintains high level of performance across data and planning accuracy.
+ Demonstrates curiosity and adaptability in learning new digital tools and platforms (e.g., SAP, Kinaxis, forecasting systems), quickly integrating them into daily operations.
+ Strong Planning and financial acumen with understanding of ERP transaction codes, planning/operational software, physical and transactional flows, etc.
+ Familiarity with AI and ML systems features including performance & expectation management, optimization, etc.
+ Actively upskills on emerging digital technologies and analytics techniques, showing agility in adopting tools and machine learning in planning use cases.

**Designee Role And Responsibilities**
The Senior Manager, Network Supply Planning may act as a delegate for the Associate Director, Network Supply Planning. This position may also be a designee for their peers.
  
  
**Required Competencies**

* Strong analytical thinking, problem solving and rapid decision-making skills.
* Demonstrated capability in implementing challenging goals, objectives and practices in a complex and ambiguous environment.
* Strong ability in negotiating and influencing without authority in complex, high impact situations.
* Demonstrated proficiency in a rapidly changing cross-cultural environment.
* Strong presentation and communication skills both, oral and written.
* Business Acumen

+ Has a strong understanding of the key business drivers of the industry / organization. Persuades others with fact-based judgments of the business situation.

* Executing for Results

+ Maintains high standards of performance for himself / herself and others and follows through on commitments.
+ Demonstrates integrity and sticks to core values and principles. Takes the long view, and when faced with challenging obstacles, persists over a significant period of time to achieve his / her agenda. Conveys a sense of urgency and drives issues to closure. Makes timely decisions when a quick response is required and a number of possible alternatives are available.

* Building Relationships and Using Influence

+ Establishes credibility and earns respect with a diverse set of internal and external stakeholders including senior executives, manufacturing and other functional leaders, regulatory professionals, contractors and other partners. Is highly articulate and makes arguments in a clear and compelling manner. Can “get things done” without compromising principles. Has excellent negotiating skills and achieves win-win outcomes in difficult situations.

**Required Qualifications And Desired Experience**
Education
  
  

* Undergraduate Degree preferably in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or Life Sciences. advanced degree, diploma or certification in Supply Chain Management (e.g., APICS CIPM / CSCP certification) strongly preferred.

Experience / Knowledge Desired
