title: Customer Support Manager
description:
**A MULTI-BRAND D2C CONSUMER PRODUCTS COMPANY**

**Job Description**

**Customer Experience | Full-Time | India (on-site) | US Customers**

**Customer Scope:**
You will own customer support across our full portfolio of consumer brands. Our customers are based in the United States, and most of our support volume arrives outside India business hours.

**Location**
: Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad

**Employment Type**
: Full-Time

**Work Hours**
: 6 Days WFO

**Shift Timings**
: 10:00AM - 7:00PM

**Notice Period: 15- 30 Days (Maximum)**

We are hiring a Customer Support Manager to own the entire customer experience after the sale. You will lead our day and night support team, set the standard for how we talk to customers, and make sure every email, direct message, chat, and review gets a fast, accurate, and human response. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will coach your team, step into escalations yourself, and use what customers tell us to help the rest of the business get better. For a subscription-heavy

business like ours, great support protects revenue directly, through saved subscriptions, fewer chargebacks, and happy repeat customers.

**Key Responsibilities:**

• Lead and develop the support team across day and night shifts, including scheduling, coverage, performance reviews, and coaching.

• Own support across every channel, including email, social media direct messages, live chat, marketplace messages, and product reviews.

• Set and track service standards, including first response time, resolution time, backlog, customer satisfaction, and quality scores, and report on them regularly.

• Manage subscription support end to end, including cancellations, updates, pauses, and save offers, with the aim of retaining customers wherever it is the right outcome for them.

• Own refunds, replacements, and returns, and make sure they follow our policies consistently while still treating customers fairly.

• Manage chargebacks and payment disputes, including responding with strong evidence and spotting patterns that cause them.

• Own reputation management, including responding to reviews on platforms such as Trustpilot and TikTok, and resolving negative or hidden reviews quickly.

• Handle escalations personally when needed, and drive upset customers and difficult cases through to a resolution.

• Run quality assurance by auditing a sample of tickets, giving structured feedback, and holding the team to a clear quality bar.

• Build and maintain the support playbook, including macros, knowledge base articles, and standard operating procedures, and keep them current as products and policies change.

• Recruit, onboard, and train new team members, and plan ahead for attrition and peak periods.

• Turn customer feedback into insight for the growth, product, and operations teams, so recurring issues get fixed at the source.

• Work with our technology team to automate repetitive tasks and improve our helpdesk, storefront, and subscription tools.

• Produce clear daily and weekly reporting on volumes, performance, and open issues.

**Required Qualifications and Experience:**

• At least five years of experience in customer support, including at least two years leading a support team.

• Experience in a direct-to-consumer, e-commerce, or subscription business, supporting customers in the United States.

• Hands-on experience with a helpdesk platform such as Freshdesk, Zendesk, or Gorgias, including reporting, automations, and macros.

• A track record of running support to clear service level targets, using metrics such as response time, resolution time, and customer satisfaction.

• Experience managing refunds, replacements, and chargebacks, and working within defined policies.

• Excellent written and verbal English, and the judgment to coach others on tone and communication.

• A calm, solution-focused approach to difficult customers and high-pressure escalations.

• Comfort managing a team across day and night shifts.

• A bachelor's degree is preferred but not required.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

• Experience with subscription businesses, including cancellation handling and retention or save flows.

• Experience with Shopify and subscription management tools.

• Experience in health, wellness, pet, or other consumer categories where product questions are common.

• Experience managing support for marketplaces such as Amazon, Walmart, or TikTok Shop.

• Experience building a support team or function from the ground up.

Where We Expect to Find This Person strong candidates are likely to come from one of the following backgrounds.

• A support team lead or manager at a direct-to-consumer or e-commerce company serving US customers.

• A manager at an outsourced customer experience provider who has run teams supporting US consumer brands.

• A senior support specialist ready to step up into people leadership, with a strong record of quality and escalation handling.

**Key Competencies:**

• You are customer-obsessed, and you care as much about how a customer feels at the end of a conversation as whether the ticket is closed.

• You are a strong coach, and you can raise a team's quality through clear, kind, and consistent feedback.

• You are calm under pressure, and you treat an escalation as a problem to solve rather than a fire to avoid.

• You are data-driven, and you use ticket trends and metrics to find root causes instead of only closing tickets.

• You are organized and reliable, and you keep coverage steady across shifts without things slipping through the cracks.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

• Pay is based on experience, in line with market standards.

Success Metrics for the First Three to Six Months

• First response and resolution times consistently meet target across all channels, including night coverage.

• Customer satisfaction and quality audit scores trend upward.

• Backlog stays low, and no ticket sits unanswered beyond the agreed limit.

• Chargeback rates and avoidable refunds decrease.

• A documented support playbook, quality review process, and reporting rhythm are in place.

• The team is fully staffed and trained, with a clear plan for covering absences and growth.

title: Integration Release Manager
description:
Position Title: Integration Release Manager
  
  
**Location : Hyderabad**
**About Opella**
**Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) and Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally.**
Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be, serving half a billion consumers worldwide and counting.
  
  
At the core of this mission are our loved brands, global teams, manufacturing sites, and specialized science and innovation centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the maker of brands including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale, and Mucosolvan.
  
  
**As a globally certified B Corp company,**
we are active players in the journey toward healthier people and planet.
  
  
**About The Job**
Join Opella’s Integration Platform team as Release Manager and take full accountability for release management across the global integration landscape. The role owns the end-to-end release lifecycle for integration changes, from planning and readiness through CAB decision-making, deployment coordination, post-release validation, reporting, and continuous improvement.
  
  
This is a dedicated operational leadership role designed to provide focus, consistency, and accountability. The Release Manager acts as the central point of coordination across Integration, application teams, Quality, Security, Operations, projects, and external partners to ensure releases are safe, predictable, compliant, and business-aligned.
  
  
Main responsibilities
  
  

* Own, define, and continuously improve the end-to-end release management process for all Integration Platform changes and deployments.
* Prepare, maintain, and communicate the integrated release calendar, aligning deployment windows, release trains, business priorities, dependencies, constraints, and support coverage.
* Lead release planning and readiness reviews, confirming that build, testing, documentation, approvals, operational handover, monitoring, rollback, and validation requirements are complete.
* Coordinate CAB preparation and participation, including change assessment, impact analysis, risk evaluation, stakeholder alignment, decision logging, and escalation of unresolved concerns.
* Facilitate go/no-go decisions and hold clear authority to recommend postponement or rejection when release quality, compliance, or operational readiness is insufficient.
* Oversee the creation, quality review, approval, and execution of release and cutover plans, including sequencing, dependency management, rollback strategies, and post-deployment checks.
* Coordinate production deployments across integration middleware, and supporting tooling.
* Ensure adherence to Opella governance, security, quality, data privacy, and applicable regulatory requirements, including GxP and SoX controls where relevant.
* Coordinate post-release validation, monitor stabilization, ensure defects and issues are correctly tracked, and lead post-implementation reviews for significant or unsuccessful releases.
* Maintain release dashboards, KPIs, decision records, audit evidence, and stakeholder reporting to provide transparent visibility of release status, risk, performance, and upcoming demand.
* Analyze release performance and release-related incidents to improve success rate, schedule predictability, deployment reliability, automation, cycle time, and stakeholder experience.
* Drive adoption of standardized release templates, checklists, controls, communication practices, and automation across all integration teams, markets, and technology platforms.
* Maintain close collaboration with product owners, architects, project managers, developers, testers, platform teams, application teams, service management, and operational support.
* Own and evolve release-related artifacts in ServiceNow and the integration catalog, ensuring traceability between changes, interfaces, technical assets, approvals, and production outcomes.

**About You**
Technical background required
  
  

* 10+ years of experience as part of a release management ecosystem, with demonstrated 3+ years on end-to-end ownership of complex enterprise releases.
* Proven experience leading release governance, CAB coordination, change assessment, release readiness, go/no-go decisions, deployment control, and post-release reviews.
* Strong practical knowledge of ITIL Change Enablement and Release Management, software development lifecycle practices, DevOps, CI/CD, and deployment automation.
* Experience coordinating concurrent releases across global, cross-functional teams in complex cloud, on-premise, and hybrid environments.
* Good understanding of enterprise integration technologies, API lifecycle, messaging and event-driven patterns, middleware, managed file transfer, data integration, and interface operations.
* Familiarity with technologies such as SAP Integration Suite, API gateways, iPaaS, Azure, observability platforms, Git-based delivery, Infrastructure as Code, and ServiceNow.
* Good understanding of application, infrastructure, network, security, and operational dependencies relevant to production integration deployments.
* Experience working in regulated or compliance-driven environments is strongly preferred, particularly with GxP, SoX, information security, auditability, and data privacy controls.
* Experience with SAP and ERP integration landscapes is an advantage.
* ITIL v4 certification is preferred. Additional certifications in project management, Agile, DevOps, or change management are an advantage.

**Soft Skills Required**

* Exceptional organization and coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple releases, dependencies, priorities, and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Strong judgment and decision-making under pressure, with the confidence to challenge readiness and escalate risk when required.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to translate technical release details into clear business impacts and executive updates.
* Demonstrated ownership, accountability, attention to detail, and commitment to disciplined execution.
* Ability to influence without direct authority and build trust in a global matrix organization.
* Calm, structured, and solution-oriented approach during high-pressure deployment windows and production issues.
* Proactive continuous-improvement mindset, with a strong orientation toward automation, simplification, quality, and measurable outcomes.

Why us?
  
  
At Opella, you will enjoy challenging, purposeful work and be empowered to improve how critical technology changes reach production. This role offers the opportunity to establish a consistent global release discipline for Integration Platforms and to directly influence delivery speed, operational resilience, compliance, and business continuity.
  
  
We Are Challengers.
  
  

* All In Together: We keep each other honest and have each other’s backs.
* Courageous: We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity.
* Outcome-Obsessed: We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity.
* Radically Simple: We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be.

**Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands.**
**www.opella.com/en/careers**

description:
**Company Description**
Myhome Constructions Pvt Ltd is a growing real estate and infrastructure development company with a strong presence in Hyderabad. The AGM QS & Planning role is a full-time, on-site position based in Hyderabad, responsible for overseeing quantity surveying and project planning activities across multiple construction projects. The role involves preparing and reviewing BOQs, cost estimates, and budgets, as well as monitoring project costs, variations, and contractual claims. title: Manager III, Facilities
description:
**Description**
Are you passionate about creating exceptional workplace environments that enable teams to do their best work? Amazon is looking for a Facilities Manager to lead operations, drive process improvements, and deliver results across a portfolio of facilities. In this role, you will manage a team responsible for ensuring our spaces run smoothly, safely, and efficiently while continuously raising the bar on service delivery. You will define strategy, set goals, and partner with stakeholders across the organization to solve complex problems and improve the experience for every person who walks through our doors. If you are a collaborative, resourceful leader who thrives on turning ambiguity into action, we want to hear from you.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Lead and develop a team of facilities professionals, providing coaching, career development support, and performance feedback to build a high-performing, inclusive team capable of delivering independently.
* Define and manage facility operations metrics, service level agreements, and audit mechanisms to measure team progress, ensure operational excellence, and report performance to leadership and key stakeholders.
* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to identify risks, negotiate priorities, and align resources to meet both short-term operational needs and long-term strategic goals for your facilities portfolio.
* Establish and refine workflows, maintenance programs, and process improvement initiatives that reduce complexity, eliminate recurring issues, and improve the day-to-day experience for building occupants.
* Evaluate scope and priority across projects, making data-driven trade-off decisions while ensuring downstream impacts are properly assessed and communicated to senior leadership.

A day in the life

title: Supervisor, Customer Service
description:
**Description**
The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
  
  
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
  
  
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
  
  
**Brief Job Overview**
The Supervisor, Customer Success provides operational leadership for the India-based Customer Success team within a global, matrixed Customer Success & Operations organization, with primary responsibility for day-to-day execution and resolution of customer requests related to quotes, orders, order changes, order status, fulfillment, pricing, and other transactional activities across the customer journey. Working closely with the US-based Senior Manager, Customer Success, the Supervisor translates global strategy and Success standards into effective local execution, while leading team performance, workforce management, escalations, process adherence, and continuous improvement to drive timely, accurate, and consistent customer outcomes.
  
  
**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
  
  
Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.
  
  
**Leadership And Operational Direction**
The Supervisor, Customer Success has the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Provide visible, inclusive leadership and set clear direction, Success standards, priorities, and accountability for the Customer Success function in India within the global operating model.
* Align routinely with the Senior Manager, Customer Success on functional priorities, performance expectations, customer and business risks, and execution plans for the India Customer Success team.
* Translate Customer Success Operations strategy into executable team plans, goals, measures, and routines aligned with customer, revenue, quality, and operational objectives.
* Lead through change by communicating business context, preparing the team for new processes and technologies, and reinforcing adoption and sustained execution.
* Promote a culture of customer focus, quality, integrity, collaboration, continuous improvement, and equitable employee engagement.
* Exercise sound financial stewardship, manage resources responsibly, and support business priorities within approved budgets.

**Team Management And Capability Building**

* Direct daily team operations and equitably allocate omni-channel work, including orders, quotes, cases, calls, and correspondence, based on volume, skills, priorities, and Success commitments.
* Recruit, onboard, train, coach, and develop Customer Success Representatives, Specialists, and Supervisors to build capability, engagement, and succession readiness.
* Establish clear job expectations and manage performance through regular feedback, recognition, mentoring, development planning, counseling, and corrective action when required.
* Monitor workload, productivity, quality, data accuracy, and Success results; identify gaps and implement targeted coaching, training, and process improvements.
* Ensure employees have the tools, knowledge, procedures, and cross-training needed to deliver consistent, high-quality Success and maintain business continuity.

**Customer Escalation And Resolution Management**

* Own and coordinate the timely investigation, documentation, communication, and resolution of complex, sensitive, or high-impact customer complaints and escalations.
* Assess business and customer impact, establish the appropriate urgency, engage accountable partners, and maintain clear ownership through resolution and follow-up.
* Identify recurring complaint and escalation themes, determine root causes with relevant partners, and convert customer feedback into corrective and preventive actions.
* Provide hands-on support across the full order cycle when needed, including quotations, registration, ordering, payment, fulfillment, access, shipment, and post-order concerns.
* Ensure escalation handling follows applicable SOPs, operating manuals, complaint requirements, and customer communication standards.
* Support the Customer Service Manager in reviewing, maintaining, and updating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure Customer Service processes remain accurate, current, and aligned with operational requirements. Conduct periodic reviews of SOPs and identify opportunities for process clarification and improvement.

**Operational Governance, Compliance, And Continuous Improvement**

* Develop, maintain, and improve Customer Success policies, SOPs, operating procedures, knowledge resources, and controls to support consistent and compliant execution.
* Ensure adherence to applicable requirements for controlled substances, permits, customs, foreign licensing, shipments, and order documentation.
* Monitor reporting and database accuracy; analyze service, quality, volume, productivity, and complaint data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
* Lead or support improvements that strengthen customer experience, service quality, efficiency, productivity, cost effectiveness, and organizational readiness.
* Maintain current knowledge of USP products, service, systems, and Customer Success practices, and perform other related duties or special projects as assigned.
* The Supervisor supports for ISO audits within the India Customer Success department, coordinating audit activities, maintaining compliance documentation, driving corrective actions, and ensuring adherence to established quality management standards.

**Who is USP Looking For?**
**Education & Experience**
The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree required in a business, sales or related field.
* Minimum of seven (7) years of experience in Customer Success, Sales, or related field in a multi-cultural environment, preferably for a global organization.
* Experience with artificial intelligence (AI), automation, or other emerging technologies in a customer service or business environment is highly desirable. Relevant AI-related training or certifications are considered a strong plus.
* Previous experience in an Order to Cash environment required.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Fluency in English required, and a second language strongly preferred.
* Willingness to work in rotational shifts.
* Customer Success focused and ability to provide a high degree of customer Success.
* Must possess ability to handle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment with a high level for stress tolerance while maintaining composure and enthusiasm.
* Excellent organization, problem analysis, problem solving and decision-making skills, and attention to details required.
* Excellent communication skills (written and oral) and presentation skills are a must.
* Individuals must possess the ability to influence without direct authority.
* Results driven with demonstrated successful outcomes.
* Excellent supervisory skills with a history of building high performing and motivated teams.
* Strong team builder and people leader with the ability and desire to work well with diverse employees and customers in a cooperative and friendly manner.
* Must be able to work independently and in a team environment.
* Must be highly proficient in the use of Microsoft software (word processing, email, spreadsheet, database, and Internet).
* Proficiency in Oracle and CRM systems desired.
* Familiarity with automated order entry systems, Ariba or other EDI processes a plus.
* Good understanding of complaint handling and resolution management.
* Familiarity with imports, exports, customs, and business with other countries strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with the culture(s) in the applicable geography(s) is strongly preferred.
* Candidates must be able to work flexible hours, when needed.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
Yes

USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.

title: Manager/Senior Manager, Engineering - Observability and Monitoring
description:
We are looking for a senior Manager, Engineering for our Observability and Monitoring teams. Someone who can take ownership of two high-visibility teams building the operational backbone of SimCorp One, and who is ready to help define how we see, detect, and resolve issues across the company before clients feel them.
  
  
**What Makes Us, Us**
Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
  
  
At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — Caring, Customer success-driven, Collaborative, Curious, and Courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
  
  
If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!
  
  
**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**
The AI & Insights area is building the foundation for reliable, intelligent operations of SimCorp's offerings. When something breaks in our systems, we need to know immediately, and our teams need to quickly be able to understand the root cause. Ideally, we see the signals in advance, initiate self-healing, and avoid interruptions for our clients. Observability and Monitoring are how we enable that.
  
  
The Observability team owns the data foundation: a standard, Open Telemetry-based way for every SimCorp system to emit logs, traces, and metrics, collected on a central Operational Data Platform that SREs, monitoring, and AI agents can all use. The Monitoring team owns what we do with that data: one governed monitoring standard with a single alert funnel, a standard alert payload, and one Grafana instance for dashboards and alert rules. Together, the two teams are the data and signal layer for AIOps: AI-assisted root-cause analysis, proactive resolution, and self-healing workflows.
  
  
You will partner closely with the Product Managers for Observability and Monitoring and with the architect to turn the roadmap into delivery, and you will report directly to the Senior Director of Engineering. You will also be part of the AI & Insights leadership team, contributing to the broader deliveries and growth of the area.
  
  
**What Will You Be Responsible For**
**Team leadership and development**

* Lead and grow the Observability and Monitoring teams, distributed across multiple locations, creating clear priorities and a supportive, engaged culture
* Develop individual engineers through regular 1:1s, coaching, and honest feedbac
* Build one coherent engineering group across two domains, with the right composition, skills, and no single-person dependencies
* Hire and onboard new engineers into fast-moving workstreams as scope grows

**Delivery and operations**

* Own delivery of the Observability and Monitoring roadmaps
* Hold a high bar on quality, security, and operational readiness

**Stakeholder and cross-team collaboration**

* Partner with the Product Managers to translate product strategy into an executable delivery plan

* Align with the Senior Director of Engineering on priorities and risks

**Strategy and growth**

* Help shape SimCorp's observability, monitoring, and AIOps strategy as scope expands from collecting data to automated root-cause analysis and self-healing
* Anticipate where the teams need to grow in skills, headcount, and tooling, and advocate for it
* Bring an informed point of view on measuring what matters, such as monitoring maturity, SLOs, and incident detection and resolution times, rather than coverage alone
* Make AI agents part of how the teams work and how SimCorp operates, with people orchestrating, reviewing, and holding the bar.

**What We Value**
**Ownership and independence**
You take responsibility without being told to, dig in when things are unclear, and are comfortable deciding with incomplete information and following through.
  
  
**Management experience**
You have led engineering teams before, ideally in a platform context, with a genuine track record of accountability for team outcomes and engagement.
  
  
**Technical grounding in observability and monitoring engineering**
You have a background in software or platform engineering and engage comfortably with telemetry (logs, traces, and metrics), instrumentation standards such as Open Telemetry, alerting, SLOs, and incident response. You are curious about how AI can speed up root-cause analysis and operations. You will not write production code, but you understand what your engineers build, ask the right questions, and spot when something is off.

You write and speak in plain, precise English, can explain a complex platform decision to a non-technical stakeholder, and represent your team with confidence in senior forums.
  
  
**Benefits**

title: Consulting Manager
description:

Consulting Manager role focused on IT consulting delivery in a hybrid work model driving high impact client engagements during day shifts with no travel requirement. * Manage project planning activities including scope definition timeline estimation resource allocation and risk identification to ensure that consulting initiatives are delivered on schedule and within agreed constraints.
* Guide execution of consulting deliverables such as process redesign implementation planning and change support to help clients adopt new digital capabilities and enhance operational resilience.

* Collaborate with cross functional teams across the organization to align consulting solutions with existing products platforms and services creating integrated offerings that enhance client outcomes and market competitiveness.

* Implement governance and quality review mechanisms that track engagement progress manage dependencies and ensure that all consulting outputs meet internal standards and client expectations.

**Qualifications**

* Possess extensive practical experience of eight to ten years in IT consulting with demonstrated success delivering technology driven transformation projects for diverse enterprise clients.

title: Vice President Operations
description:
**Some careers shine brighter than others.**

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of **Vice President Operations**

Lead the operational management and evolution of Domestic Payments, ACH(Automated Clearing House ), RTP(Real time payments) and other Emerging Payments processing within Payments Business Service. The role is accountable for safe, resilient and client-focused execution, driving end-to-end consistency of operational design, efficiency through standardisation and global solutions, and strong risk and control outcomes—while supporting ongoing market infrastructure change and new scheme adoption.

**In this role, you will:**

* Own day-to-day operational performance for Domestic, ACH, RTP and Emerging Payments processing, ensuring delivery against all agreed service levels/PLAs (cut-offs, quality, Audit & Risk outcomes, OOE and operational losses).
* Design, manage and report operational performance using robust MI/KPIs; ensure reporting is accurate, timely and aligned to agreed standards and regulatory expectations. Drive client experience outcomes by reducing client effort and improving transparency (e.g., fewer avoidable rejects/returns, faster resolution of exceptions, clearer status/communications through agreed channels). Lead standardisation and simplification across the functional line, striking the right balance between global consistency and required local/scheme-specific needs.
* Drive productivity and cost transparency; identify and deliver efficiency opportunities through process redesign, automation and improved workflow/tooling. Ensure all change activities (scheme changes, platform upgrades, new products/rails, regulatory deadlines) are communicated, agreed and deployed with minimal operational disruption. Supervise migrations/transitions where applicable, leveraging existing expertise to shorten transition timelines and stabilise performance post-move.
* Ensure appropriate risk and control strategies are in place for all processes under remit; proactively identify control gaps and drive sustainable remediation. Manage incidents (including those caused by external factors such as scheme outages or market events) through effective co-ordination, timely escalation and stakeholder communications. Ensure operational readiness and resilience for evolving payments infrastructure (including new schemes and message format migrations), delivering solutions to mandatory timelines. Partner with Global Businesses, Transformation, Technology and other stakeholders to shape and deliver operational change programmes and innovation across payments workflows. Plan and manage ad-hoc tasks and senior management queries, ensuring relevant and timely responses.
* Build and lead a high-performing and engaged payments operations team; set clear direction, expectations and accountability. Retain talent, manage underperformance and attrition, and ensure development and career progression opportunities across payments talent pools. Role model Operational Excellence and continuous improvement; embed a culture of disciplined execution, learning and “fix it once, fix it properly”.
* Promote an inclusive environment that supports diversity and reflects HSBC values; operate effectively across cultures and geographies. Maintain strong working relationships with peer groups and senior managers to co-ordinate delivery, remove blockers and report progress and results. Contribute to the broader payments governance structure, including policy and decision-making, through active participation in committees/forums.

**To be successful you will:**

* Recognised as a Subject Matter Expert in Payments Business Service / Payments Operations, with strong understanding of domestic clearing, ACH processing, RTP/instant payments and emerging payment rails (including exceptions, returns, rejects and operational controls).
* 10+ years’ experience in Operations Management, including strong operational control capability and a proven track record in delivery. Strong programme/change/project management skills; able to deliver standardisation, migrations and operational transformation safely..
* Excellent planning, organising and commercial skills, including strong financial management capability and ability to drive cost transparency. Resourceful and outcome-focused; able to leverage available resources to achieve goals.
* Prior experience driving innovative operational solutions (process, automation, tooling, MI) is an advantage.

title: Restaurant Manager
description:
Restaurant Manager – Sorano Mumbai

About Sorano

Sorano is an Italian restaurant by Manifest Hospitality, bringing an elevated Italian dining experience to Colaba, Mumbai. The restaurant focuses on authentic Italian cuisine, premium hospitality, thoughtfully curated beverages, and a high-quality guest experience.

With a strong focus on food, service, ambience, and guest engagement, Sorano aims to create a destination for both local and repeat clientele, combining Italian culinary identity with contemporary restaurant hospitality.

Location: Colaba, Mumbai

Company: Manifest Hospitality

Outlet: Sorano – Italian Restaurant

Job Type: Full-time | On-site

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Restaurant Manager to lead the operations of Sorano Mumbai, an Italian restaurant in Colaba. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in premium standalone restaurants, excellent floor management skills, commercial understanding, and the ability to drive both guest experience and revenue.

Key Responsibilities

1. Restaurant Operations

Oversee day-to-day restaurant operations.

Ensure smooth and efficient floor operations.

Maintain high standards of service, hospitality and guest experience.

Ensure compliance with company SOPs.

Coordinate with kitchen, bar and service teams.

Handle operational issues and guest concerns effectively.

2. Guest Experience & Clientele

Build strong relationships with regular and high-value guests.

Personally handle VIP and important guests when required.

Track guest preferences, occasions and feedback.

Develop repeat clientele and ensure regular follow-ups.

Maintain a strong guest database for future business generation.

Drive guest satisfaction and repeat business.

3. Sales & Business Development

Take ownership of outlet sales and revenue targets.

Monitor daily, weekly and monthly sales performance.

Identify opportunities to increase revenue and average guest spend.

Drive upselling across food and beverages.

Develop strategies to increase repeat business and new clientele.

Build local networks and relationships to generate business.

4. Bar & Beverage Sales

Take particular ownership of bar revenue and beverage sales.

Drive cocktail, premium spirit and bottle sales.

Work with the bar team to improve beverage upselling.

Ensure proper control over beverage inventory, wastage and variance.

Coordinate with the Bar Manager/Mixologist on promotions and sales initiatives.

Focus on increasing beverage contribution and overall outlet profitability.

5. P&L & Commercial Understanding The candidate must understand the commercial side of restaurant operations.

Responsibilities include:

Understanding outlet P&L.

Monitoring sales against budgets and targets.

Controlling food and beverage costs.

Monitoring manpower cost.

Controlling wastage, breakage and pilferage.

Monitoring discounts, complimentary bills and voids.

Reviewing daily sales and cost reports.

Identifying areas of leakage and taking corrective action.

Understanding contribution margins and profitability.

The Restaurant Manager should be able to look at the numbers and answer:

“Where are we making money, where are we losing money, and what do we need to do this month to improve profitability?”

6. Team Management

Lead and motivate the restaurant and bar team.

Set clear performance expectations.

Conduct regular briefings and performance reviews.

Ensure proper manpower deployment.

Identify training requirements.

Maintain discipline and accountability.

Develop a strong service-oriented team culture.

7. Events & Promotions

Drive private parties, corporate events and group bookings.

Work closely with Sales and Marketing teams to maximise event opportunities.

Develop guest-led promotions and activation ideas.

Leverage personal contacts and local networks to generate business.

Ensure events are commercially viable and operationally well executed.

8. Cost Control & Compliance

Monitor inventory and stock movement.

Ensure proper billing and cash-handling procedures.

Control wastage and pilferage.

Ensure compliance with company SOPs and statutory requirements.

Maintain operational documentation and reporting.

Key KPIs

The Restaurant Manager will be evaluated on:

Monthly Sales Achievement vs Target

Average Revenue & Revenue Growth

Average Guest Spend

Guest Count & Traffic

Repeat Clientele & Guest Retention

Repeat Business

Party & Event Revenue

Incremental Business

Food Cost & Cost Control

Beverage Cost & Variance Control

Manpower Cost & Productivity

P&L / Outlet Profitability

Guest Satisfaction & Feedback

Guest Database Quality & Growth of Clientele

Team Performance & Operational Excellence

Candidate Profile

Prior experience as a Restaurant Manager / Outlet Manager in premium restaurants.

Strong experience in floor management and guest experience.

Good understanding of F&B sales, bar operations and P&L.

Strong leadership and team-management skills.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Mumbai restaurant market experience will be an advantage.

Experience with Italian cuisine / premium dining / standalone restaurants will be preferred.

Strong commercial mindset with a focus on revenue, profitability and guest retention.

title: Clinical Study Manager
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
**Job Title: Clinical Study manager- local studies**
**Location:**
(HO) Mumbai
  
  
**Role Summary:**
Provides leadership to study team, local strategic planning and operational delivery of assigned local clinical studies through all phases of study management (preparation, study start-up, conduct, close-out), in accordance with Roche quality standards, all applicable regulations, timelines and budget commitments.
  
  
**How does the role serve the patients?**

* Provides hands-on experience to KOLs on Innovative treatment through local phase 4, non-interventional studies, Investigator initiated studies, Real world evidence generation, Compassionate use program, Post trial access program
* By providing early access to innovative treatment to Indian patients.
* By generating robust safety as well as efficacy data on Indian patients through participation in the clinical trials which in turn facilitates regulatory approvals for Roche Innovative products

**Accountabilities**
Has full accountability and oversight for all assigned studies at country level (local studies) in accordance with the overall project plan, manages and maintains accurate study level plans (e.g. timelines, budget, resource, risk and quality plans) in the appropriate Roche planning system.
  
  

* Leads local study teams, represents Country /Region Clinical Operations at the global SMT, and provides global teams with feedback from an Affiliate perspective
* Works with relevant global study team to manage day to day activities of the study, including monitoring report review, problem solving, issues escalation , timely closure of non-productive studies and tracking of safety procedures
* Plans and executes country study goals and commitments, and ensures compliance to relevant processes, Roche quality and safety standards, regulations, timelines and budget commitments
* Provides operational oversight of Investigator-initiated studies and Compassionate Use studies in terms of Roche quality and safety standards, regulations, timelines and budget allocation
* Highlights deviations and risks in plans to relevant parties, develops and implements mitigation strategies as required
* Coaches and provides support to responsible study team members by maintaining effective communication
* Provides study oversight, leadership and support to Clinical Research Organisation (CRO) staff to ensure overall delivery at the country and site level, and interfaces with CRO Management regarding feedback on CRO staff performance as required
* Oversees study feasibility, site monitoring performance, preparation of Risk Based Monitoring plans, and ensures eTMF completeness and oversight of all relevant compliance activities for allocated studies (including translations, as applicable)
* Provides inputs to and/or develops study related materials such as Monitoring plans, recruitment plans and study Newsletters
* Supports/coordinates the negotiation of site budgets within Fair Market Value guideline, budget plans and provide oversight for site payments as per contract, as required
* Participates in local quality/compliance reviews, internal audits, and regulatory inspections, ensuring inspection readiness at all times and completion of Corrective and Preventative Actions for allocated studies
* Develops and maintains optimal site relationships with key investigator sites, alliance partners and/or collaborative group for current and future Roche studies
* Participates in overall therapeutic area support together with the therapeutic leads and country experts (e.g. landscaping activities, investigator/site development activities or affiliate cross functional teams, etc.), as required
* Performs/coordinates for Health Authority presentation for the study/protocol amendments
* For Local Studies, provides the leadership and clinical operations expertise for the local study team

**Internal Stakeholders**
All Medical functions, Procurement, Legal, Finance
  
  
**External Stakeholders**
HCPs and HCOs, Regulatory authorities, Industry Bodies, Patient Support Groups and Vendors
  
  
**Functional Competencies**
Knowledge of ICH-GCP, Indian Regulations, multiple therapy area knowledge, technical expertise in the field of clinical operation, vendor management
  
  
**Behavioral Competencies**
Exhibition of Roche Core Values, Exhibition of Servant Leadership, Patient centricity in decision making, Strong Collaboration and Networking skills, Inspiring and Influencing
  
  
**Eligibility Criteria (Qualification And Experience)**

* University degree or equivalent; professional qualification preferably in a medical/science related field Pharmaceutical medicine training highly desirable
* Higher degree and / or specialist accreditation desirable
* Employee has completed minimum 1 year with Roche Pharma (Applicable for internal hire)
* Employee having an overall experience of minimum 5 years in Pharmaceutical / Biotech / Clinical Research industry with minimum 5 years in Clinical Operations
* Clinical operations and quality assurance
* Job Location: Mumbai (HO)
* Willingness to relocate

Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
  
  
**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

title: AVP- REBO FXMM OTCD Settlement
description:
Job Title : AVP – FXMM & OTC Derivatives
  
  
Department: Markets Operations ( FXMM‑OTCD)
  
  
About Business line/Function: The FX MM OTC business line drives the origination, execution and post‑trade processing of all over‑the‑counter foreign‑exchange and money‑market transactions across the bank’s global client base. It delivers end‑to‑end trade lifecycle services—including confirmation, collateral management, DVP settlement and exception handling—while adhering to the highest standards of risk control, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency. Leveraging a unified technology platform and a worldwide network of clearing partners, the team ensures seamless, timely and secure settlement outcomes that underpin BNP Paribas’s liquidity and pricing capabilities in the FX‑MM markets.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
The FXMM Derivative Back‑Office is responsible for the day‑to‑day settlement of derivative products, Fixed income products and money‑market instruments. The role combines 25 % people‑management with 75 % “business‑as‑usual” operational delivery, ensuring that all trades are processed efficiently, accurately and in line with regulatory and internal policy requirements. Team operates in close collaboration with marketers, sales and other internal function teams (APAC) to offer client-first post trade services.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Ensuring all trades are instructed, matched & settled on a timely basis
* Monitoring of failing trades & updating system with details of reason for fails , Reducing fails and/or potential fails by means of pairing off or offering partial for deliveries
* Cash management related with funding trades
* Knowledge & creation of MT103, MT202 Payment and MTMX Messages.
* Settlement of Repo and Bonds transactions and associated products in a timely and cost effective manner
* Process payments for value‑date and value‑date ‑ 1; ensure all payments clear.
* Ensure timely processing and approval of corporate/inter‑bank trades.
* Execute trade settlement with on‑shore/off‑shore clients.
* Review critical‑control reports for manual settlement/processing and perform end‑of‑day reconciliations.
* Manage cash‑funding related to trade settlements.
* Troubleshoot operational issues and resolve them promptly.
* Assist team members with daily operational requirements.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, internal policies and procedures.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders (traders, sales, risk, etc.).
* Monitor and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) to identify improvement opportunities and drive operational excellence.

Contributing Responsibilities
  
  

* Support people‑management activities (coaching, performance reviews) for team.
* Participate in continuous‑improvement initiatives and process‑optimization projects.
* Contribute to knowledge‑sharing and training sessions within the wider Operations community.
* Liaise with technology teams on system enhancements and automation opportunities.

Technical & Behavioral Competencies
  
  

* Deep knowledge of FXMM,Fixed Income/Bonds/REPO and OTC Derivatives products and settlement processes.
* Proficiency with SWIFT messaging (MT103, MT202, MTMX) and manual payment creation/authorization.
* Strong understanding of regulatory frameworks and risk‑management principles applicable to derivatives and money‑market trades.
* Ability to perform EOD reconciliations, cash‑management, and control‑report analysis.
* Experience with operations technology/systems (e.g., settlement platforms, treasury management systems).
* Excellent analytical & problem‑solving abilities.
* Strong communication & interpersonal skills to build relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Ability to lead, coach and develop a small team in a fast‑paced environment.
* High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and compliance.
* Resilience and capability to thrive under pressure and meet tight deadlines.

**Specific Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in finance, Economics, or a related field (or equivalent).
* Experience: Minimum 12 years of operations experience, with at least 5 years in FXMM and OTC derivatives; proven experience managing teams
* Domain Knowledge: Excellent knowledge of FXMM and OTC derivatives products, processes, and associated regulatory requirements.
* Additional: Experience with operations technology/systems is a plus.

**Technical Skills**
Skills Referential (Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities)
  
  

* FXMM settlement processes
* OTC derivatives lifecycle & settlement
* Fixed Income/Bonds/REPO products & process
* SWIFT messaging (MT103, MT202, MTMX)
* Regulatory compliance & risk management
* End‑of‑day reconciliations & cash‑management
* Operations platforms & automation tools

**Behavioral Skills**

* Analytical thinking & problem solving
* Effective communication & stakeholder management
* Leadership, coaching & team development
* High resilience & ability to work under pressure
* Continuous‑improvement mindset

Education Level : Master’s Degree or equivalent
  
  
Location : Mumbai/Bangalore, India

title: Head of Business & Operation - D2C Fashion
description:
Head of Business & Operations

**Organisation:**
SheRox

**Industry:**
Women's Athleisure, Activewear & D2C Fashion

**Location:**
Mumbai preferred

**Experience:**
10–15 years

**Business Stage:**
Pre-launch

**Compensation:**
Commensurate with experience

**Career Growth:**
Potential progression into broader executive leadership, based on performance

About SheRox

SheRox is an emerging women's athleisure brand focused on creating comfortable, stylish and functional activewear for Indian women.

Our mission is to build a brand that combines global activewear aesthetics with Indian consumer preferences, offering quality products at accessible prices.

The brand is being developed for a growing market of women seeking fitness and lifestyle apparel that balances performance, comfort and everyday wearability.

As we prepare for launch, we are looking for an entrepreneurial business leader who can build the commercial and operational foundations of SheRox and lead its growth.

About the Role

We are looking for a
**Head of Business & Operations**
to take ownership of the commercial development, operational execution and business performance of SheRox.

The selected candidate will be responsible for building and scaling the business across product development coordination, sourcing, manufacturing, merchandising, distribution, e-commerce, financial management and team leadership.

This is a hands-on leadership position suited to someone who has previously built or scaled an apparel, activewear or D2C consumer business.

The ideal candidate should understand the complete product-to-market process, from fabric selection and manufacturing economics to customer acquisition, pricing, inventory management and profitability.

The role involves working closely with the founder, creative leadership and executive management to translate the business vision into an operationally efficient and commercially sustainable brand.

The position offers potential progression toward a CEO role over approximately 2–3 years, subject to demonstrated performance, business growth and leadership requirements. Such progression is not guaranteed.

Key Responsibilities1. Business Strategy and Leadership

* Develop and execute the overall business strategy for SheRox.
* Establish operational priorities, commercial targets and business growth plans.
* Translate the brand vision into measurable business objectives and execution plans.
* Lead business planning, budgeting and performance reviews.
* Identify market opportunities and build strategies for sustainable expansion.
* Work closely with the founder and executive leadership on key business decisions.

2. P&L and Financial Management

* Take ownership of business profitability and commercial performance.
* Prepare and manage operating budgets, revenue forecasts and financial plans.
* Monitor gross margins, contribution margins, operating expenses and working capital.
* Develop product pricing strategies based on costs, competition, target consumers and profitability.
* Track commercial performance across products, categories and sales channels.
* Identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency and overall business economics.

3. Product Strategy and Merchandising

* Develop product assortment and SKU strategies aligned with the brand's target customers.
* Work with the Creative & Product Design Head to build commercially viable activewear collections.
* Support decisions relating to product categories, pricing, fit, functionality and consumer demand.
* Oversee merchandising, product launches and seasonal collection planning.
* Analyse product performance, customer feedback and category profitability.
* Balance consumer demand, product availability, margins and inventory investment.

4. Sourcing, Manufacturing and Supply Chain

* Identify and manage manufacturing partners, sourcing vendors and suppliers.
* Oversee product development coordination, sampling, production planning and quality requirements.
* Understand and evaluate technical fabrics, garment construction, fitting challenges and product performance.
* Negotiate commercial terms, manufacturing costs, lead times and minimum order quantities (MOQs).
* Establish processes for quality assurance, production tracking and vendor performance.
* Manage supply chain risks and ensure timely product availability.

5. D2C, E-commerce and Sales Growth

* Develop and execute the brand's direct-to-consumer and e-commerce strategy.
* Oversee online sales performance, customer conversion and revenue growth.
* Collaborate with marketing teams on customer acquisition, retention and brand growth.
* Monitor customer acquisition costs, conversion rates, repeat purchases, return rates and channel profitability.
* Improve customer experience across ordering, delivery, returns and after-sales support.
* Evaluate opportunities across digital marketplaces, retail channels and other distribution models.

6. Inventory, Fulfilment and Operations

* Establish systems for demand planning, inventory management and replenishment.
* Monitor inventory turnover, stock availability, slow-moving products and working capital utilisation.
* Coordinate logistics, warehousing, fulfilment and returns management.
* Implement operational processes that support scalable business growth.
* Develop standard operating procedures and performance reporting systems.
* Ensure efficient coordination between sourcing, product development, sales and fulfilment.

7. Team Building and Cross-functional Leadership

* Build and lead a lean, high-performing business operations team.
* Identify staffing requirements and manage external specialists and service providers.
* Establish accountability, operating processes and performance measures.
* Coordinate closely with creative, product, manufacturing, finance and marketing teams.
* Manage vendors, commercial partners and service providers.
* Lead execution across functions while maintaining strong communication with the founder and executive leadership.

8. Brand Growth and Market Expansion

* Evaluate market opportunities across Indian consumer segments and geographic regions.
* Develop strategies for reaching customers in metropolitan and Tier 2/3 markets.
* Identify suitable partnerships and distribution opportunities.
* Use customer insights, market data and business performance to guide expansion.
* Support the development of a long-term commercial roadmap for the brand.

Mandatory Requirements

* Make Connections – Builds strong, authentic relationships across teams and functions. Collaborates effectively to drive shared success.

* Authentic & Trustworthy – Demonstrates integrity, transparency, and consistency in words and actions.
* Accountable & Ownership-Driven – Takes responsibility for outcomes and holds self and others to high standards.
* Adaptable & Resilient – Navigates change with flexibility, resourcefulness, and a solution-oriented mindset

**About You**
To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:

* Relevant years of experience of capital projects supply chain experience in an EPC, full project delivery environment.

**Specific Requirements:-**

* Ability to work with other cultures, disciplines, management, contractors, and suppliers in a functional support and team role.

* Effective interpersonal and communications skills, ability to lead multi discipline teams across diverse geographies.

title: Sr Strategy & Execution Leader BioTech (Lifesciences)
description:
**About Paramverse Bio**

Paramverse Bio Pvt. Ltd. is building India’s next great bio company, with a focus on biological agriculture. Founded in 2024 and part of Paramverse Group, it develops and sells indigenous microbial formulations under the DHARITRI SUTRA™ brand. The portfolio spans 21 registered products across three lines: RAKSHAK (bio-protection), POSHAK (bio-nutrition), and AMRITAM (export-grade compliance).

Every product is delivered through the “Doctor of Soil” model: a certified agronomist, a personalised prescription, and data to show whether it worked. Paramverse Bio is live across nine Indian states in Phase 1 (FY27), with 48 territories, institutional-grade manufacturing, and field-to-export traceability.

**What You Will Own**

Platform Strategy & Cross-Industry Planning

* Drive end-to-end execution of key strategic programs across Paramverse Bio’s seven target industries — not just agriculture.
* Support the CEO’s Office in scoping new B2B verticals (pharma CDMO, food-grade enzymes, bio-surfactants, cosmetic actives) — market sizing, competitor mapping, PE-framework evaluation, and go/no-go recommendations.
* Build and maintain the cross-industry opportunity pipeline: track where capital is flowing, which sectors are maturing, and where Paramverse’s shared platform creates a structural cost or speed advantage.
* Coordinate the translation of platform-level capabilities (fermentation, AI, manufacturing) into industry-specific revenue plans across B2B2C (Agri), B2B (Pharma + Industrial), and B2C (Consumer Brands) channels.

Go-to-Market & Commercial Execution

* Partner with sales leadership, state heads, and commercial teams to track performance, identify gaps, and drive corrective actions across the agricultural biologicals business (Dharitri Sutra).
* Support market expansion and distribution growth across existing and new geographies — building structured GTM playbooks, retailer onboarding frameworks, and territory-level P&L dashboards.
* Coordinate with regulatory, agronomy, and external partners to support product registrations, compliance, field trials, and market-readiness activities across both agri and non-agri portfolios.
* Track competitive intelligence across all target sectors — funded startups, policy shifts, regulatory changes, and M&A activity that affects Paramverse’s positioning.

Manufacturing, Technology & Data

* Work with the manufacturing and R&D teams to track greenfield plant milestones, capacity utilisation, and the seasonal production-swing strategy (agri in Kharif, industrial in off-season).
* Support the AI and computational biology initiatives — tracking research partnerships, model development milestones, and the data flywheel that connects fermentation batches to field outcomes.
* Help build the business case for each manufacturing phase expansion — marginal capex analysis, capacity-revenue mapping, and utilisation economics.

Operations, Reporting & Governance

* Build structured project plans, milestones, dashboards, and review mechanisms to track progress and drive accountability across all active programs.
* Prepare CEO-facing reviews, MIS dashboards, investor updates, and board-level business recommendations.
* Manage cross-functional collaboration with Finance, HR, Legal, IT, and external advisors to ensure smooth operations.
* Analyse business and program performance data to generate insights and support decision-making — from per-acre unit economics in agri to EBITDA modelling for B2B pilot batches.
* Identify operational bottlenecks, solve ambiguous business problems, and implement scalable processes as the organisation grows from a single-market operation to a multi-industry platform.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Engineering degree with strong academic credentials; MBA from a leading business school preferred.
* 4–10 years of experience in Program Management, Strategy, Business Operations, Management Consulting, or General Management roles — ideally in environments that span multiple industries or business lines.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities with a structured, first-principles approach to execution.
* Experience managing cross-functional stakeholders and driving outcomes without formal authority — across technical, commercial, and operational teams.
* High ownership mindset with the ability to thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous, and evolving environments where the playbook doesn’t exist yet.
* Ability to shift fluently between strategic thinking (market sizing, competitive positioning, capital planning) and hands-on execution (dashboards, vendor coordination, field visits).
* Strong written and verbal communication — you will prepare materials that go directly to the Founder, Governing Council, and investors.
* Intellectual curiosity about biology, fermentation, AI, and the broader bio-economy transition — you don’t need a science background, but you need to understand the platform at a technical level.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in Biotechnology, AgriTech, Pharmaceuticals, CDMO, Specialty Chemicals, Food Ingredients, or FMCG — any sector where biology meets manufacturing at scale.
* Exposure sales operations, commercial excellence, GTM strategy, or multi-geography market expansion.
* Experience working directly with founders, C-suite leadership, or in a CEO’s Office / Founder’s Office capacity at a high-growth company.
* Familiarity with regulatory processes (CIB, FCO, FSSAI, CDSCO), product validation programs, or field trial management.
* Comfort with financial modelling — unit economics, capacity utilisation, PE-framework evaluation, and investor-grade business plans.
* Exposure AI/ML workflows, data platforms, or computational biology — even at a non-technical level.

title: Senior Manager (Veeva Vault RIMS Expert)
description:
**Mumbai or Vadodara, India (hybrid role: 3 days office, 2 days home per week)**
**About The Company**
Pharmanovia is a dynamic, fast-growing international pharmaceutical company with a portfolio of over 20 brands across more than 160 markets. Our mission is to improve patient health globally through the revitalisation of niche, tried-and-trusted medicines. Our core behaviours are:
  
  

* We act decisively, but we never compromise on quality.
* We keep our promises and do as we say.
* We value our heritage and foster an entrepreneurial spirit.
* We reinvest in our future – in our products, our brands and our people.
* We give back to our communities.

Since its inception in 2013, Pharmanovia has grown consistently year on year, focusing on delivering high-quality branded prescription medicines to patients, prescribers, and healthcare providers worldwide. Our growth has enabled the company to reinvest in its products, brands, people, and to give back to its communities. A people business with a strong, supportive culture that encourages innovation and entrepreneurial spirit, our team comprises over 300 employees from 29 nationalities and operates from offices in the UK, Denmark, the Netherlands, Switzerland, Italy, Spain, Germany, the U.A.E., India, Australia, and Singapore. We are an agile, committed, and innovative global speciality pharma business and a preferred partner for innovator pharma companies, instigating a paradigm shift in the life cycle management of iconic medicines. We seek to engage extensively with clinical communities to communicate product improvements and to prioritise environmental, social, and governance considerations across the business and workforce. Pharmanovia’s therapeutic areas include Cardiovascular, Oncology, Endocrinology and Neurology.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced
**Senior Manager (Veeva Vault RIMS Expert)**
to take ownership of Pharmanovia’s regulatory technology platform. This role is responsible for the administration, configuration, optimisation and continuous improvement of the Veeva Vault RIMS ecosystem, ensuring it supports regulatory operations, data integrity and compliance across global markets. You will act as the subject-matter expert for Veeva Vault, working cross-functionally with Regulatory, Quality, and IT teams to drive platform performance, user adoption, and data quality.

**Platform Ownership & Release Management**

* Lead end-to-end Veeva Vault release management (planning, impact assessment, validation, testing, deployment)
* Coordinate with Veeva and internal teams for seamless releases
* Deliver training and demos for new functionality

**Data Governance & RIMS Data Management**

* Own regulatory data in Vault RIMS, ensuring accuracy, completeness and compliance
* Manage foundational data (product, variants, packaging)
* Monitor data quality using KPIs and implement CAPAs
* Lead data migration, cleansing, taxonomy and metadata management

**Configuration & Change Management**

* Configure workflows, lifecycle states, security models, document types and controlled vocabularies
* Manage change requests end-to-end, ensuring best practices and compliance
* Support ongoing system enhancements and internal releases

**Incident & Service Management**

* Lead incident management and issue resolution as the primary escalation point
* Coordinate with Veeva support for platform issues
* Drive process improvements to reduce incident volume

**Reporting & Insights**

* Develop and maintain reports and dashboards
* Identify data anomalies and ensure reporting accuracy

User Support & Adoption
  
  

* Provide global user support and training (structured and ad hoc)
* Create and maintain documentation, work instructions and guidance

**Access & Governance**

* Manage user access, roles and permissions aligned with governance standards
* Ensure compliance with data security and regulatory requirements

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify and deliver improvements to enhance system usability and efficiency
* Provide quarterly recommendations with measurable impact

**Qualifications**
**Essential Experience**

* 10+ years’ experience with Veeva Vault RIMS or similar systems
* Veeva Vault configuration and administration
* Regulatory data management and lifecycle processes
* Document management systems in life sciences
* Experience in GxP-regulated environments (GMP/GDP/GVP)
* Experience working with SaaS/cloud-based platforms

**Preferred**

* Experience in regulatory operations, submissions or publishing systems
* Knowledge of system validation, testing and Agile methodologies
* Veeva Vault certifications

**Pay Range And Compensation Package**
We offer a competitive salary plus a bonus and rewards package, including holidays, employee recognition awards, social events, a pension scheme, and hybrid working.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Statement**
Pharmanovia is an equal-opportunity employer. title: Securities & Derivatives Analyst Market Ops
description:
As the Treasury Operations Manager – Fixed Income & Money Market, you will be the operational backbone of our treasury desk. Your expertise will ensure that every trade—from government securities to short-term money market instruments—is executed, settled, and reconciled flawlessly. You will safeguard operational integrity, enhance process efficiency, and enable our traders and portfolio managers to focus on market opportunities with confidence
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
**Mandatory Requirements:**

* End-to-end settlement process for Fixed Income (G-Secs, corporate bonds, T-Bills) and Money Market instruments (CPs, CDs, call/notice money, repos).
* Verify, authorize, and release high-value transactions in compliance with RBI guidelines and internal risk controls.
* Coordinate with counterparties, custodians, clearing corporations, and internal teams to ensure timely trade confirmations and settlements.
* Monitor and resolve trade exceptions, breaks, and discrepancies through proactive follow-ups.
* Ensure accurate accounting entries, reconciliations, and regulatory reporting for all treasury transactions.
* Stay updated on market regulations, settlement cycles, and compliance requirements impacting treasury operations.
* Ensure accurate valuation of fixed income securities (G-Secs, SDLs, corporate bonds) using market-based and model-based approaches, in line with RBI and accounting standards.
* Good understanding on transactions processing of Primary & Secondary market corporate bond, CP & CD.
* Hands-on experience with market applications like NDS, CROMS, E-KUBER, CBRICS & FTrac.
* Manage operational aspects of Primary Dealership activities—auction participation, underwriting commitments, and secondary market trades.
* Prepare and review regulatory reports (ORFS, SGL, RBI returns) with zero tolerance for errors.
* Coordinate with front office, risk, compliance, and custodians to ensure smooth trade lifecycle management.
* Stay updated on RBI circulars, market developments, and valuation methodologies to ensure compliance and best practices.

**Good-to-Have Requirements:**

* Implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, reduce operational risk, and strengthen internal controls.
* Drive process improvements and automation initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and reduce risk.
* Manage daily cash flow, liquidity positions, and collateral requirements to support trading activities.
* Preparation of all related Regulatory submissions to RBI inclusive of Primary Dealership reports and Standard monthly, Quarterly as well as Yearly reports like PDR II, Risk Based Supervision, etc.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Master’s degree or relevant professional certifications (e.g., CA, FRM, CFA) preferred.

**What You'll Bring**

* 5–8 years of experience in Treasury Operations with a strong focus on fixed income and money market instruments.
* In-depth knowledge of valuation techniques for fixed income securities, including yield curve construction, duration/convexity analysis, and mark-to-market processes.
* Hands-on experience in Primary Dealership operations, including auction bidding, underwriting, and settlement.
* Strong understanding of RBI regulations, SGL/CSGL processes, and clearing systems.
* Proficiency in treasury management systems and advanced Excel skills.
* Exceptional attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work under tight deadlines.
* A collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively across teams.

description:

Delivers and manages all the applications in the ECIS environment in both the current state and in the future transformed state. Responsible for ensuring their current functioning in production at all times.

The key accountability of this function is to own, deliver, and manage all applications for ECIS through a combination of development, testing, implementation, and production tech operations. + Work with the Enterprise Architect for the end-to-end architecture of the proposed solutions from a functional and technical perspective, as well as from an InfoSec, Compliance, and Regulatory perspective.
+ Responsible for the overall governance, risk and controls implementation across the technology landscape.
+ Ensure that solution design, development, testing, implementation, and production tech operations processes are as per ECIS standards.

  
  

* Governance, Risk, and Controls (GRC)

- Create the Business Case for the programs covering the architecture, financials, business benefits of the different programs. Ensure follow-throughs on their approval processes.

+ Risk

- Identify, track, and mitigate all program risks through RAID logs.

+ Controls

- Ensure spends are within budget.

+ Financials

- Work closely with finance to provide accurate and timely cost and spend projections so as to ensure that finance is able to accurately account for the financials into the P&L.

* Resource Management

+ Resource Tracking

- Ensure that resource hiring and development plans are put in place for all resources, and are executed with no exceptions.
- All mandatory certifications are to be completed by all the resources.
- Ensure that each third party vendor resource has a defined exit date and the exit procedures are carried out in accordance with the defined exit date.

* Develop strong working relationships with local stakeholders like Product, Ops, HR, Finance etc.

+ Ensures that operational procedures are fit for purpose, and that operational problems are identified and resolved

* Technology Controls

+ Manage Technology Enterprise Risk Register

+ Establish and maintain the Business Process Architecture for core Technology Processes with support of accountable process owners.

* Vendor Management

+ Review and track Supplier SLAs and KPIs to ensure optimum portfolio support for Delivery teams

Mandatory

* Experience of setting up and managing high performance bank tech architecture from scratch.

**What Could Set You Apart**

* Apply new perspectives on existing solutions to solve complex problems.
