We are looking for a proactive, responsible, and result-oriented Operations Manager to oversee the day-to-day operations, maintenance, and service management of our crane fleet. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring crane uptime, coordinating maintenance activities, managing technicians and spare parts inventory, controlling operational expenses, and maintaining effective communication with clients and crane operators.

The ideal candidate should have strong coordination, problem-solving, communication, and operational management skills, with the ability to handle field operations and travel as required.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

**1. Crane Maintenance & Fleet Management**

* Oversee routine and preventive maintenance of cranes to ensure maximum equipment availability and operational efficiency.
* Monitor crane condition, upkeep, and maintenance schedules.
* Ensure timely identification and resolution of mechanical and operational issues.
* Coordinate breakdown maintenance and minimize equipment downtime.
* Maintain proper records of crane servicing, repairs, and maintenance activities.

**2. Technician & Service Team Coordination**

* Coordinate with technicians for daily maintenance and repair activities.
* Address and resolve technicians' technical queries and operational concerns.
* Monitor technician performance, work progress, and service quality.
* Ensure timely completion of assigned maintenance and repair tasks.

**3. Spare Parts & Inventory Management**

* Manage crane spare parts inventory and maintain adequate stock levels.
* Monitor spare parts consumption, availability, and replenishment requirements.
* Coordinate procurement of required spare parts.
* Maintain proper inventory records and ensure accountability for spare parts.
* Avoid unnecessary purchases, wastage, and inventory shortages.

**4. Expense & Cost Control**

* Monitor and control day-to-day operational and maintenance expenses.
* Ensure cost-effective utilization of manpower, materials, and resources.
* Maintain records of operational expenses and submit periodic reports to management.

**5. Client Relationship & Communication**

title: AVP - Journey Excellence and Optimisation
description:
Embark on a transformative journey as
**“**
AVP - Journey Excellence and Optimisation
**”**
at Barclays, where you’ll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You’ll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unparalleled customer experiences.
  
  
You will join the Business Banking transformation team, which shapes future-state operating models and redesigns end-to-end customer and colleague journeys. Working across Operations, Product, Technology, Risk, Compliance and Customer Experience, the team turns strategic designs into practical transformation roadmaps that simplify processes, strengthen controls and enable sustainable digital change.
  
  
**Skills**
To be successful in this role as a “AVP - Journey Excellence and Optimisation”, you should possess the following skillsets:
  
  
**Target Operating Model Design**

* Lead the development and evolution of Target Operating Models across Business Banking customer and operational journeys.
* Conduct current-state assessments to understand existing processes, customer and colleague pain points, operating structures, technology dependencies, controls and performance.
* Define future-state operating-model components across people, process, technology, data, controls, governance and performance management.
* Develop clear design principles to guide future-state structures, service models and ways of working.
* Define roles, responsibilities, capabilities, interaction models, governance arrangements and decision rights required to support the target state.
* Ensure proposed operating models are practical, scalable and aligned with Business Banking priorities, customer needs and applicable regulatory expectations.
* Maintain traceability between identified business problems, design decisions, proposed changes and intended outcomes.

**Customer and Colleague Journey Transformation**

* Lead the assessment and redesign of end-to-end customer and colleague journeys across areas such as onboarding, servicing, lending, Customer Due Diligence and case management.
* Apply customer-centred design principles to simplify journeys, reduce avoidable friction and improve customer and colleague outcomes.
* Facilitate journey-mapping and design workshops with operational teams, subject-matter experts and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Identify process gaps, failure points, unnecessary hand-offs, duplication, delays and control weaknesses.
* Translate complex operational challenges into simplified, scalable and digitally enabled future-state journeys.
* Ensure journey designs appropriately consider different customer needs, servicing requirements and risk profiles.
* Establish appropriate measures to assess the impact of journey changes on customer experience, service quality, turnaround time and operational performance.

**Process Optimisation and Continuous Improvement**

* Apply appropriate process-improvement methodologies to assess and redesign end-to-end processes.
* Develop current-state and future-state process maps, service blueprints and supporting design documentation.
* Identify opportunities to remove process debt, reduce manual activity, simplify hand-offs and improve first-time-right outcomes.
* Use operational data, customer insight and colleague feedback to identify root causes and prioritise improvement opportunities.
* Assess opportunities to improve productivity, create capacity and strengthen process resilience.
* Embed continuous-improvement principles within future-state processes and operating models.
* Support the identification, validation, measurement and tracking of transformation benefits.

**Digital, Automation and AI Enablement**

* Identify and assess opportunities to use digital workflow, automation, process mining, analytics, artificial intelligence and generative AI within Business Banking journeys.
* Work with Product and Technology partners to translate business requirements into appropriate digital and technology capabilities.
* Support the assessment of technology feasibility, business value, operational impact and control implications.
* Ensure that proposed technology solutions are integrated into the wider operating model rather than implemented as isolated process changes.
* Contribute to the design and implementation of workflow, case-management and AI-enabled servicing solutions.
* Promote responsible adoption of technology, with appropriate consideration of governance, data, customer outcomes, operational resilience and controls.

**Transformation Planning and Delivery**

* Translate agreed target-state designs into structured and executable delivery roadmaps.
* Define delivery phases, dependencies, business readiness requirements, risks, assumptions and intended outcomes.
* Support the development of business cases, investment proposals and governance submissions.
* Partner with change and delivery teams to transition designs from concept through mobilisation, implementation and embedding.
* Provide design oversight during delivery to ensure that implemented changes remain aligned with agreed target-state principles.
* Identify and manage design risks, dependencies and issues, escalating where appropriate.
* Support pilot, test-and-learn and phased implementation approaches where these are appropriate.
* Monitor delivery progress, benefit realisation and adoption against agreed measures.
* Produce clear updates, recommendations and decision papers for senior stakeholders and governance forums.

**Risk and Control**

* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work performed.
* Ensure target operating models and journey designs appropriately consider regulatory requirements, operational risk, customer outcomes, data, privacy and control effectiveness.
* Identify potential risks and control impacts arising from process, technology, organisational or operating-model changes.
* Engage Risk, Compliance, Legal and Control stakeholders at the appropriate stages of design and delivery.
* Ensure key controls, accountabilities, governance arrangements and escalation routes are clearly reflected in the future-state design.
* Support completion of relevant risk assessments, governance reviews and approvals.
* Escalate material design, delivery or control concerns through the appropriate governance channels.
* Ensure all activities and duties are carried out in full compliance with regulatory requirements, the Enterprise Risk Management Framework and applicable internal Barclays policies and standards.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills Include**

* Experience identifying and evaluating opportunities across digital workflow, automation, process mining, analytics, artificial intelligence and generative AI, including consideration of business value, operational impact, governance and controls.
* Experience developing business cases, benefits assessments, executive papers and senior-management updates, and providing design oversight through mobilisation, implementation and embedding.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based in our Pune office.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To collaborate with stakeholders and use data and MI to identify process optimisation opportunities for capacity creation in relevant business areas.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development and implementation of strategies to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of banking operations, using data led insights.
* Participation in projects and initiatives to improve performance & optimisation efficiency and effectiveness.
* Development of reports and presentations on performance & optimisation and communicate findings to internal senior stakeholders.
* Identification of industry trends and developments, and collaboration with stakeholders across the bank to provide recommendations for change and improvement within performance and optimisation processes.
* Development and implementation of analytics and reporting performance & optimisation to mitigate risks and maintain efficient operations.
* Identification of capacity creation in operations using data and Management Information.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: CTRM - RightAngle | Manager
description:
**Summary**

Leverage advanced data, AI, and emerging technologies with deep domain and industry insights to help bring clarity from complexity and accelerate the path to value creation.

Manager or equivalent
  
  
As a Manager at Deloitte Consulting, you will oversee the technical delivery of enterprise-scale software solutions, lead cross-functional and global teams and mentor junior members. Our market-leading teams help clients embrace complexity to accelerate performance, disrupt through innovation, and lead in their industries.
  
  
We help organizations in their efforts to achieve regulatory and legal compliance and transform their departments to add greater value to the business. We combine highly specialized skills focused on process, risk and controls to produce transformative insights. Our team

Specifically, our service offerings address the operations, compliance, and risk management challenges prevalent across the commodities value chain. * Have worked on or previously supported integration of Right Angle with other applications using.net class dll and WCF services.
* Leverage AzureDev Ops or similar deployment workflow for RA development and deployments
* Have worked on or have supported Right Angle version upgrades.
* Familiar with deployment of RightAngle enhancements and customizations.

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Familiarity with Service now ticket system
* Worked on Agile methodologies
* Worked on RightAngle version 15 or above.

**Education:**

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university.
* MBA or related PG preferred

**Location:**

* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. title: Lead - IT Operations
description:
IT and Operations Lead
  
  

* This role is ideal for someone who enjoys being deeply hands-on, solving problems directly, and building scalable IT practices from the ground up without heavy layers of management.
* Sahaj is a growing global software engineering consultancy — and this role sits right at the heart of that growth. You will be joining at a point where IT infrastructure, security, and operations need to scale alongside the business.
* That means building processes and systems that work today and hold up as the organisation expands — across headcount, offices, and complexity. If you have done this before in a similar environment, you will know exactly what this role demands.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own IT strategy and operations across global offices, while remaining hands-on in execution to ensure scalable, secure, and reliable systems.
* Actively manage and support infrastructure across Mac environments, SaaS platforms, and cloud services (AWS, GCP).
* Own and directly manage cloud governance practices, including billing oversight, cost management, resource tagging standards, and execution of platform upgrades.
* Hands-on ownership of endpoint and device security, including implementation and day-to-day management of tools such as Jamf, Sophos Endpoint, and similar platforms.
* Drive and execute processes around licensing, asset management, hardware provisioning, onboarding, and exit management — building for scale, not just the current headcount.
* Establish and implement standards for networking, hardware setup, and workplace IT practices across all locations.
* Provide practical, tool-driven security oversight for systems, data, and global collaboration.
* Partner with leadership to support business growth while actively resolving IT issues and maintaining operational reliability.
* Travel domestically as needed to align and implement IT practices across locations.
* Manage vendors and partners for asset purchase, leasing, sourcing, and decommissioning.

Good to Have
  
  

* Experience contributing to IT and security programmes in growing organisations.

Ideal Candidate
  
  

* ~8 years of experience in IT infrastructure, cloud platforms, and security, with exposure to distributed teams.
* Demonstrable experience working within a scaling organisation — you have built or significantly evolved IT infrastructure, processes, and security practices as a business has grown, and you understand the difference between what works at 50 people and what needs to change at 200.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Mac-based environments, SaaS tools, and enterprise cloud platforms (AWS/GCP).
* Proven hands-on experience with endpoint management and security tools such as Jamf, Sophos Endpoint, or equivalent.
* Demonstrated ability to build and execute IT processes, policies, and governance structures that scale — not just document them, but own them end to end.
* Strong working knowledge of cloud governance, including billing management, cost control, resource tagging, and upgrade execution.
* Comfortable operating as a hands-on individual contributor in a flat structure, with full ownership of IT operations and no existing team to inherit.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to work closely with leadership and teams across geographies.
* Based in Bangalore or Pune; fully on-site.

Sahaj Culture
  
  

* A culture defined by trust, radical transparency, and profound respect.
* The exhilarating opportunity to collaborate and learn from some of the finest minds in the technology industry.
* The freedom to work across multiple domains and redefine what's possible.

Benefits at Sahaj
  
  

* Unlimited leaves, trusting you to manage your balance.
* Life Insurance & Private Health insurance fully covered by Sahaj.
* RSUs, stake in our shared success.
* An authentically flat organizational structure (No hierarchy).
* Complete Open Salaries transparency.

**Job Description Summary**
Role purpose
  
  
Supervises employees on an assigned shift to perform maintenance or service functions to specific time, quality, and cost standards. At more senior levels may include a higher degree of troubleshooting and more complex maintenance such as machine installation/replacement or electrical work.

Perform a range of site-maintenance activities, critically reviewing and providing input while working within the established site-maintenance plan to achieve preestablished outcomes.

Troubleshoot and diagnose equipment and systems for emergency repairs and carry out preventive maintenance inspections.

Provide operational support services and sometimes act as first-line supervisor of transactional operations area. Involves using existing systems and protocols.

Respond to personal objectives and use performance management systems to improve personal performance; or monitor the performance of the team, allocate work and review completion, take appropriate corrective action to ensure timeliness and quality, and contribute to formal individual performance management and appraisal.

Follow the organization's health, safety, and environment (HSE) policies, procedures, and mandatory instructions to identify and mitigate environmental risks and risks to the well being of self and others in the workplace; instruct the team in safe working methods; identify instances of risky behaviors within the team and take appropriate action, escalating serious issues as appropriate.

Plan and coordinate testing and inspection of products and processes. Implement corrective actions or continuous improvement initiatives and monitor them to make sure they are effective.
  
  
**Operational Compliance**
Use the internal communications system to access specific information.

title: Manager – Supply Development
description:
**Position Summary**
The Supply Development Manager leads the development, qualification, and performance improvement of HUSCO’s India-based casting and machining supply base. The role is focused on hydraulic-grade iron castings (grey, compacted graphite, and ductile iron – greensand and shell mold), high-pressure aluminum die castings with secondary machining, and dedicated machine shops supplying finished components to HUSCO India and other global HUSCO facilities. The position partners with global Engineering, Purchasing, and Quality teams to launch new programs, drive supplier capability, and ensure delivered parts meet hydraulic application requirements.
  
  
HUSCO provides individuals with the opportunity to pursue a career within a fast-paced, industry-leading and entrepreneurial organization.
  
  
Husco is committed to building an environment for employees to be able:
  
  

* To have the flexibility of their own work and put a personal ‘stamp’ on their output.
* Continuously expand and development their professional skills and knowledge.
* Create a product for our customers that serves a greater purpose to communities around the world.

**PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES**

* New Product Introduction (NPI) Leadership
* Lead supplier development activities for new programs in partnership with global Engineering and Purchasing teams, from print review through SOP.
* Own and execute DPAR, PPAP, Safe Launch, and Heightened Control Plan deployment at India casting and machining suppliers.
* Support early design and manufacturability reviews for castings and machined components, including gating/feeding, machining stock, and critical-to-function feature capability.
* Drive supplier readiness, tooling validation, and PPAP approval to meet global launch timing for parts shipped to HUSCO facilities (India and global).
* Participate in capacity planning and equipment selection for the overall process for both foundry and machining development in partnership with Husco supply chain and supplier’s leadership team.
* Supplier Performance, Quality & Improvement
* Manage supplier performance against PPM, on-time delivery, and quality targets for the India casting and machining base supporting global HUSCO plants.
* Lead Non-Conformance Report (NCR) closure: ensure timely containment, root cause analysis, corrective action, and effectiveness verification at suppliers.
* Develop, deploy, and govern formal Supplier Improvement Plans (SIPs) for underperforming suppliers, with clear milestones and exit criteria.
* Drive process capability improvement in foundry operations (sand, melt chemistry, pouring, shakeout) and in machining (fixturing, tooling, CNC capability, metrology/gauging).
* Supplier Auditing & New Supplier Evaluation
* Conduct process, quality system, and capacity audits at existing iron foundries, aluminum HPDC suppliers, and machine shops.

title: Cluster Manager
description:
Go-Grab is building the next generation of smart vending and convenience retail in India. We operate smart vending machines across leading colleges and high-footfall locations, bringing snacks, beverages and everyday essentials closer to consumers through technology-driven retail.

As we continue expanding across cities and campuses, we are looking for a
**Cluster Manager**
to take ownership of our operations across a cluster.

About the Role

As a Cluster Manager, you will be responsible for ensuring that our machines are consistently operational, well-stocked and performing efficiently. This is a highly hands-on role involving
**people management, inventory, field operations, machine performance, vendor management and problem-solving**
.

You will work closely with the central operations, supply chain, technology and business teams to ensure smooth execution on the ground.

What you'll do

* Own
  **end-to-end operations**
  for Go-Grab's machines across your assigned city/cluster
* Ensure high machine uptime, product availability and operational performance
* Manage and supervise
  **field teams, refillers, technicians and other on-ground partners**
* Plan and monitor daily refilling, replenishment and inventory movement
* Track machine-level performance and identify underperforming locations
* Conduct regular
  **RCA (Root Cause Analysis)**
  for operational issues and implement corrective actions
* Ensure machines are properly maintained, clean, functional and customer-ready
* Monitor inventory, stock availability, expiry and product movement
* Coordinate with the warehouse/supply team to ensure timely replenishment
* Manage vendors and third-party service providers where required
* Handle escalations from colleges, customers and internal teams
* Build strong relationships with
  **college/institution stakeholders**
  at the operational level
* Support new machine installations and
  **new campus launches**

What we're looking for

* **2–6 years of experience**
  in operations, city operations, field operations, supply chain, logistics, retail operations or a similar role
* Experience managing
  **multiple locations/sites**
  is strongly preferred
* Experience managing field teams, vendors, delivery teams, technicians or frontline employees
* Strong people-management and execution abilities
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment
* Willing to be
  **hands-on and spend time on the ground**
  when required
* Strong ownership mentality — you don't wait for someone else to solve a problem
* Experience in
  **quick commerce, logistics, FMCG, retail, food & beverage, facility management or other field operations**
  is a plus

Who will thrive in this role?

We're looking for someone who is
**street-smart, resourceful and highly execution-oriented**
.

This is not a desk-only operations role. You should be comfortable going to a campus, speaking to a refiller, checking a machine, investigating why inventory is missing, understanding why availability has dropped, solving the issue and putting a process in place so it doesn't happen again.

You will have significant ownership of your city's performance and will be expected to
**identify problems before they become escalations**
.

If you enjoy solving real-world operational problems, managing people and building processes in a fast-growing startup, this role is for you.

title: Manager - Operations
description:
**About Udhyam**
Udhyam Learning Foundation is on a mission towards Making Bharat Entrepreneurial. We believe that
  
  
entrepreneurship is a powerful way to channelize an individual’s potential. Entrepreneurship enables agency and allows an individual to work on their strengths while creating value for the world.
  
  
Our Programs
  
  

* Udhyam Shiksha works on developing entrepreneurial mindsets among the youth and enabling them to achieve their potential, having impacted :47,00,000 learners across 12 Indian states.
* Udhyam Vyapaar focuses on nano businesses in India, and solving large problems faced by them, at scale; having already enabled 10000+ entrepreneurs.

**About Maadhyam**
Maadhyam is Udhyam’s initiative to bridge the gap between government school students and opportunities beyond the classroom.
  
  
Working with students in Grades 9–12, Maadhyam helps young people discover and access opportunities that can shape their future — from scholarships and internships to exposure visits, mentorships, courses and employment pathways.
  
  
The program is currently embedded within government school systems across Haryana, Punjab and Uttarakhand. In its first three months, Maadhyam reached over 4,500 students and generated 14 offers.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Manager to lead Maadhyam’s operations team and help shape the next phase of the program.
  
  
The person will manage a team across Maadhyam operations, student engagement and content creation. They will guide and mentor the team, enable independent ownership, and ensure strong execution across functions.
  
  
The role will work closely with the Director – Maadhyam to shape strategy, identify opportunities for growth and translate these into execution.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Strategy & Program Development
  
  

* Work with the Director and define Maadhyam’s strategy, priorities and approach.You will own the operations outcomes across all states.
* Understand the opportunity ecosystem for young people and identify gaps and potential areas for Maadhyam to build.
* Translate strategy into clear plans across operations, student engagement and content.
* Use insights from students, partners and the team to continuously improve the program.

Team Leadership
  
  

* Lead, manage and develop the central and state teams for Maadhyam.
* Set clear priorities and outcomes while enabling team members to independently own their areas.
* Coach team members on problem-solving, stakeholder management and quality of execution and build a culture of ownership, collaboration and accountability.

Opportunities & Student Engagement
  
  

* Plan daily school & student engagement with field teams, and hold the teams to execution accountability
* Guide the team in taking partners to school, design the interventions, build buzz, follow up with students, and supporting students in understanding about and applying to opportunities & beyond
* Own teacher and student led models in target schools, be outcome focussed and devise execution plans accordingly
* Build a team that is empathetic towards students, and can work with students, teachers, parents and the partners you identify to collectively ensure students can access more opportunities with greater confidence
* Build content & digital media engagement strategies to find ways to engage students, unearth their aspirations, expose them to new learning and career pathways

Partnerships & Ecosystem
  
  

* Support the team in converting partnerships into meaningful, high-quality opportunities for students.
* Help navigate complex stakeholders and build long-term relationships.

Execution & Learning
  
  

* Build and maintain strong relationships with government officials, partner organisations, resource persons, district officials, school principals and teachers.
* Establish systems for monitoring program implementation and outcomes. Build the team's capacity to collect, analyse and use data for decision-making, identify gaps and drive corrective actions.
* Foster a culture of experimentation and learning, identifying what is working and what needs to change.
* Drive improvements in how Maadhyam operates and delivers outcomes for students.
* Take overall accountability for performance, proactively identify opportunities and challenges, make informed decisions, and ensure timely achievement of program goals.
* Work closely with State teams, Curriculum, M&E, Product & Tech, HR, Communications and other teams to ensure effective planning, coordination and delivery.

What We're Looking For
  
  

* 7–10 years of experience, with meaningful experience in the development, education, social sector, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of one or more areas relevant to Maadhyam — youth/student engagement, content creation, ecosystem building or program implementation.
* Strong strategic thinking with the ability to get into the details and drive execution.
* Excellent communication in English and Hindi, networking and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong ownership, grit and bias for action and experimentation, with the ability to take initiative, lead teams and drive tasks to completion.
* Comfort working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment.
* Excited by Maadhyam’s mission of expanding access to opportunities for young people who have limited guidance, exposure and confidence in accessing them.
* Strong experience in team management and large-scale operations, with the ability to experiment, pilot new approaches and deliver results with limited resources.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams, government stakeholders, partners and other external stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving skills, adaptability, and a continuous willingness to learn, improve, and respond effectively to changing program needs.

Started in 2002 by a group of young corporate professionals, today Smile has evolved into a national level development organization impacting lives of over 2 million under privileged children and their families with project presence in 27 states across India,10 offices in strategic locations and over 650 employees, besides countless volunteers, well- wishers and supporters.

Furthermore, continuously for past Six years Smile is a Great Place to Work © Certified organization and is considered ‘Gold Standard’ in identifying and recognizing Great Workplace Cultures.

description:

·Coordinate closely with manufacturing plants to communicate allocation plans and production requirements, ensure timely production and dispatch of tyres, and drive closure of complete as well as partially fulfilled export orders.

·Collaborate with Central Planning and manufacturing teams by sharing weekly pending order reports, reviewing production constraints, and supporting production prioritization to meet export commitments.

·Optimize inventory utilization and order fulfillment through continuous review of stock availability at plants and monitoring unallocated warehouse inventory to support efficient export order execution.

·Prepare and maintain MIS and performance reports covering order status, stock allocation, dispatches, pending orders, shipment readiness, and other key operational metrics for management review and decision-making.

·Inventory Allocation Accuracy (%)

·Pending Order Aging (Days)

· Dispatch Lead Time Compliance

·Plant Coordination and Order Closure Effectiveness

·Customer Order Service Level Achievement

* Production Planning Interface
* MIS & Data Analysis
* Warehouse Operations Understanding

* Stakeholder Management
* Process Improvement & Problem Solving

title: D2CX, Founder's Office
description:
The
**Founder’s Office- Inc42 Courses**
owns the growth engine behind Inc42's executive education vertical —
**D2CX, D2CX Foundations, RetailX and D2CX.AI.**

This role sits inside the Founder's Office and works across two mandates. First,
**new initiatives**
: identifying what Inc42 Courses should build next — new programs, formats, cohorts, pricing constructs, and revenue lines — and taking them from idea to live product. Second,
**operating efficiency**
: acting as the connective tissue between content, editorial, design, marketing, growth, product, and operations so that every cohort runs tighter, faster, and more profitably than the last.

Inc42 Courses has already worked with 400+ D2C founders across eight cohorts. The next phase is about scale — more programs, more learners, better unit economics, and a repeatable operating system that doesn't depend on heroics.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who can think like a product owner, execute like a program manager, and read a funnel like a growth marketer.

**Your Impact in This Role:**

* **Build What's Next:**
  You'll research, design, and launch new programs, formats, and revenue lines across the Inc42 Courses portfolio — from curriculum architecture to pricing to go-to-market.
* **Own The Operating System:**
  You'll design the end-to-end operating model for course delivery — admissions, onboarding, session flow, mentor management, community, and completion — and make it repeatable across programs.
* **Drive Cross-Functional Efficiency:**
  You'll align content, design, marketing, growth, product, and operations around a single cohort calendar, removing dependencies and duplicated effort.
* **Make The Numbers Visible:**
  You'll build the dashboards and reporting cadence that give founders real-time visibility into enrolments, funnel health, revenue, engagement, and learner outcomes.
* **Raise The Bar On Experience:**
  You'll own learner experience end-to-end, ensuring every cohort reflects the standard associated with the Inc42 brand.

**About Inc42 Media**

**Inc42**
**is India's #1 startup media & intelligence platform**
that informs, educates and empowers startup & business leaders through its incisive reporting, insightful reports, curated Events, Conferences & communities, and industry-leading executive courses & programs.

Since launching in January 2015 and having risen to become the authoritative voice on India's startup economy, we've moved markets, gotten the early scoop on billions of dollars of transactions, and told you what's happening deep inside some of the fastest-growing startups & industries alike. Our stories have been followed by the Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg, Reuters, TechCrunch, and other major outlets hundreds of times. We also track over 10,000+ startups and provide market research and intelligence through our in-depth research reports, and we organise some of the most sought-after conferences and Events for startup & business leaders across India.

**The Inc42 Impact**

* Inc42 stories reach over
  **50 Mn+**
  people monthly
* Published more than
  **55,000**
  stories
* Successfully conducted
  **150+**
  events
* Launched
  **100+**
  research reports
* Receives
  **500+**
  startup applications monthly
* Worked with
  **350+**
  brands

**The Inc42 Courses Portfolio**

**Program**

**Format**

**Built For**

**D2CX**

12-week hands-on hybrid accelerator

Early-stage D2C founders scaling from INR 1 Cr to 10 Cr

**D2CX Foundations**

6-week self-paced + live program

First-time founders launching a D2C brand profitably

**D2CX.AI**

Focused paid program on AI-led brand & content building

D2C operators building an AI-native marketing stack

**Primary Responsibilities**

**1. New Initiatives & Program Development**

* Identify, evaluate, and build new initiatives across the Inc42 Courses vertical — new programs, cohort formats, certifications, workshops, sprints, and community layers.
* Run market, competitor, and demand research to validate what founders will pay for, and translate findings into concept notes, business cases, and launch plans.
* Own curriculum architecture in partnership with editorial and faculty — module structure, session outcomes, assignments, tooling, and assessment.
* Define pricing, cohort sizing, seat economics, and revenue targets for each program; test and iterate on offers.
* Take new programs from concept to live — landing page, curriculum, faculty, funnel, launch campaign, and first cohort — with clear ownership at every step.

**2. Program Operations & Cohort Delivery**

* Own the end-to-end cohort lifecycle across D2CX, D2CX Foundations, and D2CX.AI — from admissions and onboarding to sessions, assignments, community, and convocation.
* Build and run the cohort calendar: session scheduling, speaker confirmations, content readiness, platform setup, and communication timelines.
* Manage the live + self-paced delivery mix — ensuring recordings, resources, playbooks, and templates reach fellows on time and in the right format.
* Track attendance, engagement, drop-offs, and completion; intervene early on at-risk fellows.
* Troubleshoot in real time during live sessions and cohort weeks, keeping delivery quality uncompromised.

**3. Cross-Functional Efficiency & Systems**

* Act as the single point of alignment across content, design, marketing, growth, product/tech, partnerships, and operations for everything Courses.
* Map current workflows, identify duplicated effort and bottlenecks, and rebuild them into leaner, documented processes with clear owners and turnaround times.
* Run a weekly operating rhythm — review calls, blockers, dependencies, and next actions — with complete visibility for the Founder's Office.
* Drive automation and tooling decisions across LMS, CRM, payments, community platforms, and internal trackers to reduce manual load per cohort.
* Ensure every recurring activity has an SOP, a template, and a named owner — so cohort N+1 costs less effort than cohort N.

**4. Funnel, Revenue & Performance Reporting**

* Own the admissions funnel end-to-end — applications, screening, conversion, payments, and onboarding — in partnership with marketing and growth.
* Work with marketing on acquisition campaigns, landing pages, content, referral loops, and alumni-led demand for each program.
* Track and report on enrolment, revenue, CAC, conversion rates, refunds, completion, NPS, and alumni outcomes.
* Build weekly and monthly dashboards and MIS for founders, with clear reads on what's working, what's at risk, and what needs a decision.
* Manage program P&L inputs — faculty costs, platform costs, production, marketing spend — and drive cost efficiency without diluting experience.

**5. Mentor & Alumni Ecosystem**

* Identify, onboard, and manage faculty, mentors, and session speakers from India's top operator and investor pool.
* Own speaker briefs, session outlines, moderation documents, and pre-session prep to ensure every session delivers a sharp, tactical takeaway.
* Build and activate the alumni network across cohorts — community programming, referrals, testimonials, and case studies.
* Manage partner and sponsor integrations within programs, ensuring deliverables are met without compromising learner experience.

**6. Documentation, Playbooks & Quality Control**

* Document program playbooks, SOPs, checklists, and templates for every recurring workflow across the vertical.
* Run structured post-cohort reviews — capturing feedback, learnings, content gaps, and operational misses — and convert them into changes for the next cohort.
* Act as the quality check on outward-facing course material: curriculum decks, landing pages, emailers, session collateral, and fellow communication.
* Maintain a single source of truth for cohort data, content libraries, and program documentation.

**Growth Path**

* Take ownership of the full Inc42 Courses P&L across programs.
* Expand the vertical into new categories, audiences, and formats beyond D2C.
* Evolve into a broader business ownership role across Inc42's education and community verticals.

**Professional Traits/Skills Required**

* 3–5 years of experience in program management, edtech operations, community-led programs, business operations, consulting, or a founder's office role — preferably in startups, media, or education-led organisations.
* Demonstrated ability to take a new initiative from idea to launch, including research, structuring, and go-to-market.
* Strong comfort with numbers — funnels, unit economics, cohort metrics, and budget management — and the ability to turn data into decisions.
* Proven track record of running multiple programs or projects in parallel with tight timelines and high visibility.
* Excellent written communication, with the ability to produce concept notes, curriculum outlines, speaker briefs, and founder-facing reports.
* Strong stakeholder management skills — comfortable working with founders, CXOs, operators, investors, faculty, and internal teams.
* A systems mindset: bias for documentation, SOPs, automation, and process improvement over repeated firefighting.
* Genuine interest in the D2C and consumer brand ecosystem; prior exposure to cohort-based learning, accelerators, or founder communities is a strong plus.
* Proficient in Google Workspace, Excel/Sheets, Notion, Asana, and modern productivity and analytics tools; familiarity with LMS, CRM, and marketing automation platforms is preferred.
* P.S: Past D2C, Founder office experience preferred

title: Remote Pod Lead - Civil and structural Engineering
description:
**About Turing:**

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

Role Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Civil or Structural Engineering expert to lead a pod of trainers building realistic, terminal-based technical tasks for Terminal Bench Science. You will review every task your trainers produce for engineering correctness, reproducibility, and grader reliability, and coach trainers to consistently deliver high-quality tasks.

**Reporting Structure:**

Reports to the Civil & Structural Engineering Team Lead. Leads a pod of approximately 5–10 trainers.

**What you'll do:**

* Review engineering tasks end to end, including problem statements, structural and geotechnical models, load cases, simulation data, computational environments, reference solutions, and automated tests.
* Validate tasks involving structural analysis, finite-element methods (FEA), earthquake and wind engineering, structural dynamics, geotechnical modeling, hydraulics, hydrology, transportation, and infrastructure systems.
* Ensure tasks require genuine multi-step engineering reasoning and reflect realistic civil and structural engineering workflows.
* Verify engineering accuracy across units, equilibrium, boundary conditions, load combinations, design codes, numerical stability, convergence, and safety factors.
* Validate computational models, solvers, dependencies, and simulation results for reproducibility and technical correctness.
* Review automated graders to ensure they evaluate meaningful engineering outputs such as forces, deflections, drifts, settlements, factors of safety, flow rates, and structural performance.
* Identify technical errors, unrealistic assumptions, incorrect tolerances, and opportunities to bypass engineering analysis.
* Provide clear, actionable feedback to task developers and track revisions through completion.
* Mentor and support technical trainers, allocate work, monitor quality and productivity, and resolve technical blockers.
* Maintain quality standards, technical documentation, and best practices across engineering task development.

**What we're looking for:**

* Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced technical experience in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Strong programming experience in Python, C/C++, Julia, Fortran, or MATLAB/Octave, with proficiency in Linux environments.
* Hands-on expertise in at least one major area: structural analysis, FEA, earthquake engineering, geotechnical modeling, or hydraulic/hydrological modeling.
* Strong understanding of engineering principles, numerical methods, simulation workflows, and model validation.
* Working knowledge of engineering design standards such as ASCE 7, ACI, AISC, Eurocodes, or IS codes.
* Experience reviewing complex technical work, engineering simulations, research outputs, or computational models.
* Strong analytical judgment with the ability to identify technical inaccuracies, edge cases, and flawed engineering assumptions.
* Experience mentoring, reviewing, or leading small technical teams.
* Excellent written communication skills for providing precise technical feedback and documenting quality standards.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with engineering simulation and analysis tools such as OpenSees/OpenSeesPy, Code\_Aster, CalculiX, FEniCS, Gmsh, PyNite, EPANET, SWMM, HEC-RAS, MODFLOW, SUMO, QGIS, or GDAL.
* Familiarity with commercial engineering software such as SAP2000, ETABS, Abaqus, PLAXIS, or STAAD.Pro.
* Experience with nonlinear time-history analysis, performance-based design, reliability analysis, or structural health monitoring.
* Familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
* Experience developing or evaluating AI coding agents, terminal-based agents, or LLM-generated engineering solutions.
* Professional engineering licensure such as PE, SE, CEng, or equivalent.
* Industry experience working on buildings, bridges, transportation networks, water systems, or major infrastructure projects.
* Prior experience in AI training, technical quality control, benchmark development, or evaluation programs.

**Offer Details:**

* Commitments Required: At least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.

title: Remote Pod Lead - Chemical Engineering
description:
**About Turing:**

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking an experienced Chemical Engineering expert to lead a team of technical trainers developing realistic, terminal-based engineering tasks for a frontier AI training and evaluation initiative.

In this role, you will oversee a pod of approximately 5–10 trainers, review chemical engineering tasks for technical accuracy, reproducibility, and evaluation quality, and ensure tasks reflect authentic chemical engineering workflows. You will also mentor trainers, maintain quality standards, and drive consistent task delivery.

**What you'll do:**

* Lead and mentor a pod of technical trainers, ensuring consistent quality, productivity, and timely delivery of chemical engineering tasks.
* Review engineering tasks end to end, including problem statements, reaction kinetics, thermodynamic and property data, process flowsheets, computational environments, reference solutions, and automated tests.
* Validate tasks involving reaction engineering, thermodynamics, phase equilibria, transport phenomena, separation processes, process simulation, process control, optimization, combustion, and electrochemical engineering.
* Ensure tasks reflect realistic chemical engineering workflows and require meaningful multi-step technical reasoning.
* Verify engineering correctness across mass and energy balances, thermodynamic consistency, property data, unit handling, and numerical convergence.
* Validate computational models, stiff ODE/DAE solvers, solver tolerances, initial conditions, and simulation results to ensure reproducibility and technical accuracy.
* Review automated graders to ensure they evaluate meaningful engineering outputs such as conversion, yield, selectivity, purity, energy consumption, and process constraint satisfaction.
* Identify technical inaccuracies, unrealistic assumptions, incorrect tolerances, and opportunities to bypass engineering calculations or simulations.
* Provide clear, actionable technical feedback, track revisions, and ensure quality issues are resolved before task approval.
* Onboard trainers, allocate work, monitor quality and throughput, escalate blockers, and maintain technical documentation and best practices.

**What we're looking for:**

* Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced technical experience in Chemical Engineering.
* Strong programming skills in Python, Julia, C/C++, or MATLAB/Octave, with proficiency in Linux environments.
* Hands-on expertise in at least one major area: process modeling, reaction kinetics, thermodynamic modeling, process simulation, or optimization.
* Strong understanding of chemical engineering fundamentals, numerical methods, computational modeling, and technical validation.
* Experience reviewing complex technical work, chemical process simulations, computational models, or research outputs.
* Ability to evaluate mass and energy balances, thermodynamic assumptions, numerical accuracy, solver convergence, and the reliability of computational results.
* Strong analytical judgment with the ability to identify technical errors, edge cases, and flawed engineering assumptions.
* Experience mentoring, reviewing, or leading small technical teams.
* Excellent written communication skills for providing precise technical feedback and documenting quality standards.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with chemical engineering simulation and computational tools such as Cantera, CoolProp, Pyomo, IDAES, DWSIM, CasADi, or OpenFOAM.
* Familiarity with commercial process simulation software such as Aspen Plus, Aspen HYSYS, or gPROMS, including reproducing workflows using open-source tools.
* Experience with process optimization, reactor modeling, separation systems, process control, or electrochemical simulations.
* Familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
* Experience developing or evaluating AI coding agents, terminal-based agents, or LLM-generated engineering solutions.
* Industry experience in petrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, energy, specialty chemicals, or chemical process manufacturing.
* Prior experience in AI training, technical quality control, benchmark development, or evaluation programs.

**Offer Details:**

* Commitments Required: At least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
* Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)

* Ensure tolerances reflect method-dependent, numerical, and stochastic variation without accepting chemically incorrect results.
* Ensure graders verify energies, geometries, thermodynamic quantities, rate constants, spectral assignments, or molecular properties rather than formatting.
* Ensure tasks cannot be gamed through hard-coded outputs, reading test files, or bypassing the intended computation.
* Screen tasks for chemical safety and dual-use concerns.
* Escalate content involving the synthesis or enhancement of hazardous, toxic, or controlled substances.
* Provide clear, actionable written feedback and track revisions through closure.
* Onboard and mentor trainers on task design standards, common pitfalls, and grader design.
* Allocate work across the pod and track throughput and quality metrics.
* Escalate blockers.
* Maintain pod documentation covering guidelines, recurring issues, and exemplary tasks.

* Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced experience in chemistry or a closely related field.
* Strong programming skills in Python, C/C++, Julia, or Fortran, with Linux and terminal proficiency.
* Hands-on experience with computational chemistry, molecular simulation, cheminformatics, or chemical data analysis.

title: Fleet & Maintenance Manager
description:
At Alstom, we build what millions depend on daily - rail transportation systems that can't afford to fail. We're more than 85,000 people worldwide creating the industry's most diverse portfolio: high-speed trains, metros, trams, maintenance services and integrated systems.
  
  
**Your future role**
Take on a new challenge and apply your
**rolling stock maintenance, reliability, and leadership expertise**
in a dynamic rail environment.
  
  
You’ll lead fleet maintenance activities to ensure
**high availability, reliability, safety, and performance**
of rolling stock. Working closely with Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, and Maintenance teams, you’ll drive operational excellence and continuous improvement across the fleet.
  
  
Day-to-day, you’ll oversee maintenance planning and execution, optimize resources, analyze reliability performance, and introduce modern maintenance practices and digital technologies.
  
  
**We’ll look to you for:**

* Leading fleet maintenance planning and execution to achieve availability and reliability targets
* Optimizing maintenance schedules, workloads, and resource allocation
* Driving Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM) and predictive maintenance strategies
* Analyzing reliability and maintenance data to reduce failures and unplanned downtime
* Implementing condition-based monitoring, digital tools, and IoT-based maintenance solutions
* Coordinating with Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, and other stakeholders
* Using CMMS to strengthen maintenance planning, execution, and asset management
* Driving Lean and continuous improvement initiatives to improve maintenance efficiency
* Ensuring adherence to safety, quality, and maintenance standards
* Developing team capability and promoting knowledge sharing and best practices

**All about you**
We value technical expertise, leadership, and a continuous improvement mindset. Some of the skills and experience that will help you succeed include:
  
  

* B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, or a relevant Engineering discipline
* 12–14 years of relevant experience, preferably in rolling stock or fleet maintenance
* Strong knowledge of rolling stock systems, fleet maintenance, and asset management
* Experience in maintenance planning, execution, and reliability improvement
* Experience with CMMS tools such as Maximo or Infor EAM
* Understanding of RCM, predictive maintenance, and condition-based maintenance
* Ability to interpret technical documentation, maintenance manuals, and reliability data
* Knowledge of Lean or Six Sigma methodologies
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder-management skills

**Your key network and stakeholders**
You’ll work closely with:
  
  

* Fleet Maintenance and Operations teams
* Engineering and Reliability teams
* Supply Chain
* Quality and Safety teams
* Cross-functional technical teams
* External partners and stakeholders

**How your success will be measured**
Your contribution will be reflected through:
  
  

* Achievement of fleet availability and reliability targets
* Reduction in unplanned failures and downtime
* Improvement in maintenance efficiency
* Achievement of contractual maintenance KPIs
* Effective resource and workload management
* Safety and quality performance
* Continuous improvement in fleet performance

**Things you’ll enjoy**
Join a challenging railway environment where you’ll work with
**advanced rolling stock and digital maintenance technologies**
while making a direct impact on fleet performance.
  
  
You’ll collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, develop your expertise in
**reliability and asset management**
, contribute to innovative maintenance practices, and help shape more efficient and sustainable mobility.
  
  
You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!
  
  
**Important to note**
As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

title: SOC Manager - IN
description:
**About Rackspace Cyber Defence**
Rackspace Cyber Defence is our next generation cyber defence and security operations capability that builds on 20+ years of securing customer environments to deliver proactive, risk-based, threat-informed and intelligence driven security services.
  
  
**Our purpose**
is to enable our customers to defend against the evolving threat landscape across on-premises, private cloud, public cloud and multi-cloud workloads.
  
  
**Our goal**
is to go beyond traditional security controls to deliver cloud-native, DevOps-centric and fully integrated 24x7x365 cyber defence capabilities that deliver a
**proactive**
,
**threat-informed**
,
**risk-based**
,
**intelligence-driven**
approach to detecting and responding to threats.
  
  
**Our Mission Is To Help Our Customers**

* Proactively detect and respond to cyber-attacks – 24x7x365.
* Defend against new and emerging risks that impact their business.
* Reduce their attack surface across private cloud, hybrid cloud, public cloud, and multi-cloud environments.
* Reduce their exposure to risks that impact their identity and brand.
* Develop operational resilience.
* Maintain compliance with legal, regulatory and compliance obligations.

**What We’re Looking For**
To support our continued success and deliver a Fanatical Experience™ to our customers, Rackspace Technology is seeking an experienced, technically proficient and customer-focused
**Security Operations Manager**
to lead the delivery of its 24×7 Managed Security Services.
  
  
The successful candidate will lead a multidisciplinary team of security analysts and engineers responsible for threat detection, incident investigation, incident response, vulnerability management and security operations across customer environments.
  
  
This is a
**hands-on technical leadership role**
, requiring strong incident investigation capabilities, excellent customer engagement skills and proven experience managing security operations in an MSSP or enterprise SOC environment.
  
  
The Security Manager will be responsible for maintaining operational excellence, developing technical capabilities, mentoring engineers and driving continuous improvements across Rackspace's Cyber Defense portfolio.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* SOC Leadership & Team Management
* Lead, manage and mentor a team of SOC analysts, security engineers and technical specialists across L1/L2/L3 functions.
* Oversee 24×7 security operations, shift coverage, workload distribution, incident escalation and operational readiness.
* Provide technical direction and guidance during complex investigations and security incidents.
* Conduct technical reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, coaching and skills development.
* Drive analyst productivity, operational quality and team performance.
* Maintain effective collaboration across security service towers.
* Security Incident Investigation & Response
* Lead technical investigations into critical and high-severity security incidents, including malware, ransomware, compromised identities, unauthorized access, suspicious network activity and cloud security threats.
* Act as the security incident lead for P1/P2 incidents, coordinating investigation, containment, remediation guidance and security recovery validation.
* Perform or oversee advanced analysis of endpoint telemetry, security logs, network events, indicators of compromise and attacker techniques.
* Guide analysts in threat hunting, incident correlation, root cause analysis and forensic evidence preservation.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, network, cloud, IAM, application and customer security teams to facilitate incident resolution.
* Ensure timely customer communication, incident updates, escalations and post-incident reporting.
* Maintain and improve incident response playbooks and investigation procedures.
* Managed Security Services & Technology Ownership

**Oversee Security Operations Across Rackspace's RCDC Portfolio, Including**

* XDR / SIEM: Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic Security and associated detection, investigation, correlation and response workflows.
* EDR: CrowdStrike Falcon and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, including threat investigation, containment, policy tuning and agent health.
* VMDR: Qualys vulnerability management, assessment coverage, vulnerability prioritization, reporting and remediation coordination.
* Edge Security: Cloudflare WAF, DDoS protection and associated security monitoring and response.
* Managed Network Security: Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet and native cloud security controls, including security incident coordination and policy management.
* MDRM / External Threat Monitoring: CloudSEK and related external exposure and threat intelligence capabilities.
* Cloud Security: CSPM/CNAPP technologies such as Prowler and Upwind, as applicable to the evolving service portfolio.

The role requires strong working knowledge of core SOC technologies and the ability to lead specialists across the broader portfolio. Deep hands-on expertise in every individual product is not expected.
  
  

* Customer Engagement & Service Delivery
* Serve as a senior technical point of contact for customer CISOs, security leaders and technical stakeholders.
* Lead technical incident discussions, operational reviews, security workshops and customer escalations.
* Explain security incidents, risks, investigation findings and remediation recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ensure delivery against agreed SLAs, KPIs, customer commitments and security service objectives.
* Oversee customer onboarding, monitoring coverage, policy configuration and operational handover.
* Identify recurring customer issues and recommend improvements to security controls, detections and operational processes.
* Build trusted customer relationships through proactive communication and technical credibility.
* Detection Engineering, Threat Intelligence & Automation
* Oversee detection rule development, tuning, alert correlation and false-positive reduction.
* Promote proactive threat hunting using MITRE ATT&CK, threat intelligence and adversary TTPs.
* Develop and improve security investigation and response runbooks.
* Identify opportunities for SOAR automation, AI-assisted investigation and pre-approved response actions.
* Improve SOC effectiveness through measurable reductions in alert noise, investigation effort and response delays.
* Ensure security automation follows appropriate authorization, testing, logging and change-control procedures.
* Vulnerability & Exposure Management
* Oversee vulnerability assessment operations, scanning coverage and agent health monitoring.
* Ensure critical vulnerabilities are appropriately prioritized, communicated and tracked.
* Coordinate remediation activities with infrastructure, cloud, application and customer teams.
* Monitor vulnerability aging, overdue findings, risk exceptions and remediation validation.
* Support customers in understanding and reducing security exposure.
* Governance, Reporting & Continuous Improvement
* Maintain SOC operational standards, investigation quality, documentation and service delivery controls.
* Track operational KPIs such as incident response compliance, investigation quality, monitoring coverage, customer escalations and service improvement.
* Lead security incident reviews, root cause analysis and corrective action planning.
* Maintain operational runbooks, escalation procedures and knowledge documentation.
* Support service enhancements, technology integrations and operational readiness for new security offerings.

**Skills & Experience**

* 10–15 years of cybersecurity experience, including approximately 4–6 years in SOC leadership, incident response or security operations management.
* Proven experience managing a 24×7 SOC or MSSP security operations environment.
* Strong hands-on experience in security incident investigation, threat detection, incident response and log analysis.
* Practical expertise in at least one major SIEM platform, preferably Microsoft Sentinel or Elastic Security.
* Strong experience with enterprise EDR technologies such as CrowdStrike Falcon or Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
* Working knowledge of vulnerability management platforms, preferably Qualys.
* Understanding of cloud security across Azure, AWS and GCP.
* Knowledge of network security, firewalls, WAF, identity security and endpoint protection.
* Experience with MITRE ATT&CK, NIST incident response guidance and security operations best practices.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent customer communication, stakeholder management and presentation skills.
* Experience handling major security incidents and coordinating multidisciplinary technical teams.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and develop high-performing technical teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in an MSSP or managed security services organization supporting multiple enterprise customers.
* Exposure to Cloudflare, Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet, CloudSEK, CSPM or CNAPP technologies.
* Experience with SOAR platforms, security automation, scripting and AI-assisted SOC operations.
* Experience supporting customer technical workshops, solution evaluations and new service onboarding.
* Familiarity with ITIL incident, problem and change management processes.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GCIH, GCIA, GSOC, SC-200, or equivalent practical expertise.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong technical leadership with a willingness to engage directly in complex security investigations.
* Customer-focused, accountable and decisive during high-pressure situations.
* Capable of balancing operational management with hands-on technical oversight.
* Effective communicator with senior customer stakeholders and internal technical teams.
* Collaborative leader who develops talent and encourages continuous learning. Proactive, adaptable and committed to improving security operations.

**About Rackspace Technology**
Rackspace Technology is the trusted operator of the full enterprise AI stack, from governed private cloud to AI inference and agents in production. From edge to core to cloud, we operate the infrastructure, data layer, and software integration to deliver business outcomes with the predictable cost, reliability, security, and compliance that regulated and mission-critical environments demand. We support customers in more than 120 countries with AI capabilities spanning private cloud, public cloud, applications, data and cyber resilience.
  
  
**More on Rackspace Technology**
Though we’re all different, Rackers thrive through our connection to a central goal: to be a valued member of a winning team on an inspiring mission. We bring our whole selves to work every day. And we embrace the notion that unique perspectives fuel innovation and enable us to best serve our customers and communities around the globe. We welcome you to apply today and want you to know that we are committed to offering equal employment opportunity without regard to age, color, disability, gender reassignment or identity or expression, genetic information, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity status, military or veteran status, nationality, ethnic or national origin, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any legally protected characteristic. **Network Service Delivery Manager – APAC**
**Introduction**
We are looking for a Network Service Delivery Manager – APAC to join our Network Service Delivery team in Information Technology. In this role, you will ensure reliable, secure, cost-effective and business-aligned network services across the Asia-Pacific region. You will be the regional link between business stakeholders, Country IT teams, Global Network, Architecture, Information Security, project teams and external service providers, and you will make sure regional needs – including offices, manufacturing plants and service locations – are well represented in our global network operating model.
  
  
This role is based in Gurugram, India, and includes regional travel as required.
  
  
**Team you will belong to**
You will join our Network Service Delivery community, working closely with the Network Service Delivery Team Lead and regional service delivery managers to keep ways of working and service delivery practices consistent across regions. We collaborate with Country IT teams, global network service owners, Information Security, Procurement, Finance and external service providers. Our work spans APAC time zones and includes participation in agreed major-incident escalation and planned maintenance arrangements.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Oversee the delivery and performance of network services across APAC sites, including local and wireless networks, software-defined WAN (SD-WAN), internet connectivity and secure remote access, aligning resilience with global site criticality standards.
* Manage service performance against agreed service-level and operational-level agreements, working with internal teams and service providers to maintain availability, capacity and readiness.
* Act as the regional escalation point for critical network incidents, coordinating restoration, stakeholder communication, root-cause analysis and corrective actions, and govern network changes and resilience testing.
* Serve as the regional focal point for network demand, ensuring business and site requirements are documented, prioritized and progressed with Country IT, Global Network, Architecture, Information Security, Operational Technology (OT) and project teams, in line with global standards and approved designs, including IT/OT network segmentation where applicable.
* Represent APAC priorities in global network service, governance and roadmap discussions, and drive regional improvement opportunities.
* Coordinate service provider relationships, monitor supplier performance and escalations, and partner with Procurement, Global Service Owners and Country IT Managers on service requirements, renewals, budgets, costs and cost optimization.
* Coordinate network needs for new site setups, expansions, relocations, closures and integrations of acquired businesses, and communicate service performance, risks, outages and decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ensure new or changed network services move into operations with accurate service records, monitoring and documentation, and drive improvements in monitoring, reporting, automation and operational analytics.

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Network Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

* Solid understanding of enterprise networking, including local and wireless networks, SD-WAN, internet connectivity, routing, VPNs, IT/OT network segmentation, high-availability architectures and network security fundamentals.
* Demonstrated experience managing service-level agreements, major incidents, problem resolution, service transitions and supplier performance.
* Strong stakeholder management, analytical, communication and commercial skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.
* ITIL Foundation certification or higher, or other relevant networking, infrastructure or IT service management certifications (nice to have).
* Experience managing network services in a global, multi-vendor environment, ideally in manufacturing, industrial, mining or other operationally critical multi-site settings, and experience within APAC (nice to have).
