title: RMS-Independence-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Assistant Director - Independence - Risk Management Services**
This role requires the candidate to build and demonstrate an in-depth technical knowledge of specific Independence support processes which are developed globally in accordance with the EY Global (EYG) Independence policies aimed towards safeguarding EY as an Independent auditor. These processes are standardized in nature and are performed by the RMS teams on behalf of EY engagement teams. The candidate will be responsible for coaching, mentoring and supervising a team of about 20-50 members on technical matters and should be able to handle and resolve their queries. The role also involves liaising with Global Independence process owners and a variety of stakeholders and end users across countries and geographies. The candidate is also expected to contribute to the GDS wide priorities and initiatives and help in building a better working world for our EY professionals and team members
  
  
**The opportunity**
Risk Management Services (RMS) is an internal function within EY GDS (Global Delivery services), responsible for protecting the organization from the risks that may arise from its professional practice. We work closely with all parts of the organization to identify and manage risks, providing coordinated advice and assistance on suite of services like Independence, Conflicts, Compliance, regulatory, policy and security issues as well as dealing with claims and queries regarding ethics. Formed in 2007, the RMS team is growing rapidly as a Center of Excellence for all standardized quality/compliance related activities.
  
  
This role will be part of the largest sub-service functions, i.e., Independence within Risk Management Services (RMS) responsible for assisting client-serving teams in maintaining EY’s Independence for its existing and prospective audit/non-audit clients.
  
  
Auditor Independence is a regulatory requirement that aims to create an ‘arm’s length’ distance between the Accounting Firm, its client serving employees and EY’s audit clients. This is done to ensure that that EY Member Practices and their professionals should be (in fact) and should appear to be (in appearance) free from interests that might be regarded as being incompatible with objectivity, integrity, and impartiality of the audit.
  
  
RMS Independence team is currently 950+ people strong, operating from 3 countries and 5 centre’s: India (Gurugram, Kochi, Bengaluru), Poland (Wroclaw), Philippines (Manila). The team is closely integrated with Global Independence and has been involved in development of key Independence processes.
  
  
The role offers opportunities to work in a dynamic, growth-focused environment, with a special emphasis on protecting EY’s reputation as an independent auditor, by providing support on niche profiles to EY member firm practices. It also involves close collaboration with global teams and stakeholders to strengthen the compliance framework and foster a mindset of continuous improvement and client enablement.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
A Manager/Senior Manager will oversee Independence processes in accordance with EYG policies, enabling audit teams to effectively mitigate independence-related risks. This role demands deep expertise in independence concepts, tools and databases to facilitate effective communication with stakeholders and senior leaders and to provide technical direction to the team members. Key responsibilities include managing stakeholder expectations, building a robust future pipeline, resolving service delivery issues promptly and having an entrepreneurial mindset along with strong relationship building skills. The candidate will oversee team performance, set goals, assess performance, provide feedback, ensure efficiency, adherence to protocols, and mentor team members for their professional development. Additionally, the role involves seeking innovative opportunities to enhance existing processes through cutting-edge technologies and spearheading business transformation initiatives.
  
  
**Technical Expertise:**

* Build domain expertise in engagement support processes, coordinating across diverse customers and geographies.
* Develop knowledge of EY Global / US SEC independence policies to support various audit client types.
* Understand EY & Regulator's audit client definitions and associated restrictions.
* Be abreast on any potential policy/regulatory changes and ability to interpret impact on process to be prepared and implement changes.
* Consult with Area Independence teams to facilitate timely sign-off on independence work programs.
* Build strong credibility by sharing insights, demonstrating business and technical acumen while engaging in relevant discussions with diverse customer groups and stakeholders across various EY geographies.
* Actively manage client’s expectation through setting up a robust client management framework
* Address & resolve service delivery issues / escalations and ensure robust governance over operating and quality assurance model.
* Seek opportunities for continuous improvement, and innovation in service offerings within the area of technical expertise.
* Embrace feedback from internal teams or stakeholders to enhance the execution of quality assignments.
* Implement quality assurance protocols to maintain high standards in all outputs and deliverables.
* Evaluate complex data and potential impacts to make timely, informed decisions, and include stakeholders for collaborative and transparent decision-making when needed.

**Client Management:**

* Actively engage and develop trusted relationships with Global Independence and other stakeholder groups to implement process changes, enhancements and improvements.
* Develop effective conflict resolution and escalation management strategies to address and resolve any issues or escalations promptly and professionally
* Ability to listen to, and accurately capture expectations and concerns and implement changes in the process to drive effectiveness and client satisfaction.
* Must be clear and concise while communicating with the stakeholder groups.
* Meet and exceed agreed team level Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

**Operations Management**

* Drive a zero-surprise delivery model, by utilizing appropriate data modelling and analysis tools and techniques.
* Lead multiple assignments, including strategic initiatives, planning, demand forecasting, and delivery of exceptional client service.
* Contribute towards and lead major Service Function/Sub Service Function strategic priorities.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to ensure high standards of service delivery.
* Collaborate with Global Independence on strategic priorities, design and onboard processes, assess resourcing requirements and create SLAs to measure success of the process.
* Manage customer outreach and identify business development opportunities to enhance service coverage

**People Management:**

* Will be handling team of approx. 20-50 team members.
* Responsible for team performance along with his/her defined individual KPI for the role.
* Responsible for hiring, talent and location expansion decisions.
* Develop and implement performance management systems that supports setting goals, performance monitoring, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Build relationship across other service and sub service lines and seek opportunities to work together.
* Maintain open and transparent communication channels with team members to ensure clarity of expectations and foster a collaborative environment.
* Address and resolve any team conflicts or issues promptly and effectively, maintaining a positive and productive work environment.
* Foster a culture of engagement by recognizing and rewarding team members' contributions and encouraging their participation in decision-making processes.
* Nurture the professional growth and development of team members through effective mentoring and identification of any training, skill development needs.
* Create succession planning for critical and key roles and individuals and ensure business continuity.
* Promote a healthy work-life balance by encouraging flexible working arrangements and supporting team members' well-being.
* Champion diversity and inclusion initiatives to create a respectful and inclusive workplace where all team members feel valued
* Ensure that individual goals are aligned with the overall objectives of the organization, fostering a sense of purpose and direction.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Must display executive presence and leadership skills to lead a team.
* Global mindset and business acumen to help build client trust and value.
* Must possess a collaborative, client- centric and enablement mindset.
* Demonstrate strong problem-solving, critical-thinking and quick decision-making abilities to navigate complex situations.
* Drive the team to consistently achieve and exceed team-level KPIs by fostering a high-performance culture, setting clear expectations and providing the necessary support and resources.
* Foster a diverse and inclusive team environment where all members feel valued and included. Spearhead business transformation initiatives on process improvement and client enablement to enhance efficiency and effectiveness for the team.
* Uphold and drive the highest standards of ethics, integrity, and values
* Participate in business resilience strategies including business continuity and impact analysis.
* Be adaptable and agile in dynamic situations, driving change management.
* Exhibit an innovative mindset with proficiency in using current technologies and a willingness to adapt to new digital tools to enhance efficiency.
* Commit to continuous learning and professional development to stay updated with industry trends and best practices.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Masters/post-graduate degree (preferably in Finance) from a reputed institute.
* At least 10-12 years of professional experience, out of which minimum 5 years’ experience should have:
* Compliance or research functions in Big 4 or other professional service organizations
* Managing reasonably mid-size teams (20 – 40 team members)
* Experience in Risk Management/Independence would be preferred
* Proven expertise in stakeholder management, delivery excellence, and maintaining financial discipline.
* Well-developed analytical, interpersonal, and communication (both verbal and written) skills in English
* Good understanding of type of company structures, Ownership structures, audit and risk management concepts.
* Good sector knowledge and understanding around various risk and Independence related trends and market dynamics will be an added advantage.

**Technologies and Tools**

* Expert in MS Office (Outlook, MS Word, MS Excel, SharePoint etc.). Ability to independently create reports and deliver impactful presentations to larger executive groups, offering actionable insights.
* Project management and Business analytics tool like Power-BI and experience in lean methodologies like Value stream mapping, 5S, Kanban, Kaizen would be preferred.
* Prior knowledge of Private equity domains along with navigating external databases like Capital IQ, Factiva
* Knowledge of future technology- like Gen-AI.

**What You Can Look For**

* A team of people with technical experience, business acumen and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment.
* A team of professionals driven by growth and client enablement mindset, while safeguarding EY’s brand name.
* A team which focuses on supporting its colleagues to excel in their respective domains and provides avenues to help acquire and demonstrate new skills.
* A team that functions with One-Team mindset and values diversity and inclusiveness.
* Opportunities to work with Global teams and stakeholders on strengthening the compliance framework.
* A team that thrives on continuous improvement and bringing in efficiencies to processes.

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Position: Project Manager - Language PMU**

**About:**

  
  

Aligned with NEP 2020, the Language Division PMU supports impact assessment and strategic directions for language institutions. The project maps the national language ecosystem, reviews institutional mandates and governance, strengthens outreach and digital visibility, and develops a performance-linked funding framework. The Project Manager will hold direct ownership of the Ministry and institutional relationship, lead a multidisciplinary team, and be accountable for institutional review and overall PMU delivery, bringing experience of managing central Ministry of Education engagements on the transformation of national institutions, higher education policy and financing, and technical education and skilling systems.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities:**

1. Lead PMU planning, team coordination and timely delivery across concurrent workstreams, holding overall management responsibility at every level of the engagement; set quality standards and review mechanisms; track milestones, risks and dependencies, and conduct weekly progress reviews.

2. Lead institutional diagnosis and mandate assessment across language institutions, reviewing functions, governance structures, overlaps, performance and NEP 2020 alignment, and recommend structural changes to improve institutional functioning and ranking.

3. Coordinate merger, integration, specialization and role-rationalization analysis with the restructuring specialist; develop future institutional roles and implementation roadmaps, and support institutions from diagnosis through execution.

4. Oversee institution and scheme data collection, field visits, validation and analysis of courses, enrolment, faculty capacity and emerging demand to build the national language landscape, including which courses to add or retire, examination and quality gaps, and linkage of language programmes with job-market demand.

5. Guide the funding specialist in reviewing grants and expenditure, assessing alternate financing mechanisms at student, institutional and systemic levels, defining outcome KPIs and benchmarks, and developing institutional scorecards and a performance-linked funding framework.

6. Coordinate flagship initiative mapping, success stories, communications, digital visibility and outreach planning; lead the digital transformation workstream, including the introduction of AI and language technologies, and oversee minister-facing and administrative dashboard requirements.

7. Manage Ministry, State and institutional consultations with Secretaries, Joint Secretaries, Vice Chancellors, faculty, students and state education departments; synthesize specialist inputs into assessment reports, policy reports, concept notes, strategy documents, presentations and implementation plans.

8. Identify integration of language institutions with national missions, skilling priorities and other Ministries' initiatives, and author strategy documents on integration opportunities under the guidance of senior Ministry officials.

Lead Windchill technical architecture, configuration, customization, integrations, migration and platform governance initiatives, ensuring alignment between PLM business processes, enterprise architecture and engineering systems. Act as a technical SME and lead technical delivery for enterprise Windchill transformation programs.

  
  

Key Responsibilities

Act as the technical SME and lead for enterprise Windchill PLM solutions across PDMLink, MPMLink, ProjectLink, PartsLink and related capabilities.

Provide technical leadership for Windchill architecture, configuration, customization, workflows, lifecycles, security, data models and system administration.

Lead Windchill integrations with CAD, ERP/SAP, MES, ALM and other enterprise applications, ensuring reliable data exchange and end-to-end process integration.

Lead Windchill migration, upgrade, consolidation and modernization initiatives, including data assessment, mapping, transformation, validation, mock migration, cutover and production migration.

Define and govern Windchill technical standards, development frameworks, customization guidelines, performance standards and reusable components.

Provide advanced troubleshooting, technical analysis and root-cause resolution for complex Windchill application, integration, performance and data-related issues.

Translate business and functional requirements into scalable Windchill technical solutions and provide technical estimates, solution designs and implementation approaches.

Lead technical design reviews, architecture discussions, code reviews, integration reviews and solution assessments with internal and client stakeholders.

Drive platform modernization, automation, performance optimization, high availability, security, monitoring and cloud adoption initiatives for Windchill environments.

Mentor Windchill developers and consultants, provide technical guidance, review deliverables, manage technical risks and support project leadership in delivery planning and execution.

  
  
  

Required Skills & Experience (Mandatory)

10–12 years of hands-on experience in PTC Windchill PLM implementations, configuration, customization, integration and technical architecture.

Strong expertise in Windchill 11/12/13 and core modules including PDMLink, MPMLink, ProjectLink and PartsLink.

Strong hands-on experience with Java, Windchill APIs, workflows, lifecycles, object models, configuration and customization.

Experience with Windchill integrations with Creo/CAD, SAP/ERP, MES, ALM and other enterprise applications.

Experience in Windchill migration, upgrade, data migration, WBM/Windchill Loader and migration validation activities.

Strong understanding of Windchill application architecture, Method Servers, BGMS, WVS/Workers, Solr, database, vaults, load balancing, SSO and enterprise infrastructure.

Ability to lead technical teams, conduct architecture/design reviews and work directly with business and client stakeholders.

  
  
  

Good to Have

Experience with Windchill+ / SaaS PLM and cloud-hosted Windchill environments.

Experience with Azure/AWS infrastructure, HA/DR, security, monitoring and performance optimization.

Knowledge of Creo, NX, CATIA, SolidWorks and multi-CAD integration with Windchill.

Experience with REST APIs, web services, Java customization, automation and integration frameworks.

Knowledge of PLM transformation, Digital Thread, Digital Twin, MBSE and Industry 4.0 concepts.

Experience working with legacy PLM platforms such as ENOVIA or Teamcenter and migrating to Windchill.

Strong understanding of product data governance, engineering change management, configuration management, BOM management and enterprise PLM processes.

###### **Experience working in global engineering environments and coordinating offshore/onshore technical teams.**

**Job Description: Center Director/ Center Manager**

Position Overview: As a Center Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing the daily operations, educational programs, and overall administration of a preschool facility. Your primary focus will be to ensure a safe, nurturing, and educational environment for young children. You will lead a team of teachers and staff; collaborate with parents.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Program Leadership and Management:**

* Supervise and support teachers and staff, providing guidance, feedback, and professional development opportunities.

* Establish and maintain high standards of educational excellence, ensuring a well-rounded and developmentally appropriate curriculum.

* Regularly assess the program's effectiveness, making adjustments and improvements as needed to meet the evolving needs of the children and families.

* Creating a Safe and Nurturing Environment: It is crucial to establish a safe, inclusive, and stimulating environment for children.

* Plan and implement marketing strategies for the school in nearby communities

* Conduct & monitor enquiries for parents who visit

* Record and report on admission enquiries.

* Monitor follow up of parents who have enquired for admission

**Parent Relationship Management:**

* Parent and Community Engagement

* Foster positive and collaborative relationships with parents and families, serving as a point of contact for enquiries, feedback, and concerns.

* Organize and conduct parent meetings, orientations, and other events to promote parent involvement and education.

* Establish effective communication channels to keep parents informed about their child's progress, upcoming activities, and any relevant updates.

**Operational Oversight:**

* Ensure compliance with licensing regulations, health and safety guidelines, and any other legal requirements.

* Develop and maintain policies and procedures related to enrollment, attendance, health, safety, and emergency protocols.

* Manage daily operations, including scheduling, staffing, budgeting, and resource allocation.

* Liaison with different departments within organization

* Maintain accurate records, documentation, and reporting as required by and the preschool's policies.

**Staff Development and Training:**

* Recruit, hire, and onboard qualified teachers and staff members.

* Provide ongoing training, mentoring, and professional development opportunities to enhance the skills and knowledge of the team.

* Foster a positive work environment that promotes teamwork, open communication, and professional growth.

* Financial and Budget Management

**Community Relations and Partnerships:**

* Build positive relationships with community organizations, educational forums, and other relevant stakeholders.

* Seek and develop partnerships that enhance the preschool's resources, services, and community involvement.

* Represent the preschool at community events, conferences, and networking opportunities.

**Qualifications and Skills:**

* Bachelors or master's degree in early childhood education, child development, or a related field. Advanced degrees are preferred.

* Relevant experience in a leadership role within a preschool or early childhood education setting.

* Comprehensive knowledge of early childhood education principles, curriculum development, and age-appropriate teaching methods.

* Strong leadership and managerial skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate a team.

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact effectively with children, parents, staff, and external stakeholders.

* Strong organizational and problem-solving abilities to manage operations, resolve issues, and make informed decisions.

* Proficiency in using educational software, administrative tools, and digital communication platforms.

* Ability to work collaboratively and build relationships with diverse individuals and communities.

* Flexibility to adapt to changing needs and demands of the preschool environment.

title: Enterprise Services GenAI Deployment Senior Manager
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Enterprise Services (ES) was established in 2022 to provide efficient, resilient, and scalable services to support the evolving needs and complexities of a more digital BCG. ES brings together business-critical operations - such as Enterprise Procurement & Payables, Global Finance & Operations Services, and Executive Support Services - alongside specialist expertise including Real Estate, Travel, and Meetings & Events. United by a common service mindset, ES enables every BCGer to focus on the work that matters most by giving time and energy back through streamlined, reliable service delivery. In doing so, ES creates cost advantage and strengthens BCG’s market differentiation, while reducing risk through consistent controls and business continuity. Through scalable platforms and globally integrated ways of working across our strategic core global hubs, Enterprise Services enhances agility and helps unlock the potential of those who advance the world.
  
  
As an Enterprise Services GenAI Deployment Senior Manager, you will work at the intersection of business operations, technology, and AI transformation. Reporting to the Enterprise Services GenAI Deployment Director, you will partner closely with ES service lines to identify, design, deploy, and scale GenAI-enabled solutions that improve efficiency, strengthen controls, and enhance employee and business outcomes.
  
  
This is a highly hands-on role. You will embed within service lines, understand operational challenges firsthand, identify high-value use cases, and help translate business needs into practical AI-enabled workflows and solutions. You will work directly with product, engineering, data, and business stakeholders to accelerate adoption and ensure solutions deliver measurable value.
  
  
Success in this role requires the ability to build strong business process understanding and the ability to apply GenAI technologies pragmatically to real-world business problems. You will help functions move from experimentation to sustained adoption while contributing to the development of repeatable deployment methodologies and best practices across Enterprise Services.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**
**AI Solution Deployment & Adoption**

* Partner with ES service lines to identify and prioritize high-value GenAI use cases
* Translate business requirements into AI-enabled workflows, prototypes, and deployment plans
* Support implementation, testing, rollout, and stabilization of AI-enabled solutions
* Drive adoption through training, change management, documentation, and stakeholder engagement
* Monitor solution performance and identify opportunities for optimization and scale

Business Partnership & Value Realization
  
  

* Build trusted relationships with operational leaders and subject matter experts across Enterprise Services
* Understand end-to-end business processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, and employee experience through GenAI
* Use data and operational insights to quantify impact and prioritize investments
* Surface risks, dependencies, and adoption challenges early and help drive resolution

**Capability Building & Continuous Improvement**

* Contribute to deployment playbooks, methodologies, and reusable implementation patterns
* Share lessons learned and best practices across functions and deployments
* Promote AI-enabled ways of working and support the development of AI capabilities across Enterprise Services
* Stay current on emerging GenAI tools, technologies, and deployment approaches relevant to Enterprise Services operations

What You'll Bring
  
  

* 7+ years of experience in operations transformation, process improvement, consulting, product deployment, business technology, or related fields
* Demonstrated experience working with AI, automation, workflow technologies, or digital transformation initiatives
* Strong understanding of Enterprise Services-type processes, such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Real Estate, Travel, or other operational functions
* Experience partnering with technical, product, data, or engineering teams to implement technology-enabled solutions
* Proven ability to identify opportunities, drive execution, and deliver measurable business outcomes
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills
* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred

Who You'll Work With
  
  
You will work closely with Enterprise Services leadership, product and engineering teams, AI and Data functions, and operational stakeholders across BCG. You will partner with cross-functional teams globally to deploy and scale AI-enabled capabilities that improve efficiency, strengthen controls, and enhance employee and business outcomes.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
**YOU'RE GOOD AT**

* Taking a hands-on, roll-up-your-sleeves approach to solving business problems using AI and automation
* Understanding operational processes and identifying practical opportunities to improve them through technology
* Translating business needs into scalable AI-enabled solutions and workflows
* Working effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Driving adoption and change in complex, matrixed environments
* Using data and insight to prioritize opportunities and measure business impact
* Operating effectively in ambiguity and adapting quickly as technologies and priorities evolve
* Communicating complex concepts clearly and persuasively to a range of audiences

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
  
  
For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
  
  
We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork
  
  
Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Incident Manager / Business Process Manager IRC307346
description:
**Description**
The Incident Manager / Business Process Manager is responsible for the governance and orchestration of the entire incident management lifecycle for customer-impacting incidents (Sev 1, 2, and 3) across all company product lines. This is a process-focused role, not a hands-on technical troubleshooting position. The primary objective is to ensure a consistent and formal process is followed, coordinate key stakeholders, manage communications, and drive post-incident reviews to foster continuous learning.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Required Skills and Experience**

* 4+ years of experience in Incident Management or Service Management with a strong focus on process governance
* Deep understanding of formal incident management frameworks (e.g., ITIL, MIM).
* Strong communication, coordination, and leadership skills with the ability to direct teams under pressure.
* Process-oriented mindset emphasizing governance, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Experience in a role focused on orchestration and process management rather than direct technical troubleshooting.

**Tools and Platforms**

* Incident Tracking: Jira
* Documentation: Confluence (for postmortems and process documentation)
* Communication: Internal and external status pages

Job responsibilities
  
  
**Incident Command and Orchestration**
Serve as the designated Incident Manager during Sev 1, 2, and 3 incidents.
  
  
Coordinate the incident response by engaging and directing the primary stakeholders, including the Resolution Driver (engineering owner responsible for the fix) and the Communication Manager (responsible for external updates).
  
  
Ensure the right personnel are involved in resolution efforts and escalate to leadership if additional resources are required.
  
  
**Process Governance and Accountability**
Maintain accountability for the entire incident management process, from identification to resolution, monitoring, and postmortem.
  
  
Ensure accurate incident categorization (Sev 1-4) using defined methodologies, considering service index, impact scope, and time to resolve.
  
  
Enforce adherence to internal SLOs for communications, leadership notifications, and postmortem timelines.
  
  
Act as custodian of all engineering policies and procedures, reviewing and updating them to remain current.
  
  
Oversee and ensure change management activities comply with audit requirements.
  
  
**Communication Management**
Own internal communications during incidents, providing regular updates to stakeholders and leadership through internal status pages.
  
  
Support the Communication Manager in preparing and posting external, customer-facing updates.
  
  
**Post-Incident Management**
Lead the blameless postmortem process for all incidents, using formal templates in Confluence.
  
  
Create postmortem reports and ensure preventive actions and lessons learned are documented as Jira tickets and assigned to the appropriate engineering teams.
  
  
**Documentation Ownership**
Own and manage the SMT Confluence space as the central repository for policies, procedures, and process documentation.
  
  
Maintain all “how-to” articles and ensure policies are accessible and up to date.
  
  
**Compliance and Reporting**
For specific US-based incidents involving service loss or emergency services, handle administrative filing of compliance reports with the legal team.
  
  
Participate in semi-annual internal audits related to emergency services compliance.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
  
  
**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Service Quality Lead
description:
**About Whirlpool India**
Whirlpool of India Limited, headquartered in Gurugram, is a leading home appliances company dedicated to enhancing life at home and inspiring generations through its trusted brands. The company operates three state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities in Faridabad, Pune & Puducherry, each reflecting Whirlpool’s commitment to providing best-in-class consumer solutions. Further driving innovation, the company has a Technology & Engineering Center, where India's world-class talent architects the next generation of home innovation. In the 2024-25 fiscal year, Whirlpool of India reported approximately INR 8110 Cr in annual revenue and employed 2193 people. More information is available at www.india.whirlpool.in
  
  
**The team you will be a part of**
The Service Quality team is responsible for setting up of the Service Quality standards for Whirlpool India along with addressing consumer complaints by effectively managing service call center. Also responsible for leading cost saving projects and service strategy consolidation along with managing the serviceability of the assigned categories.
  
  
**This Role In Summary**
The Service Quality Lead will be responsible for driving end-to-end service quality, customer experience, technical capability, and product/service performance for the Air Conditioner and Microwave categories. The role will identify quality gaps and convert customer, field and data insights into effective corrective and preventive actions. It will drive sustainable improvement in key service KPIs, including repeat rate, First Time Fix, NPS and complaint resolution. The role will also lead P4G and Total Cost of Quality (TCQ) initiatives focused on reducing Cost of Poor Quality, warranty costs, repeat repairs and service inefficiencies. Partnering with cross-functional teams, the role will identify, quantify and deliver impactful cost-saving opportunities without compromising customer experience or service quality.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities Will Include**

* Ensure service readiness for new product launches, including SOPs, technical training, tools, spares, troubleshooting and field support.
* Analyse customer VOC, field data, product failures and service trends to identify quality gaps, recurring issues and improvement opportunities.
* Lead RCA, CAPA and corrective actions for critical and recurring product/service quality issues in collaboration with Engineering, Plant Quality,Manufacturing,Marketing and Service Operations.
* Drive Field Fix implementation for identified product and technical issues, ensuring effective execution, compliance and closure across the service network
* Drive P4G and TCQ initiatives to reduce Cost of Poor Quality, warranty costs, repeat repairs, material consumption, avoidable visits and other service-related costs.
* Establish effective control over customer machine replacements and Under-Warranty (UW) costs, ensuring appropriate validation, approvals and cost governance.
* Manage coordination with FPS vendors for technical interventions, product quality issues, field actions and resolution of critical cases.
* Drive technical capability development of Service Engineers, Master Engineers and Service Partners through targeted training, certification and technical interventions.
* Own LMS platform management for the categories, ensuring training content, curriculum, certification, completion and capability tracking are effectively managed.
* Drive SBOM readiness and MSL review for new and existing products, ensuring adequate parts availability based on failure trends, installed base and service requirements.
* Monitor and improve Service Partner quality performance through audits, scorecards, governance reviews and structured improvement plans.
* Establish early-warning mechanisms and quality dashboards to proactively identify product, process and service quality risks.
* Benchmark best practices and lead continuous improvement and quality transformation projects across the service network.

**Minimum Requirements**
**Education:**
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, preferably Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics,Production or a related discipline.
  
  
**Preferred Skills And Experiences**
8+ years in Consumer Durables, HVAC, Refrigeration or related industries, with strong service and field operations exposure.
  
  
Strong expertise in spare parts planning, SBOM readiness, MSL optimisation and parts availability.
  
  
Proven experience in Service Partner quality, technical capability and FPS/vendor coordination.
  
  
Strong cross-functional leadership across Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Marketing and Service.
  
  
Data-driven problem-solving, stakeholder management and ability to convert VOC/field insights into improvements.
  
  
Experience in new product launch readiness, including SOPs, training, tools, spares and field support.
  
  
Excellent communication and presentation skills with senior leadership and field teams.

title: Merchandiser
description:
**About D2 International**

For over 30 years, D2 International has partnered with leading fashion brands across Europe and the United Kingdom, developing and manufacturing premium leather handbags, accessories, and small leather goods.

Our work sits at the intersection of design, craftsmanship, and commercial execution. Every season, we collaborate with international design, sourcing and buying teams to deliver products that meet exacting standards of quality, craftsmanship, cost and delivery.

**The Opportunity**

We are looking for an experienced
**Merchandiser**
for merchandising operations and oversee the complete product lifecycle, from initial concept and development through production and final shipment.

The role requires strong technical, commercial and operational expertise, along with the ability to manage teams, build buyer relationships and drive cross-functional execution. You will be responsible for ensuring that product development, costing, production planning and order delivery are aligned with buyer expectations, quality standards and business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Oversee end-to-end merchandising operations, ensuring seamless execution from product development and sampling to bulk production and final dispatch.
* Manage, and develop the merchandising team, establishing clear priorities, accountability and performance standards.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with international buyers, designers and sourcing teams, serving as a key point of coordination for product development and order execution.
* Oversee design interpretation, sampling, technical revisions and buyer approvals, ensuring product accuracy, feasibility and timely closure.
* Guide the team in reviewing product construction, patterns, materials, hardware, trims and finishing in coordination with pattern masters, technicians and craftsmen.
* Drive costing strategies, cost optimisation and commercial negotiations while ensuring product quality and profitability objectives.
* Coordinate with Production, Sourcing, Quality, Stores and external vendors to ensure material readiness, production feasibility and smooth order execution.
* Oversee production planning, order tracking and delivery schedules, proactively identifying risks, resolving bottlenecks and ensuring timely shipment.
* Establish effective monitoring mechanisms for development timelines, sample approvals, production milestones, quality parameters and delivery commitments.
* Ensure adherence to buyer specifications, technical requirements, quality standards and pre-shipment compliance.
* Work closely with senior management and cross-functional teams to improve merchandising processes, operational efficiency and overall order execution.
* Review merchandising reports, order status, costing, delivery performance and team productivity, providing timely updates and insights to management.
* Manage multiple buyer accounts and order portfolios, ensuring effective resource allocation and consistent delivery performance.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Management, Fashion Management, Merchandising or a related discipline.
* **7–12 years of experience**
  in merchandising, preferably within leather goods, handbags, accessories or export manufacturing, with prior team management experience.
* Strong technical knowledge of leather goods construction, patterns, materials, trims, hardware and finishing.
* Proven experience managing the complete product lifecycle, from development and buyer approvals to bulk production and final shipment.
* Demonstrated ability to lead merchandising teams, manage multiple buyer accounts and drive cross-functional execution.
* Strong understanding of product costing, commercial negotiations, material optimisation, production planning, quality control and delivery management.
* Experience in handling international buyers, interpreting technical specifications and resolving product development and production-related challenges.
* Strong leadership, decision-making, negotiation and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi, with confidence in managing international business relationships.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and standard business communication tools.
* A strategic yet hands-on professional with strong commercial acumen, attention to detail and end-to-end accountability.

**Why Join D2?**

* Work directly with renowned international fashion brands.
* Lead end-to-end merchandising operations across global product development and manufacturing programmes.
* Work alongside highly skilled craftsmen, pattern masters, technicians and manufacturing professionals.
* Influence products from initial concept to finished goods reaching leading retail markets across the globe.
* Play a significant role in strengthening merchandising capabilities, operational processes and business performance.

**Apply If**

* You can translate creative concepts into technically sound and commercially viable products.
* You have the leadership capabilities to manage teams, buyers and multiple order portfolios.
* You can balance product quality, commercial objectives and delivery commitments.
* You proactively identify risks, resolve bottlenecks and drive stakeholders towards closure.
* You thrive in a fast-paced export manufacturing environment and take ownership of business outcomes.

**Candidates willing to relocate to Kolkata are welcome to apply.**

  Please send your resume to
  **hrd@d2international.com**

Competent and goal-driven

Organised and analytical
  
We’re looking for a self-motivated and quick-thinking facilities manager who can solve problems using quantitative methods and holistic approaches. Likewise, we’re on the lookout for well-organised leaders who plan tasks in advance and constantly stay ahead of deadlines.
  
Engaging and professional
  
A passion for excellence is what makes a great facilities manager. We’ll need someone who can do more than the bare minimum to meet our clients’ expectations. In this role, you’ll also be working with different kinds of people, so you’ll need to be an expert in handling them professionally. Likewise, you’ll need to effectively manage, train and inspire the team to always do better. You’ll also need to take the time to listen to your people to create better work impact.
  
  
What you can expect from us
  
  
At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realize your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.
  
  
Apply today!
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:

About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

description:
SkyQuest is seeking a senior programme leader to manage a 24-month technical assistance programme supporting a national agricultural development finance institution in Nigeria. The programme aims to strengthen the Institution’s ability to mobilise and deploy capital to agricultural enterprises and organisations serving smallholder farmers, particularly women and underserved producers.

About the role

The TSU Manager will lead a multidisciplinary Technical Support Unit (TSU) and act as the central integration point between the Institution’s CEO and executive management, the funding partner and specialist teams. The role is accountable for programme governance, strategic coherence, executive and Board engagement, delivery oversight and the quality of programme deliverables.

Key responsibilities

* Lead programme governance, integrated planning, decision-making, escalation, risk and issue management, and formal phase-gate reviews.
* Manage a multidisciplinary team of specialist leads; set accountabilities, allocate work, monitor delivery and review all deliverables before submission.
* Serve as the principal counterpart to the Institution’s CEO and executive management and the primary point of contact for the funding partner.
* Lead executive validation sessions, strategic reviews and Board presentations, subject to CEO approval.
* Direct the institutional diagnostic, maturity assessment, prioritisation process and development of a resourced implementation plan.
* Integrate specialist work across agricultural finance and credit risk, technology and data, agribusiness investment readiness, blended-finance capital mobilisation and climate finance.
* Oversee design and testing of a multi-source financing facility, including capital structure, blended-capital architecture, financing documentation and mobilisation strategy.
* Ensure pilots are evidence-based, evaluated and refined, with clear benefits for organisations serving smallholder farmers.
* Lead programme performance management, monitoring, evaluation and learning (MEL), quarterly reviews and the formal mid-term review.
* Oversee institutionalisation, capability transfer and handover of validated policies, tools, models, SOPs and operating arrangements to named Institution owners.

Qualifications and experience

**Education:**
Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Agricultural Economics, Development Studies, Business Administration or a related field. CFA, ACCA, ICAN, PMP/PRINCE2 or equivalent is an advantage.

· 16+ years in development finance, agricultural finance, financial-institution advisory or large technical assistance programmes.

·       Substantial hands-on experience in agricultural lending and agri-finance, including credit appraisal, risk assessment and portfolio management.

· At least 8 years leading multidisciplinary teams on complex, multi-stakeholder programmes as Team Leader, Programme Director or equivalent.

· Experience advising CEOs, executive committees and Boards of banks, DFIs or public financial institutions.

· Track record leading assignments for development partners such as the World Bank Group, AfDB, FCDO, major philanthropic foundations or similar.

· Proven delivery of institutional transformation programmes that were successfully handed over to the client institution.

· Strong programme governance, integrated planning, dependency and risk management, and results-based management skills.

· Sound understanding of DFI operating models and blended-finance instruments.

**Desirable:**
Experience with Nigerian or Sub-Saharan African DFIs; facility or fund design; investor or lender engagement; MEL; gender-inclusive finance; and smallholder-focused impact measurement. Hausa, Yoruba or Igbo is an advantage.

title: Head - Environment
description:
**Purpose of the Job**

As the Environment Lead of the Environment team for a coal mine, the primary objective is to ensure regulatory compliance and environmental stewardship throughout all phases of the mining operation. This role involves developing and implementing environmental management systems, coordinating with regulatory agencies, conducting monitoring activities, and overseeing environmental audits to uphold environmental standards and mitigate risks.

**Key Responsibilities of Role**

**Environmental Compliance Management:**

* Innovate and deploy an Environment Management System to ensure adherence to regulatory requirements and international standards.
* Coordinate with regulatory agencies for obtaining necessary authorizations and permits, including Consent to Establish (CTO), Environment Clearance (EC), and Hazardous Waste Authorizations.
* Drive pre-project environmental compliance by coordinating forest clearances and securing environment clearance, including Coastal Regulation Zone (CRZ) clearance if applicable.
* Obtain Consent to Establish (CTO) post-clearance to commence construction activities.
* Manage hazardous waste authorization and liaise with the Central Ground Water Authority (CGWA) for water use, seepage, and groundwater management.

**Communication and Coordination:**

* Strategise with internal and external stakeholders, including regulatory bodies, to fulfill environmental compliance requirements and submit necessary reports.
* Follow up with various departments, internal staff, and senior management for environmental projects and inspections.
* Coordinate with RO& HO CECB, MoEF, CGWA to fulfill the environment compliances and send the reports/MIS.
* Coordinate with different departments for site inspection visits by regulatory authorities and close any findings or observations.

**Audit and Maintenance:**

* Ensure internal environmental audits on a quarterly basis, identify gaps, and implement corrective actions to improve environmental performance.
* Ensure timely maintenance and calibration of company-owned environmental monitoring equipment to maintain data accuracy.
* Conduct weekly safety inspection in the mine area, coal washery area, Loading & unloading area and CHP 1 & 2 area including DG sets. Find out the safety observations/Gaps and update in safety gensuite software.
* Maintain Environmental expenditure as per approved Budget Plan.

**Monitoring, Reporting and Analysis:**

* Conduct air and groundwater quality monitoring at planned locations as per statutory approvals using advanced monitoring equipment.
* Implement and comply with environmental regulations specified in EC, CTEs, CTOs, and CGWA NOCs, ensuring timely submission of statutory reports to relevant authorities.
* Prepare and submit monthly, quarterly, Half-Yearly EC, FC Compliance reports & annual CGWA compliance reports.
* Develop monthly Management Information System (MIS) reports with respect to environmental performance and submit them to the Site Head and Head Office.

**Education Qualification**

* BE-Chemical/ B.E. Environment / M.Sc. Environment

**Work Experience**

* 15 – 20 years of relevant experience

title: Quality and Reliability Manager – Memory Products
description:
Quality and Reliability Manager Memory Products

**Location:**
Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India

**Work Mode:**
Onsite

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Experience:**
12 - 18 Years

**Industry:**
Semiconductor / ATMP / OSAT / Memory Products

Role Overview

We are looking for a Quality and Reliability Manager to lead product-quality, package-reliability and qualification activities for memory products in a high-volume semiconductor assembly and test environment.

The role will own reliability strategy, qualification execution, product-health monitoring, failure analysis and corrective-action closure for DRAM, NAND and related memory products. The position requires strong semiconductor product-quality knowledge and experience working across packaging, assembly, test, product engineering, manufacturing and customer-quality functions.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead quality and reliability engineering for semiconductor memory products and package technologies.
* Develop product- and package-qualification strategies aligned with JEDEC and customer requirements.
* Define reliability test plans, qualification matrices, sample sizes, acceptance criteria and release requirements.
* Manage reliability testing, including HTOL, HAST/uHAST, temperature cycling, MSL and high-temperature storage.
* Review qualification results and approve products, packages, materials and process changes for manufacturing release.
* Monitor product-health, reliability, yield, defect and quality indicators during high-volume manufacturing.
* Lead investigation of reliability failures, manufacturing excursions, customer returns and field-quality issues.
* Coordinate electrical and physical failure analysis to identify package-, process-, material- and device-related causes.
* Drive root-cause analysis, containment, corrective action and recurrence-prevention activities.
* Partner with package, product, process, test and equipment engineers during NPI and production ramp-up.
* Assess reliability risks associated with material, equipment, supplier, process and package changes.
* Establish reliability-monitoring plans and early-warning mechanisms for abnormal product trends.
* Support supplier qualification and improvement programs for substrates, leadframes, mold compounds and other materials.
* Lead 8D, CAPA, FMEA and risk-assessment activities for product-quality and reliability issues.
* Prepare qualification reports, reliability summaries, risk assessments and customer-facing technical documentation.
* Support customer audits, quality reviews and technical discussions related to product and package reliability.
* Build and develop the quality and reliability engineering team.
* Ensure laboratory methods, equipment and records comply with internal and industry requirements.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor s or Master s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Materials, Physics, Mechanical, Microelectronics Engineering or a related discipline.
* 12 18 years of semiconductor quality, product reliability, package reliability or qualification experience.
* At least 4 6 years of experience managing quality, reliability or failure-analysis engineers.
* Strong experience with semiconductor assembly, packaging and test operations.
* Knowledge of DRAM, NAND, NOR or other memory-product reliability is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience planning and executing product and package qualification programs.
* Hands-on knowledge of accelerated reliability testing and failure mechanisms.
* Experience investigating qualification failures, manufacturing excursions and customer complaints.
* Strong understanding of statistical data analysis, quality systems and risk-management methodologies.
* Ability to support global teams and manufacturing escalations in a 24 7 production environment.

Technical Skills Memory Product Quality

* DRAM and NAND product quality
* Non-volatile memory reliability
* Memory-package qualification
* Product-health monitoring
* Yield and defect analysis
* Product-change qualification
* Customer-quality management
* Manufacturing-quality controls

* SEM/EDS
* Dye-and-pry analysis

Quality and Statistical Tools

* Root-cause analysis
* CAPA
* FMEA
* Fault Tree Analysis
* Design of Experiments
* Statistical Process Control
* Process Capability Analysis
* Measurement System Analysis
* Weibull and reliability-data analysis
* JMP, Minitab or equivalent software

Standards and Compliance

* JEDEC reliability standards

As India’s most reliable express logistics provider, we empower commerce by reaching over 56,000+ locations across India and connecting to 220+ countries through our global DHL network. If you're looking to join a purpose-led, people-first organization that shapes India’s supply chain with integrity and care—

**Position Overview:**
The Air Hub Manager is accountable for end-to-end operational performance of an individual Air Hub, ensuring safe, timely and accurate movement of inbound, outbound and transit shipments in synchronization with flight schedules and downstream network cut-offs.
  
  
The role owns day-to-day Air Hub execution including shipment receipt, processing, build-up / breakdown, loading and unloading, operational cut-off adherence, manpower deployment, throughput, turnaround time, shipment quality and coordination with Aviation and ground-handling stakeholders.
  
  
Leads hub operational teams across shifts and ensures seamless connectivity between Aviation, First Mile, CPU, Surface and Last Mile operations.
  
  
The role works closely with the Regional Air Hub Manager and Regional Air Fleet & Network Manager to ensure flight connectivity, vehicle placement, capacity utilization, disruption recovery and consistent service performance.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
To manage a safe, reliable and high-performing Air Hub by ensuring timely shipment processing and flight connectivity, optimum manpower and infrastructure utilization, strict adherence to operational cut-offs, and continuous improvement in throughput, service quality, productivity and cost.
  
  
**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**
**Air Hub Operational Leadership**

* Own day-to-day operational performance of the Air Hub across all shifts.
* Translate flight schedules, shipment volumes and regional network requirements into daily operating plans.
* Ensure timely receipt, processing, build-up / breakdown and dispatch of inbound, outbound and transit shipments.
* Maintain operational readiness for all scheduled and ad-hoc flight movements.
* Ensure seamless handover between Air Hub, Aviation, Fleet, CPU, Surface and Last Mile operations.
* Proactively escalate network, capacity or service risks to the Regional Air Hub Manager.

**Flight & Network Connectivity**

* Ensure shipments are processed and positioned within defined flight and network cut-offs.
* Monitor inbound and outbound flight connectivity and prevent avoidable missed connections.
* Coordinate with Aviation and ground-handling teams on flight schedules, aircraft capacity and operational changes.
* Ensure rapid operational response to delays, cancellations, diversions or capacity constraints.
* Coordinate contingency plans and recovery actions during network disruptions.
* Ensure timely downstream connectivity following inbound flight arrivals.

**Hub Throughput & Turnaround Time**

* Own hub throughput, processing TAT and flight-related operational timelines.
* Monitor hourly shipment flow and identify potential bottlenecks before they affect connectivity.
* Ensure effective load balancing across shifts and operating areas.
* Drive rapid turnaround of inbound and outbound shipment flows.
* Prevent backlog accumulation and ensure timely clearance of shipment exceptions.
* Improve flow efficiency through process and layout optimization.

**People Leadership & Workforce Management**

* Lead supervisors, executives, operational employees and outsourced workforce across the Air Hub.
* Plan shift manpower based on flight schedules, shipment volumes and operational requirements.
* Ensure effective deployment across processing, build-up, breakdown, loading and support activities.
* Drive productivity, attendance, discipline and accountability across shifts.
* Build capability through coaching, structured training and on-the-job development.
* Maintain contingency manpower plans for absenteeism, peak periods and irregular operations.

**Shipment Quality & Operational Accuracy**

* Ensure accurate shipment processing, scanning, segregation and routing.
* Monitor missorts, misroutes, damages, offloads and other Air Hub exceptions.
* Drive root-cause analysis and corrective action for recurring operational defects.
* Ensure physical-to-system shipment reconciliation and complete scan compliance.
* Maintain shipment security, handling quality and chain-of-custody discipline.
* Reduce rework and avoidable service failures.

**Capacity & Infrastructure Management**

* Monitor Air Hub processing and infrastructure capacity against current and forecast volumes.
* Ensure availability and operational readiness of equipment, workstations and material-handling systems.
* Coordinate with Engineering / Facilities teams for maintenance and breakdown resolution.
* Support layout optimization and infrastructure improvements.
* Identify emerging capacity constraints and provide inputs for expansion or enhancement.
* Ensure readiness for peak periods and major customer volume surges.

**Cost & Productivity Management**

* Monitor operating cost and productivity of the Air Hub.
* Drive improvement in shipments per man-hour and resource utilization.
* Optimize manpower deployment, consumables and facility resources.
* Reduce avoidable handling, overtime, rework and operational wastage.
* Track cost and productivity trends and initiate corrective actions where required.
* Support achievement of regional cost-efficiency objectives without compromising service.

**Safety, Security & Compliance**

* Ensure strict adherence to operational, aviation-interface, safety and security requirements.
* Maintain compliance with Blue Dart SOPs, applicable airport procedures and internal control requirements.
* Conduct regular operational and safety reviews.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations and corrective actions.
* Coordinate with Security and Aviation stakeholders on shipment-handling and access-control requirements.
* Maintain strong workplace safety, housekeeping and equipment-operating standards.

**Continuous Improvement & Technology**

* Identify recurring bottlenecks and operational failure points within the hub.
* Drive structured root-cause analysis and continuous-improvement initiatives.
* Support implementation of automation, scanning and digital-operating tools.
* Track adoption and benefits from new processes and technologies.
* Use operational data to identify productivity and service-improvement opportunities.
* Share successful practices with the Regional Air Hub Manager for wider replication.

**Stakeholder & Governance**

* Work closely with the Regional Air Hub Manager and Regional Air Fleet & Network Manager.
* Coordinate with Aviation, CPU, Surface Operations, First Mile, Last Mile, Security, Engineering, IT, Finance and HR.
* Conduct regular performance reviews with shift and operational teams.
* Provide accurate daily / weekly operational reporting and network-risk visibility.
* Ensure timely escalation and resolution of issues impacting flights or network connectivity.
* Act as the location SME for Air Hub operations.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration or related discipline preferred; MBA / PG desirable.
* Experience: 8–11 years of relevant experience in express logistics, air cargo, aviation-linked logistics, hub operations, transportation or high-throughput distribution operations.
* Strong hands-on exposure to Air Hub / airport logistics, hub processing, mid-mile or network operations.
* Experience managing inbound, outbound and transit shipment flows in a time-critical operating environment.
* Proven experience leading medium-to-large operational teams across multiple shifts.

* Experience in manpower planning, productivity management and cost optimization.

The Master Scheduling function leads the integrated planning and scheduling backbone of the Injection Molding Machine manufacturing business. This role ensures synchronization across

, driving operational efficiency, cost optimization, and customer delivery performance.
  
  
The position institutionalizes demand-supply balancing, ERP/MRP discipline, and logistics governance, converting business forecasts into executable production schedules and supply chain flows across geographies. The function serves as a primary point of contact for and liaison with sales, engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain.

**Strategic Leadership and Policy**

* Design standard operating procedures, best practices, and frameworks for the entire scheduling department.
* Align long-term operational goals with business objectives and financial targets.
* Lead, mentors, and evaluate a team of schedulers, planners, and coordinators.

**Master Production Schedule (MPS) Oversight**

* Directs the creation and maintenance of the high-level Master Production Schedule (MPS) over medium-to-long-range horizons.
* Balance demand and capacity. Evaluate the sales forecasts against facility, labour, and machine capacity to ensure realistic output.
* Risk management: Identify supply chain bottlenecks or resource shortages and run what-if scenarios to resolve conflicts

* Own material requirement planning aligned with production schedules.
* Implement and operate lean practices like VMI, JIT, ROP and Kanban to maintain optimal stock.
* Ensure timely procurement and availability of raw materials, components, and consumables. Provide rolling forecast to suppliers.
* Collaborate with supply chain team for import/export compliance and lead-time optimization.
* Decide and update safety stocks, Long lead time parts and Inventory control.

**Production Planning & Control**

* Collaborate with design engineering, & supply chain team for ensuring sales delivery timeline.
* Monitor shop floor execution, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure adherence to timelines.
* Implement lean practices to minimize WIP and optimize throughput.

title: Deputy Manager, IT User Support
description:
**Description**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
The role is responsible for providing expert-level day-to-day technical support to employees across hardware and software systems, with a strong focus on complex troubleshooting, fault rectification, and timely resolution. The role independently diagnoses and resolves advanced issues, ensures effective escalation and coordination when required, and contributes to root-cause analysis to prevent recurrence. The role maintains high service quality and SLA adherence, ensures accurate documentation, and upholds IT policies and information security practices, while serving as a technical authority without people-management responsibility.
  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Resolve complex hardware and software issues independently
* Transition from hands-on technical support to leading IT user support operations, driving team performance, SLA adherence, and service delivery excellence
* Perform advanced troubleshooting and fault rectification
* Manage escalations and coordinate with specialist teams
* Ensure timely incident closure in line with SLAs
* Conduct root-cause analysis and recommend preventive actions
* Maintain detailed incident and resolution documentation
* Support system access, configurations, and device setups
* Ensure adherence to IT policies and security standards
* Contribute to continuous improvement of support processes

**Job Responsibilities – Plant It Lead**

* Plant IT Leadership & Service Delivery: Lead end-to-end IT operations and service delivery for the plant, covering Quality Informatics, Manufacturing Informatics, IT Infrastructure, End User Computing, and Information Security.
* Quality & Manufacturing Informatics: Provide techno-functional leadership and support for QC laboratory and manufacturing computerized systems, including LIMS, Empower, and equipment control systems, ensuring availability, compliance, qualification, and effective lifecycle management.
* Plant IT Infrastructure: Own and manage plant-level LAN/WAN, servers, network, firewalls, Wi-Fi, internet connectivity, server rooms, storage, backup, and end-user computing infrastructure to ensure reliable and uninterrupted business operations.
