**Position Overview:**

The Air Hub Manager is accountable for end-to-end operational performance of an individual Air Hub, ensuring safe, timely and accurate movement of inbound, outbound and transit shipments in synchronization with flight schedules and downstream network cut-offs.

The role owns day-to-day Air Hub execution including shipment receipt, processing, build-up / breakdown, loading and unloading, operational cut-off adherence, manpower deployment, throughput, turnaround time, shipment quality and coordination with Aviation and ground-handling stakeholders.

Leads hub operational teams across shifts and ensures seamless connectivity between Aviation, First Mile, CPU, Surface and Last Mile operations.

The role works closely with the Regional Air Hub Manager and Regional Air Fleet & Network Manager to ensure flight connectivity, vehicle placement, capacity utilization, disruption recovery and consistent service performance.

**Job Purpose:**

To manage a safe, reliable and high-performing Air Hub by ensuring timely shipment processing and flight connectivity, optimum manpower and infrastructure utilization, strict adherence to operational cut-offs, and continuous improvement in throughput, service quality, productivity and cost.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**

**Air Hub Operational Leadership**

* Own day-to-day operational performance of the Air Hub across all shifts.
* Translate flight schedules, shipment volumes and regional network requirements into daily operating plans.
* Ensure timely receipt, processing, build-up / breakdown and dispatch of inbound, outbound and transit shipments.
* Maintain operational readiness for all scheduled and ad-hoc flight movements.
* Ensure seamless handover between Air Hub, Aviation, Fleet, CPU, Surface and Last Mile operations.
* Proactively escalate network, capacity or service risks to the Regional Air Hub Manager.

**Flight & Network Connectivity**

* Ensure shipments are processed and positioned within defined flight and network cut-offs.
* Monitor inbound and outbound flight connectivity and prevent avoidable missed connections.
* Coordinate with Aviation and ground-handling teams on flight schedules, aircraft capacity and operational changes.
* Ensure rapid operational response to delays, cancellations, diversions or capacity constraints.
* Coordinate contingency plans and recovery actions during network disruptions.
* Ensure timely downstream connectivity following inbound flight arrivals.

**Hub Throughput & Turnaround Time**

* Own hub throughput, processing TAT and flight-related operational timelines.
* Monitor hourly shipment flow and identify potential bottlenecks before they affect connectivity.
* Ensure effective load balancing across shifts and operating areas.
* Drive rapid turnaround of inbound and outbound shipment flows.
* Prevent backlog accumulation and ensure timely clearance of shipment exceptions.
* Improve flow efficiency through process and layout optimization.

**People Leadership & Workforce Management**

* Lead supervisors, executives, operational employees and outsourced workforce across the Air Hub.
* Plan shift manpower based on flight schedules, shipment volumes and operational requirements.
* Ensure effective deployment across processing, build-up, breakdown, loading and support activities.
* Drive productivity, attendance, discipline and accountability across shifts.
* Build capability through coaching, structured training and on-the-job development.
* Maintain contingency manpower plans for absenteeism, peak periods and irregular operations.

**Shipment Quality & Operational Accuracy**

* Ensure accurate shipment processing, scanning, segregation and routing.
* Monitor missorts, misroutes, damages, offloads and other Air Hub exceptions.
* Drive root-cause analysis and corrective action for recurring operational defects.
* Ensure physical-to-system shipment reconciliation and complete scan compliance.
* Maintain shipment security, handling quality and chain-of-custody discipline.
* Reduce rework and avoidable service failures.

**Capacity & Infrastructure Management**

* Monitor Air Hub processing and infrastructure capacity against current and forecast volumes.
* Ensure availability and operational readiness of equipment, workstations and material-handling systems.
* Coordinate with Engineering / Facilities teams for maintenance and breakdown resolution.
* Support layout optimization and infrastructure improvements.
* Identify emerging capacity constraints and provide inputs for expansion or enhancement.
* Ensure readiness for peak periods and major customer volume surges.

**Cost & Productivity Management**

* Monitor operating cost and productivity of the Air Hub.
* Drive improvement in shipments per man-hour and resource utilization.
* Optimize manpower deployment, consumables and facility resources.
* Reduce avoidable handling, overtime, rework and operational wastage.
* Track cost and productivity trends and initiate corrective actions where required.
* Support achievement of regional cost-efficiency objectives without compromising service.

**Safety, Security & Compliance**

* Ensure strict adherence to operational, aviation-interface, safety and security requirements.
* Maintain compliance with Blue Dart SOPs, applicable airport procedures and internal control requirements.
* Conduct regular operational and safety reviews.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations and corrective actions.
* Coordinate with Security and Aviation stakeholders on shipment-handling and access-control requirements.
* Maintain strong workplace safety, housekeeping and equipment-operating standards.

**Continuous Improvement & Technology**

* Identify recurring bottlenecks and operational failure points within the hub.
* Drive structured root-cause analysis and continuous-improvement initiatives.
* Support implementation of automation, scanning and digital-operating tools.
* Track adoption and benefits from new processes and technologies.
* Use operational data to identify productivity and service-improvement opportunities.
* Share successful practices with the Regional Air Hub Manager for wider replication.

**Stakeholder & Governance**

* Work closely with the Regional Air Hub Manager and Regional Air Fleet & Network Manager.
* Coordinate with Aviation, CPU, Surface Operations, First Mile, Last Mile, Security, Engineering, IT, Finance and HR.
* Conduct regular performance reviews with shift and operational teams.
* Provide accurate daily / weekly operational reporting and network-risk visibility.
* Ensure timely escalation and resolution of issues impacting flights or network connectivity.
* Act as the location SME for Air Hub operations.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* **Education**: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration or related discipline preferred; MBA / PG desirable.
* **Experience**: **8–11 years** of relevant experience in express logistics, air cargo, aviation-linked logistics, hub operations, transportation or high-throughput distribution operations.
* Strong hands-on exposure to Air Hub / airport logistics, hub processing, mid-mile or network operations.
* Experience managing inbound, outbound and transit shipment flows in a time-critical operating environment.
* Proven experience leading medium-to-large operational teams across multiple shifts.
* Strong understanding of operational cut-offs, shipment connectivity, throughput and turnaround-time management.
* Experience in manpower planning, productivity management and cost optimization.

title: Production Manager - Cushions & Covers unit
description:
**Designation: Manager – Cushion & Covers**

**Location: Gandhinagar, Gujarat**

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced Production Manager – Cushion & Cover Category to lead end-to-end production operations for our cushion, cover, soft furnishing, and related customized textile products.The incumbent will be responsible for managing production planning and execution, cutting, stitching/sewing, filling, finishing, quality, manpower productivity, machine utilization, and timely order fulfilment.The role requires strong expertise in soft textile products, cushion and cover manufacturing, stitching operations, production planning, process optimization, quality management, and large-scale shop-floor operations. The candidate will work closely with PPC, Quality, SCM, Industrial Engineering, Maintenance, Design, and other cross-functional teams to ensure efficient and timely execution of customer orders.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Production Operations Management**

* Lead day-to-day production operations for cushion, covers, soft furnishings, and customized textile products.
* Manage end-to-end manufacturing processes including fabric cutting, printing/customization, stitching, sewing, filling, assembly, finishing, packing, and dispatch.
* Ensure achievement of daily, weekly, and monthly production targets.
* Optimize manpower and machine utilization to achieve planned production volumes.
* Ensure production schedules are executed as per customer requirements and committed delivery timelines.
* Monitor shop-floor operations and proactively address bottlenecks affecting production output.

**2. Production Planning & Execution**

* Coordinate closely with PPC and SCM teams to ensure availability of fabrics, trims, fillers, accessories, packaging materials, and other required raw materials.
* Plan production capacity based on order volumes, product complexity, manpower availability, and machine capacity.
* Monitor WIP, production flow, line balancing, machine loading, and bottlenecks.
* Ensure effective production sequencing for multiple SKUs, customized orders, and varying product specifications.
* Establish effective shift planning, production allocation, and handover mechanisms.
* Ensure smooth execution of urgent and priority orders without compromising quality.

**3. Cutting, Stitching & Sewing Operations**

* Drive operational efficiency across cutting, stitching, sewing, filling, assembly, and finishing processes.
* Optimize cutting layouts and fabric utilization to minimize wastage.
* Improve stitching productivity through appropriate machine allocation, line balancing, and operator skill mapping.
* Monitor sewing machine efficiency, operator productivity, cycle times, and line output.
* Identify process constraints and implement corrective actions to improve throughput.
* Standardize processes and SOPs across different product categories and production lines.

**4. Quality Management**

* Ensure adherence to defined product specifications, workmanship standards, and customer requirements.
* Minimize defects, rejection, rework, fabric wastage, stitching defects, dimensional deviations, and finishing issues.
* Work closely with QA/QC teams to establish process quality checkpoints.
* Drive root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions for recurring quality issues.
* Ensure consistency in dimensions, stitching quality, filling density, finishing, appearance, and overall product quality.
* Monitor quality metrics and implement continuous improvement initiatives.

**5. Manpower & Shop-Floor Management**

* Lead supervisors, line leaders, operators, tailors, cutters, helpers, and other shop-floor personnel.
* Plan manpower deployment based on production requirements and skill availability.
* Monitor attendance, productivity, discipline, and workforce utilization.
* Develop skill matrices and identify training requirements for operators and supervisors.
* Drive multi-skilling and cross-training initiatives to improve workforce flexibility.
* Build a performance-oriented, disciplined, and safety-focused production culture.

**6. Machine & Equipment Management**

* Ensure optimum utilization of stitching, sewing, cutting, printing, filling, and finishing equipment.
* Coordinate with Maintenance teams to minimize machine breakdowns and production downtime.
* Monitor machine efficiency and support preventive maintenance initiatives.
* Identify requirements for new machines, tooling, automation, and process improvements.
* Support machine installation, trials, commissioning, and production stabilization.
* Evaluate opportunities for automation in repetitive and high-volume production processes.

**7. Productivity & Process Improvement**

* Drive Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, 5S, line balancing, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Improve productivity through optimization of manpower, machine utilization, process flow, and cycle times.
* Identify opportunities to reduce material wastage, rework, overtime, and production costs.
* Analyze production MIS and KPI dashboards to identify performance gaps.
* Establish and monitor KPIs for productivity, efficiency, quality, wastage, downtime, and on-time production.
* Drive standardization and process improvement across the cushion and cover manufacturing operations.

**8. Cross-Functional Coordination**

title: Business Operations Manager – Customer Experience & Team Management
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a mature, proactive and result-oriented Business Operations Manager who can independently manage day-to-day business coordination, customer escalations, employee matters, departmental communication and internal processes.

The person will act as the central coordination point between the Director, employees, customers and all departments.

This is a management position, not a routine administrative or assistant role.

The selected candidate will be responsible for ensuring that:

* Customer issues are addressed promptly and professionally.
* All departments work together effectively.
* Employees understand their responsibilities and remain accountable.
* Work is completed within agreed timelines.
* Company policies and standard operating procedures are followed.
* Work-from-home employees are monitored effectively.
* Routine operational decisions are handled independently.

The ideal candidate should be confident in handling people, solving problems, making decisions and managing multiple responsibilities without requiring constant supervision.

**Key Responsibilities1. Business Operations & Departmental Management**

* Oversee and coordinate the day-to-day functioning of all departments.
* Coordinate with Sales, Administration, Accounts, Reservations and Operations.
* Ensure smooth communication and information flow between departments.
* Monitor daily, weekly and monthly departmental activities.
* Ensure that employees complete assigned tasks within deadlines.
* Follow up on pending work and resolve interdepartmental coordination issues.
* Conduct regular departmental meetings and review operational progress.
* Identify bottlenecks and ensure that issues are resolved.
* Ensure that all departments follow company policies and approved processes.
* Prepare regular operational updates for the Director.

**2. Customer Experience & Escalation Management**

* Handle customer complaints and escalated service-related matters.
* Take ownership of customer issues arising before, during and after tour bookings.
* Coordinate with Sales, Reservations and Operations to resolve customer concerns.
* Handle sensitive customer situations professionally and calmly.
* Ensure that customers receive timely responses and appropriate resolutions.
* Monitor recurring complaints and identify the underlying reasons.
* Maintain an escalation and resolution tracker.
* Ensure that customer service standards are consistently maintained.
* Recommend improvements to the customer experience and booking process.

**3. Employee Management & Workplace Coordination**

* Monitor employee attendance, punctuality, discipline and workplace conduct in coordination with Admin/HR.
* Ensure employees understand their roles, responsibilities and reporting structure.
* Address routine employee concerns and workplace issues.
* Handle internal coordination problems and employee conflicts.
* Monitor task allocation and employee productivity.
* Ensure that employees follow company policies and procedures.
* Conduct regular one-to-one discussions with employees.
* Coordinate with Admin/HR regarding leave, attendance, documentation and employee records.
* Identify employees requiring additional guidance, support or corrective action.
* Maintain confidentiality when dealing with employee-related matters.

**4. Performance Monitoring & Employee Reviews**

* Establish and monitor departmental and employee-level KPIs in consultation with department heads.
* Conduct monthly performance reviews.
* Review departmental productivity, task completion and pending activities.
* Identify performance gaps and discuss corrective measures with employees.
* Ensure that department heads provide timely performance updates.
* Track employee improvement plans where required.
* Recognise good performance and recommend employee development opportunities.
* Share significant performance concerns and recommendations with the Director.

**5. Work-from-Home Employee Monitoring**

* Monitor employees working remotely through defined task trackers and reporting systems.
* Ensure daily and weekly work updates are submitted.
* Monitor task completion, deadlines, productivity and communication.
* Coordinate with relevant department heads to address performance issues.
* Ensure remote employees remain connected with the rest of the organisation.
* Identify delays, communication gaps and productivity concerns.

**6. Itinerary, Calendar & Internal Information Management**

* Monitor changes to tour itineraries, departure calendars and business schedules.
* Ensure approved updates are communicated to all relevant departments.
* Coordinate with Sales and Operations when tour-related information changes.
* Ensure internal calendars, booking information and operational documents remain updated.
* Ensure employees have access to the correct and latest information.
* Prevent communication gaps caused by outdated documents or incomplete updates.
* Coordinate the preparation and distribution of internal announcements.

**7. Training, Employee Knowledge & Development**

* Identify training requirements across departments.
* Coordinate employee onboarding and internal training sessions.
* Ensure employees understand company products, tour processes and service standards.
* Arrange regular knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Ensure employees receive updates about new tours, destinations, policies and operational changes.
* Maintain training records and employee knowledge documentation.
* Identify skill gaps and recommend suitable training or development initiatives.

**8. Office Administration, Systems & Infrastructure**

* Monitor the overall condition and functioning of the office.
* Ensure computers, laptops, phones, internet connections and other office equipment are maintained.
* Coordinate the creation and allocation of official email accounts and business contact numbers.
* Maintain records of company-issued devices, SIM cards, accounts and access permissions.
* Monitor office maintenance, repairs and equipment requirements.
* Coordinate with vendors and service providers.
* Ensure office resources are used responsibly.
* Work with Admin/HR to maintain a professional, organised and productive workplace.

**9. Process Improvement & Business Development Support**

* Identify operational inefficiencies and suggest practical solutions.
* Develop and improve internal processes, SOPs, checklists and reporting systems.
* Recommend improvements in employee productivity and departmental coordination.
* Identify recurring operational problems and ensure corrective action.
* Support the Director in implementing business priorities and internal improvement initiatives.
* Prepare reports highlighting operational challenges, risks and improvement opportunities.
* Take ownership of assigned business improvement projects.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* 6–10 years of professional experience in Business Operations, Operations Management, Administration Management, Hospitality, Travel & Tourism, Aviation, Automobile, Retail or a service-oriented organisation.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in team management, employee supervision or cross-functional coordination.
* Graduate degree in Business Administration, Management, Hospitality or a related discipline.
* MBA or relevant management qualification will be an advantage.
* Proven experience handling customer escalations and employee-related issues.
* Experience managing multiple departments, teams or business functions.
* Good understanding of business operations, reporting, performance monitoring and process improvement.
* Strong knowledge of Google Workspace, Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, email and CRM systems.

**Preferred Candidate Background**

Candidates with experience in the following industries will be preferred:

* Travel and Tourism
* Hospitality and Hotel Management
* Aviation and Airline Operations
* Automobile Dealerships and Service Operations
* Retail and Customer Service
* Business Process and Service Management

Candidates from other industries with strong business operations and people-management experience are also welcome.

**What We Expect From You**

We are looking for someone who:

* Takes ownership instead of waiting for instructions.
* Can manage people confidently and professionally.
* Can handle difficult customers and employees with maturity.
* Does not depend on the Director for every routine decision.
* Can coordinate multiple departments effectively.
* Is organised, systematic and accountable.
* Can identify problems and implement solutions.
* Maintains confidentiality and professional ethics.
* Is comfortable working in a growing business environment.
* Is willing to take responsibility for outcomes, not just activities.

**What We Offer**

* An important management position with direct access to the Director.
* Opportunity to lead and coordinate a team of 15–25 employees.
* An opportunity to improve and develop business systems and processes.
* A professional and growth-oriented working environment.

title: EHS & Maintenance Manager
description:
**Position Title:**
Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) & Maintenance Manager
  
  
*Hydro Prokav Pumps India Pvt Ltd*
*Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu*
**About Us**
*Hydro Prokav Pumps, part of Ingersoll Rand, a leading progressive cavity pump (PCP) manufacturer and exporter headquartered in Coimbatore, India. Hydro Prokav core expertise lies in PCP solutions, the perfect choice for handling tough, viscous, abrasive, and high-consistency mediums. Equipped with state-of-the-art machinery and testing facilities, our integrated plant ensures precision manufacturing and rigorous quality control for every pump produced.*
**Job Summary**
*The EHS & Maintenance Manager is responsible for leading and managing the site's Environment, Health & Safety, Sustainability, Engineering Maintenance, Utilities and Facility Management functions.*
**Responsibilities**
**Maintenance Planning & Execution**

* Full statutory and regulatory compliance
* Prevention of injuries, occupational illnesses and environmental incidents
* Implementation of corporate EHS policies and standards
* Effective ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 management systems
* Reliable and safe operation of plant machinery and utilities
* Preventive and predictive maintenance effectiveness
* Equipment reliability and reduction of unplanned downtime
* Effective energy and resource management
* Engineering and EHS project execution
* Sustainability and emission reduction
* Emergency preparedness
* Continuous improvement in safety, environmental and operational performance

**EHS, Compliance & Safety**

* Ensure compliance with all applicable EHS and statutory requirements, including TNPCB, DISH, Fire & Rescue Services, CEIG, DTCP and other regulatory authorities.
* Manage statutory licenses, consents, approvals, renewals, registers, inspections and regulatory submissions.
* Implement and maintain ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 management systems, including internal/external audits, management reviews and CAPA closure.
* Lead HIRA, JSA, Permit-to-Work, LOTO, contractor safety and high-risk activity controls.
* Drive accident prevention, SIF/Fatality Prevention, safety inspections, near-miss reporting and proactive safety programs.
* Lead incident investigations, Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and corrective/preventive actions.
* Maintain Emergency Response Plans and conduct periodic mock drills for fire, chemical spills, medical and other emergencies.
* Conduct EHS training, employee engagement and safety awareness programs to strengthen site safety culture.

**Environment & Sustainability**

* Manage environmental compliance covering air emissions, effluent, hazardous waste, chemical management, water, energy and waste disposal.
* Manage applicable EPR compliance, authorized waste vendors and environmental documentation.
* Drive energy efficiency, GHG emission reduction, renewable energy, water conservation, recycling and waste-reduction initiatives.
* Collect, validate and report EHS and sustainability performance data to corporate stakeholders.
* Support Scope 1, Scope 2 and relevant Scope 3 GHG accounting, ESG reporting, LCA and Product Carbon Footprint initiatives, as applicable.
* Develop and monitor environmental and sustainability KPIs against corporate targets.

**Maintenance, Engineering & Utilities**

* Lead overall mechanical, electrical, utility, facility and infrastructure maintenance activities.
* Develop and execute preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance programs to improve equipment reliability and availability.
* Monitor equipment performance through PM compliance, downtime, MTBF, MTTR and repeat breakdown analysis.
* Lead RCA for major equipment failures and implement permanent corrective actions.
* Ensure reliable operation of electrical systems, compressors, HVAC, water systems, fire protection systems and other plant utilities.
* Manage electrical safety and CEIG compliance, including preventive maintenance and statutory inspections.
* Plan shutdown maintenance, critical spare requirements, AMCs and maintenance service contracts.
* Lead engineering, safety, sustainability and energy-efficiency improvement projects.
* Manage contractors and vendors for maintenance and engineering activities with strong EHS controls.
* Prepare and control EHS and maintenance budgets, optimizing cost without compromising safety, compliance or equipment reliability.

**Basic Qualifications**

* BE mechanical/Electrical with 10-15 years experience

**Key Competencies**

* EHS statutory and regulatory compliance
* ISO 14001 & ISO 45001
* HIRA, JSA, PTW & LOTO
* Incident Investigation & Root Cause Analysis
* SIF / Fatality Prevention
* Environmental & Chemical Management
* Sustainability & ESG Reporting
* GHG Accounting & Carbon Reduction
* Preventive & Predictive Maintenance
* Mechanical & Electrical Maintenance
* Equipment Reliability, MTBF & MTTR
* Utilities & Facility Management
* Energy Management
* Engineering Project Management
* Contractor & Vendor Management
* Budget & Cost Management
* Team Leadership & Cross-functional Coordination

**What We Offer**

* We are all owners of the company! Stock options (Employee Ownership Program) that align your interests with the company's success.
* Yearly performance-based bonus, rewarding your hard work and dedication.
* Leave Encashments
* Maternity/Paternity Leaves
* Employee Health covered under Medical, Group Term Life & Accident Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program
* Employee development with LinkedIn Learning
* Employee recognition via Awardco
* Collaborative, multicultural work environment with a team of dedicated professionals, fostering innovation and teamwork.

**Job Title: Manager – Platform Governance**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a skilled and experienced Manager – Platform Governance to manage the governance processes, controls, and compliance oversight for enterprise platforms supporting data products and corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines platform governance, risk coordination, and team leadership to promote secure, reliable, and well-controlled platform services. The ideal candidate will work with platform engineering, operations, security, architecture, and business teams to embed practical governance across services supporting P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will be accountable for coordinating governance reviews, maintaining control and exception records, monitoring adherence to approved standards, and supporting audit readiness within the assigned platform scope. You will enable delivery teams to meet governance requirements while escalating unresolved risks to accountable decision-makers.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
**Platform Governance & Control Oversight**

* Maintain the platform governance framework, control inventory, ownership matrix, and review calendar in alignment with enterprise policies and approved architecture and security standards.
* Translate approved policies into practical control requirements, review checklists, and evidence expectations for platform provisioning, operation, change, and retirement.
* Coordinate governance reviews for new platform services and significant changes, tracking required approvals, control gaps, and actions before release or onboarding.
* Maintain platform and service inventories with accountable owners, criticality classifications, dependencies, and lifecycle status; coordinate periodic validation with service teams.
* Coordinate periodic access reviews with identity and service owners, covering privileged access, least privilege, segregation of duties, and timely removal of inappropriate access.
* Administer policy exceptions and risk registers, documenting rationale, compensating controls, accountable owners, expiry dates, and approvals by designated authorities.

**Risk, Compliance & Audit Readiness**

* Plan risk-based governance and control review activities, prioritizing critical platforms, overdue findings, and material changes in consultation with security and risk teams.
* Coordinate control self-assessments and evidence collection; verify evidence completeness and traceability while supporting independent assurance and audit teams.
* Track and report control coverage, review completion, overdue remediation, expired exceptions, and repeat findings; escalate material issues through agreed governance forums.
* Coordinate remediation plans with control owners, monitor milestones, and obtain supporting evidence before recommending closure to authorized reviewers.
* Partner with security, privacy, legal, and data governance teams to map applicable obligations to platform controls, including logging, retention, data protection, and third-party service requirements.

**Team Leadership & Talent Management**

* Manage a team of governance analysts or coordinators, allocating review, reporting, and evidence-management responsibilities across supported platforms.
* Build a culture of accountability, constructive challenge, consistent documentation, and collaboration with engineering and operational teams.
* Manage capacity planning, onboarding, performance feedback, and training; develop backup coverage for recurring governance and audit activities.
* Coach team members on control assessment, evidence quality, risk documentation, issue tracking, and clear stakeholder communication.

**Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with finance stakeholders and platform owners to understand business criticality, reporting dependencies, and control requirements for supported services.
* Coordinate with architecture, engineering, operations, security, and risk teams to clarify control ownership and resolve governance gaps without duplicating responsibilities.
* Facilitate governance forums, prepare decision papers, record decisions and approvals, and track agreed actions to completion.
* Communicate governance status, emerging risks, exceptions, audit readiness, and remediation progress clearly to management and business stakeholders.

**Governance Enablement & Continuous Improvement**

* Standardize reusable control checklists, evidence templates, onboarding criteria, and exception workflows to improve consistency and reduce administrative effort.
* Work with engineering teams to automate control monitoring and evidence collection where feasible, including policy-as-code checks and governance dashboards.
* Review lessons from incidents, audits, and control failures; recommend framework improvements and track evidence of resilience testing, lifecycle reviews, and secure service retirement.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of experience in technology governance, platform operations, IT risk, compliance, or technology controls, including responsibility for enterprise platform governance activities.
* 2+ years of team leadership or people-management experience, with a track record of coordinating cross-functional control reviews and developing governance or operations teams.

**Technical Expertise**

* Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and its governance capabilities, including resource organization, policy enforcement, identity, and audit logging.
* Understanding of enterprise platform services, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, and service lifecycle management sufficient to assess control coverage and engage technical owners.
* Experience with control inventories, risk and exception registers, evidence repositories, and GRC or IT service management tools.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, configuration management, and policy-as-code concepts to support governance integrated into engineering workflows.
* Understanding of access governance, segregation of duties, data classification, encryption, logging, retention, vulnerability management, and third-party technology risk.

**Governance & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to coordinate risk-based control reviews, audit preparation, issue remediation, and governance reporting across multiple stakeholder groups.
* Familiarity with relevant frameworks such as COBIT, ITIL, ISO/IEC 27001, or NIST; ability to apply requirements proportionately to platform scope and business risk.
* Strong planning, documentation, analytical, and follow-through skills, including the ability to interpret control metrics and distinguish evidence gaps from confirmed control failures.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A), reporting dependencies, and internal control requirements is preferred.
* Experience supporting governance for finance transformation, ERP-connected platforms, enterprise analytics, or other business-critical technology services is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong team supervision, workload planning, coaching, and cross-functional coordination skills.
* Clear stakeholder communication, including the ability to explain control gaps, risk implications, and required actions to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to exercise sound judgment, challenge constructively, and balance proportionate governance with efficient delivery while respecting approval boundaries.
* High ownership mindset focused on control effectiveness, reliable evidence, timely escalation, and continuous improvement.

title: Fabric Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Raaha Garments is a Tiruppur-based apparel export house with over four decades of experience serving leading global brands with premium knitwear and woven garments. Evolving from a family-led venture into a structured manufacturing operation, the company manages all core garmenting processes in-house, including auto-cutting, stitching, embroidery, finishing, quality control, and washing labs. Raaha Garments specializes in garments for infants, children, men, and women, with strong fabric capabilities across Single jersey, Rib, Interlock, Fleece, Waffle, French terry, Poplin, Twill, and licensed merchandise featuring globally recognized characters.

**Role Description**
The Fabric Manager role is a full-time, on-site position based at Raaha Garments in Tiruppur, Tamil Nadu. The Fabric Manager will oversee end-to-end fabric procurement and management, including vendor coordination, ordering, and ensuring timely delivery aligned with production schedules. This role involves monitoring fabric quality, conducting inspections, and working closely with the quality control and production teams to maintain standards across various fabric types and licensed products. The Fabric Manager will manage fabric inventory, optimize utilization, and support cost-effective sourcing strategies while maintaining compliance with certifications and buyer requirements. Day-to-day responsibilities also include collaborating with cross-functional teams, resolving fabric-related issues, and supporting continuous improvement in fabric sourcing and handling processes.

**Qualifications**

* Strong knowledge of textiles, including knit and woven fabrics, and familiarity with specialized materials used in infants, kids, men’s, and women’s garments.
* Experience in fabric procurement, vendor development, and supply chain coordination, with the ability to manage lead times and negotiate favorable terms.
* Proficiency in fabric quality control, inspection methods, and adherence to relevant standards, certifications, and buyer specifications.
* Demonstrated team management skills, including coordinating with production, merchandising, and quality teams, and supporting a collaborative work environment.
* Effective negotiation and communication skills for working with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Textiles, Garment Technology, Fashion Technology, or a related field preferred.
* Experience in an apparel manufacturing or export house environment, ideally in Tiruppur or similar hubs.

title: Greenhouse Construction Supervisor
description:
**Company Description**
Indian Agro Service is a recognized manufacturer, wholesaler, and distributor specializing in organic kitchen gardens, roof garden creation, hydroponic cultivation, and a wide range of seeds and vegetables. The organization focuses on sustainable and innovative agricultural solutions for residential and commercial clients. In addition to products, Indian Agro Service provides residential landscape services and related offerings to support customized green spaces. Team members collaborate closely with customers to design and implement practical, eco-friendly growing systems. The company values hands-on expertise, quality service, and continuous improvement in modern agriculture practices.
  
**Role Description**
The Greenhouse Construction Supervisor is a full-time, on-site role based in Perundurai, responsible for overseeing the end-to-end construction and setup of greenhouse structures. The role includes planning daily work schedules, coordinating labor and materials, and supervising site activities to ensure projects are completed safely, on time, and within quality standards. The supervisor conducts regular site inspections, monitors construction progress, and enforces construction safety procedures and regulatory compliance. This position also involves communicating with clients, vendors, and internal teams, resolving issues that arise on-site, and maintaining accurate records of work done, materials used, and timelines. The role requires hands-on involvement in greenhouse installation, troubleshooting structural or technical challenges, and supporting continuous improvements in construction methods and efficiency.

* Candidates should possess strong supervisory skills and site supervision experience to manage construction crews and daily operations.
* Candidates should possess effective communication skills to coordinate with clients, vendors, and team members and provide clear instructions on-site.

* Relevant technical diploma, trade certification, or degree in civil engineering, agriculture engineering, or a related field is preferred.

title: Branch Manager – Coworking Operations
description:
**Job Title: Branch Manager – Coworking Operations**

**Company:** Betaspace Coworking  
**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu  
**Job Type:** Full-time, on-site  
**Experience:** 5+ years, including branch or facility management  
**Reporting to:** Operations Head / Management  
Contact Number : 0091 9500 8187 02

**About Betaspace**

Betaspace provides managed offices, private offices, coworking desks, meeting rooms, and virtual office services. We focus on delivering well-maintained workspaces, reliable facilities, and responsive client service.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced Branch Manager to take ownership of a Betaspace branch’s operations, team performance, client experience, occupancy, and collections follow-up.

You will lead the branch team, maintain service standards, resolve operational issues, control approved expenses, and support business growth through effective enquiry handling, client retention, and renewals.

This is an active leadership role requiring regular branch inspections, direct team supervision, sound judgement, and accountability for results.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

**1. Branch Ownership and Operational Management**

* Take overall responsibility for the assigned branch’s daily operations and performance.
* Ensure the branch is clean, organised, fully functional, and ready for clients.
* Conduct regular walkthroughs and review opening, operating, and closing checks.
* Establish clear work priorities, assign responsibilities, and verify completion.
* Anticipate operational needs and address gaps before they affect clients.
* Implement company policies and approved operating procedures consistently.

**2. Team Leadership and Performance**

* Lead admin executives, housekeeping, security, and other assigned support staff.
* Set clear expectations, allocate work, and monitor service quality.
* Plan attendance coverage, shifts, leave arrangements, and staff handovers.
* Review daily reports and verify that reported work has been completed.
* Coach team members and conduct regular performance discussions.
* Address performance gaps and recommend training, staffing, or corrective action to management.
* Support recruitment and onboarding of branch employees.

**3. Housekeeping and Workspace Standards**

* Maintain consistent standards across reception, cabins, workstations, meeting rooms, pantry, washrooms, and common areas.
* Oversee daily cleaning schedules, periodic deep cleaning, and inspection checklists.
* Ensure cleaning gaps are corrected and recurring issues are addressed.
* Monitor workspace appearance, furniture condition, signage, and overall ambience.
* Ensure available spaces are maintained to the same standard as occupied areas.

**4. Client Relationships and Service Standards**

* Build professional relationships with client representatives and key contacts.
* Take ownership of escalated complaints and coordinate timely resolution.
* Track client concerns, commitments, and service requests through completion.
* Conduct periodic feedback discussions to understand satisfaction and changing requirements.
* Coordinate approved workspace changes and additional service requests.
* Identify dissatisfaction or potential exits early and develop retention actions with management.

**5. Occupancy, Enquiries, and Business Growth**

* Maintain accurate occupancy and availability records for seats, cabins, and offices.
* Oversee enquiry response, branch tours, proposals, and prospective client follow-ups.
* Coordinate with sales and management to convert suitable enquiries into bookings.
* Monitor upcoming vacancies, move-ins, expansions, and move-outs.
* Identify opportunities for additional seats, meeting room use, and other relevant services.
* Work towards occupancy and revenue targets agreed with management.
* Offer pricing, discounts, or commercial commitments only within approved authority.

**6. Collections Follow-up and Renewals**

* Review outstanding payments with the accounts team and assign follow-up actions.
* Ensure invoices and payment reminders reach the appropriate client contacts.
* Track payment commitments and escalate overdue or disputed amounts promptly.
* Coordinate clarification of billing concerns with accounts and management.
* Plan renewal discussions before agreements expire.
* Maintain visibility of renewal status, potential exits, and revenue risks.
* Implement access-related actions only through approved company procedures.

**7. Facilities and Preventive Maintenance**

* Oversee the operational readiness of internet, Wi-Fi, AC, lighting, drinking water, washrooms, access systems, and other facilities.
* Coordinate UPS, generator, CCTV, electrical, and other technical servicing with authorised personnel.
* Maintain preventive maintenance schedules, service records, and applicable AMC details.
* Plan maintenance activities to minimise disruption to clients.
* Monitor breakdowns, response times, recurring faults, and repair completion.
* Escalate infrastructure risks with practical recommendations and cost estimates.

**8. Vendor and Building Coordination**

* Manage branch-level coordination with technicians, suppliers, service providers, and building representatives.
* Obtain and evaluate quotations based on cost, quality, and service requirements.
* Seek approvals before confirming purchases or work beyond delegated limits.
* Monitor vendor attendance, timelines, work quality, and completion.
* Verify supporting bills and work completion before recommending payment.
* Coordinate building-related matters such as shared facilities, parking, access, and maintenance.

**9. Client Onboarding, Bookings, and Exits**

* Oversee workspace preparation and smooth onboarding of new clients.
* Ensure documentation, access cards, keys, and handover records are coordinated.
* Review meeting room bookings, day passes, and workspace allocations.
* Ensure client commitments are communicated clearly to the branch team.
* Supervise exit inspections, asset checks, access returns, and handovers.
* Coordinate financial closure with accounts and management.

**10. Expense Control, Procurement, and Inventory**

* Monitor branch operating expenses against approved budgets.
* Review purchase requests, stock requirements, and petty cash records.
* Ensure expenses have appropriate approvals and supporting documents.
* Maintain accountability for furniture, equipment, keys, access cards, and consumables.
* Prevent avoidable wastage, stock shortages, and unnecessary expenditure.
* Recommend cost improvements while maintaining service standards.

**11. Safety, Security, and Incident Management**

* Oversee visitor management, access control, and security coordination.
* Ensure emergency contacts are available and exits remain unobstructed.
* Report hazards, damage, security concerns, and significant incidents immediately.
* Coordinate incident response according to company procedures.
* Maintain incident records and follow up on corrective actions.
* Ensure staff understand their responsibilities during emergencies.

**12. Reporting and Branch Performance Review**

* Submit a daily branch summary covering completed work, client issues, maintenance, enquiries, collections follow-up, and pending actions.
* Review staff reports for accuracy and completeness.
* Maintain an action tracker with responsible persons and target completion dates.
* Share weekly or monthly performance updates as required by management.
* Highlight occupancy, renewals, overdue payments, expenses, service gaps, and staffing requirements.
* Present issues with clear facts, proposed solutions, and approvals required.
* Implement approved improvements and track their effectiveness.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline; qualifications in business administration, hospitality, or facilities management are an advantage.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in coworking operations, business centres, facilities management, hospitality, serviced offices, or a similar environment.
* Experience independently managing a branch, office, property, or facility.
* Demonstrated experience leading teams and handling client escalations.
* Experience in vendor management, expense monitoring, occupancy support, renewals, and collections follow-up.

**Required Skills**

* Strong leadership, delegation, and team supervision.
* Professional communication in Tamil and English.
* Excellent client relationship and complaint-resolution skills.
* Ability to prioritise competing operational and commercial requirements.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, email, and performance reporting.
* Good judgement in handling expenses, vendors, and client commitments.
* Consistent follow-through and accountability for branch results.
* Ability to identify risks early and escalate with recommended solutions.
* Willingness to inspect the branch regularly and supervise operations directly.

**Key Performance Measures**

Performance will be reviewed against targets agreed with management, including:

* Branch cleanliness, readiness, and service standards.
* Client satisfaction, complaint resolution, and retention.
* Occupancy, enquiry follow-ups, and booking conversions.
* Renewal completion and timely collections follow-up.
* Staff attendance coverage, productivity, and work quality.
* Maintenance completion and control of recurring faults.
* Expense control and accuracy of branch records.
* Timely reporting and completion of pending actions.

**Work Arrangement**

This is a full-time, on-site position at an assigned Betaspace branch in Coimbatore. Salary will be based on experience and demonstrated capability. Working hours, weekly off, and benefits will be discussed during the recruitment process.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Education:

* Master's (Required)

Language:

* English (Required)

Location:

* Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

* Share approved pricing and proposals in coordination with management or the sales team.
* Track enquiries and ensure timely follow-ups.
* Maintain accurate information on occupied and available seats and cabins.
* Highlight upcoming vacancies, expansion opportunities, and potential client exits.

**8. Bookings, Client Onboarding, and Exits**

* Oversee meeting room bookings, day passes, and workspace allocations.
* Ensure booked spaces and new client workspaces are ready on time.
* Coordinate documentation, access cards, keys, and client handovers.

**9. Payments, Renewals, and Documentation**

* Coordinate with accounts on outstanding payments and assigned collection follow-ups.

* Track upcoming renewals and coordinate timely discussions.
* Ensure required client documents and agreements are followed up and maintained.

**10. Inventory, Procurement, and Expense Control**

* Maintain records of furniture, equipment, keys, access cards, and consumables.
* Monitor stock levels and raise purchase requests in advance.
* Manage assigned petty cash and maintain bills, vouchers, and expense records.
* Ensure purchases and expenses remain within approved limits.
* Identify practical cost savings while maintaining service quality.

**11. Safety, Security, and Incident Coordination**

* Monitor visitor management and coordinate with security personnel.
* Keep emergency contacts accessible and ensure exits and access routes remain clear.
* Report safety hazards, unauthorised access, damage, and unusual incidents immediately.
* Coordinate the initial response to operational incidents according to company procedures.
* Ensure closing and handover checks are completed and documented.

**12. Reporting and Continuous Improvement**

* Submit an accurate daily branch operations report before leaving for the day.
* Review reports submitted by branch staff and verify important updates.
* Report client issues, maintenance status, attendance gaps, enquiries, payment follow-ups, expenses, and pending actions.
* Assign a responsible person and target completion date for pending tasks.
* Share periodic summaries of branch performance and recurring concerns.
* Recommend improvements and implement approved changes.

description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: Manager – Platform Governance**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a skilled and experienced Manager – Platform Governance to manage the governance processes, controls, and compliance oversight for enterprise platforms supporting data products and corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines platform governance, risk coordination, and team leadership to promote secure, reliable, and well-controlled platform services. The ideal candidate will work with platform engineering, operations, security, architecture, and business teams to embed practical governance across services supporting P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will be accountable for coordinating governance reviews, maintaining control and exception records, monitoring adherence to approved standards, and supporting audit readiness within the assigned platform scope. You will enable delivery teams to meet governance requirements while escalating unresolved risks to accountable decision-makers.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
**Platform Governance & Control Oversight**

* Maintain the platform governance framework, control inventory, ownership matrix, and review calendar in alignment with enterprise policies and approved architecture and security standards.
* Translate approved policies into practical control requirements, review checklists, and evidence expectations for platform provisioning, operation, change, and retirement.
* Coordinate governance reviews for new platform services and significant changes, tracking required approvals, control gaps, and actions before release or onboarding.
* Maintain platform and service inventories with accountable owners, criticality classifications, dependencies, and lifecycle status; coordinate periodic validation with service teams.
* Coordinate periodic access reviews with identity and service owners, covering privileged access, least privilege, segregation of duties, and timely removal of inappropriate access.
* Administer policy exceptions and risk registers, documenting rationale, compensating controls, accountable owners, expiry dates, and approvals by designated authorities.

**Risk, Compliance & Audit Readiness**

* Plan risk-based governance and control review activities, prioritizing critical platforms, overdue findings, and material changes in consultation with security and risk teams.
* Coordinate control self-assessments and evidence collection; verify evidence completeness and traceability while supporting independent assurance and audit teams.
* Track and report control coverage, review completion, overdue remediation, expired exceptions, and repeat findings; escalate material issues through agreed governance forums.
* Coordinate remediation plans with control owners, monitor milestones, and obtain supporting evidence before recommending closure to authorized reviewers.
* Partner with security, privacy, legal, and data governance teams to map applicable obligations to platform controls, including logging, retention, data protection, and third-party service requirements.

**Team Leadership & Talent Management**

* Manage a team of governance analysts or coordinators, allocating review, reporting, and evidence-management responsibilities across supported platforms.
* Build a culture of accountability, constructive challenge, consistent documentation, and collaboration with engineering and operational teams.
* Manage capacity planning, onboarding, performance feedback, and training; develop backup coverage for recurring governance and audit activities.
* Coach team members on control assessment, evidence quality, risk documentation, issue tracking, and clear stakeholder communication.

**Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with finance stakeholders and platform owners to understand business criticality, reporting dependencies, and control requirements for supported services.
* Coordinate with architecture, engineering, operations, security, and risk teams to clarify control ownership and resolve governance gaps without duplicating responsibilities.
* Facilitate governance forums, prepare decision papers, record decisions and approvals, and track agreed actions to completion.
* Communicate governance status, emerging risks, exceptions, audit readiness, and remediation progress clearly to management and business stakeholders.

**Governance Enablement & Continuous Improvement**

* Standardize reusable control checklists, evidence templates, onboarding criteria, and exception workflows to improve consistency and reduce administrative effort.
* Work with engineering teams to automate control monitoring and evidence collection where feasible, including policy-as-code checks and governance dashboards.
* Review lessons from incidents, audits, and control failures; recommend framework improvements and track evidence of resilience testing, lifecycle reviews, and secure service retirement.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of experience in technology governance, platform operations, IT risk, compliance, or technology controls, including responsibility for enterprise platform governance activities.
* 2+ years of team leadership or people-management experience, with a track record of coordinating cross-functional control reviews and developing governance or operations teams.

**Technical Expertise**

* Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and its governance capabilities, including resource organization, policy enforcement, identity, and audit logging.
* Understanding of enterprise platform services, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, and service lifecycle management sufficient to assess control coverage and engage technical owners.
* Experience with control inventories, risk and exception registers, evidence repositories, and GRC or IT service management tools.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, configuration management, and policy-as-code concepts to support governance integrated into engineering workflows.
* Understanding of access governance, segregation of duties, data classification, encryption, logging, retention, vulnerability management, and third-party technology risk.

**Governance & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to coordinate risk-based control reviews, audit preparation, issue remediation, and governance reporting across multiple stakeholder groups.
* Familiarity with relevant frameworks such as COBIT, ITIL, ISO/IEC 27001, or NIST; ability to apply requirements proportionately to platform scope and business risk.
* Strong planning, documentation, analytical, and follow-through skills, including the ability to interpret control metrics and distinguish evidence gaps from confirmed control failures.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A), reporting dependencies, and internal control requirements is preferred.
* Experience supporting governance for finance transformation, ERP-connected platforms, enterprise analytics, or other business-critical technology services is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong team supervision, workload planning, coaching, and cross-functional coordination skills.
* Clear stakeholder communication, including the ability to explain control gaps, risk implications, and required actions to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to exercise sound judgment, challenge constructively, and balance proportionate governance with efficient delivery while respecting approval boundaries.
* High ownership mindset focused on control effectiveness, reliable evidence, timely escalation, and continuous improvement.

description:

**Senior Network Product Manager**
Global Network Services | Platform Infrastructure
  
  
**Role Summary:**
Own the global network product portfolio across data centers and datarooms , route/switch, observability, automation, lifecycle, resiliency, and vendor governance.
  
  
**Function**
Platform Infrastructure / DC connect
  
  
**Level**
Senior Product Manager
  
  
**Primary Scope**
Cisco, Arista, LAN/WAN, VXLAN, L2/L3 networking, monitoring, automation, lifecycle management
  
  
**Key Outcomes**
Resilient network services, product roadmap execution, vendor accountability, reduced technical debt, improved observability
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
At EY, network services are foundational to secure, resilient, and high-performing technology operations. As the firm modernizes infrastructure, strengthens cyber resilience, expands cloud connectivity, and improves global platform reliability, EY requires a senior product leader to provide end-to-end ownership of the global datacenter dataroom network product portfolio.
  
  
The Senior Network Product Manager will own network strategy, roadmap, lifecycle, standards, observability, service health, and vendor governance. This role requires deep technical credibility across Cisco and Arista route/switch platforms, VXLAN, L2/L3 networking, WAN, routing protocols, and network management tools, combined with practical product leadership and executive communication skills.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Product Strategy and Ownership
  
  

* Own the global Network Product strategy, roadmap, standards, and lifecycle management.
* Define multi-year modernization plans for network resiliency, security, automation, supportability, and simplification.
* Align network capabilities with business priorities, cloud strategy, regulatory obligations, cyber requirements, and operational needs.
* Define product KPIs, OKRs, service levels, technical debt plans, capacity trends, and platform health metrics.
* Partner with engineering, operations, security, procurement, and finance teams to support roadmap execution and investment planning.

Technical Product Leadership
  
  

* Act as the senior product owner and technical authority for enterprise route/switch networking across data centers, data rooms, campus, WAN, and cloud connectivity.
* Provide product direction for Cisco Catalyst 9000, Cisco Nexus, Arista switching, routers, load balancer connectivity, DCI, and network segmentation patterns.
* Guide architecture standards for VXLAN EVPN fabrics, L2/L3 designs, routing domains, high availability, resiliency, and failover patterns.
* Ensure network standards account for OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, route redistribution, multicast, QoS, network segmentation, and secure connectivity requirements.
* Review product risks, design gaps, lifecycle exposure, and operational friction points across the global network estate.

Network Observability and Intelligence
  
  

* Own product strategy for syslog, telemetry, packet visibility, network performance monitoring, configuration compliance, and network maps.
* Improve visibility into device health, topology, routing state, capacity, configuration drift, fault domains, and service impact.
* Drive adoption of proactive monitoring, event correlation, root cause analysis, and automated runbook capabilities.
* Establish network health dashboards used by operations, engineering, security, and leadership teams.

Lifecycle, Risk, and Compliance
  
  

* Maintain product lifecycle plans for hardware, software, firmware, support contracts, end-of-life, end-of-support, and vulnerability exposure.
* Partner with cyber, risk, and operations teams to prioritize patching, remediation, modernization, and compensating controls.
* Ensure audit-ready documentation, ownership clarity, design traceability, and standard evidence for critical network products.
* Drive technical debt reduction and simplify non-standard designs, legacy connectivity, and unsupported platforms.

Vendor and Partner Governance
  
  

* Govern network delivery from strategic partners, managed service providers, telecom carriers, Cisco, Arista, and network tooling vendors.
* Review vendor designs, operational changes, implementation plans, support performance, and service quality against product standards.
* Hold partners accountable for resiliency, documentation, standards compliance, operational readiness, and measurable outcomes.
* Influence sourcing, contract renewals, support models, licensing, and platform investment decisions.

Automation and Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Champion network automation, configuration standardization, and infrastructure-as-code practices.
* Drive use of APIs, Ansible, Git-based network configuration, telemetry, and orchestration to reduce manual effort and improve control.
* Promote repeatable deployment models, self-service capabilities, automated compliance checks, and self-healing operations where practical.

Core Technical Expertise
  
  
**Domain**
**Expected Knowledge**
**Cisco Platforms**
Cisco Catalyst 9000, Cisco Nexus, IOS-XE, NX-OS, route/switch, HA patterns, software lifecycle, Smart Licensing, TAC engagement
  
  
**Arista Platforms**
Arista data center and campus switching, EOS, CloudVision concepts, route/switch operations, lifecycle and support models
  
  
**Network Architecture**
L2/L3 enterprise networking, data center fabrics, VXLAN EVPN, DCI, LAN, campus, WAN, SD-WAN, cloud connectivity
  
  
**Routing and Switching**
OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, route redistribution, STP, VLANs, VRFs, multicast, QoS, HSRP/VRRP, ECMP, segmentation
  
  
**Observability and Tools**
NetBrain, SNMP, syslog, telemetry, packet capture, ThousandEyes, SolarWinds, LogicMonitor, Elastic.
  
  
**Automation and Governance**
Ansible, APIs, templates, configuration compliance, drift monitoring, Git-based workflows, policy-based controls, runbook automation
  
  
**Risk and Lifecycle**
EOL/EOS, vulnerability remediation, firmware/software upgrades, capacity planning, resiliency testing, audit evidence, documentation standards
  
  
**Skills And Experience**

* 14+ years of progressive enterprise networking experience in large, global, highly regulated environments.
* 5+ years of product ownership, platform ownership, architecture leadership, or senior network engineering leadership experience.
* Proven experience managing network product roadmaps, lifecycle plans, budgets, vendor governance, and operational performance.
* Deep hands-on understanding of Cisco and Arista route/switch technologies with ability to challenge designs and guide standards.
* Strong understanding of LAN, WAN, data center, cloud connectivity, routing protocols, network segmentation, and resiliency engineering.
* Experience building product health dashboards, service metrics, technical debt plans, and leadership-facing executive updates.
* Ability to communicate clearly with executives, technical teams, security stakeholders, procurement, finance, and vendor partners.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure, CCNP Enterprise, Arista ACE, cloud networking, or equivalent practical expertise.
* Experience with network automation, telemetry, NPM/NCM tooling, and configuration compliance platforms.
* Experience operating global network services across multiple data centers, regions, business-critical sites, and cloud providers.
* ITIL, product management, Agile, or service ownership experience.
* Experience modernizing legacy network estates and reducing vendor dependency through standards, automation, and better documentation.

Success Measures
  
  

* Clear product roadmap with measurable delivery milestones and funding alignment.
* Reduced lifecycle risk across network hardware, software, firmware, and support contracts.
* Improved network availability, observability, configuration compliance, and incident response quality.
* Standardized designs and documentation across global data center, data room, WAN, and cloud connectivity services.

title: MS - FDL - Senior Manager - AI Architect
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: Senior Manager – AI Architect**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Manager – AI Architect to lead the strategy, architecture, and governance of enterprise AI solutions supporting data products and corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines AI/ML architecture, technical leadership, and people management, translating business needs into secure, scalable, and responsible AI solutions. The ideal candidate will integrate predictive machine learning, generative AI, and appropriately controlled agentic workflows with enterprise applications and data to enable transformation across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will own AI architecture quality and technology roadmaps across engagements, lead architects and technical specialists, and partner with data science, engineering, product, security, risk, and business teams to guide solutions from discovery through production adoption and measurable value realization.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
**AI Strategy & Architecture Leadership**

* Define the AI architecture strategy and roadmap, aligning prioritized use cases with enterprise technology standards, data readiness, risk appetite, and business objectives.
* Lead discovery and feasibility assessments; determine when rules, analytics, traditional ML, or generative AI are appropriate, and validate options through measurable proofs of concept.
* Design end-to-end AI architectures spanning data ingestion, feature or embedding pipelines, model training or adaptation, retrieval, inference, orchestration, APIs, and enterprise integration.
* Evaluate model providers, open-weight models, cloud AI services, and build-versus-buy options; balance quality, latency, scalability, cost, licensing, data residency, and vendor dependency.
* Establish reference architectures and design standards for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), model serving, and agentic workflows, including permission-aware retrieval, tool authorization, and human approval for consequential actions.
* Lead architecture reviews and resolve complex AI design challenges; guide model selection, prompting, fine-tuning where justified, evaluation design, and integration with production systems.

**AI Delivery, Governance & Operational Excellence**

* Provide architecture oversight across AI initiatives, defining acceptance criteria, technical dependencies, delivery risks, and stage gates from experimentation through production readiness.
* Partner with engineering and platform teams to establish MLOps and LLMOps practices, including versioned datasets, models and prompts, reproducible evaluation, deployment controls, and rollback.
* Define task-specific evaluation frameworks covering predictive performance, groundedness, retrieval quality, hallucination risk, robustness, fairness where relevant, latency, and cost; validate against representative test data and business baselines.
* Design production monitoring for data and model drift, output quality, reliability, usage, and inference spend; establish fallback behavior, incident response, and controlled model or provider updates.
* Embed responsible AI, privacy, security, and applicable compliance controls with risk and legal teams, including data provenance, audit trails, prompt-injection defenses, sensitive-data protection, and risk-based human oversight.

**Team Leadership & Talent Management**

* Lead and scale an AI architecture team, coordinating data scientists, ML engineers, data engineers, and application specialists across engagements; develop architects and technical leads.
* Build an inclusive, high-performance AI practice focused on rigorous experimentation, responsible innovation, reusable knowledge, and measurable business outcomes.
* Own hiring, resource planning, performance management, succession planning, and capability development aligned with AI delivery demand and evolving technology needs.
* Mentor architects and technical specialists on AI design, evaluation rigor, production readiness, stakeholder influence, and career growth; strengthen peer reviews and communities of practice.

**Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with finance transformation leaders, product owners, and clients to identify AI opportunities, clarify process constraints, and define measurable success criteria.
* Present AI solution options, limitations, investment needs, and risk trade-offs to decision-makers; align expectations on automation boundaries, human review, and business value.
* Lead AI architecture inputs for proposals, RFP responses, and demonstrations, including solution narratives, prototypes, estimates, data requirements, and implementation assumptions.
* Communicate architecture decisions, evaluation results, residual risks, adoption readiness, and realized business impact clearly to executive and technical audiences.

**Reusable AI Solutions & Innovation**

* Develop reusable AI reference designs, evaluation suites, retrieval components, model integration patterns, and governance templates to accelerate consistent delivery.
* Assess emerging AI capabilities through structured experiments and business cases; scale only where evidence supports performance, operational feasibility, and acceptable risk.
* Enable finance-focused capabilities such as document intelligence, knowledge assistants, forecasting, and anomaly detection, with traceable outputs and controls appropriate to each use case.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, AI, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 12+ years of experience across software engineering, data platforms, solution architecture, or AI/ML, including substantial experience architecting and deploying production AI/ML solutions.
* 5+ years of technical people-management experience, with a proven track record of leading architects or engineering teams and delivering complex, cross-functional AI or data initiatives.

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep experience designing AI solutions on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including managed AI services, deployment options, security, resilience, and cost optimization.
* Strong foundations in machine learning, model evaluation, and applied statistics, with practical expertise in generative AI, LLMs, embeddings, vector search, RAG, and model adaptation trade-offs.
* Strong Python and software architecture skills, with experience in ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn), APIs, data pipelines, and enterprise application integration.
* Experience with MLOps and LLMOps, including experiment tracking, model registries, evaluation automation, CI/CD, model serving, observability, and lifecycle management.
* Strong understanding of AI security and responsible AI, including data leakage, prompt injection, model limitations, explainability, fairness assessment, access controls, and human-in-the-loop design.

**AI Architecture & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to guide AI solutions from use-case discovery and feasibility assessment through architecture, evaluation, production deployment, and operational transition.
* Experience conducting architecture reviews, model and vendor evaluations, AI risk assessments, and production-readiness reviews across multidisciplinary teams.
* Strong skills in technical estimation, capacity planning, inference cost modeling, and total cost of ownership analysis, balancing model quality, latency, reliability, and business value.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Understanding of enterprise data and business processes; exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A) and associated control requirements is preferred.
* Experience applying AI/ML to finance transformation, ERP-connected workflows, document processing, forecasting, or enterprise analytics is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong people leadership, practice development, and coaching skills, with the ability to lead architects and influence data science, engineering, and business teams.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including executive-level engagement and the ability to explain AI capabilities, limitations, and risks without overstating results.
* Ability to balance AI strategy with pragmatic implementation, challenge assumptions using evidence, and make sound decisions amid rapidly evolving technology.
* High ownership mindset focused on responsible AI adoption, production reliability, solution quality, and measurable business outcomes.
