title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
About Exotel

Exotel is a leading customer engagement platform that helps businesses run conversations with their customers across voice, messaging and contact centre channels. Thousands of businesses across India, Southeast Asia and the Middle East rely on Exotel every day. Our Finance team sits at the centre of how we plan, spend and grow.

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on FP&A professional who enjoys building both the numbers and the process behind them. You will own key parts of our planning cycle, partner closely with business leaders on cost and strategy, and help shape how finance operates as we scale. This is a builder role: some processes exist, many need to be set up, and you will roll up your sleeves to make them work.

What You Will Do

**Planning and Forecasting**

* Drive the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) process end to end: build the model, coordinate inputs across functions and consolidate the final plan.
* Own the monthly rolling forecast, tracking actuals against plan and forecast and explaining variances clearly.
* Build and maintain driver-based models for revenue, gross margin and operating costs.

**Business Partnering**

* Partner with business and functional heads to understand cost drivers and support decision-making.
* Design and run cost allocation methodologies (COGS, shared costs, overheads) to produce accurate product, customer and segment profitability.
* Support strategic initiatives with financial analysis: pricing, unit economics, investment cases and scenario planning.
* Prepare clear, insight-led reporting for leadership and the Board.

**Process Building**

* Set up and document FP&A processes, templates and controls where none exist today.
* Improve data flows between ERP, billing and reporting systems to make planning faster and more reliable.
* Identify gaps and fix them yourself rather than waiting for someone else to.

What We Are Looking For

* 3 to 4 years of experience in FP&A, business finance or a related role (CA / MBA Finance preferred).
* Hands-on experience with AOP and rolling forecasts.
* Exposure to cost allocation and profitability analysis.
* Strong Excel and financial modelling skills; experience with ERP systems (Dynamics 365 Business Central or similar) and BI tools is a plus.
* A track record of setting up or significantly improving a finance process.
* Uncompromising integrity: you handle sensitive information with discretion and call out what the numbers really say.
* A genuine team player who works well across functions and shares credit freely.
* Willingness to work from our Bengaluru office.

Why Join Us

* Real ownership from day one, with direct exposure to senior leadership.
* A chance to build processes that will scale with the company.
* A collaborative team that values ownership, accuracy and getting things done.

title: Finance Planning Analyst (FP&A)
description:
**Description**
ROLE OVERVIEW
  
  
We are looking for an experienced finance professional to join Ceragon’s global Finance COE as Manager – FP&A & Cost Management, based in India. The role will lead fixed-cost management and analysis, supported by COGS, revenue, gross margin and CAPEX analysis, budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis and management reporting.
  
  
The primary focus is end-to-end visibility and performance management of fixed costs, including headcount and payroll, R&D, SG&A, IT, facilities and other corporate operating costs. The role will understand cost drivers, challenge assumptions, monitor performance against budget and forecast, and partner with budget owners to improve cost discipline and financial performance.
  
  
The successful candidate will be commercially oriented, analytically strong and comfortable partnering with FP&A, Controllership, HR, Operations, Supply Chain, procurement, Sales and senior business leaders in a global, matrixed environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Fixed Cost Management
* Own global fixed-cost planning, budgeting, forecasting and performance management.
* Provide visibility and analysis of headcount, payroll, R&D;, SG&A;, IT, facilities and other corporate fixed costs.
* Establish and monitor cost drivers and KPIs; lead monthly actual vs. budget/forecast variance and root-cause analysis.
* Partner with functional and regional budget owners to challenge assumptions, improve cost discipline and identify optimization opportunities.
* Manage headcount and personnel-cost planning, including hiring plans, attrition, vacancies, salary increases, bonuses and other workforce drivers.
* Analyze R&D; and SG&A; cost structures, identifying trends, cost pressures, efficiency opportunities and potential cost leakage.
* Assess fixed versus variable cost behavior, operating leverage and the impact of cost structure on profitability.
* COGS, Revenue & Gross Margin
* Drive COGS planning and forecasting across key cost components; analyze performance, drivers and corrective actions with Operations, Supply Chain and Procurement.
* Analyze revenue mix, pricing, customer/project profitability and gross-margin movements; support commercial decisions and highlight risks and opportunities.
* CAPEX
* Lead CAPEX planning, forecasting and performance analysis, including approved spend, commitments, actuals and capitalization.
* Monitor CAPEX variances and investment utilization, ensuring alignment between approvals, POs, capitalization and financial reporting.
* FP&A; & Management Reporting
* Lead monthly and quarterly management reporting across fixed costs, COGS, revenue, gross margin, CAPEX and overall financial performance.
* Prepare executive-level analysis covering key drivers, risks, opportunities and recommended actions.
* Own budget vs. actual, forecast vs. actual and year-over-year variance analysis.
* Develop financial models for fixed costs, COGS, revenue, gross margin and CAPEX, including scenario and sensitivity analysis.
* Support AOP, long-range planning and rolling forecasts; establish standardized KPIs and dashboards for visibility and accountability.
* Business Partnering & Transformation
* Act as a strong finance business partner to functional and regional leadership and translate financial data into clear business insights and actions.
* Identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency, financial controls, reporting quality and planning processes.
* Drive automation and standardization using Power BI, ERP/EPM systems and other technology-enabled solutions, while improving data quality and reporting timeliness.

**Requirements**
REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS
  
  

* 10+ years of relevant finance experience across FP&A;, cost management, commercial finance, management accounting, controllership or financial planning.
* CA or CMA qualification in India is required.
* Strong hands-on experience in fixed-cost management, including headcount, payroll, R&D;, SG&A;, IT, facilities and corporate operating costs.
* Strong understanding of cost drivers, fixed vs. variable cost structures and operating leverage; solid experience in COGS, revenue, gross margin, profitability and CAPEX analysis.
* Strong budgeting, forecasting, AOP, rolling forecast, variance analysis and financial modeling skills, including driver-based forecasting and scenario/sensitivity analysis.
* Advanced Excel skills and experience with Power BI, Tableau or similar BI tools; experience with Oracle, SAP, HFM, Oracle EPM or similar ERP/EPM platforms.
* Experience working with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams in a global, matrixed organization.
* Strong analytical, communication and presentation skills, with high ownership and attention to detail.
* Experience in telecom, technology, manufacturing or project-based organizations is preferred.

title: Credit Analyst
description:
Job Description: Analyst, Credit Strategy and Underwriting

Team: Risk Operations — Credit Strategy and Analytics

Level: 6 years of relevant experience

Type: Individual contributor, analytical mandate; not a queue-based or SLA-driven role (2

positions)

Coverage: Core business hours

Role Summary

The Analyst, Credit Strategy and Underwriting supports the design, testing, and monitoring credit

strategies across its lending and credit products. The role turns application, bureau, and portfolio data

into analysis the credit strategy team can act on: how underwriting rules and limits are performing,

where the portfolio is drifting, and what a proposed policy change would do to approvals, losses, and

revenue before it goes live.

Most of the work is defined — a recurring report, a requested cut of the data, a back-test of an existing

rule. The value of the role sits in the rest: a result that looks too good, a segment moving against the

portfolio, a shift in performance that could be real borrower behaviour or could be a data artefact. The

analyst is expected to notice these, test them, and say plainly what the data does and does not support.

These are the cases the role exists to get right.

Credit policy, risk appetite, and strategy approvals. The analyst prepares the analysis and the

recommendation and makes the decision.

Key Responsibilities

Credit and Underwriting Analysis

● Analyse application, bureau, and performance data to assess how underwriting rules, score cut-

offs, and credit limits are performing against expectation.

● Size proposed credit policy and limit changes — approval rate, expected loss, exposure, and

revenue impact — before they go forward for approval.

● Review declined and marginal populations to identify where the current strategy is too tight or too

loose.

● Provide the evidence base for periodic credit policy reviews: what is working, what is not, and

what should change.

Strategy Testing and Monitoring

● Design and read out champion/challenger and A/B tests on credit strategies, with sample size,

control group, and success criteria agreed before launch.

● Monitor tests in flight and flag early when results breach agreed guardrails.

● Track vintage, roll-rate, and early-delinquency performance on new strategies against the

expected curve.

● Document test design, results, and recommendations so that decisions can be reconstructed and

audited later.

Portfolio and Performance Reporting

● Build and maintain recurring portfolio reporting: originations, utilisation, delinquency by bucket,

losses, and key risk indicators.

● Reconcile reporting to source data and to finance figures, and explain variances rather than only

reporting them.

● Automate recurring reports and remove manual spreadsheet steps wherever practical.

● Turn results into short written readouts that lead with the conclusion and the recommended

action.

Analytical Rigour and Data Quality

● Test any result that looks unusual before reporting it — check for data issues, definition changes,

or population shifts.

● Separate correlation from cause, and state the confidence behind each finding.

● Raise data quality gaps and inconsistent definitions with the data owner, with a proposed fix.

● Write SQL that is readable, commented, and reproducible by another analyst.

Experience & Qualifications

Level and Tenure

● 6+ years in credit risk, credit strategy, underwriting analytics, or a comparable quantitative role in

financial services.

● Degree in a quantitative discipline (statistics, economics, mathematics, finance, engineering) or

equivalent practical experience.

Required Skills and Experience

● Practical SQL: able to independently write joins, aggregations, and window functions against

large tables.

● Advanced Excel: pivot tables, lookups, and scenario models that another analyst can follow and

audit.

● Working knowledge of consumer credit concepts — bureau scores, delinquency buckets, vintage

analysis, roll rates, and the approval/loss trade-off.

● Analytical judgement: able to explain how a conclusion was reached, what would change it, and

where the data is weak. Assessed at interview through a case exercise.

● Clear written communication — able to turn analysis into a short, specific recommendation for a

non-technical reader.

Preferred

● Python or R for data analysis.

● Experience with consumer lending products such as credit cards, lines of credit, instalment loans,

or credit-builder products.

● Exposure to Canadian credit bureau data.

● Experience with a BI or dashboarding tool.

● Hands-on experience running champion/challenger tests.

What Success Looks Like

● Accuracy — analysis reconciles to source and holds up under review.

● Decision usefulness — recommendations are specific, sized, and acted on; readouts lead with

the answer.

● Test discipline — tests launch with agreed design and success criteria, and read out on

schedule.

● Early warning — adverse portfolio trends and data issues are raised before they show up in

losses.

● Efficiency — recurring reporting becomes progressively more automated quarter over quarter.

title: Business Finance Manager
description:
**About the role**

Urban Vault is growing fast, and the financial and commercial decisions that drive that growth need a dedicated owner. As Business Finance Manager, you will be the Finance Head's right hand on money matters: leading financial discussions, reviewing every agreement before it is signed, and making sure payments and commitments are accurate and on time.

You will hold your own seat in commercial conversations, bring a point of view backed by numbers, and push back when terms, costs or processes don't add up.

**Key responsibilities**

**Agreements and commercial review**

* Review all client, landlord, vendor and broker agreements before signature; flag commercial, financial and risk issues.
* Own the contract review checklist and sign-off trail so nothing is signed on the assumption it was already checked.
* Work with legal counsel on non-standard terms and escalate only what needs founder judgement.

**Financial discussions and decision support**

* Represent the founder's office in financial discussions with landlords, clients, brokers, partners and investors.
* Build deal models and unit economics for new centres and large client deals (rent, fit-out, occupancy, margin, payback).
* Prepare clear, numbers-backed recommendations and say no when a deal doesn't work.

**Payments and controls**

* Validate and approve broker commissions and other critical payments against agreed terms.
* Set up approval workflows and delegation limits so routine items no longer route to the founder.
* Track receivables, payables and contractual commitments; flag cash-flow risks early.
* Keep a tight control on the fitout cost
* Optimisation of all cost FMS, fitout, G&A etc

**Business partnering and reporting**

* Own finance for a defined set of business units or departments: budgets, forecasts and variance reviews.
* Produce monthly MIS and centre-level P&L views for leadership.
* Coordinate with accounts, tax and audit teams to keep books and compliance on track.

What we're looking for

**Must have**

* MBA (Finance) from a reputed institute, with 4–5 years in business finance, FP&A, deal advisory or a founder's office.
* Hands-on experience reading and negotiating commercial agreements (leases, service contracts, commission terms).
* Strong financial modelling and Excel skills; comfortable building a deal model from scratch.
* Clear, confident communication in writing and in the room with senior external stakeholders.
* The judgement and backbone to push back, including on the founder, with data.

**Good to have**

* CA qualification (strongly preferred).
* Background in real estate, coworking, hospitality or other multi-location businesses.
* Experience setting up approval workflows, delegation of authority or finance controls in a scaling company.

title: Research - Product Specialist - Associate
description:
**About AQR Capital India**

AQR is a global investment firm built at the intersection of financial theory and practical application. We strive to deliver concrete, long-term results by looking past market noise to identify and isolate the factors that matter most, and by developing ideas that stand up to rigorous testing. By putting theory into practice, we have become a leader in alternative strategies and an innovator in traditional portfolio management since 1998.

At AQR India, our employees share a common spirit of academic excellence, intellectual honesty and an unwavering commitment to seeking the truth. We’re determined to know what makes financial markets tick – and we’ll ask every question and challenge every assumption. We recognize and respect the power of collaboration, and believe transparency and openness to new ideas leads to innovation.

**About The Team**

The Global Stock Selection (GSS) group is responsible for the portfolio management and research of AQR's strategies relating to individual equities and equity related securities across all global liquid markets. GSS models are applied to market-neutral long/short portfolios in AQR hedge funds as well as to long-only and equity extension portfolios for institutional equity mandates, tax-aware mandates and mutual funds.

Within GSS, the Product Specialist team is central to communication with and support of our existing and prospective investors, and often serves as the external face of equity portfolio management. The team educates investors and prospects on our strategies through written answers to client questions, new business presentations, and review discussions of existing investments. Additionally, the team is involved in different stages of the investment process, including product development, performance monitoring and analysis. The team interacts closely with the rest of the firm including, most notably, business development, research, and portfolio implementation, as well as trading, legal, compliance, risk and marketing. Product specialists have in-depth knowledge of the strategies they cover and are expected to be in-house experts on those products. They are an integral part of initiatives to create, manage, and sell AQR products.

**Your Role:**

We are seeking an exceptionally talented individual to join GSS’s product specialist team. title: Asset Management - VP/AVP
description:
**POSITION OVERVIEW**

Asset Management lead plays a senior leadership role within the Asset Management Division, overseeing a team of financial analysts and support staff responsible for delivering analytics, metrics, and reporting in support of institutional investment management. The Director serves as the primary point of contact for prioritizing and streamlining recurring and ad hoc reporting, collaborating with U.S. counterparties, and driving operational excellence across a diversified portfolio of assets.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Leadership & Team Management**

▪      Supervise, train, mentor, and lead a junior team of associates and financial analysts across recurring model updates and ad hoc reporting.

▪      Act as the primary point person to prioritize, streamline, and deliver reporting supporting institutional investment management.

▪      Foster a collaborative, high-performance culture aligned with organizational goals and client expectations.

**Financial Modeling, Reporting & Analytics**

▪      Deliver recurring and ad hoc reporting evaluating cash flows, risk metrics, and investment performance across Corporate, Structured Finance, Energy, Aviation, and Commercial Real Estate portfolios.

▪      Prepare detailed financial projection models and track reporting covenants against legal documents.

▪      Develop and maintain tearsheets and dashboards on underlying investment positions, delivering actionable insights into portfolio performance and risk exposure for senior stakeholders.

▪      Generate operating performance reviews across key return metrics including IRR, MOIC, DPI, RVPI, and TVPI.

▪      Interface with U.S. and European counterparties in support of portfolio analysis and reporting deliverables.

▪      Manage financial modeling updates, qualifying performance against prior periods and financial forecasts.

▪      Address non-conformance and conduct covenant sensitivity tracking and duration analysis.

▪      Monitor changes in asset valuations, market data, and collections against underwritten projections on a QoQ basis.

▪      Evaluate risk management practices in complement to evolving portfolio performance metrics.

**Portfolio & Asset Management**

▪      Continuously research and monitor assigned product sectors and portfolio companies with global investments, primarily in the U.S. and Europe.

▪      Interface with Operations, Accounting and Asset Management teams across the full investment lifecycle — from loan closing through return of capital and payoff.

▪      Support asset and loan administration activities in coordination with cross-functional stakeholders.

**Process & Operational Efficiency**

▪      Lead the creation, implementation, and documentation of process and procedural frameworks to improve team efficiency and generate KPIs.

▪      Establish and maintain file maintenance protocols and best practices across the Asset Management function.

**Requirements**

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education**

▪      Bachelor's degree required in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.

▪      Master's degree (MBA or MS Finance) strongly preferred.

**Experience**

▪      8-12+ years of progressive experience in asset management, structured finance, credit analysis, or a related financial discipline.

▪      Minimum 3-5 years in a supervisory or team leadership capacity managing analysts and/or associates.

▪      Demonstrated experience across multiple asset classes including Corporate Credit, Structured Finance, Energy, Aviation, and/or Commercial Real Estate.

▪      Hands-on experience with financial covenant monitoring, financial modeling, cash flow analysis, and IRR calculations.

▪      Prior experience managing institutional investor relationships and collaborating with U.S. and European counterparties preferred.

**Certifications**

▪      CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst) designation strongly preferred or actively pursuing.

▪      FRM (Financial Risk Manager) or CAIA (Chartered Alternative Investment Analyst) certifications a plus.

**Technical & Core Competencies**

▪      Demonstrated ability in Microsoft Excel, including complex financial models, scenario analysis, and sensitivity tables.

▪      Proficiency in leveraging AI tools and technologies (e.g., generative AI platforms, AI-assisted analytics) to enhance financial analysis, accelerate reporting workflows, and support data-driven decision-making.

▪      Deep expertise in credit agreement structures, and financial covenant frameworks.

▪      Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to present complex financial analysis to senior stakeholders.

▪      Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

▪      Collaborative mindset with demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally across Operations, Accounting, Legal, and Asset Management teams.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

This is a high-impact leadership opportunity for a seasoned finance professional to drive analytical excellence and operational rigor within a sophisticated institutional investment platform. The Director will be integral to investment performance monitoring, risk evaluation, and team development across a globally diversified portfolio.

"this job description is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, and duties may change".

title: FP&A Lead / Business Finance Lead
description:
**Join Skillz and Level Up Your Career!**
Are you ready to take your career to the next level? Join Skillz, the first publicly-traded mobile esports platform that hosts billions of casual mobile gaming tournaments for millions of players worldwide. Skillz is revolutionizing the gaming industry, providing the ultimate platform for competitive mobile games. By fostering social competition within games, Skillz empowers developers to create multi-million dollar franchises while connecting players through fair, enjoyable, and meaningful competition.
  
  
At Skillz, we firmly believe that everyone is born with unique skills and deserves to experience an epic win. We understand the thrill of achievement and the satisfaction of overcoming challenges. That's why we passionately champion game developers and players alike, empowering them to unleash their full potential through the power of competition.
  
  
**Life @ Skillz**

* Culture of Impact: Join a united team of builders, creators, innovators, and entrepreneurs driven by the desire to win. At Skillz, we create value and make a difference in the world.
* Comprehensive Benefits: Enjoy peace of mind with our comprehensive benefits package, which includes 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision expenses for both you and your entire family.
* Wellness Support: Enhance your well-being with our array of wellness initiatives, including meditation and mental health resources, physical fitness coaching and classes, family planning assistance, health and parenting guidance, virtual therapy sessions, and more.

**Why Skillz?**

* Pioneers of Skill-Based Competition: Skillz is not just any company in the gaming industry; we are the pioneers of skill-based competition, partnered with industry titans like UFC, NFL, T-Mobile, Buzztime, while also hosting renowned events like the Game Developer Conference (GDC). Join us in transforming the way people play games and building the home of competition for all.
* Impact Beyond Gaming: Skillz harnesses the power of its platform to support nonprofit organizations such as Susan G. Komen, American Cancer Society, the NAACP, and more. By participating in Skillz tournaments, you can make a difference and contribute to causes you care about.
* Recognized Success: Skillz has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, CNBC's Disruptor 50, San Francisco Business Times' Best Places to Work, Forbes' Next Billion-Dollar Startups, and the #1 fastest-growing company in America on the Inc. 5000 list, and many more.
* Talent Magnet: Join a team of talented professionals who are passionate about what they do. Our team includes experts from Meta, Apple, Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Tesla, Twitter (X), Roblox, Zynga, Samsung, Lyft, EA, Riot, Nexon, Gameskraft, PlayStation, Unity, Scopely, Tinder, Intel, Deloitte, EY, Twitch, DraftKings, and more.

**The Future of Gaming Awaits!**
The gaming industry is larger than movies, music, and books combined, with over 3 billion active gamers playing monthly and over 25 million active developers worldwide. Mobile gaming, in particular, is the fastest-growing segment, projected to reach $300 billion by 2025. At Skillz, you have the opportunity to be at the forefront of this exciting industry and shape its future.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities**

* Own game-level P&L, including the ~$5M annual developer-cost line, and review existing developer agreements against title-level performance for optimization or renegotiation opportunities.
* Own partnership & distribution deal economics — NPU from distribution, cost per NPU, D30/D360 ROAS.
* Stand up and run a deal-level IRR approval process for new partnership/distribution deals.
* Provide first finance coverage for the YayZ build, including early P&L/KPI reporting once a cadence exists.
* Track Arena content-sourcing retention & engagement economics with Cheyne Cole's team.
* Flag this seat's own support needs early, given no dedicated analyst is currently assigned.

**Key Competencies**

* Vendor/developer-contract review fluency — able to read existing agreements, benchmark terms, and structure a renegotiation or optimization case.
* Deal-economics fluency — comfortable modeling NPU, cost-per-NPU, and multi-horizon ROAS for partnership deals.
* Able to stand up a net-new approval process (deal IRR) rather than just operate an existing one.
* Comfortable operating solo across four distinct threads (game-level P&L/developer cost, Partnerships, Distribution, YayZ) without dedicated analyst support.
* Build-stage mindset — comfortable establishing a finance function from zero for YayZ.

**Experience**

* 4+ years in FP&A, corporate development, or partnerships/deal finance.
* Direct experience with deal economics, IRR/ROI modeling, or partnership P&L analysis.
* Experience reviewing or negotiating developer, licensing, or vendor agreements, ideally with a cost-optimization mandate.
* Comfortable operating with US-based stakeholders across time zones.
* Gaming, media, or platform-business experience preferred.

Skillz embraces diversity and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to diversifying our workforce, we do not discriminate on the basis of age, race, sex, gender, gender identity, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, marital status, citizenship, veteran status, or disability status, and we operate in compliance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance

title: Sr. Specialist Accounting
description:
Note to candidates
  
  
Candidate should be comfortable working in 2 PM – 11 PM shift on regular days and 6 PM – 3 AM shift during Month-End closing, and stretch as per business need. Please apply accordingly.

* The Senior Professional, Financial Accounting & Controllership job establishes and leads the implementation of accounting policies and fiscal controls to safeguard the organization's assets. FINANCIAL RISK & REPORTING: Develops and implements process simplification, standardization and automatization of financial risk and reporting to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and effectiveness in financial risk management.

**Qualifications**

+ Professional finance qualification such as CA, CMA, CPA, ACCA, or equivalent.
+ At least 4-5 years of experience in financial accounting, controllership, audit, internal controls, or financial reporting.
+ Strong Excel and power BI skills
+ Good knowledge of applicable accounting standards and corporate accounting policies.
+ Experience / knowledge of SAP.

title: Finance Controlling Analyst
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.
  
  
**Job Description for Finance Controlling Analyst:**
Haleon is a global leader in consumer healthcare, committed to delivering innovative solutions that improve the health and well-being of people around the world. We are seeking a talented Finance Controlling Analyst to join our Corporate and Global Business team, where you will play a crucial role in driving financial excellence and supporting strategic initiatives.
  
  
As a Finance Controlling Analyst, you will be an integral part of the Corporate and Global Business team, responsible for ensuring accurate financial reporting and compliance with SOX controls. You will support month-end close activities, review financial reports, and facilitate efficiency improvements in line with our Automation, Faster Better Close, and cost optimization strategies. Your expertise will drive best practices and alignment of financial requirements across Haleon.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Month-End Close Support: Assist in the preparation and execution of month-end close activities to ensure timely and accurate financial reporting.
* Financial Reports Review: Analyze and review financial reports to ensure compliance with internal and external standards.
* SOX Controls Execution: Execute and monitor SOX controls to ensure compliance with Sarbanes-Oxley requirements.
* Efficiency Improvements: Facilitate the delivery of efficiency improvements in support of Automation, Faster Better Close, and cost optimization initiatives.
* Best Practices and Alignment: Drive best practices and alignment of financial requirements across Haleon, ensuring consistency and accuracy in financial processes.

***Why you?***
**Basic Qualifications:**
We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance & Accounting
* Certified Public Accountant (CPA) or Association of Certified Chartered Accountants/ACCA certified
* Experience in Global reporting and accounting processes and performance management systems
* Strong understanding of SOX compliance and financial reporting standards.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a global team environment.
* Proficiency in financial software and tools.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:
  
  

* MBA
* Ability to effectively manage time and resources against agreed deadlines for activities
* Good communicator, confident in interacting with all levels of individuals across a variety of internal functions
* Flexibility and ‘can do’ attitude to ensure that task is achieved

**Job Posting End Date**
2026-11-10
  
  
**Equal Opportunities**
Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  
  
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  
  
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.
  
  
**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

title: VP - Portfolio Strategy (Commercial Real Estate)
description:
**Role: VP - Portfolio Strategy (Commercial Real Estate)**

**We are looking for a seasoned portfolio strategy professional to lead portfolio analytics, performance reporting, and strategic insights for a global real estate credit investment platform.**

**This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of real estate finance, portfolio management, data analytics, and technology, partnering with senior leadership to support investment decisions, enhance portfolio performance, and strengthen risk oversight.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead portfolio performance reporting, executive presentations, and analytical deliverables for senior leadership and external stakeholders.
* Develop dynamic financial models and sensitivity analyses to evaluate portfolio performance, returns, and risk exposure.
* Monitor portfolio composition and key loan metrics, including Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR), to support informed decision-making.
* Partner with portfolio management, asset management, and cross-functional teams to deliver consistent, data-driven insights.
* Drive benchmarking, business plan reviews, and portfolio-level analysis to identify opportunities for performance improvement.
* Lead process optimization, reporting automation, data governance, and the adoption of AI-enabled solutions.
* Manage and prioritize team deliverables, ensuring accuracy, quality, and timely execution across global stakeholders.

**Requirements:**

* 9+ years of relevant experience in portfolio management, financial analytics, investment strategy, or business analytics.
* Exposure to real estate credit, private credit, commercial real estate lending, asset management, private equity, or related financial services.
* Strong financial modelling, quantitative analysis, and portfolio performance assessment capabilities.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; working knowledge of SQL, VBA, or other programming languages is preferred.
* Experience preparing executive-level reports, board presentations, and investment-related analytical materials.
* Proven ability to lead teams, manage competing priorities, and collaborate with global stakeholders, including offshore teams.
* A track record of driving process improvements, reporting efficiencies, and technology-led transformation.
* A bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, STEM, or a related discipline. CA and/or CFA qualifications would be an advantage.

**The Ideal Candidate:**

A strategic thinker with strong analytical depth, sound financial judgment, leadership maturity, and the ability to translate complex portfolio data into actionable business insights.

*The real value of portfolio strategy lies not just in understanding where a portfolio stands today, but in anticipating where it can go tomorrow. If you can turn financial data into decisions that improve returns, strengthen risk management, and shape investment strategy, this opportunity is worth exploring.*

title: Principal Consultant - Transportation and Infrastructure advisory
description:
**Job Description**
At WSP, we are driven by a shared purpose: to create positive, long-lasting impacts on the world around us. As a global leader in strategic advisory services, we are proud to have been named
**#1 Advisor by Deal Value in 2024**
by Infranews. Our Investment and Transaction Advisory team plays a leading role in shaping transport infrastructure investment and delivery, combining technical expertise with commercial insight to support capital allocation, project development, and transaction execution.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced
**Principal Consultant**
to join our growing advisory team, with a focus on technical and commercial due diligence and strategic advisory in transportation and infrastructure (T&I).
  
  
This is a senior role to work as part of the wider advisory team across end-to-end transaction cycles, including origination support, due diligence, investment decision-making, and post-deal strategic advisory - across a diverse portfolio of assets such as:
  
  

* Roads (toll roads, highways, expressways)
* Rail and metro systems
* Airports and aviation infrastructure
* Ports, terminals, and logistics platforms
* Urban mobility (bus systems, EV infrastructure, intermodal hubs)

This is a unique opportunity to work across a diverse portfolio of infrastructure asset classes, including
**transport technologies and energy infrastructure**
, while also providing exposure to a broader range of infrastructure sectors, including energy, transport and social infrastructure, across high-profile investment transactions and strategic advisory mandates.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Supporting the delivery of technical due diligence assignments for investors, lenders, and developers across transportation infrastructure assets
* Overseeing assessments covering:
* Asset condition, operations, and lifecycle performance
* Demand forecasts, traffic/revenue assumptions, and capacity utilisation
* Capex requirements (expansion, lifecycle, rehabilitation)
* O&M strategies, contracts, and performance benchmarking
* Providing strategic advisory across:
* PPP/PFI concessions and contract structures
* Investment cases, business plans, and valuation inputs
* Risk identification, mitigation strategies, and sensitivity analysis
* Providing technical and commercial input into bids and pursuits, shaping competitive proposals through robust asset and demand insights to strengthen proposals.
* Supporting cross-sector infrastructure assignments, leveraging WSP’s broader capabilities in digital, energy interface, and sustainability.
* Participating in international engagements, including site visits and stakeholder meetings where required.

**OUR TEAM**
The Investment and Transaction Advisory team has a strong track record of supporting clients at the early stage of projects such as feasibility plans, market forecasts as well as technical assessment of complex projects. As part of the GCC delivery team, the role supports opportunities and projects across Europe, Asia and North America. Our key clients cover a wide range of different organisations in the private and public sectors. Key clients include financial institutions (pension funds, investors and financiers), operators (utilities, ports, rail and mobility) and energy industry.
  
  
We are expanding from a strong transport base into new sectors, including industrial clients, major government programmes (e.g. Port Infrastructure Fund, UK Freeports), mobility, and energy infrastructure. WSP has a global network of over 10,500 advisory professionals and 80,000 employees across technical, sustainability and advisory disciplines, enabling our front-end consultancy to draw on deep expertise across t ransaction advisory (including PPP), investment advisory, market studies, demand forecasting, feasibility studies, and management consultancy.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**WE’D LOVE TO HEAR FROM YOU IF YOU HAVE**

* Extensive experience in transportation and infrastructure advisory, with demonstrated delivery across:
* Roads / highways / toll concessions
* Rail / metro systems
* Airports / ports / logistics assets
* Strong track record in technical due diligence, PPP advisory, or transaction support.
* Deep understanding of:
* Demand modelling (traffic/passenger/freight)
* Concession agreements and regulatory frameworks
* O&M practices and lifecycle asset management
* Proven ability to work on complex, multi-disciplinary assignments
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate technical findings into commercial insights for investors and lenders.
* A collaborative mindset and flexibility to operate across sectors and geographies.

BGV:
  
  

* Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.
* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

**About Us**
WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation & Infrastructure, Property & Buildings, Earth & Environment, Power & Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
  
  
With approximately
**4,000 talented people**
across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru & Mumbai offices) in India and more than
**73,000 globally**
, in 550
**offices across 40 countries**
, we engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
  
  
At “WSP” we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Uniﬁed under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones:
**Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise.**
**www.wsp.com**
**We are**

* Passionate people doing purposeful and sustainable work that helps shape our communities and the future.
* A collaborative team that thrives on challenges and unconventional thinking.
* A network of experts channeling our curiosity into creating solutions for complex issues.

***Inspired by diversity, driven by inclusion, we work with passion and purpose.***
**Working with Us**
At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.
  
  
**Our Hybrid Working Module**
With us, you can operate in a flexible, agile, yet structured work environment and follow a Hybrid Work Model.
  
  

* Maximize collaboration.
* Maintain product quality and cultural integrity.
* Balance community, collaboration, opportunity, productivity, and efficiency.

**Health, Safety and Wellbeing**
Our people are our greatest asset, and we prioritize a safe work environment. Health, safety, and wellbeing are integral to our culture, with each of us accountable for fostering a safe workplace through our “Making Health and Safety Personal” initiative. Our Zero Harm Vision drives us to reduce risks through innovative solutions, earning recognition for our global health and safety practices with the prestigious RoSPA Health and Safety Awards for six consecutive years.
  
  
**Inclusivity and Diversity**
WSP India is dedicated to fostering a sustainable and inclusive work environment where our greatest strength - Our People -feel valued, respected, and supported. We ensure an unbiased approach in hiring, promotion, and performance evaluation, regardless of age, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, marital status, physical ability, education, social status, or cultural background.
  
  
**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
Join our close-knit community of over 73,300 talented global professionals dedicated to making a positive impact. Together, we can make a difference in communities both near and far.
  
  
**With us, you can.
  
  
Apply today.**
**NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES:**

Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to WSP in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where WSP has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. You will be joining the Investment Services function that allows us to deliver a comprehensive, holistic approach to each client relationship — for asset managers and asset owners, insurance companies, and official institutions globally. It means our client-facing functions work together to bring the very best solutions and services the firm has to offer — across all of our locations, products, and capabilities.

* Analyze large-scale datasets and contribute to data modelling and data mart design.
* Implement reporting and visualization solutions using BI suites such as Jasper, WebFocus, Actuate, and eSpreadsheet.
* Apply strong SQL skills for data analysis, query optimization, and validation.
* Collaborate with data sourcing teams and product stakeholders to ensure data integrity and alignment with business logic.

* Knowledge of data governance and data quality techniques.
* Familiarity with Big Data platforms, cloud technologies, Snowflake, and Databricks.
* Understanding of front, middle, and back-office investment operations and trade lifecycle.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality outputs on time.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Accounting, MIS, Computer Science, or related field.
* 10+ years of experience in data analysis, dashboard design, and business intelligence.
* Experience with financial reporting, data warehousing, and BI tool architecture.
* Familiarity with SDLC or Agile methodologies.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
At NAVEX, we’re making the world a better place. A safer place. A more ethical place. A place where anyone, anywhere can have a voice. That’s a serious impact.
  
  
Our high-performance culture is driven by our values. We move with speed, passion and purpose — as one team. We are bold in our ideas, accountable in our actions, and committed to doing the right things right.
  
  
Our Senior Financial Analyst is a core member of a tight-knit FP&A team, reporting to the Manager, FP&A with direct exposure to the VP of FP&A and CFO on board materials, operating reviews, and strategic planning. You'll own a high-impact territory across COGS, Product & Engineering, Facilities, IT, & Information Security — leading budgeting and forecasting cycles, owning monthly variance analysis, and identifying the process improvements that scale with us. It's a role built for someone who wants the next step on the ladder: strong performers here grow into finance leadership.
  
The talent and drive of our team members are key to our continued success.
  
**About NAVEX:** We're the global leader in integrated risk and compliance management software, trusted by more than 10,000 customers — including most of the Fortune 1000 — to power their ethics hotlines, policy management, and risk programs. We're PE-backed, profitable, and investing aggressively in the next phase of growth.
  
You’ll thrive in this hybrid role surrounded by an engaged, collaborative team deeply committed to your success. Join us and help shape what’s next!
  
  
**What you’ll get:**  

* Meaningful Purpose. Your work helps organizations operate with integrity and protect their people—at a scale few companies can match.
* High-Performance Environment. We move with urgency, set ambitious goals, and expect excellence. You’ll be trusted with real ownership and supported to do the best work of your career.
* Candid, Supportive Culture. We communicate openly, challenge ideas—not people—and value teammates who embrace bold thinking and continuous improvement.
* Growth That Matters. You can count on authentic feedback, strong accountability, and leaders invested in your success so you can achieve real growth.
* Rewards for Results. We provide clear, competitive compensation designed to recognize measurable outcomes and real impact.

**What you’ll do:**  

* Drive the financial story behind a high-impact FP&A territory — including COGS, Product & Engineering, IT, Information Security, & Facilities — owning budgeting, forecasting, and monthly analysis end-to-end
* Sit at the table with business leaders, translating their priorities into financial plans and pushing back where the numbers tell a different story
* Build the models that drive real decisions — driver-based forecasts, scenario analysis, ROI cases, and resource plans that shape where the company invests next
* Turn variance into action — connect actuals vs. budget into clear recommendations that change how the business operates, not just how it reports
* Move at the speed of the business during forecast, budget, and close cycles — Planful, NetSuite, and Excel are your toolkit for delivering answers with pace, urgency, and accuracy
* Get in front of senior leadership — author the financial narratives, risk/opportunity callouts, and operating review materials that the CFO and FP&A leadership take into board and executive forums
* Own CapEx strategy for R&D and technology investments — project-level analysis, forecast updates, and the cross-functional alignment that keeps spend tied to outcomes
* Upgrade the FP&A function itself — sharpen models, modernize reporting tools, and bring structure to a fast-moving environment where your improvements stick

**What you’ll bring:**

title: Senior Analyst - Finance
description:
### **About Exotel**

Exotel is a leading customer engagement platform that helps businesses run conversations with their customers across voice, messaging and contact centre channels. Thousands of businesses across India, Southeast Asia and the Middle East rely on Exotel every day. Our Finance team sits at the centre of how we plan, spend and grow.

### **About the Role**

We are looking for a hands-on FP&A professional who enjoys building both the numbers and the process behind them. You will own key parts of our planning cycle, partner closely with business leaders on cost and strategy, and help shape how finance operates as we scale. This is a builder role: some processes exist, many need to be set up, and you will roll up your sleeves to make them work.

### **What You Will Do**

**Planning and Forecasting**

* Drive the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) process end to end: build the model, coordinate inputs across functions and consolidate the final plan.
* Own the monthly rolling forecast, tracking actuals against plan and forecast and explaining variances clearly.
* Build and maintain driver-based models for revenue, gross margin and operating costs.

**Business Partnering**

* Partner with business and functional heads to understand cost drivers and support decision-making.
* Design and run cost allocation methodologies (COGS, shared costs, overheads) to produce accurate product, customer and segment profitability.
* Support strategic initiatives with financial analysis: pricing, unit economics, investment cases and scenario planning.
* Prepare clear, insight-led reporting for leadership and the Board.

**Process Building**

* Set up and document FP&A processes, templates and controls where none exist today.
* Improve data flows between ERP, billing and reporting systems to make planning faster and more reliable.
* Identify gaps and fix them yourself rather than waiting for someone else to.

### **What We Are Looking For**

* 3 to 4 years of experience in FP&A, business finance or a related role (CA / MBA Finance preferred).
* Hands-on experience with AOP and rolling forecasts.
* Exposure to cost allocation and profitability analysis.
* Strong Excel and financial modelling skills; experience with ERP systems (Dynamics 365 Business Central or similar) and BI tools is a plus.
* A track record of setting up or significantly improving a finance process.
* Uncompromising integrity: you handle sensitive information with discretion and call out what the numbers really say.
* A genuine team player who works well across functions and shares credit freely.
* Willingness to work from our Bengaluru office.

### **Why Join Us**

* Real ownership from day one, with direct exposure to senior leadership.
* A chance to build processes that will scale with the company.
* A collaborative team that values ownership, accuracy and getting things done.

The role applies professional judgement to solve variable and evolving reporting, accounting and data-related issues, while partnering with finance and business stakeholders to improve reporting quality, process effectiveness and operational outcomes. The role contributes to continuous improvement initiatives and supports the adoption of digital and data-driven ways of working across finance activities.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Deliver reporting and accounting activities: Execute reporting, accounting and analytical processes accurately and on time in accordance with established standards, governance requirements and service expectations.
* Perform financial analysis and reporting: Analyse financial information, identify trends, investigate variances and provide insights that support business and finance decision-making.
* Manage tactical projects and initiatives: Lead or contribute to reporting, information management and data-related projects that improve finance delivery and business outcomes.
* Support financial stewardship and controls: Ensure compliance with accounting policies, financial controls, reporting requirements and governance frameworks.
* Resolve reporting and data issues: Investigate and address reporting, accounting and data-related challenges, applying sound judgement and root-cause analysis techniques.
* Partner with stakeholders: Build effective working relationships with finance colleagues, business stakeholders and process owners to support reporting and accounting objectives.
* Contribute to process improvement: Identify opportunities for standardisation, simplification and continuous improvement across reporting and accounting activities.
* Leverage digital and analytical tools: Utilise reporting systems, analytics platforms and automation solutions to improve efficiency, reporting quality and insights generation.
* Maintain data quality and integrity: Ensure financial data is accurate, complete and reliable to support reporting, accounting and performance management activities.
* Support change implementation: Contribute to the adoption of new processes, technologies and ways of working within reporting and accounting operations.

**What You Bring**
The ideal candidate is a knowledgeable finance professional who combines strong reporting and accounting fundamentals with analytical capability, attention to detail and a continuous improvement mindset. They are comfortable working independently within established frameworks, solving complex operational issues and collaborating with stakeholders to improve finance outcomes. They embrace digital and data-driven ways of working and are committed to delivering high-quality, reliable and insight-driven finance support.
  
  

* Experience in financial reporting, accounting, finance operations, controllership or related finance disciplines.
* Practical experience performing financial analysis, reporting activities or accounting processes.
* Understanding of financial statements, accounting principles, reporting frameworks and internal controls.
* Experience working with financial systems, reporting tools, ERP platforms or analytics solutions.
* Experience participating in process improvement, automation or transformation initiatives is advantageous.
* Professional accounting qualification, finance qualification or relevant finance, accounting or business degree preferred.
* Financial reporting and accounting knowledge: Understanding of accounting principles, reporting processes, financial controls and governance requirements.
* Financial analysis capability: Ability to analyse financial information, identify trends and develop meaningful insights and recommendations.
* Problem solving and judgement: Ability to evaluate information, investigate issues and develop practical solutions to reporting and accounting challenges.
* Data management and analytical skills: Ability to work with financial data, reporting tools and information systems to support finance delivery.
* Process management: Understanding of end-to-end finance processes and the ability to execute activities accurately and efficiently.
* Digital and technology awareness: Familiarity with reporting technologies, analytics tools, automation solutions and digital finance capabilities.
* Stakeholder engagement: Ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders across functions and locations.
* Communication skills: Ability to communicate financial information clearly and tailor messages to different audiences.
* Continuous improvement mindset: Ability to identify opportunities to improve efficiency, effectiveness and quality of finance processes.
* Adaptability and learning agility: Ability to work in evolving environments and adopt new technologies, tools and ways of working.
* Demonstrate ownership and accountability for delivery quality and operational excellence.
* Build trusted working relationships with stakeholders through professionalism and collaboration.
* Apply sound judgement in resolving reporting and accounting issues.
* Seek opportunities to improve processes, controls and service performance.
* Demonstrate curiosity and continuous learning, particularly in digital, data and analytics capabilities.
* Contribute positively to team effectiveness, knowledge sharing and collaboration.
* Uphold high standards of integrity, governance and financial stewardship.

**What We Offer**
You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.
  
  

* Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
* Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
* Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
* Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
* Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
* Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
* Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and
* international teams.
* Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

**An Inclusive & Progressive Place to Work**

* To power progress together, we need to attract and develop the brightest minds and make sure every voice is heard. Here are just some of the ways we’re nurturing an inclusive environment – one where you can express your ideas, extend your skills, and reach your potential.
* We’re creating a space where people with disabilities can excel through transparent recruitment process, workplace adjustments and ongoing support in their roles. Feel free to let us know about your circumstances when you apply, and we’ll take it from there.
* We’re closing the gender gap – whether that’s through action on equal pay or by enabling more women to reach senior roles in engineering and technology.
* We’re striving to be a pioneer of an inclusive and diverse workplace, promoting equality for employees regardless of sexual orientation or gender identity.

**Shell in India**
Shell is a diversified energy company in India with 13,000 employees, and presence in Integrated Gas, Downstream, Power, Renewable and Upstream. Additionally, we have deep capabilities in R&D, digitalisation, and business operations.
  
  
Our global strategy, Powering Progress, is designed to generate value for our shareholders, customers, and the wider society, and focuses on creating more value with less emissions. The strategy supports our purpose of providing more and cleaner energy solutions, with the aim of profitably transforming Shell into a net-zero emissions energy business by 2050. As India moves towards its target of net-zero emissions by 2070, Shell India aims to play a leading role in securing vital energy for today, while investing in, and helping to build, the energy system of the future through strategic investments in the country.
  
  
Our Lubricants business serves over 50,000 consumers through a strong network of over 200 distributors, and operates an end-to-end value chain that spans conceptualization, development, and production at a world-class blending plant at Taloja. Through our 350-plus retail stations, we offer an integrated mobility experience including fuels, cafes, and convenience stores, with a prominent network of EV recharging facilities.
  
  
Shell owns and operates a LNG re-gasification terminal at Hazira, Surat, with a capacity of 5 MTPA and a LNG truck-loading unit that plays a crucial role in helping meet India’s growing demand for gas across sectors. In 2022, Shell acquired Sprng Energy in a $1.55 billion deal to build an integrated energy transition business in the country. Sprng is a leading renewable energy company in India which develops and manages solar, wind, and hybrid power generation facilities and infrastructure.
  
  
Our three capability centres across Bangalore and Chennai serve as a technology and innovation powerhouse for Shell globally, working as a delivery engine for core technical, digital, and finance processes: pioneering digital innovation and cutting-edge technologies across the energy sector. We also have strong academic partnerships and collaborations with leading universities and technology institutes to accelerate decarbonization efforts within the energy sector.
  
  
We are committed to positively contributing to the communities in which we operate through programmes on STEM Education, Skilling, and Livelihood across India. We nurture and invest in startups developing initiatives focused on accelerating energy innovation through programs such as Shell E4 and Shell Eco-marathon. We also have strategic investments in new energy companies such as Husk Power, d.light, Orb Energy, and Cleantech Solar.

title: Liquidity Risk Reporting - Analyst
description:
Join Barclays as Liquidity Risk Reporting – Analyst where the role holder will support wider team with the completion of their reporting and control activities, assisting them with the investigation and resolution of more complex issues. At Barclays, we don't just anticipate the future - we're creating it.
  
  
**To Be Successful In This Role, You Should Have**

* Must have good communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to work collaboratively with the Reporting teams across the different locations.
* Good presentation skills.
* Very good Microsoft Excel skills.
* Understanding of Balance Sheet and Finance processes.
* Understanding of Control and Governance frameworks.
* CA/CWA/CS/MBA/Finance/Commerce/Economics background.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**

* Experience supporting the roll out of controls frameworks.
* Understanding of Treasury and/or Risk systems in Barclays.
* Reporting work experience in a Bank / Financial Institution.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based in our Chennai / Noida office.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To verify that the bank has sufficient funds to meet its short-term and long-term obligations, and the development and implementation of strategies to manage the bank's liquidity position.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development and implementation of funding and liquidity strategies to efficiently manage the bank’s liquidity position within regulatory requirements and risk appetite at favourable commercial outcomes with respect to funding costs.
* Analysis and quantification of the regulatory and behavioural liquidity risk impact of transactions undertaken by business units.
* Maintenance of strong relationships with key business units and working with the business units to manage liquidity to within constrains.
* Monitoring of key liquidity metrics and trends and advising on actions to be taken to maintain funding and liquidity levels within tolerance.
* Managing intra-group funding arrangements to ensure subsidiaries are adequately funded and managed within balance sheet, large exposure and capital constraints.
* Design and implementation of stress testing methodologies to assess the bank's liquidity resilience under various financial shocks, economic downturns, and sector-specific crises, and analysis of stress testing results and development of mitigation strategies to address potential liquidity shortfalls.
* Development of new tools, models and data analysis to support and enhance the bank’s funding and liquidity management capabilities.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

**What is the job about?**
As our Chief Finance Business Partner, CBS IMEA, you will be the trusted finance leader and single point of contact for all financial matters within the performance unit. * Drive end-to-end business performance management by providing visibility into EBIT, cash flow, operational drivers, emerging risks, and growth opportunities.

* Ensure manual journal entries are properly recorded, with appropriate supporting documentation
* Reconcile balance sheet accounts ensuring high-accuracy financial reporting

* Compliance of the financial records with SOX and SES policies and procedures
* Respect strict closing deadlines, to allow timely consolidation of SES’s results
* Ensure intercompany transactions are properly recorded and reconciled
* Maintain internal controls over financial reporting to meet SOX requirements
* Fulfilment of regulatory obligations associated with each entity
* Prepare annual statutory financial statements and any other tax filings or other reporting obligations
* Ensure compliance with applicable Accounting Standards and transfer pricing policies
* Financial analysis over Group results
* Prepare monthly review of companies’ results, including analysis of variances to prior and budget
* Oversight over external accounting service providers (if required)

* Maintain reconciliation between IFRS consolidation ledger and local ledger (in SAP), as well as between local ledger (in SAP) and local ledger (in external provider’s system)

COMPETENCIES
  
  

* Excellent analytical skills and detail-focused
* Thorough understanding of Accounting Standards (IFRS) and/or other respective countries Local GAAP.

* Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting with the professional qualification of Chartered Accountancy

title: Manager Procurement Cost Engineering
description:
We, at Leggett & Platt Incorporated, are searching for a Manager Procurement Cost Engineering within our Procurement team to help support our Automotive business. Did you know we are the world’s leading designer and manufacturer of seating support and comfort systems for transportation manufacturers, as well as tier one and two suppliers within the automotive industry? That’s right! Our automotive products fall into four primary groups: Seating and Lumbar support, Motors, Actuators and Massage Systems. If you join our team, your work will ensure people across the world have a little more comfort in their lives.
  
  
As a Manager Procurement Cost Engineering you will have the opportunity to lead the global Procurement Cost Engineering team and partners closely with Category Management and Regional Procurement to support sourcing decisions, supplier negotiations, and cost reduction initiatives. The team you will be working with is collaborative and innovative
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the Procurement Cost Engineering Team by managing, coaching, and developing team members while setting priorities and performance expectations.
* Partner with Category Management and Regional Procurement to align cost engineering activities with category strategies, sourcing projects, and business priorities.
* Deploy new cost estimating software and develop supporting processes to ensure effective integration into the business. Establish costing standards and best practices to ensure consistent and accurate cost modeling across regions and categories.
* Oversee cost modeling and analysis for materials, components, assemblies, and finished products using should-cost methodologies and cost estimating tools.
* Support Category Management and Regional Procurement with cost analyses, supplier cost assessments, and recommendations that enable effective sourcing decisions, supplier negotiations, RFQs, and contract negotiations.
* Support Category Management/Regional Procurement requests by identifying cost reduction opportunities through VA/VE, process improvements, material substitutions, and localization initiatives in collaboration with Engineering.
* Review supplier pricing and market trends upon request from Category Management & Regional Procurement by validating supplier quotations, analyzing cost variances, and monitoring commodity and manufacturing cost drivers.
* Provide reporting and business insights through cost analyses, benchmarks, savings tracking, and market intelligence to support decision-making and procurement performance.

**Experience**

* 7-10+ years of experience in cost engineering, product costing, procurement, sourcing, or manufacturing.
* Experience developing should-cost models and supporting sourcing decisions and supplier negotiations.
* Experience with should-cost modelling and cost estimating tools and leading cross-functional projects.
* Prior team leadership experience.

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline.

* Experience in large-scale EPC, industrial, infrastructure, oil & gas, or energy projects.
