title: Portfolio Manager
description:
Account Management, Client Relations, Client Retention, Customer Experience, Customer Success, Real Estate
  
  
Portfolio Manager
  
  
**C$30,000–C$36,000 Annually | Full-Time | Remote | Eastern Time Hours**
The Opportunity
  
  
Royal York Property Management is hiring a Portfolio Manager to manage a portfolio of existing clients, properties, and active service files.
  
  
You will keep clients informed, monitor rent and account activity, coordinate property services, resolve problems, renew agreements, and protect client relationships.
  
  
This role requires strong service ownership and sales ability. You must be comfortable handling objections, explaining value, discussing pricing, preventing cancellations, and identifying opportunities to expand client relationships.
  
  
Direct property-management experience is preferred but not required. Candidates with strong experience in account management, portfolio management, client success, relationship management, sales, or service operations are encouraged to apply.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**

* Act as the primary contact for an assigned portfolio of property owners and tenants.
* Manage multiple client accounts, properties, and active service files.
* Complete client onboarding and collect required property, owner, and tenant documents.
* Provide proactive updates about completed work, outstanding issues, and next steps.
* Monitor rent collection and follow up on overdue balances.
* Review monthly property activity before owner payouts, including rent received, fees, expenses, invoices, reserves, and holdbacks.
* Investigate account discrepancies and coordinate corrections with the accounting team.
* Coordinate maintenance requests with internal teams and external service providers.
* Handle owner and tenant complaints, urgent issues, and service escalations.
* Identify dissatisfied or at-risk clients and take action to prevent avoidable cancellations.
* Manage agreement renewals and discuss pricing or service concerns within company guidelines.
* Handle objections, reinforce the value of the company’s services, and identify appropriate opportunities to expand client relationships.
* Monitor tenant notices, vacancies, turnovers, and re-leasing activity.
* Maintain accurate CRM notes, documents, tasks, deadlines, and follow-ups.
* Identify stalled files and escalate financial, legal, or service risks when necessary.
* Use technology and AI tools to improve documentation, communication, reporting, and efficiency.

**What You’ll Need**

* Three or more years of experience in account management, portfolio management, property management, client success, relationship management, sales, or service operations.
* Experience managing multiple clients, accounts, properties, claims, cases, or active files simultaneously.
* Experience with client retention, renewals, objection handling, negotiation, account growth, or consultative sales.
* Experience monitoring rent, invoices, recurring payments, accounts receivable, or overdue balances.
* Confidence reviewing account activity, statements, expenses, and supporting documents.
* Strong client communication and experience handling complaints or escalations.
* Excellent organization, documentation, and follow-through.
* Experience using a CRM, ticketing system, property-management platform, or workflow-management system.
* Ability to coordinate work across internal departments and external providers.
* Strong judgment when managing deadlines, financial concerns, sensitive information, and client expectations.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Availability to work full-time during Eastern Time business hours.
* Reliable internet, backup connectivity or power, a suitable computer, and a professional environment for calls.

Experience in property management, leasing, real estate operations, housing, facilities, insurance, financial services, SaaS, telecommunications, managed services, or another recurring-service industry will be considered.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  
Success means maintaining an organized portfolio, communicating proactively, collecting rent promptly, reviewing property accounts accurately, resolving service issues, securing renewals, protecting client relationships, and supporting portfolio growth.
  
  
Who Will Succeed
  
  
The right person takes ownership instead of waiting to be reminded. You are comfortable handling difficult conversations, challenging unclear explanations, negotiating professionally, and coordinating several parties until a problem is fully resolved.
  
  
You are client-focused and commercially aware. You know how to protect a relationship without making promises, offering discounts, or bypassing procedures simply to satisfy a client.
  
  
**Compensation**
The annual compensation range is
**C$30,000–C$36,000**
, based on relevant experience, qualifications, and demonstrated ability.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Apply with your resume. If your background aligns with the position, you will receive an email with a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours of applying.
  
  
See All Open Roles

title: Risk Consulting - Actuarial - IFRS17 Life - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role Name And Description**
**Senior, Life Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**
Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Senior to join our Life Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
  
  
Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team, the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Senior Consultant, you will:
  
  

* Responsible for delivering high quality results and generating effective and impactful solutions
* Provide focused solutions and training to Staff members
* Be responsible for ensuring all engagement are delivered within time
* Deliver engagements in line with our values and commitment to quality, consistently driving projects to completion and ensuring that work is of high standard

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Good analytical skills
* Ability to do investigations in models / reporting process and independently solve problems.
* Hands-on experience in actuarial valuation software Prophet will be added advantage. Advanced level experience in Prophet will be valuable
* Strong experience on Excel is must and experience on VBA would be good
* In-depth understanding of insurance products and regulations of US / EMEIA / APAC markets
* Willingness to learn and apply learning actively in project work
* Self-motivation and proactiveness in driving project
* Willingness to travel to meet and work with clients

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Experienced resource – preferably 3-6 years
* Experienced in the following topics: Actuarial reserving, Assumption setting, Modelling software

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience of working with Prophet, MG ALFA, GGY Axis, Moses, RAFM, etc.
* Knowledge of IFRS 17, US GAAP, Solvency II and other insurance regulations around the globe
* Preferred Actuarial Degree / Good exam progress
* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree ideally business, actuarial or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* AI Literacy – Good knowledge on GenAI, Agentic AI would be an added advantage

**What We Look For**

* Good communication skills
* English fluent in speaking
* Good English writing skills
* Experience of leading/supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building industry relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**Job Description**
Ocean Export Pricing & Booking Management
  
  

* Develop and execute booking strategies aligned with volume, capacity, customer and profitability objectives.
* Ensure clear visibility of bookings, carrier allocation, capacity utilization and pricing commitments.
* Optimize carrier mix with focus on core carriers including Hapag-Lloyd, CMA CGM, MSC, COSCO and Maersk.
* Maintain spot business within defined thresholds and drive greater utilization of core carrier contracts.
* Monitor booking performance and proactively address capacity, rate and allocation gaps.
* Ensure timely and accurate updation of pricing, booking and performance trackers.

Carrier & Rate Management
  
  

* Manage commercial relationships with shipping lines and support negotiation of competitive ocean freight rates.
* Track market movements, carrier rate changes, GRIs/PSS and other relevant pricing developments.
* Provide regular market intelligence and pricing updates to Sales and network offices.
* Identify opportunities to optimize carrier selection and improve overall buying efficiency.
* Ensure pricing decisions balance competitiveness, volume growth and profitability.

Sales & Commercial Support
  
  

* Partner with Sales, network offices and sector teams to support new business acquisition and existing account growth.
* Develop pricing strategies for own accounts, new opportunities and special products.
* Support sales promotions across network offices, sectors and target customer segments.
* Provide timely and competitive quotations to improve business conversion.
* Maintain accurate quote logs and track business wins, losses and conversion trends.

Trade Lane Development
  
  

* Identify opportunities to develop and expand priority ocean export trade lanes.
* Analyse market trends, customer demand, carrier capacity and competitive pricing to identify growth opportunities.
* Develop strategies for new and special products and support their commercial penetration.
* Drive year-on-year growth across identified target trade lanes.

Volume & Profitability Management
  
  

* Drive FCL volume growth through effective pricing, carrier strategy and commercial support.
* Monitor contribution and EBITA performance across trade lanes, customers and carrier portfolios.
* Identify opportunities to improve yields, reduce cost leakage and enhance profitability.
* Work with Sales and Operations to improve conversion and profitable volume acquisition.

Performance & MIS Management
  
  

* Maintain accurate and timely monthly pricing and performance sheets.
* Ensure regular updates of quote logs, booking trackers, carrier allocation and market intelligence.
* Monitor business win percentage, FCL volumes, carrier mix and profitability against targets.
* Prepare periodic performance analysis and highlight key trends, gaps and corrective actions to management.

Branch & Product Maturity
  
  

* Work with target branches to improve ocean export pricing capability and product maturity.
* Provide guidance to branches on market rates, carrier strategies, trade lanes and pricing practices.
* Drive adoption of standard pricing processes and commercial best practices across eligible branches.
* Support branches in improving pricing discipline, customer conversion and profitable volume growth.

title: Global Billing Operations - Senior Manager
description:
Role: Invoice Review Lead, Global Billing Function
  
  
**Location: Chennai**
**Background**
State Street has established a Global Billing Function under Controllership, which is responsible for client billing set up and invoicing across all business lines and geographies globally at State Street. Organizationally, it combines all groups performing these activities globally, and also includes centers residing in State Street Shared Service locations in Poland, India and China. Billing Organization owns aspects of business-as-usual activities within billing areas and also drives process improvements and automation.
  
  
**Basic Purpose Of Job**
The Invoice Review Lead will be responsible for all aspects of the invoice billing process including invoice raising, OOPS (Out of Pocket Expenses) invoicing, and invoice review across State Street global businesses spread across countries & regions.
  
  
The Invoice Review Lead will manage a large team with a complex engagement model on a day-to-day basis. The individual will be directly responsible for daily management of accurate, consistent, and timely invoice deliverables. This individual will provide subject matter expertise in invoice preparation and review including receivables analytics. The Invoice Review Lead will also be responsible for managing State Street Global Advisors’ invoice production and review.
  
  
In addition to Business As Usual (BAU) responsibilities as described above, this role will also be involved in process re-engineering, standardization, and automation efforts.
  
  
**Responsibilities:-**
**Business As Usual (BAU) Activities**

* General responsibility for all operational invoicing activities
* End-to-end responsibility for a major group of the billing process: Invoice preparation and review
* Oversee and manage the invoice review team to achieve global consistency and effectiveness in controls; accurate, quality work; and transparency into activities and results. Maintain a robust control environment: process controls, process oversight and process governance responsibility
* Develop the team to adopt “owner’s mind set”, work independently, and effectively manage timelines
* Manage resources to assist with ad-hoc invoice projects
* Measure progress toward goals; and evaluate productivity and team efficiency. Review and assess regularly with team members and with management
* May serve as a subject matter expert on particular invoice related issues
* Coaches the team and gathers feedback for performance appraisals

**Process Re-Engineering, Standardization, And Automation**

* Assist with the process Re-Engineering, Standardization, and Automation efforts for invoicing
* Responsible for ongoing process improvements

**Expectations**

* Bachelor’s/Master’s Degree in Finance, CPA Qualified with an experience minimum of 10 to 12 years working with invoices in a global billing function at a large financial services institution.
* Knowledge of various services and industry trends of billing methods for those services like Custody services, Sub custodian, trust services and out pocket expense billing, asset management etc.
* Experience of building and maintaining strong control environment (risk excellence, experience with SOX, RCSA controls, etc.), establishing policies, procedures and strong internal controls.
* Demonstrated leadership in improving/building-out the invoice function for multiple geographies and business areas
* Experience assisting with re-engineering processes and driving similar centralization of the end-to-end activities for the major financial institutions

**Skills Required**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite (Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Word, Visio), advance levels of Excel (pivot tables, formulas, excel workbook maintenance best practices)
* Knowledge of billing systems
* Conceptual understanding of company-wide financial architecture (GL, sub-GL technology, specialized tools) applicable to the above process groups of processes
* First level management expertise required
* Independent decision-making capabilities, demonstrated thought leadership
* Pride of ownership with the ability to deliver high quality results timely
* Self-motivated, self-assured, and self-managed
* Strong analytical and ability to analyze and summarize complex financial transactions
* Strong attention to details
* Problem solving skill
* Highly organized with ability to multi-task and work under high pressure deadlines
* Must be able to work in a fast paced environment

**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

title: Sr. Consultant
description:
**Job Summary**
Sr Consultant in a hybrid work model will deliver advanced business and technology consulting services for global clients applying eight to ten years of expertise to solve complex problems optimize processes and drive measurable outcomes while aligning solutions to company strategy and creating sustainable value for customers and society.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive end to end consulting engagements for global clients by analyzing complex business problems and designing practical solutions that improve operational efficiency and long term value creation for the company and its customers.
* Provide expert guidance on process optimization by evaluating current workflows identifying bottlenecks and recommending improvements that enhance productivity and reduce overall delivery risk across projects.
* Collaborate closely with cross functional teams in a hybrid work environment to translate client needs into detailed solution approaches that are feasible scalable and aligned with organizational standards and industry best practices.
* Develop comprehensive project plans by defining scope estimating effort and planning activities that ensure timely delivery of consulting outcomes within the agreed quality benchmarks for day shift operations.
* Lead advanced data driven analysis using appropriate tools and methods to uncover patterns quantify benefits and present clear insights that support informed decision making and strategic planning for client stakeholders.
* Prepare high quality client deliverables including reports presentations and recommendations that communicate complex concepts in a clear narrative and support adoption of proposed solutions across business units.
* Manage stakeholder expectations by maintaining transparent communication clarifying requirements and regularly tracking progress so that project objectives remain achievable and aligned with client priorities.
* Support implementation of approved solutions by providing detailed guidance to execution teams resolving issues and validating outcomes against predefined success metrics to ensure sustainable impact for both the client and the company.
* Mentor junior consultants informally by sharing domain knowledge reviewing their analysis and offering constructive feedback that strengthens team capability and maintains consistent consulting standards.
* Coordinate with internal governance and quality teams to ensure that all engagements adhere to organizational policies regulatory requirements and ethical practices that protect customer trust and societal interests.
* Drive continuous improvement by capturing lessons learned from each engagement proposing enhancements to methodologies and promoting reuse of proven practices across similar consulting assignments.
* Engage in regular client review sessions during day shift hours to present progress updates validate assumptions and refine solution approaches based on evolving business conditions and stakeholder feedback.
* Contribute to business development activities by identifying follow on opportunities within ongoing engagements and supporting the creation of proposals that demonstrate tangible value and long term partnership potential.

**Qualifications**

* Apply eight to ten years of consulting or relevant industry experience by demonstrating deep understanding of business analysis methods and solution delivery practices that consistently produce measurable performance improvements.
* Utilize strong analytical and problem solving skills to interpret complex data sets and business scenarios while selecting appropriate techniques that lead to clear and actionable recommendations for clients.
* Demonstrate proficiency in standard productivity and collaboration tools commonly used in hybrid consulting environments to coordinate tasks document findings and maintain seamless communication across locations.
* Leverage excellent communication and presentation skills to explain detailed analysis defend recommendations and facilitate constructive dialogue with diverse stakeholder groups in a respectful and inclusive manner.
* Show proven ability to work independently within a hybrid work model by organizing personal workload meeting commitments without supervision and adapting flexibly to changing client and project demands.
* Bring experience in structured methodologies such as project management and process improvement frameworks applied pragmatically to ensure disciplined execution and repeatable positive outcomes.
* Display strong client management capabilities by building trustful relationships understanding industry context and tailoring consulting approaches so that solutions remain relevant and practical for each organization.

title: Senior Oracle P2P consultants
description:
**Job Description:**

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Procure to Pay (P2P) Process Specialist to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for understanding our existing business processes in the procure to pay cycle, defining new processes, and mapping these to Oracle ERP capabilities.

Fusion Practices is award winning Oracle Cloud partner, and a strong Oracle Cloud and Change transformation.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Business Process Analysis:

* Analyse existing P2P processes to identify inefficiencies and areas for improvement.
* Gather and document business requirements from stakeholders.

Process Redesign:

* Define and design new P2P processes to improve efficiency, accuracy, and compliance.
* Ensure new processes align with overall business strategy and goals.

Oracle ERP Mapping:

* Map new P2P processes to Oracle ERP system capabilities.
* Guide technical team for redesigned P2P processes.

Implementation and Testing:

* Work with IT and functional teams to implement new P2P processes
* Develop and execute testing plans to ensure successful implementation.

Training and Support:

* Create training materials and conduct training sessions for end-users.
* Provide ongoing support and troubleshooting for P2P processes.

Continuous Improvement:

* Monitor the effectiveness of new Procure to Pay processes and make adjustments as necessary.
* Stay updated with the latest Procure to Pay best practices.

Requirements
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Proven experience in P2P process design and implementation.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle ERP system, specifically in P2P modules.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

title: Liquidity Risk Reporting - Analyst
description:
Date live: 10/29/2026

Business Area: Finance

Area of Expertise: Finance

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000137282

  

Join Barclays as Liquidity Risk Reporting – Analyst where the role holder will support wider team with the completion of their reporting and control activities, assisting them with the investigation and resolution of more complex issues. At Barclays, we don't just anticipate the future - we're creating it.

  
  

To be successful in this role, you should have:

* Must have good communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to work collaboratively with the Reporting teams across the different locations.
* Good presentation skills.
* Very good Microsoft Excel skills.
* Understanding of Balance Sheet and Finance processes.
* Understanding of Control and Governance frameworks.
* CA/CWA/CS/MBA/Finance/Commerce/Economics background.
  

  

Some other highly valued skills may include:

* Experience supporting the roll out of controls frameworks.
* Understanding of Treasury and/or Risk systems in Barclays.
* Reporting work experience in a Bank / Financial Institution.
  

  

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

  
  

This role is based in our Chennai / Noida office.

**Purpose of the role**

To verify that the bank has sufficient funds to meet its short-term and long-term obligations, and the development and implementation of strategies to manage the bank's liquidity position.

**Accountabilities**

* Development and implementation of funding and liquidity strategies to efficiently manage the bank’s liquidity position within regulatory requirements and risk appetite at favourable commercial outcomes with respect to funding costs.
* Analysis and quantification of the regulatory and behavioural liquidity risk impact of transactions undertaken by business units.
* Maintenance of strong relationships with key business units and working with the business units to manage liquidity to within constrains.
* Monitoring of key liquidity metrics and trends and advising on actions to be taken to maintain funding and liquidity levels within tolerance.
* Managing intra-group funding arrangements to ensure subsidiaries are adequately funded and managed within balance sheet, large exposure and capital constraints.
* Design and implementation of stress testing methodologies to assess the bank's liquidity resilience under various financial shocks, economic downturns, and sector-specific crises, and analysis of stress testing results and development of mitigation strategies to address potential liquidity shortfalls.
* Development of new tools, models and data analysis to support and enhance the bank’s funding and liquidity management capabilities.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Sr. Financial Analyst -MNC -CTC upto 20 LPA
description:
The Senior Financial Analyst is a hands-on senior finance professional responsible for accurate accounting, month-end reporting, forecasting, budgeting, monthly estimates, financial analysis and commercial insights across. The role owns defined finance processes and delivers clear analysis and recommendations to support business performance and decision-making.

Job Requirements:-

**Financial Reporting, Month-End & Control**

**•**
Own and actively prepare month-end close activities, including journals, accruals, prepayments, reconciliations, monthly estimates, management reporting and review-ready working papers.

• Review financial outputs and supporting analysis for accuracy, completeness and compliance, resolving issues and escalating material risks where required.

• Analyse financial and operational performance, explain variances to budget, forecast and prior periods, and identify trends, risks and opportunities.

• Maintain the integrity of financial information through effective controls, reconciliations, policy compliance and timely resolution of accounting issues.

**Leadership, Coaching & Continuous Improvement**

• Lead defined finance processes and coordinate delivery across relevant reporting and planning cycles, while remaining personally accountable for key outputs.

• Provide technical guidance, coaching, knowledge sharing and review support to Financial Analysts and other finance colleagues.

• Identify and implement improvements to reporting, systems, data quality, controls and process efficiency through standardisation and automation.

**Financial Analysis & Business Partnering**

• Partner with Finance, Operations and Commercial stakeholders to support operational and commercial decision-making and improve business performance.

• Prepare financial and operational analysis, business cases, profitability reviews and investment evaluations within the assigned scope.

• Translate complex financial and operational information into clear insights, options and practical recommendations.

**Planning, Forecasting & Performance Management**

• Actively prepare budgets, forecasts, monthly estimates and longer-term plans for the assigned portfolio.

title: Assistant Manager General Ledger
description:
**Context & Purpose:**
JLL Business Services (JBS) operates in a matrixed global environment supporting multiple clusters across AMER, APAC & EMEA regions. Employees are expected to combine operational excellence during close cycles with strong analytical capabilities, stakeholder partnership, process governance, automation adoption and continuous improvement. The organization values ownership, transparency, collaboration, controllership mindset, problem solving and leadership at all levels.
  
  
**Duties and Responsibilities:**
The focus of the role will be upon -
  
  
Completes assigned close tasks to the close calendar and checklist; confirms task completion in the tracker; flags risks to deadlines to the reviewer before the due date; supports cut-off and accrual data collection.
  
  
Fully accountable to the GL month end close (MEC) including Balance Sheet reconciliation preparation
  
  
Act as a strategic bridge between Business and executive leadership. Align departmental priorities with company-wide growth targets, analyze performance data, and advise leaders on operational improvements.
  
  
**What the job involves:**
P2 is the core ownership level of the R2R role framework, sitting between the P1 &P3 roles, with independent ownership of close activities and balance sheet accounts. This document defines the P2
**Assistant Manager**
General Ledger role within the R2R function, which delivers Month-End Close (MEC), Reconciliations, Financial Reporting, Governance and Continuous Improvement for global accounting operations. The role goes beyond execution: it investigates root causes, resolves issues without close supervision, performs meaningful variance and trend analysis, and partners regularly with entity controllers and business partners. P2s review the work of P1 analysts, support their onboarding, and begin to contribute to process improvement and automation. Success is measured by on-time, accurate delivery of owned deliverables, reconciliation health and the quality of insight provided to stakeholders
  
  
Detailed job responsibilities are mentioned in below table:
  
  
***Key Responsibilities:***
**Area**
**Responsibilities At This Level**
**Month-End Close (MEC)**
Independently plans and executes owned close activities (accruals, provisions, intercompany, cut-off and allocations) to the calendar; tracks dependencies; escalates risks early with proposed solutions; contributes to post-close lessons learned.
  
  
**Journal Entry Management**
Prepares standard and moderately complex journals (accruals, reclassifications, provisions, FX revaluation) with full support; reviews journals prepared by P1s; ensures compliance with policy and approval thresholds.
  
  
**Balance Sheet Reconciliations**
Owns reconciliations for assigned accounts, including medium and high-risk accounts; ensures timely preparation, certification and evidence in Account Reconciliation Cloud Services (ARCS); investigates and resolves reconciling items; reviews P1 reconciliations.
  
  
**Open Item Management**
Manages aging and clearance of open items across owned accounts; drives action with owners in the business and finance; escalates items beyond threshold with root cause and a clearance plan; reports the aging trend.
  
  
**Financial Reporting**
Prepares and reviews management and statutory reporting inputs, schedules and disclosures; ensures reporting accuracy and consistency with the ledger; supports consolidation and group reporting submissions.
  
  
**Variance Analysis**
Performs month-on-month, actual-versus-budget and forecast variance analysis; identifies drivers and root causes; writes concise commentary for controllers and business partners; recommends corrective actions.
  
  
**Governance & Controls**
Operates and evidence key controls for owned processes; performs self-assessments; identifies control gaps and proposes remediation; ensures adherence to policy, SOX or equivalent requirements and segregation of duties.
  
  
**Audit Support**
Prepares audit documentation for owned accounts; responds to internal and external auditors directly on routine queries; supports remediation of findings.
  
  
**Stakeholder Management**
Acts as the day-to-day contact for entity controllers and business partners on owned areas; sets expectations on timelines and data needs; manages escalations on a first-line basis.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement**
Identifies recurring errors, bottlenecks and manual effort in owned processes; implements local improvements; updates procedures and desk instructions; participates in Lean or Six Sigma activities.
  
  
**Digital & Automation Adoption**
Maximises Account Reconciliation Cloud Services (ARCS) auto-matching and workflow features; builds and uses Excel and Power BI tools to improve analysis; documents requirements for automation candidates and supports testing and user acceptance.
  
  

***Required Technical Skills:***
**Skill**
**Expected capability**
**General Accounting**
Strong command of the accounting cycle including accruals, provisions, fixed assets, intercompany, FX and cut-off; applies sound judgement on standard transactions.
  
  
**IFRS / US GAAP**
Working knowledge of the standards that affect owned accounts (revenue, leases, provisions, financial instruments, FX); applies policy correctly and recognises when to seek technical guidance.
  
  
**MEC Management**
Plans and manages own close deliverables, dependencies and cut-off; anticipates delays and recovers the schedule.
  
  
**Balance Sheet Reconciliations**

description:
About the Job

At Opella, we have one shared mission – we work passionately, every day, to ‘serve healthier, fuller lives’ now and for the generations to come.

In order to do so, we strive to act as a force for good by integrating sustainability along our business and employees’ mission and operate responsibly from both a social and environmental point of view.

Everything we do is centered around people’s interests – our consumers, our customers, healthcare professionals, and our employees – across the world.

We are building loved brands that serve 1bn consumers worldwide, through our key platforms: Allergy, Physical & Mental Wellness, Pain, Digestive Wellness and Cough, Cold & Flu.

We aspire to become the best Fast Moving Consumer Health (FMCH) company in & for the world and we aim to build a work environment where people can thrive, grow, enjoy and be at their best.

**Our team**
designs, delivers, and governs Digital Technology services and capabilities for Opella worldwide.

We deliver our solutions in a highly competitive market answering FMCH needs and sometimes supporting regulated environments (GxP, SoX and other regional or local regulations).

Our team operates in an international context, serving all markets in most of the countries around the world.

Digital Technology & Architecture organization encompasses following capabilities: Integration, Enterprise Architecture, Cloud engineering, Platform Engineering (e.g. DevOps & related framework), FinOps, Platforms (ServiceNow, Observability, Chatbots, SAP, Salesforce, RPA, …), Digital Workplace and Cloud Infrastructure.

**Delivery & Performance**
provides the management system that connects strategy, portfolio execution, financial performance, governance, and operational improvement across Technology & Architecture. The team works across domains to create transparency, strengthen accountability, and enable faster, better-informed decisions.

Are you passionate about turning strategy into brilliant execution, improving financial visibility, and simplifying how technology is governed and delivered? Join us as Delivery & Performance Lead within the Technology & Architecture organization and help strengthen portfolio execution, operational performance, and leadership decision-making across Opella.

Delivery & Performance Lead

Job Summary

The Delivery & Performance Lead drives disciplined execution, financial performance, governance, and operational excellence across Opella’s Technology & Architecture organization. The role provides an integrated view of delivery progress, portfolio health, budgets, risks, dependencies, and outcomes, enabling leaders to make timely, evidence-based decisions.

Working across technology domains and in close partnership with Finance, Procurement, project managers, and business stakeholders, the role strengthens ways of working, improves transparency and accountability, and supports simplification of the technology portfolio and landscape.

Key Responsibilities

Technology Delivery & Performance

* Drive execution discipline and delivery performance across the Technology & Architecture portfolio.
* Maintain clear visibility of progress, milestones, outcomes, risks, issues, dependencies, and delivery commitments.
* Challenge delivery plans constructively, facilitate issue resolution, and support recovery actions where performance is off track.
* Promote outcome-based planning and consistent portfolio delivery practices.

Financial & Budget Management

* Oversee budget tracking, forecasting, purchase order management, and financial performance across Business as Usual and Separation Costs.
* Reconcile actuals, commitments, forecasts, and variances in partnership with Finance, Procurement, and budget owners.
* Improve financial transparency, cost control, and decision-making through reliable data and timely insight.
* Identify financial risks and opportunities and coordinate corrective actions with accountable owners.

Governance & Ways of Working

* Strengthen delivery governance, standards, reporting rhythms, decision forums, and operating models.
* Clarify accountabilities, decision rights, escalation paths, and performance expectations.
* Standardize practical ways of working that improve consistency, speed, and execution efficiency without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
* Drive continuous improvement based on delivery data, stakeholder feedback, and lessons learned.

Portfolio & Digital Landscape Simplification

* Create an integrated view of initiatives, demand, capacity, investment, and strategic alignment.
* Support portfolio prioritization and sequencing, balancing business value, cost, risk, dependencies, and delivery capacity.
* Contribute to technology landscape simplification by identifying overlaps, rationalization opportunities, and complexity reduction actions.
* Ensure initiatives remain aligned with Technology & Architecture priorities and Opella’s strategic objectives.

Performance Reporting & Executive Insights

* Define and maintain meaningful KPIs covering delivery, financial health, risk, capacity, quality, and outcomes.
* Develop dashboards and management reporting that provide a trusted, concise view of portfolio performance.
* Translate delivery and financial data into actionable insights, options, and recommendations for leadership.
* Improve data quality and reporting automation to reduce manual effort and accelerate decision-making.

Cross-functional Collaboration & Digital Enablement

* Partner with Technology & Architecture leaders, project and portfolio managers, Finance, Procurement, and business stakeholders.
* Facilitate alignment across functions, surface trade-offs, and ensure actions and decisions are followed through.
* Act as a trusted partner to leadership, combining constructive challenge with pragmatic execution support.
* Where relevant, use AI-powered tools and digital solutions to improve productivity, streamline reporting, and simplify ways of working.
* Facilitate animation of team routines and coach our Teams to work in Agile ways of working and according to the Project Management methodology defined by our Digital group.

Core Skills & Expertise

* Technology delivery and performance management.
* Project and portfolio management.
* Budget management, forecasting, purchase order management, and cost control.
* Technology governance, operating models, and decision frameworks.
* KPI development, analytics, and executive reporting.
* Stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership.
* Process optimization and continuous improvement.
* Digital transformation and AI enablement.

Required Qualifications

* Significant experience in technology delivery, portfolio performance, PMO, finance, operations, or a comparable role in a complex international organization.
* Proven ability to manage budgets and forecasts, interpret financial data, and drive cost accountability.
* Strong understanding of project and portfolio governance, delivery methodologies, and technology operating models.
* Excellent analytical, communication, facilitation, and executive presentation skills.
* Ability to influence without direct authority, manage competing priorities, and operate effectively in ambiguity.
* Pragmatic, structured, detail-oriented, and able to connect strategic priorities with operational execution.
* Fluent English required; additional languages are an advantage.

Tools & Digital Capabilities

* **Project & Portfolio Management**
  : Jira.
* **Collaboration & Knowledge Management:**
  Confluence, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint.
* **Reporting & Analytics:**
  Power BI, Microsoft Excel.
* **AI & Productivity:**
  Microsoft Copilot and generative AI tools like Vibe Coding.
* **Financial & Procurement Processes:**
  budget tracking, forecasting, and SAP.

Success Indicators

* Leadership has a reliable, timely, and actionable view of delivery and financial performance.
* Portfolio milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions, and accountabilities are transparent and actively managed.
* Budget forecasts are accurate, variances are understood, and financial actions are completed on time.
* Governance and reporting are simpler, more consistent, and focused on decisions and outcomes.
* Prioritization and landscape simplification decisions are supported by clear data and strategic alignment.

Stakeholders recognize the function as a trusted partner that improves execution, accountability, and operational efficiency.

title: EYP-Working Capital-Assistant Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- Parthenon – S&E - WCAS (Assistant Manager)**
**Working Capital Advisory Services (WCAS)**
WCAS is a cornerstone of EY's Transformation offerings to clients, working in tandem with other EY practices to drive top line and bottom-line growth with measurable cash benefits.
  
  
Our team is committed to improving the cash-impacting processes of EY clients globally. We aim to help clients enhance their liquidity, resulting in increased Free Cash Flow (FCF) from operations. Our approach includes in-depth analysis and benchmarking, data-driven diagnostics of Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, and Forecast-to-Fulfil processes using EY's market leading methodologies and tools, and interventions focused on liquidity, such as Cash Flow Forecasting support.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We seek Assistant Managers with expertise in Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), inventory optimization, and/ or supply chain management. Ideal candidates will have 4-7 years of experience in operational improvements with a strategic, transformation-oriented mindset, demonstrated by:
  
  

* Analyzing market/industry trends.
* Ideating from the client's perspective and strategizing with a 'big picture' approach.
* Aligning with client objectives for value, differentiation, ease of implementation, and long-term enablement.
* Experience in key sectors (e.g., Life Sciences and Healthcare, Advanced Manufacturing/ Industrials, Technology, Consumer Products or Retail).
* An end-to-end and transformational approach during pursuits, proposals, and engagements.

As a contributor to our performance improvement, and strategic growth initiatives, you will use your advanced skills in operational and financial data modelling to provide strategic insights to clients and internal stakeholders
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support in executing WCAS engagements either individually or as part of a team to support key conclusions in developing and executing Working Capital optimization opportunities, support strategy and process optimization programs and Cash positioning
* Analyze historical transactional and financial data and market trends to create accurate and reliable opportunity and benefits measures
* Working closely with client teams and GDS leads to tailor models to specific client needs.
* Present deliverables and solutions to clients, clearly communicating assumptions, methodologies, and implications for their business.
* Contribute to the development of proposals and participate in client presentations for new business opportunities.
* Engage in continuous learning and development to stay abreast of best practices in Working Capital and Cash management
* Maintain the highest standards of quality and compliance with EY's ethical guidelines and professional standards.
* Mentor and guide junior analysts in developing their analytical skills and understanding of methodologies
* Data analysis with extensive use Power BI / Alteryx / PowerPoint and advanced MS Excel
* Working knowledge of AI assistants such as copilot for developing automation agents for business development and other use cases

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Inventory Management Expertise: Experience in inventory turnover analysis, just-in-time inventory practices, and demand forecasting to reduce holding and shortage costs
* Credit and Receivables Management: Knowledge of credit policies, credit analysis, and accounts receivable management through Quote-to-Cash process analysis and designing strategies to minimize days sales outstanding (DSO).
* Payables and Disbursements Management: Expertise in managing accounts payable and optimising the Procure-to-Pay cycle. Experience in implementing efficient payment processes to maximise days payables outstanding (DPO).
* Supply chain management: Functional knowledge and experience within Plan, make, source, deliver pillars of supply chain management is a plus
* Data Analytics: Experience in working with large volumes of transactional data to develop segmentation and opportunity models (Must have- Power BI, Alteryx/SQL, MS Office applications; Good to have - Python/R, VBA, Snowflake/Databricks)
* Experience of working with stakeholders in global landscape
* Excellent problem solving and interpersonal skills
* Willingness to Travel: Openness to international travel for business purposes.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Post Graduate degree in business, accounting, finance, engineering, computer science or related field from a premier institute with 4-7 years of applicable industry / analytics and/or consulting experience
* Track record of delivering performance improvement projects related to supply chain/inventory optimization, sourcing/procurement or sales/accounts receivable that deliver tangible results (cost take out, revenue growth, increased cash flow, etc.).

**What You Can Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EYP practices globally with running businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  
EY is committed to being inclusive in all dimensions of diversity to ensure every employee is able to be and bring their authentic self to work, every day.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

• MBA (Finance), CFA, CA, Economics, Commerce, Finance, or any related discipline.

What You'll Do:**

* P&L & Balance Sheet Review: Conduct thorough P&L reviews and quarterly Balance Sheet reconciliations, providing clear variance analysis and business justifications for cost fluctuations.
* Provisions & Accruals: Track, record, and periodically review provisions, unbilled revenues, and accrual aging schedules for timely adjustments or releases.

**Job Description**
**SCOPE OF WORK FOR SR. ASSOCIATE ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT ROLE**

* Loan Application Review & Credit Assessment:

Review and analyze loan applications and supporting documentation including income, credit reports, employment history, and property details. Assess borrower creditworthiness using the 4 C's methodology (Character, Capacity, Capital, Collateral) to ensure sound lending decisions and adherence to underwriting guidelines.
  
  

* Income Calculation & Financial Analysis:

Evaluate and calculate borrower income from various sources including salaried, hourly, commission, bonus, rental, and self-employment income. Analyze documents such as paystubs, W-2s, tax returns, and business financials (Schedule C, K-1, 1065, 1120S) to determine qualifying income accurately and consistently.
  
  

* Collateral & Property Evaluation:

Review appraisal reports, AVMs, and residential valuation documents to validate property value and ensure compliance with lending guidelines. Analyze title reports, lien positions, and ownership details to mitigate collateral risk.
  
  

* Underwriting Decision & Documentation:

Prepare detailed underwriting summaries, identify red flags, and document conditions and stipulations within the Loan Origination System (LOS), preferably Encompass. Recommend appropriate loan structures based on comprehensive risk assessment and borrower profile analysis.
  
  

* Workflow Management & Communication:

Collaborate with processors, loan officers, and internal stakeholders throughout the underwriting lifecycle. Provide clear communication on loan decisions, required conditions, and final clear-to-close (CTC) status to facilitate timely loan closing.
  
  

* Risk Identification & Compliance:

Identify discrepancies, inconsistencies, and potential risks in loan files. Ensure all underwriting decisions comply with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and investor guidelines to maintain portfolio quality.
  
  

* Reporting & Reconciliation:

Handle reconciliation of complex borrower accounts and prepare daily aging and pipeline reports to track loan progress, turnaround times, and performance metrics against departmental KPIs.
  
  

* System Utilization & Process Adherence:

Utilize LOS platforms (Encompass preferred) and adhere to underwriting workflows, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and compliance with company standards and best practices.
  
  

* Borrower Communication & Clarification Requests:

Issue clear and professional requests for additional documentation or clarification from borrowers and their representatives. Follow up on outstanding items to maintain loan file completeness and expedite the underwriting process.
  
  

* Exception Handling & Escalation:

Identify loans that fall outside standard guidelines and prepare exception reports with supporting analysis. Escalate complex or non-standard situations to management with recommendations for approval or denial.
  
  

* Quality Assurance & File Review:

Conduct thorough quality reviews of loan files to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance. Identify process improvements and provide feedback to team members to enhance overall departmental performance.
  
  

* Regulatory Compliance & Audit Readiness:

Maintain current knowledge of federal and state lending regulations, including TRID, ECOA, FHA, VA, and USDA guidelines. Ensure all underwriting decisions and documentation are audit-ready and compliant with regulatory examinations.
  
  

* Loan Product Knowledge & Guideline Updates:

Stay current with evolving loan products, investor guidelines, and underwriting standards. Communicate guideline changes to team members and implement updates to underwriting procedures promptly.
  
  

* Mentoring & Knowledge Sharing:

As a senior-level associate, mentor junior underwriting staff and processors on best practices, complex underwriting scenarios, and policy interpretations to foster team development and consistency.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS**
**Education & Credentials:**

* High School Diploma/GED and Bachelor's Degree (Mandatory)
* Mortgage industry certification or licensing (e.g., NMLS) preferred

**Core Competencies:**

* Strong understanding of the 4 C's of Credit (Character, Capacity, Capital, Collateral)
* Expertise in income calculation and financial analysis, including self-employed and non-traditional borrower income sources
* Comprehensive knowledge of residential loan products and investor guidelines
* Proficiency with Loan Origination Systems (LOS), with Encompass experience preferred
* Advanced analytical and decision-making skills with strong attention to detail

**Technical & Regulatory Knowledge:**

* Working knowledge of federal and state lending regulations, including TRID, ECOA, FHA, VA, and USDA guidelines
* Familiarity with appraisal reports, Automated Valuation Models (AVMs), and property valuation methodologies
* Understanding of title reports, lien positions, and collateral risk assessment
* Experience with quality assurance processes and file review procedures

**Professional Skills:**

* Excellent verbal and written communication abilities
* Strong organizational and time management skills
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
* Proficiency in preparing reports, summaries, and documentation
* Problem-solving capabilities with ability to identify and escalate exceptions appropriately

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 3+ years of mortgage underwriting or loan processing experience
* Demonstrated mentoring or leadership experience with junior staff
* Knowledge of regulatory examination and audit procedures
* Experience with reconciliation and pipeline reporting

description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title: Operational Risk Management (ORM), Senior Analyst - AVP**

**Location: Mumbai, India**

**Role Description**

* As an ORM Senior Analyst supporting the Business Supervisory Office (BSO), you will provide support in overseeing the Operational Risk Management Framework and proactively manage a range of operational risks inherent to the business including non-financial risks, conduct and control matters and regulatory developments relevant to the U.S. Private Banking business.
* Perform quality assurance reviews of Operational Risk (OR) forms submitted by 1LoD, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance with governance standards; assess incidents to determine applicability for Event Management (EMAPP) reporting and drive appropriate escalation where required.
* Maintain and oversee the centralized Operational Risk incident tracker, ensuring accurate recording, monitoring, and timely follow-up of risk events and remediation actions, while developing high-quality management information (MI), including event analysis and presentations for Risk Forums to support informed decision-making.
Identify opportunities to enhance existing processes and controls, including leveraging automation to improve efficiency, strengthen the control environment, and drive consistency in risk management practices.  

**What we’ll offer you**

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy

* Best in class leave policy
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Provide hands-on support and oversight for U.S. Private Banking Operational Risk Management activities, including Risk & Control Self-Assessments (RCSA), issue and findings management, operational risk event management and remediation tracking to ensure alignment with the Operational Risk Management Framework (ORMF)
* Draft, document, and maintain U.S. Private Banking–specific policies, procedures, manuals, and control documentation, ensuring consistency with internal governance standards and regulatory requirements.
* Support the production and delivery of operational risk reporting and management information, including dashboards, governance materials for forums such as the Risk Council to enable effective oversight and risk-based decision-making.
* Maintain subject matter expertise on operational risk topics relevant to U.S. Private Banking, including regulatory expectations, emerging risks, and internal governance frameworks to provide informed guidance and support to stakeholders.
* Collaborate closely with 1st Line and 2nd Line of Defence stakeholders to ensure timely completion of operational risk activities, deliverables, and adherence to framework requirements
* Support the implementation of new or updated operational risk and control requirements, ensuring effective integration into existing processes and alignment with business and regulatory expectations.
* Proactively identify, assess, and escalate sensitive or emerging operational risk issues, providing clear analysis and well-reasoned recommendations to support informed decision-making and effective risk mitigation
* Trade Surveillance: Support the surveillance of capital markets trading activity to identify potential market abuse, including front running, pump-and-dump and market manipulation, and review transactions for adherence to client suitability, best-interest and applicable regulatory requirements.
Transaction Monitoring: Conduct AML transaction monitoring across wires, ACH and cross-border activity, including higher-risk jurisdictions and Russian-nexus clients; review transaction and CAM alerts, assess activity against expected client profiles, investigate potential AML indicators and escalate matters requiring further review.  

**Your skills and experience**

* Strong understanding of Operational Risk Management frameworks, including RCSA, issue and findings management, event management, and remediation tracking with the ability to apply these effectively in a dynamic business environment
* Demonstrated ability in drafting and maintaining policies, procedures, and control documentation, ensuring alignment with internal governance standards and regulatory requirements.
* Proven experience in risk reporting and management information (MI), including preparation of dashboards, governance materials, and presentations for senior stakeholders
* Solid knowledge of regulatory expectations, non-financial risks, and control environments, with the ability to interpret and apply evolving regulatory requirements to business processes
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience working collaboratively across 1st and 2nd Line of Defence teams and effectively escalating and managing emerging risk issues.
Ability to co-ordinate with multiple stakeholders and manage projects/tasks on an end-to-end basis  

**How we’ll support you**

* Training and development to help you excel in your career
* Coaching and support from experts in your team
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

**https://www.db.com/company/company.html**

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

title: Senior Accounting Analyst, Mortgage
description:
**Who We Are:**

Real REMAX Group (Nasdaq: REAX) is a global real estate company bringing together two trusted brands and a shared belief: when real estate professionals are empowered by innovation and community, everyone benefits. By combining Real’s AI-powered technology platform and entrepreneurial community with REMAX’s iconic global brand and trusted franchise network, we’re building one of the industry’s most innovative real estate companies. Together, our network of more than 180,000 real estate professionals spans over 120 countries and territories, united by a commitment to helping agents and brokers build stronger businesses and deliver exceptional experiences for their clients.

One Real Mortgage, our in-house mortgage division, extends that same vision into the lending side of the transaction - giving agents and their clients a fully integrated path from contract to closing, all within the Real REMAX Group ecosystem.

At Real REMAX Group, we believe in pairing Tech x Humanity to create something truly different.

Learn more at https://realremaxgroup.com/ and our affiliate relationships: https://onerealmortgage.com/affiliated-businesses/

**Work Schedule:** IST 5PM - 2AM, Monday - Friday

**About the Role:**

We’re looking for a Senior Accounting Analyst, Mortgage to join our Mortgage Accounting team. In this role, you’ll own core day-to-day accounting for One Real Mortgage, from journal entries and reconciliations through accounts payable, broker check processing, and expense bill-backs, so the business closes on time with accurate, well-supported books. The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, organized, and proactive about chasing down discrepancies, and someone who communicates clearly with partners across mortgage operations and the broader finance team.

This is a great opportunity to build deep expertise in mortgage accounting, strengthen close and reconciliation processes for a growing business line, and make a visible impact on the quality of financial reporting for our ancillary businesses.

**What You’ll Do:**

* **Month-End and Year-End Close:** Prepare and post journal entries, accruals, reclassifications, and adjusting entries to ensure a timely and accurate financial close.
* **General Ledger Management:** Review general ledger activity, investigate discrepancies, ensure accurate account classification, and maintain supporting documentation for all entries.
* **Account Reconciliations:** Prepare and review balance sheet reconciliations, investigate reconciling items, and ensure outstanding balances are appropriately resolved.
* **Financial Reporting:** Prepare monthly financial reports, supporting schedules, and account analyses to support management reporting and financial reviews.
* **Accounts Payable Management:** Review and process vendor invoices, validate supporting documentation, monitor outstanding invoices, and ensure timely payment processing.
* **Broker Check Processing and Reconciliation:** Track broker checks received, verify additional funds, coordinate payment processing, and follow up on outstanding checks and related transactions.
* **Expense Allocation and Bill-Backs:** Review expenses and allocate costs to the appropriate entities, departments, or business units, including preparing intercompany and other expense bill-backs.
* **Supporting Documentation and Audit Readiness:** Maintain organized documentation for journal entries, reconciliations, invoices, payments, and other financial transactions to support internal and external audit requests.

**What You’ll Bring:**

* Strong working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and core accounting concepts, including accruals, reconciliations, and intercompany activity.
* Hands-on experience with an ERP or general ledger system (e.g., NetSuite or similar) and proficiency in Excel, including lookups, pivot tables, and reconciliation workbooks.
* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, with the ability to trace transactions to support and resolve discrepancies independently.
* Strong organization and time management skills to meet month-end close deadlines while handling recurring AP and payment processing.
* Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort partnering with mortgage operations, AP, and finance stakeholders to follow up on open items.
* Familiarity with mortgage lending operations or financial services accounting is a plus.

**Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* 6+ years of accounting experience, ideally including month-end close, balance sheet reconciliations, and accounts payable; mortgage, lending, or financial services experience preferred.
* CA or progress toward CA is a plus but not required.

**How We Work: Our Operating Principles**

Our Operating Principles are the blueprint of Real REMAX Group’s culture. They guide how we show up, make decisions, and bring our mission to life every day:

* **Be Agent Obsessed:** We design every decision around creating value for our agents and their clients.
* **Move Fast with Purpose:** We act with urgency, clarity, and focus—without compromising our standards.
* **Own Your Outcome:** Effort matters, but results matter more. We adapt, learn, and improve.
* **Be Bold; Challenge Often:** We challenge assumptions, rethink “the usual,” and push for smarter, simpler solutions.
* **Win Together:** We set high standards, collaborate deeply, and celebrate shared success.

**Additional Details:**

* **Location Requirements:** Candidates must be based in India to be considered.
* **Physical Requirements:** Ability to sit for long periods of time.

**Our Commitment:**

Real REMAX Group is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital or family status, disability, citizenship, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

  Lead the design, execution, and monitoring of business plans, capital / operating budgets, and cost-control frameworks to ensure financial targets and project scopes are met without compromising quality.

  Lead the annual and multi-year budgeting process (operating and capital expenditure budgets) in alignment with corporate strategy.

  Translate high-level business goals into actionable financial plans and department level allocations.

  Track real-time expenditures against approved budgets, identifying cost overruns or savings early.
* **Variance Reporting:**
  Investigate root causes of budget variances and issue actionable recommendations or corrective action plans to leadership.
* **Value Engineering:**
  Balance cost-cutting initiatives with quality, risk, and delivery schedules to prevent downstream rework.

* **Budget Accuracy:**
  Variance within an acceptable threshold (between actuals and forecasted/budgeted figures.
* **Forecast Reliability:**
  Timely and accurate delivery of monthly/quarterly rolling forecasts.
* **Cost Saving & Efficiency:**
  Measurable reduction in waste, unapproved overruns, or non-essential expenditures without impacting quality.

Analyst, Risk Management
  
  
**Job Description**
The primary responsibility is to support the CRM team to ensure customer risk is appropriately monitored in accordance with Mastercard’s policies & procedures and risk appetite framework. The role also involves partnering with our Corporate Treasury Central Team and Settlement Operations teams to assist with any CRM data validation or CRM system testing related to CEM (Customer Exposure Management) improvements as well as preparing commercial underwriting documentation before handing it over to senior analysts for completion.
  
  
Mastercard has approximately $68B in credit exposure to financial institutions and other counterparties worldwide, placing the CRM role as a key part of its evolving and quickly growing business model. The magnitude and strategic nature of this exposure necessitates periodic engagement with senior management, Mastercard’s sales, franchise, and product organizations as well as our customers (issuers, acquirers, etc. This provides great opportunities to learn and grow your career within Mastercard.
  
  
**Role**

* Daily read of Factiva/CreditEdge customer related news and regulatory website to scan for customer’s financial distress
* Monitor 24/7 global customer exposures and, based on volume trends and news/regulatory websites, immediately inform risk managers in case of urgencies (bankruptcies, insolvencies, administration etc)
* Monitor 24/7 the company prefunding accounts.
* Follow up with customers and account managers on open settlement positions of customers for small settlement failures, coordinating with Account Managers and Settlement operations, to determine if genuine or if it is a reconciliation issue
* Participate in decision process, including emergency procedures as directed by the Risk Managers
* First assembling of Commercial Underwriting for senior risk analysts, including data points such as volume/exposure trends, recommended CEM thresholds limits and settlement analysis
* CEM (Customer Exposure Monitoring) System testing
* Ad hoc reporting on customer volume, exposure and CEM declines trends
* Report and coordinate with the appropriate teams in case of CEM inaccuracies or process failures
* Maintain Customer Exposure Monitoring Manual
* Participate in various process improvement initiatives and best practices sharing;
* Access/check balances on customer bank account subject to security agreements, as applies

**All About You**

* Graduate/Postgraduate degree in business, economics, econometrics or equivalent.
* Experience in credit risk assessment and financial statements analysis (preferably).
* Accuracy, self-drive, accountability and sense of urgency.
* Outstanding written and verbal English communication skills.
* Advanced Excel, Word, and PowerPoint user.
* Positive attitude, strong work-ethic, and good sense of humor.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
