title: Dir Financial Operations
description:
HMH is a learning technology company committed to delivering connected solutions that engage learners, empower educators and improve student outcomes. As a leading provider of K–12 core curriculum, supplemental and intervention solutions, and professional learning services, HMH partners with educators and school districts to uncover solutions that unlock students’ potential and extend teachers’ capabilities.
  
  
HMH serves more than 50 million students and 4 million educators in 150 countries. For more information, visit www.hmhco.com
  
  
We are building an enterprise FinOps capability to strengthen the financial management of HMH's technology run-rate. Reporting within the CIO organization, the Director of FinOps will lead the practices, operating cadence, analytics, and governance required to understand, forecast, and optimize recurring technology spend, with primary focus on Cloud, AI, and SaaS.
  
  
This is a FinOps leadership role with strong technology fluency, not a cloud engineering or architecture role. The successful candidate must understand how technology consumption and commercial models drive cost and be comfortable working with technical teams and consumption data. Deep engineering expertise is not required. The role's primary value is translating usage, demand, contracts, and technology decisions into financial visibility, forecasts, optimization actions, and better business decisions.
  
  
A central part of the role is working directly with Budget Owners and Contract Owners. Budget and Contract Owners retain accountability for their budgets, business needs, vendor relationships, and contractual decisions. FinOps provides the financial intelligence, governance, forecasting, utilization analysis, optimization insight, and operating cadence that enables those owners to manage spend effectively.
  
  
The scope includes cloud infrastructure and platforms, AI models and services, SaaS applications, data and observability platforms, security tooling, and other material recurring technology services. HMH operates a hybrid environment today and is working toward greater use of AWS over time, making both current-state run-rate management and forward-looking migration economics important.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Own technology run-rate visibility.**
Establish and maintain a consolidated view of recurring technology spend across Cloud, AI, SaaS, and other material technology services. Provide clear visibility into actuals, budget, forecast, commitments, utilization, major cost drivers, and emerging financial risks.
  
  
**Lead the FinOps operating model.**
Establish and mature HMH's FinOps strategy, governance, processes, standards, and accountability mechanisms. Define practical approaches for cost ownership, allocation, tagging, showback, forecasting, optimization tracking, and financial performance measurement.
  
  
**Partner with Budget Owners.**
Establish a regular operating cadence with technology Budget Owners to review actual spend, run-rate, forecast, variances, demand changes, optimization opportunities, and corrective actions. Help owners understand what is driving their spend and provide the analysis needed to keep financial performance aligned with plan.
  
  
**Partner with Contract Owners.**
Work with Contract Owners, Procurement, Vendor Management, and Finance to connect consumption and utilization data to contract commitments, renewals, pricing structures, and sourcing decisions. Provide early visibility into underutilization, overconsumption, redundant capabilities, renewal exposure, and commercial optimization opportunities.
  
  
**Optimize Cloud spend.**
Partner with Engineering, Architecture, and platform teams to identify and financially evaluate rightsizing, idle resource reduction, storage and database optimization, commitment utilization, platform consolidation, and other Cloud optimization opportunities. Technical teams determine and implement appropriate engineering actions; FinOps quantifies the opportunity, tracks execution, and validates financial realization.
  
  
**Manage AI economics.**
Build visibility into AI-related consumption and run-rate, including model and API usage, tokens, agent execution, AI platform licensing, GPU or compute consumption, and other material AI services. Develop appropriate attribution and unit economics, forecast adoption-driven cost, identify abnormal consumption, and establish financial guardrails before usage outpaces visibility.
  
  
**Optimize SaaS economics.**
Develop visibility into SaaS spend, license utilization, product tiers, overlapping capabilities, contractual commitments, and renewal timing. Partner with Contract Owners and Procurement to identify rationalization, consolidation, renegotiation, and license optimization opportunities.
  
  
**Forecast and plan.**
Lead technology run-rate forecasting and support budgeting and scenario planning. Incorporate known business demand, product adoption, seasonality, technology roadmaps, migration activity, contract changes, and AI adoption into forward-looking forecasts. Continuously improve forecast accuracy and explain material variances.
  
  
**Track savings through realization.**
Maintain a disciplined optimization pipeline from opportunity identification through owner assignment, action, implementation, and validated financial realization. Distinguish between theoretical savings, cost avoidance, negotiated savings, and savings that actually appear in financial results.
  
  
**Inform executive decisions.**
Give the CIO and Technology Leadership Team a clear view of technology run-rate, forecast performance, optimization progress, realized savings, commitments, utilization, and emerging financial risks. Translate complex consumption and financial data into concise recommendations and decisions.
  
  
**What You Bring**
**Core FinOps depth (primary requirement):**

* 8+ years of relevant experience across FinOps, Cloud Financial Management, TBM, technology finance, financial analytics, SaaS economics, or related disciplines, including experience operating or leading a FinOps or technology cost management capability at meaningful scale.
* Demonstrated experience with forecasting, budgeting support, cost allocation, optimization, commitment management, variance analysis, and savings realization.
* Experience partnering directly with Budget Owners, Contract Owners, Finance, FP&A, Procurement, Vendor Management, and technology teams.
* Working experience with FinOps platforms such as Finout, CloudZero, Apptio Cloudability, CloudHealth, Harness, Kubecost, or comparable technologies.
* Strong analytical capability with cloud billing, SaaS licensing, contract, utilization, and other technology consumption datasets.
* Ability to translate financial and technology consumption information into practical recommendations, actions, and executive-level insights.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to challenge assumptions with data while maintaining shared accountability with spend owners.

**Technology fluency (required, but this is not a pure technical role):**

* Working knowledge of public cloud economics and commercial models, particularly AWS, with familiarity with at least one additional major cloud platform desirable.
* Understanding of how cloud architecture, engineering practices, AI adoption, SaaS usage, and technology demand influence consumption and cost.
* Comfort working with technical teams and interpreting consumption data without needing to be the engineer or architect responsible for designing the underlying solution.
* Familiarity with AI consumption models, including APIs, tokens, models, agents, platform licenses, and compute-intensive workloads.
* Proficiency with analytical and reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python, APIs, or comparable technologies is valuable; hands-on software engineering is not required.
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

**Nice To Have**

* FinOps Foundation certification and/or relevant AWS, Azure, or GCP credentials.
* Experience managing or analyzing generative AI costs, AI API and token economics, AI platform licensing, GPU infrastructure, or agentic workloads.
* SaaS optimization, software asset economics, license rationalization, and technology vendor negotiation experience.
* Experience with cloud commitments such as Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, committed-use agreements, enterprise discounts, and marketplace consumption.
* Migration economics, including modeling the financial impact of moving workloads from data centers to public cloud.
* Experience establishing unit economics for large digital products or technology platforms.
* TBM or technology portfolio management experience in a sizable enterprise technology organization.

**How We Weight This**
FinOps depth, financial discipline, and the ability to influence spend owners matter more in this role than deep engineering expertise. We are looking for someone who can understand the technology well enough to identify and challenge cost drivers, but whose primary strength is turning consumption, contracts, demand, and financial data into disciplined run-rate management and actionable decisions.
  
  
Success looks like a technology run-rate that is transparent and predictable; Budget Owners who understand and actively manage their spend; Contract Owners who enter renewals with clear utilization and demand data; forecasts that hold; optimization actions that convert into realized financial results; well-utilized cloud and commercial commitments; controlled AI consumption; improved SaaS utilization; and fewer technology spending surprises.
  
  
Put simply, the mission is to create transparency, accountability, and financial intelligence around HMH's Cloud, AI, SaaS, and broader technology run-rate so that Technology and business leaders can make better investment, sourcing, consumption, and operational decisions and get more value from every technology dollar.
  
  
The Information Technology organization is transforming to realize our mission: Become a leader in HMH’s digital transformation, and as a strategic partner, innovate and deliver highest value, competitive advantage solutions across all corporate and business functions. Our ambition is to be a digital leader through innovation and develop and deliver leading edge technology such as robotic process automation and artificial intelligence to solve some of HMH’s greatest operational business challenges. Our professionals will have business relevant skills to connect our HMH partners to technologies that propel the businesses to deliver the greatest value for HMH and our customers.
  
  
We are building a team of IT professionals with an insatiable appetite to learn, a relentless focus on customer service, a technological curiosity toward future possibilities, and a creativity in solving business challenges with leading technologies. Our team will find ways to work together, create a sense of community where it’s safe to take risks and learn together, develop our careers, and all have an opportunity to work on new technologies. We will work together, learn together and have fun together. As a team, we will lead HMH’s digital transformation.

title: Analyst, Risk Management
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Analyst, Risk ManagementJob Description:  
  
The primary responsibility is to support the CRM team to ensure customer risk is appropriately monitored in accordance with Mastercard’s policies & procedures and risk appetite framework. The role also involves partnering with our Corporate Treasury Central Team and Settlement Operations teams to assist with any CRM data validation or CRM system testing related to CEM (Customer Exposure Management) improvements as well as preparing commercial underwriting documentation before handing it over to senior analysts for completion.
  
Mastercard has approximately $68B in credit exposure to financial institutions and other counterparties worldwide, placing the CRM role as a key part of its evolving and quickly growing business model. The magnitude and strategic nature of this exposure necessitates periodic engagement with senior management, Mastercard’s sales, franchise, and product organizations as well as our customers (issuers, acquirers, etc. This provides great opportunities to learn and grow your career within Mastercard.  
  
Role:  
  

* Daily read of Factiva/CreditEdge customer related news and regulatory website to scan for customer’s financial distress
* Monitor 24/7 global customer exposures and, based on volume trends and news/regulatory websites, immediately inform risk managers in case of urgencies (bankruptcies, insolvencies, administration etc)
* Monitor 24/7 the company prefunding accounts.
* Follow up with customers and account managers on open settlement positions of customers for small settlement failures, coordinating with Account Managers and Settlement operations, to determine if genuine or if it is a reconciliation issue
* Participate in decision process, including emergency procedures as directed by the Risk Managers
* First assembling of Commercial Underwriting for senior risk analysts, including data points such as volume/exposure trends, recommended CEM thresholds limits and settlement analysis
* CEM (Customer Exposure Monitoring) System testing
* Ad hoc reporting on customer volume, exposure and CEM declines trends
* Report and coordinate with the appropriate teams in case of CEM inaccuracies or process failures
* Maintain Customer Exposure Monitoring Manual
* Participate in various process improvement initiatives and best practices sharing;
* Access/check balances on customer bank account subject to security agreements, as applies

  
All About You:  
  

* Graduate/Postgraduate degree in business, economics, econometrics or equivalent.
* Experience in credit risk assessment and financial statements analysis (preferably).
* Accuracy, self-drive, accountability and sense of urgency.
* Outstanding written and verbal English communication skills.
* Advanced Excel, Word, and PowerPoint user.
* Positive attitude, strong work-ethic, and good sense of humor.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a detail-oriented Senior Accounts Executive to manage sales reconciliation, bank transactions, collections, payment processing, and refunds. The role requires strong reconciliation skills, accuracy in financial transactions, and the ability to maintain updated financial records across internal systems and payment channels.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Sales Reconciliation:**

  Reconcile sales transactions across internal systems, payment gateways, COD (Cash on Delivery), and IB Credit, ensuring accuracy and timely resolution of discrepancies.
* **Bank Reconciliation:**

  Manage bank entries, payment uploads, and monthly bank reconciliation, ensuring all transactions are accurately recorded.
* **Payment Verification:**

  Thoroughly verify payment files, beneficiary bank details, and supporting documents before processing or uploading payments.
* **Collections Management:**

  Track and update collections received through NEFT and IB Credit, confirm corresponding orders, and maintain accurate manual records.
* **Refund Processing:**

  Complete monthly bank reconciliation, sales reconciliation, and other finance-related closing activities within defined timelines.
* **Record Maintenance:**

  Ensure accurate and up-to-date records of collections, payments, refunds, and reconciliation statements.
* **Discrepancy Resolution:**

  Investigate mismatches, identify outstanding transactions, and coordinate with relevant internal teams and payment partners for timely resolution.
* **Process Compliance:**

  Follow established financial controls, verification procedures, and approval workflows to ensure accuracy and prevent payment errors.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* **4–7**

  years of relevant experience in accounting, bank reconciliation, sales reconciliation, or payment operations.
* Strong understanding of bank reconciliation, payment gateways, NEFT, UPI, COD, and credit-based transactions.
* Hands-on experience with Excel, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, and data reconciliation.

title: Sr. Accountant (Project Finance)
description:
At Lummus Technology, innovation thrives, and excellence is a shared pursuit. When you join Lummus, you are empowered to make an impact and be part of a dynamic team that celebrates creativity, encourages professional development, and fosters collaboration.
  
  
From our technology portfolio to our global workforce, Lummus is growing at a rapid pace, and we hope that you will grow with us during this exciting time.
  
  
The Project Finance position is responsible for the financial management, forecasting, reporting, and analysis of assigned projects throughout the project lifecycle. The role partners closely with Project Managers, Project Controls, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, Commercial, and Operations teams to provide financial insight, support project performance, monitor project risks and opportunities, and ensure accurate forecasting of revenue, costs, margin, cash flow, and working capital. The position also supports project billing activities to ensure alignment between project execution, contract requirements, and financial performance.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities**
**Project Financial Management**

* Support projects throughout the project lifecycle, including project setup, budget review, forecast maintenance, cost tracking, cash flow monitoring, and project closeout.
* Partner with Project Managers and Project Controls to monitor project performance and provide financial analysis to support project execution.
* Prepare and maintain project forecasts, including revenue, cost, gross margin, cost-to-complete, receipts, disbursements, and working capital metrics.
* Analyze forecast changes, project performance trends, and actual results against budget and prior forecasts.
* Identify project risks and opportunities and support the development of mitigation plans.

**Financial Analysis and Business Support**

* Analyze monthly project financial results and provide commentary on revenue, cost, profitability, cash flow, receivables, contract assets and liabilities, and key project drivers.
* Support financial reviews and project performance discussions with project and business leadership teams.
* Review project commitments, cost trends, estimate revisions, and forecast assumptions.
* Support Technical Service Agreement, vendor-based, reimbursable, and commission-based projects through financial review and performance analysis.
* Assist in evaluating project-related commercial and financial matters as projects progress through execution.

title: Manager Finance
description:
**Commercial And Retail Finance Manager - Job Description**
**Position Overview:**
The Commercial and Retail Finance Manager is responsible for comprehensive financial management of commercial and retail real estate portfolios, including financial planning, analysis, reporting, invoice generation, CAM reconciliations, and budgeting. This role provides strategic financial insight to support business decisions, optimize portfolio performance, and ensure accurate financial operations across property management.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Invoice Generation & Accounts Receivable Management**
Generate and issue monthly tenant invoices for base rent, CAM charges, property taxes, insurance, and other recoverable expenses. Prepare and distribute quarterly or annual CAM estimate bills and reconciliation statements. Process lease escalations, percentage rent calculations, and special billing requirements. Monitor accounts receivable aging and coordinate collection efforts with property management teams. Reconcile tenant payments and resolve billing discrepancies. Maintain accurate tenant billing records and ensure compliance with lease terms.
  
  
**CAM (Common Area Maintenance) Management**
Administer CAM programs including calculation of tenant pro-rata shares based on lease terms and square footage. Prepare annual CAM budgets and estimate bills for distribution to tenants. Conduct detailed annual CAM reconciliations comparing actual expenses to billed estimates. Generate tenant-specific reconciliation statements showing overages or refunds due. Review and allocate operating expenses to appropriate CAM pools (common area, HVAC, parking, etc.). Ensure compliance with lease-specific CAM provisions, caps, and exclusions. Handle tenant CAM audits and respond to inquiries regarding expense allocations. Track and manage CAM over/under collections and adjust future billings accordingly.
  
  
**Budgeting & Forecasting**
Lead the annual budgeting process for assigned commercial and retail properties, collaborating with property management teams. Develop detailed operating and capital budgets including revenue projections, operating expenses, CAM recoveries, and capital expenditures. Create quarterly reforecasts reflecting current market conditions, leasing activity, and operational changes. Analyze historical trends and market data to establish realistic budget assumptions. Present budget proposals to senior management and property owners for approval. Monitor budget performance throughout the year and provide variance explanations. Prepare rolling 12-month forecasts to support cash flow planning and strategic decision-making.
  
  
**Financial Planning & Analysis**
Conduct variance analysis comparing actual performance to budgets, forecasts, and prior periods. Prepare financial models to evaluate investment opportunities, lease transactions, and capital projects. Monitor key performance indicators including NOI, occupancy rates, rent collections, operating expense ratios, and recovery percentages. Analyze lease structures and their financial impact on property cash flow. Identify opportunities to improve revenue collection and expense management.
  
  
**Financial Reporting**
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements for property portfolios. Generate management reports highlighting financial performance, trends, and actionable insights. Produce owner reports with detailed variance explanations and supporting schedules. Present financial results to senior leadership, property owners, and stakeholders. Track and report on tenant rent rolls, lease expirations, and renewal activity. Ensure timely and accurate reporting in compliance with GAAP and company policies.
  
  
**Property Operations Support**
Partner with property management teams to optimize revenue and control operating expenses. Review and approve operating expense invoices and code to appropriate accounts. Support vendor contract negotiations by analyzing cost structures and payment terms. Analyze lease agreements for billing requirements, escalations, and recovery provisions. Coordinate with leasing teams on financial aspects of lease negotiations and tenant concessions. Support capital project planning with financial analysis and budget tracking.
  
  
**Team Collaboration**
Work cross-functionally with asset management, leasing, property management, and corporate finance teams. Mentor junior finance staff on billing processes, CAM procedures, and financial analysis. Build strong relationships with property teams to understand operational drivers of financial performance. Collaborate with accounts payable teams to ensure proper expense coding and allocation.
  
  
**Qualifications:**
**Required:**
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Real Estate, or related field. 5-7 years of progressive finance experience in commercial real estate property management. Strong knowledge of commercial lease structures, CAM calculations, and recovery methodologies. Demonstrated expertise in tenant billing, invoice generation, and accounts receivable management. Proven experience managing annual budgeting and CAM reconciliation processes. Advanced Excel skills including financial modeling, pivot tables, and complex formulas. Proficiency with property management systems (Yardi, MRI, or similar) and accounting software. Understanding of GAAP, real estate accounting principles, and lease accounting standards. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and attention to detail. Strong written and verbal communication skills for tenant and stakeholder interactions. Ability to manage multiple properties and priorities simultaneously while meeting deadlines.
  
  
**Preferred:**
CPA, CFA, or relevant professional certification. Experience with both commercial office and retail property types. Knowledge of percentage rent calculations and gross-up provisions. Familiarity with tenant improvement allowances and lease incentive accounting. Experience supporting acquisitions, dispositions, or property transitions. Background in lease administration and critical date tracking.
  
  
**Technical Competencies:**
Expert knowledge of CAM allocation methodologies and industry best practices. Proficiency in lease abstract interpretation and billing requirement identification. Strong understanding of operating expense categories and allocation principles. Experience with recoverable versus non-recoverable expense classification. Ability to prepare detailed reconciliation schedules and supporting documentation. Knowledge of tenant audit processes and documentation requirements.
  
  
**Core Competencies:**
Strategic thinking with ability to translate financial data into business insights. Results-oriented with focus on driving portfolio performance and maximizing recoveries. Strong problem-solving abilities and capacity to resolve complex billing issues. Collaborative approach with ability to work effectively across departments. Detail-oriented with commitment to accuracy in financial reporting and tenant billing. Customer service mindset when dealing with tenant inquiries and concerns. Adaptability to changing business needs, lease requirements, and regulatory standards.
  
  
**Working Conditions:**
Office-based role with potential for hybrid arrangements. May require occasional property site visits. Peak workload during month-end close, quarterly forecasting, annual budgeting (typically Q4), and CAM reconciliation season (typically Q1-Q2).
  
  
**Reporting Structure:**
This role typically reports to a Director of Finance, Portfolio Controller, or Senior Finance Manager and plays a critical function in bridging financial management with property operations to maximize asset value, ensure accurate tenant billing, and optimize expense recoveries.

title: Senior Associate-CAAS
description:
**Position Summary**

The Assistant Manager - CAAS is responsible for managing accounting engagements, supporting client relationships, overseeing day-to-day accounting operations, and ensuring timely delivery of high-quality financial reporting services. The role requires strong expertise in U.S. accounting practices, client onboarding, non-profit accounting, month-end close processes, and team supervision.

The ideal candidate will serve as a key liaison between clients and the engagement team, ensuring service excellence, compliance, operational efficiency, and continuous process improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

Client Service & Engagement Management

* Manage a portfolio of client accounting engagements across various industries, including non profit organizations.
* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients and build trusted advisor relationships.
* Ensure timely and accurate delivery of accounting, bookkeeping, and financial reporting services.
* Participate in client meetings, review financial results, and address accounting-related inquiries.
* Identify opportunities to expand services and enhance client satisfaction.

Client Onboarding

* Lead and coordinate the end-to-end client onboarding process.
* Gather and review client documentation, accounting records, and system access requirements.
* Assess current accounting processes and identify transition risks.
* Develop onboarding plans, timelines, and workflow documentation.
* Ensure smooth migration of accounting functions and establish standard operating procedures.

Accounting & Financial Reporting

* Review monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.
* Oversee general ledger maintenance, account reconciliations, and closing activities.
* Ensure compliance with U.S. GAAP and firm quality standards.
* Analyze financial data and provide actionable recommendations to clients.
* Support budgeting, forecasting, cash flow management, and management reporting activities.

Non-Profit Accounting

* Manage accounting engagements for non-profit organizations.
* Review fund accounting, grant accounting, donor restrictions, and program expense allocations.
* Ensure compliance with non-profit reporting requirements and applicable accounting standards.
* Assist clients with preparation of financial statements, audit schedules, and regulatory reporting.

Team Leadership & Development

* Supervise, mentor, and review the work of staff and senior accountants.
* Provide technical guidance, coaching, and performance feedback.
* Assist in resource planning and workload management across engagements.
* Support training initiatives and promote continuous learning within the team.

Process Improvement & Compliance

* Identify opportunities for process automation and efficiency improvements.
* Develop and maintain accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls.
* Ensure adherence to firm policies, quality standards, and engagement deadlines.
* Support audit requests and client compliance requirements.

**Qualifications/Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
* CPA, CA, CMA, or equivalent professional qualification preferred.
* 3-5 years of progressive accounting experience with exposure to client service environments.
* Experience managing accounting engagements and leading teams.
* Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and financial reporting.
* Experience with client onboarding and transition management.
* Experience supporting or managing non-profit accounting engagements preferred.
* Proficiency in accounting software such as QuickBooks, Sage Intacct, NetSuite, Xero, or similar platforms.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Strong reporting and HR data management capabilities.

**Core Professional Competencies**

Technical Skills

* Financial Accounting & Reporting
* General Ledger Management
* Month-End & Year-End Close
* Account Reconciliations
* Budgeting & Forecasting
* U.S. GAAP
* Client Onboarding
* Non-Profit Accounting
* Fund Accounting
* Grant Accounting
* Audit Support
* Financial Analysis

Professional Skills

* Client Relationship Management
* Project & Engagement Management
* Team Leadership & Mentoring
* Problem Solving & Decision Making
* Stakeholder Management
* Communication & Presentation Skills
* Time Management & Prioritization
* Process Improvement & Automation

Success Measures

* Timely completion of assigned engagements.
* High client satisfaction and retention.
* Accuracy and quality of financial reporting.
* Successful onboarding and transition of new clients.
* Effective management of non-profit accounting engagements.
* Team development, engagement, and productivity.
* Compliance with firm quality and regulatory standards.

This role offers an excellent opportunity for an accounting professional to develop leadership capabilities while managing diverse client engagements and contributing to the growth of the CAAS practice.

title: Accountant
description:
**Who You'll Work With**
You are someone who thrives in a high-performance environment, bringing a growth mindset and entrepreneurial spirit to tackle meaningful challenges that have a real impact.
  
  
In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we’ll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities to help you quickly broaden your expertise, grow into a well-rounded professional, and contribute to work that truly makes a difference.
  
  
When you join us, you will have:
  
  

* Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
* A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* Exceptional benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

**Your Impact**
You will work on multiple accounting areas, including financial statement preparation, month-end close, pensions, leases, M&A, etc.
  
  
You will co-own and drive defined workstreams within the firm’s financial reporting processes. Specific responsibilities may include (but are not limited to): executing defined tasks within the monthly and quarterly close process, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timeliness; helping in preparing journal entries, account reconciliations, and supporting schedules in accordance with firm policies; performing variance analysis and analytical reviews to support reliable financial reporting; assisting in maintaining documentation to support internal controls and audit requirements and support in preparation of financial reporting schedules and related documentation.
  
  
You will also monitor assigned accounts and processes to identify discrepancies, risks, or process gaps, collaborate with Controllership team members and finance partners to resolve issues in a timely manner and identify and recommend process enhancements, automation opportunities, or standardization improvements within assigned areas. You will develop proficiency in firm systems, reporting tools, and accounting policies.
  
  
Your work will help firm Controllership to accomplish its core mission of financial stewardship.
  
  
You will be based in Gurgaon as part of our firm Controllership team. This team informs the financial position of the firm to internal and external stakeholders, enables strategic decision making and stewardship of resources through principled accounting policy, and protects the firm against financial risk via strong internal controls and efficient, tech-enabled processes.
  
  
Firm Controllership is responsible for preparing quarterly and annual consolidated financial statements (with associated annual external audit), owning the month-end close process, monitoring and authoring finance policies and standards, accounting for firm-level areas (e.g., pensions, leases), and calculating firm profit for Partner bonus distribution.
  
  
**Your Qualifications and Skills**

* Professional qualification (e.g., CPA, CA) required
* 4-year degree, preferably in Finance or a related field
* 1+ years of accounting or finance experience, preferably within a professional service, corporate, or Big 4 audit environment
* Foundational knowledge of U.S. GAAP and general accounting principles
* Understanding of financial reporting processes and internal controls
* Working knowledge of financial systems and reporting tools
* Ability to independently manage responsibilities with attention to deadlines and quality
* Sound judgment in identifying issues and escalating complex matters appropriately with strong analytical and problem-solving skills for routine accounting matters
* Collaborative mindset with clear communication across teams and functions
* Strong organizational and time management skills
* High attention to detail and commitment to financial integrity
* Technical proficiency in financial systems, adopting AI and automation to enhance efficiency

title: Sr. Accountant (Project Finance Billing)
description:
At Lummus Technology, innovation thrives, and excellence is a shared pursuit. When you join Lummus, you are empowered to make an impact and be part of a dynamic team that celebrates creativity, encourages professional development, and fosters collaboration.
  
  
From our technology portfolio to our global workforce, Lummus is growing at a rapid pace, and we hope that you will grow with us during this exciting time.
  
  
The Project Finance - Billing position is responsible for the accurate and timely preparation, review, submission, and tracking of customer invoices across a range of project-based contracts. The role works closely with Project Managers, Project Finance, Accounts Receivable, Tax, Treasury, Operations, and customers to ensure billings comply with contractual requirements, supporting documentation is complete, and billing-related issues are resolved efficiently. The position also supports month-end billing close activities, reconciliations, collections visibility, and audit readiness.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Billing Administration**

* Review customer contracts, purchase orders, amendments, billing schedules, and commercial terms to identify billing milestones, invoice triggers, payment terms, tax requirements, documentation requirements, and customer-specific invoicing instructions.
* Prepare and submit customer invoices for milestone, reimbursable, work order, advance, proforma, Technical Service Agreement, catalyst, and other project-based billing arrangements.
* Coordinate with Project Managers and Operations teams to obtain supporting documentation required for invoice submission.
* Validate invoice values against approved billing schedules, change orders, reimbursable costs, contractual fee arrangements, and project records.
* Monitor invoice status from preparation through submission and customer acceptance.

**Billing Controls and Reconciliations**

* Maintain billing trackers covering invoice status, approvals, collection status, withholding tax deductions, credit notes, debit memos, and other billing-related activities.
* Perform month-end billing cut-off reviews to ensure invoices are recorded in the appropriate accounting period.
* Reconcile billing records to ERP transactions and investigate discrepancies.
* Review pending billings, unbilled milestones, reimbursable costs, and billing exceptions and communicate status and actions required for resolution.
* Support withholding tax, accounts receivable, and cash receipt reconciliations.

**Collections and Stakeholder Coordination**

* Coordinate with Accounts Receivable and Treasury teams regarding cash application, customer remittances, unapplied cash, short payments, and collection matters.
* Support resolution of customer billing disputes and invoice-related inquiries.
* Work closely with Project Finance to provide billing, collections, and working capital information supporting project financial reviews and forecasts.

**Month-End Close and Reporting**

* Support month-end billing close activities and reporting requirements.
* Prepare billing-related analyses, including billings raised, pending billings, collection status, billing risks, and open issues.
* Maintain complete and audit-ready billing documentation, including approvals, supporting calculations, customer correspondence, and contract references.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Commerce, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in project billing, contract billing, accounts receivable support, project accounting, or a related finance role.
* Experience supporting project-based businesses, preferably within engineering, technology, energy, petrochemical, industrial services, construction, or EPC environments.
* Strong understanding of contract billing, milestone billing, reimbursable cost billing, withholding taxes, accounts receivable processes, and billing reconciliations.
* Ability to interpret commercial contracts and translate billing requirements into accurate invoice packages.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with close attention to detail.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ERP systems such as JD Edwards, Oracle, SAP, or similar platforms.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.

Lummus Technology is the global leader in developing technology solutions that make modern life possible and focus on a more sustainable, low carbon future. We license process technologies in clean fuels, renewables, petrochemicals, polymers, gas processing and supply lifecycle services, catalysts, proprietary equipment and digitalization to customers worldwide.
  
  
**Lummus Technology is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**
We value diversity and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to any protected characteristic under applicable law. Applicant information will be processed in accordance with applicable privacy and data protection laws.

title: Virohan - Manager/Senior Manager - Financial Reporting & Controllership - CA
description:
**About Virohan**
Founded about a decade ago by Kunaal Dudeja, Nalin Saluja, and Archit Jayaswal, Virohan is an education-to-industry partner building the workforce powering India's healthcare future.
  
  
We partner with universities and colleges across India to deliver industry-aligned programs in Healthcare and management, helping students bridge the gap between education and real-world employability.
  
  
At Virohan, we believe healthcare education needs to go beyond classrooms.
  
  
Our model combines academic learning with hands-on industry exposure and strong healthcare partnerships, ensuring students are prepared for real roles.
  
  
Today, Virohan has trained 13,000+ healthcare professionals, with a growing network of university and industry partners across the country.
  
  
Backed by global investors including Blume Ventures (India), Mynavi Corporation (Japan), Rebright Partners (Japan), Elea Foundation (Switzerland), Artha Impact (Switzerland), Bharat Inclusive Technologies Seed Fund (India), and Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Venture Capital (Japan), we are building at the intersection of education and healthcare-two of India's fastest-growing sectors.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
This role owns the controllership and financial reporting engine of a business that collects fees from thousands of students across 20+ campuses and settles revenue with university partners under collaboration agreements.
  
  
It is a high-ownership seat: you will report directly to the CFO, hold the statutory and control agenda end-to-end, and lead a team of four.
  
  
What makes this role distinctive.
  
  
Virohan's finance function is deliberately lean and supported by established outsourced partners for transaction processing, GST and TDS.
  
  
This role is therefore designed as an owner of the control framework and a manager of providers-not a preparer of entries.
  
  
You will spend your time on judgement, controls, audit and reporting quality rather than on volume processing.
  
  
You will also have direct exposure to the Board, investors and lenders through the CFO.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
To own statutory accounting, the monthly close, audit, taxation, compliance and the control environment for Virohan-producing reporting the Board, investors, lenders and auditors can rely on, and building the control maturity appropriate to a company.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own monthly, quarterly and annual financial close, ensuring timely and accurate reporting.
* Lead statutory financial statements, provisions, reconciliations, revenue recognition and accounting accuracy.
* Prepare MIS and lender/investor reporting in partnership with the CFO.
* Design and own the internal control framework across P2P, O2C, payroll, treasury and reporting.
* Establish segregation of duties, approval matrices, maker-checker controls and risk mitigation mechanisms.
* Own IFC/ICFR, statutory audits, related-party reporting and closure of audit observations.
* Support fundraising diligence and maintain robust finance documentation and control testing.
* Own GST, TDS, RCM, 15CA/CB and other direct/indirect tax compliance.
* Manage tax notices, statutory filings and compliance calendars with zero-default accountability.
* Review tax-related clauses in partner and vendor contracts.
* Own end-to-end payroll finance, including validation, disbursement, reconciliation and accounting.
* Ensure compliance with PF, ESIC, PT, LWF, gratuity, TDS and applicable labour laws across locations.
* Strengthen payroll controls and partner with HR on payroll policies and statutory changes.
* Own student fee receivables, ageing, collections and cash conversion across campuses.
* Lead university partner settlements, reconciliations and dispute resolution.
* Oversee revenue accruals, discounts, refunds, scholarships and dropout accounting.
* Drive DSO reduction and strengthen controls around collections and reconciliations.
* Own the end-to-end procure-to-pay cycle, including vendor onboarding, invoice processing, payments and reconciliations.
* Ensure vendor master integrity, approval controls, TDS/GST compliance and timely provisioning.
* Manage fixed assets and drive payment discipline and working capital efficiency.
* Own treasury operations, banking relationships and daily bank reconciliations.
* Drive cash-flow forecasting, liquidity visibility and banking/payment controls.
* Support lender and covenant reporting.
* Lead and develop a team of four across AP, AR & Collections and Controllership.
* Manage outsourced accounting, tax, payroll and audit partners.
* Own finance systems including Zoho Books, Zoho Analytics and Keka.
* Standardise processes and build a scalable, well-documented finance Chartered Accountant with 3-8 years of post-qualification experience.
* Has personally run a monthly close within the last three years-this is a hands-on leadership role, not a purely supervisory one.
* Has owned a statutory audit end-to-end as the company-side lead.
* Strong working command of Indian GAAP, GST, TDS and Companies Act compliance.
* Has designed or substantially rebuilt an internal control framework-not merely operated within one someone else built.
* Working knowledge of payroll statutory compliance (PF, ESIC, PT, gratuity) and Indian labour law as it applies to a multi-state workforce.
* Experience managing outsourced finance or tax providers.
* Has managed a team of three or more.
* Comfortable operating with limited structure and building process where none exists.

title: Senior Specialist, Strategy Pricing & Interchange
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
****Title And Summary****
Senior Specialist, Strategy Pricing & Interchange
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
Mastercard is seeking a highly analytical and commercially minded professional to join the RAISE Value Quantification team within Strategy Pricing & Interchange. This role will help shape how Mastercard translates product, service, and customer value into scalable pricing strategies, business cases, and decision-ready analytics.
  
  
The ideal candidate will bring strong experience in predictive modeling, machine learning, pricing analytics, and data science, combined with the ability to influence commercial decisions. The role partners closely with Product, Pricing, Commercialization, Data Science, and regional teams to build value-based pricing models, quantify customer impact, and support growth-oriented pricing decisions across Mastercard.
  
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Predictive Modeling and Explainability
* Design and build predictive models that quantify the economic, operational, and customer value of Mastercard products and services.
* Measure revenue, cost savings, efficiency, risk reduction, and customer impact to inform pricing and commercialization decisions.
* Translate model outputs into clear value stories, commercial insights, and business cases.
* Pricing Analytics & Modeling
* Develop value-based B2B pricing models, commercial frameworks, and analytical tools that support product pricing and go-to-market strategy.
* Estimate adoption, revenue impact, customer economics, churn elasticity, and outcome-based scenarios.
* Run pricing scenarios and sensitivity analyses to guide strategic trade-offs and executive decision-making.
* Machine Learning & Advanced Analytics
* Apply machine learning, statistical techniques, and advanced analytics to identify pricing opportunities, customer value drivers, and performance trends.
* Analyze large datasets and prepare structured inputs for predictive modeling.
* Build forecasts and analytical outputs that support pricing strategy, product planning, and performance management.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
**Qualifications**
Education
  
  

* Master's degree in quantitative fields such as Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Finance, Mathematics, Computer Science, or Operations Research.

Must-Have Experience
  
  

* 6-8 years of experience in data science and pricing analytics with demonstrated experience building predictive models, pricing models, business case frameworks, or value quantification methodologies.
* Proven ability to analyze large, complex datasets and convert analytical findings into business recommendations.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to commercial and senior stakeholder audiences.

Must-Have Technical Skills
  
  

* Strong working knowledge of predictive modeling, machine learning, forecasting, statistics, and model explainability.
* Proficiency in Python, including Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, and Statsmodels.
* Advanced SQL skills for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.

Must-Have Business & Pricing Skills
  
  

* Experience with pricing elasticity, revenue optimization, customer economics, financial modeling, or commercial strategy.
* Understanding of value-based pricing principles and how analytical insights inform commercial decision-making.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to link data, insights, and business impact.

Must-Have Professional Skills
  
  

* Excellent communication, storytelling, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior leaders.
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
* Curiosity, learning agility, and innovation mindset.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in payments, fintech, banking, SaaS, consulting, or other data-rich commercial environments.
* Advanced Excel skills, including financial modeling, Power Query, and analytical modeling.
* Experience with visualization tools, dashboarding, or application development.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
Why Join Us
  
  
This is an opportunity to join Mastercard's Strategy Pricing & Interchange team in a high-impact role that combines advanced analytics, pricing strategy, and commercial influence.
  
  
Strategic Impact
  
  
Shape value-based pricing strategies that influence product decisions, customer economics, and commercialization outcomes across Mastercard. You will use data science, machine learning, and predictive modeling to solve complex commercial challenges using rich payments data.
  
  
Collaborative Culture
  
  
Work across Pricing, Product, Commercialization, Data Science, and regional teams in a culture that values curiosity, collaboration, analytical rigor, and continuous learning.
  
  
Career Growth
  
  
Gain exposure to global stakeholders, senior leaders, and high-visibility initiatives while building deep expertise in pricing strategy, value quantification, and advanced analytics.
  
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
Why Mastercard
  
  
At Mastercard, we're more than a global payments technology company. We're a community of thinkers, builders, and innovators committed to powering economies and empowering people. We foster a culture of curiosity, collaboration, and inclusion, where every idea can create impact.
  
  
Whether you are developing next-generation pricing models, applying machine learning to commercial challenges, or influencing strategic decisions through analytics, you will have the opportunity, support, and resources to grow your career while making a meaningful difference.
  
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Come With An Inherent Risk To The Organization. Therefore, Every Person Working For Or On Behalf Of Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices.
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of information being accessed.

* Complete all mandatory security and compliance training in accordance with Mastercard guidelines.

Starke Aquacare Technologies is an Indian manufacturer and supplier of water treatment filtration media, serving domestic and international markets.

Maintain accurate daily accounting entries in Tally.

Manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, and general ledger.

2. Quarterly Profit & Loss & Financial Reporting

Prepare quarterly Profit & Loss (P&L) statements.

Calculate gross profit, operating expenses, and net profitability.

Prepare Balance Sheets and financial summaries for management review.

Reconcile inventory, purchases, sales, and expenses before quarterly closing.

Analyze quarterly financial performance and identify significant variations.

3. Advance Income Tax & TDS

Calculate estimated annual taxable income based on quarterly financial results.

Prepare quarterly advance income tax calculations and coordinate timely payments.

Maintain TDS deductions, payments, returns, and reconciliations.

Coordinate with the Chartered Accountant for income tax compliance and annual finalization.

4. GST Compliance

Prepare and file GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B within prescribed deadlines.

Reconcile GSTR-2B with purchase records and input tax credit.

Maintain GST records for domestic and export transactions.

Assist in annual GST reconciliation and return filing.

Ensure proper GST treatment of sales, purchases, and expenses.

5. Export & Domestic Sales Accounting

Prepare domestic and export sales invoices.

Generate e-way bills and applicable e-invoices.

Maintain export-related accounting records and documentation.

Coordinate with banks for export document submission and e-BRC-related requirements.

Reconcile export customer payments and outstanding receivables.

6. Inventory, Payroll & Other Responsibilities

Perform daily stock reconciliation through the Inventory Management System (IMS).

Verify factory, godown, labour, and transporter bills.

Prepare monthly salary sheets based on attendance, overtime, and deductions.

Maintain monthly accounting checklists and financial documentation.

Assist with GeM tender submissions and other accounting-related administrative tasks.

Required Qualifications & Skills

B.Com / M.Com / CA Inter preferred.

Minimum 3 years of practical accounting experience.

Strong proficiency in Tally Prime, Microsoft Excel, and Google Sheets.

Hands-on experience with GST returns, TDS, and income tax compliance.

Practical knowledge of quarterly P&L preparation and advance income tax calculation is essential.

Experience preparing Balance Sheets and reconciling financial statements.

Familiarity with export accounting and documentation will be an added advantage.

Ability to independently manage accounting deadlines with minimal supervision.

Who Should Apply?

We are particularly interested in candidates who:

✓ Can independently manage company accounts in Tally.

✓ Have personally handled GST and TDS compliance.

✓ Can prepare and explain quarterly P&L statements.

✓ Understand advance income tax calculations and payment deadlines.

✓ Are accurate, organized, responsible, and deadline-oriented.

✓ Have experience working with manufacturing, trading, or export companies.

How to Apply

Interested candidates may apply through LinkedIn or share their updated resume with Starke Aquacare Technologies.

Please mention your current salary, expected salary, notice period, and experience with Tally, GST, P&L reporting, and advance tax calculations.

* Market intelligence. Monitor regulation, taxation, industrial policy, macroeconomics, consumer demand, OEM strategy, new-model activity, electrification and competitive developments across the region.

* Education. Bachelor's or master's degree in economics, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Statistics or a related discipline.
* Experience. Approximately 1-5 years in automotive research, market intelligence, forecasting, consulting, data analytics or a closely related role. Strong candidates with transferable experience are also encouraged to apply.
* Regional expertise. Good understanding of the Indian automotive market and the factors shaping vehicle demand. Exposure to one or more ASEAN markets is a strong advantage.

title: Senior Capital Specialist
description:
Gurgaon, Haryana, India
  
  
AXA XL is the Property & Casualty risk division of AXA, created from the acquisition of XL Catlin in 2018. We partner with mid-sized to multinational clients to take their business further, with more than 30 lines of business to offer solutions for existing and emerging risks. With 9,000+ colleagues based in approximately 30 countries; we can serve clients in more than 200 countries. The key purpose of this role is to support the SDL Actuarial Risk in ensuring that the risk profile of AXA XL Division is adequately modelled and communicated via an internal capital model that reflects the SII and BMA standards.
  
  
**What You’ll Be DOING**
What will your essential responsibilities include?
  
  
**Capital Modelling**

* Lead elements of the calibration, running, maintenance, development and validation of the Internal Model across AXA UK (Health, Personal Lines & Commercial lines). The principal tool used is ReMetrica.
* Review model code and make amendments as necessary.
* Manage receipt of actual, forecast and planning data for capital modelling and communicate with stakeholders to ensure consistency of use.
* Review and justify appropriateness of model inputs and outputs.
* Run analysis of change, investigating and justifying results.
* Contribute materially to Solvency Data Quality reporting, ensuring standards are met, and be a role model for embedding a control framework.
* Drive development and maintenance of the Internal model to ensure compliance with the risk measurement requirements evolving within local regulatory rules.
* Lead elements of model use, facing into the business.
* Ownership and execution of critical processes including Standard Formulae/STEC Projections/Risk Margin calculations.
* Participate and contribute to group working parties and develop appropriate model evolution plans for implementation.
* Assist in meeting regulatory and other requirements to secure ongoing approval for the AXA UK components of the internal model used for capital assessment.
* Respond to queries or ad hoc investigations regarding the capital or underlying risk position of AXA UK.
* Provide information and field questions relating to all parts of the model on a tactical basis.

**Risk Management**
**Requirements**
Contribute to the effective implementation of the risk-management system, focusing on the risk modelling that underpins the calculation of the capital requirements and to the Own Risk and Solvency Assessment (ORSA). Specifically, this involves:
  
  

* Ensure an effective insurance risk management system which complies with Group and Local policy requirements and those of the regulator.
* Leading parts of the capital assessment process – see above.
* Provision of capital modelling output to support actuarial analyses and risk second opinions.
* Driving development and embedding of capital related Insurance and Health risk appetites within AXA UK.
* Ensure compliance with relevant policies.

**Reinsurance Arrangements**

* Contribute to the annual reinsurance review process by assessing the impact of reinsurance on capital, supporting the Actuarial Function team (Deputy Chief Actuary and Senior Catastrophe Risk and Reinsurance Manager) to perform analysis determining whether risk transfer arrangements are efficient and optimal.

**Actuarial Research and Development**

* Drive delivery of appropriate actuarial analysis and research to support business goals and drive strategy as may be requested from time to time.
* Collaborate with other colleagues in the wider UK Capital Team & Actuarial Function on latest developments.

**Internal Financial Control (IFC), Internal Model Review (IMR) and External Validation**

* Internal Financial Control (IFC), Internal Model Review (IMR) and External Validation , ensure processes and controls are undertaken and evidenced appropriately in a timely manner.

You will report to Vice President, Group Services.
  
  
**What You Will BRING**
We’re looking for someone who has these abilities and skills:
  
  
**Required Skills And Abilities**

* Qualified or nearly qualified Actuary.
* Track record in capital modelling is desirable otherwise experience in Reserving or Pricing roles in P&C business.
* Curious, inquisitive, innovative and open to new ideas.
* A self-starter with outstanding organizational skills, and ability to work in multi-geography team.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Highly numerate and analytical with robust academic record and ability to solve complex problems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Python and R coding skills beneficial.
* Ability to work self supportedly on key areas of responsibility, with only peer review required.
* Ability to use expert judgment to check and validate technical results.
* Ability to work across functional teams.

**Desired Skills And Abilities**

* Strategic mindset, balancing excellent attention to detail with the big picture.
* Knowledge of ReMetrica beneficial but not essential.
* Willingness to learn and take on tasks outside areas of prior experience.
* Knowledge of accounting concepts for GAAP/IFRS is beneficial.
* Knowledge of solvency balance sheet is beneficial.
* Experience of working for a general insurer or health insurer.
* Knowledge of reserving and / or pricing, which is beneficial to capital modelling decisions.

**Who WE are**
AXA XL, the P&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. For mid-sized companies, multinationals and even some inspirational individuals we don’t just provide re/insurance, we reinvent it.
  
  
How? By combining a comprehensive and efficient capital platform, data-driven insights, leading technology, and the best talent in an agile and inclusive workspace, empowered to deliver top client service across all our lines of business − property, casualty, professional, financial lines and specialty.
  
  
With an innovative and flexible approach to risk solutions, we partner with those who move the world forward.
  
  
Learn more at axaxl.com
  
  
**What we OFFER**
**Inclusion**
AXA XL is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic. At AXA XL, we know that an inclusive culture and enables business growth and is critical to our success. That’s why we have made a strategic commitment to attract, develop, advance and retain the most inclusive workforce possible, and create a culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work and reach their highest potential.
*It’s about helping one another — and our business — to move forward and succeed.*

* Five Business Resource Groups focused on gender, LGBTQ+, ethnicity and origins, disability and inclusion with 20 Chapters around the globe.
* Robust support for Flexible Working Arrangements
* Enhanced family-friendly leave benefits
* Named to the Diversity Best Practices Index
* Signatory to the UK Women in Finance Charter

Learn more at axaxl.com/about-us/inclusion-and-diversity. AXA XL is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
  
  
**Total Rewards**
AXA XL’s Reward program is designed to take care of what matters most to you, covering the full picture of your health, wellbeing, lifestyle and financial security. It provides competitive compensation and personalized, inclusive benefits that evolve as you do.
  
  
We’re committed to rewarding your contribution for the long term, so you can be your best self today and look forward to the future with confidence.
  
  
**Sustainability**
At AXA XL, Sustainability is integral to our business strategy. In an ever-changing world, AXA XL protects what matters most for our clients and communities. We know that sustainability is at the root of a more resilient future. Our 2023-26 Sustainability strategy, called “Roots of resilience”, focuses on protecting natural ecosystems, addressing climate change, and embedding sustainable practices across our operations.
  
  
**Our Pillars**

* Valuing nature: How we impact nature affects how nature impacts us. Resilient ecosystems - the foundation of a sustainable planet and society – are essential to our future. We’re committed to protecting and restoring nature – from mangrove forests to the bees in our backyard – by increasing biodiversity awareness and inspiring clients and colleagues to put nature at the heart of their plans.
* Addressing climate change: The effects of a changing climate are far-reaching and significant. Unpredictable weather, increasing temperatures, and rising sea levels cause both social inequalities and environmental disruption. We're building a net zero strategy, developing insurance products and services, and mobilizing to advance thought leadership and investment in societal-led solutions.
* Integrating ESG: All companies have a role to play in building a more resilient future. Incorporating ESG considerations into our internal processes and practices builds resilience from the roots of our business. We’re training our colleagues, engaging our external partners, and evolving our sustainability governance and reporting.
* AXA Hearts in Action: We have established volunteering and charitable giving programs to help colleagues support causes that matter most to them, known as AXA XL’s “Hearts in Action” programs. These include our Matching Gifts program, Volunteering Leave, and our annual volunteering day – the Global Day of Giving.

For more information, please see axaxl.com/sustainability.

title: Ecommerce Specialist
description:
Brand Head / E-commerce Growth Manager – Ecomhub24

**Company:**
FlixooLive – Ecomhub24

**Location:**
Kolkata

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

About Ecomhub24

**Ecomhub24 is the e-commerce enablement and brand-scaling division of FlixooLive.**

We partner with consumer brands to launch, manage and scale their businesses across
**Myntra, Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, Ajio and other digital marketplaces**
.

Our ecosystem combines marketplace management, cataloguing, pricing, advertising, inventory planning, warehousing, fulfilment, analytics and growth strategy.

Our vision is to build and manage a portfolio capable of generating
**10,000+ orders per day**
.

The Role

We are looking for a
**Brand Head / E-commerce Growth Manager**
who can take complete ownership of the growth and performance of brands managed by Ecomhub24.

This is not just an account-management role. We want someone who can
**think like a business owner**
, understand numbers, identify growth opportunities and build systems that can scale brands profitably.

Key Responsibilities

* Own the
  **monthly growth and overall performance**
  of assigned brands.
* Manage brands across multiple marketplaces and categories.
* Develop and maintain
  **brand-wise, marketplace-wise and SKU-wise P&L sheets**
  .
* Build effective
  **inventory planning, replenishment and stock management systems**
  .
* Develop
  **pricing, discounting, margin and promotional strategies**
  .
* Establish listing and cataloguing guidelines for different marketplaces.
* Monitor and improve product listings, content, keywords, images and marketplace compliance.
* Plan and optimise
  **marketplace advertising campaigns**
  .
* Track ROAS, ACOS, contribution margins and advertising profitability.
* Analyse sales, returns, cancellations, inventory ageing and SKU-level profitability.
* Identify
  **hero products, underperforming SKUs and new growth opportunities**
  .
* Coordinate with cataloguing, warehouse, operations, advertising and marketplace teams.
* Develop and maintain
  **SOPs, dashboards and reporting systems**
  .
* Conduct weekly and monthly brand performance reviews.
* Maintain proactive communication with partner brands.
* Ensure partner brands receive transparent reporting, actionable growth plans and strong operational support.
* Take ownership of
  **partner satisfaction, retention and monthly growth**
  .

What Success Looks Like

Over the first
**6 months**
, the objective will be to create the systems, strategies and execution capability required to scale selected existing brands towards approximately
**100–500 orders per day**
, depending on category, inventory and marketplace potential.

The larger Ecomhub24 mission is to build a diversified brand portfolio capable of generating
**10,000 orders per day**
.

Who Should Apply?

We are looking for candidates with hands-on experience in:

* E-commerce marketplace management
* Brand/account management
* Marketplace advertising
* Inventory planning
* Pricing and profitability
* P&L management
* Cataloguing and listings
* Sales analytics and reporting
* Marketplace operations

Experience in
**fashion, apparel, kidswear, lifestyle or consumer categories**
will be preferred.

You should be
**analytical, commercially minded, execution-driven and comfortable taking ownership of numbers and business outcomes**
.

Why Ecomhub24?

We are currently building Ecomhub24 into a large-scale e-commerce growth and fulfilment ecosystem.

This role offers an opportunity to work directly on multiple brands, build processes from the ground up and grow into a larger
**leadership position**
as Ecomhub24 expands.

We are particularly interested in people who have experience
**scaling brands rather than simply maintaining marketplace accounts**
.

Apply

Please apply through LinkedIn with your updated CV and mention:

**Current CTC | Expected CTC | Notice Period | Current Location | Marketplaces Managed | Largest Brand/Account Managed | Highest Monthly Orders/GMV Managed**

**Ecomhub24 — E-commerce Enablement & Brand Scaling Division of FlixooLive**

title: Sr. Finance Specialist (L07)
description:
**Role Title: Sr. Finance Specialist (L07)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
Controllership organization within Finance COE responsible to monitor day-to-day accounting activities involved in Synchrony business. Controllership mostly covers Cash Accounting, general accounting, client accounting, reconciliations, closing & reporting, system maintenance, governance related sub-processes. Every process contributes to our quarterly & annual financial close process and ensure that we have accurate external reporting.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
This role will support Cash Accounting processes including daily balancing of customer related payment activity, disbursements, month-end close, and month-end reconciliations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Detailed knowledge of process flow of assigned accounts and Blackline balancing procedures
* Completion of daily balancing/tasks for all assigned accounts and monitoring of aged items in accordance with assigned thresholds
* Research/follow up on all reconciling items for assigned accounts with strong root cause/action plans documented.
* Process improvement ideas for assigned accounts and implementation of small scope improvements
* Completion of month-end responsibilities including journal entry preparation and reconciliations in accordance with SYF standards
* Support of Governance initiatives including job aid preparation, updates, and testing
* Support adhoc reporting requests
* Other duties as assigned

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting or Finance with 1-2 years of accounting experience or in lieu of a degree 3-4 years of accounting experience
* 1-2 years of GL/ Balance sheet reconciliation
* Excellent communication skills – both oral and written

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting or Finance with 1-2 years of accounting experience or in lieu of a degree 3-4 years of accounting experience

**Desired Characteristics**

* Excellent analytical and problem solving skills
* Software Skills (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
* Excellent organization and follow up skills
* Ability to execute in a fluctuating environment
* Demonstrated commitment to quality and customer service
* Experience with reconciliation systems (Blackline)
* Experience with Treasury systems
* Experience with Oracle
* Prior banking experience

**Work Timings:**
**4:00 PM to 1:00 AM IST**
This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with Asia and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs). We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hub or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.
