title: Risk Consulting - Actuarial - IFRS17 Life - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role Name And Description**
**Senior, Life Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**
Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Senior to join our Life Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
  
  
Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team, the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Senior Consultant, you will:
  
  

* Responsible for delivering high quality results and generating effective and impactful solutions
* Provide focused solutions and training to Staff members
* Be responsible for ensuring all engagement are delivered within time
* Deliver engagements in line with our values and commitment to quality, consistently driving projects to completion and ensuring that work is of high standard

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Good analytical skills

* Zelfstandig samenstellen van (complexere) jaarrekeningen en tussentijdse cijfers.

title: Senior Principal Consultant – TSU Manager (Team Leader)
description:
SkyQuest is seeking a senior programme leader to manage a 24-month technical assistance programme supporting a national agricultural development finance institution in Nigeria. The programme aims to strengthen the Institution’s ability to mobilise and deploy capital to agricultural enterprises and organisations serving smallholder farmers, particularly women and underserved producers.

About the role

The TSU Manager will lead a multidisciplinary Technical Support Unit (TSU) and act as the central integration point between the Institution’s CEO and executive management, the funding partner and specialist teams. The role is accountable for programme governance, strategic coherence, executive and Board engagement, delivery oversight and the quality of programme deliverables.

Key responsibilities

* Lead programme governance, integrated planning, decision-making, escalation, risk and issue management, and formal phase-gate reviews.
* Manage a multidisciplinary team of specialist leads; set accountabilities, allocate work, monitor delivery and review all deliverables before submission.
* Serve as the principal counterpart to the Institution’s CEO and executive management and the primary point of contact for the funding partner.
* Lead executive validation sessions, strategic reviews and Board presentations, subject to CEO approval.
* Direct the institutional diagnostic, maturity assessment, prioritisation process and development of a resourced implementation plan.
* Integrate specialist work across agricultural finance and credit risk, technology and data, agribusiness investment readiness, blended-finance capital mobilisation and climate finance.
* Oversee design and testing of a multi-source financing facility, including capital structure, blended-capital architecture, financing documentation and mobilisation strategy.
* Ensure pilots are evidence-based, evaluated and refined, with clear benefits for organisations serving smallholder farmers.
* Lead programme performance management, monitoring, evaluation and learning (MEL), quarterly reviews and the formal mid-term review.
* Oversee institutionalisation, capability transfer and handover of validated policies, tools, models, SOPs and operating arrangements to named Institution owners.

Qualifications and experience

**Education:**
Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Agricultural Economics, Development Studies, Business Administration or a related field. CFA, ACCA, ICAN, PMP/PRINCE2 or equivalent is an advantage.

· 16+ years in development finance, agricultural finance, financial-institution advisory or large technical assistance programmes.

·       Substantial hands-on experience in agricultural lending and agri-finance, including credit appraisal, risk assessment and portfolio management.

· At least 8 years leading multidisciplinary teams on complex, multi-stakeholder programmes as Team Leader, Programme Director or equivalent.

· Experience advising CEOs, executive committees and Boards of banks, DFIs or public financial institutions.

· Track record leading assignments for development partners such as the World Bank Group, AfDB, FCDO, major philanthropic foundations or similar.

· Proven delivery of institutional transformation programmes that were successfully handed over to the client institution.

· Strong programme governance, integrated planning, dependency and risk management, and results-based management skills.

· Sound understanding of DFI operating models and blended-finance instruments.

**Desirable:**
Experience with Nigerian or Sub-Saharan African DFIs; facility or fund design; investor or lender engagement; MEL; gender-inclusive finance; and smallholder-focused impact measurement. Hausa, Yoruba or Igbo is an advantage.

description:

* Cluster Business Ownership
* Deliver new-to-bank current-account acquisition, account activation, average quarterly balance growth, transaction throughput and fee-income targets for the cluster.
* Build and execute a catchment-led acquisition strategy for high-potential business segments such as wholesalers, distributors, manufacturers, traders, schools, hospitals, clinics, professional firms and service establishments.
* Translate cluster targets into branch-, team- and individual-level productivity plans.
* Own the current-account business plan, sales funnel, conversion pipeline and weekly performance rhythm.
* Improve portfolio quality by prioritising transaction-active, balance-building and cross-sell-ready relationships over dormant or low-value acquisition.

* Sales Leadership and Channel Execution
* Lead, coach and motivate a field-sales organisation to consistently deliver acquisition and value-build targets.
* Establish a disciplined sales cadence covering joint calls, market visits, lead reviews, branch huddles, pipeline reviews and conversion tracking.
* Ensure each relationship manager follows a profile-based sales approach rather than a generic product pitch.
* Develop market intelligence on competitor propositions, local business clusters, referral sources and emerging commercial hubs.
* Build productive referral ecosystems with Chartered Accountants, trade associations, market intermediaries, merchant networks, developers, institutional administrators and existing clients.

* Current-Account Activation and Value Build-Up
* Ensure newly acquired accounts become transaction-active within defined activation timelines.
* Drive operating balances, inward credits, collections, payment activity and digital banking adoption.
* Track early-warning indicators including low funding, non-activation, declining balances, low transaction velocity and potential attrition.
* Build strategies to migrate primary transaction flows—collections, vendor payments, payroll, taxes and operating cash—to the bank.
* Improve account quality by monitoring average balance, debit transactions, credit transactions and account profitability.

* Solution-Led Cross-Sell
* Use the current account as the primary operating hub for business clients and identify the appropriate product solution based on the customer’s business model.
* Drive adoption of corporate internet banking and mobile approvals; cash management and bulk payment solutions; POS, Android POS, QR and Soundbox; sweep-in / sweep-out or FFD structures; debit cards; collections and transaction banking solutions; and promoter, family, wealth and premium savings propositions.
* Partner with product teams to convert business pain points into integrated propositions—for example, POS for collections, Internet Banking for payment controls, FFD for temporary balances and Aspire/premium banking for promoter wallet deepening.

* Customer Relationship and Service Governance
* Build senior-level relationships with anchor clients and participate in strategic joint calls for high-value prospects.
* Ensure timely resolution of onboarding, account-opening, transaction, service and digital-banking issues.
* Work with branches and operations teams to reduce turnaround time, improve onboarding quality and strengthen client experience.
* Review top customers and at-risk accounts regularly to protect balances, transactions and wallet share.
* Drive customer retention through proactive engagement, problem solving and relevant product deepening.

* Risk, Compliance and Portfolio Quality
* Ensure all sourcing, onboarding and account activation follows internal policies and applicable KYC, AML, fraud-risk and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain high standards of customer due diligence, documentation quality, source-of-funds understanding and business-profile validation.
* Monitor exceptions, unusual transaction behaviour, documentation gaps and operational risks; escalate promptly where needed.
* Build a culture of right-first-time acquisition, with no compromise on compliance for target achievement.

* People Leadership
* Recruit, develop, retain and performance-manage a high-quality current-account sales team.
* Set clear scorecards covering acquisition, activation, AQB/AMB, transaction activity, fee income, cross-sell, productivity, service quality and compliance.
* Conduct structured coaching through joint market visits, call observations, weekly reviews and capability-building sessions.
* Identify skill gaps and develop targeted interventions around sales planning, segment understanding, solution selling, digital banking and compliance.
* Maintain a strong talent pipeline and manage attrition proactively.

title: Data Privacy Specialist
description:
**About ComplyDP**

ComplyDP is a lawyer-led privacy compliance company helping Indian businesses meet the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the DPDP Rules, 2025. We combine a compliance platform with hands-on legal advisory, and work with clients ranging from high-growth startups to SEBI-regulated financial services groups and large manufacturing enterprises. We are a small, fast-moving team in Bengaluru where legal and engineering sit side by side.

**The Role**

**We are hiring Privacy Lawyer to lead DPDP engagements for our enterprise clients end to end. You will own the legal side of each engagement, from gap assessment to remediation, front client conversations with general counsel and compliance heads, and work directly with our engineering team to turn legal obligations into product logic. This is a builder’s role: you will shape how ComplyDP delivers privacy compliance at scale.**

**What you will do**

* Lead DPDP gap assessments and remediation plans for enterprise clients, including multi-entity groups
* Draft and review privacy notices, consent language, data processing agreements, vendor and processor clauses, and internal policies
* Map processing activities and identify legitimate uses, consent requirements and cross-border transfer considerations
* Design and own DPR (Data Principal Request) and personal data breach response playbooks for each client
* Work with engineering to encode DPDP obligations into the ComplyDP platform
* Track regulatory developments under DPDP and sectoral overlaps (SEBI, RBI, IFSCA) and update client advice
* Support sales on legal questions during client scoping
* Review work of and mentor junior associates as the team grows

**What we are looking for**

* 4 to 8 years of experience in corporate advisory, regulatory or in-house legal roles (not purely litigation)
* Strong working knowledge of the DPDP Act and Rules: consent and notice, legitimate uses, Significant Data Fiduciary obligations, DPR timelines and breach reporting
* Excellent drafting skills and the confidence to lead calls with senior client stakeholders
* Comfort working with technical teams and reading data flows

**Good to have**

* Experience with BFSI or capital markets clients, or regulatory exposure to SEBI, RBI or IFSCA
* GDPR or cross-border data transfer experience
* In-house privacy experience at a tech or fintech company, or time in a Big 4 privacy or risk practice
* CIPP/E, CIPP/A or a similar certification (we will support you in getting one)

**Why join**

* Lead real enterprise engagements from day one, not just research memos
* Build at the intersection of law and technology in one of the most important new areas of Indian regulation
* Work directly with the founders, both with legal and product backgrounds
* Competitive compensation, plus support for certifications and professional development

**Location:**
Bengaluru, with travel to client sites in Mumbai and Delhi as needed

* **Hiring process:**
  Intro call, a short paid drafting exercise reviewing a privacy notice against DPDP, then a conversation with the founders.

title: Intellectual Property Specialist
description:
**About Us:**

Exide Energy Solutions Limited is a wholly owned Subsidiary of Exide Industries Limited, leading battery manufacturing and distribution company in India with annual revenues of $1.8+ Bn. Exide Energy Solutions Limited is investing $500+ Mn dollars to setup India’s first Giga plant to manufacture Lithium-Ion Cells at Devanahalli Industrial Area in Bengaluru. Exide is also deeply invested in further developing li-ion technology with significant R&D investments including setup of in-house team as well as necessary lab infrastructure to support development activities.

**Job Summary:**

An Intellectual Property (IP) Specialist is responsible for protecting, managing, and maximizing the value of an organization's intellectual assets, including patents, trademarks, copyrights, trade secrets, and technology innovations. The role involves coordinating invention disclosures, conducting patent and prior-art searches, supporting patent filing and prosecution activities, monitoring IP portfolios, and ensuring compliance with intellectual property laws and regulations.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **IP Portfolio Management:**
  Oversee filings, renewals, maintenance, and recordals for patents and trademarks.
* **Search & Analysis:**
  Conduct Freedom-to-Operate (FTO) searches, patentability assessments, prior-art analysis, and competitive landscape studies.
* **Drafting & Prosecution:**
  Assist in drafting patent applications, handling office actions, and coordinating with patent/trademark offices or external counsel.
* **Risk & Infringement Monitoring:**
  Identify potential IP infringements, support litigation preparation, and build risk mitigation or design-around strategies.
* **Commercialization & Contracts:**
  Support IP licensing agreements, due diligence for mergers and acquisitions (M&A), and technology-transfer discussions.

**Technical and Legal Knowledge**

* **IP Law:**
  In-depth understanding of statutory frameworks for patents, trademarks, industrial designs, and copyrights.
* **Technical/Scientific Acumen:**
  Ability to comprehend complex engineering, software, or scientific innovations to draft or review patent claims.
* **Filing and Registration:**
  Proficiency in preparing, submitting, and managing applications with national or international IP offices.
* **Prior Art & Landscape Searches:**
  Skill in conducting comprehensive prior art searches, patent landscaping, and freedom-to-operate analyses.

**Analytical and Investigative Skills**

* **IP Due Diligence:**
  Evaluating the strength, validity, and risks of an IP portfolio during mergers, acquisitions, or investments.
* **Infringement Detection:**
  Monitoring markets, competitor output, and online spaces to spot unauthorized use or counterfeiting.
* **Damage and Valuation Assessment:**
  Assisting in calculating infringement damages and understanding the commercial/financial valuation of IP assets.

**Communication and Documentation**

* **Drafting Contracts:**
  Experience writing and reviewing licensing agreements, non-disclosure agreements (NDAs), technology transfer contracts, and assignment deeds.
* **Translating Complexity:**
  Skill in distilling dense legal or technical language into clear, actionable advice for business leaders and inventors.
* **Creative and Technical Writing:**
  Precision in drafting formal objections, responses to examination reports, and educational content.

**Strategic and Management Competencies**

* **Portfolio Management:**
  Aligning an organization’s IP assets with its long-term business and branding goals.
* **Dispute Resolution Support:**
  Assisting legal counsel with litigation prep, gathering evidence, handling oppositions, or negotiating settlements and coexistence agreements.

**Behavioural Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication and presentation abilities.
* Team-oriented with a collaborative mindset.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced R&D and manufacturing environment.
* Strong focus on quality.

**Education:**

Bachelor’s or advanced degree in a specialized technical domain (Engineering, IT/Software) or Law (LLB /LL.M / IPR Diploma).

**Experience:**
5+Years

title: Enterprise Talent - Risk, Governance, Vendor Management Lead
description:
**Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 62 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
**Enterprise Talent - Risk, Governance, Vendor Management Lead**
**Location- Bangalore and Hyderabad**
**Role Overview**

* The Enterprise Talent Risk, Governance and Vendor Management Lead is responsible for setting and owning Enterprise Talent policies and for overseeing end-to-end risk management, governance, compliance and vendor management both in our BAU (Business as usual) operation and our continuous Change and Transformation agenda. This includes oversight of any global externally contracted recruitment delivery models and contingent workforce engagement channels (e.g. Recruitment Process Outsourcing, Resource Augmentation, Contingent worker Managed Service).
* Operating as the second line of defense for Enterprise Talent (ET), the role ensures the right governance and approvals are in place for change initiatives and consistently followed thereafter, meeting internal control standards, internal and external audit and assurance requirements, data privacy obligations, and applicable local labour laws and regulatory requirements—while keeping governance proportionate so it supports, rather than detracts from our customer experience.
* The role defines the control and governance framework and expectations, provides effective oversight and constructive challenge, and confirms adherence through monitoring and testing, assurance activity, and maintaining audit readiness.

**In This Role, You Will**

* Maintain and monitor ET policies, , the global risk-and-control framework, and clear RACI (Responsible, Accountable, Consulted, Informed) ownership across teams, markets and vendors.
* Lead the ET monthly Risk Management Meeting and advise leadership on complex governance, risk and control matters.
* Ensure adherence to global and local controls, internal policies, entity-level controls, labor laws, compliance requirements and audit actions.
* Coordinate internal and external audit readiness, requests and responses with Internal Audit, HR Risk, SOX (Sarbanes–Oxley Act) , FCC (Financial Crime Compliance) and other stakeholders.
* Establish governance for contingent workers, including engagement channels, labor-law requirements, third-party worker risks and claims.
* Ensure compliance with data privacy, data protection and cross-border transfer requirements, including Data Visas and IGSAs.
* Maintain the ET Business Continuity Plan and oversee annual Risk and Control Assessments aligned with the Operational Risk Management Framework.
* Conduct quality assurance and control monitoring, report effectiveness and issues, investigate root causes, and drive remediation.
* Govern ET suppliers, including service reviews, SLAs (Service Level Agreement), assurance, renewals, RFPs (Request for Proposal), contract changes, cost, performance and supplier-risk escalation.
* Promote fair customer treatment and Group Values while reassessing operational, regulatory, technology and compliance risks and maintaining effective internal controls.

**To Be Successful You Will**

* 12-20 yrs of experience in global risk, controls and compliance leadership: Proven experience leading risk, controls and compliance for Talent Acquisition/Talent Management—or comparable People processes—across multiple countries or regions in a regulated environment, including defining and maintaining a global risk and control framework.
* Governance design and policy adherence: Strong track record of designing and embedding governance and approval controls, including senior committee or forums, while ensuring compliance with internal policies, standards and AB&C expectations.
* Control monitoring, assurance and MI (Market Intelligence) : Experience running periodic control monitoring, testing and assurance activities; producing clear management information for senior leadership; and using insights to reduce exceptions and improve control effectiveness.
* Issue investigation and remediation: Proven ability to investigate control breaches and process divergence, conduct root-cause analysis, assess and quantify impact, and drive remediation to closure through named owners, agreed timelines and sustainable fixes.
* Audit readiness and delivery: Evidence of maintaining audit-ready documentation and evidence packs, coordinating audit requests and responses, and managing audit findings through to closure within agreed timelines.
* Data privacy and sensitive-data handling: Demonstrated working knowledge of data privacy and data-protection requirements, with practical experience applying them to hiring and talent processes, associated data flows and relevant cross-border considerations.
* Senior stakeholder influence and conflict resolution: Proven ability to partner with and influence senior stakeholders and key control functions, including People Business Risk/ ER (Employee Relations), Legal and Market Operations, while resolving tensions between delivery pace, local requirements and global standards.
* Executive communication and vendor governance: Ability to produce decision-ready updates for senior audiences, including escalation triggers, options analysis and recommendations, alongside experience governing a multi-vendor ecosystem through clear performance metrics, service governance and continuous improvement.
* Commercial, procurement and benefits realization: Track record of partnering with Procurement on supplier selection and contracting, including RFP inputs, evaluation criteria and award recommendations, while delivering benefits such as cost reduction, leakage reduction, supplier rationalization and improved commercial compliance.
* MSP, contingent staffing and third-party risk governance: Experience managing MSP (Managed Service Provider) arrangements, including rate-card discipline, and controlling the full contingent-worker lifecycle—onboarding, extensions and tenure governance, compliance checks and clean offboarding—together with completing TPEM (Third Party Engagement Management) activities, identifying control gaps, driving mitigations and escalating material supplier risks appropriately

title: Principal Officer
description:
**Who We Are.**
Axi is a leading global provider of margin and deliverable Foreign Exchange, Contracts for Difference (CFDs), and Financial Spread betting. Our business has evolved into a world-class, multifaceted brokerage with offices in six regions. With heavy investment in the latest trading technology, Axi seeks to offer the most comprehensive end-to-end trading experience available, servicing traders of all levels from beginners to institutional-level clients.
  
  
**Let's talk about the cool stuff you will do at Axi!**
As the Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) / Principal Officer (PO) for our Trading Platform, you will be responsible for filing STRs with the FIU-IND (Financial Intelligence Unit - India) which is a part of the Finance Ministry. You will be the single point of contact for all KYC - AML/CFT matters. You will also be ensuring that the business is compliant to all applicable local /international AML-CFT regulations and identifying Money Laundering (ML) risks.

* Ensure that our product and business is compliant with local and international KYC norms/laws.
* File STRs with FIU-IND in an error-free and timely manner.

* Develop a sanction screening framework for the organisation.
* Own the KYC and Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) pod to ensure that all onboarded customers are compliant, and the product is efficient to capture any ML risks.
* Work closely with the Product team to ensure that sufficient ML risk engines are built that will detect fraudulent transactions.
* Liaise with Law Enforcement Agencies (LEA) to ensure resolution of any KYC related issues identified.

* Be the owner for various internal KYC-EDD and other compliance SOPs

**Are you the one?**

* 10+ years of experience preferably in the financial services or trading or fintech industry.
* Worked as an Principal Officer for at least 2-3 years.
* Experience in fintech/ digital / start-ups / other high growth set-ups will be valued.
* Deep understanding of compliance and risk.
* Worked with multiple teams thereby demonstrating strong collaborative traits with focus on problem solving.
* Keen to understand various concepts in Web3 like tokenization, custody, Travel Rule, etc.

* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* Bachelor’s degree from one of the premier colleges in India. Post-graduation is a plus.

* Competitive and attractive compensation.

**About The Role**
The Cyber Security Governance & Assurance Specialist executes a range of workstreams in delivering contributions to the BT Group's overall cyber security risk management program, which is designed to ensure that the BT Group's technology systems and data are adequately protected.

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

title: Legal Officer
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – LEGAL OFFICER

**Designation:** Legal Officer  
**Department:** Legal and Administration  
**Reports To:** Management  
**Industry:** Higher Education / Educational Institution

1. Job Objective

To protect the institution's legal interests by providing legal advice, handling legal documentation, managing litigation, coordinating court proceedings, and ensuring compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

2. Key Roles and Responsibilities

**A. Legal Advisory and Representation**

* Provide legal advice to management on institutional matters, disputes, and potential legal risks.
* Represent the institution before courts, tribunals, and other legal authorities, subject to applicable professional requirements and authorisation.
* Handle civil, criminal, contractual, employment-related, and other legal matters involving the institution.
* Coordinate with external advocates and senior counsel whenever required.
* Prepare case briefs, legal opinions, and recommendations for management.

**B. Litigation and Court Proceedings**

* Handle legal cases filed by or against the institution.
* Draft and review petitions, affidavits, counter-statements, written submissions, and other legal pleadings.
* Monitor court cases, hearing dates, filing deadlines, and case progress.
* Coordinate with concerned departments to collect evidence, records, and supporting documents.
* Keep management informed about case developments and recommended legal action.

**C. Legal Notices and Documentation**

* Draft, issue, review, and respond to legal notices.
* Prepare replies to notices, complaints, claims, and legal communications.
* Draft and vet contracts, agreements, Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs), lease deeds, service agreements, and other legal documents.
* Review appointment letters, employment contracts, disciplinary notices, and termination-related documentation.
* Maintain confidential records of legal cases, notices, agreements, and court orders.

**D. Educational Institution Legal Matters**

* Handle legal matters relating to students, parents, faculty, employees, vendors, and other stakeholders.
* Advise management on student disciplinary cases, complaints, and institutional disputes.
* Provide legal support in matters relating to university affiliation, regulatory approvals, accreditation, and institutional administration.
* Handle disputes concerning admissions, fees, examinations, employment, and institutional policies.
* Review institutional rules, policies, declarations, and undertakings from a legal perspective.

**E. Labour Law and Employment Matters**

* Advise HR on employment-related legal issues, disciplinary proceedings, employee grievances, and termination matters.
* Handle employment disputes and coordinate legal proceedings involving employees.
* Provide guidance on applicable labour laws and statutory obligations.
* Assist in handling POSH-related legal matters and other workplace compliance issues, maintaining confidentiality and following applicable procedures.

**F. Property and Contractual Disputes**

* Handle legal matters relating to institutional property, leases, rentals, and ownership documentation.
* Review and advise on contractual disputes involving vendors, contractors, service providers, and other parties.
* Support management in dispute resolution, settlement negotiations, and recovery proceedings where appropriate.

**G. Compliance and Legal Risk Management**

* Monitor changes in applicable laws affecting educational institutions.
* Identify legal risks and recommend appropriate preventive measures.
* Ensure that legal notices, court orders, statutory deadlines, and compliance requirements are addressed within the prescribed timelines.
* Maintain a centralised record of ongoing litigation, legal opinions, contracts, and pending legal actions.
* Submit periodic reports to management on legal cases, risks, and important developments.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)Sl. No.Key Result AreaKey Performance Indicators1Litigation ManagementTimely preparation, filing, and follow-up of legal cases and court proceedings.2Legal AdvisoryTimely and accurate legal opinions and recommendations to management.3Legal Notices and DraftingAccurate preparation and timely response to legal notices and pleadings.4Contract ManagementTimely review and vetting of agreements and contracts.5Employment and Institutional DisputesEffective handling and follow-up of employee, student, and other institutional disputes.6Legal ComplianceTimely identification and communication of applicable legal obligations and deadlines.7Documentation and ReportingAccurate maintenance of legal records and timely submission of case-status reports.8Risk ManagementIdentification of legal risks and recommendations to minimise institutional exposure.4. Educational Qualification

* LL.B. from a recognised university.
* Enrolment with the relevant State Bar Council, as applicable to the role.
* Additional qualifications in civil law, corporate law, labour law, or litigation will be an advantage.

5. Experience

* Preferably 3–5 years of experience in legal practice or litigation.
* Experience handling court cases, drafting legal pleadings, issuing legal notices, and advising organisations.
* Experience in educational institutions or handling university, employment, and institutional disputes will be preferred.

6. Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of legal procedures and applicable laws.
* Excellent legal drafting, research, and case-management skills.
* Court appearance and litigation-handling experience.
* Strong negotiation, communication, and analytical skills.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive matters professionally.
* High integrity, sound judgement, and attention to detail.

7. Reporting and Coordination

The Legal Officer will report to Management and coordinate with HR, Administration, Finance, Academic Departments, external advocates, courts, tribunals, and other relevant authorities.

8. Expected Outcomes

* Effective protection of the institution's legal interests.
* Timely handling of litigation, legal notices, and disputes.
* Accurate legal documentation and contract management.
* Reduced legal and compliance risks.
* Timely legal guidance to management and other departments.

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person

description:
At U.S. Bancorp India, we’re on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Job description:**

* A professional in this role manages post-charge-off accounts through the litigation process, including account documentation, attorney vendor oversight, legal workflow monitoring, judgment activity, settlements, and recalls. The position requires handling sensitive account conditions such as bankruptcy, military status, fraud, complaints, etc., while ensuring compliance with legal, regulatory, and internal policy requirements.
* This role also coordinates with internal teams and external vendors, maintains accurate records, supports quality control, and escalates issues as needed. Strong attention to detail, excellent Microsoft suite skills, ability to complete complex tasks with minimal oversight and critical thinking skills.
* Performs a variety of document processing and record keeping tasks associated with customer accounts that require a thorough knowledge of products and services in the assigned area.
* Duties may include entering new account information; changing information on existing accounts; recording transactions; answering customer inquiries; receiving, classifying, consolidating and summarizing documents and information; completing reports and providing administrative support. Responsibilities may also include customer service duties such as answering customer inquiries, resolving customer problems and responding to customer requests for information.

**Role Responsibilities:**

* Identifying Accounts for Legal Placement - Accounts are systemically reviewed for litigation eligibility using criteria maintained by the Technology Reporting and Analytics (TR&A) Team. Exclusion criteria include bankruptcy, SCRA (Servicemembers Civil Relief Act), statute of limitations, consumer disputes, fraud, and other flagged issues.
* Right to Cure - Certain states (IA, KS, WI, SC, ME, MO, NE) require a Right to Cure (RTC) letter before litigation can proceed. RTC requirements do not apply to Small Business accounts.
* Account Review Process - Legal Designees manually review accounts flagged as litigation eligible (L01) in the Computer Assisted Collections System (CACS). Accounts not meeting criteria are removed from legal consideration; those meeting criteria are assigned for litigation.
* Attorney Vendor Placement - Eligible accounts are sent to Attorney Vendors, who receive required documentation (statements, agreements, applications). Vendors are responsible for collection efforts and legal actions.
* Legal Process - Vendors attempt collection before litigation (Initial Demand Letter, 30 days). If unresolved, lawsuits are filed, affidavits prepared, and court actions are pursued. Judgments are entered, and post-judgment remedies (garnishments, voluntary payments, liens) are applied. The team members monitor, and validates accuracy, key milestones and/or legal documents. Special handling for bankruptcy, SCRA, complaints, credit bureau disputes, fraud, cease and desist, and deceased account holders.
* Settlements & Recalls - Settlements can occur pre-litigation, during litigation, or post-judgment. Accounts may be recalled from Attorney Vendors for various reasons (strategy, bankruptcy, death, settlement, payment in full).
* Payment Processing - Payments are reconciled between U.S. Bank and Attorney Vendors monthly.

**Special Handling Accounts:**

* Bankruptcy: Accounts are recalled and handled according to bankruptcy rules.
* SCRA: Active-duty military accounts are placed on hold; litigation is paused or dismissed.
* Complaints & Disputes: Accounts are placed on hold and investigated; litigation may be recalled if complaints have merit.
* Fraud: Accounts are placed on hold during investigation; litigation resumes or is recalled based on findings.
* Cease and Desist: Accounts are coded and handled according to legal requirements.
* Deceased: Litigation is dismissed if all account holders are deceased; continues against surviving holders on joint accounts.

**Competencies:**

* Litigation Eligibility Assessment
* Regulatory Compliance
* Critical Thinking and Judgment
* Attention to Detail
* Risk Identification and Mitigation
* Account Analysis
* Decision Documentation
* Quality Assurance and Control Execution
* Complex Case Escalation
* Accountability and Independent Execution

Skills:
  
  

* Litigation eligibility review
* Delinquent and charged-off account analysis
* Regulatory and policy compliance
* Critical thinking and sound judgment
* Risk identification and mitigation
* Detailed documentation and recordkeeping
* Quality assurance and control validation
* Complex case escalation and resolution
* Microsoft 365 proficiency

Qualifications:
  
  
Basic Qualifications - High school diploma or equivalent - Typically four or more years of clerical and customer service experience Preferred Skills/Experience - Thorough knowledge of products, services, terminology, procedures and systems related to assigned area - Strong customer service skills - Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously while maintaining a high level of customer service - Ability to independently identify and resolve complex problems - Proficient computer navigation skills using a variety of software packages including Microsoft Office applications - Effective verbal and written communication skills
  
  
Years of experience – 4+ relevant years

title: Senior Risk Manager, INFORM Act, Account Compliance Risk
description:
**Description**
We are looking for an experienced compliance professional to join the Account Compliance Risk & Quality (ACRQ) team within Amazon's 1st Line of Defence, providing dedicated, independent risk oversight of the INFORM Consumers Act program. The INFORM Act requires online marketplaces to collect, verify, and disclose information about high-volume third-party sellers to protect consumers from fraud and illicit goods.
  
  
Sitting within Account Compliance Risk, the role operates independently from the teams responsible for day-to-day execution of INFORM requirements and controls. You will provide senior-level regulatory risk judgement and an independent view of compliance and risk exposure to senior leadership and governance forums. You are the person who sees the full picture across Legal, Technology, Program, and Operations, connects the dots across workstreams, and raises red flags when the program's risk posture is trending in the wrong direction. The team is actively building AI-powered risk assessment tools and automated monitoring frameworks, and you will be expected to engage with and help shape how these capabilities are applied to oversight work.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own and maintain the INFORM Obligation Register and Compliance Requirements Document (CRD), ensuring all regulatory requirements are mapped, current, traceable to controls, and translated into actionable compliance requirements for programme teams.
* Provide independent, evidence-based assessment of the end-to-end INFORM risk and control environment, covering seller identification, verification, certification, disclosure, enforcement, and reporting. Review and challenge control design and operating effectiveness using monitoring results, operational metrics, incidents, and complaints.
* Identify emerging risks, systemic weaknesses, and concentrations of regulatory exposure. Lead regulatory horizon scanning, translate changes into impacts for the control environment, and maintain risk appetite thresholds and escalation mechanisms in partnership with Legal.
* Produce clear, decision-oriented risk reporting for senior leadership and governance forums covering current exposure, control effectiveness, issue health, and direction of travel. Support regulatory enquiries and examinations where required.
* Drive continuous improvement of the oversight framework through data and automation, manage dependencies with adjacent domains such as KYC, seller experience, and data privacy, and hold programme teams accountable for timely remediation through structured escalation.

A day in the life
  
  
Your morning starts with a question you return to every day: does the compliance picture people believe match the evidence underneath it? Before the US comes online, you use the quiet hours to look past the dashboards, not to read the green, but to test whether it is real or whether a control is quietly drifting behind a reassuring number.
  
  
Mid-morning you are building the oversight framework itself, defining how obligations map to controls, how risk is assessed and calibrated, and how a signal travels from a monitoring exception to a decision in front of leadership. After lunch the work turns live. You join Program, Technology, and Legal partners across time zones, often as the only person on the call holding the regulatory-risk lens, and you challenge whether a change lands cleanly against an INFORM obligation before it ships.
  
  
**About The Team**
The ACRQ team provides independent risk oversight of some of Amazon's most significant regulatory compliance programs. We are a small, senior team operating across multiple entities, jurisdictions, and regulatory regimes, working closely with Legal, second line of defence, programme teams, and senior leadership. Over the past year we have invested heavily in AI-powered risk assessment and automated monitoring, and that investment is accelerating.
  
  
This role is a genuine springboard. The combination of regulatory expertise, independent oversight, and senior stakeholder engagement prepares you for compliance leadership or broader risk positions. The INFORM space is still evolving, so you will have the opportunity to shape the framework rather than inherit a settled one. If you want to do work that matters at a global scale and grow while doing it, we would love to hear from you.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 6+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience within financial services and payment institutions
* Experience managing multiple competing priorities simultaneously and driving goals to completion

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
* Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent
* Master's degree or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:

Vidlexinfo LLC is a growing business consulting and staffing company focused on building effective, long-term partnerships with clients. Job Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced
**US Immigration Executive**
with 3-5 years to manage end-to-end employment-based immigration processes for our organization. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience handling various work visa categories, PERM labor certification, I-140 petitions, Requests for Evidence (RFEs), Labor Condition Applications (LCAs), prevailing wage requirements, occupation code classifications, and complete immigration documentation. This role requires strong organizational skills, a thorough understanding of U.S. immigration regulations, and the ability to coordinate effectively with attorneys, employees, HR, recruiters, and government agencies.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage the complete lifecycle of employment-based immigration cases from initiation through approval.
* Coordinate and process work visa petitions, including H-1B, H-1B Transfers, H-1B Amendments, H-1B Extensions, and other employment-based visa categories.
* Handle end-to-end PERM Labor Certification processes, including document collection, recruitment coordination, audit file maintenance, and filing support.
* Prepare and coordinate I-140 Immigrant Petitions, ensuring accuracy and timely submission of supporting documentation.
* Draft, review, and submit Labor Condition Applications (LCAs) while ensuring compliance with Department of Labor regulations.
* Interpret Prevailing Wage Determinations (PWDs), wage levels, and Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) codes for appropriate job classifications.
* Coordinate with immigration attorneys on case preparation, filing strategies, and legal documentation.
* Manage and respond to Requests for Evidence (RFEs), Notices of Intent to Deny (NOIDs), and audit requests by gathering supporting documentation and preparing response packages.
* Maintain accurate immigration records, employee files, case trackers, and compliance documentation.
* Ensure adherence to USCIS, Department of Labor (DOL), and Department of State immigration regulations and filing deadlines.
* Track case progress and provide regular status updates to employees, hiring managers, HR, and leadership.
* Review immigration documents for completeness, accuracy, and compliance before submission.
* Support employees throughout the immigration process by answering questions and providing timely guidance.
* Assist with public access file (PAF) preparation and maintenance for H-1B compliance.
* Monitor changes in U.S. immigration laws, policies, and procedures and recommend process improvements.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Legal Studies, or a related field.
* 3-5 years of experience managing employment-based U.S. immigration cases.
* Strong understanding of USCIS, Department of Labor (DOL), and employment-based immigration regulations.
* Experience handling PERM Labor Certification, I-140 petitions, and employment-based visa processing.
* Hands-on experience drafting LCAs and working with Prevailing Wage Determinations and wage levels.
* Knowledge of SOC occupation codes and job classification requirements.
* Experience preparing documentation for RFEs, audits, and other immigration-related requests.
* Familiarity with immigration case management systems and document management tools.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, and Outlook.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience working with immigration attorneys or corporate immigration teams.
* Experience with immigration compliance reporting and internal audits.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while managing strict deadlines.
* Familiarity with E-Verify, I-9 compliance, and employment eligibility verification processes.

Key Skills

* Employment-Based Immigration
* H-1B Visa Processing
* PERM Labor Certification
* I-140 Petitions
* Labor Condition Applications (LCA)
* Prevailing Wage Determinations (PWD)
* Wage Level Analysis
* SOC Occupation Codes
* USCIS Compliance
* Department of Labor (DOL) Regulations
* RFE & NOID Response Management
* Immigration Documentation
* Case Management
* Process Improvement
* Time Management
* Communication & Documentation

title: FAAS - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS – Assurance FAAS – Manager – Control & Compliance**
**The opportunity**
Financial Accounting Advisory Services (FAAS) professionals provides advisory services including Accounting and regulatory support for accounting change and special matters; accounting processes and controls support. We are looking for a professional to join EY FAAS, having expertise across the FAAS solutions and specifically for engagements related to Process and Control, Process compliance and reviews, SOX and, Developing Standard Operating Procedure manuals, Enterprise Risk Management & Payment application.
  
  
FAAS is a dynamic group of people focused on helping our clients solving tomorrow’s problems today through integrated solution service offerings in the area of risk, such as internal control assessment, risk management and financial controls. Risk continues to move up the agenda and our team work with many of today's front-running companies. Our clients want integrated, strategic, tech-enabled, end-to-end solutions and we deliver tailored risk offerings putting client value and relationships at the core of what we do. You can expect to work with senior client personnel and drive high quality work products.
  
  
Our Risk team consists of talented colleagues who invite you to bring your natural curiosity and innovative thoughts to work each day. Working within our team, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. We offer excellent career development, diverse opportunities and fantastic work life balance including hybrid working. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated manager to join our dynamic Control & Compliance team. The ideal candidate will bring technical expertise in risk management, internal control assessment and implementation of internal control framework. In this role, you will lead the delivery of high-quality outcomes across a portfolio of clients in the internal audit and internal controls space. You will manage multiple engagement teams and stakeholders, both internally and externally, taking full ownership of projects and relationships. Your focus will be on delivering impactful results, on time, within budget and in line with EY’s quality and risk management practices. Key responsibilities include:
  
  

* Client Delivery and Project Management: Lead and manage multiple client engagements. Oversee planning, fieldwork and reporting of findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders. Ensuring high-quality deliverables, on time within budget.
* Technical Expertise: Act as a key trusted advisor in discussing complex regulations with clients, including UK Corporate Reform, US Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance, Global Internal Audit Standards and other industry-specific regulatory compliance requirements.
* Quality and Risk Management: Ensure compliance with EY’s quality and risk management processes across client acceptance, contracting and engagement delivery. Proactively identify and manage risks across engagements, escalating issues where appropriate.
* Stakeholder Management: Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and proactively manage client expectations to ensure alignment on project goals, timelines and deliverables. Collaborate cross-functionally with other EY service lines and subject matter experts to deliver high quality insights. Collaborate with internal leader/s, provide regular updates on engagement progress and support internal decision-making through clear communication and proactive escalation and the ability to flex communication styles.
* Team Leadership and Development: Mentor and coach junior team members through effective supervision to develop their technical and professional skills. Support career development through performance reviews and providing timely, regular and actionable feedback. You will contribute to a positive team environment by demonstrating consistent commitment and optimism toward work challenges.
* Business Development: Build the EY brand through high quality delivery. Support in the identification of new opportunities and development of proposals. Build EY’s market presence through contribution to thought leadership and client events.
* Promoting EY’s values: Champion EY’s commitments to integrity, respect and teaming in all client and internal interactions. Foster an inclusive and diverse working environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.
* Practice development: contribute to practice development and internal initiatives such as learning and development programmes and solution development.

**Skills And Experience**

* You will be a trusted manager with proven technical expertise in risk, control and compliance that will complement our teams in delivering high-quality solutions to our clients. Your skills and experience will include:
* Control & Compliance experience: Proven and relevant professional experience across core process and controls solutions (e.g. internal audit, SOX and internal controls) in consulting, government or industry. Extensive experience in process mapping, walkthroughs, risk analysis (strategic, financial, operational and compliance) and control identification and design assessment. The ability to act as a trusted advisor to clients on risk and control issues, such as controls remediation or Enterprise Risk Management.
* Technical skills and knowledge: In depth understanding of core business processes, associated risks, and leading practice controls. Strong leadership and communication skills, technical knowledge, and the ability to write at a publication quality level in order to communicate findings and recommendations to clients. Strong business acumen, including the ability to compile information quickly and accurately, and to test data and assumptions for informed decision-making.
* Engagement management: Track record demonstrating success in leading high-performing teams, mentor junior staff and foster a culture of continuous learning. Experienced in managing complex project and multiple stakeholder groups including senior clients and internal leadership. Demonstrated ability to balance project management and delivery skills across a range of clients, including financial management, quality, and risk management requirements.
* Communication and interpersonal skills: Strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and build trust at all levels. Being an active listener, having self-awareness when dealing with others, and adapting your own approach to differences in individual style and backgrounds, recognising the risk of unconscious biases.
* Client delivery: Demonstrated success in delivering high-quality, client-focused solutions on time and within budget with a commitment to going above and beyond for clients.
* Commercial acumen: Commercially aware, with a track record of developing relevant propositions and sales collateral and supporting business development efforts.
* Technology and innovation: Proficient in leveraging technology such as data analytics, automation, and AI in project delivery. Experience with data visualisation tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and core business systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle). Proficient across the Microsoft Office suite (e.g. PowerPoint, Excel and Word). Ability to develop dashboards across key data visualization tools and produce visual reports to track key risks and control metrics, noted as desirable but not essential.
* Professional attributes: Self-stater with a proactive mindset, natural curiosity and commitment to delivering excellence for our clients. Ability to work in areas of uncertainty and navigate ambiguous situations, adaptable and inclusive, with strong self-awareness and the ability to work effectively across diverse teams. Up to date with industry trends, emerging risks, and the UK regulatory landscape. Adaptability and the ability to work effectively across diverse teams.
* Other desirable skills and experience: Professional experience, skills and knowledge in the following areas is desirable but not essential; finance transformation, controls automation, programme assurance, IT control including analysing core systems (e.g., SAP and Oracle) to identify control weaknesses

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Significant managerial and professional experience in risk, process and controls services in a consulting, industry or public sector setting.
* Chartered Accountant (CA), CPA (US), ACCA (UK) or MBA with 5-10 years of experience with a large global corporate Process, Risk and Control and/or similar experience
* Experience on the following Process and Control / SOX areas:

+ Governance, controls and regulation
+ Governance, Risk & Compliance
+ Process and Control
+ Process reviews
+ Standard Operating Procedures
+ Enterprise Risk Management
+ Revenue Assurance
+ SOX
+ Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR)
+ Design and Implementation testing
+ Process walkthroughs and testing effectiveness of controls

* Strong problem solving and analytical skills
* Strong sales, presentation and client management skills
* Strong training and mentoring skills
* Ability to manage a team and to establish credibility as a trusted advisor with clients
* Effective written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to present complex information in a concise and clear manner
* Strong executive presence and ability to interface with all levels of management (EY and clients)
* Strong project management and organizational experience
* Willingness and ability to travel approximately 50% to 80% of the time

**What we look for:**

* We are interested to hear from entrepreneurial people who feed on the energy of a thriving global team. We seek a high level of drive, commitment to achieving solutions, and ability to work under pressure. We need people worthy of trust, who demonstrate enthusiasm, passion to grow fast and are highly motivated to support this purpose.
* We invite applications from all cultures, backgrounds and experiences and are proud of our culture where people from all walks of life can grow and thrive. If you want to know more about our people and our culture, search #EyCulture on LinkedIn.

**What we offer:**
EY is committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance.
  
  
We offer a competitive remuneration package. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next, including having the opportunity to gain an EY Tech MBA which is an accredited MBA program offered to all EY professionals globally
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

The role partners with AI agents in a human-in-the-loop model, using AI-assisted workflows to accelerate evidence gathering, risk documentation, and control narratives while validating outputs for accuracy.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Technology Risk Assessments
  
  

* Lead or support technology risk assessments to identify, assess, and manage risks, including effective data-driven reporting and tracking of risk reduction activities.
* Execute risk assessments across SOX ITGCs, SOC 1, SOC 2, PCI DSS and NYDFS control expectations.
* Plan and conduct risk assessments to identify, quantify, and prioritize technology risks.
* Translate assessment outputs into actionable treatment plans, control improvements, and executive risk narratives.

Advisory Services
  
  

* Provide cross-functional risk and control guidance on process improvement, post-implementation reviews, and remediation activities.
* Support stakeholders in interpreting requirements and embedding controls into business processes.

Risk Register
  
  

* Maintain Risk Register entries across assigned technology domains, ensuring risks are documented, owned, risk-rated, and tracked through closure.

Policy Governance
  
  

* Support policy authoring, review cadence, and exception intake, keeping policies aligned to regulatory and industry frameworks.

AI-Augmented Delivery
  
  

* Use AI-assisted workflows (human-in-the-loop) to accelerate evidence collection, risk documentation, and control narratives, validating AI output for accuracy and confidentiality.

Control Testing & Evidence
  
  

* Perform control testing and evidence collection for SOC 2, PCI DSS, and SOX ITGC programs, mapping findings to applicable framework requirements.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* Minimum 4+ years in GRC, technology risk, IT audit, or compliance.
* Solid working knowledge of risk registers, policy governance, and advisory support within a regulated or SaaS environment.
* Working proficiency with AI-assisted tools to draft and review risk and control content, with judgment on when to validate.
* Familiarity with NIST CSF 2.0, COBIT 2019, COSO ERM, and ISO 31000.
* Strong written communication and attention to detail.
* Relevant certifications preferred (e.g., CRISC, CISA, or progress toward them).
* Working experience with GRC tooling (e.g., ServiceNow IRM, AuditBoard, OneTrust, Vanta, Drata) and control testing/evidence collection.
* Familiarity with cloud/hybrid environments (AWS, Azure) and major frameworks (SOC 2, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, NIST CSF 2.0).
* Preferred experience in the Property Management, Multifamily Housing, SaaS, FinTech, or PropTech industries.

title: Legal Counsel, Client Coverage, CCIB
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**

* Develop and maintain a strong understanding of the Bank's business strategy, operating environment and strategic priorities, and contribute to the delivery of the objectives of both the Legal and Business teams. Partner with stakeholders on key strategic initiatives, including the development of new products, services and processes, and the ongoing enhancement of existing business frameworks. Provide strategic, commercially focused legal advice to enable business growth while ensuring robust governance and proactive identification, assessment and management of legal risks arising from the Bank's activities in India.

**Business**

* Provide timely, practical and commercially focused legal support to the CIB and TB businesses in India, facilitating the achievement of business objectives within the Bank's risk appetite, legal and regulatory framework.
* Collaborate with colleagues across the Legal function and other control functions to deliver effective solutions on complex legal, regulatory and business matters impacting the Bank's operations in India.
* Support the adaptation and implementation of global products, initiatives and documentation in India, ensuring consistency with Group standards while addressing local legal and regulatory requirements.
* Work closely with Product, Business, Compliance, Operations, Documentation and other stakeholders to facilitate the launch of new products, processes and initiatives, and the enhancement of existing offerings.

**Processes**

* Ascertain that the local documents are aligned with the global documents and processes.
* Identify gaps in legal processes and documentation, and initiate review or remediation as required to address such gaps.
* Establish, maintain and continuously enhance legal processes and documentation standards to support efficient and consistent delivery of legal services to the business.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to streamline processes, simplify documentation and improve client and business outcomes while maintaining appropriate legal and regulatory safeguards.

**People & Talent**

* Engagement with stakeholders for working towards ease of business and simplification of processes and documents.
* Collaborate with members of Legal teams across SCB network locations.

**Risk Management**

* Identify, assess and categorise legal risks arising from products, transactions, documentation and business initiatives, ensuring that such risks are appropriately evaluated and managed.
* Determine matters requiring approvals, waivers or escalations under applicable policies and governance frameworks, and ensure that legal risks are promptly highlighted to relevant stakeholders and committees.
* Provide legal guidance to support informed decision-making, balancing commercial objectives with the Bank’s legal, regulatory and reputational risk considerations.

**Governance**

* Ensure compliance of documentation with applicable laws, regulations and Group governance standards.
* Conduct periodic reviews of product governance documents.

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key stakeholders**
**Internal**

* Legal
* Business
* Product specialists
* Compliance
* Audit, Risk and Credit
* Documentation Units
* Operations

**External**

* Law firms (local as well as international)
* External auditors
* Peers in other Banks and Financial Institutions
* Regulators

**Other Responsibilities**

* Support for strategic and cross border legal and business initiatives across the SCB franchise.

**Skills And Experience**

* Legal landscape
* Regulatory Framework
* Business model

**Qualifications**

* LL. B. (Bachelor of Laws)
* A minimum 7– 8 years of experience in banking and finance, gained in private practice and/or an in-house legal function.

**About Standard Chartered**
We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
  
  
Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
  
  
**Together We**

* Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
* Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

**What We Offer**
**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,**
we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  
  

* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

title: Legal Associate, Country Legal - India
description:
*Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure? If so, CIP Fund Solutions is looking for Legal Associate to join our office in Mumbai, India*
**Team**
You will join the India legal team, led by the Legal Counsel and made up of 3–4 lawyers. The team provides integrated legal support across CIP’s Indian renewable energy portfolio, covering project contracts, financing, JV and shareholder matters, real estate and regulatory work, and corporate governance. It works closely with the investment, debt finance, commercial and finance teams, and with external counsel, and collaborates with CIP colleagues in Europe, the Americas and Asia-Pacific.
  
  
Role
  
  
Reporting to the Legal Counsel, you will provide practical legal support to CIP and the CIP-managed funds’ renewable energy portfolio in India. You will take ownership of workstreams with a reasonable degree of independence. You will be a first point of contact for the India business teams and a trusted collaborator for our global legal, investment and finance colleagues across Europe, the Americas and Asia-Pacific. The workload varies, so flexibility is expected from both sides, particularly for calls with colleagues in Europe, the Americas and Asia-Pacific. We will support your learning and development, and you will have room to help build the function as the team grows. This is a full-time, office-based position at our Mumbai office in BKC, working closely with the India team and collaborating with colleagues across time zones.
  
  
**Responsibilities will consist of, but are not limited to:**

* Draft, negotiate and manage EPC, O&M, supply and other construction and operations contracts for wind, solar and storage projects.
* Support project financing and project development, including reviewing financing, security creation and perfection documents, and coordinating legal opinions and conditions precedent with external counsel.
* Handle general commercial contracts, including power purchase agreements, lease and land agreements, and other project agreements.
* Support JV management, including reviewing and administering shareholders’ and JV agreements.
* Support the projects team on regulatory approvals, permits and real estate matters, including title searches and land diligence, managing disputes and regulatory issues, and coordinating with local counsel.
* Manage litigation and disputes (where they arise) in coordination with external counsel.
* Advise on India-specific company secretarial, Board and Executive Committee matters, insurance, and ethical and governance issues, and ensure compliance with internal CIP/CIP FS policies and procedures.
* Support operational legal matters for CIP, such as NDAs and engagement letters, and advise on HR and admin issues.
* Track regulatory and legislative developments in the Indian renewables sector and flag their impact to the business.

**You**
The ideal candidate will be a graduate of a reputed law school in India and qualified to practice law in India, with 3–4 years of post-qualification experience, including at least 2 years with a reputable law firm. Experience in energy, infrastructure, project finance, M& A, or real estate, with direct exposure to the renewable energy sector considered an advantage. The candidate should also have demonstrated experience in drafting and negotiating commercial contracts and managing transactions with limited supervision.
  
  
**We look for the following in a candidate:**

* Close attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
* Sound commercial judgement and the ability to give clear, practical advice to non-lawyers.
* Good organization and prioritization across multiple matters, with the ability to work with minimal supervision and take initiative.
* Ability to guide and mentor junior colleagues and to manage external counsel effectively.
* Interest in renewable energy assets and in regulatory changes and updates.
* Fluency in English, both spoken and written, with effective communication skills.
* Willingness to work in an international, busy and varied environment across time zones.

**The process**
Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.
  
  
As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.
  
  
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.
  
  
---
  
  
**CIP Fund Solutions’ commitment to diversity and inclusion**
CIP Fund Solutions is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.
  
  
A diverse workforce allows CIP Fund Solutions to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, or ethnicity.
  
  
**CIP Fund Solutions**
CIP FS’ purpose is to enable CIP’s ambition to scale rapidly over the coming strategy-period - supporting our colleagues with professional and efficient financial, legal, tax and business operations through the cycle from fund formation and capital raising, to deploying investments into construction of large-scale greenfield renewable energy assets, as well as M&A.
  
  
For more information, please visit CIP Fund Solutions.

Partner with business leaders to evaluate legal implications of strategic initiatives, new business opportunities, operational decisions, investments, and expansion plans.

Identify legal risks associated with business activities and recommend effective mitigation strategies that balance legal protection with business objectives.

Support senior management in decision-making by providing risk-based legal analysis and strategic recommendations.
